咱们掷硬币猜边儿决定吧。

deficit.en: The deficit had grown with the connivance of the banks.
deficit.zh: 在银行纵容下，赤字增加。

deficit.en: He promised to get to work on the state's massive deficit.
deficit.zh: 他承诺着手处理该国严重的赤字问题。

deficit.en: The trade balance has been in deficit for the past five years.
deficit.zh: 过去五年来贸易状况一直是逆差。

exception.en: There is one exception to this general principle.
exception.zh: 这个一般性原则有一例外。

exception.en: No one could possibly take exception to his comments.
exception.zh: 任何人都不可能对他的意见提出异议。

exception.en: Nobody had much money at the time and I was no exception.
exception.zh: 那时候谁都没有很多钱，我也不例外。

ally.en: He is a close ally of the president.
ally.zh: 他是总统的一位亲密盟友。

ally.en: He's stunned by today's resignation of his longtime ally.
ally.zh: 他被自己的长期助手今天的辞职所震惊。

ally.en: Besides, with Jonathan's wild game to contain with, I would really welcome an ally.
ally.zh: 此外，要对付乔纳森的疯狂游戏，我真的欢迎一个盟友。

confront.en: Once again, I chose to confront the issue head-on.
confront.zh: 又一次，我选择了直面这个问题。
我们必须乐观地面对未来。

reputation.zh: 他的名誉可说是白璧无瑕。

reputation.en: He was anxious to preserve his reputation.
reputation.zh: 他急于维护自己的名声。

glance.zh: 特雷弗和我相互瞥了一眼。

dimension.en: You will open a new dimension to your life.
dimension.zh: 你将为你的生活打开一个新的维度。

dimension.en: Loutherbourg, like other contemporary painters, wanted to add the dimension of time to his paintings.
dimension.zh: 像其他当代画家一样，卢德堡想要在他的绘画中加入时间这一维度。

dimension.en: The Vroom model emphasizes the participative dimension of leadership: how leaders go about making decisions.
dimension.zh: 弗鲁姆模型强调领导力的参与性维度：领导者如何进行决策。

personnel.zh: 她的第一份工作是在人事部。

personnel.en: I looked your address up in the personnel file.
personnel.zh: 我从人事档案里查到了你的地址。

immigration.en: He called for much stricter curbs on immigration.
immigration.zh: 他呼吁对移民实行更为严格的限制。

immigration.en: He was criticized for his tough stand on immigration.
immigration.zh: 他因在移民问题上立场强硬受到批评。

immigration.en: First, you have to go through immigration and customs.
immigration.zh: 首先你必须通过移民局和海关的检查。

peer.en: She gets on well with her peer group.
Teenagers may find it difficult to resist peer pressure.
peer.zh: 青少年可能觉得很难抗拒同龄人的压力。

peer.en: Climbing steep stairs to the choir gallery you peer into a cavernous interior.
peer.zh: 登上陡峭的楼梯来到唱诗班楼座，你便可窥见如洞穴般空旷的内部。

recognition.en: She gained only minimal recognition for her work.
recognition.zh: 她的工作仅仅得到极少的赞誉。

recognition.en: Her unusual talent gained her worldwide recognition.
recognition.zh: 她非凡的才能举世公认。

recognition.en: There is a general recognition of the urgent need for reform.
recognition.zh: 人们普遍认识到迫切需要改革。

implication.en: The implication was plain, if left unstated.
implication.zh: 即使不说出来，隐含义也很明显。

implication.en: Implication in a murder finally brought him to the gallows.
implication.zh: 与一桩谋杀案的牵连最终把他送上了绞刑架。

implication.en: They resent the implication that they have behaved irresponsibly.
implication.zh: 他们对那种暗示他们的行为不负责任的言论非常不满。

retirement.zh: 她早已超过了退休年龄。
他大大超过了退休年龄。

whisper.zh: 她低沉沙哑地轻声说话。

anxiety.zh: 她因焦虑而面露忧心之色。

anxiety.en: Anxiety can be caused by lack of sleep.
anxiety.zh: 睡眠不足可能导致焦虑。

phenomenon.zh: 该现象引起莫里思博士的兴趣。

phenomenon.en: Globalization is a phenomenon of the 21st century.
The causes of the phenomenon are still incompletely understood.
phenomenon.zh: 造成这种现象的原因尚未彻底弄清。

swing.en: I need to work on my swing.
swing.zh: 我需要改进我的挥杆动作。

swing.en: When he's not on the tennis court, you'll find him practising his golf swing.
swing.zh: 当他不在网球场时，你会发现他在练高尔夫挥杆动作。

swing.en: He took a wild swing at the ball.
swing.zh: 他对准球猛地挥拍一击。

literally.en: I literally jumped out of my skin.
Greenfly can literally suck a plant dry.
literally.zh: 蚜虫的确能把一株植物吸干。

literally.en: There are literally hundreds of prizes to win.
literally.zh: 真的有好几百份奖品可以领呀。

convention.en: The convention does not apply to us.
By convention the deputy leader was always a woman.
convention.zh: 按惯例，这一领导职务的副职总是由女性担任。

convention.en: The party hired her to stage-manage their convention.
convention.zh: 该党雇她精心策划他们的大会。

embrace.en: He held her in a warm embrace.
He opened his arms wide to embrace her.

pan.en: She cracked an egg into the pan.
pan.zh: 她往锅里打了一个鸡蛋。

pan.en: She put a pan of water on the stove.

mayor.zh: 市长揭开了宴会的序幕。

mayor.en: My uncle was the mayor of Memphis.
mayor.zh: 我叔叔是孟菲斯市市长。

mayor.en: He's a distant relative of the mayor.

consultant.en: She is a consultant to the government.
He is currently engaged as a consultant.
He was a consultant rheumatologist at the local hospital.
consultant.zh: 他是当地医院的一位风湿病学顾问。

administrator.en: He is well-intentioned but a poor administrator.
administrator.zh: 他用意良好，但却是位糟糕的管理者。

administrator.en: He's a local government administrator, that is to say a civil servant.
administrator.zh: 他是地方政府的行政官员，也就是公务员。

administrator.en: Our administrator is a paragon of neatness, efficiency, and reliability.
administrator.zh: 我们的管理者是整洁、高效、真实可信的杰出典范。

enterprise.en: Horse breeding is indeed a risky enterprise.
enterprise.zh: 养马的确是一项有风险的事业。

enterprise.en: State bureaucracies can tend to stifle enterprise and initiative.
enterprise.zh: 国家官僚体制会压抑人的进取心和积极性。

enterprise.en: Its geographical location stimulated overseas mercantile enterprise.
enterprise.zh: 它的地理位置激发了海外商业企业的兴趣。

bind.en: Take him home and bind his wounds.
bind.zh: 带他回家，包扎他的伤口。

bind.en: The miser said, "Bind me fast, bind me fast, for pity's sake."
bind.zh: 守财奴说：“快把我绑起来，快把我绑起来，可怜可怜我吧。”

bind.en: They can bring us freedom in our relationships or bind us to them.
bind.zh: 它们可以给我们带来关系上的自由，也可以把我们束缚在一起。

recipe.en: This recipe is foolproof—it works every time.
recipe.zh: 这个食谱绝对管用，每次都万无一失。

recipe.en: This recipe will be enough for four servings.

elementary.zh: 有文化现在包括基本的计算机技能。

elementary.en: A proton is an elementary particle of matter that possesses a positive charge.
elementary.zh: 质子是带正电荷的物质的基本粒子。

elementary.en: The move from elementary school to middle school or junior high can be difficult.
elementary.zh: 从小学进入中学或者初中的这种变动可能会有困难。

aggressive.en: Some children are much more aggressive than others.
aggressive.zh: 一些孩子比其他孩子好斗得多。

aggressive.en: We decided that in the game we would be physical and aggressive.
aggressive.zh: 我们决定，在比赛中我们将积极拼抢，大胆进攻。

protein.en: You need more protein to build you up.
protein.zh: 你需要更多蛋白质以增强体质。
极为精密的蛋白质纤维是能被看见的。

protein.en: The gene is activated by a specific protein.
protein.zh: 这种基因由一种特异性蛋白激活。

jail.zh: 他已从监狱里放出来了。

jail.en: A forty-foot-high concrete wall encircles the jail.
jail.zh: 一道40英尺高的水泥墙环绕着该监狱。

absence.zh: 没有人注意到他不在场。

absence.en: She did not mention her mother's absence.
absence.zh: 她没有提到她母亲的缺席。

absence.en: I can't think of any possible explanation for his absence.
absence.zh: 我想不出他缺席的任何理由。

diversity.en: Two of our greatest strengths are diversity and community.
diversity.zh: 我们的两个最大优点是多样性和团体精神。

diversity.en: There is a need for greater diversity and choice in education.
diversity.zh: 教育方面需要更加多元化和更大的选择性。

diversity.en: We have nothing against diversity; indeed, we want more of it.
diversity.zh: 我们并不反对多样化；其实，我们希望有更多的多样化。

historian.en: Historian Michael Beschloss debunks a few myths.
historian.zh: 历史学家迈克尔·贝斯切罗斯揭露了一些神话的真相。

historian.en: Although not formally trained as an art historian, he is widely respected for his knowledge of the period.
historian.zh: 虽然他不是科班出身的艺术史学家，但他对这一时期的知识却普遍为人尊重。

historian.en: She is a historian of military history.

respondent.en: One respondent to the survey believed that there is no true emotional bonding without touching and smelling a loved one.
respondent.zh: 一名调查对象认为，如果触摸不到爱人和闻不到爱人的气味，就没有真正的情感纽带。

respondent.en: "Artists help scientists reach a broader audience and make emotional connections that enhance learning," one respondent said.
respondent.zh: 一位受访者说：“艺术家帮助科学家开拓观众群体，并建立情感联系，从而改善学习效果。”
只有一位受访者表示乐观。

negotiate.en: Opposition grew and the government agreed to negotiate.
negotiate.zh: 反对势力日益强烈，政府同意进行谈判。

negotiate.en: Western governments have this week urged him to negotiate and avoid force.
negotiate.zh: 西方国家政府本周已敦促他进行谈判并且避免使用武力。

negotiate.en: The continued fighting threatens to undermine efforts to negotiate an agreement.
negotiate.zh: 持续的战斗有可能破坏通过谈判达成协议的努力。

substantial.zh: 他做了大量的慈善捐赠。

substantial.en: They are making substantial claims for improved working conditions.
substantial.zh: 他们就改善工作条件提出了实质性要求。
他吃了一顿丰盛的早餐。

restore.en: Troops were sent in to restore order.
The police are trying to restore public order.
restore.zh: 警察正在努力恢复公共秩序。

restore.en: We will restore her to health but it may take time.
restore.zh: 我们会让她恢复健康，但这或许需要时间。

biological.en: Many biological processes are controlled by hormones.
biological.zh: 许多生物变化过程都是由激素控制的。

biological.en: Darwin eventually put forward a model of biological evolution.
biological.zh: 达尔文最终提出了一套生物进化的理论模式。

biological.en: Biological systems have been doing this for billions of years.
biological.zh: 生物系统亿万年来都在这样做。

conventional.en: Biofuels can be mixed with conventional fuels.
conventional.zh: 生物燃料能够和传统燃料混合。

conventional.en: It's taken a long time to break out of my own conventional training.
conventional.zh: 摆脱我自己的传统训练花了很长一段时间。

conventional.en: He had a simple, conventional deal and paid 20 percent down at settlement.
conventional.zh: 他做了一笔简单而常规的交易，在结算时预付了20%的定金。

dealer.en: You are well advised to buy your car through a reputable dealer.
dealer.zh: 你通过一个声誉好的经销商来买车是明智的。

dealer.en: The dealer will provide you with a courtesy car while your vehicle is being repaired.
dealer.zh: 车辆维修期间，经销商会提供免费使用的汽车。
他是一个成功的汽车经销商。

deputy.zh: 她委任了谁为她的副手？

deputy.en: His brother was acting as his deputy in America.
deputy.zh: 他的兄弟充当他在美洲的代理人。

deputy.en: By convention the deputy leader was always a woman.
deputy.zh: 按惯例，这一领导职务的副职总是由女性担任。

utility.en: We can greatly enhance the utility of green space through designs that provide a range of different uses in a confined space.
utility.zh: 我们可以通过在有限的空间中提供多种不同用途的设计，大大提高绿色空间的实用性。

utility.en: The Conservatives plan to adopt this strategy by making utility companies print the average local electricity and gas usage on people's bills.
utility.zh: 保守党计划采用这一策略，让公用事业公司将当地的平均用电量和用气量印在人们的账单上。

utility.en: He used to own Toyota's Hilux Surf, a sport utility vehicle.
utility.zh: 他曾经拥有丰田的 Hilux Surf——一款运动型多用途车。

assure.en: She's perfectly safe, I can assure you.
assure.zh: 我可以向你保证，她绝对安全。

assure.en: Victory would assure a place in the finals.
assure.zh: 胜利将确保能参加决赛。

assure.en: Victory would assure them a place in the finals.
assure.zh: 胜利将确保他们能参加决赛。

clinical.en: The new drug is undergoing clinical trials.
clinical.zh: 这种新药正在进行临床试验。

clinical.en: They have been treated with this drug in clinical trials.
clinical.zh: 他们在临床试验中一直接受这种药物的治疗。

clinical.en: The first clinical trials were expected to begin next year.
clinical.zh: 第一批临床试验预计明年开始。

highway.zh: 安尼塔开车沿着太平洋公路向北行驶。
公路巡警关闭了这条路。

highway.en: I crossed the highway, dodging the traffic.
highway.zh: 我闪身避让着来往的车辆，穿过了公路。

precisely.en: Children come to zoos precisely to see captive animals.
precisely.zh: 孩子们到动物园来正是为了看那些被关起来的动物。

precisely.en: "All I did was write the truth."—"Precisely! Now everyone knows."
precisely.zh: “我所做的就是把真相写出来。” —“正是！现在大家都知道了。”

wage.en: Some of them earn below the minimum wage.
wage.zh: 他们中的一些人挣的钱低于最低工资。

wage.en: Wage rates depend on levels of productivity.
wage.zh: 工资水平取决于生产量的多寡。

wage.en: Wage increases must be in line with inflation.
wage.zh: 工资的增长必须与通货膨胀率一致。

ingredient.en: What is the active ingredient in aspirin?
ingredient.zh: 什么是阿司匹林中的有效成分？

ingredient.en: Coconut is a basic ingredient for many curries.
ingredient.zh: 椰子是多种咖喱菜的基本成分。

ingredient.en: Speed is the essential ingredient of all athletics.
ingredient.zh: 速度是所有体育运动的基本要素。

snap.en: She closed her purse with a snap.
snap.zh: 她啪嗒一声合上了钱包。

snap.en: Snap! I've just bought that CD too!
snap.zh: 真是巧了！我也刚买了那张光盘！

stake.en: Joan of Arc was burnt at the stake.
General Motors acquired a 50% stake in Saab for about $400m.
stake.zh: 通用汽车公司以大约4亿美元获得了萨博50%的股份。

terrorism.zh: 我们需要团结起来反对恐怖主义。

terrorism.en: I am utterly opposed to any form of terrorism.
terrorism.zh: 我坚决反对任何形式的恐怖主义。

terrorism.en: The government is taking a firm line on terrorism.
terrorism.zh: 政府现在对恐怖主义采取强硬的态度。

refugee.en: Many of the refugee villages are in isolated areas.
refugee.zh: 许多难民村位于偏僻的地方。

refugee.en: Troops tried to set up a lookout post inside a refugee camp.
refugee.zh: 军队试图在一个难民营里设一个瞭望台。

ultimate.en: Plants are the ultimate source of all foodstuffs.
ultimate.zh: 植物是所有食物的最终来源。

ultimate.en: Their ultimate aim was a market economy for Hungary.
ultimate.zh: 他们的最终目标是为匈牙利建立市场经济。

corporation.en: He was a stockholder in a hotel corporation.
corporation.zh: 他是一家酒店公司的股东。

corporation.en: The firm has close ties with an American corporation.
corporation.zh: 这家商行与一家美国公司关系密切。

corporation.en: The rule applies where a person owns stock in a corporation.
corporation.zh: 该规定对于在公司里拥有股份的人适用。

incorporate.en: The new cars will incorporate a number of major improvements.
incorporate.zh: 这种新型汽车将包含许多重大的改进。

incorporate.en: TV and movie producers often incorporate an element of bad behavior.
incorporate.zh: 电视和电影制作人通常会融入不良行为的元素。

incorporate.en: For example, universities could incorporate IDPs into their graduate curricula to help students discuss, plan, prepare for, and achieve their long-term career goals.
incorporate.zh: 例如，大学可以将个人发展计划纳入研究生课程，帮助学生们讨论、计划、准备和实现长期职业目标。

hip.zh: 他跌了一跤将髋关节摔裂。

hip.en: She broke her hip in the fall.
The car struck him a glancing blow on the hip.

assumption.en: His actions were based on a false assumption.
assumption.zh: 他的行为基于错误的设想。

assumption.en: The whole argument rests on a false assumption.
assumption.zh: 整个论证都是基于一个错误的假设。

assumption.en: We are working on the assumption that it was a gas explosion.
assumption.zh: 我们正依据它是一起燃气爆炸的假设而行动。

assign.en: Influenced by old ideas, some units assign posts according to seniority.
assign.zh: 由于受旧观念的影响，有些单位分配工作按资排辈。

assign.en: Assign responsibilities around the house and make sure homework deadlines are met.
assign.zh: 为房屋中的人分配责任，并确保家庭作业在期限内完成。

assign.en: Later in the year, she'll assign them research papers.
assign.zh: 今年晚些时候，她将给他们布置论文。

gear.zh: 滑雪用具有时会很昂贵。

provision.en: There is a lack of adequate provision for disabled students.
provision.zh: 为残疾学生提供的服务不够。

provision.en: The government is responsible for the provision of health care.
provision.zh: 政府负责提供医疗服务。

provision.en: One provision of the law was to roll back taxes to the 1975 level.
provision.zh: 该法律的一项条款是把税收削减至1975年的水平。

gang.zh: 警方怀疑当地的一个不良帮派。

gang.en: The gang tied up a security guard.
gang.zh: 那群歹徒把一名保安人员捆绑起来。

gang.en: The gang assaulted him with iron bars.
gang.zh: 该团伙用铁棒袭击了他。

advocate.en: He is a strident advocate of nuclear power.
advocate.zh: 他是发展核能的坚定拥护者。

advocate.en: Many experts advocate rewarding your child for good behaviour.
advocate.zh: 很多专家主张对小孩的良好表现加以奖励。

advocate.en: I felt that it was irresponsible to advocate the legalization of drugs.
advocate.zh: 我觉得主张毒品合法化是不负责任的。

index.zh: 甚至有一个特别的主题索引。

index.en: It will be published with annotations and index.
index.zh: 这本书出版时将附有注释和索引。

index.en: The Dow Jones index fell 15 points this morning.
index.zh: 道琼斯指数今天上午下跌了15点。

yell.en: Her yell sent nearby grouse running for cover.
yell.zh: 她的喊声让附近的松鸡奔跑着四处躲藏。

yell.en: Something brushed past Bob's face and he let out a yell.
yell.zh: 什么东西擦过了鲍勃的脸，他发出了一声大叫。
他们咒骂我并大喊大叫。

pregnant.zh: 她没好气地说：“我没有怀孕。”

distant.zh: 他是我远房的一个表亲。

distant.en: He's a distant relative of the mayor.

satellite.en: The moon is a satellite of earth.
The news programme came to us via satellite.
satellite.zh: 新闻节目是通过卫星传送到我们这里来的。

universal.en: Agreement on this issue is almost universal.
universal.zh: 这个问题几乎取得全体一致的意见。

universal.en: Several writers have posited the idea of a universal consciousness.
universal.zh: 几个作者都假设一种普遍意识的思想。

universal.en: The dove is a universal symbol of peace.
universal.zh: 鸽子是和平的共同象征。

spin.en: She puts a lot of spin on the ball.
spin.zh: 她打出的球旋转得很厉害。

spin.en: Her resignation put her colleagues in a spin.
spin.zh: 她的辞职令同事们摸不着头脑。

darkness.zh: 那艘巨轮在黑暗中破浪前行。

darkness.en: They left under the cloak of darkness.
darkness.zh: 他们在黑暗的掩护下离开了。

fence.en: I tore my jeans on the fence.
fence.zh: 我的牛仔裤被篱笆挂破了。

fence.en: I ripped my jeans on the fence.
fence.zh: 我的牛仔裤在栅栏上划破了。

characterize.en: The piercing cries of the rhinoceros hornbill characterize the Southeast Asian rain forest, as do the unmistakable calls of the gibbons.
characterize.zh: 犀鸟刺耳的鸣叫，和长臂猿那不会被认错的叫声，象征着东南亚雨林。
怎么描绘本杰明·富兰克林（Benjamin Franklin）呢？

prior.en: The firm I wanted to use had prior commitments.
prior.zh: 我选择的那家公司有优先承诺。

prior.en: He claimed he had no prior knowledge of the protest.
prior.zh: 他声称他事先对那次抗议一无所知。

assault.en: Police were shocked by the viciousness of the assault.
assault.zh: 警方对这一攻击的残忍感到震惊。

assault.en: A third brigade is at sea, ready for an amphibious assault.
assault.zh: 第三旅在海上待命，随时准备从海上发起进攻。

assault.en: John's soldiers were readying themselves for the final assault.
assault.zh: 约翰的士兵们正在为最后的进攻做好准备。

violation.en: To deprive the boy of his education is a violation of state law.
violation.zh: 剥夺这个男孩的受教育权是一种违反州法律的行为。

violation.en: The judge called the decision "a flagrant violation of international law."
violation.zh: 法官称这个决定是“对国际法的公然违反”。

violation.en: His possession of classified documents in his home was, at the very least, a violation of navy security regulations.
violation.zh: 他把机密文件放在家里，这最起码是违反了海军安全条例。

headquarters.zh: 通过无线电向总部发出了警报。
他们把总部设在了斯温登。
我在等待总部的录用审查许可。

rub.en: She gave her knee a quick rub.
She sometimes asks if I want a back rub.
rub.zh: 她有时问我是否想要一次背部按摩。

rub.en: You may need to give the floor a rub-down with glasspaper.
rub.zh: 你可能得用玻璃砂纸打磨一下地板。

controversy.en: He is a lightning rod for controversy.
controversy.zh: 他是个富有争议的人物.

tragedy.zh: 整个事件以悲剧而告终。
我们看到的是情节剧，而不是悲剧。

fade.en: The colour in this material does not fade.
Further, natural dyes tended to be muddy in hue and fade quickly.
fade.zh: 此外，天然染料往往是浑浊的颜色而且它们很快褪色。

fade.en: My resentment of her slowly began to fade.
fade.zh: 我对她的怨恨慢慢地开始消退了。

funeral.zh: 大约有三十人参加了葬礼。

constitute.en: China's ethnic minorities constitute less than 7 percent of its total population.
constitute.zh: 中国的少数民族构成总人口的不到7%。

constitute.en: Testing patients without their consent would constitute a professional and legal offence.
constitute.zh: 未得病人同意即对其进行试验会构成职业和法律犯罪。

constitute.en: Both of these lobes together constitute a pi bond.
constitute.zh: 上下两片叶一起组成了一根 π 键。

establishment.en: The speaker announced the establishment of a new college.
establishment.zh: 发言人宣布了新学院的成立。

establishment.en: It will result in the establishment of the world's largest marine reserve.
establishment.zh: 它将促成建立世界上最大的海洋保护区。

establishment.en: The hotel is a comfortable and well-run establishment.
establishment.zh: 这家旅馆环境舒适且经营良好。

squeeze.en: We managed to squeeze six people into the car.
squeeze.zh: 我们在那辆车上挤进了六个人。

squeeze.en: Seven people in the car was a bit of a squeeze.
squeeze.zh: 那辆车坐了七个人是有点挤。

squeeze.en: If you move forward a little, I can squeeze past.
squeeze.zh: 你朝前挪一挪，我就可以挤过去了。

mask.en: The gunman, whose mask had slipped, fled.
mask.zh: 面具滑落的持枪歹徒逃走了。

mask.en: Dina lit a cigarette, trying to mask her agitation.
mask.zh: 黛娜点燃了一支烟，试图掩饰她的不安。

mask.en: This mask leaves your complexion feeling soft and supple.
mask.zh: 这种面膜使你的皮肤变得柔软娇嫩。

comprehensive.en: Streaming within comprehensive schools is common practice.
comprehensive.zh: 综合中学常把学生按能力分班。

comprehensive.en: The idea was to create a comprehensive road map of the Web.
comprehensive.zh: 这个想法原是为万维网做一个综合指南。

comprehensive.en: The Rough Guide to Nepal is a comprehensive guide to the region.
comprehensive.zh: 《尼泊尔概览》是介绍该地区的一本全面指南。

prominent.en: He had an angular face with prominent cheekbones.
prominent.zh: 他有一张颧骨突出、棱角分明的脸。

prominent.en: He went on to earn a prominent professorial position.
prominent.zh: 他接着得到了一个著名的教授职位。

prominent.en: Here the window plays a prominent part in the design.
prominent.zh: 这里，窗户在设计中有着突出的作用。

regardless.en: She always travels first-class regardless of expense.
regardless.zh: 无论费用多高她总是乘头等舱。

regardless.en: Despite her recent surgery she has been carrying on regardless.
regardless.zh: 尽管她最近动了手术，她却一直在不顾一切地继续工作。

regardless.en: Everyone has the right to good medical care regardless of their ability to pay.
regardless.zh: 无论支付能力如何，每个人都有权得到良好的医疗。

presentation.en: A computer software glitch fouled up their presentation.
presentation.zh: 一个电脑软件故障弄砸了他们的展示会。

presentation.en: I am making a multimedia presentation for my science project.
presentation.zh: 我正在为我的科学项目做多媒体演示。

presentation.en: Computer graphics will give your presentation the professional touch.
presentation.zh: 计算机绘图将会使你的演示具有专业特色。

representation.en: A graphical representation of results is shown in figure 1.
representation.zh: 图1中显示了结果的图解表示。

representation.en: The snake swallowing its tail is a representation of infinity.
representation.zh: 蛇含其尾表示无穷无尽。

representation.en: Puerto Ricans are U.S. citizens but they have no representation in Congress.
representation.zh: 波多黎各人是美国公民，但是他们在国会中没有代表。

violate.en: Thornburgh said such demands wouldn't violate the First Amendment.
violate.zh: 桑伯说这样的要求不违反第一修正案。

violate.en: Nuclear weapons seem to violate the just war principle of proportionality.
violate.zh: 核武器似乎违背了罚当其罪的正义战争原则。

violate.en: Those who violate traffic regulations should be punished.
violate.zh: 那些违反交通规则的人应该受到惩罚。

partnership.zh: 婚姻应当是平等的伴侣关系。

partnership.en: He invited me to go into partnership with him.
It was a nifty arrangement, a perfect partnership.
partnership.zh: 这既是个绝佳的安排，又是个完美的合作。

emission.en: The emission of gases such as carbon dioxide should be stabilized at their present level.
emission.zh: 二氧化碳之类气体的排放应该被控制在目前的水平上。

emission.en: It is clear that the U.S. will meet its emission goals.
emission.zh: 很明显，美国将会达到其排放目标。

emission.en: Emission of these "greenhouse" gases contributes to global warming.
emission.zh: 这些“温室”气体的排放会导致全球变暖。

vital.zh: 旅游业对于经济至关重要。

vital.en: Trust is a vital component in any relationship.
vital.zh: 在任何关系中，信任都是一个至关重要的因素。
快速消除压力非常重要。

fate.en: My fate is neither up to me nor up to heaven.

fate.zh: 她的命运与他的交织在一起。

fate.en: I see no use arguing with fate.
fate.zh: 我认为与命运抗争没有什么用。

mere.en: He seemed so young, a mere boy.
mere.zh: 他看来那么年轻，只是个孩子。
1 000元对她来说不过是区区小数。

segment.en: She cleaned a small segment of the painting.
segment.zh: 她擦干净了这幅画的一小部分。

segment.en: That shift affected only one segment of the population.
segment.zh: 这种转变只影响了一部分人口。

distinction.en: We need to draw a distinction between the two events.
distinction.zh: 我们得把两起事件区别开来。

distinction.en: The distinction between craft and fine art is more controversial.
distinction.zh: 工艺和美术之间的区别更有争议。

variation.en: This delicious variation on an omelette is quick and easy to prepare.
variation.zh: 这种略有变化的美味煎蛋饼做起来又快又容易。

variation.en: Variation among humans is limited to the possible permutations of our genes.
variation.zh: 人类的变化形式受限于我们基因可能的那些排列。

variation.en: Modern violins had a greater variation, a larger differential.
variation.zh: 现代小提琴有更大的变化，更大的差异。

correspondent.en: One ABC correspondent had totally missed the point of the question.
correspondent.zh: 美国广播公司的一名记者完全没有领会这个问题的关键。

correspondent.en: I am the foreign correspondent in Washington of La Tribuna newspaper of Honduras.
correspondent.zh: 我是洪都拉斯《论坛报》驻华盛顿的记者。

correspondent.en: A correspondent for Reuters news agency says he saw a number of demonstrators being beaten.
correspondent.zh: 路透通讯社的一名记者说他看到一些示威者遭到殴打。

radical.en: It was a radical departure from tradition.
radical.zh: 这从根本上违背了传统。

radical.en: A radical overhaul of the tax system is necessary.
Such a radical proposal would never get through Congress.
radical.zh: 如此激进的提案永远不会在国会获得通过。

significance.en: The president's visit is loaded with symbolic significance.
significance.zh: 总统的访问富有象征意义。

significance.en: They discussed the statistical significance of the results.
significance.zh: 他们讨论了这些结果在统计学上的意义。

significance.en: The new drug has great significance for the treatment of the disease.
significance.zh: 这种新药对于这种病的治疗有重大的意义。

vessel.en: The vessel yesterday reached anchorage off Dubai.
vessel.zh: 该船昨日抵达迪拜附近的锚地。

vessel.en: He loaded his vessel with another cargo and set sail.
vessel.zh: 他又往他的船上装了一件货就启航了。

vessel.en: A plane with Danish markings was over-flying his vessel.
vessel.zh: 一架带有丹麦标志的飞机正从他的轮船上空飞过。

flee.en: He was caught trying to flee the country.
flee.zh: 他试图逃离该国时被抓住了。

flee.en: For an instant, Barney was tempted to flee.
flee.zh: 那一瞬间，巴尼很想逃走。

flee.en: Many refugees have been forced to flee their homeland.
flee.zh: 很多难民被迫逃离了祖国。

tribe.en: The valley is inhabited by the Dani tribe.
tribe.zh: 这个山谷里居住着丹尼部落。

tribe.en: His intercession could be of help to the tribe.
tribe.zh: 他的调解会对该部落有帮助。

tribe.en: Few know that the tribe was just passing through.
tribe.zh: 几乎没人知道这个部落只是路过。

evolution.en: Darwin eventually put forward a model of biological evolution.
evolution.zh: 达尔文最终提出了一套生物进化的理论模式。

evolution.en: We're dealing with probably the biggest missing link in what we know about human evolution.
evolution.zh: 我们正在解决的可能是我们所知的人类进化过程中缺失最大的一环。

evolution.en: What is the first step in evolution?

lawn.en: I mow the lawn every week in summer.
lawn.zh: 夏天我每周都要修剪草坪。

lawn.en: There were ducks quacking on the lawn.
lawn.zh: 有鸭子在草坪上发出嘎嘎的叫着。

lawn.en: She ran swiftly over the lawn to the gate.
lawn.zh: 她轻快地跑过草坪，来到大门口。

council.zh: 林木委员会倡导植树造林。

council.en: The Council answered those questions in the negative.
council.zh: 理事会对那些问题做出了否定回答。

wisdom.en: All human wisdom is summed up in these two words: 'Wait and Hope.'
wisdom.zh: 人类的全部智慧就包含在这四个字里面：“等待”和“希望”。

wisdom.en: They were godlike in their wisdom and compassion.
wisdom.zh: 他们的智慧和关爱有如圣贤一般。

wisdom.en: In this job you need to exhibit the wisdom of Solomon.
wisdom.zh: 做这份工作需要表现出所罗门王一样的才智。

vulnerable.en: She was left feeling exposed and vulnerable.
vulnerable.zh: 她感到自己孤立无助，非常脆弱。

vulnerable.en: Those most vulnerable to heat stress are the elderly.
vulnerable.zh: 上了年纪的人最容易因受热而生病。

vulnerable.en: Their tanks would be vulnerable to attack from the air.
vulnerable.zh: 他们的坦克将易受空袭。

garlic.en: You can taste the garlic in this stew.
garlic.zh: 在这炖肉里你可以尝出大蒜的味道。

garlic.en: The generous amount of garlic adds flavour.

poetry.zh: 杰伊朗读诗歌非常动听。
他聊起诗来一聊就是半天。

celebrity.en: He was voted the worst dressed celebrity.
celebrity.zh: 大家一致认为他是衣着最差的名人。

celebrity.en: She dislikes the loss of privacy that attends TV celebrity.
celebrity.zh: 她不喜欢成为电视名人后随之失去个人隐私。

stability.en: It was a time of political stability and progress.
stability.zh: 那是一个政治稳定和进步的时期。

stability.en: Political stability, meanwhile, will be a prime concern.
stability.zh: 与此同时，政治稳定将是头等大事。

stability.en: My father wanted me to become a professional and have more stability.
stability.zh: 我父亲希望我成为一名专业人士，有更多稳定性。

fantasy.en: He retreated into a world of fantasy.
The story is a magical mix of fantasy and reality.
fantasy.zh: 这个故事是一个幻想与现实的奇妙组合。

fantasy.en: Enough of fantasy, the workaday world awaited him.
fantasy.zh: 幻想之后，等待他的是平凡的现世。

plot.en: Can you follow the plot so far?
plot.zh: 你到目前能理解这个情节吗？
这种情节确实让人难以置信。
一个狡诈的阴谋受到了怀疑。

framework.en: She sets up a framework to deconstruct various categories of film.
framework.zh: 她创建了一个框架来解析影视的各种分类。
此评估仅仅是一个框架。

framework.en: The outer tent fits over the framework.
framework.zh: 外层帐篷安置在帐篷的框架上。

ongoing.en: When Pemberton created his drink, it represented an ongoing trend.
ongoing.zh: 当彭伯顿发明他的饮料时，它代表了一种持续的趋势。

ongoing.en: They were also more likely to have an ongoing medical condition and be overweight.
ongoing.zh: 他们也更有可能出现持续的病症和超重问题。
警方的调查在持续进行中。

gesture.zh: 格里芬先生打了个急促而不连贯的手势。

gesture.en: He struck his breast in a dramatic gesture.
gesture.zh: 他以戏剧性的姿态捶他的胸。

psychology.en: He studied philosophy and psychology at Yale.
psychology.zh: 他在耶鲁大学学习哲学和心理学。

psychology.en: He graduated from York with a degree in Psychology.
psychology.zh: 他毕业于约克大学，获心理学学士学位。

psychology.en: Abraham Maslow described psychology as "the science of being."
psychology.zh: 亚伯拉罕•马斯洛将心理学描述为“存在科学”。

divorce.zh: 这桩离婚案没有人提出异议。

athletic.en: Xandra is an athletic 36-year-old with a 21-year-old's body.
athletic.zh: 赞德拉是位36岁却有着21岁人体格的运动型人。

athletic.en: They have been given college scholarships purely on athletic ability.
athletic.zh: 他们完全凭他们的运动才能获得了大学奖学金。

athletic.en: He wanted his sons to become strong, virile, and athletic like himself.
athletic.zh: 他希望他的儿子们变得像他一样身强力壮、充满阳刚之气，并擅长体育运动。

shade.en: Let's sit in the shade for a while.
shade.zh: 咱们在阴凉处坐一会儿吧。

shade.en: Let's sit in the shade and keep cool.
shade.zh: 咱们坐在阴凉处乘凉吧。

shade.en: I'm going to shade this part in.
shade.zh: 我要把这一部分画得再暗一些。

obligation.en: We have a moral obligation to protect the environment.
obligation.zh: 我们有道义责任保护环境。

obligation.en: She did not feel under any obligation to tell him the truth.
obligation.zh: 她觉得没有义务告诉他实情。

obligation.en: Governments have at least a moral obligation to answer these questions.
obligation.zh: 政府至少在道义上有责任回应这些问题。

sustain.zh: 哪些行星可以维持生命的存在？

sustain.en: The ice will not sustain your weight.
sustain.zh: 这冰承受不了你的体重。

sustain.en: The cash dividends they get from the cash crop would sustain them during the lean season.
sustain.zh: 他们从经济作物中得到的那些现金红利能支撑他们度过歉收季节。

differ.en: French and English differ in this respect.
differ.zh: 在这方面法语和英语不同。

differ.en: Ideas on childcare may differ considerably between the parents.
differ.zh: 在抚育儿童方面父母的观点可能迥然不同。
他们在成分上有什么不同？

palm.en: He muted the strings with his palm.
Palm trees stir in the soft Pacific breeze.
palm.zh: 棕榈树在太平洋和煦的微风里轻轻摇动。

palm.en: He smacked a fist into the palm of his hand.
palm.zh: 他用拳头啪地猛击一下手掌。

composition.en: We had to write a composition on the subject "My Pet."
composition.zh: 我们得就“我的宠物”这个主题写一篇作文。

composition.en: Television has transformed the size and social composition of the audience at great sporting occasions.
composition.zh: 电视改变了大型体育赛事观众的数量及其社会构成。

composition.en: Extracting information about the large-scale composition of a planet from a sample weighing a millionth of a gram was a fascinating example of scientific endeavour.
composition.zh: 从重量为百万分之一克的样品中提取有关行星宏观组成的信息是一个极为有趣的科学尝试实例。

carbon.en: CO is the formula for carbon monoxide.
Organic compounds contain carbon in their molecules.
carbon.zh: 有机化合物的分子里含碳。

briefly.zh: 我见过蜜凯拉一次，时间很短。

scheme.en: We devised a scheme to help him.
scheme.zh: 我们想出了一个计划来帮助他。

scheme.en: This isn't the first harebrained scheme he's had.
scheme.zh: 这已经不是他制定的第一个愚蠢计划了。

scheme.en: The government has twice declined to back the scheme.
scheme.zh: 政府已经两次拒绝支持该计划。

tobacco.en: Johnson still knew next to nothing about tobacco.
tobacco.zh: 约翰逊仍然对烟草几乎一无所知。

tobacco.en: We need to take a firm line on tobacco advertising.
tobacco.zh: 我们需要对烟草广告采取强硬的态度。

survivor.zh: 我是个幸存者。能勉强过活。

survivor.en: General Geichenko was a survivor. His father, also a top-ranking officer, had perished during the war.
survivor.zh: 格晨科将军是一位幸存者。他的父亲也是一位高级军官，在战争中丧生了。

survivor.en: This soldier was the sole survivor of the battle.
survivor.zh: 这名士兵是这场战斗唯一的生还者。

crack.en: Water seeped from a crack in the pipe.
crack.zh: 水从管道的一个裂缝中渗出。

crack.en: She peeped through the crack in the curtains.
crack.zh: 她透过窗帘的缝隙窥视。

galaxy.zh: 银河系由1千亿颗恒星组成。
天文学家们发现了一个遥远的星系。

galaxy.en: At least one supernova occurs per decade in our galaxy.
galaxy.zh: 每十年至少有一颗超新星在我们的银河系中出现。

limitation.en: They would resist any limitation of their powers.
limitation.zh: 他们会抵制对他们权力的任何限制。

limitation.en: All the talk had been about the limitation of nuclear weapons.
limitation.zh: 整个会谈都是关于核武器的限制。

limitation.en: This drug has one important limitation. Its effects only last six hours.
limitation.zh: 这种药物有一个很大的限制因素，其药效只能持续6个小时。

trace.en: How far back can you trace your family tree?
trace.zh: 你的家谱可以追溯到多少代？

trace.en: The trace showed a normal heart rhythm.

incredible.en: I felt I'd made an incredible discovery.
incredible.zh: 我感到自己有了一个惊人的发现。
“简直是令人难以置信，”库尔特突然容光焕发地说到。

incredible.en: It was an incredible display of motherly love and forgiveness.
incredible.zh: 那是慈母般关爱与宽容的一次令人难以置信的体现。

preference.en: I can't say that I have any particular preference.
preference.zh: 我说不出自己有什么特别偏好。

preference.en: Preference will be given to graduates of this university.
preference.zh: 这所大学的毕业生会获得优先考虑。

preference.en: Let's make a list of possible speakers, in order of preference.
preference.zh: 咱们按优先顺序列出一份可能请到的发言者名单。

publicly.zh: 这个消息没有对外公开。

publicly.en: He later publicly apologized for his comments.
publicly.zh: 后来他对自己的言论作了公开道歉。

publicly.en: They issue a fixed number of shares that trade publicly.

shrug.zh: 埃里卡做了个有点儿不以为然的耸肩动作。

shrug.en: He gave a feeble shrug and tried to squirm free.
shrug.zh: 他微微地耸了耸肩，扭动着试图挣脱。

extension.zh: 她可以通过分机308找到我。

legitimate.zh: 他的生意是否绝对合法？

legitimate.en: The empire could not cohere as a legitimate whole.
legitimate.zh: 这个帝国无法凝聚成一个合法的整体。

legitimate.en: The government said that it has suspended all aid to Haiti until that country's legitimate government is restored.
legitimate.zh: 政府说它已经暂停对海地的所有援助，直到海地恢复合法政府为止。

orientation.en: His sexual orientation was a lot more gay than straight.
orientation.zh: 他的性取向更像是同性恋的而非异性恋的。

orientation.en: The orientation of the planet's orbit is changing continuously.
orientation.zh: 该行星轨道的方向不断变化。

orientation.en: To a society which has lost its orientation he has much to offer.
orientation.zh: 对一个迷失了方向的社会，他有许多要做的。

inflation.zh: 通货膨胀是一种持续的威胁。

cope.en: I was left to cope on my own.
cope.zh: 就剩下我一个人来单独对付。

cope.en: Fit people are better able to cope with stress.
cope.zh: 健康的人较能应付压力。

cope.en: Farmers are struggling to cope with an invasion of slugs.
cope.zh: 农民正在努力对付蛞蝓的大肆侵害。

flame.zh: 火焰噼啪噼啪地熄灭了。

flame.en: The custom of lighting the Olympic flame goes back centuries.
flame.zh: 点燃奥运圣火的风俗可追溯到几个世纪前。

flame.en: Can the heart's flame die in the flame of the funeral pile?
flame.zh: 心的火焰会在火葬堆的火焰中熄灭吗？

cluster.en: Each atomic cluster is made up of neutrons and protons.
cluster.zh: 每个原子团簇是由中子和质子组成的。

cluster.en: The illustration shows a cluster of five roses coloured apricot orange.
cluster.zh: 插图上展示了一簇杏黄色的5朵玫瑰。

cluster.en: The system deploys only one cluster with two servers in the New York area.
cluster.zh: 该系统仅在纽约地区部署一个集群和两个服务器。

depict.en: Although we still depict nostalgic snow scenes on Christmas cards, winters are now very much warmer.
depict.zh: 虽然我们还在圣诞卡上描绘引人怀旧的雪景，但现在冬天温暖多了。
事实证明很难客观地描述它。

depict.en: It didn't depict scenes or models exactly as they looked.
depict.zh: 它没有准确如实地描述场景或模型。

dependent.en: The area is heavily dependent on tourism.
dependent.zh: 这个地区非常依赖旅游业。

dependent.en: She is still financially dependent on her parents.
dependent.zh: 她在经济上仍然依靠父母。

dependent.en: She had grown ever more peevishly dependent on him.
dependent.zh: 她脾气变得更坏，对他的依赖更重了。

flesh.en: It makes my flesh creep to think of it.
flesh.zh: 一想起它我就心惊肉跳。

flesh.en: I'm only flesh and blood, like anyone else.
flesh.zh: 我只是血肉之躯，跟其他人一样。

mortgage.en: We paid off our mortgage after fifteen years.
mortgage.zh: 我们历经十五年的时间还清了抵押借款。

mortgage.en: Mortgage defaults have risen in the last year.
mortgage.zh: 按揭借款违约在近一年里呈上升趋势。

mortgage.en: They have burdened themselves with a high mortgage.
mortgage.zh: 他们负担了一笔很高的按揭借款。

operator.zh: 接线员将为你接通电话。

operator.en: He dialled the operator and put in a call to Rome.
operator.zh: 他拨通了接线员，往罗马打了一个电话。

operator.en: He is a very shrewd operator with an incisive mind.
operator.zh: 他是一位非常精明的经营者，有着敏锐的头脑。

sanction.en: He may now be ready to sanction the use of force.
sanction.zh: 他或许现在正准备批准使用武力。

sanction.en: The government refused to sanction a further cut in interest rates.
sanction.zh: 政府拒绝批准进一步降低利率。

sanction.en: The Security Council will consider taking future actions against sanction-busters.
sanction.zh: 安理会将考虑未来采取措施打击破坏制裁的人。

civilian.en: A civilian was killed by a stray bullet.

civilian.zh: 他们轰炸了军事和民用目标。

civilian.en: His supporters want a clean-up of civilian corruption.
civilian.zh: 他的支持者们想要一场对民间腐败的大整顿。

habitat.en: The panda's natural habitat is the bamboo forest.
habitat.zh: 大熊猫的天然栖息地是竹林。

habitat.en: This species has nearly died out because its habitat is being destroyed.
habitat.zh: 因栖息地正受到破坏这一物种已濒于灭绝。

habitat.en: To save remaining herds and habitat, the national parks department is planning to cull 2000 elephants.
habitat.zh: 为挽救余下的兽群及其栖息地，国家公园管理部门正计划杀掉2000头大象。

devote.en: The original intention was to devote three months to the project.
devote.zh: 最初的计划是在这个项目上投入三个月的时间。

devote.en: It can't be denied that we need to devote more resources to this problem.
devote.zh: 无可否认，我们必须投入更多的资源来解决这个问题。

devote.en: We devote several days to the exploration of the magnificent Maya sites of Copan.
devote.zh: 我们投入了几天时间在科潘宏伟的玛雅遗址考察。

ease.en: I gave him some brandy to ease the pain.
ease.zh: 我给了他一些白兰地以减轻疼痛。

ease.en: The task was accomplished with comparative ease.
ease.zh: 这项任务完成得比较容易。

seize.zh: 当你活着的时候，好好把握生命。
我们应该抓住这个宝贵的机会。

nomination.en: They opposed her nomination to the post of Deputy Director.
nomination.zh: 他们反对任命她为副主任。

nomination.en: He quickly won his party's nomination to contest the elections.
nomination.zh: 他迅速赢得了其党派的提名来参加竞选。

nomination.en: He won the nomination as Democratic candidate for the presidency.
nomination.zh: 他赢得了民主党总统候选人的提名。

summit.zh: 中午时分我们抵达峰顶。
我们和他们一路赛跑到最高点。

gifted.en: She was an accomplished pianist, a superb swimmer, and a gifted artist.
gifted.zh: 她曾是一位很有造诣的钢琴家、一流的游泳健将和天才艺术家。

gifted.en: He was a natural politician, a gifted orator who knew how to work a crowd.
gifted.zh: 他曾是位天生的政治家，是位有天赋且知道如何凝集民众的演说家。

gifted.en: Michael may have been a dunce at mathematics, but he was gifted at languages.
gifted.zh: 迈克尔在数学方面可能是个笨学生，但他在语言方面是有天赋的。

acid.en: Rye is tolerant of poor, acid soils.
acid.zh: 黑麦耐贫瘠的酸性土壤。

acid.en: Carbolic acid is usually used for cleaning.

frustration.en: She telephoned her best friend to vent her frustration.
frustration.zh: 她打电话给自己最好的朋友来发泄她的沮丧。

frustration.en: It was a time fraught with difficulties and frustration.
frustration.zh: 这是一个充满困难和挫折的时期。

frustration.en: Frustration, anger and desperation have led to a series of wildcat strikes.
frustration.zh: 挫败感、愤怒和绝望引发了一系列自发性罢工。

odds.en: He was at odds with the boss.

repeatedly.en: He struck at me repeatedly with a stick.
repeatedly.zh: 他拿着棍子一再朝我打过来。

repeatedly.en: Both men have repeatedly denied the allegations.
repeatedly.zh: 两个人都再三地否认这些指控。

repeatedly.en: He was paged repeatedly as the flight was boarding.
repeatedly.zh: 登机时，他被反复地呼叫着。

lung.en: He was born with only one lung.
lung.zh: 他生下来就只有一个肺。

lung.en: He was diagnosed with inoperable lung cancer.
lung.zh: 他被诊断患有无法手术的肺癌。

distinguish.en: It's important to distinguish fact from fiction.
distinguish.zh: 区别真实和虚构是重要的。

distinguish.en: It was hard to distinguish one twin from the other.
distinguish.zh: 很难分辨出一对孪生儿谁是谁。

discourse.en: Not only do they report on current events but also inform and shape the public discourse.
discourse.zh: 它们不仅报道时事，而且为公众论述提供信息和塑造形象。

discourse.en: The subject of automation and its role in our economy has taken hold in American public discourse.
discourse.zh: 自动化及其在我们经济中所起作用的话题已在美国公众话语中占据一席之地。

discourse.en: Break the tension with smiles and humor to reinforce the idea that this is friendly discourse and that all are working toward a common goal.
discourse.zh: 用微笑和幽默来打破紧张气氛，强调这是段友好的谈话，并且所有人都在朝着共同的目标努力。

distinct.en: There was a distinct smell of gas.
Being tall gave Tony a distinct advantage.
distinct.zh: 托尼个子高是个明显的优势。
身高6英尺3英寸有明显的劣势！

portray.en: He has worked hard in recent months to portray New York in a better light.
portray.zh: 最近几个月他一直努力工作要从一个更好的角度描绘纽约。

portray.en: Though advocates portray grass-fed products as a win-win situation for all, they do have downsides.
portray.zh: 尽管支持者将草饲产品描绘成对所有人都有利的双赢局面，但这些产品也有缺点。

portray.en: Why does cartoonist Mike Luckovich portray groundhog Phil confessing in front of reporters that he accepted money from the White House?
portray.zh: 漫画家麦克·卢科维奇为什么在画中描绘土拨鼠菲尔在记者面前承认自己收受了白宫的钱呢？

basket.en: There was a complimentary basket of fruit in our room.
basket.zh: 我们房间里有一篮免费赠送的水果。

basket.en: He saw the dog's twitching nose poke out of the basket.
basket.zh: 他看见那条狗颤搐的鼻子从篮子里露出来。

basket.en: The dollar has fallen 6.5 percent this year against a basket of currencies from its largest trading partners.
basket.zh: 美元对其最大贸易伙伴们的一篮子货币今年贬值了6.5%。

moderate.en: He was an easygoing man of very moderate views.
moderate.zh: 他是一个有着温和观点性情随和的人。

moderate.en: The team enjoyed only moderate success last season.
moderate.zh: 上个赛季，这个队伍只取得了中等成绩。

moderate.en: Lasik is best for moderate, not severe, vision problems.
moderate.zh: 镭射视力矫正手术对中等而不严重的视力问题最有效。

persuade.en: I did my damnedest to persuade her.
persuade.zh: 我已经全力以赴地去说服她了。

persuade.en: How did you manage to persuade him?
I failed in my attempt to persuade her.

subsequent.zh: 后来发生的事证实了我们的怀疑。

subsequent.en: Subsequent experiments failed to replicate these findings.
subsequent.zh: 后来的实验没有得出同样的结果。

subsequent.en: Developments on this issue will be dealt with in a subsequent report.
subsequent.zh: 这个问题的发展将在以后的报道中予以说明。

ghost.en: It wasn't a ghost; it was a real person.
ghost.zh: 那不是鬼魂，是实实在在的人。

ghost.en: A ghost indeed! I've never heard anything so silly.
ghost.zh: 真是见鬼！我可从没听说过这样无聊的事。

ghost.en: She's the editor of a new collection of ghost stories.
ghost.zh: 她编了一部新版鬼故事集。

frequent.en: She's a frequent visitor to the US.
She is a frequent traveller to Belgium.
frequent.zh: 她经常到比利时去旅行。

frequent.en: Symptoms included frequent dryness in the mouth.

exceed.en: It is dangerous to exceed the recommended dose.
exceed.zh: 超过建议使用的剂量会有危险。

exceed.en: Your intake of alcohol should not exceed two units per day.
exceed.zh: 你每天酒精摄入量不能超过两个单位。

exceed.en: You risk incurring bank charges if you exceed your overdraft limit.
exceed.zh: 如果超出了透支限额，就有被银行加收费用的风险。

widespread.zh: 漫天要价的情况普遍存在。

widespread.en: The new laws have gained widespread acceptance.
There is widespread apathy among the electorate.

miracle.en: It is a miracle no one was killed.
miracle.zh: 没有人死亡真是个奇迹。

miracle.en: Short of a miracle, we're certain to lose.
miracle.zh: 除非发生奇迹，否则我们输定了。

miracle.en: The transformation has been nothing short of a miracle.

script.zh: 珍妮在写一个电影脚本。
这部剧本充其量不过是匠人之作。

script.en: That line isn't in the original script.
script.zh: 原剧本中没有那句台词。

sin.en: Chocolate equals sin in most people's lexicon.
sin.zh: 巧克力在大多数人的字典里等同于罪恶。

sin.en: Sin is a harsh tyrant in your life. But Christ not only died for our sins, he died to sin.
sin.zh: 罪是你生命中的一个残酷暴君。但是基督不仅为我们的罪舍命，而且他向罪而死。

tactic.en: It's thought the fires were started by the prisoners as a diversionary tactic.
tactic.zh: 人们认为火是囚犯们放的，是一种使人分心的策略。

tactic.en: One tactic involves where to display the goods.
tactic.zh: 其中一个策略涉及到在哪里展示商品。

tactic.en: This was the first time he'd used the card tactic.
tactic.zh: 这是他第一次使用纸牌策略。

identification.zh: 你有没有任何身份证件？
请出示任何身份证件好吗？

identification.en: After a pause he asked, "You got any identification?"
identification.zh: 他停顿了一下问道，“你们有什么身份证明吗？”

transformation.en: The transformation of American sea power began in 1940.
transformation.zh: 美国海军力量的改革开始于1940年。

transformation.en: Norah made plans for the transformation of an attic room into a study.
transformation.zh: 诺拉制订了将阁楼间改造为书房的几个方案。

transformation.en: The way in which we work has undergone a complete transformation in the past decade.
transformation.zh: 在过去的十年里，我们的工作方式经历了彻底的变革。

headline.en: 'Ten shot dead by gunmen,' ran the newspaper headline.
headline.zh: 报纸的标题为“枪手击毙十人”。

headline.en: They ran the story under the headline 'Home at last!'.
headline.zh: 报纸刊登这个报道的大标题为“终于回家了！”。

headline.en: Both newspapers carried the same banner headline, "Where are you, Mr. President?"
headline.zh: 两份报纸刊登了相同的头版通栏大标题：“总统先生，你在哪里？”

invasion.en: There was widespread condemnation of the invasion.
invasion.zh: 那次侵略遭到了人们普遍的谴责。

invasion.en: The actress described the photographs of her as an invasion of privacy.
invasion.zh: 那位女演员认为她的这些照片是对隐私权的侵犯。

invasion.en: He leaned towards her and she stiffened at this invasion of her personal space.
invasion.zh: 他向她俯过身去，这种侵犯她个人空间的举动让她绷紧了身子。

carrier.en: They brought baby Michael along in a carrier.
carrier.zh: 他们把小迈克尔放在婴儿车上一起带来了。

carrier.en: He stooped to pick up the carrier bag of groceries.
carrier.zh: 他弯腰提起装满食品杂货的购物袋。

carrier.en: American Airlines is the third-largest carrier at Denver International Airport.
carrier.zh: 美国航空公司是丹佛国际机场第三大客运航空公司。

venture.en: Grace was flushed with the success of the venture.
venture.zh: 格雷斯为这次成功冒险感到兴奋。

venture.en: People are afraid to venture out for fear of sniper attacks.
venture.zh: 人们不敢冒险外出，害怕狙击手的袭击。

venture.en: I was still uncommitted to the venture when we reached Kanpur.
venture.zh: 直到我们到达坎普尔时，我还是不太支持这次冒险。

adequate.en: Make sure that the firm's insurance cover is adequate.
adequate.zh: 要确保该公司的保险保障是足够的。

adequate.en: She didn't give an adequate explanation for being late.
adequate.zh: 她没有给出充分的理由说明迟到的原因。

adequate.en: We cannot guarantee adequate supplies of raw materials.
adequate.zh: 我们不能保证提供充足的原料。

nonetheless.zh: 尽管如此，保持谨慎是明智的。

nonetheless.en: But it's remarkable for all that, nonetheless.
nonetheless.zh: 尽管如此，这还是很了不起的。

nonetheless.en: There are nonetheless several empirically proven benefits.
nonetheless.zh: 尽管如此，还是有一些被经验证明的益处。

grocery.zh: 他们经营一家小食品杂货店。

grocery.en: I worked stocking shelves in a grocery shop.
grocery.zh: 我在一家杂货店工作，给货架上货。

grocery.en: The grocery shop is offering customers 5 cents for each shopping bag re-used.
grocery.zh: 该杂货店为顾客重复使用每个购物袋给5美分。

intensity.en: The solemn intensity of Jade's gaze discomfited him.
intensity.zh: 在杰德强烈而严肃的凝视下他狼狈不堪。

intensity.en: Everyone I know who kept it up at that intensity is burned-out.
intensity.zh: 我所认识的一直保持那样工作强度的人都早衰了。

intensity.en: The intensity of the work left little room for personal grief or anxiety.
intensity.zh: 该工作的强度很少给个人留下悲伤或忧虑的机会。

exhibit.en: This exhibit was kindly loaned by the artist's family.
exhibit.zh: 这件展品是艺术家的家人惠借而展出的。

exhibit.en: The new exhibit will tour a dozen US cities next year.
exhibit.zh: 这批新展品明年将在美国十二个城市巡回展出。

exhibit.en: He had kindly offered to loan us all the plants required for the exhibit.
exhibit.zh: 他友好地主动提出了借给我们展览会所需的全部植物。

blanket.en: I wrapped a blanket around the baby.
blanket.zh: 我用毯子把婴儿裹了起来。

blanket.en: He rolled himself up in the blanket.
She tucked a blanket around his legs.
blanket.zh: 她拿一条毯子把他的双腿裹好。

margin.en: The group had a net profit margin of 30% last year.
margin.zh: 该集团去年的净利润空间为30%。

margin.en: She added her comments in the margin.
margin.zh: 她在页边空白处加上了她的评语。

concrete.zh: 我们坐在混凝土地板上。
我当时没有明确而具体的证据。

prescription.zh: 妮古拉拿了治疗链球菌性咽喉炎的处方药。

prescription.en: The pharmacist will make up your prescription.
prescription.zh: 药剂师会给你依处方配药。

prescription.en: They are not available without a prescription.
prescription.zh: 这些药没有处方不能出售。

brick.zh: 那所学校是用砖建造的。
他从一座砖拱门下面走过。
砖块哗啦一声砸入了窗户。

recruit.en: He is hoping to recruit a chairman from outside the company.
recruit.zh: 他在希望从公司之外招聘一位董事长。

recruit.en: The police are trying to recruit more black and Hispanic officers.
recruit.zh: 警方正试图招收更多的黑人和西班牙裔的警官。

recruit.en: The police are trying to recruit more officers from ethnic minorities.
recruit.zh: 警察机关正试图从少数民族中征募更多的新警员。

consensus.en: There is a growing consensus of opinion on this issue.
consensus.zh: 对这个问题的看法日趋一致。

consensus.en: There is a general consensus among teachers about the need for greater security in schools.
consensus.zh: 教师们对必须加强学校的保安有普遍的共识。

consensus.en: The consensus among the world's scientists is that the world is likely to warm up over the next few decades.
consensus.zh: 全世界科学家的共识是地球可能在未来几十年中变暖。

patch.en: He had a black patch over one eye.
Our dog has a bald patch on its leg.
patch.zh: 我们的狗腿上脱了一片毛。

colonial.en: His guerrillas defeated the colonial army in 1954.
colonial.zh: 他的游击队在1954年打败了殖民军。

colonial.en: Tunisia achieved independence from French colonial rule in 1956.
colonial.zh: 突尼斯于1956年从法国的殖民统治下获得独立。

colonial.en: Why are you interested in doing something on community planning in colonial times?
colonial.zh: 你为什么对殖民时期的社区规划方面感兴趣？

sake.en: You can do it. Please, for my sake.
sake.zh: 这个你是能做的。求你了，就算为了我。

sake.en: They stayed together for the sake of the children.
sake.zh: 为了孩子，他们还待在一起。

pregnancy.en: Pregnancy is a natural part of womanhood.
pregnancy.zh: 怀孕是女子成年期的一个自然部分。

gaze.zh: 她用目光缓缓扫视了一下室内。
我的双眼迎视他冰冷的目光。

reinforce.en: I hope this will reinforce Indonesian determination to deal with this kind of threat.
reinforce.zh: 我希望这会加强印度尼西亚对付这类威胁的决心。

reinforce.en: Remember you want your visuals to reinforce your message, not detract from what you are saying.
reinforce.zh: 要记住，你是要用视觉资料来强化你的信息，而不是削弱你所讲述的内容。

reinforce.en: We agreed on a form of splint to reinforce the damaged portion.
reinforce.zh: 我们同意用一种夹板来加固损坏的部分。

clue.en: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
clue.zh: 关于杀手身份的重大线索是他的绰号——花生。

clue.en: Geneticists in Canada have discovered a clue to the puzzle of why our cells get old and die.
clue.zh: 加拿大的遗传学家已经发现了解开我们细胞衰老死亡之迷的线索。

occupation.en: Her main occupation seems to be shopping.
occupation.zh: 逛商店购物似乎是她的主要消遣。

occupation.en: I suppose I was looking for an occupation which was going to be an adventure.
occupation.zh: 我想我那时在寻找一份冒险型职业。

occupation.en: You will be asked to fill in a form with details of your birth and occupation.
occupation.zh: 你会被要求填写一张有关你的出生和职业详情的表格。

confusion.zh: 曼迪的主导情绪是困惑。

confusion.en: Teddy turned to Mona with a look of mild confusion.
confusion.zh: 特迪转向莫娜，脸上带着些许困惑。

confusion.en: There followed a long period of confusion and muddle.
confusion.zh: 接下来是很长一段时间的困惑和混乱。

sacred.zh: 印度教徒把牛奉为圣物。

sacred.en: The owl is sacred for many Californian Indian people.
sacred.zh: 猫头鹰对于很多加利福利亚的印第安人来说是神圣的。

sacred.en: The eagle is the animal most sacred to the Native Americans.
sacred.zh: 鹰是印第安人眼中最为神圣的动物。

formula.en: This formula is used to calculate the area of a circle.
formula.zh: 这个公式用于计算圆的面积。

formula.en: CO is the formula for carbon monoxide.

cognitive.en: As children grow older, their cognitive processes become sharper.
cognitive.zh: 随着孩子们长大，他们的认知过程也变得越来越敏锐了。

cognitive.en: They lack the cognitive and memory skills.
cognitive.zh: 他们缺乏认知和记忆能力。

cognitive.en: What kinds of cognitive abilities are we talking about?
cognitive.zh: 我们所说的是哪些类型的认知能力呢？

collective.en: He will see that he is participating in all the decisions of the collective.
collective.zh: 他要确保他在参与集体企业的所有决策。

collective.en: This principle of collective bargaining has been a mainstay in labour relations in this country.
collective.zh: 这种集体谈判原则已成为该国劳动关系的一个重要基础。

homeless.en: He was homeless, so we took him in.
homeless.zh: 他无家可归，我们便收留了他。

homeless.en: This project is designed to help homeless people.
homeless.zh: 这个项目旨在帮助无家可归的人。

homeless.en: London is full of homeless people begging in the streets.
homeless.zh: 伦敦大街上到处都是无家可归的乞丐。

attribute.en: Each level should have exactly one caption attribute.
attribute.zh: 每个级别都应该有一个标题属性。

attribute.en: People were beginning to attribute superhuman qualities to him.
attribute.zh: 人们开始赋予他超人的品质。

attribute.en: The committee refused to attribute blame without further information.
attribute.zh: 如果没有进一步的情况，委员会拒绝归罪于任何人。

sigh.en: We all heaved a sigh of relief.
sigh.zh: 我们都如释重负地舒了一口气。

sigh.en: Mr. Collier heaved a sigh and got to his feet.
sigh.zh: 科利尔先生深深叹了一口气，然后站起身。

dare.en: You told him? How did you dare?
How dare you talk back to me!

tunnel.en: The tunnel was blasted out of solid rock.
tunnel.zh: 这条隧道是在坚固的岩石中炸出来的。

defendant.zh: 陪审团作出了对被告有利的裁决。

defendant.en: The defendant pleaded guilty and was fined $500.
The defendant drove negligently and hit a lamp post.
defendant.zh: 被告不小心驾驶，撞到一根路灯柱上了。

fitness.zh: 他对健身过于忧心忡忡。

fitness.en: Fitness has become an obsession with him.
The long climb tested our fitness and stamina.
fitness.zh: 那次长距离爬山是对我们健康状况和耐力的考验。

grave.zh: 死者亲属在墓前献了花圈。

grave.en: They stood in silent homage around the grave.
grave.zh: 他们恭敬地站在坟墓周围致默哀礼。

container.en: The metal container began to emit a clicking sound.
container.zh: 金属容器开始发出咔嗒咔嗒的声音。

container.en: Do not fill the container more than two-thirds full.
container.zh: 加入的量不要超过容器总容量的2/3。

container.en: Food will last longer if kept in an airtight container.
container.zh: 如果贮藏在密封的容器里，食物能保持比较久的时间。

lap.zh: 她双目低垂，看着自己的腿。

lap.en: He was overtaken on the final lap.
She sat with her hands in her lap.
lap.zh: 她双手放在大腿上坐着。

virtue.en: The plan has the virtue of simplicity.
virtue.zh: 这项计划的优点是简单。

virtue.en: She was certainly no paragon of virtue !
virtue.zh: 她决不是道德高尚的典范！

dramatically.en: The cost of living has increased dramatically.
dramatically.zh: 生活费用已大幅增长了。

dramatically.en: The number of homeless people has increased dramatically.
dramatically.zh: 无家可归者的人数急剧增加了。

dramatically.en: At speeds above 50 mph, serious injuries dramatically increase.
dramatically.zh: 时速超过50英里时，重伤机率急剧上升。

indication.en: There is no indication which way the vote could go.
indication.zh: 没有迹象表明投票的结果会怎么样。

indication.en: He searched Hill's impassive face for some indication that he understood.
indication.zh: 他在希尔没有表情的脸上搜寻着一些他理解的迹象。

indication.en: There had been no indication of either breathlessness or any loss of mental faculties right until his death.
indication.zh: 直到去世，他既没有出现呼吸困难也没有脑功能丧失的迹象。

architect.en: The architect drew the house in section.
architect.zh: 建筑师绘制了房子的剖面图。

architect.en: The architect stepped back to admire his handiwork.
architect.zh: 建筑师向后退了退，欣赏着自己的作品。

architect.en: The architect is drawing up plans for the new offices.
architect.zh: 建筑师正在绘制新办公楼的设计图。

anniversary.zh: 今天是我们的结婚纪念日。
今天是我们的周年纪念日。

anniversary.en: We celebrated our 25th wedding anniversary in Florence.
anniversary.zh: 我们在佛罗伦萨庆祝结婚25周年。

rail.en: Raw materials and labour come by ship , rail or road.
rail.zh: 从水上、铁路和公路运来原料和工人。

rail.en: Ticket prices include your flight and onward rail journey.
rail.zh: 票价包括您的飞行航程和接续的铁路旅费。

rail.en: She climbed the staircase cautiously, holding fast to the rail.
rail.zh: 她紧握扶手，小心翼翼地爬上楼梯。

couch.en: She slipped out of the jacket and tossed it on the couch.
couch.zh: 她快速脱下了那件上衣，把它丢在沙发上。

couch.en: We were sitting on the couch in the living room watching TV.
couch.zh: 我们那时正坐在起居室的沙发上看电视。

couch.en: Linda lay face down on a living room couch, nibbling popcorn.
couch.zh: 琳达趴在客厅的一张沙发上，小口吃着爆米花。

alliance.en: The alliance stands ready to do what is necessary.
alliance.zh: 该联盟已准备好采取必要行动。

alliance.en: Art shouldn't enter an unholy alliance with business.
alliance.zh: 艺术不该和商业成为错误的同盟。

alliance.en: They joined with a ramshackle alliance of other rebels.
alliance.zh: 他们加入了一个其他反叛分子拼凑起来的联盟。

hypothesis.en: Work will now begin to test the hypothesis in rats.
hypothesis.zh: 在老鼠身上验证这一假设的工作现在要开始了。

hypothesis.en: The statistics to prove or disprove his hypothesis will take years to collect.
hypothesis.zh: 要花数年来收集证实或推翻他的假设的数据。
伽利略提出了一种新的假设。

compose.en: Protein molecules compose all the complex working parts of living cells.
compose.zh: 蛋白质分子构成了活细胞所有复杂的工作部件。

compose.en: He started at once to compose a reply to Anna.
compose.zh: 他立刻开始给安娜写回信。

legend.en: She was a legend in her own lifetime.
legend.zh: 她在世的时候就是一个传奇人物。

legend.en: The castle is steeped in history and legend.
legend.zh: 这座城堡充满着历史和传奇色彩。

legend.en: It is difficult to separate legend from truth.

regulate.en: The FCC has no statutory authority to regulate the Internet.
regulate.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会没有规范因特网的法定权力。

regulate.en: Under such a plan, the government would regulate competition among insurance companies so that everyone gets care at lower cost.
regulate.zh: 根据这样一个计划，政府会控制保险公司之间的竞争，这样每个人都能以较低价格获得保险。

regulate.en: The government should regulate the app-based car rental market.
regulate.zh: 政府应规范以应用软件为基础的汽车租赁市场。

adolescent.zh: 多数青春期的问题都是暂时的。

adolescent.en: He was showing off, as is the way with adolescent boys.
adolescent.zh: 他在炫耀，青春期的男孩都是这个样子。

adolescent.en: A little adolescent rebellion is commonly believed to be healthy.
adolescent.zh: 少许青春期叛逆被普遍认为是一个健康的现象。

norm.en: How did smiling in photographs become a post-Victorian norm?
norm.zh: 照片中的笑容是如何成为后维多利亚时代的行为准则的？

norm.en: They take touching as a cultural norm in social interactions.
norm.zh: 他们将触碰视为社会交往中的一种文化规范。

norm.en: Non-smoking is now the norm in most workplaces.
norm.zh: 大多数工作场所现在都已禁止吸烟。

resign.en: He was under strong pressure to resign.
resign.zh: 他承受着要辞职的巨大压力。

organ.en: The largest organ in the body is the liver.
organ.zh: 体内最大的器官是肝脏。

organ.en: The patient's immune system would reject the transplanted organ as a foreign object.
organ.zh: 该病人的免疫系统会将移植器官作为异物加以排斥。

organ.en: Organ donation to strangers is considered an unselfish act.
organ.zh: 捐赠器官给陌生人是一种无私的行为。

concerning.en: He asked several questions concerning the future of the company.
concerning.zh: 他问了几个有关公司前途的问题。

concerning.en: All cases concerning children are dealt with in a special children's court.
concerning.zh: 所有涉及儿童的案件均由儿童特别法庭审理。

concerning.en: His work is full of profundities and asides concerning the human condition.
concerning.zh: 他的作品充满了有关人类境况的深邃见解和话外音。

receiver.zh: 他砰的一声将电话听筒摔下来。

receiver.en: The receiver had already clicked into place.
receiver.zh: 听筒咔的一声放回原位了。

receiver.en: She picked up the receiver and started to dial.

salmon.zh: 他们在狭长海湾里钓鲑鱼。

salmon.en: At the reception they served smoked salmon.
salmon.zh: 在招待会上，他们端上了熏三文鱼。

salmon.en: He gave them a splendid lunch of smoked salmon.
salmon.zh: 他款待了他们一顿极好的熏三文鱼午餐。

ritual.en: It is a familiar, and quintessentially Japanese ritual.
ritual.zh: 它是个熟悉而又典型的日式仪式。

ritual.en: Sunday lunch with the in-laws has become something of a ritual.
ritual.zh: 星期天，和姻亲们共进午餐已经成了例行的公事。

ritual.en: Their mating ritual is just so impersonal.
ritual.zh: 它们的求偶仪式是如此的没有人情味。

superior.zh: 他总是显得那么有优越感。
芬奇富有优越感地一笑。
敌人拥有战术上的优势。

combat.en: It was the end of a long combat.
combat.zh: 那是一场长时间搏斗的结束。

combat.en: Over 16 million men had died in combat.
combat.zh: 一千六百多万人在战斗中阵亡。

combat.en: The government is taking action to combat drug abuse.
combat.zh: 政府正在采取措施，打击滥用毒品。

surgeon.en: I knew that I owed the surgeon my life.
surgeon.zh: 我明白外科医生救了我的命。

surgeon.en: He is reputed to be the best heart surgeon in the country.
surgeon.zh: 他号称是这个国家最好的心脏外科医生。

surgeon.en: The surgeon would pick up his instruments, probe, repair, and stitch up again.
surgeon.zh: 外科医生会拿起器械进行探查、修复，然后再缝合。

stem.en: Stem cell research is supported by many doctors.
stem.zh: 干细胞研究得到很多医生的支持。

stem.en: The plant's stem is marked with thin green longitudinal stripes.
stem.zh: 这种植物的茎上长有绿色细长条纹。

stem.en: 'Writ' is the stem of the forms 'writes', 'writing' and 'written'.

log.en: You need a password to log on.
The system is unable to log you on.
log.zh: 这个系统无法让你登录。

log.en: Customers pay to log on and gossip with other users.
log.zh: 顾客们花钱登录，与其他用户闲聊。

counsel.en: He had always been able to count on her wise counsel.
counsel.zh: 他总是能够指望她明智的忠告。

counsel.en: The court then heard counsel for the dead woman's father.
counsel.zh: 法庭接着听取了女死者的父亲所请律师的陈述。

counsel.en: Counsel for the defence submitted that the evidence was inadmissible.
counsel.zh: 被告律师认为这一证据不可采纳。

echo.en: The hills sent back a faint echo.
echo.zh: 座座山丘传来微弱的回声。

echo.en: There was an echo on the line and I couldn't hear clearly.
echo.zh: 电话里有回音，我听不清楚。

echo.en: His words were an echo of what she had heard many times before.
echo.zh: 他的话是她多次听到过的话的重复。

pill.en: I took a pill to help settle my nerves.
pill.zh: 我吃了一片药，好放松一下神经。

pill.en: She had been on the pill for three years.
Every pill made my insides turn upside down.
pill.zh: 每片药都使我的胃翻江倒海。

sculpture.en: I take no real interest in monumental sculpture.
sculpture.zh: 我对宏伟的雕塑并没有真正感兴趣。

compound.en: Common salt is a compound of sodium and chlorine.
compound.zh: 普通食盐是钠和氯的化合物。

compound.en: A compound sentence contains two or more clauses.
compound.zh: 复合句包含两个或多个从句。

compound.en: Honey is basically a compound of water, two types of sugar, vitamins and enzymes.
compound.zh: 蜂蜜主要是水、两种糖、维生素和酶的混合物。

bare.en: The hills above the valley are bare rock.
bare.zh: 河谷上面的山是光秃秃的岩石。

integrate.en: He didn't integrate successfully into the Italian way of life.
integrate.zh: 他没有成功融入到意大利的生活方式中去。

integrate.en: They have not made any effort to integrate with the local community.
integrate.zh: 他们完全没有尝试融入本地社区。

integrate.en: The strategy is to integrate the development of these cities for a better economic structure.
integrate.zh: 策略就是整合这些城市的发展，以便形成更好的经济结构。

slope.en: The town is built on a slope.

slope.zh: 过了一英里后，山坡变陡了。

slope.en: The street must have been on a slope.
slope.zh: 那条街一定是一直在一个斜坡上。

subtle.en: But TV images require subtle gradations of light and shade.
subtle.zh: 但是电视影像需要有细微的光影变化。

subtle.en: Her paintings capture the subtle hues of the countryside in autumn.
subtle.zh: 她的油画捕捉住了秋天乡村的微妙色调。
那项工作需要一个头脑敏锐的人去做。

acceptance.en: The new laws have gained widespread acceptance.
The acceptance of new members is strictly controlled.
acceptance.zh: 接纳新成员的工作受到严格控制。

acceptance.en: Social acceptance is important for most young people.
acceptance.zh: 对大多数青年来说，为社会所接纳很重要。

sponsor.en: Please could you sponsor me for my school's campaign for Help the Aged?
sponsor.zh: 请问你们能赞助我开展我校的“帮助老年人”活动吗？

sponsor.en: The company plans to sponsor television programmes as part of its marketing strategy.
sponsor.zh: 公司计划赞助电视节目，以此作为营销策略之一。

sponsor.en: Adidas is an official sponsor of the World Cup, so its logo appears on the field.
sponsor.zh: 阿迪达斯是世界杯的官方赞助商，所以，它的标志出现在赛场上。

pump.en: The pump sucks air out through the valve.
pump.zh: 气泵通过阀门把空气抽出去。

pump.en: I left my purse back there on the gas pump.
pump.zh: 我把钱包忘在那儿的油泵上了。

pump.en: The pump doesn't work and we have no running water.
pump.zh: 这个水泵不运转了，我们没有自来水。

ethical.en: The trade association promotes ethical business practices.
ethical.zh: 这个贸易协会提倡合乎道德标准的商业行为。

ethical.en: These shoppers are concerned with some ethical issues.
ethical.zh: 这些购物者也关心一些道德问题。

ethical.en: How can one become an ethical shopper when buying things?
ethical.zh: 一个人在买东西的时候怎样才能成为一个有道德的购物者呢？

experimental.en: The equipment is still at the experimental stage.
experimental.zh: 这种设备仍处于试验阶段。

experimental.en: The senator is ready to argue for an experimental lifting of the ban.
experimental.zh: 该参议员已准备好争取那条禁令的试验性解除。

experimental.en: For the time being, however, immunotherapy is still in its experimental stages.
experimental.zh: 然而，目前免疫疗法还处于试验阶段。

civilization.en: I finally reached what we laughingly call civilization.
civilization.zh: 我终于到了我们戏称为文明之地的地方。

civilization.en: Environmental damage threatens the whole of civilization.
civilization.zh: 环境的破坏威胁着整个文明世界。

civilization.en: It's good to be back in civilization after two weeks in a tent!
civilization.zh: 在帐篷里住了两个星期后又回到人类文明的生活可真好呀！

melt.en: As the climate warms (up) the ice caps will melt.
melt.zh: 随着气候变暖，冰盖将融化。

slam.zh: 他们在1990年赢得了大满贯。

slam.en: I heard the door slam behind him.
slam.zh: 我听见他随手砰地把门关上了。

slam.en: She gave the door a good hard slam.
slam.zh: 她使劲一推，门砰的一声关上了。

integrity.zh: 他的诚实正直未受到过质疑。

integrity.en: Mayhew is a man of rock-solid integrity.
integrity.zh: 梅休是一个正直可靠的男人。

integrity.en: I have always regarded him as a man of integrity.
integrity.zh: 我一直把他看作个正直的男人。

entitle.en: This ticket does not entitle you to travel first class.
entitle.zh: 你拿这张票不能坐头等舱。

entitle.en: If the warranty is limited, the terms may entitle you to a replacement or refund.
entitle.zh: 如果保修单有限制，这些条款可让你有权换货或退款。

entitle.en: Golden parachutes entitle them to a full year's salary if they get booted out of the company.
entitle.zh: 黄金降落伞使他们一旦被公司解雇将有权获得一整年的薪水。

evident.en: The threat of inflation is already evident in bond prices.
evident.zh: 通货膨胀的威胁在证券价格上已经是明显可见的。

evident.en: It was evident that someone had gone through my possessions.
evident.zh: 显然有人翻过我的物品。

evident.en: The privations of monastery life were evident in his appearance.
evident.zh: 修道院生活的清苦从他的穿着外表明显地表露出来。

essence.en: The essence of dialectical thought is division.
essence.zh: 辩证思想的实质是二分法。

essence.en: Though complicated in detail, local taxes are in essence simple.
essence.zh: 虽然细节复杂，地方税本质上是简单的。

essence.en: For many, the essence of French living is to be found in the rural heartlands.
essence.zh: 对许多人来说，法国生活方式的精髓要到心脏地带的乡村去寻找。

logic.en: I had to concede the logic of this.
logic.zh: 我得承认这件事情有它的逻辑。

logic.en: I don't follow the logic of your argument.
logic.zh: 我不理解你观点的逻辑。

logic.en: I fail to see the logic behind his argument.
logic.zh: 我不明白支持他论据的是什么逻辑。

exclude.en: She gets very upset if I exclude her from anything.
exclude.zh: 如果有什么事我将她排除在外，她就会非常难过。

exclude.en: We should not exclude the possibility of negotiation.
exclude.zh: 我们不应该排除谈判的可能性。

exclude.en: I cannot entirely exclude the possibility that some form of pressure was applied to the neck.
exclude.zh: 我不能完全排除有些压力作用到了颈部的可能性。

harsh.en: If that sounds harsh, it is meant to.
harsh.zh: 如果那声音听起来是刺耳的，它就是如此。
部长受到了严厉的批评。

suburban.en: And there isn't good public transportation from inner city Detroit to those suburban malls.
