thereby.zh: 这给你了一个机会去为他人祈祷和祝福，从而赐福给你自己。

feedback.en: The teacher will give you feedback on the test.
feedback.zh: 老师会对你的测验提供反馈信息。

feedback.en: We didn't know that the feedback meant.
feedback.zh: 我们不知道那些反馈意见代表着什么。

feedback.en: It can provide students with instant feedback.
feedback.zh: 它可以为学生提供即时反馈。

spectrum.en: Red and violet are at opposite ends of the spectrum.
spectrum.zh: 红色和紫色位于光谱的两端。

spectrum.en: A spectrum is formed by a ray of light passing through a prism.
spectrum.zh: 一束光通过棱镜就会形成光谱。
你不能从（信念）范围上跳下来。

indicator.en: But it's not the only indicator and, paradoxically, its significance is declining.
indicator.zh: 但这并不是唯一的指标，而且矛盾的是，它的重要性正在下降。

indicator.en: As an indicator of shifts in the Earth's climate, the isotope record has two advantages.
indicator.zh: 作为地球气候变化的指标，同位素记录有两个优势。

indicator.en: Yes, the power indicator was on, and it was running, but somehow the sound didn't come through.
indicator.zh: 是的，电源指示灯是亮的，机器也正在运行，但是不知怎么的声音就是出不来。

laser.en: She's had laser surgery on her eye.
The print quality of the new laser printer is superb.
laser.zh: 新激光打印机的打印质量好极了。

laser.en: Laser discs can store prodigious amounts of information.
laser.zh: 激光磁盘能够贮存大量信息。

bold.zh: 在1960年，这是一个大胆的举动。
阿莫瑞塔成了一位英勇无畏的反叛者。

bold.en: Big, successful moves need bold, masterful managers.
bold.zh: 大的成功的行动需要大胆有驾驭力的管理者。

reluctant.en: Mr. Spero was reluctant to ask for help.
reluctant.zh: 斯珀洛先生不愿意请求帮助。

reluctant.en: She was reluctant to admit she was wrong.
We were reluctant to start the long trudge home.
reluctant.zh: 我们不情愿的开始长途跋涉回家。

expertise.en: Griffith's expertise is in writing legal briefs.
expertise.zh: 格里菲思的专长在于撰写法律案情摘要。

expertise.en: We have the expertise to help you run your business.
expertise.zh: 我们有帮助你经营自己业务的专门知识。

expertise.en: We need to tap the expertise of the people we already have.
expertise.zh: 我们需要利用我们现有人员的专业知识。

practically.zh: 实际说来，我们买不起这东西。

practically.en: I meet famous people practically every day.
practically.zh: 我几乎每天都见到名人。

parade.en: Felipe was in uniform for the parade.
He is not one to parade his achievements.
parade.zh: 他不是一个爱炫耀自己成就的人。

parade.en: The carnival parade was a magnificent spectacle.
parade.zh: 狂欢节游行场面热烈，蔚为大观。

hint.en: She let fall a further heavy hint.
hint.zh: 她似乎无意中又说出了一个明显的提示。

hint.en: It was the barest hint of a smile.
hint.zh: 那是一个几乎不露一丝痕迹的笑。

hint.en: There was not a hint of badness in him.

realm.zh: 王国的防御是至关重要的。

realm.en: In the realm of olfaction, we must make do with descriptions and recollections.
realm.zh: 在嗅觉领域，我们只能勉强依赖于描述与回忆。

realm.en: Smirks, raised eyebrows, and quizzical looks are not out of the realm of possibility.
realm.zh: 傻笑、扬起的眉毛和戏弄的样子都是在可能出现的范围之内的。

blend.en: It's a class move, allowing new and old to blend seamlessly.
blend.zh: 这是一次班级活动，让新老同学亲密无间地融合在一起。

recipient.en: If you are submitting your resume in English, find out if the recipient uses British English or American English because there are variations between the two versions.
recipient.zh: 如果你要提交英文简历，要弄清楚收件人使用的是英式英语还是美式英语，因为两者是有区别的。

recipient.en: With so many ways to communicate, how should a manager choose the one that's best—particularly when the message to be delivered is bad or unwelcome news for the recipient?
recipient.zh: 有如此丰富的沟通方式，经理应该如何选择最好的方式——特别是当你要传递的消息对接收者来说是坏消息或是不受欢迎的消息时？

recipient.en: Gift certificates are personalized with both the recipient and giver names.
recipient.zh: 礼品券上标明了获得者和给予者的名字。

accounting.en: The debate revolves around specific accounting techniques.
accounting.zh: 这场讨论围绕具体的会计技巧。

accounting.en: But full cost accounting will be introduced without delay.
accounting.zh: 但是，全面成本核算马上将被采用。

accounting.en: Most large companies now use computers for accounting and housekeeping operations.
accounting.zh: 多数大公司现在用计算机进行会计运算和内务操作。

peel.en: The paint is starting to peel off.
Will you peel the potatoes for me?
peel.zh: 你给我削土豆皮好不好？

flip.en: The handstand was followed by a back flip.

bias.en: The course has a strong practical bias.
Bias against women permeates every level of the judicial system.
bias.zh: 对妇女的偏见全面影响司法体系的各个层面。

bias.en: Be careful you don't leave yourself open to charges of political bias.
bias.zh: 你要小心别留下把柄，让人家指责你带有政治偏见。

metaphor.en: Confession is a bad metaphor for what those poets did.
metaphor.zh: 忏悔录并不能很好地比喻那些诗人的所作所为。

metaphor.en: This is a metaphor used to illustrate this observation.
metaphor.zh: 这是一个用来说明这一观察的隐喻。

diplomatic.en: The phrase is common diplomatic parlance for spying.
diplomatic.zh: 这种说法是对间谍行为的常用外交辞令。
英国和阿根廷重新建立了外交关系。

diplomatic.en: The two countries have severed all diplomatic links.
diplomatic.zh: 两国断绝了一切外交关系。

judicial.en: The case is subject to judicial review.
judicial.zh: 这个案子必须接受司法审查。

judicial.en: He had the state's judicial power behind him.
judicial.zh: 他有国家司法力量在其背后支持他。

judicial.en: Bias against women permeates every level of the judicial system.
judicial.zh: 对妇女的偏见全面影响司法体系的各个层面。

entity.en: These countries can no longer be viewed as a single entity.
entity.zh: 这些国家不能再被看成是一个单独的实体。

entity.en: He rescued the company and later spun off its textile division into a separate entity.
entity.zh: 他挽救了该公司，后来又把它的纺织部脱离出来组建成一个独立实体。

entity.en: The unit has become part of a larger department and no longer exists as a separate entity.
entity.zh: 这个单位已附属于一个大的部门，不再作为一个实体独立存在。

garbage.en: Dig a pit and bury the garbage.
Put the lid on the garbage can.

garbage.zh: 一般的垃圾会被送到一般的垃圾填埋场。

automatically.zh: 该供暖系统可自动关闭。
那个装置自动断开了点火器。

minimize.zh: 把你打开的所有窗口最小化。

minimize.en: Good hygiene helps to minimize the risk of infection.
minimize.zh: 保持清洁有助于最大限度地减少感染的危险。

minimize.en: Concerned people want to minimize the risk of developing cancer.
minimize.zh: 忧心忡忡的人们想把患上癌症的风险降到最低。

reception.zh: 招待会开得冷冷清清的。
所有来宾必须到接待处报到。

reception.en: You can leave a message with reception.
reception.zh: 你可以在接待处留个口信。

elegant.en: She is always so chic, so elegant.
elegant.zh: 她总是那么时髦，那么优雅。

elegant.en: She was an elegant and accomplished woman.

chin.en: She landed a punch on his chin.
chin.zh: 她对着他的下巴揍了一拳。
她若有所思地抚摩着下巴。
约翰打个哈欠，挠挠下巴。

racism.en: Racism has been a scar on the game.
racism.zh: 种族主义行为给这项运动抹了黑。

racism.en: We need to purge our sport of racism.
racism.zh: 我们必须消除体育界的种族主义。
恐惧心理会助长种族主义。

vanish.en: Ann saw the cheer vanish from her children face.
vanish.zh: 安看到孩子们脸上的笑容消失了。

vanish.en: The track seemed to vanish a hundred yards from where I stood.
vanish.zh: 离我站的地方一百码远，小路似乎消失了。

vanish.en: Some people believe that schools and libraries will vanish in the wake of the Internet.
vanish.zh: 一些人相信，在互联网到来之后，学校和图书馆会消失。

confess.en: We persuaded her to confess her crime.
confess.zh: 我们说服她坦白她的罪行。

confess.en: She was reluctant to confess her ignorance.
confess.zh: 她不愿意承认自己无知。

confess.en: "I confess to being a big wuss," she admitted.
confess.zh: “我承认我是个胆小鬼。”她实话实说。

necessity.en: Water is a basic necessity of life.
necessity.zh: 水是一种基本生活必需品。

necessity.en: There is agreement on the necessity of reforms.
necessity.zh: 关于改革的必要性有一致意见。

necessity.en: We were discussing the necessity of employing more staff.
necessity.zh: 我们在讨论是否需要雇用更多员工。

banking.en: She's thinking about a career in banking.
banking.zh: 她正在考虑从事银行业。

banking.en: Bankers were fearful of a world banking crisis.
banking.zh: 银行家们害怕会有一场世界性的银行业危机。

gravity.en: I don't think you realise the gravity of the situation.
gravity.zh: 我认为你没有意识到形势的严重性。

gravity.en: Arrows would continue to fly forward forever in a straight line were it not for gravity, which brings them down to earth.
gravity.zh: 要不是重力使箭掉落地上，它将会一直沿直线往前飞行。

gravity.en: How low gravity affects the human body.

casual.zh: 这个男孩嘻皮笑脸、随随便便。
她的穿着随意而不失雅致。

casual.en: The disease is not spread by casual contact.
casual.zh: 此病不会通过偶然接触传染。

diminish.en: Deserts in sub-Saharan Africa will diminish gradually.
diminish.zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的沙漠将逐渐减少。

diminish.en: In zones of increased turbulence, the planes' wakes will decay more quickly and the effect will diminish.
diminish.zh: 在湍流增强的区域，飞机的尾流会消失得更快，它的效果也会减弱。

diminish.en: Conversely, teachers who have a tendency to "overdirect" can diminish their gifted pupils' learning autonomy.
diminish.zh: 相反，有“过度指导”倾向的教师会削弱天才学生的学习自主性。

intent.en: His intent is clearly not to placate his critics.
intent.zh: 他的目的显然不是要安抚批评他的人。

intent.en: I was so intent on my work that I didn't notice the time.
intent.zh: 我专心工作，以致忘了时间。

intent.en: His intent was to connect college students.
intent.zh: 他的目的是把大学生联系起来。

isolate.en: Researchers are still trying to isolate the gene that causes this abnormality.
isolate.zh: 研究人员仍然在试图分离导致这种畸形的基因。

isolate.en: This policy could isolate the country from the other permanent members of the United Nations Security Council.
isolate.zh: 这项政策可能会将这个国家从联合国安理会的其他常任理事国中孤立出来。

isolate.en: Element 43's radioactivity makes it easy to isolate and measure.
isolate.zh: 43号元素的放射性使其易于分离和测量。

chop.en: Three more schemes have got the chop.
chop.zh: 又有三个方案遭斧削了。

chop.en: Sometimes they have to chop down a tree for firewood.
chop.zh: 有时他们不得不砍倒一棵树来做木柴。

chop.en: You peel the onions and wash them, then chop them.
chop.zh: 你把洋葱削一下，再洗洗，然后再切碎。

assembly.en: He was to address a public assembly on the issue.
assembly.zh: 他要对公众集会发表演说谈论这个问题。

assembly.en: The assembly was mandated to draft a constitution.
assembly.zh: 大会被授权起草一份章程。

assembly.en: Last year the millionth truck rolled off the assembly line.
assembly.zh: 去年，第100万辆卡车驶下了装配线。

productive.en: He was hopeful that the next round of talks would also be productive.
productive.zh: 他对下一轮会谈也会富有成效充满了希望。

productive.en: Too much spending on rearmament would place an insupportable burden on the nation's productive capacity.
productive.zh: 过于庞大的重整军备开支会给国家的生产力带来难以承受的负担。

inventory.en: They're likely to hold big fire sales to liquidate their inventory.
inventory.zh: 为了盘活库存，他们很可能会进行大甩卖。

inventory.en: I did all of the ordering for the store, and I kept track of the inventory.
inventory.zh: 我为店里做了所有的订单，并记录了库存情况。

inventory.en: This concept appears in manufacturing where they count both scrap and inventory.
inventory.zh: 这一概念出现在制造业中，在其中计算废料和库存。

magnitude.en: We did not realize the magnitude of the problem.
magnitude.zh: 我们没有意识到这个问题的重要性。

magnitude.en: America and Russia do not face a problem of the same order of magnitude as Japan.
magnitude.zh: 美俄两国没有面临与日本同样的重要级别的问题。

magnitude.en: The devastating 7.9 magnitude Sichuan earthquake which killed about 90,000 people in western China.
magnitude.zh: 四川破坏力极强的7.9级地震导致中国西部约9万人死亡。

hostage.en: There was none of the drama and relief of a hostage release.
hostage.zh: 丝毫没有人质释放的戏剧性场面和放松。

hostage.en: He must be treated as a hostage of high rank, not as a common prisoner.
hostage.zh: 他一定要作为一个高级人质而不是一般囚徒来对待。

hostage.en: He momentarily confounded his critics by his cool handling of the hostage crisis.
hostage.zh: 他通过冷静处理人质危机顿时使他的批评者们大吃一惊。

steep.en: The path led up a steep hill.
steep.zh: 小路通向一座陡峭的山丘。
他们爬上了一个陡峭的堤岸。
我们把车开上了陡峭的峡谷。

popularity.zh: 近来他已不如过去那样受欢迎。

popularity.en: Her popularity clearly shows no sign of waning.
popularity.zh: 她的受欢迎程度显然没有显示出下降的迹象。

popularity.en: Her popularity has been on the wane for some time.
popularity.zh: 她的人气一段时间以来江河日下。

alien.en: Such an attitude is alien to most businessmen.
alien.zh: 这种态度对大多数商人都很陌生。

alien.en: In a world that had suddenly become alien and dangerous, he was her only security.
alien.zh: 在一个突然变得陌生而危险的世界里，他是她唯一的守护神。

alien.en: It is a paradise of romance for alien life.
alien.zh: 它是外星生命的浪漫天堂。

equation.en: X and Y in the equation are both unknowns.
equation.zh: 等式中的X和Y都是未知数。

equation.en: This figure is reached by a fiendishly clever equation.
equation.zh: 这个数值是用及其巧妙的方程解出来的。

equation.en: The equation is impossible for any value of n greater than 2.
equation.zh: 这个等式对于任何大于2的数值都不成立。

dynamic.en: The dynamic of the market demands constant change and adjustment.
dynamic.zh: 市场的动力要求有不断的变化和调整。

dynamic.en: The programme is 90 minutes of dynamic Indian folk dance, live music, and storytelling.
dynamic.zh: 该节目为90 分钟，由动感印度民间舞蹈、现场音乐表演和说书组成。

dynamic.en: He seemed a dynamic and energetic leader.
dynamic.zh: 他看来是个富有创新力与活力的领导。

precious.en: Her family's support is particularly precious to Josie.
precious.zh: 家人的支持对乔茜尤为珍贵。

precious.en: A family break allows you to spend precious time together.
precious.zh: 一次家庭休假使你有机会和家人共度宝贵时光。

prohibit.en: Surfwatch allows parents to prohibit access to specific web sites, newsgroups, and bulletin boards.
prohibit.zh: 过滤器软件可以让父母禁止对特定的网站、新闻组和电子布告栏的访问。

prohibit.en: Record's suggestion is to prohibit agents from hiring models with a BMI below 18.
prohibit.zh: 克劳德的建议是禁止代理公司雇用身体质量指数低于18的模特。

prohibit.en: The trade laws did prohibit Anglo-Americans from competing with large-scale British manufacturing of certain products, most notably clothing.
prohibit.zh: 在英国大规模生产的某些产品上，贸易法确实禁止英裔美国人与英国竞争，尤其是服装产业。

realistic.en: We are now far more sober and realistic.
realistic.zh: 我们现在严肃多了，也现实多了。

realistic.en: These proposals represent a realistic starting point for negotiation.
realistic.zh: 这些提议代表着谈判的一个现实起点。
我们必须制订可实现的目标。

gathering.en: We will be exploring different approaches to gathering information.
gathering.zh: 我们将探索收集信息的不同方法。

outstanding.zh: 毋庸置疑，他是一个出色的人。

outstanding.en: He's known to be an outstanding physicist.
outstanding.zh: 他被公认为杰出的物理学家。

stumble.en: I hope you don't stumble over any event during the holiday.
stumble.zh: 我希望您不要绊倒在假期中的任何事件上。

stumble.en: She whirled suddenly, one arm reaching for something near her side but failed, and it made her stumble.
stumble.zh: 她突然转动身子，一只胳膊伸向身边，似乎想抓住什么但没抓到，这让她绊了一跤。

stumble.en: The sudden weakness in her legs made her stumble.
stumble.zh: 她突然两腿发软踉跄了一下。

artificial.zh: 这种食品不含人工调味品。
这种果汁不含人工防腐剂。

artificial.en: Most artificial joints are cemented into place.
artificial.zh: 绝大部分人造关节是被黏结复位的。

automobile.en: Thanks to the automobile, Americans soon had a freedom of movement previously unknown.
automobile.zh: 由于有了汽车，美国人很快就获得了前所未有的行动自由。

automobile.en: The parts of an automobile are standardized.
automobile.zh: 汽车零件是标准化了的。

automobile.en: Automobile accidents maim many people each year.
automobile.zh: 汽车车祸每年使许多人残废。

abstract.zh: 要慢慢培养才会欣赏抽象艺术。

abstract.en: It's not a question of some abstract concept of justice.
abstract.zh: 这不是一个有关正义的某一抽象概念的问题。

abstract.en: A modern abstract painting takes over one complete wall.
abstract.zh: 一幅现代抽象画占了整整一面墙。

descend.en: The pilots were told to descend to 2-2,000 feet.
descend.zh: 飞行员被告知要将飞机下降到2-2000英尺。

descend.en: It expels gas to descend, and expels water from trim bladders to rise.
descend.zh: 它通过排出气体来下降，并通过把水排出气囊来上升。

tide.en: Is the tide coming in or going out?
Miles of sand are exposed at low tide.
tide.zh: 在低潮时数英里的沙滩就会显现出来。

tide.en: We set sail (for France) at high tide.
tide.zh: 我们在涨潮时起航（前往法国）。

readily.en: The components are readily available in hardware stores.
readily.zh: 这些零件在五金商店容易买到。

readily.en: When she told them what she intended they readily consented.
readily.zh: 她告诉他们她的打算时，他们欣然同意。

readily.en: I asked her if she would allow me to interview her, and she readily agreed.
readily.zh: 我问她是否允许我采访她，她欣然同意了。

revolutionary.en: She ran away with him to Mexico and espoused the revolutionary cause.
revolutionary.zh: 她与他一起逃到了墨西哥，支持革命事业。

revolutionary.en: This revolutionary expansion required energetic nation-building policies.
revolutionary.zh: 这次革命性扩张需要有积极的国家建设政策。

revolutionary.en: Invented in 1951, the rotary engine is a revolutionary concept in internal combustion.
revolutionary.zh: 1951年发明的旋转引擎是内燃领域的一个革命性观念。

cooperate.en: He agreed to cooperate with the police investigation.
During our meeting, he indicated his willingness to cooperate.
cooperate.zh: 在我们会晤期间，他提及了合作的意愿。

romance.zh: 这是一场发展缓慢的恋情。

romance.en: The movie mixes broad humor with romance.
romance.zh: 那部电影把粗俗幽默和浪漫故事结合在一起。

romance.en: Romance is making a comeback. Reality is out.
romance.zh: 浪漫正回归；现实已过时。

hardware.en: The components are readily available in hardware stores.
hardware.zh: 这些零件在五金商店容易买到。

hardware.en: Hardware shops have sold out of water pumps and tarpaulins.
hardware.zh: 五金商店的水泵和防水油布已经销售一空。

hardware.en: To be totally secure, you need a piece of hardware that costs about $200.
hardware.zh: 为保证绝对安全，你需要一个花费约为两百美元的硬件。

kit.zh: 我孩提时的偶像是基特·卡森。

whip.zh: 他甩了个响鞭，马儿就奋蹄向前奔去。

whip.en: He could whip a crowd into hysteria.
whip.zh: 他可以怂恿一群人，使他们变得歇斯底里。

mushroom.zh: 我已经把所有的蘑菇都拿出去了。

tragic.zh: 这本小说兼有喜剧和悲剧的特点。
这只是一场悲惨的事故。

tragic.en: The play is both comic and tragic.

mechanic.zh: 机修工立即找到了出故障的地方。

mechanic.en: A good mechanic is worth his weight in gold.
mechanic.zh: 一位优秀的技工是不可多得的。

mechanic.en: He was a born mechanic with a flair for design.
mechanic.zh: 他天生是个有设计才华的机械师。

jar.en: She opened up a jar of plums.
I can't get the lid off this jar.
jar.zh: 我打不开这广口瓶的盖子。

underlying.en: The underlying trend of inflation is still upwards.
underlying.zh: 通货膨胀的潜在趋势仍然是上升的。

underlying.en: To stop a problem you have to understand its underlying causes.
underlying.zh: 要解决问题，你得了解其潜在原因。

underlying.en: Unemployment may be an underlying cause of the rising crime rate.
underlying.zh: 失业可能是犯罪率攀升的潜在原因。

utilize.en: Sound engineers utilize a range of techniques to enhance the quality of the recordings.
utilize.zh: 音响工程师利用一系列的技术来提高录音质量。

utilize.en: The agents were able to utilize their full potential and experiences to build up the company.
utilize.zh: 这些代理人能够充分利用他们的潜力和经验来促进公司发展。

utilize.en: Even the government of Iran has been forced to utilize the very tool they attempted to squelch to try to hold on to power.
utilize.zh: 即使伊朗政府也被迫利用这个他们原本试图粉碎的工具来维持自己的权力。

pork.en: Here the cooks dish out sweet and sour pork.
pork.zh: 在这儿厨师们把咕咾肉分份儿。

pork.en: Legs of pork were cured and smoked over the fire.
pork.zh: 猪腿在火上经过了烟熏处理。

pork.en: This month's offers include a pork loin and avocados.
pork.zh: 这个月的特价品包括猪后臀肉和鳄梨。

creativity.zh: 对孩子们制定的各种规定压制了创造力。

creativity.en: His illness had not stunted his creativity.
creativity.zh: 疾病没有扼杀他的创造力。

creativity.en: Becoming your own person releases your creativity.
creativity.zh: 保持你自己的本色可以释放出你的创造力。

fisherman.en: The fisherman rowed us back to the shore.
fisherman.zh: 渔夫划船将我们送回到岸上。

fisherman.en: Spyros Latsis started his career as a humble fisherman in the Aegean.
fisherman.zh: 斯派罗斯·拉齐斯最初的职业是爱琴海的一名地位低微的渔夫。

fisherman.en: With great difficulty, the fisherman manoeuvred his small craft close to the reef.
fisherman.zh: 渔夫艰难地驾着小船靠近了礁石。

sympathy.en: We expressed our sympathy for her loss.
sympathy.zh: 我们对她的损失表示了同情。

sympathy.en: I have some sympathy with this point of view.
sympathy.zh: 我对这一观点有些赞同。

entrepreneur.en: An entrepreneur is more than just a risk taker. He is a visionary.
entrepreneur.zh: 企业家不仅是个冒险者，还是一个有远见的人。
美国企业家史蒂夫·乔布斯对这一点坚信不疑。

entrepreneur.en: It was designed and built for a local entrepreneur and his family.
entrepreneur.zh: 它是为一位当地企业家和他的家人设计和建造的。

bureau.en: I wondered what else he'd taken and nosed around his bureau.
bureau.zh: 我想知道他还拿走了什么，就探查了他的办事处。

bureau.en: The Better Business Bureau holds an enormous amount of information on any business problem.
bureau.zh: 商业信用局存储着有关任何商务问题的大量信息。

bureau.en: A baseball mitt and ball rested on top of the bureau.
bureau.zh: 衣柜顶上摆着棒球手套和棒球。

syndrome.en: This syndrome is associated with frequent coughing.
syndrome.zh: 这种综合征与经常咳嗽有关。

syndrome.en: About 70% of women suffer from premenstrual syndrome.
syndrome.zh: 大约70%的妇女都患有经前综合症。

syndrome.en: Irritable bowel syndrome seems to affect more women than men.
syndrome.zh: 肠易激综合症对女性比对男性影响更大。

ambition.zh: 这是她终身追求的目标。

ambition.en: He was corrupted by power and ambition.
ambition.zh: 权力与野心使他腐化堕落。

ambition.en: Even when I was young I never had any ambition.
ambition.zh: 即使当我年轻的时候我也从未有过什么雄心。

breeze.zh: 风铃在微风中叮当作响。

costly.en: You want to avoid costly legal proceedings if you can.
costly.zh: 如果能够的话你希望避免昂贵的法律诉讼。

costly.en: The best equipment is costly but is well worth the outlay.
costly.zh: 最好的设备花费大，但这种开支很值得。

costly.en: Buying new furniture may prove too costly.
costly.zh: 购买新家具可能会花钱太多。

ambitious.en: He is ambitious and susceptible to flattery.
ambitious.zh: 他雄心勃勃，而且很喜欢听恭维话。

ambitious.en: For socially ambitious couples this is a problem.
ambitious.zh: 对在社会地位方面有野心的夫妇来说，这是个问题。

ambitious.en: Chris is so ambitious, so determined to do it all.
ambitious.zh: 克里斯是如此雄心勃勃，如此坚决地要把它做完。

presumably.en: I couldn't concentrate, presumably because I was so tired.
presumably.zh: 我的精神集中不起来，大概是太累了吧。

presumably.en: Presumably you'll be given moving expenses from the Portugal job.
presumably.zh: 大概你会从葡萄牙的工作中得到搬家的费用。

presumably.en: Presumably, you keep your doors locked at night and while you're away.
presumably.zh: 想必你在晚上、以及不在家的时候都锁着门。

influential.en: He was one of the most influential performers of modern jazz.
influential.zh: 他是最有影响力的现代爵士乐表演者之一。

influential.en: The West has gradually relaxed its hostile attitude to this influential state.
influential.zh: 西方对这个有影响力的国家的敌对态度已趋缓和。

translation.zh: 原文的反语用法在翻译中丢失了。
此书在翻译过程中丢失了一些原意。

translation.en: I have only read Tolstoy in translation.
translation.zh: 我只读过托尔斯泰作品的译本。

metropolitan.en: Two years ago, he signed over his art collection to the New York Metropolitan Museum of Art.
metropolitan.zh: 两年前，他签字把他的艺术收藏品转让给了纽约大都会艺术博物馆。

metropolitan.en: Manners nowadays in metropolitan cities like London are practically non-existent.
metropolitan.zh: 如今在如伦敦这样的大都市中，礼仪实际上是不存在的。

metropolitan.en: Manners nowadays in metropolitan cities like London are practically non-existent.
metropolitan.zh: 如今在如伦敦这样的大都市中，礼仪实际上是不存在的。

uncertain.zh: 经济气候依然是不确定。

uncertain.en: The baby took its first uncertain steps.
uncertain.zh: 宝宝迈出了最初的蹒跚的脚步。

dissolve.en: Warm the sugar slightly first to make it dissolve quicker.
dissolve.zh: 首先把糖微微加热让它更快地溶化。

dissolve.en: The substance does not dissolve in water whether heated or not.
dissolve.zh: 无论加热与否，这种物质都不溶于水。

dissolve.en: Let's take solid salt, and dissolve it in a bunch of liquid water.
dissolve.zh: 让我们把食盐固体，溶解在一堆液态水里。

gut.en: Toxins can leak from the gut into the bloodstream.
gut.zh: 毒素能够从肠道渗透到血液里。

gut.en: Let's have your gut reaction to the facts as we know them.
gut.zh: 请告诉我们你对这些我们了解的事实的直觉反应。

gut.en: Gerald's violin strings are made of gut rather than steel.
gut.zh: 杰拉尔德的小提琴弦是用肠线而不是钢丝制成的。

insert.en: Open any of the layout templates, insert your text, make any other changes, and print.
insert.zh: 打开任何一个设计模板，插入你的文本，做任何其他改动，然后打印。

insert.en: For every resource, insert one row into this table.
insert.zh: 对于每个资源，在这个表中插入一行。

insert.en: You insert it into the machine and you are ready to make copies.
insert.zh: 你把它插入机器，就可以复印了。

helmet.en: He locked his helmet into position with a click.
helmet.zh: 他喀哒一声把头盔扣好。

helmet.en: A man in a crash helmet was mounting a motorcycle.
helmet.zh: 一个戴着防撞头盔的男子正骑上一辆摩托车。

helmet.en: He waved back, put down the kickstand, and took off his helmet.
helmet.zh: 他向后挥挥手，放下撑脚架，并脱掉他的头盔。

waist.en: He tied the rope around his waist.
waist.zh: 他把那条缆绳系在他的腰上。

waist.en: Ricky kept his arm around her waist.

crush.en: She had a crush on you, you know.
crush.zh: 你知道吧，她曾暗恋过你。

crush.en: They crush the olives with a heavy wooden press.
crush.zh: 他们用沉重的木制压榨机把橄榄压碎。

crush.en: Don't chew, break, or crush the tablet.
crush.zh: 不要咀嚼、咬破或压碎药片。

panic.zh: 他竭力让自己不要恐慌。

panic.en: Nina felt a sudden dart of panic.
panic.zh: 尼娜突然感到一阵恐慌。

panic.en: Her calm expression hid her inward panic.
panic.zh: 她平静的外表掩盖了内心的恐慌。

cliff.en: The car had toppled over the cliff.
cliff.zh: 汽车从山崖上跌落下去了。

cliff.en: They came straggling up the cliff road.
cliff.zh: 他们零零散散地沿着悬崖小路走上来。

minimal.en: The work was carried out at minimal cost.
minimal.zh: 这项工作是以最少的开销完成的。

minimal.en: The cooperation between the two is minimal.
minimal.zh: 两者之间的合作是最低程度的。

minimal.en: There's only a minimal amount of risk involved.

cord.en: He began to worry at the knot in the cord.
Mary got up, much mystified, and found the cord.
cord.zh: 玛丽站了起来，有些困惑，她找到了绳子。

cord.en: After the cord was cut, each sister took turns with their brother.
cord.zh: 绳索被割断后，姐妹们轮流和她们的兄弟在一起。

cocaine.en: Crack is a highly potent and addictive derivative of cocaine.
cocaine.zh: 强效纯可卡因是一种药效极强、容易使人上瘾的可卡因制剂。

cocaine.en: Cocaine addicts get specialized support from knowledgeable staff.
cocaine.zh: 可卡因上瘾者从知识丰富的人员那里得到专业化的帮助。

cocaine.en: Six tons of cocaine were seized last week in Panama's biggest drug bust.
cocaine.zh: 上周在巴拿马最大的毒品突袭行动中收缴了6吨可卡因。

illusion.en: No matter how beautiful the illusion, it remains a dream.
Mirrors in a room often give an illusion of space.
illusion.zh: 房间里的镜子常给人一种空间增大的错觉。

illusion.en: The idea of absolute personal freedom is an illusion.
illusion.zh: 绝对个人自由的观念是一种幻想。

anonymous.en: You can remain anonymous if you wish.
anonymous.zh: 如果你愿意你可以保持匿名。
捐赠者希望不披露姓名。

anonymous.en: The man was arrested after an anonymous tip-off.
anonymous.zh: 有人匿名举报后，那个人被抓了起来。

tolerate.en: I don't know how you tolerate that noise!
tolerate.zh: 我不知道你怎么能忍受那样的噪音！

tolerate.en: Lying is something that I will not tolerate.
tolerate.zh: 撒谎是我所不能容忍的。

tolerate.en: We have to tolerate each other's little foibles.
tolerate.zh: 我们得互相容忍对方的小缺点。

flexibility.en: A certain amount of flexibility is built into the system.
flexibility.zh: 该体系加入了一定的灵活性。

flexibility.en: Computers offer a much greater degree of flexibility in the way work is organized.
flexibility.zh: 利用计算机，工作安排可以灵活得多。

flexibility.en: The flexibility of distance learning would be particularly suited to busy managers.
flexibility.zh: 远程学习的灵活性尤其会适合忙碌的经理们。

appreciation.en: You have to take capital appreciation of the property into account.
appreciation.zh: 你得将那个房产的资本增值考虑进来。

appreciation.en: The aim is to inculcate businesspeople with an appreciation of different cultures.
appreciation.zh: 其目的是教导商界人员学会欣赏不同的文化。

appreciation.en: She shows little appreciation of good music.
appreciation.zh: 她感受不到美好音乐的妙处。

equivalent.en: Zip disks could be used to store the equivalent of three music CDs.
equivalent.zh: 压缩盘能用以存储相当于3张音乐CD容量的内容。

equivalent.en: The German 'Gymnasium' is the closest equivalent to the grammar school in England.
equivalent.zh: 德语Gymnasium基本上相当于英格兰的文法学校。

equivalent.en: The helmets are designed to withstand impacts equivalent to a fall from a bicycle.
equivalent.zh: 头盔设计成能承受相当于从自行车上摔下来的力度。

decorate.en: The boys are planning to decorate when they get the time.
decorate.zh: 男孩们正计划在他们有时间的时候装修。

decorate.en: When they came to decorate the rear bedroom, it was Jemma who had the final say.
decorate.zh: 他们开始装修后卧室时，说了算的人是杰马。

decorate.en: My mom and I would decorate it.

booth.en: He came barreling down the hill and smashed into a phone booth.
booth.zh: 他沿山坡飞驰下来，撞在了一个电话亭上。

booth.en: In the next booth he could see an elderly lady, talking volubly.
booth.zh: 在隔壁的电话亭里，他看见一个上了年纪的妇女在滔滔不绝地说着。

booth.en: I called her from a public phone booth near the entrance to the bar.
booth.zh: 我在酒吧入口附近的一个公用电话亭给她打了电话。

momentum.en: The vehicle gained momentum as the road dipped.
momentum.zh: 那辆车顺着坡越跑冲力越大。
旋转的陀螺正在失去动量。

momentum.en: There are other kinds of momentum as well.

pulse.zh: 安的脉搏因惊恐而加快了。
他的脉搏速率突然下降。

fixed.zh: 很多餐馆提供固定价格的菜单。
萨拉为我们准备了一些食物。

donation.en: You can of course help by giving them a donation directly.
donation.zh: 你当然可以通过直接给他们一笔捐赠来帮助他们。

donation.en: A local businessman stepped in with a large donation for the school.
donation.zh: 当地一位商人出面捐了一大笔款给学校。

donation.en: Since war broke out, the phones at donation centres have been ringing off the hook.
donation.zh: 自从战争爆发以来，捐款中心的电话一直响个不停。

irony.en: 'England is famous for its food,' she said with heavy irony.
irony.zh: “英格兰的食物很有名哪。”她极其讽刺地说道。

sibling.en: The remaining 22% lived in the home of another family member (such as a grandparent, in-law or sibling), a non-relative, or in group quarters like college dormitories.
sibling.zh: 剩下22%的人住在另一个家庭成员家里（如祖父母、姻亲或兄弟姐妹）、非亲属成员家里、或是像大学宿舍一样的集体住房里。

sibling.en: A calm, rule-following child might respond better to a different sort of parenting than a younger sibling.
sibling.zh: 一个冷静、循规蹈矩的孩子对不同类型的养育方式的反应可能比弟弟妹妹更好。

sibling.en: A calm, rule-following child might respond better to a different sort of parenting than, for example, a younger sibling.
sibling.zh: 一个冷静、守规矩的孩子对某种不同的育儿方式的反应可能会好过其弟弟妹妹。

alley.en: I dodged back into the alley and waited a minute.
alley.zh: 我往后一闪，躲进胡同里等了一会儿。

alley.en: When he saw the police arrive, he bolted down an alley.
alley.zh: 他看见警察来了，便从小巷逃走了。

alley.en: He wheeled his bike into the alley at the side of the house.
alley.zh: 他把自行车推进了房屋一侧的胡同里。

midst.en: She stood preening in their midst, delighted with the attention.
midst.zh: 她得意洋洋地站在他们中间，为受人瞩目而高兴。

midst.en: Many were surprised to see him exposed like this in the midst of a large crowd.
midst.zh: 很多人看到他这样暴露在一大群人当中，都感到很意外。

midst.en: Eleanor arrived in the midst of a blizzard.
midst.zh: 埃莉诺到达时正下着暴风雪。

interact.en: You have to understand how cells interact.
interact.zh: 你必须得了解细胞之间是如何相互作用的。

interact.en: They learn how to interact with their peers.
interact.zh: 他们学习如何与同龄人互动。

interact.en: This determines both people interact in meetings.
interact.zh: 这决定了人们在会议上的互动方式。

rival.en: This year the newspaper has outsold its main rival.
rival.zh: 今年该报的发行量已超过了它的主要对手。

rival.en: Their smaller rival is battling to end their duopoly.
rival.zh: 比他们小的竞争对手正在为结束他们两家寡头集团而斗争。

rival.en: There is often no discernible difference between rival brands.
rival.zh: 相互竞争的品牌之间往往看不出明显的区别。

punch.en: She landed a punch on his chin.
punch.zh: 她对着他的下巴揍了一拳。

scramble.en: There was an undignified scramble for the best seats.
scramble.zh: 大家争抢最好的位子，真是有失体统。

scramble.en: More than three million fans are expected to scramble for tickets.
scramble.zh: 预计会有三百万以上的歌迷抢购门票。

scramble.en: She managed to scramble out of the vehicle as it burst into flames.
scramble.zh: 她设法从突然起火的车里爬了出来。

passing.zh: 我招呼了一辆路过的出租车。
路过的驾驶者按响了汽车喇叭。

passing.en: He should have shot instead of passing.

persist.en: Existential questions requiring religious answers still persist.
persist.zh: 需要宗教解答的生命问题持续存在着。

persist.en: He urged the United States to persist with its efforts to bring about peace.
persist.zh: 他敦促美国坚持努力实现和平。
我会坚持不懈，直到成功。

icon.en: Click on the icon when you want to print.
icon.zh: 你想打印时就点击一下这个图标。

icon.en: Kate clicked on the mail icon on her computer screen.
icon.zh: 凯特点击了她电脑屏幕上的邮件图标。

icon.en: The icon on this tab is a beanie.
icon.zh: 这个标签上的图标是一个无檐小便帽。

shed.en: He was discovered hiding in a shed.
shed.zh: 人们发现他原来藏在棚屋里。

shed.en: David built us a shed in the back yard.
shed.zh: 戴维帮我们在后院搭了个棚子。
素食主义已经摆脱了其古怪的形象。

foster.zh: 福斯特先生以141票轻松获胜。

foster.en: The children were placed with foster parents.
foster.zh: 这些小孩已安顿好，交给寄养父母了。

foster.en: We couldn't adopt a child, so we decided to foster.
foster.zh: 我们不能领养孩子，所以决定代养一个。

franchise.en: In the reorganization, Southern Television lost their franchise.
franchise.zh: 在改组过程中南方电视公司失去了特许经营权。

franchise.en: We have strengthened the franchise over the past year and GE Capital's earnings recovery should continue.
franchise.zh: 在过去的一年中，我们加强了特许经营，通用电气的资本收益恢复将继续。

franchise.en: The Iron Man franchise should trust Downey more, trust that we want to hang out with Tony Stark.
franchise.zh: 《钢铁侠》剧组应该更信任小唐尼一些，应该相信我们观众愿意跟着托尼·斯塔克。

legislature.en: A roar of approval resounded through the legislature.
legislature.zh: 一片赞成声在议会中回响。

legislature.en: His first important chance to show his mettle came when he opened the new session of the legislature.
legislature.zh: 当他主持召开新一届立法会议的时候，让他显示魄力的第一次重要机会来了。

legislature.en: The proposals before the legislature include the creation of two special courts to deal exclusively with violent crimes.
legislature.zh: 摆在议会面前的提案包括建立两个特殊法庭专门审理暴力犯罪案件。

consequently.en: They had children and were consequently tied to the school vacations.
consequently.zh: 他们有几个孩子，因此被学校假期束缚住了。

consequently.en: Consequently even this vast chorus was occasionally overwhelmed by the brass.
consequently.zh: 结果连这个大合唱偶尔也被铜管乐所压倒。

consequently.en: Consequently, even as the blogosphere continues to expand, only a few blogs are likely to emerge as focal points.
consequently.zh: 因此，虽然博客空间继续扩大，但只有少数博客有可能脱颖而出成为焦点。

heal.en: As they heal, the bones will fuse together.
heal.zh: 骨头愈合时将会连接在一起。

heal.en: It was a hurt that would take a long time to heal.
heal.zh: 那是需要很长时间才能愈合的创伤。

heal.en: That cut is taking a long time to heal.
heal.zh: 那伤口需要很长时间才能愈合。

filter.en: A new filter can save on energy bills.
filter.zh: 一个新的过滤器能节省能源开支。

filter.en: A filter will remove most impurities found in water.
filter.zh: 过滤器会滤掉水中的大部分杂质。

filter.en: Put the coffee in the filter and let the water run through.
filter.zh: 把咖啡放入过滤器里让水流过。

fever.en: He had an earache and a fever.
My Uncle Jim had a high fever.
fever.zh: 我的叔叔吉姆发高烧了。

accessible.en: The centre is easily accessible to the general public.
accessible.zh: 该中心对于广大公众来讲很便利。

accessible.en: The museum is easily accessible by car.
accessible.zh: 开车可以方便地到达博物馆。

accessible.en: These documents are not accessible to the public.
accessible.zh: 公众无法看到这些文件。

organism.en: Multiplication of cells leads to rapid growth of the organism.
organism.zh: 细胞的繁殖导致有机体的迅速生长。

organism.en: DNA carries the genetic blueprint which tells any organism how to build itself.
organism.zh: 脱氧核糖核酸带有决定有机体形成方式的遗传型板。

exploit.en: As computer systems become even more sophisticated, so too do the methods of those who exploit the technology.
exploit.zh: 正如计算机系统变得越来越复杂，开发计算机技术的人所采用的方法也日趋复杂。

exploit.en: What do you think my last exploit was?
exploit.zh: 你觉得我最后一项功绩是什么？

exploit.en: Modern technology is good enough to exploit all the sea resources.
exploit.zh: 现代技术足以开发所有的海洋资源。

sensation.en: News of his arrest caused a sensation.
sensation.zh: 他被捕的消息引起了轰动。

sensation.en: Floating can be a very pleasant sensation.
sensation.zh: 漂浮会给人一种非常愉快的感觉。

sensation.en: The pain was so bad that she lost all sensation.
sensation.zh: 疼得太厉害了，她完全失去了感觉能力。

partially.zh: 他的母亲失去了部分视力。

partially.en: The road was partially blocked by a fallen tree.
partially.zh: 倒下的一棵树挡住了部分道路。

partially.en: The judge, therefore, reversed, at least partially, his original decision.
partially.zh: 因此，法官至少推翻了一部分他原来的判决。

shove.en: She gave Gracie a shove toward the house.
shove.zh: 她把格雷西向那所房子猛地一推。

shove.en: You have to give the door a shove or it won't close.
shove.zh: 这门你得猛推一下，否则关不上。

charter.en: The charter proclaimed that all states would have their own government.
charter.zh: 宪章规定，各州皆允建立各自的政府。

charter.en: Seats on charter flights are usually sold as part of a package deal with hotel accommodations.
charter.zh: 包机的座位通常是作为酒店住宿打包出售的一部分。

charter.en: Green awareness is now entrenched—along with sport and culture—as a permanent dimension of the Olympic Charter.
charter.zh: 环保意识现在已经根深蒂固，它连同体育和文化一样，成为奥林匹克宪章的永久内容。

stove.en: I came in and kindled a fire in the stove.

stove.zh: “我们可能会毁了炉子。” —“管它呢！”

reminder.en: This has been a timely reminder to us all.
reminder.zh: 对我们大家来说这个提醒非常及时。

reminder.en: His words were a pointed reminder of her position.
reminder.zh: 他刻意提醒了她的身份。

reminder.en: The accident was a salutary reminder of the dangers of climbing.
reminder.zh: 这次事故提醒人们注意登山的种种危险，倒也不无益处。

comprise.en: Older people comprise a large proportion of those living in poverty.
comprise.zh: 在那些生活贫困的人中，老年人占有很大的比例。

comprise.en: People with disabilities comprise a large part of the population.
comprise.zh: 残疾人占人口的很大一部分。

comprise.en: These finds, together with later finds, comprise all that experts know about Minoan culture.
comprise.zh: 这些发现，连同之后的发现，是专家对米诺斯文化的全部了解。

consent.en: Silence must not always be read as consent.
consent.zh: 不要总是将沉默理解为同意。

consent.en: The written consent of a parent is required.
consent.zh: 要求有家长的书面同意。

consent.en: At no time did I give my consent to the plan.
consent.zh: 我从未同意过这项计划。

ecological.en: We risk upsetting the ecological balance of the area.
ecological.zh: 我们有可能破坏这个地区的生态平衡。

ecological.en: Large dams have harmed Siberia's delicate ecological balance.
ecological.zh: 大坝损害了西伯利亚脆弱的生态平衡。

ecological.en: These statistics are important from an ecological point of view.
ecological.zh: 就生态学而言，这些统计数字很重要。

surrounding.en: The farm and surrounding area was flooded.
surrounding.zh: 农场和周围地区遭洪水淹没。

surrounding.en: The surrounding countryside is windswept and rocky.
surrounding.zh: 这周围的乡村风多石头多。

surrounding.en: We searched the surrounding neighbourhood for the missing boy.
surrounding.zh: 我们在附近寻找失踪的男孩儿。

dam.en: A dam burst and flooded their villages.
dam.zh: 一个大坝决堤，淹没了他们的村子。

dam.en: The dam burst under the weight of water.
dam.zh: 大坝在水的巨大压力下溃决了。

outfit.en: She was wearing an outfit she'd bought the previous day.
outfit.zh: 她穿着前一天买的一套服装。

outfit.en: Her stage outfit of hot trousers, over-the-knee boots and a tube top was a bit much.
outfit.zh: 她在舞台上的装扮是热裤、过膝长靴加紧身抹胸，太过分了。

outfit.en: The revamp includes replacing the old navy uniform with a crisp blue and white cotton outfit.
outfit.zh: 改进的内容包括将旧海军制服换成清新的蓝白相间的棉套装。

unprecedented.en: The mission has been hailed as an unprecedented success.
unprecedented.zh: 这次使命已被宣布为一次空前的成功。

unprecedented.en: We are now witnessing an unprecedented increase in violent crime.
unprecedented.zh: 我们现在看到暴力犯罪空前增多。

unprecedented.en: Such policies would require unprecedented cooperation between nations.
unprecedented.zh: 这样的一些政策会要求国与国之间前所未有的合作。

columnist.en: I think you'd agree he's a very respected columnist.
columnist.zh: 我想你可能会同意，他是个十分受人尊敬的专栏作家。

columnist.en: Hap LeCrone, a Cox News Service columnist, is a clinical psychologist.
columnist.zh: 考克斯新闻服务专栏作家哈普·勒克罗恩是一名临床心理学家。

columnist.en: With us to talk about the findings in the study is Washington Post columnist Kevin Blackstone.
columnist.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》专栏作家凯文·布莱克斯通将与我们一起探讨这项研究的发现。

preliminary.en: The doctors have successfully concluded preliminary tests.
preliminary.zh: 医生们已成功完成了初步化验。

preliminary.en: Preliminary results show the Republican Party with 11 percent of the vote.
preliminary.zh: 初步结果显示共和党得到11%的选票。

preliminary.en: It was agreed that another round of preliminary talks would be held in Beijing.
preliminary.zh: 商定了又一轮预备会谈将在北京举行。

patent.en: P&G applied for a patent on its cookies.
patent.zh: 宝洁公司为其饼干申请了专利。

patent.en: He knows his way around the intricate maze of patent law.
patent.zh: 他通晓错综复杂的专利法。

gross.en: Gross sales reached nearly $2 million a year.
gross.zh: 全年总销售额达到近二百万美元。

gross.en: Interest is paid gross, rather than having tax deducted.
gross.zh: 利息按总额来付，没有扣除税收。

texture.en: It has an orange flavour and smooth texture.
texture.zh: 它有一种桔子的味道，质地光滑。

texture.en: Each brick also varies slightly in tone, texture and size.
texture.zh: 每块砖在色调、质地和尺寸上也略有不同。

texture.en: Within a month, both the texture and condition of your hair should improve.
texture.zh: 不出一个月，你头发的质地和状况应该都会改善。

damn.en: Oh damn! I forgot he was coming.
damn.zh: 真该死！我把他要来这事儿给忘了。

damn.en: Don't be flippant, damn it! This is serious!
damn.zh: 该死，不要不当回事！这是很严肃的！

hormone.zh: 雌激素是一种雌性荷尔蒙。

hormone.en: When the stem dies, its hormone signal also ceases.
hormone.zh: 当茎死亡时，它的激素信号也停止了。

hormone.en: Ethylene is the natural plant hormone in fruit that makes them turn ripe, apparently.
hormone.zh: 很明显，乙烯是水果中天然的植物激素，使水果成熟。

frontier.zh: 坚定的个人主义铸就了美国这个前沿社会。

frontier.en: They are planning to build a faithful recreation of the original frontier town.
frontier.zh: 他们正计划建造一座和原来边境城镇一模一样的复制品。

frontier.en: The war was over before he was sent to the frontier.
frontier.zh: 战争在他被派往边境之前就结束了。

spray.en: I bought a spray to kill the weeds.
spray.zh: 我买了一种喷剂可以除草。

spray.en: He spray-painted his name on the wall.
spray.zh: 他把自己的名字用喷漆喷在了墙上。

spray.en: The officers blasted him with pepper spray.
spray.zh: 该警察用胡椒粉喷雾剂喷他。

disclose.en: Neither side would disclose details of the transaction.
disclose.zh: 双方都不会透露交易的细节。

disclose.en: I am afraid we are not at liberty to disclose that information.
disclose.zh: 恐怕我们无权透露那信息。

disclose.en: The spokesman refused to disclose details of the takeover to the press.
disclose.zh: 发言人拒绝向新闻界透露公司收购的详细情况。

custody.en: Who will have custody of the children?
custody.zh: 谁来负责监护这些孩子？

custody.en: He was released from custody the next day.
custody.zh: 他第二天被从拘留中释放。

custody.en: The bank provides safe custody for valuables.
custody.zh: 这家银行提供对贵重物品的安全保管服务。

oak.en: This table is made of solid oak.
oak.zh: 这张桌子是用实心橡木制作的。

oak.en: An old oak tree once stood here.
oak.zh: 以前这儿长着一棵老橡树。

interfere.en: We take the view that it would be wrong to interfere.
interfere.zh: 我们所持的态度是：干涉是错误的。

interfere.en: I try not to let work interfere with my personal life.
interfere.zh: 我尽量不让工作干扰我的私生活。

interfere.en: She never allows her personal feelings to interfere with her work.
interfere.zh: 她从不让她的个人感情妨碍工作。

beast.zh: 他将他们称之为“野兽机器”。

beast.en: Now we have a beast of a different kind.
beast.zh: 现在我们有一种不同的野兽。

beast.en: He saw the public as a great beast or a bewildered herd.
beast.zh: 他认为大众是野兽或者是迷路的羊群。

uncover.en: When the seedlings sprout, uncover the tray.
uncover.zh: 幼苗发芽后，揭开盘上的遮盖物。

uncover.en: The reason he had to uncover it was that beehive tombs, like everything else, were buried.
uncover.zh: 他必须揭开它的原因是这些蜂窝墓，像其他东西一样，被埋在地下。

uncover.en: The scientist is engaged in serious research to uncover the very nature of the physical world.
uncover.zh: 这位科学家正在进行认真的研究，以揭示物理世界的本质。

speculation.en: I am tired of all the speculation.
speculation.zh: 我厌烦了所有这些猜测。

speculation.en: Speculation is rife that he will be fired.
speculation.zh: 他将被解雇的猜测盛行。

speculation.en: Speculation about a divorce proved totally unfounded.
speculation.zh: 有关离婚的猜测证实纯属无稽之谈。

attendance.zh: 他的出勤记录时好时差。
她在学校的出勤率很低。
出席人数之多令人振奋。

installation.en: Installation of the new system will take several days.
installation.zh: 新系统的安装需要几天时间。

installation.en: Hundreds of lives could be saved if the installation of alarms was more widespread.
installation.zh: 如果警报器的安装范围更为广泛，成百上千人的生命就可能获救。

installation.en: Create an SIS installation file for easy deployment of your application.
installation.zh: 创建 SIS 安装文件，以便于部署您的应用程序。

behalf.en: She was nominated to speak on our behalf.
behalf.zh: 她被指派代表我们发言。

behalf.en: Your proxy will need to sign the form on your behalf.
behalf.zh: 你的代理人将须代表你在表格上签字。

behalf.en: She made an emotional public appeal on her son's behalf.
behalf.zh: 她代表儿子作了感动人心的公开呼吁。

innovative.en: For assistance, they turned to one of the city's most innovative museums.
innovative.zh: 为了寻求帮助，他们求助于该市最具创新精神的博物馆中的一座。

innovative.en: He was one of the most creative and innovative engineers of his generation.
innovative.zh: 他是同代人中最富有创造力和革新精神的工程师之一。

innovative.en: Why are so few companies truly innovative?
innovative.zh: 为什么真正创新的公司如此之少？

shark.en: The shark described a circle around the shoal of fish.
shark.zh: 这条鲨鱼围绕着鱼群游动。

stimulate.en: These businesses stimulate the creation of local jobs.
stimulate.zh: 这些企业刺激了当地就业机会的产生。

stimulate.en: America's priority is rightly to stimulate its economy.
stimulate.zh: 美国的首要任务自然是刺激经济。

stimulate.en: She questioned whether it was feasible to stimulate investment in these regions.
stimulate.zh: 她质问在这些地区刺激投资是否可行。

mill.en: His father worked shifts in a steel mill.
mill.zh: 他的父亲在一家钢铁厂轮班工作。

mill.en: The old mill is now little more than a ruin.
mill.zh: 老磨坊现在只剩下一点残垣断壁了。

mill.en: The steel mill was dismantled piece by piece.
mill.zh: 钢厂已经一块块拆散了。

tag.en: Have you looked at the price tag?

tag.zh: 我们选择保留这个标签。
它通过标签来做到这一点。

stance.en: What is the newspaper's stance on the war?
stance.zh: 那家报纸对这场战争持什么立场？

stance.en: The United States has taken a lot of criticism for its hard-line stance.
stance.zh: 美国因其强硬立场遭到众多批评。

stance.en: There appears to be increasing support for the leadership to take a more aggressive stance.
stance.zh: 似乎有不断增长的对领导层采取更强立场的支持。

outsider.en: Their jargon is impenetrable to an outsider.
outsider.zh: 他们的行话外人听不懂。

outsider.en: An outsider might misconstrue the nature of the relationship.
outsider.zh: 外人可能会误解这种关系的本质。
她总是把赌注押在不大可能获胜的马上。

fleet.en: Russia and Ukraine have been disputing the ownership of the fleet.
fleet.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰一直在争夺该舰队的所有权。

fleet.en: With its own fleet of trucks, the company delivers most orders overnight.
fleet.zh: 因为有自己的运输车队，该公司的大部分订货可以第二天就送到。

fleet.en: They maintain a very powerful fleet in Oriental waters.
fleet.zh: 他们在远东海域保持着一支非常强大的舰队。

vertical.en: There was a vertical drop to the ocean.
vertical.zh: 至海洋有一段垂直落差。

vertical.en: The climber inched up a vertical wall of rock.
vertical.zh: 那名登山者一点点爬上了一处垂直的岩石峭壁。

vertical.en: For some buildings a vertical section is more informative than a plan.
vertical.zh: 对一些建筑物来说，垂直剖面图比平面图提供的信息更多。

compel.en: She could compel him to support the child after it was born.
compel.zh: 她可以迫使他在孩子出生后抚养孩子。

compel.en: Nothing can compel me to do such a thing.
compel.zh: 没有什么可以强迫我做这件事。

compel.en: I now take the view that religion is harmless so long as it does not compel its members to proselytize.
compel.zh: 我现在认为宗教是无害的，只要它不强迫其成员改变宗教信仰。

sensitivity.en: Some children develop a sensitivity to cow's milk.
Dickens was lauded for his social and moral sensitivity.
sensitivity.zh: 狄更斯因他的社会和道德敏感度被称赞。

sensitivity.en: Confidentiality is important because of the sensitivity of the information.
sensitivity.zh: 这情报很敏感，务必保密。

proclaim.en: The details of her skeleton proclaim her human affinity.
proclaim.zh: 她骨骼的细节证明了她与人类的密切关系。

proclaim.en: They are no longer willing to debate whether photography is or is not a fine art, except to proclaim that their own work is not involved with art.
proclaim.zh: 他们不再愿意争论摄影是否是一门艺术，只是宣称自己的作品与艺术无关。

proclaim.en: What better time to proclaim the good news?
proclaim.zh: 什么时间分享这个好消息比较好呢？

instant.en: For an instant I was infected by her fear.
instant.zh: 一瞬间，我被她的恐惧所感染。

instant.en: For an instant, Barney was tempted to flee.
instant.zh: 那一瞬间，巴尼很想逃走。

instant.en: The engine delivers instant acceleration whatever the revs.
instant.zh: 不论转速如何，发动机都可以立即加速。

debut.en: His debut album was hugely successful Stateside.
debut.zh: 他的首张专辑在美国获得了巨大成功。

debut.en: Their latest release is a worthy successor to their popular debut album.
debut.zh: 继首张唱片大受欢迎之后，他们最新推出的专辑再获成功。

debut.en: She is hoping her US debut will be the first step on the road to fame and fortune.
debut.zh: 她希望她在美国的首次演出将是她走上名利双收之路的第一步。

hike.en: The site is reached by a 30-minute hike through dense forest.
hike.zh: 要花30分钟徒步穿过密林才能到达那个地方。

hike.en: He had been bitten by a snake during a rough hike.
hike.zh: 他在一次艰难的徒步旅行中被蛇咬了。

hike.en: Join a small group hike tour for an evening of exploration in the heart of Washington.
hike.zh: 加入小型徒步旅行团，用一个晚上去探索华盛顿的中心。

scent.en: The dogs must have lost her scent.
scent.zh: 狗准是闻不到她的气味了。

scent.en: A police dog picked up the murderer's scent.
scent.zh: 一条警犬嗅出了凶手的气味。

scent.en: The scent of climbing roses wafts through the window.
scent.zh: 蔷薇的香味随风从窗户飘进来。

constitution.en: A new constitution was promulgated last month.
constitution.zh: 上个月颁布了一部新宪法。

constitution.en: The assembly was mandated to draft a constitution.
constitution.zh: 大会被授权起草一份章程。

constitution.en: The constitution invested him with certain powers.
constitution.zh: 宪法赋予了他一些权力。

sack.zh: 四百名工人面临解雇的危险。

sack.en: They got through a sack of potatoes.
sack.zh: 他们把一麻袋土豆吃完了。

sack.en: The poor old sod got the sack yesterday.
sack.zh: 那位可怜的老兄昨天给解雇了。

stack.en: A stack of files awaited me on my desk.
stack.zh: 我桌上有一堆文件正待我去处理。

stack.en: He ordered them to stack up pillows behind his back.
stack.zh: 他命令他们在他背后堆放一些枕头。

stack.en: There's a stack of unopened mail waiting for you at the house.
stack.zh: 家里有一大堆信等你拆呢。

tray.en: She came in with a tray of drinks.
tray.zh: 她端着一托盘饮料走进来。

tray.en: Stark took two whiskeys from a tray.
tray.zh: 斯塔克从托盘里拿了两杯威士忌。

tray.en: He brought her breakfast in bed on a tray.
tray.zh: 他把早餐用托盘给她送到床上。

cease.en: They voted to cease strike action immediately.
cease.zh: 他们投票决定立即停止罢工。

cease.en: Heavy fighting erupted there today after a two-day cease-fire.
cease.zh: 激烈的战斗在两天的停火之后今天在那里爆发了。

cease.en: Dos Santos has demanded that UNITA sign a cease-fire and demobilize its troops.
cease.zh: 多斯·桑托斯强烈要求安哥拉彻底独立全国同盟签订停火协议并遣散它的军队。

inherit.en: He has no son to inherit his land.
inherit.zh: 他没有儿子来继承他的土地。

inherit.en: Sheila will inherit everything in the event of his death.
inherit.zh: 他一旦故去，所有财产都由希拉继承。

inherit.en: We inherit from our parents many of our physical characteristics.
inherit.zh: 我们从父母的遗传中得到许多体貌特征。

pioneer.en: What if I am a pioneer or even a genius?
pioneer.zh: 要是我是个开拓者，甚至是个天才怎么办？

pioneer.en: Li Dong, 46, is a pioneer in this field.
pioneer.zh: 46岁的李东是这一领域的先驱。

pioneer.en: In the US, California has been a pioneer.
pioneer.zh: 在美国，加利福尼亚州是一个开拓者。

nasty.en: He had a temper and could be nasty.
nasty.zh: 他脾气暴躁，会令人讨厌。

nasty.en: Ticks can carry a nasty disease which affects humans.
nasty.zh: 壁虱可传播危害人类的严重疾病。

shrink.zh: 我已经看过了精神病医生。

shrink.en: If you give up exercise, your muscles shrink and fat increases. By the same token, if you expend more energy you will lose fat.
shrink.zh: 如果你放弃锻炼，肌肉就会萎缩，脂肪会增多。同样地，如果你消耗较多的体能，你就会减掉脂肪。

wheat.en: He raises 2,000 acres of wheat and hay.
wheat.zh: 他种植了2000英亩的小麦和饲料用草。

wheat.en: The price of wheat has decreased by 15%.

rational.en: There is no rational explanation for his actions.
rational.zh: 对他的所作所为无法作出合理的解释。

rational.en: The decision was based on emotion rather than rational thought.
rational.zh: 这个决定不是基于理性的思考而是基于感情作出的。

rational.en: The alphabet might be more rational if all the vowels came first.
rational.zh: 要是所有的元音都排在前面，字母表也许会更合理些。

fierce.en: There's been some fierce competition for the title.
fierce.zh: 已有一些为此头衔的激烈竞争。

fierce.en: The plans have already come in for fierce criticism.
fierce.zh: 这些计划已遭到激烈的批评。

envision.en: I don't envision working with him again.
envision.zh: 我想象不出再与他一起工作的可能。

envision.en: We envision the camera becoming so small that it integrates into clothing, such as the button of a shirt, a brooch, or a pendant.
envision.zh: 我们想象一下，如果这个摄影机非常小巧，我们就可以把它放进衣服里，像衬衫扣子、胸针、或是项链的坠子一样。

envision.en: In the future we envision a federation of companies.
envision.zh: 我们设想将来会有公司联盟。

aisle.en: Coffee and tea are in the next aisle.
aisle.zh: 咖啡和茶在下一个走道处。

aisle.en: The aisle was floored with ancient bricks.
aisle.zh: 过道由古旧的砖块铺就。

aisle.en: She held me firmly by the elbow and led me to my aisle seat.
aisle.zh: 她使劲抓着我的胳膊肘，把我领到靠过道的座位上。

protocol.en: While SIP is a request-response protocol, there is not necessarily only one response to every one request.
protocol.zh: 虽然 SIP 是请求-响应协议，但每个请求不一定只有一个响应与之对应。

protocol.en: Cerf has been working with NASA's Pasadena Jet Propulsion Laboratory—the people behind the recent Mars expedition—to design what he calls an "interplanetary Internet protocol."
protocol.zh: 瑟夫一直在与美国宇航局的帕萨迪纳喷气推进实验室（最近火星探测的幕后人员）合作，设计他所说的“星际互联网协议”。

protocol.en: The Kyoto Protocol, which set different duties for all countries to cut emissions, states that different countries should reduce their collective greenhouse emissions accordingly.
protocol.zh: 《京都议定书》为各国设定了不同的减排义务，规定各国应相应地减少各自的温室气体排放总量。

kingdom.en: Rome annexed the Nabatean kingdom in AD 106.
kingdom.zh: 罗马帝国于公元106年并吞了纳巴泰王国。

kingdom.en: The animal kingdom is full of fine and glorious creatures.
kingdom.zh: 动物界有很多精巧而美妙的生物。

kingdom.en: He taught his followers that they could all be members of the kingdom of God.
kingdom.zh: 他教导他的信徒说他们都会成为天国的成员。

weaken.en: Nothing could weaken his resolve to continue.
weaken.zh: 什么也不能削弱他继续下去的决心。

weaken.en: He accused them of conniving with foreign companies to weaken employment rights.
weaken.zh: 他指控他们与外国公司共谋来削弱雇用权。

vocal.en: She loved singing as a child and started vocal training at 12.
vocal.zh: 她还是个小孩的时候就爱唱歌，12岁就开始了声乐训练。

vocal.en: If a singer coughs, this can result in the bruising of the vocal cords.
vocal.zh: 如果歌手咳嗽，这可能会导致声带瘀伤。
奥毕森的音域跨越三个八度。

exclusively.en: The proposals before the legislature include the creation of two special courts to deal exclusively with violent crimes.
exclusively.zh: 摆在议会面前的提案包括建立两个特殊法庭专门审理暴力犯罪案件。

exclusively.en: Today he was able to focus his message exclusively on the economy.
exclusively.zh: 今天他能够将重点聚焦在经济方面。

exclusively.en: He paints from a palette consisting almost exclusively of grey and mud brown.
exclusively.zh: 他画画几乎只用包含灰色和土褐色的色调。

marketplace.en: He made his way to the marketplace.
Companies must be able to survive in the marketplace.
marketplace.zh: 公司必须有能力在市场竞争中生存下去。

marketplace.en: Competition in the financial marketplace has eroded profits.
marketplace.zh: 金融市场的竞争降低了利润。

terrain.en: The terrain changed quickly from arable land to desert.
terrain.zh: 这里的地形很快由耕地变为沙漠。

terrain.en: The enemy would always have the advantage of familiarity with the rugged terrain.
terrain.zh: 敌人会一直在对崎岖地形的熟悉上占有优势。

terrain.en: The truck bumped its way over the rough terrain.
terrain.zh: 卡车在崎岖不平的地面上颠簸行进。

unfair.zh: 人生有时似乎非常不公平。

risky.en: Horse breeding is indeed a risky enterprise.
risky.zh: 养马的确是一项有风险的事业。

risky.en: Investing in airlines is a very risky business.
risky.zh: 投资航空公司是非常冒险的生意。
“先别行动，”他警告道，“太冒险了。”

genre.en: We have artist and genre annotation for the albums.
genre.zh: 我们为专辑提供了艺术家和流派注释。

genre.en: Here you're trying to promote this great music genre.
genre.zh: 你正试图在这里推广这种伟大的音乐流派。

genre.en: This book is a novel, your first attempt at that genre.
genre.zh: 这本书是一部小说，您第一次尝试这种体裁。

deploy.en: It also pledged not to deploy AI whose use would violate international laws or human rights.
deploy.zh: 它还承诺不会部署违反国际法或人权的人工智能。

deploy.en: Notwithstanding the previous guidelines, purchase at least one spare hard disk for each model hard disk you deploy.
deploy.zh: 尽管有前面的指导方针，但为您部署的每个模型硬盘购买至少一个备用硬盘。

deploy.en: On June 7 Google pledged not to "design or deploy AI" that would cause "overall harm," or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms.
deploy.zh: 谷歌在6月7日承诺不会“设计或部署”可能会造成“全面伤害”的人工智能，也不会开发人工智能制导武器，或将人工智能用于违反国际准则的监控。

distract.en: It was all a ploy to distract attention from his real aims.
distract.zh: 那全是障眼法，借以转移对他真实目的的注意。

distract.en: It was another attempt to distract attention from the truth.
distract.zh: 这又是企图分散人们对事实真相的注意力。

distract.en: It serves to distract a predator while the octopus makes its escape.
distract.zh: 它的作用是在章鱼逃跑时分散捕食者的注意力。

merit.en: The case does not merit further investigation.
merit.zh: 这个案子不值得进一步调查。

merit.en: The argument seemed to have considerable merit.
merit.zh: 这个论点似乎有相当大的价值。

chunk.en: Chester Cheetah chews a chunk of cheep cheddar cheese.
chunk.zh: 切斯特猎豹嚼着一大块切达干酪。

chunk.en: The next time you see a chunk of seaweed … notice the beauty of it.
chunk.zh: 下次你看到一大块海草……注意它的美。

chunk.en: Everyone got a chunk of meat which was distributed by a bizarre stone knife.
chunk.zh: 每个人都得到一大块肉，用一把奇怪的石刀分着吃。

ladder.zh: 那梯子看来摇摇晃晃的。

jungle.en: The tiger's home is in the jungle.
The lion is the king of the jungle.
We decided to go deeper into the jungle.
jungle.zh: 我们决定继续深入丛林。

migration.en: During the last recession, migration to the sunbelt accelerated.
migration.zh: 前一个经济萧条期间，向美国南部阳光地带移民的速度加快了。

migration.en: Now, migration is a natural survival strategy.
migration.zh: 现在，迁徙是一种自然的生存策略。

migration.en: They have led some birds to give up on migration.
migration.zh: 它们导致一些鸟类放弃迁徙。

retailer.en: A stronger relationship between the retailer/producer and the consumer isn't just about financial incentives.
retailer.zh: 零售商或生产商与消费者之间更强的关系不仅仅是经济激励。

retailer.en: The Future Group, India's largest retailer, has introduced "organized chaos" into its shops to make consumers feel at home.
retailer.zh: 印度最大的零售商 Future Group 将“有序的杂乱”引入商店，让顾客有宾至如归的感觉。

retailer.en: Even when a retailer gets a customer to walk in the store, she can easily see if there's a better deal online or at another store nearby.
retailer.zh: 即使零售商让顾客走进商店，她也能很容易地看到网上或附近的商店是否有更好的交易。

invade.en: Whales will invade king penguins' breeding grounds.
invade.zh: 鲸鱼会入侵帝企鹅的繁殖地。

invade.en: Species that invade a territory can harm ecosystems, agriculture and human health.
invade.zh: 入侵一个地区的物种会危害生态系统、农业和人类健康。

invade.en: I suspect that whatever Facebook has done so far to invade our privacy, it's only the beginning.
invade.zh: 我认为，到目前为止，无论 Facebook 做了什么侵犯我们的隐私的事情，这仅仅是个开始。

hurricane.en: Sometimes a nor'easter can be worse than a hurricane.
hurricane.zh: 一场东北风暴有时比一次飓风还糟糕。

hurricane.en: Hurricane Betty is now approaching the coast of Florida.
hurricane.zh: 飓风贝蒂正在逼近佛罗里达海岸。

hurricane.en: The eye of the hurricane hit Florida just south of Miami.
hurricane.zh: 飓风中心袭击了迈阿密正南面的佛罗里达州。

density.en: The region has a very high population density.
density.zh: 这一地区人口密度很高。

density.en: Jupiter's moon Io, whose density is 3.5 grams per cubic centimetre, is all rock.
density.zh: 木星的卫星木卫一全是岩石，其密度为每立方厘米3.5克。

density.en: Astronomers know that Pluto and Triton have nearly the same size, mass, and density.
density.zh: 天文学家们知道冥王星和海王卫一拥有几乎相同的体积、质量和密度。

coup.en: Mr. Ben Bella was deposed in a coup in 1965.
coup.zh: 本·贝拉先生在1965年的一次政变中被罢免了。

coup.en: Stock markets plunged at the news of the coup.
coup.zh: 政变的消息一传来，股票市场便暴跌。

coup.en: U.S. officials are discounting rumours of a coup.
coup.zh: 美国政府官员对一场政变的传闻将信将疑。

classify.en: Classify them by branch, region, and year.
classify.zh: 将它们按部门、地区和年份分类。

classify.en: Thing is that it's very difficult to classify.
This is true regardless of how we classify the service.
classify.zh: 无论我们如何对服务进行分类，这都是真的。

ambassador.en: I've been invited to meet with the ambassador.
ambassador.zh: 我已经被邀请和大使会晤。

ambassador.en: The ambassador appealed for a change in U.S. policy.
ambassador.zh: 该大使呼吁美国政策的变革。

ambassador.en: The ambassador called the report deceitful and misleading.
ambassador.zh: 大使称该报导是不实的和误导的。

supportive.en: The silent majority of supportive parents and teachers should make their views known.
supportive.zh: 表示支持的父母和老师们是沉默的大多数，他们应该公开表达他们的观点。

supportive.en: People in supportive relationships may handle stress better.
supportive.zh: 得到支持的人可以更好地处理压力。

supportive.en: Then there are the psychological benefits of a supportive partner.
supportive.zh: 此外，伴侣的支持也会带来心理上的好处。

journalism.en: What's the best way to get into journalism?
journalism.zh: 进入新闻界的最佳途径是什么？

journalism.en: I've made some useful contacts in journalism.
journalism.zh: 我在新闻界结交了一些有用的人。

journalism.en: He eventually found his niche in sports journalism.
journalism.zh: 最后他在体育新闻界找到了理想的工作。

stimulus.en: For many firms, they are a stimulus to revenue.
stimulus.zh: 对许多公司来说，它们是刺激收入的因素。

stimulus.en: Regard each failure as a stimulus to further efforts.
stimulus.zh: 把每次失利看成对进一步努力的激励。

stimulus.en: Each of these methods compares an infant's state prior to the introduction of a stimulus with its state during or immediately following the stimulus.
stimulus.zh: 所有这些方法都把引入刺激前婴儿的状态与引入刺激时或之后婴儿的状态进行比较。

ecosystem.en: The ecosystem will be thrown out of whack.
This unique ecosystem may soon be under pressure.
ecosystem.zh: 这个独特的生态系统可能很快就会面临压力。

ecosystem.en: The question of ecosystem stability is complicated.
ecosystem.zh: 生态系统稳定性的问题是复杂的。

informal.zh: 每门课程包括10至12次每周1次的非正式见面会。

informal.en: Discussions are held on an informal basis within the department.
informal.zh: 讨论限于在本部门内非正式地进行。

informal.zh: 董事会成员们预定在今天稍后进行非正式讨论。

likewise.zh: 她的第二次婚姻也不幸福。

likewise.en: What is fair for homeowners likewise should be fair to businesses.
likewise.zh: 对私房业主公平的，同样也该对商家公平。

likewise.en: He voted for the change and he expected his colleagues to do likewise.
likewise.zh: 他投票赞成变革并期望他的同事投同样的票。

feather.en: I taped the base of the feather onto the velvet.
feather.zh: 我用胶带把羽毛的根部粘到天鹅绒上。

feather.en: The feather must be removed with a straight, firm pull.
feather.zh: 羽毛必须笔直地用力一拔才能拔掉。
这只小鸡很快就要长羽毛了。

sphere.en: Because the earth spins, it is not a perfect sphere.
sphere.zh: 因为地球旋转，所以它不是个完完全全的球体。

sphere.en: This area was formerly within the sphere of influence of the US.
sphere.zh: 这一地区先前属于美国的势力范围。
我们有这个巨大的活动范围。

dip.en: A brief dip into history serves to confirm this view.
dip.zh: 随便翻阅一下历史就足以证实这种观点。

dip.en: Just when she was ready to dip into her savings, Greg hastened to her rescue.
dip.zh: 就在她准备动用积蓄时，格雷格赶来救了她的急。

dip.en: He gave a dip of his head.

boast.en: All three Internet agencies boast they've won major accounts.
boast.zh: 所有的三家网络代理公司都夸口说他们已赢得了大客户。

boast.en: I don't want to boast, but I can actually speak six languages.
boast.zh: 不是我吹嘘，我确实能讲六种语言。

boast.en: In its heyday, the studio's boast was that it had more stars than there are in heaven.
boast.zh: 该制片厂吹嘘，它在鼎盛时期拥有的明星比天上的星星还多。

tighten.en: The thought of Nick made her throat tighten.
tighten.zh: 一想到尼克就会让她的喉咙发紧。

tighten.en: Some countries tighten monetary policy to avoid inflation.
tighten.zh: 一些国家紧缩货币政策以避免通货膨胀。

tighten.en: The government has decided to tighten its immigration policy.
tighten.zh: 政府已决定收紧其移民政策。

sole.zh: 她唯一的目的就是扩大个人权势。

sole.en: My sole reason for coming here was to see you.
sole.zh: 我到这儿唯一的原因就是来看你。

sole.en: The shoe's sole had a slightly textured surface.
sole.zh: 鞋底表面有较浅的纹理。

publicity.en: All the publicity nearly sent him crazy.
publicity.zh: 成天生活在公众的注意之下让他差一点发疯了。

publicity.en: They got married in a blaze of publicity.
publicity.zh: 他们结婚的事受到了传媒大力宣扬。

pat.en: Pat it dry with a soft towel.
pat.zh: 用柔软的毛巾将它轻轻拍干。

unfold.en: Araby is easier because it's linear, the story unfold chronologically.
unfold.zh: 《阿拉比》比较简单，因为它是线性的，故事按时间顺序展开。

unfold.en: Unfold the flag first, and then hoist it quickly to the top of the flagpole.
unfold.zh: 先把旗子展开，然后迅速地把它升到旗杆的顶端。

validity.en: We had doubts about the validity of their argument.
validity.zh: 我们对他们的论点的正确性有过怀疑。

validity.en: The period of validity of the agreement has expired.

validity.zh: 应由警方来评价证据的有效与否。

weed.en: He is eager to weed out the many applicants he believes may be frauds.
weed.zh: 他急于剔除那些他认为可能是行骗的申请人。

weed.en: I volunteered to weed the hospital garden.
weed.zh: 我自愿给医院的花园除草。

partial.en: I might be accused of being partial.
partial.zh: 我可能会被人指责是偏袒的。

partial.en: He's partial to sporty women with blue eyes.
partial.zh: 他对蓝眼睛的、运动型的女人是偏爱的。

partial.en: It was only a partial solution to the problem.
partial.zh: 那只是部分地解决了这个问题。

compliance.en: Inspectors were sent to visit nuclear sites and verify compliance with the treaty.
compliance.zh: 监察员被派去参观核址并核实条约的遵守情况。

compliance.en: The U.N. Security Council has linked any lifting of sanctions to compliance with the ceasefire terms.
compliance.zh: 联合国安全理事会将任何制裁的解除与遵守停火条款联系起来。

compliance.en: New regulations have imposed extensive compliance costs on companies still using older industrial coal-fired burners.
compliance.zh: 新规定给仍在使用老式工业燃煤燃烧器的公司带来了巨大的合规成本。

collar.en: She flicked the dust off her collar.
collar.zh: 她轻轻弹掉了衣领上的灰尘。

collar.en: He always wears a collar and tie for work.

supposedly.en: The novel is supposedly based on a true story.
supposedly.zh: 据说这部小说是以一个真实的故事为依据的。

supposedly.en: There's supposedly an alligator in one of their bathtubs.
supposedly.zh: 据说有一条鳄鱼在他们的浴缸里。

supposedly.en: Dickens's mother supposedly came from a more respectable family.
supposedly.zh: 据说狄更斯的母亲来自一个更有名望的家庭。

deem.en: They deem travel an important part of their life.
deem.zh: 他们认为旅行是他们生活中重要的一部分。

deem.en: I deem it an honour to accept your invitation.
deem.zh: 承蒙您的邀请，我觉得很荣幸。

deem.en: You might even deem it as extreme.
deem.zh: 你可能认为这是在走极端。

specialty.en: Reinhard's specialty is scaling the Andes in search of sacrificial remains.
specialty.zh: 莱因哈德的专长是攀登安第斯山脉，寻找祭祀遗迹。

specialty.en: Our specialty here are Italian wines, and these tend to be fruity with medium acidity.
specialty.zh: 我们这里的特色是意大利葡萄酒，这种酒的果味酸度适中。

glimpse.en: He caught a glimpse of her in the crowd.
glimpse.zh: 他一眼瞥见她在人群里。

glimpse.en: Below us you could glimpse the rooftops of a few small villages.
glimpse.zh: 在我们下面，你能瞥见一些小村庄的屋顶。

glimpse.en: Some of the fans had waited 24 hours outside the hotel to catch a glimpse of their heroine.
glimpse.zh: 某些追星族为了一睹女杰的风采已在宾馆外守候了24小时。

premise.en: The premise is that schools will work harder to improve if they must compete.
premise.zh: 前提是各学校如必须竞争就会更加努力改进。

premise.en: His reasoning is based on the premise that all people are equally capable of good and evil.
premise.zh: 他的推理是以人可以为善亦可以为恶为前提的。

premise.en: Linda, co-founder of Scores, a leading digital analytic company, established her organization on a simple premise.
premise.zh: 领先的斯科尔数字分析公司的联合创始人琳达，在简易的前提下建立了自己的组织。

artifact.en: The Clovis point may be the most analyzed artifact in archaeology.
artifact.zh: 克洛维斯矛头可能是考古学中被分析得最多的手工艺品。

artifact.en: Theoretically, you may be correct in claiming that every artifact has potential scientific value.
artifact.zh: 从理论上讲，您认为每件文物都具有潜在的科学价值可能是正确的。

artifact.en: It is hoped that new SI definitions will be uniformly artifact-free.
artifact.zh: 希望新的 SI 定义会统一为无人工的。

mentor.en: Leon Sullivan was my mentor and my friend.
mentor.zh: 利昂·沙利文既是我的导师，也是我的朋友。

mentor.en: Eventually, he was excommunicated along with his mentor.
mentor.zh: 最终，他与他的导师一起被革出教门。

mentor.en: So, over the fierce objections of his mentor Hofmann, he left college to give birth to the modern chemical industry.
mentor.zh: 于是，不顾他的导师霍夫曼的强烈反对，他离开了大学，创立了现代化学工业。

lightning.zh: 如今驾车需要飞快的反应。

lightning.en: Another flash of lightning lit up the cave.
lightning.zh: 又一道闪电照亮了那个洞穴。

excessive.en: Excessive conformity is usually caused by fear of disapproval.
excessive.zh: 过分随大流通常是由于担心不被认同造成的。

excessive.en: Excessive pressure can lead to perforation of the stomach wall.
excessive.zh: 过大的压力会导致胃壁穿孔。

excessive.en: The police vigorously denied that excessive force had been used.
excessive.zh: 警方坚决否认曾过度使用武力。

disappointment.zh: 她很失望，但表现得很大度。
她设法掩藏住自己的失望。

disturb.en: Don't disturb Jane, she's studying for her exams.
disturb.zh: 不要打扰简，她正在温习功课，准备考试呢。

disturb.en: If you get up early, try not to disturb everyone else.
disturb.zh: 如果你起得早，尽量不要打扰别人。

rib.en: You've fractured a rib, maybe more than one.
rib.zh: 你断了一根肋骨，也许不止一根。

rib.en: If you sneeze too hard, you could fracture a rib.
rib.zh: 要是你打喷嚏用力过猛，你可能会折断肋骨。

rib.en: We picked up the rib fragment, flipped it over and there were these two clear marks.
rib.zh: 我们捡起肋骨碎片，将它翻过来，就发现有这两处清晰的痕迹。

debris.en: Falling debris rained on us from above.
debris.zh: 碎片从上面像雨点儿一样落在我们身上。

debris.en: Survivors clung to pieces of floating debris.
debris.zh: 生还者紧紧抱住一块块漂浮在水面上的残骸。

debris.en: The roof collapsed, showering us with dust and debris.
debris.zh: 屋顶塌了下来，灰尘、碎片纷纷落在我们身上。

slavery.zh: 他们当时认为奴隶制是不道义的。

slavery.en: Fearful alchemy is a useful definition of slavery.
slavery.zh: 可怕的炼金术是奴隶制的一个有建设性的定义。

slavery.en: The statesmen's political lives depended on slavery.
slavery.zh: 政治家们的政治生活依赖于奴隶制。

rod.en: The rod bent double, the reel shrieked and ratcheted.
rod.zh: 该操作杆加倍弯曲，线轴发出刺耳的嗒嗒声。

rod.en: Her mother was there, trying to put a curtain rod up over the little window.
rod.zh: 她妈妈在那儿，正试着给小窗上安一根挂帘杆。

rod.en: This is a traditional fuel rod lens that glows underwater.
rod.zh: 这是一个传统的水下发光的燃料棒镜头。

mineral.en: The rock is rich in mineral salts.
Mineral oils are used to lubricate machinery.
mineral.zh: 矿物油被用来润滑机器。

mineral.en: The product provided inadequate vitamin and mineral supplementation.
mineral.zh: 这种产品不能充分补充维生素和矿物质。

commodity.en: Crude oil is the world's most important commodity.
commodity.zh: 原油是世界上最重要的商品。

commodity.en: Money was a commodity she never thought about except in the abstract.
commodity.zh: 金钱是她从未具体想过的一种商品。

commodity.en: The group became a sales juggernaut in the commodity options business.
commodity.zh: 这个集团已经成为一个商品期权交易的销售巨头。

ash.en: Ash began to erupt from the crater.
ash.zh: 火山灰开始从火山口喷出。

ash.en: She dusted some ash from her sleeve.
He brushed the cigarette ash from his sleeve.
ash.zh: 他掸掉了袖子上的烟灰。

cemetery.zh: 他被安葬在海格特墓地。

cemetery.en: Gunmen guarded homes near the cemetery with shotguns.
cemetery.zh: 枪手携带猎枪守卫着公墓附近的住宅。

cemetery.en: The whole area has been shocked by the desecration of the cemetery.
cemetery.zh: 整个地区都被对公墓的亵渎震惊了。

equality.en: All our activities are premised on the basis of "Quality with Equality."
equality.zh: 我们所有活动都是以“优质、平等”为基本前提的。

equality.en: Zach insists that he is but one among many who are fighting for equality.
equality.zh: 扎克坚持认为他仅仅是许多为平等而战的人们中的一个。

equality.en: Europe is not a gender-equality heaven.
equality.zh: 欧洲不是性别平等的天堂。

spare.en: He could have taken a spare key.
spare.zh: 他原本可以带上一把备用钥匙的。

spare.en: How do you spend your spare time?
They don't have a lot of spare cash.
spare.zh: 他们并没有很多多余的现金。

harassment.en: The harassment had become too much to tolerate and he decided to move out.
harassment.zh: 骚扰已让他忍无可忍，他决定搬走。

harassment.en: Sexual harassment of women workers by their bosses is believed to be widespread.
harassment.zh: 女员工受其上司性骚扰的情况被认为是广泛存在的。

harassment.en: The amendment will force senators to show where they stand on the issue of sexual harassment.
harassment.zh: 该修正案将迫使参议员们表明他们在性骚扰问题上采取什么立场。

fame.zh: 名声并没有使他有丝毫改变。

striking.zh: 罢工的工人在工厂附近设置了纠察队。

striking.en: He used striking visuals to get his point across.
striking.zh: 他用醒目的视觉资料解释他的观点。

wheelchair.zh: 这家旅馆有轮椅通道吗？

wheelchair.en: Ramps should be provided for wheelchair users.
wheelchair.zh: 应该给轮椅使用者提供坡道。

wheelchair.en: Many new trains have space for wheelchair users.
wheelchair.zh: 许多新火车都为坐轮椅者留有空间。

likelihood.zh: 传染的可能性微乎其微。

likelihood.en: There is very little likelihood of that happening.
likelihood.zh: 几乎没有发生那种事情的可能。

likelihood.en: He faces growing unease among the Democrats about the likelihood of war.
likelihood.zh: 他面对着民主党人对战争可能性的日益增加的不安。

toll.en: The official death toll has now reached 7 000.
toll.zh: 官方公布的死亡人数现已达7 000人。

toll.en: There are fears that the casualty toll may be higher.
toll.zh: 人们担心伤亡人数可能会更多。

toll.en: Most people who drive the toll roads don't use them every day.
toll.zh: 大部分开车上收费公路的人不是每天都走公路。

rim.en: There is also a new steering wheel with an energy-absorbing rim to cushion the driver's head in the worst impacts.
rim.zh: 还有新式方向盘，其边缘具有减震功能在最严重的冲击中缓冲保护司机的头部。

rim.en: Insects that land on the rim of the pitcher slide on the liquid and tumble in.
rim.zh: 落在水罐边缘的昆虫在液体上滑行，并在里面打滚。

rim.en: Other items included a Lapita burial urn with modeled birds arranged on the rim as though peering down at the human remains sealed inside.
rim.zh: 其他物品还包括一个拉皮塔人的骨灰盒，骨灰盒边缘摆放着模型鸟，仿佛在俯视密封在里面的人类遗骸。

isolated.en: I felt very isolated in my new job.
isolated.zh: 我在新的工作岗位上觉得很孤独。
这个国家在外交上仍然是孤立的。

isolated.en: Patients with the disease should be isolated.
isolated.zh: 这种病的患者应予以隔离。

cling.en: Since you don't like your perception of him, why cling to it?
cling.zh: 既然你不喜欢你对他的看法，为什么还坚持这个看法呢？

cling.en: He had one last hope to cling on to.
cling.zh: 他还抱着最后的一线希望。

cling.en: The cat tried to cling to the edge by its claws.
cling.zh: 那只猫试图用爪子抓紧边沿。

blink.en: He developed a nervous twitch and began to blink constantly.
blink.zh: 他患上了一种神经痉挛病，开始不停地眨眼睛。

processor.en: You can download the file and edit it on your word processor.
processor.zh: 你可以把文件下载，用文字处理系统做编辑。

processor.en: He would often be working away on his word processor late into the night.
processor.zh: 他经常会在他的文字处理机上持续工作到深夜。

processor.en: The computer acts as a word processor where the text of a speech can be input at any time.
processor.zh: 计算机起着文字处理器的作用，一篇讲话的文本可随时输入。

eligible.en: They are not eligible for sick pay.
eligible.zh: 他们没有资格领病假工资。

eligible.en: He's only 17 and therefore not eligible to vote.
eligible.zh: 他只有17岁，因此没有投票选举的资格。

eligible.en: Only 60% of eligible voters actually used their vote.
eligible.zh: 只有60%的符合资格的投票人行使了选举权。

demographic.en: Such changes are also indicators of economic dynamism and demographic expansion.
demographic.zh: 这些变化也是经济活跃和人口膨胀的指示器。

demographic.en: There are substantial differences among consumers with similar demographic characteristics.
demographic.zh: 具有相似人口统计学特征的消费者之间存在实质性差异。

demographic.en: By the mid-19th century most of Europe was in the first stage of the demographic transition.
demographic.zh: 到19世纪中叶，欧洲的大部分地区处于人口转变的第一阶段。

plunge.zh: 他的体重开始骤然下降。

plunge.en: The company is planning a deeper plunge into the commercial market.
plunge.zh: 这家公司正计划进一步投入商业市场。

plunge.en: He took the plunge into the deep end.

legislator.en: Each constituency will return only one legislator.
legislator.zh: 每一选区只能有一位“立委”。

legislator.en: Which countries have the largest number of people per legislator?
legislator.zh: 哪些国家的议员代表最多数的人？

legislator.en: Last month Austin Badon, another state legislator, dropped out because he was finding it hard to raise money.
legislator.zh: 上个月，另一位州议会议员Austin Badon也因筹款困难而退出。

refuge.en: They took refuge in a bomb shelter.
refuge.zh: 他们在一个防空洞里避难。

refuge.en: A further 300 people have taken refuge in the US embassy.
refuge.zh: 又有300人在美国大使馆避难。

refuge.en: Four people who sought refuge in the Italian embassy have left voluntarily.
refuge.zh: 到意大利大使馆寻求避难的四个人已经自愿离开了。

chill.en: A chill shiver rippled over his skin.
chill.zh: 一阵寒颤传遍了他全身。

chill.en: His words sent a chill down her spine.
chill.zh: 他的话让她觉得毛骨悚然。

rally.en: After a brief rally the shares returned to $2.15.
rally.zh: 短暂的反弹之后，股票回到了$2.15。

rally.en: Speakers at the rally expressed sentiments of unity.
rally.zh: 集会上的发言者们表达了团结的观点。

rally.en: The rally was intended to be a show of strength by the socialists.
rally.zh: 社会主义者组织这次集会意在显示力量。

outlet.en: Sport became the perfect outlet for his aggression.
outlet.zh: 运动成为他攻击性心理的最佳出路。

outlet.en: They also needed an outlet to plug in their phones.
outlet.zh: 他们还需要一个插座来给手机充电。

outlet.en: Her father had found an outlet for his ambition in his work.
outlet.zh: 她父亲在工作中找到了施展抱负的途径。

steer.en: What is it like to steer a ship this size?
steer.zh: 驾驶这样大小的船会怎么样呢？

steer.en: The book tries to steer you through the maze of alternative therapies.
steer.zh: 这本书试图引导你穿越替代疗法的迷雾。

vendor.en: She stopped at one vendor, flashed her badge, and picked a handful of mushrooms.
vendor.zh: 她在一个小贩跟前停住了，亮了亮徽章，然后抓起一把蘑菇。

vendor.en: The new security, taking him for a beggar or a vendor, didn't allow the dean to enter the building.
vendor.zh: 新的保安把院长当成乞丐或小贩，不允许他进入大楼。

vendor.en: We watched locals beginning their day: some eating bowls of spicy noodles for breakfast; a vendor grating green papaya into a salad.
vendor.zh: 我们看见居民们开始新的一天：有些人吃碗麻辣面当早饭,一个小贩把木瓜拌入沙拉。

cheer.en: I think he misses her terribly. You might cheer him up.
cheer.zh: 我觉得他太想念她了。你也许能使他振作起来。

cheer.en: The colonel was rewarded with a resounding cheer from the men.
cheer.zh: 上校被这些人们报以一阵响亮的欢呼。

cheer.en: A great cheer went up from the crowd.
cheer.zh: 观众爆发出一阵热烈的欢呼声。

intact.zh: 这个花瓶保存得完好无损。
战争之后没几座完好的建筑了。

intact.en: Most of the house remains intact even after two hundred years.
intact.zh: 虽然过了两百年，这房子的大部分还保持完好。

peanut.zh: 詹姆斯朝她轻轻弹一颗花生。

peanut.en: I had two peanut butter and jelly sandwiches.
peanut.zh: 我吃了两个花生酱果酱三明治。

peanut.en: You can even get peanut butter and jelly on an English muffin for breakfast.
peanut.zh: 早餐时你甚至可以吃到英式松饼，佐以花生酱和果冻。

thrive.zh: 新商家在这一地区蓬勃兴起。
如今，她的公司继续蓬勃发展。

thrive.en: However, some birds thrive in noisy environments.
thrive.zh: 然而，有些鸟会在嘈杂的环境中茁壮成长。

elaborate.en: She went on to elaborate her argument.
elaborate.zh: 她进而详尽阐述了她的论点。

elaborate.en: She concocted some elaborate story to explain her absence.
elaborate.zh: 她精心编造了解释她不在场的一些谎言。

elaborate.en: According to the prosecution, the officers manufactured an elaborate story.
elaborate.zh: 根据起诉，军官们精心编造了事情的经过。

chew.en: I do not chew gum in public.
chew.zh: 我不在公共场合嚼口香糖。

chew.en: After the operation you may find it difficult to chew and swallow.
chew.zh: 手术后你咀嚼和吞咽都会感到困难。

chew.en: Don't chew, break, or crush the tablet.
chew.zh: 不要咀嚼、咬破或压碎药片。

auction.zh: 吉恩在拍卖行做文书工作。

auction.en: The sale is a big coup for the auction house.
auction.zh: 这次拍卖额对该拍卖行而言是极为难得的成就。

auction.en: Trading was very light ahead of yesterday's auction.
auction.zh: 昨天的拍卖之前交易很少。

steak.en: He dug his fork into the steak.
What's the best way to cook steak?
How would you like your steak done?

shareholder.en: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure, executives who don't get the nod also may wish to move on.
shareholder.zh: 由于董事会迫于股东们的压力而严格审查公司的接任方案，那些未获得许可的高管们也可能会想辞职。

shareholder.en: The words that have mattered are efficiency, flexibility, shareholder value, business-friendly, wealth generation, sales, impact and, in newspapers, circulation.
shareholder.zh: 关键词是效率、灵活性、股东价值、商业友好、创造财富、销售、影响力，以及报纸的发行量。

shareholder.en: Greece's fourth-biggest lender may call a shareholder meeting to seek approval for a 500 million- euro capital increase.
shareholder.zh: 希腊第四大银行可能会召开股东会议，寻求批准来增加5亿欧元资本。

conception.en: My conception of a garden was based on gardens I had visited in England.
conception.zh: 我对花园的概念是基于我在英格兰参观过的一些花园的。

conception.en: The plan was brilliant in its conception but failed because of lack of money.
conception.zh: 尽管这计划构想绝妙，但终因资金不足而告流产。
整个概念在科学上是不准确的。

comply.en: She must be made to comply with the rules.
They refused to comply with the UN resolution.
comply.zh: 他们拒绝遵守联合国的决议。

comply.en: Some beaches had failed to comply with environmental regulations.
comply.zh: 一些海滩没能遵守环保规定。

triumph.en: She gave a little crow of triumph.
triumph.zh: 她轻轻地发出了胜利的欢呼声。

triumph.en: Her triumph was a cause for celebration.
triumph.zh: 她的胜利是庆祝的理由。

triumph.en: The winning team returned home in triumph.

comparable.en: By contrast, the comparable figure for Canada is 16 percent.
comparable.zh: 对比之下，加拿大的可比数字是16%。

comparable.en: In other comparable countries, real wages increased much more rapidly.
comparable.zh: 在其他可比的国家里实际工资增长快得多。

comparable.en: Analysts predict that Digital will price the new line at less than half the cost of comparable IBM mainframes.
comparable.zh: 分析家们预测迪吉多公司会将其新线产品的价格定在低于可比的IBM公司大型主机成本的一半的水平。

calculation.zh: 凯茜作了一个粗略的计算。
我们的猜测通过计算得到证实。

conscience.en: He won't let it trouble his conscience.
conscience.zh: 他不会让这件事搞得自己良心不安。

conscience.en: He lay awake, scourged by his conscience.
conscience.zh: 他备受良心的折磨，不能入睡。

conscience.en: The crime lay heavy on her conscience.
conscience.zh: 那件罪行使她内疚不安。

constraint.en: Journalists were given the freedom to visit, investigate, and report without constraint.
constraint.zh: 新闻记者被赋予在没有约束下参观、调查和报道的自由。

constraint.en: The boy felt constraint in her presence.
constraint.zh: 那男孩在她面前感到局促不安。

constraint.en: The terrible constraint on organ transplantation is that every life extended depends on the death of someone young enough and healthy enough to have organs worth transplanting.
constraint.zh: 器官移植的可怕约束是，一个人生命的延长要依赖于另一个足够年轻、健康的人的死亡，因为只有这些人身上才有值得移植的器官。

scratch.en: Scratch my back – I've got an itch.
His work simply isn't up to scratch.
scratch.zh: 他的工作根本达不到要求。

emotionally.en: He said that we were emotionally immature.
emotionally.zh: 他说我们在感情上是不成熟的。
他们遭受了肉体上和感情上的折磨。

inevitably.en: Are mothers and teens inevitably at loggerheads?
inevitably.zh: 母亲与青少年不可避免地会发生争执吗？

inevitably.en: Older cars inevitably lack the latest safety refinements.
inevitably.zh: 较老式的汽车难免缺乏最新的安全改进。

inevitably.en: Such a policy would inevitably draw fierce resistance from farmers.
inevitably.zh: 这样的政策将不可避免地引起农民的激烈抵制。

interval.en: The process is repeated after a short interval of time.
interval.zh: 该程序间隔很短时间就重复一次。

interval.en: The interval between major earthquakes might be 200 years.
interval.zh: 大地震之间的间隔时间可能有200年。

interval.en: There is a 15-minute interval between two boats.
interval.zh: 两艘船之间有十五分钟的间隔。

expedition.en: The expedition was bedevilled by bad weather.
expedition.zh: 探险队深受恶劣天气的困扰。

expedition.en: Forty-three members of the expedition were killed.
It won't be labelled in any way as a military expedition.
expedition.zh: 它无论如何也称不上是一次军事远征。

similarity.en: There was a very basic similarity in our philosophy.
similarity.zh: 我们的人生哲学在根本上很相似。

similarity.en: The report highlights the similarity between the two groups.
similarity.zh: 这份报告强调两组之间的相似性。

similarity.en: Heather is also 25 and from Boston, but the similarity ends there.
similarity.zh: 希瑟也是25岁，也是波士顿人，但是他们的相似之处仅限于此。

lid.en: I can't get the lid off this jar.
lid.zh: 我打不开这广口瓶的盖子。

dumb.en: That was a pretty dumb thing to do.
In her early movies she played a dumb blonde.
dumb.zh: 在她早期的电影中，她扮演傻乎乎的金发女郎。

dumb.en: Nowadays we say someone is 'speech-impaired', not dumb.
dumb.zh: 现在我们说某个人“有语言障碍”，而不说是哑巴。

philosophical.en: He pondered, as if over some deep philosophical point.
philosophical.zh: 他沉思着，仿佛在思索某个深奥的哲学问题。

philosophical.en: The philosophical problems of chance and of free will are closely related.
philosophical.zh: 关于偶然性和自由意志的哲学问题是紧密相联的。

philosophical.en: He was more accustomed to cocktail party chatter than to political or philosophical discussions.
philosophical.zh: 比起政治或者哲学讨论，他更习惯于鸡尾酒会上的闲谈。

bulk.en: The bulk of the population lives in cities.
bulk.zh: 大多数人口居住在城市里。

bulk.en: Heterosexual contact is responsible for the bulk of HIV transmission.
bulk.zh: 异性间的性接触是造成大多数艾滋病病毒传播的原因。

mortality.en: Premature birth is the main cause of perinatal mortality.
mortality.zh: 早产是围产期死亡的主要原因。

mortality.en: The nation's infant mortality rate has reached a record low.
mortality.zh: 该国的婴儿死亡率已达历史最低。

mortality.en: Infant mortality is a reliable barometer of socio-economic conditions.
mortality.zh: 婴儿死亡率是社会经济状况的可靠指标。
