sprinkle.en: Sprinkle onion and cheese in the pie plate.
sprinkle.zh: 把洋葱和干酪撒在饼盘中。

sprinkle.en: You can sprinkle shallots and tomatoes on the surface as you like.
sprinkle.zh: 你可以随喜好在表面撒上青葱和番茄。

sprinkle.en: Sprinkle with cinnamon if desired and top with a thinly sliced apple.
sprinkle.zh: 如果需要的话，撒上肉桂，然后在上面放上切成薄片的苹果。

patron.en: Frederick the Great was the patron of many artists.
patron.zh: 腓特烈大帝是许多艺术家的赞助人。

patron.en: Catherine the Great was a patron of the arts and sciences.
patron.zh: 凯瑟琳大帝是艺术和科学的赞助人。

patron.en: In 1755 British writer Samuel Johnson published an acerbic letter to Lord Chesterfield rebuffing his patron for neglecting and declining support.
patron.zh: 1755年，英国作家塞缪尔·约翰逊发表了一封致切斯特菲尔德勋爵的讽刺信，斥责其赞助人忽视并且拒绝支持他。

municipal.en: The municipal authorities gave the go-ahead for the march.
municipal.zh: 市政当局批准了此次游行。

municipal.en: The municipal authorities here are preparing for food rationing.
municipal.zh: 此地的市政当局正为食物配给制做准备。

municipal.en: Islanders have campaigned for the abolition of one of the three tiers of municipal power on the island.
municipal.zh: 岛民们已经发起了运动，要废除该岛3级市政权力中的1级。

conversion.en: No conversion from analogue to digital data is needed.
conversion.zh: 没有必要把模拟转换为数字数据。

conversion.en: Currency-conversion costs remain one of the biggest obstacles to cross-border trade.
conversion.zh: 货币兑换成本仍是跨境贸易的最大障碍之一。

conversion.en: This whole conversion process relies on a particular enzyme.
conversion.zh: 这整个转化过程依赖于一种特殊的酶。

liver.en: The largest organ in the body is the liver.
liver.zh: 体内最大的器官是肝脏。

liver.en: The drug can cause inflammation of the liver.
liver.zh: 这种药会引发肝脏炎症。

liver.en: She was on a wait list for a liver transplant.
liver.zh: 她的名字当时在肝移植等候者名单上。

solely.en: Too often we make decisions based solely upon what we see in the magazines.
solely.zh: 大多数时候，我们仅仅依据在杂志上看到的东西作决定。

solely.en: He became solely responsible for the firm.
solely.zh: 他成了公司唯一的负责人。

tolerance.en: She had no tolerance for jokes of any kind.
They were working to a tolerance of 0.0001 of a centimetre.
tolerance.zh: 他们在按0.0001厘米的公差加工。

tolerance.en: They have a policy of zero tolerance for sexual harassment.
tolerance.zh: 他们对性骚扰采取零容忍态度。

harmony.en: The book contrasts modern civilization with the ideal of the noble savage who lived in harmony with nature.
harmony.zh: 这本书将现代文明同与自然界和谐相处的高尚野蛮人的理想进行了对比。

harmony.en: Was it on the train "Harmony" that John met with his girlfriend?
harmony.zh: 约翰是在“和谐号”列车上遇到他的女朋友的吗？

harmony.en: The only way for us to survive is to live in harmony with nature.
harmony.zh: 我们生存的唯一途径就是与自然和谐相处。

goat.en: I roped the goat to a post.
goat.zh: 我把山羊拴在一根柱子上。

goat.en: Reaching a maximum height of 56cm the pygmy goat is essentially a pet.
goat.zh: 这种最高只能长到56厘米的小山羊基本是作为宠物来养的。

goat.en: A goat was standing up against a tree on its hind legs, trying to get at the leaves.
goat.zh: 一只山羊后腿趴在一棵树上站起来，试图去够树叶。

peasant.en: That forced peasant farmers to try to eke a living off steep hillsides.
peasant.zh: 那迫使农民要靠在陡峭的山坡上来勉强维持生计。

peasant.en: He was born of a peasant family.
peasant.zh: 他出生于一个农民家庭。

peasant.en: He was a peasant in his early years.

neat.en: She was wearing a neat black suit.
neat.zh: 她穿着整洁的黑色礼服。

neat.en: He arranged the documents in neat piles.
neat.zh: 他把文件一摞摞地码得整整齐齐。
她欣赏他写的一手好字。

cruise.en: He was billed as the new Tom Cruise.
cruise.zh: 他被宣传为新汤姆•克鲁斯。

cruise.en: They were rescued by a passing cruise ship.
cruise.zh: 他们被一艘经过的游轮救起。

cruise.en: I've always wanted to go on a cruise.

formerly.en: He had formerly been in the navy.
I learnt that the house had formerly been an inn.
formerly.zh: 我得知这座房子以前是家客栈。

formerly.en: Formerly he often lingered about [around] a park, doing nothing.
formerly.zh: 从前他时常在公园里逛荡，无所事事。

widow.en: She became a widow a year ago.
"You're a widow?"—"Yes. My husband's been dead a year now."
widow.zh: “你是个寡妇？”——“是的，我丈夫去世1年了。”

impulse.en: Unable to resist the impulse, he glanced at the sea again.
impulse.zh: 他抑制不住冲动，又看了一眼大海。
他往往凭一时冲动行事。

brake.en: The brake pedal had just snapped off.
brake.zh: 制动踏板刚才突然断裂了。

brake.en: The truck fishtailed when Bruun hit the brake.
brake.zh: 当布隆踩刹车时，卡车摆尾行驶。

brake.en: High interest rates are a brake on the economy.
brake.zh: 高利率阻碍了经济发展。

deposit.zh: 房东可以收取一笔可退还的押金。

deposit.en: A returnable deposit is payable on arrival.
deposit.zh: 抵达时应支付可退还押金。

brutal.en: They lived in happy insulation from brutal facts.
brutal.zh: 他们生活在幸福中，与残酷事实相隔绝。

brutal.en: This juxtaposition of brutal reality and lyrical beauty runs through Park's stories.
brutal.zh: 残酷的现实和抒情诗般的美并存贯穿于帕克的故事之中。

brutal.en: Hook itched to do it, but it seemed too brutal.
brutal.zh: 胡克很想这么做，但似乎太残忍了。

forbid.en: I forbid anyone to touch that clock.
forbid.zh: 我不准任何人碰那台钟。

predator.en: Now if you are a bird and there is a predator around.
predator.zh: 假设你是一只鸟，且现在周围有捕食者。

predator.en: A predator is an animal that hunts and eats other animals.
predator.zh: 捕食性动物是一种猎食其他动物的动物。

predator.en: It serves to distract a predator while the octopus makes its escape.
predator.zh: 它的作用是在章鱼逃跑时分散捕食者的注意力。

voluntary.en: She works there on a voluntary basis.
voluntary.zh: 她自愿在那里无偿工作。

poke.en: He gave me a poke in the ribs to wake me up.
poke.zh: 他捅了一下我的肋部把我叫醒。

poke.en: John smiled at them and gave Richard a playful poke.
poke.zh: 约翰冲他们笑了笑，还顽皮地捅了理查德一下。

poke.en: Right yonder's where I saw Injun Joe poke up his candle, Huck!
poke.zh: 哈克，我就是在那看见印第安·乔伸出蜡烛的！

opt.en: People still opt for monogamy and marriage.
opt.zh: 人们还是选择单一配偶制和婚姻。

opt.en: Many say that, given a choice, they would opt for a holiday to put the pep back in their lives.
opt.zh: 很多人说，要是能选择，他们宁愿选择休假来恢复活力。

opt.en: If the banks opt to pull the rug from under the ill-fated project, it will go into liquidation.
opt.zh: 如果这些银行选择不再支持那项倒霉的工程，它就将破产。

valid.en: All tickets are valid for two months.
valid.zh: 所有的票在两个月内有效。

valid.en: Our realty agent says the sales contract is valid.
valid.zh: 我们的房地产代理人称该销售合同是有效的。

valid.en: This special offer is valid until the end of the month.
valid.zh: 这个特价优惠月底前有效。

forum.en: The forum is now open to all budding entrepreneurs.
forum.zh: 该论坛现在向所有崭露头角的企业家开放。

forum.en: The quarterly had been a forum for sound academic debate.
forum.zh: 这份季刊曾经是正统学术辩论的论坛。

forum.en: Members of the council agreed that was an important forum for discussion.
forum.zh: 理事会成员们一致认为那是一个用于讨论的重要论坛。

soar.zh: 他的市场份额不断高涨。

soar.en: The eagle can soar without flapping their wings.
soar.zh: 老鹰无需振翼就能翱翔。

soar.en: Most animals seek shade when temperatures in the Sahara Desert soar to 120 degrees Fahrenheit.
soar.zh: 当撒哈拉沙漠的温度飙升到120华氏度时，大多数动物会寻找庇荫处。

enact.en: It is imperative that governments around the world enact laws to protect the environment at home and abroad.
enact.zh: 世界各国政府必须制定法律来保护国内外的环境。

enact.en: It is imperative that governments around the world should enact laws to protect the environment both at home and abroad.
enact.zh: 世界各国政府必须制定法律来保护国内外环境。

enact.en: Members of the English Civil War Society will re-enact the battle.
enact.zh: 英格兰内战协会的成员将再次展现那场战争。

autonomy.en: She sets a high value on autonomy.
The six fractious republics are demanding autonomy.
autonomy.zh: 这六个不安分的加盟共和国要求自治。

autonomy.en: Each of the area managers enjoys considerable autonomy in the running of his own area.
autonomy.zh: 每一位地区经理在各自主管的区域都享有相当大的自主权。

thread.en: He took a needle and thread and sewed it up.
thread.zh: 他取来一根针和线并把它缝起来。

thread.en: A common thread runs through these discussions.
thread.zh: 这些讨论都贯穿着一条共同的主线。

thread.en: The blue fabric was interwoven with red and gold thread.
thread.zh: 蓝布中交织着红色和金色的线。

removal.en: They rejected a demand for the removal of all nuclear weapons.
removal.zh: 他们拒绝了清除所有核武器的要求。

removal.en: What they expected to be the removal of a small lump turned out to be major surgery.
removal.zh: 他们本以为只是切除一个小肿块，结果却成了个大手术。

removal.en: Nearby Malaysia may have the right to order the wreck's removal, the newspaper said.
removal.zh: 附近的马来西亚可能有权命令移除残骸，该报纸说。

fraction.en: The fraction was then multiplied by 100 and rounded to the nearest half or whole number.
fraction.zh: 该分数然后被乘以100，再四舍五入成半数或者整数。

fraction.en: Their economy is still a fraction of ours.
fraction.zh: 他们的经济仍然是我们的一部分。

fraction.en: It's usually a small fraction of the total.
fraction.zh: 它通常只是总数的一小部分。

landmark.en: Marble Arch is a famous London landmark.
landmark.zh: 大理石拱门是伦敦著名的标志性建筑。

landmark.en: The Menger Hotel is a San Antonio landmark.
landmark.zh: 蒙尔饭店是圣安东尼奥的一个标志性建筑。

landmark.en: There are efforts under way to designate the bridge a historic landmark.
landmark.zh: 在努力把这座桥定为历史地标。

tourism.zh: 旅游业对于经济至关重要。

tourism.en: Tourism is the lifeblood of the city.
tourism.zh: 旅游业是这座城市的命脉。

tourism.en: There's money to be made from tourism.

distinctive.en: Chick peas have a distinctive, delicious, and nutty flavour.
distinctive.zh: 鹰嘴豆有独特可口的坚果味。

distinctive.en: When Miles Davis died jazz was robbed of its most distinctive voice.
distinctive.zh: 当迈尔斯•戴维斯去世时，爵士乐里最具特色的声音也被夺走了。

distinctive.en: They have big eyes and distinctive visual centers.
distinctive.zh: 它们的眼睛很大，有独特的视觉中心。

threshold.en: She felt as though she was on the threshold of a new life.
threshold.zh: 她觉得好像就要开始新生活了。

suite.en: I suggest we fit you up with an office suite.
suite.zh: 我建议我们为你配备一间办公套房。

suite.en: We were entertained in the company's hospitality suite.
suite.zh: 公司款待我们住进他们的迎宾套间。

suite.en: Malone got to his feet and followed his superior out of the suite.
suite.zh: 马隆站起来跟着他的上司走出套房。

straw.en: The floors are covered with woven straw mats.
straw.zh: 地板上铺着用草编织的垫子。

straw.en: She was noisily sucking up milk through a straw.
straw.zh: 她正用吸管咕嘟咕嘟地喝牛奶。

straw.en: I stumbled through mud to a garden strewn with straw.
straw.zh: 我跌跌撞撞地走过泥泞来到一个散满稻草的院子。

fragile.en: Oil pollution could damage the fragile ecology of the coral reefs.
fragile.zh: 石油污染可能破坏珊瑚礁脆弱的生态环境。

fragile.en: The company does not accept liability for fragile, valuable or perishable articles.
fragile.zh: 公司对于易碎、贵重或易腐烂的物品不负责任。

globe.en: Dr. Russel is creating an elite herd by cross-breeding goats from around the globe.
globe.zh: 罗素博士正在通过使来自世界各地的山羊杂交而创造一种精品羊群。

globe.en: He still wheels and deals around the globe.
globe.zh: 他仍在世界各地钻营谋取。

globe.en: The overhead light was covered now with a white globe.
globe.zh: 顶灯现在被一个白色的球状物罩了起来。

exhaust.zh: 我的汽车需要一个新排气管。

objection.en: I have no objection to your request.
His objection was ruled out of order.
objection.zh: 他的反对被裁定为违反会议规则。

objection.en: I have no objection to banks making money.
objection.zh: 我对银行赚钱没有反对意见。

prevail.en: We hoped that common sense would prevail.
prevail.zh: 我们希望常识能占上风。

prevail.en: Rick still believes that justice will prevail.
prevail.zh: 里克仍然相信正义会占上风。

prevail.en: Those beliefs still prevail among certain social groups.
prevail.zh: 这些信念在某些社会群体中仍很盛行。

overnight.zh: 几乎在一夜之间我被治愈了。

blast.zh: 爆炸声震破了奥利·威廉斯的耳鼓。

blast.en: The blast may have vaporized the meteorite.
blast.zh: 爆炸可能使陨石汽化了。

blast.en: The blast caused several buildings to catch fire.
blast.zh: 爆炸导致了几个建筑物起火。

denial.zh: 乔安娜的否认听上去像是真的。

denial.en: With major life traumas, like losing a loved one, for instance, the mind's first reaction is denial.
denial.zh: 面对人生的重大创痛，例如失去深爱的人，心理的第一反应就是拒绝接受。

denial.en: The denial only seemed to make the thing worse for Tom.
denial.zh: 汤姆的否认似乎只会使事情变得更糟。

rental.zh: 你的账单包括电话线路的租用费。
电话费包括线路租用费。

rental.en: It has been let at an annual rental of $393,000.
rental.zh: 它已经以每年$393000的租金租出去了。

fragment.en: She read everything, digesting every fragment of news.
fragment.zh: 她什么都读，对新闻的每一个片段都细细品味。

fragment.en: We introduce fragment identifiers for the speakers.
fragment.zh: 我们为演讲者引入了片段标识符。

fragment.en: You can see one of these functions in the code fragment below.
fragment.zh: 您可以在下面的代码片段中看到这些函数之一。

warmth.zh: 这些香水温暖且令人愉悦。

warmth.en: She felt the warmth of his arms around her.
warmth.zh: 她感到了他双臂搂着她的温暖。

warmth.en: The letter was devoid of warmth and feeling.
warmth.zh: 这封信既无热情又无感情。

screw.en: I can't get the screw to turn.
There should be no exposed screw heads.

undergraduate.en: Every day, there's going to be a TA in the undergraduate lounge.
undergraduate.zh: 每天都会有一名助教在本科休息室里。

undergraduate.en: One idea is to allow people to study law as an undergraduate degree.
undergraduate.zh: 一个想法是允许人们在本科阶段学习法律。

undergraduate.en: This leaves today's average law-school graduate with $100000 of debt on top of undergraduate debts.
undergraduate.zh: 这让如今的法学院毕业生平均承担10万美元的债务，居本科生债务之首。

projection.en: The idea of God is a projection of humans' need to have something greater than themselves.
projection.zh: 人类需要有强于自身的形象，上帝就是这个想法的投射。

projection.en: With the advent of projection in 1895-1896, motion pictures became the ultimate form of mass consumption.
projection.zh: 随着1895到1896年间投影技术的出现，电影成为大众消费的最终形式。

projection.en: With the advent of projection, the viewer's relationship with the image was no longer private, as it had been with earlier peepshow devices.
projection.zh: "随着投影的出现，观众与图像的关系不再像早年使用西洋镜设备时那样私密。

drill.en: This is not a fire drill—it's for real.
drill.zh: 这不是救火演习—是真失火了。

drill.en: A plug had been inserted in the drill hole.
drill.zh: 那个钻孔里已经塞上了塞子。

mansion.en: The mansion has been put up for sale.
His new luxury mansion was a world away from the tiny house where he was born.
mansion.zh: 他那座新的豪宅与他出生的小屋完全不能相比。

mansion.en: I spent two nights in the mansion .
mansion.zh: 我在那座大厦住了两个晚上。

authorize.en: Only the president could authorize the use of the atomic bomb.
authorize.zh: 只有总统能授权原子弹的使用。

authorize.en: It would certainly be within his power to authorize a police raid like that.
authorize.zh: 他肯定有权批准那种警方突袭行动。

authorize.en: The Wilderness Society lobbied Congress to authorize the Endangered Species Act.
authorize.zh: 荒野协会游说国会批准《濒危物种法》。

charm.zh: 他具有不可否认的魅力。

charm.en: He exudes natural charm and good humour.
charm.zh: 他表现出一种与生俱来的魅力和幽默感。

loyal.en: They had remained loyal to the president.
He went back to his loyal, long-suffering wife.
loyal.zh: 他回到了对他忠贞不渝、长期受苦的妻子身边。

loyal.en: They were unflinchingly loyal to their friends.
loyal.zh: 他们对朋友不变的忠诚。

ego.zh: 超人的第二自我是克拉克•肯特。

ego.en: He has the biggest ego of anyone I've ever met.
ego.zh: 他是我所见的最自负的人。

ego.en: His ego allows him to be humble, if you see what I mean.
ego.zh: 他的自我使他谦卑，如果你能明白我所说的意思。

clay.zh: 这些砖是用陶土制成的。

clay.en: She fashioned a pot from the clay.

availability.en: All the holidays on offer are subject to availability.
availability.zh: 现行所有的节假日只有在情况允许时才可放假。

availability.en: One area of contention is the availability of nursery care.
availability.zh: 争论的一个方面是提供幼儿保育的可能性。

availability.en: The second is the availability of sufficient time and space.
availability.zh: 第二点是有足够的时间和空间。

fare.en: The taxi driver picked up a fare at the station.
fare.zh: 出租车司机在车站接了一名乘客。

radar.zh: 他们通过雷达确定了船只的位置。
我们的雷达开始追踪那些喷气式飞机。

radar.en: The ship's radar scanned the sea ahead.
radar.zh: 船上的雷达扫描了前方海域。

frown.zh: 她一皱眉，额头显出了皱纹。

frown.en: She looked up with a puzzled frown.
frown.zh: 她困惑地皱着眉抬头看。

frown.en: His forehead was bunched in a frown.

molecule.en: The DNA molecule is compounded from many smaller molecules.
molecule.zh: 脱氧核糖核酸分子是由许多更小的分子组成的。

molecule.en: A molecule of water consists of two atoms of hydrogen and one atom of oxygen.
molecule.zh: 水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成。

molecule.en: Two atoms of hydrogen combine with one atom of oxygen to form a molecule of water.
molecule.zh: 两个氢原子和一个氧原子结合组成一个水分子。

retreat.zh: 他们切断了敌人的退路。

retreat.en: The French, suddenly outnumbered, were forced to retreat.
retreat.zh: 法军在人数上突然处于劣势，被迫撤退了。

rubber.zh: 这个男孩儿穿着橡胶底的鞋。

rubber.en: The smell of burning rubber filled the air.
rubber.zh: 空气中弥漫着橡胶燃烧的气味。

rubber.en: The stench of burning rubber was overpowering.
rubber.zh: 燃烧橡胶散发出的臭味极其强烈。

rehabilitation.en: A number of other techniques are now being used by psychologists in the rehabilitation of young offenders.
rehabilitation.zh: 一些别的技术现正被心理学家们用于年轻罪犯的复原。

rehabilitation.en: On campus, he quickly found that beyond ordinary counselling, the university had no services for students who were undergoing physical rehabilitation and suffering from depression like him.
rehabilitation.zh: 在学校里，他很快发现，除了普通的心理咨询，学校没有为那些像他一样正在进行身体康复和患有抑郁症的学生提供任何服务。

rehabilitation.en: The prison service has the twin goals of punishment and rehabilitation.
rehabilitation.zh: 监狱有惩罚和改造双重目的。

steadily.en: The company's exports have been increasing steadily.
steadily.zh: 公司的出口量一直稳步增长。

youngster.en: As a youngster, she might have found it too restrictive, not creative enough.
youngster.zh: 作为一个年轻人，她可能会发现这项活动约束太多，不够创新。

youngster.en: Tests do not compensate for gross social inequality, and thus do not tell how able an underprivileged youngster might have been had he grown up under more favorable circumstances.
youngster.zh: 测试并不弥补明显的社会不公，因此不能说明一个物质条件差的年轻人，如果在较好的环境下成长的话，会有多大才干。

youngster.en: For example, tests do not compensate for gross social inequality, and thus do not tell how able an underprivileged youngster might have been had he grown up under more favorable circumstances.
youngster.zh: 例如，测试并不弥补明显的社会不公；因此，它们不能说明一个物质条件差的年轻人，如果在较好的环境下成长的话，会有多大才干。

premium.zh: 这种股票以高于面值的价格出售。

premium.en: Space is at a premium in a one-bedroomed apartment.
premium.zh: 单居室公寓的空间是很有限的。

premium.en: You have to pay a high premium for express delivery.
premium.zh: 快递须付高额的附加费。

contemplate.en: The thought of war is too awful to contemplate.
contemplate.zh: 战争太可怕了，真不敢去想。

contemplate.en: I can't contemplate what it would be like to be alone.
contemplate.zh: 我不能想象独自一人会是个什么样子。

contemplate.en: They contemplate trouble in obtaining hotel reservation.
contemplate.zh: 他们考虑到预订旅馆有困难。

overwhelm.en: It was clear that one massive Allied offensive would overwhelm the weakened enemy.
overwhelm.zh: 显然同盟国一次大规模的进攻就会彻底击败已被削弱的敌军。

overwhelm.en: There is this "detachment" and I realize that there are obviously experiences which would overwhelm everyone.
overwhelm.zh: 有了这种“超然”，我意识到显然有一些经历会压垮所有人。

overwhelm.en: Initially unrestrained by predators of their own, foreign predators are likely to be able to multiply rapidly and overwhelm intended targets.
overwhelm.zh: 外来掠食者最初不受自身掠食者的限制，它们可能会迅速繁殖并击溃预定目标。

spark.en: A spark ignites the fuel in a car engine.
spark.zh: 汽车发动机中的燃料由火花点燃。

spark.en: He passed an electric spark through a mixture of gases.
spark.zh: 他使一束电火花穿过一团气体混合物。

spark.en: This spark is the strength of conviction.
spark.zh: 这个火花就是信念的力量。

fatigue.en: Driver fatigue was to blame for the accident.
fatigue.zh: 这个事故是驾驶员疲劳所致。

fatigue.en: She was plagued by weakness, fatigue, and dizziness.
fatigue.zh: 她被虚弱、疲劳和眩晕折磨。

fatigue.en: The wing of the plane showed signs of metal fatigue.
fatigue.zh: 机翼显示出金属疲劳的迹象。

ironically.en: Ironically, for a man who hated war, he would have made a superb war cameraman.
ironically.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，他这样一个憎恨战争的人曾经可能成为一名优秀的战地摄影师。

ironically.en: Ironically, the book she felt was her worst sold more copies than any of her others.
ironically.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，那本书她觉得最糟糕，却比她的其他任何一本书卖得都好。

ironically.en: Ironically, he could not draw particularly well.
ironically.zh: 讽刺的是，他并不是特别擅长绘画。

speculate.en: It is useless to speculate why he did it.
speculate.zh: 对他为什么这么做妄加猜测毫无用处。

speculate.en: It's always hard to speculate about the future.
It's tempting to speculate about what might have happened.
speculate.zh: 大家不禁猜测，到底发生了什么事。

marker.en: He placed a marker where the ball had landed.
marker.zh: 他在球落地的地方放了个标记。

marker.en: Price is not always an accurate marker of quality.
marker.zh: 价格并不总是质量的准确标志。

bucket.en: We let the bucket down by a rope.
bucket.zh: 我们用绳子把吊桶放下去。

bucket.en: She ran hot water into the bucket.
She threw a bucket of water over them.

meantime.en: I'll contact them soon. Meantime don't tell them I'm back.
meantime.zh: 我会尽快和他们联系。在此期间，不要告诉他们我回来了。

meantime.en: In the meantime the war of nerves seems likely to continue.
meantime.zh: 同时心理战似乎很有可能要继续下去。

meantime.en: My first novel was rejected by six publishers. In the meantime I had written a play.
meantime.zh: 我的第一部小说遭到六家出版商的拒绝。其间我又完成了一部戏剧。

preach.en: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to preach.
preach.zh: 很抱歉，我并没有说教的意思。

preach.en: He said he was trying to preach peace and tolerance to his people.
preach.zh: 他说他正试图向他的人民宣扬和平与宽容。

substantially.en: Salaries and associated costs have risen substantially.
substantially.zh: 薪金与相关费用大大增加。

substantially.en: The percentage of girls in engineering has increased substantially.
substantially.zh: 工科女生的比例已经大大增长了。

marble.en: Her heels clacked on the marble floor.
marble.zh: 她的鞋后跟在大理石地面上发出咔嗒咔嗒的响声。

marble.en: Marble Arch is a famous London landmark.
marble.zh: 大理石拱门是伦敦著名的标志性建筑。

provoke.en: His duty was to conciliate the people, not to provoke them.
provoke.zh: 他的任务是安抚这些人，而不是激怒他们。

provoke.en: Premature moves in this respect might well provoke a reaction against the reform.
provoke.zh: 在这方面过早的行动可能会激起对改革的抵触。

provoke.en: They accused both radicals and conservatives of trying to provoke a split in the party.
provoke.zh: 他们指责激进人士和保守人士都企图挑起党内分歧。

trauma.zh: 患者的大脑受到严重损伤。

trauma.en: He confronted his childhood trauma and tried to exorcize the pain.
trauma.zh: 他与童年时代的精神创伤对抗并试图祛除这种痛苦。

trauma.en: This would indicate that reparative therapy has the potential to help patients with advanced brain trauma to gain an improved quality of life.
trauma.zh: 这表明，修复性治疗有可能帮助晚期脑损伤患者获得更好的生活质量。

surveillance.en: He was arrested after being kept under constant surveillance.
surveillance.zh: 他在被连续监视之后给逮捕了。

surveillance.en: The police are keeping the suspects under constant surveillance.
surveillance.zh: 警方正对嫌疑人实施不间断监视。

surveillance.en: Police swooped on the home after a two-week surveillance operation.
surveillance.zh: 警方经过两周的监视行动后突击搜查了该住宅。

depart.en: They depart, with a smile and a nod, and we miss them, and feel resentful.
depart.zh: 他们微笑着点点头，离开了，而我们又怀念他们，又怨恨他们。

depart.en: The research showed that the airport you depart from also influences the cost.
depart.zh: 这项研究显示，你离开的机场也会影响成本。

depart.en: These vehicles are only rated to spend about 200 days in space, so they'll have to depart soon.
depart.zh: 这些飞行器只能在太空中停留大约200天，所以他们必须尽快离开。

explicit.en: He gave me very explicit directions on how to get there.
explicit.zh: 他清楚地向我说明了去那儿的路线。
他们应该有明确的许可吗？
这让他们的表达更加直白明确。

magnetic.zh: 这种矿石有轻微的磁性。

magnetic.en: Magnetic coils focus the electron beams into fine spots.
magnetic.zh: 磁线圈将电子束聚焦成细小的点。

magnetic.en: A radio signal has both electrical and magnetic properties.
magnetic.zh: 无线电信号既具有电的特性也具有磁的特性。

technician.en: It quickly became clear that the woman was not a computer technician.
technician.zh: 事情很快就搞清楚了，这名女子不是电脑技术员。

technician.en: When my voice hit a certain decibel, I was passed along, like a hot, irritable potato, to a technician.
technician.zh: 当我的声音达到一定分贝时，我就像一个令人易怒的热土豆一样被移交给技术员。

technician.en: An X-rays technician is refusing to do her job until the firm agrees to replace its out-dated equipment.
technician.zh: 一名X光技术人员拒绝工作，除非公司同意更换过时的设备。

devastating.en: Oil spills are having a devastating effect on coral reefs in the ocean.
devastating.zh: 海上溢油对海洋里的珊瑚礁有着毁灭性影响。

devastating.en: It will be a devastating blow to the local community if the factory closes.
devastating.zh: 如果这家工厂倒闭，将给当地居民以毁灭性的打击。

arrow.en: She fired an arrow at the target.

soak.en: What I need is to soak in a hot tub.
soak.zh: 我需要的是在浴盆里泡个热水澡。

soak.en: I'm going to go and soak in the bath.
Give the shirt a good soak before you wash it.
soak.zh: 把衬衫好好泡一泡再洗。

transmit.en: The speed with which digital cameras can take, process, and transmit an image is phenomenal.
transmit.zh: 数码相机拍摄、处理、传输图像的速度惊人。

transmit.en: This is currently the most efficient way to transmit certain types of data like electronic mail.
transmit.zh: 这是目前传输电子邮件等某类数据最有效的方法。

mutter.en: "Excuse me," I mutter, "I have to get this sham over with."
mutter.zh: “对不起。”我喃喃地说，“我得把这个假动作做完。”

mutter.en: John would rub his eyes and mutter, "It is true, we did fly."
mutter.zh: 约翰揉了揉眼睛，喃喃自语道：“这是真的，我们真的飞了。”

mutter.en: The old man, still pacing back and forth, ceased to speak aloud, and began to mutter.
mutter.zh: 老人仍在来回踱步，不再大声说话，开始喃喃自语起来。

ribbon.en: The road was a ribbon of moonlight.
ribbon.zh: 这条路在月光下如同一条缎带。

ribbon.en: She had tied back her hair with a peach satin ribbon.
ribbon.zh: 她用一条桃红色的缎带把头发扎在了脑后。

ribbon.en: Mrs. Haines stood nearby, holding scissors to cut a ribbon.
ribbon.zh: 海恩斯太太站在旁边，拿着剪刀剪缎带。

harvest.en: The poor harvest caused prices to rise sharply.
harvest.zh: 收成不好导致物价急剧上涨。

harvest.en: The vegetable harvest is disastrously behind schedule.
harvest.zh: 蔬菜收割灾难性地滞后于计划。

harvest.en: Rice farmers here still plant and harvest their crops by hand.
harvest.zh: 这里的稻农仍然用手工种植和收割庄稼。

slot.zh: 别人可以取代你的位置。

slot.en: He dropped a coin into the slot and dialled.
slot.zh: 他把一枚硬币投进了那个投币口，然后拨了号。

slot.en: He has a regular slot on the late-night programme.
slot.zh: 他在深夜节目中有一档固定栏目。

consecutive.en: The Cup was won for the third consecutive year by the Toronto Maple Leafs.
consecutive.zh: 这个奖杯连续第三年由多伦多枫叶队赢去了。

consecutive.en: The manufacturing economy contracted in October for the sixth consecutive month.
consecutive.zh: 制造业经济到10月份已连续萎缩6个月了。

consecutive.en: In Ontario, August was the first month with below-normal temperatures after eight consecutive months above normal.
consecutive.zh: 在安大略省，8月份是连续8个月高于正常温度之后的第一个低于正常温度的月份。

spy.en: He was denounced as a foreign spy.
spy.zh: 有人告发他是外国间谍。

spy.en: He was jailed for five years as an alleged spy.
spy.zh: 他被指控为间谍而被监禁了5年。

spy.en: "She thinks you're a spy," Scott said matter-of-factly.
spy.zh: “她认为你是一名间谍，”斯科特面无表情地说。

coordinate.en: She'll show you how to coordinate pattern and colours.
coordinate.zh: 她会向你展示如何搭配款式和颜色。

coordinate.en: They appointed a new manager to coordinate the work of the team.
coordinate.zh: 为协调这个队的工作，他们任用了一位新经理。

coordinate.en: Government officials visited the earthquake zone on Thursday morning to coordinate the relief effort.
coordinate.zh: 政府官员星期四上午视察了地震灾区以协调救灾工作。

riot.en: After about 10 minutes the riot police arrived.
riot.zh: 大约10分钟之后，防暴警察就到了。

riot.en: Cars and buses were set ablaze during the riot.
riot.zh: 暴乱中许多轿车和公共汽车被纵火焚烧。

nutrient.en: You said that the nitrogen cycle is also an important nutrient cycle.
nutrient.zh: 你说了，氮循环也是一个重要的营养循环。

nutrient.en: You can look at the nutrient broken down as a function of the percent daily values.
nutrient.zh: 你可以把分解的营养成分看做及每日建议摄取量的一个功能。

citizenship.en: They're going to take my citizenship away.
citizenship.zh: 他们将夺走我的公民权。

citizenship.en: Citizenship is about the sense of nationhood.
citizenship.zh: 公民身份涉及国家意识。

citizenship.en: You can apply for citizenship after five years' residency.
citizenship.zh: 居住五年后可申请公民资格。

severely.zh: 浓雾严重影响了能见度。
他的看护人说他严重残疾。

severely.en: Her hair was tied severely in a bun.
severely.zh: 她的头发简单地盘成了一个发髻。

ridge.en: The fawn ran to the top of the ridge.
He slowed the pace as they crested the ridge.
ridge.zh: 当他们到达山脊时，他放慢了步伐。

ridge.en: Rammick lives high on a ridge in a 400-home subdivision.
ridge.zh: 拉米克住在高高的山脊上一块有400户的住宅区。

frustrate.en: Words frustrate her, like fastened buttons at which she can only fumble.
frustrate.zh: 言语使她感到挫败，就像扣上的扣子，她只能摸索着按。

frustrate.en: Gender inequality continues to frustrate a lot of female employees.
frustrate.zh: 性别不平等仍然让许多女员工感到沮丧。

frustrate.en: First, choose problems to work on that "challenge but do not frustrate".
frustrate.zh: 首先，挑选“有挑战性但不令人沮丧”的问题，并解决它们。

contributor.en: Sulphur dioxide is a pollutant and a major contributor to acid rain.
contributor.zh: 二氧化硫是一种污染物，并且是形成酸雨的主要因素。

contributor.en: They reported that clouds are an important and heretofore uninvestigated contributor to the climate.
contributor.zh: 他们报告说，云是影响气候的一个重要因素，但迄今尚未进行过调查研究。

contributor.en: What was a significant contributor to the past glory of public schools?
contributor.zh: 是什么对公立学校过去的辉煌做出了贡献？

specify.en: For the effect, you need to specify a size, with the horizontal size first, and then the vertical size.
specify.zh: 为实现这个效果，您需要指定一个尺寸，首先是水平尺寸，然后是垂直尺寸。

specify.en: It's got to be practical so don't forget to specify things like who would be involved, and the cost, and the order that things would be done in.
specify.zh: 它必须是实用的，所以不要忘记指定诸如参与者有谁、成本、完成顺序等事宜。

specify.en: The trick is not only to specify just one or even two dimensions of the objective, but also to understand how to help people better achieve the objective.
specify.zh: 窍门在于，不仅要指定目标的一个、甚至两个维度，还要了解如何帮助人们更好地实现目标。

transit.en: The contents of the package may have settled in transit.
transit.zh: 包裹里的东西可能在运输途中摇密实了。

transit.en: During their talks, the two presidents discussed the transit of goods between the two countries.
transit.zh: 在会谈中，两位总统讨论了两国之间货物的运输。

seminar.en: The seminar was to discuss diversification of agriculture.
seminar.zh: 该研讨会讨论的是农业多种经营。

seminar.en: Seminar topics are chosen for their accessibility to a general audience.
seminar.zh: 专题讨论会的话题是根据普通听众的理解力来选定的。

seminar.en: Students are asked to prepare material in advance of each weekly seminar.
seminar.zh: 要求学生为每星期一次的研讨班预先准备好材料。

dense.en: The area was covered in dense jungle.
This creature's fur is short, dense and silky.
dense.zh: 这种动物的毛短、浓密且柔顺。

dense.en: We fought our way through the dense vegetation.
dense.zh: 我们在茂密的植被中开出一条通路。

electronics.en: Racal Electronics shares have been in a strong uptrend.
electronics.zh: 瑞卡尔电子公司的股票已处在强劲上升趋势中。
索恩的电子公司雇佣了大约五千名员工。

electronics.en: The term electronics refers to electrically induced action.
electronics.zh: 电子学描述的是电力产生的作用。

articulate.zh: 她是个善表达的年轻女子。

articulate.en: He was too drunk to articulate properly.
articulate.zh: 他醉得连话都说不清楚。

swell.en: Her arm was beginning to swell up where the bee had stung her.
swell.zh: 她胳膊给蜜蜂蜇了，肿了起来。

swell.en: When you develop a throat infection or catch a cold the glands in the neck swell up.
swell.zh: 当你咽喉发炎或感冒时, 脖子上的腺体会肿起来。

biography.en: This book is a well balanced biography.
biography.zh: 这是一本很公正的传记。

biography.en: Nelson Mandela is the subject of a new biography.
biography.zh: 纳尔逊•曼德拉是一本新传记的传主。

biography.en: His biography is nothing but self-regarding nonsense.
biography.zh: 他的传记只不过是自命不凡的一派胡言。

hazard.en: A new report suggests that chewing gum may be a health hazard.
hazard.zh: 一份新的报告指出，嚼口香糖可能给健康带来危害。

hazard.en: Catching colds is unfortunately an occupational hazard in this profession.
hazard.zh: 不幸的是，患感冒是这个行业的职业风险。

hazard.en: The recent outbreaks of cholera are a timely reminder that this disease is still a serious health hazard.
hazard.zh: 最近几次爆发的霍乱是一个适时的提醒，该疾病依然是个严重的健康危害。

cue.en: Can you cue me when you want me to begin speaking?
cue.zh: 你要我开始讲话时能给我暗示一下吗？

cue.en: She stood in the wings and waited for her cue to go on.
cue.zh: 她站在舞台侧面等待着出场的提示。

cue.en: He chalked his billiard cue again and again.
cue.zh: 他一再用白垩粉擦他的球杆尖。

seldom.zh: 我很少感到过这么快乐了。
这些日子他们很少看电视。

seldom.en: She was a severe woman who seldom smiled.
seldom.zh: 她是个严肃的女人，脸上很少出现笑容。

economically.en: The factory is no longer economically viable.
economically.zh: 这个工厂在经济上已经维持不下去了。

economically.en: Services could be operated more efficiently and economically.
economically.zh: 可以更有效、更经济地提供服务。

economically.en: Now is the time when we must all live as economically as possible.
economically.zh: 现在是我们都必须尽可能节俭度日的时候了。

compelling.en: There is no compelling reason to believe him.
compelling.zh: 没有令人信服的理由让人相信他。

compelling.en: This compelling story begins with the crowning of Queen Victoria in 1837.
compelling.zh: 这个吸引人的故事开始于1837年维多利亚女王的加冕。

compelling.en: That would appear to be some pretty compelling evidences.
compelling.zh: 这似乎是一些很有说服力的证据。

tile.en: That's tile next tiling you need to do.
tile.zh: 那是你下一步要铺的瓷砖。

tile.en: To find out, we introduced bacteria to squares of tile, carpet or wood.
tile.zh: 为了找到答案，我们把细菌注入到方砖、地毯或木制品上。

tile.en: But when the food was in contact with tile or wood, 48-70% of bacteria were.
tile.zh: 但当食物与瓷砖或木头接触时，会有48% -70%的细菌（留在上面）。

vague.zh: 这项描述是相当含糊的。
这些指控的内容模糊不清。

vague.en: The phrasing of the question was vague.
vague.zh: 在这个问题上措词模糊。

balanced.zh: 这个队的队员配备得不是很均衡。

balanced.en: It is essential that your diet is varied and balanced.
balanced.zh: 重要的是你的饮食应当是多样而平衡的。

balanced.en: He balanced his budgets by rigid control over public expenditure.
balanced.zh: 他通过严格控制公共开支来平衡预算。

weave.en: She sat at her loom and continued to weave.
weave.zh: 她坐在织布机前，继续织布。

weave.en: They would spin and weave cloth, cook and attend to the domestic side of life.
weave.zh: 他们纺纱、织布、做饭，还料理家务。

weave.en: The key is to weave relevant personal anecdotes into your writing.
weave.zh: 关键是要编织有关的个人轶事到你的写作中。

convenience.en: They may use a credit card for convenience.
convenience.zh: 他们可以为了方便而使用信用卡。
这家旅馆既舒适又方便。

convenience.en: Frozen fish is a very healthy convenience food.
convenience.zh: 冻鱼是一种非常健康的方便食品。

plea.en: He reached a plea bargain with the authorities.
plea.zh: 他和当局达成了辩诉交易。

plea.en: A plea bargain was offered by the state assuring her that she would not go to prison.
plea.zh: 该州提出了一份认罪辩诉协议，保证她不会入狱。

plea.en: The district court ruled that Popper's silence in court today should be entered as a plea of not guilty.
plea.zh: 该区法院裁决波珀今天在法庭中的缄默应被看作是进行无罪抗辩。

sustainable.en: The creation of an efficient and sustainable transport system is critical.
sustainable.zh: 一个高效而可持续发展的交通系统的创建是非常重要的。

sustainable.en: The farming methods of ants are at least sustainable.
sustainable.zh: 蚂蚁的养殖方式至少是可持续的。

sustainable.en: We've talked recently about the importance of sustainable energy.
sustainable.zh: 最近我们谈到了可持续能源的重要性。

timber.en: Men were loading up a truck with timber.
timber.zh: 工人正在把木料装上卡车。

timber.en: He felled, peeled, and hewed his own timber.
timber.zh: 他自己砍树、剥皮并劈成木材。

timber.en: They have been bartering wheat for cotton and timber.
timber.zh: 他们一直在用小麦交换棉花和木材。

bulb.en: This makes the total cost of the bulb and energy $27.
bulb.zh: 这使得灯泡和电量的总耗费升为$27。

bulb.en: On the stairway to the basement, he took the light bulb out of the socket.
bulb.zh: 在通向地下室的楼梯上，他把灯泡从灯座上拧了下来。

bulb.en: It is easy to change a light bulb, sure, but it is harder to change the bulb and its fixture.
bulb.zh: 换一个灯泡当然很容易，但是要更换灯泡和其固定装置就比较难了。

bolt.en: Loosen the bolt so the bars can be turned.
bolt.zh: 松开螺栓，这样那些木板就能被翻过来了。

bolt.en: She leaned on the door and pushed the bolt home.
bolt.zh: 她倚在门上，上好了门闩。

skilled.en: We have a problem of skilled labour.

skilled.zh: 她是个技艺高超的书法家。

spine.en: A bone in my spine was out of alignment.
spine.zh: 我的脊椎骨有一节脱位。

cargo.en: The cargo was hoisted aboard by crane.
cargo.zh: 货物由起重机吊上了船。

cargo.en: A fire had been reported in the cargo hold.
You can contract with us to deliver your cargo.
cargo.zh: 你们可以和我们签订合同，由我们负责运输你们的货物。

devil.zh: 他真是个令人厌烦的老家伙。
他是个奸诈狡猾的家伙。

devil.en: I miss the old devil, now that he's gone.
devil.zh: 老家伙这一走，我还真想他。

dock.en: The ferry is expected to dock at 6.
dock.zh: 渡船预计在6点停靠码头。

dock.en: They dropped the sails and threw a line to a man on the dock.
dock.zh: 他们放下风帆，把船缆抛给码头上的人。

marine.en: Bezanik is diving to collect marine organisms.
marine.zh: 贝赞尼克正在潜水采集海洋生物。

marine.en: Marine mammals generally swim with the current.
marine.zh: 海洋哺乳动物一般顺水而游。

marine.en: Marine life was discovered at depths previously thought to be azoic.
marine.zh: 在先前被认为没有任何生命迹象的海洋深处发现了海洋生物。

epidemic.en: Today, doctors are fearing a worldwide epidemic.
epidemic.zh: 如今，医生们在担心一次世界性的流行。

epidemic.en: Hospitals were already fully extended because of the epidemic.
epidemic.zh: 这场流行病已使各医院以最大负荷运转。

epidemic.en: Health officials have successfully confined the epidemic to the Tabatinga area.
epidemic.zh: 卫生官员们已经成功地将该传染病控制在塔巴廷加地区。

trim.en: American companies looked at ways they could trim these costs.
trim.zh: 美国公司研究了他们可能削减成本的方案。

fatal.en: There was a fatal flaw in the plan.
fatal.zh: 计划中有一个致命的缺陷。

fatal.en: Even moderate amounts of the drug can be fatal.
fatal.zh: 这种药的用量即使不很大也会致命。

fatal.en: It is impossible to say who struck the fatal blow.
fatal.zh: 不可能确定是谁给了那致命的一击。

warehouse.en: We have plenty more of them in the warehouse.
warehouse.zh: 我们仓库里这类东西还多得很。

warehouse.en: The warehouse has been badly damaged by fire.
Matters were made worse by a fire in the warehouse.
warehouse.zh: 仓库失火使得事态更为严重。

inherent.en: Individuality is a valued and inherent part of the British character.
inherent.zh: 个性是英国人重视并固有的特征。

inherent.en: The use of these materials does involve some inherent questions.
inherent.zh: 对这些材料的使用确实涉及了一些固有的问题。

inherent.en: Everyone has his inherent ability, which is easily concealed by habits.
inherent.zh: 每个人都有与生俱来的能力，只是很容易被习惯所掩盖。

bronze.zh: 她的头发闪耀着青铜色和金黄色的光彩。

bronze.en: He won three golds and a bronze.
bronze.zh: 他获得三枚金牌和一枚铜牌。
她是奥林匹克铜牌得主。

accelerate.en: Growth will accelerate to 2.9 percent next year.
Exposure to the sun can accelerate the ageing process.
accelerate.zh: 暴露在日光下会加快老化过程。

drown.en: Animals get tangled in fishing nets and drown.
drown.zh: 动物被缠在渔网里淹死了。

drown.en: It was as if she wanted us to drown together.
drown.zh: 她好像想要我们俩一起淹死似的。

drown.en: They drown when the tide rises, for then it is submerged.
drown.zh: 他们在涨潮时被淹死，因为那时岩石被海水被淹没了。

vacuum.zh: 真空吸尘器靠抽吸除尘。
这个真空吸尘器有股难闻的气味。

vacuum.en: Exclusion of air creates a vacuum in the bottle.
vacuum.zh: 瓶子里的空气排除后就产生真空。

stereotype.en: There's always been a stereotype about successful businessmen.
stereotype.zh: 对成功的商人们总有一种成见。

stereotype.en: That this is a positive stereotype makes it no less a stereotype, and therefore unacceptable.
stereotype.zh: 这种成见即使是积极的也依然是成见，因而是不可取的。
这是一个荒谬的刻板印象。

dictate.en: The choice that does this is "dictate".
dictate.zh: 做到这一点的选择是“命令”。

dictate.en: What right do they have to dictate how we live our lives?
dictate.zh: 他们有什么权利强行规定我们该怎样生活？

dictate.en: What gives them the right to dictate to us what we should eat?
dictate.zh: 是什么给他们权利来规定我们该吃什么？

spit.en: Notices in the waiting room requested that you neither smoke nor spit.
spit.zh: 等候室的告示要求人们不要吸烟也不要随地吐痰。

spit.en: He spit it out, saying it was awful.
He'll make a fine fire for this spit.
spit.zh: 他会让火旺起来，发出噼啪声音的。

manual.en: There is a manual pump to get rid of the water.
manual.zh: 有一台手动水泵用来排水。

manual.en: She opened her desk drawer and took out the manual.
manual.zh: 她打开书桌抽屉，拿出手册。

kneel.en: Don't bend or kneel next to fireworks once you light them.
kneel.zh: 点燃烟花时不要弯腰或跪在烟花旁。

kneel.en: It seemed as though he dared not kneel directly before God.
kneel.zh: 他似乎不敢直接向上帝下跪。

kneel.en: You can squat rather than kneel to lift an object from the floor.
kneel.zh: 你可以蹲着而不是跪着把一个物体从地板上抬起来。

naval.en: He was the senior serving naval officer.
naval.zh: 他曾是高级现役海军军官。

naval.en: He accepted a commission as a naval officer.
naval.zh: 他接受了海军军官的任命。

naval.en: He had been a naval ensign stationed off Cuba.
naval.zh: 他曾是派驻在古巴的海军少尉。

laundry.en: He worked in the laundry at Oxford prison.
laundry.zh: 他曾在牛津监狱的洗衣房工作。

bore.zh: 埃玛生了个儿子，取名卡尔。
他是一个非常令人讨厌的家伙。

retrieve.en: There was absolutely no way that we were going to be able to retrieve it.
retrieve.zh: 我们绝对不可能把它找回来。

retrieve.en: The men were trying to retrieve weapons left when the army abandoned the island.
retrieve.zh: 那些人正试图找回该军队撤离这个岛时留下的武器。

retrieve.en: It includes methods to add and delete bookmarks, retrieve a user's bookmark list, and retrieve (or rename) a user's tags.
retrieve.zh: 它包括添加和删除书签、检索用户书签列表和检索（或者重命名）用户标记的方法。

beloved.en: It was a gift from her beloved.
beloved.zh: 那是她心爱的人送的礼物。

beloved.en: Strangely enough, the last thing he thought of was his beloved Tanya.
beloved.zh: 真奇怪，他最后想到的是他心爱的坦尼娅。

overseas.en: Nearly half the students come from overseas.
overseas.zh: 几乎一半学生来自海外。

overseas.en: They do a lot of business in lucrative overseas markets.
overseas.zh: 他们在利润丰厚的海外市场上生意很多。

overseas.en: Overseas investment has had a positive effect on exports.
overseas.zh: 海外投资对出口有积极影响。

tribute.en: The director paid tribute to all she had done for the charity.
tribute.zh: 董事赞扬她为慈善事业所做的一切。

tribute.en: At her funeral her oldest friend paid tribute to her life and work.
tribute.zh: 在葬礼上，她最早的朋友对她的一生和工作给予了高度的赞扬。

tribute.en: The song is a tribute to Roy Orbison.
tribute.zh: 这首歌是敬献给罗伊·奥比森的。

bizarre.en: Fantasies cannot harm you, no matter how bizarre or far out they are.
bizarre.zh: 无论多么荒诞或怪异的幻想都伤害不到你。

nominate.en: The Security Council can nominate anyone for secretary-general.
nominate.zh: 安全理事会可以提名任何人为秘书长。

nominate.en: If you'd like to recognize the greenness of an individual or organization, why not nominate them for an Environmental Achievement Award.
nominate.zh: 如果你想赞扬某个人或团体的绿色环保行为，何不将他们提名为环境成就奖的候选人？

nominate.en: If you are interested, I will be happy to nominate you.
nominate.zh: 如果你感兴趣，我很乐意提名你。

devise.en: Experts are trying to devise ways to clean up the huge slick.
devise.zh: 专家们在努力想出清除大面积浮油的办法。

devise.en: You are supposed to devise strategies to alter the cues and routines.
devise.zh: 你应该设计一些策略来改变球杆和动作。

devise.en: Your assignment will be to choose a discipline that interests you, and devise an experiment.
devise.zh: 你们的任务是选择一个感兴趣的学科，然后设计一个实验。

anchor.en: The ship lay at anchor two miles off the rocky coast.
anchor.zh: 船在离岩岸两英里处抛锚停泊。

scrutiny.en: Foreign policy has come under close scrutiny recently.
scrutiny.zh: 近来，政府的外交政策受到了认真彻底的审查。

scrutiny.en: They subject the effects of tourism to scrutiny.
scrutiny.zh: 他们对旅游业的影响进行详细审查。

scrutiny.en: There's still someone who deserves scrutiny—the person holding the phone.
scrutiny.zh: 仍有一个人需要仔细审查——拿着电话的那个人。

skeptical.en: If you're still skeptical about exercising, we can only ask you to trust us and give it a try.
skeptical.zh: 如果你仍对锻炼持怀疑态度，我们只能请你相信我们，试一试。

skeptical.en: Andrew Hacker, for the record, remains skeptical.
skeptical.zh: 准确来说，安德鲁·哈克仍然对此表示怀疑。

skeptical.en: What is skeptical observers' opinion on ancestry testing?
skeptical.zh: 持怀疑态度的观察者们对血统检测的看法是什么？

bargain.en: He said he wasn't prepared to bargain.
He reached a plea bargain with the authorities.
bargain.zh: 他和当局达成了辩诉交易。

bargain.en: She has an eye for a bargain.

suppress.en: Indeed, the war effort against Britain tended to suppress class conflicts.
suppress.zh: 实际上，针对英国的战争导致对阶级冲突的压制。

suppress.en: This then meant that the military had to remain to suppress rebellion and organize government.
suppress.zh: 这就意味着军队必须留下来镇压叛乱，组织政府。

suppress.en: It seems that men with traditional views of masculinity are more likely to suppress outward emotions and to fear emotions, supposedly because such feelings may lead to a loss of composure.
suppress.zh: 具有传统男子气观念的男性似乎更有可能抑制外部情绪和恐惧情绪，大概是因为这种情绪可能会导致失去镇定。

unfortunate.zh: 她把这项决定说成是“令人遗憾”。

unfortunate.en: He was unfortunate to lose in the final round.
unfortunate.zh: 他不幸在最后一轮输了。

brass.en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
Our door knocker is cast in solid brass.
brass.zh: 我们的门环是纯铜铸造的。

betray.en: He was offered money to betray his colleagues.
betray.zh: 有人收买他出卖他的同事。

betray.en: Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
betray.zh: 我实在告诉你们，你们中有个人要背叛我了。

betray.en: Now trust me--tell me what it is, and trust me--I won't betray you.
betray.zh: 现在相信我——告诉我是什么，相信我——我不会背叛你。

intensive.en: Ahead of us lay ten days of intensive training.
intensive.zh: 我们还要进行十天的强化训练。
集约耕作使土壤变得贫瘠。

bureaucracy.en: They are faced with a mountain of bureaucracy.
bureaucracy.zh: 他们面临着一大堆的官僚制度。
官僚主义会使申请耽搁数月之久。

bureaucracy.en: We need to free business from the dead hand of bureaucracy.
bureaucracy.zh: 我们必须摆脱官僚主义对工作的严重影响。

consistency.en: Dilute the paint with water until it is the consistency of milk.
consistency.zh: 用水把颜料稀释到牛奶的黏稠度。

consistency.en: Mix flour and milk to the right consistency.
consistency.zh: 请把面粉和牛奶调到适当的稠度。

consistency.en: How to maintain consistency of approach and delivery?
consistency.zh: 如何保持方法和交付的一致性？

challenging.en: She does not like anyone challenging her authority.
challenging.zh: 她不喜欢任何人挑战她的权威。

challenging.en: Mike found a challenging job as a computer programmer.
challenging.zh: 迈克找到了一份富有挑战性的工作——当电脑程序师。

challenging.en: Building a home from scratch can be both exciting and challenging.
challenging.zh: 白手起家既激动人心又具有挑战性。

videotape.en: I watched a slow-motion videotape replay of his fall.
videotape.zh: 我看了他跌倒时的慢动作录像回放。

videotape.en: There is nothing to stop viewers from recording the films on videotape.
videotape.zh: 没有办法阻止观众用录像带录下电影。

videotape.en: Two technicians were preparing a videotape recording of last week's programme.
videotape.zh: 两名技师正在准备上周节目的录像。

compassion.en: Mom was incensed at his lack of compassion.
compassion.zh: 妈妈对他缺乏同情心非常愤怒。

compassion.en: Elderly people need time and compassion from their physicians.
compassion.zh: 老年人需要医生的时间和同情心。

compassion.en: Confucianism and Taoism both stress the importance of compassion.
compassion.zh: 儒家和道家都强调同情的重要性。

beneficial.en: A good diet is beneficial to health.
beneficial.zh: 良好的饮食有益于健康。

beneficial.en: Early resolution of geopolitical issues would be beneficial.
beneficial.zh: 尽早解决地缘政治学议题是有益的。

beneficial.en: It can be beneficial to share your feelings with someone you trust.
beneficial.zh: 与你信任的人分享你的情感会是有益的。

reproduce.zh: 这些生物体通过单性生殖进行繁殖。

reproduce.en: Most reptiles reproduce by laying eggs on land.
reproduce.zh: 大多数爬行动物通过在陆地产卵进行繁殖。

reproduce.en: The movie makes no pretension to reproduce life.
reproduce.zh: 这部电影并未标榜重现了真实生活。

aboard.en: She invited 750 people aboard the luxury yacht, the Savarona.
aboard.zh: 她邀请了750人登上这艘豪华游艇，萨瓦罗纳号。

aboard.en: The most junior executive officer outranked the senior engineer officer aboard ship.
aboard.zh: 船上最低的执行官也比高级工程官的级别高。

aboard.en: As the ship berthed in New York, McClintock was with the first immigration officers aboard.
aboard.zh: 当那艘轮船停泊在纽约时，麦克林托克正和第一批上船的移民官员们在船上。

legendary.en: The hill is supposed to be the resting place of the legendary King Lud.
legendary.zh: 这座山据说是传说中的路德国王休息的地方。

legendary.en: The Dutch battle against the sea is legendary.
legendary.zh: 荷兰人与大海的战斗是传奇的。

legendary.en: Good evening and welcome to tonight's edition of Legendary Lives.
legendary.zh: 晚上好，欢迎来到今晚的传奇生活。

complication.en: Blindness is a common complication of diabetes.
complication.zh: 失明是糖尿病常有的一种并发症。

complication.en: The age difference was a complication to the relationship.
complication.zh: 年龄差异是使该关系复杂化的一个因素。

complication.en: The bad weather added a further complication to our journey.
complication.zh: 恶劣的天气给我们的旅行增加了更多的困难。

awkward.en: Amy made an awkward gesture with her hands.
awkward.zh: 艾米用双手做了一个笨拙的手势。

worm.en: He stopped on it to look for a worm.
To wriggle is to wrest about like a worm.
worm.zh: 蠕动就是像虫子一样扭来扭去。

worm.en: The worm burrowed its way under the earth.

dome.en: The shelter is built by lashing poles together to form a small dome.
dome.zh: 该掩蔽处是把杆子捆到一起形成一个小圆顶而搭建成。

dome.en: The use of steel and concrete has allowed the builders to perch a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
dome.zh: 钢筋混凝土的使用使建筑者们能将一个轻巧的混凝土穹顶架在8根细柱上。

restoration.en: I specialized in the restoration of old houses.
I owe the restoration of my hearing to this remarkable new technique.
restoration.zh: 我把我听力的复原归功于这项非凡的新技术。

restoration.en: Volvo's three-man team stripped the car and treated it to a restoration.
restoration.zh: 沃尔沃的3人小组拆了那辆汽车并对它进行了修复。

concession.en: He was ready to make a concession.
She made no concession to his age; she expected him to work as hard as she did.
concession.zh: 她丝毫也不体谅他的年龄，要求他干得像她一样卖力。

concession.en: Finish the following sentence with an adverbial clause of concession.
concession.zh: 用让步状语从句完成下列句子。

authentic.en: She has authentic charm whereas most people simply have nice manners.
authentic.zh: 她有真正的魅力，而大多数人只是有礼貌而已。

authentic.en: Authentic Italian cooking is very healthy—witness the low incidence of heart disease in Italy.
authentic.zh: 正宗的意大利烹饪对健康非常有益，在意大利心脏病发病率低就是证据。

authentic.en: I don't know if the painting is authentic.
authentic.zh: 我不知道这幅画是不是真迹。

inadequate.en: Supplies of food and medicines are inadequate.
inadequate.zh: 食品和药物的供应是不足的。

inadequate.en: Public expenditure on the arts is woefully inadequate.
inadequate.zh: 艺术上的公共支出严重不足。

inadequate.en: The rations that they gave us were meagre and inadequate.
inadequate.zh: 他们给我们的配给量是很少的，是不够的。

subsequently.en: The original interview notes were subsequently lost.
subsequently.zh: 采访记录原稿后来丢失了。

subsequently.en: Subsequently, new guidelines were issued to all employees.
subsequently.zh: 随后，新的准则发给了所有雇员。

subsequently.en: He subsequently worked on Boeing's 747, 767 and 737 jetliner programmes.
subsequently.zh: 他后来从事了波音747、767 和 737喷气式飞机的项目。

editorial.en: Your editorial blithely ignores the hard facts.
editorial.zh: 你们的社论轻率地忽略了铁的事实。
这篇社论有几处事实性错误。

editorial.en: We are not about to change our editorial policy.
editorial.zh: 我们不打算改变我们的社论方针。

locker.en: In the locker room, Amanda changed quickly.
locker.zh: 在更衣室里，阿曼达快速地换好了衣服。

locker.en: The fresh food locker contains tortillas, fresh bread, breakfast rolls, and fresh fruits and vegetables.
locker.zh: 这个新食品柜装着玉米粉圆饼、鲜面包、早餐卷、新鲜水果和蔬菜。

locker.en: Besides the meal and pantry food lockers, a fresh food locker is packed at KSC and installed on the shuttle 18 to 24 hours before launch.
locker.zh: 除了饭和食品储藏室，一个新食品柜也在肯尼迪天空中心被打包，并在发射前18到24小时装上航天飞机。

merger.en: Plans for a merger have been scotched.
His justification for the merger was just hot air.
merger.zh: 他提出的合并理由只是连篇空话。

merger.en: The merger has been on the cards for some time now.
merger.zh: 合并的事情已经酝酿了一段时间。

haunt.en: The Wanglang Preserve in western Sichuan is the haunt of the giant panda.
haunt.zh: 川西的王朗自然保护区是大熊猫出没的地方。

haunt.en: Many a climb, they had together that took them far up, to the bare cliffs near the eagle's haunt.
haunt.zh: 他们一起爬了很多次山，爬到了离老鹰出没的地方不远的悬崖上。

haunt.en: The pub is a favourite haunt of artists.
haunt.zh: 这家酒吧是艺术家最爱光顾的地方。

crude.en: Honestly, Nev! Must you be so crude!.
crude.zh: 天哪，尼夫！你怎么能如此粗暴呢！

crude.en: Crude oil is the world's most important commodity.
crude.zh: 原油是世界上最重要的商品。

faithful.en: The officers died faithful to the honour of a soldier.
faithful.zh: 军官们怀着对军人气节的忠诚而捐躯。

faithful.en: I have been a faithful reader of your newspaper for many years.
faithful.zh: 我是贵报多年来的忠实读者。

faithful.en: She was rewarded for her 40 years' faithful service with the company.
faithful.zh: 她为公司忠诚服务了40年，因而获得奖赏。

completion.en: The new library is close to completion.
The project is due for completion in the spring.
completion.zh: 这项工程预定在明年春季竣工。

evoke.en: His case is unlikely to evoke public sympathy.
evoke.zh: 他的情况不大可能引起公众的同情。

evoke.en: It became apparent that smell can evoke strong emotional responses.
evoke.zh: 很明显，气味可以引起强烈的情绪反应。

evoke.en: Why do the seal's laboratory dives always evoke this response, regardless of their length or depth?
evoke.zh: 为什么不管它们潜水的长度和深度如何，海豹在实验室潜水时总是会引起这种反应？

vein.en: A tiny wire is threaded through a vein to the heart.
vein.zh: 一根细金属丝从静脉里穿到心脏。

vein.en: He could have died after developing deep vein thrombosis during a flight to Sydney.
vein.zh: 他在飞往悉尼的航班上引发成深部静脉血栓之后，差点送命。

vein.en: Passengers on long-haul flights are being warned about the risks of deep vein thrombosis.
vein.zh: 长途航班上的乘客须注意可能出现深静脉血栓。

surrender.en: They had raised the white flag in surrender.
surrender.zh: 他们已经升起白旗投降。

scar.en: He had a scar on his forehead.
The cut healed up without leaving a scar.

variance.en: Many of his statements were at variance with the facts.
variance.zh: 他的许多陈述都与事实相矛盾。

variance.en: These conclusions are totally at variance with the evidence.
variance.zh: 这些结论与证据完全相悖。

variance.en: Although qualitative variance among nerve energies was never rigidly disproved, the doctrine was generally abandoned in favor of the opposing view.
variance.zh: 尽管神经能量之间的质量差异从未被严格否定，但这一学说普遍被放弃，相反的观点则被支持。

surge.en: An electrical surge damaged the computer's disk drive.
surge.zh: 电流浪涌损坏了计算机的磁盘驱动器。

surge.en: She felt a sudden surge of anger.
She felt a surge of excitement run through her.
surge.zh: 她感到一阵激动传遍全身。

sailor.en: A sailor carrying a sawn-off shotgun was arrested in Los Angeles.
sailor.zh: 一位携带着锯短的散弹枪的水手在洛杉矶被捕。

sailor.en: Divers this morning found the body of another American sailor drowned during yesterday's ferry disaster.
sailor.zh: 潜水员们今天早晨发现了在昨天渡轮失事中淹死的又一名美国水手的尸体。
他就可以像水手一样回答。

inspect.en: Elaine went outside to inspect the playing field.
inspect.zh: 伊莱恩到外边去检查运动场。

inspect.en: Make sure you inspect the goods before signing for them.
inspect.zh: 要确保在签收货物之前进行检验。

inspect.en: Public health officials were called in to inspect the premises.
inspect.zh: 公共卫生官员奉召来视察了建筑物。

commentary.en: You can hear commentary on the game at halftime.
commentary.zh: 你可在中场休息时听到对比赛的评论。

commentary.en: He kept up a running commentary on everyone who came in or went out.
commentary.zh: 他不断地对上下场的每一名队员进行解说。

commentary.en: Ms. Rich will be writing a twice-weekly commentary on American society and culture.
commentary.zh: 里奇女士将就美国社会和文化每周写两篇评论文章。

imperial.zh: 宫廷玉液酒，一百八一杯~

imperial.en: He matriculated in the English Literature Department at the Tokyo Imperial University.
imperial.zh: 他被东京帝国大学英语文学系录取了。
王子被任命为皇家猪倌。

compensate.en: Nothing can compensate for the loss of a loved one.
compensate.zh: 失去心爱的人是无法补偿的。

compensate.en: The damages are designed to compensate victims for their direct losses.
compensate.zh: 该赔偿金是用来补偿受害人的直接损失的。

compensate.en: A surge in domestic sales helped compensate for a fall-off in export sales.
compensate.zh: 国内销售的增长帮助补偿了出口销售的减少。

fossil.en: Burning fossil fuels uses oxygen and produces carbon dioxide.
fossil.zh: 燃烧化石燃料消耗氧气并产生二氧化碳。

fossil.en: On a global scale, 77% of energy is created from fossil fuels.
fossil.zh: 全球77%的能量产生自化石燃料。

fossil.en: The electricity industry consumes large amounts of fossil fuels.
fossil.zh: 电力工业消耗大量的矿物燃料。

hover.en: Hover Camera records movements with a 13MP camera and takes 4K videos.
hover.zh: 无人相机可以用1300万像素记录运动，拍摄 4K 视频。

hover.en: With the development of science and technology, a Chinese young man Wang Mengqiu, invented Hover Camera.
hover.zh: 随着科技的发展，中国年轻人王梦秋发明了无人相机。

hover.en: It is the best choice for weddings, sports games and holidays because Hover Camera is convenient for the users to carry.
hover.zh: 它是婚礼、运动会和假期的最佳选择，因为无人相机方便用户携带。

inappropriate.en: It is inappropriate simply to throw money at these problems.
inappropriate.zh: 只是用钱去处理这些问题是不适当的。

inappropriate.en: I feel the remark was inappropriate for such a serious issue.
inappropriate.zh: 我觉得对如此严肃的问题来说，这评论是不恰当的。

inappropriate.en: He chose a singularly inappropriate moment to make his request.
inappropriate.zh: 他选在一个极其不恰当的时刻提出要求。

stunning.en: A viewing platform gave stunning views over the valley.
stunning.zh: 从观景台向山谷望去，景色之壮观令人叹为观止。

stunning.en: It's got a gripping story, great acting, superb sets, and stunning effects.
stunning.zh: 电影有扣人心弦的故事情节、精湛的表演、绝妙的布景和惊人的特效。

viable.en: The plane will be commercially viable if 400 can be sold.
viable.zh: 这飞机若能售出400架从商业上看就可行。

viable.en: If industrial agriculture is to be replaced, what is a viable alternative?
viable.zh: 如果工业化农业要被取代，那么可行的替代方案是什么呢？

viable.en: These farmers will never actually sell any of the lands, provided that farming it remains viable.
viable.zh: 实际上，只要耕种仍然可行，这些农民不会出售任何土地。

clarify.en: Thank you for writing and allowing me to clarify the present position.
clarify.zh: 谢谢你来信并允许我澄清目前的状况。

clarify.en: I hope you could clarify a few things for me.
clarify.zh: 我希望你能帮我澄清几件事。

clarify.en: Mr. Wang wondered about her response, and just to clarify, he asked her another question.
clarify.zh: 王先生想知道她的回答，只是想澄清一下，他又问了她一个问题。

countless.en: She brought joy to countless people through her music.
countless.zh: 她通过自己的音乐把快乐带给了无数人。

countless.en: Countless people have had a stab at solving the riddle.
countless.zh: 无数人试图解开这个谜。

copper.en: Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin.

upcoming.en: We'll face a tough fight in the upcoming election.
upcoming.zh: 我们在即将到来的竞选中将面临一场恶战。

upcoming.en: I believe that he would be the best possibility to recapture the centre vote in the upcoming election.
upcoming.zh: 我相信他将是在即将来临的选举中最有可能夺回中间选票的人。

upcoming.en: Do you feel bored with the upcoming summer?
upcoming.zh: 你对即将到来的夏天感到无聊吗？

sketch.en: She drew a sketch map of the area to show us the way.
sketch.zh: 她画了一幅这个地区的略图，用来给我们指路。

sketch.en: The drama group did a sketch about a couple buying a new car.
sketch.zh: 剧社上演了一出夫妻二人买新车的短剧。

sketch.en: She made her cakes without drawing sketch first.
sketch.zh: 她做蛋糕时不会先画草图。

pupil.en: These complex formulae are beyond the grasp of the average pupil.
pupil.zh: 这些复杂的公式是一般小学生不能理解的。

pupil.en: Amy was a pupil in Grade Three.
pupil.zh: 艾米是一名三年级的学生。
她深受每个学生的喜爱。

ward.en: Mr. Ward wasn't a rogue at all.
ward.zh: 沃德先生根本不是个无赖。

ward.en: He worked as a nurse on the children's ward.

neglect.en: We often neglect to make proper use of our bodies.
neglect.zh: 我们经常疏忽了合理使用我们的身体。

neglect.en: All too often the animals die through neglect.
neglect.zh: 动物因缺乏照料而死亡的事司空见惯。

neglect.en: The buildings are crumbling from years of neglect.
neglect.zh: 由于多年无人维修，这些建筑物行将倒塌。

strive.en: Newspaper editors all strive to be first with a story.
strive.zh: 报纸编辑都力争率先报道。

strive.en: We encourage all members to strive for the highest standards.
strive.zh: 我们鼓励所有成员为达到最高标准而努力。

strive.en: You should always strive to achieve more, however well you have done before.
strive.zh: 不管以前做得多么好，你应该始终争取更大的进步。

mound.en: I've got a mound of paperwork to do.
mound.zh: 我有一堆文案工作要做。

mound.en: They banked the earth (up) into a mound.
mound.zh: 他们把土堆成一个土丘。

mound.en: The castle was built on top of a natural grassy mound.
mound.zh: 这座城堡建在一个天然的绿草如茵的小丘上。

bang.zh: 突然发出砰的一声巨响。

bang.en: 'Bang, bang, you're dead!' shouted the little boy.

medieval.en: It is a perfect example of a medieval castle.
medieval.zh: 这是最典型的中世纪城堡。

medieval.en: He began studying politics and medieval history.
medieval.zh: 他开始学习政治学和中世纪史。

medieval.en: He was able to pinpoint on the map the site of the medieval village.
medieval.zh: 他能在地图上准确找出那个中世纪村庄的位置。

tilt.en: The second movement involved in the hypothesis has to do with axial tilt.
tilt.zh: 假设中涉及的第二个运动与轴向倾斜有关。

tilt.en: The table is at a slight tilt.
He answered with a tilt of his head.

rob.zh: 她到罗布那儿寻求慰藉。

rob.en: Rob Harmeling won the sprint in Bordeaux.
rob.zh: 罗布•哈梅林赢得了波尔多短跑赛。

rob.en: That Rob was a snob and a social climber could not be denied.
rob.zh: 那个罗布是个势利小人，喜欢攀龙附凤——无可否定。

biologist.en: Dingle is an evolutionary biologist who studies insects.
biologist.zh: 丁格尔是一位研究昆虫的进化生物学家。

biologist.en: Biologist Edmond Mouton runs the nutria control program for Louisiana.
biologist.zh: 生物学家 Edmond Mouton 负责路易斯安那州的海狸鼠控制项目。

biologist.en: To prove his point, Cialdini cites an interview with molecular biologist James Watson.
biologist.zh: 为了证明他的观点，Cialdini 引用了分子生物学家 James Watson 的采访。

monetary.zh: 欧洲的货币体制正在瓦解。

monetary.en: Some countries tighten monetary policy to avoid inflation.
monetary.zh: 一些国家紧缩货币政策以避免通货膨胀。

monetary.en: Domestic conditions did not justify a loosening of monetary policy.
monetary.zh: 国内的条件不适宜放宽货币政策。

knot.en: She tied a knot in a cherry stem.
knot.zh: 她在樱桃梗上打了个结。

knot.en: I tied a knot in the rope.
His clumsy fingers couldn't untie the knot.
knot.zh: 他的手很笨拙，无法解开这个结。

antibiotic.en: They expect the antibiotic products to be exported to Southeast Asia and Africa.
antibiotic.zh: 他们期望抗生素产品出口到东南亚和非洲。

antibiotic.en: He just handed me this pill, an antibiotic.
antibiotic.zh: 他刚递给了我抗生素药丸。

antibiotic.en: A new antibiotic requires only a three-day course of treatment.
antibiotic.zh: 一种新的抗生素只需要三天疗程。

prosperity.zh: 他们的繁荣依靠的是出口带来的增长。

prosperity.en: Our future prosperity depends on economic growth.
prosperity.zh: 我们未来的繁荣昌盛依赖经济的发展。

prosperity.en: He was pursuing a utopian dream of world prosperity.
prosperity.zh: 他那时在追求一个不切实际的世界繁荣之梦。

accumulate.en: Lead can accumulate in the body until toxic levels are reached.
accumulate.zh: 铅可以在体内积聚直至到达有毒的程度。

accumulate.en: It was his ambition to accumulate a million dollars before he turned thirty.
accumulate.zh: 他的雄心是在30岁以前积攒100万美元。
它们基本上不积累身体脂肪。

prosecute.en: The police have decided not to prosecute because the evidence is not strong enough.
prosecute.zh: 警方已决定不起诉，因为证据不够充分。

prosecute.en: He has decided to prosecute her after careful consideration of all the relevant facts.
prosecute.zh: 他仔细考虑了所有相关事实后，决定起诉她。

prosecute.en: The Attorney General was aware of the political implications of his decision to prosecute.
prosecute.zh: 总检察长知道自己起诉的决定可能引起的政治后果。

ray.en: Ray was getting very hot and bothered about the idea.
ray.zh: 雷为这个想法感到焦虑不安。

ray.en: It will only register on sophisticated X-ray equipment.
ray.zh: 只有在先进的X光设备上它才会显示出来。

ray.en: "Is there something else?" Ray queried as Helen stopped speaking.
ray.zh: 海伦话音刚落，雷便问道：“还有别的什么吗？”

intervene.en: The problem lies in deciding when to intervene.
intervene.zh: 问题在于决定何时介入。

intervene.en: The security forces had to intervene to prevent the situation worsening.
intervene.zh: 那些安全部队不得不干预以阻止形势变得更糟。

intervene.en: They remain unwilling to intervene militarily in what could be an unending war.
intervene.zh: 他们仍然不愿意对一场可能无休止的战争进行军事干预。

glow.en: The fresh air had brought a healthy glow to her cheeks.
glow.zh: 新鲜空气使她两颊红润、精神焕发。

glow.en: There was no light except for the occasional glow of a cigarette.
glow.zh: 除偶尔有香烟的微弱红光外没有一点亮光。

glow.en: She felt a small glow of satisfaction.
glow.zh: 她感到了一丝满足的喜悦。

embody.en: As a ballerina, to embody the duality of the Swan Queen and the black swan can be a fiendishly difficult task.
embody.zh: 作为一名芭蕾舞女演员，体现天鹅女王和黑天鹅的二元性可能是一项极其困难的任务。

embody.en: Indeed, the streets of San Jose seem, in some ways, to embody the best of America.
embody.zh: 的确，圣何塞的街道在某些方面似乎展现出美国最好的一面。

embody.en: British cars, once memorably described as a skip on wheels, have come to embody the national humiliation of that benighted era.
embody.zh: 英国汽车在记忆中一度被称为车轮上的跳板，如今已成为那个愚昧时代的国耻象征。

rug.en: The corners of the rug were curling up.
The rug adds a dash of colour to the room.
rug.zh: 小地毯为房间增添了一点色彩。

rug.en: It is not possible to reposition the rug without damaging it.
rug.zh: 想要挪动地毯又不损坏它是不可能的。

dull.en: She brought sunshine into our dull lives.
dull.zh: 她给我们乏味的生活带来了欢乐。

raid.en: It sounds like an air raid siren.
raid.zh: 这听起来像是空袭警报。

raid.en: The weapon used in the raid was a replica.
raid.zh: 抢劫案中使用的武器是一件仿制品。

raid.en: The success of the raid depended on split-second timing.
raid.zh: 袭击的成功取决于分秒不差的时间安排。

crown.en: She is determined to retain her Wimbledon crown.
crown.zh: 她决心卫冕她的温布尔登网球赛的冠军宝座。

crown.en: The crown was set with precious jewels—diamonds, rubies and emeralds.
crown.zh: 王冠上镶嵌着稀世珍宝—有钻石、红宝石、绿宝石。

crown.en: Between 1987 and 1990, Steffi Graf largely held off Navratilova's challenge for the crown.
crown.zh: 1987到1990年期间，施特菲•格拉芙很大程度上抵挡住了纳芙拉蒂洛娃的夺冠挑战。

creep.zh: 不安全感可能会悄然而生。
不知不觉间，开始出错了。

creep.en: It makes my flesh creep to think of it.
creep.zh: 一想起它我就心惊肉跳。

fake.en: No one spotted that the gun was a fake.
fake.zh: 没有人留意到那是一支假枪。

fake.en: A sharp-eyed shop clerk spotted the fake.
fake.zh: 一名眼尖的售货员发现了假货。

fake.en: He tried to fake sincerity as he smiled at them.
fake.zh: 当他朝他们笑的时候，他设法假装真诚。

crab.en: I can't remember when I last had crab.
crab.zh: 我不记得上次吃蟹是什么时候了。

crab.en: Although it is tasty, crab is very filling.
crab.zh: 螃蟹虽然好吃，但很容易让人饱。

crab.en: Divers battled for hours to try to free a whale entangled in crab nets.
crab.zh: 潜水员们奋战了几个小时，试图解救一条被捕蟹网缠住的鲸鱼。

illustration.en: Let me, by way of illustration , quote from one of her poems.
illustration.zh: 作为说明，让我援引她的一首诗。

illustration.en: She looked like a princess in a nineteenth-century illustration.
illustration.zh: 她看上去像19世纪插图里的公主。

illustration.en: The illustration shows a cluster of five roses coloured apricot orange.
illustration.zh: 插图上展示了一簇杏黄色的5朵玫瑰。

hydrogen.en: Hydrogen and oxygen combine to form water.
Atoms of hydrogen are fused to make helium.
Hydrogen combines with oxygen to form water.

worthy.en: A number of the report's findings are worthy of note.
worthy.zh: 这份报告里有些调查结果值得注意。

worthy.en: He felt he was not worthy of her.
The bank might think you're worthy of a loan.
worthy.zh: 这家银行可能认为你应该得到一笔贷款。

probability.en: There seemed to be a high probability of success.
Without a transfusion, the victim's probability of dying was 100%.
probability.zh: 不输血的话，该患者的死亡概率是100%。

probability.en: There is a 60% probability that the population will be infected with the disease.
probability.zh: 民众感染这种疾病的概率为60%。

vinegar.en: If the sauce seems too sweet, add a dash of red wine vinegar.
vinegar.zh: 如果酱太甜，就加少许红酒醋。

capitalism.en: He preached the virtues of capitalism to us.
capitalism.zh: 他向我们宣扬资本主义的优点。

capitalism.en: He rails against the iniquities of capitalism.
capitalism.zh: 他谴责资本主义的种种罪恶。
资本主义强调的是创新、竞争和个人至上。

advisory.en: We are simply involved in an advisory capacity on the project.
advisory.zh: 我们只不过是以顾问身份参与这个项目。

advisory.en: She is the chair of the Defense Advisory Committee on Women in the Military.
advisory.zh: 她是军队女兵国防顾问委员会的主席。

advisory.en: What do we learn from the Dietary Guidelines Advisory Committee's scientific report?
advisory.zh: 我们从膳食指南咨询委员会的科学报告中了解到了什么？

remedy.en: There is no simple remedy for unemployment.
remedy.zh: 失业问题没有简单的解决办法。

remedy.en: Their remedy lay within the range of existent technology.
remedy.zh: 他们的补救措施在现有科技范围内。

remedy.en: Your only remedy is to go to law.
remedy.zh: 你唯一的补救办法是诉诸法律。

inability.en: Some families go without medical treatment because of their inability to pay.
inability.zh: 有些家庭因无力支付医疗费用而得不到医治。

inability.en: Wall Street analysts have been highly critical of the company's seeming inability to control costs.
inability.zh: 华尔街的分析家们对该公司似乎无力控制成本一事一直批评甚多。

inability.en: Her inability to concentrate could cause an accident.
inability.zh: 她无法集中注意力可能会导致意外。

manuscript.zh: 我读过她的诗作的手稿。

manuscript.en: He had seen a manuscript of the book.
manuscript.zh: 他见过这本书的一份手稿。

morality.en: Standards of morality seem to be dropping.
He actively promoted the dissemination of scientific ideas about matters such as morality.
morality.zh: 他积极地推动诸如道德之类的科学观念的传播。

morality.en: Wisdom without morality is like a ring without a gem.
morality.zh: 没有道德的智慧就像没有宝石的戒指。

smash.en: They did not need to smash paint and canvas; they went beyond this to smash the whole continuity of logical thought.
smash.zh: 他们不需要打碎颜料和画布；他们超越了这一点，打碎了整个逻辑思维的连续性。

smash.en: We had to smash the door open.
smash.zh: 我们只得用力把门撞开。

smash.en: Her new series is a smash hit.
smash.zh: 她的新系列节目极为成功，引起轰动。

disagreement.en: The disagreement arose over a different use of terminology.
disagreement.zh: 分歧的缘起在于专门用语使用的不同。

disagreement.en: There is considerable disagreement over the safety of the treatment.
disagreement.zh: 这种疗法是否安全争论很大。

disagreement.en: The disagreement over trade tariffs has soured relations between the two countries.
disagreement.zh: 贸易关税上的分歧导致两国关系恶化。

hopeful.en: She is hopeful of returning to work soon.
The latest trade figures are a hopeful sign.
hopeful.zh: 最新贸易数字令人鼓舞。

hopeful.en: Things didn't look too hopeful at the start of the year.
hopeful.zh: 在年初，情况显得并不十分美妙。

mandatory.en: He was married, and that was mandatory.
mandatory.zh: 他结婚了，这是强制性的。

mandatory.en: I think that mandatory voting is a no-braine and dumb idea.
mandatory.zh: 我认为强制投票这事是一个无脑的，极其愚蠢的想法。

mandatory.en: An effective and mandatory program sponsored by the high school is the only solution to this serious problem.
mandatory.zh: 由高中主办的的有效的强制性项目是解决这一严重问题的唯一办法。

lesser.en: People voted for him as the lesser of two evils.
lesser.zh: 人们投票选他只是出于两害相权取其轻罢了。

lesser.en: Students played the lesser parts and sang in the chorus.
lesser.zh: 学生们扮演了一些次要角色，并参加了合唱团的演唱。

lesser.en: He was encouraged to plead guilty to the lesser offence.
lesser.zh: 有人怂恿他供认犯了那个较轻的罪行。

soda.zh: 她很快地把汽水一饮而尽。
他喝了一杯冰激凌果味汽水。

soda.en: The soda was warm and had gone flat.
soda.zh: 这汽水是温的，已走了气。

dive.en: The goalkeeper made a dive for the ball.
dive.zh: 守门员一个鱼跃向球扑去。

dive.en: The plane made a dive to a lower altitude.

junk.en: He lived on a diet of junk food.
We still get junk mail for the previous occupants.
junk.zh: 我们仍会收到给先前住户的垃圾邮件。

junk.en: The truth is that junk bonds were misnamed, and therefore misunderstood.
junk.zh: 事实上，“垃圾债券”被叫错了名字，因此也被误解了。

devoted.en: He devoted his energies to the reformation of science.
devoted.zh: 他把他的全部精力投入到了科学的革新中。
她深深爱着自己的家庭。
她全力倾注于自己的事业。

stun.en: A guard zapped him with the stun gun.
stun.zh: 一名警卫用眩晕枪击中了他。

stun.en: Princessfish are a species of coral-reef fish that are captured alive by divers who first stun the individual fish by squirting a certain poison at them.
stun.zh: 公主鱼是一种珊瑚礁鱼，潜水员会先将某种毒药喷到鱼身上，使其昏迷，然后将其活捉。

stun.en: This speech seemed to stun the King.
stun.zh: 这番话似乎使国王大吃一惊。

manufacture.en: They manufacture the class of plastics known as thermoplastic materials.
manufacture.zh: 他们生产被称为热塑材料的塑料类制品。

manufacture.en: Coca-Cola, Pepsi and Cadbury use franchisers to manufacture, bottle and distribute their products within geographical areas.
manufacture.zh: 可口可乐、百事可乐和吉百利公司利用特许经销商在一定的地区内生产、罐装和销售其产品。

manufacture.en: Brookman & Langdon were said to manufacture the most desirable pens and these necessarily command astonishingly high prices.
manufacture.zh: 据说布鲁克曼兰登公司制造的钢笔最令人满意，而这必然地导致高得惊人的价格。

mature.en: Jane is very mature for her age.
Girls become sexually mature earlier than boys.
Clare has a mature and responsible attitude to work.
mature.zh: 克莱尔对待工作成熟而可信赖。

affection.en: I still have affection for my old school.
affection.zh: 我对母校依然很有感情。

affection.en: She still speaks about him with great affection.
affection.zh: 说起他来她依旧一往情深。

philosopher.zh: 卡洛斯有几分哲人气质。

philosopher.en: "While we teach, we learn," said Roman philosopher Seneca.
philosopher.zh: “我们在教书的同时也在学习。”罗马哲学家塞内加说。

philosopher.en: The individual who promoted this idea was a Stoic philosopher.
philosopher.zh: 提出这一观点的人是一位斯多葛派哲学家。

breakdown.zh: 她精神崩溃后还在恢复中。

breakdown.en: Susan had a mental breakdown and was diagnosed with schizophrenia.
breakdown.zh: 苏珊精神崩溃，被诊断为精神分裂。

breakdown.en: Ms. Carey appeared to blame her breakdown on EMI's punishing work schedule.
breakdown.zh: 凯丽女士看来是将自己的崩溃归咎于百代公司紧张的工作安排。

clutch.zh: 这辆车需要换一个新的离合器了。
离合器因过热而失灵了。

clutch.en: He pushed in the clutch and coasted to a halt.
clutch.zh: 他踩下离合器，滑行了一会儿便停下来了。

conceal.zh: 蒂姆几乎掩饰不住自己的失望。

conceal.en: If only he could conceal his part in the accident.
conceal.zh: 如果他能掩盖他在那次事故中有份参与就好了。

conceal.en: He didn't attempt to dissimulate or conceal his true feelings.
conceal.zh: 他没有尝试着掩饰或隐瞒自己的感受。

curl.en: Dry curly hair naturally for maximum curl and shine.
curl.zh: 让卷发自然地风干以最大限度地增加头发的卷曲和光泽。

curl.en: The paper started to shrivel and curl up in the heat.
curl.zh: 那张纸在高温下开始起皱卷曲。

curl.en: The wave and curl of her blonde hair gave her sensuality and youth.
curl.zh: 波浪式的卷曲金发使她显得性感并富有青春活力。

kidney.en: Doctors removed the healthy kidney from the donor.
kidney.zh: 医生从捐献者体内取出了健康的肾脏。

kidney.en: The blade missed his kidney, but went into his bowel.
kidney.zh: 刀片没刺中他的肾脏，但却扎进了他的肠子。

healing.en: A muscle tear will leave a scar after healing.
healing.zh: 肌肉撕裂在治愈后会留下伤疤。

healing.en: They are transfigured by the healing powers of art.
healing.zh: 他们因艺术的治愈力量而变得容光焕发。

healing.en: The wound is healing nicely and the patient is healthy.
healing.zh: 伤口在很好地愈合，病人情况良好。

goodness.zh: 天哪，我不清楚他知不知道。

destiny.zh: 她与他的命运紧密相联。

destiny.en: We are masters of our own destiny.
destiny.zh: 我们是自己命运的主人。

destiny.en: What happens next could decide their destiny.
destiny.zh: 接下来发生的事可能会决定他们的命运。

literacy.en: Many adults have problems with literacy and numeracy.
literacy.zh: 很多成年人有读写和计算的困难。

literacy.en: Of course, literacy isn't the same thing as intelligence.
literacy.zh: 当然，识字与智力不是一回事。

literacy.en: Six months later John had developed literacy and numeracy skills, plus confidence.
literacy.zh: 六个月后，约翰已经能够识字和算数了，也有了自信。

solo.en: The slow movement opens with a cello solo.
solo.zh: 慢乐章开头是一段大提琴独奏。

solo.en: The original version featured a guitar solo.
solo.zh: 原版以吉他独奏为特色。

leak.en: Water had started to leak into the cellar.
More details are now beginning to leak out.
leak.zh: 更多的细节现在开始泄露出来。

leak.en: Crews are working to plug a major oil leak.
leak.zh: 机组人员正在努力堵一个漏油的大洞。

greenhouse.en: It sets targets for reduction of greenhouse-gas emissions.
greenhouse.zh: 它为减少温室气体排放设立了目标。

greenhouse.en: The specific impact of the greenhouse effect is unknowable.
greenhouse.zh: 温室效应的具体影响尚不可知。

greenhouse.en: You can make your flights carbon neutral by planting trees to make up for the greenhouse gas emissions.
greenhouse.zh: 你可以通过种树抵消温室气体排放，这样你的飞行就可以做到碳中和。

trillion.en: They located a meteorite with a mass of over a trillion tons.
trillion.zh: 他们找到了一块重逾一万亿吨的陨石。

trillion.en: Yesterday I laid out a plan to cut $4 trillion from our deficit.
trillion.zh: 昨天我推出了一份削减政府赤字4万亿美元的计划。

trillion.en: These catastrophic events caused more than $1.5 trillion in economic losses.
trillion.zh: 这些灾难性的事件造成的经济损失超过1万5千亿美元。

parliament.zh: 他们使税收提案在议会强行通过。

parliament.en: Parliament passed the bill without further amendment.
parliament.zh: 议会未作进一步修改便通过了议案。

expenditure.en: He is rigorous in his control of expenditure.
expenditure.zh: 他在控制开支方面一丝不苟。

expenditure.en: You must ask permission for all major expenditure.
expenditure.zh: 一切重大开支均须报请批准。

homicide.en: The police arrived at the scene of the homicide.

homicide.zh: 她说，该州法医办公室已经判定，格雷先生的死属于他杀。

homicide.en: The statute of limitations on crimes other than homicide is five years, so Reyes cannot be prosecuted for the attack.
homicide.zh: 除杀人罪以外的罪行的诉讼时效为5年，所以雷耶斯不能因为那次袭击被起诉。

herd.en: She pushed her way through a herd of lunchtime drinkers.
herd.zh: 她从一群午餐时饮酒的人中间挤了过去。

herd.en: A herd of goats was nibbling the turf around the base of the tower.
herd.zh: 一群山羊正在啃着塔基周围的草皮。

herd.en: With no natural predators on the island, the herd increased rapidly.
herd.zh: 由于岛上没有天然食肉动物，牧群的数量迅速增加。

passionate.zh: 他对所有文学作品都有热情。

passionate.en: Passionate, energetic debate does not require anger and hard feelings to be effective.
passionate.zh: 充满激情、充满活力的辩论不需要愤怒和厌恶情绪就能产生效果。

passionate.en: He is very passionate about the project.
passionate.zh: 他对这个项目非常热诚。

addiction.en: She helped him fight his drug addiction.
addiction.zh: 她帮助了他对抗自己的毒瘾。

addiction.en: He has never conquered his addiction to smoking.
He needed money to feed his addiction to gambling.
addiction.zh: 他需要钱来满足他的赌瘾。

probe.en: The surgeon would pick up his instruments, probe, repair, and stitch up again.
probe.zh: 外科医生会拿起器械进行探查、修复，然后再缝合。
“天问一号”探测器是什么时候发射的？
“天问一号”是中国首个火星探测器。

psychiatrist.en: One forensic psychiatrist described him as having an incurable antisocial personality disorder.
psychiatrist.zh: 一位法庭精神病医生将他描述为患有不可治愈反社会人格障碍。

psychiatrist.en: She'd better see a psychiatrist at the consoling center.
psychiatrist.zh: 她最好去心理咨询中心看精神病医生。

psychiatrist.en: What is characteristic of a chronic complainer, according to psychiatrist Eric Berne?
psychiatrist.zh: 根据精神病学家埃里克·伯恩的说法，习惯性抱怨者的特征是什么？

pipeline.en: A consortium plans to build a natural-gas pipeline from Russia to supply eastern Germany.
pipeline.zh: 一家财团计划修建一条从俄罗斯向德国东部供应天然气的管道。

pipeline.en: They made a pipeline blow up test.
pipeline.zh: 他们做了一个管线爆破试验。

pipeline.en: Recently they have laid an underground pipeline.
pipeline.zh: 他们最近铺了一条地下管道。

atom.en: Neutrons and protons are bound together in the nucleus of an atom.
atom.zh: 在一个原子的核内，中子和质子聚合在一起。

atom.en: A molecule of water consists of two atoms of hydrogen and one atom of oxygen.
atom.zh: 水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成。

atom.en: Two atoms of hydrogen combine with one atom of oxygen to form a molecule of water.
atom.zh: 两个氢原子和一个氧原子结合组成一个水分子。

snack.en: Lunch was a snack in the fields.
snack.zh: 午饭是在野外吃的快餐。

snack.en: I only have time for a snack at lunchtime.
snack.zh: 中午，我的时间只够吃点心。

snack.en: It is customary to offer a drink or a snack to guests.
snack.zh: 通常用饮料或小吃招待客人。

migrant.en: The area was an important resting place for many types of migrant birds.
migrant.zh: 该地区是多种候鸟的重要栖息地。

migrant.en: The government revoked her husband's licence to operate migrant labour crews.
migrant.zh: 政府撤销了她丈夫经营流动劳工团队的许可证。

competence.en: Many people have testified to his competence.
competence.zh: 很多人已证实了他的能力。

competence.en: The judge has to act within the competence of the court.
competence.zh: 法官必须在法庭的权限范围内行使权力。

competence.en: The selection process is based on rigorous tests of competence and experience.
competence.zh: 挑选过程是建立在对能力和经验严格缜密的考核的基础之上的。

supplement.en: Industrial sponsorship is a supplement to government funding.
supplement.zh: 工业界的赞助是对政府拨款的补充。

supplement.en: Business sponsorship must be a supplement to, not a substitute for, public funding.
supplement.zh: 商业赞助必须是公共资助的补充而非替代物。

supplement.en: The hand-out is a supplement to the official newspaper.
supplement.zh: 这份分发的是官方报纸的增刊。

ink.en: The ink had run on the wet paper.
ink.zh: 墨迹在那张湿纸上渗开了。

distress.en: She was obviously in distress after the attack.
distress.zh: 她受到攻击后显然很痛苦。

distress.en: Widows seem to experience more distress than widowers.
distress.zh: 寡妇似乎比鳏夫感受更多痛苦。

distress.en: He keeps coming to the aid of this damsel in distress.
distress.zh: 他经常去帮助这位处于痛苦中的少女。

adaptation.en: This recipe is an adaptation of an old favourite.
adaptation.zh: 这个食谱是一个传统名食谱的改编。

adaptation.en: Most living creatures are capable of adaptation when compelled to do so.
adaptation.zh: 大多数生物在为情势所迫时都能适应。

adaptation.en: Branagh won two awards for his screen adaptation of Shakespeare's Henry the Fifth.
adaptation.zh: 布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

infect.en: A single mosquito can infect a large number of people.
infect.zh: 一只蚊子就能传染很多人。
他的创造力会感染其他的学生。

infect.en: There is, however, a chance that the virus will infect the bilby, an endangered native marsupial.
infect.zh: 然而，这种病毒有可能会感染兔耳袋狸，这是本土的一种濒危有袋类动物。

memorial.en: The town raised a memorial to those killed in the war.
memorial.zh: 这座小镇为战争中牺牲的人树立了一座纪念碑。

memorial.en: Building a memorial to Columbus has been his lifelong dream.
memorial.zh: 建一座哥伦布纪念碑一直是他一生的梦想。

memorial.en: The painting will be a lasting memorial to a remarkable woman.
memorial.zh: 这幅油画将成为对一位杰出女性的永久纪念。

pledge.en: In the treaty both sides pledge to respect human rights.
pledge.zh: 双方在条约中都许诺尊重人权。

pledge.en: He asked her to pledge the house as security for a loan.
pledge.zh: 他要她抵押房子作为贷款担保。

pledge.en: The government had retreated from its pledge to reduce class sizes.
pledge.zh: 政府已经改变了缩小班级规模的承诺。

paradigm.en: "It's a different paradigm of how to treat disease," says Dr. Brenda Rea.
paradigm.zh: “这是治疗疾病的另一范式。”布伦达·雷亚博士说。

paradigm.en: A paradigm shift, some researchers hope, can address that gap between education and action.
paradigm.zh: 一些研究人员希望，范式转变可以缩小教育和行动之间的差距。

paradigm.en: Organizations have had legitimate and pressing reasons to shift to a new paradigm of employer-employee relations.
paradigm.zh: 组织已经有了合法的和紧迫的理由来转变为一个新范式的雇主与雇员的关系。

appetite.zh: 所有的水獭都有一个贪吃的胃口。

appetite.en: Go for a walk. It'll give you an appetite.
appetite.zh: 去散散步，你就有食欲了。

backward.en: The diver flipped over backward into the water.
backward.zh: 跳水运动员向后翻转跳入水中。

backward.en: He unlocked the door of apartment two and disappeared inside after a backward glance at Larry.
backward.zh: 他打开2号公寓的门锁，向后瞥了拉里一眼之后走进去就不见了。

backward.en: She was walking backward on the walkway.
backward.zh: 她正在人行道上向后走。

hierarchy.en: Like most other American companies with a rigid hierarchy, workers and managers had strictly defined duties.
hierarchy.zh: 像大多数其他等级制度森严的美国公司一样，工人和管理人员都有严格界定的职责。

hierarchy.en: Such a hierarchy may also exist in plants.
hierarchy.zh: 这种等级结构也可能存在于植物中。

offend.en: A TV interviewer must be careful not to offend.
offend.zh: 电视采访者必须小心别得罪人。

offend.en: Neil did not mean to offend anybody with his joke.
offend.zh: 尼尔开那个玩笑并非想冒犯谁。

offend.en: I try to offend the least amount of people possible.

reconstruction.en: He said the task of reconstruction would demand much patience, hard work, and sacrifice.
reconstruction.zh: 他说重建工作会需要高度坚韧、勤劳和奉献。

reconstruction.en: The early human skeleton reconstruction "Lucy" dating back 3.2 million years debuted yesterday.
reconstruction.zh: 昨天，追溯到320万年前的原始人骨架重建“露西”首次亮相。

reconstruction.en: Young Iraqis are to be encouraged to participate in the country's reconstruction, by cleaning the streets and repairing schools.
reconstruction.zh: 通过清理街道和修复学校，鼓励伊拉克年轻人参与国家重建。

sympathetic.en: Tourists are, in the main, sympathetic people.
sympathetic.zh: 游客们大都是有同情心的人。

sympathetic.en: I did not feel at all sympathetic towards Kate.
sympathetic.zh: 我对凯特一点也不同情。

sympathetic.en: She was very sympathetic to the problems of adult students.
sympathetic.zh: 她对成年学生的问题很同情。

hostility.en: There was open hostility between the two schools.
hostility.zh: 这两所学校公开相互敌对。

hostility.en: In spite of her hostility, she was attracted to him.
hostility.zh: 尽管心存敌意，她还是被他吸引住了。
