spectator.zh: 成千上万的观众从希腊各地聚集而来，但已婚妇女甚至不能作为观众入场。

spectator.en: The most popular spectator sport is football.
spectator.zh: 足球是最吸引观众的体育比赛。

spectator.en: The role of a work is to communicate its message to the spectator.
spectator.zh: 一部艺术作品的作用在于把它的含义传达给观众。

comet.en: The orbit of this comet intersects the orbit of the Earth.
comet.zh: 这颗彗星的轨道和地球的轨道相交。

comet.en: We were not altogether sure that the comet would miss the Earth.
comet.zh: 我们不太确定这颗彗星是否会错过地球。

comet.en: The comet is going to come back in 2061 and we are all going to be able to see it. Well, our offspring are, anyway.
comet.zh: 这颗彗星将于2061年返回，到时我们都可以看到它。哦，无论如何，我们子孙是可以看到的。

bleed.en: One morning, the old man started to bleed.
bleed.zh: 有天早上，老人开始出血。

bleed.en: When winter arrives, my fingers split and bleed in the cold air.
bleed.zh: 在寒冷的冬天，我的手指会裂开流血。

bleed.en: The driver fled the scene of the accident, leaving the girl to bleed on the sidewalk.
bleed.zh: 司机逃离了事故现场，留下女孩在人行道上流血。

cocktail.en: Why don't you mix a cocktail for our guests?
cocktail.zh: 你给客人调制鸡尾酒好吗？

cocktail.en: On arrival, guests are offered wine or a champagne cocktail.
cocktail.zh: 到达时，客人们可以享用葡萄酒或一份香槟鸡尾酒。

cocktail.en: Celebrating a promotion, I took her to a posh hotel for a cocktail.
cocktail.zh: 为庆祝晋升，我带她去了一家豪华酒店喝鸡尾酒。

saint.en: Every parish was named after a saint.
saint.zh: 每个教区都以一个圣徒的名字命名。

saint.en: He reconnoitred the Gulf of Saint Lawrence, travelling up the magnificent river as far as modern Montreal.
saint.zh: 他侦察了圣劳伦斯海湾，沿着壮丽的河流向上前行直到现代的蒙特利尔。

saint.en: I go to the 7th grade in Saint Michael School.
saint.zh: 我在圣迈克尔学校上七年级。

choke.en: Very small toys can choke a baby.
choke.zh: 很小的玩具可使婴儿窒息。

choke.en: The brandy made him choke, but it restored his nerve.
choke.zh: 白兰地呛到他了，但恢复了他的勇气。

choke.en: The plant will soon choke ponds and waterways if left unchecked.
choke.zh: 如不控制这种植物的生长，池塘和水道很快就要被阻塞。

pesticide.en: The crops are regularly sprayed with pesticide.
This pesticide is diluted with water and applied directly to the fields.
pesticide.zh: 这种杀虫剂用水稀释后直接施用在田里。

delegate.zh: 那位加拿大代表没给答复。

delegate.en: Some managers find it difficult to delegate.
delegate.zh: 有些经理认为难以做到知人善任。

delegate.en: Horton's Achilles heel was that he could not delegate.
delegate.zh: 霍顿的致命弱点是他不肯放权。

rotation.en: Wheat, maize and sugar beet are planted in rotation.
rotation.zh: 小麦、玉米和甜菜是轮流种植的。

rotation.en: The workers in this workshop do day and night shifts in weekly rotation.
rotation.zh: 这个车间的工人上白班和上夜班每周轮换一次。

rotation.en: The earth's gravity slows the moon's rotation, matching it to the speed of its orbit.
rotation.zh: 地球引力减缓了月球的自转速度，使之与其轨道的速度相匹配。

cautious.zh: 他们采取了十分谨慎的态度。

cautious.en: He was cautious of his footing, wary of the edge.
cautious.zh: 他小心翼翼地站稳，注意着边缘。

cautious.en: Employers may become overly cautious about taking on new staff.
cautious.zh: 雇主在雇用新员工的问题上可能会过于谨慎。

tremble.en: I will never forget the look on the patient's face, the tremble in his hand.
tremble.zh: 我将永远不会忘记那病人脸上的表情和他颤抖的手。

tremble.en: He felt the earth tremble under him.
tremble.zh: 他感觉大地在脚下颤动。

tremble.en: "Please understand this," she began, a tremble in her voice.
tremble.zh: “请理解这个”，她开始用颤抖的声音说道。

affordable.en: They want their parents to have access to affordable long-term care.
affordable.zh: 他们希望他们的父母可以得到负担得起的长期看护。

affordable.en: Exorbitant housing prices have created an acute shortage of affordable housing for the poor.
affordable.zh: 过高的房价使穷人负担得起的房源严重短缺。

affordable.en: It could make extra training and instruction affordable.
affordable.zh: 这使人们负担得起额外的培训和指导费用。

prejudice.zh: 对我来说，种族歧视非常可恶。

temporarily.en: I'm afraid we're temporarily out of stock.
temporarily.zh: 很遗憾，我们暂时脱销了。

temporarily.en: The stress of war temporarily unhinged him.
temporarily.zh: 战争的压力暂时使他精神错乱。

temporarily.en: We regret this service is temporarily unavailable.
temporarily.zh: 我们很抱歉暂时不能提供这一服务。

certificate.en: He was shown a photocopy of the certificate.
certificate.zh: 给他看了证书的复印件。

certificate.en: She's going in for the Cambridge First Certificate.
certificate.zh: 她打算参加剑桥初级证书考试。

certificate.en: She didn't like the course but she stuck it out to get the certificate.
certificate.zh: 她并不喜欢这门课，但为了拿证书还是耐着性子学完了。

designate.en: Japan's prime minister-designate is completing his cabinet today.
designate.zh: 日本即将上任的首相今天将完成他的内阁组建。

designate.en: There are efforts under way to designate the bridge a historic landmark.
designate.zh: 在努力把这座桥定为历史地标。

designate.en: If you want to designate a period, you have to look at tangible things like pottery, particularly painted pottery, because it's easier to categorize.
designate.zh: 如果你想标注某段时期，你必须借助有形的事物，就像陶器，尤其是彩绘陶器，因为它们更容易分类。

mercy.en: It's a mercy she wasn't seriously hurt.
They showed no mercy to their hostages.
mercy.zh: 他们对人质丝毫不讲仁慈。

cult.en: Their son ran away from home and joined a cult.
cult.zh: 他们的儿子离家出走，加入了一个异教团体。

cult.en: Sandman's experimentation has made him something of a cult figure on the local music scene.
cult.zh: 桑德曼的实验已经使他成为当地音乐领域颇受人崇拜的人物。

cult.en: It gained something of a cult after it was widely circulated on the Internet.
cult.zh: 在互联网上广泛流传后，它获得了某种程度的崇拜。

motel.en: He put Elizabeth's motel bill and airfare on his expense account.
motel.zh: 他把伊丽莎白住汽车旅馆的费用和机票费用记在了他的报销账户上。

motel.en: His abhorrence of racism led him to write "The Algiers Motel Incident."
motel.zh: 他对种族主义的痛恨促使他写了《阿尔及尔汽车旅馆事件》。

motel.en: She found a small, inexpensive motel on the outskirts of the town; it was barren and unlovely.
motel.zh: 她在镇郊找了一个又小又便宜的汽车旅馆，设施不全也不好看。

hatred.en: Often her feelings were nearer hatred than love.
hatred.zh: 她的感情往往更像是恨，而不是爱。

hatred.en: He felt hatred for the students who did not know the value of hard work.
hatred.zh: 他憎恨那些不懂得努力学习的价值的学生。

hatred.en: It manifests itself in hatred, stereotypes, prejudice, and discrimination.
hatred.zh: 它表现为仇恨、成见、偏见和歧视。

diameter.en: It turns out that the diameter is actually 2.5 centimeters.
diameter.zh: 它的直径实际上是 2.5 厘米。

diameter.en: The microscope can magnify the object 100 times in diameter.
diameter.zh: 这架显微镜能把物体的直径放大100倍。

enlist.en: They hoped to enlist the help of the public in solving the crime.
enlist.zh: 他们希望寻求公众协助破案。

enlist.en: If the bailiff thinks that things could turn nasty he will enlist the help of the police.
enlist.zh: 如果司法官认为情况可能会变糟，他会寻求警方帮助。

enlist.en: I had to cut down a tree and enlist the help of seven neighbours to get it out of the garden!
enlist.zh: 我不得不砍了一棵树，然后找了7位邻居帮忙把它从院子里弄出去。

predecessor.en: He is cast in a different mould from his predecessor.
predecessor.zh: 他和他的前任性格不一样。

predecessor.en: The new governor is an improvement on his predecessor.
predecessor.zh: 新任总督胜过他的前任。

predecessor.en: He faced the same kind of problems as his predecessor.
predecessor.zh: 他面临着与他的前任同样的问题。

induce.en: Nothing would induce me to take the job.
induce.zh: 没有什么能诱使我接受这份工作。

induce.en: Whales being sociable animals probably need the stimulus of sizeable gatherings to induce reproductives behavior.
induce.zh: 鲸作为社会性动物，可能需要大规模聚集的刺激来诱导繁殖行为。

acute.en: There is an acute shortage of water.

acute.zh: 他的身体因严重的肾衰竭而垮掉了。

disclosure.en: Much more could be done to encourage "long-termism," such as changes in the tax code and quicker disclosure of stock acquisitions.
disclosure.zh: 在鼓励“长期主义”方面，我们还可以做得更多，比如修改税法，加快股票收购信息的披露。

disclosure.en: Patient disclosure, facilitated by the therapist, seems also to facilitate the process of normalizing.
disclosure.zh: 在治疗师的帮助下，病人的倾诉似乎也促进了正常化的进程。

disclosure.en: Wipers were a safety item, Shipman explained, and the law required disclosure of all the engineering before Ford could give Kearns a contract.
disclosure.zh: 希普曼解释说，雨刷是安全项目，法律规定在福特同卡恩斯签署协议前，需解密全部工程。

juvenile.en: Juvenile crime is increasing at a terrifying rate.
juvenile.zh: 青少年犯罪在以惊人的速度增加。

juvenile.en: She wasn't sent to the juvenile court; instead she was cautioned.
juvenile.zh: 她未被送上少年法庭，而是受到了警告。

juvenile.en: Is it just a coincidence that juvenile crime is on the rise?
juvenile.zh: 青少年犯罪率上升只是一个巧合吗？

gown.en: Her gown was very French and very chic.
gown.zh: 她的礼服是地道的法国风格，非常时髦有品位。

gown.en: She was arrayed in a black velvet gown.
gown.zh: 她穿着一件黑色天鹅绒长礼服。

gown.en: The priest fumbled in the folds of his gown.
gown.zh: 这位牧师胡乱地整了整长袍上的褶皱。

notably.en: The house had many drawbacks, most notably its price.
notably.zh: 这房子有很多缺陷，尤其是它的价格。

notably.en: The divorce would be granted when more important problems, notably the fate of the children, had been decided.
notably.zh: 当更重要的问题，尤其是孩子们的命运被决定时，离婚就会获得批准。

notably.en: Growth which rarely continues beyond the age of 20, demands calories and nutrients—notably, protein—to feed expanding tissues.
notably.zh: 人 的发育需要能量和营养——尤其是蛋白质——用来供给组织的生长，但人超过20岁之后很少再继续发育。

halt.en: The leading car came to a halt.
halt.zh: 行驶在前面的车停了下来。
公共汽车剧烈地晃动着停了下来。
汽车嘎的一声停了下来。

persistent.en: I had a persistent cough for over a month.
persistent.zh: 我持续咳嗽已经一个多月了。

persistent.en: Three children were removed from the school for persistent bad behaviour.
persistent.zh: 三个孩子因持续行为不检被学校开除。

persistent.en: Despite persistent rain showers, the lawn and pavilion were packed with fans.
persistent.zh: 尽管有持续阵雨，草坪上和亭子里还是挤满了仰慕者。

torture.en: Many of the refugees have suffered torture.
torture.zh: 许多难民都遭受过拷打。

torture.en: He would not torture her further by trying to argue with her.
torture.zh: 他不会通过和她争吵而进一步折磨她。

torture.en: I believed that in civilized countries, torture had ended long ago.
torture.zh: 我相信在文明国家酷刑早就废止了。

exile.en: He is now living in exile in Egypt.
He was dethroned and went into exile.

chorus.en: The chorus was singing "The Ode to Joy."
chorus.zh: 合唱团那时正在唱着《欢乐颂》。

chorus.en: Students played the lesser parts and sang in the chorus.
chorus.zh: 学生们扮演了一些次要角色，并参加了合唱团的演唱。

roar.zh: 我们听见了狮子的吼声。

roar.en: I could barely hear above the roar of traffic.
roar.zh: 过往车辆的轰鸣声使我几乎什么也听不见。
响起了一片表示赞成的喊叫声。

architectural.en: Sometimes his designs received honourable mentions, and were reproduced in architectural journals.
architectural.zh: 有时，他的设计获得荣誉奖，并在建筑杂志中刊登。

architectural.en: His interest in science and technology was leavened by a genuine passion for architectural history and theory.
architectural.zh: 对建筑历史学和其理论的热爱使他对科学和技术的兴趣更加浓厚了。

architectural.en: He constructed his house with an eye to architectural beauty.
architectural.zh: 他在建造房屋时着眼于建筑之美。

revive.zh: 护理人员无法使她苏醒。

revive.en: Their efforts to revive him were futile.
revive.zh: 他们努力使他苏醒，但失败了。

fountain.en: The main square has a fountain that spouts water 40 feet into the air.
fountain.zh: 主广场有个喷泉，喷水高达40英尺。

fountain.en: "What's that thing in the middle of the fountain?"—"Some kind of statue, I guess."
fountain.zh: “喷泉中间那个东西是什么？”—“我想是雕像之类的吧。”

revenge.en: The crime had revenge stamped all over it.
revenge.zh: 从各方面看这次犯罪都是复仇行为。

revenge.en: The arrests raised the spectre of revenge attacks.
revenge.zh: 拘捕增加了对报复性攻击的恐惧。
这个故事其实是关于复仇的。

sour.zh: 炎热的天气使得牛奶变酸了。

sour.en: Too much pulp produces a sour wine.
sour.zh: 过多的果肉会让酒变酸。

sour.en: The stewed apple was sour even with honey.
sour.zh: 炖过的苹果即使加了蜂蜜也还是酸的。

reside.en: I reside at the mission at St. Michael's.
reside.zh: 我住在圣迈克尔教堂的布道所。

reside.en: Most known extrasolar planets reside in highly elongated, not circular, orbits.
reside.zh: 大多数已知的太阳系外行星都居住在高度拉长而非圆形的轨道上。

reside.en: Community members may reside temporarily in one of the lower zones to manage the extraction of products unavailable in the homeland.
reside.zh: 社区成员可以暂时居住在一个较低的区域，以管理在本土无法获得的产品的提取。

empirical.en: There is no empirical evidence to support his thesis.
empirical.zh: 没有实证根据来支持他的论点。

empirical.en: The empirical evidence considered here is subject to many qualifications.
empirical.zh: 这里所考虑的经验证据有许多限制条件。

empirical.en: They place great emphasis on empirical studies.
empirical.zh: 他们非常重视实证研究。

caution.en: 'Caution' is the key word in this situation.
caution.zh: 在此情形之下，caution为关键词。

caution.en: I would caution against getting too involved.
caution.zh: 我要提出警告，别介入得太深。

originate.zh: 所有的碳水化合物均来源于植物。

originate.en: Current services originate in two key measures.
originate.zh: 当前的服务起源于两个关键措施。

originate.en: Regularly flowing rivers and streams that originate within arid lands are known as "endogenous".
originate.zh: 起源于干旱地区的流动性河流和溪流通常被称为“内源河流”。

lure.en: Few can resist the lure of adventure.
lure.zh: 很少有人能抵御历险的诱惑力。

lure.en: He attempted to lure her away from husband and family.
lure.zh: 他企图引诱她离开丈夫和家庭。

lure.en: In this case, the document instance lists only one lure.
lure.zh: 在本例中，此文档例子只列出一个诱饵。

correlate.en: Economists who study the relationship between money and happiness have consistently found that, above a certain income, the two do not reliably correlate.
correlate.zh: 研究金钱与幸福关系的经济学家们一致发现，在一定的收入之上，两者之间就并没有可靠的关联。

correlate.en: The figures do not seem to correlate.
correlate.zh: 这些数字似乎毫不相干。

correlate.en: Researchers are trying to correlate the two sets of figures.
correlate.zh: 研究人员正试图展示这两组数字的相关性。

compile.en: We are trying to compile a list of suitable people for the job.
compile.zh: 我们在努力编制一份适合做这项工作的人员名单。

erupt.en: Ash began to erupt from the crater.
erupt.zh: 火山灰开始从火山口喷出。

erupt.en: The volcano could erupt at any time.
erupt.zh: 这座火山随时可能爆发。

erupt.en: He avers that chaos will erupt if he loses.
erupt.zh: 他断言如果他失败将会爆发动乱。

loom.en: She sat at her loom and continued to weave.
loom.zh: 她坐在织布机前，继续织布。

loom.en: You've got to be able to make decisions on the fly as deadlines loom.
loom.zh: 你必须能够立刻作出决定，因为最后期限迫在眉睫。

loom.en: Now the Emperor himself wished to see the costly manufacture, while it was still in the loom.
loom.zh: 当这布还在织的时候，皇帝就亲自去看它了。

notable.en: His eyes are his most notable feature.
notable.zh: 他的双眼是他最明显的特征。

notable.en: The game was also notable for the bizarre behaviour of the team's manager.
notable.zh: 这场比赛另一值得注意的地方是该队经理人异乎寻常的表现。

notable.en: The proposed new structure is notable not only for its height, but for its shape.
notable.zh: 那座提议的新建筑值得注意，不仅因其高度，还因其外形。

endorsement.en: The election victory is a clear endorsement of their policies.
endorsement.zh: 竞选成功显然是对他们政策的支持。

endorsement.en: This is a powerful endorsement for his softer style of government.
endorsement.zh: 这是对他的更温和的执政风格的强有力认可。

endorsement.en: It's a dramatic endorsement for a technology most people think about only when their smartphone goes dark.
endorsement.zh: 对于一项大多数人只有在智能手机黑屏时才会想到的技术来说，这是一个戏剧性的认可。

cane.en: In his hand, he carried a gold-tipped cane.
cane.zh: 他手里拿着一根有金制端部的手杖。

cane.en: He stopped, shifting his cane to his left hand.
cane.zh: 他停下来，把手杖移到左手。

cane.en: The main plants that are used for biofuel production now are sugar cane, corn.
cane.zh: 现在用于生物燃料生产的主要植物是甘蔗和玉米。

commerce.en: The music business marries art and commerce.
commerce.zh: 音乐行当将艺术和商业结合在一起。

commerce.en: They have made their fortunes from industry and commerce.
commerce.zh: 他们从工商业中发了财。

commerce.en: The business is no longer regarded as a citadel of commerce.
commerce.zh: 这个生意已经不再被看作是商业堡垒了。

fortunate.en: In this respect we are very fortunate.
fortunate.zh: 在这方面，我们是很幸运的。

fortunate.en: I often think about those less fortunate than me.
fortunate.zh: 我经常想到那些不如我幸运的人。

fortunate.en: She is in the fortunate position of having plenty of choice.
fortunate.zh: 她处在一个可有很多选择的幸运位置上。

forge.en: They agreed to forge closer economic ties.
forge.zh: 他们同意建立更密切的经济联系。

forge.en: He again pledged to forge ahead with his plans for reform.
forge.zh: 他再次发誓要继续推进他的改革计划。

forge.en: Not long ago, just being in IRC was enough to forge bonds between chatters.
forge.zh: 不久前，只需参加因特网中继聊天就足以在聊天者之间建立联系。

disrupt.en: A stroke can disrupt the supply of oxygen to the brain.
disrupt.zh: 中风可导致大脑供氧中断。

disrupt.en: It could disrupt the food chains there.
disrupt.zh: 它可能会破坏那里的食物链。

disrupt.en: They can disrupt experiments with the bacteria organisms they carry.
disrupt.zh: 他们可以通过携带的细菌来扰乱实验。

established.en: By then she was established as a star.
established.zh: 那时她作为明星的地位已经确立。

established.en: That link is an established medical fact.
established.zh: 那种联系是被证实了的医学事实。

established.en: We had already established contact with the museum.
established.zh: 我们已经与那个博物馆建立了联系。

breakthrough.en: God willing, there will be a breakthrough.
breakthrough.zh: 天公作美的话，会有所突破。

breakthrough.en: This discovery was perceived as a major breakthrough.
breakthrough.zh: 这一发现被视为一项重大突破。

breakthrough.en: The company looks poised to make a significant breakthrough in China.
breakthrough.zh: 该公司看上去稳将在中国实现一次重大突破。

desirable.en: It is desirable that interest rates be reduced.
It is desirable that interest rates should be reduced.

desirable.zh: 这栋房子有许多吸引人的特点。

slim.zh: 她喜欢瘦高个子的男人。

slim.en: The young woman was tall and slim.
slim.zh: 那个年轻女子个子高挑，身材苗条。

remains.zh: 他的勇敢仍然不容置疑。
这个问题至今仍在激烈地辩论中。

alert.en: The bank is alert to the danger.
alert.zh: 该银行对这种危险有警觉。
她整个人保持着戒备状态。

allege.en: The claimants allege that manufacturers failed to warn doctors that their drugs should be used only in limited circumstances.
allege.zh: 索赔人声称生产商没有警告医生他们生产的药品只能在特定的条件下使用。

allege.en: The court papers allege she may be a voyeur.
allege.zh: 法庭文件宣称她可能是一个偷窥狂。

allege.en: The details that police allege are horrific.
allege.zh: 警方指控的细节非常可怕。

hut.en: The little prefabricated hut was lifted away by a huge crane.
hut.zh: 那间小小的预制棚屋被一台巨大的起重机吊走了。

hut.en: You haven't lived till you've learned how to yodel at a tea dance in a mountain hut!
hut.zh: 你要是还未学会在山间小屋的下午茶舞会上用约德尔调歌唱的话，那你就白活了！

hut.en: Heidi just now came out of the hut.

dinosaur.en: The fossils at Dinosaur Cove are embedded in hard sandstone.
dinosaur.zh: 恐龙湾中的化石嵌在坚硬的砂岩中。

dinosaur.en: 'Dinosaur' combines CGI animation with live-action location shots.
dinosaur.zh: 《恐龙》结合了电脑生成的动画和外景地实地拍摄的画面。

attain.en: Students with high hope set themselves higher goals and know how to work to attain them.
attain.zh: 被寄予厚望的学生为自己设定更高的目标，并知道如何努力实现这些目标。

attain.en: Thus they are not able to "experience life" and so they attain a high life span in captivity.
attain.zh: 因此，他们不能“体验生活”，从而在囚禁中获得了较长的寿命。

attain.en: Many of these people acquired far more experience of exploration than most Europeans could hope to attain.
attain.zh: 这些人中有很多人获得了探险经验，远比大多数欧洲人希望获得的更多。

excite.en: Daniel's early exposure to motor racing did not excite his interest.
excite.zh: 丹尼尔早期对赛车运动的接触并没有激起他的兴趣。

excite.en: We tend to have a good memory for things that excite our senses or appeal to our emotions.
excite.zh: 我们往往记得那些能够激起我们的共鸣或者诉诸情感的事物。

excite.en: Such a view, however, fails to explain the ability of some works of art to excite the human mind.
excite.zh: 然而，这种观点并不能解释为什么某些艺术作品能够激发人类思维。

urgent.en: I have some urgent business to attend to.

choir.zh: 她目前担任一个大合唱团的指挥。
合唱团的演唱准确无误。

pronounce.en: I don't know how to pronounce this word.
pronounce.zh: 我不知道这个单词怎么发音。
我把你的名字读对了吗？

confine.en: He did not confine himself to the one language.
confine.zh: 他没把自己局限于这一门语言。

confine.en: I will confine myself to looking at the period from 1900 to 1916.
confine.zh: 我将把自己考察的范围限定在1900年至1916年这段时间以内。

confine.en: Confine the use of insecticides to the evening and do not spray plants that are in flower.
confine.zh: 只限晚间使用杀虫剂，并且不要对花期植物喷药。

banner.en: I felt the banner rip as we were pushed in opposite directions.
banner.zh: 当我们被挤向相反的方向的时候，我感到横幅撕裂了。

banner.en: Using a Magic Marker, he wrote seven digits on the poster-size banner.
banner.zh: 他用白板笔在海报大小的横幅上写了七个数字。

banner.en: The patriots unfurled the banner of freedom.
banner.zh: 爱国志士们打出了自由的旗帜。

assertion.en: Their work makes a rather startling assertion: the trait we commonly call talent is highly overrated.
assertion.zh: 他们的研究提出了一个相当惊人的主张：我们通常称为天赋的特征被严重高估了。

assertion.en: To live in the United States today is to gain an appreciation for Dahrendorf's assertion that social change exists everywhere.
assertion.zh: 今天生活在美国，是对达伦多夫关于社会变革无处不在的主张的赞赏。

assertion.en: The 8-0 objection to President Obama turns on what Justice Samuel Alito describes in his objection as "a shocking assertion of federal executive power".
assertion.zh: 对奥巴马总统的反对以8比0的结果告终，大法官塞缪尔·阿利托在他的反对意见中称，这是“对联邦行政权力令人震惊的断言”。

orthodox.en: Shavuot is a two-day festival for Orthodox Jews.
orthodox.zh: 五旬节是正统犹太教教民为期两天的节日。

orthodox.en: Most orthodox doctors however dismiss this as complete nonsense.
orthodox.zh: 然而大多数传统的医生将此视为纯粹的胡言乱语而不予考虑。

orthodox.en: Karouzos's poetry shows a profound preoccupation with the Orthodox Church.
orthodox.zh: 卡鲁佐斯的诗歌表现出对东正教的深切关注。

outbreak.en: The area was struck by an outbreak of cholera.
His death set in motion a train of events that led to the outbreak of war.
outbreak.zh: 他的死引发了一系列的事件，从而导致了战争的爆发。

outbreak.en: He was interned as an enemy alien at the outbreak of the Second World War.
outbreak.zh: 他在第二次世界大战爆发时被作为敌国侨民扣押了。

strand.en: She was wearing a strand of crystal beads.
Pauline wore a silk dress with a strand of pearls.
strand.zh: 保利娜穿了一条带有一串珍珠的丝绸连衣裙。

strand.en: She wore a single strand of pearls around her neck.
strand.zh: 她脖子上戴着单串珍珠。

payroll.en: All told there were 104 people on the payroll.
Before Harrington knew it, she was down to her last $20,000, not enough to cover payroll.
payroll.zh: 在哈林顿知道这件事之前，她只剩下最后的2万美元，还不够支付工资单。

payroll.en: I thought graduate teaching assistants will automatically put on the payroll at the beginning of the semester.
payroll.zh: 我原以为研究生助教会在学期开始时自动进入发放工资的名单。

orchestra.zh: 这支管弦乐队的声望有所提高。
马苏尔很有信心地带领了那个管弦乐队。
这个交响乐团没有把贝多芬的乐曲演奏好。

bead.en: A bead curtain separated the two rooms.
bead.zh: 一挂珠帘子把两个房间分开。

bead.en: Her bead necklaces and bracelets jangled as she walked.
bead.zh: 她的珠子项链和手镯在她走路时叮当作响。

bead.en: You can imagine a bead with a wire going through it and the bead can only slide back and forth.
bead.zh: 你可以想象一个有金属丝穿过的珠子而且这个珠子只能前后滑动。

grim.en: They painted a grim picture of growing crime.
grim.zh: 他们描绘了一个犯罪增长的严酷局面。

grim.en: The house looked grim and dreary in the rain.
grim.zh: 这房子在雨中显得阴郁凄凉。

drought.zh: 干旱持续了好多个星期。

drought.en: During the drought the river dried up.
drought.zh: 旱灾期间，河流都干涸了。
那里的干旱正在耗尽财力物力。

profitable.en: It would take a miracle to make this business profitable.
profitable.zh: 让这个公司赢利简直是天方夜谭。

profitable.en: Other less profitable services are to be axed later this year.
profitable.zh: 其他盈利较少的服务项目预定今年稍晚将大量削减。

profitable.en: For us, saving energy has been very, very profitable.
profitable.zh: 对我们来说，节约能源是非常非常有益的。

uphold.en: We have a duty to uphold the law.
uphold.zh: 维护法律是我们的责任。

uphold.en: Our policy has been to uphold the law.
uphold.zh: 我们的政策一直是维护法律。

uphold.en: It is the responsibility of every government to uphold certain basic principles.
uphold.zh: 每个政府都有责任维护某些基本原则。

commentator.en: He achieved celebrity as a sports commentator.
commentator.zh: 他作为一名体育评论员而享誉四方。

commentator.en: "Today's young people are quite calculating," says Chieko Akiyama, a social commentator.
commentator.zh: 社会评论员秋山千子说：“当今的年轻人非常精于算计。”

commentator.en: As that great commentator on human affairs, Dr. Samuel Johnson, once remarked, "Men have been wise in very different modes; but they have always laughed in the same way."
commentator.zh: 正如人类事务的伟大评论家塞缪尔·约翰逊博士曾经说过的那样：“人类智慧的展现方式各不相同,但笑的方式是相同的。”

hazardous.en: They were incinerating hazardous waste without a licence.
hazardous.zh: 他们没有许可就把危险废弃物烧成灰烬。

hazardous.en: The report calls for a ban on the import of hazardous waste.
hazardous.zh: 这篇报道呼吁禁止危险废弃物的进口。

hazardous.en: They have no way to dispose of the hazardous waste they produce.
hazardous.zh: 他们没法处理那些由他们制造出来的危害性废弃物。

confirmation.en: She glanced over at James for confirmation.
confirmation.zh: 她瞟了詹姆斯一眼寻求确认。

confirmation.en: These times are provisional and subject to confirmation.
confirmation.zh: 这些期限是暂定的，还有待确认。

confirmation.en: They took her resignation as confirmation of their suspicions.
confirmation.zh: 他们认为她的辞职证实了他们的猜疑。

believer.en: I made no secret of the fact that I was not a believer.
believer.zh: 我对自己不是一个宗教信徒的事实并不隐瞒。

believer.en: For a believer, replies to all the questions about life and work are far different because he trusts in God.
believer.zh: 对一个信徒来说，对所有生活和工作问题的回答是大不一样的，因为他相信上帝。

believer.en: If you're going to create a TV show that deals week after week with things that are unbelievable, you need an actor who can play a believer, you know, a person who tends to believe everything.
believer.zh: 如果你要创作一部每周都在讲述令人难以置信的事情的电视剧，你就需要一个能扮演信徒的演员，你知道的，就是一个相信一切的人。

merge.zh: 他的部门将和我的合并。

merge.en: The banks are set to merge next year.
merge.zh: 这几家银行准备明年合并。

merge.en: A proposal to merge the two companies was voted through yesterday.
merge.zh: 两家公司合并的建议已于昨日投票通过。

shaft.en: The depth of the shaft is 520 yards.
A shaft of moonlight fell on the lake.
The fire began in a lift shaft and spread to the roof.
shaft.zh: 大火从电梯通道里开始，然后蔓延到了屋顶。

theft.en: She appeared on six charges of theft.
theft.zh: 她因被控犯有六项盗窃罪而出庭受审。

convenient.en: If it's convenient I can come tomorrow.
convenient.zh: 方便的话，我可以明天过来。

convenient.en: I'll call back at a more convenient time.
convenient.zh: 在方便的时候我会回电话的。

convenient.en: It is very convenient to pay by credit card.
convenient.zh: 用信用卡付款非常方便。

accommodation.zh: 她在accommodation一词中漏掉了一个字母m。

prescribe.en: The physician may prescribe but not administer the drug.
prescribe.zh: 内科医师可以开处方但不可发药。

prescribe.en: Therapists cannot prescribe drugs as they are not necessarily medically qualified.
prescribe.zh: 治疗师们不能开药方，因为他们不一定具备医疗资格。
你的大夫可能会开抗生素。

grind.en: There was an old mill that really did grind corn.
grind.zh: 有一个真正碾磨玉米的老磨坊。

grind.en: The grind of heavy machines could get on their nerves.
grind.zh: 重型机器发出的嘎嘎磨擦声会让他们心烦意乱。

grind.en: Store the peppercorns in an airtight container and grind the pepper as you need it.
grind.zh: 将胡椒子储藏在密封容器里，当你需要的时候把它磨成粉。

lone.en: A lone sea gull flew across the sky.
lone.zh: 一只孤独的海鸥在空中飞过。

lone.en: They perpetuate the myth of the lone genius.
lone.zh: 他们使孤独天才的神话永垂不朽。

lone.en: The vision acquired an especially keen charm that made me race with all speed toward my lone gratification.
lone.zh: 这景象具有一种特别强烈的魅力，使我全速奔向我孤独的满足。

registration.en: Entry is only allowed on payment of the full registration fee.
registration.zh: 缴付全数登记费用方可进入。

registration.en: The registration form showed his date of birth as August 2, 1979.
registration.zh: 登记表上显示他的出生日期是1979年8月2日。

registration.en: They have campaigned strongly for compulsory registration of dogs.
registration.zh: 他们大力开展了狗的强制性登记活动。

courtesy.en: I was treated with the utmost courtesy by the staff.
courtesy.zh: 我受到了工作人员极有礼貌的接待。

courtesy.en: The president paid a courtesy call on Emperor Akihito.
courtesy.zh: 总统礼节性地拜访了明仁天皇。

courtesy.en: Good customer relations require courtesy, professionalism and effective response.
courtesy.zh: 良好的客户关系需要礼貌、专业和有效的回复。

graphic.en: The exhibition traces the history of graphic design in America from the 19th century to the present.
graphic.zh: 这个展览会追溯了从19世纪到现在美国平面设计的历史。

graphic.en: In a graphic, only a few words are used to explain what the picture shows you.
graphic.zh: 在图表中，只有几个词用来解释图片所显示的内容。

graphic.en: This overturning of convention, this assailing of standard graphic and typographic formats, was part of a search for intellectual freedom.
graphic.zh: 这种对传统的颠覆，这种对标准图形和排版格式的攻击，是对知识自由追求的一部分。

subway.zh: 过街地道里涂满了乱七八糟的图画和文字。

subway.en: The closest subway stop is Houston Street.
subway.zh: 最近的地铁站是休斯敦街。

subway.en: The subway is efficient and spotlessly clean.

circulation.en: The coins were taken out of circulation.

circulation.zh: 这份报纸的发行量在继续增长。

circulation.en: A number of forged tickets are in circulation.
circulation.zh: 有一些假入场券在流通。

transplant.en: She was on a wait list for a liver transplant.
transplant.zh: 她的名字当时在肝移植等候者名单上。

transplant.en: He was recovering from a heart transplant operation.
transplant.zh: 他正从心脏移植手术中康复。

transplant.en: The operation to transplant a kidney is now fairly routine.
transplant.zh: 移植肾脏的手术如今相当常见。

explosive.en: He appeared to be treating the potentially explosive situation with some sensitivity.
explosive.zh: 他似乎正在有些敏感地处理潜在的爆炸性局面。

explosive.en: The explosive new style helped cut Killy's racing time dramatically.
explosive.zh: 这种爆发性的新方式极大地缩短了基利的比赛时间。

illuminate.en: Instead of formulas and charts, the two instructors use games and drawings to illuminate their subject.
illuminate.zh: 这两位教师用游戏和图画而不是公式和图表来阐明他们的题旨。

illuminate.en: Second, data can illuminate patterns of behavior we haven't yet noticed.
illuminate.zh: 其次，数据可以阐明一些我们尚未注意到的行为模式。

illuminate.en: Such explanations, however, illuminate neither the source of this curious convention nor the reason for its popularity.
illuminate.zh: 然而，这样的解释既不能说明这个奇怪的惯例的来源，也不能说明它流行的原因。

penetrate.en: Air cannot penetrate between the soil particles, making the soil oxygen-poor.
penetrate.zh: 空气不能穿透土壤颗粒，这使得土壤中缺少氧气。

penetrate.en: Our eyes could not penetrate the darkness.
penetrate.zh: 我们的眼睛在黑暗中什么也看不见。

congressman.en: Another congressman clung on with a majority of only 18.
congressman.zh: 另一位国会议员在获得仅仅18张多数票的情况下保住了位子。
一次严重跌伤使这位68岁的国会议员丧失了行动能力。

congressman.en: The congressman was accused of a breach of secrecy rules.
congressman.zh: 这个国会议员被指控违反保密条例。

venue.en: We're still trying to decide on a venue.
venue.zh: 我们仍然在设法选定一个会场。
会场被3 000名俱乐部会员挤得满满的。

venue.en: The venue for the World Cup remains undecided.
venue.zh: 世界杯的举办地点尚未确定。

canal.zh: 他们沿运河测量了水深。

innocence.zh: 我坚信她是清白无辜的。

parameter.en: If you have enough RAM, set the value of this parameter as large as possible to decrease the indexing time dramatically.
parameter.zh: 如果你有足够的内存，请将该参数的值设置得尽可能大以显著减少索引时间。

parameter.en: If this were more than a demo, some other logic would choose the parameter, perhaps prompting the user to supply the information.
parameter.zh: 如果这不仅仅是一个演示的话，某些其他的逻辑将选择参数，可能会提示用户提供该信息。

parameter.en: There are striking differences in life span between different species, but within one species the parameter is relatively constant.
parameter.zh: 不同物种之间的寿命存在显著差异，但在同一物种内，这一参数是相对稳定的。

grill.en: Place under a hot grill until the nuts have toasted.
grill.zh: 把这些坚果放在高温烤架下面烤熟。

grill.en: Apart from peppers and eggplant, many other vegetables grill well.
grill.zh: 除了甜椒和茄子，许多别的蔬菜烤起来也不错。

flaw.en: There was a fatal flaw in the plan.
flaw.zh: 计划中有一个致命的缺陷。

flaw.en: There is always a flaw in the character of a tragic hero.
flaw.zh: 悲剧主角总有性格上的缺点。

flaw.en: The only flaw in his character seems to be a short temper.
flaw.zh: 他性格中唯一的缺点似乎就是脾气急躁。

champagne.zh: 罗宾打开了一些香槟酒。

optimism.zh: 他刚刚建立的乐观情绪消失了。

optimism.en: There are very real grounds for optimism.

posture.en: Good posture helps your bust look bigger.
posture.zh: 好的姿势可以使你的胸部看起来更丰满。

posture.en: Back pains can be the result of bad posture.
posture.zh: 腰背疼可能是不良姿势造成的。

posture.en: Exercise, fresh air, and good posture are all helpful.
posture.zh: 体育运动、新鲜空气和良好姿势都很有效果。

systematic.zh: 他们开始了系统的搜查。

systematic.en: Most of them are based on systematic reviews.
systematic.zh: 它们中的大多数都是基于系统的评论。
其他的系统评论也支持她的结论。

reassure.en: Banks are built to look solid to reassure their customers.
reassure.zh: 银行修建得看上去很坚固，以使顾客放心。

reassure.en: He didn't need to go to hospital, but he went just to reassure himself.
reassure.zh: 他用不着去医院，去了只是想让自己放心点。（北美英语）

reassure.en: His father smiled weakly in a forlorn attempt to reassure him that everything was all right.
reassure.zh: 他父亲淡淡地一笑，枉然地试图要他放心，一切都安然无恙。

rehearsal.en: We only had six days of rehearsal.
rehearsal.zh: 我们只有六天的排练时间。

rehearsal.en: The rehearsal process also irked him increasingly.
rehearsal.zh: 排练过程也更加让他厌烦。

rehearsal.en: The rehearsal studio is buzzing with lunchtime activity.
rehearsal.zh: 排练场被午餐时段活动搞得很热闹。

invoke.en: You also have to invoke the stored procedure once.
invoke.zh: 您还必须调用一次存储过程。

invoke.en: In choosing a method for determining climatic conditions that existed in the past, paleoclimatologists invoke four principal criteria.
invoke.zh: 在选择确定过去存在的气候条件的方法时，古气候学家援引了四个主要标准。

invoke.en: While we invoke the precautionary principle, which always recommends erring on the side of caution, we have to recognize there will be trade-offs to be made.
invoke.zh: 当我们援引总是建议谨慎行事的预防原则时，我们必须做出权衡。

correspond.en: Your account and hers do not correspond.
correspond.zh: 你说的情况与她说的不相符。

correspond.en: Your account of events does not correspond with hers.
correspond.zh: 你对事情的陈述与她说的不相符。

correspond.en: Racegoers will be given a number which will correspond to a horse running in a race.
correspond.zh: 观看赛马的观众将领到一个与参赛马匹相对应的号码。

revival.en: There are encouraging signs of an artistic revival.
revival.zh: 有了鼓舞人心的艺术复兴的迹象。

revival.en: This return to realism has produced a revival of interest in a number of artists.
revival.zh: 这次向现实主义的回归引起了对许多艺术家兴趣的复苏。

revival.en: The most surprising bout of consolidation and revival has been in Latin America.
revival.zh: 最令人惊讶的整合与复活发生在拉丁美洲。

discard.en: Einstein had the chutzpah to discard long-established theory.
discard.zh: 爱因斯坦拥有抛弃早已既定的理论之胆识。

fireplace.en: A huge fire was blazing in the fireplace.
We hung her portrait above the fireplace.
fireplace.zh: 我们把她的画像挂在壁炉上方。

fireplace.en: There was a fire burning in the fireplace.

peach.en: He picked out the ripest peach for me.
peach.zh: 他给我挑了个熟透了的桃子。

peach.en: Rain begins to fall and peach trees blossom.
peach.zh: 雨开始下，桃树就开花了。

peach.en: The walls were painted white with a hint of peach.
peach.zh: 墙壁粉刷成了略呈桃红的白色。

nurture.en: Parents want to know the best way to nurture and raise their child to adulthood.
nurture.zh: 父母们想了解把他们的孩子养育成人的最好方法。

nurture.en: Unique to mammals, the limbic cortex impels creatures to nurture their offspring by delivering feelings of tenderness and warmth to the parent when children are nearby.
nurture.zh: 当哺乳动物的孩子们在附近时，独有的边缘皮层向家长传递温柔和温暖的感觉，促使哺乳动物去养育后代。

nurture.en: It's important to nurture a good working relationship.
nurture.zh: 维持良好的工作关系非常重要。

frightening.en: It was a very frightening experience and they were very courageous.
frightening.zh: 那是一次非常令人恐惧的经历，但他们非常勇敢。
城市可能是可怕的地方。

frightening.en: They are equally fumy and frightening, but they are also aspirational.
frightening.zh: 他们同样让人感到愤怒和恐惧，但他们也让人充满希望。

frighten.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to frighten you.
frighten.zh: 对不起，我没有吓唬你的意思。

frighten.en: He would never frighten anyone or cause them any harm.
frighten.zh: 他永远不会吓唬或伤害任何人。

frighten.en: All this was just designed to frighten me and keep me in line.
frighten.zh: 所有这一切只是设计来吓唬我、让我守规矩。

vivid.en: The report paints a vivid picture of life in the city.
vivid.zh: 报告生动地描绘了都市生活。

vivid.en: He gave a vivid account of his life as a fighter pilot.
vivid.zh: 他生动地描述了他那战斗机飞行员的生活。

poison.en: Her blood was found to contain poison.
poison.zh: 她的血液中发现有毒素。
有些蘑菇含有致命毒素。

poison.en: There is no known antidote to the poison.
poison.zh: 这种毒的解药尚未发现。

tenant.en: The decorating was done by a previous tenant.
tenant.zh: 装修是一位前房客搞的。

tenant.en: The rent is a matter for negotiation between the landlord and the tenant.
tenant.zh: 租金可以由房东和租户协商确定。

tenant.en: Under the provisions of the lease, the tenant is responsible for repairs.
tenant.zh: 按契约规定，房客负责房屋维修。

furious.en: He risked a glance at her furious face.
furious.zh: 他壮着胆子瞅了瞅她那张愤怒的脸。

furious.en: The miners were furious and threatened to walk out.
furious.zh: 矿工们很愤怒，威胁要罢工。

furious.en: She drove off at a furious pace.

undoubtedly.en: Mozart's compositions are undoubtedly among the world's greatest.
undoubtedly.zh: 莫扎特的作品无疑位列于世界上最伟大的作品之中。

undoubtedly.en: Undoubtedly, political and economic factors have played their part.
undoubtedly.zh: 毫无疑问，政治和经济因素起了作用。

undoubtedly.en: Country music was undoubtedly one of the forerunners of rock and roll.
undoubtedly.zh: 乡村音乐无疑是摇滚乐的先导之一。

ruler.en: The ruler cracked and splintered into pieces.
The former military ruler of Lesotho has been placed under house arrest.
ruler.zh: 莱索托前军事统治者已被软禁了。
打扰一下，这是你的尺子吗？

omit.en: If you are a student, you can omit questions 16–18.
There are as many textbooks that omit it as a type of movement as include it.
omit.zh: 也有不少课本没有把它包括在冰川移动的一种类型里。

omit.en: Omit dull and ineffective generalities and make sure you give concrete examples.
omit.zh: 避免枯燥、无效的空谈，并确保你给出了具体的例子。

noble.zh: 他为了高尚的事业而牺牲。

noble.en: He had implicit faith in their noble intentions.
noble.zh: 他对他们的崇高目标深信不疑。

spider.zh: 小孩踩了那只蜘蛛一脚。

spider.en: A spider had spun a perfect web outside the window.
spider.zh: 蜘蛛在窗外结了一张完整的网。

spider.en: The spider must wait for prey to be ensnared on its web.
spider.zh: 蜘蛛一定要耐心等待，直到猎物被它的蛛网困住。

obsession.en: She would try to forget her obsession with Christopher.
obsession.zh: 她会试图忘掉她对克里斯托弗的迷恋。

obsession.en: This untutored mathematician had an obsession with numbers.
obsession.zh: 这位未接受过正式教育的数学家对数字十分痴迷。

obsession.en: Our obsession with thinness is also fueled by health concerns.
obsession.zh: 对健康方面的担忧也助长了我们对苗条身材的痴迷。

certainty.en: A general election became a certainty last week.
Such attitudes are valueless unless they reflect inner cognition and certainty.
certainty.zh: 这种态度如果不能反映内心的认知和确定性就毫无价值。

problematic.en: It could be a bit problematic, legally speaking.
problematic.zh: 从法律上说，可能是有点问题。

problematic.en: We are deeply concerned to get out of this problematic situation.
problematic.zh: 我们非常想摆脱这种问题重重的局面。

problematic.en: It's likely that the mothers in the study didn't consider spanking to be problematic behavior.
problematic.zh: 很可能研究中的母亲们认为打屁股不是有问题的行为。

vocabulary.zh: 阅读会增加你的词汇量。
孩子的词汇量通过阅读得到扩大。

nutrition.en: There are alternative sources of nutrition to animal meat.
nutrition.zh: 有能替代动物肉类的其他营养来源。
这种食物为你提供营养。

nutrition.en: It simply focuses on nutrition and health.

melody.en: We're going to sing Beethoven's bass beneath Beethoven's melody.
melody.zh: 我们要唱贝多芬旋律下面的低音部分。

melody.en: Now, listen to the melody generated by applying this mapping to rule 150.
melody.zh: 现在，聆听把映射应用到150号规则所产生的旋律。

electron.en: Magnetic coils focus the electron beams into fine spots.
electron.zh: 磁线圈将电子束聚焦成细小的点。

electron.en: The electron microscope uses a beam of electrons to produce images at high magnifications.
electron.zh: 电子显微镜利用一束电子产生高倍放大的影像。

electron.en: It is a naked electron and is a sodium positive ion.
electron.zh: 它是个裸电子，是钠正离子。

physicist.en: He's known to be an outstanding physicist.
physicist.zh: 他被公认为杰出的物理学家。

physicist.en: Although Einstein was the better physicist, Hilbert was the better mathematician.
physicist.zh: 尽管爱因斯坦是更好的物理学家，但希尔伯特是更好的数学家。

physicist.en: I think it promises enrichment for any reader from those who know little about science to the career physicist.
physicist.zh: 我认为它为任何读者都提供了丰富的知识，不论是对科学知之甚少的人，还是职业物理学家。

maple.en: She was stoking the stove with sticks of maple.
maple.zh: 她正在给炉子添枫树枝。

maple.en: The Cup was won for the third consecutive year by the Toronto Maple Leafs.
maple.zh: 这个奖杯连续第三年由多伦多枫叶队赢去了。

maple.en: He dug a hole in our yard on Edgerton Avenue to plant a maple tree when I was born.
maple.zh: 他在我出生时在埃杰顿大道我家的院子里挖了个坑，种了一棵枫树。

cultivate.en: The people cultivate mainly rice and beans.
cultivate.zh: 这里的人们主要种植稻子和豆类。
我们该如何培养积极的情感呢？

cultivate.en: I want to cultivate the relationship with myself.
cultivate.zh: 我想培养和自己的关系。

microphone.zh: 麦克风发出了尖厉的噪声。

microphone.en: He clipped the microphone (on) to his collar.
microphone.zh: 他把麦克风别在衣领上。

microphone.en: He grabbed my microphone and we tussled over that.
microphone.zh: 他抓住我的话筒，我们为此扭打起来。

realization.en: It was the realization of his greatest ambition.
realization.zh: 这就实现了他的宏伟抱负。

realization.en: We shall gladly lend every effort in our power toward its realization.
realization.zh: 我们将乐意为它的实现而竭尽全力。

realization.en: Without the participation of intellectuals, the realization of the four modernizations is impossible.
realization.zh: 没有知识分子的参加，实现四化是不可能的。

meadow.en: For six months they camped out in a meadow at the back of the house.
meadow.zh: 他们在房子后面的草地上露宿了6个月。

meadow.en: Ten men went to mow a meadow.

meadow.zh: 孔雀在周围的草地上昂首阔步。

disposal.en: Congress passed a law that regulates the disposal of waste.
disposal.zh: 国会通过了一条管理废物处理的法律。

disposal.en: Attempts are being made to solve the problem of waste disposal.
disposal.zh: 正在想办法解决废物处理的问题。

disposal.en: Therefore, less money is spent for garbage disposal.
disposal.zh: 因此，花在垃圾处理上的钱就少了。

defy.en: I wouldn't have dared to defy my teachers.
defy.zh: 我可不敢不听老师的话。

defy.en: I defy anyone not to cry at the end of the film.
defy.zh: 我倒要看看有谁在电影结尾时不哭。

defy.en: This was the first (and last) time that I dared to defy my mother.
defy.zh: 这是我第一次（也是最后一次）胆敢违抗我母亲。

cherry.en: She tied a knot in a cherry stem.
cherry.zh: 她在樱桃梗上打了个结。

cherry.en: The cherry blossom came out early in Washington this year.
cherry.zh: 华盛顿的樱花今年开得早。

mining.en: He amassed a fortune from silver mining.
mining.zh: 他靠开采银矿积累了一笔财富。

mining.en: Mining would pollute the lake and denude the forest.
mining.zh: 采矿将会污染湖水并伐光森林。

magical.en: Her words had a magical effect on us.
magical.zh: 她的话对我们有一种魔力般的作用。

magical.en: The beautiful island of Bermuda is a magical place to get married.
magical.zh: 美丽的百慕大岛是缔结良缘的神奇之地。

magical.en: The magical rock shapes are made by human beings.
magical.zh: 这种神奇的岩石形状是人为制造的。

accordingly.en: It is a difficult job and they should be paid accordingly.
accordingly.zh: 它是一项艰巨的工作，他们应该相应地获得报酬。

accordingly.en: The cost of materials rose sharply last year. Accordingly, we were forced to increase our prices.
accordingly.zh: 去年材料成本大幅度提高，因此我们被迫加价。

accordingly.en: They realized that some of their prices were higher than their competitors' and revised prices accordingly.
accordingly.zh: 他们意识到他们的部分价格比竞争对手的高，就相应地调整了价格。

plug.zh: 插头坏了，露出带电的电线。

plug.en: Check that the plug has not come loose.
plug.zh: 检查一下别让插头松脱了。
这个插头有没有安装保险丝？

tempt.en: Cars like that may tempt drivers to speed.
tempt.zh: 那样的汽车可能会引诱司机超速行驶。

tempt.en: Vivien refuses to put down bait to tempt wildlife to the waterhole.
tempt.zh: 维维恩拒绝放饵到水坑引诱野生动物。
什么也不能引诱她做坏事。

lamb.en: The lamb was a puny little thing.

declaration.en: It was meant to sound like an epoch-making declaration.
declaration.zh: 有意让它听起来像是一个划时代的宣言。

declaration.en: Some delegates believe the final declaration is likely to be too timorous.
declaration.zh: 一些代表认为这份最后的声明可能有些过于畏首畏尾的感觉。

declaration.en: On the customs declaration, the sender labelled the freight as agricultural machinery.
declaration.zh: 在报关单上，发货方将货物列为农业机械。

scrap.en: There's always tons of scrap paper in Dad's office.
scrap.zh: 爸爸的办公室里总有大量的废纸。

scrap.en: Thousands of Europe's tanks and guns are going to the scrap heap.
scrap.zh: 成千上万的欧洲坦克和枪炮将被废弃。

scrap.en: It won't make a scrap of difference.

academy.en: The Academy Awards appear to validate his career.
academy.zh: 这些奥斯卡金像奖看来证实了他的职业生涯的价值。

academy.en: The academy is far more inclusive now than it used to be.
academy.zh: 该学院如今比过去更为兼收并蓄。

academy.en: The movie won nine Academy Awards, including Best Picture.
academy.zh: 这部电影荣获九项奥斯卡金像奖，包括最佳影片奖。

inject.en: 'Geo-engineering plans to inject stratospheric aerosols or to seed clouds would act to cool the planet, and act to increase the extent of sea ice,' says Rasch.
inject.zh: 拉施说：“地球工程计划将平流层的气溶胶注入到云层中，这将起到冷却地球的作用，并增加海冰的范围。”

inject.en: The US National Center for Atmospheric Ressearch has already suggested that the proposal to inject ulphur into the atmosphere might affect rainfall patterns across the tropics and the Southern Ocean.
inject.zh: 美国国家大气研究中心已经表示，向大气中注入硫的提议可能会影响整个热带和南大洋的降雨模式。

inject.en: The US National Center for Atmospheric Research has already suggested that the proposal to inject sulphur into the atmosphere might affect rainfall patterns across the tropics and the Southern Ocean.
inject.zh: 美国国家大气研究中心已经表示，向大气中注入硫的提议可能会影响整个热带和南大洋的降雨模式。

axis.zh: 地球环绕自身的轴心转动。

axis.en: Precession, basically is the change in the direction of earth's axis of rotation.
axis.zh: 岁差，基本上是地球自转轴方向的改变。

narrator.zh: 这部小说有一个全知全能的叙述者。

narrator.en: Suddenly, the narrator speaks in his most rhetorically elevated mode.
narrator.zh: 突然，讲述者以其最华丽的措辞方式讲起来。

narrator.en: His fictionalized portrait of the artist as a young man is recalled by an older, disillusioned narrator.
narrator.zh: 他虚构的艺术家年轻时的肖像由一位年长、醒悟的叙述者回忆起来。

dual.en: Dual language programs can be an exception.
dual.zh: 双语课程可能是个例外。

dual.en: The dual system is rigid and discriminatory.
dual.zh: 双轨制僵化，带有歧视性。

dual.en: The latest iPhone 6s, for example, has a dual core processor and fits nicely into your pocket.
dual.zh: 例如，最新的 iPhone 6s 拥有双核处理器，可以很好地放进口袋。

supervise.en: I supervise the packing of all mail orders.
supervise.zh: 我监督所有邮购商品的包装。

supervise.en: A team was sent to supervise the elections in Nicaragua.
supervise.zh: 一队人马被派去监督尼加拉瓜的选举。

supervise.en: The U.N. pledged to help supervise the clearance of mines.
supervise.zh: 联合国承诺帮助监督扫雷工作。

precede.en: He gestured to Alice to precede them from the room.
precede.zh: 他示意艾丽斯从房间里出来走在他们前面。

precede.en: Capitalize all proper nouns but not the articles (a, an) that precede them.
precede.zh: 把所有的专有名词大写，它们之前的冠词(a, an)则不用。

precede.en: This factor must precede an ice age and have the effect of slightly lowering Earth's temperature.
precede.zh: 这一因素一定出现在冰川期之前，并有稍微降低地球温度的效果。

triangle.en: Its outline roughly forms an equilateral triangle.
triangle.zh: 它的大致轮廓是一个等边三角形。

triangle.en: The sum of all the angles of a triangle is 180 degrees.
triangle.zh: 一个三角形的所有角度之和是180度。

aspiration.en: There is also a place in a young life for noble purposes that include a dedication to the broader society, a love of country and an aspiration to make their own leadership contributions.
aspiration.zh: 在年轻人的生活中，也有崇高的目标，包括为更广大的社会作出奉献、热爱国家，以及成为领导者做出贡献的抱负。

aspiration.en: But there is also a place in a young life for noble purposes that include a dedication to the broader society, a love of country and an aspiration to make their own leadership contributions.
aspiration.zh: 但在年轻人的生活中，也有崇高的目标，包括对社会的奉献，对国家的热爱，以及做出自己的领导贡献的渴望。

aspiration.en: Generating enough light could be prohibitively expensive, unless cheap, renewable energy is available, and this appears to be rather a future aspiration than a likelihood for the near future.
aspiration.zh: 除非有廉价可再生能源，否则制造足够光的成本可能会高得令人望而却步，而这似乎只是未来的愿望而非近期能实现的。

shield.en: He clanged his sword three times on his shield.
shield.zh: 他用他的剑当当当地敲了3下盾。

shield.en: The gunman used the hostages as a human shield.
shield.zh: 持枪歹徒用人质作人体盾牌。

shield.en: The police officer fended off the blows with his riot shield.
shield.zh: 警察用防暴盾牌抵挡攻击。

substitute.en: He was brought on as (a) substitute after half-time.
substitute.zh: 他作为替补队员在下半场上场。

substitute.en: Jefferson entered as a substitute in the 60th minute.
substitute.zh: 杰斐逊在第60分钟时作为替补队员上了场。

substitute.en: Reduced-calorie cheese is a great substitute for cream cheese.
substitute.zh: 低卡路里干酪是奶油干酪的极好替代品。

supervision.en: The FCC should be put under strict supervision.
supervision.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）应该受到严格监督。

supervision.en: The old man's will was executed under the personal supervision of the lawyer.
supervision.zh: 老人的遗嘱是在律师的亲自监督下执行的。

supervision.en: It's a great opportunity to learn more about fitness through the clear instruction and supervision of a fitness instructor.
supervision.zh: 在健身教练的明确指导和监督下了解更多关于健身的知识，这是一个非常好的机会。

gravel.en: The car drew up with a crunch of gravel.
gravel.zh: 那辆汽车在沙砾路上嘎吱一声停了下来。

gravel.en: She heard the crunch of tyres on the gravel driveway.
gravel.zh: 她听到车胎碾在碎石铺成的私家车道上发出的嘎吱声。

calcium.en: Calcium is found most abundantly in milk.
Calcium may aid in the prevention of colon cancer.
calcium.zh: 钙可能有助于预防结肠癌。

calcium.en: Vitamin D is necessary to aid the absorption of calcium from food.
calcium.zh: 从食物中吸取钙需靠维生素D的帮助。

textile.en: He rescued the company and later spun off its textile division into a separate entity.
textile.zh: 他挽救了该公司，后来又把它的纺织部脱离出来组建成一个独立实体。

textile.en: But the textile boom lasted only several decades.
textile.zh: 但是纺织业的繁荣只持续了几十年。

textile.en: They aided a substantial textile industry in another city.
textile.zh: 他们在另一座城市援助了一家庞大的纺织厂。

precedent.en: They were determined to break from precedent.
The ruling set a precedent for future libel cases.
precedent.zh: 这项裁决为今后的诽谤案提供了判例。

precedent.en: The trial could set an important precedent for dealing with similar cases.
precedent.zh: 这次审判能为处理类似案件开创一个重要先例。

nationalism.en: I think we'd better leave the subject of nationalism.
nationalism.zh: 我想我们最好不要再谈论民族主义这个话题了。

nationalism.en: Before, you mention nationalism and…Ah, right, yes.
nationalism.zh: 之前你提到了民族主义，对，是的。

nationalism.en: Does it represent Yeats's own early cultural nationalism and the work represented in The Wind Among the Reeds and other early poems?
nationalism.zh: 它是否代表了叶芝自己早期的文化民族主义，以及在《风中芦苇》和其他早期诗歌中所代表的作品？

eternal.en: He has the upbeat manner of an eternal optimist.
eternal.zh: 他永远都持乐观主义者的那种快乐态度。

eternal.en: Allow me to embrace you as a sign of my eternal gratitude.
eternal.zh: 请允许我拥抱你，以表达我永远的感激之情。

interpreter.en: They volunteered me for the job of interpreter.
interpreter.zh: 他们擅自指定由我担任口头翻译。

interpreter.en: Speaking through an interpreter , the President said that the talks were going well.
interpreter.zh: 总统通过译员说会谈进展良好。

interpreter.en: Speaking through an interpreter, Aristide said that Haitians had hoped coups were behind them.
interpreter.zh: 通过口译员，亚里斯蒂德说海地人希望政变再也不发生了。

calf.en: The calf lapped up the bucket of milk.
calf.zh: 牛犊把那桶牛奶津津有味地喝光了。

calf.en: Hillsden was complaining of a cramp in his calf muscles.
calf.zh: 希尔斯登一直在抱怨他小腿肌肉抽筋。
汉斯，你的小牛犊在哪儿呢？

nursery.en: Her youngest child is at nursery now.
nursery.zh: 她最小的孩子现在上托儿所。

nursery.en: The nursery is bright and cheerful, with plenty of toys.
nursery.zh: 该托儿所明亮宜人，有许多玩具。

nursery.en: One area of contention is the availability of nursery care.
nursery.zh: 争论的一个方面是提供幼儿保育的可能性。

collision.en: He said it was true that a collision had happened.
collision.zh: 他说碰撞真的发生了一次。

collision.en: Their car was in a head-on collision with a truck.
collision.zh: 他们的车同一辆卡车迎面相撞。

collision.en: There was a slight collision but my car was undamaged.
collision.zh: 虽有轻微碰撞，但我的汽车没有损坏。

encompass.en: They correspond roughly to small municipal, medium-sized metropolitan and major metropolitan airports respectively, and encompass an increasingly rigorous set of regulations.
encompass.zh: 它们分别大致相当于小型市政机场、中型都市机场和大型都市机场，并包含一套日益严格的规章制度。

encompass.en: The hand tool additions encompass everything from tubing cutters to nut drivers.
encompass.zh: 手工具添加包含从油管刀具到螺母驱动器的所有工具。

encompass.en: They built a moat to encompass the castle.
encompass.zh: 他们在城堡周围修了一条护城河。

verify.en: An external auditor will verify the accounts.
verify.zh: 外部审计员将核实这些账目。

verify.en: They now take extra steps to verify the creditworthiness of customers.
verify.zh: 他们现在采取额外措施来验证客户的信用。

verify.en: Inspectors were sent to visit nuclear sites and verify compliance with the treaty.
verify.zh: 监察员被派去参观核址并核实条约的遵守情况。

creek.en: I'll bet we could find some at North Creek—in the mine.
creek.zh: 我打赌我们能在小溪北边的矿井里面找到一些。

creek.en: Wombat Creek Winery is an independent privately owned company producing fine wine as an art.
creek.zh: 袋熊溪酒庄是一家独立的私营公司，以生产优质葡萄酒为艺术。

creek.en: "There's Toad Hall," said the Rat; "and that creek on the left, where the notice-board says, Private."
creek.zh: “那是蛤蟆府，”水鼠兰特说；“左边的小溪，就是布告牌上写着‘私人'的地方。”

clan.en: Every family cultivates its vendetta; every clan, its feud.
clan.zh: 每个家庭都有自己的仇怨；每个氏族都有自己的世仇。

clan.en: To deal with the rabbit problem, settlers introduced stoats — a member of the weasel clan and a terrific predator.
clan.zh: 为了应对兔子的问题，定居者们引进了白鼬。 白鼬是黄鼠狼家族的一员——也是一个恐怖的掠食者。

clan.en: A weapon which would kill with accuracy at fifteen hundred yards opened a whole new vista of delights to every family or clan which could acquire it.
clan.zh: 一件能在一千五百码开外精准杀伤的武器，为每一个能获得它的家庭或部族带来了一幅全新的欢乐景象。

diplomacy.en: Diplomacy was in his blood: his ancestors had been feudal lords.
diplomacy.zh: 他的外交能力是天生的：他的祖上曾是封建王侯。

diplomacy.en: UN mediators are conducting shuttle diplomacy between the two sides.
diplomacy.zh: 联合国调解员们在双方之间进行着穿梭外交。

diplomacy.en: The veto has been a traditional instrument of diplomacy for centuries.
diplomacy.zh: 数世纪以来，否决已经成为一种传统的外交手段。

mat.en: Wipe your feet on the mat before you come in, please.
mat.zh: 请在垫子上擦擦脚再进来。

mat.en: Of course, you found your door-mat.
mat.zh: 当然，你找到了你的擦脚垫。

mat.en: Who ever heard of a door-mat TELLING anyone anything?
mat.zh: 谁听说过擦脚垫能告诉人什么事？

spice.en: The spice imparts an Eastern flavour to the dish.
spice.zh: 这种调味品会给菜肴添加一种东方风味。

spice.en: The Spice Islands were within the Spanish domains.
spice.zh: 香料群岛曾是西班牙的领地。

spice.en: My team is working on a spice vending machine for spices.
spice.zh: 我的团队正在设计一个香料自动售货机。

immense.en: The immense difficulties facing European businessmen in Russia were only too evident.
immense.zh: 摆在俄罗斯的欧洲商人面前的巨大困难是极其明显的。

immense.en: If it had hit the Earth, it would have made a crater 100 miles across and thrown up an immense cloud of dust.
immense.zh: 如果它撞上了地球，就会砸出一个100英里宽的大坑并扬起巨大的尘埃云团。

confused.zh: 我被搞糊涂了，把那件事从头到尾再说一遍吧。
我的话使他既惊讶又困惑。

independently.en: Ceiling and wall lights can operate independently.
independently.zh: 天花板和墙上的灯能够独立操控。

independently.en: It was the first time that she had lived independently.
independently.zh: 那是她第一次独立生活。

independently.en: It enhances people's ability to work independently.
independently.zh: 它提高了人们独立工作的能力。

hop.zh: 快上车吧，我开车送你回家。

hop.en: He crossed the hall with a hop, skip and a jump.
hop.zh: 他来了一个三级跳远穿过了大厅。

instrumental.en: Asian-American parents are enthusiastic supporters of the competitive instrumental music program.
instrumental.zh: 亚裔美国人的父母是这个竞争激烈的器乐项目的热情支持者。

instrumental.en: Instrumental ties are social links formed when we cooperate with other people to achieve some goal.
instrumental.zh: 工具性联系是我们为了实现某种目标而与他人合作时形成的社会联系。

instrumental.en: Instrumental ties predominate in secondary groups; we perceive people as means to ends rather than as ends in their own right.
instrumental.zh: 工具性关系在次级群体中占主导地位；我们把人当作达成目的的手段，而不是目的本身。

aftermath.en: The aftermath of the war was a huge shock for the people in that country.
aftermath.zh: 战争的后果对那个国家的人民是一个巨大的打击。

aftermath.en: The equipment in American studios was more advanced than anything in Britain, which had led the Beatles' great rivals, the Rolling Stones, to make their latest album, "Aftermath", in Los Angeles.
aftermath.zh: 美国录音室的设备比英国的任何设备都要先进，这使得甲壳虫乐队的劲敌——滚石乐队——得以在洛杉矶制作他们的最新专辑《后果》。

aftermath.en: A lot of rebuilding took place in the aftermath of the war.
aftermath.zh: 战后进行了大量的重建工作。

dean.en: The University of Washington elected him dean in 1956.
dean.zh: 华盛顿大学在1956年选他为院长。

dean.en: She was dean of the University of Washington's Graduate School.
dean.zh: 她曾任华盛顿大学研究生院的院长。

useless.en: She knew it was useless to protest.

astronaut.en: Astronaut Pierre Thuot tried to latch the 15-foot robotic arm onto the satellite.
astronaut.zh: 宇航员皮埃尔·索特想要把这个长15英尺的机械手安到人造卫星上。

astronaut.en: There is an astronaut model on it.
astronaut.zh: 上面有一个宇航员模型。

reproduction.en: The reproduction and growth of the cancerous cells can be suppressed by bombarding them with radiation.
reproduction.zh: 癌细胞的繁殖和生长可通过放射线辐射加以抑制。

reproduction.en: The quality of reproduction isn't very good on this recording.
reproduction.zh: 这录音的复制质量不太好。

reproduction.en: Consumption patterns and reproduction patterns are contradictory.
reproduction.zh: 消费模式和再生产模式是矛盾的。

altar.en: He genuflected in front of the altar.
The altar was flanked by two Christmas trees.
altar.zh: 圣坛的两侧有两棵圣诞树。

altar.en: The white dove of innocence fluttered over the altar.
altar.zh: 纯洁的白鸽在圣坛上起舞。

crust.zh: 把糕饼烤至外皮呈金黄色。

crust.en: Earthquakes leave scars in the Earth's crust.
crust.zh: 地震会在地壳上留下痕迹。

crust.en: Less dense substances move upwards to form a crust.
crust.zh: 密度小的物质向上浮动并形成一层皮。

gasp.en: At last, I hear a soft thud, a gasp, and silence.
gasp.zh: 最后，我听到轻轻的砰的一声，一声喘息，然后是一片寂静。

gasp.en: It was the eyes that made Mr. Craven gasp for breath.
gasp.zh: 是那双眼睛让克雷文先生喘不过气。

gasp.en: When people don't get enough oxygen, they often begin to gasp for air.
gasp.zh: 当人们得不到足够的氧气时，常常就会开始喘气。

flu.en: I'm glad that you're over the flu.
flu.zh: 我很高兴你的流感好了。

millennium.zh: 你们是如何欢庆千禧年的？

millennium.en: Managing ecosystems sustainably is more profitable than exploiting them, according to the Millennium Ecosystem Assessment.
millennium.zh: 根据千禧生态系统评估报告，可持续地管理生态系统比掠夺消耗它更有好处。

millennium.en: Kofi Annan's staff devised the millennium development goals.
millennium.zh: 科菲安南的工作人员策划了千年发展目标。

mosquito.en: A single mosquito can infect a large number of people.
mosquito.zh: 一只蚊子就能传染很多人。

mosquito.en: I threw aside my mosquito net, jumped out of bed and drew up the blind.
mosquito.zh: 我撩开蚊帐，跳下床，拉开百叶窗。

mosquito.en: In recent decades, mosquito vectors of chikungunya have spread to Europe and America.
mosquito.zh: 最近几十年，基孔肯雅热的蚊子媒介已传播到欧洲和美洲。

unconscious.zh: 那年轻人仰面倒下，不省人事。

unconscious.en: He had drunk himself unconscious on vodka.
unconscious.zh: 他喝伏特加酒喝得不省人事。

guardian.zh: 德斯蒂妮的法定监护人是她的祖母。

guardian.en: A delightful guide was my guardian angel for the first week of the tour.
guardian.zh: 令人愉快的导游是我第一周旅行的守护神。

guardian.en: The ill-advised conceit of the guardian angel dooms the film from the start.
guardian.zh: 对守护天使的蹩脚设计弄巧成拙，从一开始就注定这部电影要失败。

obey.en: Dogs can be trained to obey orders.
obey.zh: 狗可以训练得听从命令。
你必须服从船长的命令。

divert.en: Even using a "hands-free" device can divert a driver's attention to an alarming extent.
divert.zh: 即使使用“免提”设备，也会在令人担忧的程度上转移司机的注意力。

divert.en: It works in compression to divert the weight above it out to the sides, where the weight is borne by the vertical elements on either side of the arch.
divert.zh: 在受到压力时，拱形结构能够起到将其上面的压力转移到侧面，在侧面的重量则由拱形结构两侧的垂直部分来承受。

divert.en: They want to divert the attention of the people from the real issues.
divert.zh: 他们想把人民的注意力从真正的问题上转移开。

vine.en: The easiest way to propagate a vine is to take hardwood cuttings.
vine.zh: 繁殖葡萄藤最容易的办法就是采取硬木扦插。

vine.en: A vine wraps round a big tree.
vine.zh: 一根藤绕在一棵大树上。

vine.en: It was the last leaf on the vine.
vine.zh: 这是藤蔓上最后的一片叶子。

thoughtful.en: He scratched his head and looked thoughtful.
thoughtful.zh: 他挠着头显出一副深思的样子。

thoughtful.en: Douglas was a complex man, thoughtful, gallant, and generous.
thoughtful.zh: 道格拉斯是个复杂的男人，他体贴、殷勤而且慷慨。

permanently.en: She had decided to settle permanently in France.
permanently.zh: 她已经决定永久定居法国。

permanently.en: The blast left him with permanently impaired hearing.
permanently.zh: 爆炸造成了他永久性听力损伤。

permanently.en: An immigrant is a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.
permanently.zh: 移民指的是永久居住在外国的人。

simulation.en: Training includes realistic simulation of casualty procedures.
simulation.zh: 训练包括伤亡处理程序的实际模拟。

simulation.en: To make the training realistic the simulation operates in real time.
simulation.zh: 为使训练真实，模拟是实时运行的。

simulation.en: The simulation takes no account of the effects of coastal erosion.
simulation.zh: 该模拟没有考虑海岸侵蚀的影响。

passive.en: His passive attitude made things easier for me.
passive.zh: 他的被动态度使我办起事来容易多了。

passive.en: They want less passive ways of filling their time.
passive.zh: 他们需要不那么消极的方式来打发时间。

passive.en: Campaigners handed out leaflets on passive smoking.
passive.zh: 发起人分发了关于被动吸烟的传单。

outrage.en: Environmentalists have expressed outrage at the ruling.
outrage.zh: 环境保护主义者对这一裁决表示愤慨。

outrage.en: There have been cries of outrage about this expenditure.
outrage.zh: 公众对这项开支发出了愤怒的呼声。

awaken.en: The aim of the cruise was to awaken an interest in and an understanding of foreign cultures.
awaken.zh: 此次巡游旨在唤起我们对外国文化的兴趣和理解。

awaken.en: As soon as you awaken, identify what is upsetting about the dream.
awaken.zh: 当你醒来的时候，找出这个梦让你不安的地方。

monopoly.en: Had he succeeded, he would have acquired a monopoly.
monopoly.zh: 如果他那时成功了，他就会获得垄断地位。

monopoly.en: The company has a virtual monopoly in this area of trade.
monopoly.zh: 这家公司实质上已经垄断了这种贸易。

monopoly.en: Planters enjoyed a natural monopoly because they had no competitors.
monopoly.zh: 种植园主享受着自然的垄断，因为他们没有竞争者。

nun.en: It has confirmed me in my decision not to become a nun.
nun.zh: 这已让我坚信我不当修女的决定是正确的。

nun.en: Were you a nun here eleven years ago?
nun.zh: 你是十一年前在这里的修女吗？

nun.en: She shaved her head and became a nun.

attachment.en: The message contains Unicode characters and has been sent as a binary attachment.
attachment.zh: 这条信息含有统一码字符，已经以二进制附件形式发送。

attachment.en: When you send an e-mail you can also send a file as an attachment and that file can be a graphic, a program, a sound or whatever.
attachment.zh: 当发送电子邮件时，你还可以把一份文件作为附件发送，该文件可以是图片、程序、或声音文件等。

attachment.en: For simplicity, use only one attachment for our test.
attachment.zh: 为方便起见，我们的测试仅使用一个附件。

optional.en: Certain courses are compulsory, others are optional.
optional.zh: 某些课程是必修的，其他是选修的。

optional.en: Optional extras include cooking classes at a top restaurant.
optional.zh: 可选的额外之物包括一家高级餐馆的烹饪课程。

optional.en: The course consists of ten core modules and five optional modules.
optional.zh: 这门课程包括十个必修单元和五个选修单元。

cigar.en: He had a few puffs at the cigar.

summon.en: She was trying to summon up the courage to leave him.
summon.zh: 当时她试图鼓起勇气离开他。

summon.en: I punched the button to summon the elevator.
It took her a full month to summon the courage to tell her mother.
summon.zh: 她用了整整一个月的时间才鼓起勇气告诉了母亲。

mobility.en: Recent years have witnessed a growing social mobility.
mobility.zh: 近年来人们的社会流动性越来越大。

mobility.en: Prior to the nineteenth century, there were almost no channels of social mobility.
mobility.zh: 19世纪以前，几乎没有社会流动的渠道。

mobility.en: It represented upward social and financial mobility.
mobility.zh: 它代表了社会和金融的向上流动。

haven.en: Some Democrats support granting the Haitians temporary safe haven in the U.S.
haven.zh: 一些民主党人支持为海地人提供在美国的临时避难所。

haven.en: It is a unique haven of endangered species.
haven.zh: 它是濒危物种的独特避难所。

haven.en: The river banks are a haven for wildlife.
haven.zh: 河的两岸是野生动物的自然栖息地。

breed.en: He used to breed dogs for the police.
breed.zh: 他过去为警察部门养殖狗。

breed.en: Frogs will usually breed in any convenient pond.
breed.zh: 青蛙通常在任何适宜的水塘里繁殖。

breed.en: Many animals breed only at certain times of the year.
breed.zh: 很多动物只在一年的某个时候交配繁殖。

assurance.en: He would like an assurance that other forces will not move into the territory that his forces vacate.
assurance.zh: 他想要其他部队不会进入他的部队撤出的那个领地的一个保证。

assurance.en: A review of this book in The Times lamented that Mr. Davis had given us no especial assurance that any of the traditional accidents can save us once more.
assurance.zh: 《泰晤士报》的一篇书评惋惜道：“戴维斯先生并没有向我们保证，任何传统的事故都能再次拯救我们。”

assurance.en: There is nothing to guarantee that everybody is willing to make the effort; there is no assurance that the learner will have any adequate return for his toil.
assurance.zh: 没有什么可以保证每个人都愿意付出努力；学生的辛苦学习是否能得到适当的回报，这是没有把握的。

consultation.zh: 戴维免费提供第一次咨询。

consultation.en: The decision was taken after close consultation with local residents.
consultation.zh: 这项决定是在与当地居民仔细磋商后作出的。

consultation.en: A personal diet plan is devised after a consultation with a nutritionist.
consultation.zh: 经向营养师作咨询后，一份个人饮食方案设计出来了。

jerk.en: Why would you invite a jerk like that anyway?
jerk.zh: 你为什么还要邀请那样一个混蛋呀？
他感到自己的头部突然反射性的抽动。

dioxide.en: Dissolved carbon dioxide makes the water more acidic.
dioxide.zh: 溶解的二氧化碳使水更具酸性。

dioxide.en: Humans take in oxygen and breathe out carbon dioxide.
dioxide.zh: 人吸入氧气，呼出二氧化碳。

dioxide.en: Burning fossil fuels uses oxygen and produces carbon dioxide.
dioxide.zh: 燃烧化石燃料消耗氧气并产生二氧化碳。

methodology.en: Together we decide on the methodology and the objectives of the research.
methodology.zh: 我们一起敲定研究的方法和目标。

methodology.en: The author comments on the entire methodology on plan design and three attention points during this process.
methodology.zh: 作者全面地论述了计划制定的整套方法，以及规划设计过程中的三个注意事项。

liquor.en: She drinks wine and beer but no liquor.
liquor.zh: 她喝葡萄酒和啤酒，但不沾烈性酒。

liquor.en: The room was filled with cases of liquor.
liquor.zh: 房间里满是一箱箱的烈性酒。

liquor.en: In 1979, Liquor Barn thrived as a discount merchandiser.
liquor.zh: 1979年，作为折扣酒品专卖店的立可仓生意兴隆。

accountable.en: Someone must be held accountable for the killings.
accountable.zh: 必须有人要对这些凶杀事件负责。

accountable.en: Politicians are ultimately accountable to the voters.
accountable.zh: 从政者最终是向选民负责。

accountable.en: Public officials can finally be held accountable for their actions.
accountable.zh: 政府官员最终是要对他们的行为负责任的。

affirm.en: I can affirm that no one will lose their job.
affirm.zh: 我可以肯定，谁都不会丢掉工作。

affirm.en: In my opinion, in the appraisal of migrant workers, it is one-sided to affirm everything or to negate everything.
affirm.zh: 在我看来，对农民工的评价中，肯定一切或否定一切都是片面的。

affirm.en: Everything I had accomplished seemed to affirm that opinion.
affirm.zh: 我所做成的每件事似乎都证实了那个观点。

sip.zh: 哈里喝了一小口波旁威士忌酒。

sip.en: He took a sip of the medicine and screwed up his face.
sip.zh: 他喝了一小口药后做了个怪相。

sip.en: Have a spoonful of sugar in your tea: It helps stress sip away.
sip.zh: 在你的茶中加一勺糖吧：帮助压力被小口喝掉。

span.en: The bridge crosses the river in a single span.

span.zh: 这套公寓非常干净整洁。

span.en: The kite has a span of 1.5 metres.

linger.en: I slunk off in the direction of the cocktail table—the only place in the garden where a single man could linger without looking purposeless and alone.
linger.zh: 我偷偷朝鸡尾酒桌的方向溜去——这是花园中唯一一个可以让一个人在这里逗留而不会显得毫无目的和孤独的地方。
童年的印象经久不忘，真是不可思议。

linger.en: When apartheid is over the maladies will linger on.
linger.zh: 种族隔离废止后，这种社会弊病还会继续。

applaud.en: He started to applaud and the others joined in.
applaud.zh: 他开始鼓掌，其他人也跟着鼓起掌来。

applaud.en: The analysts applaud the cuts in marginal businesses, but insist the company must make deeper sacrifices.
applaud.zh: 分析家们赞同对边际业务的削减，但坚持认为公司必须作出更大牺牲。

fax.en: Can you send it to me by fax ?
fax.zh: 你能用传真把它发给我吗？

stabilize.en: It is anticipated that inflation will stabilize at 3%.
stabilize.zh: 据预测，通货膨胀将稳定在3%。

stabilize.en: Although her illness is serious, her condition is beginning to stabilize.
stabilize.zh: 虽然她的病情很严重，但她的情况正开始稳定下来。

stabilize.en: The district's enrolment is expected to stabilize in 2006-07 at 10,200 students.

excess.zh: 我一时热情过度答应了工作到很晚。

excess.zh: 飞机在机场上空盘旋以耗掉多余的燃料。

proponent.en: Halsey was identified as a leading proponent of the values of progressive education.

proponent.zh: 沿海移民路线最具影响力的支持者是加拿大考古学家克努特·弗拉德马克。

antique.en: This isn't a genuine antique—you've been done.
antique.zh: 这不是真正的古董—你上当了。

antique.zh: 他们在设法把那张普通桌子当真正的古董推销出去。

legitimacy.zh: 桑普拉斯以6比1、6比2和6比1战胜了卡尔-尤韦·斯蒂布，证明了他挑战冠军头衔的合理性。

legitimacy.en: Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy.
legitimacy.zh: 时间，而不是意图，赋予了他们合法性。

legitimacy.en: These ethnic- and class-based traditions themselves challenged the legitimacy of patriarchal marriage.
legitimacy.zh: 这些基于种族和阶级的传统本身就挑战了父权婚姻的合法性。

deed.zh: 我的奶奶说，做好事本身就是一种回报。

deed.zh: 史密斯通过单边契据将自己的名字更改为杰维斯—史密斯。

propaganda.zh: 艺术可以用作宣传的工具。

propaganda.en: The news reports were being discounted as propaganda.
propaganda.zh: 人们认为这些新闻报道不过是为了宣传，不可全信。

parallel.en: The road runs parallel to the river.
parallel.zh: 这条路和这条河是平行的。
这些平行线像是岔开了。

parallel.en: Remsen Street is parallel with Montague Street.
parallel.zh: 雷姆森大街与蒙塔古大街是平行的。

underscore.en: But Seto's paper does underscore the importance of managing that transition.
underscore.zh: 但濑户的论文确实强调了管理这种转变的重要性。

underscore.en: The Labour Department figures underscore the shaky state of the economic recovery.
underscore.zh: 劳工部的数字突出显示了经济复苏的不稳定。

underscore.en: By default, the separator is an underscore character.
underscore.zh: 在默认情况下，分隔符是下划线字符。

microwave.en: The microwave will bleep when your meal is ready.
microwave.zh: 烹调结束时，微波炉会发出哔哔的声音。

microwave.en: The microwave beeps to let you know when it has finished.
microwave.zh: 微波炉烹饪完毕时会发出哔哔声提醒你。

formulate.en: Governments need to formulate energy policies that promote economically and environmentally sound development.
formulate.zh: 各国政府需要制订促进经济和环境充分发展的能源政策。

formulate.en: Computers increasingly become principal actors in leveraging data to formulate questions, which requires radically new ways of reasoning.
formulate.zh: 计算机日益成为利用数据来制定问题的主要角色，而这需要全新的推理方法。

formulate.en: I was impressed by the way he could formulate his ideas.
formulate.zh: 我对他表述自己想法的独特用词印象深刻。

incidence.en: The incidence of breast cancer increases with age.
incidence.zh: 乳腺癌的发病率随着年龄的增长而上升。

incidence.en: Incidence of the disease is fairly evenly spread across Europe.
incidence.zh: 这种疾病的发生率在欧洲各地相当平均。

incidence.en: Authentic Italian cooking is very healthy—witness the low incidence of heart disease in Italy.
incidence.zh: 正宗的意大利烹饪对健康非常有益，在意大利心脏病发病率低就是证据。

fulfill.zh: 我们有很多的爱要实现。

fulfill.en: That is why we can fulfill our destiny.
fulfill.zh: 这就是为什么我们能实现我们的命运。

fulfill.en: These cleaners could fulfill all customers' demands.
fulfill.zh: 这些清洁剂可以满足所有顾客的需求。

specimen.en: I found that there were these rings in every specimen except for the smallest.
specimen.zh: 我发现这些环在所有的标本中都存在，最小的除外。

specimen.en: The snake has been named Silver Boa because it is metal-colored and the first specimen found was climbing a silver palm tree.
specimen.zh: 这条蛇被命名为银蟒，因为它呈金属色，并且第一个被发现的标本当时正在爬一棵银色棕榈树。

specimen.en: The snake has been named silver boa because it is metallic colored and the first specimen found was climbing a silver palm tree.
specimen.zh: 这种蛇被命名为银蟒，因为它是金属色的，而且发现的第一个标本是爬一棵银色的棕榈树。

corrupt.en: Does it corrupt or instruct our children?
corrupt.zh: 那它会使我们的孩子堕落，还是会教导他们呢？

corrupt.en: Their self-proclaimed leaders have often proved quarrelsome and corrupt.
corrupt.zh: 他们自封的领导人往往被证明是好斗和腐败的。

monk.zh: 他将自己扮作一个僧人。

monk.en: He shaved his head and became a monk.
Purity is an idea for the yogi or the monk.
monk.zh: 纯洁是瑜伽士或修道士的观念。

thorough.zh: 我们正在进行彻底的调查。

thorough.en: This very thorough survey goes back to 1784.
thorough.zh: 这项非常彻底的调查可追溯到1784年。

thorough.en: The garage gave the car a thorough going-over.
thorough.zh: 修车厂对这辆汽车进行了彻底检修。

obscure.en: Her poetry is full of obscure literary allusion.
obscure.zh: 她的诗随处可见晦涩的文学典故。

obscure.en: We mustn't let these minor details obscure the main issue.
obscure.zh: 我们不能让枝节问题掩盖主要问题。
我觉得她的讲座非常费解。

spectacle.en: It was a spectacle not to be missed.

spectacle.zh: 目击了这一奇异的景象。

heroin.en: Police have made one of the biggest seizures of heroin there's ever been.
heroin.zh: 警方这次缴获的海洛因是迄今为止数目最大的几宗之一。

heroin.en: The authorities have placed the drug in Class A, the same category as heroin and cocaine.
heroin.zh: 当局已把这种毒品定为A级，与海洛因和可卡因属同一类。

heroin.en: For Williams, these activities became what he calls "electronic heroin."
heroin.zh: 对威廉姆斯来说，这些活动变成了他所说的“电子海洛因”。

thrill.en: She gets an obvious thrill out of performing.
thrill.zh: 她显然从表演中得到一种兴奋感。

thrill.en: I can remember the thrill of not knowing what I would get on Christmas morning.
thrill.zh: 我记得，在不知道圣诞节早上会收到何种礼物时自己的激动心情。

thrill.en: Wendy's heart went flutter with a sudden thrill.
thrill.zh: 温迪的心突然激动得一阵颤动。

reproductive.en: Not all doctors truly understand the reproductive cycle.
reproductive.zh: 并非所有的医生都完全地了解生育周期。

reproductive.en: The choice of habitat seems to affect reproductive success.
reproductive.zh: 栖息地的选择似乎会影响繁殖的成功率。

reproductive.en: Dad, I need to memorize a unit about the reproductive cycle of plants.
reproductive.zh: 爸爸，我需要记住一个关于植物繁殖周期的单元。

outlook.en: He had a practical outlook on life.
I adopted a positive outlook on life.
outlook.zh: 我选择了一种积极的人生观。

outlook.en: The house has a pleasant outlook over the valley.
outlook.zh: 房子俯瞰山谷，景色宜人。

recreation.en: I play the flute in a wind band for recreation.
recreation.zh: 我在管乐队吹长笛消遣。

recreation.en: His only form of recreation is playing football.
recreation.zh: 他唯一的娱乐就是踢足球。

recreation.en: Saturday afternoon is for recreation and outings.
recreation.zh: 周六下午是娱乐和外出的时间。

matrix.en: That matrix has properties that vary in different locations in the body, but basically it's a highly hydrated or water-rich gel.
matrix.zh: 这种基质在体内不同的位置有不同的性质，但基本上它是一种高度水合或富水的凝胶。

matrix.en: At one time it was thought that these matrix grains might be pristine nebular dust, the sort of stuff from which chondrules and inclusions were made.
matrix.zh: 曾经有人认为，这些基质颗粒可能是原始的星云尘埃，即形成陨石球粒及其内含物的物质。

matrix.en: Chondrules and inclusions in Allende are held together by the chondrite matrix, a mixture of fine-grained, mostly silicate minerals that also includes grains of iron metal and iron sulfide.
matrix.zh: 阿伦德陨星里的陨石球粒和内含物是由球粒陨石基质结合到一起的；这是一种细粒混合物，主要包括铁颗粒和硫化铁的硅酸盐矿物。

cone.en: In one week he was the owner of a cone five hundred feet high.
cone.zh: 一个星期之内，他拥有了一个500英尺高的圆锥体。

cone.en: French fries, eaten from a paper cone are the Belgian's favourite food.
cone.zh: 用锥形纸装的炸薯条是比利时人最喜欢的食物。

cone.en: The classic cone shapes of a Fuji or Kilimanjaro are created when erupting magma piles up.
cone.zh: 富士山或乞力马扎罗山经典的圆锥形是由喷发的岩浆堆积而成的。

spatial.en: Their strengths in memory and spatial skills matched.
spatial.zh: 他们的记忆力和空间技能一样。

spatial.en: His manual dexterity and fine spatial skills were wasted on routine tasks.
spatial.zh: 他的手巧和很好的感悟空间的技能被浪费在日常事务中了。

spatial.en: One is also able to see how specific acts are related to a temporal and spatial context.
spatial.zh: 人们也能看到具体的行为如何与时间和空间背景相关联。

stroll.en: We went for a stroll in the park.
It was too hot even for a gentle stroll.
stroll.zh: 这样的天气连慢慢散步都太热。

stroll.en: They went for a stroll along the waterfront.

nitrogen.en: The faeces contain nitrogen which fertilizes the soil.
nitrogen.zh: 排泄物含有肥沃土壤的氮。
氮是一种不稳定的元素。
氮就是其中的一个副产品。

respective.en: It is important that we dovetail our respective interests.
respective.zh: 我们寻求各自利益共同点是重要的。

respective.en: The happy couple and their respective parents took to the floor.
respective.zh: 那幸福的一对和他们各自的父母开始跳起舞来。

respective.en: They are each recognized specialists in their respective fields.
respective.zh: 他们在各自的领域都被视为专家。

integral.en: As an integral part of learning, it brings about positive changes, making people develop and grow.
integral.zh: 作为学习的一个组成部分，它带来了积极的变化，使人发展和成长。

integral.en: Materials and methods of construction are integral parts of the design of architecture structures.
integral.zh: 建筑材料和施工方法是建筑结构设计的重要组成部分。

integral.en: All models have an integral CD player.
integral.zh: 所有型号都有内置的激光唱片机。

rebound.en: Everyone is banking on an economic rebound to help ease the state's fiscal problems.
rebound.zh: 每个人都指望经济反弹来帮助缓解国家的财政问题。
一个咒语可以“偏斜”或“反弹”。

rebound.en: The causes of this population rebound are consequences of other human actions.
rebound.zh: 人口反弹的原因是其他人类行为的后果。

circulate.en: Leave a gap at the top and bottom so air can circulate.
circulate.zh: 在顶部和底部各留一点空隙，这样空气就可以流通了。

circulate.en: Rumours began to circulate about his financial problems.
circulate.zh: 有关他财务困难的谣言开始流传开来。

circulate.en: Rumours were already beginning to circulate that the project might have to be abandoned.
circulate.zh: 有关这个项目可能被迫放弃的流言已经开始在四处传播。

transparent.zh: 这昆虫的翅膀几乎是透明的。

transparent.en: All of these are transparent to the user.
transparent.zh: 所有这些对用户而言都是透明的。

transparent.en: A transparent object doesn't absorb or scatter light.
transparent.zh: 透明物体不吸收或散射光。

classification.en: The classification based on DNA seems to be much more reliable.
classification.zh: 基于 DNA 的分类似乎更可靠。

classification.en: Chinese garbage classification policy has come into operation in several cities.
classification.zh: 中国垃圾分类政策已经在多个城市生效。

classification.en: Doing garbage classification in a right way can turn waste into wealth, which will benefit us a lot.
classification.zh: 正确实施垃圾分类能够变废为宝，从而使我们受益良多。

intriguing.zh: 这些发现带来了非常有趣的问题。

intriguing.en: It gave me an intriguing window into the way people live.
intriguing.zh: 这为我提供了一个了解人们的生活方式的有趣窗口。

maximize.en: In order to maximize profit, the firm would seek to maximize output.
maximize.zh: 为了最大限度地增加利润，这家公司将试图最大限度地增加产量。

maximize.en: It makes sense to buy at dealer prices so you can maximize your profits if you resell.
maximize.zh: 以批发价格买进是有道理的，如果你再转卖就可以最大化你的利润。

maximize.en: They can maximize the odds of success.
maximize.zh: 他们可以最大限度地提高成功的几率。

absurd.en: He has a good sense of the absurd.
absurd.zh: 他对荒诞事物有较强的识别能力。

absurd.en: Of course it's not true, what an absurd idea.
absurd.zh: 那当然不合乎事实，这个想法太荒唐了！

absurd.en: His high-flown style just sounds absurd today.
absurd.zh: 他的浮夸风格如今听起来真是荒谬。

temptation.en: An expensive bicycle is a temptation to thieves.
temptation.zh: 高档自行车对窃贼是个诱惑。

temptation.en: I yielded to temptation and had a chocolate bar.
temptation.zh: 我经不住诱惑，吃了一大块巧克力。

temptation.en: Will they be able to resist the temptation to buy?
temptation.zh: 他们能抵抗得住购买的诱惑吗？

thrust.en: He thrust at me with a knife.
They thrust him into the back of a jeep.
thrust.zh: 他们把他猛推入吉普车的后部。

thrust.en: It provides the thrust that makes the craft move forward.
thrust.zh: 它提供了使飞机前进的推力。

reservoir.en: Torrents of water gushed into the reservoir.
The reservoir was low after the long drought.
reservoir.zh: 久旱之后水库的水位下降了。

reservoir.en: Water is piped from the reservoir to the city.
reservoir.zh: 水用管子从水库输送到城市。

strap.en: He looped the strap over his shoulder.
strap.zh: 他把带子绕了一个圈挎在肩上。

strap.en: Nancy gripped the strap of her beach bag.
strap.zh: 南希抓住自己海滩休闲包的带子。

strap.en: She pulled the strap of her nightgown onto her shoulder.
strap.zh: 她把睡衣的带子拉到她的肩上。

cigaret.en: The birds will be encouraged to clean the park through the use of a small box that delivers a small amount of bird food each time the rook deposits a cigaret and/or a small piece of rubbish.
cigaret.zh: 每当白嘴鸦丢下一根香烟或一小块垃圾的时候，人们就会用一个装了鸟食的小盒子来鼓励鸟儿们打扫公园。

cigaret.en: I like having cigaret with my drink.
He lit a cigaret in order to calm his mind.
cigaret.zh: 他点燃一支香烟，镇定一下情绪。

feast.en: The Jewish feast of Passover began last night.
feast.zh: 犹太人的宗教节日逾越节昨晚开始了。

feast.en: The feast was served by his mother and sisters.
feast.zh: 宴席由他的母亲和姐妹们招待。

feast.en: They were happy to partake of our feast, but not to share our company.
feast.zh: 他们喜欢享用我们准备的丰盛大餐，但是不喜欢和我们呆在一起。

conductor.en: The conductor beat time with a baton.
Graphite is a highly efficient conductor of electricity.
conductor.zh: 石墨是一种高效的电导体。

conductor.en: Under its new conductor, the orchestra has established an international reputation.
conductor.zh: 在新指挥的领导下，这个乐团建立了国际声誉。

analogy.en: The analogy between music and fragrance has stuck.
analogy.zh: 音乐与香味的类比已经深入人心了。

analogy.en: The teacher drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.
analogy.zh: 老师打了个比喻，把人的心脏比作水泵。

inhabitant.en: The former inhabitant of the Canary Isles continued his dithyrambic.
inhabitant.zh: 从前的加那利群岛居民继续喝着酒。

inhabitant.en: Princess was an inhabitant of the great Tenochtitlan.
inhabitant.zh: 公主是一个大特诺奇居民。
大力保障和改善林区民生。

logo.en: The team's logo was emblazoned on the baseball caps.
logo.zh: 球队标识醒目地印在棒球帽上。

logo.en: She was sporting a T-shirt with the company's logo on it.
logo.zh: 她穿了一件带有公司徽标的T恤衫，很是得意。

logo.en: The company carries a variety of binders that can be imprinted with your message or logo.
logo.zh: 该公司经营各种可以印上客户所需信息或标识的活页夹。

intensify.en: Failure can never defeat me but only intensify my desire to succeed.
intensify.zh: 失败永远无法打败我，只会增强我对获得成功的渴望。

intensify.en: Criticism over the original state of the building is likely to intensify over the coming days.
intensify.zh: 在未来几天，对这座建筑原始状态的批评可能会加剧。

intensify.en: That is clearly an untenable view, since editors can often intensify reader interest in a news topic by giving it frequent coverage.
intensify.zh: 这显然是站不住脚的观点，因为编辑通常可以通过频繁报道来增强读者对新闻话题的兴趣。

sway.zh: 更糟糕的是，它开始晃动。

sway.en: She leads a second horse, an old sway-backed mare.
sway.zh: 她牵着另一匹马，一匹摇摇晃晃的老母马 。

sway.en: Shall we sway backward and forward, Mary, as if we were dervishes?
sway.zh: 玛丽，我们要不要前后晃来晃去，就好像我们是托钵僧似的？

upgrade.en: How do we know when to invest in an upgrade?
upgrade.zh: 我们如何知道何时投资升级？
人们应该定期升级他们的设备。

upgrade.en: Maybe there's no need for an upgrade and that's OK.
upgrade.zh: 也许不需要提升也没关系。

erosion.en: Soil erosion was mitigated by the planting of trees.
erosion.zh: 植树造林减轻了土壤侵蚀。

erosion.en: More familiar landscapes have been sculpted by surface erosion.
erosion.zh: 更多熟悉的地形是由地表侵蚀形成的。

erosion.en: We'll never be able to stop beach erosion, we can only stave it off.
erosion.zh: 我们永远都不能阻止海滩被侵蚀，我们只能暂缓其发生。

manifest.en: If you take a look at his biography, you can get a good idea of how his life experiences manifest themselves in his theories of beauty.
manifest.zh: 如果你看一下他的传记，就可以知道他的人生经历是如何体现在他的美学理论中的。

manifest.en: The virus needs two weeks to manifest itself.
manifest.zh: 这种病毒需要两周才能发作。

manifest.en: The anger he felt is manifest in his paintings.
manifest.zh: 他的愤怒明显地表现在他的绘画之中。

refusal.en: Her answer amounted to a complete refusal.
refusal.zh: 她的答复等于完全拒绝。

refusal.en: His refusal to talk was simple stubbornness.
refusal.zh: 他拒绝交谈只是出于固执。

refusal.en: His refusal to discuss the matter is very annoying.
refusal.zh: 他拒绝商量这件事，令人很恼火。

recreational.zh: 什么娱乐设施现在是可用的？

recreational.en: These areas are set aside for public recreational use.
recreational.zh: 这些地方已经划出来用于公共娱乐。

recreational.en: The town and its environs are inviting, with recreational attractions and art museums.
recreational.zh: 这个城镇及其周边地区十分引人入胜，建有休闲胜地和艺术博物馆。

flush.en: He heard the flush of a toilet.
Do you sweat a lot or flush a lot?
flush.zh: 你常出汗或是常脸红吗？

flush.en: Make sure the paving stones are flush with the lawn.
flush.zh: 务必要使铺路石和草坪齐平。

lick.en: Well I will lick you, if you fool with me.
