lick.zh: 好吧，如果你戏弄我，我就会打你。

lick.en: "And I didn't have to lick them, either," he added.
lick.zh: “而且我也没有打他们。”他补充道。

unaware.en: He was blithely unaware of the trouble he'd caused.
unaware.zh: 他漫不经心，丝毫没有察觉他惹的麻烦。

unaware.en: She was sublimely unaware of the trouble she had caused.
unaware.zh: 她压根儿没察觉自己闹出了乱子。

unaware.en: She was unaware that I could see her.

align.en: A tripod will be useful to align and steady the camera.
align.zh: 三脚架会有助于对齐稳住照相机。

align.en: The top and bottom line of each column on the page should align.
align.zh: 版面每栏的头一行和末一行要对齐。

align.en: How did you align strategies throughout the company?
align.zh: 你是如何加强整个公司的策略创新的？

predominantly.en: The landscape has remained predominantly rural in appearance.
predominantly.zh: 该风景看上去主要保留了乡村风貌。

predominantly.en: In the 21st century the nature of work has predominantly moved from being manual labour and manufacturing to service economy based upon technological innovation.
predominantly.zh: 在21世纪，工作的性质已主要从体力劳动和制造业转移到以技术创新为基础的服务经济。

predominantly.en: She works in a predominantly male environment.
predominantly.zh: 她在一个男性居多的环境里工作。

mighty.zh: 你很清楚，你是做不到的。

mighty.en: There was a flash and a mighty bang.
mighty.zh: 一道闪光伴随着一声轰然巨响。

mighty.en: It's something you'll be mighty proud of.
mighty.zh: 这是个你会非常骄傲的事。

idiot.en: I realized I was babbling like an idiot.
idiot.zh: 我意识到我像个傻瓜一样在胡言乱语。

idiot.en: Standing there on stage I felt a complete idiot.
idiot.zh: 我站在舞台上觉得简直是一个大傻瓜。

defect.en: He was born with a hearing defect.
Children with the defect need all the help.
defect.zh: 有缺陷的孩子需要各种帮助。

defect.en: Not only was our defect rate lower, but the architecture and design were superior.
defect.zh: 不仅仅是我们的缺陷率更低了，而且我们的架构和设计也更优秀。

accountant.en: She has an appointment with her accountant.
accountant.zh: 她和她的会计师有个约会。

accountant.en: It would probably pay you to hire an accountant.
accountant.zh: 聘一名会计师或许对你有好处。

accountant.en: She has been an accountant all her working life.
accountant.zh: 她在整个职业生涯中一直是会计师。

vulnerability.en: A baby is the embodiment of vulnerability.
His vulnerability makes him even more lovable.
vulnerability.zh: 他的弱点甚至使他显得更可爱。

subjective.en: Everyone's opinion is bound to be subjective.
subjective.zh: 每个人的意见都必定是主观的。

subjective.en: We know that taste in art is a subjective matter.
subjective.zh: 我们知道艺术品味是个主观问题。

valve.en: This valve regulates the flow of water.
The pump sucks air out through the valve.
valve.zh: 气泵通过阀门把空气抽出去。

owl.zh: 一只猫头鹰在附近啼叫。

owl.en: The owl seems to have deserted its nest.
owl.zh: 这只猫头鹰似乎不要这个窝了。

owl.en: The owl is sacred for many Californian Indian people.
owl.zh: 猫头鹰对于很多加利福利亚的印第安人来说是神圣的。

petition.zh: 吉尔自告奋勇组织请愿。
我们在为请愿书收集签名。

petition.en: They turned in a petition with 80 000 signatures.
petition.zh: 他们递交了一份有8万人签名的请愿书。

slash.en: The mayor will have to slash the city's already bare-bones budget.
slash.zh: 市长将不得不削减该市已经降到最低限度的预算。

slash.en: He's just nipped out to have a slash.
slash.zh: 他刚才急急忙忙跑出去撒尿了。

slash.en: Car makers could be forced to slash prices.
slash.zh: 汽车制造商可能会被迫大幅度降价。

artery.en: He had an operation last year to widen a heart artery.
artery.zh: 他去年动了一次扩张心脏动脉的手术。

artery.en: A muscular spasm in the coronary artery can cause a heart attack.
artery.zh: 冠状动脉内肌肉痉挛会导致心脏病发作。

artery.en: They could remove the block in his artery.
artery.zh: 他们可以移除他动脉中的阻塞物。

correspondence.en: We have been in correspondence for months.
We kept up a correspondence for many years.
correspondence.zh: 我们保持了很多年的通信联系。

correspondence.en: I took a correspondence course in computing.
correspondence.zh: 我学了一门计算机函授课程。

curator.en: Let's say a museum curator comes to you with a problem.
curator.zh: 假设一个博物馆馆长带着一个问题来找你。

curator.en: The curator entered the darkest part of the basement to search for the dagger.
curator.zh: 馆长走进地下室最黑暗的地方去寻找短剑。

curator.en: Peter Forey is curator of fossil fishes at the Natural History Museum.
curator.zh: 彼得·富里是自然历史博物馆鱼化石的负责人。

static.en: My hair gets full of static when I brush it.
static.zh: 我梳头时头发就有好多静电。

static.en: When the weather turns cold and dry, my clothes develop a static problem.
static.zh: 天气变冷变干时，我的衣服就会产生静电问题。

static.en: After only a minute an authoritative voice came through the static on the radio.
static.zh: 过了仅一分钟后，透过广播的静电噪音传出了一个威严的声音。

nonsense.en: I just don't believe in this nonsense.

mist.zh: 乳白色的薄雾弥漫了山谷。

humble.en: He always makes much of his humble origins.
humble.zh: 他总是非常在意他卑微的出身。

humble.en: His views come from his own humble beginnings.
humble.zh: 他的观点源自于他卑微的出身。

humble.en: He gave a great performance, but he was very humble.
humble.zh: 他的表演很精彩，但他却很谦逊。

thesis.en: This thesis does not stand up to close inspection.
thesis.zh: 这个论点经不起仔细推敲。

thesis.en: There is no empirical evidence to support his thesis.
thesis.zh: 没有实证根据来支持他的论点。

thesis.en: Have you decided on a working title for your thesis yet?
thesis.zh: 你选了论文的暂定题目吗？

coefficient.en: Only teak matches oak's expansion coefficient and stays watertight.
coefficient.zh: 只有柚木才能达到橡木的膨胀系数，并保持水密性。

coefficient.en: The coefficient of compaction is 1.22 on the mechanical loader.
coefficient.zh: 机械装载机的压实系数为1.22。

coefficient.en: The coupling coefficient of transformer relates the transforming efficiency.
coefficient.zh: 变压器的耦合系数与变压器的效率有关。

audio.en: This digital audio player supports multiple formats.
audio.zh: 这台数字音频播放器支持多种格式。

audio.en: He demonstrated how audio signals could be transmitted along cables without distortion.
audio.zh: 他演示了音频信号如何通过电缆传输而不失真。

audio.en: Users can download MP3 music files and record them directly onto a CD audio disc using a PC CD burner.
audio.zh: 使用者可下载MP3音乐文件并用个人电脑光盘刻录机直接将其刻录到音频光盘上。

cosmic.en: NASA plans to launch a satellite to study cosmic rays.
cosmic.zh: 美国国家航空航天局计划发射一颗卫星来研究宇宙射线。

cosmic.en: Anything from cosmic rays to radiation to diet may activate a dormant oncogene.
cosmic.zh: 从宇宙射线到辐射到日常饮食，任何东西都可能激活潜伏的致癌基因。

cosmic.en: The AU is a cosmic measuring rod, and the basis of how we scale the Universe today.
cosmic.zh: 天文单位是宇宙的标尺，是我们今天测量宇宙的基础。

qualified.en: He qualified as a doctor last year.
qualified.zh: 他去年获得了医生的资格。

qualified.en: There is an urgent need for qualified teachers.
This man was not qualified to drive and was speeding.
qualified.zh: 这个男子没有资格开车， 而且还在超速驾驶。

complicate.en: I do not wish to complicate the task more than is necessary.
complicate.zh: 我不想使这项任务不必要地复杂化。

complicate.en: The day's events, he said, would only complicate the task of the peacekeeping forces.
complicate.zh: 他说那天的事件只会使维和部队的任务复杂化。

complicate.en: While intelligent people can often simplify the complex, a fool is more likely to complicate the simple.
complicate.zh: 聪明的人往往能把复杂的事情简单化，而傻瓜更有可能把简单的事情复杂化。

ponder.en: CubeSat researchers suggest that now's the time to ponder unexpected and unintended possible consequences of more people than ever having access to their own small slice of space.
ponder.zh: 立方体卫星（CubeSat）的研究人员认为，由于有机会进入属于自己的小宇宙空间的人前所未有地多了起来，现在是时候考虑一下其带来的意料及计划外的后果了。

ponder.en: Cube Sat researchers suggest that now's the time to ponder unexpected and unintended possible consequences of more people than ever having access to their own small slice of space.
ponder.zh: Cube Sat 公司的研究人员表示，现在是时候考虑一下越来越多的人进入自己的狭小空间而可能产生的意想不到的后果了。

ponder.en: They were left to ponder on the implications of the announcement.
ponder.zh: 他们被留下来琢磨这项宣告的含义。

sanctuary.en: The church became a sanctuary for the refugees.
sanctuary.zh: 教堂成为这些难民的庇护所。

sanctuary.en: His church became a sanctuary for thousands of people who fled the civil war.
sanctuary.zh: 他的教堂成了数千逃避内战的人们的一个避难所。

sanctuary.en: Palau also established the world's first shark sanctuary in 2009.
sanctuary.zh: 2009年，帕劳还建立了世界上第一个鲨鱼保护区。

denounce.en: They were at the mercy of informers who might at any moment denounce them.
denounce.zh: 他们完全受那些随时可能告发他们的告密者的支配。

denounce.en: German leaders all took the opportunity to denounce the attacks and plead for tolerance.
denounce.zh: 德国领导人们都藉此机会谴责这些攻击，并且恳请宽容。

denounce.en: No wonder it has become fashionable to denounce many universities as little more than elaborate con tricks.
denounce.zh: 难怪谴责许多大学只不过是精心设计的骗局已经成为一种潮流。

stool.en: He hoisted himself onto a high stool.
stool.zh: 他抬身坐上了一张高凳子。

stool.en: He hitched himself onto the bar stool.
stool.zh: 他一跃坐到了酒吧间的高凳上。

stool.en: The stool had a torn, red plastic seat.
stool.zh: 这条无靠背凳子有一个破了的、红色的塑料坐部。

lounge.en: Let's meet in the cocktail lounge at the Hilton.
lounge.zh: 咱们在希尔顿酒店的酒廊见面吧。

lounge.en: Alcoholic beverages are served in the hotel lounge.
lounge.zh: 宾馆的休息室供应酒类饮料。

lounge.en: We went through passport control and into the departure lounge.
lounge.zh: 我们通过护照检查站进入了候机大厅。

tuna.en: She began opening a can of tuna.
tuna.zh: 她开始打开一罐金枪鱼。

tuna.en: Tuna can be grilled, fried or barbecued.
tuna.zh: 金枪鱼可以烤、煎或烧烤着吃。

tuna.en: Thick tuna steaks are eaten rare, like beef.
tuna.zh: 厚厚的金枪鱼片要半熟吃，就像牛肉一样。

credible.zh: 她的说法似乎在许多人看来是可信的。

credible.en: Alternatives provide a credible threat to suppliers, even if the ability to switch is constrained.
credible.zh: 替代方案对供应商构成了可靠的威胁，即使转换的能力受到限制。

credible.en: Though its villain also receives his rightful deserts, the thriller presents a less comfortable and credible world.
credible.zh: 虽然反派也得到了应有的惩罚，但这部惊悚片呈现了一个不那么舒适可信的世界。

revision.en: The phase of writing that is actually most important is revision.
revision.zh: 写作中真正最重要的阶段是修改。

daylight.zh: 作画的最佳时间是白天。

daylight.en: Through the aperture he could see daylight.
daylight.zh: 通过这个孔隙他能看到日光。

daylight.en: The street looks very different in daylight.
daylight.zh: 在白天大街显得很不一样。

warrant.en: There is no warrant for such criticism.
They issued a warrant for her arrest.
warrant.zh: 当局发出了逮捕她的令状。
总统签署了死刑执行令。

mattress.en: The mattress is best on a solid bed base.
mattress.zh: 床垫最好放在结实的床座上。

mattress.en: He crouched down and reached under the mattress.
mattress.zh: 他蹲下来，把手伸到了床垫下面。

mattress.en: The mattress and base are normally bought as a set.
mattress.zh: 床垫和床基通常成套购买。

horizontal.en: He shifted his position from the horizontal.
horizontal.zh: 他从水平姿势变换成其他姿势。

horizontal.en: The brown vinyl covering all the horizontal surfaces is coming unstuck in several places.
horizontal.zh: 所有横面上盖的棕色乙烯基塑料有些地方开始脱落了。

horizontal.en: I'd like to discuss with you this horizontal portion.
horizontal.zh: 我想和你讨论一下这个横向部分。

exceptional.en: This deadline will be extended only in exceptional circumstances.
exceptional.zh: 只有在特殊情况下才会延长最后期限。

exceptional.en: Capital punishment is allowable only under exceptional circumstances.
exceptional.zh: 只有在特殊情况下才允许判死刑。

wary.en: Be wary of strangers who offer you a ride.
wary.zh: 提防那些主动让你搭车的陌生人。

wary.en: People did not teach their children to be wary of strangers.
wary.zh: 人们以前没教过自己的孩子们要提防陌生人。

wary.en: Yet he was wary of projects aiming to provide a visual rendering of his novel Invisible Man.
wary.zh: 然而，他对旨在为他的小说《隐形人》提供视觉效果的项目持谨慎态度。

bundle.en: Her eyes suddenly alighted on the bundle of documents.
bundle.zh: 她的目光突然落到了这捆文件上。

bundle.en: That car must have cost a bundle.
She tied the newspapers in a bundle.

saturated.en: Fish oils are less saturated than animal fats.
saturated.zh: 鱼油不如动物脂肪饱和。

saturated.en: Snack food market is largely saturated, and to grow.
saturated.zh: 休闲食品市场基本饱和，并呈增长趋势。

saturated.en: The snack food market is largely saturated, and to grow.
saturated.zh: 休闲食品市场基本饱和，并呈发展趋势。

linen.en: From it he took a large, heavy linen bag and brought it to the child.
linen.zh: 他从那里拿来一个又大又重的亚麻布口袋，递给孩子。

linen.en: In the late 17th century, French refugees arrived here and developed the linen industry.
linen.zh: 17世纪晚期，法国难民来到这里，发展了亚麻工业。

embed.en: In fact, the process can embed small flaws in the genes of clones that scientists are only now discovering.
embed.zh: 事实上，这个过程可能会在克隆的基因中嵌入一些小的缺陷，而科学家们直到现在才发现这些缺陷。

embed.en: First of all, he wanted to embed in his upcoming high potentials, the user application of really advanced investment theory.
embed.zh: 首先，他想在他即将到来的高潜力中，嵌入真正先进的投资理论的用户应用。

embed.en: Not only did they develop such a device but by the turn of the millennium they had also managed to embed it in a worldwide system accessed by billions of people every day.
embed.zh: 他们不仅开发了这样一种设备，而且在世纪之交，他们还成功地将其嵌入到每天有数十亿人访问的全球系统中。

ozone.en: Ozone is a highly reactive form of oxygen gas.
ozone.zh: 臭氧是一种高度活跃的氧气形态。

ozone.en: The ozone layer screens out dangerous rays from the sun.
ozone.zh: 臭氧层能遮挡住来自太阳的有害射线。

ozone.en: It is widely known that CFCs can damage the ozone layer.
ozone.zh: 众所周知氯氟烃会破坏臭氧层。

robbery.zh: 莫里斯已经承认犯有抢劫罪。

robbery.en: They had been found guilty of armed robbery.
robbery.zh: 他们被判犯有持械抢劫罪。

robbery.en: A man has been arrested in connection with the robbery.
robbery.zh: 一名男子因与这桩抢劫案有关已被逮捕。

memorable.en: Her speech was memorable for its polemic rather than its substance.
memorable.zh: 她的演说之所以令人难忘，不是因其内容而是因其辩论方法。

memorable.en: Movie music can be made memorable because its themes are repeated throughout the film.
memorable.zh: 电影音乐可以制作得令人难忘，因为其主旋律在影片中反复出现。
户外广告可以令人难忘。

recorder.en: He was wired up to a police tape recorder.
recorder.zh: 他被连接到了警方的录音机上。

recorder.en: The guards permitted me to bring my camera and tape recorder.
recorder.zh: 守卫允许我带上相机和录音机。

recorder.en: Rodney put the recorder on the desk top and pushed the play button.
recorder.zh: 罗德尼把录音机放在桌面上，按下了播放键。

footstep.en: Road, in fact, is under your footstep.
I lended my ear to hear but there was no footstep.
But now, Pearl, I hear a footstep along the path, and the noise of one putting aside the branches.
footstep.zh: 不过，珠儿，这会儿我听到有脚步声沿着小路走来，—还有拨开树枝的声音。

drip.en: She was then hooked up to an IV drip.
drip.zh: 接着就给她接上了静脉滴注。

drip.en: He was put on intravenous drip to treat his dehydration.
The silence was broken only by the steady drip, drip of water from the roof.
drip.zh: 只有屋顶上滴答滴答持续不断的滴水声打破了寂静。

elevate.en: Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the material standards of a particular industry.
elevate.zh: 更好的办法是帮助提升美的概念，超越特定行业的物质标准。

elevate.en: I built a platform to elevate the bed.
elevate.zh: 我搭了一个台子把床抬高了。
情绪紧张会使血压升高。

loosen.en: Relax, smile; loosen up in mind and body.
He reached up to loosen the scarf around his neck.
loosen.zh: 他伸出手松开围在脖子上的围巾。

loosen.en: Many business groups have been pressing the Federal Reserve to loosen interest rates.
loosen.zh: 许多商业团体一直在施加压力要求联邦储备局放宽利率。

intake.en: Your intake of alcohol should not exceed two units per day.
intake.zh: 你每天酒精摄入量不能超过两个单位。

intake.en: Salt intake may lead to raised blood pressure in susceptible adults.
intake.zh: 盐的摄入可能导致易病的成年人血压升高。

intake.en: Nutritionists say only 33 percent of our calorie intake should be from fat.
intake.zh: 营养学家说我们所摄入的卡路里中只应有33%来自脂肪。

lottery.en: The lottery provides harmless fun for millions.
lottery.zh: 彩票抽奖为数百万人提供正当娱乐。

lottery.en: She bought a lottery ticket and won more than $33 million.
lottery.zh: 她买了一张彩票，中了三千三百多万美元。

lottery.en: The proceeds from the lottery go towards sports and recreation, as well as swelling the coffers of the government.
lottery.zh: 彩票收入用于体育和娱乐事业，以及充实国库。

chore.zh: 对我来说，购物真是件苦差事。
这是按部就班的乏味的杂务。

chore.en: She sees exercise primarily as an unavoidable chore.
chore.zh: 她把锻炼主要看作是不得不做的琐事。

lengthy.en: A deal was struck after lengthy negotiations.
lengthy.zh: 经过漫长的谈判终于达成了协议。

lengthy.en: The book ends on a lengthy description of Hawaii.
lengthy.zh: 这本书以一段对夏威夷的冗长描述作结。

lengthy.en: Friedman's lengthy report quoted an unnamed source.
lengthy.zh: 弗里德曼冗长的报告引用了一个未指明出处的资料。

fringe.en: My fringe was cut short, but the rest of my hair was long.
fringe.zh: 我的刘海剪得短,但其余的头发长。

fringe.en: The monarchists are a small fringe group who quarrel fiercely among themselves.
fringe.zh: 君主制拥护者们是个边缘性小团体，内部争吵激烈。

fringe.en: They are paid their salaries and are entitled to fringe benefits on a pro-rata basis.
fringe.zh: 他们领工资，同时还能按比例享受附加福利。

tattoo.en: On the back of his neck he has a tattoo of a cross.
tattoo.zh: 他后脖子上有个十字文身。

tattoo.en: In the old days, they would paint and tattoo their bodies for ceremonies.
tattoo.zh: 过去，他们会为了某些仪式而在身上绘图、文身。

tattoo.en: I can give them a massage, and they can give more tattoo.
tattoo.zh: 我可以给他们按摩，然后他们可以纹更多的纹身。

lease.en: They lease the land from a local farmer.
lease.zh: 他们从当地一位农场主手中租得这块土地。

lease.en: He took up a 10-year lease on the house.
lease.zh: 他为这房子签了10年的租约。

lease.en: The lease plainly states that all damage must be paid for.
lease.zh: 租约明确规定，一切损坏必须赔偿。

murmur.en: The doctor said James had now developed a heart murmur.
murmur.zh: 医生说詹姆斯心脏现在出现了杂音。

murmur.en: The excited murmur grew louder as the whole group collected in the old dining room.
murmur.zh: 当所有人都聚集在老旧的餐厅时，兴奋的低语声音越来越大。

coral.en: The island is encircled by a coral reef.
coral.zh: 这个岛周围都是珊瑚礁。

coral.en: An unspoiled coral reef encloses the bay.
coral.zh: 未经破坏的珊瑚礁围绕着该海湾。

coral.en: Although the coral looks hard, it is very delicate.
coral.zh: 虽然那珊瑚看起来坚硬，它其实非常易碎。

appliance.en: Before you buy a new appliance, talk to someone who owns one.
appliance.zh: 购买新电器之前，先和有这个电器的人谈谈。

appliance.en: When people discover that an appliance is broken, they often stop using it.
appliance.zh: 当人们发现电器坏了，通常就不会再去使用它了。

appliance.en: If you have an appliance that doesn't work, send a letter to the store that sold it.
appliance.zh: 如果你的电器坏了，那就给出售它的商店写封信。

census.en: Of these, 40% told census-takers they were Muslims.
census.zh: 这些人当中，有40%的人告诉人口普查员说他们是穆斯林。

census.en: The detailed assessment of the latest census will be ready in three months.
census.zh: 有关最新人口普查的详细评估工作将在3个月内就绪。

census.en: Census data has shown Australians come from more than 200 countries.
census.zh: 人口普查数据显示，澳大利亚人来自200多个国家。

circus.en: My dad took me to the circus.
We took the children to the circus.
circus.zh: 我们带孩子去看了马戏表演。

circus.en: My real ambition was to work in a circus.
circus.zh: 我真正的理想是去马戏团工作。

inhabit.en: They inhabit reed huts built on stilts above the water.
inhabit.zh: 他们居住在建在水中木桩上的芦苇草屋里。

inhabit.en: The Olympic marmots inhabit meadows high in the Olympic Mountains where the weather conditions are much harsher.
inhabit.zh: 奥林匹克土拨鼠栖息的草地在奥林匹克山脉的高地，那里的气候条件要恶劣得多。

inhabit.en: A similar strategy—accelerated development combined with a resting stage—has also allowed amphibians to inhabit deserts.
inhabit.zh: 一个类似的策略——加速发展与休息阶段相结合——也使两栖动物得以栖息在沙漠中。

corps.en: David McNeil is travelling with the White House press corps.
corps.zh: 大卫•麦克尼尔正与白宫记者团同行。

corps.en: Henceforth all branches of the naval officer corps were equal to one another.
corps.zh: 从此以后海军军官团的各个分支都相互平等。

quota.en: I'm going home now—I've done my quota of work for the day.
quota.zh: 我现在要回家了—我已完成了今天的工作指标。

quota.en: The quota of four tickets per person had been reduced to two.
quota.zh: 每人4张票的限额已减少到了2张。

quota.en: The bill would force employers to adopt a quota system when recruiting workers.
quota.zh: 该法案将迫使雇主们在录用工人时采取配额制。

excerpt.en: The May issue will feature a cover photo of a woman firefighter in San Francisco for an excerpt from a new book, "Fighting Fire."
excerpt.zh: 五月号的封面照片是一名旧金山的女消防员，节选自新书《救火》。

excerpt.en: An excerpt of the interview is below.
excerpt.zh: 下面是访谈的一些摘录。
考虑一下清单5中的代码引用。

stride.en: He set off with a loping stride.
stride.zh: 他迈着轻快的步伐出发了。

stride.en: He took the ridiculous accusation in stride.
stride.zh: 他从容应对那荒谬的指控。

stride.en: The campaign is just getting into its stride.
stride.zh: 这场运动刚刚进入状态。

miniature.en: It looks like a miniature version of James Bond's car.
miniature.zh: 它看上去像一辆小型的詹姆斯•邦德的汽车。

miniature.en: Through play, children act out in miniature the dramas of adult life.
miniature.zh: 通过游戏，孩子们演出了成年人生活的缩影。

miniature.en: Ecuador provides a perfect introduction to South America; it's a continent in miniature.
miniature.zh: 厄瓜多尔是南美的一个绝佳概览；它是整个大陆的缩影。

oversight.en: William was angered and embarrassed by his oversight.
oversight.zh: 威廉对自己的疏忽感到恼火和尴尬。

oversight.en: I didn't mean to leave her name off the list; it was an oversight.
oversight.zh: 我不是有意在名单上漏掉她的名字的，这是个疏忽。

oversight.en: The bill creates an oversight board with the authority to investigate and punish accounting firms.
oversight.zh: 该法案创建了一个有权调查并处罚会计师事务所的监督委员会。

reunion.en: When we decide to say farewell, we are not far from reunion.
reunion.zh: 当我们决定告别的时候，就离重逢不远了。

reunion.en: If you don't come to the reunion you'll be sorely missed.
reunion.zh: 你要是不来参加团聚，大家会非常想念你的。

copyright.en: Who owns the copyright on this song?
copyright.zh: 谁拥有这首歌曲的版权？

copyright.en: Who owns the copyright on this movie?
copyright.zh: 谁拥有这部电影的版权？

copyright.en: The agreement assigns copyright to the publisher.
copyright.zh: 协议规定将版权转让给出版商。

ripe.en: Reforms were promised when the time was ripe.
ripe.zh: 曾经作出承诺，时机一成熟就进行改革。

ripe.en: You'll need four ripe tomatoes, skinned and chopped.
ripe.zh: 需要四个熟了的西红柿，去皮切碎。

viewpoint.en: She will have her own viewpoint on the matter.
viewpoint.zh: 她对这个问题会有她自己的看法。

viewpoint.en: You have to know where to stand for a good viewpoint.
viewpoint.zh: 你得知道站在哪儿才会有好的视角。

viewpoint.en: From a practical viewpoint, I'd advise you not to go.
viewpoint.zh: 从实际角度考虑，我劝你不要去。

coordination.en: Learning to drive is all a matter of coordination.

coordination.zh: 醉酒影响言语能力和协调性。

coordination.en: You need good hand-eye coordination to play ball games.
coordination.zh: 玩球类游戏，手和眼的动作要协调好。

amazed.en: We were amazed by the play's success.
Just the size of the place amazed her.
amazed.zh: 仅仅地方之大就使她十分惊奇。

amazed.en: Just the huge size of the place amazed her.
amazed.zh: 仅仅地方之大就使她十分惊奇。

snatch.en: He is puzzled, rather than vengeful when other children snatch things from him or push him around.
snatch.zh: 当其他孩子从他手里抢东西或把他推来推去时，他感到困惑，而不是报复。

snatch.en: I managed to snatch an hour's sleep.
snatch.zh: 我偷空儿睡了一小时的觉。

jewel.en: He asked how much I spent on the rare jewel.
jewel.zh: 他问我花了多少钱买这件稀有的珠宝。

jewel.en: The lowest estimate would put the worth of the jewel at ＄200.
jewel.zh: 按最低的评估这块宝石也值 200 美元。

jewel.en: It's a jewel box of about 150 artifacts, the density of the installation providing a powerful experience for the visitor than does the sparser display.
jewel.zh: 它是一个珠宝盒，大约有150件手工艺品，陈设的密度比稀疏展览更能为参观者提供了强大的体验。

slogan.en: The Republicans tried to trump this with their slogan.
slogan.zh: 共和党人试图用他们的口号来胜出。

slogan.en: The ceremony was disrupted by unprecedented heckling and slogan-chanting.
slogan.zh: 典礼因前所未有的起哄和口号声而中断。

slogan.en: "the survival of the fittest," a slogan that virtually preempted all debate.
slogan.zh: “适者生存”，一个几乎无可辩驳的口号。

outrageous.en: By diplomatic standards, this was outrageous behaviour.
outrageous.zh: 按外交标准，这是不可接受的行为。

outrageous.en: I felt as if I had made an outrageous howler.
outrageous.zh: 我觉得自己似乎犯了个不可容忍的低级错误。

accord.en: These results accord closely with our predictions.
accord.zh: 这些结果和我们的预测相当一致。

accord.en: This action would not be in accord with our policy.
accord.zh: 这一行动不会符合我们的方针。

accord.en: He did not quit as France's prime minister of his own accord.
accord.zh: 他不是自愿地辞去法国总理一职的。

shrine.en: Wimbledon is a shrine for all lovers of tennis.
shrine.zh: 温布尔登是所有网球爱好者的圣地。

shrine.en: The monument has been turned into a shrine to the dead and the missing.
shrine.zh: 这座纪念碑已经变成了纪念那些过世或失踪的人的圣地。

shrine.en: Near a shrine, she found a beautiful bird singing on a big stone.
shrine.zh: 在一个神龛附近，她发现一只美丽的鸟在一块大石头上唱歌。

perch.en: A lady was walking to work when she saw a parrot on a perch in front of a pet store.
perch.zh: 有一位女士在步行去上班途中，看见一只鹦鹉栖息在一间宠物店前面。

perch.en: The mother carried each baby up a rainforest tree to a safe perch inside a bromeliad plant.
perch.zh: 这位母亲把每一个婴儿衔到一棵热带雨林的树上，放在凤梨科植物里一个安全的栖息处。

perch.en: "Very well," answered the sparrow, "do so, and in the meantime, I will perch upon that bush."
perch.zh: “很好，”麻雀回答说，“照我说的做，在这期间，我将栖息在那丛灌木上。”

individually.en: These paints can be used individually or in combination.
individually.zh: 这些涂料可单独或混合使用。

individually.en: We'd better go in a group, not individually.
individually.zh: 最好集体去，不要单个儿去。

individually.en: The manager spoke to them all individually.
individually.zh: 经理逐一和他们各人谈话。

albeit.en: He finally agreed, albeit reluctantly, to help us.
albeit.zh: 尽管勉强，他最后还是同意帮助我们。

albeit.en: Charles's letter was indeed published, albeit in a somewhat abbreviated form.
albeit.zh: 查尔斯的信确实被刊登了出来，尽管有些删节。

albeit.en: They strongly suggest that the neutrino has mass, albeit an infinitesimal amount.
albeit.zh: 他们强烈表明中微子是有质量的，尽管质量是无穷小的。

nickname.en: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
nickname.zh: 关于杀手身份的重大线索是他的绰号——花生。

nickname.en: His family's Cantonese nickname for him translates as Never Sits Still.
nickname.zh: 他家人为他起的广东话绰号翻译过来意思是“永远坐不住”。

mold.en: Mold is usually green, white, black or gray.
mold.zh: 霉菌通常为绿色、白色、黑色或灰色。

misery.en: Their energies were focused on the alleviation of the refugees' misery.
misery.zh: 他们把精力集中在了对难民苦难的减轻上。

misery.en: Save my child from all that misery!
misery.zh: 把我的孩子从所有那些苦难中救出来吧！

misery.en: There is much less physical misery than before.
misery.zh: 身体上的痛苦比以前少多了。

avenue.en: He walked up Fifth Avenue to clear his head.
avenue.zh: 他在第五大街上走，让头脑清醒清醒。

avenue.en: Lily lives in a penthouse just off Park Avenue.
avenue.zh: 莉莉住在离公园大街不远的一处顶层公寓里。

avenue.en: Bergdorf Goodman has opened a men's shop on Fifth Avenue.
avenue.zh: 伯格多夫·古德曼在第五大道上开了一家男装店。

addict.en: She is a TV addict and watches as much as she can.
addict.zh: 她是一个电视迷，看尽可能多的电视。

addict.en: Naylor acknowledged, in a letter to the judge, that he was a drug addict.
addict.zh: 在一封写给法官的信中，内勒承认他是一个吸毒者。
一个网络成瘾者通常会做些什么？

marginal.en: High marginal tax rates may act as a disincentive to working longer hours.
marginal.zh: 边际税率过高也许会抑制加班时间。

marginal.en: The analysts applaud the cuts in marginal businesses, but insist the company must make deeper sacrifices.
marginal.zh: 分析家们赞同对边际业务的削减，但坚持认为公司必须作出更大牺牲。

marginal.en: To call something "marginal" means it is not very good.
marginal.zh: 所谓“边缘”意味着它不是很好。

dial.en: I can't get a dial tone on this phone.
dial.zh: 我在这部电话上听不到拨号音。

dial.en: She picked up the receiver and started to dial.
Broadband is still more expensive than dial-up services.
dial.zh: 宽带还是要比拨号服务费钱得多。

mustard.en: A little mustard is served on the side to add further piquancy.
mustard.zh: 旁边加上一点芥末来增添辛辣味。

mustard.en: He dropped his hot dog on the pavement and someone's dog ate it, mustard and all.
mustard.zh: 他把热狗掉在了街上，然后不知谁的狗给吃了，连带芥末全都吃了个精光。

mustard.en: Your wit is as thick as Tewkesbury Mustard.
mustard.zh: 你的智慧像图克斯伯里芥末一样厚。

berry.en: Mr. Berry said the timing was a coincidence and that his decision was unrelated to Mr. Roman's departure.
berry.zh: 贝里先生说时间的安排是个巧合，而且他的决策与罗曼先生的离去毫无关系。

berry.en: Berry agrees and hopes her team's findings might one day help to break down plastics in landfills.
berry.zh: 贝里对此表示同意，并希望她团队的研究结果有朝一日能帮助分解垃圾填埋场中的塑料。

berry.en: Chuck Berry, who I saw a year or two ago, played guitar and did something approximating a dog walk.
berry.zh: 在一两年前，我看到 Chuck Berry 弹着吉他，像小狗走路一样跳着舞步。

ramp.en: The expressway on-ramp lay just ahead.
ramp.zh: 高速公路的入口匝道就在前方。

ramp.en: A ramp allows easy access for wheelchairs.
The traffic on the off-ramp slowed to a crawl.
ramp.zh: 驶出匝道的交通慢得在爬进。

mug.en: He picked up his mug and blew off the steam.
He stirred instant coffee into a mug of hot water.
mug.zh: 他将速溶咖啡搅入一大杯热水中。

mug.en: The mug tipped over, spilling hot coffee everywhere.
mug.zh: 杯子倒了，热咖啡溅得到处都是。

relaxed.zh: 这酒使他浑身发暖轻松起来。
午餐时的气氛是轻松的。

relaxed.en: She looked relaxed as she plucked a chicken.
relaxed.zh: 她拔鸡毛的时候看上去很轻松。

hail.zh: 我们顶着冰雹和大雪开车。

hail.en: Hail was hammering down onto the roof.
It started to hail, huge great stones.
hail.zh: 天空开始下冰雹，巨大的雹子。

whatsoever.en: They showed no consideration whatsoever for my feelings.
whatsoever.zh: 他们根本不体谅我的感情。

whatsoever.en: My school did nothing whatsoever in the way of athletics.
whatsoever.zh: 我的学校就体育运动而言没有任何作为。

whatsoever.en: I have had very little help from doctors and no sympathy whatsoever.
whatsoever.zh: 我从医生那儿得到的帮助极少，而且没得到任何同情。

notify.en: Please notify us if the above is not correct.
notify.zh: 如果上面所说的不正确，请通知我们。

notify.en: The only course of action left to me was to notify her employer.
notify.zh: 我可能采取的唯一措施就是通知她的雇主。

notify.en: We may vary the limit at our discretion and will notify you of any change.
notify.zh: 我们可酌情决定更改限制，并会将任何变更通知你。

garment.en: He was wearing a strange shapeless garment.
garment.zh: 他穿着一件没样子的奇怪衣服。

garment.en: The thicker the material, the less susceptible the garment will be to wet conditions.
garment.zh: 布料越厚，衣服通常就越不容易浸湿。

naive.en: Their approach to life is refreshingly naive.
naive.zh: 他们对待生活的态度天真率直，令人耳目一新。

naive.en: Their view was that he had been politically naive.
naive.zh: 他们的看法是，他在政治上曾是幼稚的。

naive.en: It's naive to think that teachers are always tolerant.
naive.zh: 认为老师总是很宽容是幼稚的。

activate.en: Anything from cosmic rays to radiation to diet may activate a dormant oncogene.
activate.zh: 从宇宙射线到辐射到日常饮食，任何东西都可能激活潜伏的致癌基因。

activate.en: Now they are trying to figure out what molecular signaling processes activate those seed-building genes in resurrection plants—and how to reproduce them in crops.
activate.zh: 如今，她们正试图弄清楚哪些分子信号转导过程激活了复苏植物的种子发育基因，以及如何将其复制到农作物上。

activate.en: They only stimulate and activate our immune system to work, telling it something harmful is coming in.
activate.zh: 它们只是刺激并激活我们的免疫系统工作，告诉它有害的东西来了。

exert.en: A number of neurotransmitters exert their effects by first increasing cyclic AMP concentrations in target neurons.
exert.zh: 许多神经递质首先通过增加靶神经元中的循环 AMP 浓度来发挥其作用。

exert.en: In order to be successful he would have to exert himself.
We all know that when we exert ourselves our heart rate increases.
exert.zh: 大家都知道，当我们竭尽全力时，心率会加速。

kindergarten.en: My musical career consisted of playing the triangle in kindergarten.
kindergarten.zh: 我的音乐生涯包括在幼儿园演奏三角铁。

kindergarten.en: Some drawings by kindergarten kids are excellent.
kindergarten.zh: 幼儿园小朋友画的一些画非常棒。

cereal.en: He ate a large bowlful of cereal.
cereal.zh: 他吃了一大碗谷类早餐。

cereal.en: I have a bowl of cereal every morning.
cereal.zh: 我每天早上吃一碗麦片粥。

cereal.en: I munched my way through a huge bowl of cereal.
cereal.zh: 我狼吞虎咽地喝了一大碗麦片粥。

certification.en: An employer can demand written certification that the relative is really ill.
certification.zh: 雇主可要求书面证明以证实这位亲属确实病了。

certification.en: It could have meant the end as far as the certification process was concerned.
certification.zh: 就认证过程而言，这可能意味着结束。

certification.en: Some states require parents or a home tutor to meet teacher certification standards.
certification.zh: 一些州要求家长或家庭教师达到教师资格认证标准。

fracture.en: I had a stress fracture in my left shin.
fracture.zh: 我的左小腿出现应力性骨折。

fracture.en: Old people's bones are more prone to fracture.
He suffered a hairline fracture of the right index finger.
fracture.zh: 他的右手食指上出现一处丝状骨折。

turnover.en: We have a fast turnover of stock.

turnover.zh: 去年我们的营业额竟然增加了。

sensible.en: A luggage rack is a sensible option.
sensible.zh: 行李架是个明智的选择。

sensible.en: It might be sensible to get a lawyer.
sensible.zh: 找个律师可能会是明智的。

sensible.en: The former option would be much more sensible.
sensible.zh: 前一种选择要明智得多。

pyramid.en: A twenty-foot steel pyramid is to be hoisted into position on top of the tower.
pyramid.zh: 一座20英尺高的钢制金字塔将被吊到塔顶该放的位置上。

pyramid.en: Traditionally, the Brahmins, or the priestly class, are set at the top of the social pyramid.
pyramid.zh: 传统上，婆罗门或僧侣阶层位于社会金字塔的顶层。

pyramid.en: The last group put the stones into the pyramid.
pyramid.zh: 最后一组把石头放进金字塔。

bachelor.en: He's the most eligible bachelor in Japan.
bachelor.zh: 他是日本最令人中意的单身汉。

bachelor.en: He is an eligible bachelor in this city.
bachelor.zh: 他是这个城市里的黄金单身汉。

bachelor.en: Believe it or not, he is still a bachelor.
bachelor.zh: 信不信由你，他还是个单身汉。

tract.en: Foods are broken down in the digestive tract.
tract.zh: 食物在消化道内被分解。

tract.en: A vast tract of land is ready for development.
She produced a feminist tract, "Comments on Birth-Control," in 1930.
tract.zh: 她1930年写了一篇女性主义短文《论计划生育》。

operational.en: The new airport is now fully operational.
operational.zh: 新机场现在可全面投入运营。

operational.en: The nuclear industry was required to prove that every operational and safety aspect had been fully researched.
operational.zh: 核工业需要证明每一个操作和安全项目都已全面调查过。

operational.en: The designers are often insensitive to the operational complexities of their machines.
operational.zh: 设计者往往对机器的操作复杂性不敏感。

decoration.en: He gave Stephanie a free hand in the decoration.
decoration.zh: 他让斯蒂芬妮在装潢时便宜行事。

decoration.en: It was a building without any adornment or decoration.
decoration.zh: 它曾是一栋完全未经装修的大楼。

decoration.en: The room was austere, nearly barren of furniture or decoration.
decoration.zh: 这个房间很简朴，几乎没有什么家具或装饰。

convincing.zh: 我们最重要的问题是说服他们。
她将编造一个有说服力的解释。

convincing.en: His sales pitch was smooth and convincing.
convincing.zh: 他的推销辞令流畅且令人信服。

descendant.en: He was an O'Conor and a direct descendant of the last High King of Ireland.
descendant.zh: 他属于奥康纳家族，是爱尔兰最后一位君王的嫡系后裔。

descendant.en: These adaptations served their descendant well as they invaded land.
descendant.zh: 这些适应机制在它们的后代进化成陆生生物时起了很好的协助作用。

descendant.en: This method tells you all information you need to know: whether one node is descendant of an ancestor of the other, whether it is before or after, and so on.
descendant.zh: 这个方法告诉您所有想知道的信息：一个节点是否是另一个节点的祖先的后代，它是在前面还是后面呢，等等。

freeway.en: The speed limit on the freeway is 55mph.
freeway.zh: 这条高速公路的限速为每小时55英里。

freeway.en: He slewed the motorbike over as they hit the freeway.
freeway.zh: 他们冲到高速公路时，他赶紧把摩托车调转方向。

freeway.en: Smoke began to spread across the freeway like fog.
freeway.zh: 烟开始像浓雾一样在高速公路上蔓延。

lump.en: I've got a lump on my shoulder.
She impaled a lump of meat on her fork.
The potter shaped and squeezed the lump of clay into a graceful shape.
lump.zh: 制陶工人把一块黏土塑形，压成漂亮的形状。

scarf.zh: 有人把我的围巾拿走了。

scarf.en: She tied her scarf over her head.

newsletter.zh: 我们出版一份通讯月刊。

newsletter.en: We shoved a copy of the newsletter beneath their door.
newsletter.zh: 我们在他们的门下塞了一份时事通讯。

newsletter.en: A monthly newsletter would contain stories about overwhelmed parents and offer guidance on how childless adults can respond to the different lobbying tactics that would-be grandparents employ.
newsletter.zh: 每月的时事通讯将包含有关不堪重负的父母的故事，并提供指导，指导无子女的成年人如何应对准祖父母采用的各种游说策略。

clash.en: The only victors in a head-on clash between the president and the assembly would be the hardliners on both sides.
clash.zh: 总统与议会间正面冲突的惟一赢家将是双方的强硬派。
他们不会（一起工作）；有时他们会有冲突。

clash.en: It's a pity the two concerts clash; I want to go to both.
clash.zh: 可惜两个音乐会时间冲突，我都想去听。

upward.en: She started once again on the steep upward climb.
upward.zh: 她再次沿着峭壁开始向上攀爬。

upward.en: Unemployment will continue upward for much of this year.
upward.zh: 失业率今年大部分时间将继续上升。

upward.en: The chopper shot upward in a manoeuvre matched by the other pilot.
upward.zh: 这架直升飞机向上冲去，另一架飞机也以相同的移动方向冲了上去。

mammal.en: A whale is a kind of mammal.
Bats is the only mammal that can fly.
mammal.zh: 蝙蝠是唯一能飞的哺乳动物。

imitate.en: Teachers provide a model for children to imitate.
imitate.zh: 教师是孩子仿效的典范。

imitate.en: He could imitate in speech or writing most of those he admired.
imitate.zh: 他能在口语或书写中模仿大多数他崇拜的人。

pumpkin.en: Pumpkin pie is a traditional American dish served on Thanksgiving.
pumpkin.zh: 南瓜馅饼是美国传统的感恩节食物。

multiply.zh: 这些生物能迅速大量繁殖。

multiply.en: What do you get if you multiply six by nine?

configuration.en: Prices range from $119 to $199, depending on the particular configuration.
configuration.zh: 价格根据配置的不同从119美元到199美元不等。

configuration.en: The precise configuration of a heat island depends on several factors.
configuration.zh: 热岛的精确结构取决于几个因素。

configuration.en: If this is the initial configuration, the server should not be running.
configuration.zh: 如果这是初始配置，则服务器不应该在运行。

velvet.zh: 她身着蓝色的天鹅绒服装。

velvet.en: She was arrayed in a black velvet gown.
velvet.zh: 她穿着一件黑色天鹅绒长礼服。

velvet.en: I taped the base of the feather onto the velvet.
velvet.zh: 我用胶带把羽毛的根部粘到天鹅绒上。

compost.zh: 这堆碎屑慢慢地分解变成了堆肥。

compost.en: I sow the seed in pots of soil-based compost.
compost.zh: 我把种子种在一盆盆施有堆肥的土里。

compost.en: The compost is specially formulated for pot plants.
compost.zh: 此混合肥料专门用于盆栽植物。

notorious.zh: 他的急性子已臭名远扬。

notorious.en: He is a notorious guy in many girls' eyes.
notorious.zh: 在许多女孩子眼里，他是个臭名昭著的家伙。

notorious.en: Hughes virtually ignores Edison's famous contemporary and notorious adversary in the field of electric light and power, George Westinghouse.
notorious.zh: 休斯实际上忽略了爱迪生在电灯和电力领域的同时代著名的、臭名昭著的对手乔治·威斯汀豪斯。

cough.zh: 格雷厄姆开始剧烈地咳嗽。

cough.en: Dirt from the motorway made him cough.
cough.zh: 公路上的灰尘使他咳嗽起来。

cough.en: Contact your doctor if the cough persists.
cough.zh: 如果持续咳嗽，就与医生联系。

lethal.en: The barriers are lethal to fish trying to swim upstream.
lethal.zh: 这些障碍物对于逆流而上的鱼来说是致命的。

lethal.en: They were close to weaponizing ricin - a lethal plant toxin.
lethal.zh: 他们快把蓖麻毒素——一种致命的植物毒素——研发成武器了。

lethal.en: The potentially lethal device was made from a length of hose packed with gunpowder, primers, and shrapnel.
lethal.zh: 这个能致命的装置是用一根装满火药、引信和弹片的软管做出来的。

stereo.en: He put some jazz on the stereo.
stereo.zh: 他用立体声音响播放了一点爵士乐。

stereo.en: She set up her stereo in her bedroom.
stereo.zh: 她把立体声音响装在了卧室里。

stereo.en: This is FM stereo one oh three point seven.
stereo.zh: 这里是调频立体声广播103.7兆赫。

olive.zh: 她穿了一件橄榄绿的T恤衫。

olive.en: She speared an olive with her fork.
olive.zh: 她用叉子扎起一个橄榄。

olive.en: Olive oil and garlic feature prominently in his recipes.
olive.zh: 橄榄油和大蒜在他的食谱中显得很重要。

roller.en: A boy of about ten came up on roller skates.
roller.zh: 一个大约十岁的男孩穿着双排四轮旱冰鞋滑了过来。

roller.en: The last few weeks have been a real roller coaster.
roller.zh: 过去的几个星期，形势真是变幻莫测。

roller.en: A cinema and roller rink attracted customers and profit.
roller.zh: 一家兼作溜冰场的电影院吸引了顾客，也招来了利润。

entail.en: What kind of responsibilities does that job entail?
entail.zh: 那份工作需要承担什么样的责任？

entail.en: Self-awareness, even in its earliest stages, might entail an awareness of others, the ability to see their perspective, to look at the world from another's point of view.
entail.zh: 自我意识，即使在它的最初阶段，也可能需要他人意识，即从他人的角度看世界的能力。

entail.en: It will entail driving a long distance every day.
entail.zh: 这意味着每天都要长途开车。

credential.en: The system might use a smart identity card, or a digital credential linked to a specific computer and would authenticate users at a range of online services.
credential.zh: 该系统可能使用智能身份证或连接到特定计算机的数字证书，并在一系列在线服务中认证用户。

credential.en: The authentication mechanisms' implementation might have weaknesses and allow, for example, credential interception and replay.
credential.zh: 身份验证机制的实现可能存在弱点，比如准许凭证拦截和重播。

credential.en: Add a network interface and SAP credential.

swirl.zh: 长长的藤葛盘绕在树身上。

swirl.en: The reason for this swirl of maritime outlawry can be found on the nearest shore.
swirl.zh: 造成这种海上流亡者漩涡的原因可以在最近的岸上找到。

swirl.en: If he/she goes into a negative swirl, ignore or give a simple "I see' or 'OK" reply.
swirl.zh: 如果他/她陷入了消极的漩涡中，忽略或者用简单的“我明白了”或“好”来答复。

toast.en: He was choking on a piece of toast.
toast.zh: 他被一块烤面包噎得透不过气来。

toast.en: You'll be as warm as toast in here.
toast.zh: 你在这里会感到暖烘烘的。

distraction.zh: 一想到这里，他就心烦意乱。

distraction.en: It causes lots of distraction to drivers.
The children are driving me to distraction today.
distraction.zh: 今天孩子们闹得我心烦意乱。

livestock.en: The heavy rains and flooding killed scores of livestock.
livestock.zh: 大雨和洪水淹死了许多家畜。

livestock.en: The robots are not limited to herding and monitoring livestock.
livestock.zh: 这些机器人并非仅能用于放牧和监控牲畜。

livestock.en: A livestock vaccine against the disease exists but is rarely used.
livestock.zh: 有一种家畜疫苗可以预防这种疾病，但它很少被使用。

fling.en: She claims she had a brief fling with him 30 years ago.
fling.zh: 她声称30年前曾跟他有过一段短暂的风流韵事。

fling.en: He was determined to have one last fling before retiring.
fling.zh: 他决心在退休前最后痛痛快快地玩乐一番。
“把这姑娘扔到海里去。”胡克喊道。

basin.en: Water dripped into a basin at the back of the room.
basin.zh: 水滴入房间后面的一个盆里。

basin.en: We were given a basin of water to wash our hands in.
basin.zh: 我们得到了一盆水洗手。

basin.en: When he had finished washing he began to wipe the basin clean.
basin.zh: 他洗漱完后开始把水盆擦干净。

heir.en: Her duty was to produce an heir to the throne.
heir.zh: 她的任务就是生育王位继承人。

heir.en: He is the eldest son and thus heir to the title.
heir.zh: 他是长子，因此是这个封号的继承人。

heir.en: He was heir to a large farm in Domleschg.
heir.zh: 他是多姆莱斯克一个大农场的继承人。

roam.en: I like to roam around the fields.
Barn eggs, sometimes called Percher, are laid by hens that have the freedom to roam a henhouse.
roam.zh: 谷仓蛋，有时被称为 Percher，是由在可以在鸡舍里自由漫步的母鸡下的蛋。

roam.en: Herds of elk, deer, and pronghorn antelope roam the grasslands, where visitors can camp, hike, and bike.
roam.zh: 驼鹿、鹿和叉角羚们已在草原上漫步，游客们可以在草原上野营、远足和骑车。

heroic.en: His heroic deeds were celebrated in every corner of India.
heroic.zh: 他的英勇事迹在印度的每个角落被传颂。

heroic.en: The heroic leader charged into battle, ready to smite the enemy.
heroic.zh: 英勇的军官冲上战场，准备重击敌人。

foam.en: All the sharp corners were padded with foam.
foam.zh: 所有的棱角都垫上了泡沫塑料。

foam.en: The breaking waves left the beach covered with foam.
foam.zh: 浪花四溅，海滩上满是泡沫。

foam.en: The water curved round the rocks in great bursts of foam.
foam.zh: 水流卷绕着岩石产生大量的泡沫。

asteroid.en: There is an asteroid on a collision course with the Earth.
asteroid.zh: 有个小行星正处于可能与地球发生碰撞的航向上。

asteroid.en: Scientists were debating whether an asteroid was about to hit the Earth.
asteroid.zh: 科学家们在争论一颗小行星是否要撞上地球。

asteroid.en: The largest asteroid is Ceres, which is about a quarter the size of the moon.
asteroid.zh: 最大的小行星是谷神星，其体积大约是月球的四分之一。

offset.en: The decline in marriage has been offset by a rise in cohabitation.
offset.zh: 同居人数的增加跟结婚人数的减少相抵消。

offset.en: Prices have risen in order to offset the increased cost of materials.
offset.zh: 为补偿原料成本的增加而提高了价格。

offset.en: A moderation in food prices helped to offset the first increase in energy prices.
offset.zh: 食品价格的降低有助于抵消能源价格的第一次上涨。

insure.en: Make sure you insure your camera against loss or damage.
insure.zh: 一定要给你的照相机投保，以防丢失或损坏。

insure.en: Families with modest incomes should insure the breadwinner or breadwinners first.
insure.zh: 收入不高的家庭应当首先为养家糊口的人投保。

insure.en: We insure against all damage, accidental or otherwise.
insure.zh: 我们的保险包括一切意外或其他损失。

interface.en: The system uses an impressive graphical interface.
interface.zh: 这一系统采用了特别好的图形界面。

interface.en: The adapter supports outbound mode only for this interface.
interface.zh: 对于此接口，适配器仅支持出站模式。

interface.en: In this case, however, my priority was not the batch interface.
interface.zh: 然而，在这种情况下，我的优先级不是成批接口。

anticipation.en: There's been an atmosphere of anticipation around here for a few days now.
anticipation.zh: 一种期待的氛围在这儿已存在几天了。

anticipation.en: He bought extra food in anticipation of more people coming than he'd invited.
anticipation.zh: 他预料来的客人会比邀请的多，就多买了食物。

straightforward.zh: 用法说明还算简单易懂。

straightforward.en: He was dependable, straightforward, the boy next door.
straightforward.zh: 他是个可靠、坦率的邻家男孩儿。

straightforward.en: She is very blunt, very straightforward, and very honest.
straightforward.zh: 她直言不讳，非常坦率，也非常诚实。

bald.en: The sun beat down on his bald pate.
bald.zh: 灼热的阳光直射到他那光光的秃顶上。

bald.en: The man's bald head was beaded with sweat.
bald.zh: 这位男子的秃头上满是汗珠。

bald.en: Our dog has a bald patch on its leg.
bald.zh: 我们的狗腿上脱了一片毛。

frustrating.en: I felt sorry for him and his colleagues – it must have been so frustrating for them.
frustrating.zh: 我很同情他和他的同事们–这对他们来说肯定是非常令人沮丧。

encouragement.en: Her words were a great encouragement to them.
encouragement.zh: 她的话对他们是极大的鼓舞。

encouragement.en: Friends gave me a great deal of encouragement.
encouragement.zh: 朋友们给了我极大的鼓励。

encouragement.en: He brightened up at their words of encouragement.
encouragement.zh: 听到他们鼓励的话，他高兴起来。

glorious.en: Harrison had a glorious career spanning more than six decades.
glorious.zh: 哈里森有过一段长达六十余年的辉煌的职业生涯。

glorious.en: The award of the Nobel Prize has crowned a glorious career in physics.
glorious.zh: 荣获诺贝尔奖使其物理学研究的辉煌事业达到了顶点。

glorious.en: They had three weeks of glorious sunshine.
glorious.zh: 他们度过了三周阳光灿烂的日子。

honesty.zh: 她的诚实是毋庸置疑的。
他的诚实是毋庸置疑的。
我可以担保她为人诚实。

crisp.en: Cook the bacon until it begins to crisp.
Bake until the pastry is golden and crisp.
crisp.zh: 把油酥糕点烤至金黄酥脆。

crisp.en: Bake the potatoes for 15 minutes, till they're nice and crisp.
crisp.zh: 把土豆烤15分钟，直到变得香脆可口。

sausage.en: The knife for cutting sausage was sitting in the sink.
sausage.zh: 用于切香肠的刀在水槽里。

fearful.en: Bankers were fearful of a world banking crisis.
fearful.zh: 银行家们害怕会有一场世界性的银行业危机。

fearful.en: They are fearful that unemployment will soon break the barrier of three million.
fearful.zh: 他们担心失业人数不久将突破300万大关。

fearful.en: What on earth are we fearful of?

selective.zh: 记忆有选择性而且会出错。

selective.en: We seem to have a selective memory for the best bits of the past.
selective.zh: 我们似乎对过去最美好的时光有选择性的记忆。
他们执行严格挑选的录取政策。

deprive.en: To deprive the boy of his education is a violation of state law.
deprive.zh: 剥夺这个男孩的受教育权是一种违反州法律的行为。

deprive.en: It may deprive a team of business opportunities.
deprive.zh: 它可能会剥夺一个团队的商业机会。

deprive.en: This will deprive your body of vital energy needs.
deprive.zh: 这将剥夺你身体对生命能量的需求。

overturn.en: Recent evidence of subtle interactions between earthquakes may overturn this assumption, however.
overturn.zh: 然而，最近有关地震之间微妙的相互作用的证据可能会推翻这一假设。

overturn.en: They overturn rocks to find them and consuming as many as 40,000 apiece in a single day.
overturn.zh: 为了找到这些他们，它们会翻倒岩石，一天就能消耗4万多块。

overturn.en: The state already has a "trigger law" on the books, which would ban most abortions, if the Supreme Court overturn Roe v Wade.
overturn.zh: 该州已将“触发法律”写入法律，如果最高法院对罗诉韦德案进行翻案，这条法律会禁止大多数的堕胎行为。

transcript.en: We don't know how the transcript leaked.
transcript.zh: 我们不知道抄本是怎样泄露的。

transcript.en: Start Squeak, click Tools, then drag a workspace and transcript window onto your desktop.
transcript.zh: 启动 Squeak，单击工具（Tools），拖拽一个工作空间（workspace）和抄本（transcript）窗口到桌面。

transcript.en: You will need to combine appropriate information from the text and the transcript to provide a complete answer to the question.
transcript.zh: 你需要结合文本和抄本中的合适信息，组织一个完整的答案回答该问题。

compact.zh: 它们的身体光滑而紧实。

compact.en: It was a compact fluorescent light bulb.
compact.zh: 那是一个紧凑型荧光灯管。

compact.en: It was indeed very compact and comfortable.
compact.zh: 它确实非常紧凑和舒适。

standpoint.en: From a medical standpoint a week is usually not a consequential delay.
standpoint.zh: 从医学观点看，一周通常不被视为是严重的拖延。

standpoint.en: He believes that from a military standpoint, the situation is under control.
standpoint.zh: 他认为从军事角度来看，局势已得到控制。

standpoint.en: This argument is untenable from an intellectual, moral and practical standpoint.
standpoint.zh: 从知识、道德和现实的角度来看，这种论点是站不住脚的。

empower.en: You must delegate effectively and empower people to carry out their roles with your full support.
empower.zh: 你们必须有效地下放权力，使人们能够在你们的全力支持下履行他们的职责。

empower.en: It is in the classroom that caring and respect for each person empower children to take a step forward toward becoming peacemakers.
empower.zh: 正是在教室里，对彼此的关心和尊重使孩子们朝着成为和平缔造者的方向迈出了一步。

mainland.en: Similar trends are observable in mainland Europe.
mainland.zh: 类似的趋势在欧洲大陆也能见到。

mainland.en: The island is joined to the mainland by a bridge.
mainland.zh: 这个岛有一座桥与大陆相连。

mainland.en: The Hebrides are to the west of the Scottish mainland.
mainland.zh: 赫布里底群岛位于苏格兰本土的西面。

flourish.en: These plants flourish in a damp climate.
flourish.zh: 这些植物在潮湿的气候下长势茂盛。

flourish.en: He opened the door for her with a flourish.
flourish.zh: 他做了一个夸张动作为她开了门。

flourish.en: Keep the soil moist. That way, the seedling will flourish.
flourish.zh: 保持土壤湿润,那样小苗就会茁壮成长。

tug.en: The tug crossed our stern not fifty yards away.
tug.zh: 那艘拖船在不到50码的地方与我们的船尾错过。

tug.en: Waiting for the Star Ferry, I see the winking lights of tug boats as they fuss around a cruise ship.
tug.zh: 在等天星轮的时候，我看到拖船的灯光闪烁着，它们在一艘游轮的周围忙乱着。

tug.en: Finally, scientists measure the star's wobble due to the planet's gravitational tug, known as the radial velocity.
tug.zh: 最后，科学家测量了由于行星的引力拖拉而产生的恒星摆动，这就是径向速度。

shiver.zh: 剧烈的颤抖使他抽搐不已。

shiver.en: A chill shiver rippled over his skin.
shiver.zh: 一阵寒颤传遍了他全身。

shiver.en: A cold shiver ran down her spine.

solidarity.en: There was a degree of solidarity and sisterhood among the women.
solidarity.zh: 这些女人之间具有一定程度的团结精神和姐妹情谊。

solidarity.en: The solidarity among China's various nationalities is as firm as a rock.
solidarity.zh: 中国各族人民之间的团结坚如磐石。

solidarity.en: Durkheim proposed that religious beliefs functioned to reinforce social solidarity.
solidarity.zh: 迪尔凯姆提出宗教信仰的作用是加强社会团结。

lobster.en: One of the most popular events is a clambake with unlimited portions of clams, lobster, and seafood salad.
lobster.zh: 那种提供不限量蛤蜊、龙虾和凉拌海鲜的野餐是最受欢迎的活动之一。

lobster.en: Waiter, this lobster has only one claw.
lobster.zh: 服务员，这个龙虾只有一只爪。

discharge.en: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay Miss Smith $500 compensation.
discharge.zh: 他被判有条件释放，并被命令向史密斯小姐支付$500的赔偿金。

discharge.en: There was a watery discharge from her ear.
discharge.zh: 她的耳朵里有水状物流出。

discharge.en: He received an honourable discharge from the army.

saddle.en: I want to be gone from here as soon as we can saddle up.
saddle.zh: 我想一配好鞍就离开这儿。

saddle.en: Why don't we saddle a couple of horses and go for a ride?
saddle.zh: 为什么我们不给几匹马配上鞍骑着转转？

saddle.en: It had a saddle with springs sticking out, which wore away the seat of my trousers.
saddle.zh: 马鞍上的弹簧翘了出来，磨坏了我臀部的裤子。

occurrence.en: Vandalism used to be a rare occurrence here.
occurrence.zh: 过去这里很少发生故意破坏公物的事。

occurrence.en: Complaints seemed to be an everyday occurrence.
occurrence.zh: 投诉似乎成了天天发生的事。

occurrence.en: One of them is a word counter, which counts for certain word occurrence in several files.
occurrence.zh: 其中之一是单词计数器，它统计某一单词在几个文件中出现的次数。

lasting.en: The training was of no lasting value.
lasting.zh: 这种训练不会有长久的效果。

lasting.en: We are well on our way to a lasting peace.
lasting.zh: 我们正迈向持久的和平。

lasting.en: We can't count on the good weather lasting.
lasting.zh: 我们不能指望这样好的天气会持久。

abundant.en: There is an abundant supply of cheap labour.
abundant.zh: 有丰富的廉价劳动力供应。

abundant.en: I have ever had abundant love experiences.
abundant.zh: 我曾经有过丰富的感情经历。

abundant.en: Our country has a vast territory and abundant resources.
abundant.zh: 我国土地辽阔， 资源丰富。

prone.en: He was found lying in a prone position.
These plants are peculiarly prone to disease.
prone.zh: 这些植物特别容易发生病变。

prone.en: Old people's bones are more prone to fracture.

hose.en: Mrs. Morrell reached for a loop of garden hose.
hose.zh: 莫雷尔夫人伸手去拿一圈橡胶软管。

hose.en: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
hose.zh: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管吸走。

aggressively.zh: 他们会凶猛地作出反应。

aggressively.en: She swished her racket aggressively through the air.
aggressively.zh: 她咄咄逼人地把球拍挥舞得呼呼作响。

burial.en: The priest prepared the body for burial.
burial.zh: 牧师为尸体做好了下葬的准备。

burial.en: The bones were disinterred and moved to a burial site.
burial.zh: 骨头被掘出并移到了一片墓地。

burial.en: His family insisted he should be given a proper burial.
burial.zh: 他的家人坚持要为他举行适当的葬礼。

formidable.en: We have a formidable task ahead of us.
formidable.zh: 我们面前有一项艰巨的任务。

formidable.en: The elderly are a formidable force in any election.
formidable.zh: 老年人在任何选举中都是一股强大的力量。

mobilize.en: If you could mobilize the resources, you could get it done.
mobilize.zh: 如果你能调动资源，你就能完成它。

mobilize.en: He helped energize and mobilize millions of people around the nation.
mobilize.zh: 他参与激励并动员了全国数百万人。

hammer.en: He hit the nail squarely on the head with the hammer.
hammer.zh: 他用锤子正对着钉子敲下去。

hammer.en: We had to hammer and shout before they would open up.
hammer.zh: 我们不得不砰砰敲打并大喊大叫，他们才会开门。

vigorous.en: She was a very vigorous sort of person.
vigorous.zh: 她是那种精力非常旺盛的人。

vigorous.en: Vita was a trailblazer, a vigorous independent.
vigorous.zh: 维塔是一位开拓者，一个精力充沛的独立派。

vigorous.en: Theodore Roosevelt was a strong and vigorous politician.
vigorous.zh: 西奥多·罗斯福是一位身体强壮、精力充沛的政治家。

packet.en: He went out to buy a packet of cigarettes.
They ate the packet of biscuits all in one go.
packet.zh: 他们一下子把那包饼干全吃光了。

packet.en: A packet of photographs arrived with the mail.

questionable.en: He has been dogged by allegations of questionable business practices.
questionable.zh: 他一直被有可疑商业行为的传言困扰着。
她帮忙的动机令人生疑。

questionable.en: The conclusions that they come to are highly questionable.
questionable.zh: 他们得出的结论大有问题。

fond.zh: 我不怎么太喜爱意大利面食。

fond.en: I have grown very fond of Alec.
fond.zh: 我已变得很喜欢亚力克。

poise.en: What amazed him even more than her appearance was her poise.
poise.zh: 比她的长相更让他惊讶的是她的沉着镇定。

poise.en: To be a successful fashion model, a guy needs to be more than just a looker. He has to have confidence, poise and a sense of style.
poise.zh: 要成为一个成功的时装模特，一个人不仅要长相出众。他还必需要自信、优雅并有时尚感。

poise.en: A Pickpocket Needs Poise, Patience And panache.
poise.zh: 扒窃是一门需要沉着、耐心与范儿的艺术。

surplus.en: Surplus grain is being sold for export.
surplus.zh: 过剩的谷物正销往国外。

surplus.en: If you eat too much, the surplus is laid down as fat.
surplus.zh: 要是吃得太多，过剩的营养就会堆积成为脂肪。

marital.en: They cited Alex's refusal to return to the marital home.
marital.zh: 他们援引了亚历克斯拒绝重返婚后住所这一事实为证。

marital.en: People are not tolerant of extra-marital peccadilloes by public figures.
marital.zh: 人们不能容忍公众人物婚外过失。

vicious.en: We need to break the vicious cycle of violence and counterviolence.
vicious.zh: 我们需要结束暴力和反暴力的恶性循环。

vicious.en: Their loss was partly due to a vicious price war between manufacturers that has cut margins to the bone.
vicious.zh: 他们的亏损部分是因为制造商之间把利润空间削减到了极点的一场恶性价格战。

vicious.en: The more pesticides are used, the more resistant the insects become so the more pesticides have to be used. It's a vicious circle.
vicious.zh: 杀虫剂使用得越多，那些昆虫的抵抗力越强，因此就要使用更多的杀虫剂。这是一个恶性循环。

surroundings.zh: 我们在富丽堂皇的环境中用餐。

surroundings.en: She felt uneasy in the unfamiliar surroundings.
surroundings.zh: 她在陌生的环境中感到局促不安。

surroundings.en: Schumacher adapted effortlessly to his new surroundings.
surroundings.zh: 舒马赫毫不费力地适应了他的新环境。

eagle.zh: 一只鹰在头顶上空盘旋。

eagle.en: The eagle was an emblem of strength and courage.
eagle.zh: 鹰是力量和勇气的象征。

photographic.en: The equipment of the photographic studio was expensive.
photographic.zh: 这个摄影室的装备花费巨大。

photographic.en: I'd been working as a sales rep for a photographic company.
photographic.zh: 我一直在担任一家摄影公司的销售代表。

photographic.en: A photographic exhibition opens at the Smithsonian on Wednesday.
photographic.zh: 一个摄影展周三在史密森尼博物馆开幕。

wedge.en: He hammered the wedge into the crack in the stone.
wedge.zh: 他用锤子把楔子砸入石缝里。

wedge.en: A small curve in the sliding part of the convex top of the lower nut acts as the wedge.
wedge.zh: 下螺母凸顶的滑动零件上有一条小弧线充当楔块。

wedge.en: The logograms were incised on damp clay tablets with a stylus with a wedge shape at its end.
wedge.zh: 这些标识是用一根末端为楔形的手写笔在潮湿的泥板上刻下的。

sandy.en: He checked the sandy areas of the arroyo for any tracks.
sandy.zh: 他检查了旱谷沙地的所有痕迹。

sandy.en: Sandy leaned across the table, his face uncomfortably close to Brad's.
sandy.zh: 桑迪将身体探过桌子，他的脸贴近布拉德的脸，使布拉德感觉很不自在。

tense.en: A massage will relax those tense muscles.
tense.zh: 按摩会使紧张的肌肉松弛。

tense.en: The massage relaxed my tense back muscles.
tense.zh: 按摩使得我背部紧张的肌肉松弛下来。
泡个澡能放松紧绷的肌肉。

server.en: The server is designed to store huge amounts of data.
server.zh: 该服务器是为存储大量数据设计的。

server.en: I'll run a diagnostic test to see why the server keeps crashing.
server.zh: 我要做诊断测试，弄清为什么服务器总是不断地生故障。

pharmaceutical.en: They're all groaning about soaring health budgets, the fastest-growing component of which are pharmaceutical costs.
pharmaceutical.zh: 他们都在抱怨飞速上涨的医疗预算，其中增长最快的部分是药品成本。

pharmaceutical.en: They're all groaning about soaring health budgets, the fastest-growing component of which are pharmaceutical costs.
pharmaceutical.zh: 他们都在抱怨飞涨的医疗预算，其中增长最快的部分是药品成本。

pharmaceutical.en: It unties the hands of the pharmaceutical industry so that they can begin treating the disease and not just the side effects.
pharmaceutical.zh: 这为制药行业松绑，这样，他们就可以开始治疗这种疾病，而不仅仅是治疗疾病的副作用。

comparative.en: The task was accomplished with comparative ease.
comparative.zh: 这项任务完成得比较容易。

comparative.en: A Washington newspaper published comparative profiles of the candidates' wives.
comparative.zh: 一家华盛顿的报纸刊登了候选人妻子们的对比简介。

comparative.en: MIT Comparative Media Studies offers both undergraduate degree opportunities and a two-year course of study leading to an SM degree.
comparative.zh: 麻省理工学院比较媒介研究提供了获得本科学位的机会，同时经过两年学习可以得到理科硕士的学位。

disturbance.en: He was charged with causing a disturbance after the game.
disturbance.zh: 他被指控在比赛结束后制造骚乱。

disturbance.en: During the disturbance which followed, three Englishmen were hurt.
disturbance.zh: 在随后的骚乱中，3个英国人受伤了。

disturbance.en: The building work is creating constant noise, dust and disturbance.
disturbance.zh: 建筑施工不断制造噪音、灰尘和干扰。

leisure.en: Leisure is often defined in opposition to work.
leisure.zh: 休闲常被定义为工作的反面。

leisure.en: Whale-watching has become a growth leisure industry.
leisure.zh: 观鲸业已成为一个快速发展的休闲产业。

leisure.en: These days we have more money and more leisure to enjoy it.
leisure.zh: 如今我们有更多的钱和空闲时间来享受了。

vegetation.en: We fought our way through the dense vegetation.
vegetation.zh: 我们在茂密的植被中开出一条通路。

vegetation.en: The hills are covered in lush green vegetation.
vegetation.zh: 这片丘岭草木茂盛，郁郁葱葱。

vegetation.en: The inn has a garden of semi-tropical vegetation.
vegetation.zh: 这家小酒店的花园里种着亚热带植物。

emit.en: The metal container began to emit a clicking sound.
emit.zh: 金属容器开始发出咔嗒咔嗒的声音。

emit.en: These cars emit more than all the microwaves in the EU.
emit.zh: 这些汽车的排放量超过了欧盟国家所有微波炉的排放量。

emit.en: Soil tilling releases carbon dioxide, and delivery vehicles emit exhaust.
emit.zh: 耕作翻土会释放二氧化碳，而运输车辆会排放废气。

magnet.en: The important fact is that the two poles of the magnet work in opposite ways.
magnet.zh: 重要的事实是，磁体两极的运行方式完全相反。

magnet.en: It's possible to hang a nail from a magnet and then use that nail to pick up another nail.
magnet.zh: 把一颗钉子挂在一个磁体上再用这颗钉子去吸起另一颗钉子是可能的。

magnet.en: I do clinical at a magnet hospital.
magnet.zh: 我在磁力医院做临床工作。

prototype.en: Chris Retzler has built a prototype of a machine called the wave rotor.
prototype.zh: 克里斯·雷兹勒做出了一台叫做波转子的样机。

prototype.en: The prototype is, by all accounts, athletic, good-natured and supersmart.
prototype.zh: 所有人都说，它的原型体格健壮、性情温和、非常聪明。

prototype.en: We broke up into groups, and each group designed its own toy and made an alpha prototype.
prototype.zh: 我们分成几个小组，每个小组都设计了自己的玩具并制作了一个 alpha 原型。

anthropologist.en: Look at your work environment like an anthropologist.
anthropologist.zh: 像人类学家一样观察你的工作环境。

anthropologist.en: The biological anthropologist Christy Turner is an expert in the analysis of changing physical characteristics in human teeth.
anthropologist.zh: 生物人类学家克里斯蒂·特纳是分析人类牙齿的物理特性变化的专家。

anthropologist.en: The anthropologist Alexander Marshack has an interesting interpretation of some of the engravings made during the Upper Paleolithic.
anthropologist.zh: 人类学家亚历山大·马沙克对旧石器时代晚期的一些雕刻有一个有趣的解释。

contempt.en: They had shown a contempt for the values she thought important.
contempt.zh: 他们对她所认为重要的价值表示蔑视。

contempt.en: The complainant has been exposed to public odium, scandal, and contempt.
contempt.zh: 原告遭到了公众的憎恶、流言和蔑视。

seasonal.en: Most seasonal hiring is done in early October.
seasonal.zh: 多数季节性招聘是在10月初进行。

seasonal.en: The figures aren't adjusted for seasonal variations.
seasonal.zh: 这些数字未作季节性变化调整。
许多植物是季节性生长的。

acquaintance.en: I am delighted to make your acquaintance, Mrs Baker.
acquaintance.zh: 贝克太太，我很高兴与您相识。

acquaintance.en: I made the acquaintance of several musicians around that time.
acquaintance.zh: 大约在那段时间，我结识了几位音乐家。

acquaintance.en: Hammer's business pedigree almost guaranteed him the acquaintance of presidents.
acquaintance.zh: 哈默的商业背景几乎保证了他与几位总统的相识。

module.zh: 从一个模块转换到另一个模块。

module.en: Go download the module and get started.
module.zh: 去下载这个模块，然后开始。

module.en: You create a new module for the selector.
module.zh: 您为选择器创建一个新的模块。

disadvantage.zh: 主要的不利条件是什么？
我们在不公平的劣势下艰难地工作。

disadvantage.en: My lack of practical experience was a disadvantage.
disadvantage.zh: 我缺少实际经验是个不利条件。

stripe.en: She wore a bright green jogging suit with a white stripe down the sides.
stripe.zh: 她穿了一套侧边有一条白色条纹的艳绿色慢跑服。

stripe.en: To see that, look very closely at the bottom edge of the stripe in the next photo, about an inch to the left of center.
stripe.zh: 要想发现那个，可以往下张照片里条纹的底部边缘，大约在中间偏左一英寸处，使劲凑近看。

stripe.en: Some barrels are red with a white candy stripe on the sides.
stripe.zh: 有些桶是红色的，边上有白色的糖果条纹。

ample.en: There was ample time to get to the airport.
ample.zh: 有足够的时间到达机场。

ample.en: The driver had ample time to brake or swerve and avoid the woman.
ample.zh: 该司机有足够的时间刹车或急转来避让那女子。

exclaim.en: The spectacular sunrise made us exclaim in surprise.
exclaim.zh: 壮观的日出让我们惊叹不已。

exclaim.en: That's why you exclaim "Ouch" after staying away from the pain signals you encountered before.
exclaim.zh: 那就是为什么你远离开始遇到的疼痛信号后才惊叫“哎呦”的原因。

exclaim.en: Could we render this inimitable picture properly, then would everybody exclaim, "Beautiful, unparalleled Italy!"
exclaim.zh: 如果我们能把这幅独一无二的图画恰当地描绘出来，那么人人都会惊叹：“美丽无比的意大利！”

foremost.en: It is first and foremost a trade agreement.
foremost.zh: 它首先是一项贸易协定。

foremost.en: This question has been foremost in our minds recently.
foremost.zh: 近来我们的心目中一直认为这个问题最重要。

foremost.en: He does a little teaching, but first and foremost he's a writer.
foremost.zh: 他干一点教学，但首要的是写作。

potent.en: Crack is a highly potent and addictive derivative of cocaine.
potent.zh: 强效纯可卡因是一种药效极强、容易使人上瘾的可卡因制剂。

potent.en: This is one of the most potent ways, Tice found, to put anger to rest.
potent.zh: Tice 发现，这是平息愤怒最有效的方法之一。

potent.en: The other half of the name represents another ingredient, less infamous, perhaps, but also strangely potent: the kola nut.
potent.zh: 名字的另一半代表了另一种成分，也许不那么臭名昭著，但也有奇特的效力：可乐果。

den.en: He would often retire to his den.
den.zh: 他往往是回自己的书房去。

den.en: They made themselves a den in the woods.
den.zh: 他们在树林里为自己搭了个窝，在里面玩。

oyster.en: Oyster beds, on the mudflats, are a form of fish farming.
oyster.zh: 滩涂牡蛎养殖场是一种水产养殖方式。

oyster.en: You're enough to try the patience of an oyster!
oyster.zh: 你都够考验一个牡蛎的耐心了！

oyster.en: How can I pull the pearl from the burning oyster?
oyster.zh: 我怎样做才能算是从燃烧的牡蛎中取出珍珠？

adverse.en: This drug is known to have adverse side effects.
adverse.zh: 众所周知，这种药具有不良副作用。

adverse.en: The improper use of medicine could lead to severe adverse reactions.
adverse.zh: 用药不当会引起严重的不良反应。

adverse.en: Lack of money will have an adverse effect on our research programme.
adverse.zh: 缺少资金将对我们的研究方案有不利影响。

sorrow.zh: 悲剧性文学使悲伤和灾难显得尊贵。

sorrow.en: They said that the decision was made more in sorrow than in anger.
sorrow.zh: 他们说作出这个决定，与其说是出于气愤，不如说是出于悲伤。
悲伤使他的头发变白了。

conditioning.en: We wanted to reduce the cost of heating and air-conditioning.
conditioning.zh: 我们想减少供暖与空调的开支。

conditioning.en: It was 90 degrees and the air conditioning barely cooled the room.
conditioning.zh: 气温是90度，空调几乎没有使房间凉快下来。

conditioning.en: You can't open the window because it screws up the air conditioning.
conditioning.zh: 你不能开窗，因为那样会破坏空调。

pastry.en: The bread, pastry and mayonnaise are homemade.
pastry.zh: 面包、糕点和蛋黄酱都是自家做的。

pastry.en: It's really a cheat, but you can use ready-made pastry if you want.
pastry.zh: 这东西真是骗人，但如果你愿意的话，可以用现成的油酥面团。

pastry.en: These doughs can be rolled out while you wait for the pastry to chill.
pastry.zh: 当你等待油酥面团冷却时，可以擀平这些生面团。

scholarly.zh: 他是一个聪明博学的人。

scholarly.en: This has been the subject of intense scholarly debate.
scholarly.zh: 这一直是学术讨论的热门话题。

scholarly.en: His revolutionary work in linguistics has aroused intense scholarly interest.
scholarly.zh: 他在语言学方面的革命性著作引起了强烈的学术兴趣。

exaggerate.en: These figures exaggerate the loss of competitiveness.
exaggerate.zh: 这些数字夸大了竞争力的下降。

exaggerate.en: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms.
exaggerate.zh: 画家可能会夸大或扭曲形状与形式。

decisive.en: He is decisive and won't shrink from a fight.
decisive.zh: 他很果断，而且不会逃避战斗。

decisive.en: The might of the army could prove a decisive factor.
decisive.zh: 军队的力量最终可能成为一个决定性的因素。

decisive.en: This is a time of decisive action and quick thinking.
decisive.zh: 这个时刻需要行动果断、思维敏捷。

reactor.en: Exelon Corp. will explore building a new nuclear reactor downstate.
reactor.zh: 美国爱克斯龙电力公司会在州的最南部研发建造一个新的核反应堆。

reactor.en: The nuclear reactor was not damaged in the lightning storm that struck late last night.
reactor.zh: 核反应堆在昨晚后半夜的雷雨中没有受损。

reactor.en: The atomic reactor generates enormous amounts of thermal energy.
reactor.zh: 原子反应堆发出大量的热能。

volcano.zh: 他正在画一座巨型火山。

volcano.en: An active volcano may erupt at any time.
Sulphur gases were emitted by the volcano.
volcano.zh: 硫磺气体由火山喷发出来。

molecular.en: This substance has now been cloned by molecular biologists.
molecular.zh: 这种物质现已被分子生物学家克隆。

molecular.en: But these cylinders cling together at a molecular level.
molecular.zh: 但是这些圆柱体在分子水平上是紧密结合的。

molecular.en: In molecular orbital theory, we named orbits based on their symmetry.
molecular.zh: 在分子轨道理论中，我们基于轨道的对称性给它们命名。

greeting.zh: 他勉强用沙哑的嗓音打招呼。

arch.zh: 他从一座砖拱门下面走过。

arch.en: Marble Arch is a famous London landmark.
arch.zh: 大理石拱门是伦敦著名的标志性建筑。

arch.en: The arch once stood alone at the entrance to the castle.
arch.zh: 拱门曾经孤零零地矗立在城堡的入口处。

pasture.en: The cattle were put out to pasture.
pasture.zh: 牛群放牧在牧场草地上。

pasture.en: The cows are out now, grazing in the pasture.
pasture.zh: 牛群现在出去了，正在牧场上吃草。

pasture.en: It was absolutely essential to separate crops from the areas that animals used as pasture.
pasture.zh: 把庄稼与牲畜的放牧区分开至关重要。

rebellion.zh: 他们没有料到会发生叛乱。

rebellion.en: It roused a feeling of rebellion in him.
Soldiers went in to put down a rebellion.
rebellion.zh: 士兵们攻进去镇压了一场叛乱。

swamp.en: The site for the airport will be reclaimed from the swamp.
swamp.zh: 这片湿地将会被开发来建机场。

swamp.en: I spent one whole night by a swamp behind the road listening to frogs.
swamp.zh: 我整个晚上都在这条路后面的一个沼泽地旁听蛙鸣。

swamp.en: Elephants were often to be found in swamp in eastern Kenya around the Tana River.
swamp.zh: 大象经常会在肯尼亚东部沼泽塔纳河各处被发现。

deliberate.en: This was a deliberate piece of misinformation.
deliberate.zh: 这是一条故意提供的虚假消息。

deliberate.en: Witnesses say the firing was deliberate and sustained.
deliberate.zh: 目击者说这次射击是蓄意的，而且还持续了一段时间。

deliberate.en: The deliberate cruelty of his words cut her like a knife.
deliberate.zh: 他故意说的残酷无情的话对她像刀割一样。

constituency.zh: 她的选区的失业人数居高不下。

constituency.en: He owns a house in his Darlington constituency.
constituency.zh: 他在自己的选区达灵顿拥有一座房子。

constituency.en: More research should be done regarding the molecular constituency of food.
constituency.zh: 应该对食物的分子组成进行更多的研究。

dash.en: Oh, Tim! I'm sorry but I have to dash.
dash.zh: 噢，蒂姆！很抱歉，但我得赶紧走了。

dash.en: He cut quite a dash in his uniform.
dash.zh: 他穿着这身制服显得特帅。

dash.en: The rug adds a dash of colour to the room.
dash.zh: 小地毯为房间增添了一点色彩。

fictional.zh: 几乎所有小说里的侦探都是虚构的。

fictional.en: They gradually add more and more fictional elements.
fictional.zh: 渐渐地，他们加入了越来越多的虚构元素。

fictional.en: To begin with, how do we create fictional characters?
fictional.zh: 首先，我们如何创造虚构的人物？

bait.en: A trap was laid, with fresh bait.
bait.zh: 陷阱设置好，还投放了新诱饵。

bait.en: This type of trap uses no bait or other attractant.
bait.zh: 这种陷阱不用诱饵或其他引诱物。

usage.zh: 汽车的使用率预计会增长。

usage.en: He was a stickler for the correct usage of English.
usage.zh: 他是一个坚持英语的正确使用的人。

usage.en: Parts of the motor wore out because of constant usage.
usage.zh: 发动机的一些部件由于不断使用而磨损了。

sore.en: His feet were sore after the walk.

reef.en: The island is encircled by a coral reef.
reef.zh: 这个岛周围都是珊瑚礁。

reef.en: An unspoiled coral reef encloses the bay.
reef.zh: 未经破坏的珊瑚礁围绕着该海湾。

oath.en: He took an oath of loyalty to the government.
oath.zh: 他做了效忠于政府的宣誓。

oath.en: I have sworn an oath of loyalty to the monarchy.
oath.zh: 我已经发誓效忠君主制。

oath.en: Under oath, Andy finally admitted that he had lied.
oath.zh: 宣誓之后，安迪终于承认他曾撒了谎。

embargo.en: The embargo would only hurt innocent civilians.
embargo.zh: 禁运反而会伤及无辜的平民。

embargo.en: The United Nations imposed an arms embargo against the country.
embargo.zh: 联合国对该国施行了武器贸易禁运。

embargo.en: The ship was impounded under the terms of the UN trade embargo.
embargo.zh: 那条船因联合国贸易禁令而遭扣押。

erect.en: They plan to erect an apartment house on that property.
erect.zh: 他们计划在那片地产上建造一座公寓楼。

erect.en: Your job, as captain of your soul, is to erect dams to keep these passions in check.
erect.zh: 作为灵魂的船长，你的工作就是竖起堤坝来控制这些激情。

erect.en: Police had to erect barriers to keep crowds back.
erect.zh: 警察只得设立路障来阻截人群。

efficiently.en: How do you motivate people to work hard and efficiently?
efficiently.zh: 你是如何激励人们努力而高效地工作的？

efficiently.en: Services could be operated more efficiently and economically.
efficiently.zh: 可以更有效、更经济地提供服务。

efficiently.en: The plan is designed to motivate employees to work more efficiently.
efficiently.zh: 这个计划旨在促使员工更加卓有成效地工作。

implant.en: They felt a woman had a right to choose to have a breast implant.
implant.zh: 他们认为妇女有权利选择隆胸。
如果假体破损了，会发生什么？

implant.en: The implant is not a complete artificial eye.
implant.zh: 这个植入体并不是一个完整的人工眼睛。

blur.en: The events of that day were just a blur.
blur.zh: 那天发生的事只剩一片模糊的记忆。

blur.en: Everything is a blur when I take my glasses off.
blur.zh: 我摘掉眼镜什么都变得模糊不清。

blur.en: The victim's face was blotted out by a camera blur.
blur.zh: 受害者的面部图像被做了模糊处理。

deficiency.en: Vitamin deficiency in the diet can cause illness.
deficiency.zh: 饮食中缺乏维生素可能导致疾病。

deficiency.en: Opacity of the eye lens can be induced by deficiency of certain vitamins.
deficiency.zh: 眼球晶状体的混浊可由缺乏某些维生素引起。

deficiency.en: The most serious deficiency in NATO's air defence is the lack of an identification system to distinguish friend from foe.
deficiency.zh: 北约防空的最大缺陷就是缺乏能够辨认敌友的识别系统。

dietary.en: Dr. Susan Hankinson has studied the dietary habits of more than 50,000 women.
dietary.zh: 苏珊·汉金森博士研究了五万多名妇女的饮食习惯。

dietary.en: What do we learn from the Dietary Guidelines Advisory Committee's scientific report?
dietary.zh: 我们从膳食指南咨询委员会的科学报告中了解到了什么？

dietary.en: What may account for the neglect of sustainability in the USDA's Dietary Guidelines according to the author?
dietary.zh: 作者认为，是什么原因导致了美国农业部膳食指南忽视可持续性？

fertilizer.en: A top dressing of fertilizer should be added to improve growth as mint impoverishes the soil quickly.
fertilizer.zh: 应施顶肥以促进生长，因为薄荷会使土壤迅速变得贫瘠。

fertilizer.en: It's fertilizer, so it has a lot of nutrients.
fertilizer.zh: 这是化肥，所以富含营养。

fairy.en: She was like a princess in a fairy tale.
fairy.zh: 她像童话故事里的一位公主。

fairy.en: Fairy tales weren't just meant for children.
fairy.zh: 童话故事不单单是为孩子们写的。

fairy.en: The fairy waved her wand and the table disappeared.
fairy.zh: 那仙女魔杖一挥，桌子不翼而飞。

altitude.en: The plane made a dive to a lower altitude.
We are flying at an altitude of 6 000 metres.

flashlight.en: Sam was flicking a flashlight on and off.
flashlight.zh: 萨姆正啪啪不停地开关着手电筒。

flashlight.en: The man walked slowly toward her, shining the flashlight.
flashlight.zh: 那个男子照着手电筒慢慢地向她走去。

flashlight.en: Pete's flashlight picked out the dim figures of Bob and Chang.
flashlight.zh: 皮特的手电筒照射出鲍勃和常的蒙胧身影。

glare.en: I shielded my eyes against the glare.
glare.zh: 我挡住眼睛以避开强光。
他的眼镜使他怒视的目光显得更凶了。

recruitment.en: In future, staff recruitment will fall within the remit of the division manager.
recruitment.zh: 以后招募新员工将属于部门经理的职责。

recruitment.en: You've been in graduate recruitment for five years.
recruitment.zh: 你已经从事毕业生招聘工作五年了。
招聘广告通常会招聘“有团队精神的人”。

handy.en: Don't throw that away—it might come in handy.
handy.zh: 别把它扔了—它或许有用。

handy.en: It would be good to have a pencil and paper handy.
handy.zh: 把铅笔和纸放在手边会很有好处。

handy.en: There is a handy storage compartment beneath the oven.
handy.zh: 在烤箱的下面有一个便利的橱柜。

varied.en: He led a full and varied life.
varied.zh: 他过着丰富多彩的生活。

varied.en: She leads a rich and varied life.
varied.zh: 她过着丰富多彩的生活。

varied.en: This is a fabulous album. It's fresh, varied, fun.
varied.zh: 这是个极好的专辑。它是新颖的、多样的、有趣的。

oddly.en: Oddly, Emma says she never considered her face to be attractive.
oddly.zh: 奇怪，埃玛说她从来都不认为她的脸蛋吸引人。

oddly.en: She felt, oddly, that they had been happier when they had no money.
oddly.zh: 她感到奇怪的是，他们没钱时生活得更幸福。

differentiate.en: I can't differentiate one variety from another.
differentiate.zh: 我无法将这几个品种区别开来。

differentiate.en: A child may not differentiate between his imagination and the real world.
differentiate.zh: 孩子也许无法区分想像与真实世界的差别。

differentiate.en: As a general rule, it's important to differentiate between effectiveness and absolute time commitments.
differentiate.zh: 一般说来，区别效率和绝对的时间投入很重要。

succession.en: They are semi-finalists for the fourth year in succession.
succession.zh: 这是他们连续第四年打入半决赛。

succession.en: He fired three shots in quick succession.
They had three children in quick succession.
succession.zh: 短短几年间，他们接连生了三个孩子。

elk.en: When the elk got up, the tarp slid off.
elk.zh: 麋鹿站起来时，防水布滑落了。

elk.en: Deer and elk populations—major food sources for the wolf—grew rapidly.
elk.zh: 鹿和麋鹿的数量迅速增长，它们是狼的主要食物来源。

elk.en: I covered the elk with a tarp and sat down near it, wrapping myself in blankets.
elk.zh: 我用一块油布盖住麋鹿，坐在它旁边，用毯子把自己裹起来。

tricky.en: It was a tricky problem but I think we've licked it.
tricky.zh: 这是一个棘手的问题，但我认为我们轻而易举地把它解决了。

tricky.en: He and I have talked through this whole tricky problem.
tricky.zh: 他和我已经详细讨论了这一整个棘手的问题。

tricky.en: It's a bit tricky at first till you get the hang of it.
tricky.zh: 它在一开始当你还没掌握它的窍门的时候有些棘手。

collaborate.en: She agreed to collaborate with him in writing her biography.
collaborate.zh: 她同意与他合作撰写她的传记。
粒子物理学家和天文学家经常合作。

remnant.en: The Ainu settlers in Hokkaido are the last remnant of a prehistoric race.
remnant.zh: 北海道的阿伊努人是史前某个种族的最后残存者。

remnant.en: It's not a remnant of some huge population that is dwindled in the last few hundred years for some reason.
remnant.zh: 它并不是由于某种原因而在过去几百年里减少的庞大人口的残余。

remnant.en: The common ancestor is, however, too recent for the new species to be a remnant of the first human excursion from Africa.
remnant.zh: 然而，共同的祖先对于新物种又太现代，而不能作为来自非洲的人类首次远足的遗迹。

recite.en: She can recite the whole poem from memory.
Each child had to recite a poem to the class.
recite.zh: 每个孩子都得在班上背诵一首诗。

cement.en: A puppy stepped in the fresh cement.
cement.zh: 一只小狗走到新铺的水泥路面上。

cement.en: He had spent several hours mixing cement.
cement.zh: 他用了几个小时的时间来搅拌水泥。

cement.en: Concrete is a mixture of sand and cement.
cement.zh: 混凝土是沙和水泥的混合物。

communal.en: The inmates ate in a communal dining room.
communal.zh: 同狱室的人在一个公共饭厅吃饭。

communal.en: Soldiers helped to bury the dead in large communal graves.
communal.zh: 士兵们协助将死者埋葬在大型公共墓地里。

cuisine.en: The Garden's menu is based on Hawaiian regional cuisine.
cuisine.zh: 花园饭店的菜肴以夏威夷地区的烹饪风格为基础。

cuisine.en: Elizabeth David enthuses about the taste, fragrance and character of Provencal cuisine.
cuisine.zh: 伊丽莎白·戴维兴奋地谈论普罗旺斯菜的口味、香气和特色。
他们为自己的美食感到自豪。

interference.en: Any outside criticism is routinely dismissed as interference.
interference.zh: 任何外来批评照例都被当作干涉而不予理睬。

interference.en: They resent foreign interference in the internal affairs of their country.
interference.zh: 他们憎恶对他们国家内政的外来干涉。

interference.en: Furthermore, they claim that any such interference is completely ineffective.
interference.zh: 此外，他们声称任何此类干涉都是完全无效的。

wrestle.en: His favorite funny tagline,"Never wrestle with a pig."
wrestle.zh: 他最喜欢的有趣标语是：“永远不要和猪摔跤。”

wrestle.en: What's the main reason for the father teaching his daughters to wrestle?
wrestle.zh: 父亲教女儿们摔跤的主要原因是什么？

underestimate.zh: 我们常常低估自己的潜力。

underestimate.en: I think a lot of people still underestimate him.
underestimate.zh: 我认为许多人仍然低估了他。

underestimate.en: He is a smooth operator. Don't underestimate him.
underestimate.zh: 他是个精明圆滑的人，别低估他。

spoil.zh: 别让他搞得你一晚上不开心。

spoil.en: We all know that fats spoil by becoming rancid.
spoil.zh: 我们都知道油脂发臭就变坏了。

maturity.zh: 她的诗歌显得非常成熟。
我们在成熟后就停止成长了。

maturity.en: Girls generally reach sexual maturity two years earlier than boys.
maturity.zh: 女孩子通常比男孩子早两年达到性成熟。

bacon.zh: 他闻到了一股熏肉的油脂味儿。

bacon.en: Cook the bacon until it begins to crisp.
Do you want bacon and eggs for breakfast ?
bacon.zh: 你早饭要吃熏咸肉和鸡蛋吗？

clause.en: The final clause in the contract will be left untouched.
clause.zh: 合同的最后一项条款将不作改动。

clause.en: A clever lawyer might find a way of getting round that clause.
clause.zh: 高明的律师也许能找到绕过那个条款的办法。

clause.en: He has a clause in his contract which entitles him to a percentage of the profits.
clause.zh: 他在他的合同里有一项条款保证他享有一定比例的利润。

devastate.en: A big worry is that these transplanted megafauna might devastate plants and animals that are native to the western United States.
devastate.zh: 最让人忧心的就是这些转移过来的巨型动物可能会毁灭美国西部一些土生土长的动植物。

devastate.en: The unscrupulous commodification of food and the destruction of foodstuffs will continue to devastate soils, livelihoods and ecologies.
devastate.zh: 无所顾忌的粮食商品化和对食品的破坏将继续破坏土壤、生计和生态。

devastate.en: The bugs could potentially devastate crops in warm southern states.
devastate.zh: 这些臭虫有可能摧毁气候温暖的美国南方诸州作物。

committed.zh: 他们是坚定的社会主义者。

committed.en: The President is committed to reforming health care.
committed.zh: 总统承诺要改革卫生保健制度。

navigate.zh: 大多数蝙蝠通过回声定位飞行。

navigate.en: Such boats can navigate on the Hudson.
navigate.zh: 这样的船能在哈得孙河上航行。

robust.en: She was almost 90, but still very robust.
robust.zh: 她将近90岁了，但身体仍然十分强健。

robust.en: He was always the robust one, physically strong and mentally sharp.
robust.zh: 他一向是个健壮的人，身体强壮、头脑敏锐。
他以典型的坚定风格作答。

ecology.en: Oil pollution could damage the fragile ecology of the coral reefs.
ecology.zh: 石油污染可能破坏珊瑚礁脆弱的生态环境。

ecology.en: Development has been guided by a concern for the ecology of the area.
ecology.zh: 关注本地区的生态状况一直是发展的指导原则。

ecology.en: We are reproducing ourselves at such a rate that our numbers threaten the ecology of the planet.
ecology.zh: 我们繁衍得如此之快，以至于人口数量威胁到地球的生态系统。

bulletin.en: The Internet is the largest computer bulletin board in the world, and it's growing.
bulletin.zh: 因特网是世界上最大的电子布告栏，并且仍在不断扩大。

bulletin.en: At 3:30 p.m. a bulletin was released announcing that the president was out of immediate danger.
bulletin.zh: 下午3:30发布了公告，宣布总统暂时脱离了危险。

bulletin.en: Surfwatch allows parents to prohibit access to specific web sites, newsgroups, and bulletin boards.
bulletin.zh: 过滤器软件可以让父母禁止对特定的网站、新闻组和电子布告栏的访问。

deployment.en: Missile deployment did much to further polarize opinion.
deployment.zh: 导弹的部署进一步地加剧了意见的分化。

deployment.en: The General's visit to Sarajevo is part of preparations for the deployment of extra troops.
deployment.zh: 那位将军对萨拉热窝的访问是为部署更多军队所做的准备工作的一部分。

deployment.en: The next phase of the operation will involve the deployment of more than 35,000 troops from a dozen countries.
deployment.zh: 下阶段的行动包括部署来自12个国家的三万五千多名士兵。

terrace.en: All rooms have a balcony or terrace.
terrace.zh: 所有的房间都有阳台或露台。

terrace.en: We lingered over breakfast on the terrace.
terrace.zh: 我们在平台上慢条斯理地吃着早餐。

accessory.en: He was charged with being an accessory to murder.
accessory.zh: 他被控为谋杀罪的从犯。

accessory.en: The company serves the national automotive aftermarket with a broad range of accessory and recreational-vehicle products.
accessory.zh: 该公司为全国机动车售后市场提供各种配件和休闲车产品。

accessory.en: For this reason, the watch industry has become an accessory business in recent years.
accessory.zh: 正因如此，手表行业近年来已成为配件行业。

resent.en: It is only natural that he should resent you.
resent.zh: 他会怨恨你是很自然的。

resent.en: The time had come when Mary had forgotten to resent Martha's familiar talk.
resent.zh: 到了玛丽不再厌恶玛莎唠叨的时候了。

resent.en: They resent the implication that they have behaved irresponsibly.
resent.zh: 他们对那种暗示他们的行为不负责任的言论非常不满。

continuity.en: Natives give it solidity and continuity; but the settlers give it passion.
continuity.zh: 当地人赋予它稳定性和延续性；但是定居者赋予了它激情。

continuity.en: It may seem that this cultural continuity gives us a huge advantage over ants.
continuity.zh: 似乎这种文化延续性使我们与蚂蚁相比占有巨大的优势。

continuity.en: It provides visual continuity to a campaign that may also be appearing in other media.
continuity.zh: 它为也可能出现在其他媒体上的广告活动提供了视觉连续的效果。

petty.en: She felt boxed in by all their petty rules.
petty.zh: 她觉得被他们的琐碎规章束缚住了手脚。

petty.en: She felt hemmed in by all their petty rules and regulations.
petty.zh: 她觉得受到他们那些琐碎的规章制度的束缚。

indirect.en: He took an indirect route back home.
indirect.zh: 他选择了一条迂回的路线回家。

indirect.en: The building collapsed as an indirect result of the heavy rain.
indirect.zh: 暴雨间接造成了那座楼房的倒塌。

indirect.en: What people had to pay in direct and indirect taxes had not gone up since 1979.
indirect.zh: 人们须缴纳的直接税和间接税从1979年开始没涨过。

temper.en: All at once she lost her temper.

blossom.en: Rain begins to fall and peach trees blossom.
blossom.zh: 雨开始下，桃树就开花了。

spacecraft.en: The two spacecraft will link up in orbit.
spacecraft.zh: 两艘宇宙飞船将在轨道上对接。

spacecraft.en: A radio signal was sent to the spacecraft.
spacecraft.zh: 向宇宙飞船发出了无线电信号。

spacecraft.en: The spacecraft burned up as it entered the earth's atmosphere.
