spacecraft.zh: 宇宙飞船进入地球大气层时被烧毁。

generic.en: The index at the back of the book lists both brand and generic names.
generic.zh: 书末尾的索引把商标名和通用名都列了出来。

generic.en: Parmesan is a generic term used to describe a family of hard Italian cheeses.
generic.zh: 巴尔马干酪是一个用来描述一类坚硬的意大利奶酪的通用名称。

generic.en: Doctors sometimes prescribe cheaper generic drugs instead of more expensive brand names.
generic.zh: 医生有时开比较便宜的非注册商标的药品，而不开比较昂贵的品牌药。

globalization.en: Globalization is a phenomenon of the 21st century.
Globalization is a catchall to describe increased international trade.
globalization.zh: 全球化是描述增长的国际贸易专业术语。

globalization.en: Others focus on the advantages of globalization.
globalization.zh: 其他人则关注全球化的优势。

marathon.zh: 这次面试真是一场马拉松。

marathon.en: It felt as though he had run a marathon.
marathon.zh: 他感到好像跑了一个马拉松似的。

marathon.en: The marathon is a severe test of stamina.
marathon.zh: 马拉松赛跑是对耐力的严峻考验。

prestigious.en: It's one of the best equipped and most prestigious schools in the country.
prestigious.zh: 它是该国设备最好、最有声望的学校之一。

prestigious.en: High scores on the GRE helped explain who got in; degrees of prestigious universities didn't.
prestigious.zh: GRE 考试的高分有助于解释谁被录取，名牌大学的学位则不然。

prestigious.en: After photography became regarded as an art form, portrait painting became less prestigious, less respected as an art form.
prestigious.zh: 在摄影被视为一种艺术形式之后，肖像画作为一种艺术形式就不那么有声望和受人尊敬了。

massacre.en: Maria lost her 62-year-old mother in the massacre.
massacre.zh: 玛丽亚在大屠杀中失去了她62岁的母亲。

massacre.en: They have suffered from a complete massacre.

icy.en: He had slipped on an icy pavement.
icy.zh: 他在结冰的人行道上滑倒了。
我的双眼迎视他冰冷的目光。

applied.en: He has applied to join the army.

applied.zh: 他申请了在加拿大的居住权。

trench.en: "With virtual reality we'll be able to put a surgeon in every trench," said Satava.
trench.zh: “有了虚拟现实技术，我们就能在每条战壕里安插一名外科医生。”萨塔瓦说道。

trench.en: This plate is growing on both sides, and since there is no intermediate trench, the two ridges must be moving apart.
trench.zh: 这个板块是在两边生长的，由于没有中间的沟槽，两个脊必然是分开的。

trench.en: The bridge lies like a trench in the fortress of the moat, which is shaped to blend in with the outlines of the landscape.
trench.zh: 这座桥就像是坐落在护城河中的一条沟渠，这种造型是为了使它与周围的风景融合在一起。

spur.en: This has forced airlines to discount fares heavily in order to spur demand.
spur.zh: 这已经迫使多家航空公司对机票大幅打折以刺激需求。

spur.en: Their attitude, rather than reining him back, only seemed to spur Philip on.
spur.zh: 他们的态度非但没令菲利普回头，似乎只是激励他继续下去。

spur.en: Let the cheers from the crowd spur you on.
spur.zh: 让群众的欢呼声激励你前进。

devotion.en: Her devotion to the job left her with very little free time.
devotion.zh: 她全身心投入工作，几乎没有闲暇。

devotion.en: He recalled her devotion to her husband during his hour of need.
devotion.zh: 他回想起她在丈夫需要帮助时所做出的无私奉献。

whistle.en: On the platform, the guard blew his whistle.
whistle.zh: 站台上，警卫吹响了他的哨子。

diesel.zh: 这些公共汽车使用的是柴油。

insane.en: The letter made her insane with jealousy.
insane.zh: 那封信使她妒忌得发疯。

insane.en: The boy is half insane with hysteria and self-indulgence.
insane.zh: 这个男孩歇斯底里、任性放纵，成了半个疯子了。

astronomy.en: We are on the threshold of a new era in astronomy.
astronomy.zh: 我们将迈入天文学的新时代。

astronomy.en: The discovery is being hailed as the Holy Grail of astronomy.
astronomy.zh: 这个发现被认为是为天文学圆了梦。

astronomy.en: Descartes received his stimulus from the new physics and astronomy of Copernicus, Galileo, and others.
astronomy.zh: 笛卡儿从哥白尼、伽利略和其他科学家的新物理学和天文学中获得了灵感。

roster.en: The Amateur Softball Association's roster of umpires has declined to 57,000.
roster.zh: 业余垒球协会的裁判员名单上的人数减少到了5.7万人。

roster.en: The next day he put himself first on the new roster for domestic chores.
roster.zh: 次日，他在新的内务值勤表上把自己排在第一个。
作为他们的供应商名册。

skeleton.zh: 人的骨骼由206块骨头组成。

skeleton.en: The skeleton has been dated at about 2000 BC.
skeleton.zh: 这骨架的年代为公元前2000年左右。

skeleton.en: Only the concrete skeleton of the factory remained.
skeleton.zh: 厂房只剩下混凝土骨架了。

spawn.en: Despite living in different waters, all eels spawn in the sea.
spawn.zh: 尽管生活在不同的水域，所有的鳗鱼都在海里产卵。

spawn.en: Nobody knows how they do it with such accuracy, or why eels spawn where they do.
spawn.zh: 没有人知道它们如何做到那么准确，或是鳗鱼为什么要在大海里产卵。

spawn.en: The light comes from female firefly squids, which spawn in spring, then die and wash ashore.
spawn.zh: 这种光来自雌性萤火虫乌贼，它们在春天产卵，然后死亡，被冲到岸上。

sew.en: I know how to sew a button on.
I had endless hours to knit and sew.
sew.zh: 我有无数的时间来缝缝织织。

sew.en: I had plenty of space to write and sew.
sew.zh: 我有足够的空间来写作和缝纫。

inflict.en: Do you have to inflict that music on us?
inflict.zh: 你非得逼我们听那种音乐吗？

inflict.en: The bursting of the bubble will inflict broad damage.
inflict.zh: 这场泡沫的破灭将造成广泛的影响。

indict.en: The ICC must decide whether to indict the suspects.
indict.zh: 国际刑事法庭必须决定是否起诉这些嫌犯。

indict.en: You can't indict whole people for the crudeness of a few.
indict.zh: 您不能因少数人的粗暴行为就控诉整个民族。

indict.en: Their decisions on whether to indict someone have mostly been unappealable.
indict.zh: 他们是否起诉犯罪嫌疑人的决定大部分情况下都是不可上诉的。

muddy.zh: 浑浊的水慢慢变得清澈起来。
我们扑哧扑哧地穿过泥泞的田地。

muddy.en: The car got stuck in the muddy ground.

marked.zh: 你为什么批这道题为错？

turtle.en: Experts say if the island is not protected, the spill could wipe out the gulf's turtle population.
turtle.zh: 专家们说如果那座小岛得不到保护，此次泄露有可能使该海湾地区的海龟灭绝。

trio.en: She chose to be backed by a classy trio of acoustic guitar, bass and congas.
trio.zh: 她选择了用原声吉他、低音吉他和康茄鼓组成的经典三重奏组合为自己伴奏。

trio.en: At the church of the Trinity in Cherbourg on Christmas Day, 1892, he had his debut as a composer with the performance of his andante for string trio and organ.
trio.zh: 1892年圣诞节那天，在瑟堡的三一教堂，他首次以作曲家身份演出弦乐三重奏和管风琴的行板。

trio.en: It took only three shots for navy snipers to kill the trio of pirates holding Captain Richard Phillips hostage on a lifeboat drifting in the high sea.
trio.zh: 海军狙击手仅用三枪就击毙了三名海盗，当时海盗挟持船长理查德·菲利普斯作为人质乘坐一艘救生艇漂浮在公海上。

thereafter.en: Thereafter she wrote articles for papers and magazines in Paris.
thereafter.zh: 从那以后，她为巴黎的报纸和杂志撰稿。

thereafter.en: The plan will help you lose 3-4 pounds the first week, and 1-2 pounds the weeks thereafter.
thereafter.zh: 该计划将帮助你在第1周减3到4磅，其后每周减1到2磅。

thereafter.en: The final section provides that any work produced for the company is thereafter owned by the company.
thereafter.zh: 最后一节规定，此后为公司创作的一切作品均为该公司所有。

leverage.en: His position as mayor gives him leverage to get things done.
leverage.zh: 他的市长身份使他有能力办成一些事情。

leverage.en: The move was a switch to leverage on the coverage of their fashion week show to make stock available immediately to consumers.
leverage.zh: 此举是一种转变，即利用时装周走秀的报道，让消费者立即可以买到库存。

leverage.en: Now some experts are proposing that we should take advantage of the teen brain's keen sensitivity to the presence of friends and leverage it to improve education.
leverage.zh: 现在一些专家提出，我们应该利用青少年的大脑对朋友在场的敏锐感知，并借助它来改善教育。

ferry.zh: 我们在奥斯坦德及时赶上了渡船。
渡轮拦腰撞了我们的船只。

ferry.en: The ferry is expected to dock at 6.
ferry.zh: 渡船预计在6点停靠码头。

turmoil.en: She lived through the turmoil of the French Revolution.
turmoil.zh: 她经历过法国大革命的混乱之后仍旧活着。

turmoil.en: After years of turmoil and torment, she is finally at peace.
turmoil.zh: 经历多年的动荡与痛苦后，她终于安心下来了。

turmoil.en: Abidjan was thrown into turmoil because of a protest by taxi drivers.
turmoil.zh: 阿比让因计程车司机们的抗议而陷入了混乱。

renewal.en: They will discuss the possible renewal of diplomatic relations.
renewal.zh: 他们将讨论恢复外交关系的可能性。

renewal.en: There has been very little renewal of personnel in higher education.
renewal.zh: 高等教育事业中人员更新很少。

renewal.en: His avowed intention was to bring about reform and spiritual renewal for the church.
renewal.zh: 他公开宣称他目标是进行教会改革和灵性的复兴。

migrate.zh: 燕子在冬天迁徙到南方。
是什么导致了季风的迁移呢？

migrate.en: What about birds that migrate at night?

clergy.en: The new proposals affect both clergy and laity.
clergy.zh: 新的提案使神职人员和平信徒都会受到影响。

clergy.en: Clergy and laity alike are divided in their views.
clergy.zh: 神职人员和信众同样都观点各异。

clergy.en: They were sons of the local clergy, of the officers at the Depot, and of such manufacturers or men of business as the old town possessed.
clergy.zh: 他们是当地神职人员的儿子，是车站官员的儿子，也是老城区的制造商或商人的儿子。

perfection.zh: 他对完美的追求是不懈的。

perfection.en: The novel achieves a perfection of form that is quite new.
They have been working on the perfection of the new model.
perfection.zh: 他们一直在努力完善新型号。

keen.zh: 我的妻子是个热衷园艺的人。

keen.en: She herself was not a keen gardener.
keen.zh: 她本人就不是一个热衷于园艺的人。

rite.en: The programme concluded with Stravinsky's 'Rite of Spring'.
rite.zh: 演出节目以斯特拉文斯基的《春之祭》结束。

rite.en: It used to be that a paper route or an after-school job at the local grocer was viewed as a rite of passage for young people.
rite.zh: 过去对年轻人来说，找一份送报纸的兼职或者放学后前往本地杂货店打工，往往被视为人生必经阶段。

rite.en: It was considered a rite of passage to own a broken down vehicle.
rite.zh: 人们认为汽车抛锚是人生的必经之路。

offspring.en: The offspring contain a mixture of the genetic blueprint of each parent.
offspring.zh: 后代体内含有父母亲基因图谱的混合。

offspring.en: Eleanor was now less anxious about her offspring than she had once been.
offspring.zh: 这时，埃莉诺已不像以前那样为子女担忧了。

offspring.en: The comet is going to come back in 2061 and we are all going to be able to see it. Well, our offspring are, anyway.
offspring.zh: 这颗彗星将于2061年返回，到时我们都可以看到它。哦，无论如何，我们子孙是可以看到的。

mathematical.en: NASA discovered a mathematical error in its calculations.
mathematical.zh: 美国国家航空航天局发现了其计算中的一个数学错误。

mathematical.en: Mathematical physics is an almost impossibly difficult subject.
mathematical.zh: 数学物理学是一门难得难以想像的学科。

mathematical.en: With mathematical problems, you can save time by approximating.
mathematical.zh: 对于数学题，你可以用近似法省时间。

imaginary.zh: 许多孩子都有假想的朋友。
很多儿童都有一个假想朋友。

imaginary.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the earth.
imaginary.zh: 赤道是一条假想的环绕地球腰部的线。

archive.en: The system will archive the information so agencies can review it in detail.
archive.zh: 该系统会将该信息存档，以便各代理机构能对其详细审阅。

archive.en: A quarter of this vast archive has been indexed and made accessible to researchers.
archive.zh: 这批数量巨大的档案的1/4都已编了索引，可供研究者查阅。

archive.en: One additional service not discussed so far is the ability to archive and prune old instances that may no longer be required.
archive.zh: 到目前为止尚未讨论的另一个服务，是存档和删除可能不再需要的旧实例的功能。

orient.en: It took him some time to orient himself in his new school.
orient.zh: 他经过了一段时间才熟悉新学校的环境。

orient.en: The mountaineers found it hard to orient themselves in the fog.
orient.zh: 登山者在大雾中很难辨认方向。

orient.en: You will need the time to orient yourself to your new way of eating.
orient.zh: 你需要时间适应新的吃法。

adhere.en: One must be duly self-disciplined to adhere to it.
adhere.zh: 人要适当自律才能坚持它。
微小的粒子紧贴着种子。

adhere.en: All members of the association adhere to a strict code of practice.
adhere.zh: 所有该协会的成员都遵守严格的业务守则。

receipt.en: I wrote her a receipt for the money.
receipt.zh: 我为那笔钱给她开了张收据。

receipt.en: The buyer has to sign a delivery note as proof of receipt.
receipt.zh: 购买者必须签收送货单表明货已收到。

pillar.en: My father is a pillar of the community.
pillar.zh: 我父亲是社区的顶梁柱。

pillar.en: The pillar obstructed our view of the stage.
pillar.zh: 柱子挡着，我们看不见舞台。

pillar.en: John put on his harness and attached it to a pillar.
pillar.zh: 约翰戴上了安全带，并把它系在了一根柱子上。

uneasy.zh: 莫莉不自在地微微窃笑了一下。

uneasy.en: She felt uneasy in the unfamiliar surroundings.
uneasy.zh: 她在陌生的环境中感到局促不安。

uneasy.en: He looked uneasy and refused to answer questions.
uneasy.zh: 他看起来心神不安，并且拒绝回答问题。

privileged.en: They were, by and large, a very wealthy, privileged elite.
privileged.zh: 他们一般都属于一个非常富有的特权阶层。

privileged.en: He had promised that the rich and privileged would no longer get preferential treatment.
privileged.zh: 他已承诺富人和特权阶层将不会再得到优待。

carriage.en: I fought my way into a carriage just before the doors closed.
carriage.zh: 我正好在车门关闭之前挤进了一节车厢。

carriage.en: Again, buyers need to check if carriage is included in the price.
carriage.zh: 此外，买主需要核实售价中是否包含运费。

messenger.en: The messenger bent and scratched at his knee where the strapping chafed.
messenger.zh: 信使弯身挠膝盖上被带子擦痛的地方。

messenger.en: There will be a messenger at the airport to collect the photographs from our courier.
messenger.zh: 机场会有一名信使从我们的快递员那儿取走照片。
他通过邮递员发出订单。

artillery.en: The town is under heavy artillery fire.
artillery.zh: 该市镇处于密集的炮火之下。

artillery.en: From 1935 to 1937 he was in the artillery.
artillery.zh: 从1935年到1937年他在炮兵部队。

artillery.en: Using tanks and heavy artillery, they seized the town.
artillery.zh: 他们使用坦克和重炮攻下了这座城市。

pavement.en: He had slipped on an icy pavement.
pavement.zh: 他在结冰的人行道上滑倒了。

pavement.en: Two cars skidded on the icy pavement.
pavement.zh: 两辆汽车在结冰的路面上打滑。

relevance.en: Politicians' private lives have no relevance to their public roles.
relevance.zh: 政治家的私生活与他们的公众角色没有相关性。

relevance.en: Perhaps the students do not understand the relevance of the material to their studies.
relevance.zh: 也许学生们不理解这些材料与他们的学习的相关性。

relevance.en: Using the so-called Maxim of Relevance we can infer things as well, or rather the speaker can imply things and the listener can make inferences.
relevance.zh: 使用所谓的关联准则，我们可以推断出一些事情，或者更确切地说，说话者可以在话语中暗示一些内容，而听者可以从这些话语中做出推断。

moist.en: The outside air was heavy and moist and sultry.
moist.zh: 户外的空气阴沉、潮湿而闷热。

moist.en: The soil is reasonably moist after the September rain.
moist.zh: 9月的雨水之后，土壤适度湿润。

moist.en: Keep the soil moist. That way, the seedling will flourish.
moist.zh: 保持土壤湿润,那样小苗就会茁壮成长。

mentality.en: I cannot understand the mentality of football hooligans.
mentality.zh: 我无法理解足球流氓的心态。

mentality.en: Police officers had a siege mentality that isolated them from the people they served.
mentality.zh: 警察过去有一种受围心态，这使他们与其服务的民众孤立开来。
据 Gumbley 所说，存在一种“您先请的心态”。

postpone.en: I, for one, would prefer to postpone the meeting.
postpone.zh: 主张推迟会期的，我就是一个。

postpone.en: It was an unpopular decision to postpone building the new hospital.
postpone.zh: 延迟兴建新医院的决定是不得人心的。

postpone.en: It is totally out of the question to postpone the midnight deadline.
postpone.zh: 延迟午夜的最后期限是根本不可能的。

tractor.en: The truck was an 18-wheeler with a white tractor.
tractor.zh: 这辆卡车有18轮，还有一个白色牵引车头。

tractor.en: Paul hooked his tractor to the car and pulled it to safety.
tractor.zh: 保罗把他的拖拉机挂在那辆小汽车上，然后把它拖到安全的地方。

tractor.en: A sprayer hooked to a tractor can spray five gallons onto ten acres.
tractor.zh: 挂在拖拉机上的喷雾器用五加仑液量能喷洒十英亩地。

beneficiary.en: Who will be the main beneficiary of the cuts in income tax?
beneficiary.zh: 削减所得税的主要受益者将是谁？

beneficiary.en: The protagonist Emily is endowed with the images of protecter of the tradition, and its convict, beneficiary and revolter.
beneficiary.zh: 主人公爱米丽同时具有传统的维护者、囚徒、受益人和反抗者多个身份。
一个主要的受益者是黄金。

contention.en: One area of contention is the availability of nursery care.
contention.zh: 争论的一个方面是提供幼儿保育的可能性。

contention.en: His case has become a source of contention between civil liberties activists and the government.
contention.zh: 他的案子已变成了公民自由活动家们和政府之间的争论缘由。

contention.en: This is an extreme example again, but it shows that the scheduling overhead of contention is not trivial.
contention.zh: 这又是一个极端的示例，但它表明争论的调度开销并不是微不足道的。

ballet.zh: 我受过做芭蕾舞演员的训练。

ballet.en: She wants to be a ballet dancer.
He's a dancer with the Royal Ballet.
ballet.zh: 他是皇家芭蕾舞团的舞蹈演员。

critically.zh: 怀曼批判地注视着他们。
她以批评的口吻谈到拉腊。
她谈到父亲时颇有微词。

velocity.zh: 加速度和速度都是矢量。

velocity.en: Jaguars can move with an astonishing velocity.
velocity.zh: 美洲豹跑起来速度惊人。

velocity.en: I mean, that's the whole point of escape velocity, right?
velocity.zh: 我的意思是，这是逃逸速度的全部意义所在，不是吗？

pathway.en: Diplomacy will smooth your pathway to success.
pathway.zh: 良好的交际会铺平你的成功之路。

pathway.en: In the early sixties, programmed learning was looked on as the pathway to mechanize the learning process.
pathway.zh: 在六十年代早期，程序化学习被看作是机械化学习过程的途径。

hub.en: The island's social hub is the Cafe Sport.
hub.zh: 该岛的社交中心是“运动咖啡馆”。

hub.en: This grand building in the centre of town used to be the hub of the capital's social life.
hub.zh: 这座位于城镇中央的宏伟建筑曾经是首都社交生活的中心。

hub.en: It's not yet the futuristic international business hub that planners imagined.
hub.zh: 它还不是规划者想象中的未来国际商业中心。

compartment.en: The fire started in the baggage compartment.
compartment.zh: 火是从行李舱着起来的。

compartment.en: He sat in the corner of a second-class compartment.
compartment.zh: 他坐在一个二等车厢的角落里。

compartment.en: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
compartment.zh: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管吸走。

reconcile.en: He could not reconcile himself to the prospect of losing her.
reconcile.zh: 他一想到有可能失去她，就觉得难以忍受。

reconcile.en: It was hard to reconcile his career ambitions with the needs of his children.
reconcile.zh: 他很难兼顾事业上的抱负和孩子们的需要。

reconcile.en: It's difficult to reconcile the demands of my job and the desire to be a good father.
reconcile.zh: 协调我工作的要求与我当个好父亲的愿望很难。

insult.en: Forgive me, I don't mean to insult you.
insult.zh: 请原谅我，我不是有意侮辱你。

insult.en: Their behaviour was an insult to the people they represent.
insult.zh: 他们的行为是对他们所代表的人们的一种侮辱。

embark.en: Some forethought and preparation is necessary before you embark on the project.
embark.zh: 你着手进行这个项目之前必须有所考虑，有所准备。

embark.en: For some women I know, this sense of trust and self-belief later in life gave them the courage to leave dysfunctional relationships or embark on new career paths.
embark.zh: 对一些我认识的女性来说，这种信任感和自信心在日后给了她们离开不正常人际关系的勇气，或是从事新职业的勇气。

embark.en: Faced withunknown challenges, they are audacious enough to embark on a perilous journey while most of their peers enjoy stable salaries by working as white-collars at high-end office buildings.
embark.zh: 面对未知的挑战，他们敢于踏上一段危险的旅程，而他们的同龄人大多在高端写字楼里做白领，享受着稳定的薪水。

usher.en: He did part-time work as an usher in a theatre.
usher.zh: 他曾在一家剧院做兼职引座员。
招待员：对不起，恐怕不行。

usher.en: The usher bowed us into the theatre.
usher.zh: 引座员恭敬地把我们迎入戏院。

perimeter.en: The plane veered off the runway and crashed through the perimeter fence.
perimeter.zh: 这架飞机突然偏离了跑道并且冲断了周边的护栏。

perimeter.en: A fence marked the perimeter of the field.
perimeter.zh: 一道篱笆标明了那块田地的周界。

perimeter.en: Guards patrol the perimeter of the estate.
perimeter.zh: 保安人员在庄园四周巡逻。

spontaneous.en: "Now my extroverted behaviour is spontaneous," he says.
spontaneous.zh: “现在我的外向行为是自发的。”他说。

spontaneous.en: When they got up, the whole place broke out into spontaneous applause.
spontaneous.zh: 当他们站起来时，全场爆发出自发的掌声。

slender.en: Sherry is black, tall, slender and soft-spoken.
slender.zh: 谢里是黑人，个头高挑，身材苗条，说话柔声细气。

slender.en: She was of below average height, petite and slender.
slender.zh: 她低于平均身高，娇小且苗条。

slender.en: The slender stalks are weighed down with flowers.
slender.zh: 纤细的花梗被花儿压弯了。

bloom.en: Most roses will begin to bloom from late May.
bloom.zh: 大多数玫瑰从五月末开始开花。

bloom.en: There are a lot of roses in bloom.

brochure.en: Our new brochure is crammed full of inspirational ideas.
brochure.zh: 我们新的小册子中振奋人心的妙计比比皆是。

brochure.en: Our brochure is printed on environmentally-friendly paper.
brochure.zh: 我们的宣传手册是用环保纸印刷的。

brochure.en: Correct me if I'm wrong , but isn't this last year's brochure?
brochure.zh: 这不是去年的小册子吗？若是我说错了就请指出。

blouse.en: That blouse sets off the blue of her eyes.
blouse.zh: 那件上衣衬托出了她的蓝眼睛。

proximity.en: He became aware of the proximity of the Afghans.
proximity.zh: 他开始意识到那些阿富汗人的接近。
随着不断接近，理解也在增加。

proximity.en: Proximity refers to the physical distance between speakers.
proximity.zh: 接近性是指说话人之间的物理距离。

lettuce.en: Lettuce was grown by the ancient Romans.
lettuce.zh: 莴苣是由古罗马人种植的。

lettuce.en: The salad consisted of a few leaves of sad-looking lettuce.
lettuce.zh: 色拉就是几片生菜的残叶。

lettuce.en: Why does it feel like even the lettuce is out to get us?
lettuce.zh: 为什么感觉甚至连莴苣都对我们不利呢？

manifestation.en: What Watson did was to observe muscular habits, because he viewed them as a manifestation of thinking.
manifestation.zh: 沃森所做的就是观察肌肉习惯，因为他认为肌肉习惯是思考的表现形式。

manifestation.en: Some manifestation of your concern would have been appreciated.
manifestation.zh: 你当时要是表现出一些关心就好了。

manifestation.en: The principal manifestation of the syndrome is syncope or presyncope, often accompanied by palpitations.
manifestation.zh: 该综合征的主要表现为晕厥或晕厥前，常伴有心悸。

perfume.zh: 这种香水闻起来什么味道？

perfume.en: He caught a whiff of her perfume.
perfume.zh: 他闻到一股她身上的香水味。

matching.en: The matching trousers have an elasticated waist with drawstrings.
matching.zh: 这条配套裤子的裤腰有松紧带。
我正在寻找匹配的袜子。

matching.en: She held up a white sweater and matching skirt.
matching.zh: 她举起一件白色毛衣和一条配套的裙子。

brace.en: Overhead, the lights showed the old timbers, used to brace the roof.
brace.zh: 在头顶上，光线照射出支撑屋顶的旧木头。

brace.en: Once they made him wear a brace but he fretted so he was downright ill.
brace.zh: 有一次，他们让他戴上支架，但他焦躁不安，因此病得很重。

brace.en: We have an internal brace that prevents the tissues from stretching but still allows you to mobilize the joint with some confidence.
brace.zh: 我们会有一个内部支撑架，可以防止组织被拉长，但是它仍然可以让你自信地活动关节。

flock.en: They kept a small flock of sheep.
The explosion scattered a flock of birds roosting in the trees.
flock.zh: 爆炸声把栖息在树丛中的鸟群惊散了。

flock.en: What was that big dark animal coming towards his flock?
flock.zh: 那是什么大型黑色动物冲他的羊群来了？

refine.en: At the same time, more of this newly discovered oil is of the type that requires a greater investment to refine.
refine.zh: 与此同时，在这些新发现的石油中，更多是需要加大投资才能提炼的类型。

refine.en: Can they refine the idea and resubmit it?
refine.zh: 他们能改进一下想法然后重新提交吗？

refine.en: Instead of trying to refine old formulas, they invent new ones.
refine.zh: 他们不是试图改进旧的公式，而是发明新的公式。

rivalry.en: It was Allen who fired this rivalry with real passion.
rivalry.zh: 是艾伦满怀激情地激发了这次对抗。

rivalry.en: There is more to the rivalry between rail and air than the experience in transit.
rivalry.zh: 铁路和航空之间的竞争不仅仅是运输方面的经验。

rivalry.en: Their distance may be temporary, but it shows that childhood rivalry isn't always outgrown.
rivalry.zh: 他们之间的距离可能是暂时的，但这表明，童年时代的竞争并不总是会消失。

symbolize.en: No one knows for sure when or why it began to symbolize peace.
symbolize.zh: 没有人确切地知道它是什么时候或者为什么开始成为和平的象征。

symbolize.en: In addition to intelligence, they also symbolize affluence and wealth.
symbolize.zh: 除了智慧，它们也象征着富足和财富。

symbolize.en: Until then, all scholars assumed that hieroglyphs were pictographs, that they symbolize objects or concepts.
symbolize.zh: 此前，所有学者都认为，象形文字是图像表意文字，即它们象征着物品或概念。

delighted.zh: 听到你的消息我非常高兴。

delighted.en: I know Frank will be delighted to see you.
delighted.zh: 我知道弗兰克见到你会非常高兴。

oval.en: It is more of an oval, it is elliptical.
oval.zh: 它更像是一个椭圆形的。

oval.en: Eggs have an oval shape appealing to artists.
oval.zh: 鸡蛋呈椭圆形，这种形状对艺术家具有吸引力。

rigorous.en: The work failed to meet their rigorous standards.
rigorous.zh: 工作没有达到他们的严格标准。

rigorous.en: Was it a curriculum that appeared more rigorous, perhaps?
rigorous.zh: 或许，这是一门看起来更严格的课程？

rigorous.en: All vitamin supplements would be evaluated in scientifically rigorous clinical trials.
rigorous.zh: 所有维生素补充剂都会经过科学严格的临床试验评估。

volatile.en: The blast occurred when volatile chemicals exploded.
volatile.zh: 冲击波是在易挥发的化学品爆炸时产生的。

volatile.en: It is like the sense of chill that follows immersion of the hand in a volatile liquid.
volatile.zh: 这很像把手浸入挥发性液体后的那种凉飕飕的感觉。

canoe.en: We paddled the canoe along the coast.
canoe.zh: 我们划着独木舟沿海岸而行。

canoe.en: The canoe floated upside down on the lake.
canoe.zh: 独木舟底朝天漂浮在湖面上。

canoe.en: The canoe is made from an impermeable wood.
canoe.zh: 该独木舟用防水木材制成。

sturdy.en: She was a short, sturdy woman in her early sixties.
sturdy.zh: 她是一位六十出头、矮小结实的女人。

sturdy.en: If you have to climb up, use a firm platform or a sturdy ladder.
sturdy.zh: 如果你必须爬上去，就用一个稳固的平台或者一个结实的梯子。

sturdy.en: They would peel large sheets of bark from the tree to form lightweight yet sturdy canoes.
sturdy.zh: 他们会从树上剥下大片的树皮，做成轻便而结实的独木舟。

broaden.zh: 我们必须扩大我们的吸引力。

broaden.en: She wanted to travel to broaden her horizons.
I thought you wanted to broaden your horizons.
broaden.zh: 我以为你想拓宽自己的视野。

hurdle.en: His horse fell at the final hurdle.
hurdle.zh: 他骑的马在最后一个跨栏倒下了。

hurdle.en: His horse fell as it jumped the last hurdle.
hurdle.zh: 他的马在跨越最后一个栏时跌倒了。
另一个障碍是山峰的形状。

definitive.en: The evidence provided by the documents of British and French colonies is not definitive.
definitive.zh: 英国和法国殖民地的文件所提供的证据并不是决定性的。

definitive.en: Models from economics and demography become the definitive tools for examining the financial base of social security.
definitive.zh: 来自经济学和人口学的模型成为检验社会保障财政基础的最权威工具。

definitive.en: The definitive version of the text is ready to be published.
definitive.zh: 正式的文本很快就要发表了。

workforce.en: The total was close to 20% of the workforce.
Over ten per cent of the workforce is now idle.
workforce.zh: 现在有超过百分之十的劳动力闲置。

workforce.en: The company yesterday shed a sixth of its workforce.
workforce.zh: 该公司昨天削减了1/6的劳动力。

propel.en: The tiny rocket is attached to the spacecraft and is designed to propel it toward Mars.
propel.zh: 微型火箭附在宇宙飞船上，用来推进飞船飞向火星。

propel.en: He also used ski poles in an unorthodox way—to propel himself as he skied.
propel.zh: 他还以一种非正统的方式使用滑雪杖，就是在滑雪时用它推动自己。

propel.en: It now appears that they also have an important influence on the geophysical processes that propel the plates across the globe.
propel.zh: 现在看来，它们对推动板块在全球范围内运动的地球物理过程也有重要影响。

voyage.en: He saw life as a voyage of discovery.
voyage.zh: 他把生命看作是一次探索未知世界的航行。

voyage.en: This voyage was his first taste of freedom.
voyage.zh: 这次航行使他第一次体验到自由的滋味。

voyage.en: In 1912, the Titanic sank on her maiden voyage.
voyage.zh: 1912年，泰坦尼克号首次航行时沉没。

parsley.en: Parsley is one of the most commonly used herbs.
parsley.zh: 欧芹是最常用的草药之一。

parsley.en: Remove from the heat, add the parsley, toss and serve at once.
parsley.zh: 从火上端下来，加入香芹，搅拌后立刻上桌。

parsley.en: Nutmeg, parsley and cider all complement the flavour of these beans well.
parsley.zh: 肉豆蔻、欧芹和苹果酒都凸显这些菜豆的味道。

replicate.en: He invited her to his laboratory to see if she could replicate the experiment.
replicate.zh: 他邀请她到他的实验室看她能否复制该实验。

replicate.en: Recently they have been able to replicate that too.
replicate.zh: 最近他们也成功地复制了这一点。

replicate.en: It could never replicate the immediacy, the kind of drama that live performance offers.
replicate.zh: 它永远无法复制现场表演的即时性和戏剧性。

distort.en: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms.
distort.zh: 画家可能会夸大或扭曲形状与形式。

distort.en: They could distort the achievement-based system of peer-review-led research.
distort.zh: 他们可能会扭曲以同行评审为导向、以学术成就基础的研究体系。

distort.en: How can you portray something exactly as it is and at the same time distort it with emotions?
distort.zh: 你怎么可能一边完全客观的作画，一边又带有感情的去使之变形呢？

swift.en: With a swift movement, Matthew Jerrold sat upright.
swift.zh: 马修·杰罗德迅速地坐直了。

swift.en: After the election there was a swift transfer of power.
swift.zh: 大选之后权力迅速交接。

swift.en: Our task is to challenge the U.N. to make a swift decision.
swift.zh: 我们的任务是敦促联合国做出迅速的决定。

overweight.en: She was only a few pounds overweight.
There was no escaping the fact that he was overweight.
overweight.zh: 他身体超重这一事实是无法回避的。

undo.en: He tried to undo the knot by picking at it with his fingers.
undo.zh: 他用手指不停地扯，想把绳结解开。

undo.en: Oh, do let me help to undo it!
I managed secretly to undo a corner of the parcel.
undo.zh: 我设法偷偷地打开包裹的一角。

stalk.en: A single pale blue flower grows up from each joint on a long stalk.
stalk.zh: 一根长梗的每个节上都长出了一朵淡蓝色的花。

stalk.en: Police officers lie in wait for the gangs who stalk their prey at night.
stalk.zh: 警官们埋伏起来等待捉拿那些夜间悄悄追踪作案对象的黑帮成员。

stalk.en: Look at the plant. Its stalk is long.
stalk.zh: 看看这株植物。它的茎很长。

tab.en: A clerk had slipped the wrong tab on Tony's X-ray.
tab.zh: 一位职员失手把一个错误的标签贴到了托尼的X光片上。

tab.en: The icon on this tab is a beanie.
tab.zh: 这个标签上的图标是一个无檐小便帽。

tab.en: The first tab is appended at this time.
tab.zh: 第一个标签是在这个时候加载的。

intimidate.en: If you're too concerned with outcomes to the extent that you manipulate and intimidate others to achieve those outcomes, then you aren't leading at all, you're dictating.
intimidate.zh: 如果你过于关注结果，为此到了去操纵和恐吓他人的程度，那么你根本不是在领导，而是在发号施令。

intimidate.en: Jones had set out to intimidate and dominate Paul.
intimidate.zh: 琼斯曾试图威胁并控制保罗。

intimidate.en: "You have no right to intimidate this man," Alison continued.
intimidate.zh: “你无权威胁这个男人，”爱丽森继续说。

verge.en: He seemed to be on the verge of total derangement.
verge.zh: 他似乎已濒临精神崩溃的边缘。

verge.en: The mountain gorilla is on the verge of extinction.
verge.zh: 居住在山区的大猩猩已濒临灭绝。

verge.en: He was on the verge of tears.

batch.en: She brought a large batch of newspaper clippings.
Each summer a new batch of students tries to find work.
batch.zh: 每年夏天都有一批新的学生要找工作。

plague.en: It delves into everything from seasickness, jet lag and the hazards of camels to malaria and plague.
plague.zh: 它探究了从晕船、时差和骆驼的危害到疟疾和瘟疫的一切。

plague.en: Public health groups applauded the approved tax as a step toward fixing certain lasting health issues that plague Americans.
plague.zh: 公共卫生组织对批准的税收法案表示欢迎，认为这是在解决困扰美国人的某些长期健康问题方面迈出的一步。

plague.en: Iconoclasts, either because they were born that way or through learning, have found ways to work around the perceptual shortcuts that plague most people.
plague.zh: 要么天生如此，要么后天习得，总之传统叛逆者找到了困扰大多数人的认知捷径的替代方法。

lace.en: She finally found the perfect gown, a beautiful creation trimmed with lace.
lace.zh: 她最终找到了那件完美的大衣，款式漂亮、饰有花边。

lace.en: I have a good pair of skates, but no matter how tightly I lace them, my ankles wobble.
lace.zh: 我有一双很好的溜冰鞋，但是无论我把鞋带系得多么紧，我的脚踝还是在里面晃荡。

lace.en: The lingerie was exquisite; silk, handmade and trimmed with a cobweb of lace.
lace.zh: 内衣很精致；真丝，手工制作，还装饰着蛛网状的花边。

lord.en: We bless your holy name, O Lord.
lord.zh: 主啊，我们颂扬您的圣名。

lord.en: I know the Lord will look after him.
lord.zh: 我知道上帝会照顾他的。

expire.zh: 你的驾照什么时候到期？
图书馆借书证四年后到期。

expire.en: He is planning another tour abroad, yet his passport will expire at the end of this month.
expire.zh: 他计划再次出国旅行，但他的护照将于本月底到期。

deter.en: It is time to go beyond the shibboleth that conventional forces cannot deter.
deter.zh: 是时候摆脱那些传统力量无法阻止的旧观念了。

deter.en: No amount of foul weather, whether hail, wind, rain or snow, seems to deter them.
deter.zh: 不管天气有多恶劣，哪怕是冰雹、大风、雨还是雪，似乎都阻止不了他们。

deter.en: Supporters of the death penalty argue that it would deter criminals from carrying guns.
deter.zh: 死刑的支持者辩称，死刑可以阻止罪犯携带枪支。

catastrophe.en: From all points of view, war would be a catastrophe.
catastrophe.zh: 从各个方面来看，战争都会是一场灾难。

catastrophe.en: Early warnings of rising water levels prevented another major catastrophe.
catastrophe.zh: 提前发出的洪水水位上涨警报防止了又一次的重大灾害。

catastrophe.en: Believe it or not, this wasn't the worst catastrophe in our planet's history.
catastrophe.zh: 信不信由你，这还不是地球历史上最严重的灾难。

adjacent.zh: 这些飞机在毗连的跑道上降落。

adjacent.en: He sat in an adjacent room and waited.
adjacent.zh: 他坐在一间相邻的房间里等。

adjacent.en: The schools were adjacent but there were separate doors.
adjacent.zh: 这些学校相邻，但是有各自的门。

withhold.en: It can be inferred that Facebook is self-enhancer's paradise because people can withhold their unflattering sides.
withhold.zh: 可以推断，Facebook 是自我增强者的天堂，因为人们可以保留自己不讨喜的一面。

withhold.en: A: Does the company withhold income tax?

ivory.en: He showed him how to blow into the ivory mouthpiece.
ivory.zh: 他给他演示了如何把气吹进象牙吹口。

ivory.en: They don't really, in their ivory towers, understand how pernicious drug crime is.
ivory.zh: 身处象牙塔里，他们并不真正懂得毒品犯罪多么有害。

embryo.zh: 胚胎研究是个让人情绪激动的问题。

embryo.en: An eight-week-old embryo is only an inch long.
embryo.zh: 一个8周大的胎儿仅1英寸长。

embryo.en: The sex of the embryo is predetermined at fertilization.
embryo.zh: 胚胎的性别早在受精时就决定了。

decorative.zh: 这镜子能照人，但也有装饰作用。

decorative.en: The curtains are for purely decorative purposes and do not open or close.
decorative.zh: 那些窗帘纯粹用于装饰目的，不能开合。

decorative.en: She began in her 20s, making textless, decorative paintings of flowers with insects.
decorative.zh: 20多岁时，她开始创作花卉与昆虫的无文本装饰画。

stark.en: Stark took two whiskeys from a tray.
stark.zh: 斯塔克从托盘里拿了两杯威士忌。

stark.en: Social divisions in the city are stark.
stark.zh: 城市里各社会阶层有明确的分野。

stark.en: She seemed to have gone stark raving mad.

coincide.en: The interests of employers and employees do not always coincide.
coincide.zh: 雇主和雇员的利益并不总是一致的。

coincide.en: The kids' views on life don't always coincide, but they're not afraid of voicing their opinions.
coincide.zh: 孩子们的生活观未必总是一致，但是他们不怕表达自己的观点。

lucrative.en: They do a lot of business in lucrative overseas markets.
lucrative.zh: 他们在利润丰厚的海外市场上生意很多。

lucrative.en: Thousands of ex-army officers have found lucrative jobs in private security firms.
lucrative.zh: 成千上万的退役军官在私人保安公司找到了薪水丰厚的工作。

lucrative.en: Most firms would take almost anything if the fees were lucrative.
lucrative.zh: 大多数律所只要收费有利可图，他们几乎什么（案件）都愿意收。

violin.en: The cello is lower than the violin.
violin.zh: 大提琴的声音比小提琴低沉。

violin.en: He taught himself to play the violin.

transcend.en: Tomorrow we will transcend these as well, and the dreamers will deserve a lot of the credit.
transcend.zh: 明天我们也将超越这些成就，且梦想家们将会得到更多的荣誉。

transcend.en: Baudelaire regarded photography as "a very humble servant of art and science"; a medium largely unable to transcend "external reality".
transcend.zh: 波德莱尔认为摄影是“艺术和科学的一个非常卑微的仆人”；是一种很大程度上无法超越“外部现实”的媒介。

transcend.en: Both Martin Luther King and John Kennedy appealed to the idea that humans can transcend what were once considered inherent limitations.
transcend.zh: 马丁·路德·金和约翰·肯尼迪都发起呼吁，倡导人类能够超越曾经被认为是固有局限性的观点。

resistant.en: The more pesticides are used, the more resistant the insects become so the more pesticides have to be used. It's a vicious circle.
resistant.zh: 杀虫剂使用得越多，那些昆虫的抵抗力越强，因此就要使用更多的杀虫剂。这是一个恶性循环。

resistant.en: Paint the shed with weather-resistant paint.
resistant.zh: 用抗风雨的油漆把棚子漆一漆。

resistant.en: Oiled wood is water-resistant and won't flake.
resistant.zh: 上过油的木头防水而且不会剥落。

escort.en: Police were called to escort her off the premises.
He arrived with a police escort shortly before half past nine.
escort.zh: 快到9点半时，他由警察护送到达了。

escort.en: Policemen had to escort the referee from the football field.
escort.zh: 警察不得不护送这位裁判离开足球场。

dedicated.zh: 他奉献很多给他的学生们。

dedicated.en: He dedicated his life to helping the poor.
dedicated.zh: 他毕生致力于帮助穷人。

dedicated.en: She dedicated her life to working for peace.
dedicated.zh: 她为争取和平奉献了自己的一生。

elicit.en: Mr. Norris said he was hopeful that his request would elicit a positive response.
elicit.zh: 诺里斯先生说他希望他的要求会引起积极的回应。

elicit.en: These differences may elicit different brain responses.
elicit.zh: 这些差异可能引起不同的大脑反应。

elicit.en: I could elicit no response from him.
elicit.zh: 我从他那里套不出任何反应。

stall.en: He sold boots at a market stall.
stall.zh: 他在市场的一个摊位上卖靴子。

stall.en: Another discovered a valuable diamond brooch covered in tar in a bathroom stall.
stall.zh: 另一个人在浴室的小隔间里发现了一个沾满柏油的珍贵钻石胸针。

stall.en: See if you can stall her while I finish searching her office.
stall.zh: 你看能不能拖住她，我好把她的办公室搜查完。

oblige.en: Moreover, the integration of the European community will oblige television companies to cooperate more closely in terms of both production and distribution.
oblige.zh: 此外，欧洲共同体的一体化将迫使电视公司在制作和发行方面进行更密切的合作。

oblige.en: Would you oblige me with some information?
oblige.zh: 拜托您给我透露些消息好吗？

oblige.en: Call me if you need any help—I'd be happy to oblige.
oblige.zh: 若有需要，尽管给我打电话。我很乐意帮忙。

vest.en: His life was saved by a quarter-inch-thick bullet-proof vest.
vest.zh: 他被0.25英寸厚的防弹背心救了一命。

vest.en: That is not my vest. My vest is red.
vest.zh: 那不是我的背心。我的背心是红色的。

inquire.en: He called them several times to inquire about job possibilities.
inquire.zh: 他给他们打了几次电话打听就业的可能性。

inquire.en: He went to the desk to inquire and make a reservation.
inquire.zh: 他到前台去咨询并做了预订。

inquire.en: Inspectors were appointed to inquire into the affairs of the company.
inquire.zh: 检查员被派去调查该公司的事务。

bust.en: For him it's the Olympics or bust.
bust.zh: 他将竭尽全力参加奥运会。

bust.en: As a show it was a bust.
bust.zh: 作为一场演出，那可不怎么样。

signify.en: He nodded to signify that he agreed.
Eating is a metaphor that is sometimes used to signify marriage.
signify.zh: “吃”是一个比喻，有时用来表示婚姻。

signify.en: Getting into Yale may signify intelligence, talent and ambition.
signify.zh: 进入耶鲁大学可能意味着有智慧、才能和雄心。

prestige.en: It was his responsibility for foreign affairs that gained him international prestige.
prestige.zh: 是他在外交事务中的尽职尽责为他赢得了国际声望。

prestige.en: Some did not get much more prestige than that.
prestige.zh: 很少有人能享有如此声望。

prestige.en: International prestige is a justification for violence.
prestige.zh: 国际声望是运用暴力的正当理由。

bolster.en: The country is free to adopt policies to bolster its economy.
bolster.zh: 这个国家可自由采取措施来巩固经济。

bolster.en: Since the former is most common among those inclined towards indifferent relationships, their predominance can bolster individuals' sense of self-worth.
bolster.zh: 由于前者在那些倾向于淡漠关系的人群中最为常见，它们的优势可以增强个体的自我价值感。

bolster.en: Falling interest rates may help to bolster up the economy.
bolster.zh: 利率下降可能有助于激活经济。

elevation.en: The city is at an elevation of 2 000 metres.
We're probably at an elevation of about 13,000 feet above sea level.
elevation.zh: 我们很可能在海拔13000英尺的高度。

elevation.en: As elevation increases, narrow, deep channels of water form throughout the marsh.
elevation.zh: 随着海拔的升高，沼泽中形成了又窄又深的水渠。

linguistic.en: His linguistic ability served him well in his chosen profession.
linguistic.zh: 他的语言能力对他所选择的职业大有帮助。

linguistic.en: The ability to write is a supreme test of linguistic competence.
linguistic.zh: 写作能力是对语言能力的最高形式的测试。

linguistic.en: Popular linguistic debate regularly deteriorates into invective and polemic.
linguistic.zh: 流行的语言辩论经常沦为谩骂和论战。

splash.en: We're going to splash out and buy a new car.
splash.zh: 我们打算挥霍一下，买辆新车。

splash.en: Let them splash around in the pool for a while.
splash.zh: 让他们在水池里扑腾一会儿吧。

vibrant.en: The room was decorated in vibrant blues and greens.
vibrant.zh: 那房间以鲜艳的蓝绿两色装饰。

vibrant.en: Tom felt himself being drawn toward her vibrant personality.
vibrant.zh: 汤姆感到自己正被她充满活力的个性所吸引。

vibrant.en: A vibrant and growing economy does not improve everyone's quality of life.
vibrant.zh: 一个生机勃发的经济体并不能提升每个人的生活质量。

backdrop.en: Their love affair was played out against the backdrop of war.
backdrop.zh: 他们在战争的背景下发生恋情。

backdrop.en: The profits rise was achieved against a backdrop of falling metal prices.
backdrop.zh: 利润的增长是在金属价格下降的背景下取得的。

backdrop.en: The election will take place against a backdrop of increasing instability.
backdrop.zh: 选举的背景是逐渐不稳的局势。

stain.en: I rubbed at the stain on the cloth.
A dark red stain was spreading across his shirt.
stain.zh: 一个暗红色的污渍正在他的衬衫上渗开。
无原罪就是“无污点“的意思。

imminent.en: Every one feels that a disaster is imminent, as if a catastrophe is about to come.
imminent.zh: 谁都感到大事不好，似乎有什么极大的灾难即将来临。

imminent.en: There's been a warning about the imminent death of literate civilization for a long time.
imminent.zh: 很长一段时间以来，一直有关于文化文明即将死亡的警告。

foil.en: Wrap the meat in foil before you cook it.
foil.zh: 把肉用锡箔裹起来后再烹调。

foil.en: Foil wrapping paper is beautiful but difficult to use.
foil.zh: 锡箔包装纸好看却难用。

foil.en: The pale walls provide a perfect foil for the furniture.
foil.zh: 浅色的墙壁完全衬托出家具的特色。

geographical.en: The survey covers a wide geographical area.
geographical.zh: 此项调查覆盖的地理区域非常广阔。

geographical.en: They studied the geographical distribution of the disease.
geographical.zh: 他们研究了这种疾病的地域分布情况。

geographical.en: The importance of the town is due to its geographical location.
geographical.zh: 这座城镇的重要性在于它的地理位置。

rude.en: The man was downright rude to us.
rude.zh: 这个家伙对我们无礼至极。

rude.en: Why are you so rude to your mother?
rude.zh: 你为什么对你的母亲这么没礼貌？

rude.en: He became surly and rude toward me.

backwards.en: I lost my balance and fell backwards.

unveil.en: The sequel will finally unveil the family secret of why Po's father is a duck.
unveil.zh: 续集将最终揭开为什么阿宝的父亲是只鸭子的家庭秘密。

unveil.en: The company, which is expected to unveil a new version of the Kindle next week, did not say when Kindle titles would be available on mobile phones.
unveil.zh: 该公司预计将于下周推出新版 Kindle，但没有透露 Kindle 电子书什么时候可以在手机上使用。

bearing.en: Recent events had no bearing on our decision.
bearing.zh: 近期的事件与我们的决定没有关系。
她整个人保持着戒备状态。

bearing.en: Young people are bearing the brunt of unemployment.
bearing.zh: 失业对年轻人的冲击最大。

frustrated.en: It's very easy to get frustrated in this job.
frustrated.zh: 这个工作很容易令人懊恼。
赖特对美国的地方偏狭观念愈发感到沮丧。

frustrated.en: He often appeared angry and frustrated by the intransigence of both sides.
frustrated.zh: 他好像总是为双方的强硬态度而愤怒和沮丧。

landlord.zh: 他的房东把房租提高了一倍。

landlord.en: She has now settled with her landlord.
landlord.zh: 她现在已经和她的房东算清了。

landlord.en: The landlord has put the rent up again.

uncommon.en: A 15-year lifespan is not uncommon for a dog.
uncommon.zh: 15年的寿命对狗来说并非罕见。

uncommon.en: Both are blessed with an uncommon ability to fix things.
uncommon.zh: 俩人都有幸具有不寻常的修理东西的能力。

uncommon.en: It is not uncommon for college students to live at home.
uncommon.zh: 大学生住在家里并不少见。

animated.en: Disney has returned to what it does best: making full-length animated feature films.
animated.zh: 迪斯尼电影公司回到他们最拿手的事情：制作长篇动画故事片。

animated.en: Now, a person can be animated from scratch.
animated.zh: 现在，一个人可以从零开始被动画化。

animated.en: In children's advertising, the "celebrities" are often animated figures from popular cartoons.
animated.zh: 在儿童广告中，“名人”往往是流行卡通中的动画人物。

deepen.en: There were plans to deepen a stretch of the river.
deepen.zh: 曾经有过加深一段河道的计划。

deepen.en: The course is an exciting opportunity for anyone wishing to deepen their understanding of themselves and other people.
deepen.zh: 这门课程对于希望加深了解自己和他人的人们来说，是个令人兴奋的机会。
她的皱纹随着年龄增长而加深。

amusement.en: What do you do for amusement round here?

amusement.zh: 他眼睛里流露出愉悦的神情。
他眼里隐约露出愉悦的神情。

curb.en: He needs to learn to curb his temper.
curb.zh: 他得学着控制自己的脾气。

curb.en: It's easier to pick up apples than to drag tree branches all the way to the curb.
curb.zh: 摘苹果比把树枝一直拖到路边要容易得多。

curb.en: If patients pay very little out of their own pockets, they have little desire to curb consumption.
curb.zh: 如果病人自掏腰包支付的钱很少，他们就不会有遏制消费的意愿。

anthropology.en: Listen to part of a lecture in an anthropology class.
Wasn't there notice on the Anthropology Department's bulletin board?
anthropology.zh: 难道在人类学学院的公告栏上没有通知吗？

anthropology.en: I took a few anthropology classes with her and they were great, inspiring.
anthropology.zh: 我和她一起上了几堂人类学的课，这些课都很好，很振奋人心。

implicit.en: Recent research on consumer memory and judgment suggests another advantage of implicit conclusions.
implicit.zh: 最近关于消费者记忆和判断的研究显示了隐含结论的另一个优势。

implicit.en: Despite these advantages, implicit conclusions may not always be more effective than explicit conclusions.
implicit.zh: 尽管有这些优势，隐性结论并不总是比显性结论更有效。

implicit.en: Because consumers are invited to make up their own minds, implicit conclusions reduce the risk of resentment, distrust, and counterargumentation.
implicit.zh: 因为邀请消费者自主决定，所以隐含的结论减少了怨恨、不信任和反驳的风险。

conquer.en: The only way to conquer a fear is to face it.
conquer.zh: 克服恐惧的唯一方法是正视恐惧。

conquer.en: The band is now setting out to conquer the world.
conquer.zh: 这支乐队现在要去征服世界。
你不能征服珠穆朗玛峰。

interestingly.en: We find, quite interestingly, men are more affected than women.
interestingly.zh: 很有趣的是，我们发现男性比女性更容易受到影响。

interestingly.en: Interestingly, apologizing can even have positive health benefits.
interestingly.zh: 有趣的是，道歉甚至对健康有益。

interestingly.en: Interestingly, there are clams and snail shells; but, no fossils of fish.
interestingly.zh: 有趣的是，那里有蛤蜊和蜗牛壳，但是，没有鱼的化石。

dictator.en: The quality of independence is so indispensable for us that parents had better act as a tutor, not a dictator.
dictator.zh: 独立的品质对我们来说是不可或缺的，所以父母最好是做一个指导者，而不是独裁者。

dictator.en: Following the fall of the military dictator in March, the country has had a civilian government.
dictator.zh: 军事独裁者3月垮台之后，该国已有了一个平民政府。

dictator.en: IT HAS been a rotten week for the dictator.
dictator.zh: 对卡扎菲来说,这是极其糟糕的一周。

composite.en: Spain is a composite of multifarious traditions and people.
composite.zh: 西班牙是多种传统和多个民族的合成体。

composite.en: The document was a composite of information from various sources.
composite.zh: 这份文件是不同来源信息的综合。

composite.en: Galton devised a method of creating composite pictures in which the features of different faces were superimposed over one another.
composite.zh: 高尔顿发明了一种将不同脸的部位相互叠加而创作合成图片的方法。

fetch.zh: 你能帮我去取我的包吗？

fetch.en: I had to fetch water from the well.

inhale.en: Then there are the taste receptors, and finally, the smell, activated when we inhale.
inhale.zh: 然后是味觉感受器，最后是嗅觉，当我们吸气时就被激活。

inhale.en: Provine realized that the reason chimps cannot emit a string of "ho ho ho" is that they cannot make more than a single sound when they exhale or inhale.
inhale.zh: 普罗文认识到，黑猩猩之所以不能发出一连串的“呵呵呵”声音的原因，在于它们在呼气或吸气时无法发出一个以上的音节。

inhale.en: Generally, you exhale on the effort, if doing weights, karate or boxing, and inhale on the return.
inhale.zh: 一般来说，如果你在做举重、空手道或拳击等运动用力时，你会呼气，然后吸气。

forthcoming.en: A monarchist party is running in the forthcoming elections.
forthcoming.zh: 一个主张君主政体的政党要参加即将来临的大选。

forthcoming.en: He reckons that the forthcoming field tests will be the turning point — and he's hoping for good news.
forthcoming.zh: 他认为即将进行的实地试验将是一个转折点，他希望有好消息。

siren.en: It sounds like an air raid siren.
siren.zh: 这听起来像是空袭警报。

siren.en: Mary heard the penetrating siren of an ambulance.
siren.zh: 玛丽听到了救护车刺耳的警报声。

circular.en: Loving a child is a circular business.
circular.zh: 爱一个孩子是一个循环。

circular.en: He pointed out that the shape of sunspots weren't circular.
circular.zh: 他指出，太阳黑子不是圆形的。

circular.en: Most known extrasolar planets reside in highly elongated, not circular, orbits.
circular.zh: 大多数已知的太阳系外行星都居住在高度拉长而非圆形的轨道上。

vacant.en: The seat next to him was vacant.
She had a kind of vacant look on her face.
vacant.zh: 在她脸上有一种茫然的表情。

vacant.en: The position of chairman has been vacant for some time.
vacant.zh: 主席的职位已经空缺一段时间了。

greed.zh: 他眼睛里闪现出贪婪的神色。
他的作为是贪婪之心所驱使的。

width.en: The terrace runs the full width of the house.
width.zh: 露台里铺砌的地面和房子一般宽。

width.en: The road was reduced to 18 ft in width by adding parking bays.
width.zh: 这条路增加了停车区域后，宽度减少为18英尺。

deaf.en: She learnt to sign to help her deaf child.
deaf.zh: 为帮助她耳聋的孩子，她学会了手语。

deaf.en: The two deaf actors converse solely in signing.
deaf.zh: 两位聋哑演员只靠打手势语交谈。

incoming.en: They claimed to have shot down one incoming missile.
incoming.zh: 他们声称已经击落了一枚来袭的导弹。

incoming.en: Either way, the incoming Fed chief will have to walk a fine line in slowly ending the stimulus.
incoming.zh: 不管怎样，这位即将上任的美联储主席不得不小心翼翼地缓慢结束这一激励计划。

incoming.en: We keep a tape of incoming calls.
incoming.zh: 我们保留打进电话的录音磁带。

weary.zh: 雷切尔看起来苍白而疲惫。
她突然感到了衰老和疲倦。
她的脸色显得憔悴疲惫。

complement.en: There will be a written examination to complement the practical test.
complement.zh: 会有一次书面考试来补充实践测试。

complement.en: The therapy can be a useful technique to complement traditional forms of psychotherapy.
complement.zh: 这种疗法可以作为一个有效的技巧，作为传统心理疗法的补充。

complement.en: We must aim to complement the rationality of the machine, rather than to compete with it.
complement.zh: 我们必须致力于补足机器的理性，而不是与它竞争。

allocate.en: The effect is caused by the way we allocate our attention.
allocate.zh: 这种效应是由我们分配注意力的方式引起的。

allocate.en: The effect is caused by the way we allocate our attention.
allocate.zh: 这种效应是由我们分配注意力的方式引起的。

allocate.en: It helps you allocate proper time for a task and perform the task more efficiently.
allocate.zh: 它能帮助你分配合理的任务时间，并助你更高效地执行任务。

lush.en: In the cold winter, daffodil foliage is still lush, full of vitality, to bring people the spring.
lush.zh: 在寒冷的冬天，水仙花依然枝叶繁茂，生机盎然，给人们送来了春意。

lush.en: On one side stand new apartment buildings for civil servants, with luxury kitchens and a sprinkler system embedded in the lush lawn.
lush.zh: 一边是林立的为公务员修建的新公寓，它们有奢华的厨房、埋入茂盛草坪的洒水系统。

lush.en: The hills are covered in lush green vegetation.
lush.zh: 这片丘岭草木茂盛，郁郁葱葱。

probable.en: It is probable that the disease has a genetic element.
probable.zh: 这种疾病很可能有遗传因素。

probable.en: If something is probable, you mean that you can trust it, so probability means trustworthiness.
probable.zh: 如果有什么是很可能的，你的意思是你可以信赖它，所以可能性意味着可信赖度。

probable.en: It is probable that many undiagnosed children exist in the education system with "invisible" disabilities.
probable.zh: 在教育系统中，很可能存在许多未被确诊的儿童，他们有“看不见的”残疾。

mourn.en: He does not mourn the demise of that world liberated from court etiquette, he says, he can call someone an "idiot" if he wants, instead of "Your Excellency".
mourn.zh: 他说，他不会为这个从宫廷礼仪中解放出来的世界的消亡而哀悼，如果他愿意，他可以称某人为“白痴”，而不是“阁下”。

mourn.en: They mourn the passing of a simpler way of life.
mourn.zh: 他们对逝去的较为淳朴的生活感到惋惜。

mourn.en: Today we mourn for all those who died in two world wars.
mourn.zh: 今天，我们向所有在两次世界大战中死难的人表示哀悼。

arguably.en: Venus was arguably a cozier habitat for life than earth.
arguably.zh: 可以说金星是比地球更舒适的生命栖息地。

arguably.en: China has arguably the fastest-growing operations in Antarctica.
arguably.zh: 可以说，中国在南极洲的业务是发展最快的。

arguably.en: With Mars the scientific stakes are arguably higher than they have ever been.
arguably.zh: 对于火星来说，科学风险可以说比以往任何时候都要高。

scarce.en: Hospital beds were scarce and medicines were practically non-existent.
scarce.zh: 当时医院病床紧缺，药物根本所剩无几。

charitable.en: He had set up two charitable trusts.
charitable.zh: 他已经成立了两家慈善信托机构。

charitable.en: We are happy to donate to bona fide charitable causes.
charitable.zh: 我们很乐意向真正的慈善事业捐赠。

charitable.en: Today there are many charitable organizations which specialize in helping the weary traveler.
charitable.zh: 今天有许多慈善组织专门帮助疲惫的旅行者。

siege.zh: 围城已经和平地结束了。

siege.en: The siege is now in its eighteenth day.
The town capitulated after a three-week siege.
siege.zh: 这座城镇被围困三个星期后投降了。

paradox.en: The story contains many levels of paradox.
paradox.zh: 这个故事包含很多层面的悖论。

paradox.en: He was a paradox—a loner who loved to chat to strangers.
paradox.zh: 他真是个矛盾人物，生性孤僻却又喜欢和陌生人闲聊。

paradox.en: It is a curious paradox that professional comedians often have unhappy personal lives.
paradox.zh: 这真是个奇怪的矛盾现象—职业喜剧演员的私人生活往往并不快乐。

barbecue.zh: 我们来一次户外烧烤吧！

barbecue.en: She shut the dog in the shed while she prepared the barbecue.
barbecue.zh: 她做烤肉时把狗关在窝里。

barbecue.en: We were going to have a barbecue but the rain put the mockers on that idea.
barbecue.zh: 我们打算露天烧烤，但因为下雨，计划泡汤了。

definite.zh: 那么，那是确切的了，是吗？

pervasive.en: The most pervasive problem is less obvious: our own behaviour.
pervasive.zh: 最普遍的问题不那么明显：即，我们自己的行为。

pervasive.en: The narrowness of this perspective ignores the pervasive recessions and joblessness of the previous decades, as Alexander Keyssar shows in his recent book.
pervasive.zh: 正如 Alexander Keyssar 在其新书中所指出的那样，这种狭隘的观点忽略了过去几十年普遍存在的衰退和失业现象。

pervasive.en: According to a recent study of retail firms, which confirmed that IT has become pervasive and relatively easy to acquire, IT by itself appeared to have conferred little advantage.
pervasive.zh: 最近对零售公司的一项研究证明了信息技术已经变得普遍且相对容易被获得，但它本身似乎并没有带来什么优势。

preside.en: They asked if I would preside at the committee meeting.
preside.zh: 他们问我是否会主持委员会会议。

preside.en: The pope sprinkled incense on the altar, then read the traditional prayer of peace in Latin, and began to preside over the mass.
preside.zh: 教皇把香撒在圣坛上，然后用拉丁文念了传统的和平祷文，并开始主持弥撒。

preside.en: The PM returned to Downing Street to preside over a meeting of his inner cabinet.
preside.zh: 首相回到唐宁街去主持一场核心内阁会议。

discriminate.en: When do babies learn to discriminate voices?
discriminate.zh: 婴儿什么时候学会辨别嗓音呢？

discriminate.en: Employers cannot discriminate on grounds of age.
The tests discriminate unfairly against older people.
discriminate.zh: 这些测验使年纪较大的人受到歧视。

strategist.en: On June 1st, Bob Stith, a former pastor from Texas, became the SBC's first national strategist for Gender Issues.
strategist.zh: 6月1日，来自德克萨斯的前牧师鲍勃·斯蒂斯成为了 SBC 的首位性别问题国家战略顾问。
我们的心理是一个聪明的战略家。
英特尔教育策划人艾琳。伦托。

disruption.en: The disruption of European trade during the war had thrown the economy into a tailspin.
disruption.zh: 战争期间欧洲贸易的中断使经济陷入一片困境。

disruption.en: It was a time of great grief and disruption, during which I thought several times of giving up.
disruption.zh: 这段时间我沮丧不已，思绪中断，屡想放弃。

disruption.en: We aim to help you move house with minimum disruption to yourself.
disruption.zh: 我们的宗旨是帮您搬家，并尽量减少它给您带来的不便。

trademark.zh: “巨无霸”是麦当劳最著名的商标。

trademark.en: She has registered a trademark for a new range of perfumes.
trademark.zh: 她已为一个新系列的香水注册了商标。

territorial.en: The ship will remain outside Chinese territorial waters.
territorial.zh: 这艘船将继续停留在中国领海之外。

territorial.en: Though their language is related to Hindi, their territorial origins are misty.
territorial.zh: 尽管他们的语言与印地语有关，但他们的领土起源却很模糊。

territorial.en: In 1992 outlaw fishing boats began illegally harvesting lobsters from the territorial waters of the country of Belukia.
territorial.zh: 1992年，非法渔船开始在贝鲁基亚国的领海非法捕捞龙虾。

displace.en: Renewable energy will have to displace fossil fuels to a much greater extent in the future to avoid unacceptable climate risks.
displace.zh: 为了避免难以容忍的气候风险，未来可再生能源将不得不在更大程度上取代化石燃料。

displace.en: Humans are the ultimate invasive species—when they move into new territory, they often displace the wildlife that was already living there.
displace.zh: 人类是终极入侵物种——当他们进入新的领地时，他们经常会取代已经生活在那里的野生动物。

displace.en: This is because, according to Archimedes' principle of displacement, floating objects displace their own weight in water.
displace.zh: 这是因为，根据阿基米德的位移原理，漂浮物在水中会转移自身的重量。

catalog.en: Let me look it up in the catalog.
Will you please send us your price list or catalog?
catalog.zh: 请把你们的价格表或目录寄给我们好吗？

catalog.en: They had to flip through a card catalog to find that dusty old volume with the article they wanted.
catalog.zh: 他们不得不翻阅卡片目录，找到那本满是灰尘的旧书，里面有他们想要的文章。

marsh.en: Through the marsh grass, the birds are rising.
marsh.zh: 穿过沼泽的草地，鸟儿们飞了起来。

marsh.en: Marsh goes on to describe his impression of Nim.
marsh.zh: 马什在继续向我们描述他对尼姆的印象。

marsh.en: Forget Gaia, save a marsh; forget the planet, save a frog.
marsh.zh: 忘记地球，去拯救一片湿地；忘记行星，去拯救一只青蛙。

gradual.en: Losing weight is a slow, gradual process.
gradual.zh: 减肥是一个缓慢而逐渐的过程。

gradual.en: The roads are built to accommodate gradual temperature changes.
gradual.zh: 这些道路是为适应气温的逐渐变化而建的。

gradual.en: The greatest hope for reform is the gradual spread of information.
gradual.zh: 改革的最大希望就是信息的逐渐传播。

polar.en: The polar vortex is a system of wintertime winds.
polar.zh: 极地涡旋是冬季风形成的一个风系。

polar.en: There was a period of excessive warmth which melted some of the polar ice.
polar.zh: 有段时期温度过高，融化了极地的部分冰层。

documentation.en: In Chapter 3, I shall describe some of the documentation that I gathered.
documentation.zh: 在第3章，我将讲述我所搜集到的一些文献资料。

documentation.en: Britain's trade figures can no longer be extracted from export-and-import documentation at ports.
documentation.zh: 英国的贸易数字再也不能从各港口的进出口文件中摘取了。

documentation.en: If you want to work not only in the code but also want documentation, use this mode.
documentation.zh: 如果您不只想处理代码，但是又想文档化，那么就使用这种模式。

puppy.en: A puppy stepped in the fresh cement.
puppy.zh: 一只小狗走到新铺的水泥路面上。

puppy.en: She can bring her puppy to school for show-and-tell.
puppy.zh: 她可以带着自己的小狗去学校上展示讲述活动课。

puppy.en: The children squealed with delight when they saw the puppy.
puppy.zh: 孩子们看到小狗时高兴得大声尖叫。

slump.en: The toy industry is in a slump.
The likelihood is that the slump will be followed by a period of buoyancy.
slump.zh: 有可能在衰退之后出现一段繁荣时期。

slump.en: The slump on Wall Street set up a chain reaction in stock markets around the world.
slump.zh: 华尔街股价暴跌在全球股票市场上引起了连锁反应。

remainder.en: He gulped down the remainder of his coffee.
remainder.zh: 他一口喝完了剩下的咖啡。

remainder.en: Efforts to persuade the remainder to follow suit have continued.
remainder.zh: 说服其余的人也跟着做的努力在继续。

remainder.en: His widow became a virtual recluse for the remainder of her life.
remainder.zh: 他的遗孀在其余生成了一名实际上的隐居者。

prohibition.en: The prohibition of using certain hardwoods for furniture and building materials goes a long way towards protecting forests and thus the flora and fauna within that habitat.
prohibition.zh: 禁止使用某些硬木来做家具和建筑材料对保护森林，从而保护该栖息地内的动植物大有帮助。

prohibition.en: Prohibition on the use of certain hardwoods for furniture and building materials goes a long way towards protecting forests and thus the flora and fauna within that habitat.
prohibition.zh: 禁止使用某些硬木作为家具和建筑材料对保护森林，进而保护该生活环境内的动植物大有帮助。

prohibition.en: Citizens still have a right to expect private documents to remain private and protected by the Constitution's prohibition on unreasonable searches.
prohibition.zh: 公民仍然有权要求私人文件保持私密性，并受到宪法的保护，免受不合理的搜查。

coconut.en: The beach was fringed by coconut palms.
The coconut palm is a native of Malaysia.
coconut.zh: 这棵椰子树是马来西亚的土生植物。

coconut.en: Coconut is a basic ingredient for many curries.
coconut.zh: 椰子是多种咖喱菜的基本成分。

badge.zh: 所有代表都要佩戴徽章。

badge.en: She pinned the badge onto her jacket.

badge.zh: 我们能给他弄个徽章吗？

navy.en: He was enlisted into the US Navy.
navy.zh: 他应征参加了美国海军。

navy.en: He had formerly been in the navy.

seafood.en: Seafood is a speciality on the island.
The seafood here is a gourmet's delight.
seafood.zh: 这儿的海鲜是美食家的一大享受。

seafood.en: The fish or seafood is heavily salted with pure sodium chloride.
seafood.zh: 鱼或海产品以厚厚的纯氯化钠盐腌制。

void.en: The contract was declared null and void.

paradise.zh: 这一地区是鸟类观察者的乐园。

paradise.en: The Koran describes paradise as a place containing a garden of delight.
paradise.zh: 《古兰经》把天堂描绘成一个拥有快乐花园的地方。

paradise.en: The ancient Egyptians saw paradise as an idealized version of their own lives.
paradise.zh: 古埃及人把天堂视为他们现实生活的理想形式。

granite.en: The towers are made of steel cased in granite.
granite.zh: 这些塔楼是钢结构，花岗岩贴面。

granite.en: "Well," I said, grinding my cigarette nervously into the granite step.
granite.zh: “好吧，”我边说边紧张地把香烟在花岗岩台阶上碾灭。

granite.en: I cut through the courtyard, past the empty granite benches where I'd met Gates.
granite.zh: 我穿过院子，经过那些空的花岗岩长椅，我在那里遇到了盖茨。

erode.en: Then over many more years, the Phosphorus-rich rocks of the new land begin to erode and the cycle continues.
erode.zh: 然后过了许多年，含磷丰富的新陆地岩石开始被侵蚀，而且循环还在继续。

erode.en: The central state, though often very rich and very populous, was intrinsically fragile, since the development of new international trade routes could undermine the monetary base and erode state power.
erode.zh: 尽管中央帝国通常非常富有和人口稠密，它本质上是很脆弱的，因为新的国际贸易路线的发展可能会破坏货币基础和侵蚀国家权力。

erode.en: The rain will erode the deeds of his life.
erode.zh: 雨水将慢慢地腐蚀掉他的生命契约。

hum.en: The place is really beginning to hum.
hum.zh: 这个地方真的开始热闹繁忙起来了。

hum.en: In the background was that eternal hum.
hum.zh: 背景里是那没完没了的哼哼声。

hum.en: She does not like poetry, but she likes to hum pop songs.
hum.zh: 她并不喜欢诗歌，但是她喜欢哼流行歌曲。

synthetic.en: Boots made from synthetic materials can usually be washed in a machine.
synthetic.zh: 用合成材料做成的靴子通常可以在机器里洗。

synthetic.en: New synthetic foods will form a regular part of people's diets.
synthetic.zh: 新的合成食品将成为人们日常饮食的一部分。

synthetic.en: The main idea here is that synthetic chemical dyes replaced textile dyes.
synthetic.zh: 其主要想法是合成化学染料代替纺织染料。

restrain.en: The government is taking steps to restrain inflation.
restrain.zh: 政府正在采取措施控制通货膨胀。
他们无法抑制自己的激动。
约翰努力压制住自己的怒气。

syrup.en: Maple syrup is made from sap extracted from the sugar maple tree.
syrup.zh: 槭糖浆是用糖槭树中提取的树液制成的。

syrup.en: After almost a month we get such syrup.
syrup.zh: 大概一个月后，我们会得到这样的糖浆。

syrup.en: Next, add the peanut butter and corn syrup.
syrup.zh: 接下来，加入花生酱和玉米糖浆。

mimic.en: At school I was a good mimic.
mimic.zh: 上学时我是一个善于模仿的人。

mimic.en: The robot was programmed to mimic a series of human movements.
mimic.zh: 机器人可按程序设计模仿人的各种动作。

mimic.en: He could mimic anybody, and he often reduced Isabel to helpless laughter.
mimic.zh: 他可以模仿任何人，而且经常逗得伊莎贝尔情不自禁地大笑。

beverage.en: We were obliged, faute de mieux, to drink the local beverage.
beverage.zh: 因为没有更好的饮料，我们只好将就着喝当地的。
咖啡是一种香味浓郁的饮料。

beverage.en: Notice the large beverage in this fellow's left hand.
beverage.zh: 注意这个人左手上的大瓶装饮料。

illegally.zh: 他通过非法途径进入了这个国家。
非法停放的车辆将被拖走。

illegally.en: He was convicted of illegally using a handgun.

pierce.en: They failed to pierce the Liverpool defence.
pierce.zh: 他们未能突破利物浦队的防线。

pierce.en: Testud lost in straight sets to countrywoman Mary Pierce.
pierce.zh: 泰斯图德连续几盘输给了女同胞玛丽•皮尔斯。

pierce.en: A tap on the door interrupted him and Sally Pierce came in.
pierce.zh: 轻轻的敲门声打断了他，萨莉•皮尔斯进来了。

wholly.zh: 这样的批评完全是不公平的。

wholly.en: In my opinion, the decision was wholly justified.
wholly.zh: 在我看来，这个决定是完全合理的。

wholly.en: The aims of the organization are wholly peaceful.
wholly.zh: 这个组织的宗旨完全是追求和平。

hybrid.en: Hybrid cars can go almost 600 miles between refuelling.
hybrid.zh: 混合动力汽车加满油能行驶将近六百英里。

hybrid.en: Hybrid cars do little harm to the environment.
hybrid.zh: 混合动力汽车对环境危害不大。

hybrid.en: A mule is a hybrid of a male donkey and a female horse.
hybrid.zh: 骡子是公驴和母马交配而生的杂种动物。

indulge.en: Only rarely will she indulge in a glass of wine.
indulge.zh: 她只是偶尔才会喝上杯葡萄酒。

indulge.en: They went into town to indulge in some serious shopping.
The inheritance enabled him to indulge his passion for art.
indulge.zh: 这笔遗产使他能够尽情投入他热爱的艺术。

pest.zh: 这几乎是一项虫害防治服务。

pest.en: He climbed on the table, pulled my hair, and was generally a pest.
pest.zh: 他爬上桌子，揪我的头发，真是个讨厌鬼。

lodge.en: He has four weeks in which to lodge an appeal.
lodge.zh: 他有4周时间来正式提出上诉。

lodge.en: I drove out of the gates, past the keeper's lodge.
lodge.zh: 我开车出了大门，经过看门人的门房。

lodge.en: He'd already started construction on a hunting lodge.
lodge.zh: 他已经开始建造一个狩猎用的小屋。

interim.en: The power-balance has evened out in the interim government.
interim.zh: 临时政府内的权力平衡已持平。

interim.en: She was sworn in as head of an interim government in March.
interim.zh: 她3月份宣誓出任临时政府首脑。

interim.en: The vice-president took power in the interim period before the election.
interim.zh: 在大选之前的过渡阶段由副总统执政。

prairie.en: The prairie vole is one such animal.
prairie.zh: 草原田鼠就是这样一种动物。

prairie.en: But winters on the prairie can still get pretty harsh today.
prairie.zh: 而草原上的冬天现在依旧是很严寒。

prairie.en: To assemble a prairie takes time—even if you have all the pieces.
prairie.zh: 组装一个大草原需要时间——即使你拥有所有的部件。

atmospheric.en: Then some astronomers came up with the idea that atmospheric ammonia might have acted as a greenhouse gas.
atmospheric.zh: 后来一些天文学家提出，大气中的氨可能起到温室气体的作用。

atmospheric.en: To serve as responsible stewards of the planet, we must press forward on deeper atmospheric and oceanic research.
atmospheric.zh: 为了成为地球上有责任心的一员，我们必须推进对大气和海洋更深入的研究。

atmospheric.en: Franklin conducted his dangerous kite experiment in a thunderstorm, founding the science of atmospheric electricity.
atmospheric.zh: 富兰克林在雷雨中进行了危险的风筝实验，从而奠定了大气电学的基础。

commuter.en: She accidentally stepped on his foot on a crowded commuter train.
commuter.zh: 她在一辆拥挤的通勤火车上不小心踩到他的脚。

commuter.en: Commuter airlines fly to out-of-the-way places. And business travellers are the ones who go to those locations.
commuter.zh: 通勤航空公司飞往偏僻的地方。此外，商务旅客就是去那些地方的人。

commuter.en: Commuter diatoms, for example, emerge only during those low tides that occur during the day.
commuter.zh: 例如，往返于通勤硅藻只在白天出现低潮时出现。

serial.en: The Mi-26 is the largest in the world serial Soviet transport helicopter.
serial.zh: 米-26 是世界上最大的前苏联系列运输直升机。

serial.en: There we'll be able to stamp it with a serial number, we actually stamp it into the metal.
serial.zh: 这样我们就可以在上面印上序列号，实际上我们可以把它印在金属上。

surpass.en: He was determined to surpass the achievements of his older brothers.
surpass.zh: 他决心超过他的几位哥哥的成就。

surpass.en: With such progress, Google's cars will easily surpass my own driving ability later this year.
surpass.zh: 有了这样的进步，谷歌汽车的驾驶能力将在今年晚些时候轻松超越我自己的车技。

surpass.en: It showed such children surpass youngsters from richer backgrounds—even those who could use computers.
surpass.zh: 调查显示，这些孩子超越了来自富裕家庭的孩子，甚至超过了那些会使用电脑的孩子。

dwarf.en: He might have been called the invulnerable dwarf of the fray.
dwarf.zh: 可以说，他是混战中的一个无懈可击的侏儒。

dwarf.en: This was not the best of it; for the dwarf said, "I know thee."
dwarf.zh: 这还不是最好的；因为小矮人说："我认识你。”

dwarf.en: The dwarf said, "I come to talk with your father, not with you."
dwarf.zh: 小矮人说：“我是来和你父亲谈的，不是来和你谈的。”

infinite.en: Human beings have an infinite capacity for self-deception.
infinite.zh: 人类自欺的能力是无穷尽的。

infinite.en: The most amazing thing about nature is its infinite variety.
infinite.zh: 大自然最让人惊叹的地方在于它的无限多样性。

infinite.en: Via the Internet, we are exposed to infinite information.
infinite.zh: 通过互联网，我们接触到无限的信息。

gossip.zh: 他喜欢闲话和流言蜚语。
她对任何形式的流言飞语都嗤之以鼻。

gossip.en: He spent the first hour talking gossip.
gossip.zh: 他头一个小时尽在说人闲话。

muscular.en: Like most athletes, she was lean and muscular.
muscular.zh: 像大部分运动员一样，她清瘦而且肌肉强健。

muscular.en: Muscular aches and pains can be soothed by a relaxing massage.
muscular.zh: 做放松按摩可以减轻肌肉疼痛。

contradict.en: Bowen and Greene's results contradict that argument.
contradict.zh: 鲍恩和格林的结果与该论点相矛盾。

contradict.en: "I am sorry," said the Owl, "to have to contradict the Crow, my famous friend and colleague."
contradict.zh: “很抱歉，”猫头鹰说，“我不得不反驳乌鸦，我杰出的朋友和同事。”

landfill.en: The poison inside them moves through rain water to the bottom of the landfill.
landfill.zh: 它们里面的毒物通过雨水流到垃圾填埋场的底部。

landfill.en: Shrinking landfill space and rising costs for burying and burning rubbish are forcing local governments to look more closely at recycling.
landfill.zh: 垃圾填埋场面积的缩小，以及填埋和焚烧垃圾成本的上升，都在迫使地方政府更深入地研究如何回收利用垃圾。

landfill.en: It will come as no surprise to learn that the main candidates spent their largest sums on flyers, leaflets, posters and other bumf destined for the landfill.
landfill.zh: 得知主要的候选人将他们最大的一笔钱花在传单、传单、海报和其他注定要被填埋的垃圾上时，这并不惊讶。

temporal.en: One is also able to see how specific acts are related to a temporal and spatial context.
temporal.zh: 人们也能看到具体的行为如何与时间和空间背景相关联。

temporal.en: Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival.
temporal.zh: 时间与环境相关联对他们的生存至关重要。

temporal.en: It's a sort of observatory that reveals how the rivers are behaving from their own temporal frame, and allows us to witness those changes on our smartwatches or phones.
temporal.zh: 它是一种观测台，按照河流自身的时间框架揭示了河流的“行为”，并让我们能够通过智能手表或智能手机见证这些变化。

commute.zh: 那么你上下班路程要花多长时间？

commute.en: People are prepared to commute long distances if they are desperate for work.
commute.zh: 亟须得到工作的人会愿意长途乘车往返上下班。

commute.en: They were asked to predict whether they'd enjoy the commute more if they conversed with other people.
commute.zh: 他们被要求预测如果与他人交谈，他们是否会更享受通勤。

bilateral.en: Kinship is unilateral while friendship and love are bilateral.
bilateral.zh: 亲情是单方面的，而友情和爱情是双方面的。

bilateral.en: The business council is aimed at balancing bilateral trade by expanding trade volume.
bilateral.zh: 商务委员会旨在通过扩大贸易规模来平衡双边贸易。

bilateral.en: This bilateral asymmetry begins to appear in the juvenile sixth stage of development.
bilateral.zh: 这种双侧不对称开始出现在青少年发育的第六阶段。

lunar.en: "Well I suppose it is based on the old lunar months, isn't it?"—"Yes, that's right."

adolescence.zh: 该剧定位于少年和青春期之间的危险的中间年龄段。
