prevalent.zh: 尽管事实上这种疾病非常普遍，治疗却远不尽如人意。

prevalent.en: Nowadays star chasing is prevalent among many teenagers.
prevalent.zh: 如今，追星在青少年中盛行。

lumber.en: Let's bring in a truck-load of lumber and start building tomorrow.
lumber.zh: 咱们运一车木材来，明天就开始建吧。

lumber.en: The lumber and paper mills in Port Angeles also block access to upstream spawning beds.
lumber.zh: 安吉利斯港的木材和造纸厂也封锁了通往上游产卵场的通道。

lumber.en: Parliament used British tax money to pay modest incentives to Americans producing such items as silk, iron, dyes, hemp, and lumber.
lumber.zh: 国会利用英国的税收资金，给予生产丝绸、铁、染料、大麻和木材等产品的美国人适度的鼓励。

benign.en: It wasn't cancer, only a benign tumour.
benign.zh: 这不是癌，只是良性肿瘤。

benign.en: This is a benign variation within circadian rhythms known as a chronotype.
benign.zh: 这是一种被称为睡眠类型的昼夜节律的良性变化。

benign.en: Moreover, in the domestic rabbits, the warts were no longer benign, but malignant.
benign.zh: 此外，家兔的疣不再是良性的，而是恶性的。

dedication.en: Her dedication to her work was admirable.
dedication.zh: 她对工作的奉献精神可钦可佩。

dedication.en: Her colleagues could not fault her dedication to the job.
dedication.zh: 她的同事认为她的敬业精神是无可挑剔的。

dedication.en: The new model is a testament to the skill and dedication of the workforce.
dedication.zh: 这种新型产品显示了全体员工的技术水平和敬业精神。

archeological.en: I would propose that scientific archeological expeditions and governmental authorities sell excavated artifacts on the open market.
archeological.zh: 我建议科学的考古考察和政府部门在公开市场上出售出土的文物。

archeological.en: I assume that most students taking the introductory level class would have little or no experience with archeological research, but that's ok.
archeological.zh: 我想大多数上入门级课程的学生的考古研究经验都是很少或没有的，但没关系。

archeological.en: What we think we know derives chiefly from archeological evidence, which is before writing--mute evidence that has to be interpreted and is very complicated.
archeological.zh: 我们目前所认为的史实，主要都是从考古证据中所得，这些无声的证据出现于文字记录之前，因此就需要繁复的考证及解读。

boulder.en: Boulder was one of the first cities in the nation to enforce a ban on smoking.
boulder.zh: 博尔德是该国率先施行禁烟令的城市之一。

boulder.en: Given enough warning, it should be possible to push a threatening boulder out of the way.
boulder.zh: 如果予以足够的警示，就有可能把一块有威胁性的巨石推开。

boulder.en: Once you have started the boulder rolling, it develops momentum, which is defined by its mass and velocity.
boulder.zh: 一旦你开始让巨石滚动，巨石就会产生动量，这是由其质量和速度决定的。

windshield.zh: 前挡风玻璃蒙上了一层水汽。
每小时420英里时，挡风玻璃碎了。

windshield.en: The bullets ricocheted off the hood and windshield.
windshield.zh: 子弹从汽车引擎盖和挡风玻璃上弹走了。

kidnap.zh: 他对绑架的指控供认不讳。
斯图尔特否认有谋杀和绑架的企图。

kidnap.en: Despite a nationwide hunt for the kidnap gang, not a trace of them was found.
kidnap.zh: 尽管已对这帮绑架团伙实行了全国范围的大搜捕，但丝毫没有发现他们的蛛丝马迹。

rugged.en: We left the rough track and bumped our way over a rugged mountainous terrain.
rugged.zh: 我们驶离坎坷的小道，又颠簸过了崎岖多岩的山地。

rugged.en: The enemy would always have the advantage of familiarity with the rugged terrain.
rugged.zh: 敌人会一直在对崎岖地形的熟悉上占有优势。

rugged.en: Planes parachuted food, clothing, blankets, medicine, and water into the rugged mountainous border region.
rugged.zh: 飞机把食物、衣服、毯子、药和水空投到崎岖的边界山区。

apt.en: The words of this report are as apt today as in 1929.
apt.zh: 这份报告的措词在当今如在1929年一样恰当。

apt.en: Babies are apt to put objects into their mouths.
apt.zh: 婴儿爱把东西往嘴里塞。

apt.en: She was apt to raise her voice and wave her hands about.
apt.zh: 她常常提高嗓门并挥舞双手。

optimal.en: You can get a globally optimal solution from locally optimal solutions to sub-problems.
optimal.zh: 你可以通过子问题的局部最优方案从而得到全局优化解决方案。

optimal.en: In the first feasible region above, the optimal solution is the right vertex of the solution space.
optimal.zh: 在上面的第一个可行域中，优化解决方案是解析空间中的右顶点。

optimal.en: Extreme high-performance sports may lead to optimal cardiovascular performance, but they quite certainly do not prolong life.
optimal.zh: 极限高强度运动可能会带来最佳的心血管功能，但这些运动肯定无法延长寿命。

earnest.en: The earnest young doctor answered all our questions.
earnest.zh: 这个认真的年轻医生回答了我们所有的问题。

earnest.en: I could tell she spoke in earnest.
earnest.zh: 我看得出她是郑重其事地说的。

coherent.en: The subjects of the curriculum form a coherent whole.
coherent.zh: 课程中的科目构成了一个连贯的整体。

coherent.en: He appeared hardly capable of conducting a coherent conversation.
coherent.zh: 他看起来几乎没有能力进行连贯的谈话。

coherent.en: He has failed to work out a coherent strategy for modernizing the service.
coherent.zh: 他无法想出一个连贯的策略来使该服务现代化。

simplicity.en: The plan has the virtue of simplicity.
simplicity.zh: 这项计划的优点是简单。

simplicity.en: The document impressed me with its elegant simplicity.
simplicity.zh: 这份文件以其精妙的简约给我留下了深刻的印象。

simplicity.en: Using plastic to pay for an order is simplicity itself.
simplicity.zh: 使用信用卡支付订单本身就很简单。

confidential.en: My letter is, of course, strictly private and confidential.
confidential.zh: 当然，我的信纯属私人信件，务须保密。

confidential.en: The deliberations of the committee are completely confidential.
confidential.zh: 委员会的审议过程是绝对保密的。

confidential.en: From time to time he passed on confidential information to him.
confidential.zh: 他不时地传送机密情报给他。

staple.en: Royal gossip is a staple of the tabloid press.
staple.zh: 围绕王室成员的飞短流长是小报的主要内容。

staple.en: Fish is a staple in the diet of many Africans.
staple.zh: 鱼是许多非洲人饮食中的主食。

staple.en: It is well-known that bamboo shoots are a panda's staple diet.
staple.zh: 众所周知，竹笋是熊猫的主要食物。

autobiography.zh: 他去年秋天出版了他的自传。

autobiography.en: His autobiography was written late in life.
autobiography.zh: 他的自传是在晚年写的。

autobiography.en: The novel is a thinly disguised autobiography.
autobiography.zh: 这部小说让人一眼就可以看出是部自传。

sleek.zh: 它们的身体光滑而紧实。

sleek.en: Now he's thrilled with his sleek neck line, he said, and even told his rabbi about the surgery.
sleek.zh: 他说，现在他对自己光滑的颈部线条很满意，甚至还把手术的事告诉了他的拉比。

sleek.en: Inside their home, the mood was all about entertainment—sleek furnishings and a funky cocktail bar.
sleek.zh: 在他们的家里，一切氛围都是为了娱乐——井然有序的家具陈设和时髦独特的鸡尾酒吧。

dune.en: My grip on the control bar was painfully tight as I ran down the lip of the dune.
dune.zh: 当我沿着沙丘的边缘向下快速奔跑时，我的双手紧紧抓住控制杆，甚至让我感到了疼痛。

dune.en: Between the shore and the inland edge of the dune field, sand alternates with the vegetated ground.
dune.zh: 在海岸与内陆沙丘地带的边缘之间，沙地与覆盖植被的地表交相辉映。

dune.en: My LED headlamp lit the white sand dune.
dune.zh: 我的LED照明灯点燃了白色的沙丘。

compatible.en: The new system will be compatible with existing equipment.
compatible.zh: 新的系统将与现有的设备相互兼容。

compatible.en: Free enterprise, he argued, was compatible with Russian values and traditions.
compatible.zh: 他辩称自由企业与俄罗斯的价值观和传统是相容的。

compatible.en: Fujitsu took over another American firm, Amdal, to help it to make and sell machines compatible with IBM in the United States.
compatible.zh: 富士通接管了另一家美国公司安岛，以帮助其在美国生产并销售与IBM兼容的机器。

rinse.en: I wanted to rinse the taste out of my mouth.
rinse.zh: 我想漱漱口，去掉嘴里的味道。

rinse.en: Fabric conditioner is added during the final rinse.
rinse.zh: 在最后一遍漂洗时加入织物柔顺剂。

staircase.en: He groped his way up the staircase in the dark.
She was sitting on the bottom step of the staircase.
staircase.zh: 她正坐在最下面一磴楼梯上。

staircase.en: The house has a superb staircase made from oak and marble.
staircase.zh: 这座房子里有用栎木和大理石做成的一流的楼梯。

susceptible.zh: 詹姆斯非常容易受奉承话的影响。

susceptible.en: Young people are the most susceptible to advertisements.
susceptible.zh: 年轻人最容易受广告影响。

susceptible.en: Like seaweed, sea grasses are very susceptible to human pollution.
susceptible.zh: 和海藻一样，海草很容易受到人类污染的影响。

ambiguity.en: It's a work full of paradox and ambiguity.
ambiguity.zh: 这部作品充满了似非而是及模棱两可之处。

ambiguity.en: The course teaches students to avoid ambiguity and obscurity of expression.
ambiguity.zh: 这门课程教学生避免表达上的模棱两可、含混不清。

ambiguity.en: The wording is likely to lead to ambiguity.
ambiguity.zh: 这种措词可能会引出歧义。

relentless.zh: 他对完美的追求是不懈的。

relentless.en: Their desires rambled on like unstoppable bores, relentless and whimsical at the same time.
relentless.zh: 他们的欲望就像永不停歇的无聊之人，既无情又异想天开。
压力现在毫无减弱之意。

fixture.en: It is easy to change a light bulb, sure, but it is harder to change the bulb and its fixture.
fixture.zh: 换一个灯泡当然很容易，但是要更换灯泡和其固定装置就比较难了。

fixture.en: The lamp, the fixture, and the room, all three must work in concert for the true benefits of end-users.
fixture.zh: 灯、固定装置和房间，三者必须协同工作，才能真正造福最终用户。

fixture.en: The fixture ended in a goalless draw.
fixture.zh: 该比赛以零比零的平局结束。

crumble.en: Nix the anonymous letter; anyone would crumble under the weight of that humiliation.
crumble.zh: 千万不要写匿名信；任何人都不会承受住这样的侮辱而崩溃的。

crumble.en: If you are living for others before yourself and pushing your own needs aside, eventually you will crumble in some way.
crumble.zh: 如果你先为别人而活，把自己的需求放在一边，那么你一定会崩溃的。

crumble.en: They appear to be okay, and they look good, and they're easy and cheaper for now, but when the storms move in, they crumble.
crumble.zh: 它们表面看起来还可以，而且现在看来十分方便和便宜，但是当暴风雨来临时，他们就崩溃了。

canopy.en: The trees formed such a dense canopy that all beneath was a deep carpet of pine needles.
canopy.zh: 这些树形成了浓密的冠盖，下面是一层厚厚的松针。

canopy.en: It was like a king's canopy, a fairy king's.
canopy.zh: 它就像国王的华盖，一个童话里国王的华盖。

canopy.en: The light shone on him through the tree canopy.
canopy.zh: 阳光透过树冠照在他身上。

periodically.en: Meetings are held periodically to monitor progress on the case.
periodically.zh: 定期召开会议监控案件的进展情况。
海星的数量会周期性地激增。

merchandise.zh: 零售商可以退回有瑕疵的商品。

merchandise.en: It was the first movie to feature onscreen product placement for its own merchandise.
merchandise.zh: 这是第一部为自己的商品做银幕植入式广告的电影。

merchandise.en: From there, the merchandise was shipped across the Mediterranean Sea.
merchandise.zh: 货物从那里被运到地中海对岸。

maternal.zh: 她没有一点做母亲的天性。

certify.en: Each year they audit our accounts and certify them as being true and fair.
certify.zh: 每年他们都会审核我们的账目，以证明其准确合理。
我们可以保证他的诚实。

blunt.en: The edge is as blunt as an old butter knife.
blunt.zh: 刃钝得跟一把老黄油刀一样。

blunt.en: The police said he had been hit with a blunt instrument.
blunt.zh: 警方说他遭到了钝器袭击。

blunt.en: I hate to be blunt, Frankie, but she just didn't strike me as being very ladylike.
blunt.zh: 恕我直言，弗朗基，但她给我的感觉不是非常端庄。

cynical.en: She wanted him to stop being so cool, so detached, so cynical.
cynical.zh: 她希望他不再那么冷酷无情，那么无动于衷，那么愤世嫉俗。

cynical.en: She may be cynical about the film industry, but ultimately she has no intention of biting the hand that feeds her.
cynical.zh: 她也许会对电影业冷嘲热讽，但终究不打算恩将仇报。

cynical.en: Straight from the cynical anonymity of a big city, we luxuriated in its happy personalism.
cynical.zh: 从大城市的愤世嫉俗的匿名性中， 我们奢侈地享受其快乐的个人主义。

fungus.en: 200,000 specimens of fungus are kept at the Komarov Botanical Institute.
fungus.zh: 20万个真菌标本被保存在科马罗夫植物研究所。

fungus.en: These are not single individual plants; each one is a symbiotic combination of an alga and a fungus.
fungus.zh: 这些不是单个的植物；每一种都是藻类和真菌的共生组合。

fungus.en: But this particular fungus nibbles away only at certain layers in the wood, leaving other layers alone.
fungus.zh: 但是这种特殊的真菌只会慢慢啃食木头的特定几层结构，而不去啃其他层。

excel.en: It can't be skills like arithmetic, which machines already excel in.
excel.zh: 不可能是算术之类的技能，这些机器已经很擅长了。
他开始在学术上脱颖而出。

excel.en: How can I read an Excel file on a computer that only has Word installed?
excel.zh: 我怎么在只装了文字处理软件的电脑上读取表格文件呢？

astronomical.en: This distance is known as the 'astronomical unit' or AU.
astronomical.zh: 这个距离被称为“天文单位”或 AU。

astronomical.en: The economics of the Superbowl are already astronomical.
astronomical.zh: 超级碗的经济效益已经是天文数字了。

gratitude.zh: 他向他们笑了笑表示谢意。

gratitude.en: I owe a debt of gratitude to all my family.
Her arms tightened about his neck in gratitude.
gratitude.zh: 她的双臂紧紧搂住他的脖子，充满感激。

hue.en: This highly visible hue is found on everything from bumblebees to school buses, traffic signs to highlighters.
hue.zh: 从大黄蜂到校车，从交通信号到标记笔，这种高度可见的色调随处可见。

hue.en: His face took on an unhealthy whitish hue.
hue.zh: 他的脸上透出一丝病态的苍白。

hue.en: His face took on an unhealthy, whitish hue.
hue.zh: 他的脸上透出一丝病态的苍白。

emperor.en: The Emperor kept himself aloof from the people.
emperor.zh: 这个皇帝对人民漠不关心。

emperor.en: Mr. Ying is well-known for his portrayal of a prison guard in the film "The Last Emperor."
emperor.zh: 英先生因在《末代皇帝》中扮演一个监狱看守而出名。

enzyme.en: This enzyme would make the filtration of beer easier.
enzyme.zh: 这种酶会使啤酒更容易过滤

enzyme.en: The scientists are cautious about using enzyme therapy on humans.
enzyme.zh: 科学家们对于人体使用酶疗法持谨慎态度。

enzyme.en: The natural enzyme is harmful to humans and animals.
enzyme.zh: 天然酶对人和动物都是有害的。

triple.zh: 到明年产量应增至三倍。

triple.en: Its population is about triple that of Venice.
triple.zh: 它的人口大约是威尼斯的三倍。

triple.en: The amount of alcohol in his blood was triple the legal maximum.
triple.zh: 他血液中的酒精含量为法定最高限量的三倍。

intercept.en: It is illegal to intercept radio messages.
intercept.zh: 窃听无线电信息是违法的。

intercept.en: It seemed like an awful thing to do when they're bringing these falcons and hawks who were imported to intercept these people.
intercept.zh: 当他们带着猎鹰和鹰来拦截这些人时，这似乎是一件可怕的事情。

intercept.en: The constant a represents the vertical intercept, and b represents the slope of the consumption schedule.
intercept.zh: 常数a表示垂直截距，b表示消费计划的斜率。

ambiguous.zh: 这里的措辞故意模棱两可。

ambiguous.en: This agreement is very ambiguous and open to various interpretations.
ambiguous.zh: 这个协议非常模棱两可，可以有多种解释。

cylinder.en: The cylinder is cooled by a jet of water.
The car was powered by a four cylinder air-cooled engine.
cylinder.zh: 这辆汽车是由一个四缸气冷式发动机驱动的。

cylinder.en: The steam was condensed rapidly by injecting cold water into the cylinder.
cylinder.zh: 由于汽缸中注入了冷水，蒸汽迅速凝结了。

cafeteria.en: Does the college cafeteria provide a healthful diet?
cafeteria.zh: 此大学餐厅是否供应有益健康的膳食？

cafeteria.en: People are sprawled on makeshift beds in the cafeteria.
cafeteria.zh: 人们四仰八叉地躺在食堂里搭起的临时床铺上。

cafeteria.en: I went and had an overpriced cup of coffee in the hotel cafeteria.
cafeteria.zh: 我到宾馆的自助餐厅里喝了杯过于昂贵的咖啡。

preceding.en: As we saw in the preceding chapter, groups can be powerful agents of socialization.
preceding.zh: 如我们在前一章所见，团组可以是社会化的有力动因。

preceding.en: She informed us that eighteen members of the staff had left during the preceding year.
preceding.zh: 她当时告知我们，18位教职员在此前的一年里离开了。

preceding.en: We shall be known better than any preceding generations.
preceding.zh: 我们将比前几代人更出名。

membrane.en: These are substances which specifically latch onto the protein on the cell membrane.
membrane.zh: 这些是专门黏附在细胞膜蛋白质上的物质。

membrane.en: In pterosaurs a greatly elongated fourth finger of each forelimb supported a wing-like membrane.
membrane.zh: 翼龙的每个前肢都有一根长长的第四指，支撑着像翅膀一样的膜。

membrane.en: Archaeopteryx shows no obvious features of gliders, such as a broad membrane connecting forelimbs and hind limbs.
membrane.zh: 始祖鸟并没有表现出明显的滑翔机的特征，比如有一层连接前肢和后肢的宽膜。

allocation.en: Town planning and land allocation had to be coordinated.
allocation.zh: 城镇规划和土地分配决定必须要协调。

allocation.en: A State Department spokeswoman said that the aid allocation for Pakistan was still under review.
allocation.zh: 国务院的一位女发言人说对巴基斯坦的援助配置仍在审核之中。

allocation.en: No choice is involved; this allocation comes as part of the genetic package from the parents.
allocation.zh: 它们别无选择，因为这种分配方式是从部分父母的基因中遗传下来的。

dismantle.en: They decided to dismantle the machine and start again from scratch.
dismantle.zh: 他们决定拆掉机器，从头再来。

dismantle.en: He asked for immediate help from the United States to dismantle the warheads.
dismantle.zh: 他向美国请求即时援助，拆除弹头。

dismantle.en: I had to dismantle the engine in order to repair it.
dismantle.zh: 我得把发动机拆开来修理。

honorable.en: Thou would'st not have an honorable Prince!
honorable.zh: 你是不会拥有一位尊贵的王子的！

communism.en: He doesn't know the difference between capitalism, communism and socialism.
communism.zh: 他不知道资本主义，共产主义和社会主义的区别。

pave.en: I believe this treaty will pave the way to peace in Europe.
pave.zh: 我相信这个条约将为欧洲的和平铺平道路。

pave.en: In India, they mix thrown-out plastic waste with asphalt and use it to pave new roadways.
pave.zh: 在印度，他们把丢弃的塑料废品和沥青混合起来，用来铺设新的道路。

pave.en: Last week, France announced that the country will pave 621 miles of road with solar panels over the next five years, with the goal of providing cheap, renewable energy to five million people.
pave.zh: 上周，法国宣布将在未来5年内铺设一条长达621英里的太阳能公路，以期为500万民众提供便宜的可再生的能源。

precaution.en: Could he not, just as a precaution, move to a place of safety?
precaution.zh: 难道他不能就当是一种防范搬到一个安全的地方去吗？

precaution.en: We are aware of the potential problems and have taken every precaution.
precaution.zh: 我们意识到了潜在的问题，已经采取了一切防范措施。

precaution.en: Take every precaution to prevent the flag from becoming soiled.
precaution.zh: 要采取一切预防措施，以防旗帜被弄脏。

fry.en: You'll fry on the beach if you're not careful.
fry.zh: 若在海滩上不小心会被太阳灼伤的。

fry.en: We should use slow fire to fry fish.
And big fish provide more and better-quality fry.
fry.zh: 而大鱼可做更多更好的油炸食物。

heap.en: His clothes lay in a heap on the floor.
She piled the papers in a heap on her desk, just anyhow.
heap.zh: 她把文件在桌上随便搁成一堆。

heap.en: There is one database heap per database.
heap.zh: 每个数据库都有一个数据库堆。

glide.en: The plane managed to glide down to the runway.
glide.zh: 飞机终于成功地滑翔降落在跑道上。

glide.en: That summer was the glide path of our love.
glide.zh: 那个夏天是我们爱情的下滑航道。

glide.en: Do you think we can glide down this glacier?
glide.zh: 你觉得我们可以从冰河上滑行下去吗？

infrared.zh: 红外探测器有多种用途。

infrared.en: It lies in the infrared range of the spectrum.
infrared.zh: 它位于光谱的红外线区域内。

infrared.en: We put an infrared microscope—a spectroscope—on tiny tiny bits of paint.
infrared.zh: 我们把红外线显微镜——一个分光镜——放在很少很少的一点颜料上。

infectious.en: Infectious diseases can be acquired in several ways.
infectious.zh: 传染病的感染途径有几种。

onset.en: Her life was finally extinguished by the onset of liver complaint.
onset.zh: 她的生命之火终因肝病发作而被掐灭了。

onset.en: "If this test could predict the onset of GVHD before the rash develops, it could be extremely valuable, " he says.
onset.zh: 他说：“如果这种检测能够在皮疹显现之前预测移植物抗宿主病的发病，那将是非常有价值的。”

onset.en: In the 1967 European outbreak, a non-itchy rash was a feature noted in most patients between 2 and 7 days after symptom onset.
onset.zh: 在1967年欧洲的疾病爆发中，大多数患者在症状发作后2至7天出现非瘙痒性皮疹。

heated.en: After some heated argument a decision was finally taken.
heated.zh: 激烈辩论以后终于作出了决定。

heated.en: The heated gas is piped through a coil surrounded by water.
heated.zh: 受热气体通过水中的一根螺旋管输送。

qualitative.en: There are qualitative differences between the two products.
qualitative.zh: 这两种产品存在着质的差别。

qualitative.en: There are qualitative differences in the way children of different ages and adults think.
qualitative.zh: 不同年龄的儿童和成人在思维方式上有着质的差异。

qualitative.en: It combines quantitative variables and qualitative variables.
qualitative.zh: 它结合了定量变量和定性变量。

pottery.zh: 我一直在上陶器制作技术课。

pottery.en: Some bowls were made of pottery and wood.
pottery.zh: 一些碗是用陶土和木头做的。

pottery.en: This is a typical example of Roman pottery.
pottery.zh: 这是一件典型的罗马陶器。

awe.en: She gazed in awe at the great stones.
awe.zh: 她敬畏地凝视着那些巨石。

awe.en: They looked at him with a mixture of horror, envy, and awe.
awe.zh: 他们带着害怕、羡慕和敬畏的混合表情看着他。

awe.en: The higher we climbed, the more awe-inspiring the scenery became.
awe.zh: 我们爬得越高，风景越是令人惊叹。

invariably.zh: 他们几乎总是将它弄错。
患者们的各种需求总是相互重合的。

informant.en: Malcolm "is an excellent speaker, forceful and convincing," one F.B.I. informant said, in 1958.
informant.zh: 马尔科姆“是个出色的讲演者，充满力量且令人信服，”1958年，一位FBI线人这么说道。

informant.en: The police made an early breakthrough, with an informant naming Smalls as the leader of the gang.
informant.zh: 当一名线人指证斯莫就是帮派头目时，警方的调查有了突破。

informant.en: Wafa said officials are now trying to find the informant who provided information that led to the attack.
informant.zh: 瓦法说，官员们现在试图找到提供信息导致这次袭击的线人。

myriad.en: There is equilibrium between a whole myriad of reactants and products.
myriad.zh: 在无数的反应物和生成物之间存在着平衡。

myriad.en: They would have to explain myriad compromises and abdications along the way.
myriad.zh: 他们将必须为其在其中无数的妥协及辞职作出解释。

myriad.en: Designs are available in a myriad of colours.
myriad.zh: 各种色彩的款式应有尽有。

scout.en: He wore the garb of a scout.
scout.zh: 他穿了一身童子军的装束。

scout.en: We went ahead to scout out the lie of the land.
scout.zh: 我们先走一步，去侦察地形。

scout.en: Joshua sends out spies to scout out the land.
scout.zh: 约书亚派出密探去侦察那片土地。

metro.en: A new metro runs under the square, carrying hundreds of thousands who used to cycle to work.
metro.zh: 一条新地铁在广场下面运行，载着数以千计过去骑自行车上班的人们。

metro.en: With the exception of South Africa, the only light rail metro system in sub-Saharan Africa is in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
metro.zh: 除了南非，非洲撒哈拉以南地区唯一的轻轨地铁系统位于埃塞俄比亚的亚的斯亚贝巴。

metro.en: Living in France, I take the metro every day.
metro.zh: 生活在法国，我每天都会乘坐地铁。

folder.zh: 那个文件夹有两英寸厚。

folder.en: Lance pulled a bundle of papers out of a folder.
folder.zh: 兰斯从一个文件夹中拉出一叠文件。

folder.en: He opened his attaché case, removed a folder, then closed it again.
folder.zh: 他打开了他的公文包，拿出了一个文件夹，然后又把它合上了。

insufficient.en: His salary is insufficient to meet his needs.
insufficient.zh: 他的薪水不够应付需要。

insufficient.en: Facilities for people with disabilities are still insufficient.
insufficient.zh: 供残疾人使用的设施仍然不足。

insufficient.en: Our industry suffers through insufficient investment in research.
insufficient.zh: 我们的工业因研究投入不足而大吃苦头。

exposed.en: There should be no exposed screw heads.
Miles of sand are exposed at low tide.
exposed.zh: 在低潮时数英里的沙滩就会显现出来。

antenna.en: You'll need a good antenna to exploit the radio's performance.
antenna.zh: 你需要一根好的天线来充分利用该电台的节目。

antenna.en: Can you see the radio antenna on that hill?
antenna.zh: 你能看见那座山上的无线电天线吗？

antenna.en: They erected a television antenna on the roof.
antenna.zh: 他们在屋顶上架起了电视天线。

stew.zh: 皮特狼吞虎咽地吃完了所有的炖牛肉。

stew.en: She served him a bowl of beef stew.
stew.zh: 她给他端了一碗炖牛肉。

stew.en: The meat needs to stew for two hours.

plausible.zh: 她是个巧言令色的说谎高手。

plausible.en: I stood still, trying to invent a plausible excuse.
plausible.zh: 我静静地站着，努力想编出一个听上去可信的借口。

plausible.en: All I can say is that he was so plausible it wasn't just me that he conned.
plausible.zh: 我只能说，他看上去好像那么可信，他骗的可不只我一个。

energetic.en: He seemed a dynamic and energetic leader.
energetic.zh: 他看来是个富有创新力与活力的领导。

energetic.en: The company is trying to create a young energetic image.
energetic.zh: 这家公司正试图塑造一个充满活力的年轻形象。

airborne.en: He enlisted in the 82nd Airborne 20 years ago.
airborne.zh: 他20年前加入了第82空降师。

airborne.en: The allies landed thousands of airborne troops.
airborne.zh: 同盟国投下了成千上万的空降部队。

airborne.en: Ford was attached to the 101st Airborne Division.

secrecy.zh: 所有相关人员均宣誓保密。

harass.en: He has sent hither swarms of officers to harass our people.
harass.zh: 他派遣大批官员到这里骚扰我们的人民。

harass.en: We've got a few small Green Peace boats that we harass the dumping ship with.
harass.zh: 我们有几艘 Green Peace 的船只，用来侵扰那艘倾倒垃圾的船。

harass.en: He will bring up your past to haunt and harass you.
harass.zh: 他将带你回到从前，困扰和骚扰你。

ethic.en: Out of Puritanism came the intense work ethic.
ethic.zh: 从清教徒主义思想中衍生出的极强职业伦理。

ethic.en: Metamorphosis, in turn, certainly represents the horrible imagery of an ethic of lucidity.
ethic.zh: 反过来，《变形记》当然代表了一种清晰的伦理道德的可怕形象。

ethic.en: The former ethic suggested success was founded on integrity, modesty, loyalty, courage, patience, and so forth.
ethic.zh: 前一种伦理认为，成功建立在正直、谦虚、忠诚、勇气、耐心等的基础上。

embarrass.en: I didn't want to embarrass him by kissing him in front of his friends.
embarrass.zh: 我并没想当着他的朋友吻他而使他感到难堪。

embarrass.en: When you embarrass me, I'll tell you.
embarrass.zh: 你要是使我感到难堪，我就会跟你说的。

embarrass.en: They were my friends, and I just didn't want to embarrass them publicly.
embarrass.zh: 他们是我的朋友，我只是不想公开说让他们难堪的话。

endanger.en: Development of the area would endanger wildlife.
endanger.zh: 开发这一地区将会危及野生生物。

endanger.en: The debate could endanger the proposed Mideast peace talks.
endanger.zh: 这场争论可能会危害中东和谈的倡议。

endanger.en: The erupting gas might endanger local children.
endanger.zh: 喷发的气体可能危及当地的儿童。

confer.en: He wanted to confer with his colleagues before reaching a decision.
confer.zh: 他想与他的同事先商议一下再作出决定。

confer.en: I will now confer a benefit on him.
As any geriatric ward shows, that is not the same as to confer enduring mobility, awareness and autonomy.
confer.zh: 正如任何老年病房所显示的那样，这与赋予病人持久的行动、意识和自主权是不一样的。

daytime.en: Some animals are inactive during the daytime.
You don't often see this bird in (the) daytime.

thermal.en: He was found by a police helicopter using thermal imaging equipment.
thermal.zh: 他被一架警用直升飞机用热成像设备找到了。

thermal.en: Rescue teams are using thermal imaging to locate survivors of the earthquake.
thermal.zh: 救援队伍正利用热成像确定地震幸存者的位置。

thermal.en: For systems transforming solar to thermal energy, the thermal energy may be stored in matter as either latent heat or sensible heat.
thermal.zh: 对于将太阳能转化为热能的系统，热能可能以潜热或显热的形式存储在物质中。

precinct.zh: 该枪击事件发生在第34警区。

precinct.en: The murder occurred just a block from the precinct.
precinct.zh: 谋杀案就发生在和警察分局相隔一条街的地方。

precinct.en: They were taken in a police van to the 60th Precinct station house for the lineup.
precinct.zh: 他们被警车拉往第60警区派出所以待进行嫌疑犯列队辨认。

arouse.en: They arouse the interest of all the readers.
arouse.zh: 它们引起了所有读者的兴趣。

arouse.en: Silly mistakes and queer clothes often arouse ridicule.
arouse.zh: 荒谬的错误和古怪的服装常引起讪笑。

arouse.en: The extension of London's Ulez will arouse strong resistance.
arouse.zh: 扩大伦敦的超低排放区会引起强烈反对。

shrub.en: Once shrub covers everything, you lose the meadow habitat.
shrub.zh: 一旦灌木覆盖了一切，你就失去了草地的栖息地。

shrub.en: Once the fire is out, the grass and shrub ecosystems should return quickly.
shrub.zh: 火一旦被熄灭，草和灌木的生态系统就会很快恢复。

shrub.en: An unremarkable shrub on the gravel plain moved and resolved into an ostrich.
shrub.zh: 砾石平原上的一株不起眼的灌木移动了一下，变成了一只鸵鸟。

napkin.en: Her father cleaned his glasses with a paper napkin.
napkin.zh: 她父亲用一张餐巾纸擦他的眼镜。

napkin.en: He picked the napkin from his lap and placed it alongside his plate.
napkin.zh: 他从腿上拿起餐巾，放在他的盘子旁边。

napkin.en: He picked up my napkin and turned it over.
napkin.zh: 他拿起我的餐巾纸并把它翻过来。

consolidate.en: Cooper and her colleagues argue that a "town of culture" award could consolidate the town city ties in Britain.
consolidate.zh: 库珀和她的同事们认为，“文化之城”奖可以巩固英国城镇与城市间的联系。

consolidate.en: The new release will be a LTS release, so it will likely be more conservative than other releases and consolidate on the many changes over the past year.
consolidate.zh: 这个新发行将是一个长期支持发行，所以，它将可能比其他发行更加保守，巩固过去一年的许多变化。

consolidate.en: Changes in the competitive dynamics of this fragmented industry are at last making it feasible for wholesalers to consolidate.
consolidate.zh: 这个支离破碎的行业竞争动态的变化，终于使批发商整合成为可能。

stressful.en: Many people thrive on a stressful lifestyle.
stressful.zh: 许多人喜欢有压力的生活方式。

stressful.en: It's a very stressful situation for everyone concerned.
stressful.zh: 这对所有相关人员来说都是一个非常有压力的情况。

stressful.en: Having aged relatives to stay in your house can be quite stressful.
stressful.zh: 年迈的亲戚住在家里有时压力相当大。

unload.en: The truck driver was waiting to unload.
This isn't a suitable place to unload the van.
Everyone helped to unload the luggage from the car.
unload.zh: 大家都帮着从汽车上卸行李。

dental.en: I've got a dental appointment at 3 o'clock.
Many of the bodies were unidentifiable except by dental records.
dental.zh: 许多尸体若不是靠牙科病历就无法辨认。

dental.en: You will automatically get free dental treatment if you are under 18.
dental.zh: 18岁以下的人一律免费得到牙科治疗。

affluent.en: The diet of the affluent has not changed much over the decades.
affluent.zh: 富人的饮食数十年来没怎么变。

affluent.en: Cigarette smoking used to be more common among affluent people.
affluent.zh: 吸烟过去在富人中更为普遍。

affluent.en: It's a fallacy that the affluent give relatively more to charity than the less prosperous.
affluent.zh: 富人比不太有钱的人给慈善机构相对更多捐赠是一种谬见。

cozy.en: This cozy workplace no longer exists here.
cozy.zh: 这个舒适的工作环境已经不复存在了。

cozy.en: It brings you a cozy feeling with soft tactile.
cozy.zh: 它带给你惬意的感觉，柔软的触感。

cozy.en: I found the lounge such a cozy place to study in.
cozy.zh: 我发现休息室是一个非常舒适的学习场所。

exacerbate.en: Noise in classrooms can only exacerbate their difficulty in comprehending and processing verbal communication with other children and instructions from the teacher.
exacerbate.zh: 教室里的噪音只会加剧他们与其他孩子的口头交流和对老师的指令的理解和处理的困难。

exacerbate.en: Moreover, putting young people in prison can exacerbate the problems—a system of mentors and helpers could be provided for those who unthinkingly break the law.
exacerbate.zh: 此外，把年轻人关进监狱可能使问题更加严重——那些不假思索的违法者可能得到一个导师和帮手系统。
而“三振出局法”更使问题恶化。

tangible.en: Unlike meditation, craft activities result in tangible and often useful products that can enhance self-esteem.
tangible.zh: 与冥想不同的是，手工活动会产生有形的、往往有用的产品，这些产品可以增强自尊。

tangible.en: But unlike meditation, craft activities result in tangible and often useful products that can enhance self-esteem.
tangible.zh: 但与冥想不同的是，手工活动会产生有形的、往往有用的产品，可以增强自尊心。

tangible.en: They would have to concentrate on natural processes that continue at a constant rate and that also leave some sort of tangible record in the rocks.
tangible.zh: 他们必须专注于以恒定速度持续的自然过程，并且在岩石中留下某种有形的记录。

feat.en: Man's first landing on the moon was a feat of great daring.
feat.zh: 人类首次登月是一个勇敢的壮举。

feat.en: The tower is being celebrated as a grand feat on the world stage.
feat.zh: 这座塔被誉为世界舞台上的一项伟大壮举。

feat.en: Though no great technical feat, the procedure opens a range of unsettling possibilities.
feat.zh: 虽然这不是什么伟大的技术壮举，但这一过程开启了一系列令人不安的可能性。

groan.zh: 多罗西亚发出了一声做作的呻吟。

groan.en: She heard him let out a pitiful, muffled groan.
groan.zh: 她听到他发出一声可怜、压抑的呻吟。

groan.en: They glanced at the man on the floor, who began to groan.
groan.zh: 他们扫了一眼地板上那个开始呻吟的男子。

dwell.en: "I'd rather not dwell on the past," he told me.
dwell.zh: “我宁愿不多想过去，”他告诉我。

dwell.en: I shut out the memory which was too painful to dwell on.
dwell.zh: 我不让自己去回忆那段会引起我太多痛苦的往事。

dwell.en: So you made a mistake, but there's no need to dwell on it.
dwell.zh: 你是错了，不过不必老是想着这事儿。

lurk.en: Cookies, however, have a darker side too, and all kinds of privacy issues lurk at every bend.
lurk.zh: 然而，网络 cookies 也有其黑暗的一面，各种隐私问题潜伏在每一个角落。

lurk.en: Dangers lurk in the path of wilderness.
lurk.zh: 在这条荒野的小路上隐伏着危险。

torch.en: One of the men shone a torch in his face.
torch.zh: 其中一个男子用火把照着他的脸。

torch.en: Len studied it a moment in the beam of his torch.
torch.zh: 莱恩借着手电筒的光把它仔细察看了一会儿。

torch.en: They struggled to keep the torch of idealism and hope alive.
torch.zh: 他们为使理想主义和希望的火炬不熄灭而奋斗。

militant.en: The fiery right-wing leader toned down his militant statements after the meeting.
militant.zh: 这位言辞激烈的右翼领导人在会后缓和了他的好战言辞。

militant.en: Saif looked less like a hedge funder and more like a fist-pumping militant in fatigues.
militant.zh: 赛义夫看起来不太像一个对冲基金经理，而更像一个穿着迷彩服挥舞拳头的激进分子。

militant.en: On average, only one out of every seven U.S. drone attacks in Pakistan kills a militant leader.
militant.zh: 平均而言，美国在巴基斯坦的无人机袭击中只有七分之一击毙了激进分子头目。

terminate.en: After a lot of agonizing she decided to terminate the pregnancy.
terminate.zh: 在多次痛苦的考虑后，她决定终止妊娠。

terminate.en: In American law, you cannot terminate an employee, for the sole purpose of age.
terminate.zh: 在美国法律中，你不能仅仅因为年龄而解雇员工。

terminate.en: People are often hesitant to terminate a project when they've already invested time or resources into it, even if it might make logical sense to do so.
terminate.zh: 当人们已经在项目上投入了时间或资源时，他们常常会犹豫是否要终止项目，即使这样做是合乎逻辑的。

attic.en: We need the steps to get into the attic.
attic.zh: 我们得踩着梯子才能爬到阁楼上去。

attic.en: They hid me from the police in their attic.
attic.zh: 他们把我藏在他们的阁楼上躲避警察。

attic.en: I've cleared out all that old junk in the attic.
attic.zh: 我把阁楼里所有的废旧杂物都清除干净了。

constellation.en: Can you see Jupiter tonight, in front of the arrowhead-shaped constellation Capricornus the Seagoat?
constellation.zh: 今晚你能看到木星吗，在箭头状星座摩羯座的前面？

constellation.en: The meteors are called Leonids because they appear to come from the same direction as that of the constellation Leo the Lion.
constellation.zh: 这些流星之所以被冠之以“狮子座”的名称，那是因为它们好像与狮子星座来自同一方向。

constellation.en: Obama's budget, which aims to cut funding in certain areas while increasing money used to create jobs, would cancel NASA's Constellation Program.
constellation.zh: 奥巴马的预算旨在削减某些领域的资金，同时增加用于创造就业的资金，这将使 NASA 的星座计划被取消。

huddle.en: The track led them to a huddle of outbuildings.
huddle.zh: 那条小路把他们带到了一片杂乱拥挤的附属建筑群。

huddle.en: We lay there: a huddle of bodies, gasping for air.
huddle.zh: 我们躺在那儿：挤作一团，大口地喘着气。

huddle.en: Between plays the coach was talking to the offence in the huddle.
huddle.zh: 赛间休息时，教练对围拢的攻方队员讲话。

beetle.en: He spied the beetle; the drooping tail lifted and wagged.
beetle.zh: 他发现了甲虫；下垂的尾巴翘了起来，摇摆着。

beetle.en: Healthy trees are also better able to fend off bark beetle.
beetle.zh: 健康的树木也能更好地抵御树皮甲虫。

beetle.en: The first thing the beetle did was to take him by the finger.
beetle.zh: 甲虫做的第一件事就是咬住他的手指。

populate.en: The French began to populate the island in the 15th century.
populate.zh: 法国人于15世纪开始迁移到这个岛。

populate.en: After that, a few small populations left Africa to populate the rest of the world.
populate.zh: 在那之后，少数人离开非洲，移居到世界其他地方。

populate.en: Last but not least, excessive use of mobile phones means much less chance of face-to-face interactions with the people who populate their real lives.
populate.zh: 最后但并非最不重要的是，过度使用手机意味着与生活在现实生活中的人们面对面交流的机会大大减少。

maneuver.en: She can then maneuver the 3D image on the computer screen to map the shortest, least invasive surgical path to the tumor.
maneuver.zh: 然后，她可以操纵电脑屏幕上的 3D 图像，以绘制出最短、切口最小的通往肿瘤的手术路径。

maneuver.en: A new back flip maneuver allowed station astronauts to photograph the shuttle's underbelly, and an extra-long robotic arm enabled astronauts see parts of the shuttle that were previously out of sight.
maneuver.zh: 新的后空翻使空间站的宇航员可以拍摄航天飞机的腹部，超长的机械臂使宇航员可以看到航天飞机以前看不见的部分。

maneuver.en: The dorsad reduction maneuver has been used for treating 120 cases of posticous cervical spondylopathy.
maneuver.zh: 背部复位手法已经被用于治疗120例后发性颈椎病。

pearl.en: A local jeweler says the pearl is worth at least $500.
pearl.zh: 一位本地珠宝商说这颗珍珠至少值$500。

pearl.en: His pearl could be displayed in a museum.
pearl.zh: 他的珍珠可以在博物馆里展出。
他那颗巨大的珍珠价值连城。

probation.en: She was found guilty of manslaughter and put on probation for two years.
probation.zh: 她被判过失杀人罪，缓刑两年。

wreck.en: The wreck was raised from the seabed in June 2000.
wreck.zh: 沉船于2000年6月从海底打捞上来。

wreck.en: The precise location of the wreck was discovered in 1988.
wreck.zh: 船舶失事的确切地点是在1988年发现的。

pirate.en: Pirate copies of the DVD are already being sold.

subscriber.en: I have been a subscriber to Newsweek for many years.
subscriber.zh: 我已是《新闻周刊》一名多年的订户。

subscriber.en: Built in subscriber manager and performance manager.
subscriber.zh: 内置订阅者管理器和性能管理器。

subscriber.en: If you are not a subscriber, you can subscribe today.
subscriber.zh: 如果您不是一个订阅者，您可以现在订阅。

renowned.en: The area is renowned for its Romanesque churches.
renowned.zh: 这个地区以其罗马式教堂闻名。

renowned.en: Chobe is also renowned for its large herds of elephant and buffalo.
renowned.zh: 乔贝还以其大群的大象和水牛而闻名。

renowned.en: Its spaceship was engineered by Bert Rutan, renowned for designing the Voyager.
renowned.zh: 它的飞船由伯特·鲁坦设计建造，此人因设计“旅行者”号飞船而闻名。

sewage.en: The pipe disgorges sewage into the sea.
sewage.zh: 这管道将污水排入大海。

sewage.en: The sea is coated with a film of raw sewage.
sewage.zh: 海上覆盖着薄薄一层未经处理的污水。

sewage.en: Sewage nutrients do increase algal growth in the harbour.
sewage.zh: 污水中的营养物的确会加快海藻的生长速度。

dusk.en: The street lights go on at dusk.
dusk.zh: 街灯在黄昏时分亮起来。
我们于黄昏时分到家了。

dusk.en: At dusk bats appear in vast numbers.
dusk.zh: 蝙蝠于傍晚时分大批出现。

masculine.zh: 法语单词“太阳”是阳性的。

masculine.en: In most languages adjectives have slightly different spellings for masculine and feminine.
masculine.zh: 在大多数语言中形容词对于阳性和阴性有略微不同的拼写。

crumb.en: She flicked a crumb off the corner of her mouth.
crumb.zh: 她轻轻擦去了嘴角的面包屑。

crumb.en: I've nothing to give you—nothing—not a crumb!
crumb.zh: 我没有东西可以给你——什么也没有——一点面包屑也没有！

crumb.en: Dr. Smith salvaged the last crumb of my self-esteem with this compassionate statement.
crumb.zh: 史密斯医生用这番富于慈悲的话语将我仅存的一点点自尊的碎屑重新拾起。

allergy.en: I have an allergy to animal hair.
These are classical examples of food allergy.
allergy.zh: 这些是食物过敏的典型病例。

allergy.en: This type of allergy can very occasionally be fatal.
allergy.zh: 这类过敏症在极个别情况下有可能是致命的。

disposition.en: The rides are unsuitable for people of a nervous disposition.
disposition.zh: 这种骑乘不适合紧张型性格的人。

dart.en: She made a dart for the door.
Nina felt a sudden dart of panic.
dart.zh: 尼娜突然感到一阵恐慌。

reversal.en: The paper says the move represents a complete reversal of previous U.S. policy.
reversal.zh: 报上说这一举动反映了之前美国政策的彻底逆转。

reversal.en: It's not hard to imagine a similar reversal happening in London.
reversal.zh: 不难想象，伦敦也会发生类似的逆转。

reversal.en: The cumulative effect was a fundamental change in how millions of people approached life itself, a reversal of attitude that must rank as one of the largest in human history.
reversal.zh: 这种累积效应对数百万人对待生活本身的态度产生了根本性的改变，这种态度的逆转肯定是人类历史上最大的一次。

wax.en: It was recorded on a wax cylinder.

wax.zh: 上光蜡可保护木材和皮革。

allegiance.en: Barons had to swear an oath of allegiance to the king.
Most historians have underestimated the extent and significance of women's political allegiance in the antebellum period.
allegiance.zh: 大多数历史学家低估了战前妇女政治忠诚的程度和重要性。

allegiance.en: My allegiance to Kendall and his company ran deep.
allegiance.zh: 我对肯达尔和他的公司的拥戴持久深厚。

graceful.en: He gave a graceful bow to the audience.
graceful.zh: 他优雅地向观众鞠了一躬。

graceful.en: The dancers were all tall and graceful.
graceful.zh: 这些舞蹈演员都个子高高的，动作十分优雅。

socialism.en: William Morris was one of the early prophets of socialism.
socialism.zh: 威廉•莫里斯是社会主义的早期传播者之一。

socialism.en: While some Socialists did view price protests as a direct step toward socialism, most Socialists ultimately sought to divert the cost-of-living movement into alternative channels of protest.
socialism.zh: 虽然一些社会主义者确实将抗议价格视为向社会主义迈出的直接一步，但大多数社会主义者最终寻求将生活成本运动转移到抗议的其他渠道。

socialism.en: He had decided long ago that he would put his trust in socialism when the time came.
socialism.zh: 他很久以前就已决定，他到时候将信仰社会主义。

disastrous.en: If word got out now, a scandal could be disastrous.
disastrous.zh: 如果现在泄露消息，丑闻可能会是灾难性的。

disastrous.en: He believed that the policies were both wrong and electorally disastrous.
disastrous.zh: 他认为这些政策既是错误的、又是选举上的灾难。

disastrous.en: They told Jacques Delors a disastrous world trade war must be avoided at all costs.
disastrous.zh: 他们告诉雅克·得洛斯，必须不惜一切代价避免灾难性的世界贸易大战。

wholesale.en: Warehouse clubs allow members to buy goods at wholesale prices.
wholesale.zh: 仓储式会所允许会员以批发价购买商品。

wholesale.en: We sell wholesale to several chains that sell retail to the public.
wholesale.zh: 我们批发给几家向公众零售的连锁店。

wholesale.en: They are only doing what is necessary to prevent wholesale destruction of vegetation.
wholesale.zh: 他们只是在做为防止植被遭大规模破坏而必须做的事情。

fusion.en: For the uninitiated, Western Swing is a fusion of jazz, rhythm and blues, rock and roll, and country music.
fusion.zh: 可以向不懂西部摇摆乐的人解释，这是融合了爵士乐，节奏布鲁斯，摇滚乐和乡村乐的一种音乐形式。

fusion.en: It is Wagner who first demonstrated the essential fusion of racial and religious feelings in Afro-American poetry.
fusion.zh: 瓦格纳是最早将美国黑人诗歌中种族与宗教情感的融合者。

fusion.en: The movie displayed a perfect fusion of image and sound.
fusion.zh: 这部电影展示了音响与影像的完美结合。

adversary.en: His rivals knew that they could expect no quarter from such a ruthless adversary.
adversary.zh: 他的竞争者明白，不能期望如此残忍的对手发善心。

adversary.en: Both of the wrestlers tried to tumble the adversary with all their strength.
adversary.zh: 双方摔跤运动员都使出了全身气力想把对手摔倒。

adversary.en: The dictionary meaning of the term "opponent" is "adversary"; "enemy "; "one who opposes your interests".
adversary.zh: 字典里“对手”一词的意思是“敌手”、“敌人”、“与你的利益相悖的人”。

voucher.en: This voucher can be redeemed at any of our branches.
voucher.zh: 这抵用券在我们的任一分支机构都可以使用。

voucher.en: This discount voucher entitles you to 10% off your next purchase.
voucher.zh: 这张优惠券可以使你下次购物时打九折。

voucher.en: "They would feel better or less pain, if they were handed cold, hard cash as opposed to a voucher," she said.
voucher.zh: 她说：“如果给他们的是现金而不是代金券，他们会感觉更好或更少痛苦。”

subsidize.en: We also don't want to subsidize the indolence of people who are too lazy to work.
subsidize.zh: 我们也不想补贴那些懒得工作的人。
鼓励和资助在家里煮饭。

shovel.en: He has to get out and shovel snow.
A shovel was leaning against the wall.
They went out in freezing conditions to shovel snow.
shovel.zh: 他们冒着严寒出去铲雪。

puppet.en: It's a puppet. Do you like puppets?
puppet.zh: 它是一个木偶。你喜欢木偶吗？

puppet.en: We are all puppets and I'm just a puppet who can see the strings.
puppet.zh: 我们都是木偶，我只不过是能看见绳子的木偶。

chapel.zh: 我们在学院的小教堂里结的婚。
弗朗西丝卡修女走进小教堂。

chapel.en: She always went to chapel on Sundays.
chapel.zh: 她总是在星期天去教堂做礼拜。

intricate.en: He knows his way around the intricate maze of patent law.
intricate.zh: 他通晓错综复杂的专利法。

intricate.en: His new play, Arcadia, is as intricate, elaborate and allusive as anything he has yet written.
intricate.zh: 他的新剧本《阿卡狄亚》是他迄今为止创作的最错综复杂、煞费苦心和让人琢磨不定的。

intricate.en: You develop in-depth knowledge of the intricate structure of the language.
intricate.zh: 你对复杂的语言结构有更深入的了解。

throne.en: Her duty was to produce an heir to the throne.
throne.zh: 她的任务就是生育王位继承人。

throne.en: She was forced to abdicate the throne of Spain.
throne.zh: 她被迫让出西班牙的王位。

throne.en: The country acknowledged his claim to the throne.
throne.zh: 这个国家承认了他继承王位的权利。

pastoral.en: The pastoral elegance of this little simile really catches us off guard.
pastoral.zh: 这个有着田园诗情画意般优雅的小比喻确实让我们毫无防备。

pastoral.en: When she first came to this pastoral area, she found life here a bit difficult to get used to.
pastoral.zh: 她刚来牧区的时候，生活上感到有点别扭。

pastoral.en: He couldn't wait to write an epic poem about something more important than pastoral shepherd life.
pastoral.zh: 他已经迫不及待地想要写一首史诗，写一些比田园牧羊生活更为重要的题材。

orchard.en: Proudly step into my orchard, my queen.
orchard.zh: 我的女王，请骄傲地走进我的果园。

orchard.en: An evil person is a blight in the orchard.
orchard.zh: 邪恶的人就像果园里的枯萎病。

fingerprint.en: Further down the road is biometric authentication, which could be encrypted with, say, a fingerprint.
fingerprint.zh: 下一步是生物识别认证，可以用指纹等进行加密。

fingerprint.en: Looking through a magnifying glass, Hanley focussed on the most legible fingerprint, which appeared to be covered with a clear finishing coat, like a varnish.
fingerprint.zh: 透过放大镜看，汉利将注意力集中到一枚最清晰的指纹上，这枚指纹表面似乎覆盖着一层罩膜，像是一层清漆。

fingerprint.en: A fingerprint is formed when a finger touches a surface.
fingerprint.zh: 当手指接触一个表面时就形成了指纹。

auditor.en: An external auditor will verify the accounts.
auditor.zh: 外部审计员将核实这些账目。

auditor.en: The auditor has questioned the legality of the contracts.
auditor.zh: 审计员已经质疑合同的合法性。

auditor.en: During several years of gambling in that casino, Williams, a state auditor earning ＄35000 a year, lost approximately ＄175000.
auditor.zh: 威廉斯是一名年薪3.5万美元的州审计员，他在那家赌场赌了好几年，输了大约17.5万美元。

renovation.en: She wants him to share his renovation experience with her.
renovation.zh: 她希望他能分享一下装修的经验。

renovation.en: Under lobby pressure, George Osborne favors rural new-build against urban renovation and renewal.
renovation.zh: 在游说者的压力下，乔治·奥斯本赞同农村的新建工程，而不是城市的改造和更新。

renovation.en: During this renovation the building's owners, CIS, consulted the solar panel company, Solarcentury.
renovation.zh: 在这次翻新期间，大楼的所有者 CIS 公司咨询了太阳能电池板公司 Solarcentury。

mural.en: Campers will share their colorful ideas and imagination with each other and work together to visualize, sketch and paint with non-traditional techniques to create the coolest mural which will be displayed in public for all to see.
mural.zh: 露营者们将彼此分享他们丰富多彩的想法和想象力，并一起用非传统技巧来设想、素描和绘画，创造出最酷的壁画，并将其作品在公共场所展示给所有人看。

mural.en: This subscriptive mural is designed partly to raise money.
mural.zh: 设计这幅签名壁画是为了筹集资金。
毕加索的壁画《格尔·尼卡》堪称巨作。

chord.en: The speaker had obviously struck a chord with his audience.
chord.zh: 讲演者显然已引起了听众的共鸣。

chord.en: This poem has struck a responsive chord in the hearts of its readers.
chord.zh: 这首诗引起了读者的共鸣。

chord.en: In himself, too, he knew that it was vibrating at last, that chord hitherto dormant and unsuspected.
chord.zh: 在他自己心里，他也知道那根弦终于在颤动了，那根弦一直蛰伏着，不曾被察觉。

glue.en: I made a model out of paper and glue.
glue.zh: 我用纸和胶水做了一个模型。

glue.en: We used glue to stick the broken pieces together.
glue.zh: 我们用胶把碎片粘到一起。

glue.en: The smell of sawdust and glue pervaded the factory.
glue.zh: 锯屑和胶水的气味弥漫在工厂里。

theatrical.en: In a theatrical gesture Jim clamped his hand over his eyes.
theatrical.zh: 以一个夸张的手势，吉姆用一只手紧紧捂住双眼。

theatrical.en: Top theatrical agents are beating a path to the teenager's door.
theatrical.zh: 顶尖级戏剧演员代理人正纷纷把目光投向那个十多岁的孩子。

turbine.en: If we can make a turbine, it's sold.
turbine.zh: 如果我们能制造涡轮机，它就卖出去了。

turbine.en: His name was Nenoit Fourneyron, and his device was the first successful water turbine.
turbine.zh: 他叫奈诺伊特·福内隆，他成功发明了第一个水轮机。

turbine.en: You don't have to erect a wind turbine in your backyard to make an impact on climate change.
turbine.zh: 你不需要在你的后院建造一个风力涡轮机来应对气候变化的冲击。

frenzy.en: This can cause a kind of mass feeding frenzy.
frenzy.zh: 这可能会导致一种大规模的疯狂进食。

frenzy.en: It seems to me that Pygmalion's frenzy is a good emblem.
frenzy.zh: 在我看来，皮格马利翁的狂热是一个很好的象征。

frenzy.en: The old man's frenzy departed, and he became all gentleness.
frenzy.zh: 老人的狂怒消失了，他变得温柔起来。

incorrect.en: The firm says it unknowingly published incorrect statistics.
incorrect.zh: 这家公司说它不知情地出版了错误的数据。

incorrect.en: We apologize unreservedly for any incorrect behaviour by Mr. Taylor.
incorrect.zh: 我们对泰勒先生做出的所有错误行为毫无保留地道歉。

incorrect.en: Regional accents are still acceptable but there is to be a blitz on incorrect grammar.
incorrect.zh: 地方口音还可以接受，但错误语法必须要大力改进。

mankind.en: His research is for the betterment of mankind.
mankind.zh: 他的研究是为了人类生活的改善。

mankind.en: He is a practical humanist, who believes in the dignity of mankind.
mankind.zh: 他是个真正的人道主义者，信奉人类的尊严。

mankind.en: Truly, this is the way of mankind.

baggage.en: The baggage hall was crowded and noisy.
All exits must be kept clear of baggage.
baggage.zh: 所有出口必须保持通畅，不得堆放行李。

baggage.en: The fire started in the baggage compartment.
baggage.zh: 火是从行李舱着起来的。

showcase.zh: 是时候表演真正的技术了！

showcase.en: The elevation of the room that once belonged only to the servants to that of design showcase for the modern family tells the story of a century of social change.
showcase.zh: 从曾经只属于仆人的房间，到现代家庭的设计展示，这种演变讲述了一个世纪以来的社会变化。

showcase.en: The festival was a showcase for young musicians.
showcase.zh: 音乐节是青年音乐家展现才华的场合。

veto.en: They need 12 votes to override his veto.
veto.zh: 他们需要12票来推翻他的否决。

veto.en: That would mean voting no, that is to say, using the veto.
veto.zh: 那就意味着投反对票，也就是说，行使否决权。

veto.en: The British government used its veto to block the proposal.
veto.zh: 英国政府行使其否决权阻止了这项提案。

setback.en: It is an unexpected setback in her fortunes.
setback.zh: 这是她好运中的一次意外的挫折。

setback.en: A further reduction in local supplies is yet another unwelcome setback to the industry.
setback.zh: 对该行业来说，本地供应的进一步减少又是一个不受欢迎的挫折。

setback.en: The move represents a setback for the Middle East peace process.
setback.zh: 此举意味着中东和平进程的倒退。

bleak.en: The weather can be quite bleak on the coast.
bleak.zh: 沿海一带的天气可能会十分阴冷。

bleak.en: The future looks bleak for the fishing industry.

traumatic.en: The condition is most often caused by a stroke or traumatic brain injury.
traumatic.zh: 这种情况通常是由中风或创伤性脑损伤引起的。

traumatic.en: A push factor can be as simple and mild a matter as difficulty in finding a suitable job, or as traumatic as war, or severe famine.
traumatic.zh: 推动因素可以是简单而轻微的事情，比如找不到合适的工作，也可以是创伤性的事情，比如战争或严重的饥荒。

traumatic.en: Divorce can be traumatic for everyone involved.
traumatic.zh: 离婚对所有相关的人都会造成痛苦。

veil.en: She put on a velvet veil, then set out.
veil.zh: 她蒙上一块天鹅绒的面纱，然后出发了。

veil.en: The veil she was wearing obscured her features.
veil.zh: 她罩的面纱遮掩了她的面容。

veil.en: A fine drizzle began to veil the hills.
veil.zh: 蒙蒙细雨渐渐笼罩了群山。

renewable.en: Renewable sources of energy must be used.
renewable.zh: 可再生的能源必须利用。

renewable.en: He has carried out extensive research into renewable energy sources.
renewable.zh: 他已经对再生能源进行了广泛研究。

renewable.en: The success of wind power represents a litmus test for renewable energy.
renewable.zh: 风能利用的成功是对可再生能源的一次立见分晓的检验。

restless.en: My father seemed very restless and excited.
restless.zh: 我父亲似乎非常坐立不安和兴奋。

restless.en: By 1982, she was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.
restless.zh: 到1982年，她焦躁不安，需要一个新的对其才华的推动力。

cheerful.en: Why are you so bright and cheerful today?
He was a cheerful and uncomplaining travel companion.
cheerful.zh: 他是一个快乐的不抱怨的旅伴。
帕迪总是很高兴，很开心。

sunrise.zh: 雨是在日出前开始下的。
日出之前我就开始工作了。

crusade.en: When the king left on the Second Crusade, he appointed Suger as regent and left him in charge of the government.
crusade.zh: 当国王在第二次十字军东征中离开时，他任命苏格为摄政王并让他掌管政府。

crusade.en: During this period, researchers interviewed nearly 3,000 women, some of whom had learnt to read as children, some during the literacy crusade and some who had never learnt at all.
crusade.zh: 在此期间，研究人员采访了近3000名妇女，其中有些人在小时候已经学会了阅读，一些是在扫盲远征运动中学会的，还有一些从未学过阅读。

crusade.en: He made it his crusade to teach children to love books.
crusade.zh: 他把教育孩子热爱书籍作为自己的奋斗目标。

torso.en: Mars is this sort of human, flabby torso—it's sympathetic, but it's a different portrayal of wars.
torso.zh: 马尔斯是这种人，有着赘肉的躯干——这让人同情，但这是对战争的不同描写。

torso.en: The man had the bulky upper torso of a weightlifter.
torso.zh: 这名男子有着举重运动员的粗壮身躯。

puzzled.en: She looked up with a puzzled frown.
puzzled.zh: 她困惑地皱着眉抬头看。

puzzled.en: She looked up with a puzzled frown on her face.
puzzled.zh: 她抬头望着，满脸困惑，双眉紧锁。

puzzled.en: Critics remain puzzled by the election results.
puzzled.zh: 评论家们对选举结果仍感到困惑。

formulation.en: This is a far weaker formulation than is in the draft resolution which is being proposed.
formulation.zh: 这是相对于正在被提议的草拟决议要弱得多的一种表述方式。

formulation.en: For such people and many more perhaps not so exceptional, the proper formulation is, "Succeed at all costs but avoid appearing ambitious."
formulation.zh: 对于这样的人，以及更多或许不那么杰出的人来说，恰当的表述是：“不惜一切代价取得成功，但要避免显得雄心勃勃。”

formulation.en: According to this formulation, highly creative activity transcends the limits of an existing form and establishes a new principle of organization.
formulation.zh: 根据这一表述，高度创造性的活动超越了现有形式的限制，建立了新的组织原则。

diagram.en: Like any such diagram, it is a simplification.
diagram.zh: 正如任何此类图表，这是个简图。

diagram.en: This is represented in the schematic diagram below.
diagram.zh: 这在下面的图解表中展现。

diagram.en: A diagram of the new road layout was superimposed on a map of the city.
diagram.zh: 新公路的规划示意图被叠映在该城市的地图上。

comb.zh: 你的头发得好好梳理一下。

comb.en: You don't sound the 'b' in the word 'comb'.
She bent to retrieve her comb from the floor.
comb.zh: 她弯腰从地上捡起她的梳子。

hurl.en: It took only one heave to hurl him into the river.
hurl.zh: 只是一推，就把他推进了河里。

hurl.en: In this context, generosity has come to mean that you hurl money around like a drunken sailor.
hurl.zh: 在这种情况下，慷慨意味着你像喝醉了的水手一样乱扔钱。

hurl.en: In this context, generosity has come to mean that you hurl money around like a drunken sailor.
hurl.zh: 在这种情况下，慷慨意味着你像喝醉了的水手一样乱扔钱。

luggage.en: Do you have a lot of luggage?
A luggage rack is a sensible option.
luggage.zh: 行李架是个明智的选择。

luggage.en: Two pieces of luggage have gone missing.

furnish.en: They'll be able to furnish you with the rest of the details.
furnish.zh: 他们将能够给你提供其余的细节。

furnish.en: Many proprietors try to furnish their hotels with antiques.
furnish.zh: 许多企业主尽可能用古董装饰他们的旅馆。

furnish.en: California law also permits nurse practitioners to furnish patients with prescriptions for most medications.
furnish.zh: 加利福尼亚法律允许职业护士为病人开大部分药的处方。

friction.en: The pistons are graphite-coated to reduce friction.
friction.zh: 活塞表面涂有石墨以减少摩擦。

friction.en: Sara sensed that there had been friction between her children.
friction.zh: 萨拉感觉到她的孩子们中间出现了摩擦。

friction.en: Friction between moving parts had caused the engine to overheat.
friction.zh: 活动部件的摩擦使发动机过热。

segregation.en: The Supreme Court unanimously ruled that racial segregation in schools was unconstitutional.
segregation.zh: 最高法院一致裁定学校实施的种族隔离措施违反宪法。

segregation.en: This pattern of human rights violations against enslaved African-Americans continued under racial segregation for nearly another century.
segregation.zh: 这种对被奴役的非洲裔美国人侵犯人权的模式在种族隔离下延续了近一个世纪。

segregation.en: Whether in nursery school, high school, or the business world, gender segregation narrows our perceptions of each other, facilitating stereotyping and sexist attitudes.
segregation.zh: 无论是在幼儿园、高中还是在商界，性别隔离限制了我们对彼此的认知，助长了刻板印象和性别歧视观念。

analytical.zh: 他缺乏深度和分析的精确性。

analytical.en: I have an analytical approach to every survey.
analytical.zh: 我对每项调查都采用一种分析的方法。

aerial.en: The aerial doesn't look very secure to me.
Aerial photography has revolutionized the study of archaeology.
aerial.zh: 航空摄影已经给考古学研究带来了一场革命。

aerial.en: Patterns that are invisible on the ground can be the most striking part of an aerial photograph.
aerial.zh: 在地面上看不见的图案可能是空中照片中最为醒目的部分。

kin.en: We have notified the next of kin.
kin.zh: 我们已经通知了直系亲属。

kin.en: Her next of kin have been informed.
kin.zh: 她最近的亲属已得到通知了。

kin.en: Fair and foul are near of kin.

voluntarily.zh: 我永远不会自愿地离开这里。

voluntarily.en: He was not asked to leave—he went voluntarily.
voluntarily.zh: 没人让他走，是他主动走的。

voluntarily.en: Four people who sought refuge in the Italian embassy have left voluntarily.
voluntarily.zh: 到意大利大使馆寻求避难的四个人已经自愿离开了。

knowledgeable.en: The lecturers are very knowledgeable and I learn a lot from them.
knowledgeable.zh: 讲师们知识非常渊博，我从他们身上学到了很多。

knowledgeable.en: Any knowledgeable wine merchant would be able to advise you.
knowledgeable.zh: 任何一位内行的葡萄酒商人都能为你提出建议。

prosperous.en: Dirty streets are no advertisement for a prosperous society.
prosperous.zh: 肮脏的街道绝不是繁荣社会的景象。

prosperous.en: Dirty streets and homelessness are no advertisement for a prosperous society.
prosperous.zh: 肮脏的街道和无家可归现象绝不是繁荣社会的景象。

prosperous.en: Barcelona has become one of the most dynamic and prosperous cities in the Mediterranean.
prosperous.zh: 巴塞罗那已经成为地中海地区最具活力、最为繁荣的城市之一。

foliage.zh: 叶子柔软，有如羽毛一般。

foliage.en: It was so thick, and the foliage so dense, that it was quite fatiguing to proceed.
foliage.zh: 它是那么茂密，树叶是那么稠密，要往前走是很累的。

foliage.en: Presently there came a quivering glow that vaguely revealed the foliage for a moment and then vanished.
foliage.zh: 过了一会儿，一道颤动的亮光隐约地照亮了树叶，然后就消失了。

unleash.en: The officers were still reluctant to unleash their troops in pursuit of a defeated enemy.
unleash.zh: 军官们仍不愿发兵追击溃敌。

unleash.en: At the same time, however, some of these applications threaten to unleash forces over which we have no control.
unleash.zh: 然而，与此同时，其中一些应用程序可能释放出我们无法控制的力量。

unleash.en: California has spent years preparing for "The Big One"—the inevitable earthquake that will undoubtedly unleash all kinds of havoc along the famous San Andreas fault.
unleash.zh: 加州已经用了数年时间准备“大招”——一定会沿着著名的圣安德烈亚斯断层释放各种破坏的一场不可避免的地震。

pollutant.en: Sulphur dioxide is a pollutant and a major contributor to acid rain.
pollutant.zh: 二氧化硫是一种污染物，并且是形成酸雨的主要因素。

pollutant.en: Nitrogen dioxide is a pollutant emitted by automobiles.
pollutant.zh: 二氧化氮是汽车排放的一种污染物。

pollutant.en: Sulfur dioxide, a major contributor to acid rain, is an especially serious pollutant because it diminishes the respiratory system's ability to deal with all other pollutants.
pollutant.zh: 二氧化硫是酸雨的主要成因之一，它是一种特别严重的污染物，因为它会降低呼吸系统处理其他污染物的能力。

giggle.en: We only did it for a giggle.
giggle.zh: 我们做那件事只是开个玩笑而已。
她发出一个少女似的咯咯笑声。

tariff.en: Mr. McCain argued that the tariff on imported ethanol of 54 cents per gallon should be scrapped.
tariff.zh: 麦凯恩先生认为应该取消每加仑54美分的乙醇进口关税。

tariff.en: If the tariff were lifted and unprocessed cashew were sold at world market prices, more farmers could profit by growing cashews.
tariff.zh: 如果关税被取消，未加工的腰果以国际市场价格出售，那么更多的农民可以通过种植腰果获利。

tariff.en: Kernland imposes a high tariff on the export of unprocessed cashew nuts in order to ensure that the nuts are sold to domestic processing plants.
tariff.zh: 克兰对出口未经加工的腰果征收高额关税，以确保腰果销往国内加工厂。

respectable.en: I have to prove myself as a respectable, balanced person.
respectable.zh: 我得证明自己是一个可敬、沉稳的人。

respectable.en: He came from a perfectly respectable middle-class family.
respectable.zh: 他来自一个非常体面的中产阶级家庭。

respectable.en: The former wild man of rock has reinvented himself as a respectable family man.
respectable.zh: 过去的那位摇滚狂人已经改变形象，成了一位体面的爱家的男人。

domination.en: They had five centuries of domination by the Romans.
domination.zh: 他们被罗马人统治了5个世纪。

domination.en: Carême, ever confident, could see beyond his short domination in the kitchen.
domination.zh: 一直很自信的卡拉姆没有满足于在厨房里的短暂统治，而是把目光放得更远。

domination.en: Law is the best hedge we have against "the domination of partiality and desire".
domination.zh: 法律是我们对抗“偏爱和欲望的支配”的最好的屏障。

examiner.en: As an examiner, she showed no favour to any candidate.
examiner.zh: 作为主考人她没有偏袒任何应试者。

examiner.en: A medical examiner has listed the deaths as homicides.
examiner.zh: 验尸官已将这些死亡列为他杀案件。

examiner.en: Check out an article written about him in the San Francisco Examiner by clicking on the link below.
examiner.zh: 点击下面的链接，可以在《旧金山观察家报》中查看一篇关于他的文章。

ignorant.zh: 他对现代科技一无所知。
千万别让你的学生感到自己一无所知。

tick.en: I wound up the watch and listened to it tick.
tick.zh: 我给手表上好发条，听着它滴答作响。

tick.en: The only sound was the soft tick of the clock.
tick.zh: 唯一的响声是钟表轻轻的滴答声。
不管怎么说，这是一只非常小的扁虱。

dine.zh: 我们周末总是在外吃饭。

dine.en: In the morning he seemed much occupied with business, and in the afternoon gentlemen from the neighourhood called and sometimes stayed to dine with him.
dine.zh: 早上他似乎忙于生意，下午附近的绅士们来访，并且有时留下来和他一起吃饭。

dine.en: Deadpool doesn't know how to lunch without dine-and-dashing.
dine.zh: 死侍不知道怎样才能不吃霸王餐。

dispatch.en: The dispatch of the task force is purely a contingency measure.
dispatch.zh: 派遣特遣队纯粹是应急措施。

dispatch.en: Mr. Vlok promised new measures to protect residents, including the dispatch of police and troop reinforcements.
dispatch.zh: 乌洛克先生答应了新的保护居民的措施，包括派遣增援的警察和军队。

dispatch.en: I also had the first BlackBerry because I was still working in dispatch at the time.
dispatch.zh: 我也有了第一部黑莓手机，因为那时我还在忙调度的事情。

hatch.zh: 这些卵很快孵化成幼虫。

hatch.en: He stuck his head up through the hatch.

hatch.zh: 母的必须找个温暖的地方孵蛋。

prolonged.en: He left the stage to prolonged applause.
prolonged.zh: 他在经久不息的掌声中退下了舞台。
拖得很长的谈判是不受欢迎的。
长时间的罢工削弱了这个行业的活力。

mediate.en: The Secretary-General was asked to mediate in the dispute.
mediate.zh: 有人请秘书长来调解这次纷争。

mediate.en: An independent body was brought in to mediate between staff and management.
mediate.zh: 由一个独立机构介入，在劳资之间进行调解。

mediate.en: Schools are not just a microcosm of society; they mediate it too.
mediate.zh: 学校不仅仅是社会的缩影；它们也会调解。

amend.zh: 与其补救于已然，不如防范于未然。

amend.zh: 议会可能会修正提议的征税法。

imitation.zh: 小孩子通过模仿学会说话。

imitation.zh: 他们模仿长辈的口气讨论重大问题。

imitation.zh: 美国的管理人员效仿日本人的做法，采用了很多经营公司的方法。

raft.en: Several logs had been lashed together to make a raft.
raft.zh: 几根原木捆扎在一起做成了木筏。

raft.zh: “你确定这筏子安全吗？”她不安地问。“再安全不过了，”马克斯自信地向她保证。

raft.en: My raft helps me cross the ocean of life.
raft.zh: 我的木筏帮助我横渡生命的海洋。

cram.zh: 晚饭后，又到了在首尔众多所谓的一个补习班里读书的时间了。

cram.en: To make up for the mediocrity, zealous parents send their kids to the expensive cram schools.
cram.zh: 为了弥补平庸，积极的父母把孩子送到昂贵的补习班。

cram.en: The aim is to reduce the importance of costly tutors and cram schools, partly to help students enjoy a more normal high-school life.
cram.zh: 目的是降低昂贵的家教和补习班的重要性，部分是为了帮助学生享受更正常的高中生活。

nutritional.en: Both provide intensive coaching, training facilities and nutritional advice.
nutritional.zh: 两者都提供强化训练、培训设施和营养建议。

nutritional.en: They get all their nutritional needs met by the genes that they've hijacked from the algae.
nutritional.zh: 它们从藻类植物那里劫来的基因满足了它们所有的营养需求。

nutritional.en: One reason may be breakfast's nutritional value—partly because cereal is fortified with vitamins.
nutritional.zh: 早餐之所以有营养，部分原因可能是谷物富含维生素。

cathedral.en: The town is famous for its cathedral.
cathedral.zh: 这个城镇以大教堂著名。

cathedral.zh: 大教堂是这座城市至高无上的骄傲。

spike.en: Even with some smoothing, there would still be a slight spike.
spike.zh: 即使是经过了一些平滑的处理，还是会有微小的尖峰。

spike.zh: 我和吉姆、伊恩、萨姆共住一所房子，还有这条狗斯派克。

spike.en: Her first major role was in Martin Scorsese's "Goodfellas" and she followed this with a part in Spike Lee's "Jungle Fever."
spike.zh: 她首先在马丁·斯柯席斯的《好家伙》中演了重要角色，随后又演了斯派克·李的《丛林热》。

palette.en: The painter's right hand holds the brush, the left the palette.
palette.zh: 那位画家的右手握着画笔，左手拿着调色盘。

palette.en: Obviously the chosen color palette is down to you, but here I'm using a mix of green and cyan.
palette.zh: 显然，你也可以选用自己的调色板的颜色，在这里我就选择了我选择的是青绿色的混合。

palette.en: It's a poem that begins, "I have heard that hysterical women say they are sick of the palette and fiddle-bow, of poets that are always gay."
palette.zh: 诗的开头写道，“我曾听见歇斯底里的女人们说，她们厌恶调色板和提琴弓，厌恶那些永远快乐的诗人们。”

selfish.en: Do you think I'm being selfish by not letting her go?
selfish.zh: 你觉得我不让她走是自私吗？

lament.en: Another piece went right through a backyard trampoline, evoking a mother's lament, "Those damned kids ..."
lament.zh: 另一块碎片正好打穿一张摆在后院的蹦床，惹得那家母亲哀叹：“这些可恶的孩子……”

lament.en: Another piece went right through a backyard trampoline, evoking a mother's lament, "Those damned kids ..."
lament.zh: 另一块碎片正好打穿一张摆在后院的蹦床，惹得那家母亲哀叹：“这些可恶的孩子……”

lament.en: Yet Walmart's year-over-year online sales only grew 7 percent, leading its CEO to lament "Growth here is too slow."
lament.zh: 然而，沃尔玛的网上销售同比仅增长了7%，导致其总裁哀叹“增长太慢”。

ignite.en: Maybe even give a little smile and ignite that twinkle in your eye.
ignite.zh: 抑或只是一个嫣然浅笑，便点燃了你眼眸中的那抹闪亮。

ignite.en: United 93 is the first feature film to deal explicitly with the events of September 11, 2001, and is certain to ignite an emotional debate.
ignite.zh: 《93号航班》是第一部明确讲述911事件的故事片，这肯定是会引发一场情绪化的的争论的。

ignite.en: Once a burning firelighter is placed against a tyre, it takes a few minutes for a car to ignite, giving the arsonist plenty of time to escape.
ignite.zh: 一旦将一个燃烧着的打火机放在轮胎上，汽车需要几分钟才能点燃，这给了纵火犯大量的时间逃跑。

revolve.en: Our planet Earth, together with other planets, revolve around our Sun in what is called our Solar system.
revolve.zh: 我们的行星地球，连同其他行星，围绕我们的太阳旋转，这就是我们的太阳系。

revolve.en: Of course, we now know that the planets, including Earth, revolve around the Sun, and that the solar system is only a tiny part of the universe.
revolve.zh: 当然，我们现在知道，包括地球在内的行星都围绕太阳公转，而太阳系只是宇宙的一小部分。

revolve.en: Geocentric means Earth-centered, so the geocentric view holds that the Sun, the planets, and the stars, all revolve around the Earth, which is stationary.
revolve.zh: 地心论是指以地球为中心，所以地心论认为，太阳、行星和恒星都围绕着地球旋转，而地球是静止的。

alternate.en: They were streaked with alternate bands of colour.
alternate.zh: 他们都带有色彩交替相间的条纹。

arsenal.zh: 阿森纳队在上半场比赛中占据上风。

bully.en: I wasn't going to let him bully me.
Damn you! I'm not going to let you bully me.
bully.zh: 你这个浑蛋！我决不让你欺负我。

bully.zh: 他能时而欺负人，时而吸引人。
