她的手镯上挂着许多金饰物。

bracelet.en: He wore a copper bracelet on his wrist.

contaminate.en: An urban food myth contends that if food spends just a few seconds on the floor, dirt and germs won't have much of a chance to contaminate it.
contaminate.zh: 一个有关食物的都市神话声称，如果食物只在地上停留几秒钟，灰尘和细菌就不太有可能污染它。
敌对关系损害我们的健康。

contaminate.en: Previously, MTBE (methyl tertiary-butyl ether) was the oxygenate of choice, but fell out of favour in 2004 when it was found to contaminate ground water.
contaminate.zh: 以前，MTBE（甲基叔丁基醚）曾作为汽油充氧剂，但是，在2004年，人们发现它污染了地下水，所以就不再使用它了。

plight.en: We were deeply moved by her plight.
plight.zh: 她的困境深深地打动了我们。

plight.en: She was touched by the plight of the refugees.
plight.zh: 难民的困境使她受到触动。

plight.en: They bore their plight with stoicism and fortitude.
plight.zh: 他们以坚忍刚毅的精神面对困境。

inhibit.en: Sore nipples can inhibit the milk supply.
inhibit.zh: 乳头疼痛可能抑制母乳分泌。

inhibit.en: Authority doesn't have to inhibit innovation but it often does.
inhibit.zh: 权威不一定要抑制创新，但它经常这样做。

inhibit.en: Moving around throughout the day can inhibit a tendency to fidget and chatter.
inhibit.zh: 一天内四处走动可以抑制你的烦躁和喋喋不休的谈话。

chaotic.en: The traffic in the city is chaotic in the rush hour.
chaotic.zh: 在上下班高峰时间，城市的交通混乱不堪。

chaotic.en: My own house feels as filthy and chaotic as a bus terminal.
chaotic.zh: 我自己的房子感觉和公共汽车总站一样污浊混乱。
他说：“传统的建设过程是混乱的。”

enormously.en: Ibrahim is 59, strong looking, enormously energetic and accomplished.
enormously.zh: 伊卜拉希姆59岁，健壮的样子，精力极其充沛且富有才华。
他们的法语水平提高了很多。

hollow.en: The squirrel disappeared into a hollow at the base of the tree.
hollow.zh: 松鼠钻进了树根处的一个洞。

hollow.en: His proud boast of leading "the party of low taxation" has a hollow ring.
hollow.zh: 他有关领导“主张低税收的政党”的豪言有空洞的感觉。

default.en: The company is in default on the loan.
On this screen, 256 colours is the default.
default.zh: 这个显示屏的系统设定值是256色。

default.en: The default option is to save your work every five minutes.
default.zh: 默认设置为每五分钟存盘一次。

vibration.en: These can cause vibration and damage the blades of the turbines.
vibration.zh: 这些（气泡）会引起振动并损坏涡轮机的叶片。

vibration.en: An earthquake is a vibration that travels through the earth's crust.
vibration.zh: 地震是一种穿过地壳的震动。

vibration.en: As snow accumulates on a steep slope, it reaches a critical point at which the slightest vibration will send it sliding into the valley below.
vibration.zh: 当雪在陡峭的斜坡上堆积时，它会达到一个临界点，在这个临界点上，最轻微的震动就会使它滑进下面的山谷。

merry.en: She was humming a merry little tune.
merry.zh: 她轻轻地哼着一首欢快的小曲儿。

merry.en: From the house come bursts of merry laughter.
merry.zh: 从房子里传出阵阵欢快的笑声。

merry.en: A merry crowd of villagers watched the proceedings.
merry.zh: 一群兴高采烈的村民观看了仪式。

disperse.en: Police used tear gas to disperse the crowds.
disperse.zh: 警察使用催泪瓦斯驱散人群。

disperse.en: Police used tear gas to disperse the demonstrators.
disperse.zh: 警察动用了催泪瓦斯来驱散示威人群。

comrade.en: Better be careful of your bookish approach, comrade.
Most of the goats ran away from their rough comrade.
comrade.zh: 大多数山羊都从它们粗暴的伙伴身边跑开了。

comrade.en: We can't remain indifferent when any comrade is in difficulty.
comrade.zh: 同志们有困难我们不能不闻不问。

sober.en: He'd been drunk when I arrived. Now he was sober.
sober.zh: 我到的时候他已经喝醉了。现在他清醒了。
他穿着一套素净的灰色衣服。

corresponding.en: A change in the money supply brings a corresponding change in expenditure.
corresponding.zh: 货币供应量的改变随即引起支出的相应改变。

corresponding.en: The rise in interest rates was not reflected in a corresponding rise in the dollar.
corresponding.zh: 利率上调没有反映在相应的美元增值上。

corresponding.en: I have been corresponding with several experts in the field.
corresponding.zh: 我一直与这个领域的几位专家保持通信。

nap.en: An elderly person may nap during the day and then sleep only five hours a night.
nap.zh: 上了年纪的人白天会小睡一会儿，然后晚上只睡5个小时。

nap.en: Don't take a nap in the afternoon.
Taking a nap is one of my favorites.
nap.zh: 睡午觉是我的爱好之一。

razor.en: He plugged his razor in to recharge it.
razor.zh: 他把剃刀插在插座上，给它充电。

razor.en: Van Gogh cut off his left ear with a razor blade in 1888.
razor.zh: 1888年，梵高用剃须刀片割掉了自己的左耳。

razor.en: Their electric razor gets hot and now the whole house smells like singed hair.
razor.zh: 他们的电动剃须刀变热了，现在整个房子闻起来像烧焦的头发。

impair.zh: 它可能会损害消化系统。

impair.en: Their inability to scowl seemed to impair their ability to see why pushy telemarketers or a lack of birthday wishes might make one's face fall.
impair.zh: 他们无法动怒似乎削弱了他们的能力，让他们明白为什么咄咄逼人的电话推销员或没得到生日祝愿可能会让一个人沉下脸来。

impair.en: Even one drink can impair driving performance.
impair.zh: 即使一杯酒也可能影响驾驶操作。

constructive.zh: 她欢迎建设性的批评意见。

constructive.en: The President told waiting reporters there had been a constructive dialogue.
constructive.zh: 总统告诉等候的记者，刚才进行了一次富有建设性的对话。

constructive.en: She believes these talks will be the start of a constructive and meaningful dialogue.
constructive.zh: 她相信这些谈话将是一次建设性的、重要的对话的开始。

charcoal.en: Grill the steaks over a wood or charcoal fire that is quite hot.
charcoal.zh: 在相当热的柴火或木炭火上烤牛排。

charcoal.en: They make the charcoal by burying wood in the ground and then slowly burning it.
charcoal.zh: 他们制作木炭时要把木头埋进地里，然后让它慢慢燃烧。

charcoal.en: It's like an old charcoal burner. The coffee is heated up like charcoal.
charcoal.zh: 它就像一个旧的木炭燃烧器。咖啡像木炭一样被加热。

intrinsic.en: Diamonds have little intrinsic value and their price depends almost entirely on their scarcity.
intrinsic.zh: 钻石没有多少内在价值，它们的价格几乎完全取决于其稀有程度。

intrinsic.en: It's got extrinsic and intrinsic value for me.
intrinsic.zh: 对我来说，它有外在和内在的价值。

intrinsic.en: Let me introduce a couple of technical terms: extrinsic value and intrinsic value.
intrinsic.zh: 让我来介绍几个术语：外在价值和内在价值。

starve.en: If my back go idle, I starve.
starve.zh: 如果我的背闲着，那我就要挨饿了。

starve.en: What can we do, but lie here and starve?
starve.zh: 除了躺在这里挨饿，我们还能做什么呢？

starve.en: Brother A said he would starve to death; Brother B said he wouldn't.
starve.zh: 哥哥 A 说他会饿死；弟弟 B 说他不会。

impatient.zh: 他不耐烦地瞥了维基一眼。
她显然是迫不及待地想离开。

reclaim.en: The good news for the industry was that investors don't seem to be in any hurry to reclaim their money.
reclaim.zh: 对该行业来说，好消息是投资者们似乎不急于要求收回他们的钱。

reclaim.en: The richest merchants in Amsterdam contributed money to reclaim a good 7,100 hectares of land.
reclaim.zh: 阿姆斯特丹最富有的商人们捐钱并开垦了7100公顷的良田。

reclaim.en: You'll have to go to the police station to reclaim your wallet.
reclaim.zh: 你得到警察局去认领你的钱包。

prevalence.en: Could it be the prevalence of tea in their culture?
prevalence.zh: 是因为茶在他们的文化中流行而造成的吗？

prevalence.en: The prevalence of black and Asian faces among those targeted has caused especial resentment.
prevalence.zh: 黑人和亚洲人的面孔在那些目标人群中普遍存在，这引起了特别的不满。

prevalence.en: Epidemiological studies have found that children with PDD have no higher prevalence of gastrointestinal tract than normal children.
prevalence.zh: 流行病学研究发现，广泛性发育障碍（Pervasive Developmental Disorder）孩子和正常孩子相比较并没有更高的胃肠道患病率。

sewer.en: He would tell her, "Oh, sinful wretch, who is spreading disease and filth like an open sewer."
sewer.zh: 他会告诉她：“噢，可恶的家伙，像露天下水道一样传播疾病和污秽。”

sewer.en: Concerns about public health led to the construction between 1876 and 1904 of three separate sewer systems to serve metropolitan Boston.
sewer.zh: 出于对公众健康的担忧，1876年至1904年期间，为了服务于波士顿市区，政府修建了三个独立的下水道系统。

sewer.en: The alligators would escape and find their way into the New York sewer system where they started reproducing, grew to huge sizes and now strike fear into sewer workers.
sewer.zh: 短吻鳄会逃跑，找到进入纽约下水道系统的路并开始在那里繁殖，长得巨大，现在还使得下水道工人感到害怕。

wield.en: The men who wield the power are certainly backing him to the hilt.
wield.zh: 那些掌权者当然都在全力支持他。

wield.en: My students quickly see that the simplest way parents can elicit cooperation from children is to wield power tools.
wield.zh: 我的学生们很快发现，父母能让孩子们合作的最简单方法就是使用奇怪的电动工具。

wield.en: He who knows only how to wield a pen usually feels quite helpless in the face of practical problems.
wield.zh: 光会耍笔杆的人，碰到实际问题往往束手无策。

fertile.zh: 农民们开垦了这个肥沃的山谷。

fertile.en: We have the most fertile soil in the Midwest.
fertile.zh: 我们在中西部有最肥沃的土壤。

fertile.en: The operation cannot be reversed to make her fertile again.
fertile.zh: 手术不可逆转，无法使她重获生育能力。

timely.en: A nasty incident was prevented by the timely arrival of the police.
timely.zh: 警察的及时到来阻止了一次严重事故。

timely.en: The incident served as a timely reminder of just how dangerous mountaineering can be.
timely.zh: 这次事故及时地提醒了人们登山运动有时会多么危险。

timely.en: The recent outbreaks of cholera are a timely reminder that this disease is still a serious health hazard.
timely.zh: 最近几次爆发的霍乱是一个适时的提醒，该疾病依然是个严重的健康危害。

slab.en: Slab pull happens at the subduction zone.
slab.zh: 板块拉伸发生在俯冲带。

slab.en: Once the ocean plate begins to sink, it would be affected by another force—slab pull.
slab.zh: 一旦海洋板块开始下沉，它就会受到另一种力量——板块拉力的影响。

slab.en: At the CBI Denver Crime Lab, technicians shake out the items in a sterile room, onto a large, white slab covered with paper.
slab.zh: 在 CBI 丹佛犯罪实验室，技术人员在一间无菌室里把这些物品抖出来，放到一个铺着纸的白色大平板上。

daunting.en: He and his wife Jane were faced with the daunting task of restoring the gardens to their former splendour.
daunting.zh: 他和他的妻子简当时面临着恢复花园昔日风采的艰巨任务。

daunting.en: She was asked if she was prepared for what might be a daunting task caring for her.
daunting.zh: 她被问道是否已经为照顾她的艰巨任务做好准备。

daunting.en: Young people have reported that for low-level conditions such as stress and anxiety, a clinical setting can sometimes be daunting.
daunting.zh: 年轻人表示，在有轻度症状的情况下，比如有压力和感到焦虑，临床环境有时会令人望而生畏。

disgust.zh: 有些人厌恶地大声嚷嚷。

prose.en: Shute's prose is stark and chillingly unsentimental.
prose.zh: 舒特的散文刻板而冷峻。

prose.en: Most of the play is written in verse, but some of it is in prose.
prose.zh: 这剧本大部分是用韵文写的，不过有一些是用散文。

prose.en: Her prose style is not always felicitous; she tends to repetition.
prose.zh: 她的散文文风并非一直恰到好处，她会赘叙。

doom.en: Does this spell the doom of the physical book?
doom.zh: 这是否意味着实体书的末日？

doom.en: "Proud and insolent youth," said Hook, "prepare to meet thy doom."
doom.zh: “傲慢无礼的年轻人，”胡克说，“准备迎接你的厄运吧。”

doom.en: Why are people so full of gloom and doom?
doom.zh: 人们的心里为什么满是悲观失望？

rancher.en: The company teamed up with Wisconsin-based rancher Northstar Bison.
rancher.zh: 该公司与威斯康星州的牧场主北极星野牛合作。

rancher.en: But for now, the Crazy Mountain rancher would rather stay put.
rancher.zh: 但是现在疯狂山脉的牧场主们还在坚守阵地。

rancher.en: Guzman was 19 when she met Varela. He told her he was a cattle rancher.
rancher.zh: 尤雅娜认识万利拉时19岁，他告诉她自己经营一个牧场。

crest.en: Annie touched the Pteranodon's crest and stroked its neck.
crest.zh: 安妮摸了摸翼龙的冠，抚摸着它的脖子。

crest.en: On the wall is the family crest.
Both birds had a dark blue crest.
crest.zh: 两只鸟都长着深蓝色的羽冠。

layout.en: The layout is hard to fault ergonomically.
layout.zh: 这一设计从工效学方面看几乎无懈可击。

layout.en: He tried to recall the layout of the farmhouse.
layout.zh: 他想回忆那农舍的布局。

layout.en: A diagram of the new road layout was superimposed on a map of the city.
layout.zh: 新公路的规划示意图被叠映在该城市的地图上。

capsule.en: You are asked to swallow a capsule containing vitamin B.
capsule.zh: 你被要求吞下一颗含维生素B的胶囊。

capsule.en: A Russian space capsule is currently orbiting the Earth.
capsule.zh: 一个俄罗斯太空舱目前正环绕地球飞行。

capsule.en: Try and keep it in a time capsule.
capsule.zh: 试着把它放在时间胶囊里。

accidental.en: The coroner recorded a verdict of accidental death.
accidental.zh: 验尸官判定这是一次意外死亡。

accidental.en: We insure against all damage, accidental or otherwise.
accidental.zh: 我们的保险包括一切意外或其他损失。

accidental.en: At least 10 000 children are involved in accidental poisonings every year.
accidental.zh: 每年至少有1万名儿童意外中毒。

hamburger.en: We stopped at a drive-in for a hamburger.
hamburger.zh: 我们在一家“免下车”餐馆停下来吃汉堡包。

hamburger.en: Shane was chowing down on a mammoth hamburger.
hamburger.zh: 谢恩正在狼吞虎咽的吃一个巨型汉堡。

lever.en: He pulled the lever and set the machine in motion.
lever.zh: 他扳动操纵杆，启动了机器。

lever.en: I put the coin in the machine and pulled the lever.
lever.zh: 我把硬币投进机器，然后拉了控制杆。

lever.en: He examined the machine, worked a lever that lifted the lid.
lever.zh: 他检查了机器，并使用杠杆打开盖子。

upright.zh: 他英俊、正直、对女士彬彬有礼。
海伦笔直地坐在椅子上。
他换成了一个挺直的姿势。

persistence.en: Skill comes only with practice, patience, and persistence.
persistence.zh: 只有通过练习、耐心和坚持不懈才能获得技能。

persistence.en: Sandra was determined to become a doctor and her persistence paid off.
persistence.zh: 桑德拉决心成为一名医生，她的坚持不懈终于带来了成功。

persistence.en: None can match your sheer will-power and persistence in wearing down the opposition.
persistence.zh: 在消磨反对派的意志方面，没有人能比得上你那惊人的毅力和恒心。

abolish.en: These reforms will abolish racially discriminatory laws.
abolish.zh: 这些改革将废除种族歧视法律。

abolish.en: An Illinois House committee voted Thursday to abolish the death penalty.
abolish.zh: 伊利诺伊州议院的一个委员会在星期四投票废除了死刑。

abolish.en: He took the first step to abolish slavery in America.
abolish.zh: 他迈出了在美国废除奴隶制的第一步。

feminism.en: "Not all feminism has to be like this," Jo maintains.
feminism.zh: 乔坚持认为，“并非所有的女权运动都得像这样。”

feminism.en: Once we get to feminism, feminism will have certain ideas of its own about the vertical axis.
feminism.zh: 当我们谈到女性主义时，女性主义都会对竖轴有自己的解读。

feminism.en: Her opposition to abortion and feminism marks her as a convinced traditionalist.
feminism.zh: 她对堕胎和女权主义的反对表明她是一个坚定的传统主义者。

yacht.en: His 36 ft yacht sank suddenly last summer.
yacht.zh: 他的36英尺游艇去年夏天突然沉没了。

yacht.en: I crewed for him on his yacht last summer.
yacht.zh: 去年夏天我在他的游艇上当船员。

interstate.en: The Florida Highway Patrol shut down the 20-mile stretch of the interstate.
interstate.zh: 弗罗里达公路巡逻队关闭了20英里的州际公路段。

interstate.en: Interstate 295 is a 20-mile beltway that bypasses Jacksonville's busy downtown area.
interstate.zh: 295号州际公路是一条20英里长、绕过了杰克逊维尔的繁华市区的环路。

interstate.en: Above all, the interstate system provides individuals with what they enrich most: personal freedom of mobility.
interstate.zh: 最重要的是，州际公路系统为个人提供了他们最富有的东西：个人行动自由。

autonomous.en: Five of the six provinces are to become autonomous regions in a new federal system of government.
autonomous.zh: 在新的联邦政府体制下，6个省中的5个将成为自治区。

autonomous.en: The next wave of autonomous farm machinery is already at work.
autonomous.zh: 下一波自主农业机械的浪潮已经开始发挥作用。

autonomous.en: Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region is boasted for its picturesque scenery.
autonomous.zh: 广西壮族自治区以风景如画而著称。

liner.en: Hundreds of small craft bobbed around the liner as it steamed into the harbour.
liner.zh: 班轮驶进港口时，周围的许多小船颠簸起来。

liner.en: Once there were regularly scheduled airlines, it became impractical to make a business trip by ocean liner.
liner.zh: 一旦有了定期的飞机航班，乘坐远洋客轮出差就变得不切实际了。

liner.en: How did you captain an ocean liner?
liner.zh: 你是怎样当上远洋客轮的船长的？

librarian.en: My dream is to be a librarian.
librarian.zh: 我的梦想是成为一名图书管理员。
图书馆管理员在图书馆里工作。

librarian.en: What do you do as a librarian?
librarian.zh: 作为图书管理员，你做些什么？

topple.en: The tree is so badly damaged they are worried it might topple over.
topple.zh: 这棵树损伤非常严重以至于他们担心它会倒下。

topple.en: So, why don't they topple over at the first tremor?
topple.zh: 那么，为什么它们在首次抖动时不倒塌？

topple.en: So, why don’t they topple over at the first tremor?
topple.zh: 那么，为什么它们在首次抖动时不倒塌？

inferior.en: Modern music is often considered inferior to that of the past.
inferior.zh: 现代音乐常被认为不如过去的。

inferior.en: He preferred the company of those who were intellectually inferior to himself.
inferior.zh: 他喜欢与那些智力不如他的人为伍。
他们在社会地位上不如他。

reinforcement.en: Since employees have different needs, what acts as a reinforcement for one may not for another.
reinforcement.zh: 由于员工需求不同，对一个人起强化作用的措施可能对另一个人不起作用。

reinforcement.en: The prairie vole has the needed receptors in its brain for these hormones in the regions responsible for reward and reinforcement.
reinforcement.zh: 在草原田鼠的大脑中，负责奖励和强化的区域有这些荷尔蒙的受体。

reinforcement.en: I am sure that this meeting will contribute to the reinforcement of peace and security all over the world.
reinforcement.zh: 我确信这次会晤将为全世界和平与安全的巩固做出贡献。

morale.en: The news has done wonders for our morale.
morale.zh: 这消息大大振奋了我们的士气。

morale.en: Morale amongst the players is very high at the moment.
Winning the competition was a wonderful boost for her morale.
morale.zh: 赢得了那场比赛使她士气大振。

vastly.en: Like most of my contemporaries, I grew up in a vastly different world.
vastly.zh: 像我同时代的大多数人一样，我在一个非常不同的世界里长大。

vastly.en: Life in the wild is vastly overrated.
vastly.zh: 野外生活被大大地高估了。

diversion.en: The party will make a pleasant diversion.
diversion.zh: 晚会会是一个很不错的消遣。

diversion.en: A smoke bomb created a diversion while the robbery took place.
diversion.zh: 劫案发生时，一枚烟雾弹转移了人们的视线。
你会发现这是一种很好的消遣。

distortion.en: He demonstrated how audio signals could be transmitted along cables without distortion.
distortion.zh: 他演示了音频信号如何通过电缆传输而不失真。

distortion.en: I think it would be a gross distortion of reality to say that they were motivated by self-interest.
distortion.zh: 我认为说他们被自身利益所驱使是对事实的公然扭曲。

distortion.en: What a distortion of resilience! A resilient child is a well-rested one.
distortion.zh: 好一个对复原力的曲解啊！复原力强的孩子往往休息得很好。

almond.en: Almond can also help your sleep because it contains tryptophan and magnesium.
almond.zh: 杏仁一样可以帮助你的睡眠，因为它富含色氨酸和镁。

almond.en: Blend up with low-fat milk or soy milk, some frozen blueberries, and perhaps some almond butter or oatmeal.
almond.zh: 将低脂牛奶或豆奶、一些冷冻蓝莓、一些杏仁奶油或者燕麦片混合起来。

prophet.en: The pity is that you are not a prophet.
The prophet appropriately appropriated the fund for repairing propeller.
prophet.zh: 提倡者恰当地为修理螺旋桨拨专款。

prophet.en: In the tradition, one of the companions asked the prophet what's the most powerful verse in Koran.
prophet.zh: 在传统中，一个同伴问先知《古兰经》中最有力量的一节是什么。

subsidiary.en: WM Financial Services is a subsidiary of Washington Mutual.
subsidiary.zh: 华盛顿互惠银行金融服务公司是华盛顿互惠银行的子公司。

subsidiary.en: The company is a wholly-owned subsidiary of a large multinational.
subsidiary.zh: 这是一家大型跨国企业的全资子公司。

subsidiary.en: The Boston-owned software company became a wholly-owned subsidiary of IBM.
subsidiary.zh: 这家波士顿所有的软件公司成了IBM的一家全资子公司。

reminiscent.en: We drank from wax-coated paper cups reminiscent of a visit to the dentist.
reminiscent.zh: 我们喝水用的蜡纸杯让我想起了那次去看牙医的事。

reminiscent.en: The way he laughed was strongly reminiscent of his father.
reminiscent.zh: 他笑的样子让人很容易想起他的父亲。

reminiscent.en: Rauxa is reminiscent of our words "raucous" and "ruckus".
reminiscent.zh: 罗克斯让人想起我们的词“沙哑的”和“喧闹的”。

validate.en: The Academy Awards appear to validate his career.
validate.zh: 这些奥斯卡金像奖看来证实了他的职业生涯的价值。

validate.en: This discovery seems to validate the claims of popular astrology.
validate.zh: 这一发现似乎证实了流行占星术的一些观点。

validate.en: If I want to validate this code in a white box manner, I have to separate UI-specific code from business code, which requires some refactoring.
validate.zh: 如果我想以白盒方式验证这段代码，就必须将特定于用户界面的代码与业务代码分开，这就需要进行重构。

pragmatic.en: All communication systems serve a purpose, a pragmatic function of some sort.
pragmatic.zh: 所有的通信系统都有一个目的，某种实用的功能。

pragmatic.en: Knowledge of chronobiological patterns can have many pragmatic implications for our day-to-day lives.
pragmatic.zh: 关于生物钟模式的知识可以对我们的日常生活产生许多实际影响。

pragmatic.en: One reason for the striking upsurge of social psychology in the United States lies in the pragmatic tradition of this country.
pragmatic.zh: 美国社会心理的显著高涨，其原因之一在于这个国家的实用主义传统。

orphan.en: He stayed with a raccoon orphan he had adopted.
orphan.zh: 他和一只他收养的浣熊孤儿待在一起。

orphan.en: It's the latest in a long line of orphan literature.
orphan.zh: 这是最新的孤儿文学作品。

orphan.en: He brought up the orphan and passed onto him his knowledge of medicine.
orphan.zh: 他把一个孤儿养大，并且把自己的医术传给了他。

inn.en: I always feel at home at Ye Olde Starre Inn.
inn.zh: 在昨日星辰客栈，我总是觉得非常舒适安逸。

inn.en: I learnt that the house had formerly been an inn.
inn.zh: 我得知这座房子以前是家客栈。

inn.en: She washed her face at the pump in front of the inn.
inn.zh: 她在客栈前的水泵旁洗了洗脸。

graze.en: The land is used by local people to graze their animals.
graze.zh: 这块地当地人用来放牧。

graze.en: I anoint the head and nose of each sheep with the same oil, and allow them to graze.
graze.zh: 我用同样的油抹在每只羊的头上和鼻子上，并让它们吃草。

graze.en: Five cows graze serenely around a massive oak.
graze.zh: 5头奶牛在一棵大橡树附近安静地吃草。

reel.en: The reel comes complete with a set of spares for all the working parts.
reel.zh: 那个卷轴配有一套所有运行部件的备用件。

reel.en: The rod bent double, the reel shrieked and ratcheted.
reel.zh: 该操作杆加倍弯曲，线轴发出刺耳的嗒嗒声。

reel.en: The musicians burst into a rousing rendition of "Paddy Casey's Reel."
reel.zh: 这些音乐家激情演绎了《帕迪·凯西的里尔舞曲》。

preview.en: He had gone to see the preview of a play.
preview.zh: 他去看过一出戏的预演。
你在上课前有预习的吗？

preview.en: You shall work in pairs or groups to show the preview results.
preview.zh: 你们要分组展示预习成果。

alleviate.en: A number of measures were taken to alleviate the problem.
alleviate.zh: 采取了一系列措施缓解这个问题。

alleviate.en: Feeling close to objects can alleviate loneliness.
alleviate.zh: 感觉接近物体可以减轻孤独感。

alleviate.en: We need to be aware of the risks and keep working to alleviate the dangers.
alleviate.zh: 我们需要意识到这些风险，并继续努力减轻这些危险。

enlarge.en: There are plans to enlarge the recreation area.
enlarge.zh: 已经有了扩大娱乐场地的计划。

enlarge.en: He didn't enlarge on the form that the interim government and assembly would take.
enlarge.zh: 他未详述临时政府和议会将会采取的形式。

comedian.en: I'm going to write good jokes and become a good comedian.
comedian.zh: 我要创作出好的笑话并且成为一个优秀的喜剧演员。

comedian.en: In a stand-up set, the comedian will often tell you their age.
comedian.zh: 在单口喜剧中，喜剧演员会告诉你他们的年龄。

comedian.en: The hosts know someone who is a comedian who will be replacing the band.
comedian.zh: 会有主办方认识的某位喜剧演员来取代乐队。

escalate.en: We do not want to escalate the war.
Conditions are still very tense and the fighting could escalate at any time.
escalate.zh: 形势依然很紧张，战斗随时可能升级。
我们来看看，这些小事儿是怎样升级的。

mock.en: You can mock, but at least I'm willing to have a try!
mock.zh: 你可以嘲笑我，但我至少愿意试一试。

mock.en: What did you get in the mock?
mock.zh: 你的模拟考试得了多少分？
他沉下脸来，装出一副严厉的样子。

cruiser.zh: 这艘巡洋舰有坚固的装甲。

cruiser.en: The Japs claimed a cruiser and a destroyer.
cruiser.zh: 日军声称击沉了1艘巡洋舰和1艘驱逐舰。

discretion.zh: 谨慎不是杰里米的长处。

discretion.en: We may vary the limit at our discretion and will notify you of any change.
discretion.zh: 我们可酌情决定更改限制，并会将任何变更通知你。

arbitrary.zh: 他做的决定难以预料，主观武断。

arbitrary.en: The choice of players for the team seemed completely arbitrary.
arbitrary.zh: 看来这个队的队员完全是随意选定的。

arbitrary.en: Finally, the security was fired for his arbitrary judgment.
arbitrary.zh: 最后，保安因为他的武断判断被解雇了。

scrub.en: I started to scrub off the dirt.
I've given the floor a good scrub.
scrub.zh: 我把地板彻底擦洗了一遍。

rubble.en: A gang of workmen were shovelling rubble onto a truck.
rubble.zh: 一帮工人正用铁锹往卡车上装碎石。

rubble.en: Brick rubble is useful as the base for paths and patios.
rubble.zh: 碎砖可用作道路和天井的基石。

rubble.en: All the buildings in the town have been reduced to rubble.
rubble.zh: 镇上所有的建筑都变成了瓦砾。

stubborn.en: Mick was stubborn and domineering with a very bad temper.
stubborn.zh: 麦克既固执又刚愎自用，脾气还很坏。

stubborn.en: The more Sarah nagged her, the more stubborn Cissie became.
stubborn.zh: 萨拉越是对她唠叨不休，茜茜就越是固执。

stubborn.en: She's proud and stubborn, you know, under that pliant exterior.
stubborn.zh: 她既傲气又固执，你知道的，在那温顺的外表下。

bathe.en: The police have warned the city's inhabitants not to bathe in the polluted river.
bathe.zh: 警方已经警告本市居民不要在那条被污染的河里游泳。

bathe.en: Slowly, people began to bathe more frequently.
bathe.zh: 慢慢地，人们开始更频繁地洗澡。

bathe.en: They clean cages, play with the animals, feed and bathe the pets and take the dogs for walks.
bathe.zh: 他们打扫笼子，和动物玩耍，给宠物喂食和洗澡，还带着狗散步。

resemblance.en: She bears an uncanny resemblance to Dido.
resemblance.zh: 她跟迪多长得离奇的相似。

resemblance.en: He bears a striking resemblance to Lenin.
resemblance.zh: 他与列宁有着不同寻常的相似之处。

resemblance.en: There was a remarkable resemblance between him and Pete.
resemblance.zh: 他和皮特有一个惊人的相似之处。

avert.en: He did his best to avert suspicion.
The aim of the current round of talks is to promote free trade and to avert the threat of increasing protectionism.
avert.zh: 本轮会谈的目的是促进自由贸易，消除日益加剧的贸易保护主义的威胁。

avert.en: They discovered the danger in time, and made shift to avert it.
avert.zh: 他们及时发现了危险，并设法避免了。

polished.en: The dark polished wood shone like glass.
polished.zh: 抛光后的深色木料像玻璃一样熠熠闪光。

polished.en: The dentist scaled and polished my teeth.
polished.zh: 牙医为我刮除牙石，抛光了牙齿。

polished.en: He beat the rugs and polished the silver.
polished.zh: 他拍打了地毯，擦亮了银器。

cavity.en: What is most noticeable is this cavity, this fluid-filled cavity that begins to develop.
cavity.zh: 最明显的是这个腔，这个充满液体的腔开始发育。

cavity.en: In contrast to cavity QED systems, the researchers can custom tailor the circuitry in many areas.
cavity.zh: 与腔 QED 系统相比，研究人员可以在许多领域定制电路。

cavity.en: Make sure you don't eat anything like steaks for the next few hours, and we'll fill the other cavity tomorrow.
cavity.zh: 你要保证，在接下来的几个小时里，不要吃任何像牛排之类的东西。明天我们会把另一个洞补上。

conjunction.en: Textbooks are designed to be used in conjunction with classroom teaching.
conjunction.zh: 教科书被设计成与课堂教学配合使用。

conjunction.en: The system is designed to be used in conjunction with a word processing program.
conjunction.zh: 本系统是为与文字处理软件配合使用而设计的。

detain.en: He caught her arm in a subconscious attempt to detain her.
detain.zh: 他下意识地抓住了她的胳膊，试图留住她。

detain.en: Millson stood up. "Thank you. We won't detain you any further, Mrs. Stebbing."
detain.zh: 米尔森站起来。“谢谢您。我们不再耽搁您了，斯特宾太太。”

detain.en: It is against the law to detain you against your will for any length of time.
detain.zh: 违反你的意愿拘留你无论多久都是违法的。

genocide.en: Preventing genocide is a collective and individual responsibility.
genocide.zh: 防止灭绝种族罪是集体和个人的责任。

genocide.en: At SOME events on his book tour, black men have accused Ralph Richard Banks of advocating genocide.
genocide.zh: 针对拉菲·理查德·班克斯书中的某些内容，黑人男性指责他是在提倡人种灭绝。

genocide.en: Whether it will pass the mathematical scrutiny which showed that classical group selection needs genocide remains to be seen.
genocide.zh: 这种说法是不是经得住数学的考验(数学研究显示经典群体选择需要群族灭绝)，仍有待观察。

catastrophic.en: The water shortage in this country is potentially catastrophic.
catastrophic.zh: 该国水资源的匮乏很可能是灾难性的。

catastrophic.en: The minister gave a warning that if war broke out, it would be catastrophic.
catastrophic.zh: 大臣警告说战争一旦爆发，将会是灾难性的。

catastrophic.en: A tidal wave caused by the earthquake hit the coast causing catastrophic damage.
catastrophic.zh: 地震引发的海啸袭击了海岸，造成了灾难性的损失。

novice.en: I'm a novice at these things, Lieutenant. You're the professional.
novice.zh: 在这些事情上我是一名新手，中尉。你是行家。

novice.en: How about attracting new people to perennial gardening and developing novice gardeners into avid gardeners?
novice.zh: 吸引新的人们种植多年生植物，把园艺初学者发展成园艺爱好者怎么样？

compliment.en: Don't be upset—I'm sure she meant it as a compliment.
compliment.zh: 别烦恼—我肯定她的原意是要称赞你的。

compliment.en: Saying she's improved comes over as a backhanded compliment.
compliment.zh: 说她进步了是一种挖苦的恭维话。

compliment.en: 'You were both wonderful!' 'So were you!' we said, returning the compliment.
compliment.zh: “你们俩太棒了！”“你也一样啊！”我们也称赞道。

blueprint.en: The report is being heralded as a blueprint for the future of transport.
blueprint.zh: 这份报告被宣称是未来运输的蓝图。

blueprint.en: The president will offer delegates his blueprint for the country's future.
blueprint.zh: 总统将向代表们提出他的国家未来蓝图。

blueprint.en: There is a slight inaccuracy in this blueprint.

pedestrian.zh: 我走过了那座狭窄的步行桥。

pedestrian.en: A pedestrian bridge now connects the parking garage with the mall.
pedestrian.zh: 现在一座人行桥连通车库和购物中心。

nude.en: She refuses to be photographed in the nude.
I don't accept that it's merely a nude.

residue.en: The residue of the estate was divided equally among his children.
residue.zh: 剩余遗产被他的孩子平分了。

residue.en: Always using the same shampoo means that a residue can build up on the hair.
residue.zh: 总是用同一种洗发水意味着残留物会在头发上越积越多。

residue.en: This incineration generated a large quantity of residue ash.
residue.zh: 这次焚烧产生了大量的残灰。

agony.zh: 他极度痛苦地瘫倒在地。

agony.en: He fell awkwardly and went down in agony clutching his right knee.
agony.zh: 他笨拙地摔倒了，紧抓住右膝盖痛苦地蹲了下去。

shorten.zh: 受伤的问题有可能缩短他的职业生涯。

shorten.en: In November the temperatures drop and the days shorten.
shorten.zh: 十一月气温下降，白天变短。

accustom.en: She tried to accustom herself to the tight bandages.
accustom.zh: 她尝试着使自己习惯那些紧绷的绷带。

accustom.en: It took him a while to accustom himself to the idea.
accustom.zh: 他过了一段时间才习惯这个想法。

accustom.en: When one has been in a family circle one cannot accustom oneself to this life!
accustom.zh: 当一个人已经在家庭圈子里，他无法习惯于这种生活！

applicable.en: What is a reasonable standard for one family is not applicable for another.
applicable.zh: 对一个家庭合理的标准对于另一个家庭并不适用。

applicable.en: Another shortcoming is that it is not applicable to certain very muscular people such as athletes and bodybuilders, who can also have artificially high BMIs.
applicable.zh: 另一个缺点是它不适用于一些像运动员和健美运动员这样的肌肉发达的人，他们也可以有人为造成的身体质量指数偏高的情况。

applicable.en: Examining the period 1870-1920, Keyssar concentrates on Massachusetts, where the historical materials are particularly rich, and the findings applicable to other industrial areas.
applicable.zh: Keyssar 考察了1870-1920年这段时期，重点研究了马萨诸塞州，那里的历史资料特别丰富，研究结果也适用于其他工业区。

empathy.en: He advised him not to get too excited by her effusions of empathy and respect.
empathy.zh: 他建议他不要因为她同情心和敬重感的迸发而过于激动。
今天，我们需要的是同理心，而不是灵感。

empathy.en: The test is considered a measure of empathy.
empathy.zh: 这个测试被认为是一种同理心的测量。

deteriorate.en: There are fears that the situation might deteriorate into full-scale war.
deteriorate.zh: 人们担心局势会恶化为全面战争。

deteriorate.en: Food is apt to deteriorate in summer.
The chemicals on shoes can deteriorate air quality.
deteriorate.zh: 鞋子上的化学物质会恶化空气质量。

collide.zh: 他们经常在政策决策上发生冲突。

collide.en: When they collide, they destroy each other.
collide.zh: 所以当它们碰撞时，它们会互相毁灭。

collide.en: Basically, a subduction zone is where two tectonic plates collide.
collide.zh: 基本上，俯冲带就是两个地壳构造板块碰撞的地方。

reap.en: Machines that reap and thresh in one operation.
reap.zh: 同时完成收割和脱粒的机器。

reap.en: You'll soon begin to reap the benefits of being fitter.
reap.zh: 你很快就会获得身体更健康带来的好处。

reap.en: The company is just starting to reap the rewards of long-term investments.
reap.zh: 这家公司正开始收获长期投资的回报。

feasible.en: She questioned whether it was feasible to stimulate investment in these regions.
feasible.zh: 她质问在这些地区刺激投资是否可行。
这一设想的可行性如何？

mastery.en: He doesn't have mastery of the basic rules of grammar.
mastery.zh: 他没有掌握基本的语法规则。

mastery.en: Later, I developed a broader theory of what separates the two general classes of learners helpless versus mastery oriented.
mastery.zh: 后来，我发展了一个更广泛的理论来区分无助型学习者和掌握型学习者。

arrogant.zh: 那听起来很傲慢，不是吗？

arrogant.en: She was said to be proud and arrogant.
I thought he was conceited and arrogant.
arrogant.zh: 我认为他自高自大而且傲慢。

preventive.en: We must take preventive measures to reduce crime in the area.
preventive.zh: 我们必须采取预防措施来减少这个地区的犯罪。

preventive.en: The police were able to take preventive action and avoid a possible riot.
preventive.zh: 警方及时采取防范措施，避免了可能发生的骚乱。

preventive.en: Too much is spent on curative medicine and too little on preventive medicine.
preventive.zh: 在治疗医学上花费太多，而在预防医学上花费太少。

dubious.en: They indulged in some highly dubious business practices to obtain their current position in the market.
dubious.zh: 他们采取了一些极为可疑的商业手段以取得目前在市场上的地位。

dubious.en: The idea was to stop such accounts being used for dubious purposes.
dubious.zh: 其想法是防止这些账户被用于可疑的目的。

dubious.en: Scant attention has been paid to many of the dubious social and economic assumptions that underlie the plan.
dubious.zh: 人们对该计划背后的许多可疑的社会和经济假设缺乏关注。

oneself.en: One has to ask oneself what the purpose of the exercise is.
oneself.zh: 大家必须问一问自己，这个锻炼的目的是什么。

oneself.en: It is difficult to make oneself concentrate for long periods.
oneself.zh: 让自己长时间聚精会神是很困难的。

facade.en: In the evening the facade is floodlit.
facade.zh: 晚上，建筑物的正面是用泛光灯照明的。

facade.en: The elaborate facade contrasts strongly with the severity of the interior.
facade.zh: 精致的门面同室内的简朴形成强烈反差。

facade.en: The cathedral was eventually completed in 1490, though the Gothic facade remains unfinished.
facade.zh: 大教堂在1490年终于完工，虽然哥特式的正面仍未建好。

bypass.zh: 他在心脏搭桥手术中活了下来。

bypass.en: Traffic in the town has dropped off since the bypass opened.
bypass.zh: 这条旁道通车后，城里来往的车辆就减少了。

bypass.en: I was elated that my recent second bypass had been successful.
bypass.zh: 令我高兴不已的是我最近的第二次搭桥手术成功了。

playwright.en: His career as a playwright had an auspicious start.
playwright.zh: 他的剧作家生涯有一个好的开头。

playwright.en: Worst of all, for a playwright specializing in characters who use the vernacular, he has a tin ear for dialogue.
playwright.zh: 最糟的是，作为一个专门刻画使用方言人物的剧作家，他在对话方面没有鉴赏力。

playwright.en: A medieval manuscript called L contains all eighteen extant tragedies by the Greek playwright Euripides.
playwright.zh: 一份名为 L 的中世纪手稿包含了希腊剧作家欧里庇得斯所有现存的十八部悲剧。

binoculars.en: I saw it as a dim fuzz through the binoculars.
binoculars.zh: 我从双筒望远镜看只见一团模模糊糊的东西。

binoculars.en: He watched the motorcycle race through his binoculars.
binoculars.zh: 他用双筒望远镜看摩托车比赛。

binoculars.en: There were maybe 60,000 sandhills just within the sweep of my binoculars.
binoculars.zh: 仅在我的双筒望远镜扫过的范围内，就有大概60000只沙丘鹤。

underlie.en: These ideas underlie much of his work.

alarming.zh: 这种疾病已经以惊人的速度传播开来。

alarming.en: The rainforests are disappearing at an alarming rate.
alarming.zh: 雨林正以惊人的速度消失。

alarming.en: The number of reported crimes is increasing at an alarming rate.
alarming.zh: 报警案件的数量正在以惊人的速度增长。

solicit.en: Like women, Burke thought, and from a similar greatness and delicacy in their nature, the aristocracy were understood at once to require deference and to solicit compassion.
solicit.zh: 伯克想，和女人一样，贵族们由于本性也同样伟大和细腻，立刻被理解为需要尊重和乞求同情。

solicit.en: They were planning to solicit funds from a number of organizations.
solicit.zh: 他们正计划向一些机构募集资金。

ache.en: My head had begun to ache and my stomach felt funny.
ache.zh: 我的头开始疼了，我的胃也感到不对劲。

ache.en: The pain, usually a dull ache, gets worse with exercise.
ache.zh: 这种疼痛，通常是隐隐作痛，运动时会加剧。

nasal.zh: 她的声音是带鼻音和有穿透性的。

nasal.en: He started to speak in a nasal sing-song voice.
nasal.zh: 他开始用一种带鼻音、抑扬顿挫的声调讲话。

nasal.en: The nasal spray was new on the market and highly efficacious.
nasal.zh: 这种鼻腔喷雾剂是市场新品，非常有效。

outing.en: We can't go without you for this outing.
On the outing, she was offered a candy bar.
outing.zh: 郊游时，有人给了她一块糖果。

outing.en: If I had time, I would certainly go for an outing with you.
outing.zh: 要是我有空的话，我肯定会和你一起去郊游。

tentative.en: We made a tentative arrangement to meet on Friday.
I'm taking the first tentative steps towards fitness.
tentative.zh: 我试探性地开始实施健身计划。

tentative.en: In one fell swoop the bank wiped away the tentative benefits of this policy.
tentative.zh: 银行一下子就抹去了该政策带来的初步好处。

stagger.en: There were so many runners that they had to stagger the start.
stagger.zh: 参加赛跑的选手很多，他们不得不把起跑的时间错开。

stagger.en: I managed to stagger the last few steps.
stagger.zh: 我好不容易跌跌撞撞走了这最后几步。

stagger.en: We seem to stagger from one crisis to the next.
stagger.zh: 我们仿佛在接连不断的危机中举步维艰。

parcel.en: The parcel came in this morning's post.
parcel.zh: 这个包裹是今天上午邮送来的。

parcel.en: There's a parcel and some letters for you.
parcel.zh: 有你的一个包裹和几封信。

parcel.en: I managed secretly to undo a corner of the parcel.
parcel.zh: 我设法偷偷地打开包裹的一角。

spicy.en: The spicy flavours in these dishes call for reds rather than whites.
spicy.zh: 这些菜肴味道辛辣，宜配红葡萄酒而不是白葡萄酒。

intercourse.en: There was social intercourse between the old and the young.
intercourse.zh: 老年人和年轻人之间有社会交往。

intercourse.en: As mentioned above, if your respect proves to be effective, people will show their respect for you, too, and it will benefit your social intercourse.
intercourse.zh: 如上所述，如果您的尊重被证明是有效的，那么人们也会对您表示尊重，这将有益于您的社交。

intercourse.en: But the women looked out from the heated, blind intercourse of farm-life, to the spoken world beyond.
intercourse.zh: 但女性从热烘烘的、闭眼运转的乡土生活中抬起了头，望向那喧嚣的世界。

wicked.en: Jane has a wicked sense of humour.
wicked.zh: 简有一种恶作剧的幽默感。

wicked.en: The judge liked using the word "wicked" of people he had sent to jail.
wicked.zh: 那位法官喜欢用“邪恶的”这个词来形容他判决入狱的人。

uprising.en: The late president Ferdinand Marcos was overthrown by a popular uprising in 1986.
uprising.zh: 已故总统费迪南德·马科斯于1986年被民众起义所推翻。

uprising.en: It is true that the publicly acknowledged leaders of an uprising frequently write memoirs.
uprising.zh: 确实，那些公开承认的起义领导人经常写回忆录。

uprising.en: Even worries about uprising gas prices and future fuel availability subsided in the eighties almost as quickly as they had emerged.
uprising.zh: 即使是对汽油油价上涨和未来燃料供应的担忧，在80年代也几乎以同样快的速度消失了。

ornament.en: Yes; then something better, something still grander, will surely follow, or wherefore should they thus ornament me?
ornament.zh: 是的；然后一定会有更好的，更美的事情到来，不然他们为什么要这样装饰我呢？

ornament.en: A nice scented sachet is not just an ornament, but more of something that contains cultural and historical richness.
ornament.zh: 一个漂亮的香囊不仅是装饰品，还含有丰富的文化和历史内涵。

ornament.en: The building is an ornament to the city.
ornament.zh: 这座建筑物为整个城市增色不少。

endurance.en: He showed remarkable endurance throughout his illness.
endurance.zh: 他在整个生病期间表现出非凡的忍耐力。

endurance.en: The exercise obviously will improve strength and endurance.
endurance.zh: 这项练习将明显增强力量和耐力。

endurance.en: He used to astound his friends with feats of physical endurance.
endurance.zh: 他过去常以身体耐力之好令其朋友们震惊。

constrain.zh: 父母不应完全限制儿童观看节目。

constrain.en: Reduced operation of the machinery should limit their production and thereby constrain the damage.
constrain.zh: 要减少机器的操作，就应该限制它们的生产，从而降低损害。

constrain.en: Sometimes environments constrain those people and sometimes environments give those people opportunity.
constrain.zh: 有时环境会限制这些人，而有时环境会给这些人机会。

pinch.en: She had to pinch herself to make sure she was not dreaming.
pinch.zh: 她不得不掐一下自己，弄清楚自己不是在做梦。

orderly.en: It's a beautiful, clean and orderly city.
orderly.zh: 这是一座美丽、干净、整齐的城市。

orderly.en: For most of his life, he was a hospital orderly.
orderly.zh: 他做了大半辈子的医院护理员。

orderly.en: President Obama has said that he had discussed his administration's desire for an orderly change to a more open government in Egypt.
orderly.zh: 奥巴马总统说他已经与他的管理班子讨论过希望埃及政府能做出有秩序的调整，变得更加开放。

surf.en: I'm going to buy a surfboard and learn to surf.
surf.zh: 我要去买个冲浪板来学冲浪。

surf.en: No one knows how many people currently surf the Net.
surf.zh: 没人知道现在有多少人在网上冲浪。

nationality.zh: 问到他的国籍，他说是美国人。

nationality.en: All applicants will be considered regardless of age, sex, religion or nationality.
nationality.zh: 所有申请者，不论其年龄、性别、宗教信仰及国籍，都可考虑。

nationality.en: "For us", he said, "every man and woman of French nationality is French."
nationality.zh: “对我们来说，”他说，“每一个法国国籍的男人和女人都是法国人。”

culinary.en: On a cold winter's day, few culinary pleasures can match it.
culinary.zh: 在寒冷的冬日，鲜有烹饪乐事能与它媲美。

culinary.en: The ultimate goal of the show is to help spread China's culinary culture to people overseas.
culinary.zh: 该节目的最终目标就是向海外人士传播中国的烹饪文化。

culinary.en: In 1816, Carême began a culinary journey which would forever mark his place as history's first top chef.
culinary.zh: 1816年，卡勒姆开始了他的烹饪之旅，且作为有史以来的第一位顶级大厨，在历史上留下了恒久的印记。

flake.en: Oiled wood is water-resistant and won't flake.
flake.zh: 上过油的木头防水而且不会剥落。

flake.en: The flat cut on the antelope's chin shows that its tongue was cut by a very sharp flake.
flake.zh: 羚羊下巴上面平整的切痕，显示它的舌头是被非常锋利的片状器具切割的。

flake.en: Others turned their attention to a proposal by representative Jeff Flake to cut $18 million from the defense budget.
flake.zh: 其他人将注意力转向代表人 Jeff Flake ，他提议要将国防预算削减1800万美元。

alcoholic.en: Alcoholic beverages are served in the hotel lounge.
alcoholic.zh: 宾馆的休息室供应酒类饮料。

alcoholic.en: The serving of alcoholic drinks was forbidden after six o'clock.
alcoholic.zh: 在6点以后供应酒精饮料是被禁止的。

alcoholic.en: Novello says college students will spend $4.2 billion yearly on alcoholic beverages.
alcoholic.zh: 诺韦洛说大学生每年会在各种酒精饮料上花费42亿美元。

appraisal.en: She was honest in her appraisal of her team's chances.
appraisal.zh: 她对自己队获胜机会的估计是诚实的。

appraisal.en: It may also be necessary to get a new appraisal of the property.
appraisal.zh: 可能还需要对该房产做个新的估价。

appraisal.en: What is needed in such cases is a calm appraisal of the situation.
appraisal.zh: 在此类情况下需要的是对形势的冷静估计。

explorer.en: The default setting on Windows Explorer will not show these files.
explorer.zh: 视窗浏览器上的默认系统设定不显示这些文档。

explorer.en: Captain Cook was an explorer of the Pacific Ocean.
explorer.zh: 库克船长是太平洋的探险家。

explorer.en: Just then, a third man arrived: Japanese explorer Nobu Shirase.
explorer.zh: 正在这时，第三个人来了：日本探险家 Nobu Shirase。

saga.zh: 这个传奇故事仍在上演。

saga.en: Juan sat quietly through the telling of this saga.
saga.zh: 胡安安静地坐着听完了这个长篇故事。

saga.en: The front page is devoted to the continuing saga of the hijack.
saga.zh: 头版是对劫持事件的连续报道。

offshore.en: One day a larger ship anchored offshore.
offshore.zh: 一天，一艘更大的船在近海抛锚。

offshore.en: The island offers a wide range of offshore banking facilities.
offshore.zh: 这座岛提供广泛的海外银行业务。

offshore.en: A powerful offshore quake could cause a large tsunami that would reach the shore within minutes.
offshore.zh: 一场强烈的近海地震可能引发一场巨大的海啸，并且在几分钟内就可以到达海岸。

superiority.en: He had a well-developed sense of his own superiority.
The technical superiority of laser discs over tape is well established.
superiority.zh: 光盘相对磁带在技术上的优越性是确定无疑的。

asylum.en: Only genuine refugees can apply for asylum.
asylum.zh: 只有真正的难民才能申请政治避难。

asylum.en: France has agreed to grant him political asylum.
asylum.zh: 法国已经同意给予他政治庇护。

biodiversity.en: Biodiversity was the buzzword of the Rio Earth Summit.
biodiversity.zh: 生物多样性是里约地球峰会上的时髦用语。

biodiversity.en: Industry representatives made it clear that their commitment was only to maintain the extent of forests, not their biodiversity.
biodiversity.zh: 业界代表们申明他们只承诺维持森林的规模而不是其生物多样性。

biodiversity.en: Biodiversity ensures a resource for new food crops and medicines.
biodiversity.zh: 生物多样性确保了新的粮食作物和药物的来源。

cubic.en: Jupiter's moon Io, whose density is 3.5 grams per cubic centimetre, is all rock.
cubic.zh: 木星的卫星木卫一全是岩石，其密度为每立方厘米3.5克。

cubic.en: A seed only needs one cubic centimeter of soil to grow.
cubic.zh: 一颗种子只需要一立方厘米的土壤就能生长。

cubic.en: New estimates of the water reserves go up to 2,700 billion cubic meters of fresh water.
cubic.zh: 据最新估计，淡水储量将达到2.7万亿立方米。

exemplify.en: These are not qualities we now exemplify.
exemplify.zh: 而我们现在倒没有了这些品质。

exemplify.en: The plays of Wilds exemplify the comedy of manners.
exemplify.zh: 王尔德的戏剧是风尚喜剧的典范。

exemplify.en: These three pictures exemplify different sorts of evil.
exemplify.zh: 这三张图展示了不同种类的恶。

adulthood.en: Is there a cut-off point between childhood and adulthood?
adulthood.zh: 童年与成年之间有分界线吗？

adulthood.en: Few people nowadays are able to maintain friendships into adulthood.
adulthood.zh: 现今很少有人能够把友谊维持到成年。

adulthood.en: Parents want to know the best way to nurture and raise their child to adulthood.
adulthood.zh: 父母们想了解把他们的孩子养育成人的最好方法。

pedal.en: The brake pedal had just snapped off.
pedal.zh: 制动踏板刚才突然断裂了。

pedal.en: The pedal had sheared off at the pivot.
pedal.zh: 这个踏板已经在轴处断裂。

pedal.en: She pressed her foot down sharply on the brake pedal.

gigantic.en: The gigantic natural harbour is a haven for boats.
gigantic.zh: 这个巨大的天然港是船舶的避风港。

gigantic.en: The monument consists of a circle of gigantic stones.
gigantic.zh: 该纪念碑由一圈巨大的石碑组成。

gigantic.en: In Red Rock Valley the road is bordered by gigantic rocks.
gigantic.zh: 在红岩谷，道路两边都是巨大的岩石。

incapable.en: The children seem to be totally incapable of working by themselves.
incapable.zh: 孩子们好像完全不能独自做事。

incapable.en: If people keep telling you you're incapable, you begin to lose confidence in yourself.
incapable.zh: 如果人们不断地对你说你无能，你就开始失去自信了。

scrutinize.en: She leaned forward to scrutinize their faces.
scrutinize.zh: 她探身向前，端详他们的面容。

scrutinize.en: Her purpose was to scrutinize his features to see if he was an honest man.
scrutinize.zh: 她的目的是仔细察看他的特征看他是不是个诚实的人。

scrutinize.en: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure, executives who don't get the nod also may wish to move on.
scrutinize.zh: 由于董事会迫于股东们的压力而严格审查公司的接任方案，那些未获得许可的高管们也可能会想辞职。

repertoire.en: His repertoire encompassed everything from Bach to Schoenberg.
repertoire.zh: 他的表演曲目从巴赫到勋伯格，样样俱全。

repertoire.en: Meredith D'Ambrosio has thousands of songs in her repertoire.
repertoire.zh: 梅雷迪思•丹布罗西奥的全部曲目达到几千首。

repertoire.en: Merely expanding the orchestra's repertoire will not be enough.
repertoire.zh: 仅仅扩大乐团的演奏曲目是不够的。

rehearse.en: We were given only two weeks to rehearse.
rehearse.zh: 只给了我们两个星期排练。

rehearse.en: They see the result they want clearly and rehearse it over and over again.
rehearse.zh: 他们清楚地看到自己想要的结果，然后一遍又一遍地预演。

rehearse.en: Create a "character"—an unshy version of yourself—and rehearse your own scenes.
rehearse.zh: 创造一个“角色”——一个不害羞的你——并排练你自己的场景。

shuffle.en: You have to shuffle the cards before the cut for the deal.
shuffle.zh: 你得先洗牌，然后再倒牌和发牌。

shuffle.en: If you shuffle that deck enough times, the orders will have to repeat.
shuffle.zh: 如果你洗牌的次数足够多，顺序就会重复。

shuffle.en: Purists say that a further drop in house prices would merely shuffle wealth around.
shuffle.zh: 纯粹主义者说房价的进一步下跌只会围绕财富重新洗牌。

psyche.zh: 他所描绘的精神是多中心的。

psyche.en: She spent her life plumbing the mysteries of the human psyche.
psyche.zh: 她毕生探索人类心灵的奥秘。

psyche.en: His exploration of the myth brings insight into the American psyche.
psyche.zh: 他对那个神话的探索揭示了美国人的心理。

loft.en: There's a lot of storage space in the loft.
loft.zh: 阁楼上有很大的存贮空间。

loft.en: He lives in a loft that backs onto Friedman's Bar.
loft.zh: 他住在一间背朝弗里德曼酒吧的阁楼里。

loft.en: A loft conversion can add considerably to the value of a house.
loft.zh: 阁楼改建能大大增加房屋价值。

uranium.en: Uranium is used to fuel nuclear plants.
Like I said before, Uranium-Lead Dating has been with us for a while.
uranium.zh: 就像我之前说到的，铀铅年代测定法已经存在一段时间了。

marvel.en: The operation was a marvel of the medical skill.
marvel.zh: 这次手术是医术上的一个奇迹。

marvel.en: Two million tourists come annually to view the Huaxi marvel.
marvel.zh: 每年有200万游客来参观华西奇迹。

lizard.en: Confident in its camouflage, being the same colour as the rocks, the lizard stands still when it feels danger.
lizard.zh: 蜥蜴对自己和石头颜色相同的保护色很自信，即便感觉危险也不动。

lizard.en: Neither the lizard nor the glass has any secrets.
lizard.zh: 无论是蜥蜴还是玻璃，都没有任何秘密。

lizard.en: The children decided to watch the lizard.

tailor.en: I was promoted to overseer at the tailor shop.
tailor.zh: 我被提拔为这家裁缝铺的工头。

tailor.en: He was wearing a suit that looked tailor-made.
tailor.zh: 他穿着一套似乎是量身定做的西装。

ceramic.en: We'll now look at another ceramic which is made from mixing sand with minerals and heating to over 600 degrees Celsius.
ceramic.zh: 现在我们来看看另一种陶瓷，它是由沙子和矿物质混合，再加热到600多摄氏度制成的。

ceramic.en: Taihu region is one of the Chinese ceramics bases, of which the world-famous Yixing clay teapot is produced by Yixing's ceramic manufacturers.
ceramic.zh: 太湖地区是中国陶瓷生产基地之一，举世闻名的宜兴陶土茶壶就是由宜兴的陶瓷生产厂家生产的。

ceramic.en: Well over half of those ships were carrying cargo stored in large ceramic jars, many of which were preserved largely intact on the ocean floor.
ceramic.zh: 这些船只中有一半以上装载着储存在大型陶瓷罐子里的货物，其中许多罐子被完好无损地保存在海底。

gem.en: Wisdom without morality is like a ring without a gem.
gem.zh: 没有道德的智慧就像没有宝石的戒指。

gem.en: There is an object relational mapper out there that is a hidden gem.
gem.zh: 那里有一个对象关系映射程序，它是一块隐藏的宝石。

gem.en: It's not as popular as Central Park. But I feel like it's kind of a hidden gem.
gem.zh: 它不像中央公园那么受欢迎。但我觉得它就像一块隐藏的宝石。

compassionate.zh: 她有一张智慧和同情的脸。

compassionate.en: One could tell at a glance that she was a compassionate person.
compassionate.zh: 一眼就能看出她是一个富有同情心的人。

compassionate.en: These charities depend on the compassionate feelings and generosity of the general public.
compassionate.zh: 这些慈善机构依赖于公众的同情和慷慨。

convene.en: The UN had the foresight to convene a "world assembly on ageing" back in 1982, but that came and went.
convene.zh: 联合国早在1982年就有远见地召开了“老龄化问题世界大会”，但后来还是不了了之。

convene.en: The committee will convene at 11.30 next Thursday.
convene.zh: 委员会将在下星期四上午11:30开会。

convene.en: We'd convene probably at least every week.
convene.zh: 可能会每个星期召集他们一次。

wrinkle.en: Ben brushed smooth a wrinkle in his trousers.
wrinkle.zh: 本把他裤子上的一个皱褶刷平了。

wrinkle.en: The skin on her cheeks and around her eyes was beginning to wrinkle.
wrinkle.zh: 她脸颊上和眼睛周围的皮肤开始起皱纹了。

wrinkle.en: Ava had a wrinkle formed on her nose.
wrinkle.zh: 艾娃的鼻子上长了一条皱纹。

psychic.zh: 我相信每个人都天生具有超自然能力。

psychic.en: He declared his total disbelief in psychic phenomena.
psychic.zh: 他宣称他完全不相信通灵现象。

psychic.en: Hanging onto dead stuff has a higher psychic cost than most of us realize.
psychic.zh: 抓住死去的东西不放会比我们所能意识到的耗费更高的精神代价。

aspire.en: Nor do they aspire to such command themselves.
aspire.zh: 他们自己也不渴望这样的命令。

aspire.en: Mary is ambitious enough to aspire to conversational fluency in Chinese in four months.
aspire.zh: 玛丽雄心很大， 竟立志在四个月里学会用汉语流利地会话。

aspire.en: Men aspire to be able to show off their six packs or their V-shape backs and there's a growing market of slimming pills aimed at men too.
aspire.zh: 男性渴望展示自己的六块腹肌或 V 型后背，针对男性的减肥药市场也在不断增长。

comprehension.zh: 这完全超出了她的理解力。

comprehension.en: Is this test a good measure of reading comprehension?
comprehension.zh: 这种测试是判断阅读理解力的好方法吗？

comprehension.en: Your reading speed and comprehension are tested during this exercise.
comprehension.zh: 你的阅读速度和理解能力将在这个练习中得到测试。

pardon.en: Pardon my asking, but is that your husband?
pardon.zh: 请原谅我多问，那位是您的先生吗？

specification.en: The office was furnished to a high specification.
specification.zh: 办公室是按高规格装潢的。

specification.en: They struggled to limit the cost by enforcing a low-tech specification.

specification.zh: 当所有这些都被收集之后，就可以制定一个培训规范了。

pier.zh: 这个码头是木结构建筑。

bluff.en: He said he would resign if he didn't get more money, but it was only a bluff.
bluff.zh: 他说如果不给他加薪他就辞职，但那不过是虚张声势而已。

slick.en: They are also covered with a slick, transparent lid that reduces drag.
slick.zh: 它们还覆盖着一层光滑、透明的盖子，可以减少阻力。

slick.zh: 船尾呈略微弯曲的线条，浮油的柔和色调突显了这种感觉。

nickel.en: Iron and some nickel, both of which are metals.
nickel.zh: 铁和一些镍，它们俩都是金属。

nickel.en: Among all commodities, nickel and copper are under particular stress.
nickel.zh: 在所有大宗商品中，镍和铜尤其承压。

nickel.en: The same phenomenon seems to be happening with aluminum, lead, and nickel.
nickel.zh: 相同的现象估计也会发生在铝、铅和镍的身上。

geometry.en: The doctor doesn't know how to teach me geometry.
geometry.zh: 这个教授不知道如何教我几何学。

geometry.en: They can also learn geometry by assembling a bicycle.
geometry.zh: 他们还可以通过组装自行车来学习几何。

geometry.zh: 然而，游戏的几何结构是理解它的必要条件。

ideally.en: Ideally, she would love to become pregnant again.
ideally.zh: 按理想来说，她想要再次怀孕。

ideally.en: Ideally, I'd like to live in New York, but that's not possible.
ideally.zh: 按理想来说，我希望住在纽约，但那是不可能的。

ideally.en: People should, ideally, be persuaded to eat a diet with much less fat or oil.
ideally.zh: 理想的做法是应该说服人们吃更低脂肪或更低油脂的食品。

broccoli.zh: 黄瓜和西兰花是绿色的。

knob.en: He twiddled a knob on the dashboard.
knob.zh: 他转动着这块仪表板上的一个旋钮。

knob.en: The knob is only held on by sticky tape.
knob.zh: 这个旋钮只是用胶带粘住的。

breach.en: They escaped through a breach in the wire fence.
breach.zh: 他们从铁丝网上的一个缺口逃走了。

breach.en: The congressman was accused of a breach of secrecy rules.
breach.zh: 这个国会议员被指控违反保密条例。

ineffective.en: Furthermore, they claim that any such interference is completely ineffective.
ineffective.zh: 此外，他们声称任何此类干涉都是完全无效的。

ineffective.en: They prove ineffective in helping mental patients.
ineffective.zh: 事实证明，它们对于帮助精神病患方面是无效的。

tablet.en: Don't chew, break, or crush the tablet.
tablet.zh: 不要咀嚼、咬破或压碎药片。

tablet.en: One in five Americans will use a tablet or smartphone.
tablet.zh: 五分之一的美国人将使用平板电脑或智能手机。

glacier.en: A liquid layer forms at the base of the glacier.
glacier.zh: 在冰川的底部形成了一层液体。

glacier.en: Friction between the glacier and bedrock is reduced.
glacier.zh: 冰川和基岩之间的摩擦减少了。

glacier.en: The first type of glacier flow is called: basal slip.
glacier.zh: 第一种冰川流动被称为：基底滑动。

cardboard.zh: 我做了一个和原物一样大小的硬纸板模型。
硬纸板是会自然分解的。

cardboard.zh: 他把手伸进他旁边的纸板箱。

polling.zh: 从早上8点以来投票很踊跃。

polling.en: He walked to the local polling place to cast his vote.
polling.zh: 他走到当地的投票点去投票。

polling.en: There has been a busy start to polling in today's local elections.
polling.zh: 今天地方选举开始时投票就非常踊跃。

yoga.en: I always do yoga on a Monday.
yoga.zh: 我总是在星期一做瑜伽。

yoga.en: She found peace through yoga and meditation.
yoga.zh: 她通过瑜伽和冥想找到了宁静。

akin.en: What he felt was more akin to pity than love.
akin.zh: 他感受到的更像怜悯，而不是爱。

akin.en: This process is akin to piecing together a jigsaw puzzle.
akin.zh: 这过程类似于拼七巧板。

akin.en: Listening to his life story is akin to reading a good adventure novel.
akin.zh: 听他的生活故事就像读一部好的探险小说。

sediment.en: Many organisms that die in the sea are soon buried by sediment.
sediment.zh: 许多在海里死亡的生物很快便被沉淀物掩埋。

sediment.en: They found a unique layer of sediment worldwide.
sediment.zh: 他们在世界各地发现了一层独特的沉积物。

sediment.en: Sediment sorting and compaction influence permeability and porosity.
sediment.zh: 沉积物的分选和压实作用影响渗透率和孔隙度。

evaporate.en: Blasting cold air over it makes the water evaporate.
evaporate.zh: 向它上面快速喷冷气可使水蒸发掉。

evaporate.en: It is more difficult for gases to "evaporate" from them.
evaporate.zh: 气体更难从中“蒸发”出来。

evaporate.en: Some of the compounds in the oil evaporate reduce their impact on the environment.
evaporate.zh: 漏油中的一些化合物的蒸发能够降低它们对环境的影响。

succumb.en: A common defense of sport hunting is that it serves a vital wildlife-management function, without which countless animals would succumb to starvation and disease.
succumb.zh: 运动狩猎的一个常见辩护是，它提供了至关重要的野生动物管理功能，没有它，无数的动物将会死于饥饿和疾病。

succumb.en: And yet I succumb to watching it.
succumb.zh: 然而，我却需要看它，向它屈服。

succumb.en: Whatever you do, don't succumb to it.
succumb.zh: 无论你做什么，都不要屈服于它。

seasoned.en: There are seasoned professionals who can teach you and show you what to do.
seasoned.zh: 有经验丰富的专业人员可以教你，并向你示范做什么。

seasoned.en: It consisted of a soup of salted water, seasoned with pepper and rancid oil.
seasoned.zh: 那是一锅加了调味的胡椒和发臭的油的咸清水汤。

seasoned.en: This dish is usually served with roast beef and seasoned gravy as a traditional Sunday lunch.
seasoned.zh: 这道菜通常都和烤牛肉、调味肉汁一起，作为一道传统的周日午餐。

radioactive.en: Radioactive water had seeped into underground reservoirs.
radioactive.zh: 放射性水已渗入了地下蓄水池。

radioactive.en: The waste is safely locked away until it is no longer radioactive.
radioactive.zh: 废料被安全地封存，直到其不再有辐射。

radioactive.en: They were exposed to radioactive fallout during nuclear weapons tests.
radioactive.zh: 他们在核武器试验过程中暴露于放射性核辐射。

simulate.en: Computer software can be used to simulate conditions on the seabed.
simulate.zh: 计算机软件可用于模拟海底状况。

simulate.en: The scientist developed one model to simulate a full year of the globe's climate.
simulate.zh: 这位科学家研制出一个模型，能模拟全年地球的气候。

simulate.en: These light-emitting diodes could simulate red light.
simulate.zh: 这些发光二极管可以模拟红光。

stature.en: Mother was of very small stature, barely five feet tall.
stature.zh: 母亲身材娇小，仅有5英尺高。

stature.en: It's more than his physical stature that makes him remarkable.
stature.zh: 不单单是他的身高使他气宇非凡。
这支管弦乐队的声望有所提高。

forearm.zh: 我的前臂挡开了第一拳。

forearm.en: He presses the bolt against a small hexagon tattooed on his forearm. The sizes match.
forearm.zh: 他把螺栓压在他前臂的一个小六边形纹身上。大小匹配。

forearm.en: The forearm and torch of the Statue of Liberty were on display at the Centennial Exposition in Philadelphia, 1876.
forearm.zh: 1876年，自由女神像的前臂和火炬在费城百年博览会上展出。

volleyball.en: They had a volleyball court in the middle of the courtyard.
volleyball.zh: 他们在院子中央有一个排球场。

intrigue.en: He found himself snared in a web of intrigue.

intrigue.zh: 他们通过设谜为他们的谈话和讨论增加乐趣。

intrigue.en: The young heroine steps into a web of intrigue in the academic world.
intrigue.zh: 年轻的女主人公陷入了学术界钩心斗角的罗网。

graph.en: They made a bar graph to display the results.
graph.zh: 他们用条形图来显示结果。

graph.en: The graph shows how house prices have risen since the 1980s.
graph.zh: 此图表明了自20世纪80年代以来房价上涨的情况。

stellar.en: Now, this apparent contradiction between geologic evidence and the stellar evolution model became known as the faint young Sun paradox.
stellar.zh: 现在，地质证据和恒星演化模型之间这种明显的矛盾被称为“微弱年轻太阳悖论”。

stellar.en: The French companies are registering stellar profits.
stellar.zh: 法国各家公司都获利丰厚。

stellar.en: Ultraviolet radiation and violent stellar winds have blown out an enormous cavity in the gas and dust enveloping the cluster.
stellar.zh: 紫外线和猛烈的星际风，在气体以及包裹星群的灰尘上吹出了一个硕大的洞。

alignment.en: The church should have no political alignment.
alignment.zh: 教会不应该有政治结盟。

alignment.en: They shunned the belief that there is a link between the alignment of the planets and events on the Earth.
alignment.zh: 他们回避了在行星的排列和地球上发生的事件之间有联系的看法。

alignment.en: For horizontal alignment, this must be consistent with the message model.
alignment.zh: 为了取得水平对齐，这必须与消息模型一致。

coarse.en: She spoke in a quiet voice but used remarkably coarse expressions.
coarse.zh: 她说话声音很轻，但使用了非常粗俗的言辞。

coarse.en: He pulled out a long coarse cloth from under the shirts.
coarse.zh: 他从衬衫下面抽出一块很长的粗布。

incumbent.en: She felt it was incumbent on herself to act immediately.
incumbent.zh: 她感到立即采取行动是她义不容辞的责任。

incumbent.en: Incumbent officeholders are difficult to defeat at the polls.
incumbent.zh: 现任官员很难在选举中被击败。

incumbent.en: The tight race is almost a duplicate of the elections in Georgia and South Dakota last month that pitted a Republican challenger against a Democratic incumbent.
incumbent.zh: 这次紧张的竞选几乎是上个月在佐治亚州和南达科他州选举的翻版，由一个共和党的挑战者竞争一个现任的民主党人。

fetus.en: Pregnant women who are heavy drinkers risk damaging the unborn fetus.
fetus.zh: 酗酒的孕妇冒有伤害胎儿的危险。

fetus.en: At the end of the first trimester, the fetus is about three inches long.
fetus.zh: 在怀孕的第三个月末，胎儿差不多有三英寸长了。

fetus.zh: 用显微镜检查细胞染色体可以查出胎儿的性别。

catalyst.en: Many policy makers insist that consumer spending is a strong economic catalyst and, therefore, a paucity of retail stores is a contributing factor to low-performing economies.

catalyst.en: I see my role as being a catalyst for change.
catalyst.zh: 我认为我的角色是促成变革。

catalyst.zh: 我非常希望这件事终将成为促成变化的催化剂。

contour.en: An isogon is a contour line for a variable which measures direction.
contour.zh: 等角线是用于测量方向的变量的轮廓线。

doctoral.zh: 埃里克告诉我，直到他拿到博士学位后他们才会要孩子。

doctoral.zh: 但获得人文学科的博士学位通常需要9年时间。

doctoral.zh: 在所有英语专业的博士生中，多达一半的人在获得学位之前就辍学了，这不足为奇。

aviation.en: The man had genius and had made his mark in the aviation world.
aviation.zh: 那位男士拥有天赋，而且在航空界已经成名。

aviation.zh: 该民航部长命令所有飞机不得起飞。

aviation.zh: 令航空公司最头疼的问题是航空燃料价格的上涨。

hawk.zh: 一只鹰在小山的上空翱翔。

hawk.zh: 老鹰在半空中盘旋，准备俯冲。

hawk.en: Can you all watch me like a hawk a second?
hawk.zh: 你们能像老鹰一样看我一会儿吗？

imaginative.en: The show's a keeper–daring, imaginative and provocative.
imaginative.zh: 这部电影值得收藏–大胆、富于想像力和煽动性。

imaginative.zh: 你的方法必须更加灵活，更富有想象力。

mercury.zh: 该公司已经为了一项减少汞排放的计划调拨了数千美元。

mercury.en: Mercury could be tracked around the building or home.
mercury.zh: 水银可能会散布到建筑物或家中。

hopeless.zh: 你是个无可救药的浪漫主义者。

hopeless.en: His speeches were magnificently written but his delivery was hopeless.
hopeless.zh: 他的演讲辞写得很好，但他的演讲却不可救药。
她对人事管理一窍不通。

pathetic.en: The small group of onlookers presented a pathetic sight.
pathetic.zh: 那一小群旁观者显出一幅可怜的样子。

pathetic.en: Tom was touched with this pathetic distress.
pathetic.zh: 汤姆被这种可怜的苦恼感动了。

pathetic.en: He was beginning to feel pathetic and sorry for himself—not for anyone else.
pathetic.zh: 科林开始为自己感到悲哀和难过——而不是为别人。

fasten.zh: 没有如何把背带系在箱子上的说明。

fasten.zh: 泰德六岁时，我们决定让他知道怎样系和解他的安全带。

gulf.zh: 地震以苏尔特湾为中心。

gulf.zh: 这片低洼的沼泽地沿海湾方向延伸数英里。

decay.zh: 存在都市衰败和黑帮暴力问题。

decay.en: When not removed, plaque causes tooth decay and gum disease.
decay.zh: 牙斑没有清除就会导致蛀牙和牙龈疾病。

decay.zh: 房东不管，房子已经破烂不堪。

hen.en: The hen may not be able to feed its young.
hen.zh: 这只母鸡也许不能喂它的幼雏。

hen.zh: 这可以使这一对正常交配同时也阻止雌禽待在窝里。
小鸡聚集在母鸡翅膀下面。

resonance.en: The ideas of order, security, family, religion and country had the same resonance for them as for Michael.
resonance.zh: 秩序、安全、家庭、宗教和国家这些概念在他们心里产生了和迈克尔一样的共鸣。

resonance.zh: 利用 3D 磁共振成像技术对脑结构进行了研究。

resonance.zh: 她的声音洪亮，有一种奇特的震撼人心的效果。

conserve.en: People should insulate their homes to conserve energy.
conserve.zh: 人们应该使住房隔冷以保存能量。

conserve.en: We should conserve oil and gas by making full use of other energy sources.
conserve.zh: 我们应该通过充分利用其他能源节约石油和天然气。

conserve.en: Whales carefully conserve their oxygen when underwater in a couple of ways.
conserve.zh: 鲸鱼在水下以几种方式小心地保存它们的氧气。

bowling.en: They go in for tennis and bowling.
bowling.zh: 他们爱好打网球和保龄球。
今天晚上我去打保龄球了。
明天一起去打保龄球吧。

wardrobe.en: Jeans are a staple part of everyone's wardrobe.
wardrobe.zh: 在每个人的衣橱里，牛仔裤是必不可少的。

wardrobe.zh: 楼上主卧室有一个可容纳一个人的大衣橱。

wardrobe.zh: 衣柜里挂着几套昂贵的衣服。

durable.zh: 这种耐久的高强度塑料盒在100英尺水深以内是防水的。

durable.zh: 精细骨瓷是非同一般地实用，因为它坚固耐用。

sift.zh: 取而代之的是，计算机将派出智能代理或软件信使，对成千上万的网站进行搜索，然后逻辑地筛选出相关的内容。

sift.zh: 我们将细查每一点证据。

bail.zh: 她交了500元保证金，获得保释。

novelty.zh: 那种新奇的情景激起了他的好奇心。

outset.zh: 一开始就要定下你的学习计划。

outset.zh: 我从不能理解为什么他不一开始就答应我们的请求。

outset.zh: 但在开始之前，让我先庆祝一下数据做得非常好的两件事。

cardiovascular.zh: 吸烟会严重增加罹患心血管和呼吸道疾病的风险。

cardiovascular.en: This is largely due to a lower risk of dying of cardiovascular disease among taller people.
cardiovascular.zh: 这主要是因为个子高的人死于心血管疾病的风险较低。

cardiovascular.en: Extreme high-performance sports may lead to optimal cardiovascular performance, but they quite certainly do not prolong life.
cardiovascular.zh: 极限高强度运动可能会带来最佳的心血管功能，但这些运动肯定无法延长寿命。

martial.en: All the men now face court martial.
martial.zh: 现在所有这些军人都面临军事法庭的审判。

martial.en: He was convicted at a court martial.
martial.zh: 他在军事法庭上被判有罪。

martial.en: He is due to face a court martial on drugs charges.
martial.zh: 他将因毒品指控面临军事法庭的审判。

repay.en: I'll repay the money I owe them next week.
repay.zh: 我将在下个星期偿还欠他们的钱。

repay.en: I can never repay your many kindnesses to me.
repay.zh: 我无法报答你对我无微不至的关怀。

repay.en: How can I ever repay you for your generosity?
repay.zh: 你对我这样慷慨，我怎么才能报答你呢？

irresponsible.en: It would be irresponsible to ignore the situation.
irresponsible.zh: 对这一状况不闻不问，那就是不负责任。

irresponsible.en: He regarded the young man as feckless and irresponsible.
irresponsible.zh: 他认为这个年轻人软弱而且不负责任。

irresponsible.en: Her casual dismissal of the threats seemed irresponsible.
irresponsible.zh: 她对这些威胁毫不在乎而不予理会，似乎很不负责任。

stimulation.en: Babies who sleep with their parents receive much more tactile stimulation than babies who sleep in a crib.
stimulation.zh: 和父母睡在一块儿的婴儿比单独睡在婴儿床上的婴儿得到更多的触觉刺激。

stimulation.en: The playgroup provides plenty of stimulation for the children.
stimulation.zh: 这个游戏小组为孩子们提供了大量的刺激。

stimulation.en: Eyes twitch randomly in response to stimulation from the brain stem.
stimulation.zh: 当脑干受到刺激时，眼睛会随机抽动。

chili.en: I only put in one tiny chili.
chili.zh: 我只放了一条小小的辣椒。

chili.en: Chili, pepper and shallot are usually necessaries in this division.
chili.zh: 红辣椒，胡椒粉和青葱通常是这一部分的必备品。

chili.en: Lunch is a ladle of chili with rice, cornbread, salad, and a slab of chocolate cake.
chili.zh: 午餐是拌有一勺干辣椒的米饭、玉米面包、沙拉和一块巧克力蛋糕。

subscribe.en: Which journals does the library subscribe to?
Maybe I ought to subscribe to the Engineering Quarterly.
subscribe.zh: 也许我应该订阅《工程季刊》。

subscribe.en: If you subscribe to this newspaper, you'll get an extra magazine.
subscribe.zh: 如果你订阅这份报纸，你会得到一本额外的杂志。

sprout.en: The seeds will sprout in a few days.
sprout.zh: 这些种子几天后就会发芽。

sprout.en: When the seedlings sprout, uncover the tray.
sprout.zh: 幼苗发芽后，揭开盘上的遮盖物。

sprout.en: If you want to try this, sprout the seeds.
sprout.zh: 要是你想试试这个，就让种子发芽。

spinal.en: This movement lengthens your spine and tones the spinal nerves.
spinal.zh: 该运动能伸展你的脊柱，强健脊髓神经。

spinal.en: Almost all sensory information from the trunk and limbs passes through the spinal cord.
spinal.zh: 几乎所有来自躯干及四肢的感官信息都经由脊髓传递。

spinal.en: Repairs to the nervous system will start with optic nerves and, in time, the spinal cord.
spinal.zh: 对神经系统的修复将从视神经开始，并适时地从脊髓开始。

eve.en: Richard had turned up on Christmas Eve with Tony.
eve.zh: 理查德在圣诞前夜与托尼一起出现。

eve.en: On New Year's Eve we had a barbecue on the beach.
eve.zh: 除夕那天我们在海滩上举行了烧烤野餐。

eve.en: On New Year's Eve I usually give a party, which is always chaotic.
eve.zh: 除夕日，我通常举办一个聚会，总是一片狼藉。

heighten.en: I think what screen dance will do, though, is heighten awareness of dance in general.
heighten.zh: 我认为荧屏舞蹈会在总体上提高人们对舞蹈的认知。

heighten.en: The campaign is intended to heighten public awareness of the disease.
heighten.zh: 这场运动的目的是使公众更加了解这种疾病。

heighten.en: But when the emotion that leads to stiffening the lip is more intense, and involves strong muscle tension, facial feedback may heighten emotional response.
heighten.zh: 但是当导致嘴唇僵硬的情绪变得更加强烈，并导致肌肉强烈绷紧时，面部表情反应就可能会增强情绪反应。

gland.en: Located near the base of the neck, the thyroid is a large endocrine gland that produces hormones that help control growth and metabolism.
gland.zh: 甲状腺位于颈部的底部附近，是一个很大的内分泌腺体，它产生激素，协助控制生长和新陈代谢。

gland.en: It is thought that being overweight may also increase the risk of cancer in the reproductive organs for women and in the prostate gland for men.
gland.zh: 人们认为，超重还可能增加女性生殖器官和男性前列腺患癌的风险。

gland.en: For example, hormones from the hypothalamus in the brain stimulate the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland.
gland.zh: 例如，来自大脑下丘脑的激素会刺激垂体前叶。

latitude.en: Most oceanic islands are similar to one another in latitude and contain plants and animals typical of tropical islands.
latitude.zh: 大多数海洋岛屿彼此都纬度相近，并且都有热带岛屿典型的动植物。

latitude.en: This is because middle- and upper- latitude timberlines are strongly influenced by the duration and depth of the snow cover.
latitude.zh: 这是因为中纬度和高纬度地区的林木线受到积雪存留时间和厚度的强烈影响。

latitude.en: If they kept on going, and the next night they saw the pair of stars setting separately, then they would know that they were at a different degree of latitude.
latitude.zh: 如果他们继续走，第二天晚上看见这两颗星星分别落下，就知道他们在不同的纬度上了。

expressive.en: You can train people to be more expressive.
expressive.zh: 你可以培训人们使其更富于表现力。

expressive.en: Her expressive gestures were motivated from within rather than from being dictated by strict technique.
expressive.zh: 她富有表现力的姿势是由内心激发的，而不是由严格的技巧来支配的。

expressive.en: It deals, of course, with the techniques of music, but only in order to show how technique is directed toward expressive aims in music and toward the listener's musical experience.
expressive.zh: 当然，它涉及音乐的技巧，但只是为了表明技巧是如何指向音乐的表达目的和听众的音乐体验的。

moose.en: He set off for a nineteen-day moose hunt in Nova Scotia.
moose.zh: 他开始了在新斯科舍为期19天的猎驼鹿行程。

moose.en: And you know, we hit a moose.
moose.zh: 而且你知道，我们撞到了一头驼鹿。

moose.en: Is that a chicken or a moose?
moose.zh: 那是只小鸡还是只驼鹿？

equate.en: I don't see how you can equate the two things.
equate.zh: 我不明白你怎么能把这两件事等同起来。

equate.en: The author doesn't equate liberalism and conservatism.
equate.zh: 该作者没有将自由主义等同于保守主义。

equate.en: It is a mistake to simply equate longevity with issues of old age.
equate.zh: 把长寿简单地等同于老年问题是错误的。

yearn.en: As humans, we yearn for social connection.
yearn.zh: 作为人类，我们渴望有社会联系。

yearn.en: All of us actually yearn for a slow and calm life.
yearn.zh: 事实上，我们都渴望一个缓慢而平静的生活。

yearn.en: Every night I yearn for sleep, I strive for it; yet it flutters on ahead of me like a curtain.
yearn.zh: 每天晚上我都渴望睡眠，我努力想要睡着，但睡眠像窗帘一样在我面前飘动。

jeopardize.en: By capping her grades at 94 while most other teachers grade on a scale that tops out at 100, your teacher could jeopardize a student's chance of getting a scholarship or getting into a top college.
jeopardize.zh: 如果你的老师把自己的成绩限制在94分，而其他大多数老师的评分范围都在100分以上，那么你的老师可能会危及学生获得奖学金或进入顶尖大学的机会。

jeopardize.en: He would never do anything to jeopardize his career.
jeopardize.zh: 他决不会做任何有损于他事业的事。

theoretically.en: Theoretically, the price is supposed to be marked on the shelf.
theoretically.zh: 从理论上说，价格是要标在货架上的。

theoretically.en: Theoretically, such equipment could help paraplegics regain movement.
theoretically.zh: 从理论上说，这样的器械可以帮助下身瘫痪者重新获得活动能力。

theoretically.en: Theoretically, in the world of trade, shipping costs do not matter.
theoretically.zh: 理论上，在贸易领域，运输成本并不重要。

sociology.en: I'll be teaching history and sociology next term.
sociology.zh: 下学期我教历史和社会学。

sociology.en: Simpson's much vaunted discoveries are in fact commonplace in modern sociology.
sociology.zh: 辛普森的那些被过分称赞的发现在现代社会学中实际上是老生常谈。

sociology.en: This degree offers a major specialization in social policy alongside a course in sociology.
sociology.zh: 该学位提供一门社会政策主专业课和一门社会学课程。

adorn.en: They wash and wax the cars, go on and on about them—some even adorn them with furry dice.
adorn.zh: 他们为车子清洗、打蜡，没完没了地谈论它们——有些人甚至用毛皮骰子装饰它们。

adorn.en: Gold was considered divine in ancient Greece and was used to adorn temples and as an offering to the gods.
adorn.zh: 在古希腊，黄金被认为是神圣的，被用来装饰庙宇和作为对神的祭品。

adorn.en: Several magnificent oil paintings adorn the walls.
adorn.zh: 几张华丽的油画使墙壁熠熠生辉。

unify.en: However, any interpretation that seeks to unify all of the novel's diverse elements is bound to be somewhat unconvincing.
unify.zh: 然而，任何试图将小说的所有不同元素统一起来的解读，都必然有些难以令人信服。

unify.en: Stirrups unify lance, rkier, and horse into a force capable of unprecedented violence.
unify.zh: 马镫将骑枪、长矛和马团结在一起，形成一股具有空前暴力能力的力量。

unify.en: By consolidating the hawks, the new alignment may also unify and perk up the doves in Israel's aviary.
unify.zh: 通过巩固鹰派，新的结盟也可能团结和振奋以色列的鸽派。

twisted.zh: 他摔了一跤，扭伤了脚踝。

twisted.en: The wheel had been twisted out of shape.

bound.zh: 他们把他的双手绑在一起。
这艘船是开往意大利的。

inaugural.en: In his inaugural address, the president appealed for national unity.
inaugural.zh: 总统在他的就职演说中呼吁全国团结。

inaugural.en: I popped into a newsagent's and bought my inaugural pack of Marlboros with a burning sense of shame.
inaugural.zh: 我冲进一家报刊亭，带着强烈的羞耻感买下了我的第一包万宝路。

inaugural.en: However, one of the shortest inaugural addresses is also one of the best remembered and most often quoted.
inaugural.zh: 然而，最短的就职演说也是最容易被记住和最经常被引用的。

pharmacy.zh: 他花了4年时间学习药剂学。

pharmacy.en: If your pharmacy doesn't stock the product you want, have them order it for you.
pharmacy.zh: 如果药房没有你所要的产品，让他们替你订货。

pharmacy.en: Whether you're behind the pharmacy counter or in the lab, you can rest easy.
pharmacy.zh: 无论你在药房的柜台还是实验室，你都可以高枕无忧了。

acceleration.zh: 加速度和速度都是矢量。

acceleration.en: Acceleration to 60 mph takes a mere 5.7 seconds.
acceleration.zh: 加速到每小时60英里仅用5.7秒。

acceleration.en: The engine delivers instant acceleration whatever the revs.
acceleration.zh: 不论转速如何，发动机都可以立即加速。

wavelength.en: If this distance is large in comparison to the wavelength, this dam simply casts a shadow.
wavelength.zh: 如果这个距离比波长大，那么这个水坝就会投下阴影。

wavelength.en: We want to divide all of this by our wavelength, and to keep our units the same we'll do meters.
wavelength.zh: 我们想用波长除以所有这些，而且为了保持单位统一我们采用米为单位。

wavelength.en: The precise thickness at which the fibre traps the light depends on the wavelength of that light.
wavelength.zh: 纤维捕捉光束的确切厚度取决于那条光束的波长。

cardiac.en: The man was suffering from cardiac weakness.
cardiac.zh: 这人当时正患心脏衰弱。

cardiac.en: She was given artificial respiration and cardiac massage.
cardiac.zh: 她接受了人工呼吸和心脏按摩。

cardiac.en: In specialties ranging from cardiac care to pediatric care, they could become as essential in daily medicine as the stethoscope.
cardiac.zh: 在心脏护理至儿科护理的专业领域中，它们在日常医学中可能会像听诊器一样不可或缺。

guru.en: The popular press tends to represent him as an environmental guru.
guru.zh: 大众媒体倾向于把他描绘成环保领袖。

guru.en: Mr. Chou can sound more like a Californian management guru than an Asian corporate patriarch.
guru.zh: 周先生听起来更像是一位加州管理专家，而不是一位亚洲公司的创始人。

guru.en: I first heard this question from strategy guru Gary Hamel, and I ask it of myself all the time.
guru.zh: 我最早是从策略大师加里·哈默尔处听到这个问题，我也一直在问自己这个问题。

contingency.en: The dispatch of the task force is purely a contingency measure.
contingency.zh: 派遣特遣队纯粹是应急措施。

contingency.en: We should be prepared for any contingency.
contingency.zh: 我们应该对任何应急情况有所准备。

spiral.en: These spiral vessels are part of a banana plant stem.
spiral.zh: 这些螺旋状的脉管是香蕉植物茎的一部分。

spiral.en: Most spiral-shaped snail species are predominantly dextral.
spiral.zh: 大多数螺旋形的蜗牛主要是右旋的。

spiral.en: He recruited some of the workers to start making spiral bulbs for TCP.
spiral.zh: 他招募了一些工人开始为 TCP 生产螺旋灯泡。

whirl.en: To free electrons, something has to make them whirl fast enough to break away from their nuclei.
whirl.zh: 为了释放电子，必须使电子高速旋转而足以摆脱它们的原子核。

whirl.en: I learn not to separate these creatures bursting with violent energy from the sky where their desires whirl.
whirl.zh: 我学会了不应拆散这些有着狂暴精力的生物，他们爆发出的精力源于天空，他们的欲念亦回旋于九霄之上。

whirl.en: Planets are believed to emerge from the accretion of particles in a disk of gas and dust as they whirl around the star.
whirl.zh: 行星被认为是由围绕恒星旋转的气体和尘埃组成的圆盘中的粒子累积而成。

paw.en: His brow resting on his paw, he pondered long and deeply.
paw.zh: 他用爪子支着额头，沉思了许久。

sovereign.en: In March 1889, she became the first British sovereign to set foot on Spanish soil.
sovereign.zh: 1889年3月，她成为首位踏上西班牙国土的英国君主。

sovereign.en: Singapore seceded from the Federation of Malaysia and became an independent sovereign state.
sovereign.zh: 新加坡脱离马来西亚联邦成为一个独立的主权国家。

sovereign.en: Lithuania and Armenia signed a treaty in Vilnius recognizing each other as independent sovereign states.
sovereign.zh: 立陶宛和亚美尼亚在维尔纽斯签订了一份互相承认各自为独立主权国家的协定。

plow.en: While most harvesting is still done manually, some have abandoned the ox-pulled plow for tractors.
plow.zh: 虽然大部分收割还是手工的，但有些人已经废弃了使用牛拉犁而改用拖拉机。

plow.en: There are those who would prefer to plow golf courses under because of the water and chemicals they use.
plow.zh: 有些人更愿意将高尔夫球场给犁掉，因为它们耗费水和化学品。

plow.en: "Monument to the Plow" called for a triangular site a mile wide on each side to be planted with seasonal crops on rotation.
plow.zh: 《犁的纪念碑》要求一三角状地块，每边宽一英里，以轮种方式在每个边种植季节性作物。

incur.en: Contractors who fall behind schedule incur heavy financial penalties.
incur.zh: 承包商如延误工期将被处以巨额罚款。

incur.en: The strategic regulation of evening body reserves is also likely to incur additional costs, as nightingales must spend more time foraging in order to build up larger body reserves.
incur.zh: 晚间的身体储能的策略管理机制，也会产生额外的能量支出，这样夜莺就必须花更多时间找食物，来增加储能。

incur.en: Though many people are accustomed to wearing shoes during all their waking hours, the more time you spend wearing shoes, the more likely you are to incur foot injuries as a result.
incur.zh: 有非常多的人习惯了只要醒着就要穿鞋，但事实是，你穿鞋的时间越长，你的脚因此受伤的可能性就越大。

flutter.en: Her heart gave a flutter when she saw him.
flutter.zh: 她见到他时心怦怦乱跳。

flutter.en: The sound of his voice in the hall made her heart flutter.
flutter.zh: 他在大厅中讲话的声音使她的心怦怦直跳。

flutter.en: Her sudden arrival caused quite a flutter.
flutter.zh: 她的突然来到引起一片慌乱。

flicker.en: Looking through the window I saw the flicker of flames.
flicker.zh: 透过窗子望出去，我看到了闪烁的火光。

flicker.en: A flicker of a smile crossed her face.
Watch the flames flicker in the room.
flicker.zh: 注视着火焰在屋里闪烁。

brag.en: One secret I learned very early on was not to brag about  success.
brag.zh: 我很早就学到的一个秘诀是不要夸耀自己的成功。

brag.en: When talking about your achievements, be confident but don't exaggerate, brag or lie.
brag.zh: 在谈到你的成就时，要自信，但不要夸大、吹牛或撒谎。

brag.en: We will leave them to smoke and chatter and brag, since we have no further use for them at present.
brag.zh: 我们让他们抽烟、聊天和吹牛，因为我们目前暂时没有事情麻烦他们。

hypothetical.en: I wasn't asking about anybody in particular—it was a purely hypothetical question.
hypothetical.zh: 我并没有问到具体某个人—那不过是个纯粹假设性的问题。

hypothetical.en: No doubt this hypothetical pattern did apply at times during the course of the recovery.
hypothetical.zh: 毫无疑问，在经济复苏的过程中，这种假设的模式确实适用于某些时候。

hypothetical.en: Whoever formulated the theory of the origin of the universe, it is just hypothetical and needs proving.
hypothetical.zh: 无论谁提出了宇宙起源的理论，它都只是一个假设，需要证明。

plank.en: A plank of wood bridged the stream.

plank.zh: 那块木板是用钉子拼接的。

delete.en: I selected a file and pressed the delete key.
delete.zh: 我选定了一份文件，然后按下了删除键。

delete.en: After we delete their names, we have some results like Figure 21.
delete.zh: 删除它们的名称之后，我们将得到如图21所示的结果。

delete.en: Dreams organize the events of the day into folders and delete what is not needed.
delete.zh: 在梦中，一天的事情被分门别类地整理好，而不必要的则会被删除。

blaze.zh: 约有四千名消防人员正在与大火搏斗。

blaze.en: She fled from the blaze, coughing and spluttering.
blaze.zh: 她从大火中逃出来，一边咳嗽，一边噗噗地吐气。

physiological.en: The problem was psychological rather than physiological.
physiological.zh: 这是个心理而不是生理问题。

physiological.en: It also keeps their physiological processes working.
physiological.zh: 它还能让自身的生理过程保持正常运作。

physiological.en: One involves physiological changes relevant to memory.
physiological.zh: 一种是与记忆相关的生理变化。

carpenter.en: She was in the second year of her apprenticeship as a carpenter.
carpenter.zh: 她当木工学徒已是第二年了。

carpenter.en: For instance, my neighbor is a master carpenter.
carpenter.zh: 例如，我的邻居是个木工大师。

carpenter.en: He opened it to find a carpenter standing at the doorway.
carpenter.zh: 他打开门发现一个木匠站在门口。

glamorous.en: It was an opera, very glamorous and very sensual.
glamorous.zh: 那是一部极富魅力，让人感官非常愉悦的歌剧。

glamorous.en: Smoking is still attractive to many young people who see it as glamorous.
glamorous.zh: 吸烟仍然对很多年轻人有诱惑力，他们将之视为魅力标志。

glamorous.en: The show demonstrates how glamorous ballroom dancing is.
glamorous.zh: 这个节目展示了交际舞是多么迷人。

relaxation.zh: 钓鱼是他最喜欢的消遣活动。

slate.en: The sea was the colour of slate.
A loose slate had fallen from the roof.
slate.zh: 一块松动的石板瓦从房顶上掉了下来。

slate.en: The area has been mined for slate for centuries.
slate.zh: 这个地区开采板岩有数百年了。

souvenir.en: I bought the ring as a souvenir of Greece.
souvenir.zh: 我买了一枚戒指，留作对希腊的纪念。

souvenir.en: Please accept this little gift as a souvenir.
souvenir.zh: 请接受这个小礼物作为纪念品。

souvenir.en: You can keep that for a souvenir if you'd like.
