lavender.zh: 它被田野包围着，周围是油菜、小麦、葡萄园、普法尔茨的藤蔓，以及普罗旺斯的薰衣草。

lavender.en: Studies have found that lemon and lavender scents can produce the most positive, calming results.
lavender.zh: 研究发现柠檬和薰衣草的气味能够产生最积极、平静的效果。

sculptor.en: He felt very strange and asked the sculptor, "Why are you making two same sculptures?"
sculptor.zh: 他感到很奇怪，就问雕刻家：“你为什么要做两个一样的雕塑？”

sculptor.en: Undeterred, he crept into the cemetery under the cloak of darkness with a bemused sculptor in tow.
sculptor.zh: 他没有被吓住，在黑暗的掩护下，拖着一个困惑的雕刻家，蹑手蹑脚地走进墓地。

sculptor.en: I know a sculptor who swaps her pieces for drawings by a well-known artist.
sculptor.zh: 我知道有个雕塑家用她自己的作品去换一位著名画家的画作。

disconnect.en: My computer crashes every time I disconnect from the Internet.
disconnect.zh: 我每次断网，计算机都会突然死机。

disconnect.en: There's a huge disconnect between the way we currently train scientists and the actual employment opportunities available for them.
disconnect.zh: 我们目前对科学家的培训方式与他们实际可获得的就业机会之间仍存在巨大的脱节。

fragrance.en: The advertisement is for a men's fragrance.
fragrance.zh: 这则广告介绍一款男士香水。

fragrance.en: The analogy between music and fragrance has stuck.
fragrance.zh: 音乐与香味的类比已经深入人心了。

fragrance.en: Elizabeth David enthuses about the taste, fragrance and character of Provencal cuisine.
fragrance.zh: 伊丽莎白·戴维兴奋地谈论普罗旺斯菜的口味、香气和特色。

authenticity.en: There are factors, however, that have cast doubt on the statue's authenticity.
authenticity.zh: 然而，有些因素已经让人们对这座雕像的真实性产生了怀疑。
他们证明了它的真实性。

authenticity.en: The members of the Punxsutawney Groundhog Club doubt the authenticity of this data.
authenticity.zh: 普克托尼克土拨鼠俱乐部的成员怀疑这个数据的真实性。

grove.en: I might as well recommend you to go to the "Grove".
It's how we can get our grove back or find our mojo.
grove.zh: 这就是如何找回我们的小树林或找到我们的魔力的办法。

grove.en: When I finished the minimill story, Grove said, "OK, I get it."
grove.zh: 当我结束小钢铁厂的故事时，格罗夫说：“好，我明白了。”

converge.en: The adult ones converge on remaining portions of healthy coral and feed hungrily.
converge.zh: 成年珊瑚聚集在健康珊瑚的剩余部分上，饥饿地进食。

converge.en: As they flow south, the five rivers converge.
converge.zh: 这5条河向南流，最终汇合在一起。

converge.en: Hundreds of tractors will converge on the capital.
converge.zh: 成百上千的拖拉机将向首都聚集。

trivial.en: It's a trivial matter and not worth fighting about.
trivial.zh: 这是一桩小事，不值得为之争辩。

trivial.en: I know it sounds trivial , but I'm worried about it.
trivial.zh: 我知道这事听起来微不足道，但我还是放心不下。

trivial.en: His mood can be gauged by his reaction to the most trivial of incidents.
trivial.zh: 他的情绪可以通过他对最琐碎的小事的反应来判定。

porcelain.en: There were lilies everywhere in tall white porcelain vases.
porcelain.zh: 到处都是插在白瓷高花瓶里的百合花。

porcelain.en: To this class of substance belong mica, porcelain, quartz, glass, wood, etc.
porcelain.zh: 属于这类物质的有云母、瓷器、石英、玻璃、木材等等。

porcelain.en: Her skin is porcelain with a smattering of freckles and she is slender, almost fashion-skinny.
porcelain.zh: 她的皮肤像瓷器那样，还带着一点雀斑。 她还很瘦，瘦得几乎像个模特。

scanner.en: The picture is digitized by a scanner.
scanner.zh: 该图通过扫描仪被数字化。

scanner.en: He's bought a new PC, colour printer, scanner—the lot.
scanner.zh: 他买了新的个人电脑、彩色打印机、扫描仪，样样齐备。

scanner.en: The identity cards are examined by an electronic scanner.
scanner.zh: 用电子扫描器来检验身份证。

deception.en: He was jailed for two years for fraud and deception.
deception.zh: 他因诈骗与欺诈被监禁了两年。

deception.en: He admitted conspiring to obtain property by deception.
deception.zh: 他承认曾密谋通过欺骗获取财产。

expanse.en: Its expanse of red Indian sandstone and wavy ribbons of glass is beautiful.
expanse.zh: 它广阔的红色印度砂岩和波浪状的玻璃带是美丽的。

expanse.en: The grass was like an expanse of gold, and below her the valley swam in golden mist.
expanse.zh: 草地都是金色的，她脚下的山谷笼罩在金色的薄雾中。

expanse.en: She began to address more ambitious themes in her dances such as The Sea, in which her dancers invisibly agitated a huge expanse of silk, played upon by colored lights.
expanse.zh: 她开始在她的舞蹈中表现出更宏大的主题，比如《大海》，在此作品中，她的舞者挥舞着一大片隐形的丝绸，这是通过彩色灯光创造出来的。

famine.en: The famine threatened to depopulate the continent.
famine.zh: 饥荒威胁着该大陆人口数量。

famine.en: If the drought continues there's going to be a famine.
famine.zh: 如果旱灾继续下去很可能要发生饥荒。

famine.en: Many Irish people went over to America during the famine.
famine.zh: 许多爱尔兰人在饥荒时期迁徙到美国。

socket.en: Is the cable long enough to reach the socket?
Plug your tabletop lamp into a dimmer instead of the wall socket.
socket.zh: 直接把你的台灯插到调光器上，而不用插到墙上的插座里。

socket.en: When either of them receives data, it writes the data to the other socket.
socket.zh: 当它们其中一个收到数据时，就会将数据写到另一个套接字。

buzz.en: I'll give you a buzz on Monday, OK?
buzz.zh: 我星期一给你打电话行吗？

buzz.en: She gets a buzz out of her work.
buzz.zh: 她从工作中得到了很大乐趣。

clump.en: This clump of paper birch trunks was backlit by a blaze of reds and yellows.
clump.zh: 这一丛纸桦树树干的背光是一片红黄相间的火焰。

clump.en: Tom proudly marched into a thick clump of sumach bushes and said, "Here you are!"
clump.zh: 汤姆得意地大步走进一丛茂密的绿树中说：“给你！”

clump.en: Galaxies tend to clump together in clusters.
clump.zh: 星系往往聚集形成星团。

cycling.en: Cycling is a cheap way to get around.
cycling.zh: 骑自行车是一种省钱的旅游方式。

cycling.en: Cycling is Europe's second most popular sport.
cycling.zh: 骑自行车是欧洲第二流行的体育运动。

cycling.en: The quiet country roads are ideal for cycling.
cycling.zh: 安静的乡村道路很适合骑自行车。

arrogance.zh: 他说话时的傲慢态度令人咋舌。

nebula.en: The size of the nebula at this stage is inversely proportional to its mass.
nebula.zh: 这个阶段的星云大小与其质量成反比。

nebula.en: As the nebula collapsed caused by its gravity, it spun faster and flattened into a disk.
nebula.zh: 当星云因其重力而坍缩时，它旋转得更快，并压扁成一个盘状。

nebula.en: During his sophomore year, he sold his first science-fiction story to a Scottish magazine named Nebula.
nebula.zh: 在他大二的时候，他把自己的第一个科幻故事卖给了一家名为《星云》的苏格兰杂志。

aquatic.en: The pond is small but can support many aquatic plants and fish.
aquatic.zh: 这个池塘虽小，但是能养活许多水生植物和鱼。

aquatic.en: Visitors can view a rich and colourful array of aquatic plants and animals.
aquatic.zh: 参观者可以观赏到一系列各种各样、色彩斑斓的水生动植物。

aquatic.en: That long skeletal structure suggests that it was aquatic.
aquatic.zh: 这种长长的骨骼结构表明它是水生动物。

lighter.zh: 较浅色的衣服对你最合适。
补充剂包装更便宜，更轻。

lighter.en: It is one of his finest works in a lighter vein.
lighter.zh: 这是他使用了较为轻盈的风格的最佳作品之一。

liaison.en: She acts as a liaison between patients and staff.
liaison.zh: 她担当病人和医务人员之间的联络员。

liaison.en: She gave him a factual account of the chronology of her brief liaison.
liaison.zh: 她就自己在短时间内的联络给了我一个确凿的大事记。

liaison.en: Liaison between police forces and the art world is vital to combat art crime.
liaison.zh: 警方和艺术界之间的联络对于打击艺术犯罪是至关重要的。

harden.en: Their action can only serve to harden the attitude of landowners.
harden.zh: 他们的举动只会使土地所有者们的态度变得强硬。

harden.en: Test to see if the finish is tacky, and if it is, leave it to harden.
harden.zh: 测试一下看看最后一道漆是否还发黏，如果是的话，那就放着让它变硬。

harden.en: The varnish takes a few hours to harden.
harden.zh: 清漆需要几个小时才能干透。

cassette.en: I swapped him my CD for his cassette.
cassette.zh: 我拿我的激光唱片换了他的盒式磁带。

cassette.en: This recording is available on disc or cassette.
cassette.zh: 这录音有激光唱片和盒式磁带两种。

cassette.en: Cassette recorders cannot rival the sound quality of CDs.
cassette.zh: 盒式磁带录音机在音质上无法与CD相媲美。

directory.en: This command deletes files from the directory.
directory.zh: 这一指令把文档从目录中删除。

directory.en: Yahoo is the oldest and best-known Web directory service.
directory.zh: 雅虎是提供网上目录检索服务最早、最知名的网站。

directory.en: You can use a directory service to search for people on the Internet.
directory.zh: 你可以使用目录服务在因特网上搜索人。

dwelling.en: The present position of the house coincides with that of an earlier dwelling.
dwelling.zh: 这栋房子现在的位置恰与原住宅的位置一致。

dwelling.en: After dwelling in Rio for ten years, she moved to Lisbon.
dwelling.zh: 她在里约居住了10年之后迁居到里斯本去了。

dwelling.en: He was therefore honourably received, and a special dwelling was assigned him.
dwelling.zh: 因此，他受到了隆重的接待，并被分配了到一个别致的住所。

vapor.en: Then it snows because as the air rises, it cools off and loses its capacity to hold water vapor.
vapor.zh: 然后就会下雪，因为当空气上升时，它就会冷却并失去保持水蒸气的能力。

vapor.en: Such feedbacks might involve ice on land and sea, clouds, or water vapor, which also absorb radiant heat.
vapor.zh: 这种反馈可能涉及陆地和海洋上的冰、云或水蒸气，这些也会吸收辐射热。

vapor.en: Astronomers therefore prefer dry sites with little water vapor, which is generally found at higher altitudes.
vapor.zh: 因此，天文学家更喜欢水蒸气很少的干燥地点，而水蒸气通常出现在海拔较高处。

evacuation.en: Each house had a helipad for a fast evacuation.
evacuation.zh: 每所房子都有一个供快速撤离用的直升机升降坪。

evacuation.en: He had acted heroically during the liner's evacuation.
evacuation.zh: 他在疏散客轮乘客的过程中表现得很英勇。

evacuation.en: An evacuation of the city's four-million inhabitants is planned for later this week.
evacuation.zh: 该市400万居民的撤离计划本周晚些时候进行。

clamp.en: The wood is held in position by a clamp.
clamp.zh: 这木头用夹钳固定住了。

clamp.en: Somebody forgot to bring along the U-bolts to clamp the microphones to the pole.
clamp.zh: 有人忘记带来把麦克风夹在支杆上的U型螺栓。

clamp.en: Blades without clips are held by screws and the clamp on the handle.
clamp.zh: 失去金属夹的刀片由螺丝和手柄上的夹子固定。

frank.zh: 那些谈话不留情面地坦率。

frank.en: Frank rasped a hand across his chin.
frank.zh: 弗兰克用一只手蹭着下巴发出擦擦的声音。

hinder.en: Unfortunately these drugs are quite toxic and hinder the body's ability to fight off infection.
hinder.zh: 不幸的是，这些药毒性很大，妨碍身体抗感染的能力。

hinder.en: It will only slow you down and hinder your career goals.
hinder.zh: 这只会拖慢你的速度，阻碍你实现职业目标。

hinder.en: The child shall not hinder me from accepting the offer, I tell you that!
hinder.zh: 我告诉你，这孩子不会妨碍我接受工作的！

irrational.zh: 他的行为正变得愈加非理性。

irrational.en: Shiller believes that America is in the grip of an irrational mania.
irrational.zh: 希勒认为，美国正处于非理性狂热之中。

irrational.en: This is a grand challenge for our age and it may require an "irrational" response.
irrational.zh: 这是我们这个时代面临的重大挑战，为此可能需要“非理性”的回应。

pristine.en: The pristine waters around the Antarctic will disappear forever.
pristine.zh: 南极周围的原始水域将永远消失。

pristine.en: Krill fishing in the Antarctic has worsened the pollution of the pristine waters.
pristine.zh: 南极的磷虾捕捞加剧了对原始水域的污染。

pristine.en: Now elsewhere in the world, Iceland may be spoken of, somewhat breathlessly, as western Europe's last pristine wilderness.
pristine.zh: 现在在世界其他地方，可能说起冰岛，人们会有些喘不过气来，说它是西欧最后的原始荒野。

alpine.en: I guess I don't need to ask, for no Alpine rose can look more blooming.
alpine.zh: 我想我不需要问，因为没有哪朵高山牧场的玫瑰开得更艳了。

alpine.en: Above the tree line there is a zone that is generally called alpine tundra.
alpine.zh: 林木线上方有一个区域，通常被称为高山苔原。

alpine.en: The most striking characteristic of the plants of the alpine zone is their low growth form.
alpine.zh: 高寒地区植物最显著的特点是生长缓慢。

navigation.en: They will be helped by the very latest in navigation aids.
navigation.zh: 他们将得到最新的导航设备的帮助。

navigation.en: Pack ice around Iceland was becoming a threat to navigation.
navigation.zh: 冰岛周围的浮冰一度成为船舶航行的威胁。

navigation.en: The expedition was wrecked by bad planning and poor navigation.
navigation.zh: 这次探险因计划不周和导航不利而失败。

plaster.en: One of the kids was peeling plaster off the wall.
plaster.zh: 其中一个孩子在剥墙上的灰泥。

plaster.en: First, you need to strip away all the old plaster.
plaster.zh: 首先，你得把原来的灰泥全部刮掉。

plaster.en: The plaster had started to come away from the wall.
plaster.zh: 灰泥已开始从墙上剥落。

abnormal.en: He concluded that Oswald was somewhat abnormal.
abnormal.zh: 他断定奥斯瓦德有点不正常。

abnormal.en: The abnormal bleeding is your body's own red flag of danger.
abnormal.zh: 这反常的流血是你身体本身的危险信号。

redemption.zh: 他渴望对其罪孽的救赎。

redemption.en: The Shawshank Redemption made much money as soon as it came out.
redemption.zh: 《肖申克的救赎》一上映就赚了很多钱。

redemption.en: Some specialized securities possess mandatory redemption features.
redemption.zh: 一些专业证券具有强制赎回的特征。

bamboo.zh: 大熊猫的基本食物是竹子。
令人遗憾的是，竹子开花后就会死亡。

bamboo.en: The panda's natural habitat is the bamboo forest.
bamboo.zh: 大熊猫的天然栖息地是竹林。

prosper.en: He may have to become more conformist if he is to prosper again.
prosper.zh: 如果想再次成功，他可能得更遵守成规。

prosper.en: The town of Breckenridge and its namesake ski area could prosper under the plan.
prosper.zh: 按照这一方案，布雷肯里奇镇及与其同名的滑雪区将会繁荣起来。

prosper.en: The example seems to indicate that some regions can prosper without the Bank's aid as well.
prosper.zh: 这个例子似乎表明，一些地区在没有这个银行援助的情况下也能实现繁荣。

downward.en: Benedict pointed downward again with his stick.
downward.zh: 贝内迪克特又用他的拐杖向下指了指。

downward.en: He works backward, building a house from the top downward.
downward.zh: 他倒着干活，从上往下盖房子。

plasma.en: After a pint of blood is collected, it is processed into its transfusible components: plasma, platelets and red blood cells.
plasma.zh: 采集一品脱血液后，将其加工成可输血的成分：血浆、血小板和红细胞。

plasma.en: Plasma amylase was studied by an enzymatic method using Bernfeld technique.
plasma.zh: 采用贝恩菲尔德技术的酶催化法来研究血浆淀粉酶。

plasma.en: Establish a method for the determination of quinapril and its active metabolite quinaprilat in human plasma.
plasma.zh: 建立一种方法测定人血浆中喹那普利及其代谢产物喹那普利拉的浓度。

heartbeat.en: She felt her heartbeat quicken as he approached.
heartbeat.zh: 随着他的走近，她觉得自己的心跳加速了。

heartbeat.en: I was a little breathless and my heartbeat was bumpy and fast.
heartbeat.zh: 我有点上气不接下气,我的心跳不稳并且很快。

stifle.en: She makes no attempt to stifle a yawn.
stifle.zh: 她并未试图忍住一个哈欠。

stifle.en: The food did nothing to stifle her queasiness.
stifle.zh: 这些食物也没能遏制住她的恶心感。

sentimental.en: A sordid, sentimental plot unwinds, with an inevitable mawkish ending.
sentimental.zh: 一段灰暗而感伤的情节慢慢展开，最后是一个不可避免的幼稚可笑的结局。

sentimental.en: For sentimental reasons I wanted to delay my departure until June 1980.
sentimental.zh: 由于感情上的原因，我想把启程时间推迟到1980年6月。

sentimental.en: This ring has great sentimental value for me.
sentimental.zh: 这枚戒指对我来说很有纪念意义。

insecurity.zh: 不安全感可能会悄然而生。

insecurity.en: He was tormented by feelings of insecurity.
She is assailed by self-doubt and emotional insecurity.
insecurity.zh: 她被自我怀疑和情感不安所困扰。

tread.en: I heard his heavy tread on the stairs.
tread.zh: 我听到他在楼梯上的沉重脚步声。

tread.en: The fat, broad tyres had a good depth of tread.
tread.zh: 鼓鼓的宽轮胎上有一道很深的花纹。

tread.en: Notice how the tread on this tyre has worn down.
tread.zh: 注意这个轮胎的花纹磨损的程度。

inclination.zh: 一种倾向掩盖另一种倾向。
她没有表现出要走的意向。
她一点都没有兴趣做家务。

synthesis.en: Instead, he advocates a synthesis of these two views.
synthesis.zh: 相反，他主张综合这两种观点。

synthesis.en: Protein synthesis begins when the gene encoding a protein is activated.
synthesis.zh: 当编码蛋白质的基因被激活时，蛋白质合成就开始了。

synthesis.en: It is a synthesis of traditional music, dancing, poetry, acrobatics and martial arts.
synthesis.zh: 它是传统音乐、舞蹈、诗歌、杂技和武术的综合。

inclusive.en: The rent is inclusive of water and heating.
inclusive.zh: 租金包括水费和暖气费。

inclusive.en: The academy is far more inclusive now than it used to be.
inclusive.zh: 该学院如今比过去更为兼收并蓄。

pilgrimage.en: They saw more rooms and made more discoveries than Mary had made on her first pilgrimage.
pilgrimage.zh: 他们比玛丽第一次漫游时看到了更多的房间，发现了更多的东西。

pilgrimage.en: The bulk of my own college books are still with me, rarely consulted but always there, reminders of moments, of stages, in a pilgrimage.
pilgrimage.zh: 我自己的大部分大学书籍还在我身边，很少查阅，但总是在那里，提醒着我在一次朝圣中的时刻，阶段。

pilgrimage.en: His grave has become a place of pilgrimage.
pilgrimage.zh: 他的陵墓成了参拜之地。

thyme.en: Scented leaves like lavender, mint or thyme.
thyme.zh: 有香味的叶子：薰衣草、薄荷和百里香。

thyme.en: When I met her she was in the fields harvesting thyme.
thyme.zh: 当我遇到她时，她正在田里丰收百里香。

thyme.en: Then throw in the garlic and scallions and sprinkle the thyme over the chicken.
thyme.zh: 然后放入蒜和葱，并在鸡块上撒上百里香。

memorize.en: I don't try to memorize speeches word for word.
memorize.zh: 我不会尝试去逐字地背那些演说。

memorize.en: He studied his map, trying to memorize the way to Rose's street.
memorize.zh: 他研究了地图，努力记住去罗丝家那条街的路。

memorize.en: Memorize a poem and pass it on.
memorize.zh: 记住一首诗并把它传下去。

monumental.en: We have a monumental task ahead of us.
monumental.zh: 极其繁重的工作在等着我们。

monumental.en: It seems like an act of monumental folly.
monumental.zh: 这似乎是一种非常愚蠢的行为。

monumental.en: I take no real interest in monumental sculpture.
monumental.zh: 我对宏伟的雕塑并没有真正感兴趣。

superficial.en: The other injured man had a superficial stomach wound.
superficial.zh: 另一名受伤男子是腹部表层受伤。

superficial.en: The book shows only a superficial understanding of the historical context.
superficial.zh: 这部书表现出对历史背景肤浅的理解。

rig.en: It took a team of engineers to rig it up.
rig.zh: 这需要一个工程师团队来操纵它。

rig.en: The oil slick resulted from an accident at the Deepwater Horizon rig in the Gulf of Mexico.
rig.zh: 这片浮油是由于处于墨西哥湾的“深海地平线”钻井平台的一次事故造成的。

rig.en: When the rig sank, the riser broke near the top while remaining attached to the blowout preventer at the bottom.
rig.zh: 当钻井平台下沉时，立管在顶部附近的地方断裂，同时另一端仍与底部的防喷器相连。

reviewer.en: The gathering was organized by Warren Buckleitner, a longtime reviewer of interactive children's media.
reviewer.zh: 这次聚会是由沃伦·巴克利特纳组织的，他是一位资深的儿童互动媒体评论家。

reviewer.en: The reviewer padded out his review with a lengthy biography of the author.
reviewer.zh: 那位评论家用冗长的作者生平来拉长他的评论。

reviewer.en: Moshe Yegar's arguments was criticized by a reviewer.
reviewer.zh: 摩西·耶格尔的观点遭到了一位书评人的批评。

puff.en: I took a puff on the cigarette and started coughing.
puff.zh: 我抽了一口烟就开始咳嗽起来。

puff.en: The magician vanished in a puff of smoke.
puff.zh: 魔术师在一股烟雾中突然不见了。

puff.en: I was starting to puff a little from the climb.
puff.zh: 爬坡弄得我有点喘息起来。

misunderstand.en: Don't misunderstand me—I am grateful for all you've done.
misunderstand.zh: 别误解我的意思—我对你所做的一切都很感激。

misunderstand.en: She no longer feared that they should misunderstand her.
misunderstand.zh: 她不再害怕他们会误解她了。

superpower.en: He emphasized the wider issue of superpower cooperation.
superpower.zh: 他强调超级大国合作这个更大的话题。

superpower.en: The United States could claim to be both a military and an economic superpower.
superpower.zh: 美国可以声称既是军事上也是经济上的一个超级大国。

superpower.en: Many Europeans may view the U.S. as an arrogant superpower that has become hostile to foreigners.
superpower.zh: 许多欧洲人可能把美国看作是一个傲慢的、对外国人充满敌意的超级大国。

excursion.en: She felt more than usually hungry after her excursion.
excursion.zh: 远足后她感到非同寻常地饥饿。

excursion.en: Another pleasant excursion is Matamoros, 18 miles away.
excursion.zh: 另一个怡人的短程旅游是18英里外的马塔莫罗斯。
他经历了一次痛苦的远足。

hallmark.en: It's a technique that has become the hallmark of Amber Films.
hallmark.zh: 这是一项已成为安伯电影公司标志的技术。

hallmark.en: Chopsticks are highly praised by Westerners as a hallmark of ancient oriental civilization.
hallmark.zh: 筷子被西方人高度赞扬为古代东方文明的标志。

hallmark.en: He liked to use the glissando as his hallmark, which he probably got from listening to Croatian folk music.
hallmark.zh: 他喜欢用滑奏作为他的标志，这可能是他听克罗地亚民间音乐时了解到的。

vocational.en: He ought to get good vocational training.
vocational.zh: 他应该接受良好的职业培训。

vocational.en: Some vocational colleges have worked with companies to teach students.
vocational.zh: 一些职业学院与公司合作来教学生。

vocational.en: Some of the vocational college teachers are skilled technicians from companies.
vocational.zh: 一些职业院校的教师是来自公司的技术人员。

asphalt.en: Sheets of rain were falling and produced a black gloss on the asphalt.
asphalt.zh: 大雨倾盆而下，使沥青有了黑色的光泽。

asphalt.en: In India, they mix thrown-out plastic waste with asphalt and use it to pave new roadways.
asphalt.zh: 在印度，他们把丢弃的塑料废品和沥青混合起来，用来铺设新的道路。

asphalt.en: The first is the heat capacity of the materials that constitute the city, which is typically dominated by concrete and asphalt.
asphalt.zh: 首先是构成城市的材料的热容，通常由混凝土和沥青主导。

satisfactory.zh: 我从未得到过一个满意的回答。

satisfactory.en: If the item is not satisfactory, you will get your money back.
Let's assume for the sake of argument that we manage to build a satisfactory database.
satisfactory.zh: 让我们为了讨论假定我们设法构建了一个令人满意的数据库。

sharpen.zh: 你如何磨尖你的斧头呢？
勇敢的人会磨练自己的意志。

subscription.zh: 目前存在的订阅库非常少。

subscription.en: Especially hard hit were the blue and pink collar departments, such as subscription fulfillment.
subscription.zh: 首当其冲的是“蓝领”和“粉领”部门，比如订阅服务部门。

impending.en: If the EEG device can be found to be consistent with changes in brain activity observed by researchers, then a hat to warn of impending errors may become a reality.
impending.zh: 如果脑电图装置能被发现与研究者观测的的大脑活动改变相符合，那么一个帽子能预警即将发生的错误可能会成为现实。

impending.en: This accords with anecdotal evidence that people often yawn in situations where they are neither tired nor bored, but are preparing for impending mental and physical activity.
impending.zh: 这与坊间流传的证据相符，即人们常会在既不累也不无聊的情况下打哈欠，只是为即将到来的精神和身体活动做准备。

impending.en: He cried in despair, plumping down on a seat, with tears impending.
impending.zh: 他绝望地叫了起来，扑通一声坐在椅子上，眼泪快要掉下来了。

microscope.en: If you look at the paper under a microscope you will see the fibres.
microscope.zh: 如果你在显微镜下观察这张纸，你就会看到纤维。

microscope.en: The sperm sample is checked under the microscope before insemination is carried out.
microscope.zh: 进行受精前用显微镜检查精子样本。

microscope.en: The electron microscope uses a beam of electrons to produce images at high magnifications.
microscope.zh: 电子显微镜利用一束电子产生高倍放大的影像。

liable.en: Tenants are jointly and severally liable for payment of the rent.
liable.zh: 租金由承租人共同且分别承担。

liable.en: You will be liable for any damage caused.
liable.zh: 你必须对造成的任何损失负赔偿责任。

liable.en: Offenders are liable to fines of up to $500.
liable.zh: 违者可能被处以最多500元的罚款。

spear.en: The spear is presumably the murder weapon.
The boys dug pits and baited them so that they could spear their prey.
spear.zh: 男孩子们挖了陷阱，在里面放上诱饵，以便用矛刺杀猎物。

spear.en: The tallest pine is a small stick to Satan's spear.
spear.zh: 最高的松木对于撒旦的长矛而言就如同一根小小的棍子。

overtime.zh: 他们支付每天150元的报酬，外加加班费。

overtime.en: This new order will mean working overtime.
overtime.zh: 这新订单一来，我们就得加班加点。

overtime.en: I also put in a request for some overtime.
overtime.zh: 我也提出了支付加班费的请求。

ledge.en: She put the vase of flowers on the window ledge.
ledge.zh: 她把那瓶花放在窗台上。

ledge.en: Dorothy had climbed onto the ledge outside his window.
ledge.zh: 多萝西已经爬到了他窗台外面。

ledge.en: He cupped his hands and gave her a boost up to the ledge.
ledge.zh: 他双手拢作杯状把她托上了窗台。

dorm.en: The dorm will remain open until 5 pm.
dorm.zh: 宿舍将一直开放到下午5点。

dorm.en: You've had bull sessions with your high school friends or in your college dorm.
dorm.zh: 你们和你们的高中朋友们或在大学宿舍有过自由讨论。

dorm.en: Some parents would rather their children rent houses outside the school instead of living a dorm.
dorm.zh: 有些家长宁愿自己的孩子出去租房住，也不想他们住在学校的寝室里。

mediation.en: The agreement provides for United Nations mediation between the two sides.
mediation.zh: 该协议为联合国对双方的调解奠定了基础。

mediation.en: All efforts of mediation by a third party were in vain at all.
mediation.zh: 第三方所作的从中调解的一切努力均告失败。

mediation.en: This rule is an exception to the above rule of not setting mediation properties during this phase.
mediation.zh: 本条规则是上述要求不在此阶段设置中介属性的那条规则的一个例外。

chimney.en: A shower of sparks flew up the chimney.

chimney.zh: 这些烟囱管帽纯属装饰。

lateral.en: Jets of compressed air gave the aircraft lateral and directional stability.
lateral.zh: 压缩气体喷流从侧面和正面稳定了机身。

lateral.en: McKinnon estimated the lateral movement of the bridge to be between four and six inches.
lateral.zh: 麦金农估计大桥的横向移动范围在4到6英寸之间。

lateral.en: Auxin also causes the plant to develop a vascular system, to form lateral roots, and to produce ethylene.
lateral.zh: 生长素还能使植物形成维管系统，形成侧根，并产生乙烯。

aroma.en: A faint aroma of coffee attracted his attention.
aroma.zh: 一股淡淡的咖啡香味吸引了他的注意。

aroma.en: A tantalizing aroma of roast beef fills the air.
aroma.zh: 烤牛肉诱人的香味弥漫在空气中。

aroma.en: The heady aroma of wood smoke emanated from the stove.
aroma.zh: 木头燃烧的浓郁香味从炉子里散发出来。

groove.en: The cupboard door slides open along the groove.
We are all unique, so we have to find our own groove and start listening to ourselves.
groove.zh: 我们都是独一无二的，所以我们必须找到自己的最佳状态，然后听从自己的。

groove.en: My life seems to be in a groove, I do the same things day after day.
groove.zh: 我的生活似乎很单调，我日复一日地做着同样的事情。

thwart.en: The security forces were doing all they could to thwart terrorists.
thwart.zh: 安全部队正尽其所能挫败恐怖分子。

thwart.en: In The Avengers, the all-star ensemble must thwart a possible world-ending scheme devised by Thor's villainous brother Loki.
thwart.zh: 在《复仇者联盟》中，众星云集，必须要阻止雷神的邪恶兄弟洛基设计的可能毁灭世界的计划。

thwart.en: The Decade can help thwart this needless loss of life.
thwart.zh: 行动十年将有助于减少这种不必要的生命损失。

buffet.en: Dinner will be a cold buffet, not a sit-down meal.
buffet.zh: 主餐是自助冷食，不是坐着等服务员送来的那种。

buffet.en: At lunchtime, there's a choice between the buffet or the set menu.
buffet.zh: 午饭时，可以选择自助餐或套餐。

buffet.en: It is a buffet, right? I love wedding buffets.
buffet.zh: 那是一个自助餐，对吗？我最喜欢婚礼自助餐了。

relay.en: They raced to a thrilling victory in the relay.
relay.zh: 他们在接力赛中取得了激动人心的胜利。

relay.en: The satellite will be used mainly to relay television programmes.
relay.zh: 这颗卫星将主要用来转播电视节目。

relay.en: Britain's prospects of beating the United States in the relay looked poor.
relay.zh: 英国队在接力赛中战胜美国队的希望看上去不大。

stint.en: We don't need to stint ourselves—have some more!
stint.zh: 我们没必要节省—再吃点！

stint.en: He did a stint abroad early in his career.
stint.zh: 他早先在国外干过一段时间。

stint.en: While serving a compulsory stint in the military, Nurmi entered a 20-k march carrying a rifle, a cartridge belt, and a knapsack.
stint.zh: 在军中服义务役的时候，努尔米带着一支步枪、一条子弹带和一个背包参加了20公里行军。

fin.en: Help save the sharks! Shark fin soup is popular in northern China.
fin.zh: 帮助拯救鲨鱼！鱼翅汤在中国北方很流行。

fin.en: Michelle reached out her hand and gently touched the fin of one of the dolphins.
fin.zh: 蜜雪儿伸出她的手，轻柔地触摸着其中一只海豚的鳍。

fin.en: Do they realize that they're killing a whole shark each time they enjoy a bowl of shark fin soup?
fin.zh: 他们是否意识到，每次享用一碗鱼翅汤时，他们就会杀死一整条鲨鱼？

dispense.en: Their members command and dispense many of the rewards that are so vital to us and that make our lives seem worthwhile.
dispense.zh: 群体中的成员掌控并分配能够维持我们生存的、使我们的生活显得有价值的极其重要的资源。
我们可以免去这些客套吗？

dispense.en: Debit cards dispense with the need for cash altogether.
dispense.zh: 有借记卡就完全不需要用现金了。

jog.en: I got up early the next morning to jog.
jog.zh: 我次日清晨早起去慢跑了。

jog.en: We plan to go for a jog together.
People jog and bike up and down there.
jog.zh: 人们在那儿来来回回地慢跑和骑自行车。

lantern.en: The night lantern glowed softly in the darkness.
lantern.zh: 夜灯在黑暗中发出微弱的光。

cruelty.en: Thomas Rane chastised Peters for his cruelty.
cruelty.zh: 托马斯·瑞训斥了彼得斯的残忍。

cruelty.en: The deliberate cruelty of his words cut her like a knife.
cruelty.zh: 他故意说的残酷无情的话对她像刀割一样。

plateau.en: We took a plane southwest across the Anatolian plateau to Cappadocia.
plateau.zh: 我们乘飞机朝西南方,越过安纳托利亚高原,飞往卡帕多细亚。

plateau.en: A broad valley opened up leading to a high, flat plateau of cultivated land.
plateau.zh: 一个宽阔的山谷展开，通向一片平坦的高原耕地。

plateau.en: The Qinghai-Xizang Plateau has long been known as the roof of the world.
plateau.zh: 青藏高原素有世界屋脊之称。

slaughter.zh: 屠宰前要先把动物击昏。

slaughter.en: The slaughter of whales is unnecessary and inhuman.
slaughter.zh: 对鲸的屠宰是不必要且不人道的。

slaughter.en: Lack of chicken feed means that chicken farms are having to slaughter their stock.
slaughter.zh: 饲料不足意味着养鸡场将不得不宰杀鸡。

lily.en: Lily lives in a penthouse just off Park Avenue.
lily.zh: 莉莉住在离公园大街不远的一处顶层公寓里。

lily.en: I have just lent it to Lily.
lily.zh: 我刚刚把它借给了莉莉。
昨天晚上莉莉在做什么？

retrospect.en: The decision seems extremely odd, in retrospect.
retrospect.zh: 回想起来，这个决定显得极其荒谬。

retrospect.en: In retrospect, I wish that I had thought about alternative courses of action.
retrospect.zh: 回想起来，我真希望自己当初考虑过其他的行动方案。

retrospect.en: In retrospect, it is possible to see the uneasy and ambiguous nature of this relationship.
retrospect.zh: 回顾过去，我们可能会看到这种关系不安和模糊的本质。

cosmetic.en: Melanie plunked her cosmetic case down on a chair.
cosmetic.zh: 梅拉妮把化妆盒漫不经心地扔到了椅子上。

cosmetic.en: She received a cosmetic makeover at a beauty salon as a birthday gift.
cosmetic.zh: 作为生日礼物，她得到了在一家美容院美容的机会。

cosmetic.en: A selection of cosmetic companies will be there to demonstrate their new products.
cosmetic.zh: 一些化妆品公司会在那里展示他们的新产品。

socialize.en: We guarantee that you will find a community with which to socialize.
socialize.zh: 我们保证你将找到一个可以社交的团体。

socialize.en: A good way to socialize is to have daily lunch with one's colleagues.
socialize.zh: 一个社交的好方法就是每天和同事一起吃午饭。

socialize.en: It was found that American youngsters today don't socialize nearly as much as the earlier generations.
socialize.zh: 研究发现，如今的美国年轻人不像前几代人那样热衷于社交活动。

grapple.en: They managed to grapple him to the ground.
grapple.zh: 他们终于把他摔倒在地。

grapple.en: The new government has yet to grapple with the problem of air pollution.
grapple.zh: 新政府还需尽力解决空气污染问题。

grapple.en: Managers have learned to grapple with networking, artificial intelligence, computer-aided engineering and manufacturing.
grapple.zh: 管理人员已经学会如何去应付网络、人工智能、计算机辅助工程和制造等问题。

mingle.en: The flowers mingle together to form a blaze of colour.
A preliminary study of a shoal of ten flesh-and-blood sticklebacks shows that they do indeed mingle with therobot.
mingle.zh: 对一个有十条鲜活的棘鱼鱼群的初步研究显示，他们确实和那条机器鱼混在了一起。
风格相互冲撞、混淆、融合。

peripheral.en: Fund-raising is peripheral to their main activities.
peripheral.zh: 对他们的主要活动而言，筹集资金是次要的。

peripheral.en: Companies are increasingly eager to contract out peripheral activities like training.
peripheral.zh: 公司越来越渴望把像培训这样的次要活动外包出去。

peripheral.en: The curriculum then becomes peripheral and is dealt with by the reserve capacity of the brain.
peripheral.zh: 然后，课程就变成了次要的，就可以被大脑的备用容量所接收了。

stocking.zh: 爱丽丝有一只蓝色的长筒袜。

floral.en: The ornate features of Buckingham Palace will be reflected on the cake, but most of the decorations will be floral, and each has a meaning.
floral.zh: 白金汉宫的华丽特点将蛋糕上反映，但大部分的装饰品都将是花卉，而且每件都蕴含一定的意义。

floral.en: Floral tributes were sent to the church.
floral.zh: 敬献的鲜花已送往教堂。

floral.en: In this living room we've mixed glorious floral prints.
floral.zh: 在这客厅里我们将各种漂亮的花卉图案搭配在了一起。

hospitality.zh: 他们的热情好客人人皆知。
他没有期待我们的热情款待。

hospitality.en: We will always remember his generous hospitality.
hospitality.zh: 我们将永远记住他的慷慨好客。

imperative.en: In 'Go away!' the verb is in the imperative.
imperative.zh: Go away!中的动词是祈使语气动词。

imperative.en: It is absolutely imperative that we finish by next week.
imperative.zh: 我们的当务之急是必须于下周完成。

imperative.en: Beethoven's music tends to move from chaos to order as if order were an imperative of human existence.
imperative.zh: 贝多芬的音乐往往从混乱走向有序，仿佛有序是人类生存的必要条件。

grammar.zh: 他解释了一个语法要点。

grammar.en: He has a good grasp of German grammar.
grammar.zh: 他德语语法掌握得很好。

grammar.en: She was marked down because of poor grammar.
grammar.zh: 她因语法不好被扣了分。

impoverished.en: The goal is to lure businesses into impoverished areas by offering them tax breaks.
impoverished.zh: 目的是通过提供减税优惠把企业吸引到贫困地区。

impoverished.en: Money and food were sent to the impoverished drought victims.
impoverished.zh: 给贫困的灾民送去了救济金和粮食。

impoverished.en: The other group lived in an "impoverished" environment in individual cages in a dimly lit room with little stimulation.
impoverished.zh: 另一组生活在“贫困”的环境中，在光线昏暗、几乎没有刺激的房间里的单独的笼子里。

respectful.en: He was very respectful at home and obedient to his parents.
respectful.zh: 他在家里很尊重人而且顺从父母。

respectful.en: The children in our family are always respectful to their elders.
respectful.zh: 我们家的孩子们总是很尊敬他们的长辈。

indifferent.zh: 他缄默无言，对人疏远而且冷漠。

indifferent.en: She had starred in several very indifferent movies.
indifferent.zh: 她领衔主演过好几部非常平庸的电影。

indifferent.en: Her dull and indifferent husband replied that he had not.
indifferent.zh: 她那迟钝而冷漠的丈夫回答说他没有。

humidity.zh: 这种潮湿使人越来越难以忍受了。
炎热与潮湿令人难以忍受。

ominous.en: The hooting of an owl came over the hill--ominous sound!
ominous.zh: 山那边传来猫头鹰的叫声——不吉利的声音！

ominous.en: IPBES chair Robert Watson says the "overwhelming evidence" presents an "ominous picture".
ominous.zh: IPBES 主席罗伯特·沃森说，“压倒性的证据”呈现出一种“不祥之兆”。

ominous.en: However, if the "click" of an opening door is part of an ominous action such as a burglary, the sound mixer may call attention to the "click" with an increase in volume.
ominous.zh: 然而，如果开门的“咔哒”声是入室抢劫之类的不祥之兆，混音器可能会提高音量，提醒人们注意这个声音。

martyr.zh: 她长期忍受神经紧张之苦。

martyr.en: Edgar was a martyr to his sense of honour and responsibility.
martyr.zh: 埃德加深为他的荣誉感和责任感所累。

howl.en: They listened to the howl of the wind through the trees.
howl.zh: 他们听着风在林间呼啸的声音。

cricket.en: The standard of professional cricket has never been lower.
cricket.zh: 职业板球的水平从来没这么低过。

cricket.en: There was precious little about the cricket to animate the crowd.
cricket.zh: 这场板球比赛极少有让观众兴奋的地方。

cricket.en: During the summer term we would play cricket at the village ground.
cricket.zh: 夏季学期里我们常在村里的空地上玩板球。

modernization.en: Successful agricultural reform is also a sine qua non of Mexico's modernization.
modernization.zh: 成功的农业改革也是墨西哥实现现代化的必要条件。

modernization.en: Modernization will bring a number of benefits to Chinese people.
modernization.zh: 现代化将给中国人民带来许多好处。

modernization.en: We must achieve modernization of science and technology, otherwise we will lag behind other nations.
modernization.zh: 我们必须实现科学技术的现代化，否则我们就会落后于其他国家。

rotten.en: The pond was choked with rotten leaves.
rotten.zh: 池塘被腐烂的叶子塞满了。

deceive.zh: 我厌恶那些欺骗我的人。

deceive.en: It is to deceive the whole country and the princess too!
deceive.zh: 这是欺骗整个国家和公主！

coating.en: In industry, diamond can form a tough, non-corrosive coating for tools.
coating.zh: 在工业中，钻石可以制成工具上的一层坚硬且耐腐蚀的涂层。

coating.en: Fluorescent lights use electricity to excite mercury vapor. This produces ultraviolet light that causes a phosphor coating inside the bulb to glow.
coating.zh: 荧光灯用电激发水银蒸气。这会生成紫外线光而使得镀在灯管内壁上的磷涂层发光.

coating.en: We put on the second coating of lacquer.

ethanol.en: In fact, most biofuels are still based on ethanol.
ethanol.zh: 事实上，大多数生物燃料仍然以乙醇为基础。

ethanol.en: Ethanol is corrosive and has less energy per litre than petrol and diesel.
ethanol.zh: 乙醇具有腐蚀性，每升的能源比汽油和柴油少。

ethanol.en: I've got some notes here about the process of turning plant-matter into ethanol.
ethanol.zh: 我这有些笔记，记录了把植物体转变成乙醇的过程。

vodka.zh: 他们喝伏特加酒醉倒了。

vodka.en: He had drunk himself unconscious on vodka.
vodka.zh: 他喝伏特加酒喝得不省人事。

crane.en: The cargo was hoisted aboard by crane.
crane.zh: 货物由起重机吊上了船。

crane.en: The load was lifted by means of a crane.
crane.zh: 重物是用起重机吊起来的。

crane.en: A crane had to be used to haul the car out of the stream.
crane.zh: 不得不用了一台起重机把轿车从河里拉出来。

relic.en: The building stands as the last remaining relic of the town's cotton industry.
relic.zh: 这座建筑物是小镇棉纺业仅存的遗迹。

relic.en: It's relic from earlier times and it has survived all these years without much change.
relic.zh: 这是更早期的遗迹，这些年一直存在，没有太多变化。

relic.en: Let' s say our scientific analysis has produced an age range when a cultural relic was produced.
relic.zh: 让我们来假设我们的科学分析已经得出了某项文物产生的年代范围。

vie.zh: 法国人说道：“这就是生活。”

vie.en: In a champagne glass pour EAU DE VIE DE FRAMBOISE and 1 Fresh Raspberry.
vie.zh: 在一个香槟杯里倒覆盆子白兰地和一个新鲜树莓。

vie.en: This limitation in time is most clearly seen whether it be an estate held for the life of the tenant, or what is called an estate pur autre vie.
vie.zh: 无论是在租户的整个生命周期内持有的房地产，还是所谓的房地产竞争，时间限制是最清晰可见的。

crow.en: The wings of a crow can never cover up the sun.
crow.zh: 乌鸦的翅膀遮不住太阳。

crow.en: She gave a little crow of triumph.
crow.zh: 她轻轻地发出了胜利的欢呼声。

crow.en: He wanted to make his critics eat crow.
crow.zh: 他想迫使批评他的人们认错。

variability.en: There's a great deal of variability between individuals.
variability.zh: 个体之间存在着很大的可变性。

variability.en: A high degree of soil variability in a small area is common, particularly within forests.
variability.zh: 小范围内的高度土壤变异是很常见的，特别是在森林里。

variability.en: Studies suggest that to date the variability in computer simulations is considerably smaller than in data obtained from the proxy records.
variability.zh: 研究表明，迄今为止，计算机模拟的可变性比从代理记录中获得的数据要小得多。

churn.en: He began to churn out literary compositions in English.
churn.zh: 他开始用英文很快地创作出大量的文学作品。

churn.en: Occasionally dolphins slap the water with their tails or churn it up in play.
churn.zh: 海豚偶尔会在戏耍时用它们的尾巴拍打海水或剧烈地翻腾海水。

churn.en: The state's refineries already churn out more than five times as much of the stuff as its small stock of dairy cattle can eat.
churn.zh: 该州的精炼厂已经生产出的饲料数量是其小型奶牛可食用量的五倍以上。

irregular.zh: 她考了我们的不规则动词。
不规则形式标注在括号内。

decree.en: An official decree invalidated the vote in the capital.
decree.zh: 一项官方法令使首都的投票失去了效力。

decree.en: In July he issued a decree ordering all unofficial armed groups in the country to disband.
decree.zh: 7月份，他颁布了一项法令，命令解散该国所有非官方武装团体。

decree.en: He backed a provision that would allow judges to delay granting a divorce decree in some cases.
decree.zh: 他支持允许法官在有些情况下推迟离婚判决的规定。

abstraction.en: Across society, the abstraction of the idea of cash makes me uneasy.
abstraction.zh: 纵观整个社会，对现金概念的抽象化让我感到不安。

abstraction.en: But across society, the abstraction of the idea of cash makes me uneasy.
abstraction.zh: 但在整个社会，对现金概念的抽象让我感到不安。

abstraction.en: Has not twentieth-century art shown that naturalism does not necessarily follow abstraction in some kind of predetermined sequence?
abstraction.zh: 二十世纪的艺术不是已经表明，自然主义不一定遵循某种既定顺序的抽象了吗？

transitional.en: Missing until recently were fossils clearly intermediate, or transitional, between land mammals and cetaceans.
transitional.zh: 直到最近才发现的化石，显然是介于陆地哺乳动物和鲸类之间的过渡物种。

transitional.en: Other features, however, show experts that Pakicetus is a transitional form between a group of extinct flesh-eating mammals, the mesonychids, and cetaceans.
transitional.zh: 然而，专家认为巴基鲸是已经灭绝的食肉哺乳动物中爪类和鲸类之间的过渡物种。

transitional.en: Poverty levels omit the transitional dynamics between levels.
transitional.zh: 贫困水平忽略了水平之间的过渡动态。

collaborator.en: You certainly shouldn't ditch teamwork, but how can you avoid the hazards of being an over-collaborator?
collaborator.zh: 你当然不应该放弃团队合作。但如何才能避免过度合作带来的风险呢？

collaborator.en: Have a collaborator stand at the exit.
collaborator.zh: 让一位合作者站在出口处。

collaborator.en: This collaborator must be replaced with a mock object.
collaborator.zh: 必须用模仿对象替换这个合作者。

downturn.zh: 他们预言将会有一次严重的经济衰退。

downturn.en: The current economic downturn is markedly different from previous recessions.
downturn.zh: 目前的经济衰退和以前的经济衰退明显不同。

downturn.en: "Even before the downturn, companies were looking for individuals with strong communication skills," Fay says.
downturn.zh: Fay 说：“即使是在低迷时期之前，公司也在寻找有强大沟通技巧的人。”

prominence.en: He came to prominence during the World Cup.
prominence.zh: 他在该世界杯期间一举成名。

prominence.en: Crime prevention had to be given more prominence.
prominence.zh: 犯罪预防得给予更多重视。

prominence.en: The newspapers have given undue prominence to the story.
prominence.zh: 报章对这件事的报道太多了。

lesion.en: The histopathological lesion is localized at these sites.
lesion.zh: 组织病理学损伤局限于这些部位。

lesion.en: Studying it therefore became known as the lesion method.
lesion.zh: 像这种的局部大脑损伤被神经学家称之为机能障碍，研究机能障碍的方法因此被称为机能障碍法。

lesion.en: The photomicrograph shown was taken from aleprosy skin lesion.
lesion.zh: 上图为显微镜拍摄到的皮肤病变部位的麻风杆菌。

butcher.en: Look on the label or ask your butcher.
butcher.zh: 看看标签或询问你的屠夫。

butcher.en: It's about music, which is too good for the butcher.
butcher.zh: 这是关于音乐的，对屠夫来说已经太好了。

temperament.zh: 他惟一的弱点是他的脾气。

temperament.en: Her mental capacity and temperament are as remarkable as his.
temperament.zh: 她的智慧和气质与他的同样出众。

temperament.en: His impulsive temperament regularly got him into difficulties.
temperament.zh: 他容易冲动的性格经常使他陷入困境。

cannon.en: Where is your Italian cannon? Get it up here!
cannon.zh: 你他娘的意大利炮呢，给我拉上来！

cannon.en: The stillness of the night was broken by the boom of a cannon.
cannon.zh: 夜晚的寂静被大炮的轰鸣声打破了。

cannon.en: We heard the bang of a cannon.
cannon.zh: 我们听到轰的一声炮响。

oblivious.en: You eventually become oblivious to the noise.
oblivious.zh: 你终究会变得不在意吵闹声的。

oblivious.en: He drove off, oblivious of the damage he had caused.
oblivious.zh: 他车开走了，没有注意到他所造成的损害。

oblivious.en: She lay motionless where she was, oblivious to pain.
oblivious.zh: 她一动不动地躺在原地，感觉不到疼痛。

multitude.en: It was an elite that believed its task was to enlighten the multitude.
multitude.zh: 精英人物都会认为自己的职责就是启迪群众。
他向聚集在那里的民众布道。

multitude.en: There are a multitude of small, quiet roads to cycle along.
multitude.zh: 有多条可以骑自行车的僻静小路。

knit.zh: 织一趟平针，织一趟反针。
菲立斯穿着一件织得厚厚的毛衣。

convoy.en: Attackers fired machine guns at the convoy.
convoy.zh: 袭击者们向护运车队开机枪。

convoy.en: The UN convoy was mined on its way to the border.
convoy.zh: 联合国车队在驶往边界的途中触雷被炸。

convoy.en: A United Nations aid convoy loaded with food and medicine finally got through to the besieged town.
convoy.zh: 一支联合国援助车队载着食物和药物终于抵达了被围困的市镇。

vitality.en: It was a performance of verve and vitality.
vitality.zh: 这是一场充满激情与活力的演出。

vitality.en: Without continued learning, graduates will lose their intellectual vitality.
vitality.zh: 如果不继续学习，毕业生们就会失去他们的思维活力。

degrade.en: Jays prefer crickets, but crickets degrade more quickly.
degrade.zh: 松鸡喜欢蟋蟀，但蟋蟀退化得更快。

degrade.en: Certain irrigation practices degrade soil quality and reduce agricultural productivity.
degrade.zh: 某些灌溉措施会降低土壤质量，降低农业生产力。

degrade.en: The main reason was that steel cables degrade very, very quickly in contact with saltwater.
degrade.zh: 主要原因是钢索与盐水接触后降解非常快。

cumulative.en: It's very close, but overall the cumulative effects of cloud are to cool Earth rather than heat it.
cumulative.zh: 这十分相近，但是总体上来说，云的累积作用是降低地球的温度而不是让地球升温。

cumulative.en: Tomorrow, we will dump a slightly larger amount, with the cumulative concentrations now trapping more and more heat from the sun.
cumulative.zh: 明天，我们会释放出更大的量，累积的浓度现在会吸收越来越多的来自太阳的热量。

cumulative.en: The condition appears to result from the cumulative effect of a number of factors, with atmospheric pollutants the principal culprits.
cumulative.zh: 这种情况似乎是由许多因素的累积的结果，而大气污染物是主要的罪魁祸首。

disruptive.zh: 酒能促成暴力的和破坏性的行为。

disruptive.en: Overfishing can be seriously disruptive to coral.
disruptive.zh: 过度捕捞会严重破坏珊瑚。

disruptive.en: The crisis will prove hugely disruptive, however.
disruptive.zh: 然而，这场危机将显示出极大的破坏性。

nylon.en: The chair is made of lightweight nylon.
nylon.zh: 那把椅子是由轻质尼龙制作的。

nylon.en: The door had been tied shut with a length of nylon cord.
nylon.zh: 这扇门已经被一段尼龙绳紧紧栓住了。

lag.en: Western banks still lag behind financial institutions in most other regions of the country.
lag.zh: 西部地区的银行仍然落后于这个国家其他大部分地区的金融机构。

lag.en: There's a time lag between infection with HIV and developing AIDS.
lag.zh: 从感染艾滋病病毒到发展成为艾滋病病人有一定的时间间隔。

lag.en: There is a long time lag between when I do the work and when I get paid.
lag.zh: 我做工作和领薪水之间相隔很长一段时间。

diploma.en: Satisfactory completion of the course will lead to the award of the Diploma of Social Work.
diploma.zh: 合格完成此课程者将获得社会福利工作文凭。

diploma.en: Only 18.8% of the class of 1982 had some kind of diploma four years after high school, versus 45% of the class of 1972.
diploma.zh: 相对于1972届学生中有45%在中学毕业4年后获得了某种文凭来说，1982届学生的这一比例只有18.8%。

diploma.en: I've just finished Level 2 diploma on design.
diploma.zh: 我刚刚获得了二级设计文凭。

outskirts.en: They live on the outskirts of Milan.

outskirts.zh: 随着他们越来越接近市郊，埃拉的心情明显变得轻松了。

outskirts.en: He did not take the direct route to his home, but made a detour around the outskirts of the city.
outskirts.zh: 他没有直接回家，而是在市郊绕了一段路。

lash.en: She went quiet for a moment while she summoned up the words to lash him.
lash.zh: 她沉默了一会儿，想了些话来怒斥他。

lash.en: When this happens you might lash out.
lash.zh: 哇，哇，哇，当这一切发生的时候，你可能会大肆宣泄。

abide.en: They have got to abide by the rules.
You'll have to abide by the rules of the club.
abide.zh: 你必须遵守俱乐部的规定。

abide.en: I can't abide people who can't make up their minds.
abide.zh: 我无法容忍下定不了决心的人。

enclose.en: Please enclose your remittance, making checks payable to Valley Technology Services.
enclose.zh: 请随信附上您的汇款，支票收款方为瓦利科技服务公司。
请附上写明姓名地址的回邮信封。

enclose.en: I enclose two tickets along with this letter.

insulation.en: Better insulation of your home will help to reduce heating bills.
insulation.zh: 增加房子的隔热性能会有助于减少供暖费用。

insulation.en: High electricity bills point to a poor heating system or bad insulation.
insulation.zh: 高额的电费账单表明供暖系统较差或者是隔热材料不好。

insulation.en: The plastic resin is used in a wide range of products, including electrical wire insulation.
insulation.zh: 塑料合成树脂被广泛应用到各种产品中，包括电线的绝缘层。

accumulation.en: The funds needed will mainly be drawn from accumulation within the enterprise.
accumulation.zh: 所需资金主要取给于企业内部的积累。

accumulation.en: And whether the community's work contributes much to an overall accumulation of knowledge is doubtful.
accumulation.zh: 社区的工作对知识的全面积累是否有很大的贡献，这一点是值得怀疑的。

accumulation.en: One study found that muscle loss and the accumulation of body fat around the abdomen are associated with a decline in fluid intelligence.
accumulation.zh: 一项研究发现，肌肉减少和腹部体脂堆积与流体智力下降有关。

fluctuation.en: Changes in climate before that period caused severe fluctuation in sea level, resulting in the extinction of the dinosaurs.
fluctuation.zh: 在此之前，气候的变化导致了海平面的剧烈波动，恐龙因此灭绝。

fluctuation.en: Changes in climate before the Cretaceous period caused severe fluctuation in sea level, resulting in the extinction of the dinosaurs.
fluctuation.zh: 白垩纪以前的气候变化导致了海平面的剧烈波动，引发了恐龙的灭绝。

fluctuation.en: Since potential markets for the minority businesses already exist through the sponsoring companies, the minority businesses face considerably less risk in terms of location and market fluctuation.
fluctuation.zh: 由于少数族裔企业的潜在市场已经通过赞助公司而存在，因此少数族裔企业面临的地理位置和市场波动风险要小得多。

imprison.en: Pitcher plants use yet another strategy, growing long tube-shaped leaves to imprison their prey.
imprison.zh: 猪笼草使用了另一种策略，它们长出长长的管状叶子来囚禁猎物。
他们通常不监禁初次犯罪的人。

imprison.en: No strainers, muslin bags or other devices to imprison the tea.
imprison.zh: 别用过滤器、薄纱袋、或是其他装置把茶叶禁锢起来。

irritate.en: Some drugs can irritate the lining of the stomach.
irritate.zh: 有些药物会刺激胃内壁。

irritate.en: Wear rubber gloves while chopping chillies as they can irritate the skin.
irritate.zh: 剁辣椒时戴上橡皮手套，因为它们会刺激皮肤。

irritate.en: In fact, this may irritate some people.
irritate.zh: 事实上，这可能会激怒一些人。

retaliation.en: The armed forces were on high alert to guard against any retaliation.
retaliation.zh: 武装部队保持高度警惕，以防发生任何报复行为。

retaliation.en: Community and church leaders have appealed for calm and no retaliation.
retaliation.zh: 社区和教会领袖呼吁人们保持冷静，不要采取报复行动。

retaliation.en: Police said they believed the attack was in retaliation for the death of the drug trafficker.
retaliation.zh: 警方说他们认为这起袭击是为那个毒贩的死而实施的报复。

flare.en: Solar flare activity is going to be much worse than what we've seen in the past.
flare.zh: 太阳耀斑活动将比我们过去看到的更糟糕。

flare.en: The flare of the match lit up his face.
flare.zh: 火柴的光照亮了他的脸。

flare.en: The sleeves are tight to the elbow, then flare out.
flare.zh: 袖子在肘部收紧，接着逐渐展开。

tasty.en: Although it is tasty, crab is very filling.
tasty.zh: 螃蟹虽然好吃，但很容易让人饱。

tasty.en: You don't have to spend a fortune to give your family tasty, healthy meals.
tasty.zh: 让家里人吃味道好又健康的餐食并不需要花许多钱。

worsen.en: We were worried that one tiny jolt could worsen her injuries.
worsen.zh: 我们担心一次轻微的颠簸都可能加剧她的伤情。

worsen.en: It may worsen the nourishment problem in low-income countries.
worsen.zh: 它可能会加剧低收入国家的营养问题。

worsen.en: If the food situation continues to worsen, entire nations will break down at an ever increasing rate.
worsen.zh: 如果粮食状况持续恶化，那整个世界将以越来越快的速度崩溃。

devour.en: The dogs come and devour the bacon.

devour.zh: 好奇的狮子们把穿山甲像足球一样传来传去，花了好几个小时试图吃掉这个被盔甲包裹的生物。

devour.en: A medium-sized dog will devour at least one can of food plus biscuits per day.
devour.zh: 一只中等大小的狗每天至少要干掉一罐食物外加饼干。

parasite.en: One of the ways the parasite spreads is through faecal matter.
parasite.zh: 寄生物传播的方式之一就是透过排泄物。

parasite.en: Schistosomiasis is diagnosed through the detection of parasite eggs in stool or urine specimens.
parasite.zh: 血吸虫病的诊断方法是，检测粪便或尿液标本中寄生虫卵。

parasite.en: An example of a parasite is a tapeworm that lives inside the intestines of a larger animal and absorbs nutrients from its host.
parasite.zh: 寄生虫的一个典例是绦虫，它生活在更大的动物的肠道内，从宿主那里吸收营养。

cock.en: The cock crows and the dawn chorus begins.
cock.zh: 公鸡叫了,众鸟的清晨鸣唱随之开始了。

cock.en: Do you hear the cock crow, Tukey?
cock.zh: 杜克，你听到公鸡叫了吗？

cock.en: The hen did this and the cock was cheerful again.
cock.zh: 母鸡照做了，公鸡又高兴了。

handkerchief.zh: 这条手绢镶着网眼花边。

handkerchief.en: He dabbed at the cut with his handkerchief.
handkerchief.zh: 他用手帕轻轻按了按伤口。

handkerchief.en: He polished his glasses with a handkerchief.

simplify.en: Our aim is to simplify the complex social security system.
simplify.zh: 我们的目的是要简化复杂的社会保险体系。

simplify.en: Although the bounding box is a polygon defining the area represented for the user, I simplify and use one point of this data.
simplify.zh: 尽管这个边界框是一个用于定义表示用户的区域的多边形，但我简化并使用该数据的一个点。

simplify.en: Though we've never had a catastrophic loss such as that, Gibbs and I did have a close call shortly before we decided to simplify.
simplify.zh: 虽然我们从未经历过那样的灾难性损失，但吉布斯和我确实在我们决定简化程序之前进行了一次简短的密切通话。

noticeable.en: It was noticeable how a few people managed to impose their will on the others.
noticeable.zh: 显而易见，有少数几个人设法把自己的意志强加于别人。

noticeable.en: Notifications have to be noticeable, but not annoying.
noticeable.zh: 通知必须是显而易见的，但不能让人厌烦。

noticeable.en: It was noticeable that none of the family were present.
noticeable.zh: 很明显这一家没有人在场。

sensory.en: Both motor and sensory functions are affected.
sensory.zh: 运动功能和感觉功能都受到影响。

sensory.en: Almost all sensory information from the trunk and limbs passes through the spinal cord.
sensory.zh: 几乎所有来自躯干及四肢的感官信息都经由脊髓传递。

sensory.en: These ranged from "sensory leakage"—where clues about the pictures accidentally reach the receiver—to outright fraud.
sensory.zh: 其中包括“感官泄露”——接受者意外地获得了有关图像的线索——延伸到彻头彻尾的欺骗。

complementary.en: He has done experiments complementary to those of Eigen.
complementary.zh: 他已经做了与艾根的实验互补的实验。

complementary.en: The team members have different but complementary skills.
complementary.zh: 队员技术不同但能互补。

complementary.en: The school's approach must be complementary to that of the parents.
complementary.zh: 学校与家长的教育方法必须相辅相成。

envy.en: I envy you having such a close family.
envy.zh: 我羡慕你有这么一个亲密的家庭。

envy.en: Their economy is the envy of the developing world.
envy.zh: 他们的经济令发展中国家羡慕。
我庆幸不必干她的那份工作。

radiate.zh: 五条道路由广场向外延伸。

radiate.en: Callahan posits that chemical elements radiate electromagnetic signals.
radiate.zh: 卡拉汉假定化学元素放射电磁信号。

radiate.en: Many kinds of woodland can be seen on the various walks which radiate from the Heritage Centre.
radiate.zh: 从遗产中心向外伸展的各条走道上可以看到多种林地。

pry.en: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to pry.
pry.zh: 对不起，我并不想刺探别人的私事。

pry.en: Sometimes he wakes up excited to work, and on other days you couldn't pry him off the couch with a forklift.
pry.zh: 有时他一醒来就兴奋地工作，但其他日子里你用叉车都无法把他从沙发上撬下来。

pry.en: Don't pry into private life of others.
pry.zh: 不要窥探别人的私生活。

denomination.en: Realizing that this type of hyperinflation and denomination increase was not sustainable, the Pengo was replaced by the Forint.
denomination.zh: 意识到了这种程度的恶性通货膨胀和面值的增加速度没法维持下去，匈牙利平格就被新货币福林所取代。

denomination.en: This so-called "denomination effect" can be a powerful predictor of consumer spending habits.
denomination.zh: 这种所谓的“计价效应”在预测消费习惯方面非常灵验。

denomination.en: "The letters' CD 'denote 'Church of Dentistry'," the man with a mask said, pointing to the door. "it is a fact a denomination of the New Wave Church."
denomination.zh: “字母‘CD’表示‘Church of Dentistry’，即牙科教会，”戴口罩的男人指着门说，“事实上它是‘新浪潮教会’的一个宗派组织。”

whereby.en: They have introduced a new system whereby all employees must undergo regular training.
whereby.zh: 他们采用了新的制度，所有的雇员都必须定期进行培训。

whereby.en: The two colleges have a reciprocal arrangement whereby students from one college can attend classes at the other.
whereby.zh: 两所学院有一项互惠协定，允许学生在院际间选课。

whereby.en: The company operates an arrangement whereby employees may select any 8-hour period between 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. to go to work.
whereby.zh: 该公司做出了一种安排，据此员工可以在上午6点到晚上8点之间任意选择8个小时去上班。

mystical.en: That was clearly a deep mystical experience.
mystical.zh: 那显然是一次刻骨铭心的神秘经历。

mystical.en: As a clergyman's son he'd imbibed a set of mystical beliefs from the cradle.
mystical.zh: 作为牧师之子，他从襁褓时就耳濡目染并接受了一套神秘信仰。

mystical.en: Watching the sun rise over the mountain was an almost mystical experience.
mystical.zh: 看着太阳爬上山冈，这几乎是一种难以言传的体验。

customary.en: It is customary to offer a drink or a snack to guests.
customary.zh: 通常用饮料或小吃招待客人。

customary.en: In the United States, it is not customary to telephone somenone very early in the morning.
customary.zh: 在美国，人们不习惯在大清早给人打电话。

customary.en: Church records show he was baptized on April 26, and three days was a customary amount of time to wait before baptizing a newly born baby.
customary.zh: 教会记录显示，他于4月26日受洗，在为新生婴儿施洗之前，通常需要等待三天。

consolidation.en: The most surprising bout of consolidation and revival has been in Latin America.
consolidation.zh: 最令人惊讶的整合与复活发生在拉丁美洲。

consolidation.en: Some experts believe that if the trend continues for much longer, further consolidation in the automotive sector is likely.
consolidation.zh: 一些专家认为，如果这种趋势持续更长时间，汽车行业的进一步合并是可能的。

consolidation.en: Some experts believe that if the trend continues for much longer, further consolidation in the automotive sector is likely .
consolidation.zh: 一些专家认为，如果这种趋势持续更长时间，汽车行业的进一步合并是可能的。

stigma.en: Recognising obesity as a chronic disease with severe complications rather than a lifestyle choice "should help reduce the stigma and discrimination experienced by many people with obesity," he adds.
stigma.zh: 认识到肥胖是一种伴有严重并发症的慢性疾病，而不是一种生活方式的选择，“应该有助于减少许多肥胖人士所经历的耻辱和歧视。”他补充道。

stigma.en: There is no longer any stigma attached to being divorced.
stigma.zh: 离婚不再是什么丢脸的事。

stigma.en: A recent study found that absence claims labels can create a stigma around foods even when there is no scientific evidence that they cause harm.
stigma.zh: 最近的一项研究发现，即使没有科学证据表明食品有害，带有“不含”字样的标签也会使其污名化。

humane.en: In the mid-nineteenth century, Dorothea Dix began to campaign for humane treatment of the mentally ill.
humane.zh: 在19世纪中叶，多罗西娅·迪克斯发起了为精神病患者争取人道待遇的运动。

humane.en: Since 1975 advocates of humane treatment of animals have broadened their goals to oppose the use of animals for fur,leather, wool and food.
humane.zh: 自1975年以来，人道对待动物的倡导者们将他们的目标扩大到反对用动物做毛皮、皮革、羊毛和食物。

humane.en: Since 1975 advocates of humane treatment of animals have broadened their goals to oppose the use of animals for fur, leather, wool and food.
humane.zh: 自1975年以来，提倡人道对待动物的人拓宽了他们的目标——反对用动物来获取毛皮、皮革、毛织物和食物。

boycott.en: We are asking people to boycott goods from companies that use child labour.
boycott.zh: 我们正呼吁大家抵制雇用童工的公司的产品。

boycott.en: A spokesman says the president has backed off from his threat to boycott the conference.
boycott.zh: 一位发言人说，总统已经撤回了他抵制这次会谈的威胁。

boycott.en: T. H. Breen argued that the consumer boycott was a brilliantly original American invention.
boycott.zh: T. H. Breen 认为，消费者抵制运动是美国的一项杰出发明。

referee.zh: 裁判叫停了那场拳击赛。

skim.en: Skim the jam and let it cool.
skim.zh: 撇去果酱上的浮沫，让它冷却。

skim.en: Skim the scum off the jam and let it cool.
skim.zh: 撇去果酱上的浮沫，让它冷却。

skim.en: I always skim the financial section of the newspaper.
skim.zh: 我总要浏览一下报纸上的财经版。

pudding.en: All that she would have to do was warm up the pudding.
pudding.zh: 她所需要做的只是加热布丁。

pudding.en: We found the apple pie pudding too good to resist. Sure enough, it was delicious.
pudding.zh: 我们觉得这块苹果馅饼布丁令人无法抗拒。果然，它很美味。

intuition.zh: 她的得体和直觉从不出错。

intuition.en: Her intuition was telling her that something was wrong.
intuition.zh: 她的直觉在告诉她事情有些不对头。
直觉可能会影响反思性任务。

deceased.en: The navy is notifying next of kin now that the identities of the deceased have been determined.
deceased.zh: 死者的身份已得到确认，海军正在通知其最近的家属。

deceased.en: Recreating a deceased famous actor or actress may violate their legitimate rights.
deceased.zh: 再现已故的著名演员可能会侵犯他们的合法权利。

deceased.en: More CGI-recreated images of deceased celebrities are expected to appear on screen.
deceased.zh: 预计将有更多已故名人的电脑合成图像出现在银幕上。

accustomed.en: Some are so accustomed to pigging out, they can't cut back.
accustomed.zh: 有些人习惯暴饮暴食了，他们不可能缩减食量。

accustomed.en: Mary Jo is still accustomed to travelling everywhere in style.
accustomed.zh: 玛丽·乔仍然习惯于很有气派地到处旅行。

accustomed.en: She was a person accustomed to having eight hours' sleep a night.
accustomed.zh: 她是那种习惯每晚睡八个小时的人。

refrigerate.zh: 做好后舀到碗里放进冰箱。

refrigerate.en: He said it's best to refrigerate them.
refrigerate.zh: 他说，此类产品最好冷藏。

reckon.en: I reckon (that) I'm going to get that job.
reckon.zh: 我认为我会得到那份工作。

reckon.en: They reckon (that) their profits are down by at least 20%.
reckon.zh: 他们估计利润至少下降了20%。

overhear.en: They were shut away in a little room where nobody could overhear.
overhear.zh: 他们躲在一个小屋子里，没有人能偷听得到。

overhear.en: Perhaps the neighbours just happened to "overhear" the cry.
overhear.zh: 也许邻居们只是碰巧“听到”了那声喊叫。

overhear.en: I happened to overhear what he said.
overhear.zh: 我碰巧听到了他所说的话。

eccentric.en: Most people considered him a harmless eccentric.
eccentric.zh: 多数人都认为他是一个无伤大雅的怪人。

eccentric.en: Her fey charm and eccentric ways were legendary.
eccentric.zh: 她让人捉摸不定的魅力和无厘头的作风是个传奇。

eccentric.en: Askew used several names, and had a reputation as an eccentric.
eccentric.zh: 艾斯丘用过几个名字，并以“怪人”著称。

fort.en: He made a firm decision to leave Fort Multry by boat.
fort.zh: 他作出了明确的决定，要乘船离开穆尔特里堡。

fort.en: I suspect that she is going to be transferred to Fort Meyer.
fort.zh: 我怀疑她将被调到迈耶堡。

fort.en: The old Dutch fort with its thick high walls looks virtually impregnable.
fort.zh: 该座荷兰老城堡城墙又高又厚，看上去固若金汤。

gracious.en: She is a lovely and gracious woman.
gracious.zh: 她是个可爱而和蔼的女人。

gracious.en: She closed with a gracious speech of thanks.
gracious.zh: 她以彬彬有礼的致谢辞作结。

gracious.en: Good gracious, look at that specimen, will you?
gracious.zh: 天哪，你看看那个家伙，好吗？

diversify.en: The key word here is diversify; don't put all your eggs in one basket.
diversify.zh: 这里的关键词是多样化投资，不要孤注一掷。

diversify.en: Rules need to be set to diversify online services.
diversify.zh: 需要制定规则以促进在线服务多样化。

diversify.en: Admonished by government entomologists, farmers began to diversify.
diversify.zh: 在政府昆虫学家的告诫下，农民们开始多样化种植。

stink.en: How many would say they all stink?
stink.zh: 有多少人会说它们都很臭?

stink.en: There is another obvious problem: farms stink.
stink.zh: 又有一个显著的问题出现：农场的臭味。

doctorate.en: Professor Lanphier obtained his doctorate in social psychology from the University of Michigan.
doctorate.zh: 兰菲尔教授从密歇根大学获得了社会心理学博士学位。

doctorate.en: Imagine mom's surprise when you, who were on your way to a doctorate at Yale and took a few acting classes.
doctorate.zh: 当你在耶鲁大学攻读博士学位时，你去上了几堂表演课。你可以想象妈妈会有多惊讶。

doctorate.en: Vivien Thomas, who had no formal medical training, in struggling against overwhelming odds, he became a cardiac surgeon and eventually to receive an honorary doctorate from Johns Hopkins University.
doctorate.zh: 薇薇安·托马斯没有接受过正式的医学训练，但他努力抗击重重困难，成为了一名心脏外科医生，并最终获得了约翰·霍普金斯大学的荣誉博士学位。

quake.en: The quake destroyed mud buildings in many remote villages.
quake.zh: 地震摧毁了许多偏远村庄的泥土房屋。

quake.en: This voice made the boys gasp and quake.
quake.zh: 这个声音吓得孩子们喘不过气来，直发抖。

grumble.en: All he ever does is grumble about things.
My main grumble is about the lack of privacy.
grumble.zh: 我最大的抱怨是缺乏隐私。

grumble.en: They grumble about how hard they have to work.
grumble.zh: 他们抱怨自己工作得很辛苦。

overthrow.en: I knew you would overthrow me in the end.
overthrow.zh: 我早知道你最终会把我打倒。

overthrow.en: Then Washington hailed his overthrow while the past was erased.
overthrow.zh: 然后华盛顿欢呼着庆祝对其统治的颠覆，而过去则被擦的一干二净。

overthrow.en: Why, work night and day, body and soul, for the overthrow of the human race!
overthrow.zh: 为什么我们没日没夜从身体到灵魂为人类的挥霍而劳作呢！

toxin.en: Tests showed increased levels of toxin in shellfish.
toxin.zh: 测试表明贝类中的毒素级别上升了。

toxin.en: They were close to weaponizing ricin - a lethal plant toxin.
toxin.zh: 他们快把蓖麻毒素——一种致命的植物毒素——研发成武器了。

toxin.en: Other mammals, such as the platypus and some shrews, are venomous, meaning they produce a toxin internally .
toxin.zh: 其他哺乳动物如鸭嘴兽和一些鼩鼱是有毒的，这意味着它们会在体内产生一种毒素。

drawback.en: The main drawback to it is the cost.
drawback.zh: 它的主要缺点是成本高。

drawback.en: This is the one major drawback of the new system.
drawback.zh: 这是新系统的一大弊端。

drawback.en: He felt the apartment's only drawback was that it was too small.
drawback.zh: 他感觉这个公寓惟一的缺点就是太小。

reckless.en: She was a good rider, but reckless.
reckless.zh: 她是个好骑手，但太鲁莽。

reckless.en: He showed a reckless disregard for his own safety.
reckless.zh: 他对个人安危全然无所顾忌。

reckless.en: Many people believe reckless drivers are treated too leniently.
reckless.zh: 很多人认为对鲁莽的司机处理得太宽大了。

foreground.en: He is the bowler-hatted figure in the foreground of Orpen's famous painting.
foreground.zh: 他就是奥彭名画的前景中那个戴圆顶礼帽的人物。

foreground.en: In the foreground, the lobby was dark, sleepy.
foreground.zh: 在前景，大厅是黑暗的，令人昏昏欲睡。

foreground.en: The figure in the foreground is the artist's mother.
foreground.zh: 图画前景中的人是画家的母亲。

freight.en: Trains are taking a lot of freight that used to be routed via trucks.
freight.zh: 火车正在运送过去由卡车运送的大批货物。

freight.en: On the customs declaration, the sender labelled the freight as agricultural machinery.
freight.zh: 在报关单上，发货方将货物列为农业机械。

freight.en: Almost all the world's freight goes by sea, rail, and road.
freight.zh: 世界上几乎所有的货物都是通过海运、铁路和公路运输的。

dazzling.en: He shielded his eyes against the dazzling declining sun.
dazzling.zh: 他遮着眼睛以挡住刺眼的夕阳。
他向艾尔伯格粲然一笑。

dazzling.en: Victoria stood out as a dazzling nonconformist.
dazzling.zh: 维多利亚以令人惊叹的异己形象而引人注目。

announcer.en: The radio announcer said it was nine o'clock.
I wonder if you could tell me a little bit about your job as a radio announcer.
announcer.zh: 我想知道你能否告诉我一些有关你作为电台播音员工作的情况。

vengeance.en: It has grown up with a vengeance.
vengeance.zh: 它带着复仇的心态成长。

vengeance.en: She set to work with a vengeance.
vengeance.zh: 她加倍努力地工作起来。

vengeance.en: It began to rain again with a vengeance.

glossy.en: Her hair was thick, glossy and in tiptop condition.
glossy.zh: 她头发浓密、有光泽且发质一流。

glossy.en: Some cart tops are glossy finished wood.
glossy.zh: 一些推车的搁板是光滑的木制品。

glossy.en: Varnish is the glossy protective layer applied to wooden furniture and other surfaces.
glossy.zh: 清漆是用于木质家具和其他表面的光滑的保护层。

ape.en: Ape conservation tackles both of these issues head on.
ape.zh: 类人猿保护直接解决这两个问题。

ape.en: When humans first emerged as a species, they shared the planet with many types of ape.
ape.zh: 当人类首次作为一个物种出现时，他们依旧跟多种类人猿共存。

ape.en: Kivell and Schmitt think this suggests the independent evolution of knuckle-walking behavior in the two African ape lineages.
ape.zh: 凯威尔和施密特认为这表明了在两个非洲类人猿谱系中关节行走行为的独立进化。

influx.en: The sudden influx of visitors is straining hotels in the town to the limit.
influx.zh: 游客突然涌入，城里的旅馆全都爆满。

influx.en: Schools and social services are also struggling to absorb the influx.
influx.zh: 学校和社会福利部门也在努力接纳突然大批涌入的人群。

influx.en: Originally, it was a Germanic language and then after the Norman Conquest in 1066, there was an enormous influx of French words.
influx.zh: 最初，它是日耳曼语，而在1066年诺曼征服之后，大量法语词汇涌入（英语）。

moth.en: I watched the moth crawl up the outside of the lampshade.
moth.zh: 我看着蛾子爬上灯罩表面。

moth.en: In relay number 70, a moth had been trapped.
moth.zh: 在70号继电器中，一只飞蛾被困住了。

moth.en: They removed the moth, and the program worked.
moth.zh: 他们弄走了飞蛾，程序继续运转。

bacterial.zh: 霍乱是一种由细菌引起的感染。

bacterial.en: The soil is depleted first by crops grown in it and second by bacterial action.
bacterial.zh: 土壤首先被其中生长的农作物消耗，其次被细菌活动消耗。

bacterial.en: It's not just dropping food on the floor that can lead to bacterial contamination.
bacterial.zh: 不仅仅是食物掉在地上会导致细菌污染。

handicap.en: Being a foreigner was not a handicap.
handicap.zh: 作一名外国人并不是一个不利条件。

handicap.en: He lost his leg when he was ten, but learned to overcome his handicap.
handicap.zh: 他10岁时失去了一条腿，但学会了战胜自己的残疾。

handicap.zh: 事实证明不会讲这种语言造成的障碍比我所想象的大。

housewife.zh: 我不喜欢“家庭主妇”这个称谓。

housewife.en: Sometimes being a mother and a housewife felt like a thankless task.
housewife.zh: 做母亲和家庭主妇有时使人觉得好像是个受累不讨好的差使。

housewife.en: Married at nineteen, she was a traditional housewife and mother of four children.
housewife.zh: 她19岁就结婚了，是个传统的家庭主妇和4个孩子的母亲。

hemisphere.en: They say God spoke to them and told them to go on a mission to the poorest country in the Western Hemisphere.
hemisphere.zh: 他们说上帝向他们开口讲话，告诉他们到西半球最贫穷的国家继续进行传教活动。

hemisphere.en: Of course, were they the first people in the Western hemisphere?
hemisphere.zh: 当然，他们是西半球的第一批人吗？

hemisphere.en: It is further divided into four regions, or lobes, in each hemisphere.
hemisphere.zh: 每个半球又进一步分化为四个区域或叶。

apprentice.en: Bailly encouraged his young apprentice to learn to read and write.
apprentice.zh: 贝利鼓励他的年轻徒弟去学习阅读和写作。

apprentice.en: By age 15, he had become an apprentice to Sylvain Bailly, a well-known dessert chef with a successful bakery in one of Paris' most fashionable neighborhoods.
apprentice.zh: 从15岁开始，他就成为了西尔文·贝利的学徒。西尔文·贝利是一位著名的甜点师，在巴黎最时尚的街区之一经营着一家成功的面包店。

apprentice.en: By age 15, he had become an apprentice to Sylvain Bailly, a well-known dessert chef with a successful bakery in one of Paris's most fashionable neighborhoods.
apprentice.zh: 从15岁开始，他就成为了西尔文·贝利的学徒。西尔文贝利是一位著名的甜点厨师，在巴黎最时尚的街区之一有一家成功的面包店。

supernatural.en: He writes short stories with a touch of the supernatural.
supernatural.zh: 他写带点儿超自然物的短篇故事。

supernatural.en: The second category of Norwegian folk tale is the supernatural.
supernatural.zh: 挪威民间故事的第二种类型是超自然。

supernatural.en: Nor is it something that could be remedied by some supernatural power.
supernatural.zh: 它也不是什么可以用超自然力量补救的东西。

outward.en: Mark showed no outward signs of distress.
outward.zh: 马克在外表上没有现出沮丧的神色来。

outward.en: It was pointing outward at an angle of 45 degrees.

absorption.zh: 这可以控制液体的吸收。

absorption.en: Vitamin D is necessary to aid the absorption of calcium from food.
absorption.zh: 从食物中吸取钙需靠维生素D的帮助。

absorption.en: Protective gloves reduce the absorption of chemicals through the skin.
absorption.zh: 防护手套可以减少皮肤对化学物质的吸收。

allude.en: I do not allude to you, my boy.
Others allude to history in more subtle ways.
allude.zh: 其他人则用更微妙的方式暗指这段历史。

allude.en: Did he allude to his hope of being captain?
allude.zh: 他提到他希望做船长的事了吗？

seduce.en: According to college folklore, a well turned essay has the power to seduce an admissions committee.
seduce.zh: 根据大学里的民间传说，一篇优秀的文章能够吸引招生委员会。

seduce.en: Naoki uses his charm to seduce Natsumi, with the real purpose of taking over her house.
seduce.zh: 直树用他的魅力勾引夏目，真正的目的是接管她的房子。

seduce.en: B: Are you trying to seduce me?

epic.en: Their four-hour match on Centre Court was an epic.
epic.zh: 他们在中心球场历时四个小时的比赛是一个壮举。

epic.en: The film is long and dramatic but does not quite earn the epithet 'epic'.
epic.zh: 这部影片篇幅长，戏剧性强，不过还不能誉为“史诗”。

epic.en: There are a number of distinguishing characteristics by which you can identify a Hollywood epic.
epic.zh: 通过其诸多与众不同的特点,你可以识别出好莱坞的史诗影片。

zoom.en: This lightweight zoom camera will fit comfortably into a fanny pack or coat pocket.
zoom.zh: 这部轻型变焦相机可以很轻易地放入腰包或外套口袋里。

zoom.en: Your camcorder should have these basic features: autofocus, playback facility, zoom lens.
zoom.zh: 你的便携式摄像机应该具有这些基本特征：自动调焦、回放及变焦镜头。

zoom.en: Most parents would probably prefer a vehicle to zoom between school and piano lessons.
zoom.zh: 大多数家长可能更喜欢一种能够在学校和钢琴课之间快速移动的交通工具。

entrepreneurial.en: In its early years the organization operated in an unconventional manner that characterized its innovative and entrepreneurial approach to the industry.
entrepreneurial.zh: 在早期，该组织以非常规的方式运作，其特点是对该行业的创新和创业方法。

entrepreneurial.en: His company, Soria Natural SA, has become an entrepreneurial success story.
entrepreneurial.zh: 他的公司Soria Natural SA，已经成为企业成功的一个案例。

entrepreneurial.en: He was eager to return to a more entrepreneurial role in which he had a big financial stake in his own efforts.
entrepreneurial.zh: 他渴望回到更具企业家性质的角色，这样他的努力就跟自己有大的金融利害关系。

coax.en: The officer spoke yesterday of her role in trying to coax vital information from the young victim.
coax.zh: 该官员昨天谈起她的职责：设法劝诱那个年轻受害人提供重要信息。

coax.en: An hour later, my midwife tried unsuccessfully to coax me out of the tub.
coax.zh: 一个小时之后，我的助产士试着把我从浴盆里哄出来，但没有成功。

coax.en: However little there is to eat, he always saves a bit o' his bread to coax his pets.
coax.zh: 不管吃的有多么少，他总是省下一点他的面包来哄他的宠物。

renovate.en: We had to renovate this after the lake overflowed its banks a couple of months ago and flooded the area.
renovate.zh: 几个月前，湖水漫过河岸，淹没了这个地区，我们不得不对它进行整修。

renovate.en: Nevertheless, this does not mean that modernization and new building should be discouraged in order to renovate and protect heritage buildings.
renovate.zh: 然而，这并不意味着为了翻新和保护遗产建筑而应打压现代化和新建。

mutation.en: Scientists have found a genetic mutation that appears to be the cause of Huntington's disease.
mutation.zh: 科学家们已经发现一个似乎是亨廷顿病病因的遗传突变。

mutation.en: If a copy of a gene is a bit different from the original, that's called a genetic mutation.
mutation.zh: 如果一个复制的基因与原来的有些许不同，那就叫做基因突变。

mutation.en: Furthermore, the single copy of a founder mutation often confers a survival advantage on carriers.
mutation.zh: 此外，创始者突变的单一拷贝通常赋予携带者生存优势。

brutality.en: He moves dangerously through a world of ruthless gangs, brutality, a vicious lust for power and money.
brutality.zh: 他在一个充满了残忍帮派、暴行、对权力和金钱有着邪恶欲望的世界里危险地移动。

brutality.en: The brutality of the crime has appalled the public.
brutality.zh: 罪行之残暴使公众大为震惊。
暴行压倒了温和的自由化。

meteor.en: Like a flash of lightning, the meteor shot across the sky.
meteor.zh: 流星像一道闪光划过天空。

meteor.en: Now astronomers think it was a meteor that burned up high in the atmosphere.
meteor.zh: 现在天文学家认为那是一颗在高空燃烧的流星。

meteor.en: Some geoscientists think that this catastrophe involved a meteor striking the earth.
meteor.zh: 一些地球科学家认为这次灾难与一颗流星撞击地球有关。

grievance.en: The main grievance of the drivers is the imposition of higher fees for driving licences.
grievance.zh: 司机们的主要不满是加诸在驾驶执照上的更高的费用。
他们的委屈是合乎情理的。

grievance.en: He had been nursing a grievance against his boss for months.
grievance.zh: 他几个月来一直对老板心怀不满。

minus.en: He put a plus instead of a minus.
minus.zh: 他填了个加号而不是减号。

attest.en: Contemporary accounts attest to his courage and determination.
attest.zh: 当时的报道证实了他的勇气和决心。

attest.en: I can attest to the absolute truth of his statement.
attest.zh: 我可以证实他的话是千真万确的。

attest.en: The fantastic achievements of modern technology and the speed at which scientific discoveries are translated into technological applications attest to the triumph of human endeavour.
attest.zh: 现代技术的惊人成就和科学发现转化为技术应用的速度证明了人类努力的胜利。

pneumonia.en: In November 1941 Payne was seriously ill with pneumonia.
She had feared she was coming down with pneumonia or bronchitis.
pneumonia.zh: 她担心自己会得肺炎或支气管炎。

duct.en: Methods Review the classic cases which were diagnosticated distal bile duct tumors by intra-operative cholangioscopy since 2005.
duct.zh: 回顾自2005年来术中胆道镜诊断术前未能发现的胆总管下端肿瘤的典型病例。

duct.en: Do you even know what a duct is?
Have you ever used duct tape to tape a duct?
duct.zh: 你曾经用管状胶带粘过管道吗？

pathogen.en: That is not a bad strategy for a pathogen.
pathogen.zh: 对于病原体，这并不是一个好的方法。

pathogen.en: When the amoebas find a pathogen, they devour it.
pathogen.zh: 一旦发现病原体，就会把它吞噬掉。

pathogen.en: But other forms of the deadly pathogen still plague victims today.
pathogen.zh: 但是其它形式的致命病原体今天依然折磨着受害者。

cradle.en: She rocked the baby to sleep in its cradle.
cradle.zh: 她摇动摇篮哄婴儿入睡。

cradle.en: The baby was rocked to sleep in a cradle.
cradle.zh: 婴儿在摇篮里被摇得睡着了。

cradle.en: A cradle is such a nice homely thing to have about a house.
cradle.zh: 摇篮在家庭中是一件很好的家常用品。

helm.en: I went aft to take my turn at the helm.
Mr. Helm plans to assert that the bill violates the First Amendment.
helm.zh: 赫尔姆先生计划坚定地陈述该法案有违《第一修正案》。

helm.en: After more than a decade at the helm of Colorado State University, Albert C Yates today announced his retirement.
helm.zh: 在掌管科罗拉多州立大学10多年后，阿尔伯特·叶慈于今天宣布退休。

pulp.en: Too much pulp produces a sour wine.
pulp.zh: 过多的果肉会让酒变酸。

pulp.en: The olives are crushed to a pulp by stone rollers.
This powerful electric juicer automatically separates the pulp from the juice.
pulp.zh: 这种大功率的电动榨汁机能够自动地将果肉与果汁分离开来。

woo.en: He barnstormed across the southern states in an attempt to woo the voters.
woo.zh: 他在南方各州作巡回演说，企图拉选票。

woo.en: Woo! At 5 in the morning, you were still awake and emailed me.
woo.zh: 哇，凌晨5点了，你还没睡，还能给我发邮件。

woo.en: Do just tell her, miss, that a young fox is here, who would like to woo her.
woo.zh: 小姐，请告诉她，这儿有一只年轻的狐狸，想向她求婚。

ranger.en: Another speedy bot is Cornell's Ranger Robot, which broke a new walking record this year.
ranger.zh: 另一款高速型的机器人是康奈尔大学的“游侠机器人”，它在今年打破了一项新的行走记录。

ranger.en: Bill Justice is a park ranger at the Carlsbad Caverns National Park.
ranger.zh: 比尔·贾斯蒂斯是卡尔斯巴德洞穴国家公园的管理员。

ranger.en: Earn yourself an official Junior Ranger Badge!
ranger.zh: 为自己赢得一个正式的初级护林员徽章！

nostril.en: Things such as nostril size vary with temperature and humidity in ways that suggest evolution is at work.
nostril.zh: 鼻孔大小等因素随着温度和湿度的变化而变化，这种事表明进化在起作用。

nostril.en: I find this one of the easiest way to control stress. Click on the link to learn how to practice alternate nostril breathing.
nostril.zh: 我认为这是控制压力最简单的方法之一。点击链接学习如何练习交替鼻孔呼吸。

spacious.zh: 他们明确要求门厅要宽敞。

spacious.en: It's a small car, yet it's surprisingly spacious.
spacious.zh: 这辆汽车不大，然而却出奇地宽敞。

crank.en: The chauffeur got out to crank the motor.
crank.zh: 司机下车用曲柄发动了引擎。

crank.en: He was idly turning a crank on a strange mechanism strapped to his chest.
crank.zh: 他漫不经心地转着绑在他胸前的一个古怪装置上面的曲柄。

crank.en: He has a limited time to crank the reforms into action.
crank.zh: 他启动各项改革的时间很有限。

annoyed.en: I was annoyed that they hadn't turned up.
annoyed.zh: 我恼怒的是他们没有露面。

annoyed.en: Elena was annoyed at having had to wait so long for him.
annoyed.zh: 埃琳娜因不得不等他那么长的时间而恼火。

seep.en: Many of us thrive on competition, but it can seep into areas of our lives where we do not want it.
seep.zh: 我们许多人靠竞争而发展，但竞争也会逐渐侵入到我们生活中不需要它的一些方面。

seep.en: The very reason that clichés so easily seep into our speech and writing—their insidious memorability—is exactly why they played such an important role in oral storytelling.
seep.zh: 陈词滥调之所以如此容易渗透到我们的演讲和写作中，是由于它们潜在的可记忆性，这正是它们在口述故事中扮演如此重要角色的原因。

seep.en: Water does not remain immobile in an aquifer but can seep out at springs or leak into other aquifers.
seep.zh: 水在含水层中并不是静止不动的，而是会从泉水中渗出，或渗入其他含水层。

relish.en: She savoured the moment with obvious relish.
relish.zh: 她显然津津有味地回味着那一刻。

relish.en: I don't relish the prospect of getting up early tomorrow.
relish.zh: 我可不愿意明天早上早起。

curry.en: You can make a curry hotter simply by adding chillies.
curry.zh: 你只需加辣椒就能增加咖喱菜的辣味。

cherish.en: Time is valuable, and we should cherish it.
cherish.zh: 时间宝贵，我们应该珍惜时间。

eruption.en: Volcanic ash showered down on the town after the eruption.
eruption.zh: 火山喷发后，小城落了一层火山灰。

eruption.en: Etna's eruption history dates back as far as 1500 B.C.
eruption.zh: 埃特纳火山喷发的历史可以追溯到公元前1500年。

eruption.en: Suppose Mount Etna erupted everyday, or imagine that each eruption there kills thousands of people.
eruption.zh: 假设一下，埃特纳火山每天都在喷发，或者那里的每次喷发都导致数千人死亡。

censorship.en: I'm opposed to censorship in any shape or form.
censorship.zh: 我反对任何形式的审查。

censorship.en: The issue has led to a reexamination of censorship rules.
censorship.zh: 这件事导致了对审查制度的重新审视。

censorship.en: Censorship is for the good of society as a whole.
censorship.zh: 审查制度是为了整个社会的利益。

unravel.en: He could unravel a knot that others wouldn't even attempt.
unravel.zh: 他能解开其他人甚至不敢尝试的绳结。

unravel.en: Last June, Pfingst told his attorneys to go back over old murder and rape convictions and see if any unravel with newly developed DNA-testing tools.
unravel.zh: 去年6月，芬斯特让他的律师去重新调查过去的谋杀和强奸定罪，看看用新开发的 DNA 测试工具是否能弄清一些未解决的问题。

unravel.en: It just so happened that while she was sipping some tea, one of the cocoons that she had collected landed in the hot tea and started to unravel into a fine thread.
unravel.zh: 事情是这样的，当她喝着茶的时候，她收集的一个蚕茧落在热茶里，然后蚕茧开始散开，变成了一根细线。

eyelid.zh: 他的左眼皮不由自主地跳着。

eyelid.en: Basal cell carcinomas can appear in some pretty strange places, including the eyelid, where it often causes a sore and the loss of eyelashes.
eyelid.zh: 基底细胞癌可以出现在一些非常奇怪的地方，包括眼睑，在那里它经常引起疼痛和睫毛脱落的现象。

eyelid.en: She didn't bat an eyelid when I told her my news.
eyelid.zh: 我把我最近的事告诉她时，她一点也不为所动。

smuggle.en: They deny conspiring together to smuggle drugs.
smuggle.zh: 他们否认共谋走私毒品。

smuggle.en: They were foiled in their attempt to smuggle the paintings.
smuggle.zh: 他们走私绘画作品的企图未能得逞。

smuggle.en: Customs officials foiled an attempt to smuggle the paintings out of the country.
smuggle.zh: 海关关员阻截了一次企图走私画作出境的阴谋。

commonplace.en: Simpson's much vaunted discoveries are in fact commonplace in modern sociology.
commonplace.zh: 辛普森的那些被过分称赞的发现在现代社会学中实际上是老生常谈。

commonplace.en: Be not content with the commonplace in character.
commonplace.zh: 不要满足于普通的共性。

mislead.en: It would be dishonest to mislead people and not to present the data as fairly as possible.
mislead.zh: 误导人们、不尽可能公正地提供数据是不诚实的。

mislead.en: As a result, these advertisements could mislead children and their parents.
mislead.zh: 因此，这些广告会误导孩子和他们的父母。

mislead.en: Some irresponsible websites allowed restaurants to post false pictures that could mislead customers.
mislead.zh: 一些不负责任的网站允许餐馆发布一些误导顾客的虚假照片。

visualize.en: He could not visualize her as old.
visualize.zh: 他无法想像她年老的样子。

visualize.en: It can help to visualize yourself making your speech clearly and confidently.
visualize.zh: 设想自己口齿清晰和充满信心地演讲是很有助益的。

visualize.en: Visualize how you would like it to end instead; the next time it occurs, try to wake up just enough to control its course.
visualize.zh: 设想一下，你是多么希望它反而能够结束；下次它再出现的时候，试着醒来，这样恰好足以控制住它的进程。

incidentally.en: Incidentally, have you heard the news about Sue?
incidentally.zh: 顺便问一句，你听说过休的事了吗？
这个信息只是偶然得到的。

incidentally.en: "I didn't ask you to come. Incidentally, why have you come?"
incidentally.zh: “我没有叫你来。顺便问一下，你为什么来呢？”

emanate.en: These chemicals can emanate certain poisonous gases.
emanate.zh: 这些化学药品会散发出某些有毒的气味。

emanate.en: What rule, then, could emanate from that unreasonable order?
emanate.zh: 那么，从这种不合理的秩序中显现出了什么准则呢？

emanate.en: The waves that emanate from the collision of two black holes should be detectable.
emanate.zh: 两个黑洞相撞时产生的波动可以测到。

mint.zh: 她嘴里咂着一颗薄荷糖。
她嘴里咂着一颗薄荷糖。

unrealistic.en: The city has unrealistic pretensions to world-class status.
unrealistic.zh: 该城市不切实际地声称为世界一流城市。

unrealistic.en: It would be unrealistic to expect such a process ever to be completed.
unrealistic.zh: 期望完成这样一个过程是不现实的。

unrealistic.en: It is unrealistic to put undue pressure on ourselves by saying we are the best.
unrealistic.zh: 说我们是最好的来给我们自己施加过多的压力是不现实的。

inaccurate.en: The book is both inaccurate and exaggerated.
inaccurate.zh: 那本书既不准确又夸大事实。
整个概念在科学上是不准确的。

inaccurate.en: The woman's inaccurate description of the whole incident.
inaccurate.zh: 那个女人对整个事件的描述不准确。

commemorate.en: Some galleries commemorate donors by inscribing their names on the walls.
commemorate.zh: 一些展览馆把捐赠者的名字刻在墙上以纪念他们。

commemorate.en: A series of movies will be shown to commemorate the 30th anniversary of his death.
commemorate.zh: 为纪念他逝世30周年，有一系列的电影要上映。

commemorate.en: The Duanwu Festival, also called the Dragon Boat Festival, is to commemorate the patriotic poet Qu Yuan.
commemorate.zh: 端午节，又叫龙舟节，是为了纪念爱国诗人屈原。

contraction.en: 'He's' may be a contraction of 'he is' or 'he has'.
contraction.zh: he's可以是he is或he has的缩约形式。

contraction.en: The most common type of headache is a tension or muscle contraction.
contraction.zh: 最常见的头痛类型是紧张或肌肉收缩。

contraction.en: The contraction of facial muscles both influences the internal emotional state and reflects it.
contraction.zh: 面部肌肉的收缩既能影响人的内心情绪，又能将它反映出来。

mythology.en: In Norse mythology the moon is personified as male.
mythology.zh: 在斯堪的纳维亚神话里，月亮被赋予了男性身份。

mythology.en: His novels are a rich synthesis of Balkan history and mythology.
mythology.zh: 他的小说是一个巴尔干半岛的历史和神话的丰富结合。

mythology.en: Altman strips away the pretense and mythology to expose the film industry as a business like any other.
mythology.zh: 奥尔特曼揭穿伪装和神话，把电影业暴露成像其他任何行业一样。

outweigh.en: The book's virtues far outweigh its faults.
outweigh.zh: 这本书优点远远大于缺失。

outweigh.en: It seems that the disadvantages often outweigh the advantages of ecotourism.
outweigh.zh: 似乎生态旅游的弊大于利。

outweigh.en: The benefits of play must outweigh costs, or play would not have evolved, according to Darwin's theory.
outweigh.zh: 根据达尔文的理论，玩乐的好处必须大于其代价，否则玩乐就不会得以进化。

simultaneous.en: Some hypotheses fail to account for simultaneous extinctions on land and in the seas.
simultaneous.zh: 有些假说不能解释同时发生在陆地和海洋的灭绝。

simultaneous.en: A lack of flow is characterized by, interruptions, simultaneous speech or mutual silences.
simultaneous.zh: 缺乏心流的特征是打断、同时讲话或相互沉默。

simultaneous.en: With simultaneous interpreting, you start translating almost as soon as the other person starts speaking.
simultaneous.zh: 在做同声传译时，你几乎是在对方开始说话时就开始翻译。

defer.en: Customers often defer payment for as long as possible.
defer.zh: 顾客们经常尽可能地推迟付款。

defer.en: Let's say, both John and Mary defer to her leadership.
defer.zh: 假设，约翰和玛丽都服从她的领导。

defer.en: Doctors are encouraged to defer to experts.
defer.zh: 鼓励医生们听从专家的意见。

abrupt.en: He was abrupt to the point of rudeness.
abrupt.zh: 他唐突到了无礼的地步。

abrupt.en: She was very abrupt with me in our meeting.
