abrupt.zh: 在我们会面时，她跟我说话非常生硬。

abrupt.en: His abrupt change of subject left her floundering helplessly.
abrupt.zh: 他突然改变话题，使她茫然不知所措。

rampant.zh: 到了20世纪20年代，杂草猖獗。

rampant.en: Malaria is still rampant in some swampy regions.
rampant.zh: 疟疾在一些沼泽地区仍很猖獗。

rampant.en: Inflation is rampant and industry in decline.
rampant.zh: 通货膨胀肆虐，工业生产下降。

antiquity.en: The museum contains the remains of Chinese antiquity.
antiquity.zh: 博物馆藏有中国古代的遗物。

antiquity.en: Although several ancient cultures practiced mummification, mummies from ancient Egypt are generally more well-preserved than mummies of similar antiquity from other cultures.
antiquity.zh: 尽管有几个古代文化有木乃伊化的习俗，但古埃及的木乃伊通常比其他文化中类似古代的木乃伊保存得更好。

antiquity.en: The statue was brought to Rome in antiquity.
antiquity.zh: 这座雕像是古时运到罗马的。

generalization.en: It also means to weigh ideas, to compare and contrast assertions, to connect one generalization to another.
generalization.zh: 它还意味着权衡观点，比较和对比断言，将一种概括与另一种概括联系起来。

generalization.en: Yet it is doubtful whether the proposition is strong enough to bear the vast weight of generalization that has been placed on it.
generalization.zh: 然而，令人怀疑的是，这个命题是否足够强大，足以承受被置于其上的广泛的泛化的重量。

generalization.en: What highly creative artistic activity produces is not a new generalization that transcends established limits, but rather an aesthetic particular.
generalization.zh: 具有高度创造性的艺术活动所产生的并不是一种超越既定界限的新的概括，而是一种美学上的特殊。

downside.en: The downside of this approach is a lack of clear leadership.
downside.zh: 这种方式的不足之处是缺乏明确的指挥。

downside.en: Yet the loss of formality has its downside.
downside.zh: 然而，失礼也有其不利的一面。

downside.en: Encouraging this kind of thinking has a downside.
downside.zh: 鼓励这种想法有个缺点。

stylish.en: Its shops are among the most stylish on the Continent.
stylish.zh: 其商店位列欧洲大陆最时尚的商店之中。

stylish.en: What you wear should be stylish and clean, and must definitely fit well.
stylish.zh: 你的穿着应该时尚整洁，而且必须非常合体。

stylish.en: She is wearing a noticeably stylish, feminine dress, plus discreet jewellery.
stylish.zh: 她穿着一条非常时髦、有女人味的连衣裙，配以小巧的首饰。

shred.en: These animals shred the prey that fall into the pitcher, and the smaller organisms feed on the debris.
shred.zh: 这些动物撕碎掉到水罐里的猎物，而小一些的生物则以残骸为食。

shred.en: There is not a shred of truth in the story.
shred.zh: 这个故事没有一点真实性。

shred.en: He instructed staff to shred sensitive documents.
shred.zh: 他指示员工用碎纸机粉碎机密文件。

tabloid.en: Tabloid newspapers love to dig up scandal.
tabloid.zh: 通俗小报都热衷于刨丑闻。

tabloid.en: Royal gossip is a staple of the tabloid press.
tabloid.zh: 围绕王室成员的飞短流长是小报的主要内容。

tabloid.en: She is an object of ridicule in the tabloid newspapers.
tabloid.zh: 她是小报讥笑讽刺的对象。

heater.en: This type of heater uses a lot of electricity.
heater.zh: 这种加热器耗电量很大。

heater.en: Run the engine and heater once in a while.
heater.zh: 每隔一段时间启动引擎和加热器。

refreshing.en: It made a refreshing change to be taken seriously for once.
refreshing.zh: 总算有一次受到认真对待，这变化真是令人耳目一新。

refreshing.en: What is refreshing is the author's easy, conversational style.
refreshing.zh: 使人耳目一新的是作者流畅的、谈话式的写作风格。

ailment.en: No ailment was found, and he investigated again.
ailment.zh: 没有发现任何毛病，于是他又检查了一遍。

ailment.en: Asthma, a bronchial condition, is much less common ailment than hay fever, an allergic inflammation of the nasal passages.
ailment.zh: 哮喘是一种支气管疾病，比花粉热（一种鼻道的过敏性炎症）要少见得多。

ailment.en: If identical twins are more similar to each other with respect to an ailment than fraternal twins are, then vulnerability to the disease must be rooted at least in part in heredity.
ailment.zh: 如果同卵双胞胎彼此在疾病方面比异卵双胞胎更相似，那么这种疾病的易感性至少在一定程度上是由遗传造成的。

reunite.en: In addition, family reunions frequently attract blood relatives from faraway places who spend considerable money and time to reunite.
reunite.zh: 此外，家庭团聚经常会吸引远方来的血亲，他们会花费大量的金钱和时间来团聚。

reunite.en: His first job will be to reunite the army.
reunite.zh: 他的第一项任务将是重新统一军队。

reunite.en: There have been rumours that the band will reunite for a world tour.
reunite.zh: 有传言说这个乐队将复合作一次环球巡演。

intrusion.en: You know that Snort is an intrusion detection system, but how does it detect intrusion?
intrusion.zh: 您知道 Snort 是一种入侵检测系统，但它是如何检测入侵的呢？

intrusion.en: Note that Apple's public opposition to the government's request is itself a hindrance to mass government intrusion.
intrusion.zh: 需要注意的是，苹果公开拒绝政府的要求本身就是对政府大规模入侵的一种阻挠。

intrusion.en: I hope you don't mind this intrusion, Jon.
intrusion.zh: 乔恩，我希望你不会介意这次打扰。

nuisance.en: He could be a bit of a nuisance when he was drunk.
nuisance.zh: 他喝醉时会是一个有点令人讨厌的人。

semiconductor.en: In semiconductor receivers transistors take the place of vacuum tubes.
semiconductor.zh: 在半导体收音机中晶体管代替了真空管。

semiconductor.en: Instead, semiconductor firms simply squeezed more patents out of existing research and development expenditures.
semiconductor.zh: 相反，半导体公司只是从现有的研发支出中榨取更多的专利。

semiconductor.en: The technology of amplifying solar energy can save the number of semiconductor materials required for photovoltaic cells.
semiconductor.zh: 通过放大太阳能的技术可以节约光伏电池所需的半导体材料的数量。

versatile.en: He is sparkling and versatile in front of the camera.
versatile.zh: 他在摄影机前聪颖机智、多才多艺。

versatile.en: He is a nimble and versatile wit.
versatile.zh: 他是一个机敏而又多才多艺的才子。

symphony.zh: 交响乐乐师不一定能视奏。

symphony.en: The orchestra played Mozart's Symphony No. 35 in D Major.
symphony.zh: 该管弦乐队演奏了莫扎特D大调第35交响曲。

symphony.en: He is a protean stylist who can move from blues to ballads and grand symphony.
symphony.zh: 他是一位富有变化的艺术家，能从布鲁斯转换到民谣以及雄壮的交响乐。

purity.en: The water is regularly tested for purity.
purity.zh: 水的纯度定期受到检测。

purity.en: The purity of the water is tested regularly.
White has always been a symbol of purity in Western cultures.
purity.zh: 在西方文化中，白色一向象征纯洁。

dizzy.en: Climbing so high made me feel dizzy.
dizzy.zh: 爬那么高使我感到头晕目眩。

vomit.en: The smell made her want to vomit.
Any product made from cow's milk made him vomit.
vomit.zh: 任何牛奶制品都会让他呕吐。

vomit.en: Zimmer slipped and nearly fell on a pool of vomit.
vomit.zh: 齐默滑了一跤，差点儿摔倒在一滩呕吐物上。

reiterate.en: I have to reiterate: The most important thing you need to do to lose body fat is to stop your sugar and cereal intake and keep your carbohydrate intake low.
reiterate.zh: 我必须要重申一下：要想减掉体内脂肪，你要做的最重要的事就是停止糖和谷物的摄取，并保持较低的碳水化合物摄入。

reiterate.en: Let me reiterate that we are fully committed to this policy.
reiterate.zh: 我再说一遍，我们完全拥护这项政策。

reiterate.en: To reiterate, the Tag name must be unique.
reiterate.zh: 再次重申，标签名必须是唯一的。

conditioner.en: Regular use of conditioner is supposed to give your hair more body.
conditioner.zh: 经常使用护发素能使头发更浓密。

conditioner.en: This hair conditioner is excellent for revitalizing dry, lifeless hair.
conditioner.zh: 这种护发素对使干枯、无生气的头发重新焕发光彩非常有效。

exterior.en: The exterior of the house needs painting.
The exterior walls were made of preformed concrete.
exterior.zh: 外墙是用预制混凝土建造的。

exterior.en: His gruff exterior concealed one of the kindest hearts.
exterior.zh: 他不友好的外表下藏着一颗最善良的心。

buffer.en: For each line in the line buffer for a CU, we need to check for the low address match to find the first line number.
buffer.zh: 要获得 CU 的行缓冲的每一行，我们需要检查低位地址匹配以找到函数的第一行的行号。

buffer.en: Many of the crashes resulting from fuzz testing are direct results of memory allocation mistakes and buffer overflows.
buffer.zh: 由模糊测试导致的许多故障都是内存分配错误及缓冲器溢出的直接结果。

buffer.en: She often had to act as a buffer between father and son.
buffer.zh: 她常常不得不在父子之间扮演调解人角色。

illicit.zh: 但丁明确地谴责不正当的恋情。

illicit.en: Consequently, a black market in imported illicit CFC's has grown.
illicit.zh: 因此，非法进口氯氟化碳的黑市已经扩大。

illicit.en: Unfortunately, the cheap alternatives are even more harmful than the illicit drugs they replace.
illicit.zh: 不幸的是，这些廉价的替代品比它们所替代的非法药物更有害。

wrongdoing.zh: 该银行强烈否认任何违规行为。

wrongdoing.en: Starting next year, any guaranteed bonus of top executives could be delayed 10 years if their banks are under investigation for wrongdoing.
wrongdoing.zh: 从明年开始，如果银行因不当行为受到调查，高管的任何保证奖金都可能推迟10年发放。

wrongdoing.en: Level Global and Loch saw investors redeem money as soon as possible because of the raid, even though they haven't been charged with any wrongdoing.
wrongdoing.zh: 目前水平国际和 Loch 公司看到投资者因为此次突袭而尽快赎回资金，尽管他们没有受到任何不当行为的指控。

perpetual.en: The perpetual argument is that funds are tight, that we have more pressing problems here on Earth.
perpetual.zh: 永恒的争论是资金紧张，我们在地球上有更紧迫的问题。

goodwill.en: I invited them to dinner, a gesture of goodwill.
goodwill.zh: 我邀请他们来吃饭以示友好。

goodwill.en: We do not want to lose the goodwill built up over 175 years.
goodwill.zh: 我们不想失去用175年建立起来的商业信誉。

goodwill.en: This gesture of goodwill did little to improve the tense atmosphere at the talks.
goodwill.zh: 这一友好姿态对改善谈判的紧张气氛几乎没起什么作用。

aerobic.en: Walking, done in the right way, is a form of aerobic exercise.
aerobic.zh: 走路方法得当的话是一种有氧锻炼。

aerobic.en: A number of fitness spas existed prior to this aerobic fitness movement, even a national chain with spas in most major cities.
aerobic.zh: 在这种有氧健身运动出现之前，市面上已经有不少健身水疗会所，在大城市甚至有全国性的连锁机构。

aerobic.en: Aerobic exercise gets the heart pumping and helps you to burn fat.
aerobic.zh: 增氧健身操能加快心跳，并有助于消耗脂肪。

covert.en: As the individual matures, that overt talking to oneself becomes covert talking to oneself, but thinking still shows up as a laryngeal habit.
covert.zh: 随着个体的成熟，公开的自言自语变成了隐蔽的自言自语，但思考仍然表现为一种喉部习惯。

covert.en: He stole a covert glance at her across the table.
covert.zh: 他隔着桌子偷偷地瞥了她一眼。
然后，他进行不公开的审议。

facet.en: Now let's look at another facet of the problem.
facet.zh: 现在咱们看问题的另一面。

facet.en: The worst may be behind them now, but the shocking losses of the past few years have reshaped nearly every facet of their lives—how they live, work, and spend—even the way they think about the future.
facet.zh: 最糟糕的情况可能已经过去，但过去几年令人震惊的损失几乎改变了他们生活的方方面面，包括他们的生活、工作和消费方式，甚至他们对未来的看法。

facet.en: The information revolution will touch every facet of composition, publication, distribution, and reading.
facet.zh: 信息革命将涉及写作、出版、发行和阅读的方方面面。

disarm.en: The troops will not attempt to disarm the warring militias.
disarm.zh: 军队不会试图解除交战民兵组织的武装。

disarm.en: There has also been a suggestion that the forces in Lebanon should disarm.
disarm.zh: 也曾有一项提议说在黎巴嫩的部队应解除武装。
超级大国绝不同意裁军。

improvise.en: You need a wok with a steaming rack for this; if you don't have one, improvise.
improvise.zh: 你需要一口带有蒸笼的锅，如果没有就临时凑合一下。

improvise.en: The real work was being done by people who knew how to play the saxophone or improvise a long melody with a few chords and a swing beat for support.
improvise.zh: 真正的工作是由那些知道如何演奏萨克斯管的人来完成的，或者是那些用几个和弦和一个摇摆节奏就即兴创作一段很长的旋律的人来完成的。

improvise.en: There isn't much equipment. We're going to have to improvise.
improvise.zh: 设备不多，我们只能将就着用。

slipper.en: He observed that if there are too many toys in front of Cameron, he will just keep moving round them and then end up going away and finding something like a slipper to play with.
slipper.zh: 他观察到，如果卡梅隆面前的玩具太多，他就会一直绕着玩具转，最后会走开，转而找个拖鞋之类的东西玩。

slipper.en: The grandfather was often hit by Mr. Tan with a slipper.
slipper.zh: 爷爷经常被谭先生用拖鞋打。

suicidal.en: He noted limitations to the study, such as the inability to determine the cause of the suicidal behavior.
suicidal.zh: 他注意到这项研究的局限性，比如很难确定自杀行为原因。

suicidal.en: Surprisingly, crying is more commonly associated with minor forms of depression than with major depression involving suicidal thoughts.
suicidal.zh: 令人惊讶的是，哭泣更加普遍与轻度抑郁症有关，而不是与有自杀想法的重度抑郁症有关。

suicidal.en: Only the suicidal venture out at night.
suicidal.zh: 只有自寻死路的人才会在晚上外出。

mole.zh: 我对你很满意，鼹鼠莫尔！

impede.en: At no time did I make an attempt to impede any investigatory effort.
impede.zh: 我从未试图妨碍任何调查的努力。
一个人不应该妨碍他人进步。

impede.en: There is a "risk of strangulation" if metal fasteners impede the flow of sap.
impede.zh: 如果金属固件阻碍了树液的流动，将会有“窒息”的风险。

subside.en: She waited nervously for his anger to subside.
subside.zh: 她提心吊胆地等他的怒气平息下来。

subside.en: Weak foundations caused the house to subside.
subside.zh: 由于地基不实，房子出现下陷。

subside.en: Sometimes, the ground at an oil field may subside as oil is removed.
subside.zh: 有时，油田的地面可能会随着石油的开采而下沉。

needy.en: It's a charity that provides help for needy children.
needy.zh: 是慈善机构为贫困孩子提供帮助。

needy.en: There will be efforts to get larger amounts of food to the needy.
needy.zh: 将努力把更多的食品送给穷人。

needy.en: Silber says the tax rollback would decimate basic services for the needy.
needy.zh: 西尔伯说税收的回落可能导致大幅缩减为贫困人口提供的基本服务。

aerospace.en: His father is a machinist in an aerospace plant.
aerospace.zh: 他的父亲是一家航空工厂的机械师。

aerospace.en: The American aerospace industry has been challenged by some stiff competition.
aerospace.zh: 美国航空航天工业遭到了一些强劲竞争产品的挑战。

aerospace.en: Shortly afterwards, cuts in defence spending forced the aerospace industry to retrench.
aerospace.zh: 此后不久，国防开支的削减迫使航空航天业紧缩开支。

outspoken.en: She was outspoken in her criticism of the plan.
outspoken.zh: 她对该计划的批评直言不讳。

outspoken.en: She is one of the ruling party's most outspoken critics.
outspoken.zh: 她是最直言不讳地批评执政党的一个人。

outspoken.en: His outspoken behaviour did not commend itself to his colleagues.
outspoken.zh: 他直言不讳的行为不受他同事的欢迎。

geological.en: The city council commissioned geological experts earlier this year to survey the cliffs.
geological.zh: 该市议会今年早些时候委托地质专家们对这些悬崖进行勘测。

geological.en: With geological maps, books, and atlases you can find out all the proven sites of precious minerals.
geological.zh: 有了地质地图、书籍和地图册，你就可以找到所有已探明的珍贵矿藏的位置。

geological.en: In geological time, a million years is recent history.
geological.zh: 在地质时代，一百万年属于近代史。

petal.en: A midge gathers pollen from a cacao flower by sticking its head inside a "petal pouch" that contains both pollen and a sticky nectar reward.
petal.zh: 一只摇蚊把它的头伸进一个“花瓣囊”里，收集可可花的花粉，“花瓣囊”里既有花粉，也有粘稠的花蜜。

petal.en: Designer Christian Louboutin Petal Sandals Light Pink is a kind of pink sandals with buckle detail at ankle strap, two petals along vamp, and a round open toe.
petal.zh: 设计师克里斯提·布鲁托浅粉花瓣凉鞋是一种脚踝带上有繁复的带扣、鞋面上有两个花瓣、圆头露趾鞋尖的浅粉色凉鞋。

petal.en: If the prince could learn to love another and earn her love in return by the time the last petal fell, then the spell would be broken.
petal.zh: 如果王子能在最后一片花瓣掉落前学会爱别人，并得到她的爱，那么所有的咒语将会被打破。

antibody.en: Two important manifestations of antigen-antibody immunity are lysis.
antibody.zh: 抗原——抗体免疫的两个重要表现是裂解。

antibody.en: There's a lag phase, and there's a slow rise to an intermediate level of antibody concentration.
antibody.zh: 有一个迟滞期，抗体浓度缓慢上升至中间水平。

antibody.en: There's no lag period, and notice that antibody levels start rising right away after the second exposure.
antibody.zh: 没有迟滞期，注意抗体水平在第二次接触后立即开始上升。

barren.en: He wants to use the water to irrigate barren desert land.
barren.zh: 他想用该水来灌溉贫瘠的沙漠土地。

barren.en: That's probably the most bare, bleak, barren and inhospitable island I've ever seen.
barren.zh: 那可能是我见过的最光秃、最荒凉、最贫瘠和最不适合居住的岛屿。

celestial.en: Tulips actually hail from an area that Chinese call the Celestial Mountains in Central Asia.
celestial.zh: 郁金香实际上来自位于中亚、中国人称为“天山”的地区。

celestial.en: Galileo's observations of Jupiter's satellites showed that the Ptolemaic theory of the motion of celestial bodies is false.
celestial.zh: 伽利略对木星卫星的观察表明，托勒密关于天体运动的理论是错误的。

celestial.en: Prayer can add to your joy a celestial perfume.
celestial.zh: 祷告能在你的欢乐上替你加上一阵属天的香味。

hinge.en: Her ire slid between us like the spanner from Father's workshop, straining our hinge.
hinge.zh: 她的怒气像父亲作坊里的扳手一样夹在我们中间，绷紧了我们的铰链。

hinge.en: By varying the width of the black lines, or hinges, researchers are able to change how far each hinge folds.
hinge.zh: 通过改变黑色线条或者铰链的宽度，研究员可以改变每条铰链可以折叠的范围。

hinge.en: The wider the hinge, the further it folds.
hinge.zh: 铰链角度越大，它能折的距离越远。

clench.en: Don't clench your fists because it can lead to tightening the arms, shoulders, and neck.
clench.zh: 不要握紧你的拳头，因为它会导致手臂、肩膀和脖子紧绷。

clench.en: They leap to their feet, clench fists and let out long screams, clawing at the ground and air.
clench.zh: 他们跳起来，握紧拳头，发出长长的尖叫声，抓向地面或空中。

clench.en: The next time you're faced with a choice that takes self-control, clench your fist or firm that bicep.
clench.zh: 下次当你面临需要自我控制的选择时，握紧你的拳头或收紧你的二头肌。

timetable.en: There was a slight hiccup in the timetable.
timetable.zh: 时间安排上出了点小问题。

timetable.en: I can't arrange everything around your timetable!
timetable.zh: 我不可能事事都按着你的时刻表安排！

prudent.en: It is clearly prudent to take all precautions.
prudent.zh: 采取一切防范措施显然是慎重的。

prudent.en: It might be more prudent to get a second opinion before going ahead.
prudent.zh: 行动之前再征求一下意见也许更为慎重。

prudent.en: The president of the republic oscillated between a certain audacity and a prudent realism.
prudent.zh: 该共和国总统施政时而大胆，时而谨慎务实。

unanimous.zh: 这项决定没有得到一致通过。

unanimous.en: The jury returned a unanimous guilty verdict.
unanimous.zh: 该陪审团作出了一份一致通过的有罪裁决。

mundane.zh: 我过着相当平淡的生活。
她的生活很平静，几乎有些枯燥。

mundane.en: On a more mundane level, can we talk about the timetable for next week?
mundane.zh: 说点儿实际的吧，我们能谈谈下周的时间安排吗？

tavern.en: Here—it's the number of a room—in a tavern, you know!
tavern.zh: 这儿——这是房间号——是客栈里的，你知道吧！

tavern.en: Eleven o'clock came, and the tavern lights were put out; darkness everywhere, now.
tavern.zh: 十一点钟到了，客栈的灯也熄了。黑暗现在无处不在。

tavern.en: Nobody entered the alley or left it; nobody resembling the Spaniard entered or left the tavern door.
tavern.zh: 没有人进出巷子；没有一个像西班牙人的人进出客栈的门。

cedar.en: The yacht is built of cedar strip planking.
cedar.zh: 这艘游艇用雪松木板材制成。

cedar.en: Quiet mountain roads wind through groves of bamboo and cedar.
cedar.zh: 幽静的山路蜿蜒穿过竹林和雪松林。

cedar.en: The cedar wood was exported as top-quality timber for architecture and shipbuilding.
cedar.zh: 雪松木被作为建筑和造船的优质木材出口到其他国家。

observatory.en: This makes it seem unlikely Nazca is an observatory.
observatory.zh: 这使得纳斯卡不太可能是一个天文台。

observatory.en: There is a small network of rhombus in tokyo astronomical observatory.
observatory.zh: 东京天文台有一个小的菱形网。

observatory.en: Here's an irony, the building we are in now, the astronomy building not far from our observatory, has unshielded lights.
observatory.zh: 讽刺的是，我们现在所在的这栋楼，离我们天文台不远的那座天文楼，竟然有未屏蔽的灯。

etch.zh: 它像不像一个蚀刻素描？

etch.en: A modern microprocessor requires a billion-dollar plant called a fab to etch onto its surface the tiny electronic components that make it run.
etch.zh: 现代的微处理器需要十亿美元的被称为 fab 的工厂，以在其表面蚀刻出使其得以运作的微型电子元器件。

smear.en: The cervical smear test is a lifesaver.
smear.zh: 宫颈涂片检查是健康救星。

smear.en: They planned to smear him by publishing information about his private life.
smear.zh: 他们计划通过公开有关他私生活方面的信息来诋毁他。

smear.en: Smear some aloe vera gel on the blister and cover it with a bandage to help it heal.
smear.zh: 在水泡上涂上芦荟凝胶，用绷带包扎，帮助愈合。

assassinate.en: Secretary: President of the Steel Trust, you mean? Do you want to assassinate him?
assassinate.zh: 秘书：你是说，钢铁托拉斯的总经理？你要行刺他吗。

assassinate.en: In 1981, when John Hinckley tried to assassinate him, he cracked a string of jokes while doctors were dealing with near-fatal lung wounds.
assassinate.zh: 1981年约翰·欣克利(John Hinckley)实施了针对他的刺杀行动，让他险些失去生命。在医生忙着处理那靠近肺部伤口时，他居然还在讲着一连串的笑话。

worthless.en: He dismissed the opinion polls as worthless.
worthless.zh: 他认为民意测验毫无用处而不予考虑。

worthless.en: The car was a worthless wreck after the collision.
worthless.zh: 撞车以后，那辆车成了毫无价值的残骸。

worthless.en: An agreement is worthless till our name is written with a pen.
worthless.zh: 除非用笔把我们的名字写下来，否则协议毫无价值。

intellect.en: Do the emotions develop in parallel with the intellect?
intellect.zh: 情感与智力同步发展吗？

intellect.en: You are endowed with wealth, good health and a lively intellect.
intellect.zh: 你天生赋有财富、健康，和敏锐的智力。

persecution.en: It is the memory and threat of persecution that binds them together.
persecution.zh: 是受迫害的记忆和威胁将他们紧紧联系在一起。

persecution.en: Yet, as often as not, they find themselves the target of persecution rather than praise.
persecution.zh: 然而，他们往往发现自己是迫害对象，而不是表扬对象。

persecution.en: Tom had become indifferent to persecution by this time.
persecution.zh: 这时，汤姆已经对和这跟迫害差不多的治疗麻木不仁。

plumbing.en: They had ensured the plumbing was overhauled a year ago.
plumbing.zh: 他们确保管道设备一年前已被彻底检修过。

plumbing.en: Most of the houses in the capital don't have indoor plumbing.
plumbing.zh: 首都大多数房屋没有室内管道装置。

plumbing.en: She learned the rudiments of bricklaying, wiring, and plumbing.
plumbing.zh: 她学过一些砌砖、布线和管道工程的基本技术。

outright.zh: 两个候选人谁也没干脆利落地获胜。
该和平计划没有被全盘否定。

quotation.en: You need to get a written quotation before they start work.
quotation.zh: 你得在他们开工之前拿到报价单。

quotation.en: But I still use the word "event" anyway, use it carefully with quotation marks.
quotation.zh: 但是无论如何我还是使用“事件”这个词，小心谨慎地带引号使用它。
每一章的开头都有一条引语。

infuse.en: The contract would infuse the region with foreign capital, an estimated 400 jobs, and spin-off service industries.
infuse.zh: 该合同将为该地区注入外资、创造约400个就业岗位以及衍生的服务业。

infuse.en: Theses terms are also intended to infuse work with meaning—and, as Rakesh Khurana, another professor, points out, increase allegiance to the firm.
infuse.zh: 这些词语旨在给工作赋予更深刻的意义，正如另一位教授凯什·库拉纳所言，这会提高员工对公司的忠诚度。

infuse.en: Please infuse with pencil powder into key-hole then running few times when door open is not flexible.
infuse.zh: 门锁开启不灵活时，请往钥匙孔内加入适量的铅笔芯粉末再往来转动几次即可。

perennial.en: The perennial vegetation adjusts to the aridity by means of various avoidance mechanisms.
perennial.zh: 多年生植物会采用各种躲避机制以适应干旱。

perennial.en: We learned that the Botai were able to build large perennial villages, sometimes with hundreds of homes.
perennial.zh: 我们了解到博泰人能够建造大型的常年村庄，有时候村里有上百户人家。

inflate.en: The promotion of a big release can inflate a film's final cost.
inflate.zh: 一部大片的发行宣传会抬高影片的最终成本。

inflate.en: The principal effect of the demand for new houses was to inflate prices.
inflate.zh: 对新住宅需求的主要结果是促使价格上涨。

longevity.en: We wish you both health and longevity.
longevity.zh: 我们祝愿您二位健康长寿。

longevity.en: Longevity is a key characteristic of a replicator.
longevity.zh: 长寿是复制器的一个关键特征。

overlap.zh: 患者们的各种需求总是相互重合的。

overlap.en: Our jobs overlap slightly, which sometimes causes difficulties.
overlap.zh: 我们的工作略有重叠，所以有时引起一些困难。

obsolete.en: With technological changes many traditional skills have become obsolete.
obsolete.zh: 随着技术的革新，许多传统技艺已被淘汰。

obsolete.en: The coal-fired steam engine was taking over, and the waterwheel was fast becoming obsolete.
obsolete.zh: 烧煤的蒸汽机开始占领市场，于是水车很快就过时了。

obsolete.en: The introduction of gunpowder gradually made the bow and arrow obsolete, particularly in Western Europe
obsolete.zh: 火药的使用使弓箭逐渐被淘汰，特别是在西欧。

culprit.en: Police collared the culprit as he was leaving the premises.
culprit.zh: 罪犯正离开现场时，警察逮住了他。

culprit.en: The police followed home the clue and finally caught the culprit.
culprit.zh: 警察根据线索追根到底，终于抓住了这个罪犯。

culprit.en: The main culprit in the current crisis seems to be modern farming techniques.
culprit.zh: 当前这场危机的罪魁祸首好像是现代农业技术。

bankrupt.en: At this rate, we'll soon be bankrupt.
bankrupt.zh: 照此情形，我们很快就会破产。

anomaly.en: The space shuttle had stopped transmitting data, a very serious anomaly for the mission.
anomaly.zh: 这架航天飞机已经停止了传输数据，这是这次任务中一个十分严重的反常现象。

anomaly.en: The January warmth turned out to be part of a remarkably persistent weather anomaly.
anomaly.zh: 一月的温暖是显著地持续异常天气的一部分。

anomaly.en: This iridium anomaly offers strong support for the Alvarez hypothesis even though no asteroid itself has ever been discovered.
anomaly.zh: 这一铱异常为阿尔瓦雷斯假说提供了强有力的支持，尽管小行星本身从未被发现。

insignificant.en: In 1949 Bonn was a small, insignificant city.
insignificant.zh: 1949年，波恩还是个不足称道的小城市。

insignificant.en: The levels of chemicals in the river are not insignificant.
insignificant.zh: 河水中的化学物质含量不容忽视。

insignificant.en: Our boss dislikes being overburdened with insignificant detail.
insignificant.zh: 我们老板不喜欢疲于应付次要的细节。

variant.en: The quagga was a strikingly beautiful variant of the zebra.
variant.zh: 白氏斑马是一种极其美丽的斑马变种。

variant.en: The ASCOD features a Lockheed-designed turret for the Scout variant.
variant.zh: ASCOD 机械化步兵战车具有由洛克希德设计的 Scout 侦察车变型炮塔的特征。

variant.en: It does, however, have earlier origins in other senses. It is a variant of hallo, which dates to 1840 and is a cry of surprise.
variant.zh: 然而，它确实在其他意义上有更早的起源。它是hallo的变体，可追溯到1840年，是一种表示惊讶的叫声。

overtake.en: It's dangerous to overtake on a bend.
overtake.zh: 在弯道强行超车是危险的。

overtake.en: Coming out of the final bend, the runner stepped up a gear to overtake the rest of the pack.
overtake.zh: 赛跑者绕过最后一个弯道后开始加速，以图超越同组的其他选手。

overtake.en: Come, waste not the time—cannot I overtake him?
overtake.zh: 来吧，别浪费时间——我追不上他吗？

arbitration.en: The judge said that arbitration was a fair and expeditious decision-making process.
arbitration.zh: 法官说仲裁是一个公正且迅速有效率的决定过程。
此事已通过强制性仲裁得到解决。

arbitration.en: The matter is likely to go to arbitration.
arbitration.zh: 这件事可能要交付仲裁。

excavation.en: She worked on the excavation of a Mayan archaeological site.
excavation.zh: 她那时从事一个玛雅考古遗址的挖掘工作。

excavation.en: Hopefully, further excavation of Catalhoyuk will yield more clues.
excavation.zh: 但愿在加泰土丘的进一步挖掘能提供更多的线索。

excavation.en: About nine metres of the boat's length was recovered; one end lay beyond the excavation and had to be left.
excavation.zh: 找到了大约九米长的船身，其一端所在的地方超出挖掘范围，必须留在原地。

scissors.en: He told me to get some scissors.

greedy.en: He attacked greedy bosses for awarding themselves big raises.
greedy.zh: 他攻击那些给自己大幅涨工资的贪婪的老板们。

greedy.en: Genesis recorded a song which took a swipe at greedy property developers who bought up and demolished people's homes.
greedy.zh: 吉尼西丝录制了一首歌曲，对买下并拆毁他人家园的贪婪房地产开发商进行抨击。

greedy.en: Mary became an honest girl and was never greedy again.
greedy.zh: 玛丽成了一个诚实的女孩，再也不贪心了。

salvage.zh: 官员们努力挽救这个局面。

salvage.en: They climbed up on the rock with their salvage.
salvage.zh: 他们带着抢救出来的财物爬到了礁石上。

shepherd.en: The shepherd followed, carrying a torch to light his way.
shepherd.zh: 牧羊人跟在后面，举着火把把路照亮。

shepherd.en: The Lord is my shepherd and I shall ask for nothing.
shepherd.zh: 耶和华是我的牧者，我一无所求。

yearly.en: The two sisters looked forward to their yearly meetings.
yearly.zh: 姐妹俩期盼着她们一年一度的会面。

yearly.en: In Holland, the government sets a yearly budget for health care.
yearly.zh: 在荷兰，政府设有一个保健年度预算。

yearly.en: Pay is reviewed on a yearly basis.

disparate.en: Nuclear polyhedrosis viral infection is one factor these disparate species share.
disparate.zh: 核多角体病毒感染是这些不同物种共有的一个因素。

disparate.en: Nevertheless, Gerteis argues, these disparate party affiliations did not diminish the actuality of reformer unity, most prominent in the 1830s.
disparate.zh: 然而，格泰斯认为，这些不同的政党联盟并没有削弱改革者团结的现状，尤其是在19世纪30年代。

disparate.en: The Atlantic Monthly has long attempted to provide a design environment in which two disparate traditions—literary and journalistic—can co-exist in pleasurable dignity.
disparate.zh: 《大西洋月刊》长期以来一直试图提供一种设计环境，让文学和新闻两种不同的传统保有尊严、愉悦共存。

sophistication.zh: 莫琳曾是老于世故的典型。

sophistication.en: In its own right it is a tool of extraordinary sophistication, yet based on an idea of ingenious simplicity.
sophistication.zh: 就其本身而言，它是一种极其复杂的工具，但却基于一种巧妙而简单的理念。

sophistication.en: As he points out, electronics companies make toys that mimic pets and children with increasing sophistication.
sophistication.zh: 他指出，电子公司制造的模仿宠物和儿童的玩具越来越复杂。

token.en: We charge only a token fee for use of the facilities.
token.zh: 我们对使用这些设施只收取象征性的费用。

token.en: The government agreed to send a small token force to the area.
token.zh: 政府同意派遣一小支象征性的部队到那一地区。

token.en: The penalty for failure will be high. But, by the same token, the rewards for success will be great.
token.zh: 失败就要付出沉重的代价，同样，成功就会获得很大的回报。

anecdote.en: There is, as Robert Rubin, the treasury secretary, says, a "disjunction" between the mass of business anecdote that points to a leap in productivity and the picture reflected by the statistics.
anecdote.zh: 正如美国财长罗伯特·鲁宾所言，在指向生产率飞跃的大量商业轶事与统计数据所反映的情况之间存在着“脱节”。

anecdote.en: This research is based on anecdote not fact.
anecdote.zh: 这项研究的根据是传闻而非事实。

anecdote.en: Pete was telling them an anecdote about their mother.
anecdote.zh: 皮特正告诉他们一个关于他们母亲的趣闻轶事。

frail.zh: 她躺在床上，看上去很虚弱。

frail.en: My grandmother was becoming more and more sad and frail as the years went by.
frail.zh: 随着岁月的流逝，我的祖母变得越来越伤感和虚弱。

dismissal.en: Her dismissal came as a bolt from the blue.
dismissal.zh: 她被解雇简直就是晴天霹雳。

dismissal.en: He sat there while I made the case for his dismissal.
dismissal.zh: 他坐在那儿，听我讲着他被解雇的原因。

dismissal.en: She decided to sue her employer for wrongful dismissal.
dismissal.zh: 她决定起诉雇主非法解雇她。

trumpet.en: I played the trumpet in the school orchestra.
trumpet.zh: 我在学校管弦乐队吹小号。

trumpet.en: It fell and hit right on his trumpet.
trumpet.zh: 它掉了下来，正好砸在他的小号上。

rash.en: Her face broke out in a rash.
rash.zh: 她脸上突然长出一片红疹。

disgusting.en: Are you lusting after me? How disgusting！
disgusting.zh: 你是在追求我吗？多么恶心！

disgusting.en: My darling, it is delicious! Why do you find it disgusting?
disgusting.zh: 亲爱的，味道好极了！你为什么觉得它恶心?

disgusting.en: They guess it may be because dogs find angry faces disgusting.
disgusting.zh: 他们猜测可能是因为狗狗们觉得愤怒的脸很讨厌。

apparel.en: In Fenchurch Street a fair child, in costly apparel, stood on a stage to welcome his Majesty to the city.
apparel.zh: 在芬切琪街，一个穿着昂贵衣服的漂亮孩子站在舞台上，欢迎国王陛下来到这座城市。

apparel.en: The store sells women's and children's apparel.
apparel.zh: 这家商店出售女装和童装。

apparel.en: Women's apparel is offered in petite, regular, and tall sizes.
apparel.zh: 女士礼服分为小号、中号和大号。

indispensable.zh: 对他来说她正变得不可或缺。

indispensable.en: She made herself indispensable to the department.
indispensable.zh: 她成为这个部门不可缺少的一分子。

indispensable.en: Cars have become an indispensable part of our lives.
indispensable.zh: 汽车已成了我们生活中必不可少的一部分。

continental.en: He sees no signs of improvement in the U.K. and continental economy.
continental.zh: 他看不出英国和欧洲大陆的经济好转的迹象。

continental.en: Prices are often higher in Hawaii than in the continental United States.
continental.zh: 夏威夷的物价常常比美国大陆高。

continental.en: The most ancient parts of the continental crust are 4000 million years old.
continental.zh: 该大陆地壳最古老的那些部分有40亿年了。

congestion.en: The plan should ease traffic congestion in the town.
congestion.zh: 这项计划对城里的交通拥挤状况应该有所缓解。

congestion.en: Congestion frequently reduces traffic to walking pace.
congestion.zh: 交通阻塞经常把车流的速度降低得如步行一般缓慢。

congestion.en: The problems of traffic congestion will not disappear in a hurry.
congestion.zh: 交通堵塞问题不会很快消失。

revolt.en: In February 1848, the people of Paris rose in revolt against the constitutional monarchy of Louis-Philippe.
revolt.zh: 1848年2月，巴黎人民奋起反抗路易-菲利浦君主立宪制。

revolt.en: If instead we regard the financing of warfare by taxation in this period as a background condition, then we will see the English reverse themselves as the main cause of the revolt.
revolt.zh: 如果我们将这一时期的通过税收来支持军事作为背景条件，那么我们就会看到英国人自己的失败反倒是造成反抗的主要原因。

sever.en: I have my eyes on it: hardly three feet to sever me!
sever.zh: 我亲眼看到了，离开我不到三尺！

sever.en: The main aim for policymakers must be to sever the connection between the two.
sever.zh: 政策制定者的主要目标是必须切断二者之间的联系。

sever.en: Each unit can simultaneously communicate with up to sever other units per piconet.
sever.zh: 在一个微微网中，每个单元都能同时与其它各单元进行通信。

dye.en: I want to dye this thing green.
dye.zh: 我想把这玩意染成绿的

dye.en: The dye is adsorbed onto the fibre.
Eyebrows can be tinted with the same dye.
dye.zh: 眉毛可淡淡地染成相同的颜色。

pamphlet.en: Madame Blavatsky wrote a pamphlet against phallicism.
pamphlet.zh: 布拉瓦夫人写了一本关于反对男性生殖器崇拜的册子。

pamphlet.en: We'll have to get this pamphlet out before next week.
pamphlet.zh: 我们必须在下星期前把这本小册子发出去。

pamphlet.en: His excellent pamphlet can be downloaded for free, here.
pamphlet.zh: 他那本出色的小册子，可以在这里免费下载。

discredit.en: His political adversaries would like to discredit him.
discredit.zh: 他的政敌想破坏他的声誉。

discredit.en: Agents provocateurs may seek to discredit the opposition.
discredit.zh: 卧底可能会设法败坏反对派的名誉。

discredit.en: Violent football fans bring discredit on the teams they support.
discredit.zh: 狂热的足球迷败坏了他们所支持球队的声誉。

buckle.en: He wore a belt with a large brass buckle.
buckle.zh: 他系着一条缀有一颗大铜扣的皮带。

buckle.en: I'd better buckle down to those reports.
buckle.zh: 我最好认真静下来努力完成那些报告。

clearance.zh: 我在等待总部的录用审查许可。

clearance.en: The pilot was waiting for clearance for take-off.
clearance.zh: 飞行员在等待起飞的许可。

clearance.en: They have to wait for clearance from air traffic control.
clearance.zh: 他们必须等待空中交通管制队下达的起降许可令。

ancestral.en: Early embryos of many species develop ancestral features.
ancestral.zh: 许多物种的早期胚胎具有其祖先的特性。

ancestral.en: This ancestral species might have evolved at a time when the islands were connected.
ancestral.zh: 这种祖先物种可能是在岛屿相连的时候进化而来的。

ancestral.en: Of today's different groups of algae, green algae are probably the most similar to ancestral plants.
ancestral.zh: 在今天的众多藻类中，绿藻可能与植物的祖先最为相似。

factual.zh: 这篇社论有几处事实性错误。

factual.en: False beliefs can be useful in a social sense even if they are not useful in a factual sense.
factual.zh: 错误的信念虽然在事实意义上没有用，但从社会意义的角度来讲是有用的。

factual.en: These methods can be classified into three types of informational writing: factual, descriptive and process.
factual.zh: 这些方法可分为三类信息写作：事实性、描述性和过程性。

salute.en: He raised his hat as a friendly salute.
They all raised their glasses in salute.

fern.en: Through stubby spinneys of akeake, I saw the bend of a river, as silvery as the underside of a fern.
fern.zh: 透过矮壮的新西兰坡柳小树林我看到了河湾，像蕨类植物叶子背面一样闪着银光。

fern.en: A ladder fern springs from a crack in the 1979 lava flows from Kilauea Volcano on the Big Island of Hawaii.
fern.zh: 1979年，夏威夷大岛的基拉韦厄火山喷发出岩浆，一株梯蕨从裂缝中钻了出来。

fern.en: The fern spike is the term given to this sudden increase in the abundance of fern spores blown into the oceans around the world.
fern.zh: 世界各地的海洋中，蕨类植物的孢子数量突然增加，这种现象被称为“蕨类植物峰值”。

oriental.en: There were Oriental carpets on the floors.
oriental.zh: 地板上铺着东方的地毯。

oriental.en: This design came to be known as the Oriental style.
oriental.zh: 这种设计后来被称为东方风格。

oriental.en: The floor was overlaid with rugs of oriental design.
oriental.zh: 地板上覆盖着东方图案的地毯。

swarm.en: A swarm of people encircled the hotel.
swarm.zh: 一大群人包围了这家酒店。

swarm.en: At the time, this was the largest swarm of robots ever tested.
swarm.zh: 当时，这是测试过的最大的机器人群。

swarm.en: A network swarm is all edges and therefore open-ended any way you come at it.
swarm.zh: 一个网络群到处都是边，因此，无论你以何种方式进入，它都是开放的。

groundwater.en: A groundwater reservoir from which water can be extracted is called an aquifer.
groundwater.zh: 可以从中抽取水的地下蓄水层被称为含水层。

groundwater.en: Wetlands have a big effect on groundwater, the amount of water below the surface of the land.
groundwater.zh: 湿地对地下水，即地表以下的水量影响很大。

groundwater.en: Research from the exhaustive study of groundwater from over 950 drilling logs has just been published.
groundwater.zh: 从950多篇钻井日志中产出的对地下水问题的详尽研究刚刚发表。

deterioration.en: The recent deterioration has been caused by an apparently endless recession.
deterioration.zh: 最近的恶化是由貌似没完没了的萧条造成的。

deterioration.en: The deterioration of the ecological system is accelerating because of the dramatic increase of human production and consumption.
deterioration.zh: 由于人类生产和消费活动的急剧增加，生态系统正在加速恶化。

deterioration.en: The steady deterioration of the very climate of this very planet is becoming a war of the first order, and by any measure, the U.S. is losing.
deterioration.zh: 这个星球气候的持续恶化正在发展为一场至关重要的战争，不论以哪种标准衡量，美国都在输掉这场战争。

freak.zh: 我一看见蛇便浑身发麻。

freak.en: Weir broke his leg in a freak accident playing golf.
freak.zh: 韦尔打高尔夫球时因一次不寻常的事故而摔断了腿。

freak.en: Diaz is a fitness freak who's trained in martial arts.
freak.zh: 迪亚斯是个受过武术训练的健身迷。

mitigate.en: One future possibility is that improved monitoring can help predict where and when bleaching will occur, which might potentially enable us to mitigate its effects.
mitigate.zh: 未来的一种可能是，升级后的监测有助于预测漂白现象发生的时间和地点，这也许能让我们减轻漂白现象的影响。

mitigate.en: It doesn't really mitigate against the confinement he has perpetrated on Lolita.
mitigate.zh: 它没能减少他对洛丽塔的限制。

mitigate.en: The leases come with painstaking stipulations to mitigate any possible environmental harm to species like the polar bear.
mitigate.zh: 这些租约附带了细致的条款，以减轻对北极熊等物种的任何可能的环境伤害。

chronicle.en: Newspapers like the San Francisco Chronicle were chronicling their own doom.
chronicle.zh: 像《旧金山纪事报》这样的报纸也在见证自己的衰落。

chronicle.en: We talk about the San Francisco Chronicle all the time. It's like the main newspaper in the city.
chronicle.zh: 我们一直在谈论《旧金山纪事报》。它就像这个城市的主要报纸。

chronicle.en: Chronicle is an informative and entertaining tour into history, beautifully illustrated and full of unbelievable facts.
chronicle.zh: 《编年史》史料丰富、有趣，图文并茂，充满了令人难以置信的事实。

interruption.en: The sudden interruption stopped Justin in mid-sentence.
interruption.zh: 贾斯廷话说到一半时被突然打断了。

interruption.en: The birth of her son was a minor interruption to her career.
interruption.zh: 她儿子的出生对她的事业造成一个小小的中断。

unrest.en: Unrest has spilt over into areas outside the city.
unrest.zh: 骚乱已经波及城市的周边地区。

unrest.en: A period of unrest followed the president's resignation.
unrest.zh: 总统辞职之后有一段时期的动荡。

unrest.en: The unrest capped a weekend of right-wing attacks on foreigners.
unrest.zh: 整个周末右翼分子对外国人的袭击最终发展成为骚乱。

soothe.en: It uses therapy animals to soothe nervous passengers.
soothe.zh: 它使用治疗动物来安抚紧张的乘客。

soothe.en: He became as wild as a beast and no one could soothe him.
soothe.zh: 他变得像野兽一样狂野，没有人能抚慰他。

soothe.en: Many people soothe their consciences by purchasing only free-range fowl and eggs, blissfully ignorant that "free range" has very little practical significance.
soothe.zh: 许多人只买自由放养的家禽和鸡蛋，以此来安抚自己的良心，幸福地忽视了“自由放养”几乎没有实际意义。

clasp.en: She had sat there twiddling nervously with the clasp of her handbag.
clasp.zh: 她坐在那里紧张地旋弄着手提包的搭扣。

clasp.en: He took her hand in his firm warm clasp.
clasp.zh: 他用温暖的手紧紧握住她的手。

blush.en: "The most important thing is to be honest," she says, without the trace of a blush.
blush.zh: “最重要的是要诚实。”她说道，丝毫不脸红。
她的笑容使我脸红心跳。

tow.en: They threatened to tow away my car.
tow.zh: 他们威胁说要拖走我的车。

tow.en: He had been using the vehicle to tow his work trailer..
tow.zh: 他一直用那辆车来拖他的活动工作室。

tow.en: The car broke down and we had to get somebody to give us a tow.
tow.zh: 汽车抛锚了，我们只得让人拖走。

peninsula.en: The boat was anchored off the northern coast of the peninsula.
peninsula.zh: 那只船停泊在了离半岛北海岸不远处。

peninsula.en: Dalian is in the south of the Liaodong Peninsula.
peninsula.zh: 大连位于辽东半岛南部。

peninsula.en: The "Empty Quarter" is a huge area of sand that covers about a quarter of the Arabian Peninsula.
peninsula.zh: “空白之地”是一大片沙地，覆盖了四分之一的阿拉伯半岛。

puddle.en: Careful you don't tread in that puddle.
The puddle evaporated rapidly in the sun.
puddle.zh: 水坑在阳光下迅速蒸发。

puddle.en: Nineveh is like a puddle, and the water inside it is becoming less and less.
puddle.zh: 尼尼微就像是一个水坑，里面的水越来越少了。

visionary.zh: 帕克认为自己是一个有远见的人。
怀特既有远见又有理性。

visionary.en: An entrepreneur is more than just a risk taker. He is a visionary.
visionary.zh: 企业家不仅是个冒险者，还是一个有远见的人。

shutter.en: There are a few things you should check before pressing the shutter release.
shutter.zh: 在按快门之前，有几件事情你应该检查。

symbolism.en: The scene is so rich in symbolism that any explanation risks spoiling the effect.
symbolism.zh: 这个场景的象征手法非常丰富，任何解释都可能破坏其效果。

symbolism.en: The symbolism may come from the fact that the olive tree takes a long time to produce fruit, so olives could only be cultivated successfully in long periods of peace.
symbolism.zh: 它的象征意义可能来自于橄榄树需要很长时间才能结出果实，所以橄榄只能在长久的和平时期才能被成功种植。

symbolism.en: The symbolism of every gesture will be of vital importance during the short state visit.
symbolism.zh: 这次短暂的国事访问中的一举一动都有极其重要的象征意义。

despise.en: All children know this about mothers, and despise them for it, but make constant use of it.
despise.zh: 所有的孩子都知道母亲的这一点，并因此而鄙视她们，但他们却经常利用这一点。
动物们厌恶动物园的圈养。

despise.en: A man must despise himself before others will.

doubtful.en: We were doubtful about the practicability of the plan.
doubtful.zh: 我们怀疑这个计划是否切实可行。

doubtful.en: Rose was doubtful about the whole idea.
doubtful.zh: 罗斯对整个设想持怀疑态度。

dismay.en: She let out a groan of dismay.
He glanced back, and saw to his dismay that they were gaining on him.
dismay.zh: 他回头一看，发现他们快追上他了，这使他很沮丧。

enjoyable.en: It was much more enjoyable than I had expected.
enjoyable.zh: 它比我原先想的要令人愉快得多。

enjoyable.en: The exhibition is an enjoyable and, ultimately, life-affirming experience.
enjoyable.zh: 这个展览是一次不但令人愉快，而且还鼓舞人心的体验。

enjoyable.en: The staff should make sure the kids have an enjoyable and educational day.
enjoyable.zh: 教职员要确保孩子们度过愉快的、有教育意义的一天。

duo.en: The duo were a real hit in last year's show.
duo.zh: 这一对搭档在去年的演出中大受欢迎。

duo.en: You can order a melon duo, tofu salad and grilled royal trumpet mushrooms with polenta.
duo.zh: 你可以要一份瓜盅，豆腐沙拉和皇家烤喇叭菇配玉米粥。

duo.en: Although Fujio is most well-known for creating the duo of cat-from-the-future Doraemon and Nobita, the museum also showcases his other works.
duo.zh: 尽管不二雄是因为创作了来自未来的猫多啦A梦和大雄这对拍档而闻名的，但是博物馆也展示了他的其它作品。

jelly.en: You can even get peanut butter and jelly on an English muffin for breakfast.
jelly.zh: 早餐时你甚至可以吃到英式松饼，佐以花生酱和果冻。

outgoing.en: She is such a gregarious and outgoing person.
outgoing.zh: 她就是这样一个爱社交而且外向的人。

outgoing.en: Responsibility and reliability are necessary qualifications, as well as a friendly and outgoing personality.
outgoing.zh: 责任感和可靠性是必需的素质，友善和外向的性格也必不可少。

emulate.en: Sons are traditionally expected to emulate their fathers.
emulate.zh: 传统上认为儿子应该效仿他们的父亲。

emulate.en: They may be able to emulate the dripping sound of a crosswalk, or the buzz of a power tool.
emulate.zh: 他们或许可以效仿人行横道的滴滴声，或者电动工具的嗡嗡声。

emulate.en: But before we try to emulate geniuses or encourage our children to do so we should note that some of the things we learn from them may prove unpalatable.
emulate.zh: 但在我们试图模仿天才或鼓励我们的孩子这样做之前，我们应该注意到，我们从他们身上学到的一些东西可能并不适合我们。

bladder.zh: 他患病的膀胱使得他小便失禁。

bladder.en: When small creatures swim past, they bend the hairs on the bladder, causing a flap to open.
bladder.zh: 当小生物游过时，它们会弯曲膀胱上的毛发，导致膀胱瓣打开。

bladder.en: My wife and I spent $600 on one Labrador retriever with a bladder infection who needed some kidney tests and $300 on the other one for an injured paw.
bladder.zh: 我和我妻子就为一患膀胱感染而需要肾检查的拉布拉多猎犬花费了600美元，同时为另外一只爪子受伤的拉布拉多猎犬支付了300美元。

refrain.en: When breaking in an engine, you should refrain from high speeds for the first thousand miles.
refrain.zh: 磨合发动机时,你应当避免在最初的1千英里高速行驶。

refrain.en: Complaints about poor food in schools have become a familiar refrain.
refrain.zh: 抱怨学校饭菜差已是耳熟能详的老调了。

refrain.en: You hear the refrain all the time.
refrain.zh: 你总是听到这样的叠句。

ceremonial.en: The visit was conducted with all due ceremonial.
ceremonial.zh: 访问按照一切应有的礼仪进行。

ceremonial.en: He represented the nation on ceremonial occasions.
ceremonial.zh: 他在礼仪场合代表着国家。

ceremonial.en: Up to now the post of president has been largely ceremonial.
ceremonial.zh: 到目前为止，总统职位在很大程度上是礼仪性的。

lavish.en: Life at the mansion was lavish and lascivious—a Puritan's ninth circle of hell.
lavish.zh: 这座宅邸的生活奢华而淫乱——一位清教徒的第九层地狱。
他们过着挥霍无度的生活。

lavish.en: He was lavish in his praise for her paintings.

ballroom.en: Several hundred people twirl around the ballroom dance floor.
ballroom.zh: 几百人在舞厅的舞池里旋转着。

ballroom.en: Nashi played fish for many years, but long ago, he might have played treble saxophone in a ballroom band in Istanbul.
ballroom.zh: 纳希打了很多年的鱼，但是在很久以前，他也许在伊斯坦布尔的一个舞厅乐队里吹过高音萨克斯管。

ballroom.en: In 1926, the Savoy Ballroom was the first large business to offer a place for people to listen to swing music and dance.
ballroom.zh: 1926年，萨沃伊舞厅是第一个为人们提供摇摆音乐和跳舞场所的大型舞厅。

pointed.zh: 我轻推了推斯坦，又指了一下。

retrospective.en: There are few precedents for this sort of retrospective legislation.
retrospective.zh: 此类有追溯效力的立法还鲜有先例。

retrospective.en: Let's just do a stand-up and let's just do a retrospective, and let's just try this.
retrospective.zh: 让我们做一个单口喜剧，让我们做一个回顾，让我们试试这个。

retrospective.en: In 1946 Moore had his first foreign retrospective exhibition at the Museum of Modern Art, New York.
retrospective.zh: 1946年，摩尔在纽约现代艺术博物馆举办了他的第一次国外回顾展。

checklist.en: Make a checklist of the tools and materials you will need.
checklist.zh: 写一张你所需工具和材料的清单。
为你的小孩列一个清单。

pilgrim.en: Pledging to run Pilgrim safely, the company has applied for federal permission to keep it open for another 20 years.
pilgrim.zh: 为了保证 Pilgrim 的安全运营，该公司已经向联邦政府申请了继续运营20年的许可。

pilgrim.en: Their family goes back to the time of the Pilgrim Fathers.
pilgrim.zh: 他们家族的渊源可追溯到清教徒前辈移民时代。

pilgrim.en: This weekend course will be of value to everyone interested in the Pilgrim Route.
pilgrim.zh: 这个周末课程对于每一个对朝圣路线感兴趣的人来说都将是重要的。

milestone.en: He said the launch of the party represented a milestone in Zambian history.
milestone.zh: 他说该党的成立代表着赞比亚历史上的一个里程碑。

milestone.en: This milestone comes at a small cost.
milestone.zh: 这一里程碑的代价很小。

milestone.en: By 2014, that milestone had shifted to age 29.
milestone.zh: 到了2014年，这一里程碑变为29岁。

curtail.en: NATO plans to curtail the number of troops being sent to the region.
curtail.zh: 北大西洋公约组织计划缩减派往该地的部队数量。
同时俄罗斯也将削减出口。

curtail.en: But I don't want it seriously to curtail my longevity.
curtail.zh: 但我真的不想让抽烟缩短我的寿命。

amusing.en: It's a very amusing game to play.
amusing.zh: 这种游戏玩起来非常有趣。

amusing.en: You come over as a capable and amusing companion.
amusing.zh: 你让人觉得是一个能干而有趣的同伴。

amusing.en: The show is very amusing and the cast is very good.
amusing.zh: 表演非常有趣，演员都很优秀。

frost.zh: 霜在窗子上形成了图案。

frost.en: The car windows were covered with frost.

hamper.en: Since all the processing plants are in urban areas, removing the tariff would seriously hamper the government's effort to reduce urban unemployment over the next five years.
hamper.zh: 由于所有的加工厂都在城市地区，取消关税将严重阻碍政府在未来五年内降低城市失业率的努力。

hamper.en: On a societal level, one could even imagine that a lack of conversational flow may hamper the integration of immigrants who have not completely mastered the language of their new country yet.
hamper.zh: 在社会层面上，人们甚至可以想象，缺乏交流可能会阻碍尚未完全掌握新国家语言的移民们融入社会。

hamper.en: He tossed his damp towel into the laundry hamper.
hamper.zh: 他把湿毛巾抛入洗衣篮里。

lineage.en: Shared intentionality evolved very early in the human lineage, he believes, and its probable purpose was for cooperation in gathering food.
lineage.zh: 他认为共享意向在人类世系中很早就得到发展了，而且它的目的很可能是在采集食物过程中相互合作。

lineage.en: They can trace their lineage back to the 18th century.
lineage.zh: 他们的家族可以直接追溯到18世纪。

lineage.en: The simplest explanation for this is that the axolotl lineage alone lost the ability to metamorphose, while others retained it.
lineage.zh: 对此最简单的解释是，只有蝾螈谱系失去了变形的能力，而其他族系则保留了这种能力。

herbal.en: Mom was a great believer in herbal medicines.
herbal.zh: 妈妈是个深信草药的人。

herbal.en: Unlicensed steroids are being disguised as herbal medicines.
herbal.zh: 无许可的类固醇被伪装成为草药。

herbal.en: Herbal remedies are remarkably successful in treating eczema.
herbal.zh: 草药疗法医治湿疹非常成功。

motto.zh: “待人宽如待己。”这就是我的座右铭。
这所学校的校训是：“责任、荣誉、国家”。

motto.en: "Stay true to yourself" has always been his motto.
motto.zh: “忠于自己”一直是他的座右铭。

vegetarian.zh: 她公开声明自己是素食者。

fragrant.en: Champenois wines can be particularly fragrant and perfumed.
fragrant.zh: 香槟酒会特别浓郁芬芳。

fragrant.en: The air was fragrant with scents from the sea and the hills.
fragrant.zh: 空气中荡漾着山和海的芬芳气息。

fragrant.en: The area is famous for its wonderfully fragrant wine which has no rivals in the Rhone.
fragrant.zh: 这一地区以其极为醇香的葡萄酒而闻名，这种酒在罗纳河流域没有可匹敌者。

china.zh: 中国一直令我心驰神往。

banquet.en: He was arranging floral centrepieces in the banquet hall.
banquet.zh: 他正在宴会大厅摆放餐桌中央的装饰花束。

equilibrium.en: We have achieved an equilibrium in the economy.
equilibrium.zh: 我们已在经济上达到平衡。

equilibrium.en: He sat down to try and recover his equilibrium.
equilibrium.zh: 他坐了下来，努力恢复平静。

equilibrium.en: Any disturbance to the body's state of equilibrium can produce stress.
equilibrium.zh: 对身体平衡状态的任何干扰都可能产生压力。

luxurious.en: To enable rental increases, you have to have luxurious furnishings.
luxurious.zh: 为能实现租金增长，你得有豪华的室内陈设。
那个百万富翁过着豪华的生活。

luxurious.en: A carpenter will build a luxurious model for about seventy-five dollars.
luxurious.zh: 一个木匠将花费大概75美元建造一个豪华模型。

ratify.en: Greek lawmakers have yet to ratify the terms—which include more spending cuts, tax hikes and theprivatization of government assets.
ratify.zh: 希腊立法者还没有批准这些条款，其中包括更多的削减开支，增加税收和政府资产私有化。

ratify.en: The parliaments of Australia and Indonesia have yet to ratify the treaty.
ratify.zh: 澳大利亚和印度尼西亚议会还未批准该条约。

ratify.en: We will work to ratify and bring into force the test ban treaty.
ratify.zh: 我们将为使《禁止核试验条约》获得批准并生效而努力。

irresistible.zh: 他轮廓分明的容貌让女人们无法抗拒。

irresistible.en: There is one thing I would like to know – What is it about Tim that you find so irresistible?
irresistible.zh: 有一件事我想知道–蒂姆到底有什么让你觉得那么不可抗拒？

murky.zh: 他有一段不清白的过去。

murky.en: The law here is a little bit murky.
murky.zh: 该法律此处有点含糊不清。

murky.en: She gazed into the murky depths of the water.
murky.zh: 她注视着那幽暗的水底。

upheaval.en: He is resigned to the noise, the mess, the constant upheaval.
upheaval.zh: 他对噪音、杂乱和持续动荡逆来顺受。

upheaval.en: Whilst chaos and upheaval reigns in the college, what of the chaos and noise that local residents are subjected to ?
upheaval.zh: 当混乱和动荡笼罩着学院的时候，当地的居民们又会遭受怎样的混乱和喧嚣呢？

upheaval.en: I can't face the upheaval of moving house again.
upheaval.zh: 我无法忍受再次搬家的折腾。

seasoning.en: The roasted seasoning largely overpowered any other flavour, although there was slightly bitter after taste.
seasoning.zh: 烤过的佐料在很大程度上盖过了所有别的味道，尽管尝过之后会比之前更苦一点。

seasoning.en: The dried aromatic leaf of the laurel (Laurus nobilis) can be used as a seasoning in cooking.
seasoning.zh: 月桂树（月桂属）的干香叶，可以在烹调中用作调味品。
2茶匙欧贝调味料或克里奥调味料。

tuberculosis.en: Hayley contracted tuberculosis and had to be put in an isolation ward.
tuberculosis.zh: 海利感染了肺结核而不得不被送进一个隔离病房。

tuberculosis.en: When 23-year-old Marilyn Brown started to feel run-down last December, it never occurred to her that she could have tuberculosis.
tuberculosis.zh: 当23岁的玛丽莲•布朗去年12月开始感到疲惫的时候，她未曾想到她会得肺结核。

tuberculosis.en: For instance, they were used to stain previously invisible microbes and bacteria, allowing researchers to identify such bacilli as tuberculosis, cholera, and anthrax.
tuberculosis.zh: 例如，用它们来给以前看不见的微生物和细菌染色，从而使研究人员能够识别出结核、霍乱和炭疽等杆菌。

demanding.zh: 里基是个非常苛求的孩子。

demanding.en: We will be demanding equal rights at work.
demanding.zh: 我们将要求工作中的平等权利。

demanding.en: Duff said he would be demanding a rematch.

lava.en: The city was entombed in volcanic lava.
lava.zh: 那个城市被火山熔岩掩埋了。

lava.en: Rivers of molten lava flowed down the mountain.
lava.zh: 大量的熔岩顺着山坡流下来。

bouquet.en: The woman carried a bouquet of dried violets.
bouquet.zh: 那个女子拿着一束干紫罗兰花。

bouquet.en: These naturally dried flowers will outlast a bouquet of fresh blooms.
bouquet.zh: 这些自然风干的花会比一束鲜花更为持久。

bouquet.en: If you're making your own bouquet, wrap your flowers in a matching ribbon or bow.
bouquet.zh: 如果你正在操办自己的宴会，可以用比较搭的丝带和蝴蝶结来包花束。

womb.en: This olfactory sense develops in the womb.
womb.zh: 这一嗅觉在子宫内形成。

womb.en: The answer may lie in the womb.
For example, parents could have one embryo implanted in the mother's womb and store its identical siblings indefinitely.
womb.zh: 例如，父母可以将一个胚胎植入母亲的子宫，无限期地储存同卵双胞胎。

tutor.en: He was my personal tutor at university.
tutor.zh: 他是我大学时的个人指导教师。

tutor.en: You seem to be on very familiar terms with your tutor.
tutor.zh: 你似乎和你的导师之间很随便。

tutor.en: Activities all take place under the guidance of an experienced tutor.
tutor.zh: 所有活动都在经验丰富的导师指导下进行。

crossroad.en: We stand today at a similar crossroad.
crossroad.zh: 今天我们就站在类似的十字路口。

crossroad.en: History has led us to a new crossroad, with new promise and new peril.
crossroad.zh: 历史已经将我们引领到一个新的十字路口，既有新承诺也有新危险。

chalk.en: You may chalk it on the wall.
chalk.zh: 你可以用粉笔把它记在墙上。

chalk.en: Think of a simple object—a piece of chalk, for example.
chalk.zh: 想象一个简单的物体，例如，一支粉笔。

chalk.en: It's not over yet—not by a long chalk.
chalk.zh: 这事还没有了结—远远没有。

furnace.en: Their first job was to rewire the whole house and install a new furnace.
furnace.zh: 他们的第一份工作是给整个房子重新布线，并安装一个新火炉。

furnace.en: This room is as hot as a furnace.
furnace.zh: 这个房间热得像火炉一样。

furnace.en: Several processes—melting, refining, homogenising—take place simultaneously in the 2000 tonnes of molten glass in the furnace.
furnace.zh: 熔炉里的2000吨熔融玻璃中，几个过程——熔化、精炼、均质化——在同时进行。

trek.zh: 你长途跋涉了多长时间？

trek.en: Last but not least, if you're hungry after a long day's trek I can recommend our local café.
trek.zh: 最后，如果你在一整天的长途跋涉后饿了，我推荐我们当地的咖啡馆。
到商业区去要走很长的路。

pigment.en: He makes his own paint, grinding up the pigment with a little oil.
pigment.zh: 他把色料块加少许油磨碎，自己制成绘画颜料。

pigment.en: You are better off using a pure green pigment.
pigment.zh: 你最好使用纯绿色颜料。

pigment.en: Why this pigment is there and what it might do was unknown.
pigment.zh: 这种色素为什么会存在和它可能有什么作用是未知的。

nuance.en: He watched her face intently to catch every nuance of expression.
nuance.zh: 他认真地注视着她的脸，捕捉每一丝细微的表情变化。

nuance.en: We can use our eyes and facial expressions to communicate virtually every subtle nuance of emotion there is.
nuance.zh: 我们可以用眼睛和面部表情来如实地传达情感上的每一丝细微差别。

nuance.en: All the complexity, nuance, and pleasure of flavor come from the sense of smell operating in the back of the nose.
nuance.zh: 所有风味的复杂性、细微差别和愉悦感都来源于鼻子后部进行的嗅觉。

gadget.zh: 这小玩意儿没多大用处。

gadget.en: This gadget is just the thing for getting those nails out.
gadget.zh: 这小玩意儿用来起那些钉子正合适。

gadget.en: Roughly the size of a soda can, sitting on a bookshelf, a relatively harmless gadget may be turning friends away from your home.
gadget.zh: 一个汽水罐大小的小东西放在书架上，这个相对无害的小玩意可能会让你的朋友远离你的住宅。

stunt.en: The band dressed up as the Beatles as a publicity stunt.
stunt.zh: 乐队扮作披头士乐队作为宣传噱头。

stunt.en: In a bold promotional stunt for the movie, he smashed his car into a passing truck.
stunt.zh: 在那部影片大胆的宣传噱头中，他把自己的汽车撞向一辆过路的卡车。

stunt.en: Yakima Canutt was a famous cowboy stunt man.
stunt.zh: 雅基玛·坎努特是一位著名的牛仔特技演员。

intuitive.en: He had an intuitive sense of what the reader wanted.
intuitive.zh: 他能直觉地感到读者需要什么。

intuitive.en: A positive pregnancy test soon confirmed her intuitive feelings.
intuitive.zh: 阳性的孕检结果很快证实了她的直觉。
这一策略在直觉上讲是有道理的。

eradicate.en: They are already battling to eradicate illnesses such as malaria and tetanus.
eradicate.zh: 他们已经在为根除疟疾、破伤风等疾病而斗争。

eradicate.en: The campaign to eradicate malaria did not do so.
eradicate.zh: 根除疟疾运动没有做到这样。

eradicate.en: Surely we will aim to finally eradicate disease and poverty.
eradicate.zh: 当然，我们的目标是最终能够消灭疾病和贫困。

underwater.en: The boat finally grounded on a soft, underwater bank.
underwater.zh: 那条船最终在一个松软的水下浅滩搁浅了。

underwater.en: If the water's cloudy like that, it'll be hard to see anyone underwater.
underwater.zh: 如果水浑浊成那样，就很难看得到水下的人。

underwater.en: Heedless of time or any other consideration, they began to search the underwater cave.
underwater.zh: 他们根本没考虑时间或任何其他因素就开始寻找水下洞穴了。

augment.en: While searching for a way to augment the family income, she began making dolls.
augment.zh: 为求增加家庭收入，她开始做起了玩具娃娃。

augment.en: The government's first concern was to augment the army and auxiliary forces.
augment.zh: 政府首要关注的是扩充军队与后备军。

augment.en: In other words, we need to look at the ways in which machines can augment human labor rather than replace it.
augment.zh: 换句话说，我们需要研究机器如何辅助人类劳动，而不是研究其如何取代它。

shun.en: They wear simple clothes and shun modern contrivances.
shun.zh: 他们穿着简单，避免了现代装束。

shun.en: More discriminating visitors now tend to shun the area.
shun.zh: 更多有鉴别能力的游客现在趋向于避开此地。

shun.en: "Humans should not try to avoid stress any more than they would shun food, love or exercise," said Dr. Hans Selye, the first physician to document the effects of stress on the body.
shun.zh: 汉斯·塞尔耶是第一个记录压力对身体影响的医生，他说：“人们不应该试图逃避压力，就像他们不逃避食物、爱或锻炼。”

fortress.en: Fear of terrorist attack has turned the conference centre into a fortress.
fortress.zh: 由于害怕恐怖分子袭击，会议中心已变成了堡垒。

fortress.en: It's easier to "capture the fortress from within."
fortress.zh: 堡垒更容易从内部攻破。

fortress.en: The general hastened to the relief of the fortress.
fortress.zh: 将军火速前往救援该要塞。

touching.en: He felt a hand touching his shoulder.
touching.zh: 他感到有只手在触摸他的肩膀。

touching.en: His devotion to his wife and family is touching.
touching.zh: 他对妻子和家人的关爱感人至深。

caption.en: As before, it's up to you to provide the caption.
caption.zh: 像以前一样，由您来提供一个标题。

caption.en: Each level should have exactly one caption attribute.
caption.zh: 每个级别都应该有一个标题属性。

caption.en: This week, we intend to put this theory to the test by asking you, our readers, to write a caption for this picture.
caption.zh: 本周，我们打算请您，我们的读者朋友，为这张图片撰写一条标题以检验这一理论。

safeguard.en: The new card will safeguard the company against fraud.
safeguard.zh: 新卡将保护公司免遭诈骗。

safeguard.en: This deal could safeguard the futures of the 2 000 employees.
safeguard.zh: 这个协议可以保障2 000名雇员今后的生活。

safeguard.en: They will press for international action to safeguard the ozone layer.
safeguard.zh: 他们将竭力要求国际行动来保护臭氧层。

larva.en: The image above is of the larva of a ground-nesting solitary bee from Turkey.
larva.zh: 上图是来自土耳其的地面筑巢独居蜂的幼虫。

larva.en: The casing is nearly airtight, which helps protect the vulnerable egg and later larva.
larva.zh: 外层几乎是密封的，可以保护脆弱的蜂卵，以及后来的幼虫。

larva.en: There is a record of a beetle larva living in dead wood for over 40 years before becoming an adult.
larva.zh: 有记录显示，一只甲虫幼虫成年前在枯木中生活了40多年。

midday.en: At midday everyone would go down to Reg's Café.
midday.zh: 中午每个人都去雷吉的小餐馆。

midday.en: Motorists were forced to turn on their headlights at midday.
midday.zh: 驾车者被强制要求在正午打开前灯。

barber.en: My father marched me over to Otto, the local barber, to have my hair cut short.
barber.zh: 爸爸把我拽到当地理发师奥托跟前，让他把我的头发剪短。

cartridge.en: Change the filter cartridge as often as instructed by the manufacturer.
cartridge.zh: 要按制造商要求的频率更换过滤套筒。

cartridge.en: He aimed his rifle, fired a single shot, then ejected the spent cartridge.
cartridge.zh: 他用步枪瞄准，开了一枪，接着排出了空弹壳。

cartridge.en: While serving a compulsory stint in the military, Nurmi entered a 20-k march carrying a rifle, a cartridge belt, and a knapsack.
cartridge.zh: 在军中服义务役的时候，努尔米带着一支步枪、一条子弹带和一个背包参加了20公里行军。

heed.en: The hermit went on muttering, and gave no heed.
heed.zh: 隐士继续念叨着，没有注意。

heed.en: If your unconscious is saying don't take that job, go on that date, poke that skunk—take heed.
heed.zh: 如果你的潜意识告诉你不要接受那份工作，那就在这天去戳穿它——注意了。

heed.en: To heed more rational monetary considerations in the face of an unfair offer requires that you "swallow your pride".
heed.zh: 面临一个不公平的出价时，留意更理性的金融考虑，需要你“吞下你的自尊心”。

unsafe.en: In the larger neighbourhood, I felt very unsafe.
unsafe.zh: 在较大的街区，我感到非常不安全。

unsafe.en: It was considered unsafe to release the prisoners.
unsafe.zh: 释放这些囚犯被认为是危险的。

unsafe.en: Discharge of raw sewage into the sea is unsanitary and unsafe.
unsafe.zh: 向大海里倾倒污水既不卫生也不安全。

malaria.en: Malaria is endemic in many hot countries.
malaria.zh: 疟疾是许多气候炎热国家的流行病。

malaria.en: At present, no widely approved vaccine exists for malaria.
malaria.zh: 目前没有被广泛认可的疟疾疫苗。

malaria.en: They are already battling to eradicate illnesses such as malaria and tetanus.
malaria.zh: 他们已经在为根除疟疾、破伤风等疾病而斗争。

avoidance.en: A person's health improves with the avoidance of stress.
avoidance.zh: 一个人只要避免紧张，健康状况就会改善。

avoidance.en: The perennial vegetation adjusts to the aridity by means of various avoidance mechanisms.
avoidance.zh: 多年生植物会采用各种躲避机制以适应干旱。

avoidance.en: Building large new hospitals in the bistate area would constitute a wasteful use of resources, on the basis of avoidance of duplicated facilities alone.
avoidance.zh: 仅在避免重复设施的基础上，在双州地区新建大型医院就是对资源的浪费。

liken.en: Others liken it to a country club.
liken.zh: 而其他人则把它比作乡村俱乐部。

liken.en: Others liken him to Captain Ahab pursuing his whale.
liken.zh: 有些人则将奥巴马比喻为追寻白鲸的阿哈船长。

liken.en: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? Saith the Holy One.
liken.zh: 那圣者说，你们将谁比我，叫他与我相等呢。

scant.en: She began to berate the police for paying scant attention to the theft from her car.
scant.zh: 她开始严厉斥责警方对她车内东西失窃一案关注不足。

scant.en: Scant attention has been paid to many of the dubious social and economic assumptions that underlie the plan.
scant.zh: 人们对该计划背后的许多可疑的社会和经济假设缺乏关注。

scant.en: I paid scant attention to what she was saying.
scant.zh: 我没大注意她在说什么。

allergic.en: Nuts can trigger off a violent allergic reaction.
allergic.zh: 坚果可以引起严重的过敏反应。

brisk.en: A brisk walk should blow the cobwebs away.
brisk.zh: 轻快的散步可以使人头脑清醒。

brisk.en: As they started up again, the horse broke into a brisk trot.
brisk.zh: 当他们又出发时，那匹马便轻快地小跑起来。
她用一种公务口吻，说话干脆利落。

gamble.en: It was wrong to gamble with our children's future.
gamble.zh: 拿孩子们的未来冒险是错误的。

gamble.en: Few firms will be willing to gamble on new products.
gamble.zh: 很少有公司愿意在新产品上冒险。

gamble.en: If you own shares in large American corporations, you're a winner in the weak-dollar gamble.
gamble.zh: 如果你持有美国大公司的股票，那么你会是这场疲软美元投机中的赢家。

bounty.en: Taking advantage of this rich bounty, Alaska's commercial fisheries have developed into some of the largest in the world.
bounty.zh: 利用这一丰富的资源，阿拉斯加的商业渔场已经发展为世界上最大的渔场之一。

bounty.en: My name is Domino Harvey -- I’m a bounty hunter.
bounty.zh: 吾名多米诺·哈维，赏金猎人。

bounty.en: However, sometimes nature's bounty is not enough.
bounty.zh: 然而有时候大自然的慷慨是不够的。

authoritative.en: He has a commanding presence and deep, authoritative voice.
authoritative.zh: 他仪态威严，声音深沉而有权威。

authoritative.en: The first authoritative study of polio was published in 1840.
authoritative.zh: 关于小儿麻痹症的首篇权威研究报告发表于1840年。

authoritative.en: Amanda launched into an authoritative disquisition about contracts.
authoritative.zh: 阿曼达开始了一番对合同的权威解释。

irritation.en: These oils may cause irritation to sensitive skins.
irritation.zh: 这几种油可能会对敏感皮肤有刺激。

irritation.en: He tried not to let his irritation show as he blinked in the glare of the television lights.
irritation.zh: 在对着耀眼的电视光线眨眼时，他竭力不把自己的恼怒表现出来。

irritation.en: If the irritation is severe enough, a sleeping person will arouse, clear the airway, then resume breathing and likely return to sleep.
irritation.zh: 如果刺激足够剧烈，睡着的人就会醒来并清理气道，恢复呼吸，并很可能再度陷入睡眠中。

flea.en: The Flea was the first to step forward.
flea.zh: 跳蚤是第一个站出来的。

flea.en: "It's all the same to me," said the Flea.
flea.zh: “这对我来说都是一样的。”跳蚤说。

flea.en: I really enjoyed going to the flea market.
flea.zh: 我真的很喜欢去跳蚤市场。

console.en: I can console myself with the fact that I'm not alone.
console.zh: 我可以用不只我一个人的这种事实来安慰自己。

console.en: This Christmas sees the launch of a new games console.
console.zh: 今年的圣诞节目睹了一种新电子游戏机的推出。

console.en: Console yourself with the thought that you did your best.
console.zh: 你可以安慰自己的是你已经尽了最大的努力。

hymn.en: The congregation stood to sing the hymn.
After the prayer, young men and women distributed olive branches while a choir sang a hymn in Greek.
hymn.zh: 祈祷结束后，唱诗班用希腊语唱赞美诗时，年轻的男男女女分发橄榄枝。

hymn.en: We do have a victory hymn, a victory hymn that's inscribed on a stele that's a slab of stone--which was erected in the year 1204 BC.
hymn.zh: 我们确实有一首胜利赞美诗，一首刻在石碑上的胜利赞美诗，石碑是一块石板，建于公元前1204年。

tolerant.en: They need to be tolerant of different points of view.
tolerant.zh: 他们需要容忍不同的观点。

solemn.en: I made a solemn promise that I would return.
solemn.zh: 我郑重承诺我会回来的。

solemn.en: Erica was solemn, pulling at her blonde curls.
solemn.zh: 埃丽卡表情严肃，拉扯着她金黄色的卷发。

solemn.en: The solemn intensity of Jade's gaze discomfited him.
solemn.zh: 在杰德强烈而严肃的凝视下他狼狈不堪。

rainfall.en: There has been below average rainfall this month.
rainfall.zh: 这个月的降雨低于平均降雨量。

rainfall.en: There have been four years of below average rainfall.
rainfall.zh: 已经有4年降雨量低于平均水平了。

rainfall.en: Record levels of rainfall fell over the southeast of the country.
rainfall.zh: 该国东南部降下了最高纪录的雨量。

heave.en: The thought of it makes me heave.
The greasy food made her stomach heave.
heave.zh: 油腻腻的食物让她胃里恶心。

heave.en: I managed to heave the trunk down the stairs.
heave.zh: 我用力把箱子弄下楼梯。

concur.en: Local feeling does not necessarily concur with the press.
concur.zh: 当地人的看法不一定和媒体一致。

concur.en: Sceptics and advocates alike do concur on one issue, however: that the most impressive evidence so far has come from the so-called "ganzfeld" experiments, a German term that means "whole field".
concur.zh: 然而，怀疑者和支持者在一个问题上达成了一致：迄今为止，最令人印象深刻的证据来自所谓的“甘兹菲尔德”实验，这是一个德语术语，意思是“整个领域”。

concur.en: Most investigators concur that certain facial expressions suggest the same emotions in all people.
concur.zh: 大多数研究人员一致认为，对所有人来说，一些特定的面部表情都表明同样的情绪。

hound.en: The hound found a profound book on the roundabout.
hound.zh: 猎犬在旋转木马上找到一本深奥的书。

hound.en: Holmes thought deeply on the way home: the story of the Hound, Sir Charles's death, the strange letter, the missing boot and the black bearded man.
hound.zh: 在回家的路上，福尔摩斯沉思着猎犬的故事、查尔斯爵士的死、那封奇怪的信、丢失的靴子和那个黑胡子男人。

hound.en: The basset hound was standing in a busy street, and everyone was stopped.
hound.zh: 巴吉度猎犬站在一条繁忙的街道上，每个人都被拦住了。

disregard.en: He showed a reckless disregard for his own safety.
disregard.zh: 他对个人安危全然无所顾忌。

disregard.en: She shows a total disregard for other people's feelings.
disregard.zh: 她丝毫不顾及别人的感受。

disregard.en: He drove with blithe disregard for the rules of the road.
disregard.zh: 他开车时全然不顾交通法规。

glaze.en: Furthermore, the designs were covered with "desert varnish", a glaze that develops on rock surfaces over thousands of years of exposure to the elements.
glaze.zh: 此外，这些设计还覆盖有“沙漠清漆”，一种在岩石表面经过数千年在这些元素暴露下而形成的釉料。

glaze.en: Several salads have either cilantro lime glaze, or orange glaze added.
glaze.zh: 有些沙拉要么加了芫荽酸糖浆，要么加了橙汁糖浆。

glaze.en: At the end of their ladies' lunch, they were served a tart with a gorgeous, glossy glaze.
glaze.zh: 在她们用餐结束前，他们上了一道馅饼，有着华丽、光滑表面的馅饼。

proxy.en: You can vote either in person or by proxy.
proxy.zh: 你可以亲自投票或请人代理。

proxy.en: Your proxy will need to sign the form on your behalf.
proxy.zh: 你的代理人将须代表你在表格上签字。

proxy.en: Then they simply checked which directors stayed from one proxy statement to the next.
proxy.zh: 接下来，他们只是检查哪些董事更换过代理声明。

camper.en: We bought a camper van so we could go away whenever the fancy took us.
camper.zh: 我们买了一辆野营车，所以我们啥时想去野营就可以去。

camper.en: We come upon a small caravan camper with its door open to a late-middle-aged Scottish couple, sitting at a folding table, taking tea and biscuits.
camper.zh: 我们遇到了一辆小型的有篷露营车，车门开着，正对着一对中年的苏格兰夫妇，他们正坐在折叠桌旁，喝着茶吃着饼干。

dread.en: My greatest dread is that my parents will find out.
dread.zh: 我最担心的就是父母会察觉出来。
它总是有这种可怕的效果吗？

livelihood.en: Predatory pricing by large supermarkets was threatening the livelihood of smaller businesses.
livelihood.zh: 大型超市的掠夺性定价正威胁着小商店的生计。

livelihood.en: A slow response to a message could hurt not only your reputation but also your livelihood.
livelihood.zh: 回复信息太慢不仅会损害名声，还影响生计。

livelihood.en: A slow response to a message could hurt not only your reputation, but also your livelihood.
livelihood.zh: 回应信息迟钝不仅会损害你的声誉，还会影响你的生计。

chemist.en: After graduating, she worked as a chemist.
chemist.zh: 毕业后，她当上了一名药剂师。

chemist.en: The chemist dissolved some material in hot water.
chemist.zh: 化学家将一些物质溶解在热水里。

chemist.en: It was created by a French chemist, Angelo Mariani, in 1863.
chemist.zh: 它是由法国化学家安吉洛·马里亚尼于1863年创造的。

stringent.en: He announced that there would be more stringent controls on the possession of weapons.
stringent.zh: 他宣布在武器的持有方面将会有更严格的控制。

stringent.en: Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being.
stringent.zh: 严格的解雇条例反而会影响生产率的增长，阻碍社会的繁荣发展和整体福利。

stringent.en: "In some cases the quality requirements are so stringent that even if you wanted to have a human do the job, you couldn't," Burnstein says.
stringent.zh: “在某些情况下，质量要求会非常严格，即使你想让人来做这项工作也不行。”伯恩斯坦说道。

paddle.en: Paddle like you're in a kayak or canoe.
paddle.zh: 像在皮划艇或独木舟上那样做划桨动作。

paddle.en: These people parachute into dangerous areas, paddle alongside massive fishing boats, or release pamphlets from airplanes.
paddle.zh: 这些人跳伞到危险地区和巨大的渔船一起划桨前进、或者从飞机上散发小册子。

revealing.en: The saboteurs had demanded money in return for revealing how they hacked into the systems.
revealing.zh: 这些破坏分子要求以钱作交换，才会透露他们是如何侵入该系统的。

revealing.en: He laughed, revealing a line of white teeth.
revealing.zh: 他笑了起来，露出一排洁白的牙齿。

revealing.en: She was dismissed for revealing trade secrets.
revealing.zh: 她因泄露商业机密被解雇。

syllable.zh: 他清楚地说出了每个音节。
potato一词的重音在第二个音节上。

deprivation.en: According to some professionals, deprivation of young children's playtime will do harm not only to children themselves but to the country and the world.
deprivation.zh: 一些专业人士认为，剥夺儿童玩耍时间伤害的不仅是儿童本身，还会伤害到国家乃至整个世界。

deprivation.en: They had withstood siege, hunger and deprivation.
deprivation.zh: 他们经受了围困、饥饿和贫穷。

deprivation.en: Millions more suffer from serious sleep deprivation caused by long work hours.
deprivation.zh: 还有数百万人由于工作时数长导致他们严重睡眠不足。

amused.en: We were all amused at his stories.
amused.zh: 我们都被他的故事逗笑了。

amused.en: Sara was not amused by Franklin's teasing.
amused.zh: 莎拉没有被弗兰克林的逗趣儿逗笑。

amused.en: His facial contortions amused the audience of schoolchildren.
amused.zh: 他扮鬼脸逗得小学生观众都笑起来了。

inflammation.en: The drug can cause inflammation of the liver.
inflammation.zh: 这种药会引发肝脏炎症。

inflammation.en: Chronic inflammation, is, of course, associated with major illnesses like heart disease and various cancers.
inflammation.zh: 当然，慢性炎症与心脏病和各种癌症等重大疾病有关。

inflammation.en: The antioxidant nutrients found in papaya have also been proven to reduce muscle inflammation and heal burns and wounds.
inflammation.zh: 在木瓜中发现的抗氧化营养素已被证明能降低肌肉炎症以及能愈合烧伤创疡。

limestone.en: The area is being quarried for limestone.
limestone.zh: 这地方正在开采石灰石。

limestone.en: The large limestone caves are also quarried for cement.
limestone.zh: 这些大石灰岩洞也用来开采水泥原料。

limestone.en: The basic ingredients are limestone and clay in the proportion 2:1.
limestone.zh: 基本成分是石灰石和黏土，比例为2:1。

inscribe.en: There is really nothing to inscribe but name and age, you see.
inscribe.zh: 您看，除了姓名和年龄就没有什么别的要刻的了。

inscribe.en: Sometimes, though, you need to inscribe variation down at the class level.
inscribe.zh: 但有时候需要记下类级别的差异。

inscribe.en: What then is the overall strategic concept which we should inscribe today?
inscribe.zh: 那么今天什么样的“全面战略概念”是我们应当题写的呢？

clumsy.en: He tried to dance, but he was too clumsy and awkward.
clumsy.zh: 他试着跳舞，但是太笨拙，太别扭。
它喘着气嘟囔着：“笨手笨脚的。”
大家对他的拙劣发言均很反感。

singular.en: In 'Tom likes jazz', the singular verb 'likes' agrees with the subject 'Tom'.
singular.zh: 在Tom likes jazz一句中，动词单数形式likes与主语Tom一致。

singular.en: 'I am' is the first person singular of the present tense of the verb 'to be'.
singular.zh: I am是动词to be现在时的第一人称单数。
我将成为一个非凡的商人。

pollute.en: Mining would pollute the lake and denude the forest.
pollute.zh: 采矿将会污染湖水并伐光森林。

pollute.en: These gases pollute the atmosphere of towns and cities.
pollute.zh: 这些气体污染城镇的空气。

outpost.en: It towered above the older buildings like a citadel, which indeed it was, the outpost of a new age, perhaps a new civilization, perhaps a new barbarism.
outpost.zh: 它屹立在古老的建筑之上，像一座城堡，也的确是一个新时代的前哨，这种前哨可能意味着一种新文明，也可能是一种新野蛮。

outpost.en: This rural outpost, 400 miles northeast of Helena, has one stoplight.
outpost.zh: 这个在赫勒拿东北400英里处的农村居民点有一个交通信号灯。

outpost.en: Ice-class tugboat "Nevskaya Zastava" ("Neva Outpost") was designed and constructed in St. Petersburg.
outpost.zh: 冰区航行拖船“涅瓦河前哨”是在圣彼得堡设计和建造的。

motivational.en: There is an abundance of evidence to support the motivational benefits that result from carefully matching people to jobs.
motivational.zh: 有大量的证据表明，人员与工作之间的仔细匹配能够带来激励效益。

motivational.en: Teachers reported significant motivational changes in 27% of the children in the growth mind-set workshop as compared with only 9% of students in the control group.
motivational.zh: 老师们报告说，参加成长型思维课的学生中，有27%的学生的积极性发生了显著的变化，而对照组中只有9%的学生的积极性有所变化。

coil.en: Tod shook his head angrily and slung the coil of rope over his shoulder.
coil.zh: 托德生气地摇摇头，把那圈绳索甩过肩头。

coil.en: Boil the oil soiled by the coil in the toilet lest it spoils.
coil.zh: 把被盥洗室里的线圈弄脏的油煮开，以免变质。

infer.en: What can we infer about the author from the text?
infer.zh: 从文章中我们能推断出作者的什么信息？

infer.en: What can we infer from the passage about the author?
infer.zh: 我们可以从文章中推断出关于作者的什么信息？

infer.en: You should learn how to infer a conclusion from statistics.
infer.zh: 你应该学会如何从数据中推断出一个结论。

mourning.en: She was still in mourning for her husband.
Yesterday the whole of Greece was in mourning.
The government announced a day of national mourning for the victims.
mourning.zh: 政府宣布全国为受害者哀悼一日。

captive.en: They were taken captive by masked gunmen.
captive.zh: 他们被蒙面的持枪歹徒劫持了。

captive.en: Children come to zoos precisely to see captive animals.
captive.zh: 孩子们到动物园来正是为了看那些被关起来的动物。

captive.en: Her heart had begun to pound inside her chest like a captive animal.
captive.zh: 她心如鹿撞，怦怦跳个不停。

overt.en: Although there is no overt hostility, black and white students do not mix much.
overt.zh: 虽然没有明显的敌意，但黑人学生和白人学生还是交往不多。

overt.en: There was little overt support for the project.
overt.zh: 对这个项目公开表示支持的很少。

overt.en: Advertisements attempt to project a latent meaning behind an overt message.
overt.zh: 广告试图传达一种隐藏在公开信息里的潜在意义。

curly.en: She had curly black hair and rouged cheeks.
curly.zh: 她有卷曲的黑发和涂脂的双颊。

curly.en: Dry curly hair naturally for maximum curl and shine.
curly.zh: 让卷发自然地风干以最大限度地增加头发的卷曲和光泽。

duplicate.en: Is this a duplicate or the original?
His task will be to duplicate his success overseas here at home.
duplicate.zh: 他的任务将是在国内复制他在海外的成功。

duplicate.en: Robert Anderson to duplicate his Mexican success in the sub-continent.
duplicate.zh: 罗伯特·安德森在次大陆复制了他在墨西哥的成功。

unreasonable.en: My literary agent thinks it is not unreasonable to expect $500,000 in total.
unreasonable.zh: 我的文学经纪人认为预期总共50万美元并非不合情理。

unreasonable.en: The fees they charge are not unreasonable.
He was being totally unreasonable about it.
unreasonable.zh: 他在这件事上蛮不讲理。

germ.en: This was the germ of a book.
germ.zh: 这是一本书的创作萌芽。

germ.en: There was a thick growth of staph germ.
germ.zh: 葡萄球菌的胚芽生长得很茂盛。

germ.en: The germ of protest has continued to spread.
germ.zh: 抗议行动的胚芽还在四处蔓延。

hysterical.en: Police and bodyguards had to form a human shield around him as the almost hysterical crowds struggled to approach him.
hysterical.zh: 当近乎歇斯底里的人群奋力接近他时，警察和保镖们不得不在他周围形成一堵人墙。

hysterical.en: It's a poem that begins, "I have heard that hysterical women say they are sick of the palette and fiddle-bow, of poets that are always gay."
hysterical.zh: 诗的开头写道，“我曾听见歇斯底里的女人们说，她们厌恶调色板和提琴弓，厌恶那些永远快乐的诗人们。”

affinity.en: The details of her skeleton proclaim her human affinity.
affinity.zh: 她骨骼的细节证明了她与人类的密切关系。

affinity.en: There is a close affinity between Italian and Spanish.
affinity.zh: 意大利语和西班牙语关系密切。

affinity.en: Sam was born in the country and had a deep affinity with nature.
affinity.zh: 萨姆在乡下出生，特别喜爱大自然。

redeem.en: He was able to redeem his watch from the pawnshop.
redeem.zh: 他得以从当铺赎回他的表。

redeem.en: He had no way to redeem his furniture out of pawn.
redeem.zh: 他无法赎回典当的家具。

redeem.en: Level Global and Loch saw investors redeem money as soon as possible because of the raid, even though they haven't been charged with any wrongdoing.
redeem.zh: 目前水平国际和 Loch 公司看到投资者因为此次突袭而尽快赎回资金，尽管他们没有受到任何不当行为的指控。

strangle.en: The Pandemic will take lives, strangle economies and destroy routines, but it will pass.
strangle.zh: 大流行病将夺去生命、扼杀经济、打破常规，但它终将会过去。

strangle.en: The dead man got up and cried, "Now will I strangle you."
strangle.zh: 那死人站起来叫道：“现在我要把你掐死。”

strangle.en: In at least one case, it tried to strangle its owner.
strangle.zh: 在至少一例病患中，那只手试图勒死主人。

stray.en: A stray dog came up to him.
stray.zh: 一只走失的狗来到他跟前。

stray.en: The dog was a stray which had been adopted.
stray.zh: 这只狗是被收养的流浪狗。

stray.en: Tourists often get lost and stray into dangerous areas.
stray.zh: 旅游者们经常迷路走进一些危险区域。

replica.en: The weapon used in the raid was a replica.
replica.zh: 抢劫案中使用的武器是一件仿制品。

replica.en: A replica of the Arch de Triumph that usually stands in Paris has been transported to Tokyo Bay for the festival.
replica.zh: 一件通常矗立在巴黎凯旋门的复制品因艺术节已被运到东京湾。

replica.en: It was decided to make the replica half-scale for reasons of cost and time, and synthetic materials were used for the stitching.
replica.zh: 由于成本和时间的原因，我们决定将复制品缩小一半，并使用合成材料来缝合。

elude.en: The two men managed to elude the police for six weeks.
elude.zh: 这两个男人想方设法逃避警方追捕达六个星期。

elude.en: Parties were able to elude each other for the space of half an hour without going beyond the known ground.
elude.zh: 在半小时的时间里，双方都能避开对方，而不会迷路。

elude.en: This difficult idea seems to elude me.
elude.zh: 这个难题看起来难住我。

contingent.en: The crowd included a big contingent from Cleveland.
contingent.zh: 人群中包括一个来自克利夫兰的大型代表团。

contingent.en: The American contingent will stay overnight in London.
contingent.zh: 美国代表团将在伦敦留宿。

contingent.en: The contingent marched in the direction of the Western Hills.
contingent.zh: 队伍朝西山的方向前进。

sponsorship.en: Sport is being debased by commercial sponsorship.
sponsorship.zh: 体育运动因受商业赞助而降低了声誉。

sponsorship.en: Eventually, we alighted on the idea of seeking sponsorship.
sponsorship.zh: 最后我们偶然想到了寻求赞助。

sponsorship.en: Industrial sponsorship is a supplement to government funding.
sponsorship.zh: 工业界的赞助是对政府拨款的补充。

sprawl.en: People sprawl in deck chairs or sit under umbrellas.
sprawl.zh: 人们四肢舒展地躺在沙滩椅上，或坐在遮阳伞下。

sprawl.en: He would take two aspirin and sprawl out on his bed.
sprawl.zh: 他会吃两片阿斯匹林，然后摊开四肢躺在床上。

sprawl.en: The whole urban sprawl of Ankara contains over 2.6 million people.
sprawl.zh: 整个安卡拉城区总共容纳了260万以上的人口。

tanker.en: A Greek oil tanker has run aground.
tanker.zh: 一艘希腊油轮已经搁浅了。

tanker.en: The tanker began to spill its cargo of oil.
The tanker failed to respond to a command to stop.
tanker.zh: 油轮未能对停止前进的指令做出反应。

daring.en: The show's a keeper–daring, imaginative and provocative.
daring.zh: 这部电影值得收藏–大胆、富于想像力和煽动性。

daring.en: The gallery was known for putting on daring exhibitions.
daring.zh: 该画廊以其举办的大胆画展而享有盛名。

daring.en: There are plenty of activities at the resort for the less daring.
daring.zh: 度假胜地有许多活动是供不太敢于冒险的人玩的。

fellowship.en: He managed to get a fellowship, and he came to the UK all the way from New Zealand.
fellowship.zh: 他设法获得了奖学金，从新西兰远道来到英国。

fellowship.en: He was offered a research fellowship at Yale.
fellowship.zh: 他得到了一个耶鲁大学的研究员职位。

fellowship.en: There was a great deal of soldierly good fellowship.
fellowship.zh: 这里有诸多真挚的战友情谊。

overflow.en: Pour in some of the broth, but not all of it, because it will probably overflow.
overflow.zh: 倒入部分肉汤，不要全部，因为很可能会溢出来。

overflow.en: Fisherman Ray Turner hand-built the V-shaped stone overflow dam, in the East Branch of the Delaware River in New York.
overflow.zh: 渔民雷·特纳在纽约德拉瓦河的东支流手工建造了这个 V 字形石头溢流堰，或称鱼梁。

overflow.en: A new office block was built to accommodate the overflow of staff.
overflow.zh: 新建了一座办公大楼以便容纳多出的员工。

paramount.en: The children's welfare must be seen as paramount.
paramount.zh: 孩子们的福利必须被视为是最为重要的。

dreadful.zh: 我们犯了一个很大的错误。
他们告诉了我们这个坏消息。

suffice.en: Generally a brief note or a phone call will suffice.
suffice.zh: 通常写个便条或打个电话就足够了。

suffice.en: A cover letter should never exceed one page; often a far shorter letter will suffice.
suffice.zh: 附信绝不应超过一页；通常一封更短的信就足够了。
这里只举一个例子就够了。

sponge.en: He wiped off the table with a sponge.
sponge.zh: 他用一块海绵擦了桌子。

sponge.en: His mind was like a sponge, ready to absorb anything.
sponge.zh: 他的脑子跟海绵似的，什么都能吸收。

sponge.en: Take your jacket off and I'll sponge it down with water.
sponge.zh: 把你的夹克脱下来，我要用海绵蘸上水把它擦一擦。

engender.en: Business and nonprofit leaders should be aware of dark patterns and try to avoid the gray areas they engender.
engender.zh: 企业和非营利组织的领导人们应该了解黑暗模式，并尽量避开它们所产生的灰色地带。

engender.en: It helps engender a sense of common humanity.
engender.zh: 它有助于引发一种共同的人道主义精神。

engender.en: This will help engender good will in others.
engender.zh: 这将有助于激发他人的善意。

artisan.en: These settlements acted like small towns, becoming centers for the artisan and trading populations.
artisan.zh: 这些居留地就像小城镇，成为了工匠和生意人的聚集地。

artisan.en: Unlike artisan workshops in which apprentices worked closely with the masters supervising them, factories sharply separated workers from management.
artisan.zh: 工厂与工匠作坊不同，作坊学徒们与监督他们的师傅密切合作，而工厂将工人与管理人员严格区分开来。

artisan.en: All of it appeared to be handmade, probably by a 17th century artisan.
artisan.zh: 这里的一切似乎都是手工制作的，很可能出自一位17世纪工匠之手。

needless.zh: 禁止吸烟会免除不必要的死亡。

needless.en: The problem, needless to say, is the cost involved.
needless.zh: 不用说，问题是所涉及的费用。

needless.en: They greet their children's teenage with needless dread.
needless.zh: 他们怀着不必要的恐惧迎接孩子们的青春期。

dissertation.en: I'm working my notes up into a dissertation.
dissertation.zh: 我正在把我的笔记整理成一篇论文。

dissertation.en: He is currently writing a dissertation on the Somali civil war.
dissertation.zh: 他正在写一篇关于索马里内战的论文。

dissertation.en: I'm supposed to have handed in a first draft of my dissertation.
dissertation.zh: 我本应将论文初稿交上去。

terminology.en: It's couched in such very user-unfriendly terminology.
terminology.zh: 其中使用了用户很难理解的此类术语。

terminology.en: There is considerable imprecision in the terminology used.
terminology.zh: 所用的术语相当不准确。

terminology.en: The disagreement arose over a different use of terminology.
terminology.zh: 分歧的缘起在于专门用语使用的不同。
