asparagus.en: When it rains, all the rain drips down right on the asparagus.
asparagus.zh: 每当下雨的时候，所有雨滴都刚好落在芦笋上。

asparagus.en: The dye can color the wee, and certain foods – such as asparagus – can make it pong.
asparagus.zh: 这种染料会使尿液变黄，一些特定的食物——比如芦笋——会使尿液发出难闻的气味。

asparagus.en: Memories of the first asparagus and carrots he ate from a garden years before led him to start growing product on the roof of his brownstone.
asparagus.zh: 多年前他第一次在花园里吃芦笋和胡萝卜的记忆，让他开始在自己褐石屋的屋顶上种植农产品。

opaque.en: You can always use opaque glass if you need to block a street view.
opaque.zh: 如果你需要挡住外面的街景，你随时可以使用不透明玻璃。

opaque.en: The clusters diffracted light, making the solution opaque.
opaque.zh: 这团物质衍射光簇，产生了不透明的溶液。

opaque.en: Metals are opaque, so the other electrode must be transparent.
opaque.zh: 金属是不透明的，因此另一个电极必须是透明的。

nausea.zh: 恶心呕吐是常见的症状。

nausea.en: I was overcome with a feeling of nausea.

optics.en: If such materials became generally available to the optics industry the payoffs from such a breakthrough would be enormous.
optics.zh: 如果此类材料能够普遍用于光学产业，这一突破带来的收益将是巨大的。

optics.en: Scientists studying optics and chromatics today still marvel at his findings.
optics.zh: 今天研究光学和色彩学的科学家们仍对他的发现感到惊奇。

optics.en: Astronomers have devised a technique called adaptive optics that can beat Earth atmosphere at its own game of blurring.
optics.zh: 天文学家已经发明出一种叫做自适应光学的技术，可以以自己的模糊方式突破大气层。

menace.en: They seem determined to menace the United States and its allies.
menace.zh: 他们好像决心要威胁美国及其盟国。

menace.en: Wildfires are becoming an increasing menace in the western United States, with Southern California being the hardest-hit area.
menace.zh: 森林大火对美国西部的威胁越来越大，其中南加州是受灾最严重的地区。

menace.en: There is a pervading sense of menace.
menace.zh: 有一种在蔓延的危险感。

cactus.en: Researchers observed one bird impale a rodent on a cactus.
cactus.zh: 研究人员观察到，一只鸟把一个啮齿动物钉到了一棵仙人掌上。

numb.en: He could feel his fingers growing numb at their tips.
numb.zh: 他能感觉到他的手指尖正在变得麻木。

numb.en: First he had been numb. Then the numbness gave way to anger.
numb.zh: 一开始他只是麻木。后来麻木被愤怒代替。

numb.en: Her numb leg gave way beneath her and she stumbled clumsily.
numb.zh: 她那麻木了的腿一软，她便重重地摔了一跤。

rewarding.en: Many experts advocate rewarding your child for good behaviour.
rewarding.zh: 很多专家主张对小孩的良好表现加以奖励。

rewarding.en: Despite its length and convoluted plot, "Asta's Book" is a rich and rewarding read.
rewarding.zh: 虽然《阿斯塔的书》篇幅冗长、情节复杂，但不失为一本丰富及有益的读物。

rewarding.en: It is rewarding to try new things.

academically.zh: 他开始在学术上脱颖而出。

academically.en: I am not an academically minded person.
academically.zh: 我不是一个有学术头脑的人。

academically.en: He failed to shine academically but he was very good at sports.
academically.zh: 他学业不怎么样，但体育棒极了。

falter.en: Dickon held Colin's arm strongly but the boy had not begun to falter.
falter.zh: 狄肯使劲抓住科林的胳膊，但那孩子还没有开始发抖。

falter.en: Recovery may be here, but it could falter.
falter.zh: 经济复苏可能已经开始，但可能出现曲折。

falter.en: They are not perfect, they falter sometimes.
falter.zh: 他们并不完美，有时他们也会与不能坚持。

warden.en: If Jan had gone to the officers she trusted, they would have had to repeat her story to the same warden.
warden.zh: 如果简去找了她信任的警官，他们就不得不向同一个典狱长重复她的故事。

warden.en: He was a warden at the local parish church.
warden.zh: 他是本地教区教堂的监察员。

warden.en: The letter closed with sincere greetings which I did not think referred to me, but the warden was sincere about the issue.
warden.zh: 这封信结尾真诚的问候我认为不是跟我说的，但是那个监狱长对待此问题倒是很真诚的。

orchid.en: He did indeed import flowers and sell them to other orchid-lovers.
orchid.zh: 他确实进口了一些兰花，然后卖给其他兰花爱好者。

orchid.en: Orchids and orchid bees are a classic example of this relationship.
orchid.zh: 兰花和兰蜂就是这种关系的典型例子。

orchid.en: He then announced that the person who grew the most beautiful orchid would take his throne.
orchid.zh: 然后他宣布谁能种出最漂亮的兰花，谁就继承他的王位。

fuss.en: Don't fuss, Mum, everything is all right.
fuss.zh: 别瞎操心了，妈妈，一切都好。

fuss.en: All that fuss over a few pounds!
fuss.zh: 为几英镑就那么大惊小怪的！

fuss.en: It was all a fuss about nothing.
fuss.zh: 这完全是无谓地自寻烦恼。

humiliate.en: "You see," said Hughes, "there's people who want to humiliate you and grind you down."
humiliate.zh: “你看，” 休斯说，“有人想羞辱你、折磨你。”

humiliate.en: I didn't want to humiliate her in front of her colleagues.
humiliate.zh: 我不想当着她同事们的面令她难堪。

breadth.en: The breadth of the whole camp was 400 paces.

breadth.zh: 我们以些微之差赢了对手。
课程设置应该内容广泛而且均衡。

gangster.en: "Angels with Dirty Faces" is a Cagney gangster pic.
gangster.zh: 《一世之雄》是一部由卡格尼主演的黑帮片。

gangster.en: I had a hankering to see 1949's White Heat, the Jimmy Cagney flick where he plays gangster Cody Jarrett.
gangster.zh: 我很想看1949年的《白热》，那是一部吉米·卡格尼主演的电影，他在其中饰演黑帮老大科迪·贾勒特。

scurry.en: He saw the cockroach scurry under it with the gecko far behind struggling to go under.
scurry.zh: 他看见那只蟑螂急匆匆地从它下面钻过去，壁虎在后面很远的地方挣扎着要钻过去。

scurry.en: Millions of terrified beings scurry about through senseless mazes of tunnels and lanes.
scurry.zh: 数百万惊恐万状的生物在毫无意义的迷宫般的隧道和小巷里跑来跑去。

scurry.en: In front of a shop, a woman in a top hat and leather boots addresses men as they scurry past.
scurry.zh: 在一家商店前面，一个戴高帽、穿皮靴的女人向匆匆走过的男人打招呼。

sterile.en: He was able to bring large sterile acreages back to fertility.
sterile.zh: 他能把大片不毛之地变回沃土。

sterile.en: He always made sure that any cuts were protected by sterile dressings.
sterile.zh: 他总是确保所有伤口都用无菌的敷料包好。

sterile.en: This top fits over the bottle and keeps the teat sterile.
sterile.zh: 这个盖子盖在瓶子上，保持奶嘴无菌。

orphanage.zh: 她参观了泰国的一家孤儿院。

orphanage.en: More likely, I was dropped at the orphanage steps or somewhere else.
orphanage.zh: 更有可能的是，我被扔在孤儿院的台阶上或别的地方。

orphanage.en: Finally, at the orphanage, Pineda began to receive support and encouragement.
orphanage.zh: 最后，在孤儿院，皮涅达开始得到支持和鼓励。

multilateral.en: Many want to abandon the multilateral trade talks in Geneva.
multilateral.zh: 许多国家想要放弃在日内瓦的多边贸易会谈。

multilateral.en: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) and the Multilateral Investment Guarantee Association (MIGA) established the Compliance Advisor/Ombudsman Office (CAO) in 2000.
multilateral.zh: 2000年，国际金融公司（IFC）和多边投资担保机构（MIGA）成立了合规顾问/投诉办公室（CAO）。
全球市场需要多边规则。

extinct.en: Herbalism had become an all but extinct skill in the Western world.
extinct.zh: 草药医术在西方世界几乎已成了一项绝迹的技术。

extinct.en: The idea of cloning extinct life forms still belongs to science fiction.
extinct.zh: 对绝种的生命形式进行克隆的想法仍然属于科学幻想。

extinct.en: Scientists are attempting to compare features of extinct animals with living analogues.
extinct.zh: 科学家正试图把已灭绝动物的特征与现存类似动物相比较。

cupboard.en: She split her head open on the cupboard door.
cupboard.zh: 她碰到碗橱门上把头碰破了。

cupboard.en: Both movies are about a monster in the bedroom cupboard.
cupboard.zh: 两部电影都是关于卧室橱柜里的一个怪物。

impetus.en: By 1982, she was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.
impetus.zh: 到1982年，她焦躁不安，需要一个新的对其才华的推动力。

impetus.en: And some people take this a step further, and they hypothesize that this migration actually provided an important impetus in the development of ancient Egypt.
impetus.zh: 有些人对这方面做了进一步的研究，并假设这次的迁移实际上为古埃及的发展提供了一个重要的动力。

impetus.en: One impetus for the policy is that companies are already starting to build massive constellations, comprising hundreds or thousands of satellites with many moving parts among them.
impetus.zh: 政策的一个动力是，公司已经开始建造大规模的星座，包括成百上千的卫星和其中许多运动部件。

plump.en: He pushed a plump little hand toward me.
plump.zh: 他向我伸出一只胖乎乎的小手。

plump.en: Maria was a pretty little thing, small and plump with a mass of curly hair.
plump.zh: 玛丽亚是个漂亮的小家伙，小小的，胖乎乎的，生着一头浓密的卷发。

lad.en: Give the lad a break—it's only his second day on the job.
lad.zh: 给这小伙子一次机会—他上工才第二天。
他真是个值得信赖的小伙子。

unilateral.en: They were forced to take unilateral action.
unilateral.zh: 他们被迫采取单方面行动。

unilateral.en: Kinship is unilateral while friendship and love are bilateral.
unilateral.zh: 亲情是单方面的，而友情和爱情是双方面的。

unilateral.en: The French tax is not just a unilateral move by one country in need of revenue.
unilateral.zh: 法国的税收并不是一个需要税收的国家单方面采取的行动。

gorilla.en: The mountain gorilla is on the verge of extinction.
gorilla.zh: 居住在山区的大猩猩已濒临灭绝。

gorilla.en: The Judge was a Monkey, a large Gorilla venerable with age.
gorilla.zh: 法官是一只猴子，一只年老而德高望重的大猩猩。

gorilla.en: The zookeeper explains to the mime that the zoo's most popular attraction, a gorilla, has died suddenly.
gorilla.zh: 动物园管理员对哑剧演员解释到，那只动物园里最受大家欢迎的、最能吸引游人的大猩猩突然死了。

assimilation.en: This technique brings life to instruction and eases assimilation of knowledge.
assimilation.zh: 这种技术给教学带来活力，并使知识的吸收更加容易。

assimilation.en: They promote social integration and assimilation of minority ethnic groups into the culture.
assimilation.zh: 他们提倡少数民族团体与该文化的社会融合及同化。

assimilation.en: Now, consider three indices of assimilation—language, home ownership and intermarriage.
assimilation.zh: 现在，思考一下这三个同化的指标——语言、房屋拥有权和异族通婚。

futile.en: Like many in Russia, she blamed the country's failings on futile attempts to catch up with the West.
futile.zh: 像在俄罗斯的许多人一样，她把这个国家的错误归咎于想赶上西方的徒劳。

futile.en: To date, the sum of my gardening experience had been futile efforts to rid the flower beds of grass.
futile.zh: 迄今为止，我全部的园艺经验就是给花圃徒劳地除草。

cultivation.zh: 集约耕作使土壤变得贫瘠。

cultivation.en: Intensive cultivation exposes the earth to the damaging forces of nature.
cultivation.zh: 密集耕作使土地遭受到大自然破坏性的力量。

cultivation.en: High schools should lay emphasis on the cultivation of students' interpersonal communication skills.
cultivation.zh: 高中应重视培养学生的人际交往能力。

salty.en: She could smell the salty tang of the sea.
salty.zh: 她能闻到海水的咸腥味。

salty.en: The resulting salty water will be discharged at sea.
salty.zh: 产生的咸水将被排放到海里。

posit.en: Most religions posit the existence of life after death.
posit.zh: 大多数宗教都假定人死后生命仍存在。

posit.en: Merzenich is also a co-founder of Posit Science, a company that makes one of the brain training programs used at Walter Reed and other military.
posit.zh: 梅泽尼奇也是假定科学公司的创始人之一。现在里德医院和其他军队用的脑部训练程序之一，就是这家公司提供的。

posit.en: Concerning the semantic formula of -men, some linguists posit that -men is a plural marker in pronouns.
posit.zh: 关于其语义特征，一些语言学家认为“-men”在人称代词后是复数标记。

bowel.en: The boy was suffering from a bowel obstruction.
bowel.zh: 那男孩当时在受肠梗阻之苦。

bowel.en: The blade missed his kidney, but went into his bowel.
bowel.zh: 刀片没刺中他的肾脏，但却扎进了他的肠子。

bowel.en: Symptoms such as stomach pains and irritable bowels can be signs of bowel cancer.
bowel.zh: 胃痛和肠易激等症状都可能是肠癌的征兆。

invasive.en: Invasive species are driving away certain native species.
invasive.zh: 入侵物种正在驱赶某些本地物种。

invasive.en: Non-native species can appear harmless for decades, then turn invasive.
invasive.zh: 非本地物种可能会在几十年内看起来无害，继而变得有入侵性。

invasive.en: What is more, non-native species can appear harmless for decades, then turn invasive.
invasive.zh: 更重要的是，非本地物种可能会在几十年内看起来无害，然后变得有入侵性。

conspicuous.en: Most people don't want to be too conspicuous.
conspicuous.zh: 大多数人不愿过于显眼。

conspicuous.en: The advertisements were all posted in a conspicuous place.
conspicuous.zh: 广告都贴在了显眼的地方。
她是个引人注目的人物。

idol.en: Screaming fans vied to get closer to their idol.
idol.zh: 尖声喊叫的崇拜者争先恐后地涌向他们的偶像。

idol.en: A great cheer went up from the crowd as they caught sight of their idol.
idol.zh: 一看见他们的偶像，人群爆发出一阵热烈的欢呼声。

idol.en: I have to watch my American Idol.
idol.zh: 我得回去看我的《美国偶像》。

ruthless.zh: 他是个残酷的扩张主义者。

ruthless.en: He's a ruthless businessman, as I know to my cost.
ruthless.zh: 我吃了苦头后才知道他是个无情的商人。

ruthless.en: The way she behaved towards him was utterly ruthless.
ruthless.zh: 她对待他真是无情至极。

ballad.zh: 这本书读起来像民谣的风格。
她的最新单曲唱片是一首情歌。

ballad.en: Last year Collins wrote a moving ballad which highlighted the plight of the homeless.
ballad.zh: 去年柯林斯写了一首感人的叙事诗，突出描写了无家可归者的苦境。

outlaw.en: Jesse was an outlaw, a bandit, a criminal.
outlaw.zh: 杰西曾是个逃犯、土匪、罪犯。
你真的是那个有名的绿林好汉吗？

outlaw.en: It is therefore highly likely that the outlaw fishing boats harvested about 9,000 tons of lobster illegally that year.
outlaw.zh: 因此，当年非法捕捞的渔船很可能非法捕捞了约9000吨龙虾。

cripple.en: A total cutoff of supplies would cripple the country's economy.
cripple.zh: 全面终止供给将使该国经济瘫痪。

cripple.en: He had been warned that another bad fall could cripple him for life.
cripple.zh: 他被警告说再一次严重摔跤会使他终身残疾。

shady.en: We went to find somewhere cool and shady to have a drink.
shady.zh: 我们去找了一个阴凉的地方，喝了一杯。

shady.en: Thatched pavilions provide shady retreats for relaxing and reading in privacy.
shady.zh: 茅亭为独自放松和看书提供阴凉的幽僻之所。

shady.en: The plants should be placed in a shady spot.
shady.zh: 这些植物应该放在阴凉的地方。

waver.en: He felt sorry for him and began first to waver and then to weaken.
waver.zh: 他为他感到难过，内心开始动摇，然后变软下来了。

waver.en: He began to waver in his resolution when a patrol wagon rolled up and more officers dismounted.
waver.zh: 当一辆巡逻车开过来并且从车上下来更多的警察时，他的决心开始动摇了。

carcass.en: After a good meal, the gray fox leaped away, leaving the carcass to be stripped clean by the condors.
carcass.zh: 美餐一顿之后，灰狐狸蹦蹦跳跳的跑开了，尸体则被兀鹰啄食干净。

carcass.en: What do you do with the carcass of a ferocious monster?
carcass.zh: 你怎么处理凶残怪物的死尸？

carcass.en: We came across the carcass of a lion.
carcass.zh: 我们遇到了一具狮子的尸体。

salient.en: In many cases, goals have economic rewards that make them more salient or powerful.
salient.zh: 在很多情况下，目标有了经济回报，会变得更加显著或强大。

salient.en: Economists label the problem "present bias": we are vulnerable to fast, salient stimulation.
salient.zh: 经济学家给这个问题贴上了“当前偏见”的标签：我们很容易受到快速、显著的刺激。

salient.en: Before colonialism, gender was more salient in central Kenya than it was in Ghana, although age was still crucial in determining authority.
salient.zh: 在殖民主义之前，性别在肯尼亚中部比在加纳更为突出，尽管年龄仍然是决定权力的关键因素。

radius.en: He indicated a semicircle with a radius of about thirty miles.
radius.zh: 他标示出一个半径大约三十英里的半圆。

radius.en: Simply change the radius to 2000, and you should start to see some results.
radius.zh: 只需将半径更改为2000，您应当便会看到一些结果，当然。

radius.en: The radiation radius of the radioactive radium radiator in the stadium is variable.
radius.zh: 放射性的镭散热器在体育场的辐射半径是可变的。

prophecy.zh: 那位老师的预言会实现吗？

prophecy.en: She was believed to have the gift of prophecy.
Fear of failure can become a self-fulfilling prophecy.
prophecy.zh: 害怕失败可能真会导致失败。

magician.en: The magician vanished in a puff of smoke.
magician.zh: 魔术师在一股烟雾中突然不见了。

magician.en: The magician took the boy into a secret room.
magician.zh: 魔术师把男孩带进了一间密室。

magician.en: As a magician, his reputation spread all over the world.
magician.zh: 作为一个魔术师，他的名声传遍世界各地。

banish.en: Women, don't banish your man to the couch or stomp off to pout in the spare bedroom.
banish.zh: 女人，不要把你的男人打发到沙发上，也不要在空闲的卧室里跺脚噘嘴。

banish.en: If we could banish all such preconceptions when we read, that would be an admirable beginning.
banish.zh: 如果我们在阅读时能摈弃所有这些先入之见，那将是一个极好的开端。

broom.en: There is a witch riding a broom.
broom.zh: 这有个骑着扫把的巫婆。

broom.en: We use broom to sweep the floor.

hasten.en: There is no point whatsoever in carefully placing our valuable artifacts in paper or cards that is going to hasten their demise.

prolong.zh: 人们似乎普遍认为，公司没有动力去延长产品的寿命。

apprehension.en: It reflects real anger and apprehension about the future.

noteworthy.zh: 我没什么特别值得关注的事情可报告。

dismal.en: The Dismal Scientist, a webzine dedicated to economic news, is fun.

inference.zh: 下列哪一项最能推翻学者的推论？

inference.en: A third risk is that consumers may infer the intended conclusion but question the validity of their inference.
inference.zh: 第三个风险是，消费者可能会推断出预期的结论，但对其推论的有效性提出质疑。

sane.en: Did he come across as a sane, rational person?
sane.zh: 他看上去是不是一个头脑清醒而理智的人？

sane.en: No sane person wishes to see conflict or casualties.
sane.zh: 理智的人都不希望看到冲突或伤亡。

sane.en: In spite of the extremity of her seclusion she was sane.
sane.zh: 尽管完全与世隔绝，她依然神智清醒。

metabolism.en: If you skip breakfast, your metabolism slows down.
metabolism.zh: 你如果不吃早饭，新陈代谢速度会减慢。

metabolism.en: The body's metabolism is slowed down by extreme cold.
metabolism.zh: 严寒可以使身体新陈代谢的速度下降。

metabolism.en: That slows the plant's metabolism and protects its dried-out tissues.
metabolism.zh: 这减缓了植物的新陈代谢，保护了其干枯的组织。

monarchy.zh: 英国是个君主立宪制国家。

monarchy.en: His book destroyed the mystique of monarchy.
monarchy.zh: 他的书消除了君主制的神秘感。

monarchy.en: I have sworn an oath of loyalty to the monarchy.
monarchy.zh: 我已经发誓效忠君主制。

engulf.en: The crisis threatens to engulf several others.
engulf.zh: 这个危机波及了其它几个成员。

engulf.en: I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.
engulf.zh: 我到了深水中。大水漫过我身。

engulf.en: The next Ice Age could take only weeks to engulf Britain.
engulf.zh: 下次冰期吞噬英国可能只需几个星期。

magnify.en: If you really magnify the spectrum of the sunlight, you could identify more than 100,000 of them.
magnify.zh: 如果你真的放大太阳光的光谱，你可以分辨出多达10万条的光谱线。

magnify.en: One of the easiest ways to segment a market is to magnify gender differences or invent them where they did not previously exist.
magnify.zh: 细分市场最简单的方法之一是放大性别差异，或者在以前不存在性别差异的地方创造性别差异。

magnify.en: The findings suggest that the body and brain have instinctive ways of healing that we could come to understand one day and then magnify.
magnify.zh: 这些发现表明身体与大脑具有其天生的自愈方法，我们有朝一日可以去理解并放大。

malpractice.en: One could even say it is marketing malpractice.
malpractice.zh: 人们甚至可以将它称为营销违规行为。

malpractice.en: And he took on a major concern for doctors: the fear of a malpractice lawsuit.
malpractice.zh: 同时，他也对医生们最担心的一个问题表达了意见，那就是医疗失误引起的法律诉讼。

malpractice.en: One doctor in Texas appeared at his own medical-malpractice trial in blue jeans.
malpractice.zh: 得克萨斯州一名医生穿着蓝色牛仔裤出席自己医疗失误案的法庭审判。

ascertain.en: It can be difficult to ascertain the facts.
ascertain.zh: 可能难以查明事实真相。

ascertain.en: Through doing this, the teacher will be able to ascertain the extent to which the child understands what he is reading.
ascertain.zh: 通过这样做，老师将能确定这个孩子对他正在读的内容的理解程度。

ascertain.en: Cricket keeps an off-field umpire for boundary calls, and to ascertain whether batsmen are run out and if catches are real.
ascertain.zh: 板球有一个场外的裁判来判定边界，并确定击球手是否出局，接球是否真实。

misguided.en: The article presents these proposals as misguided.
misguided.zh: 文章把这些提案评为误导的产物。

misguided.en: But based on today's socioeconomic trends, this hope is, unfortunately, misguided.
misguided.zh: 但不幸的是，基于当今的社会经济趋势，这种希望被误导了。

misguided.en: She only did it in a misguided attempt to help.
misguided.zh: 她是要帮忙，只是想法不对头。

outburst.en: There was an extraordinary outburst of applause from every corner of the auditorium.
outburst.zh: 观众席的每一个角落都爆发出热烈的掌声。
这反常的感情冲动的真正原因是什么？

outburst.en: She was alarmed by his violent outburst.
outburst.zh: 他暴跳如雷，令她惊恐万状。

sinister.en: There was something cold and sinister about him.
sinister.zh: 他给人一种冷酷阴险的感觉。

sinister.en: Even the sinister bio-mimicry of the Preying Mantis, luring unsuspecting pollinators to their death, has a beautiful symmetry to it.
sinister.zh: 即使是邪恶的捕食螳螂，它用以引诱不知情者上钩的拟态，也是一个美丽的对称形态。

sinister.en: The sinister Harrison tells Stella that she can keep him safe if she sleeps with Harrison and does not reveal what she has been told.
sinister.zh: 阴险的哈里森告诉斯特拉，如果她与哈里森睡觉，她可以保护哈里森的安全，并且不会揭露哈里森的所作所为。

mower.en: A robotic lawn mower will run over a neighbor's cat.
mower.zh: 一台自动割草机会碾过邻居的猫。

mower.en: It's love that makes the boy climb, as it made the mower work, remember?
mower.zh: 是爱使男孩爬上去，就像它使割草机工作了，记得吗？

mower.en: Watching your wealth build can be like watching the grass grow; sometimes the mower comes in and cuts everything down.
mower.zh: 看着你自己的财富积累就像看着草丛生长；有时割草机会进来，将一切砍倒。

auditorium.en: Anderson was to sing at the Constitution Hall auditorium.
auditorium.zh: 安德森将要在宪法厅的观众席演唱。

auditorium.en: Schreiber addressed an auditorium overflowing with journalists.
auditorium.zh: 施赖伯向挤满了新闻记者的观众席致辞。

plentiful.en: Our food, such as it is, is plentiful.
plentiful.zh: 我们吃的，虽不很好，却很丰富。

plentiful.en: She survived because of a plentiful supply of fresh water.
plentiful.zh: 由于淡水供应充足，她活了下来。

starvation.en: Starvation brings biochemical changes in the body.
starvation.zh: 饥饿引起体内的生化变化。

starvation.en: I was suffering from acute sunstroke, starvation and exhaustion.
starvation.zh: 我当时正受着急性中暑、饥饿和疲惫之苦。

starvation.en: Millions will face starvation next year as a result of the drought.
starvation.zh: 由于发生旱灾，明年将有数百万人面临饥饿的威胁。

microscopic.en: Microscopic examination of a cell's chromosomes can reveal the sex of the fetus.
microscopic.zh: 用显微镜检查细胞染色体可以查出胎儿的性别。

microscopic.en: Phytoplankton are microscopic plants that grow in the ocean.
microscopic.zh: 浮游植物是生长在海里的微小植物。

microscopic.en: Even today, microscopic meteorites continually bombard Earth, falling on both land and sea.
microscopic.zh: 即使是现在，微小的陨石仍在不断地撞击地球，然后落到陆地上和大海中。

deflect.en: He raised his arm to try to deflect the blow.
deflect.zh: 他举起手臂试图挡开这一击。

deflect.en: Cage changed his name to deflect accusations of nepotism.
deflect.zh: 凯奇改了名字以转移裙带关系的指责。

deflect.en: The war did not deflect him from the path he had long ago taken.
deflect.zh: 战争没有使他改变很久之前就选择的道路。

defiance.en: A note of defiance entered her voice.
defiance.zh: 她的声音里带有公然反抗的口气。

defiance.en: At least they will see, I hope, pictures of their father being hauled off to jail in defiance.
defiance.zh: 至少，我希望，他们将看到一些照片，那是他们的父亲在反抗中被拖向了监狱。

defiance.en: Angry protestors with clenched fists shouted their defiance.
defiance.zh: 愤怒的抗议者们紧握拳头高声抗议。

luminous.en: The luminous dial on the clock showed five minutes to seven.
Encompassed in a luminous cloud, of which he was now merely the fiery heart, he swung through unthinkable arcs of oscillation, like a vast pendulum.
luminous.zh: 他现在只不过是一颗火热的心，被一团发光的云所包围，他像一个巨大的钟摆一样，在不可思议的摆动的弧线上摇摆。

luminous.en: They painted the door a luminous green.
luminous.zh: 他们把门漆成了翠绿色。

shear.en: Competitors have six minutes to shear four sheep.
shear.zh: 参赛者们有6分钟的时间来给4只羊剪毛。

shear.en: The shear changed the quadrilateral into a parallelogram.
shear.zh: 四边形被剪成了平行四边形。

shear.en: To concrete shear walls, they add steel braces to a skyscraper's skeleton or beefier rebar.
shear.zh: 为了用混凝土覆盖剪力墙，他们把钢托支撑加到摩天大楼的骨架或是大钢筋上。

amplify.en: This landscape seemed to trap and amplify sounds.
amplify.zh: 这种地形好像能聚拢和扩大声音。

amplify.en: Subjects are wearing headphones that amplify their heartbeat.
amplify.zh: 受试者正戴着放大他们心跳声的耳机。

modernist.en: He's connected to both those strains as well as the modernist strain.
modernist.zh: 他与这两种风格和现代主义风格都有联系。

modernist.en: It was a modernist triumph, and many elements remain central features of today's kitchen.
modernist.zh: 这是一个现代主义的胜利，许多元素仍然是当今厨房的核心特征。

modernist.en: Post-Modernist designers began to experiment with decoration and color again.
modernist.zh: 后现代主义设计师开始再次尝试装饰和色彩。

inauguration.en: They later attended the inauguration of the University.
inauguration.zh: 他们后来参加了该大学的成立典礼。

inauguration.en: The inauguration was set to resemble a coronation.
inauguration.zh: 该就职典礼被设计成一个类似加冕典礼的仪式。

lofty.en: It was a bank that started out with grand ideas and lofty ideals.
lofty.zh: 那是一家创办时带着宏大理念、崇高理想的银行。

lofty.en: They were richly gilt, and their lofty prows and sterns were elaborately carved.
lofty.zh: 它们都漆成富丽的金色，高大的船头和船尾都是精雕细琢的。

lofty.en: The room was light and lofty compared to the basement.
lofty.zh: 这个房间与地下室比起来更亮更高。

horrify.zh: 对不起，是不是吓到你了？
这个想法听起来可能让你不寒而栗。
刺激的自己都快吓傻了。

rot.en: The house was riddled with dry rot.
rot.zh: 屋子因木材干腐而变得千疮百孔。

rot.en: The rubbish in modern landfills does not rot.
rot.zh: 现代垃圾填埋场里的垃圾不会腐烂。

rot.en: The wood must not get damp as rot can quickly result.
rot.zh: 木头不能受潮，否则很快就会烂掉。

fume.en: As I said, it's a particularly hazardous substance and is worked with in fume hoods.
fume.zh: 就像我说过的，这是尤其有害的物质，在通风柜中才能用。

fume.en: Lie precariously at the edge of the mattress and fume if you must, but lie in the same bed.
fume.zh: 躺在床的边沿，摇摇欲坠，如果你一定要的话，可以发火，但要躺在同一张床上。

fume.en: It has slashed the cost of toll roads to almost one-tenth of the normal level, attracting yet more people on to fume-choked roads.
fume.zh: 它将收费公路的成本削减至正常水平的近十分之一，然而致使更多的人走上烟雾弥漫的道路。

warranty.zh: 这辆汽车仍在保修期内吗？

warranty.en: The television comes with a full two-year warranty.
warranty.zh: 这台电视机有整两年的保修期。
这台笔记本电脑还在保修期内吗？

pollen.en: Seeds and pollen are spread by the wind.
pollen.zh: 种子和花粉是随风传播的。

pollen.en: As the day goes on, the pollen dries up and becomes hard.
pollen.zh: 随着日子一天天过去，花粉变得又干又硬。

pollen.en: Avoid trips to the country while the pollen count is high.
pollen.zh: 花粉计数高时，尽量避免去乡村旅行。

dent.en: There was a dent in the nearside wing.
dent.zh: 左边挡泥板上有一个凹痕。

dent.en: They can beat out the dent in the car's wing.
dent.zh: 他们能把汽车挡泥板上的凹痕敲平。

dent.en: These can dent and scratch your floor.
dent.zh: 这些都会让你的地板产生凹陷、划痕。

rusty.zh: 自行车生锈了，但还能骑。

rusty.en: The box was fastened with a rusty wire.
rusty.zh: 那个箱子是用生锈的铁丝捆紧的。

rusty.en: A thin curl of smoke rose from a rusty stove.
rusty.zh: 一缕薄薄的青烟从生锈的炉子里冉冉升起。

terrestrial.en: Still, some small terrestrial animals can achieve high speeds.
terrestrial.zh: 然而，一些小型陆生动物可以达到高速。

terrestrial.en: The terrestrial world is green now, but it did not start out that way.
terrestrial.zh: 陆地世界现在是绿色的，但一开始它并不是这样的。

terrestrial.en: These rocky planets are called "Terrestrial Planets".
terrestrial.zh: 这些岩态行星被称为“类地行星”。

alienation.en: The richness of Oshima's work lies in its ability to fuse alienation with involvement.
alienation.zh: 大岛渚作品的丰富性在于其将疏离感与参与感融为一体的能力。

alienation.en: Iconoclasts face alienation and failure, but can also be a major asset to any organization.
alienation.zh: 反传统者面临着被疏远和失败的处境，但他们也可能成为任何组织的主要资产。

alienation.en: Nor are residents of large communities any likelier to display psychological symptoms of stress or alienation, a feeling of not belonging, than are residents of smaller communities.
alienation.zh: 大社区的居民也不像小社区的居民那样更有可能表现出压力或疏远的心理症状，也就是一种缺乏归宿感的感觉。

jug.en: The beer ran into the jug and Catherine stood looking on.
jug.zh: 啤酒流入壶中，凯瑟琳站在一旁看着。

jug.en: The bed, the mirror, the white jug and basin gleam like the sky outside.
jug.zh: 床、镜子、白色的水壶和脸盆像外面的天空一样闪闪发光。

permeate.en: Water will easily permeate a cotton dress.
permeate.zh: 水很容易渗透棉布衣服。

permeate.en: Fossils are often washed together on-site in a large bath which can allow water and contaminants in the form of contemporary DNA to permeate into the porous bones.
permeate.zh: 化石通常在大浴池中进行现场清洗，这可以使水和现代 DNA 形式的污染物渗透到多孔骨骼中。
现代生活处处离不开统计。

maritime.en: The reason for this swirl of maritime outlawry can be found on the nearest shore.
maritime.zh: 造成这种海上流亡者漩涡的原因可以在最近的岸上找到。

maritime.en: Today, China is trying to build the Silk Road Economic Belt and the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road.
maritime.zh: 今天，中国正在努力建设“丝绸之路经济带”和“21世纪海上丝绸之路”。

maritime.en: The tiny island nation has set aside 500,000 square kilometres—80 percent—of its maritime territory, for full protection.
maritime.zh: 这个小小的岛国已经留出了占其海洋领土80%的50万平方公里用于全面保护。

acquaint.en: You will first need to acquaint yourself with the filing system.
acquaint.zh: 你首先需要熟悉文件归档方法。

acquaint.en: Have steps been taken to acquaint breeders with their right to apply for licenses?
acquaint.zh: 已经采取措施让饲养动物者了解他们申请执照的权利了吗？

acquaint.en: Prior to the interview, acquaint yourself with the laws pertaining to job discrimination.
acquaint.zh: 面试前，先熟悉与工作歧视有关的法律。

taxation.en: Their policies on taxation didn't endear them to voters.
taxation.zh: 他们的税收政策并没使他们受到选民的欢迎。

taxation.en: A number of simplifications have been made to the taxation system.
taxation.zh: 税收制度已经历过多次简化。

taxation.en: Taxation is not popular in principle, merely acceptable in context.
taxation.zh: 征税原则上不受大众欢迎，只是联系背景看是可接受的。

loophole.en: "Cayman takes advantage of a legitimate loophole—and the financial system is none the weaker for it," says one regulator in Europe.
loophole.zh: “开曼群岛利用了法律的漏洞——金融制度也没有变得更弱。”欧洲一监管者说道。

loophole.en: It is estimated that 60,000 businesses are exploiting a loophole in the law to avoid prosecution.
loophole.zh: 据估计6万家公司在钻法律的空子来逃避起诉。

loophole.en: If you're not a big fan of bitter, chemists have just the loophole for you.
loophole.zh: 如果你不喜欢苦味，药剂师则正好可以给你钻个空子。

statistic.en: I felt I was no longer being treated as a person but as a statistic.
statistic.zh: 我感觉我不再被看作人，而被看作一个统计数字了。

statistic.en: The statistic figures in the report are not accurate. You should not refer to them.
statistic.zh: 这篇报告中的统计数据不精确，你不应该参照他们。

statistic.en: The most important statistic of the day, however, was the $100,000,000 in TV advertising fees.
statistic.zh: 然而，当天最重要的统计数字是1亿美元的电视广告费。

afflict.en: There are two main problems which afflict people with hearing impairments.
afflict.zh: 有两大问题困扰有听觉障碍的人。

afflict.en: ECONOMIC woes afflict many at the moment.
afflict.zh: 经济灾难此刻折磨着许多人。

afflict.en: I don't want to afflict you with my troubles.
afflict.zh: 我不想使你为我的困难而苦恼。

browse.en: We only model for browse, select, purchase, and pay.
browse.zh: 我们只为浏览、选择、购买和支付建模。

browse.en: Sit at your computer, probably at home or at the office, search and browse, and buy.
browse.zh: 坐在你的电脑前，可能在家里或在办公室，搜索、浏览和购物。

browse.en: It's the iPad that's going to enable developers to create entirely new ways to browse, discover and connect with singles.
browse.zh: iPad 将使开发者能够创造全新的方式来浏览、发现单身人士，并与他们建立联系。

tan.en: It's safer to fake a tan with make-up rather than subject your complexion to the harsh rays of the sun.
tan.zh: 用化妆来伪造棕褐色的皮肤比让皮肤暴露于强烈的太阳光线更安全。

tan.en: They look best with tan or light brown suits.
tan.zh: 它们与棕褐色或浅棕色的西装搭配最好看。

tan.en: She is tall and blonde, with a permanent tan.
tan.zh: 她个子高，一头金发，皮肤黝黑。

amass.en: My dream is to amass one million coffee mugs.
amass.zh: 我的梦想是收集一百万个咖啡杯子。

amass.en: He is planning to amass a fortune for a rainy day.
amass.zh: 他正打算积蓄财富以备不时之需。

amass.en: Iran continues to amass power and expand its regional influence.
amass.zh: 伊朗在继续积攒力量并扩展它的区域影响力。

inefficient.en: The whole process is wasteful and inefficient.
inefficient.zh: 整个程序既浪费又效率低。

inefficient.en: The train company is overstaffed and notoriously inefficient.
inefficient.zh: 这家铁路公司人员超编，且出了名地没有效率。

inefficient.en: Overall, barter is a very inefficient means of organizing transactions.
inefficient.zh: 总的说来，物物交换是一种非常低效的组织交易的方式。

slum.en: This bum is an unemployed man in the slum.
slum.zh: 这个流浪汉是贫民区的一个失业者。

slum.en: Several businessmen had to slum it in economy class.
slum.zh: 几个商人只好将就着坐在经济舱里。

slum.en: In Sal Paulo, you can see shopping malls full of designer goods right next door to the slum areas without proper water and electricity supplies.
slum.zh: 在萨尔保罗，你可以看到紧挨着贫民区的购物中心里满是名牌商品，却没有适当的水电供应。

traverse.en: They don't like dense forests either, so they traverse these high, open shoulders between the river and the woods, where they can see and run.
traverse.zh: 它们也不喜欢密集的树林，所以它们穿过河流和树林间这些高耸而开阔的山肩，在那里它们能够看到并奔跑。

traverse.en: In their cross-country journey, the animals must traverse many smaller bodies of water, such as rivers and small lakes.
traverse.zh: 在越野旅程中，动物们必须穿越许多面积较小的水域，比如河流和小湖泊。

traverse.en: Pronghorn, dependent on distance vision and speed to keep safe from predators, traverse high, open shoulders of land, where they can see and run.
traverse.zh: 叉角羚依靠远距离视觉和速度来躲避捕食者，它们在开阔的高地上穿行，在那里它们能看见东西并追逐它们。

thermometer.en: It is essential that you are able to read a thermometer.
thermometer.zh: 能读出温度计上的温度是基本要求。

thermometer.en: The thermometer shows the temperature in Celsius and Fahrenheit.
thermometer.zh: 温度计显示摄氏温度和华氏温度。

disdain.en: Koons has engrossed himself in a world of commercialism that most modern artists disdain.
disdain.zh: 孔斯已沉醉于多数现代艺术家所鄙视的商业主义世界。

cape.en: I like that part of Cape Town.
cape.zh: 我喜欢开普敦的那个地方。

cape.en: He swished his cape around his shoulders.
Their first port of call will be Cape Town.
cape.zh: 他们第一个停靠港是开普敦。

savvy.en: He is known for his political savvy and strong management skills.
savvy.zh: 他以其政治洞察力和高超的管理手段著称。

savvy.en: Raised in an era of privatization and increased consumer choice, today's tech savvy workers have embraced a free market in love as well as economics.
savvy.zh: 成长在一个私有化和消费者选择增多的时代，如今精通技术的工人们已经在爱情和经济上接受了自由市场。

savvy.en: As proud as I am that my son is tech-savvy like his daddy, it's equally important to me that he have analog skills: the ability to bait a hook, clean a gutter.
savvy.zh: 我的儿子和他的爸爸一样精通技术，这让我很自豪，但对我来说同样重要的是，他也有会通过模仿学习技能：能够给鱼钩上钩、清理排水沟。

mow.en: Ten men went to mow a meadow.
I mow the lawn every week in summer.
mow.zh: 夏天我每周都要修剪草坪。

precursor.en: He said that the deal should not be seen as a precursor to a merger.
precursor.zh: 他说这次交易不应该被看作是合并的前兆。

precursor.en: Error is often the precursor of what is correct.
precursor.zh: 错误常常是正确的先导。

precursor.en: We talked about the artificial hip, which is a modern precursor of the splint I talked about before.
precursor.zh: 我们说到的人造髋关节就是我之前讲过的夹板的现代前身。

vibrate.en: The ground shook and the cliffs seemed to vibrate.
vibrate.zh: 大地摇晃，那些悬崖似乎在颤动。

vibrate.en: It's important to tighten up the wheels properly, otherwise they vibrate loose and fall off.
vibrate.zh: 把车轮拧紧很重要，否则它们会振动而松脱。

vibrate.en: Some of them are powerful enough to make the water vibrate.
vibrate.zh: 它们当中的一些很有能量，足以让水震动。

poignant.en: Her face was a poignant reminder of the passing of time.
poignant.zh: 她的容颜显示青春已逝，令人感伤。

poignant.en: These include comedy, satire, poignant drama, historical and regional drama.
poignant.zh: 其中包括喜剧、讽刺剧、悲情剧、历史剧和地方剧。

poignant.en: One of the most poignant sights awaiting visitors is the funfair, which was due to open just a few days before disaster struck.
poignant.zh: 等待着游客的最心酸的景象之一是游乐场，它原定在灾难发生前几天开放。

treadmill.en: He exhausted himself on an endless treadmill to pay for rent and food.
treadmill.zh: 为了支付房租和食物，他精力全都耗在了一份没完没了的单调工作上。

treadmill.en: She says she is able to take Zumba exercise classes three times a week and work out on the treadmill twice a week.
treadmill.zh: 她说她每周能上三次尊巴健身课，并每周在跑步机上锻炼两次。

treadmill.en: The havoc that the "treadmill syndrome" can bring about is well illustrated by what happened to cotton farmers in Central America.
treadmill.zh: “跑步机综合症”可能带来的浩劫，在中美洲棉农身上已经得到了很好的体现。

impart.en: The ability to impart knowledge and command respect is the essential qualification for teachers.
impart.zh: 传授知识并博得尊敬的能力对老师们来说是基本的条件。

impart.en: You need to have specialist teachers who impart what they know.
impart.zh: 你需要有专业的老师来传授他们所知道的知识。

impart.en: Forcing a child to behave morally may prevent her from internalizing the lesson you're trying to impart.
impart.zh: 强迫孩子按道德行事可能会妨碍她将你试图传授的教训内化。

finite.en: Only a finite number of situations can arise.
finite.zh: 只有有限的几种情况可能会出现。

finite.en: It is quite possible that space and time are finite.
finite.zh: 很有可能空间和时间是有限的。

parachute.zh: 飞机用降落伞空投补给。

parachute.en: My first parachute jump was an exhilarating experience.
parachute.zh: 我第一次跳伞的经历很令人激动。

browser.zh: 你需要一个最新的网络浏览器。

browser.en: On the phone browser, you can save to this queue in the cloud.
browser.zh: 在手机浏览器上，您可以保存到云中的这个队列。

browser.en: You don't need to restart the browser after installing an extension.
browser.zh: 安装完扩展之后，你不用重启浏览器。

arousal.en: The processes of arousal and concentration give attention its direction.
arousal.zh: 觉醒和集中的过程为注意力提供了方向。

arousal.en: Arousal is at first general, with a flooding of impulses in the brain stem; then gradually the activation is channeled.
arousal.zh: 一开始觉醒是普遍的，在脑干中有大量的脉冲，然后激活作用逐渐被输送。

arousal.en: An early strain of research claimed that when we watch television, our brains mostly exhibit slow alpha waves—indicating a low level of arousal, similar to when we are daydreaming.
arousal.zh: 一项早期的研究表明，当我们看电视时，我们的大脑大多表现出缓慢的阿尔法波，这表明我们的兴奋程度程度较低，类似于做白日梦的状态。

amuse.en: She suggested several ideas to help Laura amuse the twins.
amuse.zh: 她给劳拉出了一些主意，好逗这对双胞胎开心。

amuse.en: I need distractions. I need to amuse myself so I won't keep thinking about things.
amuse.zh: 我需要娱乐。我需要自我消遣，这样我才不会一直想事情。

speedy.en: Nowadays, speedy and colorful water scooters are gaining in popularity.
speedy.zh: 如今，速度快、色彩鲜艳的水上摩托车越来越受欢迎。

speedy.en: Another speedy bot is Cornell's Ranger Robot, which broke a new walking record this year.
speedy.zh: 另一款高速型的机器人是康奈尔大学的“游侠机器人”，它在今年打破了一项新的行走记录。

motivated.en: They are motivated by a need to achieve.
motivated.zh: 他们被成功的需要激励着。

motivated.en: The coach tried to get his charges motivated.
motivated.zh: 该教练设法激励他的队员们。
他的作为是贪婪之心所驱使的。

pundit.en: One online pundit said that Obama sounded "like a grumpy old man".
pundit.zh: 一位网络权威人士表示，奥巴马听起来“像一个脾气暴躁的老头”。

pundit.en: One online pundit said that Obama sounded "like a grumpy old man".
pundit.zh: 一位网络权威人士表示，奥巴马听起来“像一个脾气暴躁的老头”。

pundit.en: Many of us try to be the pundit who predicts the next trend in our industry.
pundit.zh: 我们中的许多人都试图成为预知行业中下一个趋势的权威。

quantify.en: The urge to quantify is embedded in our society.
quantify.zh: 量化的冲动根植于我们的社会。

quantify.en: It's tough to quantify how good a person is at remembering.
quantify.zh: 很难量化一个人的记忆力有多好。

quantify.en: It's the dangers parents can't—and may never—quantify that occur all of sudden.
quantify.zh: 父母不能量化——可能永远无法量化——的危险，往往会突然发生。

hairy.en: He was wearing shorts which showed his long, muscular, hairy legs.
hairy.zh: 他穿着短裤，露出修长、健壮、多毛的双腿。

hairy.en: Men still appear to be labouring under the misapprehension that women want hairy, muscular men.
hairy.zh: 男人们似乎仍误以为女人喜欢体毛多的肌肉男。

hairy.en: He stuck his nose out of the doghouse and saw four slender, hairy animals.
hairy.zh: 他把鼻子探出狗窝，看见了四只细长的、毛茸茸的动物。

abdomen.en: He went into the hospital to undergo tests for a pain in his abdomen.
abdomen.zh: 他去了医院接受对他的腹部疼痛进行的各项检查。

abdomen.en: Spiders usually have silk glands under their abdomen.
abdomen.zh: 蜘蛛通常在腹部下有丝腺。

abdomen.en: Scans of his chest, abdomen, and pelvis likewise showed nothing.
abdomen.zh: 扫描他的胸部、腹部和骨盆也没有什么发现。

entice.en: The bargain prices are expected to entice customers away from other stores.
entice.zh: 低廉的价格意在把顾客从其他商店吸引过来。

entice.en: Retailers have tried almost everything, from cheap credit to free flights, to entice shoppers through their doors.
entice.zh: 从低价信贷到免费航班，零售商们几乎用尽一切办法说服购物者惠顾。

entice.en: Management is able to use the growth to entice and encourage employees.
entice.zh: 管理层能够利用增长来吸引和鼓励员工。

reserved.en: I've reserved a room in the name of Jones.
reserved.zh: 我以琼斯的名字预订了一个房间。

reserved.en: These seats are reserved for special guests.
reserved.zh: 这些座位是留给贵宾的。

reserved.en: We reserved two tickets in the name of Brown.
reserved.zh: 我们用布朗的名字预订了两张票。

partition.en: For example, DB2 supports massively parallel processing (MPP) architecture and can run on a single partition (EE) or multiple partitions (EEE).
partition.zh: 例如， DB2 支持大规模并行处理（MPP）构件，并能在单个分区（EE）或者多个分区（EEE）上运行。

partition.en: The uncle had made a wooden partition here for the goats, and covered the floor with straw.
partition.zh: 叔叔在这里为山羊做了一个木隔板，并把稻草铺在地板上。

partition.en: Germany's seizure of Austria and the Munich Pact for the partition of Czechoslovakia (1938) also aroused the American people.
partition.zh: 德国占领奥地利，为瓜分捷克斯洛伐克而签署了《慕尼黑条约》（1938年），也引起了美国人民的注意。

swelling.en: You may notice redness and swelling after the injection.
Poison from the fish causes paralysis, swelling, and nausea.
swelling.zh: 这种鱼的毒素会引起瘫痪、肿胀、恶心。

swelling.en: His eye was partly closed, and there was a swelling over his lid.
swelling.zh: 他一只眼睛半闭着，眼睑上有个肿块。

berth.en: Goldring booked a berth on the first boat he could.
berth.zh: 戈德林在第一艘他能订到卧铺的船上订了个位子。

berth.en: He gave the dog a wide berth.
She gives showbiz parties a wide berth.
berth.zh: 她对娱乐聚会敬而远之。

demolish.en: Our intention was quite the opposite – to demolish rumours that have surrounded him since he took office.
demolish.zh: 我们的意图恰恰相反–要粉碎自他就职以来就缠着他的谣言。

demolish.en: We are going to demolish the old building.
demolish.zh: 我们准备爆破这座旧大楼。

demolish.en: A record she would demolish the following year!
demolish.zh: 而这个记录她明年肯定能打破。

radiant.en: On her wedding day the bride looked truly radiant.
radiant.zh: 在她婚礼那天，新娘看起来真的是容光焕发。

radiant.en: The earth would be a frozen ball if it were not for the radiant heat of the sun.
radiant.zh: 要是没有太阳的辐射热，地球将会是一个冰冻的球体。

backbone.en: You might be taking drastic measures and you've got to have the backbone to do that.
backbone.zh: 你可能在采取极端措施，而且你得有骨气做它。

backbone.en: Primary care should be the backbone of any health care system.
backbone.zh: 基层医疗应该是任何卫生医疗系统的支柱。

marrow.zh: 该骨髓捐献者是她14个月大的妹妹。

marrow.en: Our bone marrow contains fat in the form of small globules.
marrow.zh: 我们骨髓里有圆滴式的脂肪。

marrow.en: There are 2,000 children worldwide who need a bone marrow transplant.
marrow.zh: 全世界有2000名需要骨髓移植的儿童。

greasy.en: The greasy food made her stomach heave.
greasy.zh: 油腻腻的食物让她胃里恶心。

greasy.en: He propped his elbows upon a greasy counter.
greasy.zh: 他把胳膊肘撑在油腻腻的柜台上。

greasy.en: Tomorrow I'm going to give the toys a good wipe as some seem a bit greasy.
greasy.zh: 明天我会把那些玩具好好擦拭一番，因为有些看上去有点油腻了。

platinum.en: The mask is formed of a gold-platinum alloy inset with emeralds and other gems.
platinum.zh: 这张面具是由黄金和白金的合金制成，并镶嵌翡翠和其他宝石。

platinum.en: Among his artworks, you could find the ring dedicated to New York or Moscow, with Italian patio or Chinese pagoda, with gems or only from platinum.
platinum.zh: 在他的作品中，你可以找到献给纽约或莫斯科的戒指，有意大利天井或中国宝塔，有宝石或仅来自铂金。

platinum.en: Her blue eyes shone and caught the light, and so did the platinum waves in her hair.
platinum.zh: 她蓝色的眼睛闪闪发光，白金色的波浪发卷也闪闪发光。

silicon.en: The new chip will be made from a piece of silicon about the size of a postage stamp.
silicon.zh: 这种新的芯片将由大约邮票大小的一块硅片制成。
斯坦福和伯克利造就了硅谷。

silicon.en: This is the silicon chip—a little chip of silicon crystal.
silicon.zh: 这是硅芯片——一个硅晶体的小芯片。

supernova.en: At least one supernova occurs per decade in our galaxy.
supernova.zh: 每十年至少有一颗超新星在我们的银河系中出现。

supernova.en: A bluish ribbon of light stretching from left to right across the picture might be a knot of gas ejected by the supernova.
supernova.zh: 一个从左延伸至右穿过整幅图片的浅蓝色光可能是由超新星喷发出的气体的集结体。
现在考虑一次超新星爆发。

denote.en: Many people believe that plural marriages denote immorality of other societies.
denote.zh: 许多人认为多妻制意味着其他社会的不道德。

denote.en: The flashing lights denote dangerous roads ahead.
denote.zh: 闪光表示前方道路危险。

denote.en: Listing 3 shows how to denote a publication list.
denote.zh: 清单3显示了如何表示发布列表。

stitch.en: The design can be worked in cross stitch.
stitch.zh: 该图案可以用十字针法编织出来。

stitch.en: The surgeon would pick up his instruments, probe, repair, and stitch up again.
stitch.zh: 外科医生会拿起器械进行探查、修复，然后再缝合。

devoid.en: In the 1950s, data on captive chimpanzees collected by James Gavan appeared devoid of evidence of an adolescent growth spurt in these apes.
devoid.zh: 在20世纪50年代，詹姆斯·加万收集的关于圈养黑猩猩的数据似乎缺乏这些类人猿出现青春期激增的证据。

devoid.en: The letter was devoid of warmth and feeling.
devoid.zh: 这封信既无热情又无感情。

devoid.en: I have never looked on a face that was so devoid of feeling.
devoid.zh: 我从未见过这样一张完全没有感情的脸。

assorted.en: The meat is served with salad or assorted vegetables.
assorted.zh: 端上的肉配有色拉或什锦蔬菜。

assorted.en: It should be a great week, with overnight stops in assorted hotels in the Adirondacks.
assorted.zh: 那该是很棒的一周，可以在阿迪朗达克山各式各样的旅馆里停留过夜。

assorted.en: The scent of that crispy brown turkey, fluffy mashed potatoes, savory stuffing, and assorted vegetables made my mouth water.
assorted.zh: 脆皮棕色火鸡、蓬松的土豆泥、开胃的馅料以及什锦蔬菜的香味让我口水直流。

immoral.en: Capital punishment was regarded as inhuman and immoral.
immoral.zh: 死刑过去被认为是非人道且不道德的。

immoral.en: There's nothing immoral about wanting to earn more money.
immoral.zh: 想多赚点钱没什么不道德。

voltage.en: Like high voltage transformers, heroes take the energy of higher powers and step it down so that it can be used by ordinary people.
voltage.zh: 英雄就像高压变压器一样，把更高的能量取下来，让普通人使用。

voltage.en: Like high-voltage transformers, heroes take the energy of higher powers and step it down so that it can be used by ordinary people.
voltage.zh: 英雄就像高压变压器一样，吸收高功率的能量，降低其电压，让普通人也可以使用。

grieve.en: I didn't have any time to grieve.
Relatives need time to grieve over loved ones they have lost.
grieve.zh: 亲属需要时间痛悼他们失去的至爱。

grieve.en: He decided not to take his medicine, so as to grieve Wendy.
grieve.zh: 他决定不吃药，好让温迪伤心。

heading.en: Can you forecast where the economy is heading?
heading.zh: 你能预测经济的发展方向吗？

receptive.en: She was always receptive to new ideas.
receptive.zh: 她总是愿意接受新观点。

receptive.en: The voters had seemed receptive to his ideas.
receptive.zh: 选民似乎愿意接受他的想法。

receptive.en: He gave an impressive speech to a receptive audience.
receptive.zh: 他做了一次感人的讲演，听众深受感动。

harness.zh: 兽医临时凑成了一套马具。

harness.en: Turkey plans to harness the waters of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers for big hydro-electric power projects.
harness.zh: 土耳其计划利用底格里斯河与幼发拉底河的水来建造大型水力发电工程。

harness.en: You can easily harness the power of both.
harness.zh: 您可以轻易地利用二者的能力。

leftover.en: You have to spit out any food leftover.
leftover.zh: 你不得不将任何食物吃剩的部分吐出来。

leftover.en: Come over here and help me pack up the leftover food.
leftover.zh: 过来帮我把剩下的食物打包。

leftover.en: She had no stomach for the leftover stew.

drizzle.en: A fine drizzle began to veil the hills.
drizzle.zh: 蒙蒙细雨渐渐笼罩了群山。

drizzle.en: Clouds had come down and it was starting to drizzle.
drizzle.zh: 云压了下来，开始下起了毛毛雨。

drizzle.en: The drizzle had now stopped and the sun was breaking through.
drizzle.zh: 细雨已经停了，太阳露出了脸。

publicize.en: The author appeared on television to publicize her latest book.
publicize.zh: 作者出现在电视上宣传她的新书。
我们必须广泛地宣扬这次会议。

publicize.en: They flew to Europe to publicize the plight of the refugees.
publicize.zh: 他们飞往欧洲报道难民的惨状。

dissipate.en: Was she the pure phantom I loved because I would never touch her, never allow my all too real hands to dissipate the mist?
dissipate.zh: 她是我爱的那个纯洁的幻影吗？因为我从没接触她，从没允许自己真实的双手来拨开那层雾。

pediatrician.en: Playing with digital devices discourages kids from active discovery, according to pediatrician Dr. Michael Yogman.
pediatrician.zh: 儿科医生迈克尔·约格曼表示，孩子们玩电子设备会妨碍他们积极地探索世界。

pediatrician.en: According to a pediatrician, no matter what kind of play children engage in, they are learning how to create things.
pediatrician.zh: 一位儿科医生表示，无论孩子们玩哪种游戏，他们都在学习如何创造东西。

pediatrician.en: She gave me the phone number for the nearest pharmacy so I could make arrangements with our pediatrician to call in prescriptions.
pediatrician.zh: 她给了我最近的药店的电话号码，这样我就可以和我们的儿科医生联系并且拿到药方。

subordinate.en: Sixty of his subordinate officers followed his example.
subordinate.zh: 他的60个下级官员都以他为榜样。

subordinate.en: He was both willing and able to subordinate all else to this aim.
subordinate.zh: 他既愿意也能够让别的一切从属于这个目标。

subordinate.en: He contented himself with a subordinate job.

bulge.en: They grow, they bulge, they stretch and sometimes they even painfully pull.
bulge.zh: 它们成长、膨胀、伸展，有时候它们甚至费力地拉伸。

bulge.en: Only galaxies with a spherical bulge—like component appear to accommodate supermassive black holes.
bulge.zh: 只有拥有球形膨胀物质的星系才可能容纳超大质量的黑洞。

bulge.en: After the war there was a bulge in the birth rate.

finale.en: Even the film's impressive finale can't hide the first hour's paucity of imagination.
finale.zh: 这部电影在开头一个小时中毫无想象力，即使有个让人印象深刻的结局也无法掩盖这个缺憾。

finale.en: Executive producer spills about episodes, "In the fall finale we reset the series again, something that we've done at the midpoint of most of our seasons."
finale.zh: 执行制作人对于剧情这样描述：“秋季档大结局中，我们又重新整合了剧情，几乎每一季的中间档都是这么做的。”

finale.en: The music worked up to a rousing finale.
finale.zh: 乐曲渐变到一个激动人心的末乐章。

oxide.en: The gas is fed back over the calcium oxide.
oxide.zh: 气体的反应体现在氧化钙上。

oxide.en: To recover the energy, the gas is fed back over the calcium oxide.
oxide.zh: 为了回收能量，气体重新与氧化钙反应。

oxide.en: Heating this chemical compound drives off carbon dioxide gas, leaving calcium oxide.
oxide.zh: 这种化合物加热后会排出二氧化碳，产生氧化钙。

pessimistic.en: I think you're being far too pessimistic.
Not everyone is so pessimistic about the future.
pessimistic.zh: 并非每个人都对未来如此悲观。

pessimistic.en: The mood of the meeting was distinctly pessimistic.
pessimistic.zh: 这次会议的气氛显然很悲观。

quarry.en: The hunters lost sight of their quarry in the forest.
quarry.zh: 猎人在森林里跟丢了猎物。

quarry.en: We ended up in an abandoned quarry.
quarry.zh: 我们最后到了一个废弃的采石场。

obscene.en: Obscene and threatening phone calls are against the law.
obscene.zh: 猥亵电话和恐吓电话是违法的。

obscene.en: The government soon launched a campaign against obscene publications.
obscene.zh: 政府很快发动了一场反淫秽出版物的战役。

obscene.en: Though each country's plan differs, they all have similar focus: curbing access to obscene content.
obscene.zh: 尽管每个国家的计划不同，但是他们都有一个相似的聚焦点：制止访问淫秽内容。

scarcity.en: This scarcity is inevitable in less developed countries.
scarcity.zh: 在欠发达国家这种匮乏是不可避免的。

scarcity.en: Either food scarcity or excessive hunting can threaten a population of animals.
scarcity.zh: 食物短缺或过度捕猎都可能威胁到动物的数量。

scarcity.en: In the wild, these birds store food for retrieval later during periods of food scarcity.
scarcity.zh: 在野外，这些鸟会储存食物以备日后食物短缺时再取用。

invader.en: By 1951 the tiny invader had been found in Virginia.
invader.zh: 到1951年，在弗吉尼亚发现了这种微小的入侵者。

invader.en: What kind of invader gives rise to such high-level monitoring?
invader.zh: 什么样的入侵者会引发如此高级别的监控？

invader.en: Among the best animated series it has offered, many stand out, including Sponge Bob Square Pants and Invader Zim.
invader.zh: 在它推出的最佳动画系列中，包括《海绵宝宝》和《外星侵略者吉姆》在内，许多动画都很优秀。

combustion.en: You might say, "Well, gee, why don't we just power our cars with hydrogen placed on an internal combustion chamber."
combustion.zh: 你可能会说：“好吧，哎呀，为什么我们不把氢气放在汽车内部的燃烧室，来驱动我们的汽车呢。”

combustion.en: The combustion of larger molecules, which have multiple carbon-carbon bonds, involves a more complex series of reactions.
combustion.zh: 具有多重碳-碳键的大分子的燃烧涉及到一系列更复杂的反应。

combustion.en: In his application, Selden described a machine with a gasoline-driven, combustion-type engine that sat in front of the driver.
combustion.zh: 在他的申请中，塞尔登描述了一种有汽油驱动的燃烧式发动机的机器，它就在司机的前面。

ventilation.en: The only ventilation comes from tiny sliding windows.
ventilation.zh: 惟一的通风来自几扇小小的推拉窗。

ventilation.en: Make sure that there is adequate ventilation in the room before using the paint.
ventilation.zh: 在使用油漆前确保室内通风充足。

ventilation.en: One method is invasive ventilation. A second method involves blowing oxygen into the lungs through a mask.
ventilation.zh: 一种方法是有创通气。第二种方法是通过面罩将氧气吹入肺部。

turbulent.en: I had to have a boat that could handle turbulent seas.
turbulent.zh: 我必须有一条能应付汹涌海浪的船。

turbulent.en: Wars and conflicts have subjected people living in this area to turbulent life.
turbulent.zh: 战争与冲突使该地区的人民过着动荡不安的生活。

turbulent.en: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations.
turbulent.zh: 动荡的商业环境也让高级管理人员变得小心翼翼，以免含糊的声明玷污了他们的声誉。

holistic.en: Many teachers have an intuitive sense that different students have different learning styles. Some are verbal and some are visual; some are linear, and some are holistic.
holistic.zh: 许多老师都有一种直觉，不同的学生有不同的学习风格。有些是语言的，有些是视觉的；有些是线性的，有些是整体的。

holistic.en: The medical world is now paying more attention to holistic medicine which is an approach based on the belief that people state of mind can make them sick or speed their recovery from sickness.
holistic.zh: 医学界现在越来越重视整体医学，这个方法是基于这样的信念，人们的精神状态可以使他们生病或加速他们从疾病中恢复。

holistic.en: Smith says he'll provide services ranging from formal seminars to on-farm work-shops on holistic management, to one-on-one hand-holding and an almost 24/7 phone hotline for farmers who are converting.
holistic.zh: 史密斯说他会提供一系列的服务，从关于整体管理的正式研讨会到农场工作坊，再到体贴周到的一对一服务以及几乎全日无休的热线电话，为正在转型的农民提供帮助。

inviting.en: He had been nervous about inviting us.
inviting.zh: 他过去一直不敢邀请我们。

inviting.en: He sent a letter inviting Naomi to attend his installation as chief of his tribe.
inviting.zh: 他给娜奥米寄了封信，邀请她来参加他就任部落酋长的仪式。

manure.en: The manure should be well dug in.
manure.zh: 肥料应均匀地混入土壤。

manure.en: There isn't time to dig deeply and put in manure or compost.
manure.zh: 没有时间挖得再深些，并放入粪肥或堆肥。

longitudinal.en: The third axis is the longitudinal axis.
For over two decades, Jancke has researched the effects of music lessons, and like Schellenberg, he believes that the only way to truly understand their effects is to run longitudinal studies.
longitudinal.zh: 20多年以来，詹克一直在研究音乐课的效果，和舍伦贝格一样，他认为唯一能够真正了解其效果的方法就是进行纵向研究。

longitudinal.en: The plant's stem is marked with thin green longitudinal stripes.
longitudinal.zh: 这种植物的茎上长有绿色细长条纹。

affirmation.en: The ruling was a welcome affirmation of the constitutional right to free speech.
affirmation.zh: 此裁决是对言论自由这一宪法权利的受人欢迎的肯定。

affirmation.en: The North Atlantic Treaty begins with the affirmation that its parties "reaffirm their faith in the purposes and principles of the Charter of the United Nations."
affirmation.zh: 《北大西洋公约》以公开肯定其成员“重申其对《联合国宪章》的目的以及原则的信念”开头。

aggravate.en: If the reports are well-founded, the incident could seriously aggravate relations between the two nations.
aggravate.zh: 如果这些报道是有根据的，那么该事件将可能导致两国间的关系严重恶化。

aggravate.en: Stress and lack of sleep can aggravate the situation.
aggravate.zh: 紧张和缺少睡眠会使情况恶化。

cornerstone.en: Research is the cornerstone of the profession.
This study is the cornerstone of the whole research programme.
cornerstone.zh: 此项研究是整个研究计划的基础。

cornerstone.en: The doctrine of surplus value is the cornerstone of Marx's economic theory.
cornerstone.zh: 剩余价值学说是马克思经济理论的基石。

exaggerated.zh: 这件事被过分地夸大了。

exaggerated.en: The book is both inaccurate and exaggerated.
exaggerated.zh: 那本书既不准确又夸大事实。

seductive.en: The main character is often unknowingly lured into this potentially lethal predicament by a seductive femme fatale, as in Original Sin.
seductive.zh: 就像在《原罪》中一样，主角经常会在不知不觉中被一位性感的蛇蝎美人引诱到这个可能致命的困境中。
这是一个很有诱惑力的论点。
她运用了自己最有魅力的嗓音。

flux.en: Our society is in a state of flux.
flux.zh: 我们的社会在不断演变。

flux.en: Both quantum mechanics and chaos theory suggest a world constantly in flux.
flux.zh: 量子力学和混沌理论都指出世界处在不断变化中。

flux.en: Education remains in a state of flux which will take some time to settle down.
flux.zh: 教育处于不断的变化中，需要一段时间才能稳定下来。

mantle.en: Reservoirs of this hot rock collect in the base of the mantle.
mantle.zh: 这些热岩石的储层聚集在地幔的底部。

mantle.en: Because of its proximity to Earth's core, the rock at the base of the mantle is much hotter than rock in the upper mantle.
mantle.zh: 由于靠近地核，地幔底部的岩石比上地幔岩石的温度高得多。

mantle.en: The "mantle plume" thus formed, once established, continues to channel hot material from the mantle base until the reservoir is emptied.
mantle.zh: 这样形成的“地幔柱”一旦形成，就会继续从地幔底部引导热物质，直到储层被排空。

gloomy.en: They found him in a gloomy, downbeat mood.
gloomy.zh: 他们发现他心情沮丧而消沉。

gloomy.en: Officials say the outlook for next year is gloomy.
gloomy.zh: 官员们称来年前景暗淡。

gloomy.en: Suddenly, the future didn't look so gloomy after all.
gloomy.zh: 突然感到前途似乎并非如此黯淡。

disposable.zh: 杰拉尔德没有多少可自由支配的收入。

disposable.en: Disposable diapers are fairly straightforward to put on.
disposable.zh: 一次性尿布非常容易穿。

disposable.en: The use of disposable products is considered ecologically unsound.
disposable.zh: 使用一次性产品被认为是没有顾及对生态的影响。

troublesome.en: Tom's whole class were of a pattern--restless, noisy, and troublesome.
troublesome.zh: 汤姆的整个班级都是一个模式——躁动不安、吵吵闹闹、麻烦不断。

troublesome.en: When it does rain, it tends to be a very light rain that isn't troublesome.
troublesome.zh: 下雨了一般也是小雨，不会造成太大的麻烦。

troublesome.en: It was a tedious and troublesome piece of work, but he finished it at last.
troublesome.zh: 这是一件乏味而麻烦的工作，但他终于完成了。

wreath.en: The Queen laid a wreath at the war memorial.
wreath.zh: 女王向阵亡将士纪念碑献了花圈。

wreath.en: A Christmas wreath exclaiming PEACE ON EARTH hangs on the restaurant door.
wreath.zh: 一个写着“世界和平”的圣诞花环悬挂在饭店的门上。

wreath.en: Hang the wreath on your wall or the front door.
wreath.zh: 把花环挂在你的墙上或者前门上。

managerial.zh: 她有没有什么管理经验？

managerial.en: Williams worked at a managerial level, while only 38.
managerial.zh: 威廉姆斯在管理层工作，而他只有38岁。

managerial.en: All the managerial personnel at the factory are hired on contract.
managerial.zh: 工厂所有管理人员都是聘用的。

discrete.en: Social structures are not discrete objects; they overlap and interweave.
discrete.zh: 社会结构不是离散的客体；他们重叠并交织在一起。

discrete.en: Put simply, a class is a discrete block or bundle of variables and methods.
discrete.zh: 简单地说，类是一个由变量和方法组成的离散块或束。

discrete.en: The discrete units that make up language can be put together in different ways.
discrete.zh: 这种组成语言的离散单元能够以不同的方式组合起来。

geometric.en: Many pictures have been based on simple geometric designs.
geometric.zh: 许多图画是以简单的几何图案为基础的。

geometric.en: Geometric designs were popular wall decorations in the 14th century.
geometric.zh: 几何图案是14世纪流行的墙面装饰。

geometric.en: When most people think of shapes, they think of colorful geometric surfaces.
geometric.zh: 当大多数人想到形状时，他们想到的都是彩色几何平面。

condemnation.en: There was widespread condemnation of the invasion.
condemnation.zh: 那次侵略遭到了人们普遍的谴责。

condemnation.en: Editors were unanimous in their condemnation of the proposals.
condemnation.zh: 编辑们一致谴责这些提议。

condemnation.en: That's a condemnation of the students as a whole, and doesn't explain all campus unhappiness.
condemnation.zh: 这是对学生整体的谴责，并不能解释所有校园的不快。

contaminant.en: Experts say testing needs to be done on each contaminant to determine the long-term effects on humans.
contaminant.zh: 专家说需要对每种污染物进行测试，以查明对人类的长期影响。

contaminant.en: High purity water systems are primarily composed of austenitic stainless steel (ss) materials due to their corrosion resistant and contaminant free properties.
contaminant.zh: 考虑到铬镍不锈钢(SS)的抗腐蚀和防污染性，高纯水系统基本上都是由铬镍不锈钢材料构成。

contaminant.en: Each of the membrane technologies is essentially a filtration process in which contaminant ions are filtered from solution using a membrane with very small water passages.
contaminant.zh: 这些膜技术本质上都是一个过滤程序，就是用一个有非常细小水通道的膜片把污染物离子从溶液里过滤掉。

enclosure.en: Within those precincts, within that enclosure, there's a large, open courtyard.
enclosure.zh: 在这些区域内，在围墙内，有一个大的、开放的庭院。

enclosure.en: Without this enclosure, but just within the street entrance, sat a grey-haired gentleman at a small table, with a large open ledger of some kind before him.
enclosure.zh: 没有围墙，就在街口，一位白发苍苍的绅士坐在一张小桌旁，面前摆着一本打开的大账本。

enclosure.en: This enclosure was so vast that the outermost wall could hardly be seen.
enclosure.zh: 这块圈地大得几乎看不见它最外面的围墙。

indicative.en: In 'Ben likes school', the verb 'like' is in the indicative.
indicative.zh: 在Ben likes school中，动词like是陈述语气。

indicative.en: Their failure to act is indicative of their lack of interest.
indicative.zh: 他们未采取行动，这表示他们没有兴趣。

indicative.en: His action is indicative of growing concern about the shortage of skilled labour.
indicative.zh: 他的行为显示对于熟练工人短缺现象的日益关注。

lagoon.zh: 彼得独自一人在泻湖上。

lagoon.en: I have tossed, and the lagoon has won.

blizzard.en: Eleanor arrived in the midst of a blizzard.
blizzard.zh: 埃莉诺到达时正下着暴风雪。

blizzard.en: We play all kinds of games at Blizzard.
blizzard.zh: 我们在暴雪尝试各种游戏。

tidy.en: They sat in her neat and tidy kitchen.
tidy.zh: 他们坐在她那干净整齐的厨房里。

tidy.en: He lives alone in a suspiciously tidy apartment.
tidy.zh: 他独自一人住在一套整洁得出奇的公寓里。

tidy.en: Except for the remarkably tidy kitchen, the place was a mess.
tidy.zh: 除了异常整洁的厨房外，这个地方一团糟。

humorous.en: He was quite humorous, and I liked that about him.
humorous.zh: 他很幽默，我喜欢他这一点。

humorous.en: The writing is brutally tough and savagely humorous.
humorous.zh: 该作品文笔痛快地犀利和极端地幽默。

humorous.en: Script editors are all juiced up over the humorous potential.
humorous.zh: 剧本编辑们全都因剧本潜在的幽默性而兴奋起来了。

melon.zh: 我最喜欢的水果是哈密瓜。

melon.en: I bought this melon at half the price.

beware.en: Motorists have been warned to beware of icy roads.
beware.zh: 已经提醒开车的人当心冰封的路面。

beware.en: Motorists were warned to beware of slippery conditions.
beware.zh: 汽车驾驶者被提醒小心路滑。

beware.en: I think the moral of the story is let the buyer beware.
beware.zh: 我想这个故事的寓意是提醒购买者当心。

utilization.en: In China today, the utilization efficiency of farming water is about 30-40 percent.
utilization.zh: 在今天的中国，农业用水的利用效率约为30%-40%。

utilization.en: This figure stands in sharp contrast to developed countries' utilization average of 70-80 percent.
utilization.zh: 这一数字与发达国家平均70%至80%的利用率形成鲜明对比。

utilization.en: The low utilization efficiency has resulted from the adoption of some traditional Chinese irrigation methods.
utilization.zh: 利用效率低的原因是采用了中国一些传统的灌溉方式。

sensational.zh: 比赛结果是轰动性的，以4:1狂胜对手。

sensational.en: The sensational verdict climaxed a six-month trial.
sensational.zh: 那项引起轰动的裁决使长达六个月的审判达到了高潮。

sensational.en: It is only the sensational that sells news magazines.
sensational.zh: 只有轰动性的消息才能促进新闻杂志的销售。

pertinent.zh: 她问了一些相关的问题。

pertinent.en: Mrs. Southern listened keenly, occasionally breaking in with pertinent questions.
pertinent.zh: 萨瑟恩夫人兴致勃勃地听着,偶尔插入一个相关的问题。

pertinent.en: More pertinent right now is whether or not the craze has reached a tipping point.
pertinent.zh: 现在更重要的是，这股狂热是否已经达到临界点。

wrath.en: Gradually the wrath faded out of the old King's face, and he said, "Kiss me, my prince."
wrath.zh: 渐渐地，老国王脸上的怒气消失了，他说：“亲吻我吧，我的王子。”

wrath.en: There was silence while one might count ten--the master was gathering his wrath.
wrath.zh: 大约有十秒钟，课室里寂静无声——老师越来越生气。
唱出阿基·利斯的愤怒吧，女神。

presumption.en: There is a general presumption that the doctor knows best.
presumption.zh: 一般人都以为医生最了解情况。

presumption.en: Everyone is entitled to the presumption of innocence until they are proved to be guilty.
presumption.zh: 在被证明有罪以前，每一个人都应被假定无辜。

presumption.en: We have learned much about the foolish idea of excluding people on the presumption of the ethnic/racial inferiority.
presumption.zh: 我们已经了解了很多关于以低等民族或种族为前提而把人排除在外的愚蠢想法。

endow.en: Herbs have been used for centuries to endow a whole range of foods with subtle flavours.
endow.zh: 香草几个世纪以来一直被用来赋予各种食品细腻的味道。

endow.en: With advice from AI specialists, art designers and culture researchers, our multi-language experts endow Lancom with an enormous potential for innovation within the world of language learning.
endow.zh: 在人工智能专家、艺术设计师和文化研究者的建议下，我们的多语言专家赋予了 Lancom 以巨大的语言学习创新潜力。

endow.en: They were deploring their parents' omission to endow them with so splendid a means of appealing to the Zamindar.
endow.zh: 他们在抱怨着他们的父母没有赋予他们这种向地主请愿的卓越口才。

anyhow.zh: “无论如何，非常感谢你。”—“不客气。”

anyhow.en: "Anyhow," she added briskly, "it's none of my business."
anyhow.zh: “无论如何”，她干脆利索地加了一句：“这不关我的事。”
无论如何，有一件事是清楚的。

vocation.en: Her vocation is her work as an actress.
vocation.zh: 她适合的职业就是当演员。

vocation.en: Nursing is not just a job—it's a vocation.
vocation.zh: 护理不仅仅是一项工作，而且还是一种职业。

racket.en: This tennis racket absorbs shock on impact.
racket.zh: 这个网球拍能减轻撞击所产生的剧烈震动。

racket.en: She swished her racket aggressively through the air.
racket.zh: 她咄咄逼人地把球拍挥舞得呼呼作响。

racket.en: Can I try your new badminton racket?
racket.zh: 我可以试用你的羽毛球拍吗？

moss.en: The moss was soft and furry to the touch.
moss.zh: 苔藓柔软，摸起来像绒毛。

moss.en: Moss had clamped an unexpectedly strong grip on his arm.
moss.zh: 莫斯出乎意料地牢牢抓住他的手臂。

waterfront.en: They went for a stroll along the waterfront.
Sometimes the house is a waterfront mansion in a gated golf community worth well over seven figures.
waterfront.zh: 有时，这所房子是一栋海滨别墅，位于一个有门禁的高尔夫社区，价值远超七位数。

waterfront.en: Christian Farrell of Waterfront Bicycle Shop, on West St. just north of Christopher St., said initially he was concerned about bike-share, though, he admitted, "I was happy to see people on bikes."
waterfront.zh: 来自克里斯托弗大街北边的西大街上海滨自行车店的克里斯蒂安·法雷尔，说他起初对共享单车很是担忧，但他承认，“我很开心看到人们骑自行车。”

abandonment.en: It's Laura who cries at Dean's abandonment, while Dean maintains this composure.
abandonment.zh: 是劳拉为迪安的被抛弃而哭泣，而迪安保持着这种镇静。

abandonment.en: Kohler attributes the immediate cause of the abandonment to problems with corn production at a high altitude during short growing seasons.
abandonment.zh: 科勒认为，（居住地）废弃的直接原因是高海拔地区的玉米生长季节较短，因此生产出现了问题。

abandonment.en: Other archaeologists have identified the immediate cause of this abandonment to be a series of short growing seasons that would have put pressure on corn production at that high an altitude.
abandonment.zh: 其他考古学家已经发现导致这种遗弃的直接原因是一系列短暂的生长季节，而这将会给生长在高海拔地区玉米的生产带来压力。

logistics.en: The skills and logistics of getting such a big show on the road pose enormous practical problems.
logistics.zh: 这样的一个大型节目进行巡演在技术和后勤方面都会面临大量实际问题。

logistics.en: Mail companies are logistics companies,which puts them in a special position to help when disaster strikes.
logistics.zh: 邮件公司是物流公司，他们在灾难降临时能够提供特殊帮助。

logistics.en: Mail companies are logistics companies, which puts them in a special position to help when disaster strikes.
logistics.zh: 邮政公司也就是物流公司，在灾难降临时能够提供特殊帮助。

stale.zh: 他们的婚姻已了无热情。

stale.en: There was a powerful smell of stale beer.
stale.zh: 有一股浓烈的馊啤酒的气味。

stale.en: A miasma of stale alcohol hung around him.
stale.zh: 他身上老有股难闻的酒精味。

obedience.zh: 伊莎贝拉被教导要不加质询地顺从。

obedience.en: A timid child, Isabella had learned obedience at an early age.
obedience.zh: 伊莎贝拉是一个羞怯的孩子，很小的时候就已经学会了顺从。

obedience.en: Instant obedience was the only safe thing.
obedience.zh: 立即服从是唯一安全的事情。

equitable.en: Mr. Roh's economic planners sought to achieve a more equitable distribution of wealth.
equitable.zh: 罗欧先生的经济规划者们努力实现更公平的财富分配。

equitable.en: Sadoway isn't alone in trumpeting energy storage as a missing link to a cleaner, more efficient, and more equitable energy future.
equitable.zh: 萨多维鼓吹在通往更清洁、高效、公平的能源未来的过程中，能源储存是一个缺失环节。而他不是唯一持这种观点的人。

equitable.en: But Sadoway isn't alone in trumpeting energy storage as a missing link to a cleaner, more efficient, and more equitable energy future.
equitable.zh: 但萨多维并不是唯一一个鼓吹能源储存是通向更清洁、更高效、更公平的能源未来的缺失环节的人。

fret.en: "You really needn't fret, Ratty," added the Badger placidly.
fret.zh: “你真的不必烦恼，鼠仔。”獾子班杰平静地补充道。

fret.en: Her baby starts to fret as soon as she goes out of the room.
fret.zh: 她一走出房间，婴儿就躁动起来。

fret.en: But congressional staffers fret that the project will eventually cost billions more.
fret.zh: 但国会的工作人员们担心这个方案最终会多花几十亿。

flatter.zh: 那种颜色很多人都不适宜。
巧妙的裁剪可以使你的身材显得优美。

disseminate.en: Political advocacy groups have begun to use information services to disseminate information that is then accessed by the public via personal computer.
disseminate.zh: 政治宣传团体已经开始使用信息服务来传播信息，公众可以通过个人电脑获取这些信息。

disseminate.en: The COE conducts frequent meetings and workshops to disseminate knowledge and further learning activities among team members.
disseminate.zh: COE 经常举行会议和研讨会，以在团队成员之间传播知识和进一步的学习活动。

disseminate.en: The approach is to develop and disseminate manufacturing guidelines and practices for improved productivity and safer, value added products and processing facilities.
disseminate.zh: 方法是制定并分发生产指南及提高生产力并提升更安全、增加附加值的产品和加工设施的规范。

errand.en: He ran off to the village on his errand of mercy.
errand.zh: 他跑向村子去执行他的仁慈使命。

errand.en: They can view a list of errands that match their interest profile, and, by entering a price, can bid to perform the errand.
errand.zh: 他们可以查看与他们的兴趣简档匹配的差事列表，并且，通过输入价格，可以为执行差事投标。

errand.en: He sent me on a fool's errand.
errand.zh: 他派我去干白费力的事。

lapse.en: He knew that he might soon lapse into unconsciousness.
lapse.zh: 他知道他可能很快就会陷入昏迷状态。

lapse.en: She had allowed her membership to lapse.
lapse.zh: 她的会员资格期满终止，没有再续。

lapse.en: After a lapse of six months we met up again.
lapse.zh: 相隔六个月之后我们又相遇了。

photon.en: The energy of a light photon or particle is different for each color.
photon.zh: 可见光子或粒子的能量因颜色不同而不同。

photon.en: The Planck–Einstein relation describes the energy of each photon in terms of the photon's frequency.
photon.zh: 普朗克—爱因斯坦关系式用光子的频率来描述每个光子的能量。

barge.en: Raw materials were carried to the works by barge.
barge.zh: 原材料由驳船运到工厂。

barge.en: She wants to cruise the canals of France in a barge.
barge.zh: 她想坐驳船游览法国的运河。

barge.en: A barge was close inshore about a hundred yards away.
barge.zh: 一艘驳船靠近海岸仅约100码远。

psychiatry.en: Srini Pillay, an assistant professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School, believes this counter-intuitive link between downtime and productivity may be due to the way our brains operate.
psychiatry.zh: 哈佛医学院精神病学助理教授斯里尼·皮莱认为，停工期与生产力之间这种反常理的联系可能是由我们大脑的运作方式造成的。

psychiatry.en: This is called negative symptom in psychiatry.
psychiatry.zh: 这在精神病学上被称作是阴性症状。
心理学和精神病学不应该是敌人。

coexist.en: Different traditions coexist successfully side by side.
coexist.zh: 不同的传统和谐地共存着。

coexist.en: Newspaper Web sites can coexist with the newspapers and still bring in healthy profit margins.
coexist.zh: 网络报纸可以与纸质报纸共存，仍能带来不错的利润。

coexist.en: The relation that exists when opposites cannot coexist.
coexist.zh: 对立面不能共存的关系。

sucker.en: I've always been a sucker for romantic movies.
sucker.zh: 我一向喜欢传奇性的影片。

sucker.en: I have always been a sucker for romantic movies.
sucker.zh: 我一向非常喜欢传奇性的影片。

sucker.en: Just as I'm a sucker for darker areas of cinema (like zombie movies, apocalyptic movies, and post apocalyptic movies), I'm a sucker for a good anti-hero.
sucker.zh: 正如我喜欢那些黑暗题材的电影(像是僵尸电影，启示录电影，或是后启示录类电影)，一个优秀的反面人物也是我所痴迷的。

chromosome.en: The scientists want to locate the position of the gene on a chromosome.
chromosome.zh: 科学家们想找到该基因在染色体上的位置。

chromosome.en: The Chromosome is now losing important genetic information and is no longer functional.
chromosome.zh: 染色体现在缺少重要的遗传信息，不再具有功能。

chromosome.en: Every time the Chromosome divides—every time one cell divides into two—pieces of the ends of the Chromosome, the telomere, get broken off.
chromosome.zh: 当每次染色体分裂时——即当每次一个细胞分裂成两个时——染色体的尾部，也就是端区，就会发生断裂。

traitor.en: He was labelled (as) a traitor by his former colleagues.
traitor.zh: 他被以前的同事称为叛徒。

traitor.en: He was a traitor. And he murdered someone in cold blood.
traitor.zh: 他是一个叛徒，而且他冷血地杀了人。

traitor.en: Tom chased the traitor home, and thus found out where he lived.
traitor.zh: 汤姆追着叛徒到了他的家，这样就知道他住在哪儿了。

espouse.en: Jerome McCann, for example, insists that Austen does not espouse the Romantic ideology.
espouse.zh: 例如，杰罗姆·麦肯坚持认为奥斯汀并不拥护浪漫主义意识形态。

espouse.en: But he must not espouse the old lady needlessly.
espouse.zh: 不过，他不能毫无必要地娶那个老女人。

espouse.en: Another goal was to actually use the technologies we espouse.
espouse.zh: 另一个设计目标是真正使用我们所倡导的技术。

unconventional.en: The vaccine had been produced by an unconventional technique.
unconventional.zh: 这种疫苗是用非常规的技术生产出来的。

unconventional.en: Despite his unconventional methods, he has inspired students more than anyone else.
unconventional.zh: 虽然用的是非常规的方法，他却比其他人更多地启发了学生。

unconventional.en: You're deliberately unconventional. Even your choice of clothes is a statement of your nonconformity.
unconventional.zh: 你故意有悖传统，甚至连着装都在表明你与众不同。

adherence.en: His rigid adherence to the rules made him unpopular.
adherence.zh: 他对规则的刻板坚持使得他不受欢迎。
确保对行业标准的遵循。

traction.en: He spent six weeks in traction after he broke his leg.
traction.zh: 他腿部骨折后做了六个星期的牵引治疗。

traction.en: Scientific and accurate analysis and calculation on the requirement for traction force is necessary when the impact compactor is working.
traction.zh: 冲击式压路机在工作时，对牵引力的要求进行科学准确的分析计算十分必要。

traction.en: Isabelle's legs were in traction for about two and a half weeks.
traction.zh: 伊莎贝尔的双腿作了大约两周半的牵引。

rodent.en: Researchers observed one bird impale a rodent on a cactus.
rodent.zh: 研究人员观察到，一只鸟把一个啮齿动物钉到了一棵仙人掌上。

rodent.en: When there is a full moon, this nocturnal rodent is careful to stay in its burrow.
rodent.zh: 在有满月出现的时候，这种夜间出没的啮齿类动物小心地呆在它的洞里。

rodent.en: Mickey Mouse starts as an ugly, little rodent.
rodent.zh: 米老鼠开始是又丑又小的噬齿动物。

lame.en: What do I want with a lame donkey?
lame.zh: 我要一只瘸腿的驴子干什么？

lame.en: So enough with the lame analogy for now.
lame.zh: 这个蹩脚的比喻到此为止吧。

iceberg.en: The above complaints are, I suspect, just the tip of the iceberg.
iceberg.zh: 上述的这些抱怨，我觉得，不过是冰山的一角。

iceberg.en: Unless we're all a lot more careful, the people who have died so far will be just the tip of the iceberg.
iceberg.zh: 除非我们大家都更加小心，否则迄今为止已经死去的人数将只是冰山一角。

iceberg.en: As for spinosaurus, diet was just the tip of the evolutionary iceberg.
iceberg.zh: 对于棘龙来说，饮食只是进化的冰山一角。

parrot.en: Generations of students have learned to parrot the standard explanations.
parrot.zh: 一届又一届的学生学会了鹦鹉学舌般地重复标准的解释。
你喜欢哪个颜色的鹦鹉？

faulty.en: The money will be used to repair faulty equipment.
faulty.zh: 这笔钱将被用来修理出故障的设备。

faulty.en: Ask for a refund if the goods are faulty.
faulty.zh: 商品如有缺陷，可要求退款。

paralysis.en: The strike caused total paralysis in the city.
paralysis.zh: 罢工使这座城市完全瘫痪。

paralysis.en: Poison from the fish causes paralysis, swelling, and nausea.
paralysis.zh: 这种鱼的毒素会引起瘫痪、肿胀、恶心。

paralysis.en: Its effects on the nervous system include weakness, paralysis, and tingling in the hands and feet.
paralysis.zh: 它对神经系统的影响包括虚弱、麻痹和手脚的略微刺痛感。

acquit.en: Will the court acquit him of the crime?
acquit.zh: 法庭会宣判他无罪释放吗？

acquit.en: I acquit Edward of all essential misconduct.
acquit.zh: 我原谅爱德华的所有根本过错。

acquit.en: The judge directed the jury to acquit all the defendants.
acquit.zh: 专业英语法官指示陪审团裁定所有被告无罪。

tempo.en: It's a difficult piece, with numerous changes of tempo.
tempo.zh: 这支曲子节奏变化多，难度很大。

tempo.en: In a new recording, the Boston Philharmonic tried the original tempo.
tempo.zh: 在一张新唱片中，波士顿爱乐乐团尝试了音乐原本的节奏。

tempo.en: He concluded that it was no higher salaries or better research facilities alone, but also the quicker tempo that lure them.
tempo.zh: 他得出的结论是，吸引他们的不仅仅是更高的工资或更好的研究设施，还有更快的节奏。

wilt.zh: 那么你会把我忘得一干二净吗？

wilt.en: Look at th' lad's legs, wilt tha'?

yeast.en: Yeast is essential for the fermentation that produces alcohol.
yeast.zh: 酵母对酿酒的发酵是必要的。

yeast.en: German beer has traditionally been made from just four ingredients – hops, malt, yeast, and water.
yeast.zh: 德国啤酒传统上一直是只由4种原料酿造而成的–啤酒花、麦芽、酵母和水。

yeast.en: To make yogurt, you need to choose your yeast first.
yeast.zh: 要做酸奶,首先你要选择酵母。

wane.en: Her popularity has been on the wane for some time.
wane.zh: 她的人气一段时间以来江河日下。

wane.en: While his interest in these sports began to wane, a passion for lacrosse developed.
wane.zh: 他对这些运动项目的兴趣开始减退的同时，对长曲棍球的兴趣却浓厚起来。

wane.en: Without demonstrable progress, the negotiators will begin to see their influence wane.
wane.zh: 没有可展示的进展，磋商者将会开始看到他们的影响力减弱。

savage.en: If you dare to have a sassy girlfriend ...You'll suddenly find that you've unexpectedly acquired a savage and wild mother.
savage.zh: 你要是敢有野蛮女友，你就会突然发现你有一个野蛮又狂野的母亲

savage.en: She had been badly hurt in what police described as 'a savage attack'.
savage.zh: 她遭受袭击而身受重伤—警方称这是一次“野蛮的袭击”。

savage.en: The book contrasts modern civilization with the ideal of the noble savage who lived in harmony with nature.
savage.zh: 这本书将现代文明同与自然界和谐相处的高尚野蛮人的理想进行了对比。

forceful.en: He was forceful, but by no means a zealot.
forceful.zh: 他很有说服力，但绝不是个狂热分子。

forceful.en: He was a man of forceful character, with considerable insight and diplomatic skills.
forceful.zh: 他是个性格坚强的人，有着非凡的洞察力和交际手腕。

forceful.en: You may need to be armed with some forceful arguments to persuade a partner into seeing things your way.
forceful.zh: 你也许需要备一些有说服力的论据来说服一个合伙人以你的方式看问题。

emblem.en: The dove is an emblem of peace.
The eagle was an emblem of strength and courage.
emblem.zh: 鹰是力量和勇气的象征。

emblem.en: It seems to me that Pygmalion's frenzy is a good emblem.
emblem.zh: 在我看来，皮格马利翁的狂热是一个很好的象征。

tack.en: I usually tack on DS after the database name.
tack.zh: 我通常在数据库名称后附加 DS。

tack.en: Products are increasingly being morphed into tack-on feature sets of bigger products.
tack.zh: 产品越来越多地转变为更大产品的附加功能集。

tack.en: In a market where there appears to be a surplus, the common mistake is to tack on too many unnecessary requirements.
tack.zh: 在一个似乎存在过剩的市场，附加太多不必要的要求是常见的错误。

willow.en: The baskets are woven from strips of willow.
willow.zh: 这些篮子是用柳条编的。

willow.en: The strips of willow are woven into baskets.
Jenny weaves baskets from willow she grows herself.
willow.zh: 珍妮用自己栽种的柳树的枝条编织篮子。

bland.en: It sounds like a commercial: easy on the ear but bland and forgettable.
bland.zh: 它听起来像句广告语：顺耳却平淡易忘。

bland.en: To make the bland taste more interesting, the locals began perking it up with local produce.
bland.zh: 为了使平淡的口味更有味道，当地人开始加些土特产来调味。

bland.en: This is not to say that he is bland.
bland.zh: 这并不是说他是平淡乏味的。

thriving.zh: 该公司的创新尝试蓬勃兴旺。

thriving.en: Business has been thriving in the past year. Long may it continue to do so.
thriving.zh: 在过去的一年里生意蒸蒸日上。但愿这种情况能持续下去。

thriving.en: The place has rapidly developed from a small fishing community into a thriving tourist resort.
thriving.zh: 这地方由原来的小渔村迅速发展成一个繁荣的旅游胜地。

hegemony.zh: 未来的全球霸权在面临关键时刻。

hegemony.en: It is a thumbing of the nose at hegemony.

palpable.en: The tension in the room was almost palpable.
palpable.zh: 屋子里的紧张气氛几乎能感觉到。

palpable.en: The tension between Amy and Jim is palpable.
palpable.zh: 埃米和吉姆之间的紧张关系是显而易见的。

palpable.en: The sense of pride in Greenland is palpable.
palpable.zh: 格陵兰岛的荣誉感是显而易见的。

aboriginal.en: They will campaign for respect for aboriginal rights and customs.
aboriginal.zh: 他们将开展尊重土著居民权利和风俗的活动。
乌鲁鲁是土著文化的中心。

aboriginal.en: Motifs of seeming simplicity can encode complex meanings in Aboriginal Australia.
aboriginal.zh: 在澳洲土著中，看似简单的图案可能包含着复杂的含义。

stationary.en: In short, the shinbashira was acting like an enormous stationary pendulum.
stationary.zh: 简而言之，这个中心支柱就像一个巨大而静止的钟摆。

stationary.en: The car should remain stationary when you take your foot off the brake pedal.
stationary.zh: 当你的脚离开刹车踏板时，汽车应该保持静止。

stationary.en: The boxes were stationary, and the one containing food was always at the same point of the compass.
stationary.zh: 箱子是固定着的，装食物的箱子总是在罗盘的同一个点上。

continual.en: She finds the continual confrontation very wearing.
continual.zh: 她发现持续的对峙使人精疲力竭。

continual.en: Due to the continual rain, the school's sports meet has been postponed again till further notice from the principal's office.
continual.zh: 由于连续下雨，学校的运动会再次推迟，要等校长办公室另行通知时间。

continual.en: The school has been in continual use since 1883.
continual.zh: 该校自1883年以来一直在不断使用中。

virgin.en: Within 40 years there will be no virgin forest left.
virgin.zh: 过不了40年原始森林将所剩无几。

virgin.en: That means that the FAA could suspend Virgin Galactic's license to fly.
virgin.zh: 这意味着联邦航空局可以暂停维珍银河的飞行许可。

virgin.en: That means that the FAA could suspend Virgin Galactic's licence to fly.
virgin.zh: 这意味着联邦航空局可以吊销维珍银河公司的飞行执照。

rectangle.zh: 这是一个较小的圆角矩形。

rectangle.en: I want the rectangle books on the shelf.
rectangle.zh: 我想要书架上的那本长方形的书。

angular.en: He had an angular face with prominent cheekbones.
angular.zh: 他有一张颧骨突出、棱角分明的脸。

angular.en: Why should I join the straying mass who want to make everything angular?
angular.zh: 为什么我要加入那些想要把一切都变得棱角分明的走失群体?

angular.en: For example, no matter how much a dancer wishes to leap off the floor and then start turning, the law of conservation of angular momentum absolutely prevents such a movement.
angular.zh: 例如，无论一个舞者多么想要跳离地板，然后开始旋转，角动量守恒定律绝对阻止这样的动作。

periphery.en: The condition makes it difficult for patients to see objects at the periphery of their vision.
periphery.zh: 这种病症使患者难于看见视觉边缘的物体。

periphery.en: To divide the empire into English core and colonial periphery, as Bailyn does, devalues the achievements of colonial culture.
periphery.zh: 把帝国划分为英国核心和殖民地外围，就像拜伦所做的那样，会贬低殖民文化的成就。

periphery.en: Taste buds are concentrated at the tip and rear of the tongue and around its periphery.
periphery.zh: 味蕾集中在舌尖、舌根及舌边。

revert.en: Otherwise, they revert to graphite or burn.
revert.zh: 否则，它们会变成石墨或燃烧。

revert.en: Thanks to slowing population growth, land currently ploughed up for crops might be able to revert to forest or wilderness.
revert.zh: 由于人口增长放缓，目前用于种植作物的耕地可能会恢复成森林或荒野。

revert.en: We also revert to old practices when we're under stress.
revert.zh: 当我们处于压力之下时，也很容易回归到旧的习惯上去。

patronage.zh: 光顾这家餐馆的人很多。

patronage.en: Promising as it is for minority businesses, this increased patronage poses dangers for them, too.
patronage.zh: 虽然这对少数民族企业是有希望的，但增加的赞助也给他们带来了危险。

patronage.en: Now he is suing the casino, charging that it should have refused his patronage because it knew he was addicted.
patronage.zh: 现在他正在起诉这家赌场，指控它本应该拒绝他的光顾，因为它知道他上瘾了。

engaging.en: His engaging personality made him popular with his peers.
engaging.zh: 他迷人的个性使他很受同龄人欢迎。

engaging.en: I was touched to find that he regards me as engaging.
engaging.zh: 让我感动的是，他认为我很有魅力。

poisonous.zh: 燃烧的硫磺会产生有毒烟雾。

poisonous.en: Poisonous chemicals got into the water supply.
poisonous.zh: 有毒的化学药品进入了供水系统。

comparatively.en: The life of the troops was still comparatively austere.
comparatively.zh: 部队生活相对而言仍然简朴。

comparatively.en: The past few days have seemed comparatively flat and empty.
comparatively.zh: 过去的几天似乎比较平淡和无聊。

comparatively.en: The unit is comparatively easy to install and cheap to operate.
comparatively.zh: 这种设备比较容易安装而且用起来便宜。

statesman.en: Hamilton is a great statesman and political thinker.
statesman.zh: 汉密尔顿是个伟大的政治家和政治思想家。

statesman.en: Success in the talks will reinforce his reputation as an international statesman.
statesman.zh: 谈判成功将会增强他作为国际政治家的声望。

statesman.en: There's Benjamin Franklin, the very model of the self-educated, self-made man, who rose from modest origins to become a well-known scientist, philosopher, and statesman.
statesman.zh: 本杰明·富兰克林是自学成才、自力更生的典范；他出身寒微，后来成为著名的科学家、哲学家和政治家。

villa.en: We rented a holiday villa in Spain.
villa.zh: 我们在西班牙租了一座假日别墅。

villa.en: My dream is to retire to a villa in France.
villa.zh: 我的梦想是退休后在法国住上一栋别墅。

invaluable.en: In his job, patience is an invaluable asset.
invaluable.zh: 他干的这份工作，耐心是无价之宝。

invaluable.en: I was able to gain invaluable experience over that year.
invaluable.zh: 在那一年里我获得了十分宝贵的经验。
