zest.en: He had a great zest for life.
zest.zh: 他对生命有着极大的热情。

zest.en: He has a zest for life and a quick intellect.
zest.zh: 他有生活的热情和机敏的头脑。

zest.en: The slight risk added zest to the experience.
zest.zh: 冒了一点儿险使得这次经历更加有趣。

ulcer.en: The ulcer had been troubling her for several years.
ulcer.zh: 溃疡已经折磨她好几年了。

ulcer.en: A 49-year-old lady had presented with an fungal corneal ulcer by a descemetocele and microperforation.
ulcer.zh: 一位49岁的患者患有真菌性角膜溃疡并发后弹力层膨出和微小穿孔。

translucent.en: The building is roofed entirely with translucent corrugated plastic.
translucent.zh: 这座建筑全部都是用半透明的波纹状塑料封顶。

translucent.en: THE mannequins were made of hollow translucent fiberglass.
translucent.zh: 这些人体模型是由中空半透明的玻璃纤维制成的。

shampoo.en: This shampoo smells fruity and leaves the hair beautifully silky.
shampoo.zh: 这种洗发香波闻上去有水果味，使头发美丽柔顺。

shampoo.en: The shampoo lathers and foams so much it's very hard to rinse it all out.
shampoo.zh: 这种洗发水起泡太多，很难冲干净。

shampoo.en: Always using the same shampoo means that a residue can build up on the hair.
shampoo.zh: 总是用同一种洗发水意味着残留物会在头发上越积越多。

triumphant.zh: 船长的声音听起来得意洋洋的。

triumphant.en: When he returned to the canopy tree his cheeks were flushed and he looked triumphant.
triumphant.zh: 当他回到那棵有着树荫的树时，他的脸颊泛着红晕，有着凯旋的表情。

triumphant.en: There was a triumphant glitter in his eyes.
triumphant.zh: 他眼睛里闪烁着胜利的光辉。

fitting.en: He wore an ill-fitting green corduroy suit.
fitting.zh: 他穿了一件很不合身的绿色灯芯绒西装。

fitting.en: Tight fitting T-shirts are making a comeback.
fitting.zh: 紧身短袖圆领T恤衫再度流行起来。

fitting.en: He could never be accused of fitting the mould.
fitting.zh: 他永远都不可能被指责属于这个类型。

halve.en: Dr. Lee believes that men who exercise can halve their risk of colon cancer.
halve.zh: 李医生认为，男人坚持锻炼，可以使他们患结肠癌的风险减半。

halve.en: Some goods, like English newspapers, keep the same price for years, but Chinese flowering cabbage can double and then halve in price in months.
halve.zh: 一些产品，比如英文报纸，多年来都保持着同一个价格，但是菜心的价格在几个月内可能翻一番，接着又减半。

halve.en: This number can halve later in life.
halve.zh: 这个数字在生命后期会减半。

precarious.zh: 我们的财政状况已经不稳定了。
那梯子看来摇摇晃晃的。

precarious.en: He earned a precarious living as an artist.
precarious.zh: 作为一个艺术家，他过的是朝不保夕的生活。

mosaic.en: Major works of painting, sculpture, mosaic and architecture were examined in situ in Venice.
mosaic.zh: 主要的绘画、雕塑、镶嵌画和建筑都在威尼斯原地得到了检查。

mosaic.en: With Mosaic, Andreessen and his friends had developed a program which could send images over the web as well.
mosaic.zh: 有了马赛克程序后，安德森和他的朋友们开发了一个程序，这个程序也可以通过万维网发送图像。

mosaic.en: With Mosaic, Andreessen and his friends had developed a program, which could send images over the web as well.
mosaic.zh: 有了 Mosaic，Andreessen 和他的朋友开发了一个程序，这个程序也可以通过网络发送图像。

rosy.en: Ultrafine powder with a rosy tinge gives the skin warmth and luminosity.
rosy.zh: 带玫瑰色的超细扑粉让皮肤显得温暖而有光泽。
黎明总是有着“红润的手指”。

clam.en: It is uncannily similar in taste and looks to New England clam chowder served in bread bowls.
clam.zh: 它的口味和外观与新英格兰的蛤杂烩惊人地相似，都放在面包碗中。

clam.en: Many other processes may alter the shell of a clam or snail and enhance its chances for preservation.
clam.zh: 许多其他的过程可能改变蛤蜊或蜗牛的外壳，增加其保存的可能性。

clam.en: Many other processes may after the shell of a clam or snail and enhance its chances for preservation.
clam.zh: 很多其它的过程可能会改变蛤蜊或者蜗牛的壳，增加它被保存下来的几率。

grassy.en: The buildings are hidden behind grassy banks.
grassy.zh: 那些建筑掩蔽在长满草的河岸后面。

grassy.en: Sheep's Meadow is a very big, open grassy field.
grassy.zh: 绵羊草坪是一个很大的、开放式的草地。

grassy.en: They sat and had their lunch on a grassy hillside.
grassy.zh: 他们坐在长满草的山坡上吃他们的午饭。

breathtaking.zh: 他说话时的傲慢态度令人咋舌。

breathtaking.en: The scene was one of breathtaking beauty.
breathtaking.zh: 美妙的景色令人叹为观止。

breathtaking.en: The house has breathtaking views from every room.
breathtaking.zh: 这房子从各个房间都能看到令人惊叹的风景。

avalanche.en: The survivors of the avalanche included 12 Britons.
avalanche.zh: 雪崩的幸存者中有12名英国人。

avalanche.en: More than a dozen people were dug out of the avalanche alive.
avalanche.zh: 十多个埋在雪崩下的人活着被挖了出来。

avalanche.en: The avalanche forced its way down the mountain, crushing everything in its path.
avalanche.zh: 雪崩冲下山来，摧毁了沿途的一切。

numerical.en: Numerical increases are used as quantifiable indicators of heightened interest in the new stimulus.
numerical.zh: 数值的增长被用来作为显示新型激励下增长利益的量化指标。

numerical.en: DNS refers to the Domain Name System, which is a directory that connects names to numerical Internet addresses.
numerical.zh: DNS 指的是域名系统，它是一个目录，将名称连接到数字互联网地址。

numerical.en: DNS refers to the Domain Name System, which is a directory that connects names to numerical Internet addresses.
numerical.zh: DNS 指的是域名系统，它是一个目录，将名称连接到数字互联网地址。

robotic.en: Which choice would we want our robotic counterparts to make?
robotic.zh: 我们希望机器人做出怎样的选择呢？

robotic.en: NASA is developing a series of robotic probes that will get the most bang from a buck.
robotic.zh: 美国国家航空航天局正在开发一系列的机器人探测器，且将会获得巨大的收益。

robotic.en: Astronaut Pierre Thuot tried to latch the 15-foot robotic arm onto the satellite.
robotic.zh: 宇航员皮埃尔·索特想要把这个长15英尺的机械手安到人造卫星上。

sluggish.en: He felt very heavy and sluggish after the meal.
sluggish.zh: 饭后他感觉身子很沉，不想动。

sluggish.en: Circulation is much more sluggish in the feet than in the hands.
sluggish.zh: 血液循环在脚部要比在手部慢得多。

sluggish.en: Don't be so sluggish. Put yourself together.
sluggish.zh: 不要这样懒散，振作起来。

grope.en: At midday you will grope about like a blind man in the dark.
grope.zh: 你必在午间摸索，好像瞎子在暗中摸索一样。

grope.en: I coast into the gas station, kill the engine, grope for my wallet.
grope.zh: 我让车子轻轻溜进了加油站，关发动机，掏钱包。

grope.en: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
grope.zh: 他们白昼遇见黑暗，午间摸索如在夜间。

coupon.zh: 他用一张买二送一优惠券结账。

coupon.en: You can get a surprise with a coupon in the following stores.
coupon.zh: 你可以在以下的商店中用优惠券获得一个惊喜。

coupon.en: They want more than the occasional coupon or reward, badge or crown.
coupon.zh: 他们要的不只是那些偶尔的赠券或者奖励、徽章或者皇冠。

venerable.en: May Day has become a venerable institution.
venerable.zh: 国际劳动节已经成为一个神圣庄严的既定节日。

venerable.en: Her Chinese friends referred to the empress as their venerable ancestor.
venerable.zh: 她的中国朋友们称那位皇后是令他们尊敬的祖先。

venerable.en: Will you please not suspect my venerable ancestors?
venerable.zh: 请你不要怀疑我那些可敬的老祖宗们，好吗？

microbe.en: Genes involved in microbe siderophore production and uptake are derepressed.
microbe.zh: 微生物铁载体产生和吸收的基因被抑制了。

microbe.en: We have a microbe doing something different than life as we know it.
microbe.zh: 我们培养了一种和我们所知的生命完全不同的微生物。

microbe.en: One day, when he was using a microscope to watch the microbe, a messenger visited him.
microbe.zh: 一天，他正在用一台显微镜观察微生物的时候，一个送信者来拜访他。

footnote.en: I'm afraid that his name will now become a footnote in history.
footnote.zh: 我认为，他的名字在历史中恐怕将变得不再重要。

footnote.en: A footnote is made at the bottom of the page.

footnote.zh: 【脚注：芝麻是一种很小的谷物。】

repetitive.en: These tasks were repetitive, lengthy and lacking any intrinsic interest.
repetitive.zh: 这些作业重复冗长，没有什么意义。

repetitive.en: This technique is particularly successful where problems occur as the result of repetitive movements.
repetitive.zh: 这项技术的成功之处在于能解决重复运动引起的问题。

repetitive.en: There are no longer any boring or repetitive tasks.
repetitive.zh: 不会再有任何无聊或重复的任务。

sanitation.en: Sanitation did not become widespread until the 19th century.
sanitation.zh: 直到19世纪，卫生设施才开始普及。

sanitation.en: The location is exceptionally poor, viewed from the sanitation point.
sanitation.zh: 从卫生角度来看，这个地段非常糟糕。

sanitation.en: More than 80% of those cases can be attributed to contact with contaminated water and a lack of proper sanitation.
sanitation.zh: 其中80%以上的病例可归因于接触了受污染的水和缺乏适当的卫生设施。

stern.en: He cast a stern glance at the two men.
stern.zh: 他严厉地瞪了那两名男子一眼。

stern.en: Our captain gave us a stern lecture on safety.
stern.zh: 我们的船长在安全问题上给了我们严厉的批评。

pathology.en: It involved research in genetics, plant breeding, plant pathology, entomology, agronomy, soil science, and cereal technology.
pathology.zh: 它涉及遗传学、植物育种、植物病理学、昆虫学、农学、土壤科学和谷物技术的研究。

pathology.en: This view has caused great controversy: Black Americans have fallen into a "tangle of pathology".
pathology.zh: 这个观点引发了极大的争议：美国黑人已经深陷一种“病态的混乱”。

pathology.en: Introversion is now a second-class personality trait, somewhere between a disappointment and a pathology.
pathology.zh: 内向如今是第二等人格特征，介于失望和病态之间。

incompatible.zh: 那两种血型是不相容的。

incompatible.en: This made its mini-computers incompatible with its mainframes.
incompatible.zh: 这使得它的微型电脑与其主机不兼容。

vain.en: I think he is shallow, vain and untrustworthy.
vain.zh: 我认为他浅薄、虚荣、不可信。

suppression.en: A mother's suppression of her own feelings can cause problems.
suppression.zh: 一位母亲对她自己情感的压抑可能会导致问题。

suppression.en: Eye problems can indicate an unhealthy lifestyle with subsequent suppression of the immune system.
suppression.zh: 眼睛问题表明一种不健康的生活方式以及随后免疫系统所受的抑制。

suppression.en: This genetically determined resting stage, characterized by the cessation of development and protein synthesis and suppression of the metabolic rate, is called diapause.
suppression.zh: 这种由遗传决定的休眠期被称为滞育，其特征是发育和蛋白质合成的停止以及代谢率的抑制。

orthodoxy.en: These ideas rapidly became the new orthodoxy in linguistics.
orthodoxy.zh: 这些观点很快就成了语言学中新的正统观念。

orthodoxy.en: But Old Princeton didn't repristinate every out-dated notion of 17th century Reformed orthodoxy.
orthodoxy.zh: 但是老普林斯顿并没有谴责所有过时的17世纪改革宗正统观念。

orthodoxy.en: The orthodoxy on inflation is certainly shifting.
orthodoxy.zh: 对于通胀的普遍看法也当然正在发生转变。

neutron.en: If the conditions are right, they will combine, fuse and form darmstadtium plus neutron.
neutron.zh: 如果条件合适，它们将结合、聚变，形成鐽中子。

neutron.en: Heavy water is heavy because the hydrogen in it weighs twice as much as ordinary hydrogen (it has a proton and a neutron in its nucleus, instead of just a proton).
neutron.zh: 重水之所以重是因为水中氢的重量是普通氢的两倍（它的原子核中有一个质子和一个中子，而不仅仅是一个质子）。

neutron.en: This work prepared the way for the discovery of the neutron by Sir James Chadwick and, above all, for the discovery in 1934 by Irène and Frédéric Joliot-Curie of artificial radioactivity.
neutron.zh: 这项工作为詹姆斯·查德威克爵士发现中子铺平了道路，尤其是为伊莲娜和弗雷德里克·约里奥特·居里在1934年发现人工放射性奠定了基础。

fir.zh: 松鼠爬上了枞树的树枝。

fir.en: All the trees lost their leaves except Fir Tree.
fir.zh: 除了枞树，所有树的叶子都掉了。

excavate.en: You might object that professionals excavate to acquire knowledge, not money.
excavate.zh: 你可能会反对专业人士为了获取知识去挖掘，而不是金钱。

excavate.en: A contractor was hired to drain the reservoir and to excavate soil from one area for replacement with clay.
excavate.zh: 一个承包商被雇来排干蓄水池里的水，然后挖出其中一块地方的泥土，换上粘土。

excavate.en: 'They even excavate pools to ensure their brood doesn't dry out.'
excavate.zh: 它们甚至会挖掘池塘以确保自己的一窝卵不会干瘪。

intrude.en: That, too, explains the heavy Washington presence at this year's show, as these new technologies intrude upon heavily regulated areas.
intrude.zh: 这也解释了为什么在今年的展会上华盛顿有很多人参加，因为这些新技术侵入了受到严格监管的领域。

intrude.en: I'm sorry to intrude on you like this.
Do you feel anxious when unforeseen incidents intrude on your day?
intrude.zh: 当无可预料的事件侵扰到你的生活时，你会感到焦虑吗？

hearty.zh: 男士们吃了一顿丰盛的早餐。

hearty.en: He gave me a hearty slap on the back.
hearty.zh: 他热情地在我背上拍了一下。

hearty.en: He nodded his head in hearty agreement.
hearty.zh: 他十分赞同地点了点头。

metric.zh: 这些螺丝钉是用公制尺码制造的。

metric.en: Around 180,000 metric tons of food aid is required.
metric.zh: 大约需要十八万公吨的食品援助。

metric.en: Converting metric measurements to U.S. equivalents is easy.
metric.zh: 把公制度量衡换算成美制度量衡很容易。

cerebral.en: When he was little, a fever gave him cerebral palsy.
cerebral.zh: 当他还小的时候，一场发烧让他患上了脑瘫。

cerebral.en: The doctors speculate that he died of a cerebral haemorrhage caused by a blow on the head.
cerebral.zh: 医生们猜测他死于头部撞击引起的脑溢血。

retarded.en: Last but not least, educators recognise that all students are unique and have different interests and abilities which can be retarded if they have to study all subjects.
retarded.zh: 最后，教育工作者认识到所有的学生都是独特的，他们有不同的兴趣和能力，如果他们必须学习所有的科目，他们的兴趣和能力可能会受到阻碍。

retarded.en: The progression of the disease can be retarded by early surgery.
retarded.zh: 早期手术可以抑制病情的发展。

retarded.en: The high costs of converting to sound and the early limitations of sound technology were among the factors that suppressed innovations or retarded advancement in these other areas.
retarded.zh: 声音转化的高成本和早期声音技术的局限阻碍了这些发明在其所在其他领域的发展。

crocodile.en: A crocodile was lurking just below the surface.
crocodile.zh: 有条鳄鱼就潜伏在水面下。

crocodile.en: An operation is beginning to try to save a species of crocodile from extinction.
crocodile.zh: 一项行动正在展开来拯救一个鳄鱼种类使其免遭灭绝。

cider.en: I generally like beer, but I'll go for cider sometimes.
cider.zh: 我通常喜欢啤酒，但是我有时候喝苹果酒。

cider.en: In the west of England, the traditional drink is cider, rather than beer.
cider.zh: 在英格兰西部，传统的饮料是苹果酒，而不是啤酒。

cider.en: For months, we shared daily heart-to-hearts and awkward kisses that tasted cider and spearmint.
cider.zh: 几个月来，我们每天心心相印，笨拙地亲吻，品尝苹果酒和留兰香薄荷的味道。

modernism.en: He was forcing the state to enthrone a particular brand of modernism.
modernism.zh: 他力推政府要尊崇那一套特定走向的现代化。

modernism.en: These by no means add up to modernism.
modernism.zh: 这些并不是现代主义的附加意义。

modernism.en: And modernism is all about verticality, from a certain Angle.
modernism.zh: 现代主义是从固定角度来看是直立的。

symmetry.en: Classical dance in its purest form requires symmetry and balance.
symmetry.zh: 真正的古典舞蹈要求对称与平衡。

symmetry.en: Symmetry is very important in this discussion.
symmetry.zh: 对称性这个讨论中非常重要。

innate.en: Americans have an innate sense of fairness.
innate.zh: 美国人有一种天生的公平感。
知识是后天获得的，不是先天就有的。

innate.en: Correct ideas are not innate in the mind.
innate.zh: 人的正确思想不是自己头脑中固有的。

zeal.zh: 他的改革热情是无穷尽的。

zeal.en: She had a kind of missionary zeal about bringing culture to the masses.
zeal.zh: 她对把文化带给大众具有一种传教士般的热情。

zeal.en: They plunged into their work with immense zeal.
zeal.zh: 他们以极大的热情投入工作。

decipher.en: The Coast Guard needs to decipher garbled messages in a few minutes.
decipher.zh: 海岸警卫队需要在几分钟内破译含混不清的讯息。

decipher.en: No math, no more squinting at the fine print and trying to decipher those words with no vowels.
decipher.zh: 没有数学，没有斜视的小字，并试图破译那些没有元音的单词。

exemplary.en: Underpinning this success has been an exemplary record of innovation.
exemplary.zh: 支持这一成功的基础是一次堪称典范的革新记录。

exemplary.en: From the earliest days of the Renaissance, the writing of history meant recounting the exemplary lives of great men.
exemplary.zh: 从文艺复兴初期开始，历史写作就意味着要重述伟人的模范生活。

shattered.en: The shattered vase lay in fragments on the floor.
shattered.zh: 打碎的花瓶在地上成了一堆碎片。

shattered.en: The explosion shattered all the windows in the building.
shattered.zh: 大楼所有的玻璃都在爆炸中震碎了。

shattered.en: Her experience of divorce shattered her illusions about love.
shattered.zh: 她的离婚经历使她对爱情的幻想破灭了。

acoustic.en: Do you remember when everyone went unplugged and acoustic?
acoustic.zh: 你还记得那时乐队都不使用电声而是用原声演奏吗？

acoustic.en: She chose to be backed by a classy trio of acoustic guitar, bass and congas.
acoustic.zh: 她选择了用原声吉他、低音吉他和康茄鼓组成的经典三重奏组合为自己伴奏。

acoustic.en: In our case, we have found the true acoustic echo beacon.
acoustic.zh: 在我们的例子中，我们找到了真正的声学回声信标。

deplete.en: Surely it is an economic nonsense to deplete the world of natural resources.
deplete.zh: 耗尽世界的自然资源无疑是一件经济上的愚蠢行为。
为什么飞行会耗尽我们的精力？

deplete.en: Unlike meat from those filthy places, it will not pollute rivers and streams, deplete groundwater or cause deforestation.
deplete.zh: 不像来自那些污秽场所的肉，它不会污染河流和小溪，不会大量消耗地下水，也不会引起滥伐森林。

perverse.en: It would be perverse to stop this healthy trend.
perverse.zh: 阻止这一健康的趋势是有悖常理的。

perverse.en: Do you really mean that or are you just being deliberately perverse ?
perverse.zh: 你是真要那样，还是故意作对？

perverse.en: Set against the compulsory mobility and clogged roads of "the great car economy", the Allegro age now has a certain perverse appeal.
perverse.zh: 与“伟大的汽车经济”中强制的流动性和拥堵的道路相比，阿莱格罗时代如今有了某种反常的吸引力。

proficiency.en: Evidence of basic proficiency in English is part of the admissions requirement.
proficiency.zh: 基本英语水平的证明是录取条件的一部分。

proficiency.en: Specifically, Conrad believes that many of the brain's capabilities stem from the pattern-recognition proficiency of the individual molecules that make up each brain cell.
proficiency.zh: 具体来说，康拉德认为大脑的许多能力源于组成每个脑细胞的单个分子的模式识别能力。

proficiency.en: We focus both on generic linguistic proficiency and specialist vocabulary.
proficiency.zh: 我们既关注一般的语言能力，也关注专业词汇。

gait.en: His gangling, awkward gait has earned him the name Spiderman.
gait.zh: 他因其笨拙且奇怪的步态而得名“蜘蛛侠”。

gait.en: There was no elation in his gait, which kept pace with the action of his sombre mind.
gait.zh: 他的步态并不得意，因为他的步态和他忧郁的心情是同步的。

gait.en: As for high-heels, they hoist the derriere and make the gait more feminine and physically attractive.
gait.zh: 至于高跟鞋，它们提升了臀部，使步态更女性化，从而体态迷人。

analogous.en: Leibniz developed closely analogous concepts and techniques.
analogous.zh: 莱布尼茨发展了类似的概念和技术。

analogous.en: The solar system also has two analogous classes of objects, smaller than planets—namely, asteroids and comets.
analogous.zh: 太阳系也有两类类似的物体，比行星还小——即小行星和彗星。

analogous.en: For example, a gap just below aluminum suggested a new element would be found with properties analogous to those of aluminum.
analogous.zh: 例如，就在铝下面有一个空位，这表明还有一个性质和铝类似的新元素存在。

obsessive.en: Her ideas seem common sense but nevertheless require you to be at least slightly obsessive.
obsessive.zh: 她的想法似乎是常识，但你至少要有点着迷。

gleam.en: I saw the gleam of the knife as it flashed through the air.
gleam.zh: 我看见了刀在空中划过时的闪光。

gleam.en: Their hope did not last long; the gleam was quickly eclipsed.
gleam.zh: 他们的希望没有延长多久，微光很快就消逝了。

accreditation.en: The university's law school failed to win full accreditation from the American Bar Association.
accreditation.zh: 这所大学的法学院没能获得美国律师协会的完整认可。

accreditation.en: The American Telemedicine Association and other organizations have started accreditation programs to identify top-quality telemedicine sites.
accreditation.zh: 美国远程医疗协会等组织已经发起认证程序用以识别最优质的远程医疗网站。

accreditation.en: Check to see if accreditation is in its future.
accreditation.zh: 检查确认一下该校将来是否会被官方认可。

resurrection.en: The name Anastasia is derived from a Greek word meaning "of the resurrection."
resurrection.zh: 阿纳斯塔西娅这个名字是从一个意为“复活”的希腊词语衍生而来的。

resurrection.en: Joe's spirits had gone down almost beyond resurrection.
resurrection.zh: 乔的情绪低落到了几乎无法恢复的地步。

resurrection.en: This is a resurrection of an old story from the mid-70s.
resurrection.zh: 这是70年代中期的一个老故事的再现。

brittle.en: They don't deform easily; they tend to be more brittle.
brittle.zh: 它们不容易变形；它们是更脆的。

brittle.en: They were quite brittle and shattered very easily if they were dropped.
brittle.zh: 它们很脆，如果掉在地上很容易碎。

brittle.en: You've already known that ice is brittle, and if you hit it with a hammer, it will shatter like glass.
brittle.zh: 大家都知道冰是易碎的，如果你拿锤子敲击它，它会如玻璃一样碎裂。

adept.en: As a composer he proved himself adept at large dramatic forms.
adept.zh: 作为一名作曲家，他显示出自己擅长创作大型的戏剧体裁。

adept.en: He's usually very adept at keeping his private life out of the media.
adept.zh: 他通常十分擅长于使他的私生活远离媒体。

adept.en: She is an adept rock-climber and a past master of the obstacle course.
adept.zh: 她擅长攀岩，也是障碍超越训练场上的老手。

outdated.zh: 这些数字现在已经过时。

outdated.en: We need to cast aside outdated policies.
outdated.zh: 我们要废除不合时宜的政策。

outdated.en: The car has been criticized for its outdated body styling.
outdated.zh: 这种轿车因其过时的车身式样而受到批评。

handicapped.en: I'm going to work two days a week teaching handicapped kids to fish.
handicapped.zh: 我将每周工作两天教残疾儿童钓鱼。

handicapped.en: The handicapped also include deaf-mutes and some brain paralysis amentia.
handicapped.zh: 残疾人还包括聋哑人及部分脑瘫智障患者。

handicapped.en: The committee will work toward the establishment of a school for the handicapped.
handicapped.zh: 该委员会将为建立一所残疾学校而努力。

coastline.en: The coastline is being eaten away year by year.
coastline.zh: 海岸线年复一年地被侵蚀着。

coastline.en: The road follows the natural contours of the coastline.
coastline.zh: 这条路沿着海岸线的自然轮廓延伸。

coastline.en: This is some of the most exposed coastline in the world.
coastline.zh: 这是世界上最无遮蔽的海岸线。

thrift.en: You cannot bring about prosperity by discouraging thrift.
thrift.zh: 不提倡勤俭节约就不会有繁盛。

thrift.en: Oppose extravagant eating and drinking and pay attention to thrift and economy.
thrift.zh: 反对大吃大喝，注意节约。

necessitate.en: The thriving obsidian operation, for example, would necessitate more miners, additional manufacturers of obsidian tools, and additional traders to carry the goods to new markets.
necessitate.zh: 例如，蓬勃发展的黑曜石业务将需要更多的矿工、更多的黑曜石工具制造商和更多的贸易商将货物运往新市场。

necessitate.en: Does it necessitate a more convoluted build process?
necessitate.zh: 是否需要更加复杂的构建过程？

necessitate.en: We have said the the real cause has to necessitate its effect.
necessitate.zh: 我们说过真正的成因必须是结果的必要影响。

subtract.en: The pupil could add and subtract but hadn't learned to divide.
subtract.zh: 这名小学生能做加法和减法，但还没学会做除法。

subtract.en: They subtract this loan balance from the sale price and you get cash to buy another house.
subtract.zh: 他们从售房价格里减去这个贷款余额，然后你就可以得到现金去买另一个房子。

subtract.en: You've got to juggle the two equations, multiply that by 4, multiply that by 3, add and subtract and so on.
subtract.zh: 你必须联立这两个方程，一个乘以4，另一个乘以3，再加减等等。

precipitate.en: I don't think we should make precipitate decisions.
precipitate.zh: 我认为我们不应该做出仓促的决定。

precipitate.en: A decrease in face-to-face social contact can precipitate depression.
precipitate.zh: 面对面社交接触的减少会导致抑郁。

precipitate.en: Four compounds, namely 10 nonacosane, 24 methylenecycloartanol, stigmasterol and dacosterol have been isolated from the precipitate of the plant's methanol extract.
precipitate.zh: 从月腺大戟根甲醇提取液的沉淀部分，鉴定了4种化合物，分别为二十九烷醇10、24亚甲基环阿尔廷醇、豆甾醇和达考甾醇。

likeness.en: These myths have a startling likeness to one another.
likeness.zh: 这些神话彼此有惊人的相似之处。

likeness.en: That year, Lincoln's likeness made its debut on the penny, thanks to approval from the U.S.
likeness.zh: 那一年，由于得到了美国的批准，林肯的肖像首次出现在便士上。

nourish.en: As Tony says, "Depression strips you of any desire to nourish yourself, in any form."
nourish.zh: 正如托尼所说，“抑郁会以任何形式剥夺任何滋养你的欲望。”

nourish.en: Warm porridge could help increase one's personal heat and nourish the body in cold weather.
nourish.zh: 在寒冷的天气里，温热的粥可以暖和身子，滋养身体。

nourish.en: By investing in education, we nourish the talents of our children.
nourish.zh: 我们通过教育投资，培养孩子们的才能。

scold.en: If he finds out, he'll scold me.
scold.zh: 如果他发现了，他会责骂我。

reflex.en: The researchers found that people given propranolol had a much lower emotional response—measured by a startle reflex—to the images.
reflex.zh: 研究者发现，服用了心得安的人们对这些图片的情绪反应——通过惊吓反射测量——低了很多。

reflex.en: Finally, the coughing reflex in reaction to irritants in the airway produces not a cough during sleep but a cessation of breathing.
reflex.zh: 最后，对呼吸道刺激物的咳嗽反射不会导致人们在睡眠期咳嗽，而会造成呼吸暂停。

reflex.en: Walt fumbled in his pocket, a reflex from his smoking days.
reflex.zh: 沃尔特在口袋里摸索，一个他以前抽烟时形成的习惯性动作。

barrage.en: He was faced with a barrage of angry questions from the floor.
barrage.zh: 他面临着听众一连串的愤怒质问。
而现在我们得到只有一连串的批评。

barrage.en: The Marina Barrage is another case in point.
barrage.zh: 滨海湾水坝是另一个例子。

inspiring.en: She was a very strong, impressive character and one of the most inspiring people I've ever met.
inspiring.zh: 她性格坚强，令人钦佩，是我见过的最能鼓舞人心的人物之一。

inspiring.en: His speech was inspiring and touched my heart.
inspiring.zh: 他的发言鼓舞人心，动人肺腑。

insulate.en: Huxley speculated that a coat of hair would insulate against loss of body heat and might streamline the body to reduce drag in flight.
insulate.zh: 赫胥黎推测，一层毛发可以隔离身体热量的流失，并可能使身体呈现流线型，以减少飞行中的阻力。

insulate.en: People should insulate their homes to conserve energy.
insulate.zh: 人们应该使住房隔冷以保存能量。

insulate.en: Is there any way we can insulate our home from the noise?
insulate.zh: 有什么办法能使我们家隔音吗？

dissatisfied.en: Miller professed himself dissatisfied with Broadway theatre.
dissatisfied.zh: 米勒表示他对百老汇剧院不满。

dissatisfied.en: If you are dissatisfied with our service, please write to the manager.
dissatisfied.zh: 对我们的服务如有不满，请函告经理。

dissatisfied.en: Eighty-two percent of voters are dissatisfied with the way their country is being governed.
dissatisfied.zh: 82%的投票者对他们国家的管理方式不满意。

consolation.en: Her appointment was seen as a consolation prize after she lost the election.
consolation.zh: 她的任命被认为是对她落选的安慰。

consolation.en: The only consolation for the baseball team is that they look likely to get another chance.
consolation.zh: 对这支棒球队的惟一安慰是他们看来可能会得到另一次机会。

consolation.en: If it's any consolation, she didn't get the job, either.
consolation.zh: 不知道这算不算得上安慰，她也没有得到那份工作。

bailout.zh: 但是大规模的拯救行动还没有到来。
那么摆脱困境的计划是什么呢？

bailout.en: Who decides when to trigger a bailout?
bailout.zh: 谁来决定什么时候援助？

transmitter.en: Rather than plugging a cable into a shoe, the Wisconsin researchers suggest installing a wireless transmitter in the heel.
transmitter.zh: 威斯康星州的研究人员用安装在脚后跟的无线发射机取代了需要塞进鞋子里的数据线。

transmitter.en: Emphasis was placed on the school as a transmitter of moral values.
transmitter.zh: 人们强调学校为道德价值观的传输者。

transmitter.en: Sensors record each movement and send it by an ankle transmitter to a smart phone.
transmitter.zh: 传感器记录下每个动作，然后通过脚踝传感器发送到智能手机上。

hacker.zh: 没有什么能百分之百地防止黑客入侵。

hacker.en: Instead, Hacker is pushing for more courses like the one he teaches at Queens College: Numeracy 101.
hacker.zh: 相反，Hacker 正在推动更多类似于他在皇后学院教授的课程：计算能力101。

hacker.en: Andrew Hacker, for the record, remains skeptical.
hacker.zh: 准确来说，安德鲁·哈克仍然对此表示怀疑。

ion.en: It is a naked electron and is a sodium positive ion.
ion.zh: 它是个裸电子，是钠正离子。

ion.en: Quartz is quartz—a silicon ion surrounded by four oxygen ions—there's no difference at all between two-million-year-old Pleistocene quartz and Cambrian quartz created over 500 million years ago.
ion.zh: 石英是石英——由四个氧离子围绕的硅离子——200万年前的更新世石英和5亿年前的寒武纪石英之间没有任何区别。

ion.en: We talked about this reaction here, where we had chloride ion in the gas phase plus sodium ion in the gas phase.
ion.zh: 我们在讨论这一个反应，气态的氯原子加上气态的钠原子。

curricular.en: She's involved in many extra-curricular activities.
curricular.zh: 她参加了许多课外活动。

curricular.en: Participating in extra-curricular activities enables us to learn to negotiate and cooperate with fellow students.
curricular.zh: 参加课外活动可以让我们学习如何与同学进行协商与合作。

curricular.en: On the one hand, participating in extra-curricular activities allows children to develop their hobbies while on the other hand, too many such activities can increase children's burden.
curricular.zh: 一方面，参加课外活动可以让学生发展自己的兴趣，而另一方面，太多的课外活动可能会增加学生的负担。

anthology.en: It's a longish poem, not in your anthology, but you can find it in The Complete Yeats.
anthology.zh: 这是一首很长的诗，你们的选集里没有，但在《叶芝诗选》里可以找到。

anthology.en: You have just one of them in your anthology, but it is one of the greatest. It is on page 130.
anthology.zh: 你们选集里只有一首，但是它是最好的之一。它在130页。

anthology.en: Having said that, there's really nothing so dead as The Norton Anthology of English Literature, or ponderous.
anthology.zh: 说了这么多，其实没有什么比《诺顿英国文学选集》更死板，或者更沉闷的了。

vacancy.en: How did the woman get to know about the job vacancy?
vacancy.zh: 那个女人是怎么知道职位空缺的？

vacancy.en: His resignation left a vacancy on the board of directors.
vacancy.zh: 他的辞职给董事会留下了一个空缺。

audition.en: Apparently he made a mess of his audition.
audition.zh: 显然他把试演搞得一团糟。

audition.en: She wrote to Paramount Studios and asked if they would audition her.
audition.zh: 她写了信给派拉蒙电影公司，问他们是否能让她试镜。

audition.en: Applicants must pass a written test, an audition and an interview and only the most promising students are accepted to study at these colleges and schools.
audition.zh: 应试者必须通过笔试、试镜和面试，只有最有前途的学生才能进入这些院校学习。

receptionist.zh: 那名接待员马上认出了他。

receptionist.en: The receptionist led the way to the boardroom.
receptionist.zh: 接待员领路来到董事会会议室。

receptionist.en: The receptionist is the first point of contact most people have with the clinic.
receptionist.zh: 多数人与诊所接触的第一个人是接待员。

addictive.en: Crack is a highly potent and addictive derivative of cocaine.
addictive.zh: 强效纯可卡因是一种药效极强、容易使人上瘾的可卡因制剂。

addictive.en: It is commonly addictive and creates risks for younger users.
addictive.zh: 它通常会让人上瘾，给年轻用户带来风险。

addictive.en: That worries the department because of the addictive nature of nicotine.
addictive.zh: 那让卫生部感到不安，因为尼古丁是一种能让人上瘾的物质。

notoriously.en: Mountain weather is notoriously difficult to predict.
notoriously.zh: 山地气候难以预料是人所共知的。
火车不准点是出了名的。
这里的天气出了名的变化无常。

prehistoric.en: We seem to have killed off all our prehistoric competitors.
prehistoric.zh: 我们似乎把史前的竞争对手都杀光了。

prehistoric.en: Beside this, prehistoric man looks technologically primitive.
prehistoric.zh: 除此之外，史前人类使用的技术看起来比较简陋。

prehistoric.en: Good morning, ready to continue our review of prehistoric art?
prehistoric.zh: 早上好，准备好继续我们对史前艺术的回顾之旅了吗？

projector.en: Our host ran a long extension cord out from the house and set up a screen and a projector.
projector.zh: 我们的主人从那所房子里牵出了一条长的延长导线，安置了一块屏幕和一个投影仪。

projector.en: A projector shines a map of the vein network directly on the skin.
projector.zh: 投影仪将静脉网络的分布图直接投射到皮肤上。

projector.en: A desktop computer, screen, projector, and loudspeakers will be available.
projector.zh: 将提供台式计算机、屏幕、投影仪和扬声器。

eloquent.en: I heard him make a very eloquent speech at that dinner.
eloquent.zh: 我听他在那次晚餐上做了一次很有说服力的演说。

nicotine.en: A nicotine spray can help smokers quit the habit.
nicotine.zh: 一种尼古丁喷剂可以帮助吸烟者戒烟。

nicotine.en: Nicotine produces a feeling of well-being in the smoker.
nicotine.zh: 尼古丁能让吸烟者产生一种愉悦的感觉。

nicotine.en: Nicotine adversely affects the functioning of the heart and arteries.
nicotine.zh: 尼古丁对心脏和动脉功能有负面影响。

seedling.en: Keep the soil moist. That way, the seedling will flourish.
seedling.zh: 保持土壤湿润,那样小苗就会茁壮成长。

seedling.en: It would be unable to grow from a seedling.
Otherwise, it would be unable to grow from a seedling.
seedling.zh: 否则，它的幼苗将无法生长。

quaint.zh: 应该恢复这一独特的风俗。

quaint.en: It is a quaint and marvellous thought!
quaint.zh: 这是一个古怪而又奇妙的想法！

quaint.en: Lord, how marvellous a thing it is, the grip his memory doth take upon his quaint and crazy fancies!
quaint.zh: 主啊，这是多么奇妙的一件事啊！他的记忆抓住了他那古怪而疯狂的幻想！

herring.en: Thousands of herring and crab are washed up on the beaches during every storm.
herring.zh: 成千上万的鲱鱼和螃蟹每逢暴风雨都会被冲上岸。

herring.en: A kipper is a whole herring fish that has been split from tail to head, salted, and smoked.
herring.zh: 腌鱼是整条鲱鱼去头去尾后以盐腌制而后烟熏而成。

herring.en: Dried cod and herring were already the staples of the European fish trade, but changes in water temperatures forced fishing fleets to work further offshore.
herring.zh: 鳕鱼干和鲱鱼干已经是欧洲鱼类贸易的主要产品，但水温的变化迫使渔船在离岸更远的地方作业。

federation.en: In the future we envision a federation of companies.
federation.zh: 我们设想将来会有公司联盟。

federation.en: By 492 votes to 391, the federation voted to maintain the status quo.
federation.zh: 联盟以492票对391票投票决定维持现状。

federation.en: The shake-up aims to recast IBM as a federation of flexible and competing subsidiaries.
federation.zh: 此次改组旨在将IBM重组为一个灵活且相互竞争的子公司联盟。

anecdotal.en: Advocates of the practice have taken issue with his team's use of anecdotal evidence like news accounts to support his conclusion that goal setting is widely over-prescribed.
anecdotal.zh: 支持这种做法的人对他团队使用如新闻报道等轶事证据来支持他的结论提出了异议，他的结论是目标设定被过分夸大。

anecdotal.en: Anecdotal evidence suggests that sales in the Southwest have slipped.
anecdotal.zh: 传闻的证据表明西南部的销售量有所下滑。

anecdotal.en: Nevertheless, anecdotal reports of wind pollination in cycads cannot be ignored.
anecdotal.zh: 然而，一些关于苏铁风媒传粉的传闻也不容忽视。

adjective.en: In French the adjective must agree with the noun in number and gender.
adjective.zh: 法语中形容词必须在数和性上与名词一致。

adjective.en: The adjective "inexpensive" used in the name is not without a reason.
adjective.zh: “低廉”这个形容词用在名字中也不是没有理由的。

adjective.en: But you can use it as an adjective to give emphasis to the word that follows it.
adjective.zh: 但是你可以用它作为形容词来强调后面的单词。

oasis.en: Oasis release their new album on July 1.
oasis.zh: 绿洲乐队将于7月1日发行他们的新专辑。

oasis.en: It hovered before his eyes like the mirage of an oasis.
oasis.zh: 它在他眼前晃动，好像海市蜃楼里的绿洲。

oasis.en: The immaculately tended gardens are an oasis in the midst of Cairo's urban sprawl.
oasis.zh: 那些打理得非常整洁的花园是杂乱扩张的开罗市区中的一片绿洲。

brilliance.en: She loved his brilliance and his generous heart.
brilliance.zh: 她爱他的才华横溢和心地宽厚。

brilliance.en: It demonstrated the brilliance of China's ancient culture.
brilliance.zh: 它显示了中国古代文化的光辉。

brilliance.zh: 他作为评论家的非凡才华实际上只是阅读他的经历的一部分。

aquarium.en: The aquarium has some interesting specimens of unusual tropical fish.
aquarium.zh: 水族馆里有一些很有趣的罕见的热带鱼。

aquarium.zh: 过去给水族馆的水过滤和充氧的尝试都已失败了。

misfortune.en: He has known great misfortune in his life.
misfortune.zh: 他一生中经历过巨大的不幸。

misfortune.en: We had the misfortune to run into a violent storm.
misfortune.zh: 我们不幸遭遇了猛烈的暴风雨。

hostess.zh: 女主人正急急忙忙地向他走来。
“鲁比，这是什么？”我的女主人问。

telling.zh: 她没有把实情都讲出来。

telling.en: I kept telling myself to keep calm.
telling.zh: 我不断叮嘱自己要保持冷静。
说不准他们会有什么反应。

obese.en: A BMI greater than 30 is considered obese.
obese.zh: 体重指数超过30则被认为是肥胖。

obese.en: Obese people tend to have higher blood pressure than lean people.
obese.zh: 肥胖的人往往比瘦人血压高。

obese.zh: 尤其对于女性而言，超重或者肥胖在职场中是一个很明显的劣势。

lecturer.zh: 她是一个出色的演讲者。

lecturer.en: He's a lecturer in French at Oxford.
lecturer.zh: 他是牛津大学的法语讲师。

lecturer.en: Dewey was an unimpressive, rather dull lecturer.
lecturer.zh: 杜威是个没特色的，有些无聊的讲师。

monolog.en: This is not meant to be a journal entry or a monolog.
monolog.zh: 这并不是意味着一条日志信息或者独白。

monolog.en: Telling the true story of the world in interior monolog.
monolog.zh: 以内心独白叙说今世的真实故事。

monolog.en: Aibileen: (Monolog) I work for the Leefolts from eight to four; six days a week. I make 95cent an hour.
monolog.zh: 艾比琳：(独白)我现在为莉芙特家工作，每天八点到四点，一周六天，我每小时挣95美分。

feud.en: Every family cultivates its vendetta; every clan, its feud.
feud.zh: 每个家庭都有自己的仇怨；每个氏族都有自己的世仇。

feud.en: The feud between Porsche and Volkswagen, and between the Piech and Porsche families that own most of them, had dragged on for two years.
feud.zh: 保时捷和大众之间、皮耶希和拥有多数大众的保时捷家族之间的恩怨，已经持续了两年。

convertible.en: In order to keep the currency convertible, they had to keep interest rates high to prevent people from demanding to exchange the gold.
convertible.zh: 为了保持货币的转换性，他们不得不将利率提高，以防人们向他们索求金子的兑换。

convertible.en: Switzerland has already chosen one version of this approach by forcing its two big banks to issue new contingent convertible (CoCo) bonds.
convertible.zh: 瑞士已经采取了类似的做法，规定其两家大银行发行新的或有可转换（CoCo）债券。

convertible.en: Her own car is a convertible VW.
convertible.zh: 她的车是一辆大众敞篷汽车。

embryonic.en: Different from the embryonic stem cell we talked about before, it's an example of an adult stem cell.
embryonic.zh: 和我们之前谈到的胚胎干细胞有所不同，这是一个成人干细胞的例子。

embryonic.en: Why people are so excited about embryonic stem cells is because in nature they become all the cells of the body.
embryonic.zh: 胚胎干细胞如此让人激动是因为它的天然功能就是分化成身体所有的细胞。

embryonic.en: Other epigenetic processes appear to occur randomly, while others are normal, such as those that guide embryonic cells as they become heart, brain, or liver cells, for example.
embryonic.zh: 其他的表观遗传过程似乎是随机发生的，而其他过程则是正常的，比如那些引导胚胎细胞成为心脏、大脑或肝细胞的过程。

audible.zh: 之后有一声很轻的饱嗝。

resurgence.en: The revival of the language, particularly among young people, is part of a resurgence of national identity sweeping through this small, proud nation.
resurgence.zh: 语言的复兴，尤其是在年轻人当中的复兴，是席卷这个自豪的小国的民族认同感复苏的一部分。

resurgence.en: Police say drugs traffickers are behind the resurgence of violence.
resurgence.zh: 警方说毒贩是暴力事件增加的原因。
麦凯恩先生的东山再起令人惊叹。

fledgling.en: I've known him ever since he was a fledgling.
fledgling.zh: 我从他羽翼未丰时就认识他了。

fledgling.en: One positive outcome that could arise from bumping into a friendly ETI is that it takes our fledgling race under its wing (tentacle).
fledgling.zh: 若是遇到友善的外星智慧生物，其积极后果之一就是会将我们这个幼稚的文明置于其卵翼（或触手）之下。

fledgling.en: His conquest of Silesia gave Prussia's fledgling industries access to raw materials.
fledgling.zh: 他征服了西里西亚，使普鲁士的新兴产业获得原材料。

fabricate.en: It angers me that people would fabricate a story like that.

fabricate.en: Their advancements have been about how to design and fabricate that intricate structure cheaply.
fabricate.zh: 它们的进展主要是关于如何低成本地设计和制备这些精细结构的。

fuse.en: Changing a fuse is one of those fiddly jobs I hate.
fuse.zh: 换保险丝是我不愿干的麻烦事之一。

fuse.en: I paid $80 to have my car radio fixed and I bet all they did was change a fuse.
fuse.zh: 我付了$80修车里的收音机，我敢断定他们只是换了根保险丝。
检查一下保险丝是否烧断了。

sow.en: The piglets are taken from the sow to be fattened for market.
sow.zh: 这些小猪被从母猪身边带走，好育肥上市。

sow.zh: 帮助我们知道如何播种我们的眼泪。

modernize.en: Romania badly needs aid to modernize its outmoded industries.
modernize.zh: 罗马尼亚迫切需要援助以对其过时的产业进行现代化。

modernize.zh: 他们抵制我们将书籍发行现代化的努力。

modernize.zh: 遗憾的是我们缺乏现代化所需的财力。

wrench.zh: 对我来说离开家是件十分痛苦的事。

wrench.zh: 可调扳手，用于关闭煤气和自来水。

wrench.zh: 我跑了好几家商店，才找到这扳手。

stoop.en: I didn't think he'd stoop to cheating.
stoop.zh: 我觉得他总不至于说谎吧。

stoop.en: They will stoop to every lowdown trick.
stoop.zh: 他们什么卑劣的手段都使得出来。

stoop.en: He tends to stoop because he's so tall.
stoop.zh: 他个子太高了，所以时常弓着背。

collateral.en: Many people use personal assets as collateral for small business loans.
collateral.zh: 许多人用个人资产作抵押，办理小额商业贷款。

collateral.en: Pawnship was a common form of collateral in West Africa.
collateral.zh: 典当在西非是一种常见的抵押品形式。

collateral.en: Why could it be a better option than collateral warranties?
collateral.zh: 为什么它比抵押担保更好呢？

ecstatic.en: Sally was ecstatic about her new job.
ecstatic.zh: 萨莉对她的新工作高兴得发狂。

ecstatic.en: They gave an ecstatic reception to the speech.
ecstatic.zh: 他们给该演讲以热烈的欢迎。

ecstatic.zh: 他的妻子生下了他们的第一个孩子，他对此欣喜若狂。

waive.zh: 他决定放弃高贵身份，和这头小牛做朋友。

disintegrate.zh: 1918年10月期间奥匈帝国开始瓦解。

disintegrate.zh: 更糟糕的是，可生物降解塑料的设计正日益普遍。

disintegrate.zh: 我们生来就注定要分解死亡，即使在理想的条件下也是如此。

thaw.zh: 天气转暖，冰雪开始融化了。

thaw.zh: 我们在初春解冻期的泥泞里艰难跋涉。

obliterate.en: A direct hit would obliterate Earth, it's said.
obliterate.zh: 直接撞击肯定会毁灭地球。

infiltrate.zh: 老师设法把她的思想渗透到孩子们的心中。

brandy.zh: 我给了他一些白兰地以减轻疼痛。

brandy.en: All sherry is made from wine fortified with brandy.
brandy.zh: 所有雪利酒都是由用白兰地强化了的葡萄酒制成的。

brandy.zh: 我不喝威士忌和白兰地，也不喝其他烈性酒。

notwithstanding.zh: 尽管天气恶劣，活动还是取得了巨大的成功。

notwithstanding.zh: 他瞧不起威廉·皮特，尽管他们俩所持有的观点相似。

entrust.en: Cheer the good stuff and entrust the rest to God.
entrust.zh: 为丈夫优秀的方面喝彩，并把其它的一切交给神。

exploratory.zh: 扫描仪将减少所需的探查手术，从而为病患者免除风险和疼痛。

biomass.en: The biomass of Keteleeria has been investigated and analyzed.

beacon.zh: 她是个指引女性们穿越她们生活最黑暗时光的希望的灯塔。

beacon.zh: 在我们的例子中，我们找到了真正的声学回声信标。

thunderstorm.en: "And I," said the mother, "I feel so uneasy, as if a heavy thunderstorm were coming."
thunderstorm.zh: “而我，”母亲说，“我感到很不安，好像一场大雷雨就要来了。”

thunderstorm.en: She climbed into the jungle gym for the drizzle had quickly changed into a large thunderstorm.
thunderstorm.zh: 她爬进了格子爬梯，因为绵绵细雨很快地变成了倾盆雷雨。

skyscraper.zh: 那幢摩天大楼高耸入云。

skyscraper.en: The majesty of the skyscraper awed me.
skyscraper.zh: 这幢摩天大厦的雄伟气势令我惊叹。

skyscraper.en: The NEC's skyscraper and its gadgetry are controlled in the basement.
skyscraper.zh: 日本国家电气公司的摩天大楼和它的配件都在地下室进行控制。

bumper.en: One of my grocery bags was still precariously perched on the car bumper.
bumper.zh: 我的一只购物袋还很不牢靠地悬挂在汽车保险杠上。

bumper.en: When I pulled out of the space, I nicked the rear bumper of the car in front of me.
bumper.zh: 我把车从车位开出来时，蹭到了我前面那辆车的后保险杠。

bumper.en: There is hope of a bumper harvest.

expend.en: If you give up exercise, your muscles shrink and fat increases. By the same token, if you expend more energy you will lose fat.
expend.zh: 如果你放弃锻炼，肌肉就会萎缩，脂肪会增多。同样地，如果你消耗较多的体能，你就会减掉脂肪。

expend.en: Growth, reproduction, and daily metabolism all require an organism to expend energy.
expend.zh: 生长、繁殖和日常的新陈代谢都需要有机体来消耗能量。

expend.en: Extreme athletes expend lots of energy breaking down and repairing and building muscles.
expend.zh: 极限运动员消耗大量能量来分解、修复和塑造肌肉。

resilient.en: He'll get over it—young people are amazingly resilient.
resilient.zh: 他会克服这些的—年轻人的适应力惊人。

resilient.en: Resilient people who think positively tend to treat every problem as a challenge, a chance for improvement of any kind, or as an opportunity for personal growth.
resilient.zh: 有韧性的人怀着乐观思维，往往把每一个问题都当作挑战，当作任何一种改进的机会，或者当作个人成长的机会。

resilient.en: What is remaining resilient is the traditional authentic experience.
resilient.zh: 保持活力的是传统的真实体验。

refinement.en: Phase III, from March 1991 to March 1993, focused on the refinement and institutionalization of these activities.
refinement.zh: 从1991年3月到1993年3月，第三阶段的重点是对这些活动做精细的改进并且使其制度化。

refinement.en: This particular model has a further refinement.
refinement.zh: 这一款式又有了进一步的改进。

refinement.en: The new plan is a refinement of the one before.
refinement.zh: 新计划比原计划有改进。

erratic.en: The electricity supply here is quite erratic.
erratic.zh: 这里的电力供应相当不稳定。

erratic.en: Businessmen are displeased with erratic economic policy making.
erratic.zh: 商人们对经济政策的飘忽不定感到气愤。

erratic.en: Heart rate tracking for three of the Alaska bears showed a drop from 55 beats per minute on average before hibernation to 14 erratic ones per minute in winter.
erratic.zh: 对三头阿拉斯加的黑熊的心率追踪显示出它们在冬眠前的平均每分钟 55 下降低到了冬天里每分钟飘忽不定的 14 下。

hilarious.zh: 林恩觉得这一切都非常滑稽。
你认识皮特吗？他风趣得很。

hilarious.en: The show was hilarious—I couldn't stop laughing.
hilarious.zh: 表演十分滑稽，弄得我笑个不停。

reciprocal.en: They expected a reciprocal gesture before more hostages could be freed.
reciprocal.zh: 他们期望在更多的人质被释放之前有互惠的表示。

reciprocal.en: The two colleges have a reciprocal arrangement whereby students from one college can attend classes at the other.
reciprocal.zh: 两所学院有一项互惠协定，允许学生在院际间选课。

reciprocal.en: The result indicates that there are reciprocal connections between the parabrachial nucleus and caudal portion of the dorsal vagal complex.
reciprocal.zh: 结果说明臂旁核和迷走神经背核簇尾侧部之间有交互联系。

dispel.en: The police moved quickly to dispel the rumours.
dispel.zh: 警察迅速采取行动来消除谣言。

dispel.en: The president is attempting to dispel the notion that he has neglected the economy.
dispel.zh: 总统正试图消除他忽视了经济这一想法。

dispel.en: They might well be overoptimistic, however since corporate executives have sometimes bought shares in their own company in a calculated attempt to dispel negative rumors about the company's health.
dispel.zh: 不过，他们可能过于乐观了，因为公司高管有时会购买自己公司的股票，目的是为了消除有关公司健康状况的负面传闻。

taunt.en: He became a taunt to his neighbours.
taunt.zh: 他成了邻居们嘲讽的对象。

taunt.en: They do not taunt you to finish what you started.
taunt.zh: 它们并不会在一旁嘲笑你，迫使你看完已经开始的书。

taunt.en: Don't chant things like "loser" or taunt them when they lose.
taunt.zh: 不要反复喊着“失败者”或者奚落他们。

pointer.en: A series of levers joined to a pointer shows pressure on a dial.
pointer.zh: 一系列控制杆连着一枚指针，在刻度盘上显示出压力数。

pointer.en: During tests over several days, the pointer or tracker tracked an IR source and directed a laser beam at that source.
pointer.zh: 在几天的测试中，指示器或跟踪器跟踪一个红外光源，并引导激光束击中目标。

pointer.en: She tapped on the world map with her pointer.
pointer.zh: 她用教鞭轻点在那张世界地图上。

yawn.en: She makes no attempt to stifle a yawn.
yawn.zh: 她并未试图忍住一个哈欠。

revere.en: To worship someone or something is to venerate him, her, or it—not necessarily as you would revere a deity, but at least with extreme devotion or admiration.
revere.zh: 崇拜某人或某物，就是崇敬他、她或它——不一定要你像敬畏一个神那样去做，但起码要发自极度的虔诚或赞美。

revere.en: Revere him, all you descendants of Israel!
revere.zh: 以色列的后裔，都要惧怕他。

revere.en: Paul Revere, in fact, was a flatware craftsman.
revere.zh: 事实上，保罗·里维尔是一个餐具工匠。

envelop.en: His energy, warmth, and curiosity envelop you like a blanket.
envelop.zh: 他的精力、热诚和好奇心如毯子一般将你包围。

envelop.en: Such storms can sometimes envelop the entire planet and change the characteristics of the atmosphere, making EDL far trickier.
envelop.zh: 这样的风暴有时会包围整个地球，并改变大气层的特性，使得 EDL 更加棘手。

envelop.en: Further up, the weather changes—low clouds envelop the mountainsides, which are covered with thick grass.
envelop.zh: 再往上走，天气就变了——低云笼罩着被厚厚的草覆盖的山腰。

distrust.en: I don't have any particular reason to distrust them.
distrust.zh: 我没有任何特殊的理由不信任他们。

distrust.en: Exaggerated claims merely fuel public distrust and disengagement.
distrust.zh: 夸大其词只会加剧公众的不信任和疏离。

distrust.en: In London in the middle of the 17th century there was general distrust of fireworks among scientists.
distrust.zh: 在17世纪中叶的伦敦，科学家们普遍不信任烟花。

emigrate.en: The men emigrate to work as seamen.
emigrate.zh: 这些男人移居国外当海员。

emigrate.en: Everybody was flabbergasted when I announced I was going to emigrate to Australia.
emigrate.zh: 当我宣布要移民去澳大利亚时，所有人都惊呆了。

emigrate.en: Certain formalities have to be gone through before you can emigrate.
emigrate.zh: 必须办理一定的手续方能移居他国。

bribe.en: She had been offered a $50 000 bribe to drop the charges.
bribe.zh: 有人用5万元贿赂她，要她撤回控告。
他们贿赂便宜的仿制药对手。

bribe.en: If people can bribe police officers, it makes a nonsense of the legal system.
bribe.zh: 如果人们可以贿赂警察，那法律制度就失去了意义。

overstate.en: Such managers have an enormous stake in succeeding, so they invariably overstate the potential of their new technologies.
overstate.zh: 这些管理者与成功有着巨大的利害关系，因此他们总是夸大新技术的潜力。

overstate.en: He tends to overstate his case when talking politics.
overstate.zh: 他一谈政治便流于夸夸其谈。

whichever.zh: 挑选你喜欢的那个品牌。

whichever.en: It takes three hours, whichever route you take.
whichever.zh: 无论你走哪一条路都需要三个小时。

whichever.en: Whichever of you gets here first will get the prize.
whichever.zh: 你们谁第一个到达这里谁就获奖。

disapprove.en: One gets the impression that they disapprove.
disapprove.zh: 本人的印象是，他们不赞成。

disapprove.en: She wants to be an actress, but her parents disapprove.
disapprove.zh: 她想当演员，可是她父母不同意。

disapprove.en: "Do you disapprove, nanna?" Justine growled, ready to do battle.
disapprove.zh: “外婆，你不赞成吗？”贾斯丁咆哮着，准备要斗争。

simplistic.en: He has a simplistic view of the treatment of eczema.
simplistic.zh: 他对湿疹治疗所持观点过于简单化。

simplistic.en: Such simplistic advice is impossible to follow.
simplistic.zh: 这种过于简单的建议是不可能被采用的。

simplistic.en: But such simplistic advice is impossible to follow.
simplistic.zh: 但这种过于简单的建议是不可能被采用的。

proclamation.en: President Abraham Lincoln, during the Civil War, issued a proclamation setting aside the last Thursday in November for the holiday.
proclamation.zh: 内战期间，亚伯拉罕·林肯总统发布了一项公告，将11月的最后一个星期四定为节假日。

proclamation.en: The proclamation of independence was broadcast over the radio.
proclamation.zh: 独立声明在广播里播出了。

proclamation.en: On January 1, 1863, during the war, Lincoln issued his famous Emancipation Proclamation.
proclamation.zh: 1863年1月1日，战争期间，林肯发表了他著名的《解放奴隶宣言》。

climax.en: The music builds up to a rousing climax.
climax.zh: 音乐逐渐达到了令人振奋的高潮。

climax.en: It was the climax to 24 hours of growing anxiety.
climax.zh: 这是24小时不断升温的焦虑的顶点。

climax.en: The festival will climax on Sunday with a gala concert.
climax.zh: 星期天的音乐盛会将把这次会演推向高潮。

victimize.en: Who did it? - I knew you were gonna victimize me, man.
victimize.zh: 是谁干的？ -我知道你想牵怒于我，伙计。

victimize.en: During disasters, the Chinese people rise up as one and help one another not victimize each other.
victimize.zh: 灾害期间，我国人民站起来之一，并互相帮助，互相不受害。

victimize.en: Legal liabilities is a important part of law, its purpose to protect to victimize the legal rights of the person.
victimize.zh: 法律责任是法律的重要组成部分，其目的是保护受害人的合法权益。

ambivalent.en: The concept of genius and of gifts has become part of our folk culture, and attitudes are ambivalent towards them.
ambivalent.zh: 天才和天赋的概念已经成为我们民间文化的一部分，人们对它们的态度是矛盾的。

ambivalent.en: He has an ambivalent attitude towards her.
ambivalent.zh: 他对她怀着矛盾的心情。
她对她的婚姻保持暧昧的态度。

unearth.en: If these are the central characters of our story about poverty, what layers of perceptions, myths, and realities must we unearth to find meaningful solutions and support?
unearth.zh: 如果这些是我们有关贫困的故事里的中心人物，那我们必须从认知、神话以及现实之中挖掘哪些层面的东西来寻求有意义的答案和依据呢？

unearth.en: When you dig deeper you steal what you unearth.
unearth.zh: 当你更深地挖掘，你便是“窃取”你所发掘的了。

unearth.en: They will unearth the buried treasure here.
unearth.zh: 他们将在这儿挖掘地下宝藏。

humid.en: It's hot out – very hot, very humid.
humid.zh: 外面热烘烘的–非常热，非常潮湿。

humid.en: The island is hot and humid in the summer.
humid.zh: 这个岛在夏季又热又潮湿。
这些植物喜欢温暖潮湿的空气。

obstruct.en: They were accused of attempting to obstruct justice.
obstruct.zh: 他们被控企图妨碍司法公正。

obstruct.en: He has tried to obstruct intellectual freedom.
What varies is not the basic form but the incidental details that do not obstruct the object's primary function.
obstruct.zh: 变化的不是基本形式，而是不妨碍物体的主要功能的附属细节。

generalize.en: It would be foolish to generalize from a single example.
generalize.zh: 仅从一个事例进行归纳的做法是愚蠢的。

generalize.en: Critics love to generalize, to formulate trends into which all new work must be fitted, however contradictory.
generalize.zh: 评论家喜欢概括，归纳出所有新作品都必须符合的趋势，不管它们是如何地不符。

generalize.en: We shouldn't be too quick to generalize that to national characteristics and stereotypes.
generalize.zh: 我们不应该太快地将其概括为民族特征和刻板印象。

induction.en: Callus induction and redifferentiation of black chokeberry leaf in vitro were studied.
induction.zh: 研究了黑苦莓叶片愈伤组织的诱导和再分化。

induction.en: The relation between the completeness of several local convex topology and that of induction topology was pointed out in this paper.
induction.zh: 指出了几种局部凸拓扑的完整性与感应拓扑的完整性之间的关系。

induction.en: The claim is that induction is rational by definition.
induction.zh: 其论调认为归纳法是理性的定义。

bungalow.en: It's large compared to the other, smaller Spanish bungalow rooms.
bungalow.zh: 和西班牙小屋的其它房间相比，它面积很大。

bungalow.en: A bungalow is a small house with one or two bedrooms and usually one bathroom.
bungalow.zh: 平房是小房子，有一个或两个卧室，通常有一个浴室。

bungalow.en: They were men's footsteps, and the men entered the bungalow and talked in low voices.
bungalow.zh: 那是男人的脚步声，他们走进平房，低声交谈。

stash.en: Police discovered a large stash of drugs while searching the house.
stash.zh: 警方搜查这栋房子时发现里面藏有一大批毒品。

stash.en: Select the option to stash the password to a file.
stash.zh: 选择将密码隐藏在在文件中的选项。

stash.en: The –stash option creates a stash file with the password.
stash.zh: –stash 选项创建一个带有密码的隐藏文件。

shard.en: This time, suppose you define one replica shard.
shard.zh: 这一次，假设您定义一个复制碎片。

shard.en: All records in an atomic unit are stored in the same shard.
shard.zh: 原子单元中的所有记录都会存储在相同的分片上。

shard.en: Now we define the shard strategies to be used in the application.
shard.zh: 现在我们定义应用程序中要使用的分片策略。

suggestive.en: Emily turned and threw her a suggestive grin.
suggestive.zh: 埃米莉转过身，猛然地向她投了个暗示性的微笑。

suggestive.en: Most adverts are just too meagre in informative content and too rich in emotional suggestive detail to be read literally.
suggestive.zh: 大多数广告只是在信息内容上太贫乏，而在情感暗示细节上太丰富，无法逐字阅读。

suggestive.en: The natural images in the poem are meant to be suggestive of realities beyond themselves.
suggestive.zh: 诗中自然景象的描写意在使人联想起那以外的现实。

dialect.en: It was difficult to understand the local dialect.
It is often appropriate to use the local dialect to communicate your message.
dialect.zh: 用方言来交流信息往往很合适。

dialect.en: It is impossible to say at what point along the continuum a dialect becomes a separate language.
dialect.zh: 要说出同一语言的方言差异到什么程度就成为一种别的语言是不可能的。

arid.en: Many Namibians are subsistence farmers who live in the arid borderlands.
arid.zh: 许多纳米比亚人都是自给自足的农民，居住在干旱的边境地区。

arid.en: Twenty million years ago, Idaho was not the arid place it is now. Rather, it was warm and damp, populated by dense primordial forest.
arid.zh: 2000万年前，爱达荷州不像现在这样干旱。确切地说，它那时温暖潮湿，生长着茂密的原始森林。

arid.en: Regularly flowing rivers and streams that originate within arid lands are known as "endogenous".
arid.zh: 起源于干旱地区的流动性河流和溪流通常被称为“内源河流”。

biased.en: He seemed a bit biased against women in my opinion.
biased.zh: 我认为他好像对妇女有点偏见。

biased.en: University funding was tremendously biased toward scientists.
biased.zh: 大学资助金是极度偏重于科学家的。

biased.en: You can't help being biased so you may as well be up front about it.
biased.zh: 你阻止不了别人对你的偏见，因此你还不如就大大方方地接受。

kettle.zh: 这个电壶需要一根新电热丝。
壶里的水开了，冒着蒸汽。

kettle.en: Someone went upstairs and brought down a huge kettle.
kettle.zh: 有人上楼拿下来一个巨大的水壶。

recruiter.en: A real estate recruiter we worked with illustrates the positive difference such training can make.
recruiter.zh: 一位与我们共事的房地产招聘人员说明了这种培训可以带来的积极影响。

recruiter.en: From the cartoon given above, we can observe that there is a recruiter talking with an interviewee.
recruiter.zh: 从上面所给的漫画中，我们可以看到有一个招聘人员和一个面试者交谈。

recruiter.en: Was it just possible that the SIS had deliberately placed these men in the path of the Russian recruiter?
recruiter.zh: 有没有可能是 SIS 故意把这些人安排在俄罗斯征募者的路线上?

dwindle.zh: 基本上一切都开始褪色。

dwindle.en: As the rivers dwindle, the conflicts could spread.
dwindle.zh: 河流在减少，冲突却在扩大。

transient.en: The studies discussed so far exposed people to noise for only short periods and only transient effects were studied.
transient.zh: "到目前为止所讨论的研究中，人们只是短时间的暴露在噪音中，而且研究的只是短暂的影响。

transient.en: For example, studies show that even brief periods of odorant stimulation produce transient reductions in receptors in the olfactory epithelium, a process termed "receptor fatigue".
transient.zh: 例如，研究表明，即使是短暂的气味刺激也会导致嗅觉上皮细胞中受体短暂的减少，这个过程被称为“受体疲劳”。

transient.en: It is argued that the influence of transient investment on public companies can be adverse.
transient.zh: 有人认为，短期投资会对上市公司产生不利的影响。

rejoice.en: When the war ended, people finally had cause to rejoice.
rejoice.zh: 战争结束，人们终于可以欢欣鼓舞了。

rejoice.en: Should we rejoice in the death of another human being?
rejoice.zh: 我们该为另一个人类的死亡而高兴吗？

rejoice.en: In him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in his holy name.
rejoice.zh: 我们的心必靠他欢喜，因为我们倚靠他的圣名。

substitution.en: In my experience a straight substitution of carob for chocolate doesn't work.
substitution.zh: 以我的经验，角豆直接代替巧克力不会奏效。

inconvenience.zh: 航空公司对所造成的任何不便表示歉意。

inconvenience.en: I have already been put to considerable inconvenience.
inconvenience.zh: 我已经被添了相当的麻烦了。

inconvenience.en: We apologize for any inconvenience caused during the repairs.
inconvenience.zh: 我们对在修理过程中所造成的任何不便表示歉意。

legalize.en: He wants to legalize drugs, ban involuntary commitments to mental institutions, and replace state schools with online education.
legalize.zh: 他想要使毒品合法化，禁止非自愿向精神病院提供服务，并用在线教育取代公立学校。

legalize.en: I think your husband should legalize immigration. Please put a statue of me in Echo Park. Thank you. No, really. I want a tuxedo on the statue.
legalize.zh: 我认为你的丈夫应该使移民合法化。请在回声公园给我立个雕像。谢谢。不，说真的。我希望雕像是穿一身礼服的。
使私人空间探索合法化。

propulsion.en: The nineteenth century witnessed a revolution in ship design and propulsion.
propulsion.zh: 19世纪经历了船舶设计和推进上的一次重大变革。

propulsion.en: Propulsion is provided by a rocket engine, rather than a propeller and rudder, which makes steering difficult.
propulsion.zh: 推进器是由火箭发动机提供的，而不是螺旋桨和方向舵，这使得转向变得困难。

propulsion.en: Scientists and engineers are beginning to study this ability of fishes in the hope of designing more efficient propulsion systems for ships.
propulsion.zh: 科学家和工程师们开始研究鱼类的这种能力，希望能设计出更有效的船舶推进系统。

saucer.zh: 她的杯子把茶碟碰得叮当响。

saucer.en: I replaced the cup carefully in the saucer.
saucer.zh: 我小心翼翼地将杯子放回茶碟。

saucer.en: Rae's coffee cup clattered against the saucer as she picked it up.
saucer.zh: 蕾把咖啡杯拿起来的时候杯子碰响了茶碟。

evergreen.en: Plant evergreen shrubs around the end of the month.
evergreen.zh: 大约在月末种植常绿灌木。

evergreen.en: Many of these plants are evergreen, so you can enjoy them all year round.
evergreen.zh: 这些植物中有许多都是四季常青的，所以可以全年观赏。
