synthesize.zh: 由于缺乏认真的尝试来综合和评估鸟类和恐龙进化细节的现有数据，这种混乱变得更加严重。

synthesize.en: What I want is for you to synthesize information to reflect back on what we've read and discussed and to form your own ideas, not just repeat points from the textbook.
synthesize.zh: 我想让你们综合信息来反映我们读过和讨论过的内容，形成自己的观点，而不是仅仅重复课本上的观点。

synthesize.en: A third function of intuition is to synthesize isolated bits of data and practice into an integrated picture, often in an "Aha!" experience.
synthesize.zh: 直觉的第三个功能是将孤立的数据和实践整合成一个完整的画面，通常一次是“惊讶”的经历。

solidify.zh: 这种混合物凝固后就成了太妃糖。

solidify.en: The Energy Department plans to solidify the deadly waste in a high-tech billion-dollar factory.
solidify.zh: 能源部计划在一家斥资10亿美元的高科技工厂里凝固这些致命的废物。

solidify.en: Keeping this kind of character sketch can help you solidify your character's personality, so that it remains consistent throughout your story.
solidify.zh: 保持这种人物草图能帮你巩固你角色的性格，以在你整个故事中保持一致性。

ascribe.en: We ascribe great importance to these policies.
ascribe.zh: 我们认为这些政策十分重要。

ascribe.en: We do not ascribe a superior wisdom to government or the state.
ascribe.zh: 我们并不将胜人一筹的智慧归属于政府或国家。

ascribe.en: Even without gadgets that understand our spoken commands, research suggests that, as bizarre as it sounds, under certain circumstances, people regularly ascribe human traits to everyday objects.
ascribe.zh: 研究表明，即使没有能够理解我们口头指令的小工具，在某些情况下，人们也会经常认为日常物品具有人的特性，尽管这听起来很奇怪。

aspiring.en: He came from an aspiring working-class background.
aspiring.zh: 他出身于有抱负的工人阶级家庭。

aspiring.en: Like so many aspiring actresses, she ended up waiting tables and temping in office jobs.
aspiring.zh: 和众多曾经满怀抱负的女演员一样，她最终也只落得在餐厅端盘子、在办公室打临时工。

aspiring.en: Aspiring host cities are picking up the code.
aspiring.zh: 有抱负的主办城市正在效仿这一准则。

dampen.en: Nothing seems to dampen his perpetual enthusiasm.
dampen.zh: 似乎没有什么能减弱他持久的热情。

dampen.en: She wasn't going to let anything dampen her spirits today.
dampen.zh: 她不想让任何事情来影响她今天的兴致。

dampen.en: None of the setbacks could dampen his enthusiasm for the project.
dampen.zh: 任何挫折都不能减弱他对这个项目的热情。

rouse.en: He did more to rouse the crowd there than anybody else.
rouse.zh: 他比其他任何人都更卖力地鼓动那里的群众。

rouse.en: She seemed to be unable to rouse herself to do anything.
rouse.zh: 她似乎打不起精神做任何事情。

rouse.en: Richard couldn't rouse himself to say anything in reply.

smother.en: She tried to smother her anger and help them resolve their conflicts.
smother.zh: 她试图抑制住怒气，帮助他们解决纠纷。

smother.en: Too much snow, for example, can smother trees, and avalanches and snow creep can damage or destroy them.
smother.zh: 例如，太多的雪会使树木窒息，雪崩和积雪蔓延会损坏或摧毁树木。

smother.en: He tried to smother the flames with a blanket.
smother.zh: 他试图用毯子把火扑灭。

unauthorized.zh: 各国对于未授权的飞越领空反应强烈。

unauthorized.en: It has also been made quite clear that the trip was unauthorized.
unauthorized.zh: 这次旅行是未经过批准的，这一点也已经非常清楚了。

eject.en: Officials used guard dogs to eject the protesters.
eject.zh: 官员们用护卫犬驱走抗议者。

eject.en: You can now safely eject the CD.
eject.zh: 您现在可以安全地弹出CD。

eject.en: I said to myself, I can't eject yet.
eject.zh: 我只有告诉自己，不能，还不能弹射。

hideous.en: They drown out Orpheus' music with the hideous roar of their howlings and their screamings and they tear him limb from limb.
hideous.zh: 她们用可怕的咆哮和尖叫淹没了俄耳甫斯的音乐，把音乐撕成了碎片。
他们新的颜色搭配难看极了！

undesirable.en: While this sounds undesirable, it can be quite good, says Polman.
undesirable.zh: 波尔曼说道，虽然这听起来不可取，但可能相当不错。

undesirable.en: Instead of normalising the undesirable behaviour, the message needs to marginalise it.
undesirable.zh: 与其将不良行为正常化，还不如利用信息将其边缘化。

undesirable.en: It would be highly undesirable to increase class sizes further.
undesirable.zh: 再增加班级人数，是大家都极不愿意的。

infancy.en: Computing science was still in its infancy.
infancy.zh: 计算机科学仍然处于初期阶段。

infancy.en: The women were asked how many children they had given birth to and how many of them had died in Infancy.
infancy.zh: 这些妇女被问及她们生了多少孩子，其中有多少在婴儿期死亡。

infancy.en: Works of several historians reveal the moral compromises made by the nation's early leaders and the fragile nature of the country's infancy.
infancy.zh: 几位历史学家的著作揭示了这个国家早期领导人在道德上做出的妥协，以及这个国家初期的脆弱本质。

mute.zh: 他缄默无言，对人疏远而且冷漠。

mute.en: She thought it better to mute her criticism.
mute.zh: 她觉得还是婉转地提出批评比较好。

mute.en: The child sat mute in the corner of the room.
mute.zh: 这孩子坐在屋子的角落里，一声不吭。

craftsman.en: He was a craftsman in metalwork from Dresden.
craftsman.zh: 他是来自德累斯顿的金工工匠。

craftsman.en: The table in the kitchen was made by a local craftsman.
craftsman.zh: 厨房里的桌子是当地一名工匠做的。

craftsman.en: The cut of a diamond depends on the skill of its craftsman.
craftsman.zh: 切割钻石的好坏取决于工匠的技艺。

intersect.en: In particularly wet years, short stretches of an otherwise dry stream-bed may have flowing water because the water table rises to intersect the land surface.
intersect.zh: 在气候特别湿润的年月里，平常干涸的河床下游可能会有水流动，因为地下水在那里位抬升到了地表以上。

intersect.en: If the water table intersect the land surface, groundwater will flow out onto the surface at springs, whether to be collected there or to subsequently flow farther along a drainage.
intersect.zh: 如果地下水位与地表相交，地下水将在泉水处流出地表，聚集于此或是随后沿着排水系统进一步流动。

eyeball.en: Other ocular signs include involuntary rhythmic movement of the eyeball.
eyeball.zh: 其它眼睛特征包括眼球无意识而有节奏的运动。

eyeball.en: The protesters and police stood eyeball to eyeball.
eyeball.zh: 抗议者与警察剑拔弩张。

eyeball.en: There are close to one million nerve fibers that connect the eyeball to the brain, as of yet it is impossible to attach them all in a new person.
eyeball.zh: 有近100万个神经纤维连接眼球和大脑，但目前还不可能把它们全部附加至另一个人体上。

dormitory.zh: 她住在一幢大学宿舍楼里。

dormitory.en: They raced back to the dormitory before the nine o'clock curfew.
dormitory.zh: 他们在9点熄灯之前拼命跑回了宿舍。

dormitory.en: The students have barricaded themselves into their dormitory building.
dormitory.zh: 学生们将自己堵在宿舍楼里。

hassle.en: He copped all the hassle after the accident.
hassle.zh: 他在事故发生后各种的罪都受了。

hassle.en: Do as you're told and don't give me any hassle!
hassle.zh: 告诉你怎么做就怎么做，别跟我顶嘴！

hassle.en: I don't think it's worth the money or the hassle.
hassle.zh: 我认为不值得为此花钱或者费劲。

moderation.en: TV is not necessarily toxic, but is something that has to be done in moderation; something that balances the other needs of the child for healthy development.
moderation.zh: 看电视不一定是有害的，但必须适度，要平衡孩子的其他需求，让孩子健康成长。

moderation.en: The United Nations Secretary General called on all parties to show moderation.
moderation.zh: 联合国秘书长呼吁各方要克制。

moderation.en: A moderation in food prices helped to offset the first increase in energy prices.
moderation.zh: 食品价格的降低有助于抵消能源价格的第一次上涨。

stipulate.en: Some laws also stipulate in explicit terms that Chinese citizens have obligations to take care of parents and raise children.
stipulate.zh: 一些法律也明确规定中国公民有义务赡养父母、抚养子女。

stipulate.en: Companies should stipulate that they will never ask for passwords, be consistent, document decisions, consider the source used and be aware that other laws may apply.
stipulate.zh: 公司应该明确规定会做到以下几点：永远不要求（求职者）提供密码，前后保持一致，记录（招聘）决策，考虑所用信息来源，清楚可能适用的其它法律。

stipulate.en: PayPal policies stipulate that sellers must prove buyers received an item.
stipulate.zh: Paypal的政策规定，卖家需核实买家已收到商品。

stricken.en: Medical supplies are being dropped into the stricken area.
stricken.zh: 正在向灾区空投医药用品。

stricken.en: The Red Cross has sent four planeloads of relief supplies to the stricken areas.
stricken.zh: 该红十字会已向灾区发送了四架飞机的救济物资。

stricken.en: We went to the aid of the stricken boat.
stricken.zh: 我们前去救助那艘失事的船。

foreman.en: He had never let a foreman see him slacking.
foreman.zh: 他从未让工头见到他偷懒过。

foreman.en: I was working as a foreman on a building site.
foreman.zh: 我在一个建筑工地当工头。

foreman.en: He still visited the dairy daily, but left most of the business details to his manager and foreman.
foreman.zh: 他仍然每天去牛奶公司，但将多数生意上的细节留给了经理和工头。

corpus.en: The two halves are linked by a trunkline of between 200 and 300 million nerves, the corpus callosum.
corpus.zh: 两半部分由2到3亿条神经组成的主干连接，即胼胝体。

corpus.en: Research showed that these two halves of the brain had different functions, and that the corpus callosum enabled them to work together.
corpus.zh: 研究表明，大脑的这两个半球具有不同的功能，胼胝体使它们能够一起工作。

corpus.en: Scientists have found quite recently that the corpus callosum in women is always larger and probably richer in nerve fibres than it is in men.
corpus.zh: 科学家最近发现，女性的胼胝体总是比男性更大，神经纤维可能也更丰富。

overdue.en: We stand to lose 10 percent of our price for each week of overdue delivery.
overdue.zh: 每逾期一周，我们就要损失10%的价格。
她的胎儿已超过预产期两周了。
这些改革早就该进行了。

memorandum.en: Perhaps even more so than with letters, memorandum should start with the statement of the purpose early in the message.
memorandum.zh: 也许备忘录比书信更重要的是，备忘录应该从信息的目的开始。

memorandum.en: When the internal message is lighthearted and relatively unimportant, humor in a memorandum can distinguish its author as a person with personality and depth.
memorandum.zh: 当内部信息是轻松的、相对不重要的时候，备忘录中的幽默可以展现作者的个性和深度。

memorandum.en: The King exclaimed, turning to the jury, who instantly made a memorandum of the fact.
memorandum.zh: 国王大叫道，转过身看着陪审员，陪审员立即作了记录。

cognition.en: Such attitudes are valueless unless they reflect inner cognition and certainty.
cognition.zh: 这种态度如果不能反映内心的认知和确定性就毫无价值。

cognition.en: Perception is important in social cognition too.
cognition.zh: 感知在社会认知中也很重要。

cognition.en: We've been talking about animal cognition—the study of animal intelligence.
cognition.zh: 我们一直在讨论动物认知——对动物智力的研究。

prolific.en: She is an accomplished painter and a prolific author of stories for children.
prolific.zh: 她是位技艺精湛的画家和多产的儿童文学作家。

prolific.en: He was also a prolific small group player, recording with Louis Armstrong, Dizzy Gillespie, and James Band as well as a composer and arranger.
prolific.zh: 他也是一位多产的小乐队成员，与路易斯·阿姆斯特朗、迪兹·吉莱斯皮和詹姆斯乐队一起录音，同时也是一位作曲家和编曲人。

prolific.en: His colorful lifestyle aside, Bob Dylan's reputation as a prolific artist stems from the vast number of songs he produced during the 1960s and 1970s.
prolific.zh: 撇开他丰富多彩的生活方式不谈，鲍勃·迪伦作为多产艺术家的声誉源于他在20世纪60年代和70年代创作的大量歌曲。

defective.zh: 零售商可以退回有瑕疵的商品。

defective.en: Her hearing was found to be slightly defective.
defective.zh: 经检查，她的听力有点缺陷。

defective.en: A manufacturer negligently made and marketed a car with defective brakes.
defective.zh: 一家制造商渎职，制造并销售了一款有制动缺陷的汽车。

shabby.en: She wore shabby old jeans and a T-shirt.
shabby.zh: 她穿着一条破旧的牛仔裤和一件T恤衫。

shabby.en: The general divided his time between his shabby offices and his home in Hampstead.
shabby.zh: 将军的时间一部分在他那破旧的办公室里度过，另一部分在他汉普斯特德的家度过。

overhaul.en: The average budget for a "major" kitchen overhaul in 2006, calculates Remodeling magazine, was a staggering $54,000; even a "minor" improvement cost on average $18,000.
overhaul.zh: 根据《重塑》杂志的计算，2006年厨房一次“大修”的平均预算高达54000美元，令人难以置信；即使是一个“小”的改进，平均花费也要18000美元。

overhaul.en: A radical overhaul of the tax system is necessary.
He managed to overhaul the leader on the final lap.
overhaul.zh: 他在最后一圈努力超过了领先的人。

conducive.en: In short, team spirit and effective communication are conducive to employee and business performance alike.
conducive.zh: 总之，团队精神和有效的沟通有利于员工和企业的绩效。

conducive.en: Cutting the working week would be conducive to the individual, giving millions of workers more time to spend as they see fit.
conducive.zh: 减少每周工作时间将对个人有益，让数百万工人有更多的时间，并在他们认为合适的地方度过这些时间。

conducive.en: In my view, it is important for parents to ensure that the home atmosphere is conducive to learning both academic and social skills.
conducive.zh: 在我看来，对家长来说重要的是确保家庭氛围有利于学习学术和社会技能。

disable.en: They can disable communications satellites and shut down power systems.
disable.zh: 它们能使通信卫星失效并关闭电力系统。

disable.en: There will be television chat shows hosted by robots, and cars with pollution monitors that will disable them when they offend.
disable.zh: 届时，将出现由机器人主持的电视谈话节目以及装有污染监控器的汽车，一旦这些汽车排污超标（违规），监控器就会使其停驶。

disable.en: There will be television chat shows hosted by robots, and cars with pollution monitors that will disable them when they offend.
disable.zh: 届时，将出现由机器人主持的电视谈话节目以及装有污染监控器的汽车，一旦这些汽车排污超标（违规），监控器就会使其停驶。

censor.en: The censor struck out the next two lines.
censor.zh: 审查员删除了下面那两行。

censor.en: The director objected to the cuts ordered by the censor.
censor.zh: 导演反对按审查员的指令作删剪。

censor.en: This means that you don't censor your thoughts, but allow your mind to go freely to a problem and see what kind of solutions or ideas come up.
censor.zh: 这意味着你不必审查你的想法，而是让你的大脑自由地去思考一个问题，看看会出现什么样的解决方案或想法。

optimum.en: The hot sun enables the grapes to reach optimum ripeness.
optimum.zh: 炙热的阳光使葡萄能达到最佳成熟状态。

optimum.en: The optimum moment has been whittled down to 7:22 a.m.
optimum.zh: 最佳时刻已缩减至上午7点22分。

optimum.en: The department of Environmental Conservation estimates the optimum population at 60.
optimum.zh: 环境保护部估计最适宜的年龄是60岁。

throng.en: We pushed our way through the throng.

throng.zh: 一位官员从人群中挤过。

articulation.en: The singer worked hard on the clear articulation of every note.
articulation.zh: 歌手苦练以便每一个音都唱得清晰。

articulation.en: This was seen as a way of restricting women's articulation of grievances.
articulation.zh: 这曾被认为是一种限制妇女表达不满的方法。

sanity.en: After her own struggle with this, Ms. Li took a step back and used her experience to build Sanity & Self, a self-care app and platform for overworked women.
sanity.zh: 在她自己与此斗争之后，李女士退了一步，利用她的经验建立了理智与自我（Sanity & Self），一个针对过度工作的女性的自我护理应用软件和平台。

sanity.en: His behaviour was so strange that I began to doubt his sanity.
sanity.zh: 他行为怪异，我有点怀疑他是否神智正常。

sanity.en: After a series of road accidents the police pleaded for sanity among drivers.
sanity.zh: 在发生一系列交通事故之后，警方提请驾驶人要谨慎驾车。

mammoth.en: Mammoth bones have also been found at some other Clovis sites.
mammoth.zh: 在其他一些克洛维斯遗址也发现了猛犸象的骨头。

mammoth.en: Any of them might conceal a mammoth graveyard or the next mummified Lyuba.
mammoth.zh: 他们中的任何一个都可能隐藏着一个猛犸象墓地或下一个木乃伊一样的柳芭。

mammoth.en: What he did was, he wrote a computer program to simulate what would happen to mammoth under certain conditions.
mammoth.zh: 他所做的是写一个电脑程序来模拟在特定条件下猛犸象会发生什么。

dagger.en: He drew his dagger and turned to face his pursuers.
dagger.zh: 他拔出匕首并且转过身去面对追他的人。

dagger.en: Peter felt for his dagger till his hand gripped it.
dagger.zh: 彼得伸手去摸他的匕首，直到他的手抓住它。

shrewd.en: He is a very shrewd operator with an incisive mind.
shrewd.zh: 他是一位非常精明的经营者，有着敏锐的头脑。

shrewd.en: He was a shrewd lawyer with a talent for uncovering paper trails of fraud.
shrewd.zh: 他是个精明强干的律师，能从一连串文件中找出诈骗的蛛丝马迹。

predatory.en: Predatory pricing by large supermarkets was threatening the livelihood of smaller businesses.
predatory.zh: 大型超市的掠夺性定价正威胁着小商店的生计。

predatory.en: People will not set up new businesses while they are frightened by the predatory behaviour of the banks.
predatory.zh: 人们在被银行的掠夺行为惊吓的情况下是不会开办新企业的。

predatory.en: Ants keep predatory insects away from where their aphids feed; Gmail keeps the spammers out of our inboxes.
predatory.zh: 蚂蚁让食肉昆虫远离蚜虫的觅食处；Gmail 使垃圾邮件发送人远离我们的收件箱。

cavern.en: Four avenues opened out of the small cavern which the great rock stood in.
cavern.zh: 大岩石所在的岩洞里有四条岔路。

cavern.en: The Spot: The Grand Canyon's Redwall Cavern
cavern.zh: 拍摄现场：大峡谷的红墙洞

cavern.en: This cavern knows no philosophers; its dagger has never cut a pen.
cavern.zh: 这窟窖不知道有哲学，它的尖刀从来没有削过一支笔。

thicket.en: A thicket makes good cover for animals to hide in.
thicket.zh: 丛林是动物的良好隐蔽处。

thicket.en: In front of the door he observed a bird which had caught itself in the thicket.
thicket.zh: 在门前，他看见了一只鸟被困在灌木丛中。

thicket.en: The hidden things silence revealed: a pheasant craning its neck to spy on us from a thicket, a crow hopping from branch to branch, a raccoon snoring in den.
thicket.zh: 他们指给我那些原本隐藏起来、却被寂静暴露了的东西：一头野鸡从灌木丛中伸长脖子打探我们，一只乌鸦在树枝间跳来跳去，一只浣熊在它的窝里打鼾。

idealism.zh: 他满脑子都是年轻人的理想主义。

idealism.en: She never lost her respect for the idealism of the 1960s.
idealism.zh: 她从未摈弃自己对20世纪60年代理想主义的崇敬。

idealism.en: They struggled to keep the torch of idealism and hope alive.
idealism.zh: 他们为使理想主义和希望的火炬不熄灭而奋斗。

prowess.en: He's always bragging about his prowess as a hunter.
prowess.zh: 他老是吹嘘自己作为猎手的高超技能。

prowess.en: In all deeds of prowess as well as in large schemes of war Richard shone.
prowess.zh: 在一切英勇的行动和大规模的战争计划中，理查德都大放异彩。

prowess.en: Mr Obama's fundraising prowess gives him momentum.
prowess.zh: 奥巴马非凡的资金募集表现给了他力量。

magistrate.en: She will face a local magistrate on Tuesday.
magistrate.zh: 她将在星期二面见一位地方治安法官。

magistrate.en: In desperation, he ran to the city and went straight to the courthouse to report the robbery to the magistrate.
magistrate.zh: 绝望之下，他跑到城里，直奔法院向地方法官报告这起抢劫案。

burglar.en: The burglar alarm should be professionally installed.
burglar.zh: 防盗警报应当由专业人员安装。

burglar.en: He opened the door and came face-to-face with a burglar.
burglar.zh: 他打开门和窃贼打了个照面。

burglar.en: The main thing to remember is to switch off the burglar alarm.
burglar.zh: 最要紧的是记住关掉防盗报警器的开关。

campfire.zh: 我的妈妈在营火上做饭。
每个人都围坐在篝火旁边。

campfire.en: We sit around a campfire at night.
campfire.zh: 到了夜里，我们坐在篝火周围。

diffusion.en: There are data on the rates of diffusion of molecules.
diffusion.zh: 有一些关于分子的扩散速率的数据。

diffusion.en: In December 1778, he proposed the plan "for the more general diffusion of knowledge".
diffusion.zh: 1778年12月，他提出了“更普遍传播知识”的计划。

diffusion.en: Iron came from West Asia, although its routes of diffusion were somewhat different than those of agriculture.
diffusion.zh: 铁器来源于西亚，尽管它的传播路径跟农业技术的传播路径有些不同。

clerical.en: The standard clerical dress throughout Europe was the long black cope.
clerical.zh: 整个欧洲的标准牧师服装是黑色的长披肩。

clerical.en: "Yes, he is our first printer," replied the clerical gentleman hastily.
clerical.zh: “是的，他是我们这儿的印刷始祖。”办事员先生赶紧回答。

clerical.en: As clerical loads increased, something had to give, and that was always face time with patients.
clerical.zh: 随着文书工作量的增加，有些事情不得不放弃，而被放弃的通常是和病人面对面交流的时间。

spearhead.zh: 这矛头引出了许多问题。

spearhead.en: Whatever his pretensions, Mr Lieberman is not ready to spearhead a revolt.
spearhead.zh: 无论他用什么借口，利伯曼先生都不会带头反抗。

spearhead.en: News reports said British and French warplanes would spearhead the attack.
spearhead.zh: 新闻报道说英国和法国战机有可能成为先遣队发动进攻。

verification.en: You should also see all of the verification points and test objects listed in the Script Explorer on the right.
verification.zh: 你还应该看到右侧的脚本资源管理器中列出的所有验证点和测试对象。

verification.en: All charges against her are dropped pending the verification of her story.
verification.zh: 在她的陈述得到证实前，所有针对她的指控都被撤回。
但是还缺乏更深的验证。

locality.en: There is no airport in the locality.
We talk of the brain as the locality of thought.
locality.zh: 我们把进行思维的地方叫做大脑。

locality.en: Following the discovery of the explosives the president cancelled his visit to the locality.
locality.zh: 发现爆炸物之后总统取消了对该地区的访问。

truce.en: The local government and the army negotiated a truce.
truce.zh: 该地方政府和军方谈判达成了休战协定。

truce.en: The two sides called a truce to avoid further bloodshed.
truce.zh: 双方宣布休战，以免更多的流血。

truce.en: That peace often looked like a brief truce before the next plunge into war.
truce.zh: 那种和平看起来常常像是投入新一轮战争前的短暂停火期。

astonished.zh: 这消息使大家十分惊讶。

astonished.en: She astonished us by saying she was leaving.
astonished.zh: 她说她要离开，令我们大为惊奇。

astonished.en: Chris acted astonished as he examined the note.
astonished.zh: 在克里斯检查这张便条时，他假装很吃惊。

threatening.en: His heart condition is not life-threatening.
threatening.zh: 他的心脏病不会危及生命。

threatening.en: My boyfriend was threatening to finish with me.
threatening.zh: 我的男朋友威胁说要跟我断绝关系。
天空乌云密布，阴沉沉的。

prerequisite.en: Good self-esteem is a prerequisite for a happy life.
prerequisite.zh: 良好的自尊心是幸福生活的先决条件。

prerequisite.en: A degree is an essential prerequisite for employment at this level.
prerequisite.zh: 学位是做这级工作必备的先决条件。

prerequisite.en: Courage is no longer a prerequisite for a stay in Naples.
prerequisite.zh: 勇气不再是留在那不勒斯的先决条件。

shortcut.en: Fame can be a shortcut to love and money.
shortcut.zh: 名望可以是得到爱情和金钱的捷径。

shortcut.en: There is a handy keyboard shortcut to save you having to scroll up to the top of the screen.
shortcut.zh: 有一个方便的键盘快捷键可用，不必滚动到屏幕的顶端。

shortcut.en: Follow the instructions on the page for your phone to add the bookmark as a shortcut on your app launcher.
shortcut.zh: 按照页面上的指示在你手机上添加书签作为你的应用启动栏中的快捷方式。

beak.en: The gull held the fish in its beak.
The male bird has a red spot on its beak.
The male is generally larger with a shorter beak.
beak.zh: 通常雄鸟体形较大，喙较短。

repository.en: Once the data and associated materials appear in a repository, answering questions and handling complaints can take many hours.
repository.zh: 一旦数据和相关的材料出现在一个存储库，回答问题和处理投诉可能需要数小时。

repository.en: In addition to being a repository for textbooks covering a wide range of subjects and educational levels, its ethic is taken from the digital music world.
repository.zh: 除了作为涵盖广泛学科和教育水平的教科书库之外，其道德标准来自数字音乐世界

repository.en: My father is a repository of family history.
repository.zh: 我的父亲对家族史无所不知。

refute.en: I covered the conference as a reporter, but what really unnerved me was a counter-conference of scholars to refute the earlier one.
refute.zh: 我以记者的身份报道了那次会议，但真正让我感到不安的是学者们召开的反驳会议。

refute.en: Even if true, this evidence does not refute the contention that editors should bear some of the blame for the reductions, unless editors are merely passive instruments responding to reader interest.
refute.zh: 即使这是真的，这一证据也不能反驳编辑应该承担部分责任的论点，除非编辑只是被动地回应读者的兴趣。

refute.en: It was the kind of rumour that it is impossible to refute.
refute.zh: 这是那种不可能推翻的谣言。

meticulous.en: He has been a meticulous manager, a manager par excellence.
meticulous.zh: 他是位一丝不苟的经理，一位出类拔萃的经理。

meticulous.en: Her talent was not in gathering information but in analyzing and assessing, a meticulous organizer who plotted and planned with the cunning of a leopard.
meticulous.zh: 她的才华不在信息收集，而在于分析和评估，她是一个一丝不苟的组织者，像豹子一样狡猾地策划和计划着。
他对任何事情都很小心谨慎。

vaccination.en: Vaccination and other prophylactic measures can be carried out.
vaccination.zh: 接种疫苗和其他预防措施可以实施。

vaccination.en: Anyone who wants to avoid the flu should consider getting a vaccination.
vaccination.zh: 任何希望避免患流感的人都应该考虑接种疫苗。

vaccination.en: Now, children aged six months to five years are to be offered the vaccination from next month.
vaccination.zh: 现在，年龄在六个月至五岁之间的儿童从下个月开始接种疫苗。

eminent.en: She invoked several eminent scholars to back up her argument.
eminent.zh: 她援引了几位赫赫有名的学者来支持她的论点。

eminent.en: It gives birth to many eminent scholars.
eminent.zh: 它孕育了许多杰出的学者。

eminent.en: Dickens was pre-eminent among English writers of his day.
eminent.zh: 狄更斯在其同时期英国作家中最为出色。

sympathize.en: I find it very hard to sympathize with him.
I must tell you how much I sympathize with you for your loss, Professor.
sympathize.zh: 教授，我必须告诉您我对您所受的损失深表同情。

sympathize.en: I heartily sympathize with you.; I have every sympathy for you.

iris.en: Iris scanning can work from a distance.
iris.zh: 虹膜扫描可以在远距离操作。

iris.en: The Global Impact Investment Network's IRIS project seeks to do just that.
iris.zh: 全球影响力投资网络的 IRIS 项目就是这样做的。

iris.en: What attracted me the most towards the Performance Team was their enthusiasm and pride in their work at Iris.
iris.zh: 绩效团队最吸引我的是他们对 Iris 工作的热情和自豪。

fraudulent.en: As is announced in the papers, our country has launched a largescale movement against smuggling and fraudulent activities in foreign currency exchange deals.
fraudulent.zh: 据报道，我国开展了一场大规模的打击外汇交易相关的走私和欺诈活动的运动。

fraudulent.en: There is no evidence that the broker was in league with the fraudulent vendor.
fraudulent.zh: 没有代理人和奸商相勾结的证据。

fraudulent.en: Review the file for any fraudulent preferences or reviewable transactions.
fraudulent.zh: 检查文件中是否存在欺诈性的首选项或可检查的事务。

onslaught.en: Tom stood still, rather flustered by this onslaught.
onslaught.zh: 汤姆站着不动，被这番猛攻弄得心乱如麻。

onslaught.en: When it comes to the reactions of the ecosystems to the onslaught of modern technology, there is no common language.
onslaught.zh: 谈到生态系统对现代科技冲击的反应时，人们异议纷纷。

onslaught.en: I watch my little daughter's face as she absorbs the powerful onslaught of arousing visuals and bloody special effects in movies.
onslaught.zh: 我看着小女儿的脸，她被电影中唤起视觉和血腥特效的强烈冲击所吸引。

realistically.en: How many can you realistically hope to sell?
realistically.zh: 实事求是地讲，你希望能卖出多少？

realistically.en: In the case of a major collection, there are probably more works on display than we could realistically view in weeks or even months.
realistically.zh: 在主要的收藏中，展出的作品可能比我们在几周甚至几个月内实际看到的还要多。

realistically.en: Kate spoke realistically about the task ahead.
realistically.zh: 凯特如实地谈了面临的任务。

pastime.zh: 他最喜欢的消遣是打高尔夫。

pastime.en: Eating out is the national pastime in France.
pastime.zh: 在法国，下馆子是全国人普遍的消遣活动。

pastime.en: His favorite pastime was patting his kitten's soft paws.
pastime.zh: 他喜爱的消遣就是轻拍他小猫柔软的爪子。

submerge.en: The waters were rising about the rock and would soon submerge it.
submerge.zh: 水涨到快跟岩石一样高了，很快就会将它淹没。

submerge.en: Their storage reservoirs stop the flow of rivers and often submerge towns, farms, and historic sites.
submerge.zh: 它们的蓄水池阻止了河流的流动，于是经常会淹没城镇、农场和历史遗迹。

submerge.en: The submarine had had time to submerge before the warship could approach.
submerge.zh: 潜水艇没等军舰靠近就及时潜入水下了。

antioxidant.en: The antioxidant nutrients found in papaya have also been proven to reduce muscle inflammation and heal burns and wounds.
antioxidant.zh: 在木瓜中发现的抗氧化营养素已被证明能降低肌肉炎症以及能愈合烧伤创疡。

antioxidant.en: It is good to consume tomatoes as they have lycopene, which is an antioxidant and hence works as a sunscreen from within.
antioxidant.zh: 食用番茄是有好处的，因为它们所含的番茄红素是一种抗氧化剂，因此从内部起着防晒霜的作用。

antioxidant.en: We need to evaluate its antioxidant capacity by TLC-bioautography.
antioxidant.zh: 我们需要通过 TLC 生物自显影技术评估其抗氧化能力。

forage.en: Another decision is when to forage for food.
forage.zh: 另一个决定是什么时候寻找食物。

forage.en: Pull yourself together, and come with me and forage.
forage.zh: 振作起来，跟我一起去找点吃的。

forage.en: Sunset casts a warm glow over the tufa formations as seagulls forage for dinner.
forage.zh: 海鸥在寻找晚餐时，夕阳在凝灰岩地层投射了温暖的光辉。

blister.en: It is not a good idea to burst a blister.
blister.zh: 把水疱弄破不是个好主意。

blister.en: I was bothered about the blister on my hand.
blister.zh: 我为手上的水疱感到很心烦。

blister.en: The affected skin turns red and may blister.
blister.zh: 受感染的皮肤会变红，并可能起水疱。

hindsight.en: With hindsight, we'd all do things differently.
hindsight.zh: 事后想来，我们可能都会以不同的方式做事。

hindsight.en: What looks obvious in hindsight was not at all obvious at the time.
hindsight.zh: 事后一目了然的在当时根本看不清。

hindsight.en: With hindsight, it was significant that the boat was found and studied by mainstream archaeologists who naturally focused on its cultural context.
hindsight.zh: 事后看来，主流考古学家发现和研究这艘船是很有意义的，他们自然会关注它的文化背景。

saturate.en: Heavy rains can saturate hillsides, leading to devastating mudslides.
saturate.zh: 大雨会浸透山坡，会导致毁灭性的泥石流。

saturate.en: Saturate the wood with oil and let it soak in. The oil protects the wood.
saturate.zh: 油浸透了木材，使之吸收，可以起到保护作用。

saturate.en: According to our results, the server starts to saturate at 350-500 users.
saturate.zh: 根据我们的结果，服务器性能会在350 - 500个用户时趋于饱和。

thorn.en: The thorn of bone may dislodge from his throat without surgery.
thorn.zh: 也许不用动手术就能去除他喉咙卡着的那块骨刺。

thorn.en: Nightingale pressed closer against the thorn, and the thorn touched her heart, and a fierce pang of pain shot through her.
thorn.zh: 南丁格尔更加的靠近那个刺，刺碰到了她的心脏，一股剧烈的疼痛击穿了她的身体。

thorn.en: She fell to reflecting again, and in looking downwards, a thorn of the rose remaining in her breast accidentally pricked her chin.
thorn.zh: 她又陷入了沉思，向下看时，她戴在胸前的玫瑰花刺扎了一下她的下巴。

discreet.en: They were gossipy and not always discreet.
discreet.zh: 他们爱说闲话，而且不总是言语谨慎。

discreet.en: Emporio Armani, the Italian fashion house, has made a discreet foray into furnishings.
discreet.zh: 意大利时装公司恩波利·阿玛尼已谨慎地涉足室内装饰业。

discreet.en: We were very discreet about the romance.
discreet.zh: 我们对这一段罗曼史守口如瓶。

pebble.en: She bent down to shake a pebble out of her shoe.
pebble.zh: 她弯下腰，把鞋里的一粒石子抖出来。

pebble.en: We remove a pebble and the system expands.
pebble.zh: 我们移开一粒小石子，系统就扩展。

pebble.en: One day, however, about midafternoon, he picked up a pebble and it was warm.
pebble.zh: 然而有一天，大约在下午三点左右，他捡到一块鹅卵石，它是温暖的。

divergent.en: Two people who have divergent views on this question are George Watt and Bob Marr.
divergent.zh: 在这个问题上意见相左的两个人是乔治·瓦特和鲍勃·马尔。

divergent.en: These writers represent community as dynamic, as something that must be negotiated and renegotiated because of its members' divergent histories, positions, expectations, and beliefs.
divergent.zh: 这些作家代表了一个充满活力的社区，由于其成员有着不同的历史、立场、期望和信仰，这个社区必须经过不断的协商和再协商。

swivel.en: I spun around in my swivel chair and chatted with Jim.
swivel.zh: 我坐在旋转椅上扭过身来，和吉姆攀谈了起来。

swivel.en: He leaned back in the swivel chair and locked his fingers behind his head.
swivel.zh: 他向后靠在转椅上，两手手指交叉锁定在脑后。

swivel.en: Let's swivel it around for just a moment, so we have a blank slate and now what's really going on?
swivel.zh: 让我们把它转一下，这样我们就有了一块空白，现在到底发生了什么?

quarrel.en: He did not mention the quarrel with his wife.
quarrel.zh: 他没有提起和妻子的争吵。

quarrel.en: My sister and I used to quarrel all the time.
quarrel.zh: 我和妹妹过去老是吵架。

methane.en: As the waste materials decompose, they produce methane gas.
methane.zh: 废物腐烂时会产生沼气。

methane.en: Another gas associated with the spread of agriculture is methane.
methane.zh: 另一种与农业扩张有关的气体是甲烷。

bulldozer.en: There would be one machine, one bulldozer for the entire area.
bulldozer.zh: 整个地区将会有一台机器，一台推土机。

bulldozer.en: You remember Martin Anderson wrote a book on the federal bulldozer describing the effect of the urban development?
bulldozer.zh: 你记得马丁·安德森（Martin Anderson）在那本关于联邦推土机的书中，如何描述城市发展效应的吗？

bulldozer.en: Someone used a bulldozer and plowed a two-foot-deep gash in the desert, unearthing the brick and bitumen remains of a stairway.
bulldozer.zh: 有人用推土机在沙漠里犁了一个两英尺深的瓦斯，挖出了楼梯的砖头和沥青残骸。

binary.en: The message contains Unicode characters and has been sent as a binary attachment.
binary.zh: 这条信息含有统一码字符，已经以二进制附件形式发送。

binary.en: The computer performs calculations in binary and converts the results to decimal.
binary.zh: 计算机以二进制数进行计算，而后把计算结果转换为十进制数。

binary.en: The instructions are translated into binary code, a form that computers can easily handle.
binary.zh: 这些指令被翻译成二进制代码，这是计算机容易处理的一种形式。

homogeneous.en: Audiences are smaller and more homogeneous than they have been in the past.
homogeneous.zh: 受众规模比过去更小、更同质。

homogeneous.en: The government's avowed aim, however, is to maintain "a substantially homogeneous society into which newcomers, from whatever sources, will merge themselves".
homogeneous.zh: 然而，政府公开宣称的目标是保持“一个实质上同质化的社会，无论出身何处的新来者都将融入其中”。

homogeneous.en: In these days the pre-industrial city in America functioned as a complex and varied organizing element in American life, not as a simple, homogeneous, and static unit.
homogeneous.zh: 在这些日子里，美国未工业化的城市在美国人的生活中是一个复杂而多样的组织元素，而不是一个简单的、同质的、静态的单位。

heady.en: After the heady days that led it to power amid the protests of the so-called Tulip Revolution of 2005, the government is now under pressure to show results.
heady.zh: 在2005年那场被称为郁金香革命的抗议中，政府兴奋的时光里登台，如今，它面临着展示政绩的压力。

heady.en: The heady aroma of wood smoke emanated from the stove.
heady.zh: 木头燃烧的浓郁香味从炉子里散发出来。

condone.en: I don't condone violence in any shape or form.
condone.zh: 我决不容忍任何形式的暴力。

condone.en: That is an act that no state or government apparatus can condone.
condone.zh: 那是任何州以及政府机构都不能纵容的一种行为。
她说父母不应该原谅这种行为。

repel.en: They have fifty thousand troops along the border ready to repel any attack.
repel.zh: 他们沿边界有5万军队，随时准备击退任何进攻。

repel.en: Ants store food, repel attackers and use chemical signals to contact one another in case of attack.
repel.zh: 蚂蚁储存食物，击退攻击者，并使用化学信号联系彼此以防被攻击。

blackout.en: She had a blackout and couldn't remember anything about the accident.
blackout.zh: 她眼前一黑，那场事故就怎么也想不起来了。

blackout.en: As the blackout hour moved across the globe, London's Big Ben, Paris' Eiffel Tower, and Arc de Triomphe flipped the switch.
blackout.zh: 当熄灯运动在全球展开时，伦敦的大本钟、巴黎铁塔、以及凯旋门都关了开关。

blackout.en: The blackout poems were a side project.
blackout.zh: 涂黑诗作就是一个编外项目。

ferocious.en: Marduk defeats Tiamat, the watery ferocious deep monster.
ferocious.zh: 年轻的暴风之神 Marduk 打败了在深水凶猛的怪物 Tiamat。

ferocious.en: From ferocious birds of prey to shy songbirds, Zuckerman has captured our avian neighbors in fascinating new ways.
ferocious.zh: 从凶猛的猛禽到害羞的鸣禽，祖克曼用这种迷人的新方式来捕获了我们的鸟类邻居。

ferocious.en: ladybird larvae are among the biggest friends we gardeners have. They're ferocious predators on problem whitefly and red spider mite.
ferocious.zh: 幼瓢虫就是园丁们最大的朋友之一，它们是凶猛的食肉动物，专门对付白粉虱和红蜘蛛螨。

rehabilitate.en: Considerable efforts have been made to rehabilitate patients who have suffered in this way.
rehabilitate.zh: 为使受这种苦的病人康复已经付出了相当大的努力。
而现在时间会为炼金术士们正名。

rehabilitate.en: Rehabilitate [the poor] at the hands of the king.
rehabilitate.zh: 从国王手里为穷人昭雪。

cashier.zh: 那个收银员态度不太友善。

gloss.en: The gel gives your hair a gloss.
