picturesque.zh: 在旅程中，我们去了风景如画的柏柏尔村庄和可爱的海滩。

picturesque.en: They may be picturesque, even poetical; or they may be pedestrian, even trivial.
picturesque.zh: 它们也许如画一般，甚至富有诗意；或者它们可能平庸，甚至微不足道。

picturesque.en: Aside from the picturesque scenery of Sichuan province, the dishes there is also an attraction to tourists.
picturesque.zh: 除了四川如画的风景以外，川菜对游客也很有吸引力。

arithmetic.en: They will concentrate on teaching the basics of reading, writing and arithmetic.
arithmetic.zh: 他们将重点教授阅读、写作和算术的基本要点。

palate.en: These nuts have been market tested and found to be most suited to the Australian palate.
palate.zh: 这些干果已经过了市场试验，结果发现它们最适合澳大利亚人的口味。

palate.en: Doctors removed parts of his upper left jaw and hard palate and considered the operation to be a success, although it left Cleveland's mouth disfigured.
palate.zh: 医生切除了他的部分上左颚和硬腭，尽管它使得克利夫兰嘴部变丑，但认为手术是成功的。

palate.en: It was a meal to tempt even the most jaded palate.
palate.zh: 这顿饭能使最没胃口的人产生食欲。

recurrent.en: Race is a recurrent theme in the work.
recurrent.zh: 种族是该作品中反复出现的一个主题。

recurrent.en: A dentist may decide to extract the tooth to prevent recurrent trouble.
recurrent.zh: 牙医可能会决定拔掉这颗牙，以防复发。

recurrent.en: The late Cretaceous extinction of the dinosaurs and ammonoids was just one of the more drastic in a whole series of such recurrent extinction episodes.
recurrent.zh: 在这一系列周期性物种灭绝事件里，白垩纪晚期恐龙和菊石的灭绝仅仅是其中一个比较严重的事件。

relieved.zh: 他们如释重负地彼此看了看。

relieved.en: We are all relieved to be back home.
relieved.zh: 回到家我们都松了一口气。

ax.en: He whittled a new handle for his ax.
ax.zh: 他为自己的斧头削了一个新斧柄。
你如何磨尖你的斧头呢？

liter.en: We just harvest them and grow a bunch in a 42-gallon (160-liter) barrel, so we can spray it out in a food-rich environment.
liter.zh: 我们只需要收割它们，然后在一42加仑（160升）的桶中种植一大批，这样我们就能把它们洒在一个食物丰富的环境里。

liter.en: Economics is precise about the tax that should, in principle, be levied to deal with negative externalities: the tax on a liter of fuel should be equal to the harm caused by using a liter of fuel.
liter.zh: 从经济学的角度来看，为了应对负外部性，原则上应该征收的税收是准确的：对一升燃料征收的税应该等于使用一升燃料所造成的危害。

liter.en: Sadly, the scientists found 1800 pieces of microplastics per liter of (每升) snow.
liter.zh: 遗憾的是，科学家们在每升雪里发现1800粒塑料微粒。

skeletal.en: That long skeletal structure suggests that it was aquatic.
skeletal.zh: 这种长长的骨骼结构表明它是水生动物。

skeletal.en: He has written only a skeletal plot for the book so far.
skeletal.zh: 那本书他目前只写了一个情节梗概。

skeletal.en: A litre of teacan contain up to 9mg of fluoride, which in excess can cause skeletal fluorosis, reducing bone quality and causing pain and stiffening of the ligaments.
skeletal.zh: 一升茶树含有高达9毫克的氟化物，过量会导致氟骨症，降低骨骼质量，导致疼痛和韧带僵硬。

hive.en: A dark cloud of bees comes swarming out of the hive.
hive.zh: 黑压压的一大群蜜蜂从那座蜂巢涌过来。

hive.en: Glass hives offer a close-up view of the bees at work, with the queen bee in each hive marked by a white dot.
hive.zh: 玻璃蜂房可以近距离观察工作中的蜜蜂，每个蜂房的蜂王都被打上白点标记。

hive.en: Tapping on the hive excited the bees.

quarterly.zh: 他们的季度会议是平淡乏味的事情。

quarterly.en: A full listing of the companies will be published quarterly.
quarterly.zh: 公司名录大全每季度出版一次。

quarterly.en: Clients normally pay fees in advance, monthly, quarterly, or yearly.
quarterly.zh: 客户们通常提前付费，或按月，或按季度，或按年。

folklore.en: The story rapidly became part of family folklore.
folklore.zh: 这个故事很快就成为家族传说的一部分。

folklore.en: In Chinese folklore the bat is a symbol of good fortune.
folklore.zh: 在中国民间传说中，蝙蝠是好运的象征。

folklore.en: On that issue, Hunt and Lipo say, archaeological evidence backs up Rapanui folklore.
folklore.zh: 关于这个问题，亨特和利普说，考古证据支持了拉帕努伊的民间传说。

depress.en: Subsidies allow growers to undercut competitors and depress world prices.
depress.zh: 补贴使得种植者能以低于竞争对手的价格出售并压低世界价格。
气氛开始使我感到压抑。
无法控制的通货膨胀将会使经济萧条。

quicken.en: She felt her heartbeat quicken as he approached.
quicken.zh: 随着他的走近，她觉得自己的心跳加速了。

quicken.en: As the pace of modern life continues to quicken, the pressure seems to be on the increase all the time.
quicken.zh: 随着现代生活节奏的不断加快，压力似乎一直在增加。

tributary.en: This is a tributary of Zhujiang River.
The principality became tributary to the Ottoman Empire during 16th century.
tributary.zh: 这个公国在16世纪成为了奥斯曼帝国的附属国。

tributary.en: Mi-(mì) LUO Jiang-Xiangbei in the Xiangjiang River is the largest tributary.
tributary.zh: 汨（mì）罗江是湘江在湘北的最大支流。

penchant.en: Neither the human imitative instinct nor a penchant for fantasy by itself leads to an autonomous theater.
penchant.zh: 无论是人类的模仿本能，还是对幻想的嗜好本身，都不会单独成为独立的戏剧形式。

penchant.en: It is widely believed that the Peugeot family tired of Mr. Streiff's autocratic ways and penchant for confrontation.
penchant.zh: 人们普遍认为，标致家族厌倦了斯特雷夫先生专横的处事方式以及对抗倾向。

geology.en: We went on a geology field trip.
geology.zh: 我们去进行地质野外考察。

geology.en: He was visiting professor of geology at the University of Georgia.
geology.zh: 他曾是佐治亚大学的地质学客座教授。

geology.en: At first he studied architecture, but later he switched to geology.
geology.zh: 起初他学建筑，但后来转到地质学。

drone.en: It helps the drone to give coffee.
Who should be allowed to have a drone?
drone.zh: 应该允许谁拥有无人机？

drone.en: In minutes, a drone will do tasks for you.
drone.zh: 几分钟后，无人机就会为你完成任务。

boon.en: At last, Hook had got the boon for which he craved.
boon.zh: 最终，胡克得到了他所渴望的恩惠。

boon.en: My wife Ilsabill Will have her own will, and hath sent me to beg a boon of thee!
boon.zh: 我的妻子伊尔莎比尔维尔有她自己的意愿，她派我来祈求你的恩惠！

pointless.en: In the end it proved a pointless exercise.
pointless.zh: 这最终证明是一项毫无意义的活动。

pointless.en: Without an audience the performance is pointless.
pointless.zh: 没有观众，演出是没有意义的。

ploy.en: It was all a ploy to distract attention from his real aims.
ploy.zh: 那全是障眼法，借以转移对他真实目的的注意。

ploy.en: Some see this as a negotiating ploy.
ploy.zh: 有人认为这是谈判的一种策略。

yarn.en: Craft Resources also sells yarn and embroidery floss.
yarn.zh: “手工之家”也售卖纱线和绣花丝线。

yarn.en: Bits of tulle and fuzzy yarn hang mistily from the rafters.
yarn.zh: 椽条上随意地缠着一片片薄纱和毛茸茸的纱线。

yarn.en: I've found that my handwork with yarn has helped my arthritic fingers remain more dexterous as I age.
yarn.zh: 我发现，随着年龄的增长，我用纱线做手工使患有关节炎的手指变得更加灵活了。

pretense.en: Altman strips away the pretense and mythology to expose the film industry as a business like any other.
pretense.zh: 奥尔特曼揭穿伪装和神话，把电影业暴露成像其他任何行业一样。

pretense.en: Altman strips away the pretense and mythology to expose the film industry as a business like any other, dedicated to the pursuit of profit.
pretense.zh: 奥尔特曼揭去电影业的伪装和神话，揭示了其与任何行业一样追逐利润的本质。

pretense.en: I could easily escape discomfort, temporarily, by answering email or browsing the web under the pretense of so-called "research".
pretense.zh: 通过回复电子邮件或以所谓的“研究”为名浏览网页，我可以很容易地暂时摆脱掉不适感。

converse.en: The two deaf actors converse solely in signing.
converse.zh: 两位聋哑演员只靠打手势语交谈。

converse.en: The child, feeling free and comfortable, started to converse with Peter, and he had to answer many questions.
converse.zh: 孩子感到自由自在，很舒服，开始和彼得交谈，他不得不回答许多问题。

converse.en: What you do for a living is critical to where you settle and how you live – and the converse is also true.
converse.zh: 你的工作决定你在哪里定居和怎样生活–反之亦然。

barley.en: The barley is fed to the cattle.

conformity.en: You'll see that he writes about, first, conformity.
conformity.zh: 你会发现他所写的首先是一致性。

conformity.en: Increasingly, this apparent diversity is becoming a mask for a new type of conformity.
conformity.zh: 这种明显的多样性正日益成为一种新型一致性的面具。

conformity.en: In fact, we are much more likely to notice departures from norms than conformity to them.
conformity.zh: 事实上，我们更可能注意到的是违反规范的例子，而往往忽视了遵守规范的行为。

benevolent.en: This concept does not imply that business is benevolent or that consumer satisfaction is given priority over profit in a company.
benevolent.zh: 这个概念并不意味着企业是仁慈的，也不意味着消费者的满意度要高于公司的利润。

benevolent.en: The almighty and benevolent God is strongly disconfirmed for residents of Haiti, yet they continue to believe that God is good and all powerful.
benevolent.zh: 全能而仁慈的上帝在海地居民中遭到强烈的否定，但他们仍然坚信上帝是善良而全能的。

benevolent.en: He's devotion keeps my girls on a benevolent leash, one that hangs quietly at their side as they trot along but occasionally yanks them back to safety and solid ground.
benevolent.zh: 他的忠诚使我的女儿们像一条仁慈的链子，当她们小跑时，这条链子静静地挂在她们身边，但偶尔会把她们拉回安全、坚实的地面。

fabrication.en: She described the interview as a "complete fabrication."
fabrication.zh: 她把这次采访描述为“纯属虚构”。

fabrication.en: Her story was a complete fabrication from start to finish.
fabrication.zh: 她的叙述从头至尾都是编造出来的。

coward.en: You coward! What are you afraid of?
coward.zh: 你这胆小鬼！你怕什么呢？
“胆小鬼！”内心一个小声音坚持说。

coward.en: By attacking me, by attacking my wife, he has proved himself to be a gutless coward.
coward.zh: 通过袭击我，袭击我妻子，他已经证明了自己是一个胆小的懦夫。

clockwise.en: He told the children to start moving clockwise around the room.
clockwise.zh: 他告诉孩子们在房间里开始按顺时针方向移动。

clockwise.en: Once the container is full, it stays shut until you turn it clockwise.
clockwise.zh: 该容器一旦满了就会保持关闭，直到你将其按顺时针方向旋转。

microorganism.en: In the rare chance that there is a microorganism that can make you sick on the exact spot where the food dropped, you can be fairly sure that the bug is on the food you are about to put in your mouth.
microorganism.zh: 极少数情况下，有一种微生物可以在食物掉落的那一刻让你生病，你可以十分确定这种细菌就在你准备放进嘴里的食物上。

microorganism.en: Halophilic Microorganism is widely distributed in globe, among which Psychropliles and Psychrotrophs have been much more studied.
microorganism.zh: 低温微生物的分布非常广泛，研究应用较多的主要是嗜冷菌和耐冷菌。

microorganism.en: Based on the experiment of biofilm A/O process, the feasibility of brief-nitrification in attached microorganism system is studied.
microorganism.zh: 基于菌膜厌氧好氧工艺法流程试验，对附着微生物简短硝化的可行性进行了研究。

deceptive.en: Johnston isn't tired of Las Vegas yet, it seems, but appearances can be deceptive.
deceptive.zh: 似乎，约翰斯顿还没有厌倦拉斯韦加斯，但表象可能是骗人的。

deceptive.en: The state sued MemberWorks separately for deceptive selling.
deceptive.zh: 该州针对 MemberWorks 公司的欺骗性销售，单独对其提起诉讼。

deceptive.en: Bancorp, which was recently sued for deceptive practices by the state of Minnesota.
deceptive.zh: Bancorp 最近被明尼苏达州以欺诈行为起诉。

dormant.en: During the winter the seeds lie dormant in the soil.
dormant.zh: 冬天种子在土壤中休眠。

dormant.en: The pupae remain dormant in the soil until they emerge as adult moths in the winter.
dormant.zh: 蛹在土壤下休眠，直到冬季才变为成年的蛾飞出来。

dormant.en: And Lechuguilla is pretty much dormant now.
dormant.zh: 而龙舌兰现在几乎处于休眠状态。

coherence.en: The anthology has a surprising sense of coherence.
coherence.zh: 该诗集的连贯性令人惊奇。

coherence.en: The points you make are fine, but the whole essay lacks coherence.
coherence.zh: 你提出的论点很好，但整篇文章缺乏呼应连贯。

coherence.en: The campaign was widely criticized for making tactical mistakes and for a lack of coherence.
coherence.zh: 该运动遭到广泛批评，因其有策略错误且缺乏连贯性。

ration.en: The meat ration was down to one pound per person per week.
ration.zh: 肉类的配给量降到了每人每周一磅。

ration.en: I've had my ration of problems for one day—you deal with it!
ration.zh: 我手头的问题已经够我忙活一天的了—你来处理这件事吧！

ration.en: The new cities and towns, squeezed by their walls, had to know and order time in order to organize collective activity and ration space.
ration.zh: 在新的城市和小镇，由于其空间的限制，那里的居民必须要知道确切的时间且安排好时间，以组织集体活动和分配空间。

birch.en: Birch bark is pliable and very easy to bend.
birch.zh: 桦树皮很柔韧，很容易弯曲。

birch.en: That's one of the great things about birch bark.
birch.zh: 那就是桦树皮的好处之一。

birch.en: The taste of the birch tree doesn't get transferred to the food.
birch.zh: 桦树的味道并不会转移到食物上。

antidote.en: There is no known antidote to the poison.
antidote.zh: 这种毒的解药尚未发现。

antidote.en: Massage is a wonderful antidote to stress.
antidote.zh: 按摩是一种极妙的对抗压力的良方。

antidote.en: A Mediterranean cruise was the perfect antidote to a long cold winter.
antidote.zh: 到地中海航游是度过漫长寒冬的绝妙办法。

treatise.en: It is not a political treatise, as those who merely judge books by their title think, but it is the finest, most beautiful work on education ever written.
treatise.zh: 它不是一篇政治论文，就像那些仅仅通过书名来评判书籍的人所想的那样，但它是有史以来关于教育方面最优秀、最美丽的著作。

treatise.en: In 1850 Lucretia Mott published her discourse on women, arguing in a treatise for women to have equal political and legal rights and for changes in the married women's property laws.
treatise.zh: 1850年，Lucretia Mott 发表了她关于妇女的论述，在一篇专著中她主张妇女拥有平等的政治和法律权利，并要求修改已婚妇女的财产法。

treatise.en: It treatise especially new requests of howff of new times, the nodus and essentiality of landscape creativity.
treatise.zh: 它特别论述了对新时代的新要求，景观创造的结点和必要性。

quiver.en: Jane couldn't help the quiver in her voice.
He sat down on a large mushroom, and now there was a quiver in his voice.
quiver.zh: 他在一个大蘑菇上坐了下来，现在他的声音颤抖起来。

quiver.en: He felt a quiver of excitement run through him.
quiver.zh: 他觉得浑身上下都兴奋起来。

purge.en: He closed his eyes and lay still, trying to purge his mind of anxiety.
purge.zh: 他闭上眼睛躺着不动，试图清除心里的焦虑。

purge.en: In the Blood Purge of 1934, a Nazi SS squad murdered Kurt von Schleicher in the doorway of his home.
purge.zh: 在1934年的血液清洗中，一个纳粹党卫军小队在库尔特·冯·施莱歇家的门口谋杀了他。

purge.en: Licorice and mung bean do detox well, especially the mung bean, which is used to purge toxins in liver.
purge.zh: 甘草和绿豆可以很好地排毒，尤其是绿豆，它可以用来清除肝脏中的毒素。

legitimize.en: If I cannot legitimize our former relations at least I can assist you.
legitimize.zh: 即使我们不能使我们过去的关系合法化，我至少也能帮助你。

legitimize.en: In a sense, competition actually is good-especially to legitimize new markets.
legitimize.zh: 从某种意义上说，竞争实际上是很有好处的——特别是在开发新市场方面。

legitimize.en: Edited by Bekoff, who says it will finally "legitimize" research on animal emotions.
legitimize.zh: 柏柯夫担任此书编辑，他认为这将最终“认可”动物情感的研究。

lobe.en: A checkup revealed a small tumour on the left lower lobe of his lung, but it had not yet metastasized.
lobe.zh: 一次检查显示，他的肺部左下叶有一小块肿瘤，但尚未扩散。

lobe.en: For example, hormones from the hypothalamus in the brain stimulate the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland.
lobe.zh: 例如，来自大脑下丘脑的激素会刺激垂体前叶。

lobe.en: The oral shield is rounded with a distinct distal lobe.
lobe.zh: 口盾是圆形的，有明显的远端叶。

intertwine.en: An attempt was made to intertwine the amusing with the educational.
intertwine.zh: 作出一种寓教于乐的尝试。

intertwine.en: Three major narratives intertwine within Foucault's text, "Madness and Civilization."
intertwine.zh: 福考特的文章《疯狂与文明》中交织着三种主要的叙述。
在马德里，轻松与欢快交织一片。

labyrinth.en: We lost our way in the labyrinth of streets.
labyrinth.zh: 我们在迷宫式的街道上迷了路。

labyrinth.en: This book is available both at Labyrinth Books and Amazon.
labyrinth.zh: 在迷宫书店和亚马逊网站上都可以买到这本书。

labyrinth.en: I zigzagged down a labyrinth of alleys.
labyrinth.zh: 我在如迷宫般的小巷里拐来拐去。

ingenious.en: They are motivated to find ingenious ways to persuade their interlocutor.
ingenious.zh: 他们受到激励去寻找巧妙的方法去说服他们的对话者。

ingenious.en: You must have managed to escape, you clever, ingenious, intelligent Toad!
ingenious.zh: 你一定是设法逃出来的，你这聪明机灵的癞蛤蟆！

ingenious.en: His smartness of the morning had seemed to Tom a good joke before, and very ingenious.
ingenious.zh: 汤姆之前觉得他早上耍的小聪明是个很好的笑话，而且很有独创性。

antelope.en: The marks on the inside of one antelope jaw showed the primitive people cut out the tongue.
antelope.zh: 一块羚羊颌骨内部的痕迹表明，这些原始人割了它的舌头。

antelope.en: They gave me an antelope which is actually a little, and they gave me an opossum and a mouse.
antelope.zh: 他们给了我一只小羚羊，还有一只负鼠和一只老鼠。

antelope.en: If the young antelope had kept learning carefully all the time, he wouldn't have been caught.
antelope.zh: 如果小羚羊一直认真学习，就不会被抓住了。

calculator.zh: 我可以借用你的计算器吗？

calculator.en: A pocket calculator only works to eight decimal places.
calculator.zh: 袖珍计算器只计算到小数点后8位。

calculator.en: Grab a calculator and you'll discover that, over 40 years going out to dinner twice a month at $40 each time amounts to half a million.
calculator.zh: 拿起计算器，你会发现，40多年来，每月两次外出吃晚餐，每次花费40美元，总计50万美元。

contagious.zh: 猩红热的接触传染性很强。

inspirational.en: She can speak with an eloquence that is almost inspirational.
inspirational.zh: 她能用一种近乎激发灵感的口才发言。

inspirational.en: He is a mountain climber, an inspirational speaker and an advocate for the disabled.
inspirational.zh: 他是一位登山运动员，一位鼓舞人心的演说家，也是一位残疾人权益倡导者。

replay.en: We watched a replay of the wedding on video.
replay.zh: 我们观看了重放的婚礼录像。

replay.en: I watched a slow-motion videotape replay of his fall.
replay.zh: 我看了他跌倒时的慢动作录像回放。

replay.en: If there has to be a replay we are confident of victory.
replay.zh: 如果不得不重赛，我们有信心赢。

counterproductive.en: In practice, however, such an attitude is counterproductive.
counterproductive.zh: 然而在实际中，这种态度会适得其反。

counterproductive.en: We think an attempt to bully them into submission would be counterproductive.
counterproductive.zh: 我们认为威逼他们屈服的尝试可能会适得其反。

counterproductive.en: Some people believe that the equal opportunity for men and women in the police force or the military may lead to counterproductive results.
counterproductive.zh: 一些人认为，男女在警察部队或军队中享有平等的机会可能会导致适得其反的结果。

saliva.en: He noticed a lot of saliva settling in his mouth.
saliva.zh: 他注意到有很多唾液滞留在他的嘴里。

saliva.en: Michael was showing the nurse how to suction his saliva.
saliva.zh: 迈可正演示给护士看如何吸出他的唾液。

saliva.en: The only thing babies like to donate is their saliva.
saliva.zh: 婴儿唯一喜欢捐赠的就是他们的口水了。

disarmament.en: The goal would be to increase political stability in the region and accelerate the pace of nuclear disarmament.
disarmament.zh: 目标会是促进区内政局的稳定并加快核武器裁减的步伐。
这会恼火支持裁军的国家。

enlighten.en: It was an elite that believed its task was to enlighten the multitude.
enlighten.zh: 精英人物都会认为自己的职责就是启迪群众。

enlighten.en: A few dedicated doctors have fought for years to enlighten the profession.
enlighten.zh: 少数富有献身精神的医生为启蒙这一行业而奋斗多年。

enlighten.en: Instead, she set up Enlighten our Future, a charity that reaches students in the countryside how to write poems.
enlighten.zh: 相反，她成立了一个名为“启迪我们的未来”的慈善机构，教导农村的学生如何写诗。

sporadic.zh: 她在学校的出勤率很低。
米凯尔的进步是零星的。
他们的锻炼是零星而温和的。

troupe.en: The first female troupe (剧团) of Yue opera was created in 1923, and then female performers gradually took the place of the males.
troupe.zh: 1923年，第一个女子越剧团成立，随后女演员逐渐取代了男演员的位置。

troupe.en: The dancing troupe will give three performances at the Century Theatre.
troupe.zh: 这个舞蹈团将在世纪剧院演出三场。

troupe.en: O Troupe of little vagrants of the world, leave your footprints in my words.
troupe.zh: 世界上的一小队小小的漂泊者呀， 请留下你们的脚印在我的文字里。

veterinarian.en: If you're a veterinarian, you're out of luck.
veterinarian.zh: 如果你是一个兽医，那你的运气可真不佳。

veterinarian.en: In extreme cases, you may need the help of your veterinarian.
veterinarian.zh: 在一些特殊情况下，你也许需要向你的兽医求助。

veterinarian.en: She's telling me about school and why she wants to be a veterinarian, and I'm thinking, "Jesus, she and her friend look exactly alike."
veterinarian.zh: 她告诉我学校里的事情以及为什么她想成为一名兽医，我就想：“天啊，她和她的朋友简直是从一个模子印出来的。”

shin.en: An operation finally cured his shin injury.
shin.zh: 手术最终治愈了他的胫骨损伤。

shin.en: She gave him a kick on the shin.
shin.zh: 她朝他的小腿踢了一脚。

shin.en: I had a stress fracture in my left shin.
shin.zh: 我的左小腿出现应力性骨折。

pore.zh: 所发生的一切取决于孔隙大小。

pore.en: This pore space is known as porosity and is expressed as a percentage of the total rock volume.
pore.zh: 这个孔隙空间被称为孔隙度，用岩石总体积的百分比表示。

pore.en: This addition of a chemically precipitated substance into pore spaces is termed "permineralization".
pore.zh: 这种化学沉淀物质进入孔隙的过程被称为“完全矿化”。

outcry.en: The new tax provoked a public outcry.
outcry.zh: 新税项引起了公众的强烈抗议。
该起谋杀引起了国际上强烈的抗议。

outcry.en: The culling of seal cubs has led to an outcry from environmental groups.
outcry.zh: 宰杀海豹幼仔的行为已引起了环保团体的强烈抗议。

lemonade.en: I wonder if there's any fizz left in the lemonade.
lemonade.zh: 我想知道这柠檬汽水中还有没有气泡。

lemonade.en: Melissa had guzzled gin and tonics like they were lemonade.
lemonade.zh: 梅丽莎狂饮杜松子酒和奎宁水调的饮品，就像喝柠檬水一样。

rooster.zh: 下蛋公鸡，公鸡中的战斗机，哦耶！
一只公鸡正带着许多母鸡。

unconditional.en: Children need unconditional love from their parents.
unconditional.zh: 孩子们需要父母无条件的爱。

unconditional.en: The warring sides have agreed on an unconditional ceasefire.
unconditional.zh: 交战各方已经对无条件停火达成了一致意见。

encode.en: Failure to encode properly can create annoying situations.
encode.zh: 无法正确编码会造成恼人的后果。

encode.en: And the best way to learn how to encode information meaningfully, Ericsson determined, was a process known as deliberate practice.
encode.zh: 埃里克森认为，学习如何有意义地编码信息的最佳方法是一种叫做刻意练习的过程。

encode.en: General knowledge of categories of events such as a birthday party or a visit to the doctor's office helps older individuals encode their experiences.
encode.zh: 成年人拥有将事件（例如一场生日聚会或去一趟医生办公室）进行分类的能力，这可以帮助他们将自己的经历进行编码。

superstition.en: It's all superstition, and there's nothing to it.
According to superstition, breaking a mirror brings bad luck.
superstition.zh: 按照迷信的说法，摔碎镜子会带来噩运。

superstition.en: Scientific materialism thus triumphed over ignorance and superstition.
superstition.zh: 科学唯物主义就这样战胜了无知和迷信。

hazy.zh: 我的视力已经变得非常模糊。

hazy.en: My memories of childhood are hazy and episodic.
hazy.zh: 我儿时的回忆是一些朦朦胧胧的松散片段。

hazy.en: The air was thin and crisp, filled with hazy sunshine and frost.
hazy.zh: 空气稀薄而清新，弥漫着朦胧的阳光与霜霭。

squid.en: Forward credits could be useful in the squid business.
squid.zh: 远期信贷在鱿鱼生意中可能是有用的。

squid.en: Although the squid is delicious, it doesn't agree with everyone.
squid.zh: 鱿鱼虽然是美味，但是并不是人人都适合吃。

squid.en: I walked into the cockpit and there was a squid there looking up at me!
squid.zh: 我走进驾驶舱，那里有一只乌贼在抬头看着我！

smallpox.en: Ebola is not as easily spread as viruses such as smallpox.
smallpox.zh: 埃博拉病毒不像天花这类病毒那样容易传播。

smallpox.en: He gave money to the World Health Organization to help defeat smallpox.
smallpox.zh: 他给世界卫生组织提供了资金以帮助消灭天花。

smallpox.en: If smallpox occurred in your community, about 30 percent of the people that acquire the disease would die from it.
smallpox.zh: 如果天花发生在你的社区，大约百分之三十得了此病的人会因此死亡。

stench.en: The stench from rotting food is stomach-churning.
stench.zh: 腐烂食物散发的恶臭让人反胃。

stench.en: He couldn't see the hyena, but the stench of it was there, the stagnant reek of meat and sweat and piss.
stench.zh: 他看不见鬣狗，但却能闻到那股恶臭，那股肉、汗和尿的恶臭。

stench.en: The stench of burning rubber was overpowering.
stench.zh: 燃烧橡胶散发出的臭味极其强烈。

sabotage.en: Protesters failed to sabotage the peace talks.
sabotage.zh: 抗议者未能破坏和平谈判。

sabotage.en: Police investigating the train derailment have not ruled out sabotage.
sabotage.zh: 警方调查火车出轨事件，没有排除人为破坏的可能。

sabotage.en: On the contrary, many of these crimes, such as embezzlement of funds, the alteration of records, theft, vandalism, sabotage, and terrorism, can be committed without a computer.
sabotage.zh: 相反，许多此类犯罪，如挪用资金、篡改记录、盗窃、破坏公物、蓄意破坏和恐怖主义，都可以在没有计算机的情况下进行。

solvent.en: Lead is more solvent in acidic water.
solvent.zh: 铅在酸性水中更易溶解。

solvent.en: They're going to have to show that the company is now solvent.
solvent.zh: 他们将不得不证明公司现在是具备偿债能力的。

solvent.en: People with gray hair often are given the discounts without even asking for them; yet, millions of Americans above age 60 are healthy and solvent.
solvent.zh: 头发灰白的人通常不用开口就能得到折扣；然而，数以百万计60岁以上的美国人身体健康，有偿还能力。

insensitive.en: We become insensitive to our experience, which means we process less information, and time seems to speed up.
insensitive.zh: 我们对自己的经历变得不敏感，这意味着我们处理的信息更少，而时间似乎在加速。

insensitive.en: There is nothing sinful or immoral about being emotional, unless your emotions make you inhuman, insensitive and cruel to others.
insensitive.zh: 情绪化不罪恶，也合乎道德，除非你的情绪让你变得不人道、麻木不仁、对他人残忍。
他已经感觉不到寒冷了。

ingenuity.zh: 人类的创造力还在继续。

ingenuity.en: The clock was the greatest achievement of medieval mechanical ingenuity.
ingenuity.zh: 钟表是中世纪机械精巧装置的最大成就。

ingenuity.en: The ingenuity of Renaissance architects extended beyond merely using a material in a way not suggested by its outward natural appearance.
ingenuity.zh: 文艺复兴时期的建筑师的独创性不仅仅是使用一种材料，而是以一种不被其外在自然外观所暗示的方式。

cascade.en: If one firm goes under it could provoke a cascade of bankruptcies.
cascade.zh: 如果一家公司倒闭，可能会引起一连串的破产。

cascade.en: Her hair tumbled in a cascade down her back.
cascade.zh: 她的长发瀑布般地倾泻在后背上。

cascade.en: He crashed to the ground in a cascade of oil cans.
cascade.zh: 他随着一连串的油桶跌落坠地。

foreseeable.en: Profit and dividend growth looks above average for the foreseeable future.
foreseeable.zh: 利润和股息的增长看上去在可预见的将来会高于平均水平。

foreseeable.en: It seems to me that this crime was foreseeable and this death preventable.
foreseeable.zh: 在我看来这罪行是可预见的且这起死亡是可避免的。

foreseeable.en: They hold that the car will remain a leading means of urban travel in the foreseeable future.
foreseeable.zh: 他们认为，在可预见的将来，汽车仍将是城市交通的主要工具。

conscientious.en: We are generally very conscientious about our work.
conscientious.zh: 我们一般对工作都是很认真的。
中央电视台的记者很有责任心。

conscientious.en: She is very conscientious and never skimps her work.
conscientious.zh: 她办事认真，从不敷衍了事。

charisma.en: He was elected to power on the strength of his charisma.
He has neither the policies nor the personal charisma to inspire people.
charisma.zh: 他既没有谋略也没有个人魅力去鼓舞人。

charisma.en: Except for a patina of charisma, he was like a thousand other bright young men in Toronto.
charisma.zh: 除了小有点儿魅力外，他和多伦多其他众多机灵的年轻小伙子没有两样。

penguin.en: Pierre is a 25-year-old penguin at the California Academy of Sciences.
penguin.zh: 这只企鹅名为皮埃尔，25岁，来自加利福尼亚科学院。

penguin.en: Penguin hopes the site will attract agents, editors and publishers scouting for new talent.
penguin.zh: 企鹅出版社希望这个网站能够吸引代理商、编辑和出版商来挖掘新的人才。

optimize.en: Companies can also optimize their energy use and cut down on the cost of electricity.
optimize.zh: 企业还可以优化能源使用，降低用电成本。

optimize.en: Some AI software can analyze and optimize marketing email subject lines to increase open rates.
optimize.zh: 一些人工智能软件能够分析和优化营销邮件主题，以提高邮件查看率。

optimize.en: China is making efforts to optimize the use of educational resources so that rural and underdeveloped areas can receive more support.
optimize.zh: 中国正在努力优化教育资源的使用，以使农村和欠发达地区能够得到更多的支持。

subtitle.en: "Kathleen" was, as its 1892 subtitle asserted, "An Irish Drama."
subtitle.zh: 如其1892年版的副标题所说的，《凯瑟琳》是“一部爱尔兰戏剧”。

subtitle.en: The subtitle was How Sugar is Killing Us.
subtitle.zh: 副标题是糖是如何杀死我们的。

subtitle.en: But it is less clear, to take the question of his subtitle, Why We Should Like, Care.
subtitle.zh: 但就他的副标题“我们为什么应该喜爱和关心”这个问题而言，答案就不那么清楚了。

decry.en: Others decry what they see as outside forces running roughshod over the old Harlem.
decry.zh: 另一些人则谴责他们所看到的外部势力对哈莱姆旧城区横行霸道。

decry.en: He is impatient with those who decry the plan.
decry.zh: 他无法忍受那些批评这项计划的人。

decry.en: But I'm not here to decry the evils of touchscreen typing.
decry.zh: 当然我这么说绝对不是为了念叨触摸屏输入的种种不是。

apprehend.en: Local people demanded that the police apprehend the miscreants.
apprehend.zh: 当地人要求警方逮捕那些恶棍。

apprehend.en: Apprehend God in all things, for God is in all things.
apprehend.zh: 在万物中领会上帝，因为上帝存在于万物中。

fennel.en: Toss arugula with fennel, add grapefruit and avocado, and gently toss.
fennel.zh: 在茴香里放入芝麻，添加葡萄柚和鳄梨，轻轻地搅拌。

fennel.en: Thick spears of asparagus and fennel were draped with thinly sliced ham.
fennel.zh: 厚厚的芦笋和茴香夹在切的薄薄的火腿片里。

tyrant.en: He is a tyrant who knows no pity.
tyrant.zh: 他是一个不知怜悯的暴君。

tyrant.en: "Geppetto looks like a good man," added another, "but with boys he's a real tyrant."
tyrant.zh: “杰佩托看上去是个好人，”另一个补充说，“但对孩子们来说，他真是个暴君。”

tyrant.en: Sin is a harsh tyrant in your life. But Christ not only died for our sins, he died to sin.
tyrant.zh: 罪是你生命中的一个残酷暴君。但是基督不仅为我们的罪舍命，而且他向罪而死。

predominant.zh: 曼迪的主导情绪是困惑。

predominant.en: In Greece, rhododendrons and oleander bloom only in springtime, when they are the predominant sources of nectar.
predominant.zh: 在希腊，杜鹃花和夹竹桃只在春天开花，那时它们是花蜜的主要来源。

predominant.en: The archaeological evidence clearly indicates, though, that Teotihuacán was the center that did arise as the predominant force in the area by the first century A.D.
predominant.zh: 然而，考古证据清楚地表明，特奥蒂瓦坎是一个中心，在公元一世纪崛起成为该地区主导力量。

depletion.en: What they find could provide clues to what might happen worldwide if ozone depletion continues.
depletion.zh: 如果臭氧的损耗继续下去，他们的发现能为全世界可能发生的情况提供线索。

depletion.en: In modern agriculture, mineral depletion of soils is a major concern, since harvesting crops interrupts the recycling of nutrients back to the soil.
depletion.zh: 在现代农业中，土壤的矿物损耗是一个主要的问题，因为收割农作物会中断养分的循环，使其无法重新回到土壤中。

depletion.en: There are no legal limits, as there are for cod and haddock, on the size of monkfish that can be caught, a circumstance that contributes to their depletion through overfishing.
depletion.zh: 像对鳕鱼和黑线鳕那样，法律没有限制对安康鱼的捕捞，这种情况导致了过度捕捞，从而导致了它们的枯竭。

fidelity.en: Fidelity means accuracy of the copying process.
fidelity.zh: 保真度是指复制过程的准确性。

fidelity.en: People have failed to act in fidelity to their vows.
fidelity.zh: 人们没能忠诚地履行自己的誓言。

knack.en: He's got a real knack for making money.
He's got the knack of getting people to listen.
knack.zh: 他有让人们倾听的诀窍。

knack.en: Chapman was the family clown, with a knack for making a joke out of any situation.
knack.zh: 查普曼是家里的诙谐人物，他有诀窍在任何场合开玩笑。

violet.en: The light was beginning to drain from a violet sky.
violet.zh: 光线正开始从紫罗兰色的天空中渐渐消失。

violet.en: Red and violet are at opposite ends of the spectrum.
violet.zh: 红色和紫色位于光谱的两端。
我的毛笔是紫罗兰色的。

highland.en: There is something undeniably soulful about the eerie whine of the highland bagpipes.
highland.zh: 高原风笛神秘的哀鸣有着不容置疑的深情。

highland.en: Although the kilt is typically regarded as being Highland dress, more kilts are now worn in the Lowland cities than in the Highlands.
highland.zh: 虽然女式格呢褶裙被看作是典型的高地服饰，但如今一些低地城市的人们更常穿着。

highland.en: The clay deposits are scattered all over, in ancient volcanic surfaces and heavily cratered highland regions, some of which have apparently been exposed by erosion only recently.
highland.zh: 粘土沉积分布在古代的火山表面和坑坑洼洼的高原地区，其中一些显然是最近才由于侵蚀而暴露出来的。

serpent.en: I'm NOT a serpent, I tell you!
Eve persuaded by the serpent, persuades Adam to do what was forbidden by God.
serpent.zh: 夏娃被蛇劝服，说服亚当去做上帝所禁止的事。

languish.en: The red should languish and the green must grow?
Why do so many young black men languish behind bars?
languish.zh: 为什么那么多年轻黑人会在狱窗下度日？

languish.en: Fresh foods and leftovers languish on crowded shelves and eventually go bad.
languish.zh: 新鲜的食物和剩饭在拥挤的架子上减减变质，最后变坏。

instructive.en: The Hawaiian Islands provided a very instructive answer.
instructive.zh: 夏威夷群岛提供了一个非常有益的答案。

instructive.en: It is instructive to see how other countries are tackling the problem.
instructive.zh: 了解别的国家如何处理这个问题是具有启发性的。

instructive.en: While it will be fun, the seminar also promises to be most instructive.
instructive.zh: 这次专题讨论会将会很有趣，也一定会非常有启发性。

commotion.en: Tolstoy was hardly aware of all the commotion.
commotion.zh: 对于这一切骚动，托尔斯泰几乎无知无觉。

commotion.en: Behind all of this commotion are day traders, those creatures of the dot-com era.
commotion.zh: 在这一切骚动的背后是短线操盘手，他们是网络时代的产物。

commotion.en: Noticing the commotion, she reached into her purse for a handful of hard candies and offered them to the kids in return for their good behavior.
commotion.zh: 她注意到骚动，从钱包里掏出一把硬糖，给了表现好的孩子们。

incomprehensible.zh: 他嘟嘟囔囔地不知说了些什么。

incomprehensible.en: He found his son's actions totally incomprehensible.
incomprehensible.zh: 他感觉儿子的行为完全无法理解。

spasm.en: The injection sent his leg into spasm.
spasm.zh: 一针打下去，他的腿就痉挛了。

spasm.en: I had slipped a disc and was frozen in a spasm of pain.
spasm.zh: 我的一块椎间盘脱臼了，突然一阵疼痛使我动弹不得。

spasm.en: A muscular spasm in the coronary artery can cause a heart attack.
spasm.zh: 冠状动脉内肌肉痉挛会导致心脏病发作。

glucose.zh: 糖尿病患者不能使葡萄糖进行恰当的新陈代谢。

glucose.en: The levels of blood glucose depend in part on what you eat and when you eat.
glucose.zh: 血糖水平在一定程度上依赖于你吃什么及什么时候吃。

discontinue.en: They either sell a product at a given price or discontinue it.
discontinue.zh: 他们要么以固定的价格销售产品，要么停止销售。

discontinue.en: Labour likewise wants to discontinue local planning where councils oppose development.
discontinue.zh: 工党同样希望在议会反对发展的情况下停止地方规划。

discontinue.en: If the attrition problem cannot be successfully addressed, Hachnut should discontinue the sponsorship program.
discontinue.zh: 如果损耗问题不能被成功地解决，Hachnut 应该停止赞助项目。

streamline.en: They're making efforts to streamline their normally cumbersome bureaucracy.
streamline.zh: 他们正努力提高其通常臃肿的官僚机构的效率。

streamline.en: Huxley speculated that a coat of hair would insulate against loss of body heat and might streamline the body to reduce drag in flight.
streamline.zh: 赫胥黎推测，一层毛发可以隔离身体热量的流失，并可能使身体呈现流线型，以减少飞行中的阻力。

beggar.en: He tossed a penny to the beggar.
A beggar came up to us and ask for money.
beggar.zh: 一个乞丐走过来向我们要钱。

beggar.en: The soldier said, "Mind thy manners, thou young beggar!"
beggar.zh: 士兵说：“注意你的举止，你这个小乞丐！”

squander.en: Similarly, a plant or animal cannot squander all its energy on growing a big body if none would be left over for reproduction, for this is the surest way to extinction.
squander.zh: 同样，如果一种植物或动物没有留下任何可以繁殖的后代，它就不能把所有的能量浪费在使自己变得更强壮上，因为这是最可能走向灭绝的方式。

squander.en: We intend to campaign against specific projects which damage the environment or squander our resources, and fight for their correction with every legal means at our disposal.
squander.zh: 我们打算反对破坏环境或浪费我们资源的具体项目，并争取利用我们所掌握的一切法律手段加以纠正。

squander.en: Hobbs didn't squander his money on flashy cars or other vices.
squander.zh: 霍布斯没有把钱挥霍在奢华汽车或其他恶习上。

tripod.en: A tripod will be useful to align and steady the camera.
tripod.zh: 三脚架会有助于对齐稳住照相机。

tripod.en: The beast held tightly on the tripod and pressed it into my side.
tripod.zh: 那野兽紧紧抓住三脚架，把它压在我的身上。

tripod.en: I held my camera tripod in both hands to form a barrier as the bear rushed into me.
tripod.zh: 熊冲向我时，我双手拿着相机三脚架形成了一道障碍。

etiquette.en: This was such a great breach of etiquette, he hardly knew what to do.
etiquette.zh: 这是一起规矩的严重违反，他几乎不知所措了。

etiquette.en: Make sure you know British social etiquette.
etiquette.zh: 确保你知道英国的社交礼仪。

intestine.en: Mice that have been given morphine are very likely to develop blood poisoning because bacteria that normally reside in the intestine typically respond to morphine by migrating into the bloodstream.
intestine.zh: 摄入了吗啡的老鼠很可能会发生血液中毒，因为通常存在于肠道的细菌会通过迁移到血液中来对吗啡做出反应。

intestine.en: Models of segmental heterotopic small intestine transplantation were established using three sleevelet vascular anastomosis.
intestine.zh: 采用三袖套血管吻合法建立大鼠节段性异位小肠移植模型。

intestine.en: The key is to take a supplement of the two main probiotics we need for the intestine, lacto-bacillus acidophilus and bifidobacterium bifidum.
intestine.zh: 关键是补充肠道所需的两种主要益生菌：嗜酸乳杆菌和双歧杆菌。

fruitful.en: We had a long, happy, fruitful relationship.
fruitful.zh: 我们曾有一段长久、愉快而富有成效的关系。
事实证明他们的努力是有成效的。

fruitful.en: The work will be more fruitful under this plan.
fruitful.zh: 按照这一方案，做这工作将更有成效。

immature.en: He said that we were emotionally immature.
immature.zh: 他说我们在感情上是不成熟的。

immature.en: His speech is immature, his vocabulary limited.
immature.zh: 他讲话不成熟，词汇量也有限。

crushing.en: These are the first machines that can stand the wear and tear of continuously crushing glass.
crushing.zh: 这些是第一批能经得住连续碾碎玻璃造成的磨损的机器。

crushing.en: Use this knife to chop, slice and mince; the side of the blade can be used for crushing garlic and some spices.
crushing.zh: 用这刀剁碎、切片或切碎物体；刀片侧面可以用于压碎大蒜和一些香料。

crushing.en: The avalanche forced its way down the mountain, crushing everything in its path.
crushing.zh: 雪崩冲下山来，摧毁了沿途的一切。

queer.en: His face was a queer pink colour.
If you ask me, there's something kind of queer going on.
queer.zh: 如果问起来的话，是有点奇怪。

fraught.zh: 有一阵令人焦虑的沉默。

fraught.en: It has been a somewhat fraught day.
fraught.zh: 这是令人颇为担忧的一天。

fraught.en: Things are as fraught as ever in the office.
fraught.zh: 办公室的情况和往常一样令人担心。

inadequacy.en: Why does social media trigger feelings of loneliness and inadequacy?
inadequacy.zh: 为什么社交媒体会引发孤独感和不满足感？

inadequacy.en: This policy is far from being ideal, but it is at least an acknowledgement of the inadequacy of our language in treating half of human race equally.
inadequacy.zh: 这一政策并不理想，但至少承认了一个事实，即在平等对待他人方面，我们的语言仍有不足。

inadequacy.en: Chantelle's assertiveness stirred up his deep-seated sense of inadequacy.
inadequacy.zh: 仙黛尔的坚定自信激起了他根深蒂固的自卑感。

riddle.en: Scientists claimed yesterday to have solved the riddle of the birth of the universe.
riddle.zh: 科学家们昨天宣布已经解开了宇宙诞生之谜。

riddle.en: This is the riddle you have to solve.
riddle.zh: 这是你必须要解决的谜题。

torrent.en: The stream had become a raging torrent.
torrent.zh: 小溪变成了一条汹涌的急流。

torrent.en: The field trip involved crossing a raging torrent.
torrent.zh: 越野旅行包括跨越一条汹涌的急流。

torrent.en: Your willpower is not like a dam that can block the torrent of self-indulgence.
torrent.zh: 你的意志力不像可以阻止自我放纵的洪流的水坝。

locomotive.en: Energy to drive a steam locomotive can be stored in other materials besides water.
locomotive.zh: 驱动蒸汽机车的能量可以储存在除水以外的其他物质中。

locomotive.en: This was before the steam locomotive, and canal building was at its height.
locomotive.zh: 这些事情都发生在蒸汽火车出现之前，而且，运河修建在那时正处于繁荣时期。

locomotive.en: At the conductor's whistle the engine-driver starts his locomotive-engine.
locomotive.zh: 乘务员哨声一响， 司机开动机车。

beaver.en: Last fall a beaver moved into the small stream beside our house.
beaver.zh: 去年秋天，一只海狸搬进了我家旁边的小溪里。

beaver.en: Keep chewing like the beaver, and you will achieve your goal in the end.
beaver.zh: 继续像海狸一样咀嚼，你最终会实现你的目标的。

beaver.en: No one believes a beaver consciously weighs the pros and cons of each of these elements.
beaver.zh: 没人会相信一只海狸能有意识地去权衡每个要素的利弊。

durability.zh: 航空公司推荐使用硬边的提箱以求耐用。

durability.en: We have always advertised our use of the Endure process, but the new study shows that despite our socks' durability, our average customer actually purchases new Dura-Socks every three months.
durability.zh: 我们一直在宣传 Endure 的生产过程，但最新研究表明，尽管我们的袜子具有耐久性，但我们的普通客户实际上还是要每三个月购买一次新的 Dura-Socks。

durability.en: By offering services to help expand the longevity of their products, they're promising quality and durability to consumers, and receiving the reputational gains for being environmentally friendly.
durability.zh: 通过提供延长产品寿命的服务，他们向消费者承诺质量和耐用性，并获得了环保的赞誉。

primal.en: Perhaps that is why we explore the starry skies, as if answering a primal calling to know ourselves and our true ancestral homes.
primal.zh: 也许这就是我们探索星空的原因，仿佛在回应一种原始的召唤，去了解我们自己和我们祖先真正的家园。

primal.en: We experience a primal feeling of panic.
primal.zh: 我们主要感受着一种恐慌的情绪。

humankind.en: It was extremely important to the destiny of humankind.
humankind.zh: 它对人类的命运极其重要。

humankind.en: When Pandora's box was opened, it unleashed swarms of diseases and disasters upon humankind.
humankind.zh: 潘多拉的盒子打开之时，便给人类带来了无数的疾病和灾难。

humankind.en: It seems that humankind is to be destroyed because they irritate the gods with their tumult and noise.
humankind.zh: 似乎是人类是要被毁灭的，因为人类的骚乱和噪音惹怒众神。

mast.en: The collective name for mast, boom and sails on a boat is the 'rig'.
mast.zh: 船的桅杆、帆桁和帆总称为“索具”。

mast.en: It was Smee who tied her to the mast.
mast.zh: 是斯密把她绑在桅杆上的。

mast.en: He climbs the mast... Then he falls down!
mast.zh: 他爬上桅杆……然后他掉下来了！

nitrate.en: We need to cut nitrate levels in water.
nitrate.zh: 我们需要降低水中的硝酸盐含量。

nitrate.en: High levels of nitrate occur in the Midwest because of the heavy use of fertilizers.
nitrate.zh: 因为大量使用化肥，中西部地区的硝酸盐含量很高。

nitrate.en: Even nitrogen, which is a gas in its elemental state, is normally absorbed from the soil as nitrate ions.
nitrate.zh: 即使是元素状态为气体的氮，也通常作为硝酸根离子从土壤中被吸收。

shameful.en: He accused the company of "shameful foot-dragging."
shameful.zh: 他指责该公司犯有“可耻的故意拖延行为”。

shameful.en: It's shameful for him to tell a lie.
shameful.zh: 对他来说，撒谎是可耻的。

shameful.en: It was a shameful thing and a cruel!
shameful.zh: 这是一件可耻的、残忍的事！

groundwork.en: Yesterday's meeting was to lay the groundwork for the task ahead.
groundwork.zh: 昨天的会议为后面的任务打下了基础。

groundwork.en: Diplomats meeting in Chile have laid the groundwork for far-reaching environmental regulations.
groundwork.zh: 在智利会晤的外交官们已经为长远的环境保护规则奠定了基础。

groundwork.en: They had laid the groundwork for future development.
groundwork.zh: 他们为此后的发展奠定了基础。

utmost.en: Our resources are strained to the utmost.
This is a matter of the utmost importance.
utmost.zh: 这是个极其重要的问题。

utmost.en: He would have done his utmost to help her.
utmost.zh: 他本来会尽最大努力帮助她。

dogma.en: The Church's long-standing dogma was losing the great battle for the truth to rationalists and scientists.
dogma.zh: 在这场为真理而战的伟大斗争中，存在已久的教会教条输给了理性主义者和科学家。

dogma.en: She was cloned from a single cell of an adult female sheep, overturning long-held scientific dogma that had declared such a thing biologically impossible.
dogma.zh: 她是从一只成年母羊的单个细胞中克隆出来的，这推翻了长期以来一直坚持的科学教条，该教条宣称这样的事情在生物学上是不可能（发生）的。

dogma.en: Don't get stuck on unit testing dogma.
dogma.zh: 不要受单元测试的教条所限。

interstellar.en: Rather, they are dark because of interstellar dust that hides the stars behind it.
interstellar.zh: 相反，它们之所以是黑暗的，是因为星际尘埃将恒星隐藏在它的后面。

interstellar.en: The interstellar material, rather like terrestrial clouds, comes in all shapes and sizes.
interstellar.zh: 星际物质很像地球上的云，形状大小各异。

interstellar.en: Optical astronomy is most directly affected, for although interstellar gas is perfectly transparent, the dust is not.
interstellar.zh: 光学天文学受到最直接的影响，因为虽然星际气体是完全透明的，但尘埃却不是。

negligence.en: The accident was caused by negligence on the part of the driver.
negligence.zh: 事故是由于司机的过失造成的。

negligence.en: The accident was the result of negligence.
negligence.zh: 这次事故是由于疏忽所致。

negligence.en: The traffic accident was allegedly due to negligence.
negligence.zh: 这次车祸据说是由于疏忽造成的。

populace.en: He had the support of large sections of the local populace.
populace.zh: 他受到当地大部分百姓的拥护。
至于人民，却是可敬佩的。

populace.en: These backward folk were labeled as "fools" by the general populace.
populace.zh: 于是这些保守落后的人被平民大众贴上了“愚人”的标签。

elastic.en: Beat it until the dough is slightly elastic.
elastic.zh: 反复捶打，直到面团略有弹性。

elastic.en: The elastic at the waist gives a nice snug fit.
elastic.zh: 腰间的松紧带使衣服正好紧紧贴在身上。

elastic.en: Her long fair hair was fastened at the nape of her neck by an elastic band.
elastic.zh: 她长长的金发用一根橡皮筋扎在了脖子后面。

bandit.en: Jesse was an outlaw, a bandit, a criminal.
bandit.zh: 杰西曾是个逃犯、土匪、罪犯。

bandit.en: We'd name him Bandit and put a red bandanna around his neck.
bandit.zh: 我们会给他起名叫 Bandit，把红色的大手帕围在他的脖子上。
班迪特似乎改变了这种状况。

protrude.en: Sufferers complain of intensely creepy-crawly skin and odd fibrous strands which protrude from open wounds.
protrude.zh: 患者抱怨说，他们的皮肤非常令人毛骨悚然，并且伤口里还会有一些奇怪的纤维状的物质伸出来。

protrude.en: His large ears protrude from the side of his head and he listens for the slightest sound.
protrude.zh: 他的大耳朵从脑袋的一侧伸出来，倾听着最轻微的声音。

protrude.en: This allows the developing TE to protrude after blastulation, facilitating the biopsy.
protrude.zh: 这使得正在发育的 TE 在鼓泡后突出，从而促进了活检。

baffle.en: Sometimes the decisions baffle and enrage me.
baffle.zh: 有时候作出的决定使我困惑甚至愤怒。
最让父母挠头的孩子提问前20名。

baffle.en: The swindler tried to baffle him out of his money, but in vain.
baffle.zh: 骗子想骗取他的钱，可是没成功。

ore.en: They struck a rich seam of iron ore.
ore.zh: 他们开出一个富铁矿层。

ore.en: The net profit amounts to 20 dollars per ton of ore.
ore.zh: 每吨矿砂的净利达20美元。

ore.en: How many tons of ore can this machine crush in an hour?
ore.zh: 这机器每小时可以破碎多少吨矿石？

pavilion.en: At the centre of the lake, there is a pavilion.
The Cat Léon, the mascot of France Pavilion, will interact with every visitor.
pavilion.zh: 猫莱昂，法国馆的吉祥物，将与每一位游客互动。

precipitation.en: Precipitation is influenced by topography among other things.
precipitation.zh: 除其他因素外，降水还受到地形的影响。

precipitation.en: Second, most of the precipitation in the Arctic is in the form of snow.
precipitation.zh: 其次，北极的大部分降水形式为雪。

precipitation.en: All the models suggest some impact on the distribution of precipitation.
precipitation.zh: 所有的模型都显示出对降水分布的影响。

childish.zh: 她真是小孩子气，太冒失了。

childish.en: It's time you put a stop to this childish behaviour.
childish.zh: 这种孩子气的行为你该收敛了。

befriend.en: The readiness of the rats to befriend the social robot was surprising given its minimal design.
befriend.zh: 出人意料的是，这只社交机器鼠的设计如此简陋，老鼠却仍愿意与它交朋友。

befriend.en: Not only does Splat befriend every cat in his class, he even converts them to a mouse-free diet.
befriend.zh: 斯普莱不仅和他班上每一只猫交朋友，而且把他们全部变成不吃老鼠主义者。

befriend.en: If Hiccup was going to take a risk and befriend a dragon, it had to be the most frightening dragon in the world.
befriend.zh: 如果 Hiccup 冒着危险去和这条龙做朋友，那它一定要是世界上最可怕的巨龙。

obscenity.en: The editors are being prosecuted for obscenity.
obscenity.zh: 编辑因刊载污秽文字而被起诉。

obscenity.en: I have never forgotten that number, and it always comes to memory attended by gibbering obscenity, peals of joyless laughter and the clang of iron doors.
obscenity.zh: 我一直没有忘记那个号码，它总会出现在记忆中，伴随着混乱的肮脏事情、欢声笑语和铁门的叮当声。

obscenity.en: Even in the case of question about obscenity.
obscenity.zh: 即使是在淫秽这个问题上。

heroism.en: By their tremendous heroism, men such as Shakleton, Scott, and Amundsen caused a new continent to emerge from the shadows, and yet that heroic age, little more than a century old, is already passing.
heroism.zh: 沙克尔顿、斯科特和阿蒙森等人以他们巨大的英雄主义，使一个新大陆从阴影中浮现，但那个英雄时代，一个多世纪前，已经一去不复返了。

heroism.en: He received a medal for his heroism.
heroism.zh: 他由于英勇而获得一枚奖章。

interplay.en: The complex interplay of species in symbiotic relationships highlights an important point about communities: Their structure depends on a web of diverse connections among organisms.
interplay.zh: 物种在共生关系中复杂的相互作用突出了群落的一个重要特点：它们的结构取决于生物之间多样的联系网络。

interplay.en: The disk exerts its own gravitational tug, and this interplay of forces robs the planet of momentum in its orbital path, forcing it to spiral in toward the star.
interplay.zh: 圆盘产生自己的引力拖曳，这种相互作用的力夺走了行  星在其轨道上的动量，迫使它盘旋向恒星的方向。

interplay.en: It is a monumental scientific achievement, and its development illustrates the essential interplay between observation, prediction, and testing required for scientific progress.
interplay.zh: 它是一项不朽的科学发现，而且它的出现说明了观察、预测和检验（科研进程中必须的活动）之间基本的相互影响。

teamwork.en: There are three fundamental principles of teamwork.
teamwork.zh: 团队合作有三个基本原则。

teamwork.en: Teamwork is a key feature of the training programme.
teamwork.zh: 团队合作是这项训练计划的重要特点。

teamwork.en: Teamwork is required in order to achieve these aims.
teamwork.zh: 要达到这些目标需要齐心协力。

exhale.en: As the lungs exhale this waste, gas is expelled into the atmosphere.
exhale.zh: 当肺呼出这股废气，气体就被排到空气中。

exhale.en: Generally, you exhale on the effort, if doing weights, karate or boxing, and inhale on the return.
exhale.zh: 一般来说，如果你在做举重、空手道或拳击等运动用力时，你会呼气，然后吸气。

exhale.en: Without gravity to help circulate air, the carbon dioxide you exhale has a tendency to form an invisible cloud around your head.
exhale.zh: 如果没有重力帮助空气循环，你呼出的二氧化碳会在你头顶周围形成一个看不见的云状物。

alloy.en: Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin.
Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
The latest model features alloy wheels and an electronic alarm.
alloy.zh: 最新款式的特色是合金车轮和电子报警器。

wasp.en: A wasp flew in the open window.
wasp.zh: 一只黄蜂飞进了开着的窗子。

wasp.en: A wasp had flown in through the window.
wasp.zh: 一只黄蜂从窗口飞了进来。

wasp.en: A wasp or bee sting is painful but not necessarily serious.
wasp.zh: 被黄蜂或蜜蜂蜇一下疼是疼，但未必碍事。

mischief.en: It's very quiet upstairs; they must be up to some mischief !
mischief.zh: 楼上很安静。他们一定在搞什么恶作剧。
她眼睛里满是使坏的神情。

mischief.en: I try to keep out of mischief.

manhood.en: When in manhood, he goes erect on two feet and when in old age, he supports his tottering legs with a stick.
manhood.zh: 成年时，他用两只脚直立，年老时，他用一根棍子支撑着蹒跚的双腿。

manhood.en: Born in rude and abject poverty, he never had any education, except what he gave himself, till he was approaching manhood.
manhood.zh: 生于粗陋和赤贫之中，在接近成年之前，除了自学之外，他从未受过任何教育。

manhood.en: His handwriting, from earliest young manhood, was flowing and graceful.
manhood.zh: 从他刚刚成年时起，他的书法就流畅而优美。

aristocratic.en: Nabokov was the scion of an aristocratic family.
aristocratic.zh: 纳博科夫曾是一位贵族家庭的小少爷。

aristocratic.en: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
aristocratic.zh: 最成功的君主国努力摒弃或隐藏他们旧式贵族作风。

aristocratic.en: Their aristocratic outfit, aristocracy of birth, which is legitimized by their heroic behavior on the battlefield.
aristocratic.zh: 他们的贵族的身份和贵族出身，由于他们在战场上的英雄行为而被认可。

formative.en: The zoology program at my university attracts students for whom zoo visits were the crucial formative experience that led them to major in biological sciences.
formative.zh: 我就任高校的动物学课程所吸引的学生，就是因为参观动物园这一段至关重要的成长经历，才选择修读生物科学专业。

formative.en: My father was a sunday painter, and his art books played a formative role in my childhood.
formative.zh: 我的父亲是个业余画家，他的艺术书籍在我的童年时代起了很大的作用。
主要是定性的(结构化的)。

adjunct.en: Physical therapy is an important adjunct to drug treatments.
adjunct.zh: 物理治疗是对药物治疗的重要补充。

adjunct.en: "We are increasingly building our homes in fire-prone ecosystems," says Dominik Kulakowski, adjunct professor of biology at Clark University Graduate School of Geography in Worcester, Massachusetts.
adjunct.zh: 马萨诸塞州伍斯特市克拉克大学地理研究生院的生物学副教授多米尼克·库拉科夫斯基说：“越来越多的人把房子建在了容易起火的环境之中。”

adjunct.en: Instead, they might be in adjunct or visiting positions.
