ravage.zh: 而他从不会毁坏花草，当然也不会是在公墓里。

ravage.en: Global droughts continue to ravage farmland, intensifying widespread malnutrition and poverty.
ravage.zh: 全球性干旱继续肆虐农田，进一步加剧普遍的营养不良和贫困。

plush.en: The Carlton-intercontinental hotel is lush, plush, and very non- backpacker.
plush.zh: 卡尔顿洲际酒店豪华舒适，背包徒步旅行者是绝对住不起的。

plush.en: The plush chairs absorb sound and soften reverberation.
plush.zh: 毛绒椅能吸收声音和软化混响。

plush.en: I am planning a trip to the United States and I'll call on you at your office to discuss the price of the plush toy at 10:00 am, TUE, SEP 18, 2005.
plush.zh: 我计划到美国一趟，并将于2005年9月18日星期二上午10点到您的办公室楼拜访您，讨论毛绒玩具的价钱。

plumber.en: This past week, a plumber completed work at my residence.
plumber.zh: 上周，一位水管工在我的住所完成了工作。

plumber.en: At the age of 74, he is still going strong as the oldest plumber in business in Boise, Idaho.
plumber.zh: 尽管他已经74岁高龄，但身体依然很健壮，是爱达荷州博伊西市商界中最老的水管工。

plumber.en: In my view, it is just as great an achievement to be a plumber or a bricklayer as it is to be a lawyer or a doctor.
plumber.zh: 在我看来，做一名水管工人或者砖匠，同做一名律师或者医生相比，所取得的成就是同样伟大的。

specialization.en: A caste system consists of ranked groups, each with a different economic specialization.
specialization.zh: 种姓制度由等级群体组成，每个群体具有不同的经济专业化。

specialization.en: Hundreds of others are more obscure in their meanings and testify to the amazing specialization in medieval arts, crafts and functions.
specialization.zh: 其他成百上千的词在含义上更加模糊，证明了中世纪艺术、工艺和功能的惊人专业化。

specialization.en: Evidence of specialization in producing raw materials and in manufacturing ceramics and textiles indicates differentiation of labor within and between communities.
specialization.zh: 生产原材料和制造陶瓷和纺织品的专业化证据表明了社区内部和社区之间的劳动差异。

latent.en: These children have a huge reserve of latent talent.
latent.zh: 这些孩子蕴藏着极大的潜在天赋。

latent.en: Advertisements attempt to project a latent meaning behind an overt message.
latent.zh: 广告试图传达一种隐藏在公开信息里的潜在意义。

latent.en: For systems transforming solar to thermal energy, the thermal energy may be stored in matter as either latent heat or sensible heat.
latent.zh: 对于将太阳能转化为热能的系统，热能可能以潜热或显热的形式存储在物质中。

disqualify.en: Since a workplace injury would disqualify an employee from such programs, some employees might be concealing injury, when it is feasible to do so.
disqualify.zh: 由于工伤会使员工失去参加这类项目的资格，一些员工可能会在可行的情况下隐瞒工伤。

disqualify.en: The lack of a good education might disqualify you from some jobs.
disqualify.zh: 由于缺乏良好的教育，可能使你不适合做某些工作。

disqualify.en: Invigilators warn or disqualify test-takers whose eyes or hands wander in suspicious ways.
disqualify.zh: 考生四处张望或者举止可疑时，监考官就会警告考生或者取消其考试资格。

wherein.en: Wherein lies the difference between conservatism and liberalism?
wherein.zh: 保守主义和自由主义的区别在哪里？

wherein.en: O, Venice is a fine city, wherein a rat can wander at his ease and take his pleasure!
wherein.zh: 啊，威尼斯是一座美丽的城市，在那里，老鼠可以自由自在地闲逛，尽情享乐！

formality.zh: 她拘谨地按礼节向他致意。

formality.en: Different levels of formality are appropriate in different situations.
formality.zh: 不同程度的注重礼节适用于不同场合。

formality.en: He has the greatest disregard for all formality.

waterproof.en: Take waterproof clothing – Oregon weather is unpredictable.
waterproof.zh: 带上防水的衣物吧–俄勒冈州的天气总是难以预测。

waterproof.en: The traditional backpack with a difference—it's waterproof.
waterproof.zh: 这个跟传统背包不同—它防水。

desolate.en: Today it's pretty desolate, barren and extremely hot.
desolate.zh: 现今那里非常荒凉、土地贫瘠，而且极其炎热。

desolate.en: He lives in a great, big, desolate old house in the country and no one goes near him.
desolate.zh: 他住在乡下一幢又大又荒凉的的老房子里，没有人接近他。

desolate.en: When plants first made the transition ashore more than 400 million years ago, the land was barren and desolate, inhospitable to life.
desolate.zh: 4亿多年前，植物第一次向海岸上迁移时，陆地上荒凉而贫瘠，并非生命宜居之地。

skew.zh: 识别潜在的歪斜和异常值。

skew.en: However there is some notable right skew.
skew.zh: 但是有一个非常显著的右歪斜。

skew.en: A few outliers skew the data, they say.
skew.zh: 他们表示：少数外行曲解了研究数据。

torment.en: After years of turmoil and torment, she is finally at peace.
torment.zh: 经历多年的动荡与痛苦后，她终于安心下来了。
你说：“不要这样折磨我——我说出来就是了。”

torment.en: The hours wasted away, and hunger came to torment the captives again.
torment.zh: 时间一分一秒地过去了，饥饿再次折磨着他们。

meteorite.en: The blast may have vaporized the meteorite.
meteorite.zh: 爆炸可能使陨石汽化了。

meteorite.en: The Allende meteorite is classified as a chondrite.
meteorite.zh: 阿连德陨石被归类为球粒陨石。

retaliate.en: It takes the most levelheaded and good-tempered of drivers to resist the temptation to retaliate when subjected to uncivilized behavior.
retaliate.zh: 只有头脑最冷静、脾气最好的司机，才能在遇到不文明行为时抵制报复的诱惑。

retaliate.en: It takes the most cool-headed and good-tempered of drivers to resist the temptation to retaliate when subjected to uncivilized behavior.
retaliate.zh: 当遇到不文明的行为时，只有头脑最冷静、脾气最好的司机才能忍住不报复。

retaliate.en: He had authorization from the military command to retaliate.
retaliate.zh: 他得到了军事指挥部进行还击的授权。

momentary.en: Such momentary thoughts were represented in words and passed down across generations.
momentary.zh: 这种瞬间的想法通过文字表达出来，代代相传。

momentary.en: The lights go off, and the din of the tourists turns from a momentary grumble of protest to a greedy growl to whispered disappointment.
momentary.zh: 灯光熄灭了，一时间游客的噪声从短暂的抗议的抱怨声变成了贪婪的咆哮声，接着变成了失望的低语声。

momentary.en: A momentary hush; the orchestra leader varies his rhythm obligingly for her, and there is a burst of chatter as the erroneous news goes around that she is Gilda Gray's understudy from the Follies.
momentary.zh: 短暂的安静；乐队指挥亲切地为她变换节奏，当她是吉尔达·格雷在《愚蠢》里的替补演员的错误消息传开时，大家议论纷纷。

impersonal.en: Their mating ritual is just so impersonal.
impersonal.zh: 它们的求偶仪式是如此的没有人情味。

impersonal.en: It's just that, it's so impersonal, I'm not used to it.
impersonal.zh: 只是，这太没有人情味了，我不习惯。

impersonal.en: The majority of the population live in massive tower blocks, noisy, dirty and impersonal.
impersonal.zh: 大多数人住在高楼大厦里，那里嘈杂、肮脏、还没有人情味。

misuse.en: The new law toughens up penalties for those that misuse guns.
misuse.zh: 这部新法律加强了对滥用枪支者的惩处。

misuse.en: He was eventually convicted for the misuse of official funds.
misuse.zh: 最终他因滥用公款被判有罪。

misuse.en: Misuse of a fire extinguisher will result in fines.

pervade.en: Tablets are newer and just beginning to pervade the market.
pervade.zh: 平板电脑较新且刚刚开始蔓延于市场。

pervade.en: However, biases against women still pervade many places on the Internet.
pervade.zh: 但是，网络上对于女性的歧视仍然屡见不鲜。

pervade.en: Expressionist graphics, decisive slogans and modernist wit pervade these images.
pervade.zh: 表象派作家生动的，坚定的标语和现代主义作者遍及街头的风趣画作。

negligible.en: The company says the cost of relocation will be negligible.
negligible.zh: 公司说迁移的费用微不足道。
它的影响是相当微不足道的。

arcade.en: We jump on our bikes and peddle off to the arcade.
arcade.zh: 我们跳上我们单车，骑车去拱廊。

arcade.en: We know this new shopping arcade is ready for lease.
arcade.zh: 我们知道这栋新的购物商场已准备好出租。

arcade.en: They want arcade games and rides in helicopters and goodness knows what else.
arcade.zh: 他们想玩街机游戏，坐直升机，天知道还有什么。

anesthesia.en: For example, in the fruit fly, researchers have identified the gene Shaker, mutations in which cause flies to shake violently under anesthesia.
anesthesia.zh: 例如，在果蝇身上，研究人员发现了基因震荡器，这种突变导致果蝇在麻醉下剧烈摇晃。

anesthesia.en: The project was inspired by a French team from Rouen University Hospital Centre where examinations are done under hypnosis instead of general anesthesia.
anesthesia.zh: 该项目受到来自鲁昂大学医院中心的一个法国团队的启发，那里的检查是在催眠下进行的，而不是全身麻醉。

anesthesia.en: Only a few other drugs, such as methohexital, etomidate, or propofol have the capability to induce anesthesia so rapidly.
anesthesia.zh: 只有少数其他药物，如美索比妥、依托咪酯、异丙酚有能力迅速诱导麻醉。

suspense.en: She waited in an agony of suspense.
I couldn't bear the suspense a moment longer.
suspense.zh: 这样提心吊胆，我一刻也受不了了。

handout.en: I have a handout, an article on pedodiversity in a section of forests near here.
handout.zh: 我有一份讲义，一篇关于附近森林中土壤多样性的文章。

handout.en: You actually see this near the top of the handout, the allusion from the Faerie Queene.
handout.zh: 事实上你们可以在讲义的顶部看到，《仙后》的暗喻。

handout.en: Explaining the difference between each is beyond the scope of this handout and unnecessary to know in order to answer the questions.
handout.zh: 解释两者之间的区别超出了本讲义的范围，而为了回答问题，是没有必要知道它们之间的区别的。

analytic.en: For one thing, excellent writing ability is beneficial to people's logical think and analytic ability.
analytic.zh: 一方面，优秀的写作能力有利于人们的逻辑思维和分析能力。

analytic.en: Linda, co-founder of Scores, a leading digital analytic company, established her organization on a simple premise.
analytic.zh: 领先的斯科尔数字分析公司的联合创始人琳达，在简易的前提下建立了自己的组织。
我还会有这样的分析能力吗？

sexism.en: Sexism is deeply entrenched in our society.
sexism.zh: 性别歧视在我们这个社会根深蒂固。

sexism.en: You're always talking in isms—sexism, ageism, racism.
sexism.zh: 你张口闭口就是各种歧视—性别歧视、年龄歧视、种族歧视。

sexism.en: It's got nothing to do with sexism. You know I'm not a sexist.
sexism.zh: 这与性别歧视毫无关系。你知道我不是个性别歧视者。

literate.en: Your children should be literate and numerate.
literate.zh: 你的孩子们应该会识字识数。

literate.en: All students should be numerate and literate when they leave school.
literate.zh: 所有的学生毕业时都应具备计算和读写的能力。

literate.en: We look for applicants who are good with numbers, computer-literate, and energetic self-starters.
literate.zh: 我们找精于计算、懂电脑、精力充沛、工作主动的申请人。

endemic.en: Today, this creature is known as the kangaroo, a widespread marsupial endemic to Australia.
endemic.zh: 今天，这种生物被称为袋鼠，是澳大利亚特有的有袋动物。

endemic.en: Malaria is endemic in many hot countries.
endemic.zh: 疟疾是许多气候炎热国家的流行病。

endemic.en: Polio was then endemic among children my age.
endemic.zh: 小儿麻痹症在当时是在我这个年纪的儿童中常见的疾病。

rapport.en: The success depends on good rapport between interviewer and interviewee.
rapport.zh: 成功取决于采访者和被采访者之间的融洽。

rapport.en: She understood the importance of establishing a close rapport with clients.
rapport.zh: 她懂得与客户建立密切和谐的关系的重要性。

rapport.en: In small groups we have a better chance to initiate contact and establish rapport with them.
rapport.zh: 在小团体中，我们有更好的机会互相接触，并建立融洽的关系。

resin.en: The plastic resin is used in a wide range of products, including electrical wire insulation.
resin.zh: 塑料合成树脂被广泛应用到各种产品中，包括电线的绝缘层。

resin.en: The bark was stretched over frames made from tree branches, stitched together and sealed with resin.
resin.zh: 树皮被铺在由树枝制成的框架上，然后将它们缝合在一起，最后用树脂密封。

resin.en: The bark was stretched over frames made from tree branches, stitched together and sealed with resin—you know that the sticky liquid that comes out of the tree—and when it dries, it's watertight.
resin.zh: 树皮在用树枝做好的框架中被拉长、延展，然后缝合在一起并用树脂密封好，就是那些从树中流出的黏黏的液体。当它干了以后就不漏水了。

fresco.en: It was quite a posh al fresco affair: the waiter was even wearing a shirt, unlike many of his compatriots.
fresco.zh: 这是一场相当豪华的户外活动：侍者甚至穿着衬衫，不像他的许多同胞。

fresco.en: He turned to Teddy and asked, “What do you think of this old fresco?”
fresco.zh: 他转向泰迪，问道：“你觉得这幅古老的壁画怎么样？”

stupidity.zh: 她没想到自己竟会这样愚蠢。

stupidity.en: My own stupidity lost me the match.
stupidity.zh: 我个人的愚蠢使我输了这场比赛。

feeble.en: Don't be so feeble! Tell her you don't want to go.
feeble.zh: 别那么软弱了！告诉她你不想去。

feeble.en: At last a feeble voice replied, "Thank you so much, dear Ratty!"
feeble.zh: 最后，一个微弱无力的声音回答道：“非常感谢你，亲爱的鼠仔！”

windfall.en: The water treatment was new, now, and Tom's low condition was a windfall to her.
windfall.zh: 现在新出了水疗法，而正好汤姆状态低迷，这下她可来了劲儿。

windfall.en: An oil boom would also mean a multibillion-dollar windfall in tax revenues, royalties and leasing fees for Alaska and the Federal Government.
windfall.zh: 石油产业的繁荣还意味着阿拉斯加和联邦政府将获得数十亿美元的意外之财：税收收入、特许权使用费和租赁费。

windfall.en: An oil boom would also mean a multibillion dollar windfall in tax revenues, royalties and leasing fees for Alaska and the Federal Government.
windfall.zh: 石油产业的繁荣还意味着阿拉斯加和联邦政府将获得数十亿美元的意外之财：税收收入、特许权使用费和租赁费。

disintegration.en: The report describes the catastrophic disintegration of the aircraft after the explosion.
disintegration.zh: 该报道描述了爆炸后飞机的灾难性崩解。

disintegration.en: The incident has hastened the disintegration of the club.
disintegration.zh: 这一事件加速了该俱乐部的解体。

disintegration.en: Some of this can be attributed to the disintegration of traditional communities, in which neighbors looked out for one another, she says.
disintegration.zh: 她说，这其中的一部分原因可以归结于邻里和睦、互相照顾的传统社区的解体。

supplant.zh: 用一个积极的想法换掉它吧。

supplant.en: CAM is almost certainly here to stay and supplant its predecessors.
supplant.zh: 这里可以断言的是，CAM肯定会替代其前辈。

supplant.en: How could a tiny Internet retailer possibly supplant a national bookstore giant.
supplant.zh: 一个名不见经传的小小互联网零售商，怎么可能取代全美最大的连锁书店呢？

patriot.en: He was also regarded as a great patriot because not only did his cartoons praise America, but, during World War II, his studios made training films for American soldiers.
patriot.zh: 他也被认为是一个伟大的爱国者，不仅因为他的卡通赞扬美国，而且，在第二次世界大战期间，他的工作室为美国士兵制作训练电影。

patriot.en: Of or relating to a chauvinistic patriot.
patriot.zh: 沙文主义者的或与其有关的。

gallop.en: I read the book at a gallop.
I was forced to attempt a gallop.
gallop.zh: 我被迫尝试一次骑马疾驰。

gallop.en: My horse suddenly broke into a gallop.

rarity.en: It was a real prize due to its rarity and good condition.
rarity.zh: 它是一件真正的稀世珍品，因为它不但稀有而且保存完好。

rarity.en: The value of antiques will depend on their condition and rarity.
rarity.zh: 古董的价值依它们的保存状况和稀有程度而定。

rarity.en: Now for cost and rarity, spices aren't native to Europe and they had to be imported.
rarity.zh: 现在由于价格和稀有度，香料不是欧洲本土的，必须进口。

nobility.en: She seemed to personify goodness and nobility.
nobility.zh: 她似乎是善良和高贵的化身。

nobility.en: Most of them were the nobility and the landed gentry.
nobility.zh: 他们大部分是贵族和地主阶层。

nobility.en: In Norman England, the greyhound was a symbol of nobility.
nobility.zh: 在诺曼时期的英格兰，灰狗是高贵一种象征。

rudimentary.en: Fossilized remains of Acanthostega, a primitive fish, reveal that even though the animal had rudimentary limbs, it could not walk on land.
rudimentary.zh: 棘螈是一种原始鱼类，它的化石遗迹显示，尽管棘螈有基本的四肢，但它却不能在陆地上行走。

rudimentary.en: He received rudimentary village schooling, but mostly he roamed his uncle's farm collecting the fossils that were so abundant in the rocks of the Cotswold hills.
rudimentary.zh: 他只在乡村学校接受了最基本的教育，但大部分时间都在叔叔的农场里游荡，收集科茨沃尔德丘陵中充裕的化石。
有些恐龙只有未充分长成的牙齿。

mite.en: ladybird larvae are among the biggest friends we gardeners have. They're ferocious predators on problem whitefly and red spider mite.
mite.zh: 幼瓢虫就是园丁们最大的朋友之一，它们是凶猛的食肉动物，专门对付白粉虱和红蜘蛛螨。

mite.en: But this can also get a mite tedious.
mite.zh: 但是，他的这种写法可能有那么一点点令人乏味。

mite.en: Old pillows are rich in mite dung and human skin flakes.
mite.zh: 旧枕头螨粪多，会让人的皮肤受损。

counteract.en: These exercises aim to counteract the effects of stress and tension.
counteract.zh: 这些训练旨在抵消压力与紧张的影响。

counteract.en: The power of red wine to counteract high cholesterol has been ballyhooed in the press.
counteract.zh: 红酒中和高胆固醇的功效在媒体上被夸大了。

counteract.en: He allows them to give advice on how to develop his strengths or counteract his weaknesses.
counteract.zh: 他允许他们就如何发展他的优势或抵消他的弱点给出建议。

detached.en: One necessary condition seems to be a somewhat detached view of human problems.
detached.zh: 一个必要的条件似乎是某种对人类难题超然客观的看法。

airtight.en: Food will last longer if kept in an airtight container.
airtight.zh: 如果贮藏在密封的容器里，食物能保持比较久的时间。

airtight.en: Store the peppercorns in an airtight container and grind the pepper as you need it.
airtight.zh: 将胡椒子储藏在密封容器里，当你需要的时候把它磨成粉。

airtight.en: The casing is nearly airtight, which helps protect the vulnerable egg and later larva.
airtight.zh: 外层几乎是密封的，可以保护脆弱的蜂卵，以及后来的幼虫。

delinquency.en: With correct guidance and good parenting, I believe juvenile delinquency can be reduced.
delinquency.zh: 有正确的引导和良好的教养，我相信青少年犯罪的事件是可以减少的。

delinquency.en: With the correct guidance and good parenting, I believe juvenile delinquency can be reduced.
delinquency.zh: 我相信在正确引导和良好教养下，青少年犯罪可以减少。

burrow.en: They go back to their own burrow.
I come out of my burrow only at night to find food.
burrow.zh: 我只在夜间从洞穴中出来寻找食物。

burrow.en: The trip to the burrow prevents the squirrel from getting too hot.
burrow.zh: 回到地洞可以防止松鼠变得太热。

replenish.en: The cavalry must immediately replenish the new horse.
replenish.zh: 骑兵部队必须立即补充新马。

replenish.en: If you replenish the ice sheets and frozen waters of the high latitudes, more light will be reflected back into space, so reducing the warming of the oceans and atmosphere.
replenish.zh: 如果高纬度地区的冰原和冻结的水得到补充，更多的光将被反射回太空，从而减缓海洋和大气的变暖。

camouflage.en: They were dressed in camouflage and carried automatic rifles.
camouflage.zh: 他们身着迷彩服，手持自动步枪。

camouflage.en: There was much laughter – a perfect camouflage for the anxiety of waiting for the verdict in the trial.
camouflage.zh: 笑声不断–审判中等待裁决时焦虑的最佳掩饰。

camouflage.en: One of its adaptations is basically camouflage.
camouflage.zh: 它的一种基本的适应性是伪装。

agitate.en: All you need to do is gently agitate the water with a finger or paintbrush.
agitate.zh: 你只需要用手指或刷子轻轻搅动水。

agitate.en: Fully agitate and aerify the pulp before flotation.

proficient.en: A great number of Egyptians are proficient in foreign languages.
Boys test better in hand-eye coordination, making them more proficient at ball sports.
proficient.zh: 男孩在手眼协调测试中更出色，这使他们更精通球类运动。

utterance.en: They lack the kind of structure that enables us to divide a human utterance into words.
utterance.zh: 它们缺乏那种能让我们把人类的话语分解成词语的结构。

utterance.en: Its images, allusions, and diction are conspicuously remote from the common "range of utterance".
utterance.zh: 它的形象、典喻和措辞明显远离普通的“话语范围”。

utterance.en: You begin to infer a context for the text, for instance, by making decisions about what kind of speech event is involved: Who is making the utterance, to whom, when and where.
utterance.zh: 例如，你可以通过判定文本涉及何种类型的语言情景，来推测文章的语境：是谁在说话，对谁说话，何时何地。

trolley.en: He took a northbound trolley on State Street.
trolley.zh: 他在州大街坐上了一辆北行的有轨电车。

trolley.en: It was a woman, pushing an old shopping trolley which was piled with bags.
trolley.zh: 那是一个女人，推着一个堆满袋子的旧购物车。

requisite.en: She lacks the requisite experience for the job.
requisite.zh: 她缺少做这份工作所必需的经验。

requisite.en: A university degree has become a requisite for entry into most professions.
requisite.zh: 大学学位已经成为在大多数行业谋职的必要条件。

bent.en: The knives were bent out of shape.
bent.zh: 那些刀已经弯曲变形了。

bent.en: He bent his head and kissed her.

hectic.zh: 这个周末忙乱得一塌糊涂。

hectic.en: My life was very hectic but empty before I met him.
hectic.zh: 我的生活在遇见他之前忙碌却空虚。

hectic.en: It seems to ease all the aches and pains of a hectic and tiring day.
hectic.zh: 它似乎可以减轻繁忙疲劳的一天带来的所有疼痛。

metropolis.en: Clearly, much planning and central control were involved in the expansion and ordering of this great metropolis.
metropolis.zh: 显然，这座伟大都市的扩张和秩序都经过了精心的规划和集中管控。

metropolis.en: Dressed in their traditional costumes, the castellers seem to epitomize an easier time, before Barcelona became a world metropolis and the Mediterranean's most dynamic city.
metropolis.zh: 在巴塞罗那成为世界大都市和地中海最具活力的城市之前，身着传统服装的叠人塔似乎是一个更安逸的时代的缩影。

metropolis.en: New Orleans is the metropolis of the American South.
metropolis.zh: 新奥尔良是美国南部的大都会。

stagnant.en: Reforming the stagnant economy requires harsh measures that would translate into job losses.
stagnant.zh: 改革停滞的经济需要严厉措施，而这将造成失业。

stagnant.en: Small business owners often ignore early warning signs of a stagnant market or of decaying profitability.
stagnant.zh: 小企业主往往忽视市场停滞或盈利能力下降的早期预警信号。

stagnant.en: While the Disc Depot's owners have apparently become wealthy enough to retire, profits at Carlo's Clothing have remained stagnant for the past three years.
stagnant.zh: 虽然 Disc Depot 的所有者显然已经足够富有，可以退休了，但是 Carlo's Clothing 的利润在过去三年中一直停滞不前。

gorge.en: Ahead was the deep V of a gorge with water pouring down it.
gorge.zh: 前面是陡深的V字形峡谷，水流倾泻而下。

gorge.en: Olduvai Gorge, an early hominid site in Tanzania, was found by a butterfly hunter who literally fell into its deep valley in 1911.
gorge.zh: 坦桑尼亚早期的原始人类遗址，奥杜瓦伊峡谷是1911年，一名蝴蝶猎人掉进峡谷深处时发现的。

exude.en: Brighter purples can exude a magical feeling.
exude.zh: 明亮的紫色可以散发出一种有魔力的感觉。

concussion.en: He was taken to hospital with concussion.
concussion.zh: 他因脑震荡被送进医院。

concussion.en: He was taken to the hospital with a concussion.
concussion.zh: 他因脑震荡被送进医院。

concussion.en: Nicky was rushed to the hospital with a concussion.
concussion.zh: 尼基由于脑震荡被迅速送往了医院。

detour.en: He was happy to make a detour for her convenience.
detour.zh: 为了方便她，他乐意绕道而行。

detour.en: We had to make a detour around the flooded fields.
detour.zh: 我们只得绕道避开被洪水淹没的田野。

detour.en: It's well worth making a detour to see the village.
detour.zh: 绕道去参观一下这村子很是值得。

accrue.en: Interest will accrue if you keep your money in a savings account.
accrue.zh: 如果把钱存入储蓄账户，就会自然生息。

accrue.en: While they may use a credit card for convenience, affluent people never let interest charges accrue.
accrue.zh: 虽然有钱人可能为了方便而使用信用卡，他们从来不让利息费累积。
又会得到怎样的公共政策结果？

magnesium.en: Almond can also help your sleep because it contains tryptophan and magnesium.
magnesium.zh: 杏仁一样可以帮助你的睡眠，因为它富含色氨酸和镁。

magnesium.en: It was generally accepted that volcanic rocks with such high levels of magnesium could not exist.
magnesium.zh: 人们普遍认为，具有如此高镁含量的火山岩是不可能存在的。

magnesium.en: First identified in 1969, komatiites are Earth's oldest known volcanic rocks and contain three times as much magnesium as do most volcanic rocks.
magnesium.zh: 科马提岩于1969年首次被发现，它是地球上已知的最古老的火山岩，含镁量是大多数火山岩的三倍。

fable.en: The old fable continues to echo down the centuries.
fable.zh: 这一古老的寓言流传了数个世纪。

fable.en: The fable is on the next page.
The fable is given on the next page.
fable.zh: 这篇寓言登在下一页上。

illustrator.zh: 她为一位插图画家当模特儿。

illustrator.en: There is one other early Romantic, who was an illustrator as well.
illustrator.zh: 还有一位早期的浪漫主义者，也是一位插画家。

illustrator.en: In ''On Thin Ice'', Richard Ellis, a writer and illustrator, paints a natural history of the icon of the north, the polar bear.
illustrator.zh: 在《薄冰之上》一书中，作家兼插画家理查·埃利斯描绘了北极图标，北极熊的自然史。

proton.en: Every time you had one more proton, you had another element.
proton.zh: 每发现多一个质子，就会多一种元素。

proton.en: Only then can they hope to describe conditions at the Big Bang, when all space and time was compressed into a volume far smaller than a proton.
proton.zh: 只有那样他们才能指望描述大爆炸的情况，所有的空间和时间全部在那时被压缩成一个远小于质子的体积。

proton.en: Heavy water is heavy because the hydrogen in it weighs twice as much as ordinary hydrogen (it has a proton and a neutron in its nucleus, instead of just a proton).
proton.zh: 重水之所以重是因为水中氢的重量是普通氢的两倍（它的原子核中有一个质子和一个中子，而不仅仅是一个质子）。

gull.en: The gull held the fish in its beak.
Several other subspecies of gull are found in the region.
gull.zh: 几个海鸥的其他亚种在此地区被找到。

gull.en: A lone sea gull flew across the sky.
gull.zh: 一只孤独的海鸥在空中飞过。

migratory.en: Some residents voiced concern that the rice could threaten certain species of rare migratory birds.
migratory.zh: 一些居民担心这种大米会威胁到某些稀有候鸟的生存。

migratory.en: To test the idea, caged night-migrating birds were placed on the floor of a planetarium during their migratory period.
migratory.zh: 为了验证这个想法，这些在夜晚迁徙的候鸟被关进笼子里，并且在它们的迁徙期间被放置在一个天文馆的地面上。

migratory.en: He noticed that as they fluttered around in the cage, they often launched themselves in the direction of their normal migratory route.
migratory.zh: 他注意到，当它们在笼子里到处飞的时候，通常会朝着常规的迁徙路线的方向。

potassium.zh: 西瓜含有维生素也有钾。

potassium.en: These chemicals modulate the effect of potassium.
potassium.zh: 这些化合物可以调节钾的功效。

potassium.en: The potassium content of foodstuffs is very variable.
potassium.zh: 食品中钾的含量是多变的。

regularity.en: Here is the image of the lines of trees and the metrical regularity of that verse that describes them.
regularity.zh: 这是排列成行的树的画面和描述它们的诗句的韵律规律性。

regularity.en: Clements and other early ecologists saw almost lawlike regularity in the order of succession, but that has not been substantiated.
regularity.zh: 克莱门茨和其他早期的生态学家认为，演替顺序中存在着几乎像法则一般的规律性，但这一点尚未得到证实。

regularity.en: Succession is influenced by many factors: the nature of the soil, exposure to sun and wind, regularity of precipitation, chance colonizations, and many other random processes.
regularity.zh: 演替受到许多因素的影响：土壤的性质、暴露于阳光和风中的时间、降水的规律性、偶然的殖民和许多其他随机因素。

pertain.en: The applied arts are thus bound by the laws of physics, which pertain to both the materials used in their making and the substances and things to be contained, supported, and sheltered.
pertain.zh: 因此，应用艺术受限于物理定律，而物理定律与所使用的材料、将要容纳、支撑和遮蔽的物质都息息相关。

pertain.en: The criteria will be different from those that pertain elsewhere.
pertain.zh: 这里的标准将不同于其他地方适用的标准。

ultrasound.zh: 超声波扫描显示她怀了双胞胎。

ultrasound.en: I had an ultrasound scan to see how the pregnancy was progressing.
ultrasound.zh: 我做了超声波扫描，检查妊娠情况。

ultrasound.en: Most women will be offered an ultrasound scan during pregnancy, although it's not obligatory.
ultrasound.zh: 大部分妇女怀孕期间都将进行超声波检查，尽管不是规定性的。

incidental.en: The winner of our Editors' Choice distinction, utilizes a special system that's capable of separating incidental RF interference from targeted jamming attacks.
incidental.zh: 我们的编辑选择的荣誉优胜者，利用了一种特殊的系统，能够将偶然的射频干扰从有针对性的干扰攻击中分离出来。

incidental.en: SimpliSafe, winner of our Editor's Choice distinction, utilizes a special system that's capable of separating incidental RF interference from targeted jamming attacks.
incidental.zh: SimpliSafe 是“编辑之选”奖项得主，它采用了一种特殊的系统，能够将偶然的射频干扰从有针对性的干扰攻击中分离出来。

incidental.en: The discovery was incidental to their main research.
incidental.zh: 这一发现是他们主要研究中的附带收获。

utilitarian.en: It was James Mill who was the best publicist for utilitarian ideas on government.
utilitarian.zh: 詹姆斯·米尔才是政府功利主义思想的最佳宣传家。

utilitarian.en: With the arguments about the lifeboat in mind, let's turn back to the philosophy, the utilitarian philosophy of Jeremy Bentham.
utilitarian.zh: 带着对救生艇上发生事件的讨论，让我们来回顾杰里米·边沁的功利主义哲学。

utilitarian.en: The emphasis of university programs today is now on the practical and the utilitarian, rather than on a general education or on personal development.
utilitarian.zh: 现在大学课程的重点是实用和功利，而不是通识教育或个人发展。

doubtless.en: He will doubtless try and persuade his colleagues to change their minds.
doubtless.zh: 他大概会尽力说服他的同事们改变主意。

doubtless.en: His direct, often abrasive approach will doubtless ruffle a few feathers.
doubtless.zh: 他那直截了当、常常很粗鲁的方式无疑会激怒一些人。

doubtless.en: Viruses and logic bombs can doubtless do great damage under some circumstances.
doubtless.zh: 病毒以及逻辑炸弹无疑会在某些情况下造成巨大损失。

aerobics.zh: 我每周做一次有氧健身运动。

aerobics.en: I don't do aerobics any more—it's too knackering.
aerobics.zh: 我再不做有氧健身操了—太累人了。

telegram.en: "I want to send a telegram."—"Fine, to whom?"
The president received a briefing by telegram.
telegram.zh: 总裁收到了一份电报简报。

cumbersome.en: Although the machine looks cumbersome, it is actually easy to use.
cumbersome.zh: 这机器虽然看起来笨重，其实使用起来很方便。

cumbersome.en: The organization changed its cumbersome title to something easier to remember.
cumbersome.zh: 这家机构把它那复杂累赘的名称改得好记一些了。

cumbersome.en: The process is cumbersome, expensive, and unreliable.
cumbersome.zh: 这个过程繁琐、昂贵而且不可靠。

agrarian.en: Of course, there is no going back to the agrarian past.
agrarian.zh: 当然，从信息时代退回到农耕时代是不可能的。

agrarian.en: When we were an agrarian nation, all cars were trucks.
agrarian.zh: 在我们是农业国家的时候，所有的车子都是卡车。

agrarian.en: The United States was largely an agrarian society then.
agrarian.zh: 当时，美国基本上是一个农业社会。

concurrent.en: It has been frequently assumed, but not proved, that the majority of the migrants in what has come to be called the Great Migration came from rural areas and were motivated by two concurrent factors.
concurrent.zh: 人们常常假设，但没有证据证明，在所谓的“大迁移”中，大多数移民来自农村地区，这是由两个同时发生的因素推动的。

concurrent.en: Galerie St. Etienne is holding three concurrent exhibitions.
concurrent.zh: 圣·艾蒂安美术馆在同时举办3场展览。

concurrent.en: He will actually be serving three concurrent five-year sentences.
concurrent.zh: 实际上他要同期服3个5年的刑期。

seaside.en: I had a grand day out at the seaside.
seaside.zh: 我在海边痛痛快快玩了一天。

seaside.en: I went to spend a few days at the seaside.
I collect shells and interesting seaside items.
seaside.zh: 我收集贝壳以及海边有趣的东西。

proliferate.en: For example, an excess of certain proteins can cause cells to proliferate abnormally and become cancerous; a lack of the protein insulin results in diabetes.
proliferate.zh: 例如，某些蛋白质的过量会导致细胞异常增殖并癌变；胰岛素蛋白质的缺乏会导致糖尿病。

proliferate.en: At the other extreme, we might successfully translocate the species, but within five or ten years that species could proliferate and become an invasive species.
proliferate.zh: 在另一个极端，我们可能会地转移这个物种，但是在5至10年内，这个物种可能会激增并成为一个入侵物种。

proliferate.en: In the corporate environment, it's easy for worksheet files to proliferate rapidly.
proliferate.zh: 在公司环境中，工作表文件很容易迅速扩散。

intermittent.en: So, even under normal situations, the gene flow among the subpopulations is more of an intermittent trickle than a steady stream.
intermittent.zh: 所以即使在正常条件下，这些亚物种间的基因流动也更像是一条断断续续的细流，而不是一条不停流淌的小溪。

intermittent.en: When the driver accelerated, the vacuum was insufficient to run the intermittent mode and the wipers would default to high speed.
intermittent.zh: 当司机加速时，真空不足以运行间歇模式，雨刷将默认为高速。

intermittent.en: Actual loss will depend upon the particular frequencies to which one is exposed, and whether the sound is continuous or intermittent.
intermittent.zh: 实际的损失将取决于暴露的特定频率，以及声音是连续的还是间歇的。

illiterate.en: A large percentage of the population is illiterate.
illiterate.zh: 人口中文盲的比例相当高。

illiterate.en: Try to imagine your life being illiterate.

sandstone.en: He set out to chisel a dog out of sandstone.
sandstone.zh: 他开始用凿子将砂岩雕刻成一只狗。

sandstone.en: Sand was deposited which hardened into sandstone.
sandstone.zh: 沙经沉积固结形成沙岩。

tulip.zh: 我们称这种狂热为“郁金香狂热”。

tulip.en: One particular tulip bulb was sold and exchanged for a small ship.
tulip.zh: 卖了一个特别的郁金香球茎，换来了一艘小船。

tulip.en: Panic spread like wild fire and the tulip market collapsed totally.
tulip.zh: 恐慌像野火一样蔓延，郁金香市场彻底崩溃。

inventive.en: He was amazingly inventive and resourceful, and played a major role in my career.
inventive.zh: 他极具创造力又足智多谋，在我的职业生涯中起了重要的作用。
她的头脑非常善于创新。

inventive.en: It inspired me to be more inventive with my own cooking.
inventive.zh: 它激励我在自己烹饪时更具创造力。

triangular.en: A usually triangular sail attached to the forestay or headstay of a sailboat.
triangular.zh: 一面通常是三角形的帆，安装在帆船的前桅支索或前支索上。

triangular.en: The stations in Aclima's arrays are triangular and measure 20 cm along a side.
triangular.zh: Aclima 阵列中的站是三角形的，沿一侧测量20厘米。

triangular.en: They used a kind of triangular graph paper to plot the three measurements against one another.
triangular.zh: 他们用一种三角形的坐标纸把三个测量值画在一起。

owing.en: Owing to staff shortages, there was no food on the plane.
owing.zh: 由于工作人员不足，飞机上没有食物。

owing.en: Owing to circumstances beyond our control , the flight to Rome has been cancelled.
owing.zh: 由于出现了我们无法控制的情况，飞往罗马的航班已被取消。

owing.en: Owing to bad weather, the plane had to change its course.
owing.zh: 由于天气恶劣, 飞机不得不更改航线。

wand.en: You can't simply wave a wand and get rid of nuclear weapons.
wand.zh: 你们不可能一挥魔杖就消除核武器。

wand.en: Visitors can expect to be searched with a metal-detecting wand.
wand.zh: 游客们可能会被用金属探测棒搜身。

wand.en: With a wave of her magic wand, she changed the frog into a handsome prince.
wand.zh: 她魔杖一挥，把青蛙变成了英俊的王子。

wry.en: His mouth twisted into a wry smile.
wry.zh: 他硬挤出一丝干涩的微笑。

engrave.en: The shop will also engrave your child's name on the side.
engrave.zh: 商店也将在一侧刻上你孩子的名字。

engrave.en: It is difficult to engrave in marble.
He had the jeweler engrave his name on the back of the watch.
engrave.zh: 他请钟表匠把他的名字刻在手表的背面。

bellow.en: I was distraught and let out a bellow of tearful rage.
bellow.zh: 我心烦意乱，发出了一声悲愤的吼叫。

bellow.en: Saul Bellow describes his impressions of the seemingly endless cornfields of Illinois.
bellow.zh: 索尔·贝娄描绘了自己对伊利诺斯州看似无边无际的玉米地的印象。

bellow.en: Her friend Saul Bellow wrote in a letter that Marilyn conducts herself like a philosopher.
bellow.zh: 她的朋友索尔·贝娄在一封信中写到梦露行如哲人。

crescent.zh: 地址是科尔维尔新月街44号。

crescent.en: A glittering Islamic crescent tops the mosque.
crescent.zh: 一个闪闪发光的伊斯兰新月标志立于该清真寺之顶。

malignant.en: Moreover, in the domestic rabbits, the warts were no longer benign, but malignant.
malignant.zh: 此外，家兔的疣不再是良性的，而是恶性的。

skillful.en: She also imagined a skillful closing argument and a winning trial.
skillful.zh: 她还想象了一个巧妙的结案陈词和胜诉的画面。

skillful.en: Like trained and skillful woodsmen, they approached without a sound.
skillful.zh: 像训练有素的伐木工一样，他们悄无声息地靠近了。

raccoon.zh: 浣熊能够生活在森林中。
浣熊可以生活在城市里。

cervical.en: The cervical smear test is a lifesaver.
cervical.zh: 宫颈涂片检查是健康救星。

cervical.en: Doctors aim to cut the number of women dying from cervical cancer by half this decade.
cervical.zh: 医生们这十年的目标在于使死于宫颈癌的妇女人数减少一半。

cervical.en: Its elongated skull with toothless tips and short cervical vertebrae indicate that it is similar to that of Pteranodon.
cervical.zh: 它窄长的头骨、没有牙齿的尖颌和短短的颈椎表明，它与无齿翼龙类似。

bravery.en: He deserves the highest praise for his bravery.
bravery.zh: 他为其勇敢应该得到至高的赞扬。

bravery.en: She'd need all her strength and bravery to cope with what lay in store.
bravery.zh: 她需要拿出全部的力量和勇气来应对即将发生的事情。

impartial.en: This newspaper has achieved a reputation for honest and impartial political reporting.
impartial.zh: 这家报纸凭诚实公正的政治报道赢得了声誉。
作为主席，我必须保持中立。

impartial.en: It can help to have an impartial third party look over your work.
impartial.zh: 让中立的第3方来检查你的工作会有所帮助。

brim.en: Her glass was filled right up to the brim.
brim.zh: 她的玻璃杯被装得满满的。

brim.en: Rain dripped from the brim of his baseball cap.
brim.zh: 雨水从他的棒球帽檐上滴下来。

brim.en: Her hat was an amazing affair with feathers and a huge brim.
brim.zh: 她的帽子嵌着羽毛，帽檐很宽，真是件奇物。

evict.zh: 不要深夜还在卧室看电视。

evict.en: A giant—or the two dozen policemen who are about to evict him?
evict.zh: 是传说中的巨人还是两队警察打算来赶走主人公？

evict.en: We politely evict the vibration motor from its home with some "convincing" from a plastic opening tool.
evict.zh: 用塑料开启工具轻轻地取出振动电机。

toxicity.en: A gene that helps neutralize aluminum toxicity in rice has been identified.
toxicity.zh: 一种有助于中和水稻铝毒性的基因已经被鉴定出来。

toxicity.en: Honey made from such nectar can cause the effects the texts describe, but only if eaten fresh since the honey loses its toxicity within a few weeks of being made.
toxicity.zh: 用这种花蜜制成的蜂蜜会产生书上所描述的效果，但只有在新鲜食用的情况下才会如此，因为蜂蜜在制作几周内就会失去毒性。

toxicity.en: The objective is to explore reproductive toxicity and mechanism of linuron on F1 male rats.
toxicity.zh: 目的是探讨利谷隆对雄性仔鼠的生殖毒性及其作用机制。

dosage.en: He was put on a high dosage of vitamin C.
dosage.zh: 他在大剂量服用维生素C。

dosage.en: His physician modified the dosage but did not change to a different medication.
dosage.zh: 他的医生调整了剂量，但没有改换成别的药方。

dosage.en: Drugs that are safe in the dosage stated on the label may be very dangerous in large doses.
dosage.zh: 服用标签上的剂量很安全，但大量服用就可能有很大风险。

insidious.en: The changes are insidious, and will not produce a noticeable effect for 15 to 20 years.
insidious.zh: 变化是悄然发生的，15到20年间不会产生明显效果。

insidious.en: He's also found a kind of insidious prejudice.
insidious.zh: 他也发现了一种潜在的偏见。

insidious.en: But he's also found a kind of insidious prejudice.
insidious.zh: 但他也发现了一种潜在的偏见。

hijack.en: Every minute during the hijack seemed like a week.
hijack.zh: 劫持过程中，每一分钟都像一个星期似的。

hijack.en: The front page is devoted to the continuing saga of the hijack.
hijack.zh: 头版是对劫持事件的连续报道。

hijack.en: Two men tried to hijack a plane on a flight from Riga to Murmansk.
hijack.zh: 两名男子试图劫持一架从里加飞往摩尔曼斯克的飞机。

versatility.zh: 老板称赞了史蒂芬的多才多艺。

versatility.en: She is a designer of extraordinary versatility.
versatility.zh: 她是位特别多才多艺的设计师。

versatility.en: Velvet as a fabric is not known for its versatility.
versatility.zh: 天鹅绒作为一种织物并非以其用途广泛而闻名。

mountainous.en: Varese Ligure is a small town in mountainous country east of Genoa.
mountainous.zh: 瓦雷泽·利古里亚是一座位于热那亚东部山区的小镇。

mountainous.en: We left the rough track and bumped our way over a rugged mountainous terrain.
mountainous.zh: 我们驶离坎坷的小道，又颠簸过了崎岖多岩的山地。

mountainous.en: Planes parachuted food, clothing, blankets, medicine, and water into the rugged mountainous border region.
mountainous.zh: 飞机把食物、衣服、毯子、药和水空投到崎岖的边界山区。

seduction.en: Attempts to brand the belly dance as an act of seduction are both demeaning and distorting.
seduction.zh: 试图将肚皮舞标榜为一种诱惑行为是贬低和扭曲的。

seduction.en: In the 1994 movie "The Last Seduction", a femme fatale coaxes her lover into killing her husband for money.
seduction.zh: 在1994年的电影《最后的诱惑》中，一个蛇蝎美人为了钱哄骗她的情人杀死了她的丈夫。

seduction.en: Unlike fashion's embrace of playful dissimulation and seduction, this beauty practice instead insists on correcting precisely measured flaws.
seduction.zh: 不像时尚界拥抱好玩的伪装和诱惑，这种美容实践反而坚持纠正精确测量的缺陷。

refresh.en: There is a hypothesis that we sleep so that our brain can repair and refresh itself.
refresh.zh: 有一种假设是，我们睡觉是为了让大脑自我修复和更新。

refresh.en: If technological diffusion and implementation develop faster, workers will have to constantly refresh their skills.
refresh.zh: 如果技术的传播和应用发展得更快，工人们将不得不持续更新他们的技能。

diffuse.en: It allows nicotine to diffuse slowly and steadily into the bloodstream.
diffuse.zh: 它使尼古丁缓慢、稳步地扩散到血液当中。

diffuse.en: The problem is how to diffuse power without creating anarchy.
diffuse.zh: 问题在于如何将权力分散而不造成无政府状态。

exuberant.en: So the exuberant young girl with dark hair and blue eyes decided to become a screen actress.
exuberant.zh: 因此，这个充满活力的年轻黑发碧眼女孩决定成为一名荧屏演员。

exuberant.en: So why did financial markets remain exuberant for so long?
exuberant.zh: 但是为什么长时间来金融市场依然火爆？

paradoxical.en: Some sedatives produce the paradoxical effect of making the person more anxious.
paradoxical.zh: 一些镇静剂产生出使人更紧张这样自相矛盾的结果。

paradoxical.en: It is paradoxical that some of the poorest people live in some of the richest areas of the country.
paradoxical.zh: 某些最贫穷的人却住在这个国家一些最富有的地区，这似乎很矛盾。

paradoxical.en: The Swedes will find this paradoxical and try to find solutions.
paradoxical.zh: 瑞典人会发现这种自相矛盾，并试图找到解决办法。

segregate.en: A large detachment of police was used to segregate the two rival camps of protesters.
segregate.zh: 一大队分遣警察被派来隔离两群敌对的抗议者。

segregate.en: HTML head and body tags segregate your document into sections.
segregate.zh: HTML head和body标记将文档分为不同的部分。

segregate.en: Oils segregate out of water because the oil-oil interaction is more favorable than the oil-water interaction.
segregate.zh: 油能与水分开，是因为油分子之间的作用比油水分子间的作用强。

prickly.en: Don't panic-- it's the tough core of the pineapple, not the prickly skin that you should tuck into.
prickly.zh: 别惊恐——你应该吃的是菠萝坚硬的果核，而不是多刺的外皮。

prickly.en: The fruit of this plant has a hard, prickly rind and soft pulp with an offensive odor but a pleasant taste.
prickly.zh: 这种植物的果实，果皮有硬刺，果肉柔软，气味难闻，但味道可口。

prickly.en: The ancient fecal material, or coprolite, was littered with seared prickly pear seeds and flecked with small bones from fish, birds, and rodents.
prickly.zh: 这块古代排泄物或粪化石，同烧焦的多刺梨种子散落在一起，点缀着来自鱼、鸟、啮齿目动物的小块骨头。

emerald.en: One time in Brooklyn, I found an emerald ring in my cab.
emerald.zh: 一次在布鲁克林，我发现车里有一枚祖母绿钻戒。

emerald.en: One time in Brooklyn, I found an emerald ring in my cab.
emerald.zh: 一次在布鲁克林，我发现车里有一枚祖母绿钻戒。

emerald.en: She told the artist, "Paint me with diamond earrings, a diamond necklace, emerald bracelets, and a ruby pendant."
emerald.zh: 她告诉那位肖像画家说：“画带着钻石耳环、钻石项链、祖母绿手镯，还有红宝石垂饰的我。”

sadden.en: I do not want to sadden you again.
The piers sadden when the affernoon moors there.
sadden.zh: 当暮色停泊在那处，码头伤感。

sadden.en: Although that wasn't surprising, it did sadden and even scare me.
sadden.zh: 尽管并不出乎意料，但还是令我难过，甚至令我恐慌。

virtuous.en: Louis was shown as an intelligent, courageous and virtuous family man.
virtuous.zh: 路易斯看上去是一个聪明、勇敢而且品德高尚的顾家男人。

virtuous.en: The vicious circle is thus transformed into a virtuous circle.
virtuous.zh: 这样，恶性循环就变成了良性循环。

virtuous.en: Far less certain, however, is how successfully experts and bureaucrats can select our peer groups and steer their activities in virtuous directions.
virtuous.zh: 然而，专家和官员们选择我们的同伴们，并将其活动引向良性方向的顺利程度有几何尚无法确定。

marginally.en: Indeed, the fourth generation is marginally worse off than the third.
marginally.zh: 事实上，第四代比第三代过得稍微差一些。

marginally.en: Sales last year were marginally higher than in 1991.
marginally.zh: 去年的销售量比1991年略微高一点。

marginally.en: They now cost marginally more than they did last year.
marginally.zh: 他们现在并不比去年贵多少。

sham.en: His love was a mere sham; what he really wanted was her money.
sham.zh: 他的爱情完全是虚假的，他真正要的是她的钱。

sham.en: To take sides at a later point would be to suggest that the earlier presumptive impartiality was a sham.
sham.zh: 在以后的某一时刻偏袒某一方，就意味着先前假定的公正只是一种假象。

sham.en: Their promises turned out to be full of sham and hypocrisy.
sham.zh: 他们的许诺到头来全是空的、骗人的。

snowflake.en: Governments have formed and disintegrated faster than a snowflake in a Himalayan gale.
snowflake.zh: 政府形成再瓦解的速度比喜马拉雅大风中的一片雪花还要快。

snowflake.en: I opened the box and saw a piece of crystal snowflake and a greeting card with "Happy Birthday" in the blank paper.
snowflake.zh: 我打开盒子并看见在白纸中有一片水晶雪花和一张写着“生日快乐”的贺卡。

snowflake.en: While Bentley may be most famous for his snowflake studies, he was a weather-lover and conducted experiments with raindrops as well.
snowflake.zh: 虽热本特利最出名的可能是他对雪花的研究，但他是一个天气爱好者，也用雨滴做实验。

abort.en: The virus can cause pregnant animals to abort.
abort.zh: 这种病毒可能导致怀孕动物流产。

abort.en: For reasons that aren't yet well understood, cloned animals often abort spontaneously or are born with defects.
abort.zh: 由于无法搞懂的原因，克隆动物通常会自行流产，或者具有天生缺陷。

abort.en: We had no option but to abort the mission.
abort.zh: 我们别无选择，只有取消这项任务。

concoct.en: We concoct them even further by deep frying them and then having them with a sugared beverage and that's certainly different than ancient times.
concoct.zh: 我们把它们炸得更透，然后将它们就着含糖饮料食用，这和古代的做法肯定不同。

concoct.en: What was the most unusual fragrance or flavor you've had to concoct?
concoct.zh: 你配制的最奇怪的香水或者香味是什么？

concoct.en: They tend to repeat questions before answering them, perhaps to give themselves time to concoct an answer.
concoct.zh: 他们往往会在回答问题前重复人家的提问，也许是为了给自己一点时间以便捏造个答案。

cramp.en: Hillsden was complaining of a cramp in his calf muscles.
cramp.zh: 希尔斯登一直在抱怨他小腿肌肉抽筋。

cramp.en: Like more and more women, she believes wedlock would cramp her style.
cramp.zh: 和越来越多的女性一样，她认为婚姻会束缚她的行为方式。

cramp.en: It is all an attitude, and one day the attitude will become a weird cramp, a pain, and then it will collapse.
cramp.zh: 它完全是一种态度，某天这种态度将变成一种奇怪的痉挛，一种痛苦，然后这种态度会倒塌。

animate.en: There was precious little about the cricket to animate the crowd.
animate.zh: 这场板球比赛极少有让观众兴奋的地方。

animate.en: Shaffer's great gift lies in his ability to animate ideas theatrically.
animate.zh: 谢弗的天赋在于他能把想法在戏剧上表现出来。

animate.en: Natural philosophy involved the study of all aspects of the material world, animate and inanimate.
animate.zh: 自然哲学涉及到了对包括有生命体与无生命体的物质世界的全面研究。

toad.zh: “班杰。”癞蛤蟆托德相当轻率地说。
我是不是很可笑，癞蛤蟆托德？

mania.zh: 我们称这种狂热为“郁金香狂热”。

mania.en: Too much happiness (think mania) can be destructive.
mania.zh: 太多的快乐（幻想狂躁症）可能是破坏性的。

mania.en: Shiller believes that America is in the grip of an irrational mania.
mania.zh: 希勒认为，美国正处于非理性狂热之中。

uterus.en: Non-identical twins are the result of two fertilized eggs implanting in the uterus at the same time.
uterus.zh: 非同卵双生胎是两个受精卵同时在子宫着床的结果。

uterus.en: Most of the neurons you have in your head, you had when you were in your mother's uterus.
uterus.zh: 你头脑中的大部分神经元，早在你处于母亲子宫中时就已经拥有。

uterus.en: If thawed semen is used, it has to be injected directly into the uterus through the ewe's belly wall.
uterus.zh: 如果使用解冻的精液，它必须通过母羊的腹壁直接注入子宫。

meditate.en: My brother would meditate on a window seat.
meditate.zh: 我哥哥会坐在靠窗的座位上冥想。

meditate.en: Oprah: Do you meditate every single day?
meditate.zh: 欧普拉：您每一天都要进行冥想吗？

dazzle.en: You can dazzle members of the opposite with your quick wit and aggressive charm.
dazzle.zh: 你可以在异性面前炫耀自己过人的才智和独特的魅力。

dazzle.en: At the time, it was only an educated guess that this so-called dazzle camouflage would work.
dazzle.zh: 那个时候，炫目伪装能够起作用只是出于一种经验上的判断。

acclaim.en: He received acclaim as a champion of the oppressed.
acclaim.zh: 他作为被压迫者的捍卫者而受到了赞誉。

acclaim.en: Elgar received many honours and much acclaim and yet he often considered himself a failure.
acclaim.zh: 埃尔加获得了很多荣誉和欢呼，但是他常常把自己看成一个失败者。

acclaim.en: In her work, she revealed a side of nature so exotic, dramatic and valuable to Europeans of the time that she received much acclaim.
acclaim.zh: 她的作品向当时的欧洲人揭示了自然界充满异国情调、富有戏剧性和价值的一面，因此她获得了很多赞誉。

jargon.en: Their jargon is impenetrable to an outsider.
jargon.zh: 他们的行话外人听不懂。

jargon.en: A lot of the jargon they use is unintelligible to outsiders.
jargon.zh: 他们所用的大量行话是外人听不懂的。

jargon.en: Can you help me translate this legal jargon into plain English?
jargon.zh: 你能帮助我用浅显易懂的英语来说明这一法律术语吗？

appease.en: Gandhi was accused by some of trying to appease both factions of the electorate.
appease.zh: 甘地被一些人指责试图对两派选民都加以姑息。

appease.en: Children aren't born knowing how to say "I'm sorry"; rather, they learn over time that such statements appease parents and friends and their own consciences.
appease.zh: 孩子并不是生来就知道如何说“对不起”；相反，随着时间的推移，他们才明白这样的表达能安抚父母、朋友和自己的良心。

appease.en: Or is it simply a move to appease its critics?
appease.zh: 或者说此举只是为了平息对它的批评？

tentacle.en: Each tentacle is about two millimeters long.
tentacle.zh: 每条触手大约两毫米长。

tentacle.en: Enthusiasts have been hospitalized after a wiggling tentacle lodged in the throat.
tentacle.zh: 热衷者曾经因为被章鱼的触手卡在嗓子中而被送往医院接受治疗。

tentacle.en: Scientists pulled up a tentacle and they believe it came from a foot-long jellyfish.
tentacle.zh: 科学家们拔除了一条触角，他们相信这是一只一英尺长水母的触角。

senseless.en: He was knocked senseless by the blow.
senseless.zh: 他被一拳打得不省人事。
他的梦想毫无意义，很不成熟。

trance.en: He was put into a trance by a police hypnotist.
trance.zh: 他被警方的一位催眠师导入了催眠状态。

trance.en: Like a man in a trance, Blake found his way back to his rooms.
trance.zh: 像一个处于催眠状态的人，布莱克回到了自己的房间。

trance.en: Lozanov experimented with teaching by direct suggestion during sleep, hypnosis and trance states, but found such procedures unnecessary.
trance.zh: 洛扎诺夫在睡眠、催眠和恍惚状态下尝试了直接暗示的教学方法，但他发现这些过程是没必要的。

industrialization.zh: 工业化很早就在西班牙开始了。
工业化彻底改变了世界。

industrialization.en: The key to the industrialization of space is the U.S. space shuttle.
industrialization.zh: 太空产业化的关键是美国的航天飞机。

obscurity.en: He spent most of his life working in obscurity.
obscurity.zh: 他在默默无闻的工作中度过了大半生。

obscurity.en: She was plucked from obscurity to instant stardom.
obscurity.zh: 她从默默无闻中得到提携，转瞬成为明星。

obscurity.en: For the lucky few, there's the chance of being plucked from obscurity and thrown into the glamorous world of modelling.
obscurity.zh: 极少数幸运者有机会从默默无闻中脱颖而出，跻身多彩的模特儿世界。

arduous.en: We must have patience in doing arduous work.
arduous.zh: 我们做艰苦的工作要有耐性。

arduous.en: He never seeks credit for himself, but is always ready to take on arduous tasks.
arduous.zh: 他在荣誉面前从不伸手，但在艰巨任务面前却当仁不让。

securely.zh: 他把带子牢牢地系在一起。

securely.en: She locked the door securely behind her.
Make sure the table is securely anchored.

pedagogy.en: I majored in English Linguistics and Pedagogy.
pedagogy.zh: 我的专业就是英语文学和教育。

pedagogy.en: I do think that interactive pedagogy really stands on its own.
pedagogy.zh: 我真的觉得这种互动性教学法，有很多优点。

pedagogy.en: That pedagogy is very interactive in this five hours we have in this classroom.
pedagogy.zh: 这种教学方法非常具有互动性，在这课堂的五个小时里。

temperate.en: The Nile Valley keeps a temperate climate throughout the year.
temperate.zh: 尼罗河流域全年气候温和。

temperate.en: Although these vegetables adapt well to our temperate climate, they tend to crop poorly.
temperate.zh: 虽然这些蔬菜能够适应我们这里的温和气候，但它们的产量常常不高。

temperate.en: Much human cultural development took place in temperate regions.
temperate.zh: 许多人类文化的发展发生在温带地区。

overriding.en: The overriding problem is the continuing deficit financing of the federal government.
overriding.zh: 最重要的问题是联邦政府的持续赤字财政。

overriding.en: Their overriding aim was to keep costs low.
overriding.zh: 他们的首要目标是维持低成本。

overriding.en: My overriding concern is to raise the standards of state education.
overriding.zh: 我最关心的是提高国民教育水平。

aptitude.en: Researchers used ACT scores as a measure of intellectual aptitude.
aptitude.zh: 研究人员用美国大学入学考试（ACT）成绩来衡量其智力资质。
她没有从事护理工作的能力。

aptitude.en: She showed a natural aptitude for the work.
aptitude.zh: 她表现出了做这工作的天赋。

whirlwind.en: After a whirlwind romance the couple announced their engagement in July.
whirlwind.zh: 在旋风式的恋爱之后，这对情侣在7月宣布定婚。
这是一场旋风般的求爱。

whirlwind.en: It was a whirlwind romance for us two.
whirlwind.zh: 对我们两个人来说，这是一种旋风式的浪漫。

emigration.en: Emigration to the West reached a peak in the 1830's.
emigration.zh: 向西部迁移的行为在19世纪30年代达到顶峰。

emigration.en: Was it emigration to a Jewish state in Palestine?
emigration.zh: 这样一个犹太国建在哪里？是巴勒斯坦吗？

emigration.en: Fujian and Zhejiang have been encouraging emigration to Africa as a source of remittances and of new jobs.
emigration.zh: 福建和浙江两省就已经鼓励人们前往非洲就业经商。

spruce.en: Trees such as spruce, pine, and oak have been planted.
spruce.zh: 像云杉、松树和橡树之类的树已经种了。

spruce.en: Chris was looking spruce in his stiff-collared black shirt and new short hair cut.

exhaustive.zh: 这绝不是份详尽无遗的清单，但它显示出很多正在进行的项目。

exhaustive.zh: 我们对你的电脑进行了彻底的扫描，但没有发现任何恶意软件。

lighthouse.zh: 灯塔是进入海港航道的标志。

astonish.zh: 我的消息会令你十分惊讶。

astonish.zh: Thunderstruck 这个词在 astonish 之后大约100年才出现在英语当中。

astonish.en: As for the bushels of sketches and studies which Millet produced in the last six weeks, well, it would astonish you to know the figure we sell them at nowadays.
astonish.zh: 至于米勒在过去六个星期里创作的大量的速写和习作，嗯，如果你知道我们现在销售它们的价格，你会大吃一惊的。

horizontally.en: The wind was cold and drove the snow at him almost horizontally.
horizontally.zh: 风很冷，裹着雪几乎是横着向他扑来。

irreversible.zh: 她陷入医生们所说的一种不可逆转的植物人状态已达5年之久。

herald.en: He picked up extra money as a local stringer for the New York Herald.
herald.zh: 他通过做《纽约先驱报》的本地特约记者赚了些外快。

herald.en: The Sydney Morning Herald carried the headline: "Sorry Ma'am, Most Australians Want a Republic."
herald.zh: 《悉尼先驱晨报》有这样一则头版标题：“对不起，夫人，大多数澳大利亚人想要一个共和国。”

captivate.zh: 愤怒的小鸟持续着令全球智能手机用户着迷的热潮。

captivate.en: The son is so captivate with the woman that he does not heed his parents' warning.
captivate.zh: 儿子为这个女人神魂颠倒，全然不顾他父母的告诫。

captivate.en: I would captivate them with money before telling them that we needed to deforest their land.
captivate.zh: 我会先用钱迷惑住他们，然后再告诉他们我们要采伐森林。

chimpanzee.en: After all, who could look at a chimpanzee on a unicycle and comprehend its real situation?
chimpanzee.zh: 毕竟，谁能看着骑在独轮车上的黑猩猩，理解它的真实处境呢?

chimpanzee.en: This second chimpanzee is not a relative of the first chimpanzee, and they've never seen each other before.
chimpanzee.zh: 第二只黑猩猩不是第一只黑猩猩的亲戚，它们以前也从来没见过面。

chimpanzee.en: Short sleeves, after all, carry the whiff of the simian: isn't it the chimpanzee that generally performs in something less than a long sleeve?
chimpanzee.zh: 短袖，归根结底，带有一种猿猴的意味：通常不是黑猩猩穿着短袖类的东西在表演吗？

baron.en: I once carried a letter to a baron of that sort.
baron.zh: 有一次，我送一封信给一个那样的男爵。

baron.en: You've also done security for Sacha Baron Cohen. Is he in character or out?
baron.zh: 你还负责了萨夏男爵科恩的安全。他是否与他身份相符呢？

baron.en: It was often intended to buy a media baron undue influence over the public.
baron.zh: 这经常让媒体巨头向公众施加了过度的影响。

strenuous.en: Strenuous efforts had been made to improve conditions in the jail.
strenuous.zh: 为改善那家监狱里的条件已做了艰苦的努力。

strenuous.en: Richard Long's A Line Made By Walking, however, involved nothing more strenuous than a 20-minute train ride from Waterloo.
strenuous.zh: 然而，理查德·朗的《行走的路线》并不比从滑铁卢坐20分钟火车更费力。

strenuous.en: She made strenuous efforts to tame her anger.

utensil.en: Taking a camping utensil that can serve as a knife, fork and spoon to school.
utensil.zh: 他把一个可以做刀、勺子还有叉子的野营工具带到学校去了。

utensil.zh: 目的探讨超声在宫内节育器观察上的局限性。

utensil.zh: 唯一不平常的就餐器具是一把剪刀，用来剪开包裹。

substantiate.en: Two types of images substantiate this theory: the strange, indecipherable geometric shapes that appear near some animals, and the few drawings of men.
substantiate.zh: 两种类型的图形证实了这种看法：在某些动物图形和极少数的人类图像附近存在着一些奇怪而难以辨认的几何图形。

substantiate.en: There is little scientific evidence to substantiate the claims.
substantiate.zh: 几乎没有能证实这些断言的科学证据。

substantiate.en: You should go through the paper many times—and then again—working to substantiate and clarify your ideas.
substantiate.zh: 你应该一遍又一遍地通读论文，努力充实和阐明你的观点。

cosmopolitan.zh: 她是个真正的四海为家的人。

cosmopolitan.en: It wasn't just poking fun at Sally, but the whole idea that our school is sort of rural, and you know, not cosmopolitan.
cosmopolitan.zh: 这不仅仅是在取笑莎莉，而是在说我们学校位置比较偏僻，不是在什么世界性的大都市。
这个俱乐部具有世界文化的气氛。

hasty.en: I made a hasty exit and managed to open the gate.
hasty.zh: 我匆忙离场，设法打开了大门。

hasty.en: Donald had overturned a chair in his hasty departure.
hasty.zh: 唐纳德仓促离开时撞翻了一把椅子。

pessimism.en: Pessimism seems to be the order of the day.
pessimism.zh: 悲观失望似乎是当今司空见惯的情形。

pessimism.en: Optimism was gradually taking the place of pessimism.
There is a mood of pessimism in the company about future job prospects.
pessimism.zh: 公司中有一种对工作前景悲观的情绪。

fluctuate.en: Body temperature can fluctuate if you are ill.
fluctuate.zh: 如果你病了，体温会波动。

fluctuate.en: The analysis reveals that intensity appears to fluctuate with a clear, well-defined rhythm.
fluctuate.zh: 分析表明，强度似乎以一种清晰的、明确的节奏在波动。

fluctuate.en: Later on in the early years of the nineteenth century, when Fort Vancouver became the headquarters of the Hudson's Bay Company, deer populations continued to fluctuate.
fluctuate.zh: 后来，在19世纪初，当温哥华堡成为哈德逊湾公司的总部时，鹿的数量继续波动。

overcoat.en: He wore an overcoat over his suit.
overcoat.zh: 他在西服外面再加了一件大衣。

overcoat.en: Her overcoat is as stylish as Jill's.
overcoat.zh: 她的大衣和吉尔的一样时髦。

overcoat.en: He placed his cap and overcoat on a chair.
overcoat.zh: 他把帽子和大衣搁在一张椅子上。

insightful.en: It's no surprise that Jennifer Senior's insightful.
insightful.zh: Jennifer Senior 的强大洞察力并不出人意料。

insightful.en: This painting shows how insightful Cecilia Beaux was as a portrait artist.
insightful.zh: 这幅画显示了塞西莉亚·博克斯作为一名肖像画家是多么有洞察力。

insightful.en: These practical, insightful designers have determined the course of late twentieth century fashion.
insightful.zh: 这些务实而又富有洞察力的设计师决定了20世纪末的时尚潮流。

launcher.en: The Marines fired back with a grenade launcher.
launcher.zh: 海军陆战队用手榴弹发射器反击。

launcher.en: Follow the instructions on the page for your phone to add the bookmark as a shortcut on your app launcher.
launcher.zh: 按照页面上的指示在你手机上添加书签作为你的应用启动栏中的快捷方式。

launcher.en: Now, I can have a M203 (an overunder M16 grenade launcher) which is not crew-served.
launcher.zh: 现在，我可以拥有 M203（M16 双筒上下重叠的榴弹发射器）了，不需要乘员就可以使用。

chronology.en: Historians seem to have confused the chronology of these events.
chronology.zh: 历史学家好像把这些事件发生的年代顺序搞混了。

chronology.en: The second part of Duffy's book is a detailed chronology of the Reformation.
chronology.zh: 黛菲书的第二部分是关于改革的一个详细年表。

chronology.en: To establish such a chronology, it is necessary to determine the relative amounts of land ice that existed at various times in the Earth's past.
chronology.zh: 为了建立这样一个年表，有必要确定地球过去不同时期存在的陆冰的相对数量。

idiom.en: It's just the first half of an idiom.
idiom.zh: 它只是一个习语的前半部分。

idiom.en: Let us look at an idiom: kill two birds with double-edged sword.
idiom.zh: 我们再看一个成语：一举两得/一箭双雕。

idiom.en: An idiom is a group of words.

coalesce.en: As the number of moisture droplets increases, they begin to coalesce into small rivulets of fluid.
coalesce.zh: 当水滴数量增加，它们会汇集成细流。

coalesce.en: Operations to split and to coalesce chunks take time.
coalesce.zh: 用于分割和合并块的操作需要花费时间。

coalesce.en: The allocator can't coalesce free space into larger blocks.
coalesce.zh: 分配程序不能将空闲空间拼合为更大的内存块。

accomplice.en: He became an unwitting accomplice in the crime.
accomplice.zh: 他糊里糊涂地成了犯罪的帮凶。

accomplice.en: Witnesses said the gunman immediately ran to a motorcycle being ridden by an accomplice.
accomplice.zh: 证人们说该枪手立即向由一名同犯驾驶的摩托车跑去。

accomplice.en: He is suspected as an accomplice of the murder.
accomplice.zh: 他涉嫌为这次凶杀案的同谋。

incline.en: I incline to the view that we should take no action at this stage.
incline.zh: 我倾向于认为我们在这个阶段不应采取行动。

incline.en: He stopped just as his truck tilted down the steep incline, put on the handbrake, and stepped out.
incline.zh: 就在他的卡车沿陡峭的斜坡向下滑的时候，他停了下来，拉住了手闸，然后下了车。

incline.en: As it lost weight, it started to incline its orbit toward the earth: it was dangerous, above and beyond anything else.
incline.zh: 当它失重的时候，它开始将它的轨道向地球倾斜：这是危险的，比其他任何东西都危险。

serenity.en: This serenity arose in part from Rachel's religious beliefs.
serenity.zh: 这种平和部分由于雷切尔的宗教信仰。

serenity.en: I had a wonderful feeling of peace and serenity when I saw my husband.
serenity.zh: 我看到我的丈夫就有一种平和安详的美妙感觉。

serenity.en: The hotel offers a haven of peace and serenity away from the bustle of the city.
serenity.zh: 那家旅馆远离闹市，是一个幽静安谧的好去处。

insomnia.en: Depression is almost always accompanied by insomnia.
insomnia.zh: 抑郁症几乎总是伴有失眠。

insomnia.en: Acute insomnia means consistent inability to sleep well for a period of three weeks to six months.
insomnia.zh: 严重失眠意味着连续三周到六个月都睡不好觉。

insomnia.en: Telling yourself to stop being anxious when you're feeling anxious is a bit like telling yourself to fall asleep when you have insomnia—it doesn't work.
insomnia.zh: 当你感到焦虑时，告诉自己不要焦虑，这有点像当你失眠时，告诉自己要入睡一样——是行不通的。

colossal.en: But the damage it has caused has been colossal.
colossal.zh: 但它造成的损害是巨大的。

colossal.en: The worst of the bombardment—including the colossal impact that knocked loose the chunk that became our moon—was over.
colossal.zh: 最糟糕的轰炸——包括将大块物质撞击得脱离地球形成月球巨大碰撞——已经结束了。

sneer.en: A smile, frown, raised an eyebrow, yawn, and sneer all convey information.
sneer.zh: 微笑、皱眉、挑眉、打哈欠和冷笑都传达信息。

sneer.en: A faint sneer of satisfaction crossed her face.
sneer.zh: 她的脸上掠过一丝得意的冷笑。

sneer.en: Canete's mouth twisted in a contemptuous sneer.
sneer.zh: 卡内特撇了下嘴，一副蔑视嘲讽的样子。

microprocessor.en: Doubling the frequency of logical operations inside a microprocessor doubles the heat output.
microprocessor.zh: 微处理器内部逻辑操作的频率加倍，产生的热量也加倍。

microprocessor.en: A control box fitted to the car contains a mini-cellphone, a microprocessor and memory, and a GPS satellite positioning receiver.
microprocessor.zh: 车上的控制箱装有迷你手机、微处理器、存储器和 GPS 卫星定位接收器。

microprocessor.en: A modern microprocessor requires a billion-dollar plant called a fab to etch onto its surface the tiny electronic components that make it run.
microprocessor.zh: 现代的微处理器需要十亿美元的被称为 fab 的工厂，以在其表面蚀刻出使其得以运作的微型电子元器件。

shopkeeper.en: Actually, the three-year-old dog is a good "shopkeeper".
shopkeeper.zh: 实际上，这只三岁的狗是个很好的“店主”。

shopkeeper.en: The robbers clobbered the shopkeeper to make him open the safe.
shopkeeper.zh: 强盗们对店主大打出手，胁迫他打开保险箱。

shopkeeper.en: She led her uncle down the street to the store, where she greeted the shopkeeper.
shopkeeper.zh: 她领着叔叔沿街来到商店，跟店主打了个招呼。

crease.en: Most outfits crease a bit when you are travelling.
crease.zh: 大多数的外套在旅行中都会有些起皱。

crease.en: Pack your suit carefully so that you don't crease it.
crease.zh: 把你的西装小心装好以免弄皱。

crease.en: You have a deep, vertical crease down the middle of your earlobe.
crease.zh: 你的耳垂中间有一条很深的垂直折痕。

compulsory.en: There is a compulsory course in statistics.
compulsory.zh: 有一门统计学的必修课。

compulsory.en: Certain courses are compulsory, others are optional.
compulsory.zh: 某些课程是必修的，其他是选修的。

compulsory.en: It is compulsory for all motorcyclists to wear helmets.
compulsory.zh: 所有骑摩托车的人都必须戴头盔，这是强制性的。

calculus.en: He began college with a timetable that included biology, calculus and political science.
calculus.zh: 他开始了大学生活，课程表上包括生物、微积分和政治学。
不是每个人都得懂微积分。

calculus.en: Newton developed mathematical concepts and techniques that are fundamental to modern calculus.
calculus.zh: 牛顿发展了现代微积分的基础数学概念和技术。

leek.en: When she was pregnant with Molly, her mother had made her gallons of potato leek soup.
leek.zh: 当她怀著茉莉的时候，她妈妈给她做了几加仑的土豆韭菜汤。

leek.en: He was inspired by the memory of the potato-and-leek soup of his childhood, which his mother and grandmother used to make.
leek.zh: 他的灵感来自童年时代的土豆韭菜汤，那是他的母亲和祖母曾经做过的。

sheen.en: The carpet had a silvery sheen to it.

sheen.en: You trained Charlie Sheen for his role as Chris, the young solider in Platoon, so you worked closely with him.
sheen.zh: 你训练查理·辛演饰演《野战排》里的年轻士兵克里斯，所以你和他密切合作。

sneeze.zh: 我们打喷嚏究竟是怎么回事？

sneeze.en: Just use a napkin every time you sneeze or cough.
sneeze.zh: 每次打喷嚏或咳嗽的时候就用餐巾。

fortify.zh: 用付出让你的决定更加坚定。

fortify.zh: 钨可用于生产汽车的防护钢板。

fortify.en: It also helped fortify our market position online.
fortify.zh: 这也有助于巩固我们的在线市场地位。

acreage.en: Truvia's total rice acreage will not be expanded in the foreseeable future, nor will rice yields per acre increase appreciably.
acreage.zh: 在可预见的将来，特鲁维亚的水稻总面积不会扩大，每亩水稻产量也不会显著增加。

acreage.zh: 这只是受益总面积的一小部分，共约50万英亩，所以优先考虑火灾或干旱风险最大的地区是至关重要的。

equator.zh: 全球定位系统在赤道附近性能最好。

equator.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the earth.
equator.zh: 赤道是一条假想的环绕地球腰部的线。

equator.en: All the planets orbit the Sun in roughly the same plane, around its equator.
equator.zh: 所有行星基本在同一个平面上围绕太阳赤道运转。

algebra.en: At twenty he translated Euler's standard work on algebra into English.
algebra.zh: 20岁时，他把尤勒的权威代数著作译成了英语。

algebra.en: Algebra is not easy for everyone to learn, but it is very useful.
algebra.zh: 代数对每个人来说都不容易学，但它非常有用。

algebra.en: He is now learning anatomy, algebra, biology and geometry which are all science and math courses.
algebra.zh: 他现在正在学习解剖学、代数、生物学和几何学，这些都属于科学和数学课程。

epoch.en: It was meant to sound like an epoch-making declaration.
epoch.zh: 有意让它听起来像是一个划时代的宣言。

epoch.en: The birth of Christ was the beginning of a major epoch of world history.
epoch.zh: 基督的诞生是世界历史一个重要时代的开始。

cork.en: He drew the cork out of the bottle.

cork.zh: 他在拔一瓶葡萄酒的瓶塞。

cork.en: I like the pop you get when you pull out a cork.
cork.zh: 我喜欢你拔出瓶塞时弄出的那“砰”的一声。

twinkle.zh: 晚上，灯光在山谷对面远处的小木屋里闪烁。

twinkle.en: Do you know why the stars twinkle so merrily?
twinkle.zh: 你知道为什么星星闪烁得那么快乐吗？

twinkle.zh: “是的，确实有！”我闪烁着神秘的眼神说道。

astound.en: He used to astound his friends with feats of physical endurance.
astound.zh: 他过去常以身体耐力之好令其朋友们震惊。

deficient.zh: 土壤最经常缺乏氮和磷。

deficient.en: Nitrogen-deficient plants exhibit many of the symptoms just described.
deficient.zh: 缺氮植物表现出上述的许多症状。

deficient.zh: 有些土壤是出了名的缺乏微量营养，因此无法支持大多数植物的生命。

cunning.en: He was as cunning as a fox.

marina.en: After a hearty breakfast of huevos rancheros, a spicy omelette with chopped vegetables and ham, it was time to head for the marina.
marina.zh: 吃完了丰盛的早餐，有墨西哥式煎蛋，一个辣煎蛋卷配切碎的蔬菜和火腿，是时候去码头了。

marina.en: Marina ate only one slice of bread.
marina.zh: 玛丽娜只吃了一片面包。

sullen.zh: 她满脸不高兴地瞪了他一眼。

sullen.en: The offenders lapsed into a sullen silence.
sullen.zh: 这些罪犯陷入了愤懑的沉默。

cypress.en: The pine and the cypress remain green all the year round.

lowland.zh: 在低地国家大片的森林被砍伐、遭受火灾或两者皆有，成为鹿群理想的觅食地。

lowland.zh: 这是一条穿过低地森林的舒适路线——很适合自行车骑行和带幼童出行的游客。

lowland.zh: 虽然女式格呢褶裙被看作是典型的高地服饰，但如今一些低地城市的人们更常穿着。

stamina.en: The marathon is a severe test of stamina.
stamina.zh: 马拉松赛跑是对耐力的严峻考验。

stamina.en: It takes a lot of stamina to run a marathon.
stamina.zh: 跑马拉松需要很大的耐力。

stamina.zh: 那次长距离爬山是对我们健康状况和耐力的考验。

flora.zh: 地衣可能是第一个成功的植物群。

flora.zh: 这就产生了生物群系的概念——一种植物群和动物群共存的结合体。

dependable.en: He was a good friend, a dependable companion.
dependable.zh: 他是个好朋友，一个可以信赖的同伴。

dependable.en: He was dependable, straightforward, the boy next door.
dependable.zh: 他是个可靠、坦率的邻家男孩儿。

childlike.en: He retained a childlike sense of wonder.
childlike.zh: 他仍然有一种孩子般的好奇感。

childlike.en: His most enduring quality is his childlike innocence.
childlike.zh: 他最持久不变的特质是孩子般的天真无邪。
