pungent.zh: 附近是一家散发出一种刺鼻气味的工厂。

pungent.en: The goats, scenting the pungent herbs, also hurried up without delay.
pungent.zh: 山羊嗅到了辛辣的草药味，也毫不迟疑地赶了上来。

pungent.en: I could smell pungent durian fruit, grilled satay and lemon detergent as my shoulder slapped against a line of wet laundry.
pungent.zh: 当我的肩膀拍打在一排湿衣服上时，我可以闻到刺鼻的榴莲果味、烤沙爹味和柠檬洗涤剂的味道。

postulate.en: The universe encompasses all of space and time we know, so it is beyond the realm of the Big Bang model to postulate what the universe beyond our horizon is.
postulate.zh: 宇宙包含我们所知的所有空间和时间，所以要求用大爆炸模型解释我们视界之外的宇宙超出了这个模型的限定范围。

postulate.en: Therefore some scientists postulate that the Earth's earliest atmosphere, unlike that of today, was dominated by hydrogen, methane, and ammonia.
postulate.zh: 因此，一些科学家推断，地球早期的大气与现在的不一样，主要由氢、甲烷和氨构成。

postulate.en: Let's postulate that she is a cook.
postulate.zh: 我们假定她是一位厨师。

sarcastic.en: The man had the effrontery to be sarcastic.
sarcastic.zh: 那个男人有冷嘲热讽的放肆劲。

sarcastic.en: 'There's no need to be sarcastic,' she said.
Before I could say anything further, the principal gave me a sly, almost sarcastic smile.
sarcastic.zh: 我还没来得及说什么，校长露出了一个狡猾、几乎有些讥讽的微笑。

trilogy.zh: 观看完魔戒三部曲的时间。
他也发明了戏剧三部曲。

trilogy.en: "It aired, and I said," What if we did a trilogy?
trilogy.zh: 第一集播出后，我说：“如果我们做成三部曲会怎样？”

panorama.en: The tower offers a breathtaking panorama of Prague.
panorama.zh: 从塔上可看到壮丽的布拉格全景。

panorama.en: Tonight's edition of 'Panorama' looks at unemployment.
panorama.zh: 今晚这辑《全景》探讨的是失业问题。

panorama.en: Dickens crafted complex plots and striking characters that capture the panorama of English society.
panorama.zh: 狄更斯精心构思了反映英国社会全貌的复杂情节和鲜明的人物形象。

tranquil.en: She led a tranquil life in the country.
tranquil.zh: 她过着恬静的乡村生活。

tranquil.en: The tranquil atmosphere of the inn allows guests to feel totally at home.
tranquil.zh: 这家客栈的宁静氛围让客人们感到宾至如归。

tranquil.en: There was no hilarity in the little town that same tranquil Saturday afternoon.
tranquil.zh: 就是在那个星期六的下午，那个宁静的小镇上没有一点欢乐的气氛。

bombard.en: The best way to see things differently to other people is to bombard the brain with things it has never encountered before.
bombard.zh: 以不同于他人的方式看待事物的最好方法就是用大脑从未接触过的事物来轰炸它。

bombard.en: Even today, microscopic meteorites continually bombard Earth, falling on both land and sea.
bombard.zh: 即使是现在，微小的陨石仍在不断地撞击地球，然后落到陆地上和大海中。

bombard.en: It carries fine particles of sand, which bombard exposed rock surfaces, thereby wearing them into yet more sand.
bombard.zh: 它携带着细小的沙粒，这些沙粒会轰击裸露的岩石表面，从而把岩石磨成更多的沙子。

topography.en: The topography of the river's basin has changed significantly since the floods.
topography.zh: 洪水过后，这条河的流域地形已经明显改变了。

topography.en: Precipitation is influenced by topography among other things.
topography.zh: 除其他因素外，降水还受到地形的影响。

topography.en: The water table is not flat but usually follows the contours of the topography.
topography.zh: 地下水位是不平坦的，而是通常随地势而变化。

rightful.en: The stolen car was returned to its rightful owner.
rightful.zh: 被盗的汽车还给了其合法的主人。

rightful.en: We have restored Hamill to his rightful place as editor.
rightful.zh: 我们已经把哈米尔恢复到他本应有的编辑职位。

rightful.en: The police have now restored the painting to its rightful owner.
rightful.zh: 警察已经把这幅油画归还给了它的合法主人。

prism.en: Light is refracted when passed through a prism.
prism.zh: 光通过棱镜时产生折射。

prism.en: A spectrum is formed by a ray of light passing through a prism.
prism.zh: 一束光通过棱镜就会形成光谱。

prism.en: This light is passed through a prism, which breaks it up into a spectrum.
prism.zh: 这种光通过棱镜，而棱镜把它分割成了一道光谱。

gymnasium.en: The basketball nets hung down from the ceiling at either end of the gymnasium.
gymnasium.zh: 篮球网垂悬于体育馆天花板的两头。
我找到了一个新的健身房。

gymnasium.en: That is the gymnasium on the third floor of Walker.
gymnasium.zh: 那是在 Walker 三楼的体育馆。

mire.en: The wheels sank deeper into the mire.
mire.zh: 轮子在泥潭中陷得更深了。

mire.en: As Somaliland's first archaeologist, Mire is now on a mission to preserve and protect what she says is a heritage at risk of disappearing.
mire.zh: 作为索马里兰的第一个考古学家，米雷现在的任务是维护和保护她所说的具有消失危险的遗产。

mire.en: It is covered with mire and dust.

courier.zh: 我们派了信使送交这些文件。

courier.en: The courier had change for a $10 bill.
A courier was dispatched to collect the documents.

trustworthy.en: He is a trustworthy and level-headed leader.
trustworthy.zh: 他是个可信赖的、头脑冷静的领导。

trustworthy.en: This occurs because they're perceived to be fair and trustworthy.
trustworthy.zh: 之所以出现这种情况，是因为他们被认为是公平的、值得信赖的。

trustworthy.en: I used to think Emily was honest and trustworthy, but now I know better.
trustworthy.zh: 我曾经认为艾米丽是诚实和值得信赖的，但现在我更清楚了。

shellfish.zh: 鱼和甲壳类水生动物是特产。

shellfish.en: Tests showed increased levels of toxin in shellfish.
shellfish.zh: 测试表明贝类中的毒素级别上升了。

shellfish.en: Think about where fish and shellfish live.
shellfish.zh: 想想鱼类和贝类所生活的环境。

hiking.zh: 她的业余爱好包括徒步旅行和摄影。

hiking.en: I had done no skiing, no climbing, and no hiking.
hiking.zh: 我从未滑过雪、攀过岩和徒步旅行过。

hiking.en: If the weather's fine, we'll go hiking this weekend.
hiking.zh: 如果天气好，我们这个周末就去远足。

ordain.en: Do for Aaron and his sons everything I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.
ordain.zh: 你要照我一切所吩咐的，向亚伦和他儿子行承接圣职的礼七天。

ordain.en: And so ordain I in all churches.
ordain.zh: 我吩咐各教会都是这样。

ordain.en: Please ordain me a Bhikkhu so that I can develop the Noble Eightfold Path.
ordain.zh: 请给我授戒让我成为比丘，这样我就能够修行八正道。

complimentary.en: There was a complimentary basket of fruit in our room.
complimentary.zh: 我们房间里有一篮免费赠送的水果。

complimentary.en: In addition to the sale, we're running a promotion for complimentary tailoring if you need it.
complimentary.zh: 除了打折，如果你需要的话，我们的促销活动还包括免费的剪裁服务。

complimentary.en: She was extremely complimentary about his work.
complimentary.zh: 她对他的工作给予了高度评价。

malicious.en: That might merely have been malicious gossip.
These are not necessarily hateful, malicious people.
malicious.zh: 这些不一定是心怀怨恨、有恶意的人。

malicious.en: It was malicious gossip, completely without substance.
malicious.zh: 这是恶意造谣，完全没有事实根据。

astute.zh: 那是个非常精明的结论。

astute.en: He is an extremely astute political tactician.
astute.zh: 他是一个极精明的政治谋略家。

unaffected.en: No area was spared or unaffected, from the foggy northern coast to the Sierra Nevada Mountains.
unaffected.zh: 从雾蒙蒙的北部海岸到内华达山脉，没有一个地区幸免或不受影响。

unaffected.en: People's rights are unaffected by the new law.
unaffected.zh: 新法规没有影响人民的权利。

unaffected.en: She seemed totally unaffected by what she'd drunk.
unaffected.zh: 她似乎完全没有受到所喝的东西的影响。

figurine.en: Does my Iron Man collectible figurine watch me when I sleep?
figurine.zh: 我收藏的钢铁侠公仔也会在我睡觉的时候看着我吗？

figurine.en: Carved figurine of an Upsara, on the walls of the Ankor Wat temple in Siam Reap, Cambodia.
figurine.zh: 柬埔寨暹粒吴哥窟寺庙墙上的雕刻塑像。

figurine.en: He'd seen her, day after day, at her desk in the technology department, poised and delicate as a China figurine.
figurine.zh: 在技术部门她的办公桌旁，他每天都能见到她，她就像瓷器上的雕画一样文静典雅。

prowl.en: There was a fox on the prowl near the chickens.
prowl.zh: 有一只狐狸在鸡群附近徘徊。

prowl.en: The ecology of the region also permitted armed predators to prowl the surrounding barrens, which were almost impossible for a state to control.
prowl.zh: 该地区的生态环境使得武装侵略者在周围的荒漠中潜行，国家几乎难以控制这些荒漠。

prowl.en: Australia's wild dog, the dingo, is on the prowl.
prowl.zh: 澳大利亚的野狗在游荡。

fertilization.en: From fertilization until birth is about 266 days.
fertilization.zh: 从受精到出生大约是266天。

fertilization.en: The sex of the embryo is predetermined at fertilization.
fertilization.zh: 胚胎的性别早在受精时就决定了。

fertilization.en: The sperm fuses with the egg to begin the process of fertilization.
fertilization.zh: 精子与卵子结合开始受精过程。

appraise.zh: 经理必须对全体员工作出评价。

appraise.en: This prompted many employers to appraise their selection and recruitment policies.
appraise.zh: 这促使很多雇主评价其人才选聘政策。

appraise.en: She stepped back to appraise her workmanship.
appraise.zh: 她后退一步，鉴赏她作品的艺术性。

entrench.zh: 它也可能使通货紧缩更加难以逆转。

entrench.en: A New Year looks sure to entrench old resentments.
entrench.zh: 新的一年，旧有的愤恨还将根深蒂固。

entrench.en: That would further entrench the divisions between the two sides.
entrench.zh: 这将进一步加剧双方的分歧。

intrinsically.en: Psychologists also agree curiosity is intrinsically motivated.
intrinsically.zh: 心理学家也同意好奇是内在驱动的。

intrinsically.en: The central state, though often very rich and very populous, was intrinsically fragile.
intrinsically.zh: 尽管中央帝国非常富足且人口稠密，但本质上还很脆弱。

intrinsically.en: Constable was extraordinarily modern in believing that nothing could be intrinsically ugly.
intrinsically.zh: 康斯特布尔很前卫地相信没有天生丑陋的东西。

extracurricular.en: Each child had participated in extracurricular activities at school.
extracurricular.zh: 每个孩子都参加了学校的课外活动。

extracurricular.en: Freedom to pursue extracurricular activities is totally unrestricted.
extracurricular.zh: 参加课外活动的自由完全不受限制。

extracurricular.en: There are more extracurricular activities in high school than in middle school.
extracurricular.zh: 高中的课外活动比初中多。

overcrowded.en: Too many poor people are living in overcrowded conditions.
overcrowded.zh: 有太多的贫民生活在十分拥挤的条件下。

overcrowded.en: He argued that the overcrowded cities were the product of a system based on "selfishness" and "rapacity."
overcrowded.zh: 他辩称说，过分拥挤的城市是建立在“自私”和“贪婪”基础上的制度造成的。

overcrowded.en: The traffic was aggressive and choked; the pedestrian crossings deadly; the buses overcrowded; the train stations scruffy and underfunded.
overcrowded.zh: 交通拥挤不堪；行人肆无忌惮；公车人满为患；火车站肮脏寒碜。

uproar.zh: 这篇文章引起了轩然大波。

uproar.en: The announcement caused uproar in the crowd.
uproar.zh: 公告在人群中引起了一阵骚动。

uproar.en: When he made his entrance on stage there was uproar.

eel.en: At once like an eel she slid between Starkey's legs into the water.
eel.zh: 她像条鳗鱼似的，立刻从斯塔奇两腿之间滑入水中。

eel.en: As soon as he touched the knocker, it became an eel and wiggled away into the darkness.
eel.zh: 他一碰到门环，它就变成了一条鳗鱼，在黑暗中扭动着消失了。

eel.en: Many people enjoy eating fried eel, but few stop to think about the life of this unique fish.
eel.zh: 很多人喜欢吃炸鳗鱼，但很少有人会停下来想想这种独特鱼类的生活习性。

vindicate.en: He tried hard to vindicate his honor.
vindicate.zh: 他拼命维护自己的名誉。

vindicate.en: The 2010 harvest did not seem to vindicate his judgment.
vindicate.zh: 但2010年的收成却似乎不能佐证其判断。

vindicate.en: Save me, o God, by your name; vindicate me by your might.
vindicate.zh: 用丝弦的乐器。神阿，求你以你的名救我，凭你的大能为我伸冤。

caterpillar.en: The caterpillar will eventually metamorphose into a butterfly.
caterpillar.zh: 毛毛虫最终将蜕变成一只蝴蝶。

err.en: The original quote about human nature went like this: "To err is human, to forgive, divine."
err.zh: 关于人性的原话是这样写的：“犯错是人的行为，而宽恕是神的事情。”

err.en: They may be wise to err on the side of caution.
err.zh: 他们宁可失之过于谨慎也不冒风险也许是明智的。

dredge.en: The papers keep trying to dredge up details of his past love life.
dredge.zh: 这些报纸老是翻出他以往爱情生活的琐事。

axle.en: The damage that trucks do to highways escalates dramatically with the weight borne per axle.
axle.zh: 卡车对公路的破坏随着每根车轴承受的重量而急剧增加。

axle.en: In the central machine room an array of ten hydraulic motors then begins to rotate the central axle.
axle.zh: 在中央机房，十个液压发动机开始旋转中心轴。

axle.en: Daimler-Benz owned the company then and had the good grace to place the Chrysler chassis on a Mercedes axle.
axle.zh: 当时，戴姆勒-奔驰拥有这家公司，很大方地把克莱斯勒的底盘放在梅赛德斯的车轴上。

fluency.en: The team lacked fluency during the first half.
fluency.zh: 该队在上半场打得不够流畅。

fluency.en: His son was praised for speeches of remarkable fluency.
fluency.zh: 他的儿子非常流利的发言受到了表扬。

fluency.en: The research investigates how foreign speakers gain fluency.
fluency.zh: 这项研究旨在调查讲外语的人如何增加流利程度。

semblance.en: The ceasefire brought about a semblance of peace.
semblance.zh: 停火协定带来了表面的和平。

semblance.en: Life at last returned to some semblance of normality.
semblance.zh: 生活似乎终于恢复了正常。

semblance.en: At least a semblance of normality has been restored to parts of the country.
semblance.zh: 这个国家的部分地区至少在表面上已恢复正常。

replete.en: Replete, guests can then retire to the modern conservatory for coffee.
replete.zh: 吃饱喝足后，宾客们可以到现代化的暖房里享受一杯咖啡。

replete.en: The book is also replete with codas.

junction.en: I had right of way at the junction.
junction.zh: 我在这交叉路口有优先通行权。
在这个路口，公共汽车有优先通行权。

junction.en: It was near the junction of City Road and Old Street.
junction.zh: 那是在城市路与老街的交叉路口附近。

instill.en: Through consumption, people come to understand, instill meaning in, and act upon objects encountered in the world.
instill.zh: 通过消费，人们开始理解、灌输意义，并对世界上遇到的物体采取行动。

instill.en: The easy rhythm and pop arrangement even instill a feeling of musical eroticism.
instill.zh: 轻松的旋律和流行音乐的安排甚至逐渐注入了一种音乐的情色的感觉。

instill.en: Schools should foster children's interest in sports to instill into them the values of teamwork and sportsmanship.
instill.zh: 学校应该培养孩子们对运动的兴趣，以教导他们合作和体育精神的价值。

jostle.en: Small cars hoot and jostle in a race against three-wheeled auto-rickshaws, dilapidated buses, and the odd bullock cart.
jostle.zh: 道路上混杂着相互鸣笛争道的小型汽车、电动三轮车、破旧的公共汽车和牛拉单车。

jostle.en: Words were his way of ordering the jostle of life.
Below, Shouting women jostle for position with their containers.
jostle.zh: 下面的妇女们叫喊着，生怕抢不到放水罐的位置。

blunder.en: It had been a monumental blunder to give him the assignment.
blunder.zh: 分配给他这项任务是一个巨大的错误。

blunder.en: She cast a sidelong glance at Eric to see if he had noticed her blunder.
blunder.zh: 她偷偷斜扫了埃里克一眼，看他有没有留意到她的错误。

blunder.en: I think he made a tactical blunder by announcing it so far ahead of time.
blunder.zh: 我认为他如此提早宣布消息是犯了战术上的错误。

allot.en: It is suggested that 5,000-6,000 years ago people in the Middle East and North Africa started to allot specific lengths of time to tasks.
allot.zh: 据说，在5000至6000年前，中东和北非的人们开始分配特定时间段来完成任务。
给大多数部门分配固定的资金。

allot.en: Enquiries are so large that we can only than allot you 200 cases.
allot.zh: 询盘如此之多，我们只能分给你们200箱货。

eyelash.en: All men are afraid of eyelash curlers.
Maybe the guy who's blinking a lot has an eyelash in his eye, and the girl covering her mouth is just self-conscious.
eyelash.zh: 也许一个男人频繁眨眼睛只是因为眼睛里进去了一根睫毛，一个女孩捂住嘴只是难为情。

eyelash.en: Eyelash vipers are indigenous to Central and South America and come in a variety of colors, including shocking yellow.
eyelash.zh: 扁斑奎蛇在中美洲和南美洲土生土长，并有着各种颜色，其中包括惹眼的黄色。

encase.en: The bag eats encase, is salary OK under minimum wage standard?
encase.zh: 包吃包住，工资就可以低于最低工资标准吗？

encase.en: To cover, envelop, or encase, as by folding or coiling something about.
encase.zh: 包起来，缠绕：覆盖、包裹或装箱，如通过折叠或缠绕某物。

thorny.en: The question of who should pay for reskilling is a thorny one.
thorny.zh: 谁应该为再培训买单是一个棘手的问题。

thorny.en: The coming use of autonomous vehicles, for example, poses thorny ethical questions.
thorny.zh: 例如，即将投入使用的自动驾驶汽车带来了棘手的伦理问题。

thorny.en: At the same time, the policy addresses none of the truly thorny questions about homework.
thorny.zh: 与此同时，该政策并没有解决关于家庭作业的真正棘手的问题。

configure.en: How easy was it to configure the software?
configure.zh: 配置该软件有多容易呢？

configure.en: After you have successfully installed these products, you must next configure demo environments.
configure.zh: 在你成功安装这些产品之后，接下来你必须配置演示环境。

cull.en: To save remaining herds and habitat, the national parks department is planning to cull 2000 elephants.
cull.zh: 为挽救余下的兽群及其栖息地，国家公园管理部门正计划杀掉2000头大象。
大多数高管盼望来场优胜劣汰。
许多补贴不当地躲过剔除。

nutritionist.en: A personal diet plan is devised after a consultation with a nutritionist.
nutritionist.zh: 经向营养师作咨询后，一份个人饮食方案设计出来了。

nutritionist.en: I've been to see an internist, a nutritionist, and a chiropractor.
nutritionist.zh: 我已经求诊过一位内科医生、一位营养学家和一位按摩师了。
韦尔登是一位营养学家。

clot.en: They removed a clot from his brain.
clot.zh: 他们从他的大脑里取出了血块。

clot.en: A brain scan revealed the blood clot.
clot.zh: 脑部扫描检查发现了那个血块。

nutritious.en: Oats provide good, nutritious food for horses.
nutritious.zh: 燕麦为马提供营养丰富的好饲料。

nutritious.en: It is always important to choose enjoyable, nutritious foods.
nutritious.zh: 选择好吃的、有营养的食品总是很重要的。

nutritious.en: Nectarine is a nutritious fruit and is welcomed by consumers.
nutritious.zh: 油桃是一种营养丰富的水果，深受消费者欢迎。

increment.en: He was able to estimate the annual increment of salt to the oceans.
increment.zh: 他能够估算出海水中盐分的年增量。

increment.en: They sighted each pole, reading off measurements that were then used to calculate the change in elevation over each increment.
increment.zh: 他们瞄准了每个极点，读出测量值，然后用这些测量值来计算每个增量上的海拔变化。

increment.en: Surveyors marched inland from the coast for thousands of miles, stopping at increments of as little as a few feet to measure their elevation, and marking each increment with two poles.
increment.zh: 测量员从海岸向内陆行进数千英里，每增加几英尺就停下来测量海拔，每增加一英尺就用两根杆子做标记。

heterogeneous.en: Geologists have long known that the Earth's mantle is heterogeneous, but its spatial arrangement remains unresolved—is the mantle essentially layered or irregu larly heterogeneous?
heterogeneous.zh: 地质学家早就知道地球的地幔是不均匀的，但是它的空间排列仍然没有确定——地幔本质上是分层的还是完全不均匀的？

heterogeneous.en: Glycans can be heterogeneous as well, consisting of many different glycoforms attached to one site.
heterogeneous.zh: 聚糖也可以是异质的，由附着在一个位点的许多不同的糖型组成。

nascent.en: Hamilton's other proposals, including protection tariffs for nascent American industry, were defeated.
nascent.zh: 汉密尔顿的其他建议，包括对新生的美国工业征收保护关税，都被否决了。

nascent.en: Another nascent technology takes a different approach.
nascent.zh: 另一种新生技术另辟蹊径。

nascent.en: But finding nascent massive stars has proven difficult.
nascent.zh: 但找到新生的巨型恒星很不容易。

electrician.en: The only electrician we could get hold of was miles away.
electrician.zh: 我们惟一能够联络上的电工在几英里之外。
电工笨拙地做接线工作。

abate.en: Steps are to be taken to abate pollution.
abate.zh: 应该采取措施减少污染。

abate.en: The demands of the north will not abate.
We must abate the noise in our big cities.
abate.zh: 我们必须在我们大城市中消除噪音。

minuscule.en: The film was shot in 17 days, a minuscule amount of time.
minuscule.zh: 这部电影用了短短的17天就拍摄完成了。

minuscule.en: This minuscule rotor wiggled clockwise or anticlockwise as molecules bumped into it from one side or the other.
minuscule.zh: 当分子从一边或另一边撞击这个微型转子时，它会顺时针或逆时针摆动。

minuscule.en: Many of these have minuscule limbs; some look more like snakes than lizards and a few have completely lost the toes on their hind limbs.
minuscule.zh: 其中很多动物都有细小的四肢；有些看起来更像蛇而不是蜥蜴，还有一些完全失去了后肢的脚趾。

deafening.en: The noise of the machine was deafening.
deafening.zh: 机器的轰鸣声震耳欲聋。

deafening.en: One blinding flash after another came, and peal on peal of deafening thunder.
deafening.zh: 炫目的闪电一道接着一道，震耳欲聋的雷声一声接着一声。

deafening.en: A bolt of lightning crossed the darkened sky, accompanied by a deafening thunder clap.
deafening.zh: 一道闪电划过漆黑的天空，伴随着震耳欲聋的雷声。

molten.en: An immense volume of rocks and molten lava was erupted.
molten.zh: 大量岩石和熔岩喷发出来。

molten.en: The volcano spewed a fountain of molten rock 650 feet in the air.
molten.zh: 这座火山喷射出的熔岩高达650英尺。

molten.en: A nearby volcano erupted violently, sending out a hail of molten rock and boiling mud.
molten.zh: 一座附近的火山猛烈爆发，喷出大量熔岩和沸腾的泥浆。

psychotic.en: The man, who police believe is psychotic, is thought to be responsible for eight attacks.
psychotic.zh: 警方相信有精神错乱的那个男人，被认为要为8起攻击事件负责。

psychotic.en: Meprobamate and benactyzine are helpful in the treatment of neurotic psychotic depression.
psychotic.zh: 眠尔通和胃复康有助于精神抑郁症的治疗。

psychotic.en: The psychotic attempted to fire the hospital.
psychotic.zh: 这个精神病人企图在医院放火。

preface.en: The preface of the book includes an account of the author's life.
preface.zh: 该书前言记述了作者生平。

preface.en: Remember I asked you from the preface, John Ray's preface, to figure out who Dolly Schiller is, who dies in childbed.
preface.zh: 还记得我曾让你们找出约翰·雷序言中的，死在产床上的多莉是谁。

preface.en: The president of the National Academy, Bruce Alberts, added this key point in the preface to the panel's report: "Science never has all the answers."
preface.zh: 美国国家科学院的主席布鲁斯·阿尔伯茨在该小组报告的前言中补充了这一点：“科学永远无法提供所有答案。”

impromptu.en: "This was an impromptu affair," explained the Rat.
impromptu.zh: “这是一件即兴的事。”水鼠解释说。

impromptu.en: This afternoon the Palestinians held an impromptu press conference.
impromptu.zh: 今天下午巴勒斯坦人召开了一场临时记者招待会。

impromptu.en: Security forces at a impromptu checkpoint marked by a small minibus wave us by.
impromptu.zh: 驻扎在一个以一辆小型面包车为标志的临时检查站的安全部队挥手示意我们通过。

deduce.en: Usually it is left to employers to deduce the potential from a list of extracurricular adventures on a graduate's resume.
deduce.zh: 通常情况下，由雇主从毕业生简历上的课外活动清单中来推断他们的潜力。

deduce.en: The authors want to deduce a brief formulation, and use all-purpose program to get exact result for echelon, rectangle and rotundity cross section.
deduce.zh: 作者想推导简短的公式，对梯形、矩形和圆形断面采用通用的程序，以得到准确的结果。

deduce.en: IQ tests ask you to complete verbal and visual analogies, to envision paper after it has been folded and cut, and to deduce numerical sequences, among other similar tasks.
deduce.zh: 智商测试要求你完成语言和视觉上的类比，想象纸张折叠和剪切之后的样子，推断数字序列，以及其他类似的任务。

postage.zh: 对于国外订单，邮资是另计的。
所有的价格都包括邮资和包装费。
本价格包括邮资和包装费。

pamper.en: "Mother, don't pamper him," he called after her.
pamper.zh: “他妈，别纵容他。”他在她身后喊道。

pamper.en: Why don't you let your mother pamper you for a while?
pamper.zh: 为什么你不让你妈妈照顾你一会儿呢？
别把你的小女儿娇坏了！

tortoise.zh: 乌龟，你跑到这儿了？这么快！

levy.en: It turns out Levy is talking in metaphorical terms.
What are UK people's opinions about the levy of tourist tax?
levy.zh: 英国人对征收旅游税有什么看法？

levy.en: Some UK cities have lobbied without success for the power to levy a charge on visitors.
levy.zh: 一些英国城市为此进行了游说，但并没有成功获得向游客收费的权力。

sonic.en: While Dairy Queen gives kids free ice cream with their meal, some chains — including Wendy's and Sonic — have added fruits and vegetables.
sonic.zh: 虽然冰雪皇后给孩子提供免费冰激凌，但有些连锁店——包括温迪店和索尼克——给菜单添加了水果和蔬菜。
音速小子在路上堵车了。

sonic.en: Let's get the violins to fill in sonic space.
sonic.zh: 于是用小提琴把声音的空间填满。

procure.en: The meat they'd managed to procure assuaged their hunger.
procure.zh: 他们想方设法获得的肉食使他们得以充饥。

procure.en: It remained very difficult to procure food, fuel, and other daily necessities.
procure.zh: 当时仍然很难获得食品、燃料和其他日用必需品。

procure.en: Timber ran short, and it was necessary to procure it from farther and farther away.
procure.zh: 木材短缺，必须从越来越远的地方获得。

nocturnal.en: The dormouse is a shy, nocturnal creature.
nocturnal.zh: 榛睡鼠是一种在夜间活动的胆小动物。

nocturnal.en: Nocturnal animals sleep by day and hunt by night.
nocturnal.zh: 夜间活动的动物白天睡觉晚上猎食。

nocturnal.en: When there is a full moon, this nocturnal rodent is careful to stay in its burrow.
nocturnal.zh: 在有满月出现的时候，这种夜间出没的啮齿类动物小心地呆在它的洞里。

lull.en: There was a lull in political violence after the election of the current president.
lull.zh: 现任总统选举结束以后，政治暴力曾暂时平息。

lull.en: Most probably, the lull is due to the summer holidays.
lull.zh: 不过，现在的间歇很可能是正放暑假的缘故。

lull.en: So how likely is Toyota to repeat Audi's 15-year lull?
lull.zh: 那么，丰田有多大的可能性重复奥迪15年的恢复？

estuary.en: Sturgeon fishing has been pretty good in the estuary.
estuary.zh: 鲟鱼捕捞在这个河口一直很好。

estuary.en: The canal was built to connect Sheffield with the Humber estuary.
estuary.zh: 修建这条运河是为了将设菲尔德和亨伯河河口连接起来。

estuary.en: The river opens up suddenly into a broad estuary.
estuary.zh: 河面突然变宽，形成了一个宽阔的河湾。

steamer.zh: 你们的轮船什么时候启航？

steamer.en: The steamer Swadeshi had fouled the Howrah bridge and sunk.
steamer.zh: “斯瓦德希”号轮船撞在豪拉桥上沉没了。

steamer.en: Under the stress of competition, steamer was added to steamer, loss piled on loss, while the income dwindled till it ceased to be worth while to print tickets.
steamer.zh: 在竞争的压力下，轮船一艘艘增加，亏损越来越大，而收入却逐渐减少，最后连印船票都不值得了。

stout.zh: 雅各布斯是个身材结实，脸色红润的男人。

stout.en: I hope you've both got stout shoes.
stout.zh: 我希望你们两个都穿结实的鞋。

stout.en: He put up a stout defence in court.
stout.zh: 他在法庭上进行了顽强的辩护。

pendant.en: She told the artist, "Paint me with diamond earrings, a diamond necklace, emerald bracelets, and a ruby pendant."
pendant.zh: 她告诉那位肖像画家说：“画带着钻石耳环、钻石项链、祖母绿手镯，还有红宝石垂饰的我。”

pendant.en: I can preserve his inspiring legacy more powerfully through writing than through the hummingbird pendant I wear around my neck.
pendant.zh: 比起我脖子上佩戴的那个蜂鸟链坠，写作更能让我有力地继承他那些让人激动的遗产。

pendant.en: We envision the camera becoming so small that it integrates into clothing, such as the button of a shirt, a brooch, or a pendant.
pendant.zh: 我们想象一下，如果这个摄影机非常小巧，我们就可以把它放进衣服里，像衬衫扣子、胸针、或是项链的坠子一样。

climatic.en: The warming of the Earth and the consequent climatic changes affect us all.
climatic.zh: 全球变暖以及随之而来的气候变化影响我们每个人。

climatic.en: It must be possible to determine the time at which the inferred climatic conditions held.
climatic.zh: 必须能够确定所推断的气候条件所维持的时间。

skylight.en: The government said that while Bhutto dodged the attack, the power of the blast struck her head against the car's skylight, causing her skull to crack and die.
skylight.zh: 政府说，布托在躲避袭击的时候，爆炸产生的威力使她的头撞在车的天窗上，导致她头骨碎裂而死亡。

skylight.en: Eight monumental curving staircases of granite with over 4000 individually cast bronze balusters are capped by for skylight domes and two stained glass rotundas.
skylight.zh: 八个巨大的弯曲的花岗岩楼梯，上面有超过4000个单独铸造的青铜栏杆，顶部是天窗圆顶和两个彩色玻璃圆顶。

skylight.en: Air terminals buildings adopt air supply tower, floor exhaust grillage and smoke exhausting skylight controlled by infrared detector.
skylight.zh: 候机楼采用了地面送风亭射流送风方式、地面排风方式及红外线对射探测器控制的排烟天窗。

flaunt.en: It's not an externally observable characteristic unless you want to flaunt it.
flaunt.zh: 除非你想炫耀它，否则它不是一个外在可见的特征。

flaunt.en: Store owners will tell you horror stories about shoppers with attitude, who walk in demanding discounts and flaunt their new power at every turn.
flaunt.zh: 商店老板会告诉你一些态度傲慢的顾客的可怕故事，他们走进来要求折扣，在每一个角落炫耀他们的新权力。

flaunt.en: If you don't want it, flaunt it.
flaunt.zh: 如果你不想要它，那就取笑它吧。

haste.en: She made haste to open the door.
The letter had clearly been written in haste.
haste.zh: 这封信明显是在匆忙中写的。

haste.en: 'More haste, less speed' is a well-known paradox.
haste.zh: “欲速则不达”是人们熟知的似非而是的隽语。

broadband.en: Broadband is still more expensive than dial-up services.
broadband.zh: 宽带还是要比拨号服务费钱得多。

broadband.en: Telcos were struggling to make money from broadband services.
broadband.zh: 各家电信公司那时正努力通过宽带业务赢利。

broadband.en: A recent study shows many broadband services lack basic security features.
broadband.zh: 最近研究表明许多宽带服务缺少基本的安全特性。

beset.en: The Europeans, beset by difficulties in the eurozone, are desperate that the job should once again go to one of them.
beset.zh: 受到欧元区困境困扰的欧洲人迫切希望，这一职位应再次由他们中的一个人担任。

beset.en: The novels chronicle the experiences of women who, beset with hardships, find within themselves qualities of intelligence, will, resourcefulness, and courage sufficient to overcome their obstacles.
beset.zh: 这些小说记录了女性的经历，她们被困难困扰，而后发现自己的智慧、意志、机智和勇气足以克服她们的障碍。

beset.en: The team was beset by injury all season.
beset.zh: 这个队整个赛季都因队员受伤而受困扰。

fascism.en: They heard the protesters shout: "No more fascism!"
fascism.zh: 他们听见抗议者在高呼：“打倒法西斯主义！”

fascism.en: It is the 70th anniversary of both the world's anti-fascism war and the victory of China's Resistance War against Japanese Aggression this year.
fascism.zh: 今年是世界反法西斯战争胜利70周年，也是中国人民抗日战争胜利70周年。

fascism.en: The ideology of the movement was a blend of fascism and ultraconservatism.
fascism.zh: 该运动的意识形态是法西斯主义和超保守主义的融合。

spade.zh: 铁锹撞在什么金属物件上发出刺耳的声音。

spade.en: I grabbed the spade and started digging.
spade.zh: 我抓起铁锹开始挖了起来。

spade.en: Whatever does that want a spade for?

slant.en: You slant the pen with an angle of 30 degrees on the paper when you're writing.
slant.zh: 你书写的时候笔身是倾斜的，和纸张形成30度的倾角。

slant.en: Each book, paper, or presentation that presents a set of patterns introduces the pattern concept with a different slant.
slant.zh: 那些展示了模式集合的每一本书、论文或展示都使用不同观点介绍了模式概念。

slant.en: To help generate lift to keep midwater, the top of the tail extends farther back than the bottom, creating a slant along the back edge.
slant.zh: 为了保持在水中不至于沉底，尾部的顶端比底端向后延伸，沿着后端形成一个斜面，产生提力。

debtor.en: That debtor in a sales contract is the Seller.
debtor.zh: 在销售合同中，此债务人为卖方。

debtor.en: Private spending in the debtor nations fell sharply.
debtor.zh: 债务国家的私人开支剧烈下降。

debtor.en: All four of the debtor countries in the chart enjoyed housing booms.
debtor.zh: 在图表中的四个债务国都享受了房地产繁荣。

mummy.en: Mummy and Daddy will be back soon.

apex.en: To maintain a balance, big "apex" fish may be as important as the small one.
apex.zh: 为维持平衡，生态系统“顶点”的大鱼可能和小鱼一样重要。

apex.en: They rigged up a tent-shaped scaffold directly above the tip of the horizontal column, with pulleys suspended from the scaffold's apex.
apex.zh: 他们在水平立柱的顶端正上方安装了一个帐篷状的脚手架，在脚手架的顶端悬挂滑轮。

apex.en: Those hanging from every wall, or upon stands in the ground, are the works of those who came before them and reached the apex of their profession.
apex.zh: 那些挂在每面墙上，或立在地面上的，是那些在她之前来，达到了艺术顶峰的前辈们的作品。

chronological.en: The facts should be presented in chronological order.
chronological.zh: 这些事实应按时间先后顺序陈述。

chronological.en: I have arranged these stories in chronological order.
chronological.zh: 我按时间顺序排列了这些故事。

chronological.en: My own shelves are a kind of roadmap through my life, telling a chronological tale.
chronological.zh: 我自己的书架是我的某种人生路标，从时间维度上讲述了我的故事。

popularize.en: At this point, Goethe was already a well-known author, so he was easily able to popularize this idea of primary colors, and specifically the idea of red, yellow and blue as THE primary colors.
popularize.zh: 此时，歌德已经是位很有名的作家了，所以他能很容易就把原色的概念推广出去，特别是把红、黄、蓝作为“三原色”的概念并加以推广。

popularize.en: The programme did much to popularize little-known writers.
popularize.zh: 这个节目大力宣扬不太知名的作家。

popularize.en: "The biggest motivation for such platforms is to popularize AI," Dube says.
popularize.zh: 杜布说：“这些平台的最大动机就是推广人工智能。”

garb.en: He wore the garb of a scout.
garb.zh: 他穿了一身童子军的装束。

garb.en: The garb was presented to Obama by elders in Wajir.
garb.zh: 这身装扮是瓦基的一位老人家送给奥巴马的。

garb.en: I wonder what our garb will look like in the future.
garb.zh: 我想知道未来我们的服装是怎么样的？

apprehensive.en: You have no reason to be apprehensive of the future.
People are still terribly apprehensive about the future.
apprehensive.zh: 人们对未来依旧极为担心。

apprehensive.en: She was deeply apprehensive that something might go wrong.
apprehensive.zh: 她很担心可能要出什么差错。

personalize.en: The mass media tends to personalize politics.
personalize.zh: 大众传媒往往把政治个人化。

personalize.en: You can usually also personalize a computer dictionary.
personalize.zh: 你还通常可以根据个人需要设计一个电脑词典。

personalize.en: When you sign up, you adopt an animated penguin to chat with friends, play games, explore, collect coins and even personalize your very own igloo.
personalize.zh: 注册时，你就会领养一只活泼的企鹅来与朋友聊天、玩游戏、探索、收集硬币、甚至让你自己的圆顶冰屋个性化。

diversification.en: The analysis also suggests that pink iguana is one of the earliest examples of species diversification on the islands.
diversification.zh: 分析还表明，粉红色鬣蜥是这一群岛上物种多样化的最早例子之一。

diversification.en: Our species originated around 200,000 years ago, and underwent tremendous diversification, culturally, technologically, linguistically, artistically, for 130,000 years.
diversification.zh: 我们的物种起源于大约20万年前，并经历了13万年的惊人的多样化进程，包括文化、技术、语言和艺术等方面。

diversification.en: The seminar was to discuss diversification of agriculture.
diversification.zh: 该研讨会讨论的是农业多种经营。

purify.en: One tablet will purify a litre of water.
It can also help to purify the water quality, reduce pollution and improve environment.
purify.zh: 荷花还可净化水质、减少污染、改善环境。

purify.en: We purify the water we drink with a water filter designed for the astronauts' use in space.
purify.zh: 我们用滤水器净化饮用水，而滤水器是专为航天员在太空中使用而设计的。

pretext.en: He left the party early on the pretext of having to work.
pretext.zh: 他借口有事要处理，早早离开了聚会。

pretext.en: He left the party early on the pretext of having work to do.
pretext.zh: 他借口有事要处理，早早离开了聚会。

pretext.en: Very often landlords don't return tenants' deposits on the pretext that tenants have done damage to the house.
pretext.zh: 房东通常不退还租户的押金，借口是租户损坏了房子。

bustle.en: We escaped from the hustle and bustle of the city for the weekend.
bustle.zh: 我们周末时躲开了城市的拥挤喧嚣。

bustle.en: The calm of the countryside came as a welcome relief from the hustle and bustle of city life.
bustle.zh: 离开喧嚣忙碌的城市生活，来到宁静的乡村，是一种令人愉快的调剂。

bustle.en: The hotel offers a haven of peace and serenity away from the bustle of the city.
bustle.zh: 那家旅馆远离闹市，是一个幽静安谧的好去处。

prioritize.en: The organization was formed to prioritize the needs of older people.
prioritize.zh: 这个机构是为优先满足老年人的需要而成立的。

prioritize.en: Prioritize what is essential to their best advantage.
prioritize.zh: 优先考虑对他们最有利的重要因素。

prioritize.en: They prioritize their favored activity over what they should do.
prioritize.zh: 他们优先考虑他们喜欢的活动而不是他们应该做的事情。

aquifer.en: A groundwater reservoir from which water can be extracted is called an aquifer.
aquifer.zh: 可以从中抽取水的地下蓄水层被称为含水层。

aquifer.en: Extraction of water depends on two properties of the aquifer: porosity and permeability.
aquifer.zh: 水的开采取决于含水层的两个性质：孔隙度和渗透性。

aquifer.en: Water does not remain immobile in an aquifer but can seep out at springs or leak into other aquifers.
aquifer.zh: 水在含水层中并不是静止不动的，而是会从泉水中渗出，或渗入其他含水层。

habitual.en: If bad posture becomes habitual, you risk long-term effects.
habitual.zh: 如果不良姿势成为习惯，你会有遭受长期影响的危险。

habitual.en: Brad needs to recognize that habitual complainers usually don't want advice.
habitual.zh: 布拉德需要认识到，习惯性抱怨的人通常不需要建议。

habitual.en: Berning have learned that there is power in tying certain behaviors to habitual cues through ruthless advertising.
habitual.zh: 伯宁已经认识到，大量无休止的广告所产生的的力量把某些行为和习惯暗示联系在一起。

sarcasm.zh: 他没有任何讽刺的意思。

sarcasm.en: Sarcasm and demeaning remarks have no place in parenting.
sarcasm.zh: 挖苦和贬损的言语不应用来教育子女。
她挖苦的语言刺伤了他的虚荣心。

snowstorm.en: Unfortunately they ran into a snowstorm along the way.
snowstorm.zh: 他们不幸在途中遇上了暴风雪。

snowstorm.en: A snowstorm hit the West today, bringing with it frigid temperatures.
snowstorm.zh: 一场暴风雪今天袭击西部地区，带来了严寒低温。

snowstorm.en: "That was a dreadful snowstorm"; and he sighed again, and was silent.
snowstorm.zh: “真是一场可怕的暴风雪。”他又叹了口气，陷入沉默。

preposterous.zh: 这些要求简直荒谬绝伦！

preposterous.en: Milton explains the preposterous idea that he has ever visited a prostitute.
preposterous.zh: 弥尔顿解释了他曾拜访过妓女这一荒谬想法。

fertilize.en: It only takes one sperm to fertilize an egg.
fertilize.zh: 只需一个精子就可以使卵受精。

fertilize.en: Since only one female usually lays eggs in a given larva, it would pay her to produce one male only, because this one male could fertilize all his sisters on emergence.
fertilize.zh: 因为通常只有一只雌性在一个特定的幼虫中产卵，所以它只会产生一只雄性，因为这只雄性可以在孵化时使它所有的姐妹受精。

fertilize.en: If they are females, a male may fertilize their eggs.
fertilize.zh: 若它们都是雌性，就要一只雄性来孵化她们的卵。

legitimately.en: Despite these vague categories, one should not claim unequivocally that hostility between recognizable classes cannot be legitimately observed.
legitimately.zh: 尽管存在这些模糊范畴，但我们不应该断然声称，在各个易于辨认出的阶层之间所存在的敌对态度就无法被合理地观察到。

legitimately.en: I'm not referring to employees who are legitimately dissatisfied with their employment conditions due to, say, being denied fair pay or flexible work practices.
legitimately.zh: 我指的不是那些没有获得公平薪酬或未能享受灵活工作方式的员工，他们对工作条件的不满是合理的。

legitimately.en: She can now legitimately claim to be the best in the world.
legitimately.zh: 现在她可以理所当然地声称自己是世界上最优秀的。

ruffle.en: I could tell that my refusal to allow him to ruffle me infuriated him.
ruffle.zh: 我可以断定，我拒绝让他激怒我使他很恼火。

ruffle.en: His direct, often abrasive approach will doubtless ruffle a few feathers.
ruffle.zh: 他那直截了当、常常很粗鲁的方式无疑会激怒一些人。

ruffle.en: Tame birds, when approached, will stretch out their necks and ruffle their neck feathering.
ruffle.zh: 驯化的鸟在人靠近时会伸长脖子，竖起脖子上的羽毛。

surmise.en: This is pure surmise on my part.
There's so little to go on, we can only surmise what happened.
surmise.zh: 几乎没有什么可继续进行的，我们只能猜测发生过的事。

surmise.en: It is mere surmise that Bosch had Brant's poem in mind when doing this painting.
surmise.zh: 博斯画这幅画时头脑里想着勃朗特的诗，这只是猜测而已。

acronym.zh: 此称呼不是只取首字母的缩写词。
请注意传统的递归首字母缩写。

vigilance.en: She stressed the need for constant vigilance.
vigilance.zh: 她强调必须时常保持警惕。

vigilance.en: Constant vigilance is necessary in order to avoid accidents.
vigilance.zh: 为了避免意外事故，必须经常保持警惕。

vigilance.en: It seems to me they still have some fight left in them. We shouldn't relax our vigilance.
vigilance.zh: 他们余勇可贾，我们不能放松警惕。

feign.en: One morning, I didn't want to go to school, and decided to feign illness.
feign.zh: 一天早上，我不愿去上学，就决定装病。

feign.en: I feign dispassion, but I'm not fooling anybody.
feign.zh: 我装作冷静，虽不是为了欺骗任何人。

feign.en: Many, in fact, feign love of life to evade love itself.
feign.zh: 事实上，许多人假装热爱生命，进而逃避爱之本身。

kerosene.en: A leakage of kerosene has polluted water supplies.
kerosene.zh: 泄漏的煤油已污染了水源。

kerosene.en: "What if there is no kerosene this winter?" said Al.—"So what?" she said. "We still have electricity."
kerosene.zh: “今年冬天如果没有煤油可怎么办呢？”阿尔说。—“那又怎么样？”她说。“我们还有电呢。”

kerosene.en: With a flash, the kerosene lamp went out.

crusty.en: Crusty whole wheat bread is my favorite.
crusty.zh: 我最喜欢硬皮全麦面包。

crusty.zh: 不管怎样，这就是守旧的沙特的现状。

crusty.en: Obviously not in physical formats like CDs, and probably not in already-crusty formats like paid downloads.
crusty.zh: 很明显不在物质媒介格式，比如CD，大概也不是已经僵化不堪的格式，比如付费下载。

conversational.en: I learnt conversational Spanish at evening classes.
conversational.zh: 我在夜校班学过西班牙语会话。

conversational.en: It's possible that we all have compromised conversational intelligence.
conversational.zh: 我们都有可能会向会话智能妥协。

conversational.en: Mary is ambitious enough to aspire to conversational fluency in Chinese in four months.
conversational.zh: 玛丽雄心很大， 竟立志在四个月里学会用汉语流利地会话。

cod.en: They unloaded their catch of cod and bass.
cod.zh: 他们卸下捕获的鳕鱼和鲈鱼。

veterinary.zh: 在瑞典，他们会说，'让我们叫兽医来。'

starch.en: There's too much starch in your diet.
starch.zh: 你的日常饮食中淀粉含量太高。

tiptoe.en: He walks as lightly as possible, almost on tiptoe, in order not to wear out his heels in too short a time.
tiptoe.zh: 他尽量轻轻地走路，几乎是用脚尖颠著走，就是为了不要太快磨烂鞋底。

tiptoe.en: To her, the exercises that Pavlova and the other ballerinas were doing seemed painful, even harmful, standing on tiptoe for hours, moving their bodies in unnatural ways.
tiptoe.zh: 在她看来，巴甫洛娃和其他芭蕾舞演员所做的练习看起来很痛苦，甚至有害，他们踮着脚尖站几个小时，别扭地移动他们的身体。

tiptoe.en: She had to stand on tiptoe to reach the top shelf.
tiptoe.zh: 她得踮着脚才能够到顶层搁架。

fanciful.en: A more fanciful theory is that Mr. Sarkozy has a natural sympathy for the country that was home to his maternal grandfather, a Jew from Thessaloniki.
fanciful.zh: 一个更稀奇的推测说，萨科奇先生对于其外祖父的祖国有一种天然的同情，他的外祖父是来自塞萨洛尼基的犹太人。
而且这个不完全是胡思乱想。
在这里获得丰收也不全是一种幻想。

attractiveness.en: Psychologist and behavioral scientist Nicholas Epley oversaw a key study into self-enhancement and attractiveness.
attractiveness.zh: 心理学家和行为科学家尼古拉斯·埃普利监督了一项关于自我提升和吸引力的重要研究。

attractiveness.en: Psychologist and behavioral scientist Nicholas Epley oversaw a key study in to self-enhancement and attractiveness.
attractiveness.zh: 心理学家和行为科学家尼古拉斯·埃普利监督了一项关于自我提升和吸引力的重要研究。

attractiveness.en: This is the age women start to become "invisible"—our value, attractiveness and power supposedly diminished by the vanishing of youth.
attractiveness.zh: 这是女性开始变得“不受人关注”的年龄——据说我们的价值、吸引力和力量会因为青春消逝而削减。

stockpile.en: An unprecedented number of unsold cars in Japan have forced Toyota to stockpile them in the parking lots of Fuji Speedway.
stockpile.zh: 日本未售出的汽车数量达到前所未有的水平，迫使丰田汽车在富士高速公路停车场大量囤积。

stockpile.zh: 智利已放弃其全部库存。

stockpile.en: Sure, times are tight and it's hard to stockpile.

delinquent.en: Someone would need to pay the $180,000 delinquent tax note at auction.
delinquent.zh: 有人需要在拍卖中支付18万美元的拖欠税款。

delinquent.en: Lenders of all stripes clearly prefer to foreclose on delinquent borrowers.
delinquent.zh: 对于逾期不还贷的借款人，形形色色的放款人明显青睐没收他们的房产。

delinquent.en: That would allow the loan to be classed as "current" rather than "delinquent".
delinquent.zh: 这样起码他们可以把贷款归类为“还贷中”，而不是“拖欠中”。

commencement.en: All applicants should be at least 16 years of age at the commencement of this course.
commencement.zh: 所有申请人在本课程开始时应至少年满16岁。

commencement.en: The protracted nature of the commencement speech did not sit well with the restless group of recent graduates.
commencement.zh: 毕业典礼演讲的时间太长，让这群焦躁不安的应届毕业生很不舒服。

commencement.en: Jobs ended his commencement talk with a call to innovation, both in one's choice of work and in one's life.
commencement.zh: 乔布斯在他的毕业典礼演讲结束时呼吁，在个人职业选择还是生活中都要创新。

populous.en: Indonesia, with 216 million people, is the fourth most populous country in the world.
populous.zh: 印度尼西亚，2.16亿人口，是人口占世界第4位的国家。

populous.en: Nigeria is the most populous African country and an economic powerhouse for the continent.
populous.zh: 尼日利亚是非洲人口最稠密的国家，也是非洲大陆的经济强国。

populous.en: The central state, though often very rich and very populous, was intrinsically fragile.
populous.zh: 尽管中央帝国非常富足且人口稠密，但本质上还很脆弱。

inactive.en: Some animals are inactive during the daytime.
In the unfertilized egg, the substances are inactive and are not distributed homogeneously.
inactive.zh: 在未受精卵中，这些物质是不活跃的，而且分布不均匀。

inactive.en: A third group are known as crepuscular: they thrive in the low light of dawn and dusk and remain inactive at other hours.
inactive.zh: 第三组被称为黄昏组：他们在黎明和黄昏的微光中茁壮成长，而在其他时间则不活跃。

wean.en: The doctor tried to wean her off sleeping pills.
wean.zh: 医生设法使她逐渐停止服用安眠药片。

wean.en: You are given capsules or pills with small quantities of nicotine to wean you from the habit.
wean.zh: 会给你一些含有少量尼古丁的胶囊或药片帮你戒瘾。

automation.en: Automation meant the loss of many factory jobs.
automation.zh: 自动化意味着许多工厂工人失业。

automation.en: In the last ten years automation has reduced the work force here by half.
automation.zh: 在过去的10年中，自动化已经减少了这里一半的劳动力。

automation.en: Administrative staff may be deskilled through increased automation and efficiency.
automation.zh: 随着自动化程度和效率提高，行政人员可能不再需要专业技能。

anatomical.en: The superior nuchal line is not always a reliable external anatomical mark.
anatomical.zh: 上项线不是一个可靠的浅表解剖学标志。

anatomical.en: Caudipteryx has an interesting mix of reptile and bird-like anatomical features.
anatomical.zh: 尾羽龙有一种有趣的爬行动物和鸟类的混合解剖特征。

anatomical.en: The anatomical relationships and the distance within the asterion, the anteriorangle of parietomastoid sutures and the adjacent bone structures were studied with dried skulls.
anatomical.zh: 研究干性颅骨标本外侧面星点、顶乳突缝前角与周围解剖结构的距离及其位置关系。

vowel.en: Each language has a different vowel system.
vowel.zh: 每种语言都有不同的元音系统。

vowel.en: The student was practising making a new vowel sound.
vowel.zh: 这个学生正在练习发一个新的元音。

vowel.en: Almost every language has an O vowel, a K consonant, and an A vowel.
vowel.zh: 几乎每一种语言都有一个 O 元音、一个 K 辅音和一个 A 元音。

leaflet.zh: 这个传单用的是可移植文档格式。

leaflet.en: You can request a free copy of the leaflet.
leaflet.zh: 你可以索要一份免费的宣传单。

leaflet.en: PS Please show your friends this letter and the enclosed leaflet.
leaflet.zh: 又及：请将这封信和随附的传单拿给你的朋友们看。

spire.en: No one would dream of straightening out the church's knobbly spire.
spire.zh: 没人会梦想使教堂的圆形尖顶变直。

spire.en: Donald perches on a nearby tree and the mouth pointed in the direction of the spire.
spire.zh: 唐纳德栖息在附近的一棵树上，嘴巴指向尖顶的方向。

spire.en: You may be one of those guys who thinks there's nothing cooler than a superhero brooding on a rooftop or cathedral spire.
spire.zh: 也许你也是那种认为没有什么比超级英雄在屋顶或教堂塔尖上沉思更酷的人。

deforestation.en: Rich countries are doing little to address deforestation.
deforestation.zh: 发达国家在解决森林采伐问题上没有什么作为。

deforestation.en: It is widely acknowledged that extensive deforestation would lead to flooding.
deforestation.zh: 众所周知，大面积的森林砍伐会导致洪水泛滥。

deforestation.en: Ferraro wanted to see if Indonesia's poverty-alleviation program was affecting deforestation.
deforestation.zh: 费拉罗想知道印度尼西亚的扶贫项目是否影响了森林砍伐。

piracy.en: Seven of the fishermen have been formally charged with piracy.
piracy.zh: 其中7名渔民已被正式指控犯有海盗罪。

piracy.en: Recently, piracy has become a hot topic under discussion.
piracy.zh: 近来，盗版成为人们讨论的热门话题。

piracy.en: He no longer took an interest in war, nor even in piracy.
piracy.zh: 什么战争什么海盗的，他都不再感兴趣了。

crevice.en: If an ant finds an outstanding hole—such as the inside of an acorn or a rock crevice—it recruits another scout to check it out.
crevice.zh: 如果一只蚂蚁找到了一个出色的洞穴——比如橡子或岩石裂缝的内部——它就会叫来另一只侦察蚁对洞穴进行检查。

crevice.en: If you put your fingers between the crevice at the bottom, and here's where you gotta watch out for the spring, pull the thing apart and that's it.
crevice.zh: 如果你把手指放到底部的缝隙中间，这里你需要小心弹簧，把东西分开，就是这样。

repudiate.zh: 工人和雇主因为共同合约而联系在一起，这一合约双方中任何一方都能拒绝履行，而且这种关系在概念上是一种合伙关系。

repudiate.en: He would repudiate all debts incurred by his son.

deflate.zh: 我不愿伤你的自尊，但是你好像高估了你对我的重要性。

deflate.en: One sharp remark is enough to deflate her.
deflate.zh: 一句尖锐的话足以使她泄气。

brandish.zh: 海胆在海峡群岛附近的海底挥舞着它们的棘突。

brandish.zh: 他大声喊道，真的从鞘中拔出马刀，挥动起来。

flamboyant.zh: 批评家们抨击他的挥霍无度和过分夸张的作风。

flamboyant.zh: 弗雷迪·默丘里曾是硬摇滚乐舞台上一颗耀眼的明星。

pelvis.en: A walker broke his arms, legs, and pelvis yesterday when he plunged 80 feet from a rocky pinnacle.
pelvis.zh: 一位步行者昨天从80英尺高的尖锥形岩石上摔下来，摔断了胳膊、腿和骨盆。

pelvis.zh: 扫描他的胸部、腹部和骨盆也没有什么发现。

pelvis.zh: 它们甚至没有与它的盆骨相连，无法支撑起它的重量。

benefactor.zh: 现在到我们的恩人那儿去吧。

benefactor.en: In his old age he became a benefactor of the arts.
benefactor.zh: 他晚年成了一位艺术赞助人。

benefactor.en: An anonymous benefactor stepped in to provide the prize money.
benefactor.zh: 一位匿名捐助人参与进来提供了奖金。

tacit.en: By tacit agreement , the subject was never mentioned again.
tacit.zh: 根据达成的默契，这个话题从未再提起过。

tacit.en: The question was a tacit admission that a mistake had indeed been made.
tacit.zh: 这个问题等于默认确实已犯了错误。

tacit.en: Exposing historians tacit and intentional sexism, herstorians set out to correct the record—to show that women had held up half the historical sky.
tacit.zh: “她史”揭露了历史学家心照不派和有意的性别歧视，开始纠正记录，表明妇女曾撑起了历史的半边天。

tarnish.en: The affair could tarnish the reputation of the senator.
tarnish.zh: 这一事件可能有损那位参议员的名声。

tarnish.en: Almost immediately, the tarnish will begin to disappear.
Say good-bye to tarnish on brass, copper, or stainless steel.
tarnish.zh: 对光泽暗淡的铜器，黄铜，或者不锈钢说拜拜。

agreeable.en: We spent a most agreeable day together.
agreeable.zh: 我们在一起度过了非常愉快的一天。

agreeable.en: The deal must be agreeable to both sides.
agreeable.zh: 交易必须是双方都可以接受的。

coffer.en: The girl is allowed to dunk her biscuits in her coffer.
coffer.zh: 这女孩得到允许，可以把饼干放在咖啡里浸一浸吃。

interchange.en: They were telling each other, with a confidential interchange of ideas, where they had been during the day.
interchange.zh: 他们彼此秘密地交换着各自的想法，告诉对方白天他们在什么地方。

interchange.en: Your task is to interchange words so that the sentence makes sense.
interchange.zh: 你的任务是替换单词使这句话讲得通。

interchange.en: The 405-167 motorway interchange is a classic cloverleaf, built in the 1960s.
interchange.zh: 建于60年代的405-167高速公路交流道是一条经典的四叶式立体交叉道。

equatorial.en: In the equatorial mountains the low growth form is less prevalent.
equatorial.zh: 在赤道山区，低生长形态较不普遍。

equatorial.en: They appear only in equatorial regions and generally do not form extensive interconnected networks.
equatorial.zh: 它们只出现在赤道地区，一般不会形成广泛的相互连通的网络。

equatorial.en: It is this irreversibly modified world, from the polar caps to the equatorial forests, that is all the nature we have.
equatorial.zh: 从极地盖帽到赤道森林，这是不可逆转的世界，这就是我们拥有的所有自然。

propriety.en: Nobody questioned the propriety of her being there alone.
propriety.zh: 没人认为她只身出现在那里不得体。

propriety.en: China has always been known as a land of propriety and righteousness.
propriety.zh: 中国从来以礼义之邦著称。

propriety.en: Their sense of social propriety is eroded.
propriety.zh: 他们的社交礼仪意识淡薄了。

inlet.en: By selecting a group of suitable entrance parameters, a submerged inlet with the trapezoid entrance on the plane surface is designed and verified.
inlet.zh: 通过选取一组合适的入口参数，设计了一种在平面上具有梯形入口的水下入口，并进行了验证。

inlet.en: TC1 is mounted directly on the pump inlet tee replacing the convectron gauge shown on the diagram.
inlet.zh: TC1直接安装在泵进口三通上，取代图中所示的对流管压力表。

inlet.en: Upon inquiry, he learnt that the inn was near an inlet.
inlet.zh: 在询问之后，他知道了客栈在一个水湾附近。

condense.en: When you summarize, you condense an extended idea or argument into a sentence or more in your own words.
condense.zh: 总结的时候，用自己的话把拓展了的观念或论据简缩成一句或几句话。

condense.en: If some reefs are destroyed by storms, starfish populations that inhabited those reefs would have to condense and concentrate on the reefs that are left.
condense.zh: 如果一些珊瑚礁被风暴摧毁了，居住在那些珊瑚礁上的海星种群将不得不集中在剩下的珊瑚礁上。

condense.en: The arch-fiend whispered him to condense into a small compass.
condense.zh: 大恶魔低声说他凝结成一个小指南针。

impenetrable.zh: 他的哲学著作是出了名地令人费解。

impenetrable.en: Their jargon is impenetrable to an outsider.
impenetrable.zh: 他们的行话外人听不懂。

impenetrable.en: No system is impenetrable, and none can promise to eliminate the worst case completely.
impenetrable.zh: 没有哪个系统是不可攻破的，也没有哪个系统能够保证完全杜绝最坏的情况发生。

brunt.en: Young people are bearing the brunt of unemployment.
brunt.zh: 失业对年轻人的冲击最大。

brunt.en: The fjords and islands of Chilean Patagonia take the brunt of the prevailing westerlies that wail across the southern seas.
brunt.zh: 智利巴塔哥尼亚的峡湾和岛屿处于盛行西风带的冲击之下，西风哀号着吹过南部洋面。

brunt.en: Schools will bear the brunt of cuts in government spending.
brunt.zh: 政府削减开支，学校将首当其冲受到影响。

elaboration.en: The importance of the plan needs no further elaboration.
elaboration.zh: 这个计划的重要性无须赘述。

elaboration.en: After the homework has been discussed, the teacher explains the topic of the lesson, slowly and with a lot of repetition and elaboration.
elaboration.zh: "讨论完作业之后，教师会缓慢地、反复精细地讲解这节课的主题。

elaboration.en: The development of an understanding of the self becomes evident between the first and second years of life and shows rapid elaboration in subsequent years.
elaboration.zh: 对自我理解的发展在生命的头一两年间变得明显，在随后的几年里快速地变得详尽。

violinist.en: He had hoped to succeed as a violinist.
violinist.zh: 他曾希望做一名有成就的小提琴家。
罗斯的父亲是一位天才的小提琴手。

violinist.en: He has been described as the world's greatest violinist.
violinist.zh: 他被称为世界上最杰出的小提琴家。

strait.en: An estimated 1,600 vessels pass through the strait annually.
strait.zh: 估计每年有1600艘船经过这个海峡。

strait.en: Yemen commands the strait at the southern end of the Red Sea.
strait.zh: 也门完全控制着红海南端的海峡。

strait.en: The house had a fabulous view out to the Strait of Georgia and the Rockies beyond.
strait.zh: 这座房子有很棒的景观，可以看到乔治亚海峡以及另一头的落基山脉。

neurologist.en: Developing self-awareness requires tuning in to what neurologist Antonio Damasio calls "gut feelings”.
neurologist.zh: 发展自我意识需要调整神经学家 Antonio Damasio 所说的“直觉”。

neurologist.en: Someone with suspected MS should see a neurologist specializing in the disease.
neurologist.zh: 患有疑似MS的症状者需要去看此类疾病的神经病专科医生。

neurologist.en: Doctor Freud was trained as a neurologist.
neurologist.zh: 弗洛伊德医生被培训成为一个神经科专家。

slang.en: Archie liked to think he kept up with current slang.
slang.zh: 阿奇乐于自认为能跟得上时新俚语。

slang.en: The manual is full of the jargon and slang of self-improvement courses.
slang.zh: 该手册中满是自我完善课程的行话和俚语。

slang.en: He tends to use a lot of slang expressions that I've never heard before.
slang.zh: 他往往用许多我以前从未听说过的俚语。

austere.en: The life of the troops was still comparatively austere.
austere.zh: 部队生活相对而言仍然简朴。

austere.en: The room was austere, nearly barren of furniture or decoration.
austere.zh: 这个房间很简朴，几乎没有什么家具或装饰。

austere.en: These days the word "kefir" is consequently more likely to bring to mind glamorous, yoga mat-toting women from Los Angeles than austere visions of blustery Eastern Europe.
austere.zh: 因此，如今“开菲尔”这个词更容易让人联想到来自洛杉矶、带着瑜伽垫的魅力四射的女性，而不是那种狂风大作的东欧的简朴景象。

enlargement.en: There is insufficient space for enlargement of the buildings.
enlargement.zh: 没有足够的空间扩建这些大楼。

enlargement.en: If you like the picture I can send you an enlargement of it.
enlargement.zh: 如果你喜欢这照片，我可以给你寄一张放大的。

enlargement.en: Uvala is a large elongate sinkhole resulting from enlargement.
enlargement.zh: 灰岩干谷是由于扩大而形成的一个大的拉长的天坑。

sedentary.en: I don't think a sedentary life would altogether suit me.
sedentary.zh: 我认为久坐不动的生活方式完全不适合我。

sedentary.en: Obesity and a sedentary lifestyle has been linked with an increased risk of heart disease.
sedentary.zh: 肥胖和久坐的生活方式被认为会增加患心脏病的几率。

sedentary.en: People suffer from obesity because of sedentary study or work.
sedentary.zh: 人们因为久坐的学习或工作而患上肥胖症。

substrate.en: Adults of this species burrow deeply into the substrate where it is cooler and perhaps moister.
substrate.zh: 这个物种的成虫深入到底层中，那里更凉爽，也许也更湿润。
绿板是一种可以接受的基板。

substrate.en: Diaminobenzidine was used as substrate in the techniques.
substrate.zh: 以二氨基联苯胺为底物。

limelight.en: Tony has now been thrust into the limelight, with a high-profile job.
limelight.zh: 托尼有一份令人注目的工作，现在已成为人们关注的焦点。

limelight.en: A male bird of paradise may put himself in the limelight by displaying his spectacular plumage in the best stage setting to attract a female.
limelight.zh: 一只雄性天堂鸟可能会在最佳的场合中展示他华美的羽毛使自己成为关注的焦点，从而吸引雌性。

sanitary.en: The hut had no cooking or sanitary facilities.
sanitary.zh: 这间茅屋里没有厨具和卫生设施。

sanitary.en: The new houses were more sanitary than the old ones had been.

apathy.en: Apathy is the long-standing curse of democracy.
apathy.zh: 冷漠是民主的长期祸根。

apathy.en: They told me about isolation and public apathy.
apathy.zh: 他们向我讲述了孤立感与公众的冷漠。

apathy.en: There is widespread apathy among the electorate.

predate.en: Most of its better buildings predate his rule.
predate.zh: 城内比较好的建筑大多在他统治之前兴建。
他写道：“所有这些，产生的时间早于大萧条。”

predate.en: These worries predate the ructions in the Arab world.
predate.zh: 这些担忧在阿拉伯世界发生动乱之前就出现了。

amber.en: Cars did not stop when the lights were on amber.
amber.zh: 当交通灯是黄色时汽车没有停下来。

amber.en: A burst of sunshine sent a beam of amber light through the window.
amber.zh: 一道阳光透过窗户射进了一束琥珀色的光。

filament.en: The light of an electric lamp comes from an incandescent filament.
filament.zh: 电灯光亮来自白炽灯丝。

filament.en: Edison's bulb is, at its core, a burning filament that casts the glow of a flame.
filament.zh: 爱迪生的灯泡，在它的中心，有一个燃烧的灯丝产生火焰的光芒。

decode.en: Cognitive scientists are now trying to decode the human imagination, to understand how the brain visualizes, dreams and creates.
decode.zh: 认知科学家现在正试图解码人类的想象力，以了解大脑是如何构思、想象以及创造的。

decode.en: All he had to do was decode it and pass it over.
decode.zh: 他所要做的就是解译它，然后把它发过去。

decode.en: About 60,000 subscribers have special adapters to receive and decode the signals.
decode.zh: 大约60000用户有专用适配器来接收和转换信号。

latex.en: Even rubber trees, the local people's main source of income, were so dry that they could no longer produce rubber latex.
latex.zh: 就连作为当地人主要收入来源的橡胶树，也因干旱而无法生产乳胶。

latex.en: Two cerebrospinal fluid specimens have tested positive for Neisseria meningitidis serogroup by latex test.
latex.zh: 通过乳胶测试，两个脑脊液标本对脑膜炎奈瑟菌血清群呈阳性反应。

snowfall.en: The total rain and snowfall amounted to 5 inches.
snowfall.zh: 总降雪和降雨量合计5英寸。

snowfall.en: Surplus snowfall is essential for a glacier to develop.
snowfall.zh: 过剩的降雪是冰川形成的必要条件。

snowfall.en: Its chances for survival are best if it turns white about the time of the first snowfall.
snowfall.zh: 如果它在第一次降雪时就变成白色，生存几率会是最高的。

mascara.zh: 她的睫毛膏被泪水弄糊了。

mascara.en: The mascara is suitable for contact lens wearers.
mascara.zh: 这款睫毛膏适合于戴隐形眼镜的人。

mascara.en: For this very reason, nothing more than mascara has to be definitely waterproof.
mascara.zh: 出于这个原因，就没有什么比睫毛膏更需要防水的了。

deviate.en: Should the use of rewards fail, members can frequently win by rejecting or threatening to ostracize those who deviate from the primary group's norms.
deviate.zh: 如果使用奖励失败了，通过拒绝或威胁来排斥那些偏离主要群体规范的人，成员可以经常获胜。

deviate.en: The bus had to deviate from its usual route because of a road closure.
deviate.zh: 因为道路封闭，公共汽车只得绕道而行。

deviate.en: They're also less likely to deviate in how they treat employees.
deviate.zh: 他们在对待员工的方式上也不太可能有失偏颇。

persevere.en: You have to persevere with difficult students.
persevere.zh: 对难教的学生你必须坚持诲人不倦的精神。
只要你坚持不懈，你自会成功。

persevere.en: Being a close loser could greatly motivate one to persevere in their research.
persevere.zh: 成为惜败者会极大地激励他们坚持自己的研究。

cortex.en: V5 is the area of the visual cortex that's responsible for the sensation of movement.
cortex.zh: V5 是负责运动感觉的视觉皮层区域。

cortex.en: The first of our three brains to evolve is what scientists call the reptilian cortex.
cortex.zh: 我们三个大脑中最先进化的是科学家们所称的爬虫脑皮质。

cortex.en: I've got to scroll up here, if I'm looking, and then I've got the visual cortex engaged.
cortex.zh: 如果我还在看的话，我得滚到这儿，然后我的视觉皮层就参与进来。

cockroach.en: He saw the cockroach scurry under it with the gecko far behind struggling to go under.
cockroach.zh: 他看见那只蟑螂急匆匆地从它下面钻过去，壁虎在后面很远的地方挣扎着要钻过去。

cockroach.en: Your hostess walks in with the turkey in a tray, and says, "I killed the last cockroach."
cockroach.zh: 你的主人用托盘托了一只火鸡进来说：“我刚刚把最后一只蟑螂拍死了。”

cockroach.en: When the lid of the nest box on an ant colony is raised, a whiff of dead cockroach wafts by.
cockroach.zh: 当蚁群的巢箱盖子被揭开时，一股死蟑螂的气息扑面而来。

hereditary.zh: 癫痫是她家族的遗传病。

hereditary.en: Cystic fibrosis is the commonest fatal hereditary disease.
hereditary.zh: 囊性纤维化是最常见的致命性遗传疾病。

maize.en: Wheat, maize and sugar beet are planted in rotation.
maize.zh: 小麦、玉米和甜菜是轮流种植的。
甘蔗比玉米需要更少的土地。

maize.en: We can grow sorghum or maize on this plot.
maize.zh: 我们可以在这块地上种高粱或玉米。

reputable.en: You are well advised to buy your car through a reputable dealer.
reputable.zh: 你通过一个声誉好的经销商来买车是明智的。

reputable.en: Is it a bona fide, reputable organization?
reputable.zh: 这是不是个合法的、值得信赖的机构？

reputable.en: Check that their courses have been validated by a reputable organization.
reputable.zh: 要确保他们的课程获得有声望机构的承认。

immigrate.en: 10,000 people are expected to immigrate in the next two years.
immigrate.zh: 在今后两年里，一万人有望移民。

immigrate.en: They plan to immigrate to Finland next year.
immigrate.zh: 他们计划明年移居芬兰。

immigrate.en: He decided to immigrate to Australia to find work.
immigrate.zh: 他决定移居到澳大利亚找个工作。

abstain.en: Peter Dutton was also the only Opposition front bencher to abstain from the apology.
abstain.zh: 彼得·达顿也是唯一一位放弃道歉的反对党前座议员。
很多人可能由于害怕而弃权。

unattractive.en: Money therefore becomes a stressful topic, and so the thought of sitting down and planning is an unattractive proposition.
unattractive.zh: 钱因而变成了一个令人紧张的话题，因此，坐下来好好做个计划并不是一个有吸引力的建议。

unattractive.en: Realizing that this particular audience would find his regional accent unattractive, Larry planned to speak with an accent that would be more acceptable to his audience.
unattractive.zh: 拉里意识到这些特定的观众会觉得他的地方口音没有吸引力，计划用一种更容易被观众接受的口音说话。
这栋建筑毫不美观，甚至可以说难看。

malnutrition.zh: 营养不良明显使病人虚弱无力。

malnutrition.en: Forty percent of the population is suffering from malnutrition.
malnutrition.zh: 百分之四十的人口营养不良。

malnutrition.en: Infections are more likely in those suffering from malnutrition.
malnutrition.zh: 感染更有可能发生在那些营养不良的人身上。

retort.en: His sharp retort clearly made an impact.
retort.zh: 他的尖锐反驳显然起了作用。

retort.en: Optimists retort that is no bad thing.
retort.zh: 乐观人士反驳说这或许并不是一件坏事。

diverge.zh: 在这个问题上意见分歧很大。
这些平行线像是岔开了。

diverge.en: Second, it appears that closely related populations of fishes on both sides of the isthmus are starting to genetically diverge from each other.
diverge.zh: 其次，地峡两侧紧密相关的鱼类种群似乎开始在基因上彼此分化。

herbicide.en: The herbicide might damage populations of certain rare plant species that the lake contains.
herbicide.zh: 除草剂可能会破坏湖泊中某些稀有植物的种群。

herbicide.en: Soybeans and corn are not sown together in the same filed; nevertheless, most farmers are reluctant to use the herbicide on their corn.
herbicide.zh: 大豆和玉米不是在同一块地里播种的；然而，大多数农民不愿意在他们的玉米上使用除草剂。

herbicide.en: One very effective herbicide is safe for corn, but soybeans are damaged even by the herbicide's residue, which remains in the soil more than a year after the herbicide is applied.
herbicide.zh: 某种非常有效的除草剂对玉米来说是安全的，但即使是除草剂的残留物也会对大豆造成损害，该残留物在施用除草剂一年多后仍残留在土壤中。

disband.en: The council voted to disband and re-form as a confederation.
disband.zh: 该政务会投票决定解散，再以联盟的形式重组。

disband.en: In July he issued a decree ordering all unofficial armed groups in the country to disband.
disband.zh: 7月份，他颁布了一项法令，命令解散该国所有非官方武装团体。

disband.en: However, as Amy Edmondson of Harvard points out, organizations increasingly use "team" as a verb rather than a noun: they form teams for specific purposes and then quickly disband them.
disband.zh: 然而，正如哈佛大学的艾米·埃德蒙森所指出的那样，越来越多的组织将“团队”用作动词而非名词，原因是他们往往为了一些特殊目的组建团队，之后迅速地又解散团队。

skating.zh: 她已多次荣获滑冰比赛的奖杯。

skating.en: We went ice skating on a frozen lake.
skating.zh: 我们去结冰的湖面上溜冰了。

typify.en: These two buildings typify the rich extremes of local architecture.
typify.zh: 这两座建筑物代表着当地建筑风格的迥异。

typify.en: Everything about this farm stands in stark contrast to the surrounding acres of neatly rowed corn and soybean fields that typify modern agriculture.
typify.zh: 这个农场的一切都与周围那些具有现代农业典型特点、整齐划一的玉米和大豆地截然不同。

typify.en: This single item will suffice to typify all the rest.
typify.zh: 即此一端， 可概其余。

devalue.en: They spread tales about her in an attempt to devalue her work.
devalue.zh: 他们散布关于她的传闻，企图贬低她的工作。

devalue.en: This way you devalue your opinion and show that you are incapable of managing your own life.
devalue.zh: 这样你就贬低了自己的观点，表明你没有能力管理自己的生活。
我们不要不公正地贬低她的工作。

bonanza.zh: 预期的销售大涨并未成为现实。

bonanza.en: Now the aid bonanza may be making things worse.
bonanza.zh: 现在救护使事情变的更糟。

intangible.en: The old building had an intangible air of sadness about it.
intangible.zh: 那座旧建筑笼罩着一种说不出的悲凉气氛。

intangible.en: It became an intangible cultural heritage of Guangxi in 2008.
intangible.zh: 2008年，它成为广西非物质文化遗产。

hump.en: Camels rebuild fat stores in their hump.
hump.zh: 骆驼在自己的驼峰内重新贮备脂肪。

hump.en: I have a massive head, a hump over my front shoulders and sharply pointed horns.
hump.zh: 我有一个巨大的头，前肩上有个隆起，还有一对尖尖的角。

hump.en: I talked to the black-faced, hump-backed doctor, and he promised to bring his friend aboard with him.
hump.zh: 我跟那个黑脸、驼背的医生谈了，他保证会带他的朋友上船。

perpendicular.en: Are the lines perpendicular to each other?
The sides of the mountain are almost perpendicular.
perpendicular.zh: 山的两侧几乎是垂直的。

perpendicular.en: What she's going to do is to start loading up the electrons, and you see this wand here move slowly, and start become perpendicular.
perpendicular.zh: 她要做的是开始加载电子，你可以看到这个棒子移动得很慢，并开始变得垂直了。

elliptical.en: Sometimes it is a little more circular, sometimes it is more elliptical.
elliptical.zh: 有时它更圆一点，有时它更像椭圆。

elliptical.en: When Earth's orbit is more elliptical, Earth is actually closer to the sun during part of the year.
elliptical.zh: 当地球的轨道更接近椭圆时，地球实际上在一年的一部分时间里更接近太阳。

elliptical.en: Astronomers suspect that pairs of planets also engage in this slingshot activity, leaving them in disturbed, elliptical orbits.
elliptical.zh: 天文学家怀疑成对的行星也参与了这种弹弓活动，使它们处于不规则的椭圆轨道上。

corrosion.en: Zinc is used to protect other metals from corrosion.
corrosion.zh: 锌被用来保护其他金属免受腐蚀。

corrosion.en: The surface corrosion was worst where the paint had flaked off.
corrosion.zh: 油漆已经剥落的地方，表面的腐蚀最严重。

corrosion.en: All planes are being inspected for possible cracking and corrosion.
corrosion.zh: 所有的飞机都在接受检查，看是否可能有裂纹和腐蚀现象。

purchaser.en: The broker will get 5% if he finds a purchaser.
purchaser.zh: 这个中间人如果找到一个买主就将提成5%。

purchaser.en: If a purchaser fails to punch in the correct PIN at the checkout, the transaction gets rejected.
purchaser.zh: 如果购买者未能在结帐时输入正确的密码，交易将不能进行。

purchaser.en: Overall between 30% and 50% of what has been bought in developed countries is thrown away by the purchaser.
purchaser.zh: 总的来说，在发达国家购买的东西有30%到50%被购买者扔掉了。

appendix.en: We are not certain whether the appendix had already burst or not.
appendix.zh: 我们不能确定阑尾破了没有。

appendix.en: The book also includes an appendix with a listing of all U.S. presidents.
appendix.zh: 这本书还包含一个列有所有美国总统的附录。

cholera.zh: 霍乱是一种由细菌引起的感染。
他们担心一种新的霍乱流行病。

cholera.en: The area was struck by an outbreak of cholera.

retract.en: They tried to persuade me to retract my words.
retract.zh: 他们试图说服我收回我的话。

retract.en: He's hoping that if he makes me feel guilty, I'll retract.
retract.zh: 他希望如果他使我感到愧疚，我就会收回自己的话。

retract.en: Mr. Smith hurriedly sought to retract the statement, but it had just been broadcast on national radio.
retract.zh: 史密斯先生急忙试图收回声明，但它刚刚已经在国家电台播出了。

zebra.en: The quagga was a strikingly beautiful variant of the zebra.
zebra.zh: 白氏斑马是一种极其美丽的斑马变种。
斑马，斑马,你听到什么了？

jumble.en: The essay was a meaningless jumble of ideas.
jumble.zh: 这篇散文思想混乱，使人不知所云。

jumble.en: It is up to Mr LaHood and the FRA to make sense of this jumble.
jumble.zh: 拉胡德先生和联邦铁路局有责任搞清楚这一混乱局面。

jumble.en: The shoreline was made up of a jumble of huge boulders.
jumble.zh: 这海岸线由一堆杂乱的巨石构成。

uniformity.en: Despite these differences, there is general uniformity in the organization and curricula of public schools throughout the country.
uniformity.zh: 尽管存在这些差异，全国公立学校的组织和课程总体上是一致的。

uniformity.en: He argues that we need statewide uniformity.
uniformity.zh: 他辩称我们需要全州统一。

uniformity.en: They tried to ensure uniformity across the different departments.
uniformity.zh: 他们努力保证各部门之间的统一。

obligatory.en: Priority must be given to the development of obligatory activities.
obligatory.zh: 必须优先发展义务活动。

obligatory.en: In the mid 60s he took the almost obligatory trip to India.
obligatory.zh: 六十年代中期，他也赶时髦到印度一游。

obligatory.en: It is obligatory for all employees to wear protective clothing.
obligatory.zh: 所有员工必须穿防护服装。

frontline.en: Chains such as KFC, McDonald's and Pizza Hut are setting a new standard of customer service, using strict employee training and constant monitoring to ensure the friendliness of frontline staff.
frontline.zh: 肯德基、麦当劳和必胜客等连锁店正在制定新的客户服务标准，采用严格的员工培训和持续监控，以确保一线员工的友好服务态度。

frontline.en: As the Frontline Club asked last month.
frontline.zh: 看看上个月媒体俱乐部Frontline的提问。
卫生专业人员处于第一线。

predominate.en: Very little light filters through the canopy of leaves and branches in a rain forest to reach ground level—or close to the ground—and at those levels the yellow-to-green wavelengths predominate.
predominate.zh: 在雨林中，很少有光透过树叶和树枝形成的树荫到达地面——或者接近地面——在这些高度上，黄色到绿色的波长占主导地位。

predominate.en: Private interest was not allowed to predominate over the public good.
predominate.zh: 私人利益不得置于公众利益之上。

predominate.en: In older age groups women predominate because men tend to die younger.
predominate.zh: 在年龄较大的人群中，女性占多数，因为男性的寿命倾向于短些。

maverick.en: He was too much of a maverick ever to hold high office.
maverick.zh: 他太特立独行了，永远都担当不了高级职位。
非规范 Web 服务：什么是非规范 Web 服务？

maverick.en: Maverick could not explain how he made up the word.
maverick.zh: 马弗里克也无法解释他是如何想出了这个词。

decimate.en: The pollution could decimate the river's thriving population of kingfishers.
decimate.zh: 污染可能大量毁灭在这条河茁壮成长的翠鸟群。

decimate.en: Silber says the tax rollback would decimate basic services for the needy.
decimate.zh: 西尔伯说税收的回落可能导致大幅缩减为贫困人口提供的基本服务。

decimate.en: Unfortunately, it took the explorers and the settlers who followed only a few decades to decimate a large part of these resources.
decimate.zh: 不幸的是，仅仅几十年以后，探险家和随后而来的定居者就摧毁了大部分的资源。

unparalleled.en: The book has enjoyed a success unparalleled in recent publishing history.
unparalleled.zh: 这本书在近期出版史上是空前的成功。

unparalleled.en: The Renaissance was an epoch of unparalleled cultural achievement.
unparalleled.zh: 文艺复兴是一个文化上取得空前成就的时代。

unparalleled.en: Could we render this inimitable picture properly, then would everybody exclaim, "Beautiful, unparalleled Italy!"
unparalleled.zh: 如果我们能把这幅独一无二的图画恰当地描绘出来，那么人人都会惊叹：“美丽无比的意大利！”

digestion.en: No liquids are served with meals because they interfere with digestion.
digestion.zh: 上菜时不提供饮料，因为会妨碍消化。

digestion.en: Digestion begins in the mouth with the action of saliva.
digestion.zh: 消化是在口腔中唾液的作用下开始的。

digestion.en: With larger stomachs and slower digestion, you don't need as much energy.
digestion.zh: 有了更大的胃和更慢的消化速度，你就不需要这么多能量了。

conditional.en: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay Miss Smith $500 compensation.
conditional.zh: 他被判有条件释放，并被命令向史密斯小姐支付$500的赔偿金。

conditional.en: According to Iran's New Islamic Penal Code, prisoners can apply for conditional release after serving a third of their sentence.
conditional.zh: 根据伊朗的《新伊斯兰刑法典》，囚犯可以在服满三分之一刑期后申请有条件释放。

conditional.en: Called conditional cash transfers or CCTs, these social assistance programs are designed to reduce inequality and break the cycle of poverty.
conditional.zh: 这些被称为有条件现金转移支付的社会援助项目旨在减少不平等现象，打破贫困循环。

coke.en: He was still hanging around, swigging the Coke out of the can.
coke.zh: 他依然在闲逛着，拿着一罐可乐大口大口地喝着。

rupture.en: I nearly gave myself a rupture lifting that pile of books.
rupture.zh: 提那一大堆书差点儿让我得了疝气。

rupture.en: The incidents have not yet caused a major rupture in the political ties between countries.
rupture.zh: 这些事件尚未造成各国间政治联系的严重破裂。

rupture.en: Because P and S waves travel at different but fairly constant speeds, the interval between their arrivals increases in proportion to the distance from the earthquake focus, or initial rupture point.
rupture.zh: 由于 P 波和 S 波以不同但相当恒定的速度传播，它们到达的间隔与到震源或初始破裂点的距离成比例地增加。

inept.en: Yes, you are often clumsy, even inept.
inept.zh: 没错，你常常笨手笨脚甚至显得无能。

inept.en: Perhaps they should add inept parents to the list.
inept.zh: 或许，航空公司更应该将不称职的父母列入黑名单。

inept.en: He wanted to hold hands. I was young, inept and scared.
inept.zh: 他想要握手，可我少不更事，笨拙，惊慌。

painless.en: The operation itself is a brief, painless procedure.
painless.zh: 手术本身是一个短暂、无痛的过程。

painless.en: Acupuncture treatment is gentle, painless, and relaxing.
painless.zh: 针灸治疗很温和，无痛，也很放松。

guild.en: Guild membership held very different meanings for tailors and seamstresses.
guild.zh: 行会会员对裁缝师和女裁缝师的意义截然不同。

guild.en: Their guild was composed not of family units but of individual women who enjoyed unusual legal and economic privileges.
guild.zh: 她们的行会不是由家庭成员组成而是由享有特殊法律和经济特权的女性组成。

guild.en: Like most other guilds, the Wildberg weaver's guild banned women from becoming masters, however, it exempted master's widow.
guild.zh: 像其他公会一样，怀尔德伯格编织者公会禁止女性成为主人，但是主人的遗孀除外。

urbanization.en: Rapid urbanization brings with it a more westernized and generally more sugary diet.
urbanization.zh: 迅速的城市化带来了一种更为西方化的、普遍摄入更多食糖的饮食习惯。

urbanization.en: That change is the rapid acceleration of urbanization.
urbanization.zh: 这种变化就是城市化的急剧加速。

urbanization.en: The urbanization wave can't be stopped—and it shouldn't be.
urbanization.zh: 城市化浪潮无法阻挡，也不应该被阻挡。

diseased.zh: 他患病的膀胱使得他小便失禁。

diseased.en: In his diseased ravings he called himself the Prince of Wales, and bravely doth he keep up the character.
diseased.zh: 在他那病态的胡言乱语中，他称自己为威尔士王子，并勇敢地保持着这个称号。

diseased.en: The arteries are diseased and a transplant is the only hope.
diseased.zh: 动脉发生了病变，移植是惟一的希望。

ruby.en: Ruby was excited about her new school.
ruby.zh: 鲁比对她的新学校很兴奋。

ruby.en: Ruby grew up to be a civil rights activist.
ruby.zh: 鲁比长大后成为一名民权活动家。

ruby.en: Ruby was black. School leaders didn't want to accept her, so they made Ruby take a hard exam and hoped she would fail.
ruby.zh: 鲁比是黑人。学校领导不想接受她，所以他们让鲁比参加了一场困难的考试，希望她不及格。

manipulative.en: He described Mr. Long as cold, calculating, and manipulative.
manipulative.zh: 他把朗先生描述为冷漠、有心计和善于操纵别人。

manipulative.en: "People assume that office politics involves some manipulative behavior," says Deborah Comer, an assistant professor of management at Hofstra University.
manipulative.zh: 霍夫斯特拉大学的管理学助理教授黛博拉·科默说：“人们认为办公室政治涉及一些操纵行为。”

manipulative.en: She is devious and sly and manipulative.
manipulative.zh: 她阴险、狡诈，而且爱操纵他人。

susceptibility.en: Stress reactions can reduce the disease fighting effectiveness of the body's immune system, thereby increasing susceptibility to illnesses ranging from colds to cancer.
susceptibility.zh: 压力反应会降低身体免疫系统对抗疾病的效力，从而增加对感冒和癌症等疾病的易感性。

susceptibility.en: Obesity raises susceptibility to cancer, and Britain is the sixth most obese country on Earth.
susceptibility.zh: 肥胖增加了患癌症的可能性，英国是全球第六大肥胖国家。

susceptibility.en: The objective is to investigate in vitro drug susceptibility of Citrobacter freundii.
susceptibility.zh: 目的是研究弗氏柠檬酸杆菌的体外抗菌药物的敏感性。

indefinite.en: The trial was adjourned for an indefinite period.
They seem determined to string the talks out for an indefinite period.
indefinite.zh: 他们好像一心要把谈判无限期地拖下去。

indefinite.en: My heart was filled with puzzlement about the indefinite future and longing for the new life.
indefinite.zh: 我的心对不确定的未来充满了困惑，渴望着新生活。

amble.en: The horse is walking at an amble.
And at this stage, should be operational Rongquan amble.
amble.zh: 而在这个阶段，必须具有可操作性吴荣泉缓行。

amble.en: Bud and Flora amble, 5 stopping at the occasional flower stall.
amble.zh: 巴德和弗洛拉悠闲地散着步，信步在一间花铺前停下来。

deplore.en: Like everyone else, I deplore and condemn this killing.
deplore.zh: 我同所有人一样强烈谴责这桩凶杀案。

deplore.en: We deplore the shift to blogs, snippets, and tweets.
deplore.zh: 我们哀叹人们转向了博客、片断消息和Twitter。

deplore.en: If we deplore Iran's brutality, shouldn't we also deplore yours?
deplore.zh: 如果我们该谴责伊朗的残暴，是否也应该谴责您的呢？

antagonism.en: There is still much antagonism between environmental groups and the oil companies.
antagonism.zh: 环境组织与石油公司之间仍有很多敌意。

antagonism.en: Outside of New York, however, there were very few instances of openly expressed class antagonism.
antagonism.zh: 然而，在纽约以外，很少有公开表达阶级对立的例子。

antagonism.en: This was deliberate antagonism under the glare of media spotlight.
antagonism.zh: 这是在媒体聚光灯下的蓄意对抗。

auxiliary.en: Esperanto was invented as an auxiliary language.
auxiliary.zh: 世界语是作为辅助语发明的。

auxiliary.en: Esperanto is an artificial language, designed to serve internationally as an auxiliary means of communication among speakers of different languages.
auxiliary.zh: 世界语是一种人造语言，目的是充当国际上不同语言使用者之间交流的辅助手段。

auxiliary.en: The government's first concern was to augment the army and auxiliary forces.
auxiliary.zh: 政府首要关注的是扩充军队与后备军。

outlive.en: I'm sure Rose will outlive many of us.
outlive.zh: 我肯定罗斯会比我们中的很多人活得长。

outlive.en: But nowadays women outlive men by about five to six years.
outlive.zh: 但现在女人平均比男人长寿五到六年。

outlive.en: Their story, and the lessons we derive from it, will long outlive them.
outlive.zh: 他们的故事以及我们从中获得的经验教训，将长久地流传下去。

genital.en: PGC from genital ridge and mesenterium of human embryo was incubated on fibroblast feeder layers for subculture.
genital.zh: 从人胚胎生殖嵴、肠系膜中消化分离的原始生殖细胞，将其接种在人子宫内膜成纤维细胞饲养层上传代培养。

genital.en: Wear loose clothing in the genital area.
genital.zh: 在外生殖器部位的衣服要宽松些。

dearth.en: There was a dearth of reliable information on the subject.
dearth.zh: 关于这个课题缺乏可靠资料。

dearth.en: Two years ago, Rupert Murdoch's daughter, Elisabeth, spoke of the "unsettling dearth of integrity across so many of our institutions."
dearth.zh: 两年前，鲁珀特·默多克的女儿伊丽莎白曾说过，“我们许多机构缺乏诚信，这令人不安。”

dearth.en: There is, however, no dearth of technological resources, rather, managers in the service sector fail to take advantage of widely available skills and machines.
dearth.zh: 然而，技术资源并不缺乏，相反，服务部门的管理人员未能利用广泛可用的技能和机器。

perspiration.zh: 他的双手被汗水浸湿了。

carefree.en: Chantal remembered carefree summers at the beach.
carefree.zh: 香岱儿想起了在海滩上的那些无忧无虑的夏日。

carefree.en: She had made their childhood so joyous and carefree.
carefree.zh: 她使他们的童年生活非常快乐、无忧无虑。

carefree.en: I was heartsick, for I felt that the splendid years of my carefree childhood had come to an end.
carefree.zh: 我很难过，因为我觉得我无忧无虑的美好童年生活结束了。

calibrate.en: You make me calibrate my joystick without the latest drivers.
calibrate.zh: 在没有新来的司机的情况下，你校准了我的飞机操纵杆。

calibrate.en: How can we better calibrate good intentions in our own lives?
calibrate.zh: 那么在我们自己的生活中，怎样才能更好地拿捏自己的善意呢？

calibrate.en: You make me want to calibrate my joystick without the latest drivers.
calibrate.zh: 在没有新来的司机的情况下，你校准了我的飞机操纵杆。

flask.en: He took out a metal flask from a canvas bag.
flask.zh: 他从帆布袋里拿出了一个金属水瓶。

flask.en: There are some sandwiches here and a flask of coffee.
flask.zh: 这儿有一些三明治和一瓶咖啡。

flask.en: The flask is completely watertight, even when laid on its side.
flask.zh: 这水瓶即使平放也不漏一滴水。

presuppose.en: All your arguments presuppose that he's a rational, intelligent man.
presuppose.zh: 你的所有论点都预先假定他是个理性聪明的人。

presuppose.en: Teachers sometimes presuppose a fairly high level of knowledge by the students.
presuppose.zh: 教师有时候假定学生的知识水平相当高。

presuppose.en: Critics seem to presuppose that great literature must be somehow burdensome to the reader; it must be difficult for the uninitiated to understand.
presuppose.zh: 评论家们似乎预设伟大的文学作品对读者来说一定是某种负担；外行人一定很难理解。

grudge.en: I grudge having to pay so much tax.
grudge.zh: 得付这么多的税我很不情愿。

grudge.en: You surely don't grudge her her success?
grudge.zh: 她获得成功，你没有不以为然吧？

bibliography.en: Listing 2 shows a sample XML document, bib.xml, which represents a bibliography of books.
bibliography.zh: 清单 2 显示了一个示例 XML 文档 bib.xml ，它表示书籍的书目。

bibliography.en: The Three Rules is a self-conscious contribution to this type of writing; it even includes a bibliography of "success studies".
bibliography.zh: 《三条规则》是对这类写作的自觉贡献；它甚至包括“成功研究”的参考书目。

bibliography.en: At the end of this chapter there is a select bibliography of useful books.
bibliography.zh: 本章末尾附着有用书籍的精选书目。

chubby.en: He had twined his chubby arms around Vincent's neck.
chubby.zh: 他胖乎乎的双臂搂住文森特的脖子。
他长得敦实，可并不发胖。

manly.en: His manly figure was adorned and enriched by a beautiful pair of donkey's ears.
manly.zh: 他的男子气概被一双美丽的驴耳朵修饰的更加饱满。

manly.en: He set himself manly tasks and expected others to follow his example.
manly.zh: 他给自己安排了体现男子气概的任务，并期待其他人去效仿他。

manly.en: Manly Tooker and Nathaniel Salisbury are mentioned as early preachers.
manly.zh: 曼利·图克和纳撒尼尔·索尔兹伯里被认为是早期的传教士。

glacial.en: Isotopic analysis of shells allowed geologists to measure another glacial effect.
glacial.zh: 对贝壳的同位素分析使得地质学家可以测量另一种冰川效应。

glacial.en: In all these diverse regions, Agassiz saw signs of glacial erosion and sedimentation.
glacial.zh: 在这些不同的地区，Agassiz 都能发现冰川侵蚀和沉降的痕迹。

glacial.en: The glacial system is governed by two basic climatic variables: precipitation and temperature.
glacial.zh: 冰川系统由两个基本的气候变量控制：降水和温度。

supervisory.en: She has a supervisory role on the project.
supervisory.zh: 她负责这个项目的监督工作。

supervisory.en: Only 6.1 percent of users have ever appealed to supervisory departments and about half of them do not know how to cancel unwanted SMS subscriptions.
