superstitious.en: A wave of superstitious fear spread among the townspeople.
superstitious.zh: 一股迷信的恐惧浪潮在城里人中蔓延。

superstitious.en: Yet oddly enough, to be born on the 13th of the month is not regarded with any fear at all, which just shows how irrational we are in our superstitious beliefs.
superstitious.zh: 然而奇怪的是，人们对出生在这个月的13号一点也不担心，这恰恰表明我们的迷信是多么不理性。
我相信13这个数字不吉利。

intersperse.en: Originally the intention was to intersperse the historical scenes with modern ones.
intersperse.zh: 原本是想用现代场景点缀历史场景。

intersperse.en: Prose-oriented XML, in particular, tends to intersperse PCDATA and tags rather freely.
intersperse.zh: 尤其是面向散文的 XML 往往会任意散布 PCDATA 和标记。

intersperse.en: Intersperse your advertisements by using the playlist editor to add interstitial advertisements in your server side playlist.
intersperse.zh: 通过使用播放列表编辑器在服务器端播放列表中添加间隙广告，来散布您的广告。

effluent.en: The effluent from the factory was dumped into the river.
effluent.zh: 那家工厂的污水被排到了河里。

effluent.en: Effluent from the sedimentation tank is dosed with disinfectant to kill any harmful organisms.
effluent.zh: 从沉降池流出的废水被加入消毒剂以杀死一切有害生物。

effluent.en: Industrial effluent often causes a problem to people's health.
effluent.zh: 工业废水常常危害人们的健康。

ingest.zh: 首先，选择要摄取的架构。
例 1 - 使用 LOAD 每日摄入数据

ingest.en: The product itself is safe to ingest.
ingest.zh: 产品本身是可以安全食用。

exposition.en: Aristotle was valued because of his clear exposition of rational thought.
exposition.zh: 亚里士多德因其对理性思维的清晰阐述而被重视。

exposition.en: These comments are part of the play's logical exposition.
exposition.zh: 这些评论是该剧逻辑阐述的一部分。

credence.en: Historical evidence lends credence to his theory.
credence.zh: 史学根据使他的理论更为可信。

credence.en: They could give no credence to the findings of the survey.
credence.zh: 他们不相信这次调查的结果。

credence.en: Good studies are needed to lend credence to the notion that genuine progress can be made in this important field.
credence.zh: 要有优秀的研究才能使人相信在这一重大领域能取得真正的进步。

quarantine.zh: 这项检疫措施现已取消。

quarantine.en: It is said that all ships coming from abroad should be performed quarantine.
quarantine.zh: 据说对所有国外来的船舶都要进行检疫。

quarantine.en: She was sent home and put in quarantine.

stammer.zh: 一位语言矫治专家治好了他的口吃。

stammer.en: Many children stammer but grow out of it.
stammer.zh: 很多小孩口吃，但长大就改过来了。

stammer.en: It's cruel to make fun of people who stammer.
stammer.zh: 嘲笑口吃的人是很不人道的。

diabetic.en: He was diagnosed (as) a diabetic when he was 64.
diabetic.zh: 他64岁时被诊断患有糖尿病。

diabetic.en: Diabetic neuropathy is damage to the nerves as a result of diabetes, and affects up to 50% of people with diabetes.
diabetic.zh: 糖尿病神经病变是由于糖尿病对神经的损害，并影响高达50%的糖尿病患者。

diabetic.en: He found her in a diabetic coma.
diabetic.zh: 他发现她因糖尿病而昏迷。

acidic.en: Lead is more solvent in acidic water.
acidic.zh: 铅在酸性水中更易溶解。

acidic.en: Dissolved carbon dioxide makes the water more acidic.
acidic.zh: 溶解的二氧化碳使水更具酸性。

maiden.en: The young man betrothed the neighboring maiden.
maiden.zh: 这名男青年答应娶邻居的少女为妻。

maiden.en: Now there was once a maiden whose name was Jorinda.
maiden.zh: 从前有个姑娘名叫约丽丹。

overload.en: Don't overload the boat or it will sink.
overload.zh: 别让船超载了，否则它会沉。

overload.en: There is always an internal circuit breaker to protect the instrument from overload.
overload.zh: 总有一个断电器以防止仪器超负荷运转。

affectionately.zh: 他深情地抚摩着她的头发。

affectionately.en: "No, no, dear child," he said affectionately, "not at once."
affectionately.zh: “不，不，我亲爱的孩子，”他深情地说，“现在不行。”

affectionately.en: He greeted Clara affectionately, and she was equally delighted to see him, for she loved her father dearly.
affectionately.zh: 他亲切地问候克拉拉，克拉拉见到他也很高兴，因为她深爱着她的父亲。

rectify.en: We must take steps to rectify the situation.
rectify.zh: 我们一定要采取措施整顿局面。

rectify.en: The comprehensive spending review offers an opportunity for the government to help rectify this.
rectify.zh: 全面支出审查让政府有机会帮助纠正这一问题。

rectify.en: Only an act of Congress could rectify the situation.
rectify.zh: 只有国会的法案才能扭转这种局面。

undeveloped.en: The big losers will be the undeveloped countries, especially in sub-Saharan Africa.
undeveloped.zh: 最大的损失者将为不发达国家，特别是撒哈拉以南的非洲国家。

undeveloped.en: There are many people whose cultures are undeveloped, but the languages they speak are by no means primitive.
undeveloped.zh: 有许多人他们的文化不发达，但他们说的语言绝不是原始的。

undeveloped.en: The reason often given for the low regard in which smell is held is that, in comparison with its importance among animals, the human sense of smell is feeble and undeveloped.
undeveloped.zh: 人们通常不重视嗅觉的原因是，虽然嗅觉对于动物很重要，但人类的嗅觉是薄弱而不发达的。

detract.en: There is a view that using celebrities can detract people from the problems at hand.
detract.zh: 有观点认为，利用名人可以转移人们对当前问题的注意力。

detract.en: He was determined not to let anything detract from his enjoyment of the trip.
detract.zh: 他下决心这次旅行不让任何事情影响他的兴致。

detract.en: Remember you want your visuals to reinforce your message, not detract from what you are saying.
detract.zh: 要记住，你是要用视觉资料来强化你的信息，而不是削弱你所讲述的内容。

foresight.en: They had the foresight to invest in new technology.
foresight.zh: 他们有投资新技术的先见之明。

foresight.en: She had had the foresight to prepare herself financially in case of an accident.
foresight.zh: 她有先见之明，经济上作了准备以防万一发生事故。

foresight.en: That showed good judgment, real foresight, didn't it?
foresight.zh: 这显示了很好的判断力、真正的远见，不是吗？

predisposition.en: There is a thin dividing line between educating the public and creating a predisposition to panic.
predisposition.zh: 教育公众和营造恐慌倾向之间只有细小的区别。

predisposition.en: Nor does it explain why, in a species where one parent determines handedness, a brood is not exclusively right or left-handed when the offspring would have the same genetic predisposition.
predisposition.zh: 这也不能解释为什么在一个由父母一方决定利手的物种中，当后代具有相同的遗传倾向时，他们并非完全是右撇子或左撇子。

predisposition.en: Nor does it explain why, in a species where one parent determines handedness, a brood is not exclusively right-or left-handed when the offspring would have the same genetic predisposition.
predisposition.zh: 这也不能解释为什么在一个由父母一方决定用利手的物种中，当后代具有相同的遗传倾向时，他们并非完全是右撇子或左撇子。

pedigree.en: She was proud of her long pedigree.
pedigree.zh: 她为自己源远流长的家世而自豪。

pedigree.en: The product has a pedigree going back to the last century.
pedigree.zh: 这项产品的渊源可追溯到上个世纪。

pedigree.en: Hammer's business pedigree almost guaranteed him the acquaintance of presidents.
pedigree.zh: 哈默的商业背景几乎保证了他与几位总统的相识。

antiquated.en: Many factories are so antiquated they are not worth saving.
antiquated.zh: 许多工厂太陈旧以致不值得保留。

slouch.en: Try not to slouch when you are sitting down.
slouch.zh: 你坐下时尽量不要无精打采。

slouch.en: Well, you would be a nice old slouch of a hermit.
slouch.zh: 好吧，那你就是个懒懒散散的隐士了。

inversion.en: Havelock Ellis used the terms "eonism" and "sexo-aesthetic inversion" to describe similar cross-gender feelings and behaviors.
inversion.zh: 哈夫洛克·埃利斯使用“异装癖”和“性反感”来描述类似的跨性别感觉和行为。

externally.en: While it is likely that fewer varieties of plant seeds have reached Hawaii externally than internally, more varieties are known to be adapted to external than to internal transport.
externally.zh: 虽然从外部到达夏威夷的植物种子品种可能比从内部到达夏威夷的品种要少，但已知的适应外部运输的品种比适应内部运输的品种要多。

externally.en: More probable is bird transport, either externally, by accidental attachment of the seeds to feathers, or internally, by the swallowing of fruit and subsequent excretion of the seeds.
externally.zh: 更有可能的是鸟类运输：或者是通过外部途径，即种籽偶然附着在羽毛上；或者是通过内部途径，即鸟类吞食果实并随后将种籽排泄出来。

externally.en: There appear to be many unexplored matters about the motivation to reflect—for example, the value of externally motivated reflection as opposed to that of teachers who might reflect by habit.
externally.zh: 反思的动机方面似乎有许多问题尚未被探索——例如，与教师可能进行的习惯性反思相对的，受外部激励的反思的价值。

saline.en: Clean the wound with large amounts of saline solution.
saline.zh: 用大量生理盐水清洗伤口。

saline.en: First of all, they are able to withstand highly saline conditions.
saline.zh: 首先，它们能够承受高盐环境。

saline.en: The mineral content of groundwater normally increases with the depth, but even quite shallow aquifers can be highly saline.
saline.zh: 地下水的矿物含量通常随深度的增加而增加，但即使很浅的蓄水层中可能含盐量也很高。

shimmer.en: Everything seemed to shimmer in the heat.
shimmer.zh: 在高温下所有的东西都好像在发光。

shimmer.en: Gold shimmer softens the look of deep violet.
shimmer.zh: 金色闪光让深紫色更加柔和。

shimmer.en: If they have a little shimmer, it makes your face brighter.
shimmer.zh: 如果它们有一点点的闪光成分，你的脸看起来会更光彩照人。

refreshment.zh: 可以请您吃点喝点什么吗？

refreshment.en: In York we had a short stop for refreshment.
refreshment.zh: 在约克，我们稍作停留，吃了点东西。

husk.en: The feasibility of preparation of particulate activated carbon from char of cocoa nut husk by water vapour microwave was studied.
husk.zh: 研究了以椰壳炭化料为原料，采用水蒸气微波法制备颗粒活性炭的可行性。

husk.en: How can we remove the husk of the grains?
husk.zh: 我们怎样去掉谷物的外皮？

husk.en: They opened their pillows and consumed the corn husk filling.
husk.zh: 他们打开枕头，吃掉里面填充的谷壳。

vortex.en: The polar vortex is a system of wintertime winds.
vortex.zh: 极地涡旋是冬季风形成的一个风系。

vortex.en: They were caught up in a whirling vortex of emotion.
When marriages break down children are swept into the vortex of their parents' embittered emotions.
vortex.zh: 当婚姻破裂时，孩子们也被卷入父母间日益恶化的情绪漩涡中。

shorthand.en: I've got a job as a shorthand typist.
shorthand.zh: 我找到了一份速记打字员的工作。

shorthand.en: I gained a shorthand and typing diploma at evening classes.
shorthand.zh: 我在夜校获得了速记和打字证书。

shorthand.en: He taught himself shorthand to get an even better job later as a court stenographer and as a reporter in Parliament.
shorthand.zh: 为了之后获得了一份更好的工作，成为一名法庭速记员和国会记者，他自学了速记。

cordial.en: I wish to take this opportunity to extend to you cordial greetings and best wishes of the Chinese Government and people!
cordial.zh: 借此机会，我谨代表中国政府和人民，向在座各位，致以诚挚的祝贺和良好的祝愿！

cordial.en: He had never known him to be so chatty and cordial.
cordial.zh: 他以前从来不知道他是这样一个健谈而友善的人。

cordial.en: One taught me reading, the other taught me composition, both of whom were cordial and strict.
cordial.zh: 一个教我阅读，一个教我写作，他们都是诚恳而严格的。

leach.en: Once the humus layer disappears, nutrients cannot be recycled and leach from the soil, converting soil from fertile to infertile and making it suitable only for savanna vegetation.
leach.zh: 一旦腐殖质层消失，养分就无法从土壤中回收和过滤，致使土壤由肥沃变为贫瘠，只适于热带草原植被的生长。

leach.en: Mr. Leach is on holiday and was not available for comment.
leach.zh: 利奇先生在休假，没空作评论。

leach.en: The teacher replied, "My dear sister, I tried my best to leach him, but your son did not want to lean the tricks and strategies of survival."
leach.zh: 老师回答说：“好姐姐，我已经尽力了，可你儿子不愿学习生存的技巧和策略。”

insecticide.en: About 70% of the cocoa acreage is treated with insecticide.
insecticide.zh: 大约70%的可可豆种植区都用杀虫剂处理过。

insecticide.en: The insecticide used on some weeds can cause health problems.
insecticide.zh: 喷洒在野草上的杀虫剂会引发各种健康问题。

peck.en: The budgerigar gave a quick peck at the seed.
peck.zh: 虎皮鹦鹉匆匆地啄了一下种子。

peck.en: They thought the birds must have come to peck his flesh.
peck.zh: 他们认为鸟儿一定是来啄食他的肉的。

peck.en: The sparrow perching upon the third horse, she began to peck him too.
peck.zh: 麻雀骑在第三匹马上，也开始啄他。

microcosm.en: The family is a microcosm of society.
Kitchell says the city was a microcosm of all American culture during the '60s.
microcosm.zh: 基切尔说这个城市曾经是60年代所有美国文化的一个缩影。

microcosm.en: Schools are not just a microcosm of society; they mediate it too.
microcosm.zh: 学校不仅仅是社会的缩影；它们也会调解。

balm.en: The place is balm to the soul.
balm.zh: 这个地方是对心灵的抚慰。

balm.en: Use a lip balm that contains sunscreen.
balm.zh: 使用含有防晒成分的唇膏。

painstaking.en: He has finally cracked the system after years of painstaking research.
painstaking.zh: 经过数年的艰苦研究，他最终破译了该系统。

painstaking.en: In fact, acquiring the exact meaning of number words is a painstaking process that takes children years.
painstaking.zh: 事实上，掌握数字单词的确切含义是一个艰苦的过程，需要花费孩子数年的时间。

painstaking.en: The leases come with painstaking stipulations to mitigate any possible environmental harm to species like the polar bear.
painstaking.zh: 这些租约附带了细致的条款，以减轻对北极熊等物种的任何可能的环境伤害。

instinctive.en: My instinctive reaction was to deny everything.
instinctive.zh: 我的本能反应是否认一切。

instinctive.en: It's an instinctive reaction – if a child falls you pick it up.
instinctive.zh: 这是一种本能的反应–如果小孩摔倒了你会扶他起来。
动物有本能的交流系统。

metamorphosis.en: By what invisible power has this surprising metamorphosis been performed?
metamorphosis.zh: 是什么无形的力量完成了这一惊人的蜕变？

metamorphosis.en: Metamorphosis, in turn, certainly represents the horrible imagery of an ethic of lucidity.
metamorphosis.zh: 反过来，《变形记》当然代表了一种清晰的伦理道德的可怕形象。

metamorphosis.en: They continue to emit distress calls underwater both as tadpoles and after they have begun metamorphosis.
metamorphosis.zh: 无论是蝌蚪还是刚开始变形的蝌蚪，它们都能够在水下发出叫声。

booking.en: Can I make a booking for Friday?
booking.zh: 我可以订星期五的票吗？

complacent.en: We cannot afford to be complacent about our health.
complacent.zh: 我们对我们的健康自满不起。

complacent.en: We must not become complacent the moment we have some success.
complacent.zh: 我们决不能一见成绩就自满起来。

complacent.en: Don't be complacent over occasional success.; Don't feel self-satisfied over a minor success.
complacent.zh: 不要沾沾自喜于一得之功。

splatter.en: Exactly how far along the wall was the blood splatter?
splatter.zh: 墙壁上的血迹究竟溅了多远？

splatter.en: Superior wetting performance with lower flux splatter.
splatter.zh: 优异的熔湿特性，溅污影响更低。

splatter.en: To add depth to the splatter, first place one normal splatter on one layer.
splatter.zh: 要添加深入到飞溅，首先是一个正常的飞溅的一层。

dung.en: She's cooking on a stove fuelled by dried animal dung.
dung.zh: 她正在一个以动物干粪便做燃料的火炉上做饭。

dung.en: Workers at Sydney's harbourside Taronga zoo are refusing to collect animal dung in a protest over wages.
dung.zh: 悉尼海港塔龙加动物园的工人因对工资的抗议而拒绝收拾动物粪便。

neurotic.en: He was almost neurotic about being followed.
neurotic.zh: 他对被人跟踪几乎神经过敏。

neurotic.en: She became neurotic about keeping the house clean.
neurotic.zh: 她对保持房子清洁有点神经质。

neurotic.en: Meprobamate and benactyzine are helpful in the treatment of neurotic psychotic depression.
neurotic.zh: 眠尔通和胃复康有助于精神抑郁症的治疗。

obedient.en: He was always obedient to his father's wishes.
obedient.zh: 他一向顺从父亲的意愿。

obedient.en: He was very respectful at home and obedient to his parents.
obedient.zh: 他在家里很尊重人而且顺从父母。

hospitable.en: The man is very hospitable; he keeps open house for his friends and fellow-workers.
hospitable.zh: 那人十分好客，无论是他的朋友还是同事，他都盛情接待。

hospitable.en: The author thinks her friend made a rational decision in choosing a more hospitable place over an apparently elegant assisted living home.
hospitable.zh: 作者认为她的朋友做出了一个理性的决定，选择了一个更热情友好的地方，而不是一个表面上雅致的养老院。

oar.en: The blade of the oar had entangled itself with the strap of her bag.
oar.zh: 桨叶和她包的带子紧紧缠在了一起。

oar.en: Each person has one oar which goes on one side.
oar.zh: 每个人都有一只桨，放在一边。

oar.en: They shoved off, presently, Tom in command, Huck at the after oar and Joe at the forward.
oar.zh: 他们很快就开船了，由汤姆掌舵，哈克划后桨，乔划前桨。

choreography.en: The Alvin Ailey American Dance Theatre was formed in the 1950s and quickly established itself as a leading exponent of progressive choreography and contemporary dance.
choreography.zh: 阿尔文·艾利美国舞蹈剧形成于20世纪50年代，并很快树立自己为激进舞蹈艺术和现代舞蹈的最主要的典范。

choreography.en: Listen to part of a lecture in a choreography class.
choreography.zh: 请听编舞课上的部分内容。

choreography.en: The choreography of Eric Hawkins is considered radical by ballet audiences.
choreography.zh: 埃里克·霍金斯的舞蹈编排被芭蕾舞剧的观众认为是不同凡响的。

irrespective.en: Everyone is treated equally, irrespective of race.
irrespective.zh: 不分种族，每个人都受到公平对待。

irrespective.en: The weekly rent is the same irrespective of whether there are three or four occupants.
irrespective.zh: 无论三个还是四个人住，周租金不变。

irrespective.en: Irrespective of the quality of a school a child's home life is of key importance.
irrespective.zh: 不管学校教育的质量如何，孩子的家庭生活都是至关重要的。

sportsman.en: The man doesn't look like a sportsman.
sportsman.zh: 这个人看起来不像运动员。

sportsman.en: Both physical fitness and mental attitude are necessary factors to be a successful sportsman.
sportsman.zh: 身体素质和心态都是成为一名成功运动员的必要因素。

sportsman.en: You might be a good leader. Good jobs for you: sportsman, player...
sportsman.zh: 你可能是位好领导。适合你的工作有运动员和球员等。

subterranean.en: The city has 9 miles of such subterranean passages.
subterranean.zh: 这座城市有9英里这样的地下通道。

subterranean.en: Tom found a subterranean lake, shortly, which stretched its dim length away until its shape was lost in the shadows.
subterranean.zh: 不久，汤姆发现了一个地下湖，它渐渐伸展，直到在黑暗中渐渐消失了。

subterranean.en: Empty paddle boats await rowers at the main cave entrance at Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park in the Philippines.
subterranean.zh: 菲律宾的公主港地下河国家公园的主洞入口处，停靠着几只空空的桨船，在等待桨手的到来。

meld.en: The key is to meld the old with the new.

unworthy.zh: 他认为自己不配得到大家赋予他的荣誉。

unworthy.en: Such opinions are unworthy of educated people.
unworthy.zh: 知识分子发表这样的言论有失身份。

unworthy.en: You may feel unworthy of the attention and help people offer you.
unworthy.zh: 你可能觉得自己不值得别人的关心和帮助。

coexistence.en: Coexistence necessitates the total noninterference by any power in the internal affairs of another.
coexistence.zh: 共处必需是任何国家都决不干涉别国的内部事务。

coexistence.en: We developed an example integration scenario that could be enabled by any of the myriad of coexistence mechanisms.
coexistence.zh: 我们开发了一个示例集成场景，该场景可以由无数的共存机制所支持。

coexistence.en: He also believed in coexistence with the West.

bleach.en: She scrubbed the counters down with bleach.
bleach.zh: 她用漂白剂把柜台擦洗干净。

bleach.en: The tree's roots are stripped and hung to season and bleach.
bleach.zh: 这些树根被剥去皮并挂起来风干晒白。

bleach.en: In order to give us our white paper and card, the makers will add bleach and other materials such as china clay and additional chemicals.
bleach.zh: 为了给我们提供白纸和卡片，制作商会添加漂白剂和一些其他材料，比如瓷土和其他化学品。

hoard.en: They've begun to hoard food and petrol and save their money.
hoard.zh: 他们已开始贮藏食物和汽油并攒钱。

hoard.en: Many Vietnamese opt to hoard dollars, not bank them.
hoard.zh: 许多越南人选择存储美元，而不是将钱存入银行。

hoard.en: The reason or reasons why people hoard are in dispute.
hoard.zh: 对人们为什么囤积的原因还有争议。

apologetic.en: They were very apologetic about the trouble they'd caused.
apologetic.zh: 他们对所惹的麻烦深感愧疚。

apologetic.en: He opened the rear door for me with an apologetic tilt of his head.
apologetic.zh: 他歉疚地歪着头为我打开了后门。

affluence.zh: 在某种程度上，富裕是成功的。

affluence.en: Unfortunately, affluence also creates new complaints and contradictions.
affluence.zh: 不幸的是，富裕也会产生新的抱怨和矛盾。

affluence.en: Affluence liberates the individual, promising that everyone can choose a unique way to self-fulfillment.
affluence.zh: 富裕解放了个人，并承诺每个人都可以选择一种独特的方式来实现自我。

blacksmith.en: The horses were sent to the blacksmith to be shod.
blacksmith.zh: 马送到铁匠那儿钉马掌去了。

blacksmith.en: The blacksmith was pelting away at the hot iron.
blacksmith.zh: 铁匠正在不停地敲打热铁。

blacksmith.en: The Smith [blacksmith] forges horseshoes with great skill.
blacksmith.zh: 这个铁匠锻制马掌的手艺很高。

escalator.en: I pushed through the crowds and on to the escalator.
escalator.zh: 我挤过人群，上了自动扶梯。

escalator.en: The escalator wafts us up and down every day.
escalator.zh: 自动扶梯天天送我们上上下下。

escalator.en: But today, the escalator is jammed at the top.
escalator.zh: 但是今天，电梯堵在了顶楼。

ripen.en: I'm waiting for the apples to ripen.
This helps to ripen new growth and makes it flower profusely.
ripen.zh: 这有助于新植物成熟并且开出繁茂的花朵。

ripen.en: They've got fruit retailing down to a fine art. You can be sure that your pears will ripen in day.
ripen.zh: 他们精于水果零售之道。你可以放心，你那些梨一天之内就会熟。

nourishment.en: The mother provides the embryo with nourishment and a place to grow.
nourishment.zh: 母亲为胎儿提供营养和一个生长的地方。

nourishment.en: Sugar gives quick relief to hunger but provides no lasting nourishment.
nourishment.zh: 糖能快速缓解饥饿感，但不提供持久的营养。

nourishment.en: It may worsen the nourishment problem in low-income countries.
nourishment.zh: 它可能会加剧低收入国家的营养问题。

stagnation.en: Stagnation in home sales is holding back economic recovery.
stagnation.zh: 住房销售的停滞正阻碍着经济的复苏。
我们从自然中学到了停滞。

stagnation.en: Lengthy periods of economic stagnation or decline have almost always left society more mean-spirited and less inclusive, and have usually stopped or reversed the advance of rights and freedoms.
stagnation.zh: 长期的经济停滞或衰退几乎总是使社会变得更加刻薄、更缺乏包容性，通常还会阻止或逆转权利和自由的进步。

enslave.en: If so, why don't we think it's acceptable to enslave people with low IQs?
enslave.zh: 如果能，为什么我们无法接受奴役低智商人群的行为呢？

enslave.en: We have contained those secret technologies that threatened us and that were to be used to enslave you.
enslave.zh: 我们包含了那些神秘的科技，也就是那些曾经威胁我们和曾被用于奴役你们的科技。

enslave.en: Your habits are a servant, and they will enslave you or free you.You choose by using your will power what they do.
enslave.zh: 你的习惯是你忠实的仆人，你只需要用你的意念选择你想让他们做的事。

discord.en: Many are being plagued by family discord, a problem that boils down to the lack of a sense of family responsibility.
discord.zh: 很多人都受到家庭不和的困扰，这一问题可以归结为家庭责任感的缺失。

discord.en: All this was compatible with older devices so long as there was only one authoritative timekeeper; but with urban growth and the multiplication of time signals, discrepancy brought discord and strife.
discord.zh: 所有这些都与旧的设备兼容，只要只有一个权威的计时器；但随着城市的发展和时间信号的倍增，报时的差异导致了不和与冲突。

additive.en: I think, though, that even in the USA, ethanol is still only used as an additive to gasoline, or petrol.
additive.zh: 不过我认为，即使在美国，乙醇仍然只用作汽油的添加剂。

additive.en: Milk is sugar-free and additive-free with nutritionists recommending skimmed milk as the best choice before bed as it is the least fattening.
additive.zh: 牛奶不含糖和添加剂，因此营养学家推荐脱脂牛奶作为睡前的最佳选择，因为它最不容易让人发胖。

additive.en: Milk is also sugar-free and additive-free with nutritionists recommending skimmed milk as the best choice before bed as it is the least fattening.
additive.zh: 牛奶也不含糖，也不含添加剂，营养学家建议睡前最好选择脱脂牛奶，因为它最不容易发胖。

puncture.en: An instrument called a trocar makes a puncture in the abdominal wall.
puncture.zh: 一种叫作套管针的器械会在腹壁上扎一个小孔。

puncture.en: Somebody helped me to mend the puncture.
puncture.zh: 有人帮我补了车胎上的洞。

puncture.en: I had a puncture on the way and arrived late.
puncture.zh: 我在路上扎破了轮胎，所以迟到了。

gauze.en: It's almost like a green gauze veil.
gauze.zh: 它几乎就像一块绿色的薄纱。

gauze.en: Ari can see a wavery shape, floating hair and floating gauze.
gauze.zh: 阿里（Ari）可以看到波浪状的模型，飘浮的头发和飘浮的纱布。

tycoon.en: Set sail in style with Luxury Liner Tycoon!
tycoon.zh: 豪华游艇大亨扬帆起航！

tycoon.en: There are a total of 16 levels in Monopoly Tycoon.
tycoon.zh: 强手大亨（游戏名）里总共有16个关卡。

tycoon.en: Betty James is definitely not a tycoon.
tycoon.zh: 贝蒂的确不是一个大亨。

methodical.en: NASA's methodical approach to the exploration of Mars has not yet answered the questions.
methodical.zh: 美国宇航局有条不紊的火星探索方式尚未解决这些问题。

methodical.en: Somehow this early fascination with life's prodigality, with wet, slimy or creepy-crawly things, becomes systematized and methodical.
methodical.zh: 不知何故，这种早期对生命挥霍无度的迷恋，对潮湿、黏糊糊或令人毛骨悚然的东西的迷恋，变得系统化和有条理了。
这是按部就班的乏味的杂务。

botanist.en: A young English botanist named Charles Darwin, the author of the theory of evolution, was the first European to see alerces, with trunks that had a circumference of 130 feet.
botanist.zh: 进化论的作者、年轻的英国植物学家查尔斯·达尔文，是第一个看到落叶柏树干圆周长达一百三十英尺的欧洲人。

botanist.en: What the botanist tells us after a number of imperfect lectures, the flower proclaimed in a minute.
botanist.zh: 植物学家需要开几次不完美讲座之后才能告诉我们的事情，花在一分钟内就告诉我们了。
亨里是英国的植物学家。

retina.en: Images are projected onto the retina of the eye.
retina.zh: 影像被投射到眼睛的视网膜上。

retina.en: Bruno had to have eye surgery on a torn retina two years ago.
retina.zh: 布鲁诺两年前因为视网膜破裂不得不进行了一次眼部手术。

retina.en: It can make fine visual distinctions because it is blessed with one million cones per square millimeter in its retina.
retina.zh: 它的视网膜上每平方毫米有一百万个视锥细胞，所以它能分辨出很细微的视觉差别。

indignant.en: They were indignant that they hadn't been invited.
indignant.zh: 他们因没有受到邀请而愤愤不平。

indignant.en: Imagine that you know you're an evil git, but you know that the person you're playing against or with, is an indignant angel.
indignant.zh: 想象一下，你知道你是个邪恶的卑鄙小人，但是，你知道，和你一起玩或对抗的人是一个愤愤不平的天使。

indignant.en: He was indignant that his rival was offered the job.
indignant.zh: 他对他的对手得到了那份工作感到愤愤不平。

dizziness.zh: 一阵突然的晕眩令他难以忍受。

dizziness.en: His head injury causes dizziness and nausea.
dizziness.zh: 他头部受伤引起眩晕和呕吐。

dizziness.en: She was plagued by weakness, fatigue, and dizziness.
dizziness.zh: 她被虚弱、疲劳和眩晕折磨。

malfunction.en: There must have been a computer malfunction.
The Super Bowl incident, which Ms. Jackson termed a "wardrobe malfunction", has prompted new scrutiny of indecency on the airwaves.
malfunction.zh: 杰克逊女士称之为“服装故障”的“超级碗”事件引发了对电视节目不雅行为的新一轮审视。

malfunction.en: The space station's deputy program manager, Kirk Shireman, said the team did an outstanding job coping with what he called "a major malfunction."
malfunction.zh: 国际空间站项目副经理谢尔曼说，这个团队在处理他所说的“重大故障”时表现出色。

brazen.en: She had become brazen about the whole affair.
brazen.zh: 她对整件事已经不感到羞耻了。

brazen.en: Now that everyone knew the truth, the only thing to do was to brazen it out.
brazen.zh: 既然大家都知道真相了，只好硬着头皮撑过去。
这种手法真的是又简单，又厚颜无耻。

adaptable.zh: 人类的适应力是无限的。

adaptable.en: Tomorrow's workers will have to be more adaptable.
adaptable.zh: 未来的工人必须具有更强的适应性。

adaptable.en: The infinitely adaptable substance has its dark side.
adaptable.zh: 这种具有极强适应性的物质也有其黑暗的一面。

interdependent.en: We live in an increasingly interdependent world.
interdependent.zh: 我们生活在一个日益相互依赖的世界。
世界正变得越来越需要相互依存。

interdependent.en: Also, many species are interdependent, intimately connected to one another.
interdependent.zh: 此外，很多物种是相互依存的，且彼此之间存在着紧密的联系。

undeniably.en: There was undeniably a strong theoretical dimension to his thinking.
undeniably.zh: 不可否认，他的想法很有理论深度。

undeniably.en: Bringing up a baby is undeniably hard work.
undeniably.zh: 抚养一个孩子无可否认地是项艰苦的工作。

undeniably.en: There is something undeniably conjectural about such claims.
undeniably.zh: 此类声明中绝对有推测的成分。

consequent.en: The warming of the Earth and the consequent climatic changes affect us all.
consequent.zh: 全球变暖以及随之而来的气候变化影响我们每个人。

consequent.en: The reduction in bullying—and the consequent improvement in pupil happiness—is surely a worthwhile objective.
consequent.zh: 减少恃强凌弱现象——进而提高小学生的幸福感——无疑是一个值得追求的目标。

consequent.en: Primary among the arguments against uniforms is their lack of variety and the consequent loss of individuality experienced by people who must wear them.
consequent.zh: 反对校服的主要理由是校服缺乏多样性，导致穿校服的人失去了个性。

jurisprudence.en: The secrets of law and jurisprudence lie in philosophy.
jurisprudence.zh: 法学、法理的奥秘在哲学之中。

deft.en: With a deft flick of his wrist, he extinguished the match.
deft.zh: 他的手腕灵巧地一抖，就熄灭了火柴。

deft.en: He finished off the painting with a few deft strokes of the brush.
deft.zh: 他用画笔熟练地勾上几笔，这幅画就完成了。

deft.en: It was going to take some deft political footwork to save the situation.
deft.zh: 当时得采取一些巧妙的政治手段以挽回局势。

spoonful.en: He took a spoonful of the stew and ate it.
spoonful.zh: 他舀起一匙炖菜吃了下去。

spoonful.en: In 'a spoonful of sugar', the word 'spoonful' is a partitive.
spoonful.zh: 在a spoonful of sugar中，spoonful一词是表量词。

spoonful.en: Like the saying goes, "A spoonful of sugar helps the medicine go down."
spoonful.zh: 俗话说：“一勺糖有助于药下肚。”

reprimand.en: He received a severe reprimand for his behaviour.
"Don't contradict your mother," was Charles's sharp reprimand.
reprimand.zh: “不要顶撞你的母亲，”查尔斯严厉的斥责。

reprimand.en: He has been fined five thousand dollars and given a severe reprimand.
reprimand.zh: 他被罚款5000美元，并且受到严厉的训斥。

unsatisfactory.en: The film's ending is an unsatisfactory cop-out.
unsatisfactory.zh: 那部电影的结尾是个不令人满意的回避。

unsatisfactory.en: There are also, of course, people who interview extremely well, but are later found to be very unsatisfactory employees.
unsatisfactory.zh: 当然，也有面试表现非常好的人，但后来发现是非常不令人满意的员工。

unsatisfactory.en: The present system of funding for higher education is unsatisfactory.
unsatisfactory.zh: 目前高等教育的经费体制并不令人满意。

contemplative.en: Martin is a quiet, contemplative sort of child.
contemplative.zh: 马丁是个安静沉思型孩子。

contemplative.en: For me, it is her face and hands, I think they are really expressive, and also, they make the woman seem very contemplative, seems like she is thinking pretty seriously about something.
contemplative.zh: "对我来说，我觉得是她的手和脸，我觉得这两个地方描绘的非常具有表现力，并且使得这位女性栩栩如生，使得我们感觉她在思考一个非常严肃的事情。

infringe.en: People fear that security cameras could infringe personal liberties.
infringe.zh: 人们担心保安摄像机会侵犯人身自由。

infringe.en: "OK," he said, "maybe you don't infringe these seven patents."
infringe.zh: 好吧，他说，可能你们真的没有侵犯这七项专利。

infringe.en: These measures need not be intrusive, or infringe upon sovereignty.
infringe.zh: 这些措施不必具有干预性，无需涉及主权。

cataract.en: These data suggest that nonenzymatic glycosylation of lens crystallins may contribute to cataract formation.
cataract.zh: 这些数据表明晶状体蛋白的非酶糖基化可能会导致白内障。

cataract.en: If a woman has certain infections during pregnancy, such as rubella or chickenpox, the baby may develop a cataract before birth.
cataract.zh: 如果一名妇女在怀孕期间发生某种感染，如风疹或水痘，那么婴儿在出生前就可能患上白内障。
白内障手术的风险包括。

sonar.en: What is it like riding a bike using sonar?
sonar.zh: 使用声纳骑自行车是什么感觉？

sonar.en: How challenging is it to teach people to use sonar?
sonar.zh: 教人们使用声纳有多难？

sonar.en: For whales, there is a theory on how sonar can kill.
sonar.zh: 对于鲸鱼来说，有一种关于声纳如何杀死它们的理论。

hypnotic.en: His voice had an almost hypnotic effect.
hypnotic.zh: 他的声音有一种近乎催眠的作用。

hypnotic.en: The hypnotic state actually lies somewhere between being awake and being asleep.
hypnotic.zh: 催眠状态实际上是介于清醒与睡眠之间。

hypnotic.en: His songs are often both hypnotic and reassuringly pleasant.
hypnotic.zh: 他的歌声常常在催人入眠的同时又使人放松愉悦。

sterilize.en: Sulphur is also used to sterilize equipment.
sterilize.zh: 硫磺也用来给设备消毒。

sterilize.en: The machine uses minute quantities of ozone to sterilize and deodorize refrigerated food vehicles.
sterilize.zh: 这个机器用微量臭氧对食物冷藏车进行消毒和除臭。

sterilize.en: He boiled his syringe and fired his knife to sterilize them.
sterilize.zh: 他把注射器放到水中煮，把刀子放在火上烧来进行消毒。

regenerate.en: Once destroyed, brain cells do not regenerate.
regenerate.zh: 脑细胞一旦遭到破坏，就不能再生。

regenerate.en: Nerve cells have limited ability to regenerate if destroyed.
regenerate.zh: 神经细胞如果被破坏其再生能力有限。

regenerate.en: She says: "I believe that the day is not far off when we will be able to prescribe drugs that cause severed spinal cords to heal, hearts to regenerate and lost limbs to regrow."
regenerate.zh: 她说：“我相信，我们能够开出药方，让切断的脊髓愈合、心脏再生、失去的四肢再生的那一天不远了。”

putter.en: I like to putter around in the garden.
I like a putter that looks and feels good.
putter.zh: 我喜欢那种看起来握起来都很好的轻击棒。

putter.en: The 12 - inch Masters mini - putter in the Augusta National pro shop.
putter.zh: 奥古·斯塔国家俱乐部专卖店的12英寸大师赛迷你推杆。

tram.en: In 1882, the city's first electric tram cars went into service.
No money can be spent on the construction and operation of the tram.
tram.zh: 没有钱可以用于有轨电车的建设和运行。

tram.en: The project will also upgrade existing tram lines and bicycle paths.
tram.zh: 该项目还将改善现有的电车线和自行车道。

besiege.en: When forty winters shall besiege thy brow.
besiege.zh: 当四十个严冬围攻你的眉梢。

besiege.en: Are the trees of the field people, that you should besiege them?
besiege.zh: 田间的树木岂是人，叫你糟蹋吗？

besiege.en: They will besiege all the cities throughout the land the LORD your God is giving you.
besiege.zh: 他们必将你困在耶和华你神所赐你遍地的各城里。

housekeeping.en: I thought that cooking and housekeeping were unimportant, easy tasks.
housekeeping.zh: 我曾认为做饭和料理家务是琐碎简单的工作。

housekeeping.en: As the working classes prospered and the servant shortage set in, housekeeping became a matter of interest to the educated classes.
housekeeping.zh: 随着工人阶级的繁荣和佣人短缺的出现，家政成为了受教育阶级感兴趣的事情。

housekeeping.en: When Emma isn't caring for Bowie, she works for four housekeeping clients, including one who requires that she should iron for eight hours.
housekeeping.zh: 当艾玛不在照顾鲍伊时，她为四个家政客户服务，其中一个客户要求她熨8个小时的衣服。

collagen.en: Our collagen is porcine collagen comes from Dayi zoology hoggery.
collagen.zh: 我们的胶原蛋白来自大邑生态养殖区的猪。

collagen.en: This collagen is highly hydrated and it forms a gel that has water-like properties.
collagen.zh: 这种胶原蛋白是高度水合的，它形成了一种凝胶，有水一样的性质。

collagen.en: The sea cucumber has a type of collagen in its skin capable of excreting or absorbing more water effectively changing from a liquid to a solid.
collagen.zh: 海参的肌肤内有一种胶原质，能有效排出或者吸收更多水，在液态和固态之间转换。

rattlesnake.en: His wild-west origins mean that he has rattlesnake fangs, and unlike European vampires, he is powered by the sun.
rattlesnake.zh: 他来自狂野的西部，这意味着他有响尾蛇般的毒牙，不像欧洲产的吸血鬼，他由太阳提供能量。

rattlesnake.en: One family of completely harmless snakes, the kingsnake, has also evolved serum that neutralizes rattlesnake venom.
rattlesnake.zh: 一种完全无毒的蛇家族，王蛇，也进化出了能中和响尾蛇毒液的血清。

rattlesnake.en: Marissa Cooper suddenly pictured the shattered corpse of a rattlesnake lying bloody on a hot patch of yellowTexas sand so many years ago.
rattlesnake.zh: 玛丽莎·库珀突然想起了数年前，一条响尾蛇的尸体被击得粉碎，血迹斑斑地躺在德克萨斯炽热黄沙上。

harmonize.en: The new building does not harmonize with its surroundings.
harmonize.zh: 那栋新楼与周围环境不协调。

harmonize.en: All of the instruments have different sounds, and the parts they play blend and harmonize with one another.

vaccinate.en: They vaccinate our children and help us to recover when we are sick.
vaccinate.zh: 他们对我们的儿童进行预防接种并帮助我们在患病时康复。

phantom.en: We're paying a heavy price for Washington's obsession with phantom menaces.
phantom.zh: 我们正在为华盛顿痴迷于幽灵般的恐吓付出沉重的代价。

phantom.en: It was related to the accident of the Phantom of the Opera. It's been repaired now.
phantom.zh: 它跟《歌剧魅影》的事件有关。现在它被修好了。

phantom.en: The Phantom of the Opera must be the most iconic Broadway musical ever, and it's for a good reason. It's so incredible.
phantom.zh: 《歌剧魅影》一定是百老汇最具代表的一部作品，这是有原因的。它真不可思议。

envious.en: I don't think I'm envious of your success.
envious.zh: 我不认为我羡慕你的成功。

envious.en: Do I sound envious? I pity them, actually.
envious.zh: 我听起来像是羡慕吗？其实，我可怜他们。

scandalous.en: Newspaper columns were full of scandalous tales.
scandalous.zh: 报纸专栏上尽是与丑闻有关的故事。

scandalous.en: They would be sacked for criminal or scandalous behaviour.
scandalous.zh: 他们会因犯罪行为或不道德的行为而遭解雇。

scandalous.en: The revelation of his scandalous past led to his resignation.
scandalous.zh: 他那段不光彩历史的曝光，导致了他的辞职。

pronunciation.en: She gave the word its French pronunciation.
pronunciation.zh: 她给出了这个单词的法语发音。

pronunciation.en: There is more than one pronunciation of 'garage'.

catering.zh: 他们从事小规模的酒席承办业务。

catering.en: There were six bidders for the catering contract.
catering.zh: 投标承办酒席的有六家商号。

catering.en: His catering business made him a millionaire at 41.
catering.zh: 他的酒宴承办生意使他在41岁时成为了百万富翁。

noxious.en: Heavy industry pollutes our rivers with noxious chemicals.
noxious.zh: 重工业排放的有毒化学物质污染着我们的河流。

noxious.en: These noxious substances limit caterpillars' growth and reduce the number of eggs that female moths lay.
noxious.zh: 这些有毒物质会限制毛毛虫的生长，减少雌蛾产卵的数量。

noxious.en: Skunk, a noxious liquid mixture of nontoxic ingredients including baking powder and yeast, is blasted onto protesters from a water cannon.
noxious.zh: 臭鼬，一种由发酵粉和酵母等无毒成分混合而成的有毒液体，从高压水枪喷到抗议者身上。

hopper.en: Soon, all became clear: the stuffing machine operator had managed to fill the teddy bear stuffing machine hopper with car wheels.
hopper.zh: 不久，所有的一切都清楚了：装箱机的操作工把玩具车轮放入了泰迪熊装箱机的送料斗。

hopper.en: During the Second World War, Hopper joined the United States Navy.
hopper.zh: 在第二次世界大战期间，霍珀加入了美国海军。

hopper.en: Grace Murray Hopper studied mathematics and physics at Vassar College and went on to earn her Ph.D. in mathematics at Yale.
hopper.zh: 格蕾丝·默里·霍珀曾于瓦萨尔学院学习数学和物理，并在耶鲁大学继续深造获得数学博士学位。

annihilate.en: I was embarrassed how to punish him when I discovered his part in the business: he's such a cobweb, a pinch would annihilate him.
annihilate.zh: 当我发现他参与了这件事时，我不知道该如何惩罚他才好：他是一个蜘蛛网，一抓就要使他消亡。

annihilate.en: This also explains why matter and antimatter annihilate.
annihilate.zh: 这也解释了为什么物质与反物质会消失。

annihilate.en: Are you allowed to annihilate your trees if you're just renting?
annihilate.zh: 如果你只是租户的话，你可以砍伐树木吗？

peacock.zh: 孔雀展开了它那灿烂夺目的尾巴。

peacock.en: Abby pointed out a peacock blue evening dress.
peacock.zh: 艾比指着一件蓝孔雀的晚礼服。

peacock.en: Each pea and peach on the beach can be reached by the peacock.
peacock.zh: 海滩上的每一颗豌豆和桃子孔雀都能触及。

transplantation.en: Professor Bruce Lahn of the University of Chicago predicts that humans won't have to donate organs for transplantation.
transplantation.zh: 芝加哥大学的 Bruce Lahn 教授预测，人类将不必捐献器官来进行移植。

transplantation.en: The terrible constraint on organ transplantation is that every life extended depends on the death of someone young enough and healthy enough to have organs worth transplanting.
transplantation.zh: 器官移植的可怕约束是，一个人生命的延长要依赖于另一个足够年轻、健康的人的死亡，因为只有这些人身上才有值得移植的器官。

transplantation.en: Late staged pneumonoconiosis is one of the best indication for isolated lung transplantation.
transplantation.zh: 晚期尘肺病是分离肺移植的最佳指征之一。

insatiable.en: Since technology has such an insatiable appetite for eating up human jobs, this phenomenon will continue to restructure our economy in ways we cannot immediately foresee.
insatiable.zh: 由于技术在吞噬人类工作方面非常“贪得无厌”，所以这一现象将会继续以短时间难以预料的方式重构我们的经济。

insatiable.en: There seems to be an insatiable demand for more powerful computers.
insatiable.zh: 人们对于加强计算机功能的要求似乎永无止境。

insatiable.en: Sin, like the cuckoo bird, has an insatiable appetite, and it tries to take over our lives.
insatiable.zh: 罪恶，就像布谷鸟一样，有着贪得无厌的欲望，它试图控制我们的生活。

purification.en: According to Klawans, ritual purification involved separation from those aspects of humanity, death and sex, which are least God-like.
purification.zh: 根据克洛文的理解，仪式的净化包括从人性、死亡和性的那些方面分离出来，这些方面与上帝最不相似。

purification.en: In the future, more effective washing techniques, management procedures, and recycling and purification of water will be needed to reduce wastage.
purification.zh: 在未来，将需要更有效的清洗技术、管理程序以及水的回收和净化技术，以减少浪费。

purification.en: One of the most advantageous and widely used method is the tandem affinity purification.
purification.zh: 串联亲和纯化是目前应用最广泛、最具优势的方法之一。

cowardly.en: This was a cowardly thing to do.
cowardly.zh: 做这种事是懦弱的行为。

octopus.en: The first one is Paul, the Octopus.
octopus.zh: 名列榜首的是章鱼保罗。

octopus.en: The octopus is the real world version of Proteus.
octopus.zh: 章鱼是现实世界里的变形怪。

gaunt.en: Looking gaunt and tired, he denied there was anything to worry about.
gaunt.zh: 他看上去憔悴而又疲劳，却否认有烦心事。

gaunt.en: I know not what the younger dreams—some vague Utopia—and she seems, when withered old and skeleton-gaunt, an image of such politics.
gaunt.zh: 我不知道年轻一代的梦想是什么——某种模糊的乌托邦——而当她憔悴衰老、骨瘦如柴时，她似乎就是这种政治的化身。
不管怎样，你看上去很憔悴。

blockage.en: The logical treatment is to remove this blockage.
blockage.zh: 合理的处理方法是清除这种堵塞物。

blockage.en: Blood rushes to your nose and causes a blockage in it.
blockage.zh: 血液涌进你的鼻子，导致鼻子堵塞。

blockage.en: The valve failing closed could be due to an internal blockage or failure.
blockage.zh: 阀门无法关闭的原因可能是内部堵塞或故障。

urchin.en: They say he is a mischief-maker, a tramp, a street urchin—Calumnies!
urchin.zh: 他们说他是个捣蛋鬼，是个流浪汉，是个街头顽童——诋毁！

urchin.en: The spines of a fire urchin form a multicolored flower off Komodo Island, Indonesia.
urchin.zh: 火海胆的刺在印度尼西亚科莫多岛附近形成了五颜六色的花朵。

urchin.en: In the first century A.D., Pliny the Elder wrote of using sea urchin ashes to treat baldness.
urchin.zh: 公元一世纪，老普林尼曾写过用海胆的灰烬治疗来秃头。

grimy.en: "They must scurry back through the grimy crevices from where they had crept," says the New Times.
grimy.zh: 《新时代》杂志说：“它们必须从它们曾经爬过的地方，从肮脏的缝隙里迅速跑回来。”

synchronize.en: The sound track did not synchronize with the action.
It was virtually impossible to synchronize our lives so as to take vacations and weekends together.
synchronize.zh: 为了一起度假和过周末而要让我们的生活同步几乎是不可能的。

synchronize.en: Many studies have shown how people attempt to synchronize with their partners, by coordinating their behavior.
synchronize.zh: 许多研究显示出，人们如何试图通过调整自己的行为来与伴侣保持同步。

barter.en: Overall, barter is a very inefficient means of organizing transactions.
barter.zh: 总的说来，物物交换是一种非常低效的组织交易的方式。

barter.en: The market-place and street were crowded with those who'd come to barter.
barter.zh: 市场和街道上挤满了来进行物物交换的人。

barter.en: The islanders use a system of barter instead of money.
barter.zh: 岛上的居民实行的是以物易物，而不是用货币。

disobey.en: It was wrong of me to disobey father and to run away from home.
disobey.zh: 我不听父亲的话，离家出走，这是不对的。

disobey.en: In case you do disobey, you will be the one to suffer, not anyone else.
disobey.zh: 万一你不听话，吃苦头的将是你，而不是别人。

disobey.en: Those who disobey will be severely punished.

crossword.en: I've finished the crossword apart from 3 across and 10 down.
crossword.zh: 这份纵横字谜除横3竖10以外我都填完了。

crossword.en: People in this category make great engineers, soldiers and crossword-puzzle solvers.
crossword.zh: 这一类人通常是优秀的工程师，士兵和字谜解答者。

crossword.en: Some of you may enjoy doing crossword puzzles and perhaps doing crossword puzzles a couple of hours a day is enjoyable.
crossword.zh: 你们之中可能有些人爱玩填字游戏，也许一天玩几小时的填字游戏是令人愉快的。

uncompromising.en: On stage she seems hard, brash and uncompromising.
uncompromising.zh: 在舞台上,她显得冷酷、自以为是而且不妥协。

uncompromising.en: He has a reputation for being tough and uncompromising.
uncompromising.zh: 他的严厉和强硬态度是出了名的。
这是一场毫不调和的斗争。

lonesome.en: I felt lonesome in the strange land.
lonesome.zh: 在那陌生的地方我觉得寂寞。

lonesome.en: It was getting so lonesome anyway, and now it'll be worse.
lonesome.zh: 待在这里只会越来越寂寞。

lonesome.en: I felt so lonesome after he left.
lonesome.zh: 他离开后我感到非常孤单。

queue.zh: 排队等候的人逐渐向前挪着脚步。

queue.en: I had to join a queue for the toilets.
queue.zh: 我只得排队等着上厕所。

queue.en: Your print job has already been sent from your PC to the network print queue.
queue.zh: 你的打印任务已经从你的个人电脑输送到网络打印队列了。

infiltration.en: I've set up rain barrels and infiltration pits to collect thousands of gallons of storm water cascading from my roof.
infiltration.zh: 我设置了雨桶和渗透坑来收集从屋顶倾泻而下的数千加仑雨水。

infiltration.en: CT scan plays an important role in finding pericolic infiltration, distal ileal involvement and lymphadenopathy.
infiltration.zh: CT 扫描在发现心包浸润、远端回肠受累和淋巴结病变中起重要作用。

infiltration.en: The typical manifestations of PCP were bilateral diffuse infiltration distributing in perihilar regions.
infiltration.zh: PCP 的典型表现是双肺弥漫性渗出性病变分布于肺门周围。

conventionally.en: Men still wore their hair short and dressed conventionally.
conventionally.zh: 男人还是留着短发，着装传统。

conventionally.en: Organically grown produce does not differ greatly in appearance from conventionally grown crops.
conventionally.zh: 有机农产品与传统方法种植的农产品在外观上没有太大的区别。

conventionally.en: However, by showing that television promotes none of the dangerous effects as conventionally believed, Anderson suggests that television cannot be condemned without considering other influences.
conventionally.zh: 然而，通过表明电视并不像人们通常认为的那样产生任何有害作用，安德森认为在没有考虑其他影响因素的情况下，不能单单归咎于电视。

compatriot.en: Chris Robertson of Australia beat his compatriot Chris Dittmar in the final.
compatriot.zh: 澳大利亚的克里斯·罗伯逊在决赛中击败了他的本国对手克里斯·迪特玛。

compatriot.en: Henry the great: during the summer of that year Wenger brought in compatriot Thierry Henry from Juventus.
compatriot.zh: 伟大的亨利：温格从尤文图斯带来了阿森纳永远的国王亨利。

compatriot.en: His compatriot Michael Frater was 0.1 seconds behind him, while Frenchman Christophe Lemaitre settled in third.
compatriot.zh: 他的同胞迈克尔·弗莱特落后他0.1秒，法国选手克里斯多夫•莱玛特雷位居第三。

violator.en: The counterpart of the punished in peace order case includes both the violated and the violator.
violator.zh: 治安案件中被处罚相对人既包括被侵害人，也包括另一方违法者。

violator.en: The greatest ruffian, the most hardened violator of the laws of society, is not altogether without it.
violator.zh: 最大的恶棍，极其严重地违犯社会法律的人，也不会全然丧失同情心。

regent.en: When the king left on the Second Crusade, he appointed Suger as regent and left him in charge of the government.
regent.zh: 当国王在第二次十字军东征中离开时，他任命苏格为摄政王并让他掌管政府。

regent.en: Technology made photographic images a common sight in the shop windows of Regent Street and Piccadilly in London and the commercial boulevards of Paris.
regent.zh: 科技使摄影图像成为伦敦摄政街、皮卡迪利大街和巴黎商业大道商店橱窗中的一道常见风景。

regent.en: He voyaged to England to cook in the modern Great Kitchen of the prince regent, George IV, and crossed continents to prepare grand banquets for the tables of Tsar Alexander I of Russia.
regent.zh: 他曾航行到英格兰在摄政王乔治四世的现代大厨房掌勺，也曾跨越过大洲为俄罗斯沙皇亚历山大一世准备过豪华宴会。

jumbo.en: Anything that merits the adjective "jumbo" is extravagantly large.
jumbo.zh: 任何能用“特大”形容的事物都是超大的。

jumbo.en: The game involves setting flight paths to safely direct jumbo jets to the large runway, smaller prop planes to the airstrip, and helicopters to the helipad.
jumbo.zh: 游戏需要设定飞行路线，来安全引导特大喷气客机到大型跑道、引导小型螺旋桨飞机至简易跑道、以及引导直升机到直升机场。

jumbo.en: It's all full of psychoanalytic mumbo-jumbo.
jumbo.zh: 这里面全是精神分析的一派胡言。

inhuman.en: Capital punishment was regarded as inhuman and immoral.
inhuman.zh: 死刑过去被认为是非人道且不道德的。

inhuman.en: There is nothing sinful or immoral about being emotional, unless your emotions make you inhuman, insensitive and cruel to others.
inhuman.zh: 情绪化不罪恶，也合乎道德，除非你的情绪让你变得不人道、麻木不仁、对他人残忍。

inhuman.en: If it is true that the only paradises are those we have lost, I will know what name to give the tender and inhuman something that dwells in me today.
inhuman.zh: 据说只有失去的才是乐园。 如果真是如此，我就知道怎样称呼今天停驻在我心中的、那温柔而不近人情的事物了。

fruitless.en: After a fruitless morning sitting at his desk he had given up.
fruitless.zh: 他在书桌前徒劳地坐了一个上午后便放弃了。

fruitless.en: He stopped to watch his son's fruitless efforts.
fruitless.zh: 他停下来看儿子徒劳的努力。
那是一次毫无结果的搜寻。

rigorously.en: Whatever regimen has been prescribed should be rigorously followed.
rigorously.zh: 不管制订的是什么样的养生计划，都要严格遵守。

rigorously.en: The question of who actually left the South has never been rigorously investigated.
rigorously.zh: 究竟是谁真正离开了南方，这个问题从未得到过严格的调查。

rigorously.en: She says, noting the FDA does not regulate supplements as rigorously as foods or drugs.
rigorously.zh: 她指出，FDA 对补剂的监管不像对食品或药物那样严格。

consign.en: Nor should it: human knowledge is too precious to consign to the ether alone.
consign.zh: 纸质图书业不应该消失：人类的知识太珍贵以至于不能只寄于计算机网络这一单一的方式记录。

consign.en: Under the consignment shop structure, Banks would consign only assets with doubtful values.
consign.zh: 根据寄售商店的结构，银行只寄售价值不清的资产。

consign.en: So the consigner can consign fake goods or the buyer can refuse to pay, leading to problems at all stages of the process.
consign.zh: 因此，委托人可以委托拍卖假货，买家可以拒绝付款，使得整个拍卖过程的各个阶段都问题重重。

impotent.en: For centuries, medicine was impotent and hence unproblematic.
impotent.zh: 几个世纪以来，医学无能为力，因此没有问题。

impotent.en: Once impotent due to Cold War rivalries, it has regained much of the authority accorded by the UN charter.
impotent.zh: 它曾经由于冷战对立而无能为力，现已重获《联合国宪章》赋予的大部分权力。
她勃然大怒，但于事无补。

telegraph.en: Now I must telegraph your father to come.
telegraph.zh: 现在我必须发电报叫你父亲来。

telegraph.en: A new telegraph line has been set up between the two cities.
telegraph.zh: 那两个城市之间架设了一条新的电报线。

telegraph.en: The telegraph, the telephone, and radio were the obvious predecessors of the Internet, iPods, and mobile phones.
telegraph.zh: 电报、电话和无线电显然是互联网、iPods 和移动电话的前身。

amplifier.en: The amplifier exploded in a fountain of sparks.
amplifier.zh: 放大器爆炸，喷射出火星。

amplifier.en: A receiver and amplifier receive the radio waves from the sub reflector, and make these weak radio waves strong enough to be recorded and turned into electronic signals.
amplifier.zh: 接收器和放大器接收来自副反射器的无线电波，并使这些微弱的无线电波强大到足以被记录下来并转化成电子信号。

amplifier.en: The modulator tube diverts current from the RF amplifier.
amplifier.zh: 调制管转移射频放大器中的电流。

partake.en: Would you care to partake of some refreshment?
They preferred not to partake in the social life of the town.
partake.zh: 他们不想参加这个镇的社交活动。

partake.en: They were happy to partake of our feast, but not to share our company.
partake.zh: 他们喜欢享用我们准备的丰盛大餐，但是不喜欢和我们呆在一起。

aviator.en: Lagerfeld, who was dressed in a tight Dior suit of broad gray and blue stripes, and a pair of aviator sunglasses, disdains this practice.
aviator.zh: 拉格菲尔德身穿迪奥的灰蓝色宽条纹紧身西装，戴着一副飞行员墨镜，对这种做法不屑一顾。

aviator.en: The Man Angel was lighter-than-air and had paddles like a rowboat that the aviator could pump.
aviator.zh: “人类天使”比空气还轻，有像划艇一样的桨，飞行员可以摇动它们。

aviator.en: Instead of an Afro, his hair was slicked and combed to one side, and he wore mirrored aviator sunglasses.
aviator.zh: 他的头发不是爆炸头，而是光溜溜地梳向一边，他还戴了一副反光飞行员墨镜。

steadfast.en: The twin lights, the shifting grey and the steadfast red, mastered the Water Rat and held him bound, fascinated, powerless.
steadfast.zh: 变幻莫测的灰色和坚定不变的红色，这两道光芒控制住了河鼠，使他处于动弹不得，痴痴迷迷，又无能为力的状态。

steadfast.en: He remained steadfast in his belief that he had done the right thing.
steadfast.zh: 他仍然坚信自己做了正确的事情。

steadfast.en: He remained steadfast in his determination to bring the killers to justice.
steadfast.zh: 他要将杀人凶手绳之以法的决心一直没有动摇。

reciprocate.en: Some day I will reciprocate your kindness to me.
reciprocate.zh: 总有一天我会报答你对我的恩德。

reciprocate.en: Some day I will reciprocate your great kindness to me.
reciprocate.zh: 总有一天我会报答你对我的厚爱。

reciprocate.en: I wasn't sure whether to laugh or to reciprocate with a remark of my own.
reciprocate.zh: 我不知道是该笑一笑还是该说点什么作为回应。

whaling.en: The commission is calling for a global ban on whaling.
whaling.zh: 委员会要求全球禁止捕鲸。

whaling.en: We have campaigned against whaling for the last 15 years.
whaling.zh: 我们最近15年一直参加反对捕鲸的运动。

whaling.en: Communities on the island depended on whaling for their livelihood.
whaling.zh: 岛上的居民靠捕鲸为生。

megawatt.en: The capacity of individual power stations, many of them hydro plants, rose from a few kilowatts to over a megawatt in less than a decade.
megawatt.zh: 在不到十年的时间里，单个发电站的发电能力就从几千瓦上升到了几兆瓦，其中许多是水力发电站。

extrinsic.zh: 现在，结婚与否很少受到来自外部的压力。

hostel.en: I've never stayed in a hostel before.
hostel.zh: 我以前从未住过招待所。

hostel.en: Someone told me there's another hostel called Gum Tree something.
hostel.zh: 有人告诉我那儿还有家招待所，叫“桉树”什么的。

hostel.en: The first possibility I found was a hostel called Top End Backpackers.
hostel.zh: 我找到的第一个选择是一家叫“顶级背包客”的招待所。

hitherto.en: How does the author view the hitherto high click-through rates?
hitherto.zh: 作者如何看待迄今为止的高点击率？

hitherto.en: Hitherto he had thought it was some fiend fighting him, but darker suspicions assailed him now.
hitherto.zh: 到目前为止，他一直以为是魔鬼在跟他搏斗，但现在更阴暗的怀疑向他袭来。

hitherto.en: In himself, too, he knew that it was vibrating at last, that chord hitherto dormant and unsuspected.
hitherto.zh: 在他自己心里，他也知道那根弦终于在颤动了，那根弦一直蛰伏着，不曾被察觉。

whirlpool.en: Some rooms also have fireplace, whirlpool bath and wet bar.
whirlpool.zh: 一些房间也有壁炉、漩涡浴盆和带水槽的吧台。

whirlpool.en: The recent rain had churned up the waterfall into a muddy whirlpool.
whirlpool.zh: 近来的雨水把那条瀑布搅成了泥水漩涡。

whirlpool.en: Despite that, there is definitely something that people, including me, fall victim to when they jump in the personal development whirlpool.
whirlpool.zh: 尽管如此，当人们包括我在内跳进个人发展的漩涡时，肯定会成为某些事情的受害者。

pretentious.en: Ironically, now that photography is securely established as fine art, many photographers find it pretentious or irrelevant to label it as such.
pretentious.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，现在摄影已被牢固地确立为美术，许多摄影师发现将其贴上标签是自命不凡或无关紧要的。

pretentious.en: That's a pretentious name for a dog!
pretentious.zh: 狗叫这个名字真够炫的！
瞧他那副自命不凡的样儿！

lenient.en: The judge was far too lenient with him.
There is little evidence that harsher punishments deter any better than more lenient ones.
lenient.zh: 甚少证据显示严惩比宽大更能遏止犯罪。

lenient.en: The judge was lenient with the wrongdoer.
lenient.zh: 法官对这个犯人很宽大。

layman.en: The subject matter was so technical as to be beyond the ken of the average layman.
layman.zh: 该主题专业性太强，一般的外行人很难理解。

layman.en: Where the law is concerned, I am only a layman.
layman.zh: 谈到法律，我不过是门外汉。

layman.en: I'm a layman. What I'm going to say may expose myself to ridicule, yet I still want to say a few words.
layman.zh: 我是个外行，我说的话可能贻笑大方，可我还是要说几句。

convection.en: It would be odd if the rising convection currents kept exact pace with them.
convection.zh: 如果上升的对流与它们保持保持完全一致，那就奇怪了。

convection.en: Theoretically, this convection would carry the continental plates along as though they were on a conveyor belt.
convection.zh: 从理论上讲，这种对流会把大陆板块带到一起，好像把它们放在传送带上一样。

convection.en: Another possibility is that the sinking plate cools the neighboring mantle and produces convection currents that move the plates.
convection.zh: 另一种可能是下沉的板块冷却了邻近的地幔，并产生对流，使板块移动。

engross.en: To write or print a final copy of; engross.
engross.zh: 誊清或印刷…的终稿；正式写成文件。

engross.en: But self, though it would intrude, could not engross her.
engross.zh: 她虽然难免想到自己，却并不是完全只想到自己。

engross.en: To occupy the full attention, interest, or time of; engross.
engross.zh: 引人注意，使着迷占据…的全部注意力、兴趣或时间； 使全神贯注。

disrespectful.zh: 迟到被认为是不礼貌的。

disrespectful.en: Is a colleague being disrespectful of your time?
disrespectful.zh: 同事是否不尊重你的时间？

normalization.en: The two sides would like to see the normalization of diplomatic relations.
normalization.zh: 双方都愿意看到外交关系的正常化。
任何归一化常数都将被重新排序。
规范化会应用到拼写变化中。

silverware.en: They bought their own dishes and silverware and brought them to America.
silverware.zh: 他们买了自己的盘子和银器，并把它们带到美国。

silverware.en: Today, most people in Western cultures expect to eat meals with their own set of silverware, their own plates, and their own glasses.
silverware.zh: 今天，西方文化中大多数人希望用自己的一套银器、盘子和杯子吃饭。

silverware.en: He has his own silverware at home.

sightseeing.en: Did you have a chance to do any sightseeing ?
sightseeing.zh: 你有没有出去游览的机会？

sightseeing.en: Sightseeing is best done either by tour bus or by bicycles.
sightseeing.zh: 观光最好要么乘游览巴士，要么骑自行车。

sightseeing.en: A sightseeing tour of the city is included to help you get your bearings.
sightseeing.zh: 城市观光游包括在内，以帮助你们弄清方向。

yoke.en: Patience and submission are the only comforts that are left to a poor people who groan under tyranny unless they are strong enough to break the yoke.
yoke.zh: 坚忍与顺从是可怜的人儿仅有的慰籍，她们在暴行面前只能低声抽泣，除非她们有力量挣脱枷锁。

yoke.en: The introduction attempts to yoke the pieces together.
yoke.zh: 引言试图将各部分硬拼凑在一起。

yoke.en: "Too much too soon either results in injury or burnout," says Mary Yoke, PhD, a faculty member in the kinesiology department at Indiana University in Bloomington.
yoke.zh: 印第安纳大学布鲁明顿分校运动机能学系教师玛丽·约克博士说道：“太多或太快的运动都会导致身体受伤或过度劳累。”

multiracial.zh: 我们生活在一个多种族的社会里。

multiracial.en: In Indiana, Iowa and South Dakota, the multiracial population increased by about 70 percent.
multiracial.zh: 在印第安纳州，洛瓦和南达科他州，混血人口增加了大约70%。

multiracial.en: The islanders have free education and health care. Their multiracial society is pretty harmonious.
multiracial.zh: 不冷不热的天气，没有疟疾，岛民们享受免费教育和医疗，他们的多种族社会十分和谐。

retailing.en: They've got fruit retailing down to a fine art. You can be sure that your pears will ripen in day.
retailing.zh: 他们精于水果零售之道。你可以放心，你那些梨一天之内就会熟。

retailing.en: Despite the tremendous challenges from online retailing, traditional retailing will be here to stay for quite some time.
retailing.zh: 尽管传统零售面临着网上零售带来的巨大挑战，但它在相当长一段时间内仍将存在。

midpoint.en: Because the midpoint of the Medieval Warm Period was about 850, an extension of Bond's cycles would place the midpoint of the next warm interval in the twenty-fourth century.
midpoint.zh: 由于中世纪温暖期的中点约为850年，因此邦德循环的延长将使下一个温暖间隔的中点出现在二十四世纪。

midpoint.en: She has not yet reached the midpoint of her life.
midpoint.zh: 她尚未达到人生历程的一半。

midpoint.en: Executive producer spills about episodes, "In the fall finale we reset the series again, something that we've done at the midpoint of most of our seasons."
midpoint.zh: 执行制作人对于剧情这样描述：“秋季档大结局中，我们又重新整合了剧情，几乎每一季的中间档都是这么做的。”

tramp.zh: 我们是经过长途跋涉回家的。

tramp.en: They say he is a mischief-maker, a tramp, a street urchin—Calumnies!
tramp.zh: 他们说他是个捣蛋鬼，是个流浪汉，是个街头顽童——诋毁！

tramp.en: Even if one were to search with a lantern, no one idle man or one tramp could have been found.
tramp.zh: 哪怕你提着灯笼去找，也找不到一个懒汉或流浪汉。

bequeath.en: She said if the world did not act conclusively now, it would only bequeath the problem to future generations.
bequeath.zh: 她说如果这个世界现在不采取正确的行动，那只会把问题遗留给后代。

bequeath.en: My small estate I bequeath to my mother;
I bequeath to you today one little girl ...
bequeath.zh: 我今天交给你一个小女孩。。。

haphazard.en: Could the same approach also shed light on abstract twentieth-century pieces, from Mondrian's geometrical blocks of colour, to Pollock's seemingly haphazard arrangements of splashed paint on canvas?
haphazard.zh: 同样的方法是否也适用于二十世纪的抽象作品呢？从蒙德里安的几何色块，到波洛克在画布上喷溅颜料看似随意的布局？
这次调查似乎的确没有计划性。

haphazard.en: The books had been piled on the shelves in a haphazard fashion.
haphazard.zh: 书架上的书堆放得杂乱无序。

commonwealth.en: The prime minister of Fiji has said Fiji is in no hurry to rejoin the Commonwealth.
commonwealth.zh: 斐济总理称斐济并不急于重返英联邦。

commonwealth.en: Britain has announced that it is to cancel about 200 million pounds' worth of debts owed to it by poorer Commonwealth countries.
commonwealth.zh: 英国宣布将免除英联邦内较为贫穷的国家欠下的约2亿英镑债务。

commonwealth.en: Now that the country has embarked on a return to democracy, Commonwealth heads of government have agreed to end the estrangement.
commonwealth.zh: 既然该国已开始恢复民主，英联邦政府首脑们已同意结束这种疏远的关系。

geothermal.en: Eighteen countries now generate electricity using geothermal heat.
geothermal.zh: 现在有18个国家使用地热发电。

geothermal.en: The contribution of geothermal energy to the world's energy future is difficult to estimate.
geothermal.zh: 地热能对世界未来能源的贡献是难以估计的。

geothermal.en: Reykjavik, the capital of Iceland, is entirely heated by geothermal energy derived from volcanic heat.
geothermal.zh: 冰岛的首都雷克雅未克完全是用火山热产生的地热能来供热的。

superfluous.en: My presence at the afternoon's proceedings was superfluous.
superfluous.zh: 我在下午的活动中的出席是多余的。

superfluous.en: She gave him a look that made words superfluous.
superfluous.zh: 她看了他一眼，这已表明一切，无须多言了。

affable.en: He was affable at one moment, choleric the next.
affable.zh: 他时而友善和蔼，时而暴躁易怒。

affable.en: Mr. Brooke is an extremely affable and approachable man.
affable.zh: 布鲁克先生是一个极为和蔼可亲的人。

affable.en: Forrest was normally mild-mannered, affable, and untalkative.
affable.zh: 福里斯特通常态度温和，和蔼可亲，不善言辞。

congenial.en: He found congenial officers who knew how to leaven war's rigours with riotous enjoyment.
congenial.zh: 他找到了和他志趣相投的懂得用狂欢来冲淡战争的残酷的军官。

congenial.en: He is back in more congenial company.
congenial.zh: 他回到了更令他愉快的同伴中。

congenial.en: This interpretation implied that the West provided a congenial environment where women could aspire to their own goals, free from constrictive stereotypes and sexist.
congenial.zh: 这种解释意味着西方提供了一个适宜的环境，在那里妇女可以追求自己的目标，摆脱束缚的刻板印象和性别歧视。

enterprising.en: What would this energetic, enterprising country be without new lands to conquer?
enterprising.zh: 如果没有新的大陆可以征服，这个充满活力和进取精神的国家会是什么样子？

enterprising.en: He is upright, optimistic, active and enterprising, striving for truthfulness, kindness and beauty, and seeking for an ideal society all his life.
enterprising.zh: 他正直、乐观向上、积极进取。他一生都在追求真、善、美，一生都在追求理想的社会。

enterprising.en: To realize this vision, Ricci is mounting one of the most lavish, enterprising—and expensive—promotional campaigns in magazine-publishing history.
enterprising.zh: 为了实现这一愿景，利玛窦正在进行杂志出版史上最奢华、最进取、最昂贵的促销活动之一。

doomed.zh: 看起来，他们的计划注定要失败。

doomed.en: I used to pour time and energy into projects that were doomed from the start.
doomed.zh: 过去我总是将时间和精力投入到一些从一开始就注定要失败的项目上。

antagonistic.en: Nearly all the women I interviewed were aggressively antagonistic to the idea.
antagonistic.zh: 我采访过的几乎所有妇女都强烈反对这一想法。

antagonistic.en: It can also be antagonistic, such as when a political candidate turns toward their competitor during a debate and makes eye contact that signals hostility.
antagonistic.zh: 它也可以是对抗性的，例如，当一个政治候选人在辩论中转向他们的竞争对手，并进行眼神交流，表明敌意。

antagonistic.en: Of the other two choices, "generally rejected by" would provide no contrast, while "antagonistic toward" suggests a relationship that would not explain why music was so widely esteemed.
antagonistic.zh: 在另外两个选项中，“普遍被拒绝”不会提供任何对比，而“对立面”则表明了一种关系，无法解释为什么音乐受到如此广泛的推崇。

indignity.en: The King chafed bitterly over the stupendous indignity thus put upon his royalty, but Hendon was moody and taciturn.
indignity.zh: 国王对他的王权受到的巨大侮辱感到非常愤怒，亨顿更是憋住一肚子气，沉默寡言。

indignity.en: Later, he suffered the indignity of having to flee angry protesters.
indignity.zh: 后来，他因为不得不逃离愤怒的抗议者而蒙受羞辱。

indignity.en: No more begging in the intense sun and rain, and no more indignity.
indignity.zh: 再也无需雨打日晒地乞讨，再也没有侮辱。

outstrip.en: This does not minimize the supremacy of their achievements, which outstrip our own as the sub-four-minute milers outstrip our jogging.
outstrip.zh: 这并不会使他们的成就的优越性减少，他们的成就远胜过我们，就像不超过四分钟跑完一英里的运动员超过慢跑的我们一样。

outstrip.en: If they could be turned into usable crops, they could outstrip even Hevea.
outstrip.zh: 如果能将它们变成有用的作物，它们甚至会胜过橡胶树。

outstrip.en: Within the next few years, jobs will outstrip demand in some professions.
outstrip.zh: 在以后的几年，一些职业会求大于供。

dissimilar.en: His methods were not dissimilar to those used by Freud.
dissimilar.zh: 他用的方法和弗洛伊德用的没有什么不同。

dissimilar.en: It would be difficult to find two men who were more dissimilar.
dissimilar.zh: 要找出两个更不同的人来可不容易。

dissimilar.en: And a room with books in it induces, at least in some, a feeling not dissimilar to that of a fire in the fireplace on a cold winter's night.
dissimilar.zh: 至少在某种程度上，房间里放着的书会带来一种与寒冷冬夜里壁炉里的火差不多的感觉。

affront.en: What a Westerner considers an honest look in the eye, the Oriental takes as a lack of respect and a personal affront.
affront.zh: 西方人认为是真诚的眼神，而东方人则认为是缺乏尊重和对个人的侮辱。

affront.en: The play was considered an affront to public morals.
affront.zh: 人们认为这出戏侮辱了公众道德。

affront.en: Life is too short to turn every personal affront into a battle.
affront.zh: 人生苦短，别太过于计较个人恩怨。

combative.en: Daniels is at his best when he's cool and direct, rather than combative and polemical.
combative.zh: 丹尼尔斯冷静、坦率时表现最好，而好斗、爱辩时则不然。

combative.en: He conducted the meeting yesterday in his usual combative style, refusing to admit any mistakes.
combative.zh: 他昨天以他一贯的好斗风格主持了会议，拒绝承认任何错误。
我是一个极端好战的人。

gelatin.en: "If I see any kind of flower, I can do it in gelatin," she says, "I took my orchid gelatin to friends' parties, and they were wowed."
gelatin.zh: “如果我看见任何一种花，我就可以用胶冻做，”她说，“我把我的兰花胶冻带到了朋友的聚会上，他们都赞不绝口。”

gelatin.en: The paint was covered by salt crystals and gelatin glue.
gelatin.zh: 可是因为该幅作品被晶体盐和明胶覆盖。

gelatin.en: What the gelatin industry does with the bones, we don't want to know.
gelatin.zh: 我们不想知道明胶企业对这些骨头做了些什么。

supplementary.en: Its designers were not high-end with supplementary lines.
supplementary.zh: 它的设计师们不是高端产品的补充线。

supplementary.en: Only rarely are supplementary worksheets distributed in a maths class.
supplementary.zh: 只有在很少的情况下，才会在数学课上发放补充作业纸。

supplementary.en: The OWF is an ideal supplementary resource for learners to engage in word-building activities during topic-based lessons.
supplementary.zh: OWF 是一个理想的补充资源，让学习者在以主题为基础的课程参与构词活动。

deluge.en: There was a deluge of requests for interviews and statements.
deluge.zh: 对接受访谈和发表声明的要求铺天盖地地涌来。

deluge.en: But the data deluge also poses risks.
deluge.zh: 但是，海量数据也提出了风险。

indecent.en: The amendment prohibits obscene or indecent materials which denigrate the objects or beliefs of a particular religion.
indecent.zh: 该修正案禁止玷污某一宗教客体或信仰的色情或不雅物品。

indecent.en: That skirt of hers is positively indecent.
indecent.zh: 她的那条裙子太暴露了。

indecent.en: She finished her first glass of wine with indecent haste.
indecent.zh: 她忙不迭地把第一杯酒干了。

roost.zh: 那只孔雀在附近的灌木丛里栖息。

roost.en: Something disturbed the bird on its roost.
roost.zh: 什么东西惊扰了那只栖息的鸟。

roost.en: For example, birds may expend more of their reserves on thermoregulation if they spend the night exposed to the wind on a song post than if they are in a sheltered roost site.
roost.zh: 例如，与在有遮挡的栖息地的鸟类相比，如果鸟类在风中露宿一晚，它们可能会更多地利用体温调节。

brook.en: The Bow Brook forms the western boundary of the wood.
brook.zh: 鲍溪成了树林的西边界。

brook.en: Brother, I pray you, do not drink of this brook; you will be changed into a wolf, and devour me.
brook.zh: 哥哥，我求求你，不要喝这个小溪的水；你会变成一头狼，然后把我吞掉。

wager.en: I'll wager that she knows more about it than she's saying.
wager.zh: 我敢打赌，她知道的比她说的要多。

wager.en: I never heard the name in my life. I'll wager anything it is not in the calendar!
wager.zh: 我这辈子从来没听说过这个名字。我敢打赌，日历上也没有这个名字！

wager.en: Laurence has just won a wager with his team over the number of Vodafone VIP members who bought tickets for concerts.
wager.zh: 劳伦斯刚刚跟他的团队就购买了音乐会门票的沃达丰 VIP 会员的数目打了一个赌，赌赢了。

detest.zh: 我厌恶那些欺骗我的人。

detest.en: I detest all things even remotely German.
detest.zh: 我厌恶所有与德国相关的，即使隔得很远。

virtuoso.en: The game was a triumph; the team gave a virtuoso performance.
virtuoso.zh: 比赛大获全胜；该队表演精彩。

virtuoso.en: For United, it was a virtuoso performance.
virtuoso.zh: 对曼联来说，这是一次如艺术家般的表现。

virtuoso.en: A virtuoso must first be an excellent technician who has made the basic practices habitual.
virtuoso.zh: 艺术品鉴赏家必须首先成为一名出色的技术师，具备基本的实践习惯。

elucidate.en: I will try to elucidate what I think the problems are.
elucidate.zh: 我将尽力阐明我认为问题的所在。

elucidate.en: There was no need for him to elucidate.

aggravated.en: The war has aggravated an acute economic crisis.
aggravated.zh: 这场战争加剧了一场严峻的经济危机。

aggravated.en: These problems were aggravated by the overvaluation of the dollar.
aggravated.zh: 对美元的过高估价加剧了这些问题。

aggravated.en: The wound, already deep, was aggravated by the necessary cutting out of the arrow-head.
aggravated.zh: 本来已经很深的伤口，再加上不得不切掉箭头，更加恶化了。

exasperated.en: 'Why won't you answer me?' he asked in an exasperated voice.
exasperated.zh: “你为什么不愿意回答我？”他愤怒地问道。
狐狸真的把他们俩都激怒了。

exasperated.en: She was becoming exasperated with all the questions they were asking.
exasperated.zh: 她开始对他们问的所有问题感到恼火。

irrigate.en: He wants to use the water to irrigate barren desert land.
irrigate.zh: 他想用该水来灌溉贫瘠的沙漠土地。

irrigate.en: The lines were thought to have been a system of canals that had been built to irrigate the surface.
irrigate.zh: 这些管道被认为是为灌溉地表而修建的运河系统。

irrigate.en: None of the water from Lake Powell is used to irrigate the area.
irrigate.zh: 鲍威尔湖的水没有被用来灌溉这一地区。

spool.en: This time I'll do it right with a spool of thread.
spool.zh: 这次我会用一轴线把它弄好的。

spool.en: Their stories spool out as Kitson hits "on" buttons in sequence.
spool.zh: 凯特森依次点击“开始”按钮，他们的故事开始展开。

rapture.en: The children gazed at her in rapture.
rapture.zh: 孩子们欣喜若狂地看着她。

rapture.en: Charles listened with rapture to her singing.
rapture.zh: 查尔斯兴致勃勃地听她演唱。

rapture.en: His speech was received with rapture by his supporters.
rapture.zh: 他的演说受到了其支持者的热烈欢呼。

audacious.en: He was known for risky tactics that ranged from audacious to outrageous.
audacious.zh: 他以大胆甚至是骇人听闻的冒险战术而闻名。

audacious.en: It's the latest turn in the unwinding of one of the most audacious promises of the 20th century.
audacious.zh: 这是20世纪最大胆的承诺之一的最新转折。

audacious.en: You been into some other audacious mischief when I wasn't around, like enough.
audacious.zh: 我不在的时候，你说不定又干了些别的胆大妄为的淘气事。

despicable.en: Let us at least see our courts make an example of these despicable criminals.
despicable.zh: 让我们至少看到我们的法庭严惩卑鄙的罪犯们以示儆戒。

despicable.en: Then he is a despicable piece of shit.
despicable.zh: 那么他真是个卑鄙的小子。

despicable.en: Some may be wicked, and some may be despicable.
despicable.zh: 也许有些人很可恶，有些人很卑鄙。

conifer.en: It is classified in the family Taxaceae, which is now classified as a conifer in the order Pinales.
conifer.zh: 它被归为红豆杉科，而红豆杉现在被归为松类针叶树。

conifer.en: In corridors cut through the forest, spread with yellow conifer needles, the paths are moist and resilient.
conifer.zh: 林间的步道垫上了一层黄色的松针，松软潮湿而又富有弹性。

feudal.en: Diplomacy was in his blood: his ancestors had been feudal lords.
feudal.zh: 他的外交能力是天生的：他的祖上曾是封建王侯。

feudal.en: This historical novel illustrates the breaking up of feudal society in microcosm.
feudal.zh: 这部历史小说是走向崩溃的封建社会的缩影。

barometer.en: A man in camp took a barometer reading at half-hour intervals.
barometer.zh: 营地里的一个人每半小时看一次气压计。

barometer.en: In past presidential elections, Missouri has been a barometer of the rest of the country.
barometer.zh: 在过去的总统大选中，密苏里州一直是该国其余各州的晴雨表。

barometer.en: Infant mortality is a reliable barometer of socio-economic conditions.
barometer.zh: 婴儿死亡率是社会经济状况的可靠指标。

hallowed.en: They protested that there was no place for a school of commerce in their hallowed halls of learning.
hallowed.zh: 他们抗议说，在他们所尊崇的学术殿堂里没有商业学院的位置。

hallowed.en: “Our Father in heaven, hallowed by your name ….
hallowed.zh: “我们在天上的父，愿人都尊你的名为圣...”

hallowed.en: Hallowed laws, regulations, standards and memes will evaporate.
hallowed.zh: 神圣不可侵犯的法规、标准和文化基因都将不复存在。

vernacular.en: Worst of all, for a playwright specializing in characters who use the vernacular, he has a tin ear for dialogue.
vernacular.zh: 最糟的是，作为一个专门刻画使用方言人物的剧作家，他在对话方面没有鉴赏力。

vernacular.en: The vast majority of the population used their own regional vernacular in all aspects of their lives.
vernacular.zh: 绝大多数人在生活的各个方面都使用他们自己的地方方言。

vernacular.en: Tom: Yes, till modern history, modern vernacular Chinese is popular.
vernacular.zh: 是啊，到了近现代就是白话文了。

astounded.zh: 她听到那消息时显得震惊。

degeneration.en: Studies have shown, for example, that two drugs are about equally effective in treating macular degeneration, an eye disease.
degeneration.zh: 例如，有一些研究表明，两种药物治疗黄斑变性这种眼病的效果差不多。

degeneration.en: Intensive farming in the area has caused severe degeneration of the land.
degeneration.zh: 这个地区的集约化农业使得土壤严重贫瘠化。

degeneration.en: Eburnation: degeneration of bone into a hard ivorylike mass.
degeneration.zh: 骨质象牙化：骨头退化成坚硬的象牙质。

electrify.en: Our job is to insPire, suPPort and eleCtrify.
electrify.zh: 我们的工作就是鼓舞、打气、支持。

electrify.en: He needs money to electrify his surface lines.
electrify.zh: 他需要钱把他的地面铁路电气化。

electrify.en: Use cable tow truck or safe wire to electrify.
electrify.zh: 采用电缆拖车或安全滑触线受电。

adjourn.zh: 这个会议将会无限期休会。

adjourn.en: Why don't we adjourn to the local hostelry?
adjourn.zh: 我们怎么不搬到本地旅馆去住呢？

dupe.en: He was accused of being a dupe of the Americans.
dupe.zh: 他被控是美国人的傀儡。

dupe.en: Nobody's perfect, even scientists get duped (or try and dupe others).
dupe.zh: 没有人是完美的，就算是科学家，一样会上当受骗。或许，科学家，也在试着骗人。

dupe.en: The "little horror" is the man a woman is forced to marry, a kind of dupe.
dupe.zh: 那个所谓的“捣蛋”鬼就是女人要被迫嫁给的人，一种愚蠢的欺骗。

trifle.zh: 1 000元对她来说不过是区区小数。

trifle.en: As a photographer, he'd found both locations just a trifle disappointing.
trifle.zh: 作为一名摄影师，他发现这两个地方都有点儿令人失望。

amphibian.en: Why does the speaker choose that amphibian as her representative of a public creature?
amphibian.zh: 为什么那位演讲者要选择这种两栖动物作为公众生物的代表呢？

amphibian.en: The world is an amphibian smorgasbord to the Epomis beetles.
amphibian.zh: 这个世界对于青步甲来说简直就是一个两栖类美食餐厅。

amphibian.en: At first this amphibian deals with the cooler days by burying itself in the soil.
amphibian.zh: 起初，天气乍凉的时候，这种两栖动物将自己埋在土壤里。

subordination.en: Written language requires a firm understanding of sequencing and subordination.
subordination.zh: 书面语言需要有对顺序和从属的认识。

subordination.en: There's no ontological subordination of the objects properties to the object itself.
Let me call it, for the purpose here, subordination, or if you wish, the executive function.
subordination.zh: 就本次会议的目的而言，姑且让我称之为从属性，如果你愿意，也可以称之为执行功能。

navigator.en: He became a navigator during the war.
navigator.zh: 战争期间他成了一名领航员。

navigator.en: The navigator took a fix on the sun and steered the ship due north.
navigator.zh: 领航员对着太阳测方位后将船朝正北驶去。
他真是个伟大的航海家。

concentric.en: On a blackboard, he drew five concentric circles.
concentric.zh: 他在黑板上画出五个同心圆。

concentric.en: Bone growth in reptiles is periodic in nature, producing a series of concentric rings in the bone, not unlike the growth rings of a tree.
concentric.zh: 爬行动物的骨骼生长在本质上是周期性的，在骨头上产生一系列的同心圆，就像树木的年轮一样。

concentric.en: The same catalogue included a type of two-pole concentric plug and socket.
concentric.zh: 相同的目录包括一种两极同心插头和插座。

kindle.en: See the peaks of thought kindle with sunrise!
kindle.zh: 见到日出点燃思想的顶峰！

kindle.en: Though I'm still not keen on the design of the Kindle, it is a vast improvement on its predecessor and certainly tolerable.
kindle.zh: 虽然我仍然不喜欢 Kindle 的设计，但它和其前身相比已经有了很大的改进，当然也可以接受。

abject.zh: 他是一个卑鄙的说谎者。

abject.en: "Rather than a case of abject failure, Rapu Nui is an unlikely story of success," they claim.
abject.zh: 他们声称：“拉普努伊不是一个悲惨的失败案例，而是一个不太可能成功的故事。”

abject.en: Born in rude and abject poverty, he never had any education, except what he gave himself, till he was approaching manhood.
abject.zh: 生于粗陋和赤贫之中，在接近成年之前，除了自学之外，他从未受过任何教育。

accredit.zh: 他们认定这些是他的见解。

accredit.en: We accredit him with finding that book.
accredit.zh: 我们相信是他找到那本书的。

accredit.en: vt. We accredit the invention of the electric light to Adison.
accredit.zh: 我们把电灯的发明归功于爱迪生。

suffrage.en: Within the United States prior to 1920, for example, only less urbanized states had granted women suffrage.
suffrage.zh: 例如，在1920年之前的美国，只有城市化程度较低的州才给予妇女选举权。

suffrage.en: The economic development theory is inadequate to explain certain historical facts about the implementation of women's suffrage.
suffrage.zh: 经济发展理论不足以解释关于妇女投票权实施的某些历史事实。

suffrage.en: For example, why was women's suffrage, instituted nationally in the United States in 1920, not instituted nationally in Switzerland until the 1970's?
suffrage.zh: 例如，为什么美国在1920年开始实行妇女选举权，而瑞士直到20世纪70年代才开始实行？

posterity.en: Posterity will remember him as a great man.
posterity.zh: 后人将会记住他是个伟人。

posterity.en: A photographer recorded the scene on video for posterity.
posterity.zh: 一位摄影师为子孙后代摄下了这个场面。

posterity.en: Their music has been preserved for posterity.
posterity.zh: 他们的音乐已为后世保存起来。

calibration.zh: 校准也是在这一步中进行。

calibration.en: ClearType Text Tuning and Display Color Calibration.
calibration.zh: ClearType文字微调和显示颜色校准。

calibration.en: You always must be sure that you have a good calibration of your wavelength.
calibration.zh: 你们必须确定，对于波长有一个，很好的标度。

envisage.en: I can't envisage her coping with this job.
envisage.zh: 我无法设想她如何应付这个工作。

envisage.en: What level of profit do you envisage?
envisage.zh: 你预计会有什么样的利润水平？

envisage.en: I don't envisage working with him again.
envisage.zh: 我想象不出再与他一起工作的可能。

illiteracy.en: For example, John Mogger became concerned about the problem of illiteracy three years ago, so he started teaching five prisoners in Brazil.
illiteracy.zh: 例如，John Mogger 三年前开始关注文盲问题，所以他开始在巴西对五名囚犯进行教学。

illiteracy.en: It would help to end illiteracy and disease, but it would also dislocate a traditional way of life.
illiteracy.zh: 它该会有助于消除文盲和疾病，但也会打乱一种传统的生活方式。

illiteracy.en: The campaign to wipe out illiteracy launched out with great vigour.
illiteracy.zh: 扫盲运动轰轰烈烈地展开了。

monsoon.zh: 是什么导致了季风的迁移呢？

monsoon.en: A monsoon is a seasonal wind that can bring in a large amount of rainfall.
monsoon.zh: 季风是一种季节性的风，它可以带来大量的降雨。

monsoon.en: As I said the monsoon migrated itself, so there was less rain in the Sahara.
monsoon.zh: 就像我说的，季风会自己转移，所以撒哈拉的雨水就少了。

exorbitant.en: Exorbitant housing prices have created an acute shortage of affordable housing for the poor.
exorbitant.zh: 过高的房价使穷人负担得起的房源严重短缺。

exorbitant.en: The exorbitant cost of our health-insurance benefits reflects the high dollar amount of medical expenses incurred by our employees.
exorbitant.zh: 我们医疗保险福利的高昂费用反映了我们员工的高额医疗费用。
但是在伦敦的价格确实过高了。

totem.en: I didn't want to be low man on the totem pole for ever.
Dashan: Oh, look. We've just passed a totem pole.
totem.zh: 大山：嘿，看，我们刚经过了一个图腾柱。

totem.en: It had totem poles, masks, beadwork, basket and prints.
totem.zh: 里面有图腾柱、面具、镶缀珠、篮筐以及版画。

destitute.en: They seem destitute of ordinary human feelings.
destitute.zh: 他们似乎一点人情味都没有。

destitute.en: When he died, his family was left completely destitute.
More than a third of the population was destitute.
destitute.zh: 超过三分之一的人口处于贫困。

frugal.en: Everyone says this, but it really is a top tip for frugal eaters.
frugal.zh: 每个人都这么说，但这确实是给节俭的食客最好的建议。

frugal.en: The honourable worker who lives a very frugal life gives away most of his money to charities.
frugal.zh: 这位可敬的工人过着非常节俭的生活，他把他的大部分钱都捐赠给了慈善机构。

frugal.en: They learned how to trim almost 20 percent off their monthly child care bills during the 30-day "Frugal Family Challenge".
frugal.zh: 在为期30天的“节俭家庭挑战”活动中，他们学会了如何削减每月近 20% 的育儿费用。

anaerobic.en: Anaerobic exercise is a powerful burst of movement followed by a period of rest.
anaerobic.zh: 无氧运动是一种爆发型运动，运动完后需要休息一段时间。

anaerobic.en: The passage's suggestion that the total anaerobic energy reserves of a vertebrate are proportional to the vertebrate's size is based on which of the following assumption?
anaerobic.zh: 这篇文章提出的脊椎动物的无氧能量储备总量与脊椎动物的体型成正比，是基于以下哪些假设？

anaerobic.en: Thus the anaerobic energy reserves of a vertebrate are proportional to the size of the animal.
anaerobic.zh: 因此，脊椎动物的无氧能量储备与动物的大小成正比。

voracious.zh: 所有的水獭都有一个贪吃的胃口。

voracious.en: Joseph Smith was a voracious book collector.
voracious.zh: 约瑟夫·史密斯是一个如饥似渴的藏书家。

voracious.en: Life is voracious, it swallows all the dead.
voracious.zh: 生命是贪婪的，它吞噬所有死亡。

remittance.en: Remittance can be made by cheque or credit card.
remittance.zh: 可通过支票或信用卡汇款。

remittance.en: Please enclose your remittance, making checks payable to Valley Technology Services.
remittance.zh: 请随信附上您的汇款，支票收款方为瓦利科技服务公司。
款子是通过银行汇寄的。

embolden.en: That might embolden American efforts to shelter its extravagantly subsidised sugar industry.
embolden.zh: 那样可能加大美国对其资助过分的制糖工业的努力庇护。

embolden.en: In fact, knowing that you'll never do everything right may embolden you to try things just for the heck of it.
embolden.zh: 事实上，知道自己不可能把件件事情都做成功能为你壮胆去只为了好玩而尝试事物。

embolden.en: But it is clear that the settlements will embolden America's Armada of class-action lawyers to redouble their efforts.
embolden.zh: 不过显而易见的是这样的赔偿方案将会鼓励美国的集体诉讼律师队伍倍加努力。

decrepit.en: The film had been shot in a decrepit old police station.
decrepit.zh: 这部电影拍摄地点在一个破旧的老警察站。

decrepit.en: Chopin's decrepit health reinforced his emotional trauma.
decrepit.zh: 肖邦身体虚弱，加重了他的感情创伤。

decrepit.en: In turn Pakistan, with a decrepit economy, needs international aid.
decrepit.zh: 反过来，对于经济破败的巴基斯坦来说国际援助仍是必须之物。

seclusion.en: She lived in seclusion with her husband on their farm in Panama.
seclusion.zh: 她和她丈夫隐居在他们在巴拿马的农场里。

seclusion.en: In spite of the extremity of her seclusion she was sane.
seclusion.zh: 尽管完全与世隔绝，她依然神智清醒。
我们目前过着乡村隐居生活。

repent.en: I was shown that I am a sinner, that I needed to repent of my sins.
repent.zh: 我被证明是个罪人，需要为我的罪孽忏悔。
我就不能忏悔我的罪过了！

outrun.en: Spending could outrun the capacity of businesses to produce the goods.
outrun.zh: 支出可能超过行业生产这些货物的能力。

outrun.en: There are not many players who can outrun me.
outrun.zh: 跑得过我的选手不太多。

opulent.en: Heavy silverplate adds an opulent touch to a formal dinner party.
opulent.zh: 沉甸甸的镀银餐具给正式晚宴增加一种奢华感。

opulent.en: The duke built an opulent palace for himself nearby.
opulent.zh: 公爵还在附近为自己建了一座豪华的宫殿。

opulent.en: We took a look into the opulent life of this incredible entrepreneur.
opulent.zh: 现在我们来了解一下这位神奇企业家的炫彩生活。

quartz.en: Rocks like quartz, well, quartz of optical quality weren't cheap.
quartz.zh: 具有像石英这样的光学品质的石头并不便宜。

quartz.en: To this class of substance belong mica, porcelain, quartz, glass, wood, etc.
quartz.zh: 属于这类物质的有云母、瓷器、石英、玻璃、木材等等。

quartz.en: Nearly all computers contain a quartz-crystal clock to regulate their operation.
quartz.zh: 几乎所有的计算机都有一个石英晶体时钟来调节它们的运行。

thunderous.zh: 他们以雷鸣般的掌声欢迎了他。

thunderous.en: His performance was met with thunderous applause.
thunderous.zh: 他的表演获得了雷鸣般的掌声。

thunderous.en: No sooner had Mo Yan stepped on the stage than the audience broke into thunderous applause.
thunderous.zh: 莫言一上台，观众就爆发出雷鸣般的掌声。

woodpecker.en: A woodcutter and a woodpecker lived in the forest.
woodpecker.zh: 一个樵夫和一只啄木鸟住在森林里。

woodpecker.en: Savor the silence, if that's what nature serves up, or thrill to the tap-tap of the woodpecker.
woodpecker.zh: 如果大自然给你的是寂静，那就尽情享受吧，或者随着啄木鸟的啄啄声而兴奋吧。

woodpecker.en: The ivory-billed woodpecker is not large, as birds go. It is about the size of a crow, but flashier.
woodpecker.zh: 象牙喙啄木鸟不像鸟那样大。它的大小和乌鸦差不多，但更华丽。

surmount.en: I realized I had to surmount the language barrier.
surmount.zh: 我认识到我必须得克服语言障碍。

surmount.en: We were able to surmount so many obstacles.
surmount.zh: 我们能克服那么多的障碍。

executioner.en: The executioner went off like an arrow.
executioner.zh: 刽子手像离弦之箭一样离开了。

executioner.en: "She's in prison," the Queen said to the executioner, "fetch her here."
executioner.zh: “她在监狱里，”王后对刽子手说，“把她带过来。”

executioner.en: "I'll fetch the executioner myself," said the King eagerly, and he hurried off.
executioner.zh: “我自己去找刽子手来。”国王急切地说，连忙走开了。

televise.en: Which channel is going to televise this match?
televise.zh: 哪个频道要转播这场球赛？

televise.en: The BBC plans to televise all Shakespear's plays.
televise.zh: 英国广播公司计划播放莎士比亚的全部戏剧。

televise.en: The BBC plans to televise all Shakespeare's plays.
televise.zh: 英国广播公司计划播放莎士比亚的全部戏剧。

feces.en: It ends up in the cats' feces and then it ends up back in rats.
feces.zh: 它从猫的排泄物中排出，又到老鼠体内。

feces.en: Wherever you go, feces, urine, blood, vomit, rotten flesh and most meat will be disgusting.
feces.zh: 无论你走到哪里，粪便、尿液、血液、呕吐物、大部分腐烂的肉都会令人作呕。

feces.en: For a moment I saw my home through her eyes: feces, rats, starvation, houses so close together that no one can breathe.
feces.zh: 那一刻我看到了她眼中的我的家乡：到处都是粪便、老鼠、饥饿，房屋都挤在一起让人无法呼吸。
