paucity.en: This confusion has been exacerbated by a paucity of serious attempts to synthesize and evaluate available data on the details of avian and dinosaurian evolution.
paucity.zh: 由于缺乏认真的尝试来综合和评估鸟类和恐龙进化细节的现有数据，这种混乱变得更加严重。

paucity.en: Even the film's impressive finale can't hide the first hour's paucity of imagination.
paucity.zh: 这部电影在开头一个小时中毫无想象力，即使有个让人印象深刻的结局也无法掩盖这个缺憾。

paucity.en: Many policy makers insist that consumer spending is a strong economic catalyst and, therefore, a paucity of retail stores is a contributing factor to low-performing economies.
paucity.zh: 许多政策制定者坚持认为，消费者支出是一个强大的经济催化剂，因此，零售商店稀缺是经济表现不佳的一个促成因素。

outgrowth.en: The law was an outgrowth of the 2000 presidential election.
outgrowth.zh: 这项法律是2000年总统选举的必然结果。

outgrowth.en: The eye first appears as a cup-shaped outgrowth from the brain.
outgrowth.zh: 眼睛开始是从大脑长出，呈杯状。

outgrowth.en: Her first book is an outgrowth of an art project she began in 2003.
outgrowth.zh: 她的第一本书是一个她于2003年开始的艺术项目的衍生物。

standby.en: Five ambulances are on standby at the port.
standby.zh: 五辆救护车在那个港口待命。

standby.en: Canned varieties of beans and peas are a good standby.
standby.zh: 各种豆类罐装食品是很好的备用食品。

standby.en: The emergency services were put on standby after a bomb warning.
standby.zh: 接到炸弹警报后，各紧急救助部门进入待命状态。

meddle.en: Already some people are asking whether scientists have any right to meddle in such matters.
meddle.zh: 已经有些人在问科学家是否有权利去干涉此类事情。
康第吼道：“你要管闲事，是不是？”

meddle.en: He is suspicious of attempts to meddle in the internal business of others.
meddle.zh: 他对企图干涉他人内部事务的行为表示怀疑。

duplication.en: There could be a serious loss of efficiency through unnecessary duplication of resources.
duplication.zh: 不必要的资源重复会导致严重的效率损耗。

duplication.en: It turns out, though, that there are various degrees of genetic duplication.
duplication.zh: 然而，事实证明，有不同程度的基因复制。

duplication.en: Little reward accompanies duplication and confirmation of what is already known and believed.
duplication.zh: 重复和确认人们已经熟知和确信的事情是没有意义的。

bewilderment.en: He shook his head in bewilderment at the obduracy of this man.
bewilderment.zh: 这男人顽固不化，令他困惑不解、连连摇头。

bewilderment.en: During the confusion and bewilderment of the second day Mary hid herself in the nursery and was forgotten by everyone.
bewilderment.zh: 在混乱和慌张的第二天，玛丽躲在育儿室里，被大家遗忘了。

bewilderment.en: Much to the bewilderment of professional scientists, quasi-religious cults are being formed around such unlikely topics as quantum physics, space-time relativity, black holes and the big bang.
bewilderment.zh: 令专业水准的科学家十分困惑的是，准宗教崇拜正围绕量子物理学、时空相对论、黑洞和大爆炸等不太可能的话题而形成。

geyser.en: Every year, Hindus greet the turn of winter into spring with a splash of color—in some areas, a geyser of color.
geyser.zh: 每年，印度教徒们都会用泼洒色彩来迎接冬去春来——有些地区用彩色喷泉。

geyser.en: A geyser of gas and liquid erupted.
geyser.zh: 并由此形成了气体和液体混合的强劲喷泉。

geyser.en: Old Faithful Geyser erupts approximately every 91 minutes.
geyser.zh: 老忠实间歇喷泉大约每91分钟喷发一次。

exhilaration.en: The exhilaration of winning such a famous event has stayed with him.
exhilaration.zh: 赢得一场如此著名赛事的欢欣始终萦绕着他。

exhilaration.en: The first few days are a blur of exhilaration and exhaustion.
exhilaration.zh: 刚开始的那些日子 兴奋与疲惫掺杂不清。

exhilaration.en: My reaction, I’m afraid, was pure exhilaration: at last I could do things my way.
exhilaration.zh: 尽管我有点儿害怕，但我的反应是真的高兴，至少我可以按我自己的方式行事。

provenance.en: Kato was fully aware of the provenance of these treasures.
provenance.zh: 卡托对这些珍宝的出处全都了如指掌。

provenance.en: All the furniture is of English provenance.
provenance.zh: 所有这些家具都是英国货。

fowl.en: Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field.
fowl.zh: 亚当给一切牲畜、空中的飞鸟、田野的走兽都起了名。

fowl.en: The priests shall not eat of anything that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.
fowl.zh: 无论是鸟是兽，凡是它自己死的，或是撕裂的，祭司都不应吃。

fowl.en: If we've redeemed this dangerous supplement for man, what about the fowl of the air and the beasts of the field?
fowl.zh: 如果我们为人类赎回了这种危险的补充物，那么空中的飞鸟和田野里的野兽呢?

underdeveloped.en: His theory was inapplicable to many underdeveloped economies.
underdeveloped.zh: 他的理论不适用于许多不发达的经济体。

underdeveloped.en: Underdeveloped countries should be assisted by allowing them access to modern technology.
underdeveloped.zh: 应该通过允许不发达国家使用现代技术来帮助它们。

underdeveloped.en: Low average population densities are characteristics of most underdeveloped countries.
underdeveloped.zh: 平均人口密度低是大多数不发达国家的特点。

perplexing.en: The Earth-Moon system has always been perplexing.
perplexing.zh: 地月系统一直令人困惑。

perplexing.en: Equally perplexing constituents of Allende are the refractory inclusions: irregular white masses that tend to be larger than chondrules.
perplexing.zh: 阿连德陨石中同样令人困惑的成分是那些耐高温的内部物质：往往比陨石球粒要大的不规则白色块状物。

perplexing.en: It took years to understand many perplexing diseases.
perplexing.zh: 许多疑难病症要耗时多年才能搞明白。

malevolent.en: Her stare was malevolent, her mouth a thin line.
It is not that men are malevolent.
malevolent.zh: 这并不是说男人心肠不好。

ointment.en: We put some ointment and a bandage on his knee.
ointment.zh: 我们在他的膝盖上涂了些药膏，还缠了一条绷带。

ointment.en: Pawpaw ointment, made from pawpaw or papaya, is commonly used as a cure-all in Australia.
ointment.zh: 木瓜膏，由木瓜或者番木瓜提炼而成，在澳大利亚作为万灵药而被广泛使用。

ointment.en: Rachel seems to be the one fly in the ointment of Caroline's smooth life.
ointment.zh: 雷切尔似乎是卡罗琳平静生活中惟一的破坏因素。

elapse.en: Years probably would elapse before his return. Some of us might never see him again.
elapse.zh: 他这一去可能就是多年，席上有些人恐怕今世也难得再见他面。

elapse.en: The further off this solid obstruction, the longer time will elapse for the return of the echo.
elapse.zh: 固体障碍物越远，回声返回所用时间就越长。

elapse.en: The last seven years have all been ‘the year of the mobile’; it is not clear how many more such years will need to elapse!
elapse.zh: 过去七年被看作“手机年”，还不清楚将来还会持续多久。

autoimmune.en: It also protects us from viruses and from autoimmune diseases.
autoimmune.zh: 它还保护我们免受病毒和自身免疫性疾病的侵害。

autoimmune.en: Watch for proteinuria, bone marrow suppression and autoimmune disease with trientine.
autoimmune.zh: 用曲安汀观察蛋白尿，骨髓抑制和自身免疫性疾病。

autoimmune.en: Myasthenia gravis(MG) is an autoimmune disease which choline receptor antibody mediates, cell immunity depends on and addiment participates.
autoimmune.zh: 重症肌无力是乙酰胆碱受体抗体介导、细胞免疫依赖、补体参与的自身免疫性疾病。

sunburn.en: You're heading for a bad attack of sunburn.
The technical term for sunburn is erythema.
sunburn.zh: 晒斑的专业术语是红斑。

sunburn.en: The risk and severity of sunburn depend on the body's natural skin colour.
sunburn.zh: 晒伤的风险和严重程度取决于身体的自然肤色。

headmaster.en: He was headmaster of a public school in the West of England.
headmaster.zh: 他曾是英格兰西部一所公学的校长。

headmaster.en: She passed a cup of tea to the headmaster.
They met with the headmaster during lunchtime.
headmaster.zh: 他们在午餐时间会见了校长。

phosphate.zh: 那是磷酸氢二钠七水合物。

phosphate.en: The structure of Triose Phosphate Isomerase is complex.
phosphate.zh: 磷酸丙糖异构酶的结构复杂。

phosphate.en: The final preparation is suspended in sterile phosphate buffered saline.
phosphate.zh: 最后的准备品悬浮在无菌磷酸盐缓冲盐水中。

goad.en: Her presence was just one more goad to Joanna's unravelling nerves.
goad.zh: 她的出现只是对乔安娜几近崩溃的神经的又一次刺激。

goad.en: Theon knew he should not goad her.
goad.zh: 席恩知道他不该刺激他。

goad.en: They goad Jack to go back inside to be with his family.
goad.zh: 他们劝杰克不要冲动，返回反恐组去与家人团聚。

sporadically.en: The distant thunder from the coast continued sporadically.
sporadically.zh: 远处海岸仍然零星地传来雷声。
战斗断断续续地进行了两个月。

repellent.en: When did eating butter become a sin, and a little bit of extra flesh unappealing, if not repellent?
repellent.zh: 什么时候吃黄油变成了一种罪过，多吃一点肉就算不招人讨厌，也不招人喜欢了？

repellent.en: This paper describes a capillary column gas chromatography method for quantitative analysis of an 0.8 % solution of transfluthrin repellent.
repellent.zh: 本文描述了用毛细管气相色谱对0.8％四氟菊酯驱蚊药液的定量分析方法。
但是，无私也是令人厌恶的。

astray.en: The judge thought he'd been led astray by older children.
astray.zh: 法官认为他是被更大的孩子们引入了歧途。

astray.en: Some day they will lead you astray.
astray.zh: 总有一天，他们会把你引入歧途的。

astray.en: How can millions of dollars go astray?
astray.zh: 数百万美元怎么会丢失了呢？

redundancy.en: Thousands of bank employees are facing redundancy as their employers cut costs.
redundancy.zh: 数千名银行职员面临裁员，因为他们的雇主要削减成本。

redundancy.en: Avoid redundancy: Define an item in the glossary or in the domain model, but not in both.
redundancy.zh: 避免冗余：在术语表或域模型中定义一个条目，但是不要在两者里面都下定义。

redundancy.en: If there's enough redundancy in the brain so that even if your right hemisphere got destroyed, your left hemisphere still has all the same memories.
redundancy.zh: 如果大脑有足够冗余，即使你的右半球被破坏了，你的左半球仍然有相同的记忆。

glossary.en: A glossary of terms is included for the reader's convenience.
glossary.zh: 为了方便读者，还收录了术语汇编。

glossary.en: Some people consider glossary and taxonomy as metadata as well.
glossary.zh: 有些人认为词汇表和分类法也属于元数据的范畴。

glossary.en: Avoid redundancy: Define an item in the glossary or in the domain model, but not in both.
glossary.zh: 避免冗余：在术语表或域模型中定义一个条目，但是不要在两者里面都下定义。

ramble.en: She went into a long ramble about the evils of television.
ramble.zh: 她开始东拉西扯地大谈电视的弊端。

ramble.en: He had lost track of what he was saying and began to ramble.
ramble.zh: 他忘了自己的话题，便开始瞎扯起来。

ramble.en: We will ramble about every rainy day.
ramble.zh: 我们将在每个雨天漫游。

sentient.en: They may not be walking, talking, human-like sentient beings, but they are clever.
sentient.zh: 他们可能不会走路，不会说话，不会像人类一样有感情，但他们很聪明。

sentient.en: You're asking me to believe in sentient meat.
sentient.zh: 难道你想让我相信肉是有知觉的？

irate.en: The owner was so irate he almost threw me out of the place.
irate.zh: 主人那么生气，他差点儿把我从那个地方赶出去。

irate.en: The speech was designed to pacify the irate crowd.
irate.zh: 讲话的目的是安抚愤怒的群众。

irate.en: Customer support calls from VIPs — Very Irate Persons — are down.
irate.zh: 来自VIP(非常生气的人)的客户支持呼叫随之下降。

legume.en: Many members of the mustard family, spurge family, legume family, and grass family are top hyperaccumulators.
legume.zh: 芥科植物、大戟科植物、豆科植物和禾本科植物中的许多植物都是顶级的超富集植物。

legume.en: We never think of this legume unless it's in our soup.
legume.zh: 我们从想不到这种豆类，除非它们放在汤里。

legume.en: Is one of the most important legume forages in China.
legume.zh: 是我国最重要的豆科牧草之一。

liberated.en: Writing poetry liberated her from the routine of everyday life.
liberated.zh: 写诗使她从日常生活的例行公事中解脱出来。

liberated.en: She was determined that she would become a liberated businesswoman.
liberated.zh: 她决定成为一名思想解放的女实业家。

liberated.en: Bolivar had received aid from Haiti and had promised in return to abolish slavery in the areas he liberated.
liberated.zh: 玻利瓦尔接受了海地的援助，并承诺在他解放的地区废除奴隶制。

fibrous.en: Silk is a fibrous protein, produced in glands within the spider or silkworm and some insects.
fibrous.zh: 丝类是一种纤维蛋白，由蜘蛛或者桑蚕和某些昆虫的腺体所产生。

fibrous.en: Sufferers complain of intensely creepy-crawly skin and odd fibrous strands which protrude from open wounds.
fibrous.zh: 患者抱怨说，他们的皮肤非常令人毛骨悚然，并且伤口里还会有一些奇怪的纤维状的物质伸出来。

fibrous.en: Leatherbacks do not have blubber, but they do have a reptilian equivalent: thick, oil-saturated skin, with a layer of fibrous, fatty tissue just beneath it.
fibrous.zh: 棱皮龟没有鲸脂，但它们有和爬行类动物相似的结构：厚且含油的皮肤，下面有一层纤维，再下面是脂肪组织。

succulent.en: Think of purslane as a great alternative to lettuce: the leaves and stems are crisp, chewy, succulent, and they have a mild lemony taste.
succulent.zh: 把马齿苋想成是生菜的一个伟大的替代品：叶和茎是脆的、耐嚼、多汁，而且它们有淡淡的柠檬味。

succulent.en: The different vegetational parts differ in their food qualities: lower down, there are succulent, nutritious leaves; higher up are the harder stems.
succulent.zh: 植物的不同部位具有不同的食用价值：靠下面的部位是营养、多汁的叶子；上面更高的部位则是更为坚硬的茎杆。

succulent.en: The early explorers and settlers told of abundant deer in the early 1800s and yet almost in the same breath bemoaned the lack of this succulent game animal.
succulent.zh: 早期的探险家和殖民者都讲述过十九世纪早期出现的大量的鹿群，但几乎同时，他们也为现在很难找到这种美味的猎物而感到惋惜。

monotonous.en: With a sense of blame, he heard rustling, foil sighs, and a monotonous hiss from pouring wine into the glass.
monotonous.zh: 他带着责难的心情，聆听到沙沙声，箔盖的叹息声以及往玻璃杯倒酒发出的单调的嘘声。

monotonous.en: It's monotonous work, like most factory jobs.
monotonous.zh: 这是个单调的工作，和大多数工厂工作一样。
飞机一次又一次反复从头顶飞过。

inducement.en: At the same time, they would break the illegal excavator's grip on the market, thereby decreasing the inducement to engage in illegal activities.
inducement.zh: 同时，他们也可以打破非法挖掘机对市场的控制，从而减少从事非法活动的诱因。

inducement.en: There is little inducement for them to work harder.
inducement.zh: 没有什么动力能促使他们加把劲工作。

inducement.en: They offer every inducement to foreign businesses to invest in their states.
inducement.zh: 他们提供了种种优惠条件吸引外国公司在他们州投资。

humanistic.en: Religious values can often differ greatly from humanistic morals.
humanistic.zh: 宗教价值观常常和人文主义道德观相去甚远。

humanistic.en: It turned from God and the authority of the Roman Catholic Church and instead favored a more humanistic approach to being.
humanistic.zh: 它背离了上帝和罗马天主教会的权威，转而倾向于一种更为人性化的生存方式。

humanistic.en: Humanistic disciplines are seriously underfunded, not just by the government and the foundations but by academic institutions themselves.
humanistic.zh: 人文学科的资金严重不足，不仅是政府和基金会的资金不足，学术机构本身也是如此。

chairperson.en: We chose Paul Stubbs to be chairperson.
chairperson.zh: 我们选保罗•斯塔布斯当主席。

chairperson.en: The chairperson is chosen by secret ballot.
chairperson.zh: 主席是通过无记名投票选举产生的。

chairperson.en: She's the chairperson of the safety committee.

kale.en: A bunch of curly kale is usually devoured in one sitting.
kale.zh: 通常一口吃掉一束羽衣甘蓝。
羽衣甘蓝也应该是嫩嫩的。

longitude.en: A similar feature is found at 13 degrees north between 230 degrees and 250 degrees longitude.
longitude.zh: 在北纬13度、经度230度到250度之间也发现了类似的特点。

longitude.en: He noted the latitude and longitude, then made a mark on the admiralty chart.
longitude.zh: 他记下经度和纬度，然后在海图上作了标记。

longitude.en: He tried to find out the longitude of pericenter.
longitude.zh: 他试图找出中心点的经度。

ether.zh: 她的话消失在九霄云外。

ether.en: It is a constitutional isomer of dimethyl ether.
ether.zh: 这是二甲醚的结构异构体。

ether.en: Archaean cell walls lack murein, and their lipids have ether links rather than ester links.
ether.zh: 古细菌的细胞壁缺乏胞壁质，其连接是醚连接而不是酯连接。

progeny.en: He was surrounded by his numerous progeny.
But it is only among our own progeny [children].
progeny.zh: 但这只是发生在我们自己的子孙身上。

progeny.en: The central issue in the case is whether patent rights to living things extend to the progeny of those things.
progeny.zh: 这里的核心问题是生物的专利权是否延伸到这些生物的后代。

evocation.en: The attributes can all be grouped into four main categories: manipulation, identification, stimulation and evocation.
evocation.zh: 这些属性可以被分为四个类别：操作性，识别性，激励性和召唤性。

evocation.en: He thrilled the home audience by speaking in his native Tamil, closing his second acceptance speech with the evocation: "God is great."
evocation.zh: 他用自己的母语泰米尔语结束了自己的第二次获奖感言，“上帝是伟大的”的欢呼，振奋了观众们。

evocation.en: This word crime overpassed the measure of what Marius, who was already greatly agitated by the abrupt evocation of Waterloo, could accept.
evocation.zh: 马吕斯在突然听见人家提到“滑铁卢”时，他已很紧张了，现在又听人说出“罪行”这种字眼，那就更超出他所能接受的限度了。

thrilled.zh: 你的消息使我兴奋极了。

thrilled.en: The electric atmosphere both terrified and thrilled him.
thrilled.zh: 这种紧张的气氛使他既害怕又激动。
我获得邀请，感到非常兴奋。

topsoil.en: This means topsoil contains few of the ingredients needed for long-term successful farming.
topsoil.zh: 这意味着表层土壤几只含有少量长期成功耕作所必需的成分。

topsoil.en: Because of this increased concentration, regrowth of plants is minimal, leading to increased erosion, which leads to a decrease in the fertile topsoil, leading to even less regrowth.
topsoil.zh: 由于浓度的增加，植物的再生长很少，导致侵蚀增加，使得肥沃的表层土壤减少，再生长更少。

topsoil.en: As it crashed down the steep mountainside like a gigantic snowplough, it swept up trees, boulders and tons of topsoil, and completely crushed and destroyed the six villages that lay in its path.
topsoil.zh: 它像一台巨大的扫雪机一样冲下陡峭的山坡，卷走了树木、巨石和成吨的表土，将沿途的六个村庄彻底摧毁。

bouncing.en: He kept bouncing up and down like a yo-yo.
bouncing.zh: 他像个悠悠球似的蹦蹦跳跳。
小白兔走路总是一蹦一跳。

bouncing.en: They are bouncing with health in the good weather.
bouncing.zh: 他们在好天气时生气勃勃。

judicious.en: Pundits who want to sound judicious are fond of warning against generalizing.
judicious.zh: 那些想让自己听起来明智的专家喜欢警告不要一概而论。

judicious.en: The president authorizes the judicious use of military force to protect our citizens.
judicious.zh: 总统授权明智动用军队来保护我们的公民。

judicious.en: McCarron said ConAgra's lower estimate stemmed from its more judicious use of hypertension data.
judicious.zh: 麦卡伦说，ConAgra 的较低估计是由于其对高血压数据的更明智使用。

symbiotic.en: There are three main types of symbiotic relationships: parasitism, commensalism, and mutualism.
symbiotic.zh: 共生关系主要有三种类型：寄生关系、共生关系和互惠关系。

symbiotic.en: These are not single individual plants; each one is a symbiotic combination of an alga and a fungus.
symbiotic.zh: 这些不是单个的植物；每一种都是藻类和真菌的共生组合。

symbiotic.en: A symbiotic relationship is an interaction between two or more species in which one species lives in or on another species.
symbiotic.zh: 共生关系是两个或多个物种之间的相互作用，其中一个物种生活在另一个物种体内，或依靠这一物种生活。

precipitous.en: The town is perched on the edge of a steep, precipitous cliff.
precipitous.zh: 该镇坐落在一个陡峭的悬崖边上。

precipitous.en: The stock market's precipitous drop frightened foreign investors.
precipitous.zh: 该股市价格猛跌让外国投资者恐惧。

precipitous.en: Could there be a mountain more precipitous than this?

substandard.en: It comes as a shock to us that some milk powder producers produce substandard milk powder which would bring harm to babies.
substandard.zh: 一些奶粉生产商生产有害婴儿的不合格奶粉，这让我们感到很震惊。

substandard.en: The cold has made already substandard living conditions even worse.
substandard.zh: 寒冷的天气使得原本就低于正常水平的生活条件更加低劣。

substandard.en: Residents in general are poor and undereducated, and live in substandard housing.
substandard.zh: 居民一般都很穷、受教育程度低，而且居住条件很差。

entwine.en: Once, years ago, he told me our lives should entwine.
entwine.zh: 多年前他曾跟我说，我们的生命应该交织在一起。

entwine.en: His dazed eyes stare at the eels, which still writhe and entwine.
entwine.zh: 他茫然地盯着那些仍在扭动缠绕的鳗鱼。

entwine.en: Facing each other, the giraffes entwine their necks in the most astonishing manner.
entwine.zh: 长颈鹿面对面地站着，以令人无比惊骇的姿势将脖子缠绕到了一起。

retake.en: Government forces moved in to retake the city.
retake.zh: 政府军开进城市，以恢复对它的控制。

retake.en: Officers were going to retake sectors of the city.
retake.zh: 军官们打算收回该市的一些军事管制区。

retake.en: Moore fought back to retake the lead later in the race.
retake.zh: 后来穆尔奋力反击，重新夺回了比赛中的领先地位。

circumscribe.en: Do not circumscribe your study only in classes.
circumscribe.zh: 不要把自己的学习只局限于课堂。

circumscribe.en: He promised, too, to scrap some of the many rules that circumscribe daily life.
circumscribe.zh: 他还承诺要废除那许多限制日常生活的规章制度。

circumscribe.en: Here the basic method to circumscribe contradiction is paraconsistent logic.
circumscribe.zh: 这里，限制矛盾的基本手法是次协调逻辑。

tusk.en: The second blind felt the elephant's tusk.
tusk.zh: 第二个瞎子摸到了大象的象牙。

tusk.en: Elephants wear the tusk down faster than they can grow it.
tusk.zh: 象牙磨损的速度快于生长的速度。

tusk.en: One of the elephants which we saw at the zoo had only one tusk.
tusk.zh: 我们在动物园看到的一头大象只有一颗象牙。

gunpowder.en: The introduction of gunpowder gradually made the bow and arrow obsolete, particularly in Western Europe
gunpowder.zh: 火药的使用使弓箭逐渐被淘汰，特别是在西欧。

gunpowder.en: The potentially lethal device was made from a length of hose packed with gunpowder, primers, and shrapnel.
gunpowder.zh: 这个能致命的装置是用一根装满火药、引信和弹片的软管做出来的。

gunpowder.en: The 24 Solar Terms is regarded as China's fifth great invention, after papermaking, printing, the compass and gunpowder.
gunpowder.zh: 二十四节气被认为是中国继造纸术、印刷术、指南针和火药之后的第五大发明。

falsehood.en: She called the verdict a victory of truth over falsehood.
falsehood.zh: 她称该裁定是一个真实对虚假的胜利。

falsehood.en: When people uttered a falsehood, the scientists noticed a burst of activity in their amygdala.
falsehood.zh: 当人们说假话时，科学家们注意到他们的杏仁核会突然活跃起来。

falsehood.en: Not only that, but when people faced no consequences for dishonesty, their falsehood tended to get even more sensational.
falsehood.zh: 不仅如此，当人们的不诚实不会造成后果时，他们的谎言往往会变得更加耸人听闻。

loath.en: He was loath to admit his mistake.
loath.zh: 他不愿承认自己的错误。

loath.en: I felt loath to sully the gleaming brass knocker by handling it.
loath.zh: 我不愿意用手去抓那个闪亮的黄铜门环以免把它弄脏。

loath.en: Sensing he held the advantage, Mr. Danbar was loath to change the subject.
loath.zh: 丹巴先生觉得占有优势，不愿改变话题。

eddy.zh: 埃迪笑着说：“看，我很大呀。”

eddy.en: And they used what they called eddy current testing.

impel.en: There are various reasons that impel me to that conclusion.
impel.zh: 有各种原因促使我作出那个结论。

impel.en: These verbs mean to constrain or impel to action.
impel.zh: 这些动词指限制或促使行动。

impel.en: But all these can only take our power to impel us to go forward.
impel.zh: 而这一切只能作为我们的动力去推动我们前进。

malt.en: German beer has traditionally been made from just four ingredients – hops, malt, yeast, and water.
malt.zh: 德国啤酒传统上一直是只由4种原料酿造而成的–啤酒花、麦芽、酵母和水。

malt.en: You can buy malt sugar candy at any time.
malt.zh: 你可以随时买到麦芽糖。

malt.en: I enjoyed the single malt they gave me, but I enjoyed the conversation much more.
malt.zh: 我喜欢他们给我的这单个单麦芽，但是，我更喜欢这交谈。

centralize.en: In the mass production era, multinational firms tended to centralize their operations.
centralize.zh: 在大规模生产时期，跨国公司倾向于集中运营。

centralize.en: In order to raise the efficiency of the water supply, measures should be taken to centralize the management of water resources.
centralize.zh: 为提高供水效率，应采取集中管理水资源的措施。
将业务流程跨业务单位集中。

materialistic.en: The most distinctive attribute of this tradition is the mechanistic, materialistic conception of humanity.
materialistic.zh: 这一传统最显著的特征是机械主义、唯物主义的人性观。

materialistic.en: During the 1980s the U.S. became a very materialistic society.
materialistic.zh: 在20世纪80年代，美国成为了一个物质至上的社会。

materialistic.en: Many said that unemployment, while extremely painful, had improved them in some ways: they had become less materialistic and more financially prudent; they were more aware of the struggles of others.
materialistic.zh: 许多人说，失业虽然极其痛苦，却在某些方面改善了他们的生活：他们变得不那么物质主义，在财务上更加谨慎了，并且更加了解别人的难处。

discerning.en: More difficult, in the moment, is discerning precisely how these lean times are affecting society's character.
discerning.zh: 目前，准确地辨别这些萧条时期如何影响社会特性是更困难的。

discerning.en: Even the most accomplished writers show their work-in-progress to discerning readers.
discerning.zh: 即使最有造诣的作家们都会展示他们创作中的作品给有鉴赏力的读者们看。

discerning.en: See how well we do in discerning the babies' emotions.
discerning.zh: 看看我们在察觉婴儿情绪方面做得有多好。

chisel.en: He set out to chisel a dog out of sandstone.
chisel.zh: 他开始用凿子将砂岩雕刻成一只狗。

chisel.en: He used a hammer and chisel to chip away at the wall.
chisel.zh: 他用锤子和凿子将墙壁一点点凿掉。

chisel.en: He broke away the veneer with a chisel.
chisel.zh: 他用凿子把胶合板拆开。

everlasting.en: That is how I found myself on the road with four kids, a baby lamb and nothing but my everlasting optimism to see me through.
everlasting.zh: 就这样，我上路了。带着四个孩子和一只小羊羔，以及支撑我走下去的永恒不变的乐观主义精神。

everlasting.en: To his everlasting credit , he never told anyone what I'd done.
everlasting.zh: 值得永远称赞的是他从未把我做的事告诉过任何人。

everlasting.en: The program, Everlasting Classics, encourages us to read more classics.
everlasting.zh: 节目《经典咏流传》鼓励我们阅读更多的经典作品。

alchemy.en: Richard told me of three 16th-century folio volumes on alchemy.
alchemy.zh: 理查德告诉过我16 世纪的关于炼金术的三卷对开本书籍的事。

alchemy.en: Fearful alchemy is a useful definition of slavery.
alchemy.zh: 可怕的炼金术是奴隶制的一个有建设性的定义。

alchemy.en: It is there that a kind of alchemy occurs when we breathe up and out the passing whiffs of our chewed food.
alchemy.zh: 当我们吸入和呼出咀嚼食物产生的气体时，这个部位就会发生一些神秘的变化。

implausible.en: I had to admit it sounded like an implausible excuse.
implausible.zh: 我不得不承认，它听上去像是个让人难以置信的借口。

implausible.en: One of the debated cures for this labor shortage remains as implausible as it's been all along: Native workers won't be returning to the farm.
implausible.zh: 而针对劳动力短缺的一个有争议的解决方法仍然像以往一样天方夜谭，毕竟美国本土工人不会回到农场工作。

chameleon.en: The chameleon can take on the colours of its background.
chameleon.zh: 变色龙可以变成周围环境的颜色。

chameleon.en: Like a chameleon, he could merge unobtrusively into the background.
chameleon.zh: 他像变色龙一样，可以不引人注意地融入背景之中。

chameleon.en: What color is the chameleon placed on the mirror?
chameleon.zh: 放在镜子上的变色龙是什么颜色的？

pompous.en: The service was grand without being pompous.
It's not his fault he's so pompous—he was born that way.
pompous.zh: 他如此自命不凡并不是他的错，他天生就是这种性格。

pompous.en: He was somewhat pompous and had a high opinion of his own capabilities.
pompous.zh: 他有些爱摆架子，并且高估自己的能力。

taper.en: Unlike other trees, it doesn't taper very much. It stays fat all the way up.
taper.zh: 不像其他树，它不是越往上越细，而是自下往上一样粗。

taper.en: If the charcoal does fail to light, use a special liquid spray and light it with a long taper.
taper.zh: 如果木炭确实点不着，喷一种专用液体喷雾剂，再用一根长蜡烛把它点燃。

taper.en: Here's a hat that has no taper.
taper.zh: 这里有一顶帽子，上面不是呈锥形的。

distill.en: You can't distill it at that point here.
They do not distill the music-gathering process.
distill.zh: 他们不去浓缩提炼收集音乐的过程。

distill.en: Be a Romantic Scientist: Distill your own perfume oil.
distill.zh: 作一个浪漫的科学家：提炼自己的香水精油。

liqueur.en: I like to macerate the food in liqueur for a few minutes before serving.
liqueur.zh: 我想把食物在利口酒里泡几分钟后再享用。

liqueur.en: The liqueur is strong but too sour yet.
liqueur.zh: 这种酒虽浓但还是太酸。

liqueur.en: Cherry liqueur on the left, cornel - on the right!
liqueur.zh: 左边是樱桃酒，右边是山茱萸酒。

nominally.en: The sultan was still nominally the chief of staff.
nominally.zh: 苏丹在名义上仍是军队领导人。

nominally.en: The road is nominally under the control of UN peacekeeping troops.
nominally.zh: 那条路名义上是在联合国维和部队的控制之下。

nominally.en: He was nominally in charge of the company.
nominally.zh: 他名义上管理着这家公司。

retard.en: Continuing violence will retard negotiations over the country's future.
retard.zh: 持续不断的暴力活动会阻碍关于国家未来的谈判的进行。

retard.en: It would be a pity to retard our development by holding back those people who are gifted enough to work and play well with less than the average amount of sleep, if indeed it does them no harm.
retard.zh: 限制那些有足够天赋、即使睡眠少于平均值却能很好地工作和娱乐的人会阻碍我们的发展，这将是一件憾事，如果这确实对他们没有害处的话。

retard.en: Others are spraying them with a chemical to retard growth.
retard.zh: 另一些人则往树上喷洒化学药剂以延缓树的生长。

dynamism.en: An illustration of China's dynamism is that a new company is formed in Shanghai every 11 seconds.
dynamism.zh: 说明中国活力的一个实例便是在上海每11秒钟就有一家新公司成立。

dynamism.en: The challenge of coping with automation underlines the need for the U.S. to revive its fading business dynamism.
dynamism.zh: 应对自动化的挑战凸显出美国重振其日渐衰落的商业活力的必要性。

dynamism.en: The challenge of coping with automation underlines the need for the U.S. to revive its fading business dynamism: Starting new companies must be made easier.
dynamism.zh: 应对自动化的挑战凸显出美国重振其日渐衰落的商业活力的必要性：必须让新公司的创办变得更容易。

considerate.en: It was very considerate of him to wait.
considerate.zh: 他一直在等候着，真是体贴人。

considerate.en: He was charming, considerate and impeccably mannered.
considerate.zh: 他富有魅力，待人体贴，举止无可挑剔。

considerate.en: She is always polite and considerate towards her employees.
considerate.zh: 她对待雇员总是客客气气，关心体谅。

cognac.zh: 菲利普斯点了一杯科尼亚克白兰地。

cognac.en: A little cognac slopped over the edge of the glass.
cognac.zh: 少量法国白兰地溢出了酒杯的边缘。

cognac.en: She had a habit of taking an occasional nip from a flask of cognac.
cognac.zh: 她有一个偶尔就着瓶子喝一小口法国白兰地的习惯。

unconcerned.en: Young people are often unconcerned with political issues.
unconcerned.zh: 青年人对政治问题往往漠不关心。

unconcerned.en: Paul was unconcerned about what he had done.
unconcerned.zh: 保罗对自己所做过的事情并不在意。

unconcerned.en: He drove on, apparently unconcerned about the noise the engine was making.
unconcerned.zh: 他继续驾车前进，对发动机发出的噪声显然毫不在意。

frailty.en: Increasing frailty meant that she was more and more confined to bed.
frailty.zh: 日益衰弱意味着她愈来愈需要卧床。
人性的这一弱点具有深远的影响。

frailty.en: Your frailty makes them wary of buying anything from you.
frailty.zh: 你的虚弱使他们从你那里购买任何东西都很谨慎。

uplift.en: The news gave them a much needed uplift.
uplift.zh: 这消息给他们带来了及时的鼓舞。

uplift.en: This victory was a massive uplift for us.
uplift.zh: 此次胜利对于我们是一个极大的鼓舞。

uplift.en: Surround yourself with people who uplift, encourage and understand you.
uplift.zh: 和那些可以鼓舞、鼓励和理解你的人在一起。

penicillin.en: One dose of penicillin can wipe out the infection.
penicillin.zh: 一剂青霉素即可消除感染。

penicillin.en: Farmers often give penicillin to beef and poultry, and because of this, penicillin has been found in the milk of treated cows.
penicillin.zh: 农民经常给牛肉和家禽注射青霉素，因此这些被注射过的奶牛的奶中含有青霉素。

extravagance.en: Going to the theatre is our only extravagance.
extravagance.zh: 去剧院看戏是我们唯一的奢侈享受。

extravagance.en: Sponging and taking more than one's share and extravagance and waste on the part of cadres must be banned.
extravagance.zh: 杜绝干部多吃多占和铺张浪费。

extravagance.en: When the company went under, tales of his extravagance surged through the industry.
extravagance.zh: 这家公司破产时，有关他的奢靡的传言传遍了整个业界。

subdivide.en: Areas allow you to subdivide a project into smaller, more manageable sections.
subdivide.zh: 区域使你可以将项目分成多个更小的、更容易管理的部分。

subdivide.en: Subdivide the diagonal section at the back-left side of the triangle with one diagonal-back parting.
subdivide.zh: 在和对角线的-背面的三角形的背面留下的边细分对角线的区段离别的。

subdivide.en: This is useful when a method is too big and you want to subdivide blocks of it into different methods.
subdivide.zh: 如果一个方法太大并且您想要把此方法再细分为不同的方法，这个重构将很有用。

reminiscence.en: Science (or rather half-way science) scoffs at reminiscence of dryad and hamadryad.
reminiscence.zh: 科学（或者伪科学）嘲笑人们回忆森林女神和树神。

reminiscence.en: The scene awakened reminiscence of my youth.
reminiscence.zh: 这景象唤起了我对青年时代许多往事的追想。

reminiscence.en: Rather it is part reminiscence, part reflection, part history, and part intuitive exploration.
reminiscence.zh: 确切地讲，它是融回忆、思考、史实和直觉探索于一身。

reticent.zh: 她闷闷不乐，面色苍白，沉默寡言。

reticent.en: She is so reticent about her achievements.
reticent.zh: 她对于自己的成就如此缄默。

gregarious.en: She is such a gregarious and outgoing person.
gregarious.zh: 她就是这样一个爱社交而且外向的人。

gregarious.en: Only in our pubs can you find the truly gregarious and communal spirit surviving, and in England even the pubs are divided along class lines.
gregarious.zh: 只有在我们的酒吧里，你才能找到真正的群居和共同生存的精神。在英国，甚至连酒吧都是按阶级划分的。

reversible.zh: 私有化趋势可能逆转吗？

reversible.en: Heart disease is reversible in some cases, according to a study published last summer.
reversible.zh: 根据去年夏天发表的一项研究，心脏病有时是可逆的。

reversible.en: If real, she notes, it might be reversible by another nudge:"Easy come, easy go."
reversible.zh: 她特别提到，这种影响即使是真实的，也可能会被另一种微小的外力逆转：“来得快，去得也快。”

blackmail.en: She started off by accusing him of blackmail but he more or less ignored her.
blackmail.zh: 她以指控他敲诈勒索开始，但他基本上没理会她。

blackmail.en: You were the one that brought up the idea of blackmail. I'd never be a party to such a thing.
blackmail.zh: 你是那个提出敲诈主意的人。我从来没想过参与这种事。

blackmail.en: We may leave our lights on in the house when we are on vacation, but through social media we tell criminals where we are, when we plan to return home, and how to blackmail us.
blackmail.zh: 当我们在度假的时候，我们可能会让家里的灯开着，但通过社交媒体，我们告诉了罪犯我们在哪里，我们打算什么时候回家，以及如何敲诈我们。

alight.en: A cigarette set the dry grass alight.
alight.zh: 一支香烟把干草点燃了。

alight.en: She paused and turned, her face alight with happiness.
alight.zh: 她停住并且转过身来，满脸洋溢着幸福。

unyielding.en: The authorities proved unyielding on one crucial demand.
unyielding.zh: 当局在一点至关重要的要求上态度非常坚决。

unyielding.en: Those are blunt, unyielding admonitions that ring in my head every day.
unyielding.zh: 那些直言不讳的忠告每天都在我脑海中响起。

unyielding.en: I did not grow up with dogs, which meant that my older daughter's unyielding determination to get one required some adjustment on my part.
unyielding.zh: 我不是和狗一起长大的，这意味着我的大女儿要养一只狗的倔强的决心需要我对自己做出一些调整。

corona.en: The disease is caused by a newly-found type of corona-virus.
corona.zh: 这种疾病是由一种新发现的冠状病毒引起的。

corona.en: We have found seven types of corona-virus that can infect humans so far.
corona.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经发现了七种可以感染人类的冠状病毒。

corona.en: During this Spring Festival, the city received much attention because of a novel corona virus.
corona.zh: 今年春节期间，这座城市因为新冠病毒而获得许多关注。

trivialize.en: It never ceases to amaze me how the business world continues to trivialize the world's environmental problems.
trivialize.zh: 工商界继续轻视世界的环境问题，这一直令我感到惊讶。

trivialize.en: It is therefore important to not trivialize your passwords.
trivialize.zh: 因此不要使用简单的口令很重要。

trivialize.en: This simple example is meant to be illustrative, not to trivialize rollback.
trivialize.zh: 这个简单的例子仅用于说明问题，并不意味着回滚就是这么简单。

whisky.en: There was more whisky in it than soda.
whisky.zh: 那里面的威士忌比苏打水多。
这家工厂用蒸馏法酿造瓶装威士忌酒。

whisky.en: She swilled the whisky around in her glass.
whisky.zh: 她晃动着杯中的威士忌酒。

subsist.en: Old people often subsist on very small incomes.
subsist.zh: 老人往往靠十分微薄的收入艰难度日。

subsist.en: According to the common definition, hunter-gathers are those who subsist by hunting wild animals and gathering wild plants.
subsist.zh: 根据常见定义，捕集者是指那些以捕猎野生动物和采集野生植物为生的人。

subsist.en: She has to get a casual work to subsist.
subsist.zh: 她不得不找一个临时工作维持生活。

counterfeit.en: Are you aware these notes are counterfeit?
counterfeit.zh: 你觉察到这些钞票是伪造的吗？

counterfeit.en: He admitted possessing and delivering counterfeit currency.
counterfeit.zh: 他承认持有和运送了假币。

counterfeit.en: It is a crime to counterfeit money.

sapphire.en: She had the sapphire set in a gold ring.
sapphire.zh: 她请人把蓝宝石镶嵌到一枚金戒指上。

sapphire.en: There are five options for the gemstone: blue topaz, opalite, onyx, sapphire and ruby.
sapphire.zh: 有五种宝石供选择，分别是蓝色托帕石、不纯蛋白石、缟玛瑙、蓝宝石和红宝石。

sapphire.en: The sky is sapphire and the stars are diamonds.
sapphire.zh: 天空是蓝宝石，星星是钻石。

holocaust.en: In more recent times the Gypsies were caught up in Nazi ethnic hysteria, and perhaps half a million perished in the Holocaust.
holocaust.zh: 在近代，吉普赛人卷入了歇斯底里的纳粹民族主义，大约有50万吉普赛人死于大屠杀。

holocaust.en: A nuclear holocaust seemed a very real possibility in the '50s.
holocaust.zh: 在50年代，核灾难似乎是件很有可能发生的事。

holocaust.en: Anne Frank personalized the horrors of the Holocaust in her own words.
holocaust.zh: 安.弗兰克用她自己的话使大屠杀的恐怖个人化。

dehydrate.en: Runners can dehydrate very quickly in this heat.
dehydrate.zh: 天这样热，赛跑运动员很快会脱水。

dehydrate.en: You can see the fresh water contained in the plant will be removed and the plant will quickly lose all its water and dehydrate.
dehydrate.zh: 你可以看到，植物中所含的淡水会被移除掉，植物将很快失去所有的水分并脱水。

dehydrate.en: If a given protein persists in the body for months or years, some of its Amadori products slowly dehydrate and rearrange themselves yet again, into new glucose-derived structures.
dehydrate.zh: 如果一种给出的蛋白质在体内存留数月或数年，其 Amadori 产物会慢慢脱水并重新排列，形成新的葡萄糖衍生结构。

incipient.en: In stands dominated by trees such as aspen, however, incipient gypsy moth outbreaks are quickly suppressed by viral epidemics.
incipient.zh: 然而，在以白杨等树为主的林分，最初的舞毒蛾爆发很快就被病毒流行病所抑制。

incipient.en: Heavy commitment by an executive to a course of action, especially if it has worked well in the past, makes it likely to miss signs of incipient trouble or misinterpret them when they do appear.
incipient.zh: 高管对某一行动方针的过度承诺，尤其是在过去行之有效的情况下，很可能会忽略问题初起的迹象，或在问题出现时误解这些迹象。

incipient.en: Just like the earlier famine, this incipient one is man-made.
incipient.zh: 就像早期饥荒那样，这次也是人为原因导致的。

viciously.en: These companies compete viciously and have different interests.
viciously.zh: 这些公司充满敌意的竞争，并且关注不同的利益点。

viciously.en: His serious and tabloid newspapers have viciously assailed the monarchy.
viciously.zh: 他的不论是严肃还是庸俗的报纸都恶意地攻击君主制度。

aquaculture.zh: 水产养殖能否真的胜任？
一些科学家批评了水产养殖。

aquaculture.en: Another is a shortage of land and freshwater for use in aquaculture.
aquaculture.zh: 另一个障碍是用于水产养殖的土地和淡水资源不足。

afield.en: Journalists came from as far afield as China.
afield.zh: 新闻记者来自中国等遥远的地方。

afield.en: Some of the demand for the services and goods was no doubt fulfilled by people drawn from far afield, but some local people certainly became entwined in this new economy.
afield.zh: 无疑，一些来自遥远地区的人们对商品和服务有所需求，但同样能够肯定的是，本地人也正在和新经济产生紧密的联系。

afield.en: You can hire a car if you want to explore further afield.
afield.zh: 假如你想逛更远的地方，可以租辆汽车。

carousel.en: Imagine you want to create a radial list box that arranges its content along a circle, like a carousel.
carousel.zh: 假设您想要创建一个放射状的列表框，将其内容沿圆周排列，就像一个旋转木马。

carousel.en: Other amenities include loft-style apartments and an ice rink, plus the usual pools, 24 restaurants, a casino and even a carousel.
carousel.zh: 其他设施包括阁楼式公寓和一个溜冰场，加上普通游泳池、24 家餐厅、一家赌场，甚至还有一个旋转木马。

carousel.en: Carousels are essentially slideshow navigations, in which the content rotates vertically or horizontally (hence the name "carousel").
carousel.zh: 旋转木马本质上是幻灯片导航，其中的内容垂直或水平旋转（因此得名“旋转木马”）。

cicada.en: The cicada is a clever little insect.
cicada.zh: 蝉是一种聪明的小昆虫。

cicada.en: In the beginning, when a cicada is under the ground, it is called a baby cicada.
cicada.zh: 蝉一开始在地下生长活动时，叫作蝉宝宝。

rebuke.en: He was silenced by her stinging rebuke.
rebuke.zh: 她的尖锐批评使他哑口无言。

rebuke.en: I would not judge nor rebuke them.
rebuke.zh: 我既不会审判他们，也不会谴责他们。

rebuke.en: You rebuke the devil, but it doesn't change anything.
rebuke.zh: 你斥责魔鬼，什么也没改变。

pester.en: People pester me and they pester others with inquiries about what I am doing.
pester.zh: 人们不断打扰我，也互相打扰，打听我正在做什么。

pester.en: While my mother prepared dinner each night, my brothers and I would pester her.
pester.zh: 每天晚上妈妈做饭的时候，我和哥哥都会缠着她问。

pester.en: It is painful to acknowledge, but marketers were right all along: pester power works.
pester.zh: 要承认这一点很痛苦，但市场营销商们的理念一直正确——孩子一哭闹，父母就买单。

innermost.en: Many patients have told me their innermost thoughts.
innermost.zh: 很多病人告诉过我他们内心深处的想法。

innermost.en: I could not express my innermost feelings to anyone.
innermost.zh: 我不能向任何人表达我内心深处的感情。

innermost.en: She never abandoned her attempts to plumb my innermost emotions.
innermost.zh: 她从未放弃过洞悉我内心深处情感的努力。

disorderly.en: She was jailed for being drunk and disorderly.
disorderly.zh: 她因酗酒和扰乱治安而被监禁。

disorderly.en: There were young men and women working away at tables all over the large and disorderly room.
disorderly.zh: 那间宽敞而又凌乱的房间里到处都是伏案工作的青年男女。

disorderly.en: They were arrested for being drunk and disorderly.
disorderly.zh: 他们因酗酒滋事而被捕。

pacifist.en: Later he was to become famous as a pacifist.
pacifist.zh: 后来他变成了一位著名的和平主义者。
后来，爱因斯坦成为了一名和平主义战士。

pacifist.en: Mr Obama has never claimed to be a pacifist.
pacifist.zh: 奥巴马从未声称过自己是和平主义者。

inhalation.en: Hundreds of children were treated for smoke inhalation.
inhalation.zh: 数以百计的儿童因吸入浓烟而接受了治疗。

inhalation.en: They were taken to the hospital suffering from smoke inhalation.
inhalation.zh: 他们因吸入浓烟被送进医院。

inhalation.en: It is transmitted between animals and humans by the bite of infected fleas, direct contact, inhalation and rarely, ingestion of infective materials.
inhalation.zh: 它通过受感染跳蚤的咬伤、直接接触、吸入和极少摄入传染物在动物与人之间传播。

capricious.en: He was accused of being capricious and undemocratic.
capricious.zh: 他被指责反复无常，不讲民主。

capricious.en: Calling them a bunch of capricious kids with half-formed ideas does them an injustice.
capricious.zh: 把他们称作一群懵懂无知、喜怒无常的孩子是冤枉了他们。

capricious.en: They're not the menials and servants of capricious gods.
capricious.zh: 他们也不是变幻无测上帝的奴仆。

wharf.zh: 金丝雀码头有哪些公司？

wharf.en: The one with the pointy roof is Canary Wharf.
wharf.zh: 那个有尖顶的是金丝雀码头。

wharf.en: I think all the big banks are in Canary Wharf.
wharf.zh: 我觉得所有的大银行都在金丝雀码头。

enforced.zh: 这些条例得到严格执行。

enforced.en: The speed limit must be rigidly enforced.
enforced.zh: 必须严格执行限速规定。

enforced.en: United Nations troops enforced a ceasefire in the area.
enforced.zh: 联合国军队在该地区强制执行停火命令。

disparage.en: I don't mean to disparage your achievements.
disparage.zh: 我并不想贬低你的成就。
你不应该轻视好的风度。

disparage.en: Don't disparage her attempts to become an actress.
disparage.zh: 别贬低她想成为一名女演员的努力。

extramarital.en: Her husband has admitted having an extramarital affair.
extramarital.zh: 她丈夫承认了有通奸行为。

extramarital.en: Today, extramarital affair has become one's private issue.
extramarital.zh: 如今婚外情已成隐私问题。

extramarital.en: Today's careers offer more opportunity for extramarital affairs.
extramarital.zh: 当今的职业生涯为婚外情提供了众多的机会。

scorpion.en: The scorpion has a sting in its tail.
The frog is satisfied, and they set out, but in midstream, the scorpion stings the frog.
scorpion.zh: 青蛙感到满足，他们便出发了，但是在途中，蝎子还是蜇了青蛙。

scorpion.en: He watches as another Scorpion is riddled from below. On fire, it banks over him, careening into the jungle.
scorpion.zh: 他看见另一只蝎子从下面被打满窟窿。着了火，在他上方转弯倾斜着跌入丛林。

intelligible.en: His lecture was readily intelligible to all the students.
intelligible.zh: 他的讲课学生们都能轻松地听懂。

intelligible.en: The language of Darwin was intelligible to experts and non-experts alike.
intelligible.zh: 达尔文的语言对专家和平常人来说都容易理解。

intelligible.en: Will it split into varieties that become less mutually intelligible?
intelligible.zh: 它会分裂成不同的变种，变得不易相互理解吗？

incendiary.en: Five incendiary devices were found in her house.
incendiary.zh: 5个燃烧装置在她家里被发现了。

incendiary.en: Ms Chung is one of them, though she knows this could be incendiary.
incendiary.zh: 郑女士就是他们中的一员，尽管她也知道，这样做无异于火上浇油。

incendiary.en: Such incendiary claims could easily be dismissed as the rants of a man with a grudge.
incendiary.zh: 如此煽动性的声明很有可能会被当成是心怀恶意的男人的怒吼而被忽略。

shackle.en: Superstition is a great shackle on men's minds.
shackle.zh: 迷信是人们思想的一大桎梏。

shackle.en: But debt can also limit one's freedom-it's a shackle, a contract.
shackle.zh: 但是，债务也可以限制一个人的自由——它是一个枷锁，一份合同。

shackle.en: He says Gerrard would be an essential signing, while urging the club to shackle Maicon.
shackle.zh: 他说杰拉德是一庄重要的签约，而同时他要求俱乐部留住麦孔。

copious.en: She supports her theory with copious evidence.
copious.zh: 她以大量的论据来支持自己的理论。

copious.en: I went out for dinner last night and drank copious amounts of red wine.
copious.zh: 昨晚我出去吃饭，喝了许多红酒。

unwrap.en: I sat on the chair to unwrap the package while he stood behind me.
unwrap.zh: 我坐在椅子上打开包裹，当时他就站在我身后。

unwrap.en: And I unwrap the computation to get back.
unwrap.zh: 最后我便可以打开计算返回最初嵌套了。
对XML进行包装、解包、转义(escape)和转回(unescape)。

enchanting.en: In the purply light of dusk the town looked peaceful and happy—enchanting even—and there was an engaging air of expectancy, of fun about to happen.
enchanting.zh: 在紫红色的暮色中，这座城镇显得宁静幸福，甚至是迷人的，空气中萦绕着一种期待的迷人气氛，一种即将要发生的有趣气氛。
她是个顶招人喜爱的孩子。
法国家庭度假的迷人胜地。

solicitor.zh: 律师保存着我们的遗嘱。

solicitor.en: My solicitor is no longer in practice.
solicitor.zh: 我的律师已不再执业了。

solicitor.en: He has always been the family solicitor.
solicitor.zh: 他一直是这个家的律师。

consonant.en: Almost every language has an O vowel, a K consonant, and an A vowel.
consonant.zh: 几乎每一种语言都有一个 O 元音、一个 K 辅音和一个 A 元音。

consonant.en: The tactic is a bit complicated for a brief article, but the basic idea is to attach each digit to a specific consonant.
consonant.zh: 对于一篇短文来说，这个策略有点复杂，但基本的概念是把每个数字跟一个特定的辅音字母关联起来。

consonant.en: Spanish Silbo, a whistle language, has only four vowel and four consonant sounds. Audible for miles, it resembles bird calls.
consonant.zh: 西班牙的席尔波语是一种口哨语言，只有四个元音和四个辅音。几英里外都能听到它的声音，它就像鸟儿的鸣叫。

inordinate.en: They spend an inordinate amount of time talking.
inordinate.zh: 他们聊天时间长得超乎想像。

inordinate.en: Either keeping personal creditors accounts or making sundry creditors adjustments can consume inordinate amounts of administrative and accounting time.
inordinate.zh: 无论是保留个人债权人账户，还是进行各种各样的债权人调整，都可能耗费过多的行政和会计时间。

inordinate.en: Babies and small children require an inordinate amount of clobber.
inordinate.zh: 携带婴儿和幼儿需备有非常大量衣物。

supersonic.en: There was a huge bang; it sounded like a supersonic jet.
supersonic.zh: 发出一声巨响；听起来像一架超音速喷气式飞机。

supersonic.en: Supersonic flight could become a routine form of travel in the 21st century.
supersonic.zh: 搭乘超音速飞机飞行会成为21世纪常见的旅行方式。

supersonic.en: Many supersonic aircraft have a similar needle at the nose.
supersonic.zh: 许多超音速飞机的机头都有类似的针状设计。

pancreas.en: One needs a heart, one a lung, one a kidney, one a liver, and the fifth a pancreas.
pancreas.zh: 分别需要心脏，肺，肾，肝，以及胰腺移植。

pancreas.en: The major proteases which the pancreas secretes are trypsinogen and chymotrypsinogen.
pancreas.zh: 胰腺分泌的主要蛋白酶是胰蛋白酶原和胰凝乳蛋白酶原。

henceforth.en: Friday 31 July 1925 henceforth became known as 'Red Friday'.
henceforth.zh: 1925年7月31日这个星期五从此以后就称为“红色星期五”。

henceforth.en: Henceforth all branches of the naval officer corps were equal to one another.
henceforth.zh: 从此以后海军军官团的各个分支都相互平等。

henceforth.en: Henceforth I will be a very different Toad.
henceforth.zh: 从此以后，我将成为一个很不一样的托德。

outmoded.en: Romania badly needs aid to modernize its outmoded industries.
outmoded.zh: 罗马尼亚迫切需要援助以对其过时的产业进行现代化。

outmoded.en: Certain jobs have gone away for good, outmoded by machines.
outmoded.zh: 某些工作因为被机器取代而永远消失了。
但是那种理念有点过时了。

offshoot.en: Psychology began as a purely academic offshoot of natural philosophy.
offshoot.zh: 心理学形成之初是作为自然哲学的一个纯学术分支。

offshoot.en: An offshoot of the biological approach called sociobiology suggests that aggression is natural and even desirable for people.
offshoot.zh: 社会生物学是生物学方法的一个分支；据社会生物学理论表明，攻击性是与生俱来的，甚至是人类所希望得到的。

offshoot.en: VW and its Audi offshoot sold 358, 500 cars in America last year.
offshoot.zh: 大众汽车及其分支奥迪去年在美国卖出了358，500辆车。

postgraduate.en: The university has a well-established tradition of welcoming postgraduate students from overseas.
postgraduate.zh: 该大学有由来已久的接收海外研究生的传统。

postgraduate.en: I'm in charge of all the admissions of postgraduate students in the university.
postgraduate.zh: 我负责这所大学所有的研究生招生工作。

postgraduate.en: In a scruffy Budapest district, a postgraduate student from Cambridge is getting a bruising reception.
postgraduate.zh: 在布达佩斯的一个破旧的地区里，一名剑桥大学的研究生受到了粗暴的接待。

chieftain.en: His father is the chieftain of the clan.
chieftain.zh: 他父亲是那个部落的酋长。

chieftain.en: Shaman and Chieftain now found in Nomad encounters.
chieftain.zh: 在大地图也可以遇到僧人和酋长了？

delude.en: We delude ourselves that we are in control.
delude.zh: 我们欺骗自己一切都在我们的控制之下。

delude.en: Each one was a girl of fair common sense, and she did not delude herself with any vain conceits, or deny her love.
delude.zh: 每一个都是明白事理的姑娘，她没有想到为了超过别人，就用虚荣的幻想去自欺欺人，或是去否认她的爱情。

delude.en: Whatever we do, we should never delude ourselves into believing that gifted children or geniuses are different from the rest of humanity.
delude.zh: 无论我们怎样做，都不应自欺欺人地相信有天赋的孩子或天才和其他人不同。

acidity.en: Our speciality here are Italian wines, and these tend to be fruity with medium acidity.
acidity.zh: 我们这里的特色菜是意大利葡萄酒，这些酒的果香通常中等酸度。

acidity.en: The proportion of free oleic acid that an olive oil contains is an accurate measure of the oil's acidity.
acidity.zh: 橄榄油中游离油酸的比例是对橄榄油酸度的精确测量。

acidity.en: She is investigating the effects of changing acidity and temperature in the sea on a creature called the purple sea urchin.
acidity.zh: 她正在调查改变海水的酸性和温度对叫紫海胆的这一生物的影响。

germinate.en: Some seed varieties germinate fast, so check every day or so.
germinate.zh: 有一些品种的种子发芽快，所以差不多每天都要察看一下。

germinate.en: Nitrogen dioxide in the smoke induces the seeds to germinate.
germinate.zh: 烟雾中的二氧化氮诱导种子发芽。

germinate.en: Actually, the seeds don't retain the power to germinate for very long.
germinate.zh: 事实上，种子不能长时间保持发芽的能力。

respiration.en: His respiration grew fainter throughout the day.
respiration.zh: 一天当中，他的呼吸越来越微弱。

respiration.en: Blood pressure and respiration are also recorded.
respiration.zh: 血压和呼吸也做了记录。

respiration.en: She was given artificial respiration and cardiac massage.
respiration.zh: 她接受了人工呼吸和心脏按摩。

assertiveness.en: Chantelle's assertiveness stirred up his deep-seated sense of inadequacy.
assertiveness.zh: 仙黛尔的坚定自信激起了他根深蒂固的自卑感。

assertiveness.en: But the real foundation of their new assertiveness is economic.
assertiveness.zh: 但它们新生自信的真正基础来自经济。

assertiveness.en: Previous episodes of Turkish assertiveness in the region have been less welcome.
assertiveness.zh: 土耳其先前虽在该区扮演决定性的角色，但却一直不受欢迎。

invalid.en: The trial was stopped and the results declared invalid.
invalid.zh: 审判被终止了，其结果被宣布无效。

invalid.en: People with invalid papers are deported to another country.
invalid.zh: 持无效证件的人被驱逐到别国。

invalid.en: Margaret resides with her invalid mother in a Seattle suburb.
invalid.zh: 玛格丽特和她有病的妈妈住在西雅图郊区。

microchip.en: Thanks to her microchip, Roxy was soon returned to her grateful owner.
microchip.zh: 多亏了她的微芯片，Roxy 很快就被归还，主人心怀感激。

microchip.en: Without the microchip, the cat would never be able to come home again.
microchip.zh: 没有微芯片，猫就再也回不来了。

microchip.en: Call the microchip company to match the number to the information of its owner.
microchip.zh: 给微芯片公司打电话，把号码和其主人匹配上。

internist.en: I've been to see an internist, a nutritionist, and a chiropractor.
internist.zh: 我已经求诊过一位内科医生、一位营养学家和一位按摩师了。

internist.en: She said that her internist had recommended that she come.
internist.zh: 她说是她的内科医生推荐她来的。

internist.en: Plotnikoff, an internist, speaks Somali and has many Somali patients.
internist.zh: 他是一位内科医师，讲索马里语，有很多索马里病人。

imperil.en: At the same time, today, the actions, and inaction, of human beings imperil not only life on the planet, but the very life of the planet.
imperil.zh: 与此同时，今天，人类的行动和不作为不仅危害地球上的生命，而且危害地球本身的生命。

imperil.en: Melting ice can help unlock ancient secrets, but warming temperatures could imperil many more historic sites.
imperil.zh: 日渐融化的冰雪可以解开尘封许久的古老秘密，然而，温暖的气候也让很多历史遗迹陷入危机之中。

imperil.en: Office etiquette and rules might also imperil new employees who haven't yet made the switch from campus mind to office mind.
imperil.zh: 办公室的礼仪和规则也困扰着新职员，他们还没从校园思维方式转换到办公室模式。

lullaby.zh: 她轻声哼唱了一支摇篮曲。

lullaby.en: The mother was crooning a lullaby to her baby.
lullaby.zh: 母亲正对着婴儿哼着摇篮曲。

lullaby.en: She was singing the saddest lullaby he had ever heard.

floodplain.zh: 跨过宽阔的波托·马克河漫滩，飞机在国家机场降落。

beehive.en: Take the beehive and its hexagonal honeycomb as an example.
beehive.zh: 拿蜂箱和它六边形的蜂巢作例子。

beehive.en: The reason he had to uncover it was that beehive tombs, like everything else, were buried.
beehive.zh: 他必须揭开它的原因是这些蜂窝墓，像其他东西一样，被埋在地下。

beehive.en: During the day, your brain is a beehive of activity—during NREM sleep, it is barely humming.
beehive.zh: 在白天，你的大脑就像一个活跃的蜂窝——在非快速眼动睡眠期间，它就几乎没有嗡嗡声了。

trimester.en: At the end of the first trimester, the fetus is about three inches long.
trimester.zh: 在怀孕的第三个月末，胎儿差不多有三英寸长了。

trimester.en: See your eye doctor within the first trimester of pregnancy.
trimester.zh: 在怀孕的前三个月要去看眼科医生。

biochemistry.en: She has a degree in Biochemistry from London University.
biochemistry.zh: 她有伦敦大学生物化学的学位。

biochemistry.en: Some of their biochemistry applications are with another Professor at MIT, Alice Ting, and her lab.
biochemistry.zh: 他们的一些生物化学应用与麻省理工学院的另一位教授 Alice Ting 和她的实验室有关。

biochemistry.en: These studies cover high-technology fields such as big data, biochemistry, new energy and robots, etc.
biochemistry.zh: 这些研究覆盖了从大数据到生物化学、从新能源到机器人等高科技领域。

atlas.en: The events took place against the dramatic backdrop of the Atlas mountains.
atlas.zh: 活动在雄伟的阿特拉斯山脉举行。

atlas.en: Provided you have not cheated by consulting an atlas, you will notice something rather surprising.
atlas.zh: 如果你没有通过查阅地图集作弊，你会注意到一些相当令人惊讶的事情。

atlas.en: He feared that a map in the atlas could pull climate scientists into another vortex of damaging controversy.
atlas.zh: 他担心新闻评述会同地图集里的地图一道，将气象学家们拉入另一个破坏性争议的漩涡之中。

repaint.en: I was going to sand down the chairs and repaint them.
repaint.zh: 我打算用砂纸打磨这些椅子然后重新刷漆。
给厨房着上一种清新、较浅的颜色。
但是我并不是说重新刷一遍。

heartless.en: I do wish I were gay and innocent and heartless.
heartless.zh: 我真希望我是快乐的、天真的、无情的。

heartless.en: I couldn't believe they were so heartless.
heartless.zh: 我无法相信他们是如此的麻木不仁。

heartless.en: What is gay and innocent and heartless?
heartless.zh: 什么是快乐、天真和狠心？

measles.en: Adults are often immune to German measles.
measles.zh: 成人往往对风疹有免疫力。

measles.en: Rubella is just another name for German measles.
measles.zh: 风疹只是德国麻疹的另一个名称。

measles.en: About 93 percent of U.S. residents are immune to measles either because they were vaccinated or they had the disease as a child.
measles.zh: 大约93%的美国居民对麻疹是免疫的，他们要么因为接种过疫苗，要么就是小时候得过麻疹。

terse.en: Well before he died of cancer in 2008, Harold Pinter knew he had earned a reputation for being "enigmatic, taciturn, terse, prickly, explosive and forbidding".
terse.zh: 早在2008年哈罗德·品特因癌症去世之前，他就知道了自己赢得了“高深莫测、沉默寡言、简洁、多刺、暴躁以及令人生畏”的名声。

terse.en: The President issued a terse statement denying the charges.
terse.zh: 总统发表了一份简短的声明，否认那些指控。

terse.en: An example of her modus operandi was provided during a terse exchange with the defendant.
terse.zh: 与被告的简短交流体现了她独特的办事方式。

introspection.en: He had always had his moments of quiet introspection.
introspection.zh: 他总有安静自省的时候。

introspection.en: What we seem to be sacrificing in all our surfing and searching is our capacity to engage in the quieter, attentive modes of thought that underpin contemplation, reflection and introspection.
introspection.zh: 在进行所有的浏览和搜索时，我们似乎正在牺牲进入更安静、专注的思维模式的能力，而这是沉思、反思和内省的基础。

cyclone.en: The race was called off as a cyclone struck.
cyclone.zh: 由于旋风袭击，比赛被取消了。

cyclone.en: The normal cyclone season extends from December to April.
cyclone.zh: 正常的飓风季节从12月持续到4月。

cyclone.en: Tthe early Pliocene had a weakened atmospheric circulation, and therefore, reduced vertical wind shear, which is favorable for tropical cyclone growth.
cyclone.zh: 上新世早期的大气环流被减弱，因此垂直风切变减小，助长了热带气旋的发展。

indigo.en: The blue dye is obtained from the indigo plant.
indigo.zh: 蓝色染料是从靛蓝植物中提取的。

indigo.en: The blue vat dye obtained until about 1900 entirely from some species of the indigo plant.
indigo.zh: 直到大约1900年，蓝色还原染料都是从靛蓝植物中提取的。

indigo.en: The indigo plant was highly valued until the discovery of chemical dyes in the 19th century.
indigo.zh: 在19世纪发现化学染料之前，靛蓝一直被高度重视。

rebut.en: But they rebut allegations that they messed up.
rebut.zh: 但它们驳斥了自己搞糟了的指控。

rebut.en: There's one big argument against people liking food that I'm going to rebut right now.
rebut.zh: 有的人反对人们都喜欢食物这个说法，我下面将要对这个进行反驳。

antiseptic.en: Ancient cultures used the spice as an antiseptic and to treat cholera and bronchitis.
antiseptic.zh: 在古代文化中，辣椒被用作防腐剂、治疗霍乱和支气管炎。

antiseptic.en: In the bathroom, I discovered a pair of hand-blown glass bottles used for storing antibiotic pills and antiseptic.
antiseptic.zh: 在浴室里，我发现了一对用来存放抗生素药丸和防腐剂的人工吹制的玻璃瓶。

antiseptic.en: Because of its irritating effect on humans, the use of phenol as a general antiseptic has been largely discontinued.
antiseptic.zh: 由于苯酚对人体有刺激性作用，它基本上已不再被当作常用的防腐剂了。

tiresome.en: Now the tiresome chirping of a cricket that no human ingenuity could locate, began.
tiresome.zh: 这时，一只蟋蟀开始发出烦人的唧唧声，而人们根本找不到它在哪。

tiresome.en: Buying a house can be a very tiresome business.
tiresome.zh: 买房子会是件很麻烦的事。

tiresome.en: Frank's efforts at flirtation had become tiresome to her.
tiresome.zh: 弗兰克一个劲地打情骂俏使得她非常厌倦。

uptake.en: The drug increases the number of red cells in the blood, enhancing oxygen uptake by 10 percent.
uptake.zh: 这种药增加血液里的红细胞数量，将氧气吸收量提高百分之十。

uptake.en: Vitamin D, or calciferol, is another fat-soluble steroid vitamin that functions to stimulate calcium uptake from the gut and its deposition in bone.
uptake.zh: 维生素 D，或钙醇，是另一种脂溶性类固醇维生素，其功能是促进肠道吸收钙并强化骨骼。

uptake.en: Vitamin D, or calciferol, is another fat soluble steroid vitamin which functions to stimulate calcium uptake from the gut and its deposition in bone.
uptake.zh: 维生素 D，或钙醇，是另一种脂溶性类固醇维生素，其功能是促进钙从肠道吸收并沉积在骨头中。

sizeable.en: The town has a sizeable Sikh population.
sizeable.zh: 城里有为数众多的锡克教教徒。

sizeable.en: Whales being sociable animals probably need the stimulus of sizeable gatherings to induce reproductives behavior.
sizeable.zh: 鲸作为社会性动物，可能需要大规模聚集的刺激来诱导繁殖行为。

sizeable.en: Denoma, a major consumer-electronics maker, had a sizeable decline in sales revenue for its most recent fiscal year.
sizeable.zh: Denoma 是一家主要的消费电子产品制造商，在最近的一个财政年度，其销售收入大幅下降。

submissive.en: Often it shifts to a submissive posture too.
submissive.zh: 通常它也会转变成一种顺从的姿态。

submissive.en: They need to learn how to be dominant and submissive because each monkey might have to play either role in the future.
submissive.zh: 他们需要学习如何主导和服从，因为每只猴子在未来都可能扮演其中任意一个角色。

submissive.en: This leads to building a brand of underconfident, submissive, low-impact non-leaders and hampers their growth and career advancement.
submissive.zh: 这会导致建立一个缺乏自信、顺从、影响力低的非领导者的品牌，阻碍他们的成长和职业发展。

electrically.en: The electrically charged gas particles are affected by magnetic forces.
electrically.zh: 带电的气体粒子受磁力的影响。

electrically.en: Everyone is going to drive electrically-powered cars. So in a few years, people won't worry about running out of gas.
electrically.zh: 每个人都将驾驶电动汽车，所以在未来几年内，人们将不用担心汽油耗尽。

electrically.en: Once attached to the rail, the car will become electrically powered from the system, and control of the vehicle will pass to a central computer.
electrically.zh: 一旦连接到轨道上，汽车将由系统提供电力，由中央计算机控制。

recollect.en: As far as I can recollect, she wasn't there on that occasion.
recollect.zh: 据我回忆，当时她不在场。
好吧，试着回忆一下——好吗？

recalcitrant.en: The danger is that recalcitrant local authorities will reject their responsibilities.
recalcitrant.zh: 危险在于那些不服从命令的地方当局将拒绝履行他们的职责。

recalcitrant.en: There was less bullying in secondary schools, with about one in twenty-five suffering persistent bullying, but these cases may be particularly recalcitrant.
recalcitrant.zh: 中学里的霸凌现象较少，约有1/25的学生遭受持续的霸凌，但这些案例可能特别棘手。

recalcitrant.en: It is far more likely that some sort of amicable settlement would be reached if the recalcitrant son or daughter knows that the alternative is a public trial.
recalcitrant.zh: 如果不听话的儿子或女儿知道另一种选择是公开审判，那么更有可能达成某种和解。

cobble.en: Soapy took a cobble-stone and dashed it through the glass.
cobble.zh: 索比捡起一块鹅卵石，向玻璃窗砸去。

cobble.en: It looks like a large, chipped grey cobble.
cobble.zh: 它看起来就像一块巨大的灰色鹅卵石，带着劈过的痕迹。

cobble.en: Still I managed to cobble a list together.
cobble.zh: 我还是想要凑出一张排名来。

psychosis.en: He may have some kind of neurosis or psychosis later in life.
psychosis.zh: 他在以后的生活中可能会有某种神经官能症或精神错乱。

psychosis.en: The mental state that had created her psychosis was no longer present.
psychosis.zh: 导致她精神错乱的那种心理状态已经不见了。
精神病：罪魁祸首还是替罪羊？

inoculate.en: A corps of doctors arrived to inoculate the recruits.
inoculate.zh: 一队医生来给新兵打防疫针。

inoculate.en: Entrepreneurs can't completely inoculate their businesses from the vagaries of the market.
inoculate.zh: 创业者不能完全让自己的事业规避市场中难以预测的行为。

inoculate.en: The size of the batch depends on how many eggs a manufacturer can obtain, inoculate and incubate.
inoculate.zh: 批量大小是根据制造商能得到、接种和孵化多少鸡蛋来决定的。

shanty.en: In the shanty towns there are very poor living standards.
shanty.zh: 棚户区的生活水平很低。

shanty.en: The shanty tottered in the strong wind and fell.
shanty.zh: 棚屋在大风中摇摇晃晃，最后倒塌了。

boarder.en: On my first time I accidentally crashed into a snow boarder.
boarder.zh: 第一次滑下来的时候我不小心撞上玩雪地滑板的人。

boarder.en: The bomb struck a security convoy, not far from the Afghan boarder.
boarder.zh: 此次爆炸袭击了一个安全护航队，位置就在距阿富汗边界不远的地方。

boarder.en: Standing on the floor, a young boarder named Carl was admiring the view.
boarder.zh: 一位名叫卡尔的寄宿生站在地上，为该情景钦佩不已。

supplementation.en: The product provided inadequate vitamin and mineral supplementation.
supplementation.zh: 这种产品不能充分补充维生素和矿物质。

supplementation.en: This multicenter trial questions the benefits of DHA supplementation during pregnancy.
supplementation.zh: 这项试验质疑了在孕期服用DHA补充剂的益处。

supplementation.en: The safety, efficacy and effective delivery of maternal micronutrient supplementation require further research.
supplementation.zh: 母体微量营养素补充的安全性、功效和有效传递需要进一步研究。

invertebrate.en: Most invertebrate species disappeared during a wave of extinctions.
invertebrate.zh: 大多数无脊椎动物在一次（物种）灭绝浪潮中消失了。

invertebrate.en: Increasing salinity caused by the evaporation resulted in the extermination of scores of invertebrate species.
invertebrate.zh: 蒸发引起的盐度增加导致了无脊椎动物物种的灭绝。

invertebrate.en: People aren't even required to seek permits to move plants or invertebrate animals around as long as they are not classified as pests.
invertebrate.zh: 人们甚至可以未经许可就对植物或无脊椎动物进行迁移，只要它们未被归类为有害动植物。

irritant.en: It may be that the itching is caused by contact with irritant material.
irritant.zh: 那儿的痒也许是由于接触刺激物而引起的。

irritant.en: Moreover, they are a direct irritant in what some politicians and scholars see as a coming conflict between the generations.
irritant.zh: 此外，在一些政客和学者看来，这两代人之间即将爆发的冲突中，它们是一个直接的刺激因素。

irritant.en: He said the issue was not a major irritant.
irritant.zh: 他说这一问题不是让他恼火的主要原因。

supposition.en: The report is based entirely on supposition.
supposition.zh: 这篇报道完全建立在推测的基础上。

supposition.en: There's a popular supposition that we're publicly funded but the bulk of our money comes from competitive contracts.
supposition.zh: 人们普遍假设我们是受公共基金的资助，但我们大部分的资金是通过签订竞争性合同得到的。

salinity.en: There are three basic processes that cause a change in oceanic salinity.
salinity.zh: 导致海洋盐度变化有三个基本过程。

salinity.en: Low salinity and high temperatures favor the survival of the starfish larvae.
salinity.zh: 低盐度和高温有利于海星幼虫的生存。

salinity.en: As the sea creeps into these freshwater marshes, however, rising salinity is hampering rice production.
salinity.zh: 然而，随着海水侵入淡水湿地，不断增加的盐分正在妨害稻米产量。

stethoscope.en: Listening to a purring cat through a stethoscope is a great relaxation technique.
stethoscope.zh: 用听诊器听猫发出的呼噜声是很好的放松技巧。

stethoscope.en: In specialties ranging from cardiac care to pediatric care, they could become as essential in daily medicine as the stethoscope.
stethoscope.zh: 在心脏护理至儿科护理的专业领域中，它们在日常医学中可能会像听诊器一样不可或缺。

stethoscope.en: The stethoscope is older than the x-ray, the ballpoint pen, Popular Science and pretty much everything else in your doctor's office.
stethoscope.zh: 听诊器比 X 射线、圆珠笔、《大众科学》以及你医生诊所里绝大部分物件还要古老。

spindle.en: The princess took the spindle and began to try and spin.
spindle.zh: 公主拿起纺锤开始试着纺线。

spindle.en: In her works, the spiraling spindle represented the beginning of chaos.
spindle.zh: 在她的作品中，螺旋形的纺锤代表了混乱的开始。

spindle.en: The spindle shaped cells arranged in fascicular, whorled and storiform.
spindle.zh: 梭形细胞呈束状、轮生和成层状排列。

pimple.en: Will dotting toothpaste on a pimple get rid of it?
pimple.zh: 在痘痘上点涂牙膏能不能治好它？

pimple.en: Sometimes, it is better to remain unknown than to make pimple hate you.
pimple.zh: 有时，保持默默无闻比让人恨你要好得多。

pimple.en: Until then, expect pre-prom pimple conniptions to continue. —Katherine Harmon
pimple.zh: 在那之前，只能继续期待青春痘爆发提前结束。

robin.zh: 罗宾打开了一些香槟酒。

robin.en: A robin was perching on the fence.
robin.zh: 一只知更鸟落在篱笆上。

aftershock.en: They were already under stress, thanks to the aftershock of last year's drought.
aftershock.zh: 去年干旱的余波已经给他们造成压力了。

aftershock.en: The largest so far was a 6.9 magnitude aftershock.
aftershock.zh: 到目前为止的最大余震为6.9级。

derelict.en: An agricultural worker, digging in the grounds of a derelict plantation, scraped open a grave.
derelict.zh: 一名农业人员在一个废弃的种植园里挖掘，挖开了一个坟墓。

derelict.en: Most of the five-storey building is dusty and derelict.
derelict.zh: 大多数的五层楼建筑往往尘土飞扬破乱不堪。

derelict.en: There were many more bullet-scarred and derelict houses.
derelict.zh: 被废弃的弹痕累累的房屋更多了。

vertebrate.en: The left side of most vertebrate brains, for example, seems to process and control feeding.
vertebrate.zh: 例如，大多数脊椎动物的左脑似乎负责的是处理和控制进食。

vertebrate.en: Thus the anaerobic energy reserves of a vertebrate are proportional to the size of the animal.
vertebrate.zh: 因此，脊椎动物的无氧能量储备与动物的大小成正比。

vertebrate.en: This is not surprising because the design of any flying vertebrate is subject to aerodynamic constraints.
vertebrate.zh: 这并不奇怪，因为任何会飞的脊椎动物的设计都受到空气动力学的限制。

demote.en: It's very difficult to demote somebody who has been filling in during maternity leave.
demote.zh: 给替代歇产假的人降职是很难的。

demote.en: It is illegal to demote an employee without reason.
demote.zh: 无缘无故将一名员工降级是违法的。

demote.en: "We are going to demote the PC to just be a device," Steve Jobs said.
demote.zh: “我们打算把PC贬为仅是设备”，乔布斯说。

encore.en: She played a Chopin waltz as an encore.
encore.zh: 她应听众的要求又加演了一首肖邦的圆舞曲。
兰昨晚最后的返场加唱曲目是《赤脚》。

encore.en: We go offstage and come back for the convention of the encore.
encore.zh: 按照惯例，当要求我们再唱一次的时候，我们得先下台然后再返回台上。

repulse.en: The armed forces were prepared to repulse any attacks.
repulse.zh: 武装部队已准备好击退任何进攻。

repulse.en: Would you like John or Mary to go with you to Repulse Bay?
repulse.zh: 你喜欢约翰或玛丽陪你去浅水湾还是你自己一个人去？

sleet.en: At any time I could run into rain, sleet, snow, or scorching heat.
sleet.zh: 任何时候我都可能会碰到下雨、下雨夹雪、下雪或是酷暑天。

sleet.en: By the time they reached the mountaintop, the sleet had changed to fluffy snow.
sleet.zh: 当他们到达山顶上的时候，雨夹雪已经变成了柔软的雪花。

sleet.en: Parts of Northwest China, Inner Mongolia, North and Northeast China will see small to moderate snow or sleet.
sleet.zh: 中国西北、内蒙古、华北和东北部分地区将有小到中雪或雨夹雪。

leaning.en: She walked slowly, leaning on her son's arm.
leaning.zh: 她倚靠着她儿子的手臂缓慢行走。

leaning.en: He was leaning nonchalantly against the wall.
leaning.zh: 他漫不经心地斜倚着墙。

leaning.en: She was leaning negligently against the wall.

lard.en: Lard help us... overweight must eat less for planet.
lard.zh: 猪油可以帮助我们…为了我们的地球着想，超重的人必须减小食量。

hiccup.en: We descendants of these animals were left with vestiges of their history, including the hiccup.
hiccup.zh: 我们这些动物的后代同样也遗留下这些痕迹，包括打嗝。

hiccup.en: A young Viking teenager named Hiccup aspires to follow his tribe's tradition of becoming a dragon slayer.
hiccup.zh: 一位名叫 Hiccup 的维京少年立志要继承部落的传统，成为屠龙者。

compendium.en: The Roman Catholic Church has issued a compendium of its teachings.
compendium.zh: 罗马天主教会已经发行了一份其教义的概略。

compendium.en: He spent 27 years writing Compendium of Material Medica.
compendium.zh: 他花了27年撰写了《本草纲目》。

compendium.en: How long did Li Shizhen spend in writing Compendium of Materia Medical?
compendium.zh: 李时珍花了多长时间写《本草纲目》？

misjudge.en: It was now his turn to misjudge his opponent.
misjudge.zh: 现在轮到他低估自己的对手了。

misjudge.en: We all misjudge people and situations every so often.

sulfate.zh: 米草类植物有能力吸收硫化物并将其转化为硫酸盐——一种植物可以利用的硫的形式；这种能力使这种草更容易在沼泽环境中生长。

sulfate.en: To investigate whether the fermented rye bran can protect the model mice receiving dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) from colitis.
sulfate.zh: 要研究发酵的黑麦麸是否能保护接受右旋糖酐硫酸钠（DSS）的模型小鼠免于结肠炎。

authenticate.en: The system might use a smart identity card, or a digital credential linked to a specific computer and would authenticate users at a range of online services.
authenticate.zh: 该系统可能使用智能身份证或连接到特定计算机的数字证书，并在一系列在线服务中认证用户。

authenticate.zh: 选择如何进行用户认证。

authenticate.zh: 将提示您进行身份验证以访问这个页面。

apathetic.en: The illness made her apathetic and unwilling to meet people.
apathetic.zh: 疾病使她冷漠，不愿见人。

apathetic.en: Even the most apathetic students are beginning to sit up and listen.
apathetic.zh: 即使最漠不关心的学生都开始坐直身子听了。

alkaline.en: Some soils are actually too alkaline for certain plant life.
alkaline.zh: 有些土壤的碱性，实际上对某些植物的生长是过高的。

alkaline.en: Antacids are alkaline and they relieve pain by neutralizing acid in the contents of the stomach.
alkaline.zh: 抗酸剂是碱性的，它们通过中和胃容物中的酸来缓解疼痛。

alkaline.en: Part of a healthy diet is drinking at least 2 liters of pure (ideally alkaline) mineral water every day.
alkaline.zh: 健康膳食的其中一个组成部分是每天至少喝2升纯净（最好为碱性的）矿泉水。

sorrowful.en: His father's face looked suddenly soft and sorrowful.
sorrowful.zh: 他父亲的面容忽然变得温柔而悲伤。
朋友，你为什么这么悲伤？

sorrowful.en: She was very sorrowful when her beauty company caught fire.
sorrowful.zh: 当她的美容公司着火时，她非常伤心。

lubricate.en: Mineral oils are used to lubricate machinery.
lubricate.zh: 矿物油被用来润滑机器。

lubricate.en: Oil riches, naturally, would lubricate the process.
lubricate.zh: 石油资源丰富，自然使这个过程更容易一些。

lubricate.en: Some of this cash is used to lubricate dollar-based international trade.
lubricate.zh: 其中一部份用于促成美元交易的国际贸易。

convulse.en: In more advanced cases, the patient will lose consciousness and may convulse.
convulse.zh: 在更严重的病例中，病人会失去知觉并抽搐。

convulse.en: Theoretical physicists have long believed that quantum effects will cause space-time to convulse wildly on the tiniest scales.
convulse.zh: 理论物理学家一直相信，在最微小的尺度上，量子效应将导致时空的杂乱震动。

convulse.en: The classic movie works which are the most beautiful Muse in holy palace of people's cultural art, are to savor the epic which can convulse people's soul and collection of literature art.
convulse.zh: 影视精品是震撼心灵的史诗的品读和文学艺术精华的集粹，是人类文化艺术圣殿中最美丽的缪斯女神。

esthetic.en: Only is has in one whole esthetic sense.
esthetic.zh: 只是有着一种整体上的美感。

esthetic.en: From the esthetic view, it was a beautiful continent.
esthetic.zh: 从美学的观点来看，那是一个美丽的大陆。

esthetic.en: There is an inherent connection among beauty, esthetic judgment, and beauty creation.
esthetic.zh: 美、审美、创美的超越性特征具有内在的逻辑联系。

cornea.en: LASIK eye surgery changes the shape of your cornea—the transparent membrane that arcs over your pupil and the colored part of your eye (iris).
cornea.zh: LASIK 眼科手术改变了你的角膜的形状——角膜是覆盖在你的瞳孔和你的眼睛的有色部分（虹膜）上的弧形透明膜。

cornea.en: Each cluster includes a pair of eyes with a sophisticated lens, retina, iris and cornea. Scientists aren't sure how they process what they see.
cornea.zh: 每组包括一对拥有复杂晶状体、视网膜、虹膜和角膜的眼睛。科学家们还不确定它们如何处理它们看到的东西。

cornea.en: The doctor told him that only by doing a cornea transplant operation could he bring his sight back.
cornea.zh: 医生告诉他，只有做角膜移植手术他才能恢复视力。

auspicious.en: His career as a playwright had an auspicious start.
auspicious.zh: 他的剧作家生涯有一个好的开头。
这很难说是什么好兆头。

hazel.en: Hazel was the new kid in class.
hazel.zh: 黑兹尔是班上新来的学生。

fluoride.en: It is a proven fact that fluoride strengthens growing teeth.
fluoride.zh: 氟化物可以强化生长中的牙齿，这是已证明的事实。

fluoride.en: At this stage, the tooth can repair the weakened area with the help of fluoride and minerals in saliva.
fluoride.zh: 在这个阶段，牙齿可以借助唾液中的氟化物和矿物质修复脆弱的部位。

fluoride.en: A litre of teacan contain up to 9mg of fluoride, which in excess can cause skeletal fluorosis, reducing bone quality and causing pain and stiffening of the ligaments.
fluoride.zh: 一升茶树含有高达9毫克的氟化物，过量会导致氟骨症，降低骨骼质量，导致疼痛和韧带僵硬。

progenitor.en: He was the progenitor of a family of distinguished actors.
progenitor.zh: 他是一个著名演艺世家的先辈。

progenitor.en: Further down the line here, if we looked in the adult brain or spinal cord and other regions, we'll find committed progenitor cells.
progenitor.zh: 沿着这条线再往后，如果我们看看成人的大脑或者脊髓和其他部位，我们就能找到定向祖细胞。

progenitor.en: The progenitor of the approach was 3m, with its famous release time for engineers to pursue pet projects.
progenitor.zh: 这种方法起源于3m，它的著名理论就是为工程师提供宽松的时间去从事他们宠爱的方案。

abbreviation.en: We will use this abbreviation in this article and throughout the series.
abbreviation.zh: 我们将在本文以及整个系列中使用这个缩写词。

sulfide.en: Bacteria feed on this oil and release hydrogen sulfide gas.
sulfide.zh: 细菌以这种油为食，并释放硫化氢气体。

sulfide.en: When hydrogen sulfide reacts with the oxygen in the water, the result of that is sulfuric acid.
sulfide.zh: 当硫化氢与水中的氧反应，得到的就是硫酸。

sulfide.en: Remote-controlled machines smash the sulfide deposits, which are then hoovered up through a riser pipe to a vessel on the surface.
sulfide.zh: 远程控制的机器粉碎硫化物沉积物，然后通过升流管将其吸附到地表的容器上。

redouble.en: The leading banks are expected to redouble their efforts to keep the value of the dollar down.
redouble.zh: 人们预计各大银行会加倍努力以保持美元的低价位。

redouble.en: There isn't much time ahead, so we should redouble our effort.
redouble.zh: 来日无多， 须加倍努力。

redouble.en: We will have to redouble our loving care of the saplings that have just been planted.
redouble.zh: 对刚栽下的小树，我们要倍加爱护。

brevity.en: Brevity is the first thing we can learn from them.
brevity.zh: 简洁是我们可以从他们身上学到的第一件事。

brevity.en: Last but not the least, a speaker has to keep in mind the value of brevity.
brevity.zh: 最后但并非最不重要的是，演讲者必须牢记简洁的价值。

brevity.en: That emphasis on brevity applies even more when you are delivering a speech.
brevity.zh: 在演讲时，强调简洁更适用。

crustacean.en: The blue part of the image is an isopod-a small crustacean.
crustacean.zh: 图片中的蓝色部分是一个等足类动物---一种小型的甲壳纲动物。

crustacean.en: After a dozen years, the crustacean will grow to the size of a tractor tire.
crustacean.zh: 十几年后，这种甲壳纲动物将长到拖拉机轮胎大小。

crustacean.en: Researchers found the 70-millimeter crustacean in the dark shale of an Oklahoma quarry.
crustacean.zh: 研究者在俄克拉荷马采石场的页岩层发现这些70毫米的甲壳纲动物。

keystone.en: That's what a keystone species does in an ecosystem.
keystone.zh: 那就是拱顶石物种在生态系统中的作用。

keystone.en: The government's determination to beat inflation has so far been the keystone of its economic policy.
keystone.zh: 政府对通货膨胀的坚决抑制迄今为止一直是其经济政策的根本。

keystone.en: It might seem that certain traits would clearly define a species as a keystone species.
keystone.zh: 似乎某些特征会清楚地将一个物种定义为关键物种。

magnificently.en: The castle is magnificently sited high up on a cliff.
magnificently.zh: 城堡坐落在高高的悬崖，十分壮观。

magnificently.en: The public have responded magnificently to our appeal.
magnificently.zh: 对于我们的呼吁，公众的反响极为热烈。

magnificently.en: His speeches were magnificently written but his delivery was hopeless.
magnificently.zh: 他的演讲辞写得很好，但他的演讲却不可救药。

bronchitis.en: She had feared she was coming down with pneumonia or bronchitis.
bronchitis.zh: 她担心自己会得肺炎或支气管炎。

bronchitis.en: Ancient cultures used the spice as an antiseptic and to treat cholera and bronchitis.
bronchitis.zh: 在古代文化中，辣椒被用作防腐剂、治疗霍乱和支气管炎。

radioactivity.en: Element 43's radioactivity makes it easy to isolate and measure.
radioactivity.zh: 43号元素的放射性使其易于分离和测量。

radioactivity.en: Born Maria Sklodowska in Poland in 1867, she is famous for her work on radioactivity, and was twice a winner of the Nobel Prize.
radioactivity.zh: 她于1867年出生在波兰，原名玛丽亚·斯克洛多夫斯卡，以放射性研究而闻名，曾两次获得诺贝尔奖。

radioactivity.en: Earth's internal heat, fueled by radioactivity, provides the energy for plate tectonics and continental drift, mountain building, and earthquakes.
radioactivity.zh: 地球内部因放射而产生的热量为板块运动、大陆漂移、造山运动和地震提供了能量。

approachable.en: Despite being a big star, she's very approachable.
approachable.zh: 她虽然是个大明星，却非常平易近人。

approachable.en: It may be to be perceived as more approachable, or more modern and stylish.
approachable.zh: 它可能会被视为更平易近人，或更现代和时尚。

badminton.zh: 打羽毛球的时候，我把跟腱撕裂了。

badminton.en: Try tennis, badminton or windsurfing. In short, anything challenging.
badminton.zh: 试试网球、羽毛球或帆板运动。简而言之，任何有挑战性的东西。

herbivore.en: The herbivore prey is of a different mind.
herbivore.zh: 食草动物的猎物有不同的想法。

herbivore.en: You probably would call me a vegetarian. But scientists call me a herbivore because I only eat leaves, grass, and other plants.
herbivore.zh: 你可能会称我为素食者。但科学家称我为草食动物，因为我只吃叶子、草和其它植物。

herbivore.en: The meat of the herbivore is, in comparison, far more edible and smell wise.
herbivore.zh: 相比之下，食草动物的肉更易食用，闻起来更美味。

presage.en: Does Golden Globe success presage an Oscar?
presage.zh: 荣获金球奖预示着荣膺奥斯卡大奖吗？

presage.en: By certain signs we may presage of heats and rains.
presage.zh: 根据某些迹象，我们可以预告酷热和下雨。

presage.en: What might this presage for Europe's overpriced markets?
presage.zh: 美国这种情况对房价过高的欧洲房市会有什么样的预示作用呢？

causeway.en: The causeway to the island is only accessible at low tide.
causeway.zh: 通往该岛的堤道只有在枯潮时才能通行。

causeway.en: Many tourist attractions there are well worth visiting, such as Sudi Causeway, the Broken Bridge and Leifeng Pagoda.
causeway.zh: 许多旅游景点都很值得参观，比如苏堤，断桥和雷峰塔。

causeway.en: The optimal location would be the 20-mile-long causeway of Afsluitdijk.
causeway.zh: 最佳地点是20英里长的阿夫鲁戴克的河道。

lotus.en: IBM is going to take over Lotus or try to take over Lotus.
lotus.zh: IBM 将接管莲花公司或试图接管莲花公司。

lotus.en: Before long, she took a lotus leaf back and spread it on the table.
lotus.zh: 不久，她拿了一片荷叶回来，铺在桌上。

lotus.en: They wanted to recreate the ability of lotus leaves to resist water.
lotus.zh: 他们想重现荷叶的抗水能力。

antimatter.en: That's because matter and antimatter are basically opposites of each other.
antimatter.zh: 那是因为物质和反物质本质上是对立的。

antimatter.en: From bizarre antimatter to experiments that tie light up in knots, physics has revealed some spooky sides of our world.
antimatter.zh: 从奇异的反物质到把光捆扎成结的实验，物理学已经揭示了我们世界的一些幽灵般的方面。

antimatter.en: That may sound odd, but the fact is at the moment of the big bang, both matter and antimatter were created for a short time.
antimatter.zh: 那听起来可能很奇怪，但事实是：在大爆炸的那一刻，物质和反物质都在很短的时间内被创造出来。

astrophysics.en: At 19, when I began studying astrophysics, it did not bother me in the least to be the only woman in the classroom.
astrophysics.zh: 19岁那年，当我开始学习天体物理学时，作为教室里唯一的女生，我丝毫没有感到困扰。

astrophysics.en: A degree in astrophysics equips the student for a variety of careers at observatories, planetaria, and educational institutions.
astrophysics.zh: 天体物理学学位使学生有众多的职业选择，比如气象台的职位、天文馆和教育行业等。

astrophysics.en: Space and time. Sounds like an astrophysics course, right?
astrophysics.zh: 空间和时间，这听起来，像不像天文课程上学的东西？

platitude.en: The talk is no more than a platitude.
platitude.zh: 这番话无非是老生常谈。

platitude.en: But this is just a reassuring platitude.
platitude.zh: 但这不过是用来安慰人的陈词滥调。

sociable.en: She was, and remained, extremely sociable, enjoying dancing, golf, tennis, skating, and bicycling.
sociable.zh: 她以前是，现在依然是极其好交际，喜欢跳舞、打高尔夫、打网球、滑冰和骑自行车。

sociable.en: For sociable souls, meeting new people by staying in their homes is part of the charm.
sociable.zh: 对于善于交际的人来说，呆在家里结识新朋友是魅力的一部分。

sociable.en: I'm not feeling very sociable this evening.
sociable.zh: 今晚我不大想跟人应酬。

verbatim.zh: 他逐字报道了那篇讲话。

verbatim.en: I was treated to a verbatim report of every conversation she's taken part in over the past week.
verbatim.zh: 有人给了我一份报告，上面一字不差地记录了她在过去的一周中参与的每一次谈话。

verbatim.zh: 在本例中更适合使用逐字插入，因为这里的目标是精确地复制游标上方的文本。

fastidious.zh: 她不过分讲究个人卫生。

fastidious.en: He was fastidious in his preparation for the big day.
fastidious.zh: 他认真仔细地准备着这个盛大的日子。

aggravation.en: Such solidarity is necessary if we are to avoid a proliferation and aggravation of tensions relating to water.
aggravation.zh: 如果我们要避免与水有关的紧张局势扩散和恶化，这种团结是必要的。

aggravation.en: I don't need all this aggravation at work.
aggravation.zh: 我工作时不需要这一切恼人的事。

aggravation.en: The drug may cause an aggravation of the condition.
aggravation.zh: 这种药可能导致病情恶化。

watercress.en: We feed our group a range of plants including watercress, Chinese leaf and dandelion leaves.
watercress.zh: 我们为我们的小组提供一系列植物，包括豆瓣菜，中国叶和蒲公英叶。

watercress.en: They can also be steamed and served on watercress with a plum sauce.
watercress.zh: 它们也可以蒸，和着西洋菜拌上苏梅酱一起食用。

watercress.en: Extracts from crushed watercress were also shown to inhibit the growth of breast cancer cells.
watercress.zh: 粉碎豆瓣菜的提取物还可以抑制乳腺癌细胞的生长。

unobtrusive.en: The service at the hotel is efficient and unobtrusive.
unobtrusive.zh: 那旅馆的服务工作有效率而不夸张。

unobtrusive.zh: 咖啡茶几是玻璃制的，尽可能地不引人注目。
它看起来一点都不唐突。

neurosis.en: The country has the advantage of peace and quiet, but suffers from the disadvantage of being cut off; the city breeds neurosis and a feeling of isolation—constant noise batters the senses.
neurosis.zh: 这个国家有和平宁静的优点，但也有与世隔绝的缺点；城市滋生了神经衰弱症和孤立感——连续的噪音冲击着人们的感官。

neurosis.zh: 他的忧虑达到了神经机能病症状的程度。

subsection.zh: 第(6)款保证该州将遵守第(f)条的规定；以及。

subtropical.zh: 我们已经对珊瑚礁通常是在哪里形成的问题进行了讨论，它们是在热带或亚热带地区沿着浅海海岸的边缘形成的，而它们的数量正在以惊人的速度减少。

subtropical.en: Many are found in tropical and subtropical areas of the world, where the accumulation of high concentrations of metals may afford some protection against plant-eating insects and microbial pathogens.
subtropical.zh: 许多超富集植物被发现于热带地区和亚热带地区，在那里，高浓度金属元素的积累可以为植物提供保护来对抗以植物为食的昆虫和细菌病原体。

subtropical.zh: 一群西鳞白鲳在日本亚热带的小笠原群岛附近的海面上徘徊。

miniskirt.zh: 她穿着迷你裙和紧身上衣走下飞机。

miniskirt.zh: 它们变得越来越短，直到迷你裙流行起来。

miniskirt.zh: 你觉得这配一件迷你裙怎么样？

disenchantment.zh: 这些人向他叙述的觉醒故事惊人地相似。

disenchantment.zh: 然而这一决定或许只会让选民对于欧盟更加不抱幻想。
