mime.zh: 演出包括舞蹈、音乐和哑剧。

mime.en: We communicated mainly by signs, gesticulation, and mime.
mime.zh: 我们主要通过信号、手势和哑剧动作来交流。

carpentry.zh: 木工是需要纯熟技巧的职业。

carpentry.en: We need people with practical skills like carpentry.
carpentry.zh: 我们需要有木工等实用技术的人。

carpentry.en: The supervisor also performs some of the carpentry duties if time permits.
carpentry.zh: 如果时间允许，主管还会做一些木工活。

appreciable.en: The new regulations will not make an appreciable difference to most people.
appreciable.zh: 新的规定对大多数人将无大影响。

appreciable.en: There has been an appreciable shift in the past week.
appreciable.zh: 在过去的一周，两国关系发生了相当大的转变。

appreciable.en: Did she have any appreciable influence on him, and thus on history?
appreciable.zh: 她有没有试图对他施以影响，从而改变历史呢？

metamorphose.en: The tadpoles metamorphose and emerge onto land.
metamorphose.zh: 蝌蚪变形并现身在陆地上。

metamorphose.en: The simplest explanation for this is that the axolotl lineage alone lost the ability to metamorphose, while others retained it.
metamorphose.zh: 对此最简单的解释是，只有蝾螈谱系失去了变形的能力，而其他族系则保留了这种能力。

metamorphose.en: From a detailed analysis of the salamanders' family tree, however, it is clear that the other lineages evolved from an ancestor that itself had lost the ability to metamorphose.
metamorphose.zh: 然而，通过对蝾螈族谱的详细分析，我们可以清楚地看到，其他谱系分支是从一个本身已经失去了变形的能力的祖先演化而来的。

begrudge.en: You surely don't begrudge him his happiness.
begrudge.zh: 你肯定不是嫉妒他的幸福吧。

begrudge.en: I do not begrudge the money I have lost.
begrudge.zh: 我不痛惜我丢失的那些钱。

begrudge.en: I don't begrudge her being so successful.
begrudge.zh: 我并没有因她如此成功而怏怏不乐。

capsize.en: We were afraid (that) we were going to capsize the boat.
Be careful not to capsize the boat.
A sudden strong wind capsize their boat.
capsize.zh: 突然一阵强风弄翻了他们的船。

averse.en: He's not averse to publicity, of the right kind.
averse.zh: 他不反对宣传，只要是正当的。

averse.en: I mentioned it to Kate and she wasn't averse to the idea.
averse.zh: 我向凯特提起这个想法，她不反对。

fractional.en: You see, fractional reserve banking works both ways.
fractional.zh: 那你看，部分准备金银行制度在两个方向同时运作。

fractional.en: An incredibly tiny fractional variation in the system energy.
fractional.zh: 极小的变化部分，对于系统能量是一个。

footpath.en: Follow this footpath and you'll eventually hit the road.
footpath.zh: 沿着这条小路走，终会走上大路。

footpath.en: Look again at the circle of trees in the middle of the plan, and the footpath that goes around them.
footpath.zh: 再次查看平面图中间的树圈，以及环绕它们的人行道。

tadpole.en: Like most amphibians these begin life in a juvenile "tadpole" state, then metamorphose into the adult form — except for one species, the axolotl, which famously lives its entire life as a juvenile.
tadpole.zh: 像大多数的两栖动物一样，它们从幼年的“蝌蚪”状态蜕变成成年的形式——蝾螈这个物种除外，众所周知，它一生都处于幼年状态。

serviceable.en: Statues and formulas, these mechanical tools of a serviceable use, or rather misuse, of his natural faculties, are the ankle-chains of a continuous immaturity.
serviceable.zh: 雕像和公式，这些有用，或者更确切地说，滥用人类天赋的机械工具，是一种脚镣，持续且不成熟。

serviceable.en: The carpet is worn but still serviceable.
His Arabic was not as good as his English, but serviceable enough.
serviceable.zh: 他的阿拉伯文没有他的英语好，但是足够用了。

irreparable.en: Incidents of this type cause irreparable damage to relations with the community.
irreparable.zh: 此类事件对与该团体的关系造成不可挽回的伤害。

irreparable.en: The move would cause irreparable harm to the organization.
irreparable.zh: 这一举动将给该组织带来不可补救的损害。

irreparable.en: But the damage he did was irreparable.
irreparable.zh: 但是他这样做的损失是难以弥补的。

indigestion.en: Indigestion is a catchall term for any kind of stomach distress.
indigestion.zh: 消化不良是任何胃部疾病的笼统用语。

indigestion.en: Garlic is also good for the treatment of bronchitis, colds, coughs, sore throat, fever and indigestion.
indigestion.zh: 大蒜还有助于治疗支气管炎、感冒、咳嗽、喉痛、发烧和消化不良。

indigestion.en: The poor fellow, with his mind on the Field of Wonders, was suffering from a gold-piece indigestion.
indigestion.zh: 这个可怜的家伙，一心想着奇妙的世界，却患了金币消化不良症。

excrete.en: Another adaptation to the salty environment is the ability to excrete excess salt back to the environment.
excrete.zh: 它们适应咸水环境的另一项进化能力是：将过多的盐分释放回环境中。

excrete.en: To excrete perspiration through the pores of the skin.
excrete.zh: 通过皮肤上的毛孔排泄汗液。

excrete.en: Infected poultry excrete virus in their secretions and faeces.
excrete.zh: 受感染家禽将病毒分泌或排泄到它们的唾液或粪便中。

jailer.en: "In that case you also are free," said the Jailer.
jailer.zh: “既然这样，你也自由了。”狱卒说。

jailer.en: "If the others go, I go, too," said Pinocchio to the Jailer.
jailer.zh: “如果别人去，我也去。”皮诺曹对狱卒说。

larynx.en: The cry occurs when air is brought into contact with the baby's larynx.
larynx.zh: 当空气接触到婴儿的喉咙时，哭声就会响起。

larynx.en: It is composed of cartilage which surrounds the larynx.
larynx.zh: 它是软骨组织包裹喉形成。

larynx.en: Cancer of the larynx: 5.37 men died for every one woman.

botany.en: They shared a common interest in botany.
botany.zh: 他们都对植物学感兴趣。

botany.en: To what degree are you interested in botany?
botany.zh: 你对植物学的兴趣达到什么程度？

botany.en: To earn a Plant Science merit badge, a scout can choose between agronomy, horticulture, or field botany.
botany.zh: 要获得植物科学奖章，侦察员可以在农学、园艺学或野外植物学之间进行选择。

hundredth.en: The bank celebrates its hundredth anniversary in December.
hundredth.zh: 这家银行在12月庆祝其百年华诞。

hundredth.en: Vietnam is celebrating the one hundredth anniversary of the birth of Ho Chi Minh.
hundredth.zh: 越南正在庆祝胡志明的百年诞辰。
今年是她的一百岁生日。

repatriate.en: It was not the policy of the government to repatriate genuine refugees.
repatriate.zh: 遣返真正的难民并不是政府的政策。

repatriate.en: China could, of course, repatriate all the dollars its exporters earn by selling stuff to the U.S..
repatriate.zh: 当然，中国可以将出口商们通过将商品挣来的美元都遣返回美国。

repatriate.en: So maybe it's time to "repatriate" those industries that were off-shored years ago, along with their jobs.
repatriate.zh: 因此，把那些几年前出境的产业，连同与它们一起出境的就业岗位“遣返回国”，也许需要时间。

uncritical.en: Disciplined, uncritical loyalty to political power became his compass for the choices he had to make.
uncritical.zh: 纪律严明、不加批判地忠于政治权力成为了他必须做出的选择的指南针。

uncritical.en: Her uncritical acceptance of everything I said began to irritate me.
uncritical.zh: 我说什么她都不论对错一概接受，这倒惹我不耐烦起来。

uncritical.en: "AI is hugely exciting," she said, "but it has limitations, which present grave dangers given uncritical use."
uncritical.zh: “人工智能技术是非常振奋人心的，”她说，“但它有局限性：如果在使用时不加以分辨，会带来重大危险。”

slander.en: Dr. Bach is now suing the company for slander.
slander.zh: 巴赫博士现在正在控告该公司犯诽谤罪。

originator.en: Johnson is a great early jazz pianist, originator of the 1920s Harlem "stride" style, and an important blues and jazz composer.
originator.zh: 约翰逊是一位伟大的早期爵士钢琴家，20世纪20年代哈莱姆“跨步”风格的鼻祖，也是一位重要的蓝调和爵士作曲家。

originator.en: As the originator of the theory of evolution, Darwin believed that the universal recognition of facial expressions would have survival value.
originator.zh: 作为进化论的创始人，达尔文认为对面部表情的普遍识别具有攸关存亡的价值。

originator.en: The "coca" in the name referred to the extracts of coca leaf that the drink's originator, chemist John Pemberton, mixed with his sugary syrup.
originator.zh: 名称中的“可口”指的是古柯叶提取物，这种饮料的发明者化学家约翰·彭伯顿把古柯叶提取物与糖浆混合在一起。

bothersome.en: Here was treasure-hunting under the happiest auspices--there would not be any bothersome uncertainty as to where to dig.
bothersome.zh: 这里真是找宝的好地方，到哪里去挖，一点也不麻烦。

bothersome.en: Just because I would not listen to that bothersome Cricket, who knows how many misfortunes may be awaiting me!
bothersome.zh: 就因为我不听那讨厌的蟋蟀的话，谁知道会有多少不幸在等着我呢！

bothersome.en: But this is starting to get bothersome.
bothersome.zh: 但是现在开始有些烦人了。

guesswork.en: It was pure guesswork on our part.
We don't deal in rumours or guesswork.
guesswork.zh: 我们不听信谣言，也不胡乱猜测。

guesswork.en: We can't make a decision based on hearsay and guesswork.
guesswork.zh: 我们不能根据传言和猜测作决定。

melatonin.en: Taking melatonin medicine has been suggested to those who are trying to fall asleep at night.
melatonin.zh: 有人建议那些想在晚上入睡的人服用褪黑激素药物。

melatonin.en: Taking melatonin drugs has been suggested to those who are struggling to fall asleep at night.
melatonin.zh: 对于那些在夜间难以入睡的人，建议服用褪黑激素药物。

melatonin.en: When spring's light comes, the melatonin diminishes, and suddenly we are awakened to the dusty, virus-filled house we've been hibernating in for four months.
melatonin.zh: 当春天的阳光来临时，褪黑激素减少了，突然间我们被唤醒，回到了我们冬眠了四个月、布满灰尘、病毒的房子。

sonata.en: Malcolm wanted to mix the beginning of a sonata, then add Beethoven for a few measures, then go back to Bach.
sonata.zh: 马尔科姆想要在开头部分加入一段奏鸣曲，然后加上几个小节的贝多芬作品，然后再回到巴赫的作品。

sonata.en: The music is abrupt and seemingly disconnected, as in the last piano sonata.
sonata.zh: 音乐很突然，似乎不连贯，就像在最后的钢琴奏鸣曲。

sonata.en: The music is abrupt and seemingly disconnected, as in the last piano sonata.
sonata.zh: 音乐很突然，似乎不连贯，就像在最后的钢琴奏鸣曲。

propellant.en: This saves valuable chemical propellant and extends mission lifetime.
propellant.zh: 这样既可以节省珍贵的化学燃料，又可以延长航天器的寿命。

propellant.en: Without those propellant burns, the station would eventually drop from orbit.
propellant.zh: 没有这些推进器的点燃，空间站最终会从轨道降落。

perishable.en: The company does not accept liability for fragile, valuable or perishable articles.
perishable.zh: 公司对于易碎、贵重或易腐烂的物品不负责任。

perishable.en: Butter is perishable and can go rancid.

perishable.zh: 自然主义与脆弱的环境。

ostentatious.en: His wife was fairly quiet but she is not an ostentatious person anyway.
ostentatious.zh: 他的妻子过去相当文静，而现在也不是一个爱招摇的人。

ostentatious.en: Obviously he had plenty of money and was generous in its use without being ostentatious.
ostentatious.zh: 显而易见，他有很多钱，花钱虽大方却不摆阔。

unsophisticated.en: It was music which unsophisticated audiences enjoyed listening to.
unsophisticated.zh: 这是那些不懂世故的听众喜欢听的音乐。

unsophisticated.en: The cattle herders had only a few possessions: unsophisticated pots and polished adzes.
unsophisticated.zh: 牧民们只有几样东西：一些并不精致的陶罐和磨光的斧子。

unsophisticated.en: He was so genuine and unsophisticated that no introduction would serve to introduce him, more than if you introduced a woodchuck to your neighbor.
unsophisticated.zh: 他是这样单纯、毫不虚伪，无需用介绍的方式来介绍他，正如你无需给你的邻居介绍土拨鼠一样。

monogamy.en: In many non-Western societies, however, monogamy has never dominated.
monogamy.zh: 然而，在很多非西方社会，一夫一妻制从未占主导地位。

monogamy.en: People in rich countries value monogamy and tend not to stray often.
monogamy.zh: 富裕国家的人重视一夫一妻制，并倾向于不经常出轨。

monogamy.en: People still opt for monogamy and marriage.
monogamy.zh: 人们还是选择单一配偶制和婚姻。

microbiology.en: His work advanced the science of microbiology.
microbiology.zh: 他的工作促进了微生物学这门科学。

microbiology.en: Dr. McCormack is a British microbiology researcher.
microbiology.zh: 麦克科马克医生是一名英国的微生物研究人员。

microbiology.en: In 2007, my lab at Clemson University published a study in the Journal of Applied Microbiology.
microbiology.zh: 2007年，我在克莱姆森大学的实验室在《应用微生物学杂志》上发表了一项研究。

overpass.en: They'd taken refuge under an overpass to ride out the flames.
overpass.zh: 他们在天桥下避难，从火中开车逃出来。

overpass.en: They deflated the tires slightly to allow the truck to drive under the overpass.
overpass.zh: 他们稍微放掉车胎的气以让卡车在跨线桥下行驶。

overpass.en: The mud volcano was absent in a previous overpass on February 11, 2010, shown in the lower image.
overpass.zh: 该泥火山在2010年2月11日同一地点所摄图像中并未出现，如图2所示。

leniency.en: The judge rejected pleas for leniency and sentenced him to a year in prison.
leniency.zh: 法官驳回了宽大处理的请求，判处他一年的监禁。

leniency.en: She appealed to the judge for leniency.
leniency.zh: 她向法官请求宽大处理。

leniency.en: The victim's widow protested at the leniency of the sentence.
leniency.zh: 受害人的遗孀抗议判决太轻。

hydrate.en: After-sun products will cool and hydrate your skin.
hydrate.zh: 晒后护肤品会清凉肌肤并为其补水。

hydrate.en: Water. Be sure to hydrate throughout the day.
hydrate.zh: 一整天都应确保水的摄入。

unbeatable.en: These resorts remain unbeatable in terms of price.
unbeatable.zh: 这些度假胜地在价格上仍是无可匹敌的。

unbeatable.en: With two more days of competition to go China is in an unbeatable position.
unbeatable.zh: 比赛进行到最后两天时，中国队已处于无敌手的地位。

unbeatable.en: Cassie was sure they would be unbeatable beans.
unbeatable.zh: 卡西确信它们会是不可战胜的豆子。

shrinkage.en: She bought a slightly larger size to allow for shrinkage.
shrinkage.zh: 她买了一件尺码稍大的以备缩水。

shrinkage.en: As a result of this "shrinkage" as the shops call it, the honest public has to pay higher prices.
shrinkage.zh: 由于这种商店所称的“缩水”，诚实的公众不得不支付更高的价格。

shrinkage.en: They could trace the growth and shrinkage of continental glaciers, even in parts of the ocean where there may have been no great change in temperature—around the equator, for example.
shrinkage.zh: 他们可以追踪大陆冰川的生长和收缩，即使是在温度变化不大的海洋区域——比如，赤道附近。

phonograph.en: In the phonograph parlors, customers listened to recordings through individual ear tubes, moving from one machine to the next to hear different recorded speeches or pieces of music.
phonograph.zh: 在留声机厅里，顾客通过单只耳道听录音，从一台机器转到另一台，听不同的演讲录音或音乐片段。

phonograph.en: By the 1910s, much of the Brazilian first phonograph records are choros.
phonograph.zh: 到1910年代，巴西的第一张留声机唱片大部分都是合唱团的。

girder.zh: 这个大梁的截面是方形的。

girder.en: Down Wall, from girder into street noon leaks.
girder.zh: 华尔街上，正午从桁隙漏到大街。

girder.en: Listen, when you start to feel weak, just tell yourself, 'I'm as strong as a girder'.
girder.zh: 听着，当你开始觉得虚弱的时候，就对自己说：‘我像钢梁一样强壮’。

symbiosis.en: The third type of symbiosis, mutualism, benefits both partners in the relationship.
symbiosis.zh: 第三种共生关系是互利共生，这种关系中的双方均能受益。

symbiosis.en: One consequence for coral reefs is that the symbiosis between the corals and algae that constitute a living reef is breaking down.
symbiosis.zh: 珊瑚礁面临的一个后果是，构成活珊瑚礁的珊瑚和藻类之间的共生关系正在瓦解。

symbiosis.en: Another principle often observed in nature is symbiosis, the formation of Allies.
symbiosis.zh: 自然界中经常能观察到的另一法则就是结盟共生。

byway.en: Thanks. Byway, tell your wife she throwsgreat party.
byway.zh: 多谢。还，请告诉尊夫人她办很成功宴会。

byway.en: This bumpy, meandering byway is difficult to negotiate.
byway.zh: 这条崎岖的羊肠小道非常难走。

byway.en: I've planned each charted course, each careful step along the byway.
byway.zh: 我计划了每条规划的路线，一路上每个小心的脚步。

cogent.en: She put forward some cogent reasons for abandoning the plan.
cogent.zh: 她为放弃这个计划提出了一些具有说服力的理由。

cogent.en: Every decision has to be backed up with rational and cogent arguments.
cogent.zh: 每项决定都应该有合理和令人信服的论据做支持。

cogent.en: Hamilton, noting that the eggs develop within their host—the larva of another insect—and that the newly emerged adult wasps mate immediately and disperse, offered a remarkably cogent analysis.
cogent.zh: 汉密尔顿指出，黄蜂卵在寄主即另一种昆虫的幼虫内发育，新出现的成年黄蜂立即交配并四散，这提供了一个非常有说服力的分析。

cellulose.en: Ants can't digest the cellulose in leaves—but some fungi can.
cellulose.zh: 蚂蚁不能消化树叶中的纤维素，但有些真菌可以。

cellulose.en: The polysaccharides are the complex carbohydrates, including starch, glycogen, and cellulose.
cellulose.zh: 多糖是复杂的碳水化合物，包括淀粉、糖原和纤维素。

cellulose.en: "The most important about this discovery is TU-103's ability to produce butanol directly from cellulose," said Mullin.
cellulose.zh: “关于这个发现最重要的是 TU-103 从纤维素直接生产丁醇的能力。”穆林说。

plausibility.en: Twenge and her team make a point of saying that they are not trying to establish causes as such, but that they are assessing the plausibility of potential causes.
plausibility.zh: 特温吉和她的团队强调，他们并不是在试图确定原因本身，而是在评估潜在原因的合理性。

plausibility.en: This time around, Twenge and her team make a point of saying that they are not trying to establish causes as such, but that they are assessing the plausibility of potential causes.
plausibility.zh: 这一次，特温吉和她的团队强调，他们并不是试图构建这样的原因，而是在评估潜在原因的合理性。
验证输入的合理性和有效性。

slurry.en: The parameters deciding the quality in polishing process are as follows: slurry, temperature, wafering time, and so on.
slurry.zh: 抛光过程中决定抛光质量的参数有：抛光浆体、抛光温度、抛光时间等。

slurry.en: The results indicate that the semi-solid slurry with much finer and uniformer primary phase particles is gained by self-inoculation method.
slurry.zh: 结果表明，通过自接种法得到具有更细的单相颗粒的半固体泥浆。

slurry.en: Then Greg looked over, slurry-eyed, asked Mandy to join the group.
slurry.zh: 最后看见格雷格用浑浊的眼睛看了看，问曼迪要不要跟他们一起。

pliable.en: Birch bark is pliable and very easy to bend.
pliable.zh: 桦树皮很柔韧，很容易弯曲。

pliable.en: The four states make up the brass buckle on that tough but pliable leather belt.
pliable.zh: 这四个州组成了这条坚韧而柔软的皮带上的铜扣。

pliable.en: As your baby grows bigger, his bones become less pliable.
pliable.zh: 随着你的宝宝慢慢长大，他的骨头柔韧性会变弱。

aqueduct.en: In Rome, you can drink from a street fountain fed by an ancient aqueduct.
aqueduct.zh: 在罗马，你能直接喝街道喷泉里的水，是从古渠道流过来的。

aqueduct.en: Objective: To explore the diagnosis, hearing and treatment of large vestibular aqueduct syndrome.
aqueduct.zh: 目的：探讨大前庭导水管综合征的诊断、听力学表现及治疗。

aqueduct.en: The Pont du Gard is a huge aqueduct half a mile long that was built nearly two thousand years ago.
aqueduct.zh: 加德桥是一个长达半英里的大型输水渠道，大约在两千年前建造而成。

oxidize.en: He has devised a process for making gold wires which neither corrode nor oxidize.
oxidize.zh: 他发明了一种制造程序，使金线既不会腐蚀也不会氧化。

oxidize.en: Too much oxygen would oxidize the iron, a reaction we don't want.
oxidize.zh: 氧气太多会使该铁氧化，这一反应我们是不想要的。

oxidize.en: Some types of die buildup oxidize quickly and turn brown or black.
oxidize.zh: 一些类型的口模积料会很快氧化并变成棕色或者黑色。

mountaineer.en: Rocky Mountaineer offers beautiful mountain and river scenery.
mountaineer.zh: 落基山登山者号提供了美丽的山川风景。

mountaineer.en: In the summer of 2010, mountaineer Gerlinde Kaltenbrunner was almost at the top of a mountain called K2 in Nepal.
mountaineer.zh: 2010年夏天，登山运动员格琳德·卡尔滕布鲁纳差一点就登上了尼泊尔乔戈里峰的山顶。

mountaineer.en: "What a funny, bashful mountaineer!" Mr. Sesemann remarked to himself, thinking that the appearance of a stranger had upset this simple son of the Alps.
mountaineer.zh: “真是个有趣害羞的山地人。”赛赛曼先生自言自语地说，他想，一个陌生人的出现，竟然把这个高山牧场单纯的孩子吓成这个样子。

asymmetric.en: Unless you have an asymmetric set-up, in which case the client can POST and/or PUT its order somewhere on the server.
asymmetric.zh: 除非你有一个不对称的设置，在这种情况下客户端可以 POST 和/或 PUT 它的订单到服务器的某处。

asymmetric.en: Under these conditions, the lobsters developed asymmetric claws, half with crusher claws on the left, and half with crusher claws on the right.
asymmetric.zh: 在这种条件下，龙虾发育出了不对称的爪子，左右一半各是破碎的爪子。

mandarin.en: They no longer spoke Mandarin well enough to answer questions.
mandarin.zh: 他们不再能很好地用普通话来回答问题了。

mandarin.en: All visitors receive the free audio guide in Russian and Mandarin.
mandarin.zh: 所有的游客都能得到免费的俄语和普通话语音指南。

mandarin.en: In Mandarin, The Forbidden City is called the Purple Forbidden City.
mandarin.zh: 在普通话中，紫禁城被称为紫色的紫禁城。

conveyance.en: Mahoney had never seen such a conveyance before.
conveyance.zh: 马霍尼从来没见过这种运输工具。

conveyance.en: He indicated that the little house must be used as a conveyance.
conveyance.zh: 他指出那座小房子必须用作交通工具。

conveyance.en: The miners rode a conveyance attached to a cable made of braided steel wire.
conveyance.zh: 矿工们乘坐连着钢索的缆车。

tenfold.en: The two companies grew tenfold in the ensuing ten years.
tenfold.zh: 这两家公司在随后10年里增长了10倍。

tenfold.en: Its numbers fall tenfold to thirty in a typical cycle, and a hundredfold change can occur.
tenfold.zh: 在一个典型的循环中，其数量会以十倍到三十倍减少，甚至会出现一百倍的变化。

tenfold.en: The firm's customer base has expanded more than tenfold in a year.
tenfold.zh: 该公司的顾客群在一年之内增加了十倍之多。

hibernate.en: When the winter winds blow, some of us would rather hibernate than work out.
hibernate.zh: 当冬天的风吹来的时候，我们中的一些人宁愿冬眠也不愿出去工作。

hibernate.en: My current pet name for her is "bear" because she has to hibernate every night.
hibernate.zh: 我现在给她的爱称是“熊熊”，因为她每天晚上都要冬眠。

hibernate.en: Unlike squirrels, woodchucks, and many other woodland animals, bears do not actually hibernate.
hibernate.zh: 与松鼠、旱獭和许多其他林地动物不同，熊实际上并不冬眠。

celluloid.en: King's works seem to lack something on celluloid.
celluloid.zh: 金的作品似乎在电影里缺了些什么。

celluloid.en: The variety of plastic objects at risk is dizzying: early radios, avant-garde sculptures, celluloid animation stills from Disney films, the first artificial heart.
celluloid.zh: 有风险的塑料制品种类繁多，令人眼花缭乱：早期的收音机、先锋派雕塑、迪士尼电影公司的动画电影剧照、第一颗人造心脏等。

celluloid.en: Competing against a celluloid legend is not easy.
celluloid.zh: 要与电影传奇故事竞争并不容易。

flax.en: Fibers of seed plants such as cotton, flax, and hemp are woven into cloth.
flax.zh: 棉花、亚麻和大麻等种子植物的纤维被织成布。

flax.en: Edison's lab tested carbonized filaments made from plants as diverse as baywood, boxwood, hickory, cedar, flax and bamboo.
flax.zh: 爱迪生的实验室测试了取材于不同植物的碳化灯丝，有月桂，黄杨木，胡桃木，雪松，亚麻和竹子。

flax.en: He understood well the importance of international trade and the potential wealth to be gained from the export of flax, hemp, pitch, furs, hides and timber.
flax.zh: 他深知国际贸易的重要性，以及亚麻、大麻、沥青、皮草、兽皮和木材等物资出口所能获得的巨大潜在财富。

combustible.en: When a petrol station burns down, you don't just want to know who dropped the cigarette; you want to know why all the combustible fumes escaped.
combustible.zh: 当一座加油站被烧毁，你不仅想知道是谁扔下了烟头，你还想了解所有易燃气体的泄露原因。

combustible.en: The inner envelope filled with helium in the head section of the blimp and the third built-in airbag at the tail is filled with ethane combustible gas.
combustible.zh: 飞船头部的内置气囊中充满了氦气，而置于尾部的第三节内置气囊则充满了乙烷可燃气体。

combustible.en: The ability of coal to release a combustible gas has long been known.
combustible.zh: 煤能够释放易燃气体这一点早已为人所知。

steamboat.en: Tom went on whitewashing the fence--paid no attention to the steamboat.
steamboat.zh: 汤姆继续刷着栅栏，没注意那只汽船。

steamboat.en: What accounts for the great outburst of major inventions in early America—breakthroughs such as the telegraph, the steamboat and the weaving machine?
steamboat.zh: 是什么导致了早期美国例如电报、蒸汽船和织布机的重大发明的大量涌现？

steamboat.en: First came the steamboat; although flatboats and keelboats continued to be important until the 1850's steamboats eventually superseded all other craft in the carrying of passengers and freight.
steamboat.zh: 首先是蒸汽船，虽然1850年时蒸汽船最终取代了所有用来运载乘客和货物的船只，随后平底船和龙骨船仍然相当重要。

meteoric.en: GM's survival would be in even greater doubt without the meteoric growth it is seeing in China.
meteoric.zh: 如果没有在中国的迅速增长，通用汽车的生存将更有疑问。

meteoric.en: The secret of Wal-Mart's meteoric rise over the past five decades has been its obsession with low prices.
meteoric.zh: 沃尔玛过去50年的飞速崛起，秘诀就在于一直采用低价策略。

meteoric.en: What accounts for the sudden meteoric rise in a sport which, after all, is played best by people who are unusually tall?
meteoric.zh: 这项毕竟还是由高得出奇的人打得最好的运动是如何迅速兴起呢？

fantastically.en: He was fantastically handsome – I just fell for him right away.
fantastically.zh: 他帅极了–我对他简直就是一见钟情。

fantastically.en: The first thing we did was rent a fantastically expensive sixth-floor apartment the size of a cupboard.
fantastically.zh: 我们做的第一件事就是租了一个非常昂贵的公寓，在第六层，只有一个橱柜那么大。

fantastically.en: The first task will be fantastically expensive.
fantastically.zh: 第一个任务的成本将会是异常昂贵。

petrol.zh: 所有的新汽车都加无铅汽油。

petrol.en: We drove there and back on one tank of petrol.
petrol.zh: 我们开车去那里来回用了一油箱汽油。

chivalry.en: The Order of the Garter is an ancient order of chivalry.
chivalry.zh: 嘉德勋位是古老的骑士勋位。

chivalry.en: He has been described as the creature and embodiment of the age of chivalry.
chivalry.zh: 他被描述为骑士时代的产物和化身。

chivalry.en: This courtly poetry came out of the idea of chivalry and courtly love that you might associate with knights in shining armor.
chivalry.zh: 这种宫廷风格的诗歌来源于骑士精神和宫廷式的爱情，你可能会把它与穿着闪亮盔甲的骑士联系在一起。

horticulture.en: With trade barriers in place, the horticulture industry in Kenya will shrivel as quickly as a discarded rose.
horticulture.zh: 由于贸易壁垒的存在，肯尼亚的园艺产业将会像遗弃的玫瑰一样迅速枯萎。

horticulture.en: Dutch peasants were able to remain unaffected by this crisis for a long time because they had specialized in dairy farming, industrial crops, and horticulture.
horticulture.zh: 荷兰的农民能够在很长一段时间内不受这场危机的影响，因为他们专门从事于奶牛养殖、工业作物和园艺的工作。

horticulture.en: In addition to dairy farming and cultivating industrial crops, a third sector of the Dutch economy reflected the way in which agriculture was being modernized—horticulture.
horticulture.zh: 除了奶牛养殖和工业作物种植，荷兰经济的第三部分反映了农业现代化的方式——园艺。

acrobatic.en: We got a lot of acrobatic types of people.
This is not the average cultural exchange. There are no obscure acrobatic troupes and no awkward high school students.
acrobatic.zh: 这不是一般的文化交流。这里没有不起眼的杂技团，也没有笨拙的高中生。

acrobatic.en: She shunned bodily ornamentation and strove to use only the natural movements of her body, undistorted by acrobatic exaggeration and stimulated only by internal compulsion.
acrobatic.zh: 她避开身体上的装饰，努力只使用身体的自然动作，不被杂技般的夸张所扭曲，只被内心的强迫所刺激。

emboss.en: Add Bevel and Emboss and Gradient Overlay.
emboss.zh: 添加斜面和浮雕和渐变叠加。

emboss.en: The silver vase is emboss with a design of flower.
emboss.zh: 这银花瓶上刻有花卉浮雕图案。

emboss.en: Bevel and Emboss layer styles add 3d effect on our shape.
emboss.zh: 倾斜和浮雕花纹层风格添加3d影响我们的形状。

apportion.en: The programme gives the facts but does not apportion blame.
apportion.zh: 这个节目只摆出事实，并不评论谁是谁非。

apportion.en: The purpose of this exercise is not to apportion blame but to solve problems.
apportion.zh: 这项工作的目的不是追究责任而是解决问题。

apportion.en: To apportion blame is not the constructive thing to do.
apportion.zh: 推卸责任不是在做建设性的事。

cataclysm.en: Cataclysm is likely to be the biggest release of next year.
cataclysm.zh: “魔兽世界·大灾难”很可能是明年发布的最畅销游戏。

cataclysm.en: The immediate cause for this cataclysm was the recession.
cataclysm.zh: 这次灾变的直接原因是这次经济衰退。

cataclysm.en: Some warned of a housing bubble, but almost none foresaw the resulting cataclysm.
cataclysm.zh: 也有些学者曾经警告人们有房市泡沫，然而几乎没有人预料到这个灾难性的结果。

ulterior.en: Sheila had an ulterior motive for trying to help Stan.
ulterior.zh: 希拉设法帮助斯坦是别有用心。

ulterior.en: I have an ulterior motive in offering to help you.
ulterior.zh: 我主动提出要帮助你是有私心的。

ulterior.en: Relevant report is totally groundless and out of ulterior motives.
ulterior.zh: 有关报道毫无根据，是别有用心的。

impassable.en: In ancient mythology there was no impassable gulf separating the divine from the human beings.
impassable.zh: 在上古神话中，神与人之间没有不可逾越的鸿沟。

impassable.en: The avenue had never been paved, and deep mud made it impassable in winter.
impassable.zh: 这条大街从来没有铺过，深泥使其在冬天无法通行。

impassable.en: A piece of impassable bog with yield of liquid peat.
impassable.zh: 一个不可逾越的泥沼区。

steamship.en: The first development in modern transportation was the steamship.
steamship.zh: 现代交通的第一次发展是蒸汽船。

steamship.en: You might hope that the columnists of this article can leisurely cross the Panama Canal by steamship.
steamship.zh: 你或许希望这篇文章的专栏作家能悠闲地坐着轮船穿越巴拿马运河。

steamship.en: The steamship veered around for the port.

chlorophyll.en: Why does chlorophyll need protection when it is the natural world's supreme light absorber?
chlorophyll.zh: 为什么叶绿素是自然界最高等的光吸收体，却需要保护？

chlorophyll.en: It's colder there, they're more stressed, their chlorophyll is more sensitive and it needs more sunblock.
chlorophyll.zh: 那里更冷，它们受到更大压力，它们的叶绿素更敏感，并且需要更多的避光措施。

chlorophyll.en: Why protect chlorophyll at a time when the tree is breaking it down to salvage as much of it as possible?
chlorophyll.zh: 在树木将叶绿素分解，以尽可能多地将其回收的时候，为什么我们还要保护叶绿素呢？

transmute.en: These entities, even while occupying a body, could transmute matter.
transmute.zh: 这些实体，即使在占用身体时，也能改变物质。

transmute.en: That is all you need for your protection, as it will deflect or transmute the dark energies.
transmute.zh: 那是你最大的保护力，因为它可以“转移”或者“改变”黑暗的能量。

transmute.en: It will in time transmute or disintegrate, as a point will be reached when it cannot remain any longer.
transmute.zh: 它将适时转化或者瓦解，随着它无法再保持下去的时候，将达到一个临界点。

counterclockwise.en: The idea that he had was, if you go from me to you, with a clockwise rotation, you go from you to me by a counterclockwise rotation.
counterclockwise.zh: 他的想法是，如果你从我这里到你这里，顺时针旋转，你从你这里到我这里是逆时针旋转。

counterclockwise.en: The dance moves in a counterclockwise direction.
counterclockwise.zh: 这个舞是逆时针移动的。

refract.en: As we age, the lenses of the eyes thicken, and thus refract light differently.
refract.zh: 随着我们年龄的增长，眼睛的晶状体变厚，因此对光线的折射也会发生变化。

refract.en: It takes an artist 4 hours to refract and reflect light to paint the Outlines of a car.
refract.zh: 艺术家要花4个小时来折射和反射光线，以画出每辆汽车的轮廓。

refract.en: Having one direction along which double refract ion of light does not take place. Used of a crystal.
refract.zh: 单轴晶体的有一个方向的，沿此方向不发生光的双折射。用于晶体。

defile.en: Insults alone cannot defile a person's honour.
defile.zh: 仅靠辱骂不可能败坏一个人的名誉。

defile.en: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
defile.zh: 这一切的恶，都是从里面出来，且能污秽人。

defile.en: It is our SINS, our transgressions against God's Law, that defile us.
defile.zh: 是我们的罪过违反了上帝的法则，使我们受到玷污。

starchy.en: Focus on healthful whole grains, beans and starchy vegetables.
starchy.zh: 重点是那些健康的全谷类，豆类和含淀粉的蔬菜。

starchy.en: But a big starchy meal can give the body more glucose than it needs.
starchy.zh: 但是高淀粉的大餐会让你葡萄糖过剩。

starchy.en: Both men and women began eating more starchy grains, such as corn and wheat, which contain sugars.
starchy.zh: 男女都开始吃更多含有大量淀粉的谷物，比如玉米和小麦，这些谷物含有糖。

consignment.en: The first consignment of food was flown in yesterday.
consignment.zh: 第一批食品昨天空运到了。

consignment.en: She sold clothes on consignment to benefit homeless people.
consignment.zh: 她以代售方式卖服装来施益于无家可归的人。

consignment.en: These kinds of risks suit your consignment。
consignment.zh: 这些险别适合你要投保的货物。

inoculation.en: This may eventually lead to routine inoculation of children.
inoculation.zh: 这最终可能发展为儿童定期接种疫苗。

inoculation.en: At an orientation meeting, the travelers were told that a visa, a landing card, and evidence of inoculation against typhoid fever would be needed by each of them.
inoculation.zh: 在一次介绍会上，这些旅行者被告知每人都需要签证、入境卡和伤寒疫苗接种证明。

inoculation.en: Serum samples were collected on 30, 60 and 140th days post inoculation.
inoculation.zh: 分别于接种后30、60和140天收集血清样本。

unaccountable.en: For some unaccountable reason, the letter never arrived.
unaccountable.zh: 不知何故，那封信始终未寄到。

unaccountable.en: For some unaccountable reason, it struck me as extremely funny.
unaccountable.zh: 很难解释是什么原因让我觉得它极为可笑。

unaccountable.en: It was strange; it was wonderful; yes, it was unaccountable--so all said that heard it.
unaccountable.zh: 这是奇怪的；这是奇妙的；是的，这是不可思议的——所有听到的人都这么说。

tempest.en: For some, it may seem silly, a tempest in a teapot.
tempest.zh: 对有些人来说，这似乎很荒唐，是小题大做。

tempest.en: I hadn't foreseen the tempest my request would cause.
tempest.zh: 我没有想到我的请求会带来这么大一场风波。

tempest.en: By and by the tempest spent itself and died without accomplishing its object.
tempest.zh: 渐渐地，暴风雨耗尽了它的力量，没有达到目的就消失了。

hominid.en: Olduvai Gorge, an early hominid site in Tanzania, was found by a butterfly hunter who literally fell into its deep valley in 1911.
hominid.zh: 坦桑尼亚早期的原始人类遗址，奥杜瓦伊峡谷是1911年，一名蝴蝶猎人掉进峡谷深处时发现的。

hominid.en: A Harvard anthropologist has proposed that using fire to cook food could be dated back to almost two million years and that it could explain hominid features like having a large brain and small teeth.
hominid.zh: 哈佛大学的一位人类学家提出，用火做饭可以追溯到近200万年前，这可以解释人类的一些特征，比如大脑大，牙齿小。

hominid.en: A hominid is really any extinct ape more closely related to us than the chimpanzee.
hominid.zh: 原始人类中任何一个灭绝的猿物种和我们的关系都比黑猩猩更密切。

unblemished.en: This method was very effective as the glass had not touched any surfaces between being soft and becoming hard, so it stayed perfectly unblemished, with a "fire finish".
unblemished.zh: 这个方法非常有效，因为玻璃在从软变硬的过程中并没有触及任何物体的表面，因而在经过“火抛光”处理后能保持完美无瑕。

unblemished.en: When we are born, we are unblemished.
unblemished.zh: 当我们出生时，我们是纯洁无瑕的。

quay.en: A crowd was waiting on the quay.
quay.zh: 有一群人在码头上等着。

quay.en: A number of fishing boats were moored to the quay.
Jack and Stephen were waiting for them on the quay.
quay.zh: 杰克和斯蒂芬正在码头等他们。

repackage.en: Think about ways to repackage your skills.
repackage.zh: 想想办法来重新包装您的技能。

repackage.en: Repackage and deploy the PetStore application.war file.
repackage.zh: 重新打包并部署PetStore应用程序的. war文件。

repackage.en: Repackage externally referenced Web modules within the EAR.
repackage.zh: 在EAR中对外部引用的Web模块重新打包。

conductive.en: Salt water is much more conductive than fresh water is.
conductive.zh: 盐水比淡水更具有传导性。

conductive.en: Key are conductive fibers made of polymers doped with additives, such as camphorsulfonic acid.
conductive.zh: 关键是由加了添加剂的聚合物，如樟脑磺酸制成的导电纤维。

conductive.en: The most common conductive material used is copper.
conductive.zh: 最常见的导电材料是铜。

trapeze.en: Install a trapeze swing onto their swing set.
trapeze.zh: 在他们的秋千组合上，安装吊架。

trapeze.en: Swiftly, neatly, with the grace of the young man on the flying trapeze, he was gone from his body.
trapeze.zh: 带着飞荡的高架秋千上那个年轻人的优雅姿态，他灵巧而敏捷地从躯体里走出来。

trapeze.en: A beautiful trapeze artist agrees to marry the leader of the circus performers who is also a dwarf.
trapeze.zh: 一位漂亮的荡秋千演员同意与马戏团演员的领导结婚，他也是一位侏儒。

strapless.en: This is no metaphor, here is the strapless watch.
strapless.zh: 这并不是比喻，没有表带的手表就在这里。

strapless.en: Strapless ball gowns and miniskirts were popular – among the women, of course.
strapless.zh: 露肩的舞会礼服和迷你裙大受欢迎——当然是在女人当中。

strapless.en: The guys were wearing black tuxes like Keith and the girls were wearing light pink strapless dresses.
strapless.zh: 小伙子们像基斯一样都穿着的黑色晚礼服，姑娘们则身穿浅红色无肩带礼服。

exhalation.en: Utter the word "calm" in your mind with every exhalation.
exhalation.zh: 在你的内心浮想“平静”这个词。

exhalation.en: He yawned in reverse: first an exhalation, then an inhalation.
exhalation.zh: 他打了个哈欠：先呼气，后吸气。

exhalation.en: With an exhalation, bring your feet up, keeping your knees bent near your chest.
exhalation.zh: 随着呼气，抬起你的双脚，双膝弯曲着靠近胸腔。

rapidity.zh: 如此迅速的下滑，其程度令人震惊。

rapidity.en: She afterward descended with so much rapidity that I lost my senses.
rapidity.zh: 她后来下降的如此极速我失去了意识。

practicable.zh: 它为商人提供切实可行的建议。

practicable.en: Please weigh the above points and see if they are practicable.
practicable.zh: 以上几点意见是否可行， 请酌定。

practicable.en: It is not practicable to offer her the original job back.
practicable.zh: 让她重回原工作岗位是不可行的。

curative.en: Too much is spent on curative medicine and too little on preventive medicine.
curative.zh: 在治疗医学上花费太多，而在预防医学上花费太少。

curative.en: The objective is to observe curative effect of complex therapy for patients with peritendinitis on the muscle tendon for crooking.
curative.zh: 目的是观察综合疗法对腱鞘炎患者弯曲肌腱的疗效。

curative.en: Analyze the etiology, therapeutic methods and curative effect of postoperative gastroplegia syndrome (PGS) after radical colectomy and proctectomy.
curative.zh: 分析结直肠癌术后胃瘫综合征（PGS）发生的病因、治疗方法和疗效。

deceleration.en: The harder the brake pedal is pressed, the greater the car's deceleration.
deceleration.zh: 刹车板踩得越紧，汽车减速越快。

deceleration.en: The deceleration gives the new medium a different refractive index.
deceleration.zh: 减速使新介质获得不同的折射率。

deceleration.en: The continent will almost surely experience a deceleration in growth.
deceleration.zh: 该大陆几乎肯定会发生增长减速。

meteorology.en: Diels also hopes to see the birth of "interactive meteorology"—not just forecasting the weather but controlling it.
meteorology.zh: 迪尔斯还希望看到“互动气象学”的诞生——不仅仅是预测天气，而是控制它。

meteorology.en: They wouldn't even have been able to get started without earth science understanding—knowledge about wind, storms, meteorology.
meteorology.zh: 如果没有对地球科学的了解——关于风、风暴、气象学的知识，他们甚至不可能起步。

merriment.zh: 她高兴得双眸闪闪发亮。

merriment.en: This unexpected result threw the company into convulsions of merriment.
merriment.zh: 这个意想不到的结果使大家笑得前仰后合。

merriment.en: They lost their heads with the delight of their new amusement, and choked with helpless merriment.
merriment.zh: 他们为这种新的消遣而高兴得发狂，又无可奈何地高兴得透不过气来。

illegality.zh: 但是时代周刊并未发现任何非法行为。

illegality.en: By contrast, illegality is part of the appeal in Italy.
illegality.zh: 不同的是，其非法性对意大利人有一定的吸引力。

hydropower.en: If we had listened to them, this hydropower station would never have been built.
hydropower.zh: 当初要是依了他们的主张，今天就不可能有这个水电站。

hydropower.en: Backup power could also be provided by linking wind farms with a solar cell, with conventional or pumped-storage hydropower, or with efficient natural-gas-burning turbines.
hydropower.zh: 将风力发电厂与太阳能电池、常规或抽水蓄能的水电或高效的天然气涡轮机连接起来，也可以提供备用电力。
水电也有它自身的问题。

shilling.en: Mrs. Medlock said I was to have a shilling a week to spend.
shilling.zh: 梅德洛克太太说我每星期有一先令可以花。

shilling.en: There's twelve of us an' my father only gets sixteen shilling a week.
shilling.zh: 我们家有十二口人，我父亲一星期只挣十六先令。

shilling.en: As the boy stood in doubt, Durbeyfield put his hand into his pocket, and produced a shilling (a unit of money used in Britain until 1971).
shilling.zh: 男孩站在那里犹豫不决的时候，德北菲尔德把手伸进口袋，拿出一先令（1971年前在英国使用的货币单位）。

declarative.en: Some researchers contend that sleep plays no role in the consolidation of declarative memory (i.e., memory involving factual information).
declarative.zh: 一些研究者认为，睡眠对于陈述性记忆（例如：牵扯到事实信息的记忆）的巩固没有影响。
简单的事情应该是声明性的。

luxuriant.en: Hair that's thick and luxuriant needs regular trimming.
luxuriant.zh: 健康浓密的头发需要定期修剪。

luxuriant.en: There was a thin strip of silver beach rising quickly to hills covered to the top with luxuriant vegetation.
luxuriant.zh: 这里有一片狭长的银色沙滩，迅速地延伸到草木繁茂的山顶。

luxuriant.en: He clothed her with the most luxuriant of rain forests and painted her soft, sandy skin a rainbow of colors.
luxuriant.zh: 他为她穿上最华丽的雨林服装，为她柔软的沙色皮肤涂上彩虹般的颜色。

impetuous.en: Although a man of blood and violence, Richard was too impetuous to be either treacherous or habitually cruel.
impetuous.zh: 虽然理查德是一个血腥暴力的人，但他过于冲动，既不奸诈，也不惯于残忍。
詹姆斯·珀内尔年轻浮躁的大臣。

undamaged.zh: 那艘韩国船只显然并未被破坏。

undamaged.en: There was a slight collision but my car was undamaged.
undamaged.zh: 虽有轻微碰撞，但我的汽车没有损坏。

undamaged.en: He emerged from the court case with his reputation undamaged.
undamaged.zh: 他挺过了官司，名声没有受损。

colloquial.en: Almost all idiomatic expressions are colloquial language.
colloquial.zh: 几乎所有的惯用语都是口头语言。

colloquial.en: Ken, compadre, I admire the colloquial style.
colloquial.zh: 肯，老伙计，说实在的我真佩服你这口语化的腔调。
注意最后口语化的表达，“去吧。”

aeration.en: This is to avoid aeration caused by droplets.
aeration.zh: 这是为了避免因曝气而引起的飞沫传播。

aeration.en: Post aeration – Air scouring continues after the liquid backwash ends.
aeration.zh: 邮局充气–空气擦亮在液态的冲洗末端之后继续。

aeration.en: The zone of aeration may be treated more efficiently as a single moisture continuum.
aeration.zh: 包气带可以更有效地作为一个单一的水分连续介质来看待。

breakage.en: Brushing wet hair can cause stretching and breakage.
breakage.zh: 梳刷湿的头发会导致拉抻和破损。

breakage.en: Any business needs insurance against ordinary risks such as fire, flood, and breakage.
breakage.zh: 任何企业都需要保险来防备诸如火灾、洪灾和破损等常见风险。

breakage.en: From a practical aspect this protected the figures against breakage and psychologically gives the images a sense of strength and power, usually enhanced by a supporting back pillar.
breakage.zh: 从实用的角度来看，这保护了雕像，让它们不破裂，并在心理上赋予形象一种强壮有力的感觉，这种感觉通常又被一个在后方支撑的柱子加强。

porpoise.en: There's a porpoise close behind us, and he's treading on my tail.
porpoise.zh: 我们后面有一只海豚，它正踩着我的尾巴。

porpoise.en: One would have thought that Pinocchio had turned into a porpoise playing in the sun.
porpoise.zh: 人们大概会以为，皮诺乔变成了一只海豚，在阳光下玩耍。

porpoise.en: The finless porpoise prefer to live in shallow, warm waters like those of theYangtze River.
porpoise.zh: 江豚喜欢生活在长江这种较为温暖，黑暗的水中。

blameless.en: None of us is entirely blameless in this matter.
blameless.zh: 在这件事上我们没有一个人是完全没有责任的。

blameless.en: The U.S. itself, of course, is not entirely blameless in trading matters.
blameless.zh: 当然，美国本身在贸易问题上并非完全无可指责。

knotty.en: The new management faces some knotty problems.
knotty.zh: 新的管理层面临着一些棘手的问题。

knotty.en: Einstein would furiously play his violin as a way to think through a knotty physics problem.
knotty.zh: 爱因斯坦会以疯狂地拉小提琴的方式来思考一个复杂的物理问题。

deface.zh: 在房子上乱涂乱画是非法的。

deface.en: I bet the defacer was thinking "if I can't deface NSA, I'll deface NASA to send my message regardless".
deface.zh: 我敢打赌，这个损毁者在想“如果我不能破坏国家安全局，我就破坏国家宇航局来发送我的信息”。

deface.en: Then let not winter's ragged hand deface.
deface.zh: 冬季粗糙手，勿令毁君颜。

smelt.en: In a horrid silence, Mrs. Darling smelt the bowl.
smelt.zh: 达琳太太在可怕的沉默中闻了闻那只碗。
那个房间里散发着浓浓的上光剂的气味。

deform.en: They don't deform easily; they tend to be more brittle.
deform.zh: 它们不容易变形；它们是更脆的。

deform.en: When the glacier comes into contact with bedrock walls or is otherwise under some kind of stress, but can't deform quickly enough.
deform.zh: 当冰川与基岩壁接触，或者在其它方面受到某种压力，但变形速度不够快时。

deform.en: If you leave, for example, a bar of ice supported only at one end, the end, the unsupported end will deform under its own weight, it'll kind of flatten out at one end, get distorted, deformed.
deform.zh: 举个例子，如果你把一根只有一端支撑的冰放在一边，没有支撑的一端会在自身的重量下变形，它的一端会变平，变形。

transference.en: It is a struggle for a transference of power.
transference.zh: 这是一场为了权力转移的斗争。

transference.en: Mobility of this kind meant also mobility of ideas, their transference across frontiers, their simultaneous impact upon many groups of people.
transference.zh: 这种流动也是思想的流动，思想转移跨越国界，与此同时还对许多群体产生着影响。

transference.en: Mobility of this kind also meant mobility of ideas, their transference across frontiers, their simulataneous impact upon many groups of people.
transference.zh: 这种流动也意味着思想的流动，他们跨越国界的转移，他们对许多群体的同时影响。

industrialize.zh: 能源消耗随着各国工业化而增加。

industrialize.en: The southern part of the country was slow to industrialize.
industrialize.zh: 这个国家的南部工业化进程缓慢。

industrialize.en: Many townships in the coastal area have begin to industrialize.
industrialize.zh: 沿海地区的许多乡镇已开始工业化。

studious.en: I was a very quiet, studious little girl.
studious.zh: 我那时是一个非常安静、用功的小女孩。

studious.en: Perhaps they're working hard—they don't appear to be very studious here, but they are very friendly.
studious.zh: 也许他们工作很努力——他们在这里似乎看上去不太用功，但他们很友好。

studious.en: She is quiet and studious, in marked contrast to her sister.
studious.zh: 她沉静勤奋，与她妹妹形成了鲜明的对照。

pantomime.en: Every day along the world's busiest border, an expensive and time-consuming pantomime is acted out.
pantomime.zh: 在这个世界上最繁忙的边境地区，每天都在上演着一场昂贵又费时的哑剧。

pantomime.en: In Thailand, people marked the start of the holiday with an underwater pantomime, complete with clowns, lions and mermaids.
pantomime.zh: 在泰国，人们通过水下哑剧来庆祝节日的开始，还有小丑、狮子和美人鱼。

pantomime.en: She handled their crops, and knew what they had eaten; her face enacted a vivid pantomime of the criticisms passing in her mind.
pantomime.zh: 她摸摸它们的嗉囊，就能知道它们吃了什么；她的脸扮演的是一出生动的哑剧，内心流露的种种批评都从脸上显现出来。

desertification.en: A third of Africa is under threat of desertification.
desertification.zh: 三分之一的非洲大陆面临着荒漠化的威胁。

desertification.en: If we continue to destroy forests, land desertification will be an inevitable result.
desertification.zh: 如果我们继续破坏森林的话，土地沙漠化将会是必然的结果。

desertification.en: The expansion of desert-like conditions into areas where they did not previously exist is called desertification.
desertification.zh: 沙漠化是指类似沙漠的生态环境扩张到原本并没有沙漠的区域。

sandstorm.en: The men lost their way in a sandstorm.
sandstorm.zh: 那些人在沙尘暴中迷路了。

sandstorm.en: His plane made a crash-landing during a sandstorm yesterday.
sandstorm.zh: 昨天他的飞机在沙尘暴中紧急降落。

sandstorm.en: The men lost their way in a sandstorm and crossed the border by mistake.
sandstorm.zh: 这些男人在沙尘暴中迷了路，误越了边境。

onwards.en: The pool is open from 7 a.m. onwards.
onwards.zh: 游泳池从早上7点起开放。
他们从1980年代起一直住在那里。

onwards.en: The little tailor went onwards, always following his own pointed nose.
onwards.zh: 小裁缝继续赶他的路，一直向前走去。

deign.en: A dim form appeared at his side, and a voice said, "Wilt deign to deliver thy commands?"
deign.zh: 一个模模糊糊的人影出现在他身边，一个声音说：“你肯屈尊下达命令吗？”

deign.en: I would not deign to comment on such behaviour.
Hermione did not deign to respond, but approached Harry.
deign.zh: 赫敏没有屈尊回答，而是走向了哈利。

invulnerable.en: Many daughters assume that their mothers are invulnerable.
invulnerable.zh: 许多女儿都臆想她们的母亲不会受到伤害。

invulnerable.en: He might have been called the invulnerable dwarf of the fray.
invulnerable.zh: 可以说，他是混战中的一个无懈可击的侏儒。

invulnerable.en: Micro-Mechanics plans to produce a chip that, because it uses only microscopic mechanical switches, will be invulnerable to radiation damage.
invulnerable.zh: 微机械公司计划生产一种芯片，因为它只使用微小的机械开关，所以不会受到辐射损伤。

unconvincing.en: I find the characters in the book very unconvincing.
unconvincing.zh: 我觉得书中的人物很不真实。

unconvincing.en: This kind of evidence is philosophically unconvincing.
unconvincing.zh: 这类证据在哲学上是不足为信的。

oceanography.en: I want to do advanced study in oceanography when I graduate.
oceanography.zh: 我想在毕业后继续在海洋学领域深造。

oceanography.en: The internship requires me to have a scuba diving certification and to be a senior oceanography student.
oceanography.zh: 这份实习要求我有潜水证书，并且是海洋学专业的大四学生。
海洋学：研究海洋的科学。

ladylike.en: She crossed the room with quick, ladylike steps.
ladylike.zh: 她迈着淑女步快速穿过房间。

ladylike.en: I hate to be blunt, Frankie, but she just didn't strike me as being very ladylike.
ladylike.zh: 恕我直言，弗朗基，但她给我的感觉不是非常端庄。

concealer.en: To start, skip powder and just dab some concealer under your eyes and over blemishes.
concealer.zh: 首先，不要扑粉，只要在眼睛下方和瑕疵处轻拍一些遮瑕膏就可以了。

concealer.en: You can use a concealer to cover the dark circles around your eyes.
concealer.zh: 你可以用一些遮瑕膏盖住你眼睛周围的黑眼圈。

concealer.en: For women under 30, a little mascara and lip gloss; over 30, add a touch of concealer.
concealer.zh: 30岁以下女性，涂些睫毛膏和口红即可；30岁以上的妇女，可用少许遮瑕霜。

navigable.en: Prior to 1815, western farmers who did not live on navigable waterways were connected to them only by dirt roads and mountain trails.
navigable.zh: 1815年之前，那些没有生活在通航的水路旁的西部农民只能从土路和山道前往那些航道。

navigable.en: The lower reaches of the river are navigable for steamers.
navigable.zh: 这河的下游能够行驶轮船。

disreputable.en: It is a wretched palace, and you are not King's children, you are disreputable children!
disreputable.zh: 这是一个肮脏的宫殿，你们不是公主王子，你们是群私生子！

disreputable.en: My actual disreputable motive was that I wanted to be the first to call it.
disreputable.zh: 我真正的龌龊动机是想成为第一个作此断言的人。

disreputable.en: Their armed forces were an ill-equipped, untrained and sometimes disreputable lot.
disreputable.zh: 他们的武装力量装备差，未经训练，有时甚至声名狼藉。

isthmus.en: North and South American species migrating across the Isthmus now came into competition with each other.
isthmus.zh: 北美和南美的物种迁徙穿过地峡，现在开始互相竞争。

isthmus.en: Second, it appears that closely related populations of fishes on both sides of the isthmus are starting to genetically diverge from each other.
isthmus.zh: 其次，地峡两侧紧密相关的鱼类种群似乎开始在基因上彼此分化。

isthmus.en: While previously the gap between the continents had allowed a free flow of water, now the isthmus presented a barrier that divided the Atlantic Ocean from the Pacific Ocean.
isthmus.zh: 以前，大陆之间的鸿沟允许水自由流动；而现在地峡形成了一道屏障，把大西洋和太平洋分隔开来。

addicted.en: People that are addicted to drugs get, er, help from the government one way or another.
addicted.zh: 那些吸毒上瘾的人，呃，通过某种方式获得政府的帮助。

addicted.en: Never think that you can talk him out of the habit if he is addicted.
addicted.zh: 如果他上瘾了，千万不要认为你能说服他改掉这个习惯。
她已经对高尔夫球入迷了。

hornet.en: The body shell of the Oriental hornet converts sunlight into electricity.
hornet.zh: 东方大黄蜂的身体外壳能将阳光转化为电能。

hornet.en: I wonder how different the hornet tissues actually are from those of that butterfly.
hornet.zh: 我想知道这只大黄蜂的组织和那只蝴蝶的有什么不同。

hornet.en: They could soon face a further threat if warmer summers and milder winters encourage the spread of the Asian hornet, which preys on bees.
hornet.zh: 如果更温暖的夏季和更温和的冬季促使捕食蜜蜂的亚洲大黄蜂的散布，它们可能很快就会面临进一步的威胁。

decentralize.en: If you were a manager, would you decentralize authority?
decentralize.zh: 如果你是一位管理者，你愿意实行分权吗？

decentralize.en: And as businesses decentralize and downsize, information systems follow suit.
decentralize.zh: 并且随着企业的分散化和小规模化，信息系统也产生同样的变化。

decentralize.en: How does PPM enhance the quality of diagnosis, treatment, decentralize and make treatment conveniently accessible for patients?
decentralize.zh: 公私混合如何提高诊断和治疗质量？它如何下放权力，便利患者治疗？

prefix.en: Car insurance policies have the prefix MC (for motor car).
prefix.zh: 汽车保险单标有MC代号（表示汽车）。

prefix.en: The prefix "glyc" is used in a generic sense to designate sugars and their derivatives like glyconic acids.
prefix.zh: 前缀 “glyc” 在一般意义上用来表示糖及其衍生物，如 glyconic acids （糖酸） 。

prefix.en: Some terms involved in the process of morphologization don't have clear definitions, such as prefix, suffix, preclitic, enclitic, etc.
prefix.zh: 形态化过程中所涉及的前缀与后缀、前附词与后附词等术语界限模糊。

sinew.en: He was tall and delicately shaped; strong in nerve and sinew, and most dextrous in arms.
sinew.zh: 他个子很高，身材纤细；有着强壮的神经和肌肉和最灵巧的手臂。

sinew.en: All tough sinew, she looked like a hawk eyeing prey.
sinew.zh: 她肌肉强健，看上去像只老鹰盯着它的猎物。

sinew.en: Prayer is the slender sinew that moves the muscle of omnipotence.
sinew.zh: 祷告是细长的肌腱可以牵动无所不能者的肌肉。

millionth.en: Last year the millionth truck rolled off the assembly line.
millionth.zh: 去年，第100万辆卡车驶下了装配线。

millionth.en: Extracting information about the large-scale composition of a planet from a sample weighing a millionth of a gram was a fascinating example of scientific endeavour.
millionth.zh: 从重量为百万分之一克的样品中提取有关行星宏观组成的信息是一个极为有趣的科学尝试实例。

millionth.en: It ain't a millionth part of it!
millionth.zh: 那不是它的百万分之一！

pollinate.en: Many of the indigenous insects are needed to pollinate the local plants.
pollinate.zh: 需要很多种土生昆虫给当地植物授粉。

pollinate.en: Bees pollinate 90 commercial crops worldwide, including most fruit and vegetables such as alfalfa, nuts, and oil-seed rape.
pollinate.zh: 蜜蜂为全球90种商业农作物授粉，包括多数水果和蔬菜，例如紫花苜蓿、坚果和油菜。

pollinate.en: It had long been thought that hummingbirds, which forage by day, pollinate its red flowers and that hawkmoths, which forage at night, pollinate its white flowers.
pollinate.zh: 长期以来，人们一直认为，白天觅食的蜂鸟会给它的红色花朵授粉，而晚上觅食的鹰蛾会给它的白色花朵授粉。

inborn.en: He had an inborn talent for languages.
Making quantitative distinctions is not an inborn skill.
inborn.zh: 区分数量并不是一项天生的技能。

inborn.en: Are some of these differences biological and inborn, a result of evolution?
inborn.zh: 这些差异有的是生物性的，有的是天生的，是进化的结果吗？

labored.en: He knocked again, harder than before, for behind him he heard the steps and the labored breathing of his persecutors.
labored.zh: 他又敲了一下门，敲得比先前更用力了，因为他听见迫害者在身后的脚步声和吃力的呼吸声。

labored.en: He was beginning to feel discouraged, his strength was leaving him, and his breathing was becoming more and more labored.
labored.zh: 他开始感到泄气了，他的力气正在消失，他呼吸越来越费劲。

labored.en: Yeats, in Adam's Curse, regrets that the beautiful is something to be labored for and he wants to conceal that labor.
labored.zh: 在《亚当的诅咒》中，叶芝遗憾道，这种美丽是值得为之劳作的，他想掩盖这种劳作。

deductive.en: To test whether children are capable of deductive reasoning.
deductive.zh: 测试孩子是否有演绎推理的能力。
因为如果那是真的，那就是演绎的。

ventilate.en: Shake up the quintessential powder in the bag, tear down the smaller paster of the ventilate adhesive plaster, and then attach the bag to the volar.
ventilate.zh: 摇晃袋子中的精华粉，撕下透气胶布的较小贴纸，然后将袋子贴到到足底。

ventilate.en: Open the window and ventilate the room.
ventilate.zh: 打开窗户，让房间空气流通。

ventilate.en: Ventilate as much as possible to completely air out the room or spill zone with outside air.
ventilate.zh: 尽可能地通风，以彻底用室外空气置换房间或泄漏区域的空气。

daunt.en: A greater natural calamity cannot daunt us.
daunt.zh: 再大的自然灾害也不能吓坏我们。

daunt.en: Even a greater natural calamity cannot daunt us.
daunt.zh: 再大的自然灾害也压不垮我们。
危险并没有吓住那英雄。

counselor.en: Listen to a conversation between a student and a counselor at the University Counseling Center.
counselor.zh: 请听一段学生和大学咨询中心辅导员之间的对话。

counselor.en: The ability to relate well with their student is something a counselor should possess, not a teacher.
counselor.zh: 与学生相处融洽的能力是辅导员应该具备的，而不是老师。

counselor.en: The ability to relate well with their students is something a counselor should possess, not a teacher.
counselor.zh: 与学生融洽相处的能力是辅导员应该具备的，而不是老师。

depreciate.en: New cars start to depreciate as soon as they are on the road.
depreciate.zh: 新车一上路就开始贬值。

depreciate.en: Shares continued to depreciate on the stock markets today.
depreciate.zh: 今日股市股价继续下跌。

depreciate.en: It will just depreciate its way out of the current mess.
depreciate.zh: 它就是要通过贬值来走出目前的困境。

commiserate.en: We sympathize with the victims and commiserate over their bad luck.
commiserate.zh: 我们同情受害者，对他们的不幸表示同情。

commiserate.en: I commiserate with you on the loss of your mother.
commiserate.zh: 你母亲逝世，我特向你慰问。

commiserate.en: You'd better commiserate John on his recent misfortunes.
commiserate.zh: 你最好对约翰最近的不幸表示同情。

optometrist.en: I know of a big optometrist store nearby.
optometrist.zh: 我知道这附近就有一家配眼镜的店。

optometrist.en: You were still at your optometrist appointment.
optometrist.zh: 你仍旧在你验光师约见的地方。

optometrist.en: Plus, your pirate optometrist supplied the men with eye patches.
optometrist.zh: 并且，你的海盗验光配镜师为海盗们提供眼罩。

instinctual.en: The relationship between a parent and a child is instinctual and stems from basic human nature.
instinctual.zh: 父母与孩子之间的关系是本能的，源于人类的本性。

instinctual.en: During critical situations, especially when a threat is perceived, the outer core loses control and fails to regulate the impulses and instinctual responses coming from the primitive brain.
instinctual.zh: 在危急情况下，特别是在察觉到威胁时，外核会失去控制，无法调节来自原始内核的冲动和本能反应。

instinctual.en: We even share some basic instinctual quantitative reasoning with distant non-mammalian relatives like birds.
instinctual.zh: 我们甚至与鸟类等非哺乳动物的远亲一样，拥有某种基于本能的基本数量推理能力。

speciality.en: Her speciality is maths, earth science, and chemistry.
speciality.zh: 她的专长是数学、地球科学和化学。

deviance.en: Error is not a deviance from truth. Right?
deviance.zh: 错误并不是真理的一种异常行为，对吧？
但他母亲注意到了他的不正常。

deviance.en: However there are interesting parallels with the study of deviance.
deviance.zh: 然而这有一些有趣的和异常行为研究的类似。

anteroom.en: He had been patiently waiting in the anteroom for an hour.
anteroom.zh: 他已经在前厅耐心等待了一个小时。

anteroom.en: Henry emerged into the anteroom where lay his late redoubted foe.
anteroom.zh: 亨利出现在前厅里，那里躺着他的死敌。

anteroom.en: In an anteroom he hastily opened his briefcase.
anteroom.zh: 在休息室里，他迅速地打开皮包。

forgetful.en: I'm getting forgetful in my old age.
forgetful.zh: 我上了年纪，变得健忘了。

forgetful.en: She has become very forgetful in recent years.
forgetful.zh: 近年来她变得十分健忘。

forgetful.en: His father began to lose his memory bit by bit, becoming increasingly forgetful.
forgetful.zh: 他父亲的记忆力开始一点点衰退，变得越来越健忘。

imbibe.en: It was advantageous to animals digest and imbibe soybean's nutrition composition.
imbibe.zh: 有利于家畜对其营养成分的消化和吸收。

imbibe.en: Shouldn’t we want to avoid a fruit that singes the mouth and makes us imbibe vast quantities of water?
imbibe.zh: 对于那些烫了我们嘴巴而不得不喝大量水的水果，为何还要去碰呢？

imbibe.en: This had the advantage of making it possible for me to imbibe it, without an effort, into my whole being.
imbibe.zh: 这在我一生之中不无益处，我可以把它吸收，不必努力。

seepage.en: Water gradually escapes by seepage through the ground.
If the former are greater, the lake is a surface-water-dominated lake; if the latter, it is a seepage-dominated lake.
seepage.zh: 如果前者较大，这个湖就是一个以表层水为主的湖泊；如果是后者，则是一个以渗漏为主的湖泊。

seepage.en: Note the word "net" measuring the actual amounts of groundwater seepage into the lake and out of the lake is a much more complicated matter than merely inferring their difference.
seepage.zh: 注意“净值”这一词：测量地下水渗入并且渗出湖水的实际水量比仅仅推断出它们的差异要复杂得多。

liquefy.en: You can liquefy the carbon dioxide to separate it from the other constituents.
liquefy.zh: 你可液化二氧化碳以使它与其他成分分离。

liquefy.en: I take my gas phase composition out and I re-liquefy it.
liquefy.zh: 把气相部分拿出来再液化。

liquefy.en: Unfortunately, an earthquake might liquefy the core of the dam.
liquefy.zh: 不幸地是，一次地震就可能将水坝的关键之处毁于一旦。

reforestation.en: Carbon reduction through reforestation and avoided deforestation.
reforestation.zh: 通过植树造林和避免乱砍滥伐减少碳排放。

reforestation.en: All of this makes the net benefit of reforestation extremely difficult to measure.
reforestation.zh: 所有这一切都使得重新造林的纯利益极难估算。

reforestation.en: But reforestation projects have higher hurdles to cross than other types of carbon-offset projects.
reforestation.zh: 与其它类型的碳补偿项目相比，造林项目要跨越的障碍更大。

inhumanity.en: John Bul Dau explores territory few can imagine-the depths of inhumanity and the boundaries of endurance.
inhumanity.zh: 常人根本无法想象约翰·布尔·道所探索的是怎样的领域：非人程度之深与忍耐程度之极。

inhumanity.en: Inquiries were made as to how it got there; I was obliged to confess, and in recompense for my cowardice and inhumanity was sent out of the house.
inhumanity.zh: 我不得不承认。 作为对我的懦弱和不友好的惩罚，我被赶出了屋子。

arthropod.en: When using Arthropod, you can see the error right away.
arthropod.zh: 如果使用Arthropod就可以立刻看到错误消息。

arthropod.en: Arthropod is a debugger tool for Flash or AIR application development.
arthropod.zh: Arthropod是个针对Flash和AIR应用开发的调试工具。

arthropod.en: The power of Arthropod is not only in its simplicity, but also in the range of different log-types.
arthropod.zh: Arthropod的强大之处不仅在于其易用性，而且它还可以区分不同的日志类型。

unperturbed.zh: 她听到这消息似乎并不惊慌。

unperturbed.en: Harvard took the lead and remained unperturbed by the repeated challenges.
unperturbed.zh: 哈佛取得了领先地位，经过再三挑战后仍然镇定自若。

unperturbed.en: At forty, I attained to an unperturbed mind.

siesta.en: A great blue heron searches for fish on the incoming tide at Siesta Beach in Sarasota, Florida, in 2009.
siesta.zh: 2009年，在佛罗里达萨拉索塔的午休海滩，一只大蓝鹭在涌来的潮水上寻找鱼。

siesta.en: They have a siesta during the hottest part of the day.
siesta.zh: 他们会在一天中最热的时候小憩一会儿。

siesta.en: There is the silence of the siesta.

digress.zh: 我离题了，我们还是说说马特的森林吧。
我的思想开始开小差了。

digress.en: Let me digress for a moment and tell you a short story.
digress.zh: 请允许我暂时离开话题一会儿，我给你讲个小故事。

perplexity.en: He began counting them and then, with growing perplexity, counted them a second time.
perplexity.zh: 他开始数，然后更加困惑地数第二遍。

perplexity.en: The little King observed his perplexity, and dissipated it with a word.
perplexity.zh: 小国王看出了他的困惑，用一句话把它消解了。

perplexity.en: Most of them just stared at her in perplexity.
perplexity.zh: 他们多数人茫然地凝视着她。

enquiry.en: It is the largest enquiry ever of its kind.
enquiry.zh: 这是同类询问调查中规模最大的一次。

enquiry.en: The police are following several lines of enquiry.
enquiry.zh: 警方正沿着几条线索进行调查。

enquiry.en: These comments are not directly relevant to this enquiry.
enquiry.zh: 这些意见与这项调查没有直接联系。

unregistered.zh: 其余的难民则苟且在未经注册的难民营中。

unregistered.en: A file system can also be unregistered.
The collections apply to none of unregistered deposits.
unregistered.zh: 无记名式的储蓄存款不办理托收。

cookery.en: I took a cordon bleu cookery course.
This meal is typical of local cookery.
cookery.zh: 这是有当地风味的饭菜。

cookery.en: The school runs cookery classes throughout the year.
cookery.zh: 这个学校全年都开设烹饪课。

sedimentary.en: Because they are porous, sedimentary rocks, such as sandstones and conglomerates, are important potential sources of groundwater.
sedimentary.zh: 由于像如砂岩和砾岩这样的沉积岩是多孔的，它们是地下水的重要潜在来源。

sedimentary.en: Although most fossils are found in marine sedimentary rocks, they also are found in terrestrial deposits left by streams and lakes.
sedimentary.zh: 虽然大多数化石是在海洋沉积岩中发现的，但它们也存在于河流和湖泊所留下的陆地沉积物中。

sedimentary.en: In this process, sedimentary rocks that originally formed on the seabed may be folded upwards to altitudes of more than 26,000 feet.
sedimentary.zh: 在这个过程中，最初形成于海床上的沉积岩可能会向上折叠到26000英尺以上的高度。

firebrand.en: We kindled a firebrand in the cave.
firebrand.zh: 我们在山洞里点燃火把。

firebrand.en: Despite her frail appearance, Jocasta Nu was known as a firebrand among the Jedi.
firebrand.zh: 尽管外表脆弱，但乔卡丝塔·纽是绝地中著名的严师。

firebrand.en: No one who knows him dare employ him, for he is a regular firebrand of discontent.
firebrand.zh: 没有人知道还有谁再敢雇佣他，因为他是个充满了愤恨的离经叛道者。

topology.en: The relation between the completeness of several local convex topology and that of induction topology was pointed out in this paper.
topology.zh: 指出了几种局部凸拓扑的完整性与感应拓扑的完整性之间的关系。

landlocked.en: Crustal movements closed the straits, and the landlocked Mediterranean began to evaporate.
landlocked.zh: 地壳运动封闭了海峡，内陆的地中海开始了蒸发。

landlocked.en: Her landlocked country is a desert land that was once a hub for ancient Saharan caravan routes.
landlocked.zh: 她居住的内陆国家是一片沙漠地，曾是古代撒哈拉商队路线的枢纽。

beautify.zh: 克莱尔为美化花园工作着。

beautify.en: You know what to beautify is, I suppose?
beautify.zh: 我想你知道怎么美化吧？

beautify.en: People often beautify their homes with paper cuttings.
beautify.zh: 人们经常用剪纸美化自己的家。

efface.en: He could not efface the impression from his mind.
efface.zh: 他不能把这个印象从心中抹去。

efface.en: The lapse of year will never efface that scene of ruin from my memory.
efface.zh: 时光的流逝绝不会把那废墟的景象从我的记忆中冲淡。

efface.en: And yet it is also true that one can write nothing readable unless one constantly struggles to efface one's personality.
efface.zh: 除非一个人能承受抹去自己个性的长期斗争，否则，他根本写不出一些具可读性的东西。

spiteful.en: Mr. Baruch dismisses that as petty and spiteful.
spiteful.zh: 巴鲁克先生驳斥其为小气和恶意的。

spiteful.en: The princess came in, and as she passed by them she had something spiteful to say to every one.
spiteful.zh: 公主走了进来，当她从他们身边走过的时候，她对每一个人都说了一些恶毒的话。

spiteful.en: The people can be wrong in an assortment of ways: lazy, spiteful, bullying or just dull and too depressed themselves to spread much cheer.
spiteful.zh: 人则会以很多方式出现问题：懒惰的、怀有恶意的、咄咄逼人的、乏味的，以及情绪过于低落而让人高兴不起来的。

interlock.zh: 这些悲剧开始互相关联。

interlock.en: Your girlfriend's fear seems to interlock with your fear.
interlock.zh: 你女友的恐惧看来和你的恐惧相关。

gecko.en: The only place they didn't check was under the bed, where the gecko was big as ever and full at last.
gecko.zh: 他们唯一没有检查的地方是床底下，壁虎还是和以前一样大，而且终于吃饱了。

gecko.en: A Tokay gecko hangs upside down in its terrarium at the Academy of Natural Sciences in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
gecko.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州费城自然科学院的养缸里，一只壁虎倒挂着。

gecko.en: Some 43 new reptile species were found on New Guinea during the report's ten-year period, including this giant bent-toed gecko.
gecko.zh: 在这份报告的十年间，在新几内亚发现了43种新的爬行动物，包括这种巨人弯趾壁虎。

barbarous.en: He thought the poetry of Whitman barbarous.
barbarous.zh: 他认为惠特曼的诗歌很粗俗。

barbarous.en: I love to sail forbidden seas, and land on barbarous coasts.
barbarous.zh: 我喜欢在禁海上航行，喜欢踏上原始海岸。

barbarous.en: He felt trees, flowers, and fences without purpose were "inartistic if not barbarous."
barbarous.zh: 他觉得，没有目的的树木、花朵、栅栏，“如果不算粗鄙，也是没有艺术性的。”

apace.zh: 而土建工程仍在快速推进。

apace.en: The intimidation of opposition campaigners proceeded apace.
apace.zh: 针对反对派活动人士的恐吓活动正在迅速蔓延。

apace.en: Elsewhere, the rearrangement of the book trade continues apace.
apace.zh: 在其他地方，图书业也在继续调整和改变。

robustness.zh: 要测试这两个脚本以确保健壮性。

robustness.en: Performance and robustness of systems in production is better.
robustness.zh: 在生产中系统的性能和强壮性更加出色。

sainthood.en: His elevation to sainthood is entirely justified.
sainthood.zh: 他的升为圣徒完全合理。

sainthood.en: After all, it was he who said "Sainthood is a thing that human beings must avoid."
sainthood.zh: 毕竟他自己曾说过，“圣人，是凡人要避免的。”

sainthood.en: Although Mandela has achieved near sainthood in his home country, it would be wrong to say there are no blemishes on his record.
sainthood.zh: 尽管曼德拉在自己的祖国已近于圣徒，却不能说其记录里就没有瑕疵。

insolent.en: "Proud and insolent youth," said Hook, "prepare to meet thy doom."
insolent.zh: “傲慢无礼的年轻人，”胡克说，“准备迎接你的厄运吧。”
“无礼的小妞儿！”伊丽莎白自言自语地说。

insolent.en: This was a race of manly men, but insolent and impious.
insolent.zh: 这时的人类雄伟刚毅，但却骄横不虔。

elongate.en: Uvala is a large elongate sinkhole resulting from enlargement.
elongate.zh: 灰岩干谷是由于扩大而形成的一个大的拉长的天坑。

elongate.en: Cytyledons and future stalk called the hypocotyl elongate.
elongate.zh: 子叶和未来称为下胚轴的主轴延长。

elongate.en: The extra length will help elongate a full face, making it appear more oval.
elongate.zh: 长出来的头发会让圆脸有被拉长的效果，从而更形似鹅蛋脸。

procrastinate.en: Most often we procrastinate when faced with something we do not want to do.
procrastinate.zh: 面对不想做的事情，我们经常拖延。

procrastinate.en: We all procrastinate sometimes, especially when it comes to things we aren't really fond of.
procrastinate.zh: 我们都有拖延的时候，尤其是遇到不喜欢的事情的时候。

procrastinate.en: "Some people procrastinate cleaning. Some people procrastinate by cleaning," says Professor Peter Stone.
procrastinate.zh: “有些人会拖延打扫卫生。有些人通过打扫卫生来拖延。”彼得·斯通教授表示。

attractively.zh: 这个房间布置得十分宜人。

attractively.en: The hotel is decorated imaginatively and attractively.
attractively.zh: 这家旅馆装饰得很有想像力和吸引力。

attractively.en: However, exhibits must be both based on artefacts and facts as we know them, and attractively presented.
attractively.zh: 然而，展品必须既以人工制品为基础，又要基于现实中我们对于它们的了解，而且要以吸引人的方式展现。

decimal.en: The figure is accurate to two decimal places.
decimal.zh: 这个数精确到小数点后两位。

decimal.en: The number is correct to three decimal places.
decimal.zh: 这个数目精确到小数点后三位数。

decimal.en: A waiter omitted the decimal point in the $13.09 bill.
decimal.zh: 一个侍者漏掉了那份$13.09的账单上的小数点。

inveterate.en: She was an inveterate experimenter in these things.
inveterate.zh: 在这些东西上，她总是要都拿来试一试。

inveterate.en: See, the soon-to-be ex is an inveterate clutterer, and I am emphatically not.
inveterate.zh: 看见了吧，即将成为我前夫的这个人是个地道的混乱无章的人，而我明显不是。

inveterate.en: Part of this sort of this inveterate Calvinism, and part of the fact that, "What if the DAMS burst?"
inveterate.zh: 即根深蒂固的加尔文主义，还有一些事实，诸如，“万一溃堤了怎么办”？

remuneration.en: Members of poor peasant families spun or wove cloth and linens at home for scant remuneration in an attempt to supplement meager family income.
remuneration.zh: 贫穷农民家庭的成员在家纺织布和亚麻以挣得很少的报酬，弥补微薄的家庭收入。

remuneration.en: It must also be done with a profit and remuneration structure that is fair to everyone.
remuneration.zh: 它还必须有一个对每个人都公平的利润和薪酬结构。
我可以问问我的酬劳是多少吗？

refraction.en: One source of error is refraction, the bending of light beams as they pass through air layers of different temperature and pressure.
refraction.zh: 误差的一个来源是折射，即光束通过不同温度和压力的空气层时发生的弯曲现象。

refraction.en: The Chinese also launched weather balloons near their theodolites to measure atmospheric temperature and pressure changes to better estimate refraction errors.
refraction.zh: 中国还在经纬仪附近发射了气象气球来测量大气温度和压力变化，以更好地估计折射误差。

refraction.en: What would a negative index of refraction look like?
refraction.zh: 如果折射率是负的,会发生什么事情?

demonstrative.en: Some people are more demonstrative than others.
demonstrative.zh: 有些人更容易流露感情。

demonstrative.en: We came from the English tradition of not being demonstrative.
demonstrative.zh: 我们的感情不外露来自于英国传统。

epidermis.en: In metaphase, it will decrease the chronic soakage of inflammatory cell, destroy the epidermis and adenalgia.
epidermis.zh: 在中期，它会减少慢性炎症细胞浸润、上皮及腺体的破坏。
它保护下面的活性表皮。

vanquish.en: And we-we still have to vanquish his shadow, too.
vanquish.zh: 而我们，我们也仍必须战胜他的影子。

vanquish.en: The best way to vanquish your enemies on the Internet?
vanquish.zh: 在网上战胜敌人的法宝？

vanquish.en: So we will weep together to care each other to vanquish our pain.
vanquish.zh: 于是我们将一起哭泣彼此关心，消除我们的痛苦。

natal.en: He arrived in Natal to see at first hand the effects of the recent heavy fighting.
natal.zh: 他到纳塔尔亲自察看最近的激战所造成的影响。

natal.en: South African troops are moving into the strife-torn Natal Province where political violence has claimed three hundred lives in the past month.
natal.zh: 南非军队正在向战乱不断的纳塔尔省行进，在过去一个月里，这里的政治暴力已经夺走了300人的生命。

natal.en: This is the chance to inspire hope, my dear comrades, in Kwa Zulu-Natal.
natal.zh: 我亲爱的同志们，现在是我们在夸祖卢-纳塔尔省重新唤起希望的机会。

omnipotent.en: Doug lived in the shadow of his seemingly omnipotent father.
omnipotent.zh: 道格生活在他那看似无所不能的父亲的阴影里。

sedimentation.en: Effluent from the sedimentation tank is dosed with disinfectant to kill any harmful organisms.
sedimentation.zh: 从沉降池流出的废水被加入消毒剂以杀死一切有害生物。

sedimentation.en: In all these diverse regions, Agassiz saw signs of glacial erosion and sedimentation.
sedimentation.zh: 在这些不同的地区，Agassiz 都能发现冰川侵蚀和沉降的痕迹。

sedimentation.en: Unfortunately, such estimates did not adequately account for past differences in rates of sedimentation or losses to the total section of strata during episodes of erosion.
sedimentation.zh: 不幸的是，这种估测没有充分考虑到过去在侵蚀期间沉积速率或地层总剖面损失的差异。

monorail.en: The monorail can be completed at the price tag of $1.7 billion.
monorail.zh: 该单轨铁路能以标价17亿美元完成。

monorail.en: MonoRail was improved greatly with the addition of cache support and JS generation.
monorail.zh: MonoRail被极大的改善，添加了缓存支持和JS生成。

crosswalk.en: They may be able to emulate the dripping sound of a crosswalk, or the buzz of a power tool.
crosswalk.zh: 他们或许可以效仿人行横道的滴滴声，或者电动工具的嗡嗡声。

crosswalk.en: Kangkang, that old man is crossing the crosswalk.
crosswalk.zh: 康康，那位老人正在过人行横道。

crosswalk.en: Now the students feel safer than before after the installation of the smart crosswalk.
crosswalk.zh: 现在，安装了智能人行横道后，学生们比以前感到更安全了。

gigabyte.en: The unsubsidized selling price of the new iPhone is $399 for the 8 gigabyte model.
gigabyte.zh: 新款 iPhone 的无补贴售价为 8g 版399美元。
其中创建了一个25 GB的数据库。

windscreen.en: The moment the windscreen shatters, you should begin to take your foot off the accelerator.
windscreen.zh: 在挡风玻璃破碎的那一刻，你应该停止踩油门。

windscreen.en: Hence the analogy that likens the conduct of monetary policy to driving a car with a blackened windscreen, a cracked rear-view mirror and a faulty steering wheel.
windscreen.zh: 因此，有人将货币政策的实施比作驾驶一辆挡风玻璃变黑、后视镜破裂、方向盘失灵的汽车。

windscreen.en: Hence the analogy that likens the conduct of monetary policy to driving a car with a blackened windscreen, a cracked rear-view mirror and a faulty steering wheel.
windscreen.zh: 因此，有人将货币政策的实施比作驾驶一辆挡风玻璃变黑、后视镜破裂、方向盘失灵的汽车。

indemnity.en: Political exiles had not been given indemnity from prosecution.
indemnity.zh: 政治流亡者还没有被给予免于起诉的保证。

indemnity.en: I was also given an indemnity form, which I duly completed and returned.
indemnity.zh: 我还收到了一份赔偿表，我按时填好并交了回来。

indemnity.en: Using letter of indemnity to obtain a clean B/L is a common practice.
indemnity.zh: 用保函换取清洁提单被普遍采用。

phoenix.en: Mr. Brooke moved on from LA to Phoenix.
phoenix.zh: 布鲁克先生离开洛杉矶继续前往菲尼克斯市。
凤凰剧社演出《朱诺与孔雀》。

phoenix.en: Out of the ashes of the economic shambles, a phoenix of recovery can arise.
phoenix.zh: 复苏之凤会从经济废墟的灰烬中腾飞而起。

fiber.en: The wings are made of a polythene film stretched over a carbon fiber frame.
fiber.zh: 机翼是由铺在碳纤维框架上的聚乙烯薄膜制成的。

fiber.en: High-fiber diets are also linked to a reduced risk of heart disease and diabetes.
fiber.zh: 高纤维饮食还能降低患心脏病和糖尿病的风险。

fiber.en: Research now says adding fiber to the teen diet may help lower the risk of breast cancer.
fiber.zh: 现在的研究表明，在青少年饮食中添加纤维可以帮助降低患乳腺癌的风险。

homeward.en: She is ready for her homeward trip.

lorry.zh: 我的父亲是个卡车司机。

lorry.en: Emergency food supplies were brought in by lorry.
lorry.zh: 应急食物是用卡车运来的。

lorry.en: Now and then they heard the roar of a heavy lorry.
lorry.zh: 他们不时听见一辆重型卡车的轰响声。

beneficent.en: Mr. Smith , a true gentlemen, is always beneficent to poor.
beneficent.zh: 史密斯先生，一个真正的绅士，总是对穷人行善。

beneficent.en: Unfortunately history offers no guarantee that a more humane and beneficent style of life inevitably prevails.
beneficent.zh: 可惜历史并没有保证那更人道、更慈善的生活方式必然获胜。

beneficent.en: Unfortunately, history offers no guarantee that a more humane and beneficent style of life inevitably prevails.
beneficent.zh: 可惜历史并没有保证那更人道，更慈善的生活方式必须获胜。

tableware.en: Tableware for outdoor use should ideally be unbreakable.
tableware.zh: 户外使用的餐具最好是不容易被打破的。

tableware.en: As the American middle class grew, they needed more tableware to show off their wealth.
tableware.zh: 随着美国中产阶级的壮大，他们需要更多的餐具来炫耀他们的财富。

tableware.en: While the new settlers were sharing cups and dipping their fingers into bowls of food, European royalty and nobility were staring to increase their tableware.
tableware.zh: 当新移民共用杯子，用手指蘸着碗里的食物时，欧洲的皇室和贵族们开始增加他们的餐具。

sufficiency.en: By and large, nomadism implies a high degree of self-sufficiency and inhibits the appearance of an extensive division of labor.
sufficiency.zh: 总的来说，游牧意味着高度的自给自足，并抑制了广泛劳动分工的出现。

sufficiency.en: A move back to self-sufficiency, the argument goes, would boost the farming industry, political sovereignty and even the nation's health.
sufficiency.zh: 这种观点认为，回归自给自足将促进农业发展、巩固政治主权、甚至提升国民健康。

sufficiency.en: I'm not advocating that we stop looking for incentives to move poor people toward self-sufficiency or that we stop punishing people for criminal behavior.
sufficiency.zh: 我并不是主张我们停止寻找激励措施，让穷人走向自给自足，也不是说我们停止惩罚犯罪行为的人。

orca.en: I am just an orca, but I am glad that my life has counted for something.
orca.zh: 我不过是只虎鲸，但我很高兴我的生命有些意义。

orca.en: Researchers believe their lungs were seared by the toxic fumes, but orca carcasses usually sink, so no autopsy was possible.
orca.zh: 研究者们认为它们是因毒烟雾灼伤肺部，但虎鲸尸体通常沉入海底，因而没办法进行尸体解剖。

orca.en: The unorthodox approach proved successful after the team from Stanford University came up with a design modeled on the structure of the ear of orca wales.
orca.zh: 在来自斯坦福大学的研究团队仿效虎鲸耳朵结构做出设计之后，该非传统的方法得以成功验证。

tensile.en: A new material developed recently has a tensile strength higher than diamond, yet it's much more flexible.
tensile.zh: 最近开发的一种新材料的抗拉强度比钻石还高，而且柔韧性更好。

tensile.en: Certain materials can be manufactured with a high tensile strength.
tensile.zh: 某些材料可以制造成抗拉伸强度大的产品。

tensile.en: First proposed in the late 1800s, the theory relies on a property of water not commonly associated with fluids: its tensile strength.
tensile.zh: 该理论于19世纪末首次提出，其依据是水的抗拉强度，而水的这种特性通常与流体无关。

ecliptic.en: Saturn still shines in the night though, farther eastward along the ecliptic plane.
ecliptic.zh: 尽管如此，土星仍然在黄道平面向东更远的地方发光。

ecliptic.en: Different circle in the sky which is the plane of the ecliptic of the solar system.
ecliptic.zh: 这将是另一个循环，这平面就是整个太阳系的黄道。

ecliptic.en: The ecliptic plane is defined as the imaginary plane containing the Earth's orbit around the sun.
ecliptic.zh: 黄道平面是一个假想的平面，理论上它包含了地球环绕太阳运行的轨道。

trifling.en: Outside California these difficulties may seem fairly trifling.
trifling.zh: 在加利福尼亚以外的其他地方，这些困难可能看起来相当得微不足道。

trifling.en: Tomorrow, you shall only do me a very trifling piece of work.
trifling.zh: 明天，你只能给我做一份很微不足道的工作。

trifling.en: What he had felt earlier in the day had been a mere trifling qualm.
trifling.zh: 他今天早些时候的感觉不过是一种轻微的不舒服。

plagiarize.en: Mike: Really? Such a talented singer would plagiarize as well?
plagiarize.zh: 麦克：是喔，这么有才华的歌手也会抄袭吗？

plagiarize.en: To plagiarize means to take the writings of another person and to use them as your own.
plagiarize.zh: 剽窃就是攫取他人的作品并当成自己的使用。

plagiarize.en: This has led some of them to falsify research results and plagiarize the work of others.
plagiarize.zh: 这势必导致他们其中的一些人伪造研究成果和剽窃他人的著作。

secondarily.en: Their clothing is primarily functional and only secondarily decorative.
secondarily.zh: 他们的衣服首先重实用，其次才讲花式。

secondarily.en: The essence of this tool is research and secondarily productive community.
secondarily.zh: 这个工具的精髓在于研究，其次是有效力的社区。

secondarily.en: Really, the implementation issue is only secondarily about using a new method.
secondarily.zh: 确实，对使用一个新方法而言如何执行只是一个次要的问题。

scanty.en: The boy followed the old man, who commanded him to open the bag in which he carried his scanty dinner.
scanty.zh: 男孩跟着老人，老人命令他打开袋子，袋子里装着他仅有的晚餐。

scanty.en: So far, what scanty evidence we have points to two suspects.
scanty.zh: 目前，我们指向两名嫌犯的证据太少。

excretion.en: More probable is bird transport, either externally, by accidental attachment of the seeds to feathers, or internally, by the swallowing of fruit and subsequent excretion of the seeds.
excretion.zh: 更有可能的是鸟类运输：或者是通过外部途径，即种籽偶然附着在羽毛上；或者是通过内部途径，即鸟类吞食果实并随后将种籽排泄出来。

excretion.en: The excretion of methyl mercury becomes very difficult because of high enterohepatic circulation and reabsorption by proximal convoluted tubule.
excretion.zh: 由于甲基汞在体内的肠肝循环和肾脏近曲小管对甲基汞的重吸收效率高，使甲基汞的体外排泄十分困难。

excretion.en: Chronic exposure to Cd mainly causes the renal proximal tubule damage, which represents that the excretion of proteinuria, glucosuria and aminoaciduria.
excretion.zh: 慢性接触镉主要引起肾小管损伤，表现为蛋白尿、糖尿和氨基酸尿。

unsanitary.en: Lack of access to safe water, poor housing, and unsanitary conditions all have a strong bearing on the health of the mother and child.
unsanitary.zh: 缺乏安全用水、住房条件差以及不卫生条件都对母亲和儿童的健康有很大的影响。

unsanitary.en: Discharge of raw sewage into the sea is unsanitary and unsafe.
unsanitary.zh: 向大海里倾倒污水既不卫生也不安全。

unsanitary.en: If big sums are to be spent on cleaning up environmental disasters, it is better to spend them on unglamorous but pressing problems such as unsanitary water in Third World countries.
unsanitary.zh: 如果要把大笔资金花在清理环境灾难上，那么最好把钱花在那些乏味但紧迫的问题上，比如处理第三世界国家不卫生的水的问题上。

overwork.en: His illness was brought on by money worries and overwork.
overwork.zh: 他的病是因操心钱和劳累过度而造成的。
过度紧张的工作使得他更加消瘦了。

overwork.en: Overwork and exhaustion are the opposite of resilience and the bad habits we acquire when we're young only magnify when we hit the workforce.
overwork.zh: 复原力与过度劳累和精力衰竭恰恰相反，进入职场后，我们年轻时养成的坏习惯只会不断放大。

landmass.en: Some 250 million years ago, the Earth contained a single landmass known as Pangaea.
landmass.zh: 大约2.5亿年前，地球只有一块大陆，称作原始大陆。

landmass.en: The granite rock landmass, which has only a few pine trees and a sandy beach, is normally known as Eagle island.
landmass.zh: 遍布花岗岩的陆地上只有少量松树和沙滩。 这里通常被称为“鹰岛”。

landmass.en: To be prepared for your future life, you don't need to know the capital of West Virginia or the landmass of Chile.
landmass.zh: 为你的未来生活做准备，你并不一定需要知道西弗吉尼亚州的首府在哪里，也不需要知道智利的国土形状如何。

harmoniously.en: The better the connections, the more harmoniously the two halves work.
harmoniously.zh: 连接得越好，两部分的工作就越和谐。

harmoniously.en: I have all along firmly believed that human should live with nature harmoniously.
harmoniously.zh: 我一直坚信，人类应该与自然和谐相处。

harmoniously.en: In stead of conquering nature, we should learn to get along with it harmoniously.
harmoniously.zh: 我们应该学会与自然和谐相处，而不是征服自然。

treble.en: Thanks to my treble saxophone teacher, Bill Hiner, for giving me a way out of the sea of bitterness.
treble.zh: 多亏我的高音萨克斯管教师比尔·希尼尔，给了我一条脱离苦海的道路。

treble.en: Nashi played fish for many years, but long ago, he might have played treble saxophone in a ballroom band in Istanbul.
treble.zh: 纳希打了很多年的鱼，但是在很久以前，他也许在伊斯坦布尔的一个舞厅乐队里吹过高音萨克斯管。

punctual.en: He's always very punctual. I'll see if he's here yet.
punctual.zh: 他一向很准时。我要看看他是不是已经来了。

stalactite.en: Seepage flow can be observed in stalactite caves.
stalactite.zh: 在钟乳石溶洞里，可以见到渗流现象。

stalactite.zh: 鼻子，很明显，是一个凝聚了的水滴，或钟乳石。

stalactite.en: A stalagmite is below a stalactite and they both grow, eventually to meet.
stalactite.zh: 石笋在钟乳石下面，它们二者都在增长，最终会合。

incise.en: We learn how to lance incise and stitch the wound.
incise.zh: 我们学会怎样用柳叶刀切开和缝合伤口。

incise.en: Flexible and sharp, it can incise, expose, exenterate and heal.
incise.zh: 富有弹性且锋利的它，能够切入、暴露、切除、治愈。

regurgitate.en: Don't regurgitate the stuff given in the textbook.
regurgitate.zh: 不要照背课本中的东西。

regurgitate.en: If not, then you may simply appreciate an ability to regurgitate facts.
regurgitate.zh: 如果回答是“不”，那么你也仅是在欣赏一种“反刍”事实的能力。

regurgitate.en: When no other food is available, they regurgitate the honeydew to feed the colony.
regurgitate.zh: 当没有别的食物可供时，它们便反刍出蜜露来喂养群体。

imprudent.en: It would be imprudent to invest all your money in one company.
imprudent.zh: 把所有的钱都投资在一家公司是不明智的。

imprudent.en: It was rather imprudent of the little girl to interrupt our conversation like that.
imprudent.zh: 这丫头，打断我们的谈话，没轻没重的。

imprudent.en: I am afraid he has been very imprudent, and has deserved to lose Mr. Darcy's regard.
imprudent.zh: 我怕他果真是太莽撞，也难怪达西先生不去理睬他。

overdraft.en: But Cahoot's overdraft rate depends on your credit rating.
overdraft.zh: 然而合伙人的透支率取决于你的信用等级。

overdraft.zh: 她的银行警告说除非她偿还透支款，否则她可能要面临诉讼。

overdraft.en: You risk incurring bank charges if you exceed your overdraft limit.
overdraft.zh: 如果超出了透支限额，就有被银行加收费用的风险。

flustered.en: She came to him somewhat excited and curious and flustered.
flustered.zh: 她向他走来时有些激动、好奇、和慌张。
将军没有被搅得慌乱不安。

flustered.zh: 她迟到了，显得火急火燎，局促不安。

cinematography.zh: 科幻惊悚片《盗梦空间》获得了最佳摄影奖。

hydrology.zh: 这座桥已被摧毁，但水库影响着这里的水文。

inadmissible.zh: 他说使用武力是万万不可的。

cytoplasm.zh: 它们位于卵细胞的细胞质中。
