你要在芝加哥作短暂停留。

ionization.en: It is formed by a process of "self-ionization".
ionization.zh: 它是由“自身电离”这一过程形成的。

ionization.en: And we can calculate the ionization energy.

ionization.zh: 那么让我们来比较一下它们的电离能。

reversion.en: This looks like a reversion to Mexico's previous solidarity with the global left.
reversion.zh: 看起来墨西哥与全球左翼之前的连结又恢复了。
概念的转化和反转架构。

reversion.en: There are no reversion messages for this feature.

titular.en: He is titular head, and merely signs laws occasionally.
titular.zh: 他是名义上的首长，仅是偶尔签署法律而已。

titular.en: The titular song 'Norwegian Wood' sings, 'I once had a girl, or should I say she once had me.
titular.zh: 主题曲‘挪威的森林’里唱着‘我曾经拥有过一个女孩，或许该说她曾经拥有过我’。

titular.en: The titular heroine is a successful woman with a distinguished career, but she conveys an essential sadness.
titular.zh: 女主人公海蒂是一个成功的女人，有个高雅的职业，但她背负着必要的悲伤。

dignify.en: The mayor was there to dignify the celebrations.
dignify.zh: 市长的光临为庆祝活动增辉。

dignify.en: We won't dignify this kind of speculation with a comment.
dignify.zh: 我们不会妄加评论这种猜测以抬高其身价。

dignify.en: I'm not going to dignify his comments by reacting to them.
dignify.zh: 我才不会理睬他的评论以抬高其身价呢。

inedible.en: Detainees complained of being given inedible food.
inedible.zh: 被拘押者抱怨所给的食物不能吃。

inedible.en: They don't waste their time on some inedible thing from their point of view.
inedible.zh: 他们不会为不能吃的东西浪费时间，从他们的角度来看。

inedible.en: Detainees complained of being given inedible food.
inedible.zh: 被拘押者抱怨所给的食物不能吃。

hypertext.en: Certainly, Andreessen didn't think up using hypertext to link Internet documents.
hypertext.zh: 当然，安德森并没想到用超文本链接互联网文档。

humus.zh: 岩石碎片与腐殖质混合在一起。

humus.en: The Black Death of 1348 was caused by gradual loss of the humus fertility found under forest trees.
humus.zh: 1348年的黑死病是由森林树木下腐殖质的逐渐丧失引起的。

humus.en: Humus is necessary for rapid decomposition of leaves by bacteria and fungi and for recycling by surface roots.
humus.zh: 腐殖质是树叶被细菌和真菌迅速分解和根部表面循环过程的必需品。

transact.en: This would free them to transact business across state lines.
transact.zh: 这会使他们自由地跨越州界进行商业交易。

transact.en: We will transact with them for truce.
transact.zh: 我们将与他们就停火进行谈判。

transact.en: At what point did you decide to add support for Transact-SQL Script Analysis?
transact.zh: 你决定对Transact - SQL脚本分析提供支持是基于哪一点考虑呢？

archeology.en: Hi, Professor Archer, you know how in class last week you said that you were looking for students who are interested in volunteering for your archeology project?
archeology.zh: 您好，阿彻教授，上周您在课堂里说过，您在找有兴趣为您的考古项目做志愿工作的学生，是吗？？

archeology.en: I actually wrote to a number of archeology departments and offered up my services.
archeology.zh: 实际上我那会儿写了信给许多考古学的相关部门表达了我的愿望。

archeology.en: Main directions are represented by archeology biology medicine nanotechnology etc.
archeology.zh: 其主要应用方向包括考古学、生物学、医药、纳米技术等等。

phlegm.en: His cough is dry, producing no phlegm.

windpipe.en: "Then why," Antonia said, "is my windpipe practically broken and me lying on the floor?"
windpipe.zh: “那么为什么，”安东尼娅说，“我的气管都坏了，我躺在地上呢？”

windpipe.en: The other is the first step on the path to a particular sort of tissue such as the lining of a windpipe.
windpipe.zh: 这一细胞在进化中首先会形成一个特殊的像气管内层一样薄膜组织。

windpipe.en: I have a good windpipe in my chest, and I have four wings that are placed outside my head, just beneath my hat.
windpipe.zh: 我的怀里有一块很好的磨石；我有四个翅膀——它们生在我的头上，恰恰在我的帽子底下。

asexual.zh: 他们的关系完全是无性的。

asexual.en: It is another unfortunate myth of our culture that older people are asexual.
asexual.zh: 我们文化中另一个可叹的观念认为年长者是无性的。

gravitation.en: Eleven point two kilometers per second, at which satellites can be freed from the gravitation of the earth, is called "escape speed".
gravitation.zh: 卫星以11.2千米每秒的速度前进可以脱离地球引力，这被称为“逃逸速度”。

gravitation.en: One of them is the force of gravitation (地心引力), which tries to pull the satellite towards the earth and is like a rope which keeps the satellite from flying away.
gravitation.zh: 其中一个是地心引力的力量，这股力量试图把卫星拉向地球，就像一根把卫星绑住的绳子，防止卫星飞远了。

sundial.en: On cloudy days or at night it was impossible to tell the time with a sun clock or a sundial.
sundial.zh: 在阴天或晚上，无法用太阳钟或日晷看出时间。
日晷上显示的时间非常精确。

sundial.en: A close up of the sundial which is very accurate, by the way.
sundial.zh: 日晷的近景，它走时非常精确。

domesticate.en: The Botai were the first to domesticate horses?
domesticate.zh: 博泰人是第一批驯养马的人？

domesticate.en: If you domesticate this raccoon, it will have trouble living in the wild.
domesticate.zh: 如果你驯养这只浣熊，它生活在野外将会有困难。

domesticate.en: Can we, somehow, resist the powers that conspire to domesticate us?
domesticate.zh: 我们能否以某种方式抵制那些合谋驯化我们的力量？

hatchling.en: Another thing would be, if a hatchling gets separated from the rest of its family, once the others get far enough away, its survival instinct kicks in.
hatchling.zh: 另一件事是，如果幼崽和家族其他成员分开，一旦其他成员离得足够远，幼崽的生存本能就开始发挥作用。

hatchling.en: Breeding season is underway for most of the world's birds, with hatchling season close behind.
hatchling.zh: 世界上大部分鸟类的繁殖季节即将到来，紧随其后的就是幼鸟出生的季节。

hatchling.en: Scientists have found a 67 million-year-old fossil of a snake coiled around dinosaur eggs and a hatchling.
hatchling.zh: 科学家在一块6700万年的化石中发现了一条蛇盘绕在恐龙蛋和一只幼仔周围。

obscenely.en: Not to mention, these ideas make some people obscenely loaded.
obscenely.zh: 更别提有些想法还让一些人还发了大财了呢。

obscenely.en: THE dirty secret of the golden age of finance was that it was obscenely easy to make money.
obscenely.zh: 金融行业黄金时代的秘密是，赚钱简直是小菜一碟并且不怎么光彩。

obscenely.en: Given the price that Greek debt now trades at, the deal is widely regarded as obscenely sweet.
obscenely.zh: 考虑到现在希腊的债务交易价格，这样的交易被广泛的认为很不奏效。

servile.en: They were obsequious and servile and did not presume to talk to their masters as if they were their equals.
servile.zh: 他们既卑躬屈膝又恭敬顺从，不敢像对待自己的同类一样与自己的主人交谈。

servile.en: I hate the touch of servile hands.
servile.zh: 我厌恶被人卑屈地迎候。

teleconference.en: Managers at their factory hold a two-hour teleconference with head office every day.
teleconference.zh: 他们工厂的经理们每天与总部举行两小时的电话会议。

teleconference.en: In this episode, we'll hear a teleconference meeting after that critical phase.
teleconference.zh: 这节课中，我们会听到危险期过后的电讯会议。

teleconference.en: The agreement covers data, voice, land mobile radio and video teleconference networks.
teleconference.zh: 该协议覆盖了数据、音频、陆地移动电台和视频电话会议网络等。

gadgetry.en: His desk is covered with electronic gadgetry.
gadgetry.zh: 他的书桌上摆满了各种电子装置。

gadgetry.en: The NEC's skyscraper and its gadgetry are controlled in the basement.
gadgetry.zh: 日本国家电气公司的摩天大楼和它的配件都在地下室进行控制。

gadgetry.en: Many other sports have embraced video and electronic gadgetry at their higher levels.
gadgetry.zh: 其他很多运动在较高水平的比赛中已经引进了录像和电子器械。

boastful.en: I tried to emphasize my good points without sounding boastful.
boastful.zh: 我在强调自己的优点时尽量不让人觉得是在自我吹嘘。

boastful.en: You're just a boastful (自夸的), spoiled alien.
boastful.zh: 你只是一个喜欢自吹自擂又娇生惯养的外乡人。

adroit.en: She is a remarkably adroit and determined politician.
adroit.zh: 她是一个相当干练而果断的政治家。

adroit.en: The governor has considerable political talents, but as a speaker, he is far less adroit than his opponent, whose oratorical skills are breathtaking.
adroit.zh: 这位州长有相当多的政治才能，但作为一名发言人，他远不如他的对手娴熟，后者的演讲技巧令人惊叹。

adroit.en: Through some adroit lawyering, Faal turned that mistake to a decisive advantage.
adroit.zh: 经由技巧高超的律师手法，法尔把这项错误转为已方明确的优势。

marsupial.en: He came across the jawbone of a 4.5 million-year-old marsupial.
marsupial.zh: 他偶然发现了一个450万年前的有袋动物的颌骨。

marsupial.en: This marsupial inhabits the deserts of central Australia where the onset of rains and the resulting sudden growth of vegetation are extremely unpredictable.
marsupial.zh: 这种有袋类动物生活在澳大利亚中部的沙漠中，那里的降雨和植被的突然生长是极其不可预测的。

marsupial.en: A University of Muenster team drew up a marsupial family tree based on DNA.
marsupial.zh: 明斯特大学的一个研究小组根据 DNA 绘制了一个有袋动物的族谱。

adverb.en: In 'run fast', the adverb 'fast' is a postmodifier.
adverb.zh: 在run fast中，副词fast是后置修饰词。

adverb.en: In 'speak quietly', the adverb 'quietly' is a modifier.
adverb.zh: 在speak quietly中，副词quietly是修饰语。

adverb.en: In 'walk slowly', the adverb 'slowly' modifies the verb 'walk'.
adverb.zh: 在walk slowly中，副词slowly修饰动词walk。

molt.en: Like all crustaceans, krill must molt in order to grow.
molt.zh: 象所有甲壳纲，磷虾必须蜕变为了增长。

molt.en: The results show that the energy metabolism changes during molt cycle.
molt.zh: 这些结果说明在蜕壳周期中能量代谢发生了变化。

molt.en: Rattlesnakes add a segment to their iconic rattles each time they molt.
molt.zh: 每次蜕皮之后，响尾蛇标志性的环节尾都会增加一节。

abstracted.en: The same abstracted look was still on his face.
abstracted.zh: 那同样心不在焉的表情仍在他的脸上。

abstracted.en: Quite aside from her tiredness, Amanda seemed unnaturally abstracted.
abstracted.zh: 除了疲惫不堪，阿曼达看上去还一反常态地心不在焉。

abstracted.en: At the shops where you spend any real money, that money is increasingly abstracted.
abstracted.zh: 在你花费实际货币的店里，这些货币正变得越来越抽象。

tropic.en: For centuries he braved arctic cold, tropic heat and inhuman privations to wrest gold from the earth.
tropic.zh: 几个世纪以来，他冒着北极的严寒、热带的酷暑和非人的贫困，从地球上攫取黄金。

tropic.en: According to scientific results, on Winter solstice, a right angle is formed by the sun and the tropic of carpricorn.
tropic.zh: 根据科学的结果，在冬至，太阳和南回归线形成了一个直角。
我们必须保护热带雨林。

tackler.en: "He's more than just a tackler," he says.
He's good with his head, he's a good tackler, strong and plays man on man.
tackler.zh: 他的头球很好，他铲球很好，强壮，打盯人。

tackler.en: Rated as one of the best full-backs in Europe, he also has pace in abundance and has been described as a 'tenacious tackler'.
tackler.zh: 作为欧洲战场上数一数二的后卫，他还拥有出众的速度和意识，被誉为“顽强的防守者”。

gratified.zh: 我们满足了朋友的好奇心。
收到他们的邀请，我感到很高兴。

gratified.en: Mr. Dambar was gratified by his response.
gratified.zh: 他的答复使丹巴尔先生感到满意。

statuesque.zh: 她有着一头深褐色头发，身材高挑挺拔。

statuesque.en: A statuesque female avatar walks up, standing over him.
statuesque.zh: 一个身材优雅的女性阿凡达走过来，站在他旁边。

statuesque.en: So we try to make them a little more perfect, a little more statuesque, if that's at all possible.
statuesque.zh: 所以，我们就试图令他们更完美，更优美典雅，尽我们所能。

teasingly.en: Hopefuls had until April 7 to apply for the "horrendous assignment" — as the company teasingly calls it — which starts mid-May.
teasingly.zh: 有望录取的夫妇要在4月7日之前申请“可怕的任务”——这是公司对指派任务戏谑的叫法——从五月中旬开始。

teasingly.en: Hopefuls have until April 7 to apply for the "horrendous assignment" -- as the company teasingly calls it -- which starts mid-May.
teasingly.zh: 这项“可怕的任务”——公司如此称呼——报名截止为4月7日，任务开始于五月中旬。

teasingly.en: He called her Artemis, Demeter, and other fanciful names half teasingly, which she did not like because she did not understand them.
teasingly.zh: 他用半开玩笑的口气叫她阿耳忒弥斯和德墨忒耳①，还叫她其他一些幻想中的名字，但是苔丝不喜欢，因为她听不懂。

collate.en: These sites collate publicly available information and present it in a user-friendly way.
collate.zh: 这些网站整理了所有公开资料，并以方便用户的形式将其呈现出来。

collate.en: The GACVS might collate such information, which should be evaluated and made widely available.
collate.zh: GACVS可负责整理此类信息，对其进行评估并使更多的人可以获得这些信息。

disconcert.en: Reporter: When they went to the farm, didn't he disconcert visitors by the way he named some of the animals?
disconcert.zh: 记者：他们去农场的时候，你爸爸有没有因为他给一些动物取名而让参观的人觉得为难？

disconcert.en: The two women looked on without uttering a word, without a gesture, without a look which could disconcert the Bishop.
disconcert.zh: 那两个妇人没有说一个字、做一个手势或露一点神气去阻扰主教，她们瞧着他行动。

interpose.en: What happens if you interpose a glass plate between two mirrors?
interpose.zh: 要是你把一个玻璃盘子插入两面镜子之间会发生什么？

interpose.en: Police had to interpose themselves between the two rival groups.
interpose.zh: 警方不得不介入这两个敌对的团体之间。

interpose.en: But how does it interpose and compel?
interpose.zh: 但是它是如何干预和强制的呢？

punctuality.en: They're very hot on punctuality at work.
He's becoming more and more obsessive about punctuality.
punctuality.zh: 他对守时要求越来越过分了。

disharmony.zh: 是什么原因让我们产生了不和协？

disharmony.en: Disharmony in your relationship may cause minor ailments.
disharmony.zh: 家庭关系不和协可能会引起些小麻烦。

disharmony.en: Even the wisest among you is only a disharmony and hybrid of plant and phantom.
disharmony.zh: 你们中间最聪明的，也仅是一个植物和鬼影的不调合物。

determinate.en: The difference between the measurements is independent of a constant determinate error.
determinate.zh: 测量之间的差异与恒定测定误差无关。

determinate.en: The direct reason of a rock project failure is rock failure. The determinate criterion is the limit allowable for change of its function.
determinate.zh: 岩石工程破坏的直接原因是工程周围岩石的破坏，确定标准是其使用功能允许改变的极限。

determinate.en: The subpixel localization is a key factor to determinate measurement accuracy in using CCD vision measurement system for measuring the size of precision part.
determinate.zh: 使用CCD成像的机器视觉系统进行精加工零件尺寸检测时，图像轮廓边缘的亚像素定位分析是决定测量精度的一个重要因素。

baleful.en: He turned toward the company; his gentle manner changed, and baleful lightnings began to play from his eyes.
baleful.zh: 他转向大家；他一改温和的态度，凶狠的闪电开始从他的眼睛里射出。

baleful.en: He now thinks this influence was baleful.
baleful.zh: 他现在认为这种影响是有害的。

baleful.en: But networks can also have baleful effects.
baleful.zh: 但是社交网络也会有有害的作用。

herdsman.en: A herd of horses is what the herdsman wants to have.
herdsman.zh: 这个牧人想拥有的是一群马。

herdsman.en: I am not to be a herdsman, I am not to be a grave-digger.
herdsman.zh: 我不做牧人，我不当仵作。

herdsman.en: As a rational being, each herdsman seeks to maximize his gain.
herdsman.zh: 作为理性人，每一个牧人都期望他的收益最大化。

introvert.en: If you're not an introvert yourself, you are surely raising, managing, married to, or coupled with one.
introvert.zh: 如果你自己不是一个内向的人，你肯定在养育、管理一个内向的人，或者和一个内向的人结了婚或在约会。

introvert.en: I have a problem. I'm an introvert.
introvert.zh: 我是一个内向的人，这对我来说是一个问题。
我就是一个性格内向的人。

crockery.en: In "To You, the Birdie!", the action was reconstructed around a badminton game, shuttlecocks landing on the ground like the sound of shattered crockery.
crockery.zh: 而在《致小鸟》中，所有情节都被重新组织在一场羽毛球比赛之中，球落地则象征陶器破碎的声音。

crockery.en: I called for the butler to clear up the broken crockery.
crockery.zh: 我叫来男管家清理摔碎的陶瓷。

crockery.en: I picked up crockery, put it on the tray.
crockery.zh: 我蹲下身子，捡起餐具碎片，放在托盘里。

inviolable.en: Yesterday's resolution says the present Polish border is "inviolable."
inviolable.zh: 昨天的决议说现有的波兰边界是“不可侵犯的。”

inviolable.en: The game had a single inviolable rule: obstacles were to be overcome, not circumvented.
inviolable.zh: 这个游戏有一个单一的不可违反的规则：困难是被克服的，不是被回避的。

pupa.en: When they reach full size, they attach to a leaf by their tail, and a pupa is formed.
pupa.zh: 当它们长到最大尺寸时，它们用尾部附着在树叶上，蛹就形成了。

pupa.en: During the pupa stage, they do not eat foods but do sit at the surface and breathe air through two small tubes.
pupa.zh: 在蛹阶段，它们不吃食物，但在水面游动时会靠两个细小的管道呼吸空气。

pupa.en: This stage (阶段) of a butterfly's life is known as the "pupa" stage.
pupa.zh: 蝴蝶生命中的这一阶段被称为“蛹”。

dissemble.en: Henry was not slow to dissemble when it served his purposes.
dissemble.zh: 形势一对他有利，亨利就马上开始隐瞒。
这意味着我们不需要任何掩饰。

dissemble.en: She tried to dissemble her disappointment with a joke.
dissemble.zh: 她用笑话掩盖她的失望。

abridge.en: I have to abridge my stay here.
abridge.zh: 我只得缩短在这里的逗留时间。

abridge.en: Book publisher may alter or abridge a work with the permission of the copyright owner.
abridge.zh: 图书出版者经版权拥有者许可，可以对作品修改或删节。

abridge.en: Under O. 3 r. 5 (1), the Court has power to extend or abridge the relevant time period.
abridge.zh: 高等法院第3号命令第5(1)条规则赋予法庭延展或缩短有关期限的权力。

polygon.en: Next, the team built a table of the segments of the polygon.
polygon.zh: 接下来，该团队构建了一个多边形片段表。

polygon.en: If the horizontal line drawn is aligned with a polygon vertex, then only the segments that are below the line are counted.
polygon.zh: 如果所绘制的水平线与一个多边形顶点对齐，那么只计算位于该线下方的部分。

polygon.en: Although the bounding box is a polygon defining the area represented for the user, I simplify and use one point of this data.
polygon.zh: 尽管这个边界框是一个用于定义表示用户的区域的多边形，但我简化并使用该数据的一个点。

fecund.en: The pampas are still among the most fecund lands in the world.
fecund.zh: 这片南美无树大草原仍然是世界上最为肥沃的地方。

fecund.en: It has now become clear how extraordinarily fecund a decade was the 1890s.
fecund.zh: 十九世纪九十年代被当今视为创造力旺盛的十年。

fecund.en: The most fecund men were those with partners six years younger.
fecund.zh: 那些伴侣小他们六岁的男性，孩子数量最多。

indolent.en: Once two indolent people in the seats next to theirs delayed them, and the newsreel started.
indolent.zh: 一次坐在他们旁边的两个懒人让他们耽搁了一会儿，新闻短片开始了。

indolent.en: He concluded ruefully that it was "arrogant and rash" to profess virtues that you cannot live up to, and retreated into indolent seclusion.
indolent.zh: 他懊悔地总结道，宣称自己信奉不能修行到的美德是非常“自傲和轻率的”。最终，他选择隐居，不理世事。

indolent.en: In a 1942 presentation at the New York Academy of Medicine, the scientists reported that after lobotomy, patients did sometimes become “indolent” or “outspoken.”
indolent.zh: 在1942年纽约医学专科学院的一个介绍会中，一些科学家提出，额叶切除术后，病人的确有时变得“懒惰”或“直言”。

unhindered.en: She had unhindered access to the files.
He was able to pass unhindered through several military checkpoints.
unhindered.zh: 他畅行无阻地通过了好几处军事检查站。

unhindered.en: His wish was fulfilled--the body rested, while the spirit went unhindered on its pilgrimage.
unhindered.zh: 他的愿望实现了——他的身体得到了休息，而他的灵魂则在遨游。

impoverish.en: We need to reduce the burden of taxes that impoverish the economy.
impoverish.zh: 我们需要减少使经济贫困的租税负担。

impoverish.en: These changes are likely to impoverish single-parent families even further.
impoverish.zh: 这些变革很可能使单亲家庭更加贫困。

impoverish.en: In losing our history, we lose part of ourselves and impoverish what is left.
impoverish.zh: 失去了我们的历史，我们自身的一部分将会失去，剩下的一部分也变得贫瘠。

matriculation.en: In secondary schools across South Africa, students are taking matriculation exams.
matriculation.zh: 南非全国各地的中学生正在参加大学入学考试。

matriculation.en: I'll go to college if I pass the Matriculation Exam.
matriculation.zh: 如果我通过了升学考试我将去上大学。

matriculation.en: Today is the first day of National Matriculation Test.
matriculation.zh: 今天是全国高考的第一天，全国数百万…

seahorse.en: His first and most celebrated underwater film is about the seahorse.
seahorse.zh: 他的第一部也是最著名的一部水下电影是关于海马的。

seahorse.en: Population data for most of the world's 35 seahorse species is sparse.
seahorse.zh: 世界上35种海马中大多数的种群数据都非常稀少。

seahorse.en: Ms. Scales recalls her first sighting of a wild seahorse as "like glimpsing a unicorn trotting through my garden".
seahorse.zh: 斯盖尔斯女士回忆起自己第一次看到野生海马的情景，就像“瞥见一只独角兽在我的花园里小跑”。

pumice.en: Beside a pumice isle in Baiae's bay.
pumice.zh: 就在巴亚海湾的一个浮石岛边。

pumice.en: Add only a little alcohol and pumice as you work.
pumice.zh: 每次只要加很少的酒精和浮石粉。

pumice.en: Pumice stones are used in the wash to create a worn look.
pumice.zh: 水洗时用浮岩石头会带来一种破旧的感觉。

coherently.en: Your response is scored on your ability to speak clearly and coherently, and on your ability to accurately convey information about the text and the transcript.
coherently.zh: 根据你清晰和连贯的表达能力，以及准确传达文本和文字信息的能力来对你的回答进行评分。

coherently.en: You should handle exceptions coherently throughout the application.
coherently.zh: 应该在整个应用程序中一致地处理异常。

coherently.en: No, you can't because we can perfectly coherently conceive of it not happening.
coherently.zh: 你并不能证明，因为我们能够非常清楚地有条理地想象出那并没有发生。

casualness.en: He was sure that the casualness of the gesture was deliberate.
casualness.zh: 他确信那似乎漫不经心的姿态是有意装出来的。
她故作轻松地做了自我介绍。

casualness.en: T-shirts, the epitome of American casualness, have moved upmarket.
casualness.zh: T恤，美国人的随意的标志，已提升至高档商品之列。

origination.en: The origination of the magma is related with the dehydration of the subducting plate of the Paleozoic Tethys Sea.
origination.zh: 岩浆的起源与古生代特提斯海俯冲板块的脱水有关。

origination.en: For example, an administrator should be able to change the rules that govern loan origination.
origination.zh: 例如，管理员应该能够更改控制贷款发放的规则。

origination.en: FlightList.xhtml: Shows available flights based on the selected destination and origination airports.
origination.zh: xhtml：根据所选择的目的机场和启程机场，显示可用的航班。

cress.en: After his project became popular, Cress took his findings on the road.
cress.zh: 在他的研究项目受到欢迎后，Cress 就把他的发现付诸实践。

cress.en: Cress started the project in his hometown Burlington, Vermont.
cress.zh: Cress 在他的家乡佛蒙特州的伯灵顿开始了这个项目。

cress.en: For the years that followed, Cress tried to spread his project across the United States.
cress.zh: 在接下来的几年里，克莱斯试图将他的项目推广到美国各地。

farmstead.en: A restaurant in the castle and a hotel in the farmstead.
farmstead.zh: 坐落在城堡里的餐厅和农舍的旅馆。

farmstead.en: Typologically, the house is close to the traditional farmstead in the Carpathians.
farmstead.zh: 该住宅在类型上接近喀尔巴阡山的传统农庄。

farmstead.en: A few days later, Clinton died Study of Heathcliff became thrush farmstead owners.
farmstead.zh: 几天后，林顿死去，希斯克利夫又成了画眉田庄的主人。

inextricable.en: Meetings are an inextricable part of business.
inextricable.zh: 会议是商业密不可分的一部分。

inextricable.en: Life is a mystery, an inextricable mystery for human society.
inextricable.zh: 生命是一个谜，是红尘中的人永远也解不开的谜。

inextricable.en: And then there is the inextricable link between energy and agriculture.
inextricable.zh: 能源与农业之间的联系是不可分的。

tenable.en: The old idea that this work was not suitable for women was no longer tenable.
tenable.zh: 认为这种工作不适合妇女的旧想法再也站不住脚了。
这种论点简直一点道理也没有。

tenable.en: The lectureship is tenable for a period of three years.
tenable.zh: 讲师这一职务任期三年。

enlightening.zh: 那次面谈让人很受启发。

enlightening.en: "Wu" means enlightening. "Kong" means emptiness, which is one of the most important understandings in Buddhism.
enlightening.zh: “悟”的意思是“启迪”。“空”的意思是“无”，这是佛学中最重要的一个认识。

touched.zh: 她的故事使我们大家深受感动。
他亲昵地碰了碰她的面颊。

touched.en: I touched him lightly on the arm.
touched.zh: 我轻轻碰了碰他的手臂。

perdition.en: And they shall become sons of perdition.
perdition.zh: 他们应成为儿子坠入万劫不复之地。

perdition.en: But woe to those who walk the path of perdition.
perdition.zh: 但那些走在毁灭道路的人将会悲痛。

perdition.en: The man trembled whenever he thought of the perdition.
perdition.zh: 这个人一想起死后的永久惩罚就颤抖不已。

diffuser.en: If they know what they're doing they'll probably use a diffuser as pictured.
diffuser.zh: 如果理发师知道他们的职责，他们可能会用图上的吹风机。

diffuser.en: A few drops of essential oils in your bath or in a diffuser will do the trick.
diffuser.zh: 在浴室或喷雾器里滴入几滴精油会起作用。

diffuser.en: It is not only the diffuser, it is just a different philosophy of designing the car.
diffuser.zh: 这不仅仅是一个扩散器，而是一部拥有另一种设计概念的赛车。

metallurgy.en: She loved metallurgy as I do, and she named one of her dogs Maggie, and one of her dogs Molly.
metallurgy.zh: 她像我一样喜欢冶金学，并且她给一只狗命名玛吉，另一只狗为莫丽。

metallurgy.en: Unlike in the Americas, where metallurgy was a very late and limited development, Africans had iron from a relatively early date.
metallurgy.zh: 美洲的冶金学发展非常晚，而且发展有限。与之不同的是，非洲人在更早的时候就有了铁。

metallurgy.en: I went to the University of Toronto and I studied chemical metallurgy.
metallurgy.zh: 上了多伦多大学，专业是化学冶金学。

profuse.en: Then the policeman recognized me, breaking into profuse apologies.
profuse.zh: 然后警察认出了我，开始一再道歉。

profuse.en: When a foreign object enters the eye, profuse tearing results.
profuse.zh: 当一个外物进入眼睛，就会不停流泪。

claret.en: This southwest region of France is the home of claret.
claret.zh: 法国西南部的这个地区是波尔多干红葡萄酒的产地。

claret.en: In Every Man His Own Butler, Cyrus Redding wrote "claret for a bishop, port for a rector, currant for a curate and gin for the clerk".
claret.zh: 在《人人都是大管家》一书中，葡萄酒商兼作者赛勒斯·雷丁写道：“干红葡萄酒配主教，波特酒配牧师，醋栗酒配助理牧师，杜松子酒配职员”。
红酒的酿造工艺更先进了。

quicksilver.en: For tips on cleaning up a broken CFL, see "Concerned About Quicksilver."
quicksilver.zh: 而关于清理破碎节能灯泡的小贴士，请参见“关于水银的知识”。

quicksilver.en: Quick as quicksilver to change, he was mercurial in nature and therefore unreliable.
quicksilver.zh: 变得像水银那样快，他天性善变，因此不可靠。

quicksilver.en: ELEMENTAL MERCURY: The "quicksilver" pictured here in a miner's hand is used to bond to gold in a slurry.
quicksilver.zh: 汞元素：画面中矿工手上的“水银”放入泥浆中用来和金结合。

dispiriting.en: Ironically after travelling nearly 50,000 kilometres, his view was clouded out at the last moment, a very dispiriting experience.
dispiriting.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，他的视野在在行进了近5万公里后的最后一刻变得模糊起来，是非常令人沮丧的经历。

dispiriting.en: It's very dispiriting for anyone to be out of a job.
dispiriting.zh: 对每个人来说，没有工作都令人沮丧。
这是个令人沮丧的过程。

landform.en: The difference is mainly in the tone not in the drainage pattern or landform.
landform.zh: 所不同的主要在色调，而不在于水系型式或地形。

landform.en: Coastal landform is changeful, much cliff, have extensive bay and beach again.
landform.zh: 海岸地形多变，多悬崖峭壁，又有辽阔的海湾与沙滩。

landform.en: The quickly achieving battlefield landform information is based on digital Photogrammetry.
landform.zh: 战场地形信息基于数字摄影测量快速获取。

beastly.zh: “约翰，”他说，打了个寒颤，“这是最恶心的东西。”
当我们受到伤害时，我们的行为都很野蛮。

outsell.en: The team's products easily outsell those of other American baseball teams overseas.
outsell.zh: 该队的产品在海外轻松卖过美国其他棒球队的产品。

outsell.en: We outsell them by two to one.
outsell.zh: 他说:“我们的软件销售量可是苹果的两倍.”

outsell.en: Collectively, those phones now outsell the iPhone.
outsell.zh: 总的来说，那些手机的销量目前超越iPhone。

cumulus.en: How much does the water in a cumulus cloud weigh?
cumulus.zh: 一朵积雨云所含的水有多重呢？

cumulus.en: Small white cumulus clouds obscure some parts of the island.
cumulus.zh: 图中白色的小积云遮住了小岛的一些地方。

cumulus.en: Cumulonimbus, along with cumulus, are the most dramatic types of cloud.
cumulus.zh: 积雨云和积云是云中最神奇的类型。

tillage.en: The researchers say tillage makes soil less resistant to being broken apart by raindrops than plowed soil.
tillage.zh: 研究者称，保护性耕作的土壤比传统耕作土壤更易渗入雨水。

tillage.en: More use of conservation tillage can assure that available water reaches the plants in drought-prone, rainfed areas.
tillage.zh: 如果更多地采用保墒耕作方式，可以保证可用水资源为干旱频发和雨浇地区的农作物所用。

tillage.en: Another recent study found that a single tillage does not harm yield or soil structure in land that is normally not tilled.
tillage.zh: 另一项最新研究发现，单独一次耕作不会对通常不耕作的土地产量或土壤结构造成破坏。

stereoscopic.en: Holograms have many advantages over stereoscopic images.
stereoscopic.zh: 与传统图像相比，全息图像有很多优点。

stereoscopic.en: Avatar shows us exactly what stereoscopic cinema is capable of.
stereoscopic.zh: 《阿凡达》向我们完完全全地展示了立体电影能做什么。

stereoscopic.en: The DCP format is also used to store stereoscopic (3d) contents.

avow.en: But whatever the danger, Christ's followers must avow their principles.
avow.zh: 但不论遭何危险，跟从基督的人必须承认自己的信仰。

avow.en: The senator was forced to avow openly that he had received some money from that company.
avow.zh: 那个参议员被迫承认曾经收过那家公司的一些钱。

avow.en: But this fear is counterbalanced by new realizations at work and with my friends, in which I am able to frankly avow that I have a disability.
avow.zh: 但是这种害怕被我在工作中和与朋友相处中的新认识抵消了。在其中，我能够坦率地承认我有疾病。

choosy.zh: 我对自己的衣着很讲究。

choosy.en: Skiers should be particularly choosy about the insurance policy they buy.
choosy.zh: 滑雪者在购买保险的问题上应特别谨慎。

choosy.en: Donor countries are becoming more choosy about which countries they are prepared to help.
choosy.zh: 捐赠国对受赠国的选择变得更加慎重了。

megacity.en: It is also the seventh largest city proper in the world, a megacity.
megacity.zh: 它也是世界第七大城市。

megacity.en: A world city is a city with a global impact – and thus not necessarily synonymous with a megacity .
megacity.zh: 世界级城市是一个有着全球影响力的城市——因此它的意义与 超级城市 (Megacity)并不相同。

megacity.en: In the competition between the megacity and the holy city, Upadhyay says, "Delhi is winning, of course."
megacity.zh: 大城市和圣城的的较量中，阿帕德·海耶说：“当然是德里赢了。”

truant.en: She was getting into trouble over playing truant from school.
truant.zh: 她由于逃学而遇到了麻烦。

truant.en: In his small studio on West 37th Street, Mr. Wu, wore a cardigan and a necktie and looked like a truant from a boarding school.
truant.zh: 在西第37号街他小小的工作室里，吴先生穿一件羊毛衫、带着一条领带，看上去好像从寄宿学校逃学的学生。

truant.en: I have been nothing but a truant and a vagabond.
truant.zh: 我一直只是个无用的流浪汉。

existent.en: The self is the only knowable existent.
existent.zh: 自我是唯一可知的存在物。

existent.en: This policy, they say, is at best confused and at worst non-existent.
existent.zh: 他们说这项政策说好听点是混乱不清，说不好听点就是根本不存在。

existent.en: Manners nowadays in metropolitan cities like London are practically non-existent.
existent.zh: 如今在如伦敦这样的大都市中，礼仪实际上是不存在的。

reflectivity.en: Figure 3 shows a sample base reflectivity image on a clear day in central North Carolina.
reflectivity.zh: 图3显示了北卡罗来纳州中部晴天的基本反射率图像样例。

reflectivity.en: The most commonly used form of radar energy return mapping is the Base Reflectivity graph.
reflectivity.zh: 最常用的雷达能量回程测绘形式是基本反射率图。

reflectivity.en: Do not include the radar base reflectivity image as it can make precise area location more difficult.
reflectivity.zh: 请勿包括雷达基本反射率图像，因为它可能会使精确定位地区变得更困难。

viciousness.en: Police were shocked by the viciousness of the assault.
viciousness.zh: 警方对这一攻击的残忍感到震惊。

viciousness.en: Your brutality arises not from viciousness, I think, but from fear.
viciousness.zh: 我认为，您的残酷并不是出于邪恶，而是害怕。

viciousness.en: It has scary viciousness in its eyes. It doesn't like you much at all.
viciousness.zh: 似乎对你有所警惕，眼神也比较可怕，一点也不亲密。

faithless.en: She decided to divorce her increasingly faithless and unreliable husband.
faithless.zh: 她决定要跟她那越来越不忠实也靠不住的丈夫离婚。

faithless.en: So receive me brother with your faithless kiss.
faithless.zh: 那么兄弟请用你不诚的吻来接纳我。

faithless.en: If you don't keep promise, you are a faithless person.
faithless.zh: 如果你没有守承诺，你是不可信的人。

hieroglyph.en: While perusing a book on the monuments of Egypt, she noticed a hieroglyph that showed a row of men standing in odd postures.
hieroglyph.zh: 在精读一本关于埃及遗迹的书时，她注意到一段象形文字，这个文字描绘了一排姿势古怪地站着的人。

hieroglyph.en: Whabout word does this hieroglyph refer to?
These stories, collected in a book entitled Hieroglyph, were just released two weeks before.
hieroglyph.zh: 这些小说都被收录在《象形文字》一书中，该书于两周前正式发行。

counterargument.en: Try to come up with a principled, compelling counterargument.
counterargument.zh: 尝试去形成一个有原则的，令人信服的反驳观点。

counterargument.en: Will you reject the counterargument and explain why it is mistaken?
counterargument.zh: 你能够驳斥相反的论点并说明为什么它是错误的吗？

counterargument.en: This paper is presented as a counterargument against the views of Professor Zhang Jinghao on translatology.
counterargument.zh: 本文试图就张经浩先生有关翻译学的观点提出商榷。

encumber.en: They can't encumber us on the road.
encumber.zh: 他们不会在路上拖累大家。

encumber.en: You shouldn’t let those heavy books encumber you.
encumber.zh: 你不该让这些沉重的书阻碍你学习。

concord.en: They expressed the hope that he would pursue a neutral and balanced policy for the sake of national concord.
concord.zh: 他们希望他能为国家的和谐而追求一种中立而平衡的政策。

concord.en: For instance, studies funded by Welch Foods—the brand behind Welch's 100% Grape Juice—found that drinking Concord grape juice daily may boost brain function.
concord.zh: 例如，韦尔奇食品公司（韦尔奇100%葡萄汁背后的品牌）资助的一项研究发现，每天饮用康科德葡萄汁可以促进大脑功能。

concord.en: Mike is graduating from Concord Academy High School and Rowan Kabbalah Community College at the same time.
concord.zh: 迈克即将同时从康科德学院高中和罗文卡巴拉社区大学毕业。

spineless.en: And you can laugh a spineless laugh.
spineless.zh: 你可以蔑视那些缺乏骨气的笑声。

spineless.en: Men dump women for being spineless, not "too nice, " expert says.
spineless.zh: 专家说，男人抛弃女人是因为她们没勇气，不是“太好”

surfing.zh: 夏威夷是冲浪运动的发源地。
他一生都在做与冲浪相关的事。

surfing.en: Surfing the Internet is fun, but it's also a time waster.
surfing.zh: 上网很有趣，但也是一件浪费时间的事。

extrusion.en: The process of forming a 3-D figure from a 2-D surface is called extrusion.
extrusion.zh: 从 2-D 平面形成 3-D 图形的过程称作挤压。

extrusion.en: The Face class contains two methods that perform extrusion: pushpull and followme.
extrusion.zh: Face 类包含两个执行挤压的方法：pushpull 和 followme。

shamble.en: Zombies shamble up the rows of the grid toward your house, and if they get past your defenses, well, you know.
shamble.zh: 僵尸们在网格的每一行向你的房子蹒跚而行，如果他们越过了你的防线，那么，你知道的。

shamble.en: Once again, as when we were small, we believe that magic can happen, that we can be different, that life is not just a predictable and frequently humiliating shamble towards the grave.
shamble.zh: 曾经，在我们小的时候我们相信这样的魔法会发生，我们能变得不同，生活不再是一切按部就班，我们不是踉踉跄跄的走向死亡。

diffident.en: John was as bouncy and ebullient as Helen was diffident and reserved.
diffident.zh: 约翰活泼、热情；而海伦却羞怯、矜持。

diffident.en: He was modest and diffident about his own success.
diffident.zh: 他很谦虚，不愿谈及自己的成功。

civilize.en: "I think it would civilize people a bit more if they had decent conditions."—"I think you've hit the nail on the head."
civilize.zh: “我认为如果人们有好的条件，就会使其更有教养一点。”—“我想你说到点子上了。”

gherkin.en: The glass-and-steel tower will be built next door to the Gherkin landmark—a pickled cuke-like structure built in 2004.
gherkin.zh: 这座由玻璃和钢铁建成的高塔将建在腌黄瓜地标旁边——一座建于2004年的腌黄瓜状建筑。

polysyllabic.en: Avoid overuse of abstract, polysyllabic words. Instead, use concrete language that your audience can visualize.
polysyllabic.zh: 避免过度使用抽象的，多音节的词。相反地，要用具体的语言来激发听众们的想象。

polysyllabic.zh: 缩略词通常指一个多音节的词扔掉一个或几个音节，然后变成的词语。

polysyllabic.en: About forty percent of the 224 polysyllabic conjunctions have not been included in the Chinese Dictionary (unabridged) by comparison.

armor.en: The new armor is not pure liquid, of course.

woolen.zh: 根据古代雅典的记载，每年雅典的年轻妇女都要合作织成一件新的羊毛长袍，用来装饰雅典娜女神的雕像。

abase.en: He would not abase himself by showing fear.
abase.zh: 他不愿露出惧色而有失身份。

abase.en: You can never abase a person for a little mistake.
abase.zh: 你永远不可以因为一个小小的错误而去贬低一个人的人格。

abase.zh: 因请求得到他人的邀请被拒绝而使自己的威望降低。

egomania.zh: 最近一些东德人退出该党，抱怨拉方丹“复仇心重”、“自大狂”。

profitless.en: Why should we spend so much time on the profitless matter?
profitless.zh: 我们为什么要花如此多的时间在这无益的事情上？

profitless.zh: 吸烟对健康是绝对有害无益的，理应全面禁止。

inclusively.en: This value should be an integer between 1 and 16384 inclusively.
inclusively.zh: 此值应为一个介于1和16384之间(含这两个数)的整数。

inclusively.en: So you should not remove it from your diet inclusively as the first step.
inclusively.zh: 所以，你不应该将其从您的饮食含作为计划的第一步。

inclusively.zh: 我获得0和89999之间的一个随机数，并且加上10000，以获得所需范围内的数字。

respire.en: Some products, such as asparagus, corn, and strawberries, respire at a higher rate than other products, such as apples, oranges, and potatoes.
respire.zh: 一些产品，如芦笋、玉米和草莓，比其他产品，如苹果、橘子和土豆的呼吸速率要高。

respire.zh: 一切生物只要活着都要呼吸。

eland.en: The common eland is pale brown, becoming blue-gray with age, and often marked with narrow, vertical white stripes.
eland.zh: 大角斑羚呈淡褐色，随年龄增长而变蓝灰色，常有垂直窄长的白色斑纹。

eland.en: The large and very heavy giant eland of forests and plains in western Africa looks more like an ox than an antelope.
eland.zh: 生活在非洲西部森林和平原上的非常笨重的大个儿大角斑羚羊，看起来不像羚羊，倒更像牛。

eland.en: Mashatu reserve has an impressive population of African elephant, eland and ostrich. the baobab trees are also plenty in the region.
eland.zh: 马沙图保护区有数量惊人的非洲象、大角斑羚和鸵鸟，还有很多猴面包树。

ruminant.en: When food is in short supply, a ruminant can last longer than a nonruminant because it can derive more energy out of the same food.
ruminant.zh: 当食物短缺时，反刍动物比非反刍动物寿命更长，因为反刍动物可以从同样的食物中获得更多的能量。

ruminant.en: The products of ruminant feed and cattle or sheep-derived feed from the enterprises and farms of 7 districts in Shaanxi province were detected by real-time PCR.

ruminant.zh: 本文综述了日粮纤维对非反刍动物肠黏膜形态和上皮细胞更新的影响及其作用机理和对动物消化功能的影响。

Chinese.zh: 日本和中国的许多茶都是绿茶。

sneaker.en: After three days without a winner, he X-rayed his sneaker out of boredom.
sneaker.zh: 在三天没有赢家的情况下，他无聊地用X光照起了自己的运动鞋。

sneaker.en: It resembles the kind of small sneaker store you might find in a low-end American mall.
sneaker.zh: 它类似于你可能在美国低端商场里找到的那种小型运动鞋商店。

sneaker.en: All of them, every sneaker, boot and sandal, every high heel and clog, every flip-flop. What do I do?
sneaker.zh: 所有的鞋，包括全部的球鞋、靴子、凉鞋，高跟鞋、木屐、人字拖……我该怎么办啊？

Easter.en: Most villagers took communion only at Easter.
Easter.zh: 大多数村民只在复活节的时候领受圣餐。

Easter.en: We're hoping to get away for a few days at Easter.
Easter.zh: 我们期待着复活节出去休几天假。

chive.en: Dried chive is available in all grocery stores.
chive.zh: 在杂货店可以买到干燥的细香葱。

chive.en: Green Asparagus Soup, Salmon Roe, Chive-Lemon Oil.
chive.zh: 绿芦笋汤， 三文鱼籽， 香葱柠檬油。

chive.en: The chive is the smallest member of the onion family.
chive.zh: 细香葱是洋葱家庭的一小成员。

lentil.en: He and Lentil kiss each other on the cheek.
lentil.zh: 他和兰缇互吻脸颊致意。

lentil.en: The guards saw you with Lentil. Up at the penthouse.
lentil.zh: 警卫看见了你和兰缇一起，上到顶楼。

oculist.en: He was not much of an oculist.
oculist.zh: 他并不是一个高明的眼科医生。

oculist.en: The oculist removed a foreign object from his eye.
oculist.zh: 眼科医生从他眼中除去一个异物。

oculist.en: If have eye ministry disease, through oculist cure also can cure.
oculist.zh: 如果有眼部疾病，通过眼科医生治疗也能治好。

Arabic.en: Flamenco has its roots in Arabic music.
Arabic.zh: 弗拉明科起源于阿拉伯音乐。

Arabic.en: Mombasa is a town with a beguiling Arabic flavour.
Arabic.zh: 蒙巴萨是一座迷人的阿拉伯风情的城市。

Arabic.en: He spoke abruptly, in barely comprehensible Arabic.
Arabic.zh: 他突然开始说话，说的是几乎没人能听懂的阿拉伯语。

Italian.en: Where is your Italian cannon? Get it up here!
Italian.zh: 你他娘的意大利炮呢，给我拉上来！
意大利鞋是无与伦比的。

Portuguese.en: Contemporary photographs are juxtaposed with a sixteenth century, copper Portuguese mirror.
Portuguese.zh: 把当代的照片与一面16世纪的葡萄牙铜镜摆放在一起。

Portuguese.en: Camping is a great way to meet the locals as the Portuguese themselves are enthusiastic campers.
Portuguese.zh: 野营是与当地居民接触的好途径，因为葡萄牙人本身就是热情的露营者。

Portuguese.en: I would love to speak Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Chinese, anything!
Portuguese.zh: 我想说意大利语、葡萄牙语、韩语、中文、任何语言！

Russian.en: He's got an O level in Russian.
Russian.zh: 他通过了俄语普通证书考试。

Russian.en: She spoke with a phoney Russian accent.
Russian.zh: 她用一种伪装的俄国腔调说话。
现代俄语字母表有31个字母。

enthrall.en: The sculptures enthrall tourists with their ingenious construction.
enthrall.zh: 这些雕塑以其精妙的设计使很多游客着迷。

enthrall.en: Except you enthrall me, never shall be free.
enthrall.zh: 倘若不被你奴役，我绝不会自由自在。

enthrall.en: The DSK scandal continued to enthrall France.
enthrall.zh: 法国上下继续关注卡恩丑闻。

Spanish.zh: 西班牙语已纳入课程内容。
西班牙语已纳入课程内容。

Spanish.en: Do you still keep up your Spanish?
Spanish.zh: 你还坚持说西班牙语吗？

underemployment.en: The figures for the growth of towns and cities represent proportional growth of unemployment and underemployment, a growth in the number of hopeless and despairing parents and starving children.
underemployment.zh: 城镇（人口）的增长数字意味着失业和未充分就业的情况成比例增长，绝望父母和挨饿孩子的人数也增长了。

underemployment.en: So the figures for the growth of towns and cities represent proportional growth of unemployment and underemployment, a growing in the number of hopeless and despairing parents and starving children.
underemployment.zh: 因此，城镇（人口）的增长数字意味着失业和未充分就业的情况成比例增长，以及绝望的父母和挨饿的孩子的人数增长。

underemployment.en: Her quip, written in 1962, was inspired by underemployment in South-East Asia.
underemployment.zh: 她在1962年写下了这句妙语，她当时是受东南亚各国失业率启发。

proceeding.en: Wait till I talk to Max before proceeding.
proceeding.zh: 等我和麦克斯谈过后再继续吧。

proceeding.en: On the way home from Vietnam, I found out that Chuck Ruff, my White House counsel during the impeachment proceeding, had died suddenly.
proceeding.zh: 从越南回家的途中，我得知，我在弹劾事件中的白宫法律顾问查克·拉夫突然辞世。

belonging.en: Language is a gift belonging to humans.
belonging.zh: 语言是属于人类的天赋。

belonging.en: Cultures give us a sense of belonging in society.
belonging.zh: 文化给我们一种社会归属感。

belonging.en: People who reach out to strangers feel a significantly greater sense of belonging.
belonging.zh: 向陌生人伸出援助之手的人能感受到更强烈的归属感。

congratulation.en: She flashed him a false smile of congratulation.
congratulation.zh: 她向他虚情假意地微微一笑表示祝贺。

congratulation.en: We have received many letters of congratulation.
congratulation.zh: 我们收到了许多祝贺信。

rigor.en: Schools acknowledge the rigor of European secondary training, and will give up to a year's credit to foreigners who have passed their high school exams.
rigor.zh: 学校承认欧洲中等教育制度的严格，并将给予那些通过了高中考试的外国学生额外的一年学分。

rigor.en: Some US schools acknowledge the rigor of European secondary training, and will give up to a year's credit to foreigners who have passed their high school exams.
rigor.zh: 一些美国学校认可严谨的欧洲中等教育，并将给予那些通过了高中考试的外国学生一年的学分。

clement.en: Lozano claimed that motorcycle driver Clement Lloyd was trying to run him down.
clement.zh: 洛扎诺声称摩托车手克莱门特•劳埃德当时正试图撞他。

clement.en: The land is fertile, the climate clement, water abundant.
clement.zh: 这里土地肥沃,气候宜人,水源充足。

clement.en: According to Clement of Alexandria, Matthew was a vegetarian.
clement.zh: 与亚历山大时期的克莱门特相应，马修是一个素食主义者。

clamor.en: In the earliest version, the gods destroy the human race because its clamor had been so disturbing to them.
clamor.zh: 在最早的版本中，众神毁灭了人类，因为人类的喧闹声对他们来说太令人烦躁了。
但这也许会招致一场喧嚣。

clamor.en: Then they would make a clamor, or throw in a burning plastic bag.
clamor.zh: 然后他们会大声嚷嚷，或者扔一个点着的塑料袋进去。

Jupiter.en: The planet Jupiter may have no solid surface at all.
Jupiter.zh: 木星表面可能根本就不是固体的。

Jupiter.en: It's not going to Jupiter. It's going to some other planetary system.
Jupiter.zh: 它不是去木星，而是去其他的星系。

shoal.en: The shark described a circle around the shoal of fish.
shoal.zh: 这条鲨鱼围绕着鱼群游动。

shoal.en: Merely observing a shoal does not make it clear which individuals lead and which follow.
shoal.zh: 仅仅只观察一个鱼群并不能清楚地区分哪些鱼群是领导，那些是随从。

shoal.en: Recent research had shown that fish recognised individual "shoal mates", social prestige and even tracked relationships.
shoal.zh: 最近的研究表明鱼可以识别各自的“鱼群伙伴”、社会威望，甚至相关的人际关系。

amenity.en: Maybe she hoped this little amenity would slow the growing inclination of women to stretch each haircut to last four months while nursing our hair back to whatever natural colour we long ago forgot.
amenity.zh: 也许她希望这个小小的便利能减缓女性不断增长的倾向，即把每次剪的头发延长到四个月，同时让我们的头发恢复到我们早已忘记的原本的颜色。

amenity.en: He immediately noticed the amenity of his new surroundings.
amenity.zh: 他立刻觉察到了新环境的宜人之处。

amenity.en: Development and natural resource amenity areas are often controversial.
amenity.zh: 自然资源开发与绿化，经常引起争议。

instalment.en: Martine puts it down to, among other things,soap operas and instalment plans introduced in the 1970s. Both played an important9 although indirect, role in lowering the birth rate.
instalment.zh: 玛蒂娜将其归因于20世纪70年代推出的肥皂剧和分期付款计划。尽管是间接的，两者在降低出生率方面都发挥了重要的作用。

instalment.en: The final instalment on the loan is due next week.
instalment.zh: 贷款的最后一期付款下个星期到期。

instalment.en: Upper-bracket taxpayers who elected to pay their tax increase in instalments must pay the third instalment by April 15.
instalment.zh: 选择分期支付增税的高额纳税人必须在4月15日之前交纳第3期税款。

confines.en: It is beyond the confines of human knowledge.
confines.zh: 这超出了人类的知识范围。

confines.en: It's an approach not dictated by the confines of conventional large scale agriculture led by international corporations.
confines.zh: 这种方法不受国际公司主导的传统大规模农业的限制。

confines.en: We live today indebted to McCardell, Cashin, Hawes, Wilkins, and Maxwell, and other women who liberated American fashion from the confines of Parisian design.
confines.zh: 我们有今天的生活，要感谢麦卡德尔、卡欣、豪斯、威尔金斯和麦克斯韦，以及其他将美国时尚从巴黎设计的限制中解放出来的女性。

appall.en: I used practically a whole bottle of red dye in the frosting, which in earlier days would appall me.
appall.zh: 我几乎用了一整瓶的红色染料来做糖霜，这在早些时候会让我感到害怕。

appall.en: Gandhi's Nonconformist ways tend to appall and alienate secular-minded observers.
appall.zh: 甘地不随主流的方法往往会吓跑和疏远那些有着世俗思想的旁观者。

appall.en: I can do something for 12 hours that would appall me if I had to keep it up for a lifetime.
appall.zh: 有些事情我只能坚持做十二个小时——要是让我坚持一辈子，我会恐惧不已。

Latin.zh: 现在学拉丁语的学生少得很。

Latin.en: Latin nouns have case, number and gender.
Latin.zh: 拉丁语名词有格、数和性。

Latin.en: Cuba was one of the least Catholic of the Latin countries.
Latin.zh: 古巴是拉丁语国家中最不信仰天主教的国家之一。

pants.en: Ted, did you poop in your pants?
pants.zh: 泰德，你是不是拉在裤子里了？

pants.en: Don't tell me you've split another pair of pants!
pants.zh: 你不会又把一条裤子撑破了吧！

pants.en: She described him as wearing brown corduroy pants and a white cotton shirt.
pants.zh: 她描述说他穿着棕色的灯芯绒长裤和一件白色的棉衬衫。

credentials.en: Why write a novel set in the future when your credentials are perfect for a historical novel?
credentials.zh: 既然您的资历很适合写历史小说，为什么还要写一部设定在未来的小说呢？

credentials.en: Shouldn't these graduates be rewarded for their education credentials and qualifications and not be treated "as cheap as cabbages"?
credentials.zh: 难道这些毕业生不应该因为他们的学历和资格证书而得到奖励，而不应该被认为是“廉价的卷心菜”呢？

gallon.en: This car does 30 miles to the gallon.
gallon.zh: 这辆汽车每加仑汽油可行驶30英里。

gallon.en: The average price for all grades of petrol at the pump was $3.49 a gallon.
gallon.zh: 加油泵所有等级的汽油平均价格为1加仑3.49美元。

gallon.en: The subsidy of 45 cents per gallon remains.
gallon.zh: 每加仑45美分的补贴仍然在存在。

quart.en: He stepped out to buy a quart of milk.
In a quart pitcher, dissolve the sugar and salt in the hot water.
quart.zh: 在一个夸脱罐里，将糖和盐溶解在热水中。

quart.en: Which has a higher boiling point, a quart of water or a gallon of water?
quart.zh: 1夸脱水和1加仑水，哪个有更高的沸点？

acre.en: 50 five-acre parcels have already been sold.
acre.zh: 五英亩一块的土地已经售出50块。

acre.en: He spent holidays at the 300-acre estate of his aunt and uncle.
acre.zh: 他在叔叔和婶婶的300英亩庄园里度过许多假日。

acre.en: There is about half an acre around the house.
acre.zh: 房子周围大约有半英亩地。

millimeter.en: These sections of rocks are dissected, using a laser, into slices a millimeter or less thick.
millimeter.zh: 采用激光将这些小岩石块切分成一毫米或更薄的薄片。

millimeter.en: It can make fine visual distinctions because it is blessed with one million cones per square millimeter in its retina.
millimeter.zh: 它的视网膜上每平方毫米有一百万个视锥细胞，所以它能分辨出很细微的视觉差别。

millimeter.en: Nanocrystals, also known as quantum dots, are semiconducting particles with a diameter of a few millionths of a millimeter.
millimeter.zh: 纳米晶体，也被称为量子点，是一种直径只有百万分之一毫米的半导体粒子。

watt.en: Two people who have divergent views on this question are George Watt and Bob Marr.
watt.zh: 在这个问题上意见相左的两个人是乔治·瓦特和鲍勃·马尔。

watt.en: His biographies of James Watt, Richard Arkwright and Josiah Wedgwood were held up as beacons to guide the working man through his difficult life.
watt.zh: 他写的关于詹姆斯·瓦特、理查德·阿克赖特和约西亚·韦奇伍德的传记被奉为是指引工人们度过艰难生活的灯塔。

watt.en: In the late 1700s James Watt designed an efficient and commercially viable steam engine that was soon applied to a variety of industrial uses as it became cheaper to use.
watt.zh: 18世纪晚期，詹姆斯·瓦特设计了一种高效的、商业上可行的蒸汽机，随着它的使用成本越来越低，它很快被应用于各种工业用途。

farther.en: We watched their ship moving gradually farther away.
farther.zh: 我们望着他们的船渐渐远去。

farther.en: Timber ran short, and it was necessary to procure it from farther and farther away.
farther.zh: 木材短缺，必须从越来越远的地方获得。

OK.zh: 摄影机准备好了吗？好，开拍！

ox.zh: 兄弟，我可以吃下一头牛！

penny.en: Unleaded petrol rose more than a penny a gallon.
penny.zh: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了一个多便士。

penny.en: The trip was expensive but it was worth every penny.
penny.zh: 这次旅行花费很大，但是花的每一分钱都不冤枉。

ton.en: They loaded about a ton of canned goods into the covered bed of a pickup truck.
ton.zh: 他们将约一吨重的罐装食品装到了小卡车的有篷拖斗里。

ton.en: The company throws off a ton of cash.
ton.zh: 这家公司甩掉一吨现金。

ton.en: The weight of this steel plate is one ton.
ton.zh: 这块钢板的重量是一吨。

stepchild.en: At first, online organizing was a stepchild within Obama's new-media operation.
stepchild.zh: 最初，在线组织只是奥巴马的新媒体计划中的一个“养子”。

stepchild.en: Egencia is the poor stepchild among the three, but indeed there is a huge potential up-side.
stepchild.zh: 易信达虽然是这三者中规模最小的，但是其潜力确实是不可小觑的。

stepchild.en: Compared to these database systems, the Apache Derby database may seem like the forgotten stepchild.
stepchild.zh: 与这些数据库系统相比，Apache Derby数据库就像是被遗忘的后娘生的孩子一样。

futurology.en: The way a good investor does really well is by engaging in successful futurology.
futurology.zh: 对未来成功的预测是一个好的投资人的取胜之道。

futurology.en: In "Idiocracy", he turns his talents to futurology.
futurology.zh: 在《白痴帝国》中，他将才华转向未来学。

futurology.en: Finally, this paper explains the application of futurology in the budgeting control.
futurology.zh: 文章最后简要说明了未来学在预算控制中的运用。

telecommunication.en: So far Huawei has grown into the world's largest telecommunication equipment supplier, selling in 170 countries.
telecommunication.zh: 迄今为止，华为已经成长为世界上最大的电信设备供应商，产品销往170个国家。

telecommunication.en: And the scarce has dealt the most severe blow to Chinese telecommunication operators.
telecommunication.zh: 这个短缺给中国电信运营商造成最严重的打击。

telecommunication.en: In the telecommunication industry, cell phone services are different from Internet services.
telecommunication.zh: 在电信行业，手机服务不同于互联网服务。

Marxism.en: There is a social analysis that he begins to be able to advance partly due to his reading in Marxism, in sociology.
Marxism.zh: 有一种社会分析表明，他开始能够进步的部分原因是他读了马克思主义和社会学。
马克思的这一错误认识，来源于。

Marxism.en: She is going to have the book on Marxism translated.
Marxism.zh: 她准备翻译马克思的书。

Canadian.zh: 我不是美国人，我是加拿大人。
他申请了在加拿大的居住权。
实际上我们不是美国人。我们是加拿大人。

eastwards.en: He sees that warm water flows back eastwards when winds that normally blow westwards weaken, or sometimes the other way round.
eastwards.zh: 他发现，当通常向西吹的风减弱时，温暖的海水就会向东流回，有时反之亦然。

eastwards.en: So Mr Pinault set his sights eastwards.
eastwards.zh: 所以皮诺先生又把他的视线转移到东部。

illogic.zh: 我同情那些没有逻辑的傻瓜。

illogic.en: From these paintings one can see the primitive order of values of these peoples, and the utilitarianism, chaos and illogic of their order of values.
illogic.zh: 从岩画中可以看出古代北方民族的原始价值观念，这种价值观念有功利性、混沌性、非逻辑性的特点。

deforest.en: The fires are likely to permanently deforest the land.
deforest.zh: 大火很可能永远地毁掉这片土地上的森林。

deforest.en: But when we arrived nobody knew we had to protect anything; we had to deforest.
deforest.zh: 但我们刚到这里的时候没有人想到我们要保护些什么；我们不得不伐林。

deforest.en: I would captivate them with money before telling them that we needed to deforest their land.
deforest.zh: 我会先用钱迷惑住他们，然后再告诉他们我们要采伐森林。

overachiever.en: The complete opposite to the lazy slob is the type a overachiever.
overachiever.zh: 跟懒散男完全相反的是工作狂男。

overachiever.en: The combination of arts and science is more likely to become overachiever.
overachiever.zh: 更有可能成为杰出者的是文理组合。

overachiever.en: This principle has gone far toward making Finland an educational overachiever.
overachiever.zh: 这一原则导致芬兰在教育方面取得出人意料的成功。

Neolithic.en: The technological knowledge needed to carve it was far superior to that for stamp seals, which had happened in the early Neolithic period.
Neolithic.zh: 雕刻它所需要的技术知识远远超过了新石器时代早期出现的印章。

Neolithic.en: It was about 5000 years ago, even before the first Egyptian pyramid that some amazing Neolithic monuments—tombs, were erected at various sites around Ireland, Great Britain and coastal islands nearby.
Neolithic.zh: 大约5000年前，甚至在第一个埃及金字塔建成之前，一些令人惊叹的新石器时代的遗迹——坟墓，就已经在爱尔兰、英国和附近的沿海岛屿的不同地方搭建起来了。

Neolithic.en: Long-handed Neolithic spoons of yew wood preserved in Alpine villages dating to 3000 B.C. have survived.
Neolithic.zh: 保存在阿尔卑斯山一带的村庄中的新石器时代的长柄紫杉木质勺子一直留存到现在，其历史可以追溯到公元前3000年。

superabundant.en: This paper mainly focuses on the study of the translational hull of superabundant semigroup.
superabundant.zh: 本文主要研究超富足半群的平移壳问题。

superabundant.en: The additions of superabundant emulsifier agent to emulsions have no obvious effects on droplet size and distribution of dispersion phase.
superabundant.zh: 过分地增加乳化剂含量对分散相液滴大小与分布也没有明显作用。

superabundant.en: Facing with the superabundant foreign exchange reserve, how to manage effectively is an important problem which we are confronted with now.
superabundant.zh: 面对规模偏多且增速较快的外汇储备，如何有效管理是当前我们面临的重要问题。

infrasonic.en: The frequencies used in sonar systems vary from infrasonic to ultrasonic.
infrasonic.zh: 声纳所使用的频率从次声到超声不等。
